description.en: One repository, three parts: a runtime injector for DSH plugin packages (inject, hot-reload, unload, promote a dev staging tool to the front, route self-heal, plus a settings-page plugin manager that lists, unloads and drags folders in to internalize), a task-aware reasoning-mode router agent preset (router-standard / router-spec / router-react), and a graded two-level task protocol whose six tools (commit_star, lock_stage, revise_do, edit_plan, mark_task, redteam_verdict) pin task state to disk. The injector implementation ships in-tree, so the install carries its own behaviour rather than a dependency list.
description.zh: 一个仓库三件套：DSH 插件包的运行时注入器（注入、热重载、卸载、开发侧挂区一键转正、路由自愈，外带设置页插件管理：列出、卸载、拖入文件夹内化）、任务感知的思维模式路由 agent 预设（router-standard / router-spec / router-react）、以及分级两级任务协议（commit_star / lock_stage / revise_do / edit_plan / mark_task / redteam_verdict 六个工具，任务状态落盘）。注入器实现直接在库内，安装的是它自己的行为而不是一份依赖清单。

description.en: Give DeepSeek Harness a real office environment.  Univer Office Plugin brings spreadsheets, docs, slides, canvases, relational tables, and more into one runtime — with connected data, validation, versioned changes, and isolated worktrees for multi-agent collaboration.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造一个真正的办公环境。Univer Office 插件将电子表格、文档、幻灯片、画布、多维表格等汇聚到同一个运行时——数据互联、修改经过校验、变更按版本管理，并以隔离工作树支持多 Agent 协作。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 Android App 与安全远程访问插件，支持局域网/远程连接和高度自定义的移动界面与扩展能力。
description.zh: 通过 Android App 或手机浏览器访问 DeepSeek Harness，支持安全局域网连接、远程访问、持久设备配对和可自定义移动界面。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness browser plugin with persistent identities, per-profile cookies and passkeys, and optional residential proxy egress.
description.zh: 给智能体配上带身份指纹的浏览器，模拟安卓设备、伪装指纹，还能用本地无限配置文件，让网页自动化更隐蔽稳定。

description.en: Failure-recovery memory: search and record failure-recovery lessons from real engineering sessions, with BM25 + semantic RAG retrieval and a lessons knowledge base.
description.zh: 失败恢复记忆库：从真实工程会话中搜索和记录失败恢复教训，支持 BM25 + 语义 RAG 检索和知识库管理。

description.en: A research workbench for LaTeX compilation, arXiv management, experiment tracking, metrics charts, and SSH task orchestration.
description.zh: 科研工作台，支持 LaTeX 编译、arXiv 管理、实验追踪、指标图表和 SSH 任务编排。

description.en: DSH 插件：每天替你刷一轮 B站，读字幕挑出值得的、写一份日报，值得的 @ 你
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 自己刷 B站 —— 读字幕原文挑内容、写日报，遇到值得看的会发评论 @ 你。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Postiz over MCP: list connected social media channels, fetch per-platform posting rules, and schedule, draft, or publish posts to X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord, Slack, Telegram and more; adds a postiz workflow skill.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Postiz：列出已连接的社交媒体渠道、获取各平台发帖规则，并向 X、LinkedIn、Instagram、Facebook、Threads、TikTok、YouTube、Reddit、Bluesky、Mastodon、Discord、Slack、Telegram 等平台排期、存草稿或发布帖子；附带 postiz 工作流技能。

description.en: Codex-style `@file` mentions: search workspace files in the composer and attach their contents to prompts.
description.zh: Codex 风格的 `@file` 文件引用，输入框里直接搜索并引用工作区文件。

description.en: Local IMAP invoice download, OCR, archive, and Excel reimbursement summaries for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 IMAP 发票下载、OCR 识别、归档与 Excel 报销汇总。

description.en: Bundles an agentic AI sandbox matrix for orchestrated multi-environment workflows.
description.zh: 提供沙箱矩阵，用于编排多环境的自动化工作流。

description.en: Cost tracking for DeepSeek Harness: session and model costs, token usage, budgets, provider balances, and coding-plan quotas. Bilingual English/Chinese UI.
description.zh: 会话与当日 API 费用统计、预算图框（已用%）、官方余额、历史看板，支持峰谷计价与官方价格一键同步。

description.en: Use ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, and Grok (X Premium) subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers — OAuth login in the web UI, no API keys
description.zh: 把 ChatGPT（Codex）、Claude、Grok 订阅当作 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方：设置页登录、模型目录、用量展示，以及 image_generate、video_generate 与 x_search 工具。

description.en: Connect locally signed-in WorkBuddy models to DeepSeek Harness with a read-only credits overview and model management.
description.zh: 将本机登录的 WorkBuddy 模型接入 DSH，支持逐模型图片输入开关、账号切换，以及带每日签到的只读积分概览。

description.en: Facilitates integration between the DeepSeek Harness desktop app and its product, enabling feature bridging across packages.
description.zh: 桥接桌面应用与其产品功能，实现不同包之间的特性集成与协同。

description.en: Offers tools for creating and manipulating canvas-based visual content in the desktop workspace.
description.zh: 提供在桌面工作区创建和操作画布视觉内容的工具。

description.en: Enables model configuration inheritance across different sessions or projects in the desktop app.
description.zh: 支持在桌面应用的不同会话或项目间继承模型配置。

description.en: Provides tools for handling Office documents such as creating and editing files in the desktop app.
description.zh: 提供处理 Office 文档的工具，支持创建和编辑文件。

description.en: Offers project management tools for organizing files, tasks, and resources in the desktop workspace.
description.zh: 提供项目管理工具，用于组织桌面工作区的文件、任务和资源。

description.en: Provides structured UI components for building consistent and organized interface elements.
description.zh: 提供结构化 UI 组件，用于构建一致且有序的界面元素。

description.en: Facilitates IPC communication for work product hosting between different app processes.
description.zh: 促进应用不同进程间的工作产品托管 IPC 通信。

description.en: Manages work references and citations across sessions in the desktop application.
description.zh: 管理桌面应用中跨会话的工作引用和引用来源。

description.en: Desktop-native BigFish companion for DeepSeek Harness — real Agent status, always on top on Windows.
description.zh: A desktop-native BigFish companion driven by DeepSeek Harness session events.

description.en: Security guard for AI agents — blocks malicious skills, prevents data leaks, protects secrets. 24 detection rules, runtime action evaluation, trust registry.

humanizer-ru: редактура русского текста для AI-агентов. Убирает канцелярит и шаблонные обороты, сверяет смысл и факты. 67 признаков, 21 жёсткий запрет, сканер, CLI, MCP и расширение Chrome. \| Russian text editing for AI agents: removes bureaucratese and template phrasing, checks facts.
白箱AGI架构探索：元认知（自我认知循环）、持续学习（知识飞轮）、世界模型（条件空间+语义时空图）、自我改进（自举纪律）、零LLM白箱管线与可审计信任护栏。

description.en: A local-first personal knowledge layer for AI agents. Build evolving knowledge spaces with LLM Wiki, knowledge graphs, and agent workflows.
description.zh: Molio 本地知识库只读工具集：列知识库、浏览文件树、全文搜索、读取原文，经本机 Molio daemon HTTP API 取数（需 daemon 常驻运行）。npm 包名 dsh-plugin-molio，dsh plugin add 即装。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来「跨会话长期记忆 + 后台自我进化」能力的纯插件实现：五轨记忆 · git 分支感知 · 回合内自我审查 · 技能自我进化与技能管理器 · 四轨待办 · COI 调度 · 会话广播 · 会话搜索 · 提示词管理器 · 临时信息便签——零核心修改、零运行时依赖，随装随用、卸载即净。

description.zh: 将 Command Code 集成进 DSH 作为模型提供商，支持实时模型目录与推理强度。

description.en: 是一层高自由度的玻璃质感主题，套在 DeepSeek Harness 网页端。顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行、轨迹视图都成了磨砂玻璃片。玻璃模糊度、磨砂度、背景（流体或自定义壁纸，壁纸还能单独调模糊和磨砂）全都能在设置卡片里自由调节。关掉开关就回到原生界面，不改 DSH 任何一行源码。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 界面换上深海玻璃拟态主题，让头部、侧栏、输入框等组件都变得通透有质感。

description.en: 面向金融与产业研究的一屏式实时行情大屏：A股/港股/美股指数、大宗商品、美债收益率、板块热点、主力资金流、7×24 快讯、产业链自选股、AI 大模型 Token 追踪。A real-time market research cockpit on a single screen: CN/HK/US indices, commodities, treasury yields, sector hotspots, capital flows, 7×24 news, industry-chain watchlists and AI token usage trends.
description.zh: 零密钥行情数据 MCP server（dsh bundle）：5 个 MCP 工具覆盖 A股/港股/美股行情、板块排行、期货、资金流与 7×24 快讯，三层上游降级兜底。

description.en: Turn the whole interface into frosted glass
🌊 DeepSeek Harness 海洋皮肤与动态主题 | Real-time ocean theme with adjustable waves, sunset & glass opacity. DSH plugin + Chrome/Edge extension; keeps your new-tab homepage.
description.zh: 实时 WebGPU 海洋皮肤，可快捷调节波浪、日光、玻璃不透明度与自动昼夜循环。

description.en: Reviews code changes by analyzing diffs and providing feedback.
description.zh: 分析代码差异并审查变更，提供改进建议。

description.en: Creates and edits slide presentations with AI assistance.
description.zh: 利用 AI 辅助创建和编辑幻灯片演示文稿。

description.en: dsh-purge 的非官方分支（fork）：适配 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2、破甲内核 v3、设置页 UI 重做 / unofficial fork of YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge (MIT)

description.zh: 桌面宠物（QQ 宠物形态）：右下角悬浮、可拖拽/投喂/玩耍。

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 HarmonyOS NEXT 技能包、离线 API 参考及 DevEco、HDC 与模拟器自动化指南。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a live iOS Simulator — and a USB-connected iPhone — inside the conversation. 22 agent tools for booting, building, driving the UI by accessibility identity, OCR text or list rows, plus a streaming sidebar panel you can tap and drag on.
description.zh: 在对话里直接操作 iOS 模拟器或 USB 连接的 iPhone：22 个 Agent 工具用于启动、构建、按无障碍标识或 OCR 文本驱动 UI、列表行操作与 SwiftUI 预览热重载，并附带可点击拖拽的流式侧边栏面板。

description.en: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
description.zh: 将 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需 API Key。

description.zh: 本地 SQLite 任务板，以原生覆盖页呈现：项目、任务、评论、关联、附件与工作流自动化，状态流转 backlog → todo → in_progress → in_review → done；提供 `taskboard_*` Agent 工具（Agent 只能提交到 in_review，验收需人工）、无头 JSON CLI 与打包 skill。

description.en: A Fully free agentic browser driver for AI , few tools, full control, real stealth, top-tier token efficiency.
Community distribution: TUI, desktop, and Web UI as one bundle with layered installation.
description.zh: 社区发行版：TUI、桌面端与 Web UI 统一体验，分层安装、一步到位。

description.en: Extensible macOS DSH workbench with native PTY
description.zh: 可扩展的 macOS DSH 工作台（原生 PTY）

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 社区内置插件市场（dsh-plugin）— 搜索插件、下载并安装 10000+ 人工精选社区插件，每日更新、完全免费。内置在 Harness「设置 → 插件中心」，无需离开应用即可浏览、搜索、安装各类 AI 插件。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区内置插件市场（dsh-plugin）— 搜索插件、下载并安装 4000+ 人工精选社区插件，每日更新、完全免费。内置在 Harness「设置 → 插件中心」，无需离开应用即可浏览、搜索、安装各类 AI 插件。

description.en: Plays an intro full-frame on a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. Four clips ship inside the plugin itself — embedded in code, with no separate video files — and an in-app library switches between them, previews the choice, and accepts your own clip. The pin button sits beside Settings.
description.zh: 打开新对话、或每次打开你钉住的那个会话时，铺满窗口播放一段片头动画。插件自带四段片头，直接内嵌在代码里（不带独立的视频文件）；界面里的片库可切换、可预览，也能随时换成你自己的片子；设置旁一键钉住会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 表情包插件：输入框一键发图、文字 token 斗图、情绪主动发图、AI 自动学图，图库市场一键安装。 · Meme/sticker plugin for DeepSeek Harness: one-click picker in the composer, text-token memes, mood-driven sending, AI learns your images, marketplace packs.
description.zh: 聊天表情包：纯文本斗图、情绪主动发图、像 QQ/微信 一样发图、AI 自动学图、自定义表情包。

description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里直接生成可交互的可视化卡片，让模型输出的数据一看就懂。

description.zh: 在设置里管理本地 DSH 技能，并只读查看公共 Agent 技能。

description.zh: 把微信接进 DeepSeek Harness，让你在微信里直接遥控 AI 助手干活。

description.zh: 新增 deepseek-web provider，把 chat.deepseek.com 网页端模型接入 DSH：浏览器登录抓取、PoW 请求签名、SSE 流式传输与基于提示词的工具调用。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：把 ego-lite 浏览器（给 AI Agent 用的 Chromium）接入 HARNESS——13 个结构化 ego_* 工具（文本语义快照、语义定位点击、表单填充、截图、CDP 控制、任务空间隔离），内置 ego 运行时，Linux + Chrome 开箱即用，无需克隆官方仓库或手动构建。
description.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：把 ego-lite 浏览器（给 AI Agent 用的 Chromium）接入 HARNESS——13 个结构化 ego_* 工具（文本语义快照、语义定位点击、表单填充、截图、CDP 控制、任务空间隔离），内置 ego 运行时，Linux + Chrome 开箱即用，无需克隆官方仓库或手动构建。

description.zh: 为交易终端提供美国市场（US）的连接能力，支持美股等品种交易。

description.en: Enables trading connectivity for Chinese markets (CN), integrated with the agent-native trading terminal.
description.zh: 为交易终端提供中国市场（CN）的连接能力，支持A股等品种交易。

description.en: Enables trading connectivity for cryptocurrency markets, integrated with the agent-native trading terminal.
description.zh: 为交易终端提供加密货币市场的连接能力，支持币种行情与交易。

description.en: Provides a unified entry point for the trading terminal, offering a three-column GUI for multiple markets and hot-swappable connectors.
description.zh: 提供交易终端统一入口，以三栏界面整合多市场行情和可切换连接器。

description.en: Pixel-perfect clones of any webpage. Paste a URL, get a measured Vite + React replica.
description.zh: 粘贴网址，一键生成像素级还原的网页克隆副本，基于 Vite + React 并自动评分。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness bundle that adds structured decisions for choosing tools, skills, task owners, and output-quality checks.
description.zh: 给 AI Agent 加个结构化决策引擎，让任务判断和执行更靠谱，支持 DeepSeek Harness 等平台。

description.en: Import full-fidelity chat histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, opencode, and more) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export back to Claude Code.
description.zh: 把 13 家 coding agent（Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor、Gemini、opencode 等）的完整对话历史导入为可续聊的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并支持反向导出回 Claude Code。

description.en: Cross-session memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: seven-layer SQLite store (soul/user/project/fact/lesson/topic/rules), BM25 retrieval, per-window dream consolidation. 跨会话七层长期记忆插件。
description.zh: 项目级跨会话记忆：node:sqlite 七层存储（soul/user/project/fact/lesson/rules/topic），首条消息缓存友好注入 + 每条消息关键词命中，memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update/project 工具，空闲窗口自动整理记忆（dream，峰时抑制）。prompt 文案按语言数据文件加载——框架支持多语言用户。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness skin market 皮肤市场 已收录200+DSH 皮肤 完善评分系统加人工审核，有便捷的社区收录入口；有在线页面方便在线浏览，也有插件方便管理本地皮肤
description.zh: 原生皮肤市场与生命周期管理器，发现社区皮肤、展示预览与兼容状态，并提供已验证的一键安装或手动安装入口。

description.en: Replaces the kernel boot page with a full-window video clip that dissolves into the app; the clip pool, enter mode and fade length are configurable in Settings → Plugins.
description.zh: 用全窗口短片替换内核启动页，片尾交叉溶解进入界面；素材池、进入方式与淡入时长都能在「设置 → 插件」里调整。

description.en: 把你能白嫖的模型额度接进 DSH 同一个池：WorkBuddy 多账号自动容错、十三家扫码登录、76 家免费额度聚合、用量看板、模型路由、本地 OpenAI 网关、积分自动化。
description.zh: 把各家免费模型额度聚到一个池子里，多账号自动容错、扫码登录、用量看板加本地网关，白嫖不浪费。

description.en: 将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 里登录过的所有账号自动并入一个 DeepSeek Harness 模型池：无需任何手动配置，你在 WorkBuddy 桌面登录的每个账号都会成为一个池成员；某个账号被限流（429）时，请求会自动切换到下一个可用账号，实现多账号自动容错轮换。
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Use your ChatGPT Plus / Pro (Codex) subscription in DeepSeek Harness (DSH): GPT-6 & Codex models, images, web search and quota via ChatGPT sign-in — no OpenAI API key. Beta: control DSH from the ChatGPT mobile app. 在 DSH 中使用 ChatGPT 订阅，并可用 ChatGPT 手机 App 远程控制。
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 在 DSH 中使用 Codex 模型，提供订阅联网搜索、额度与安全重置、图片工具、高速模式和模型感知上下文；无需 API Key 或 Codex CLI。

description.en: Import full-fidelity conversation histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code / Codex / ChatGPT / Cursor / Gemini / Reasonix / opencode / ZCode / Grok Build / OpenClaw / Pi / Hermes / Kimi) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export/sync back to Claude Code.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 的 JSONL 对话记录（含工具调用和思考过程）导入成 DeepSeek Harness 会话，方便接着聊。

description.en: Multi-device remote access for DeepSeek Harness: continue an active session from your phone, tablet, browser, or another computer over an end-to-end encrypted channel (Noise IK + adaptive relay/WebRTC transport), with device authorization, ApiProxy-only remote capabilities, and read-only file preview via dsh-file-viewer — no shell, remote desktop, or write access.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多端远程访问：从手机、平板、浏览器或另一台电脑继续进行中的会话，端到端加密通道（Noise IK + 自适应 Relay/WebRTC 传输），设备授权管理；远程端仅开放 ApiProxy 能力，支持 dsh-file-viewer 只读文件预览，不提供 Shell、远程桌面或写入权限。

description.en: DSH适用的大肥鱼跑步思考强度滑块。Codex-style model and reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DSH 原生模型选择器加入大肥鱼思考强度滑块，按模型声明的档位调节推理强度，拖动时奔跑动画随之加速。

description.en: Adds an animated DeepSeek Chan reasoning-effort slider to DSH's native model selector, following model-declared levels with a running animation that speeds up while dragging.
description.zh: 为 DSH 原生模型选择器加入大肥鱼思考强度滑块，按模型声明的档位调节推理强度，拖动时奔跑动画随之加速。

description.en: Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool: multi-account rotation, 429 cooldowns, live credits, a model catalog with per-model credit multipliers and free/night-discount tags, QR-code login for 13 vendors, and aggregate free-tier channels. Accounts persist across restarts.
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 登录过的所有账号自动并入 DSH 模型池：多账号轮换自动容错、429 冷却、实时积分，模型目录按模型标注积分倍率与限时免费 / 夜间折扣，扫码登录 13 家厂商，聚合免费额度渠道。账号重启不丢。

description.en: Second-model auto-review on the approval answerer chain: a read-only reviewer subagent returns structured allow/deny verdicts with reasons, fail-closed by default.
description.zh: 审批链上的第二模型自动审查：只读审查子代理返回带理由的 allow/deny 结构化裁决，默认 fail-closed。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 破甲一体化安全分析插件：Android · Web · Native · Protocol · Malware · AI-Security 全领域聚合（9 bundle + 1 preset）
Office document preview, editing, and DOCX generation for DeepSeek Harness, powered by Fylar Office SDK.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接预览、编辑 Office 文档，还能生成 DOCX 文件，不用切换软件就能搞定。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) backup & restore plugin — export, import, migrate and sync your complete DSH configuration, plugins, MCP servers, skills and workspace. One-click migration to another machine.
description.zh: 一键备份、导出、导入与迁移整套 DSH 配置：设置、插件、MCP、技能与工作区。密钥默认不导出；若选择包含，则以 AES-256-GCM 加密而非明文写出。导入先预览、自动备份并可回滚，profile 可保存多套配置，远程同步经私有 Git 仓库推送可移植配置且不含密钥。

description.en: Office document preview, editing, and DOCX generation for DeepSeek Harness, powered by Bamboo Office SDK.
description.zh: 支持办公文档预览、编辑及DOCX生成，基于Bamboo Office SDK。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin: skill and MCP management（Web界面的skill/MCP管理工具）
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中管理技能与 MCP 服务器：技能卡片热启停、工作区作用域、分组、批量迁移与拖拽导入，以及 stdio/HTTP MCP 增删改查、连接测试、密钥脱敏，并附带统一 dsh-panel 命令行。

description.en: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.
description.zh: 会话内直接找插件：按关键词/分类搜索本精选 registry，返回描述与可直接执行的安装命令。

description.en: Agentic memory infra for AI agents
description.zh: 基于 SodaMem 守护进程的双时间轴记忆：每轮组装提示词时注入检索结果，回合结束后自动写回，读路径不经工具调用也不额外调用模型；每条召回的事实都标注来源回合并带有效期，失效的事实不再被检索到。

description.en: Pi Host ABI compatibility engine: after one install, unmodified Pi extensions from npm mount as native DSH plugins with `dsh plugin add <pi-package>`. Verified end to end on stock DSH with pi-mcp-adapter (full MCP manager: OAuth, resources, prompts, MCP Apps, elicitation, sampling), @tintinweb/pi-subagents, pi-code, pi-hermes-memory and pi-background-tasks; `pi2dsh inspect` reports a package's compatibility before installing.
description.zh: Pi Host ABI 兼容引擎：装一次之后，npm 上的 Pi 扩展原包经 `dsh plugin add <pi-package>` 直接作为 DSH 原生插件挂载。已在官方 DSH 上端到端验证 pi-mcp-adapter（完整 MCP 管理面：OAuth、resources、prompts、MCP Apps、elicitation、sampling）、@tintinweb/pi-subagents、pi-code、pi-hermes-memory、pi-background-tasks；`pi2dsh inspect` 在安装前报告一个包的兼容情况。

description.en: DBLP and arXiv literature search, BibTeX retrieval and full-text acquisition with session-owned background jobs; an EduWork-maintained fork of SihanLv/dsh-literature.
description.zh: 检索 DBLP 与 arXiv 文献、获取 BibTeX 和全文，支持归属当前会话的后台任务；由 EduWork 接续维护的 SihanLv/dsh-literature 分支。

description.en: Configurable OIDC login and token-authorized model access, including LiteLLM and opt-in oidc-llm integration, with a standalone DSH Web backend.
description.zh: 可配置的 OIDC 登录与令牌授权模型接入，支持 LiteLLM 和显式启用的 oidc-llm 集成，提供独立 DSH Web 后端。

description.en: A workspace-based Studio for source-grounded reports, slides, tables, mind maps, quizzes, flashcards, audio and video, using DSH models and shared artifact services. Office generation requires Python 3.12+ with its dependencies and DSH_OFFICE_PYTHON configured; media rendering requires Chromium, and local ASR additionally requires whisper.cpp and a model.
description.zh: 基于工作区资料的 Studio，复用 DSH 模型与共享成果服务，制作报告、演示文稿、表格、思维导图、测验、闪卡及音视频。Office 生成需 Python 3.12+ 及相关依赖，并配置 DSH_OFFICE_PYTHON；媒体渲染需 Chromium；本地语音转写另需 whisper.cpp 和模型。

description.en: Read-only IMAP search and attachments, plus SMTP sending under DSH permissions, with separate reading and sending switches and a credential-backed settings page.
description.zh: 通过只读 IMAP 检索邮件与获取附件，按 DSH 权限发送 SMTP 邮件，提供独立收发开关和接入凭据存储的设置页。

description.en: Local semantic memory and prior-chat retrieval with source references, editable memories, retention, forget controls, undo, and JSON import/export.
description.zh: 本地语义记忆与过往对话检索，保留来源引用，支持编辑、保留、遗忘、撤销及 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Bridges the Pi and DeepSeek Harness ecosystems, enabling unmodified Pi extensions to run as native DSH plugins.
description.zh: 打通 Pi 与 DeepSeek Harness 生态，让 Pi 扩展无需修改即可作为原生 DSH 插件运行。

description.en: Bridge the Pi and DeepSeek Harness ecosystems: one Pi Host ABI runs unmodified Pi extensions as native DSH plugins. 打通 Pi 与 DSH 生态。
description.zh: 让 Pi 生态的扩展无需修改就能直接跑在 DeepSeek Harness 上，轻松迁移插件、打通两个 AI 工具生态。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness roleplay bundle with SillyTavern migration, agent personas, and conversation workflow tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里跑原生角色扮演，角色直接当 Agent 行动，还能把 SillyTavern 的角色卡、世界书和预设搬过来用。

description.en: Let Your Ideas Flow — Tydora is a modern desktop Markdown editor combining WYSIWYG editing, bidirectional links, mind maps, and an infinite canvas — empowering deep thinking and effortless expression.
description.zh: 一款现代桌面 Markdown 编辑器，支持所见即所得、双向链接、思维导图和无限画布，帮你理清思路、轻松表达。

description.en: 让 QQ Bot 接入 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的官方插件
description.zh: QQ Bot IM channel plugin for deepseek-harness (dsh)

description.en: DSH Archive Manager — 在 DeepSeek Harness 中安全查看、恢复和管理已归档会话 · Safely view, restore, and manage archived sessions in DSH
description.zh: 在设置里增加已归档会话页，可按工作区搜索、恢复和删除已归档会话。

description.en: 🌟安装即自带mattpocock/skills v1.3.1的27个工程与效率技能，无需手动装技能。400亿token打造本插件，在原始技能之上提供10倍的开发效率，也能帮助新手更快上手该技能套件。全力支持GitHub issue；Markdown为预览版；GitLab暂不支持。感谢您的使用和支持🌹
description.zh: 安装即自带mattpocock/skills v1.3.1的27个工程与效率技能，无需手动装技能。400亿token打造本插件，在原始技能之上提供10倍的开发效率，也能帮助新手更快上手该技能套件。全力支持GitHub issue；Markdown为预览版；GitLab暂不支持。感谢您的使用和支持💗

description.en: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness with a content-addressed evidence ledger, versioned sealed reports where every claim carries a verification verdict and the manifest hash seals the directory, and retrieval orchestration that reuses the ctx.web and ctx.jobs seams.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可核查研究报告引擎：通过内容寻址的证据台账和版本化封存报告使每条结论携带核查结论，由 manifest 哈希封存目录，检索编排复用 ctx.web 与 ctx.jobs 接口。

description.en: 🚀 DeepSeek Harness 多通道远程访问与安全守护插件 | 局域网扫码直连、Cloudflare / 自建公网隧道、微信 / QQ / 飞书 / Telegram 机器人全生命周期对话 | 内置全协议访问安全认证、后台防篡改与容灾保命体系
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 远程与移动端接入插件：提供局域网扫码直连、Cloudflare 与自建公网隧道，以及微信、QQ、飞书、Telegram 机器人交互，内置安全认证与访问控制。

description.en: Industry and company research domain pack for DeepSeek Harness: methodology skills, industry chain mapping, public-source policy/news tracking, company research cards, and auditable research reports. Research only - not investment advice.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性行业研究报告：公司与行业研究流程基于分阶段证据产出结构化、可核验的报告。

description.en: Let the AI connect to databases and write SQL for you.
description.zh: 让 AI 帮你连数据库、写 SQL。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin integrating TypeSafe Jev as a System One decision layer for agent selection, supervision, corrections, and approvals.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Provides a Codex-style interface for interacting with DeepSeek Harness, enhancing the user experience.
description.zh: 用Codex的方式打开deepseek-harness

description.en: Pop-out sidebar: lists artifacts and a file tree with multiple preview formats, pops out into a separate browser tab you can drag to another monitor, and coexists with other sidebar plugins simultaneously.
description.zh: 可弹出式侧边栏：侧边栏展示产物与文件树，支持多种文件预览形式；并可弹出为独立浏览器标签页（可拖至另一显示器）；兼容其他sidebar插件，可以同时显示。

description.en: 把dsh会话界面切换成galgame游戏界面的插件
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面变成 Galgame 游戏视窗，支持立绘、对话框和场景编辑，让聊天更有代入感。

description.en: 专门为 agent 打造的开源 agent 搜索工具，具备 200+的搜索源及多语言搜索能力，覆盖中文/英文/学术/代码/购物/金融/新闻/百科。
description.zh: 面向 agent 的统一搜索与证据核验：120+ 引擎多语言路由，垂直域与结构化模态卡，10 个 MCP 工具与 wide_research 编排，fetch 核验回填证据分的证据闭环。

description.en: 将 DSH Web 默认的 Deep Diving.../深度求索中... 换成：1379 条梗 · 打字机特效 · 昼夜渐变 · 弹幕 · 5 套外观主题 · 四个鲸尾动作,14 个词库包可编辑 | Custom phrases, typewriter, day/night gradients, danmaku, themes & whale-tail motion for the DSH status line (1379 phrases, 14 packs).
description.zh: 把 dsh 回合状态行换成 1059 条中英文案的轮播：打字机输出、流动彩虹渐变、弹幕、12 个可开关的主题词库包、实时占位符与标签页标题轮换。两个 star 包默认关闭；星标者包每位星标者一条文案，由工作流每周刷新。

description.en: Search built for agents: multilingual coverage across web, academic, code, shopping, finance, news, and encyclopedias.
description.zh: 专为 agent 打造的搜索工具：多语言，覆盖中文/英文/学术/代码/购物/金融/新闻/百科。

description.en: DSH Codex UI — 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供 Codex 风格侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航 · A Codex-style sidebar, workspace session tree, global search, and turn navigation for DSH Web
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里还原 Codex 界面，侧边栏、工作区树和搜索都能用，操作更顺手。

description.en: A multilingual agent search tool covering Chinese, English, academic, code, shopping, finance, news, and encyclopedia.
description.zh: 多语言智能体搜索工具，覆盖中英、学术、代码、购物、金融、新闻和百科。

description.en: dsh-sd-bridge-guard插件已发布，可以帮你完善提示词，提高图片质量，并做到dsh无限制生图
AI-assisted local creator workbench for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把每条视频变成一个本地文件夹，从选题到发布一站式管理，AI 帮你搞定创作全流程。

description.en: 让 Agent 的工作方式可组合、可审查、可持续改进，最终实现 Agent Self Evoling。 DeepSeek Harness Web plugin with composable task controls and isolated, human-reviewed self-evolution.
description.zh: 提供常规执行、第一性原理提示、独立对抗审查三种任务模式。

description.en: DSH 预设编辑器插件, 支持一键破甲.
description.zh: DSH 预设编辑器插件, 支持一键破甲.

description.en: Provides a Codex-style user interface for chat interactions.
description.zh: 提供 Codex 风格的聊天交互界面。

description.en: Sidebar usage panel that attributes tokens to the relay site that served each request, read from your existing provider config: today/month/all-time totals, per-site and per-model breakdowns, a year activity heatmap, and New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek balances.
description.zh: 侧边栏用量面板：把 Token 归属到实际服务该请求的中转站，站点从已有的 provider 配置中读出，无需额外配置；含今日/本月/累计三窗口、按站点与模型下钻、一年活跃度热力图，以及 New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek 余额。

description.en: 88 installable open-source Agent Skills for research, social intelligence, marketing, and business workflows—compatible with Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 通过文件系统 Skill provider 将 88 个研究、社交情报、营销与商业 Agent Skills 挂载到 dsh。

description.en: Add Jev agent supervision, shared findings, interjections, and approval controls for DSH 0.1.7-rc.2.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中集成 TypeSafe Jev，用于技能与文件选择、任务监督、共享结论纠错、工具输出过滤、审批辅助和历史步骤阶段导航；所有功能默认禁用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Android — build, run, and interact with a live emulator or USB device stream inside a conversation, driven entirely through adb.
description.zh: 在对话里直接操作 Android 设备——模拟器或 USB 手机，完全通过 adb 驱动：20 个 Agent 工具用于流式投屏、Gradle 构建运行、UI 树或 OCR 交互、logcat、进程与内存检查，并附带三键导航面板。

description.en: Terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness with local VS Code JSON/JSONC theme import, inherited terminal background effects, mouse text selection, structured tool and diff views, Session/Profile/plugin management, and Skill/MCP browsers.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的终端工作区，支持导入本地 VS Code JSON／JSONC 主题、继承终端背景效果、鼠标文本选择、结构化工具与 Diff 视图、Session／Profile／插件管理，以及 Skill／MCP 浏览。

description.en: WebView2-based DSH launcher

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness kept as plain markdown, one fact per file, readable in any editor. The `MEMORY.md` index has a hard 200-line / 25 KB cap enforced by `ctx.tools.guard()`: a write that would grow an over-cap index is denied, while a rewrite that shrinks it always passes, so an oversized index can be compacted step by step. The plugin never writes memories on its own — what is kept is decided by you and the model. The same store is also used by Claude Code, Codex, Kiro and OpenClaw.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆，以纯 markdown 保存：一条事实一个文件，任何编辑器都能打开。索引 `MEMORY.md` 有 200 行 / 25KB 的硬上限，由 `ctx.tools.guard()` 强制执行——让已超限的索引继续变大的写入会被拒绝，而缩小它的重写一律放行，于是过大的索引可以一步步压缩下来。插件不会自行写入记忆，记什么由你和模型决定。同一个记忆库也被 Claude Code、Codex、Kiro、OpenClaw 使用。

description.en: Adds a strip above the composer that lists sent-but-unread (steering) text messages and recalls them before the model reads them, one by one or all at once.
description.zh: 在输入框上方列出已发送但模型尚未读取的插话消息，可在模型读取前逐条或一次性撤回。

description.en: Claude Code-style declarative permission rules: ordered allow/deny/ask YAML rules matching tool names, arguments, workspace paths, and agent identity on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, with full session-log audit, dry-run mode, and hot reload.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格的声明式权限规则：按序 allow/deny/ask 的 YAML 规则，在 tools/pre-execute 瀑布上匹配工具名、参数、工作区路径与 agent 身份，带完整会话日志审计、干跑模式与热重载。

description.en: Local-first MCP App for scientific figures. Import, review, and publish a global library on disk; reuse exact templates in Pi, DeepSeek Harness (dsh), Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Wisp.
description.zh: 把科研图表存到本地做成模板库，在 Claude、DSH、Cursor 等工具里直接复用，画图不用重来。

description.en: DSH RedTeam 模式：把 DeepSeek Harness 变成红队作战指挥台——一个靶标名称拉起信息收集/漏洞检测/漏洞利用/内网渗透四个角色，资产与战果实时落入本地 SQLite 事实库（仅供已授权测试）
description.zh: 红队作战模式：只发一个靶标单位名称，主会话指挥五个执行角色（信息收集/资产梳理/漏洞发现/漏洞利用/内网渗透）推进演练，并发数可配置；开工前先做技能与资源预检，缺 key 或 VPS 一次性向用户要齐；得分对齐《突破入侵类得分规则（合并版）》8 类 25 项，上限、权限取高、同服务去重均由服务端判定。发现落入本机 SQLite 事实库并带发现时间；右侧常驻控制台为 5 个分区 / 10 个页面（态势、资产、成果、报告、资源），跟随当前会话，包含资产测绘、智能体、会话隧道、漏洞战果、攻击链、得分目标、报告、按归类组织的 POC/EXP 知识库，以及逐条说明不可用原因的技能库。报告下载文件名使用靶标名，下载与页面同源，补齐动作、请求、凭据、隧道与攻击文件路径，并减少误报复现缺口。随包 16 个侦察/检测向技能（含 DeepSeek Search/Fetch 公开情报）、56 个 redteam_* 工具与一键自更新；攻击链技能仍作为独立工具箱 Release 附件。

description.en: Profile-wide DSH governance and routing with a Web Control Center for responsibility and evidence inspection, plus compaction, scoped semantic memory, safety continuity, and verified delivery; compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.1.
description.zh: 面向整个 DSH profile 的治理与路由 bundle，提供用于职责与证据检查的 Web Control Center，以及压缩、本地作用域语义记忆、安全连续性与真实验收；兼容 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。

description.en: Read-only Agent work-path observer for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 只读会话工作路径观察器：收起轮次看阶段数、执行数、耗时与 tok/s，展开看并行分支、工具结果与供应商可见推理。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that adds usage and cost views, custom instructions, font settings, a session overview, and desktop-pet skins.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 个人中心：跨会话用量统计、按模型成本估算、全局自定义指令、外观全局字号、数据驱动的桌面宠物（位图/矢量皮肤）与会话状态概览，纯本地离线运行。

description.en: Code-first React and TypeScript task apps rendered inline, in Canvas, full screen, or on localhost, with interaction state available to later agent turns and approval-gated MCP and API access.
description.zh: Code-first React + TypeScript 任务应用，支持 Inline、Canvas、全屏与 localhost；交互状态可供 Agent 后续轮次读取，MCP 和 API 访问在用户授权后执行。

description.en: Provides a local content and operations workbench for creators, streamlining content production workflows.
description.zh: Jacky Creator：面向内容创作者的 DeepSeek Harness 本地内容与运营工作台

description.en: Governs AI agent tasks by aligning goals, planning, orchestrating, and verifying delivery while managing risks.
description.zh: 治理 AI agent 任务，对齐目标与事实，规划调度并验证交付。

description.en: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness control of the Tabbit Browser: auto-loads the tabbit-browser skill on install, detects official Tabbit and Tabbit Browser releases (>= 1.9.0), checks the tabbit-cli persistent runtime, diagnoses the per-platform DSH sandbox mode needed to call the CLI, and downloads the region-matched official installer via a background job when no qualifying version is present.

description.zh: 将 DSH 会话中明确表达的经验整理为可审核的原生 Skill 草稿，并仅在用户确认后保存。

description.en: Codex-style workflow auto-collapse: finished turns fold into a single "processed in Xs" row leaving only the final answer; tool calls and think blocks collapse into live-summary chips that follow streaming; expand level by level, fully reversible on uninstall.
description.zh: Codex 风格工作流自动折叠：回合完成收成一行「已处理 X秒」只留最终正文，工具/思考块折叠成实时摘要 chip（运行中跟随流式滚动），逐级点击展开；卸载完整还原。

description.en: The DSH plugin-development knowledge base as an on-demand agent skill: official constraints, task workflows, API reference and community gotchas, installed with the bundle so the agent can look things up while building a plugin.
description.zh: DSH 插件开发知识库，作为按需加载的 agent 技能随 bundle 安装：官方约束、任务工作流、API 参考与社区踩坑，写插件时让 DSH 自己查。

description.en: In-app plugin store for the DSH Web UI: browse, search, one-click install, compat badges.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 内置插件商店：浏览、搜索、一键安装、兼容性徽章。

description.en: Shared multi-agent task board (create/claim/transition/query) over a Cordis service key.
description.zh: 多 agent 共享任务板：经 Cordis service key 创建/认领/流转/查询任务。

description.en: deepSeek 余额监控与用量统计（DSH 动态 Cordis 插件）：余额监控 · 官方充值入口 · 用量统计 · 三方插件管理
description.zh: deepSeek 余额监控与用量统计（DSH 动态 Cordis 插件）：余额监控 · 官方充值入口 · 用量统计 · 三方插件管理

description.en: Balance monitoring, usage statistics, and third-party plugin management in the DSH Web interface.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部的 DeepSeek 钱包余额：信用卡图标配余额数字，按剩余额度着色（≥ ¥2 绿色、¥0–2 黄色、≤ ¥0 红色），挂载时、每轮对话结束和点击时刷新；余额变动时带符号差额上飘淡出。

description.en: Cross-platform Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: virtual-mouse human-like operation (screen_observe + computer_click + type + key + scroll + drag, 11 tools), AX-tree zero-vision-cost mode with free GLM-4V-Flash vision fallback, safety guards (snapshot TTL / app whitelist / dangerous-action approval / password-box protection).
description.zh: 跨平台 Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作（screen_observe / computer_click / type / key / scroll / drag 共 11 个工具），AX 语义树零视觉成本 + GLM-4V-Flash 免费视觉兜底，安全护栏（快照 TTL / 应用白名单 / 危险操作审批 / 密码框保护）。

description.en: DSH notification & remote-control plane: one `notify()` API across 28 outbound channels, six inbound control channels, phone approvals/questions/task control, a Native DSH Notify & Control UI, live outbound hot-apply, multi-agent routing, and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 通知与远程操作控制面：一个 `notify()` API 接入 28 个出站渠道，六条入站控制通道承载手机审批、提问与任务控制；提供 DSH 原生「通知与控制」UI、出站热生效、多 agent 路由，并保持零运行时依赖。

description.en: Bring ChatGPT’s reasoning to your local codebase. Work directly, or delegate larger tasks to DSH.
description.zh: 将 ChatGPT 的推理能力引入本地代码库，支持直接或委派任务。

description.en: IM webhook and local notifications on turn completion, errors, or approval (Feishu/WeCom/DingTalk/Slack/Discord/custom).
description.zh: 回合完成、报错或待审批时发送 IM webhook 与本地通知（飞书/企业微信/钉钉/Slack/Discord/自定义）。

description.en: Provides a central hub for managing presets and configurations in the plugin suite.
description.zh: 为插件套件提供预设和配置的集中管理入口。

description.en: Export the append-only session log as human-readable Markdown or HTML, grouped by trajectory source.
description.zh: 将只追加的会话日志导出为可读的 Markdown 或 HTML，按轨迹来源分组。

description.en: A plugin that assists in building and scaffolding other DSH plugins.
description.zh: 辅助构建和脚手架其他 DSH 插件的插件。

description.en: Serves as a living plugin directory with hourly refresh, daily compatibility tests, an in-app store, and scaffolding tools.
description.zh: 提供实时插件目录，含小时刷新、每日兼容测试、内置商店和脚手架。

description.en: Orchestrates multiple agents with resource awareness for efficient task execution in Codex and DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在Codex和DeepSeek Harness中资源感知地编排多代理，高效执行任务。

description.en: Evidence-first deep reading for books, articles, PDFs, and document sets with claim-evidence reports, knowledge maps, recall questions, a Host tool, and an optional Web reading panel.
description.zh: 面向图书、文章、PDF 与文档集的证据优先精读工具，提供观点—证据报告、知识地图、回忆问题、Host 工具与可选 Web 阅读面板。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）远程 Web 启动 + 用户名/密码认证插件。 |  DeepSeek Harness Remote‑Web‑Launch Plugin with Username/Password Auth
description.zh: DSH远程Web启动插件，支持用户名密码认证。

description.en: Integrates coding agent CLIs, persistent terminals and remote workspaces into the native DeepSeek Harness interface.
description.zh: 将十几种编程助手 CLI、持久终端与远程工作区接入 DSH 原生界面。

description.en: Configure reasoning-effort levels and sub-agent defaults for custom DSH models.
description.zh: 为 DSH 自定义模型配置思考档位和子 agent 默认思考强度。

description.en: Terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar "Terminal" entry opens a multi-tab xterm.js interactive terminal over a real PTY (node-pty), with SSH remote tabs (ssh2, agent / key / password auth), a cwd following the current session, and tty_list / tty_capture / tty_send agent tools.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的终端面板：侧边栏「终端」打开多标签页 xterm.js 全交互终端（node-pty 真实 PTY），支持 ssh2 原生 SSH 远程标签页（agent/key/password 三种认证），cwd 跟随当前会话，并提供 tty_list / tty_capture / tty_send 三个 agent 工具。

description.en: Docker container panel for the DSH Web GUI: containers (optionally including stopped), docker inspect details, logs, stats snapshots, image list and one-shot exec on the local machine or SSH hosts — read-only by default (mutations and exec are permission-gated), with a per-container terminal drawer embedded via the tty plugin.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Docker 容器面板：本机或 SSH 主机上的容器列表（可选含已停止）、docker inspect 详情、日志、stats 快照、镜像列表与一次性 exec——默认只读（启停删与 exec 均需显式开启权限），可经 tty 插件在面板底部就地打开容器终端。

description.en: 深海鱼篓：不用 agent 登记，自动收进本场会话产出的文件——右侧栏预览、一键打包 zip、归档。Zero-registration deliverable basket for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 右侧栏「鱼篓」不用 agent 登记，自动汇总本场会话产出或改动的文件，支持预览、一键打包 zip 与归档。

description.en: Google Antigravity (agy) OAuth auth + model access plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multi-account pool, 429 rotation, device fingerprinting, CLI and web login.
description.zh: Google Antigravity (agy) OAuth auth + model access plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multi-account pool, 429 rotation, device fingerprinting, CLI and web login.

description.en: Code-graph integration for the DSH Web GUI: a "Codegraph" card in Settings → Plugins with index status, symbol search, callers / callees / impact views, and one-click sync / index; hosts the codegraph MCP server and injects a CodeGraph usage guideline into the system prompt. Requires the codegraph CLI.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Codegraph 集成：设置 → 插件 中的「Codegraph」卡片提供索引状态、符号搜索、callers/callees/impact 查看与一键 sync/index；托管 codegraph MCP 服务器，并向 system prompt 注入 Codegraph 使用指引。需安装 codegraph CLI。

description.en: MCP server configuration card for the DSH Web GUI: add / edit / enable / disable MCP servers over stdio (local subprocess) or streamable-http (remote), with js: prefixed expressions for env / header values, status badges, and hot-reload on save.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 MCP 服务器配置卡片：增删改查与启用/停用 MCP 服务器（stdio 本地子进程 / streamable-http 远程两种传输），env / headers 值支持 js: 前缀表达式，带状态徽标，保存即热生效。

description.en: Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback) and settings panels, highlights matches, and jumps to the matching session or settings card.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的全局搜索插件：侧边栏全局搜索框全文搜索历史会话（走 sessionQuery 全文索引，未启用时降级为逐会话扫描）与设置面板，关键词高亮，点击直达会话或对应设置卡片。

description.en: 🐋 DSH 鱼的记忆：给会话一份会淡忘的长期记忆，每条都带时间。名字里的「鱼」来自 DeepSeek 的鲸鱼。
description.zh: 按会话分开的长期记忆，会随时间变淡，按证据分召回、每轮注入几条到系统提示词里。

description.en: Ecosystem infrastructure: a thin browser console for managing official repository plugins (zero patches) plus a make-dsh-plugin skill for guided plugin development.
description.zh: 插件生态基建：浏览器面板管理官方 repository 插件（0 patch）+ make-dsh-plugin 插件开发引导技能。

description.en: Daily RSS/Atom news digest for DSH: built-in channels plus a curated awesome-rsshub-routes catalog and custom feeds (validated on save), aggregated into one "今日值得读" Markdown digest each day and injected into the system prompt; Web GUI settings card and sidebar reader.
description.zh: DSH 的 RSS/新闻聚合插件：内置渠道库 + awesome-rsshub-routes 精选订阅源目录 + 自定义源（保存时真实抓取校验），每天自动汇总成「今日值得读」Markdown 并注入 systemPrompt；带 Web 设置卡片与侧边栏阅读弹窗。

description.en: Profile management card for the DSH Web GUI: view, create (base / web / headless templates), copy, rename and delete DSH profiles under ~/.dsh/profiles, with per-profile port configuration and a copyable launch command.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Profile 管理卡片：可视化查看、创建（base / web / headless 三种模板）、复制、重命名与删除 ~/.dsh/profiles 下的 profile，支持逐 profile 端口配置并复制带 --port 的启动命令。

description.en: 为 better-sidebar 提供 Office 三件套预览（.docx/.xlsx/.pptx），独立 bundle 瘦身主体 | Provides Office-suite preview (.docx/.xlsx/.pptx) for better-sidebar as a separate bundle to slim the core
description.zh: 为 better-sidebar 插件添加 Office 文档预览，作为独立包分发。

description.en: Lark/Feishu bot channel for DeepSeek Harness: each chat drives its own agent, and tool approvals, model questions, and plan reviews return as cards answered by a button or a reply. Switch workspace and model from the chat (`/cd`, `/model`, `/new`), and run several bots that keep separate sessions and can hand turns to each other in one group.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 机器人渠道：每个会话驱动独立 agent，工具审批、模型提问与计划审阅都以卡片回到聊天，点按钮或直接回复即可作答；聊天里用 `/cd`、`/model`、`/new` 切工作区、换模型、重开会话，多个机器人各自独立并可在同群交接回合。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle registering one skill that turns long-form production (academic papers, industry analysis, business commentary) into a 9-role pipeline: T1 literature / T2 data / T3 case scouts running in parallel, T4 analyst, T5 writer, T6 critical companion, T7 auditor, T8 finalizer run by the coordinator, T9 peer reviewer — across 6 phases with triangular evidence verification, a 26-check M-gate (25 scripted checks plus one human checkpoint), a G0-G16 audit including a Chinese AI-trace gate, peer-review scoring with journal matching, and 4 human checkpoints. Installs with `dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` (package.json#dsh.bundle.patch plus a lib/index.js entry that registers the skill); ships role cards for T1-T9, templates and 36 zero-dependency verification scripts, with five-language READMEs.
description.zh: DSH bundle 技能包：把深度长文生产（学术论文 / 行业分析 / 商业评论）拆成 9 角色流水线——T1 文献 / T2 数据 / T3 案例三线并行检索、T4 分析、T5 写作、T6 批判伙伴、T7 审计、T8 终检（主控亲执行）、T9 同行评审，跨 6 个阶段，含三角验证、M 门 26 项终检（25 项机检 + 1 项人工）、G0-G16 独立审计（含中文 AI 痕迹闸）、审稿评分与期刊匹配，以及 4 个人在环节点。以 bundle 分发（`package.json#dsh.bundle.patch` + `lib/index.js` 入口注册技能），`dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` 即装；随包 T1-T9 角色卡、模板与 36 个零依赖校验脚本，README 五语。

description.en: Bundles Chinese traditional wisdom skills like Bazi, Ziwei, and Feng Shui with a deterministic engine and dashboard.
description.zh: 中华传统智慧（玄枢）AI Agent 技能包的 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Cordis 插件：八字/紫微/六爻/梅花/奇门/风水/五运六气/体质全融合，本地确定性引擎 + 可视化 Dashboard，一行 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: Mobile remote-control suite: bundle plugin with native sidebar entry and admin drawer, self-healing bearer-token gateway over LAN/Tailscale, Android app (sessions/approvals/questions/goals), /fs/* file transfer (Range resume, 2GB upload), latency-based multi-server auto-switch, offline chat cache.
description.zh: 移动远程控制套件：原生侧边栏入口 + 管理抽屉的 bundle 插件，自带 Bearer 令牌网关自愈（局域网/Tailscale）；Android App 覆盖会话/审批/提问/goal；/fs/* 文件端点（Range 断点续传、2GB 上传）；多服务器测速自动切换；聊天记录离线缓存。

description.en: Host page for kit plugin configuration in the DSH Web GUI: registers a "Plugin configuration" section in Settings — peer to the built-in General section — through the official settings.section slot and declares a settings.kit.item child slot, which dsh-plugin-kit plugins render their own config cards into. Installing it alone shows an empty page; cards appear as slot-registering kit plugins are installed.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中 kit 插件配置的宿主页：经官方 settings.section 扩展点在「设置」里注册一行与「通用设置」平级的「插件配置」页，并声明子 slot「settings.kit.item」，供 dsh-plugin-kit 各插件把自己的配置卡片渲染到该页。只装本包时该页显示「暂无可用配置项」，卡片随注册该 slot 的 kit 插件出现。

description.en: Floating DSH desktop pet with 12 authored state animations for requests, tools, compaction, archive and prompt enhancement; live context occupancy; a persistent cross-session Lifetime Ledger; per-provider/model totals, hourly trends and 7/30-day views; dark/light theme switching; optional cost estimates (off by default) with a visual price editor and monthly budget alert; client-side skin ZIP import; JSON/CSV usage export; snapshot-only panel reads with background incremental indexing; and opt-in prompt enhancement with editable preview and DSH composer submission.
description.zh: DSH 悬浮桌面用量小宠物：用 12 个正式状态动作反馈请求、工具、上下文压缩、归档和提示词增强，展示实时上下文占用、跨会话终身用量账本、服务商/模型统计、小时趋势与近 7/30 日视图；支持深色/浅色主题切换；可选成本估算（默认关闭）与可视化价格表、月预算告警；客户端皮肤 ZIP 导入；JSON/CSV 用量导出；通过纯快照面板读取和后台增量索引避免打开面板时扫描历史，并提供用户主动触发、可编辑预览和直接发送的提示词增强。

description.en: Adds a blue whale pet that idles and eats on your DSH interface, adding playful charm to the workspace.
description.zh: 在你的deepseek-harness上养一只吃白饭的大蓝鲸

description.en: 为明日方舟的长篇剧情打造的RAG类DSH插件，拥有多种快速检索能力。
description.zh: 为明日方舟的长篇剧情打造的RAG类DSH插件，拥有多种快速检索能力。

description.en: Double-check before you ship: grill the requirements, test the implementation, prove the delivery. An engineering-discipline bundle for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 工程纪律守门：动笔前审讯需求，红绿测试证据门，交付后对抗评审，并汇总交付报告与逐维度核对。

description.en: Multi-engine web search and evidence synthesis for AI coding agents. Unified MCP server, Pi extension, and DeepSeek Harness bundle — free search, X/Twitter, parallel research, and TUI setup.
description.zh: 给 AI 编程助手接上多引擎联网搜索，免费搜网页和 X，还能并行调研、汇总证据。

description.en: DSH plugin ecosystem (700+ plugins)
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的插件生态（700+ 插件）

description.en: Adds /review, /review-status, and /review-cancel to spawn an independent native subagent that inspects a chosen Git scope (base branch, uncommitted changes, a commit, or custom instructions) and returns a findings report in the current conversation, with English or Chinese output from the host locale.
description.zh: 提供 /review、/review-status 和 /review-cancel，用独立原生子 Agent 审查所选 Git 范围（基准分支、未提交更改、某次提交或自定义要求），并把发现报告返回当前会话；报告语言跟随宿主 locale，支持中英文。

description.en: A Remielle(ZZZ) desktop pet for the dsh web GUI that switches animated sticker moods with the harness work state.
description.zh: 蕾米埃尔(绝区零)桌宠：随 DSH 工作状态切换动画表情。

description.en: Data quality checking for DeepSeek Harness — profiling, cleaning, and verification pipelines with structured reports.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据质量检查：数据画像、清洗与验证流水线，产出结构化报告。

description.en: ACP profile plugin and standalone stdio server for using the full DSH agent from Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.
description.zh: ACP profile 插件与独立 stdio server，可从 Zed 等 ACP 客户端使用完整 DSH agent，并共享 DSH 凭据与会话。

description.en: Adds a sidebar question-asking tab to DeepSeek Harness, enabling Codex-style side questions or Claude Code's /btw feature.
description.zh: 一个基于DSH-better-sidebar的侧边栏提问tab，实现类codex的侧边提问或claude code的/btw功能

description.en: Lark/Feishu IM bot channel for DeepSeek Harness | 飞书 DeepSeek Harness （DSH）插件
description.zh: 把飞书/Lark 变成 DeepSeek Harness 的聊天入口，在群里直接和 AI 对话干活。

description.en: Lark/Feishu IM bot channel for DeepSeek Harness: chats drive agents, replies and approvals return as messages and cards | 飞书 DeepSeek Harne…
description.zh: Lark/Feishu IM bot channel for DeepSeek Harness: chats drive agents, replies and approvals return as messages and cards | 飞书 DeepSeek Harne…

description.en: dsh-plugin-kit is a general-purpose plugin collection for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: environment variable / secret management, MCP server configuration, Prompt management, Profile management, RSS / news aggregation, and a desktop client launcher。
description.zh: 提供环境变量、MCP 配置、提示词、配置文件、RSS 和启动器等工具集。

description.en: A general-purpose collection offering environment, MCP, prompt, and profile management tools.
description.zh: 通用工具集，提供环境、MCP、提示词和个人资料管理。

description.en: Manages environment variables and secrets for the DeepSeek Harness GUI.
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness GUI 的环境变量和密钥。

description.en: Provides prompt management and organization for users.
description.zh: 提供提示词的管理和组织功能。

description.en: Log query card for the DSH Web GUI over Elasticsearch / OpenSearch: one query surface with per-dialect query strings and clickable examples, field-name completion, filter chips, a time histogram whose bars zoom into that window, field facets that turn a bucket into a filter, and a result list with level colors, stack-continuation rows, columns and paging; Docker container logs are a collection source that reuses the docker plugin. Ships five read-only loglens_* tools (sources / search / fields / facets / context) sharing the same execution layer as the panel. Outbound requests only reach configured sources, judged on the resolved IP, without following redirects and with size and timeout caps.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的日志查询卡片（Elasticsearch / OpenSearch）：一个查询面——按来源方言给查询串与可点例子、字段名补全、筛选芯片、可点柱缩放时间窗的时间分布、把分组的桶点成筛选、带级别染色与堆栈续行标记的结果列表（可选列、可翻页）；Docker 容器日志作为采集来源复用 docker 插件。agent 侧五个只读 loglens_* 工具（sources / search / fields / facets / context）与面板共用同一执行层。出站只打到已配置的来源，按解析后的 IP 判定，不跟随重定向，并有体积与超时上限。

description.en: Plugin family for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: a pnpm monorepo with a plugin template, dev kit, and one-command all-in-one bundle — Codegraph, env & secrets, MCP config, profiles, prompts, RSS digest, global search, and terminal panel.
description.zh: DSH 插件全家桶：模板、开发套件加一键打包，帮你快速开发和管理 DSH 插件。

description.en: DSH Remote · 口袋里的 DSH 控制台 会话 · 审批 · 提问 · 文件传输，局域网 / Tailscale 直连 多服务器自动选优，聊天记录离线可看 带 Token 鉴权，数据只在你的设备之间流动 Sessions · approvals · questions · file transfer over LAN / Tailscale. Automatic fastest-server selection. Chat history available offline. Token-authenticated — your data flows only between your devices.
description.zh: 手机远程控制 DSH，随时审批、提问、传文件，局域网或 Tailscale 直连，数据只在设备间流动。

description.en: Provides a plugin template and development kit for building DeepSeek Harness plugins within a monorepo structure.

description.en: Puts the Markdown documents, source files, images and video that already exist anywhere in the session workspace into the DSH sidebar, ranked by relevance to the current conversation. The default lexical mode matches your recent messages against title, summary and body locally with IDF weighting (BM25) — no model calls, no network, nothing leaves the machine. The list comes from scanning the workspace rather than from a recent-files list, so restarting DSH or opening a new session does not empty it. Results are organised into a three-tier reading order (primary / supporting / related) with a verifiable reason on every row — which field matched, which document cites this one — and one click opens an in-place preview: Markdown as rendered text, relative-path images actually drawn, source code with the host's own syntax highlighting, video streamed over HTTP Range. The same Context Pack is exposed to the agent as a knit_docs tool. Later versions added read evidence and lifecycle tracking (attribution is frozen at the moment of reading), pin / exclude (exclusion applies before retrieval, and is undoable), relation evidence (references / imports / tests, with line numbers) and an incremental index reused across restarts. Since v0.23 there is also an optional hybrid mode: it is off by default and only runs once you configure an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embedding provider yourself. When it runs, what leaves the machine is your query text plus each candidate file's title and summary — a Markdown summary is an excerpt of the body's first paragraph (at most 60 characters), a code file's summary is its workspace-relative directory, and an image or video contributes its file name; full bodies and absolute paths are not sent, and a loopback provider keeps everything on this machine. Since v0.24 it also associates uncommitted changes: a read-only git status (fixed argv, no shell, whitelisted child-process environment) combined with the same reference / import / test / mention evidence shows which files a change is likely to drag along, and it is off by default. The benefit of semantic retrieval still awaits a real-provider run, so no recall improvement is claimed.
description.zh: 把会话工作区里已有的 Markdown 文档、源码、图片与视频列进 DSH 侧边栏，按与当前对话的相关性排序。默认的词法模式用最近几条消息在本地与标题、摘要、正文做带 IDF 加权的匹配（BM25）—— 不调用模型、没有网络出口，内容不出本机。列表来自工作区扫描，而不是「最近打开记录」，所以重启 DSH 或新开会话都不会变空。排序结果组织成主要 / 辅助 / 相关三层的阅读顺序，每一条都写明可核验的理由（命中了哪个字段、被哪一篇引用），点一行即可就地预览：Markdown 按渲染后的样子显示、相对路径图片真实渲染、源码走宿主自带的语法高亮、视频走 HTTP Range 流式播放。同一份 Context Pack 也作为 knit_docs 工具交给 agent。后续版本陆续补上读取证据与生命周期（归因在读那一刻冻结）、固定 / 排除（排除先于检索生效，且可恢复）、关系证据（引用 / 导入 / 测试，带行号）与增量索引（重启后复用）。v0.23 起还多一条可选的混合检索：默认关闭，只有你自己配好 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容的 embedding 服务才会生效。它生效时，发出去的是你这句查询原话加上每篇候选文件的标题与摘要 —— Markdown 的摘要取自正文首段（不超过 60 字），代码的摘要是它所在的工作区相对目录，图片 / 视频贡献的是文件名；完整正文与绝对路径都不发送，指向本机服务（loopback）时内容不出这台机器。v0.24 起还能做变更关联：用一条只读的 git status（固定 argv、不走 shell、子进程环境白名单），配合同一套引用 / 导入 / 测试 / 提及证据，指出这次改动大概率该一起看哪些文件 —— 默认关闭。语义检索的收益仍待真 provider 实测，因此不承诺召回提升。

description.en: Multi-source web search and fetch failover for DeepSeek Harness sessions: takes over the session searchProvider and fetchProvider seams and tries configured sources in a chosen order — TinyFish, Tavily and the official search as a fallback that always participates and can be repositioned but not removed. Multiple API keys per platform are spread round-robin, usage snapshots drive pre-flight exclusion of exhausted accounts, and per-request timeouts plus same-platform retry control failover granularity. Web fetching runs local HTTP first, then falls back to TinyFish Fetch server-side rendering and Tavily Extract, so pages still load when local egress is blocked by proxy or DNS policies. A per-platform panel shows key usage and plan limits. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-failover-search`.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供多来源网页搜索与抓取故障转移：接管会话的 searchProvider 与 fetchProvider 接缝，按可配置顺序尝试已配置来源——TinyFish、Tavily 与官方搜索，官方固定参与兜底、位置可调但不可移除。每平台可配多个 key 轮转分摊，基于用量快照做请求前账号排除，单请求超时与同平台重试控制转移粒度。网页抓取本地 HTTP 优先，失败后依次兜底 TinyFish Fetch 服务端渲染与 Tavily Extract，本机网络受限时代理或 DNS 拦不住页面抓取。插件页按平台展示各账号用量与套餐额度。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-failover-search`。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立的图像生成与编辑 Skill、工具和设置界面。

Runs Midscene on the models already configured in DeepSeek Harness instead of separate third-party API keys: hosts an OpenAI-compatible bridge on 127.0.0.1 (default port 8787, automatically skipping occupied ports) that proxies chat completions, streaming and non-streaming, to the DSH host model layer, so DeepSeek official routing, CodeBuddy, Codex and custom OpenAI/Anthropic endpoints all become available to Midscene agents while credentials stay inside the provider plugins and the bridge never touches them. A `/v1/midscene-env` endpoint generates the four MIDSCENE_MODEL_* environment lines with the model family inferred, and seven built-in skills — browser, desktop, Android, iOS and HarmonyOS automation plus a Vitest E2E skill and a Midscene knowledge reference — appear in the session skill catalog without `npx skills add`. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-midscene`.
description.zh: 让 Midscene 直接用 DeepSeek Harness 里已配置的模型，不再需要第三方模型 API Key：在 127.0.0.1 托管一个 OpenAI 兼容桥接服务（默认端口 8787，被占用时自动跳号），把流式与非流式的对话补全代理到 DSH 宿主模型层，DeepSeek 官方路由、CodeBuddy、Codex 与自定义 OpenAI/Anthropic 端点对 Midscene 全部可用；凭据留在各提供方插件内，桥不接触。`/v1/midscene-env` 端点直接生成四行 MIDSCENE_MODEL_* 环境变量并自动推断模型家族；浏览器、桌面、Android、iOS、鸿蒙自动化加 Vitest E2E 与 Midscene 知识参考共 7 个内置技能随装随用，无需 `npx skills add`。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-midscene`。

description.en: Windows plugin that swaps the host shell executor for Git for Windows bash across every agent mode, materializes Git Bash variants of the standard, minimal, PTC and Cordis presets (per-file sha256-marked, user edits preserved), and exposes a gitBash capability so companion presets pick Git Bash automatically; when dsh-better-sidebar is installed it also adopts that sidebar's terminal shell (UI tabs and the model-facing terminal_* tools) through its official settings seam.
description.zh: Windows 插件：将宿主 shell 执行器换成 Git for Windows bash（全部 Agent 模式生效），并物化标准/极简/PTC/创造四个 Git Bash 预设变体（逐文件 sha256 标记、用户修改保留）；发布 gitBash 能力服务，让配套预设自动选用 Git Bash；若装有 dsh-better-sidebar，还会通过对方官方设置补丁口把其终端（UI 标签与模型 terminal_* 工具）一并切到 Git Bash。

description.en: Automatically add emojis to AI replies.
description.zh: 为 AI 回复自动添加表情。

description.en: DSH productivity plugin: timeline navigation, prompt library, conversation export, quick notes, and more.
description.zh: DSH 效率插件：时间轴、提示词库、导出对话、闪记等提效功能。

description.en: Enhances the DeepSeek Harness interface with sticky fuzzy search for model selection, improving navigation speed.
description.zh: 为模型选择提供固定模糊搜索，提升界面导航速度。

description.en: Remote DeepSeek Harness with full server-side API access (`settings.*` / `credentials.*` / `host.listDirectory`). Token-gated reverse proxy, per-device sessions, phone invite QR, fence self-check, optional approval / CIDR / idle timeout / local TLS, WebSocket/SSE.
description.zh: 远程访问 DeepSeek Harness 且服务端 API 完整：转发时改写 Host/Origin，恢复其他方案必定 403 的 settings.* / credentials.* / host.listDirectory。令牌门、按设备会话、可选首访审批。

description.en: QA pipeline as 10 agent skills: requirement analysis, test strategy, case writing and review, E2E (Playwright) and API automation, exploratory, regression scope and bug analysis, backed by a shared knowledge base with format rules, risk model and schema validators.
description.zh: 软件测试全流程技能包：10 个技能覆盖需求分析、测试策略、用例编写与审查、E2E（Playwright）与 API 自动化、探索式测试、回归范围与 Bug 分析，共享知识库提供格式规范、风险模型与 Schema 校验脚本。

description.en: Keep branching from any completed answer at any depth while the main session stays untouched.
description.zh: 从任意层级的已完成回答持续创建隔离分支，主会话始终不受影响。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 破甲：让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model.
description.zh: 给各种模型一键换破甲提示词，按模型分别配置，默认提示词针对国模小码酱。

description.en: 🐋 鲸鱼娘桌宠 · Whale Girl Live2D —— DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 界面里的 Live2D 桌宠：跟着 agent 的真实状态换表情与动作，点一下就能直接跟 agent 说话，右键是钱包。A Live2D desktop pet for the DSH Web UI. 安装 Install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:Andersen216/dsh-whale-girl-live2d
description.zh: DSH 里的 Live2D 桌宠「鲸鱼娘」：模型常驻 Web 界面，跟着 agent 的真实状态换表情与动作（思考、调工具、逐字输出、报错、收工庆祝），点一下就能直接给 agent 发消息、回复逐字冒进气泡；右键菜单可换表情、戴眼镜贴纸、摆桌面场景、演一次性小动作，动作全部照模型作者自己的按键表设计，互不冲突、到点自动收回。模型素材非商业（CC BY-NC-SA 4.0），代码 MIT，作者 Andersen216。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web bundle for searching sessions, browsing full-text results, and inserting cross-session references into the composer.
description.zh: 会话工作台：全文搜索历史会话、一键 @引用 召回最多 3 个，并管理会话视图标签栏（显示/隐藏 + 拖拽排序）。

description.en: Read Hacker News feeds, comment trees, user profiles, and Algolia search results through DSH tools.
description.zh: 用于获取 Hacker News 榜单、讨论串、搜索和用户资料的工具。

description.en: Bottom Info Bar — an information bar plugin for DeepSeek Harness: provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and r…
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Customize the "deep diving" thinking status label to anything you like.
description.zh: 把鲸鱼娘思考时的 "deep diving" 状态文案自定义成任意你想要的样子。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 素材浏览插件：按工作区查看 MUSE AV 素材与出图记录，复制素材直链。DSH asset browser for MUSE AV workspaces, image libraries and generation history.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里按工作区浏览 MUSE AV 素材库和出图记录，点一下就能复制直链当垫图用。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI bundle that provides a government-style portal for sessions, models, permissions, and usage views.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的全部 Agent 能力搬进政务风办事大厅，独立端口打开就能用。

description.en: Academic writing guard (EN/ZH bilingual): removes AI-style defensive writing, protects scientific evidence (numbers, citations, claim strength, null findings, scope) during polishing, and calibrates writing toward a target journal (Journal Profile + Journal Fit). Deterministic local regex/statistics, zero network/LLM; writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile with auto-audit on paper writes.
description.zh: 论文写作守卫（中英双语）：去掉 AI 式防御性写作，润色时守住科学证据（数字/引用/主张强度/零结果/scope），并按目标期刊校准写作风格（Journal Profile + Journal Fit）。纯本地正则/统计，零网络零 LLM；提供 writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile，论文写入后自动审计。

description.en: SillyTavern preset mode, macro engine and editor for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接用 SillyTavern 预设，提示词管理、宏引擎和编辑器一站搞定。

description.en: Bloom Morandi theme: ten variants (mist, cinnabar, petal, ripple, sage, stone, lapis, amber, aurora, lavender) built on OKLCH so light and dark stay perceptually even, switchable from the top bar, with all 20 foreground/background pairs measured at WCAG AA or better.
description.zh: Bloom 莫兰迪主题：十款变体（黛蓝 mist、朱砂 cinnabar、桃夭 petal、天青 ripple、竹青 sage、赭石 stone、青金 lapis、琥珀 amber、落霞 aurora、青莲 lavender）基于 OKLCH 调色，明暗切换不跳变，顶栏一键切换，每套配色右侧标出处诗句，20 组「主色 + 底色」实测全部达到 WCAG AA。

description.en: Expose MineRU document parsing tools to the model.
description.zh: 向模型暴露 MineRU 文档解析工具。

description.en: 自动分类、收录和验证 DeepSeek-Harness 社区插件市场。 Automatically categorize, curate, and validate the DeepSeek-Harness community plugin marketplace.
description.zh: 自动分类、收录和验证 DeepSeek-Harness 社区插件市场。 Automatically categorize, curate, and validate the DeepSeek-Harness community plugin marketplace.

description.en: A DSH Web sidebar note panel for saving ideas, reminders, and TODO items to the local archive.
description.zh: 编辑框工具栏便签，随手记点子和 TODO，自动保存为 Markdown，一键发送到对话。

description.en: Compress completed model reasoning blocks into labeled thought nodes through the DSH streaming pipeline.
TapTap Maker integration for DeepSeek Harness: bundled MCP tools, Maker workflow and feature skills, plus a packaged CLI path for project initialization and diagnostics.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 TapTap Maker 集成：提供内置 MCP 工具、Maker 工作流与功能技能，以及用于项目初始化和诊断的随包 CLI 路径。

description.en: Multi-agent team collaboration for DeepSeek Harness with per-assistant models, skills, MCP servers, independent contexts, shared workspaces, task coordination, and conversation management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多 Agent 团队协作，支持助手独立模型、Skills、MCP 服务与上下文，以及共享工作区、任务协调和会话管理。

description.en: Remote control for dsh web from a phone browser, from anywhere (no public IP needed): hosted cloud relay works over 4G, or self-host the router; one command installs the desktop bridge and this in-harness Settings panel (cloud/self-hosted tabs, account login, bridge start/stop, feedback); the tunnel data plane is end-to-end encrypted (E2EE phone↔desktop, with a QR / one-time-link desktop grant so you never re-type the password), with HTTP/WebSocket pass-through, access-key auth, a live device list and optional traffic quotas.
description.zh: 手机浏览器远程控制 dsh web，人在哪都能用（免公网 IP）：官方托管中继 4G 即用，也可自建 relay；一条命令安装电脑端 bridge 与设置页「远程控制」面板（云端/自建切换、账号登录、bridge 启停、反馈）；隧道数据面端到端加密（E2EE：手机↔电脑端正文与 WS 内容加密，中继只见路由元数据；支持扫码/一次性链接桌面授权，免重复输密码）；HTTP/WebSocket 全量透传，访问密钥认证、实时设备列表、可选流量配额。

description.en: Let agents search, read, and cite your local Zotero library: find papers, browse notes and annotations, pull evidence by question, open the source document, generate citations.
description.zh: 让代理搜索、阅读并引用本地 Zotero 文献库，包括论文、笔记、注释与引用。

description.en: Your coding agents remember what you decided — and what you changed. Plain-Markdown memory in Obsidian, shared by Claude Code, Codex and Cursor over MCP. Every answer cites its page; when the vault does not know, it says so. Imports your past sessions on install.
description.zh: 给编程 AI 装个共享第二大脑，每晚自动整理 Obsidian 笔记，精准召回还能拒绝瞎编。

description.en: DSH 上下文注入审计插件：统计 AGENTS.md 指令链/技能目录/工具 schema 的 token 成本，检测重复与冲突；Web UI 圆环面板 + context_audit 工具。Context Doctor for DeepSeek Harness: audit instruction-chain / skill catalog / tool schemas token cost.
description.zh: 上下文注入审计：统计指令链/技能目录/工具 schema 的 token 成本，检测重复与冲突。

description.en: Local Obsidian vault as the agent knowledge store, with read-only DSH tools that route status, preference, correction, memory, project, search, and suggest to the matching page.
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 库当作 Agent 知识库，并用只读 DSH 工具把状态、偏好、纠错、记忆、项目、搜索与建议路由到对应页面。

description.en: Review agent file changes in a Diff panel, add comments for follow-up edits, and undo edited or newly created files.
description.zh: 在 Diff 面板中审查 Agent 的文件改动、添加评论以继续修改，并撤销已编辑或新建的文件。

description.en: Installs four multi-agent math-research presets for DSH: v2 (probability-driven pipeline with multi-verifier debate), v3 (paper-style Markdown knowledge base with a planner agent and a reusable method library), v4 (persistent self-organizing residents that message and meet), and v5 (a research institute with an academician who decomposes and assigns work, voting researchers, temp workers, group chat and a compare-and-set task board); all four support checkpoint resume, human intervention, and an optional Lean formal-verification switch (off/encourage/require) whose passing proof turns the vote into a fidelity check of the Lean statements.
description.zh: 为 DSH 安装四个多代理数学研究预设：v2（概率驱动流水线 + 多验证器辩论）、v3（论文式 Markdown 知识库 + 规划代理 + 可复用方法库）、v4（常驻自组织成员，靠留言与开会决定一切）、v5（研究所：院士拆解并分派任务、有表决权的研究员、临时工、群聊与 CAS 任务板）；四套均支持断点续跑、人工干预，以及可调档的 Lean 形式化验证（off/encourage/require，一旦跑通，表决转为对 Lean 陈述的忠实性核对）。

description.en: SSH ops terminal for DSH Web UI: drive a connected server from the main conversation (ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect) while keeping an interactive xterm.js terminal on the right.
description.zh: DSH SSH 运维终端：在主对话中直接指挥已连接的服务器（ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect），右侧保留可交互的 xterm.js 终端。

description.en: Claude Science-style research workbench: ReAct research-loop engine (research_* tools), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), and 10 science skills for genomics/pathogens/bioinformatics.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Claude Science 式科研工作台：ReAct 研究循环引擎（research_* 工具）、带溯源的版本化工件（artifact_* 工具）与面向基因组/病原体/生物信息的 10 个科研技能。

description.en: Recall any user message: rolls the conversation (official session fork) and workspace files (per-message shadow git snapshots) back to before it, with a diff-preview confirmation panel.
description.zh: 消息撤回：在用户消息旁加「撤回」按钮，把对话历史（官方会话 fork）与项目文件（逐消息影子 git 快照）一并回退到该消息发送之前，带差异预览确认面板。

description.en: Kimi no Na wa (Your Name) theme: cinematic wallpaper, comet-blue glassmorphism, movie logo swap and unified scrollbars for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 《你的名字。》主题：电影壁纸、彗星蓝玻璃拟态、电影 Logo 替换与统一滚动条。

description.en: Design-fidelity QA for text-only models: a `deepseek_vision` tool borrows an eye from any OpenAI-compatible vision route, so the model can judge whether an implementation matches its mock — shipped with the benchmark behind that judgement (four fixtures, 23 injected defects, raw transcripts) and the questioning discipline it depends on.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的设计稿保真判定：`deepseek_vision` 工具从任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉路由借来一只眼，让模型判断实现与设计稿是否一致——并附上支撑该判定的基准（4 组夹具、23 处注入缺陷、逐格原始输出）与其依赖的提问纪律。

description.en: Manages model tiers or routing for different AI models in scientific workflows.
description.zh: 在科学工作流中管理不同 AI 模型的层级或路由。

description.en: 催更姬：给大肥鱼一个小说工作台。写正文、理设定、画情节，和 AI 一起讨论、续写与改稿。
description.zh: 催更姬：DSH 小说写作工作台，支持章节编辑、共享剧情画布、人物与世界设定分组、写作预设和按范围导入导出，供作者与 AI 一起讨论和推进故事。

description.en: Claude Science-style research workbench: ReAct research-loop engine (research_*tools), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), and 10 science skills for genomics/pathogens/bioinformatics.
description.zh: 面向科研场景的智能工作台，支持循环研究、版本化数据追踪和基因组/病原体等生物信息分析。

description.en: Read RSS feeds, retrieve podcast transcripts, collect web links for rewrites, and discuss articles in native Harness conversations.
description.zh: 阅读 RSS、获取播客原文、收录网页并生成改写，在 Harness 原生对话中伴读。

description.en: Local Obsidian vault as the agent knowledge store, with read-only DSH tools that route status, preference, correction, memory, project, search, and suggest to the matching page.
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 库当作 Agent 知识库，并用只读 DSH 工具把状态、偏好、纠错、记忆、项目、搜索与建议路由到对应页面。

description.en: DSH 视频皮肤：聊天背景 + 有声开机动画 + 界面内透明度调节
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Whale-maid theme for DSH desktop and Web UI with light and dark palettes, ocean illustrations, hand-drawn frames, and a native Windows companion.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端与 Web UI 鲸鱼女仆主题，提供亮暗配色、海洋插画、手绘边框和 Windows 原生桌宠。

description.en: AI image and video generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image over per-channel model catalogs with per-family request shaping (gpt-image, Grok Imagine, Nano Banana, Seedream, GLM-Image, Qwen-Image, MiniMax image-01, DALL-E 3), a sidebar generation studio, an infinite canvas with node workflows, files preview and canvas skills, and a prompt template library; the video side adds text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-keyframe and multi-reference modes on an async submit/poll/download pipeline, host-side video tools, video nodes on the canvas, and clip stitching of two or more video nodes into one MP4 with the local ffmpeg.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 AI 生图与生视频插件：文生图/图生图按渠道配置模型目录，并按模型族适配请求协议（gpt-image、Grok Imagine、Nano Banana、Seedream、GLM-Image、Qwen-Image、MiniMax image-01、DALL-E 3），提供侧边栏生图工作台、带节点工作流的无限画布、文件预览与画布技能，以及提示词模板库；生视频侧含文生视频、图生视频、首尾帧与多参考图模式，走异步提交/轮询/下载链路，另有宿主侧视频工具、画布视频节点，并可用本机 ffmpeg 把两个以上视频节点拼接成一个 MP4。

description.en: Standalone workspace file-tree panel for the DSH web UI: a session-header icon opens an animated popup of the current workspace tree; click or drag a file to insert its reference into the composer, with search, inline preview, live settings, and zh/en i18n; single-purpose, zero-config, one-command install.
description.zh: 独立单功能的工作区文件树面板：会话头部图标打开当前工作区目录树的动画弹窗；点击或拖拽文件即可把引用插入输入框；自带搜索、行内预览、实时设置与中英双语；零配置，一条命令即装即用。

description.en: Rewind a DeepSeek Harness conversation and its workspace together without touching Git; every rewind is a fork and /redo reverses it.
description.zh: 同步回退 DeepSeek Harness 的对话与工作区，不碰 Git；每次回退都是一个 fork，/redo 可撤销。

description.en: An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question requests.
description.zh: DSH Web 页内宠物，提供多会话任务提醒，可打开任务、停止当前轮次，并处理受支持的审批和问答请求。

description.en: A Claude-persona desktop pet pinned to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI — shows balance, today's usage, peak/off-peak pricing and per-turn cost, with editable bubbles (text, balance, usage, pricing, images, random lines and weighted choices), per-line styles and fonts, a floating quick editor, sound effects, and custom character/audio. Ships animated roles that breathe and blink, plus a balance-alert variant that switches to a crying face when the balance falls below the alert line; 256/384 animation tiers and an optional 512 HD pack installed from the resource manager. 63 Claude-flavored lines. A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).
description.zh: 右下角的 Claude 拟人桌宠「小克」：显示余额、今日已用、峰谷定价与每轮消耗，泡泡内容可编辑（文本、余额、今日、峰谷、图片、随机语句与并列加权选择），支持逐行样式与字体、悬浮快捷编辑、音效与自定义角色/音效；内置会呼吸、会眨眼的动态角色，余额低于预警线时切换成哭脸，动图分 256/384 两档，并可在资源管理里安装 512 高清包；台词 63 条。二创自 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget（MIT）。

description.en: Voice AI girlfriend for the Web UI: FunASR mic input, Qwen3-TTS spoken replies, companion animation window, and two-way QQ chat (text/voice/image push) via NapCat.
description.zh: Web UI 语音 AI 女友：FunASR 麦克风语音输入、Qwen3-TTS 语音回复、数字人动画窗、QQ 双向聊天（文本/语音/图片推送，经 NapCat）。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness bundle that snapshots plugin and profile changes, guards boot, and rolls back failed installations.
description.zh: Install safety net for DeepSeek Harness: pre-install snapshots, one-click/automatic rollback, guarded boot, and incident reports that auto-trigger agent analysis. DeepSeek Harness 插件安装安全网：安装前自动快照、一键/自动回退、守护启动、事故报告自动触发 Agent 分析。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness bundle that provides a controlled exit command for completed or canceled tasks.

Controls your real Chrome from DSH over a local WebSocket bridge: tab management, navigation, DOM snapshots, page JS evaluation, clicks, typing, screenshots, waits and dialog handling behind a Settings toggle.
description.zh: 通过本地 WebSocket 桥接让 DSH 操控你的真实 Chrome：标签页管理、导航、DOM 快照、页面 JS 求值、点击输入、截图、等待与弹窗处理，默认关闭需在设置中开启。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Garmin Connect — AI-powered fitness data access
description.zh: 接入 Garmin Connect 健身数据，提供 AI 分析与集成。

description.en: Pins the model's reasoning language to a tier picked in Settings - General - Thinking language (Simplified Chinese, or a default tier that only constrains replies and leaves reasoning to the model), by injecting a system-prompt section at order -1000000 and re-hoisting it to first place at the end of the assemble waterfall, plus an optional per-turn copy placed ahead of each user message for models that follow static sections weakly.
description.zh: 把模型思考语言锁定为「设置 → 通用设置 → 思考语言」里选定的档位（简体中文，或只约束回复、把思考交还模型的默认英文），实现方式是以 order -1000000 注入 system prompt section，并在 assemble 瀑布末端把它重排到首位兜底；另可开启每轮前置同一指令的用户消息通道，用于对静态 section 服从弱的模型。

description.en: DirectorX as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: AI video/image/audio skills, knowledge corpus, and configurable vision/image/video/audio model tools.

description.en: UI enhancement suite for the DSH web client: Chinese locale completion, one-row stats, auto-expanded thinking, chat width, session archiving and delete, plus an optional prompt-injection switch (off by default).

description.en: A hand-drawn pixel whale companion for the DSH Web UI that reacts to agent activity.

description.en: Advanced per-model reasoning and capacity settings for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Web access for DSH agents: fetch JS-rendered or protected pages as clean markdown, aggregated search across 14 engines, and stateful interactive sessions (click, type, scroll, eval, screenshot) against a hosted or self-hosted Rust browser engine. Every session returns a live view URL so a human can watch the agent browse and take over with the mouse.

description.en: DFY 插件组合包：壁纸、外观、归档管理、媒体内容、图像生成、交互可视化、任务守卫和 Codex 连接。
Browses and manages user skills already on disk in DSH and supported agent home directories.
description.zh: 浏览和管理 DSH 及受支持 Agent 主目录中已有的用户技能。

description.en: Hash-anchored read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit tools: every line gets a unique 3-character content hash, edits target hashes instead of line numbers, and served-state verification rejects stale ranges with fresh anchors.
description.zh: 基于哈希锚定的 read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit 工具：每行分配唯一的 3 字符内容哈希，编辑按哈希而非行号定位；对已提供状态逐行校验，过期范围会被拒绝并回传新锚点。

description.en: Offers a trading research workbench with typed market data, deterministic indicators, and interactive chart cards, strictly for analysis.
description.zh: 提供交易研究工作台，含类型化市场数据、确定性指标和交互式图表卡片，仅供研究。

description.en: Tunnel-mode remote control for dsh web: the plugin adds an in-harness Settings panel (cloud/self-hosted mode tabs, account login, bridge start/stop, feedback) with same-origin /dsh-remote relay routes; the desktop bridge and self-hosted relay-router in this repo tunnel local dsh web to a phone browser as an installable PWA with access-key auth, live device list and optional traffic quotas.
description.zh: 隧道模式远程控制 dsh web：插件在设置页新增「远程控制」面板（云端/自建模式切换、账号登录、bridge 启停、反馈）并提供同源 /dsh-remote 路由；仓库自带的电脑端 bridge 与自托管 relay-router 构成隧道，把本地 dsh web 以可安装 PWA 形式开放到手机（访问密钥认证、实时设备列表、可选流量配额）。

description.en: 给 AI 伙伴一个会自己判断、你看得见的心情 —— 每轮聊完自动判断涨跌，右下角挂饰看数值、情绪和时间线
description.zh: 给 AI 伙伴一个每轮判定、以一小段上下文提示的心情，面板里能看心情值、情绪维度与时间线。

description.en: DSH 个人工作台：日历 + 任务列表 + AI 澄清/拆解/执行/复盘 | Personal workbench for DeepSeek Harness Web: calendar + task list + AI assistant

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的免费 Web Search / 网页抓取插件，支持 Tavily、Exa、Brave、百度、SearXNG 等多个引擎按可配置顺序自动 fallback

description.en: 可视化地自定义配置 Agent 的提示词（prompt）、工具（tools）、可见技能（skills）、子代理、备用模型，轻松创建团队。
description.zh: 可视化地自定义配置 Agent 的提示词、工具、可见技能、子代理与备用模型，把它们编成一支团队。不写宿主的任何预设文件。

description.en: Unified multi-provider web search and fetch: BYOK key pools, health monitoring, and deterministic fallback.

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web bundle for persistent agent teams with member memory, workspaces, channels, and task threads.
Add a startup animation with interactive authorization screens, sound effects, and configurable identity text.

Local-only project memory with zero bundled runtime dependencies or external services: JSON as the source of truth plus generated PROJECT_MEMORY.md, token-bounded session-frozen Hot Memory for prompt-prefix cache stability, cached cross-project BM25 recall, trusted session/turn provenance, explainable pre-write duplicate/conflict governance, editable importance/pin/tags/supersede/archive lifecycle, configurable top-level turn-end distillation, and a bilingual Web GUI for search, inspection, diagnostics, and live settings.
description.zh: 仅本地运行、零捆绑运行时依赖（仅使用 DSH 宿主 peer）且不调用外部服务的项目记忆：以 JSON 为单一事实源并自动生成 PROJECT_MEMORY.md、按 token 有界且按会话冻结的 Hot Memory 以保持 prompt-prefix cache 稳定、带查询缓存的跨项目 BM25 召回、可信 session/turn 溯源、可解释的写前重复/冲突治理、可编辑的重要度/置顶/标签/supersede/归档生命周期、可配置的顶层回合自动蒸馏，以及支持搜索、检查、诊断和实时设置的中英双语 Web GUI。

description.en: Manages archived DSH chats with conversation search, restore, and confirmed safe permanent deletion.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 归档聊天，支持聊天记录搜索、恢复和二次确认的安全永久删除。

description.en: Use locally authenticated Codex CLI and Claude Code accounts as DSH model providers.

description.zh: AI4Scholar 学术检索：覆盖 Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Google Scholar、arXiv、bioRxiv/medRxiv 与 DOI 解析的 38 个工具（搜索、引用图谱、作者、推荐、PDF 全文分片、自动引用、科研绘图），跨平台去重统一搜索，设置页 API Key 卡片，按次积分统计与 `/ai4scholar` 余额卡。

description.zh: Multitask 减震器模式（Agent preset）：主对话只做需求理解、任务下发与结果汇总，读文件、跑命令、搜索与构建全部下放子代理；含四类 worker、危险操作审批闸门，且零 DSH 源码改动。

description.en: LSP action surface for DSH: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints and rename, all backed by real language servers.
description.zh: DSH 的 LSP 动作面：诊断、格式化、补全、代码动作、符号、签名提示、inlay 提示与重命名，全部由真实语言服务器驱动。

description.zh: 为模型提供创建、读取和更新 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 文件的工具。

description.en: Generative UI for DeepSeek Harness — the agent writes TSX and the web UI compiles every frame as it streams, so a card renders while its JSX is still unclosed. Inline in the conversation, or in a side canvas.
description.zh: 让 AI 在对话中或侧边栏里插入流式生成的 UI，以 TSX 书写——模型的母语之一，不必再教它一套 JSON schema。流式渲染不闪烁，状态跨帧保留、无硬刷新，对 UI 的点击直接驱动下一轮对话。inline 形态流式最重要，side canvas 形态更 agentic。卡片内部同样具备 agentic 能力——执行 bash、curl、调用模型、读写文件。

description.en: DSH 朗读桥：会话里的话自动交给 DeepSeek 网页端朗读，声音从你自己的电脑里出来
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek 网页端自带的朗读，把 DSH 里的对话念出来，靠一个小浏览器扩展驱动。

description.en: 把 WorkBuddy（多账号/企业版）、Trae CN / TRAE SOLO CN、Qoder CN 三家订阅聚合进同一个 DSH 模型选择器：会话内换模型不丢历史、积分倍率、逐模型思考档位、每日自动签到、读图与 Agent 工具调用。One DSH plugin aggregating WorkBuddy / Trae / Qoder subscriptions into one model picker: mid-session switching, credit multipliers, reasoning effort, daily check-in, vision, tools.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件把 WorkBuddy（个人多账号、企业版与国际版 WorkBuddy AI）、Qoder CN、Trae CN 的模型聚合进同一个模型选择器，共用一套对话历史，支持积分倍率、逐模型思考档位、国际版上游声明的最大上下文窗口，并在渠道有签到活动时自动领取。

description.en: Let DSH agents explore, build, and chat on Minecraft servers through native game tools.
