description.en: 工作推gal两不误~面向DeepSeek Harness的跨会话事件感知Galgame引擎与界面插件，支持鲸鱼娘/GPT/Claude/Grok/Gemini/Kimi多位模型娘角色
description.zh: 边干活边推gal，把模型娘同事做成跨会话事件感知的Galgame界面，工作恋爱两不误。

description.en: DSH↔Godot engine runtime bridge: launch and drive a running Godot 4.x game through its in-game TCP interaction server — 16 tools (runtime control via ~130 game commands, scene/UI inspection, GDScript eval, input simulation, screenshots, headless static ops, project editing, export, script validation, engine-path setup), replaces godot-mcp.
description.zh: DSH↔Godot 引擎运行时控制桥：通过游戏内置 TCP 交互服务器启动并操控运行中的 Godot 4.x——16 个工具（约 130 条运行时命令、场景/UI 检查、GDScript eval、输入模拟、截图、headless 静态操作、项目编辑、导出、脚本编译检查、引擎路径设置），替代 godot-mcp。

description.en: DSH 片头开机动画增强版：播放控制、触发规则、会话名单、分时段片头、片库管理、中英双语。A full-frame intro animation for DSH. Fork of NativeDog1/dsh-boot-animation.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加开机动画，打开或切换会话时视频铺满窗口播放，还能分时段换片头。

description.en: Upload a file and let the model actually read it
description.zh: 文件上传（彩色附件卡片、会话隔离存储、sha256 去重、TTL 清扫）+ 内容嗅探的 read_document 文档读取（PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT）。

description.en: Pause and resume tasks automatically during user-defined time windows to avoid peak-hour API costs; includes account balance display and 10-minute granularity spend bar chart.
description.zh: 自定义时间窗口自动暂停/恢复任务，高峰时段节省 API 费用；含账户余额显示和 10 分钟粒度的消费柱状图。

description.en: Voice input for the web UI: tap Alt (or Alt+Space) to start/stop dictation, browser Web Speech (zero-config) or OpenAI-compatible cloud ASR, optional polish through DSH-configured LLM, settings UI.
description.zh: 面向 Web UI 的语音输入插件：点按 Alt（或 Alt+空格）开始/停止听写，支持浏览器内置 Web Speech（零配置）或 OpenAI 兼容云端 ASR，可选经 DSH 已配置模型润色，带设置页。

description.en: Deep reading & summarization for DSH: books/papers/videos/web into structured Obsidian notes via plugin parsers, MapReduce parallel deep-read subagents, JSON Schema outputs and an idempotent cache.
description.zh: DSH 精读与摘要：书籍/论文/视频/网页经可插拔解析器转成结构化 Obsidian 笔记，MapReduce 并行精读子代理、JSON Schema 输出与幂等缓存。

description.en: Multi-agent workflow for math-modeling contests: the "UltraMath" preset runs a problem from reading through framework, derivation, coding, verification, paper and review, plus 4 single-stage role presets (mathematician, engineer, writer, reviewer) and 33 model-library skill docs.
description.zh: 数学建模竞赛多 Agent 求解工作流：「UltraMath」主控预设一个预设跑通 读题→框架→推导→编码→验算→论文→审稿 全流程，另有 数学家/工程师/作家/审稿人 4 个单阶段角色预设与 33 篇模型库技能文档。

description.en: A Honkai: Star Rail "Firefly" theme with wallpaper/video backgrounds, firefly-green neon palette, transformation boot animation, ambient particles, BGM, typewriter SFX, and context-aware emote easter eggs.
description.zh: 崩坏：星穹铁道「流萤」主题：立绘/动态壁纸、萤火绿霓虹配色、开屏变身动画、萤火氛围粒子、背景音乐、打字音效与按对话触发的表情包彩蛋。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory under the "memory palace" metaphor: dual-scope SQLite stores (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval with RRF fusion and recency/proof ranking boost, automatic capture from the session log (including the final turn), provenance audit chains, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a settings-page Memory Library panel with corridor topology, tour butler, and refurb list.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆插件，以「记忆宫殿」隐喻重构 agent 长期记忆：双层 SQLite 分库（用户级 + 按 git origin 隔离的项目级）、FTS5 + 本地向量 RRF 融合与新鲜度/命中排序 boost、从会话日志自动摄取（含末轮）、来源审计链、巩固蒸馏与衰减遗忘，以及设置页「记忆库」面板（走廊拓扑、导览管家、翻新清单）。

description.en: Control local DSH conversations from QQ through the official QQ bot platform and a dedicated settings panel.
description.zh: 把 QQ 变成你的 AI 遥控器，随时远程指挥 DeepSeek Harness 干活。

description.en: Edge TTS voice plugin for DeepSeek Harness: read assistant replies aloud, auto-read toggle, voice settings panel (free, no API key)
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 用 Edge 语音朗读助手回复，支持自动朗读开关和语音设置面板，免费无需 API 密钥。

description.en: 科幻推理等级滑条 for DeepSeek Harness：Ultra 档 + 闪电编排模式 + 子代理 tok/s 读数 / A sci-fi reasoning-effort slider for DSH
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框加一条科幻发光滑条，随手调推理等级，还能开 Ultra 档和闪电模式。

description.en: Custom Claude provider support for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Custom Claude provider support for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Floating panel for the DSH web UI managing MCP servers and skills: per-server deferred tool loading (ToolSearch, off by default) keeps a server's tools out of every turn's context — the prompt lists tool names only, and a tool's full schema enters the list once the model finds it with the built-in tool_search, so a turn stops paying for schemas it never calls. MCP servers live in a global scope or a project's own .dsh/mcp.json, with per-server enable/disable, a 47-service market and import from ten other clients; skills are auto-discovered across their real scopes with shadowing, and model auto-invocation versus manual-only is a switch per skill.
description.zh: DSH 网页的悬浮面板，管 MCP 也管技能：逐服务器开启工具延迟加载（ToolSearch，默认关闭）——该服务器的工具不再每轮常驻上下文，提示词里只列工具名，模型用内置 tool_search 搜到哪个，哪个的完整参数 schema 才进工具列表，每一轮不再为没调用的 schema 付上下文。MCP 分全局与项目两级（项目写在它自己的 .dsh/mcp.json，只该项目会话可见），逐台启停，另有 47 个服务的市场与从 10 种其他客户端导入配置；技能由宿主自动发现，面板按真实作用域与同名遮蔽逐条列出，每个技能「模型自动调用 / 仅你手动调用」就地可拨。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless long reads), one-click voice-pack installs from a registry, and a portable RVC runtime.
description.zh: 用免费 Edge TTS 或你自己的 RVC 音色朗读 AI 回复：消息朗读与自动朗读、长文自适应分块渐进播放（无缝衔接）、音色包仓库一键安装、便携 RVC 运行时。

description.en: Provides a Git worktree-aware session view for the DSH web interface, aiding in managing multiple worktrees.
description.zh: 为DSH网页界面提供感知Git worktree的会话视图，便于管理多个工作树。

description.en: Adds a customizable title bar for the DeepSeek Harness interface, enhancing visual layout and user experience.
description.zh: 为界面添加可定制的标题栏，增强布局与用户体验。

description.en: Archive, restore, permanently delete, and move DeepSeek Harness sessions across workspaces from one unified settings panel.
description.zh: 在统一设置面板中归档、恢复、彻底删除并跨工作区移动 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

description.en: Tracks token usage, cache hits, billing peaks, and balance, with CSV/JSON/PNG export capabilities.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 用量与消耗插件（dsh-usage-plugin）—— 每次调用的 token 用量/缓存命中统计、峰谷计费、余额查询、CSV/JSON/PNG 导出，可经桌面端一键安装或命令行 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: Provides fireworks-related tools for DSH, offering utility functions for terminal users.
description.zh: 提供烟花相关工具，为终端用户增添实用功能。

description.en: A DSH workflow bundle with pipeline tools, task routing, scheduled wakeups, and recovery for stalled jobs.
description.zh: 多智能体管线管理内核，提供任务板、台账、部署、注册表、巡检和打包复用，一站式掌控整个流水线。

description.en: Cyberpunk 2077 / Night City theme: NC yellow and neon cyan identity, CRT scanlines, Kiroshi hover lock-on, combat-state HUD, synthesized typewriter and message SFX, and hidden easter eggs (relic / johnny).
description.zh: Cyberpunk 2077 / 夜之城主题：NC 黄 × 霓虹青配色、CRT 扫描线、Kiroshi 悬停锁定、战斗状态 HUD、合成打字机与消息音效，以及隐藏彩蛋（relic / johnny）。

description.en: IM Companion for dsh-im: groups Feishu/WeChat/QQ bots by Agent in DSH workspaces and enhances DSH native session states (blue/orange/red rail markers for running, needs-review and error), with left badges, one-click filter, fleet overview and drag-to-move. Clean uninstall.
description.zh: dsh-im辅助插件：创造助理/家的概念，把飞书/微信/QQ等机器人收进DSH工作区，并提供更多强大的扩展功能。增强DSH原生会话状态:哪些在执行任务、哪些在等你回复、哪些有异常。感谢使用🌹。

description.en: QA project workbench for dsh: manage test projects, requirements, test cases, defects, milestones, reports and approval gates through a browser UI and 18 QA-domain tools.
description.zh: dsh 质量项目工作台：通过浏览器界面和 18 个 QA 领域工具管理测试项目、需求、用例、缺陷、里程碑、报告与审批门禁。

description.zh: 自包含浏览器运行时：Playwright（chromium）+ OpenCLI 作为插件本地依赖（全局复用回退），提供 `browser` 服务与 9 个交互式浏览器工具。

description.en: Persistent MCP server management UI (FAB + settings tab + host Remote) for DeepSeek Harness Web
description.zh: 提供持久化的 MCP 服务器管理界面，包含浮动按钮和设置选项卡。

description.en: Deepseek-harness-workbench-plugin
description.zh: 提供插件开发工作台，辅助构建与测试。

description.zh: 跨实例互联：经 interconnect 服务在多个 DSH 实例间转发消息与事件。

description.en: Minecraft development skills and tools for DeepSeek Harness: 8 skills covering Paper/Spigot plugins, Fabric, Forge and NeoForge mods, addon development against major mods, and Gradle/JDK build setup across Minecraft 1.7.10 through 26.x; the mc_scaffold project generator and the mc_gradle Gradle runner; an intake skill that asks for missing version/platform details before starting; four built-in subagents; and a second Minecraft Architect preset whose mc_codex tool runs the user's own Codex CLI through the codex app-server protocol to draft the skeleton, after which DSH fills the marked method bodies and verifies the build.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Minecraft 开发技能与工具：8 个技能覆盖 Paper/Spigot 插件、Fabric、Forge 与 NeoForge 模组、大型模组附属开发，以及 Minecraft 1.7.10 至 26.x 全时代的 Gradle/JDK 构建配置；另含 mc_scaffold 项目生成器与 mc_gradle 构建执行器、开工前先批量询问缺失版本/平台信息的 intake 技能、4 个内置子代理，以及第二个「Minecraft 架构师」预设——其 mc_codex 工具通过 codex app-server 协议驱动你自己的 Codex CLI 写出骨架，再由 DSH 填充标记处的方法体并验证构建。

description.en: Runs a nine-stage foreign trade acquisition SOP with human approval gates, customer dedup, and audit logging in a safe dry-run mode.
description.zh: 执行九阶段外贸获客SOP，含人工审批、客户去重和审计日志，默认安全演示。

description.en: DSH Web UI 右侧小游戏面板：18 款离线小游戏（恐龙跳一跳 / 俄罗斯方块 / 坦克大战 / 扫雷 / 2048 / 数独 / 吃豆人 / 跟枪练习等），可扩展游戏注册表，等待模型回复或修 bug 时的摸鱼神器
description.zh: 右侧小游戏面板：18 款离线小游戏，等模型回复时的摸鱼神器。

description.en: DSH 右侧栏里的可编辑画布 —— 加上让模型直接改图的两个工具
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的可编辑画布，加两个模型工具（diagram_read、diagram_apply），直接读写工作区、载体是原生 .drawio 文件：无损写回让画布读不懂的单元逐字节保留，文件指纹 revision 支撑起对并发编辑的乐观锁。

description.en: Interactive UI, HTML/SVG diagrams and animation for DeepSeek Harness Web
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上可交互组件、HTML/SVG 图解和动画，让回答更直观好看。

description.en: Reflective self-evolution plugin for local Qwen3.8 27B/3.8 Flash and online APIs: a coding-loop convergence steerer curbs Qwen3.8 27B/Flash repeated-verification deep-thinking to converge faster and cut thinking time; a five-state delivery guard detects and corrects stuck turns and infinite loops; model-agnostic host logic, mostly compatible with online APIs; per-use continual self-improvement with counter-reason self-checks, critic escalation, inverted-index memory retrieval, coding-loop convergence steering, and a five-state delivery guard.
description.zh: 面向本地 Qwen3.8 27B/3.8 Flash 及线上 API 的反思进化插件：编码循环收敛器针对 Qwen3.8 27B/Flash 的重复验证大思考加速收敛、减少思考时间；五态交付护栏检测并纠正卡住/死循环；model-agnostic 宿主逻辑，线上 API 多数可通用；每次使用持续自进化，带反问式自检、批评升级、倒排索引记忆检索、编码循环收敛提示与五态交付护栏。
一键打包整合 DSH 插件，自动生成整合包，方便分享和分发。

description.en: One-command backup, restore & migration for all DSH user data (~/.dsh) with a visual Settings panel: scheduled auto-backup with tiered retention, sha256 verification, hardened restore with auto-rollback and a result receipt, typed sub-backups (--types), credential redaction into a local vault, private-repo GitHub sync for moving to a new machine, and an out-of-process rescue console (zero-dependency rescue web UI in the backup dir) that works even when the host won't boot. /backup doctor checks and repairs corrupt session logs from a known-good backup and quarantines them before rotation; migrate-check statically predicts which sessions a host upgrade would break (frozen event-list rules, filename/generation mismatch, hardlink support, legacy credentials); the credential sentinel preserves pre-migration copies before the host rewrites them; smart backup snapshots before host upgrades; /backup check-update and /backup update report and install new releases (snapshotting first). Restore handles attachment hard links and arbitrarily large archives (streamed listing). Current npm version 0.13.4; spans DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 through 0.2.0-rc.1, including 0.2.0's install-time peer gate. macOS/Linux/Windows.
description.zh: 一条命令备份、恢复与迁移 DSH 全部用户数据（~/.dsh），附可视化设置面板：定时自动备份与每日/每周分级保留、sha256 校验、失败自动回滚并回执的加固恢复、分类型子集备份（--types）、凭据脱敏进本机 vault、GitHub 私有仓库同步跨机迁移、宿主起不来也能用的进程外救援通道（备份目录内置零依赖救援网页）。/backup doctor 从已知良好备份体检并定点修复损坏会话日志、轮换前先隔离；migrate-check 迁移预检在升级前静态扫描，预测哪些会话会被新宿主拒绝（冻结清单、文件名代际不匹配、硬链接、旧版凭据布局等）；凭据哨兵在宿主改写前自动存底；智能备份在宿主升级前快照；/backup check-update 与 /backup update 感知并一键更新（先留快照）。恢复链路支持含附件硬链接的归档与超大归档（清单走原始流逐行校验）。当前 npm 版本 0.13.4；覆盖 DSH 0.1.1-rc.2–0.2.0-rc.1，含 0.2.0 起的安装期 peer 闸门。macOS/Linux/Windows。

description.en: Syncs the wallpaper currently applied in Wallpaper Engine to the DSH Web UI background through a local bridge: preview/capture/full render modes, monitor lock, a wallpaper library panel for local and market content, focus lens with eye tracking, immersive mode, and a Windows app launcher that installs software from direct links or a cloud-drive share link and starts it with one click.
description.zh: 把 Wallpaper Engine 当前应用的壁纸经本地桥接同步为 DSH Web 界面背景：预览/捕获/完整三档渲染、显示器锁定、本地与市场壁纸库面板、专注透镜与眼动追踪、沉浸模式，以及支持直链与网盘分享链接安装、一键启动的 Windows 应用启动器。

description.en: Reversible context slimming for DeepSeek Harness: TOON-style lossless tabular re-encoding of uniform JSON arrays, stride-sampled table windows with line numbers, and cross-turn dedup for repeated tool output; every replacement passes a byte-plus-token gate (≤72% bytes, strictly fewer estimated tokens) and the original is spilled to disk behind a `[save-token #id]` notice retrievable in one call via the `save_token_expand` tool, with billed and avoided token metering on a settings dashboard.
description.zh: 可逆的上下文瘦身插件：均匀 JSON 数组走 TOON 式无损表格化重编码，管道表按行号抽样保留窗口，90 秒内字节级相同的工具输出跨轮去重；每次替换都要通过双重门（压缩后 ≤72% 字节且估算 token 严格下降），原文落盘并以 `[save-token #id]` 标记，可用 `save_token_expand` 工具一步取回；设置页仪表盘分别统计实际计费与节省的 token。

description.en: Integrates OpenCode Zen's free models into DeepSeek Harness with 1M context and full metadata.
description.zh: OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness。1M 上下文，同步全部元数据

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: the AgentRouter relay as one pi-ai route with a domestic/international endpoint switch, plus the outbound request compatibility the relay requires.
DSH PUA — 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 PUA 任务推进、角色风味、验收循环和运行状态卡片 · PUA task persistence, personas, verification loops, and live status cards for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 提供 /pua，在 Agent 失败后促使其换方法，并在宣称完成前核验收据；含 15 种公司风格、角色模式、全局与会话设置，以及可选验收循环（直到验收命令通过、达到迭代上限或用户取消）。

description.en: Match context windows for configured DSH models in one click, show capacity sources, and support selective bulk configuration, manual editing, and continuous synchronization.
description.zh: 一键匹配 DSH 已配置模型的上下文窗口，展示容量来源，支持勾选批量配置、手动编辑和持续同步。

description.en: A native DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin bridging dsh coding agents to Feishu/Lark group chats — one group, one project directory.
description.zh: 将编码代理接入飞书群聊，便于项目协作。

description.en: A pluginized microkernel architecture for building, orchestrating, and extending multi-agent systems in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给多智能体系统搭一套可插拔的微内核，让流程能编排、状态有据可查、边界清晰可扩展。

description.en: Remember user preferences and working principles across sessions with memory decay and token-budgeted retrieval.
description.zh: 让模型主动记下你的判断依据（原则/红线/工作方式），跨会话复用 —— 有容量上限、会遗忘、每条都说得出为什么记。0.7.0 重构为画像式速写，带证据追溯与红线硬约束，告别冷冰冰的数据库列表。

description.en: A native DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin bridging dsh coding agents to Feishu/Lark group chats — one group, one project directory.
description.zh: 把本地 dsh 编程助手接进飞书/Lark 群聊，一个群对应一个项目目录，在群里就能直接指挥写代码。

description.en: Interactive K-line analysis for DeepSeek Harness with multi-market quotes, technical indicators, news, and fundamentals.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的交互式 K 线分析，支持多市场行情、技术指标、新闻和基本面信息。

description.en: DSH-vison is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds image understanding for text-only models by converting images into descriptions from a configured vision-capable model.
description.zh: DSH-vison 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，为不支持多模态的模型补充图片理解能力。agent 仍可直接接收图片；插件调用 DSH 中已配置的视觉模型生成文字描述，再把描述交给纯文本模型。原始图片会保留在会话历史中，UI 仍可显示图片；模型侧则通过替换后的消息看到描述文字。readimage 工具也会采用同样的处理方式，多模态模型则自动放行，不重复识别。

description.en: DSKIN · DeepSeek Harness（DSH）卡通像素皮肤插件 / Cartoon pixel skin plugin for DSH Web GUI — 原始界面不动，像素宠物会散步、眨眼、跳跃 / living pixel pets that stroll, blink and hop
description.zh: DSKIN · DeepSeek Harness（DSH）卡通像素皮肤插件 / Cartoon pixel skin plugin for DSH Web GUI — 原始界面不动，像素宠物会散步、眨眼、跳跃 / living pixel pets that stroll, blink and hop

description.en: A native DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin bridging dsh coding agents to Feishu/Lark group chats — one group, one project directory.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Claude Code /rewind for DeepSeek Harness: git-first workspace snapshots before every mutating tool execution, turn-boundary session forks, and a one-shot /rewind command that restores files and forks the session back to a checkpoint.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code /rewind 等价能力：每次变更型工具执行前捕获 git 优先的工作区文件快照，轮次边界 fork 会话，一条 /rewind 命令恢复文件并把会话回退到检查点。

description.en: Remote & mobile security gateway: zero-modification Tailscale/LAN access with QR pairing, RSA encryption, brute-force defense and mobile style snippets; auto-yields the shared pairing service to other remote plugins so coexistence never crashes startup.
description.zh: 远程与移动端安全网关：零改动 DSH 底层代码开放 Tailscale/局域网访问，支持扫码配对、RSA 加密、防暴力破解与移动端样式片段；与其他远程插件共存时自动让出共享配对服务，避免启动崩溃。

description.en: Play Gomoku against the AI, or let two AIs battle it out.
description.zh: 与 AI 下五子棋，也可让 AI 对局比棋力。

description.en: Classifies pending tool calls with Jev (TypeSafe AI's non-generative decision model) on tools/pre-execute — confident high-risk calls are denied, ambiguous ones escalated to approval — and auto-approves clearly-granted reversible calls on approval/request behind argument-evidence gating. Also subclasses the session-reference resolver so snapshots keep Jev-scored messages instead of dropping oldest-first. Degrades to stock behavior on any provider failure; shadow mode with a /jev-stats command; TypeSafe or OpenRouter endpoints; 64 tests.
description.zh: 在 tools/pre-execute 上用 Jev（TypeSafe AI 的非生成式决策模型）对待执行的工具调用分类——高置信高危拒绝、存疑转审批——并在 approval/request 上对明确授权且可逆的调用做带参数证据门控的自动批准。另子类化 session-reference resolver，让引用快照按 Jev 打分保留消息而非最旧优先丢弃。任何 provider 故障均回退原生行为；提供 shadow 模式与 /jev-stats 统计命令；支持 TypeSafe 或 OpenRouter 入口；64 个测试。

description.en: Cyrene theme dsh plugin
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 换成昔涟（《崩坏：星穹铁道》）的粉白渐变毛玻璃主题，附带侧边栏可编辑的人格设定、昔涟表情包、新会话欢迎页形象，以及可开关 / 选图 / 轮换 / 调淡的整页背景图。非官方非商业同人作品；昔涟及相关美术素材版权归米哈游（miHoYo / HoYoverse）所有，与官方无隶属或背书关系。

description.en: Collection of skills for Upstash
description.zh: 为AI编程助手提供Upstash SDK技能包，快速上手数据库、缓存等操作。

description.en: Delete DSH conversations instead of archiving them, see the whole family a conversation spawned (its subagents and derived conversations), and delete in bulk. / 真正删除 DeepSeek Harness 里的会话，并看清它生出的子智能体与派生对话。
description.zh: 从 DSH 中永久删除会话，并可选择递归删除派生对话和子智能体会话。

description.en: DSH UI Skin Loader / DSH UI 皮肤加载器
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面一键换肤，装上就能自由切换各种 UI 皮肤，让工具界面更顺眼。

description.en: DSH UI Skin Loader / DSH UI 皮肤加载器
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness — live-syncs the GitHub dsh-plugin topic  into a searchable, paginated settings tab with one-click install and agent tools (market_search / market_install).
description.zh: 把 GitHub 上 1800 多个 DSH 插件同步进设置面板，搜索、分页、一键安装全都有。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) UI for DeepSeek Harness — a panel-driven control console: every slash command is a button on the ⚙️ control-panel card, in-card approvals and questions, live streaming cards, and one-QR app setup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书 UI：面板驱动控制台——每个斜杠命令都是 ⚙️ 控制面板卡片上的按钮，卡内审批与提问，流式卡片，扫码一次完成配置。

description.en: A plugin management panel: one-click enable/disable for installed plugins plus a GitHub dsh-plugin marketplace with details and one-click installs.
description.zh: 插件管理面板：已安装插件一键启用/停用，内置 GitHub dsh-plugin 插件市场，支持详情查看与一键安装。

description.en: Desktop notification reminders.
description.zh: 桌面通知提醒。

description.en: Connect CommandCode Go accounts to DSH with account rotation and subscription usage displays.
DSH UI Skin Loader / DSH UI 皮肤加载器
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Live2D desk pet overlay for the DSH web GUI: mirrors agent state (thinking, idle, error, done, awaiting approval) with motions and speech bubbles, per-part touch reactions, drag-to-dock, switchable personas, and custom models via URL or local path.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠悬浮层：镜像 agent 思考/空闲/出错/完成/待审批状态，配动画与气泡，支持分部位触摸反应、拖动停靠、切换人设，以及通过 URL 或本地路径加载自定义模型。

description.en: Renders OpenTiny GenUI charts, forms, calculators and mini apps inline in DSH replies via schemaJson fences, with user actions flowing back into the conversation.
description.zh: 通过 schemaJson 代码块在 DSH 回复内渲染 OpenTiny GenUI 图表、表单、计算器等迷你应用，用户操作自动回传对话。

description.en: Converts session, agent-loop, LLM, and tool lifecycle events into OpenTelemetry GenAI traces and metrics, exported over standard OTLP/HTTP to any compatible backend, with content capture off by default.
description.zh: 将会话、Agent 循环、LLM 与工具生命周期事件转换为 OpenTelemetry GenAI 调用链与指标，通过标准 OTLP/HTTP 导出到任意兼容后端，正文采集默认关闭。

description.en: Search and manage archived and unarchived chats with read-only previews, tags and notes, workspace archiving, ZIP backups, origins and branches, manual residual-chat checks and automatic update checks. Retains legacy Recycle Bin recovery without automatic cleanup.
description.zh: 管理已归档与未归档会话，支持搜索、只读预览、标签备注、工作区归档、ZIP 备份、来源分支、手动残留会话检查和自动检查更新；保留旧回收记录恢复，停用自动清理。

description.en: Notifications for four session states, with browser alerts and prompts.
description.zh: 会话完成等四种状态的通知响应，支持浏览器提示。

description.en: MCP server manager (stdio / streamable-http): per-working-directory project and global config tiers; project-level MCP collapsed into 4 atomic tools through a middleware layer by default (`middleware: all` folds in global servers too, hot-switchable in the settings page); workspace isolation prevents cross-project interference; configs keep `${ENV}` references only, with no plaintext secrets on disk; runtime registration API for other plugins to inject MCP servers.
description.zh: MCP 服务器管理器（stdio / streamable-http）：按工作目录分项目级/全局两级配置；项目级 MCP 默认经中间层收敛为 4 个原子工具（`middleware: all` 连同全局服务器一并收敛，设置页热切换）；工作空间隔离防串台；配置只存 `${ENV}` 引用、不落盘明文密钥；提供运行时注册接口供其他插件注入 MCP。

description.en: Per-round thinking-level (reasoning_effort) control for DeepSeek Harness: pick Auto and it schedules low/high/max from the recent tool-call history, or fix a wire level (off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max) manually, with custom wire mapping, a model-aware capability guard, and context-window presets (64K–1M); its per-model capability card pairs with a separate plugin, [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions) (installable from dsh-market), so custom OpenAI-compatible gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted) can try reasoning — the card writes llm-pi-ai capabilities, the adapter drives the wire (compat.thinkingFormat), and this plugin auto-maintains the takeover list.
description.zh: DSH 逐轮思考级别（reasoning_effort）控制：选择 Auto 即按近期工具调用历史自动调度 low/high/max，或手动固定线路档位（off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max），支持自定义线路映射、模型能力护栏与上下文窗口预设（64K–1M）；其逐模型能力卡片与另一独立插件 [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions)（可在 dsh-market 安装）联动，让自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关（vLLM / LM Studio / 自托管）也能试用推理——卡片写入 llm-pi-ai 能力，适配器接管线路（compat.thinkingFormat），本插件自动维护接管列表。

description.en: Four-source migration wizard: move Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DSH (/move wizard with approval gate and idempotent move.json, resumable sessions).
description.zh: 四合一迁移向导：把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Hermes 的会话、记忆、技能、指令与斜杠命令迁入 DSH（/move 向导，审批门 + 幂等 move.json，会话可续聊）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: DietrichGebert/ponytail lazy senior mode & 7-rung ladder port, 6 skills with bilingual descriptions & per-skill toggles, zero tools, zero-cache-miss.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：DietrichGebert/ponytail 懒人 senior 模式与七阶梯子完美移植，6 个技能描述双语自由切换，各个技能自由开关，零 tool 注册，全场景零缓存破坏。

description.en: Installs a multi-agent novel-writing preset for DeepSeek Harness: one conductor agent dispatches five specialized subagents — world-building, plotting, character management, prose writing, and QA review.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 安装一个多智能体小说创作预设：一个统筹队长派单五个专职子代理——架构世界、策划剧情、管理人物、执笔写文、质检复核。

description.en: Task-event notification center: 6 event kinds (ask / approval / completion / subagent completion / error / turn end), dual channels (browser Notification + host system toast) plus Bark/Webhook push channels (ntfy, Gotify, self-hosted gateways); quiet hours with urgent exceptions, approval-timeout re-reminders, completion-storm aggregation, and notification text redaction.
description.zh: 任务事件通知中心：6 类事件（提问 / 审批 / 完成 / 子代理完成 / 错误 / 轮次完成），双通道（浏览器通知 + 宿主系统 toast）外加 Bark/Webhook 推送频道（ntfy、Gotify、自建网关）；支持免打扰时段与紧急例外、审批超时二次提醒、完成风暴聚合、通知文本脱敏。

description.en: DeepTrace — deterministic agent reports from session logs (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly/custom): cost & token breakdown, 8 insight rules, collaboration review, live provider balance, PDF/PNG/HTML export; read-only, never rewrites history.
description.zh: 深迹 DeepTrace — 从会话日志生成日报/周报/月报/年报/自定义区间报告：成本与 Token 拆解、8 条确定性洞察、协作复盘、实时模型余额、PDF/PNG/HTML 导出；只读，绝不改写历史。

description.en: 第三方适配插件：把上游 REA（github.com/morluto/rea）的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 mcp__rea__* 工具。2.x 会自动准备 Node、REA CLI、JDK 与 Ghidra 并把那一行接好；逆向分析能力全部由上游 REA 提供。
description.zh: 第三方适配插件：把上游 REA（逆向一切，github.com/morluto/rea）的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 mcp__rea__* 工具。2.x 自带供给：把 Node、REA CLI、JDK、Ghidra 装到 <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle 下，再经 shim 启动 REA —— 干净机器跑一次 setup 即可用；1.x（v1 分支 / npm 1.0.6）是纯配置适配器，需要你自己装好 REA 与 Ghidra。逆向分析能力由 REA 提供，覆盖原生二进制（Hopper/Ghidra/IDA）、JavaScript/Electron 应用、.NET 程序集、网站、Android APK 与 adb 设备、固件与进程捕获。

description.en: Advisor - Pair a second model that passively reviews each turn with notes and predicts your next prompt.  搭配一个会在每轮对话被动注入见解和提示词预测的副模型。
description.zh: 搭配一个副模型，每轮被动审查并注入见解。

description.en: DSH 一次性只读旁问插件：基于当前上下文回答，独立气泡，不执行工具 · One-shot read-only side-ask plugin: answers from current context in an independent bubble, no tool execution
description.zh: 提供 /btw 一次性上下文旁问，不执行工具；回答显示在可复制、折叠或关闭的独立气泡中，不写入主对话。

description.en: 一键同步壁纸引擎各类动态场景壁纸的插件，设置应用启动项。A "wallpaper engine" synchronization plugin mounted on the deepseek harness can synchronize static wallpapers
description.zh: 把 Wallpaper Engine 的壁纸实时同步成 DSH 网页背景，还带可调面板，让界面更好看。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness (dsh) to a local Obsidian vault: search, read, write, move, and trash notes.
description.zh: 把 dsh 连接到本地 Obsidian vault：通过 `obsidian_*` 工具搜索、读取、写入、移动与回收笔记。

description.en: A switchable QQ2006 skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with a coral-blue theme and retro assets.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 界面一键变回 2006 年 QQ 客户端，珊瑚蓝主题加复古元素，可随时切换。

description.en: Real session deletion with trash and restore, archived cleanup, and batch delete from settings.
description.zh: 真正删除会话：回收站可还原、归档清理、设置页批量删除。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that adds a conversation navigation panel with bookmarks and rollback links.
description.zh: 1:1 复刻 DeepSeek 官网右侧对话导航栏（ScrollNav）：悬停展开面板、阅读位置高亮、点击跳转。

description.en: Second model passively reviews each turn and injects advice
description.zh: 第二模型被动审查每轮并注入建议

description.en: Zero-dependency toolkit: time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema — ten deterministic tools in one install.
description.zh: 零依赖工具包：time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema 十件套一键安装。

description.en: Add Devin web and code search with account authentication for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.1 hosts.
Connect browser-backed model sessions to DeepSeek Harness through a dedicated bridge bundle.

Manage MCP servers and skills from a panel in the DSH sidebar: edit rows in the profile or global cordis.patch.yml, toggle them, check whether an HTTP server answers, scan Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini configs and import the servers they declare, and browse, create, edit, enable or delete skills by rewriting the user-invocable policy in SKILL.md.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏的面板里管理 MCP 服务器与技能：编辑 profile 或全局 cordis.patch.yml 中的行、启用停用、探测 HTTP 服务器是否响应、扫描 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini 的配置并导入其中声明的服务器，以及浏览、新建、编辑、启停与删除技能（直接重写 SKILL.md 的 user-invocable 策略位）。

description.en: Visible agent browser over CDP: 30+ bcdp_* automation tools, realtime SSE watch panel with direct click/scroll/IME input, element picking quoted into the composer as balanced @"picks/*.json" references, and human-verification notices.
description.zh: 看得见的 Agent 浏览器（CDP 接入）：30+ bcdp_* 工具，实时观察窗支持直接点击/滚动/中文输入，点选元素以 @"picks/*.json" 引用投进输入框，人机验证提醒；DSH 0.1.5/0.1.7/0.2.0 宿主各有一条对应版本线。

description.en: Claude Code-inspired Auto Memory meets Codex-inspired Session consolidation, bringing simple, transparent, and context-efficient long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 融合 Claude Code 的 Auto Memory 与 Codex 的 Session 记忆整理，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供简单、透明、上下文友好的长期记忆。

description.en: Multi-provider usage stats framework (v2 adapter contract): persistent capsule plus detail panel; DeepSeek official (interval-bookkeeping daily usage derivation with a peak/valley countdown badge, working even without an official usage endpoint) and OpenCode Go built in; any other data source joins by dropping in a single mjs adapter file, hot-swappable from the settings page, with API keys kept on the host.
description.zh: 多 provider 用量统计框架（v2 适配器契约）：常驻胶囊 + 详情面板；内置 DeepSeek 官方（区间记账法推算每日用量 + 峰谷倒计时徽标，官方无用量接口也能算）与 OpenCode Go；其他数据源只需放入一个 mjs 适配器文件即可接入，设置页热插拔，密钥只留在宿主端。

description.en: Layered memory for DSH whose agent-facing surface is 10 tools: high-privilege writes (memory_add, memory_delete, memory_import), rumination controls (memory_ruminate, _cancel, _status), and a memory graph (memory_search_graph, memory_expand_graph_node), built over an L0-L3 distillation pipeline that recalls and injects relevant memories before each model step.
description.zh: 分层记忆插件，面向 Agent 暴露 10 个工具：高权限写入（memory_add / memory_delete / memory_import）、反刍控制（memory_ruminate / _cancel / _status）与记忆图谱（memory_search_graph / memory_expand_graph_node），底层为 L0–L3 蒸馏管线，并在每步模型调用前召回注入相关记忆。

description.en: Adds Xiaomi MiMo, Doubao, and browser text-to-speech to DSH, with automatic read-aloud, custom voices, and optional UI sound effects.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供小米 MiMo、豆包和浏览器本地语音朗读，支持自动播报、自定义音色与可选 UI 音效。

description.en: Access the dsh web UI over LAN: HTTP/HTTPS/WS forwarding plus TLS (self-signed or custom certificates); adaptive Brotli/gzip compression for HTTP and permessage-deflate for WebSocket; half-open WebSocket probing keeps mobile clients from going stale after backgrounding; launch-token auto-injection lets LAN devices connect without copying the token; DNS-rebinding protection + loopback-only upstream allowlist.
description.zh: 局域网访问 dsh web UI：HTTP/HTTPS/WS 转发 + TLS（自签名/自定义证书）；HTTP 自适应 Brotli/gzip 与 WebSocket permessage-deflate 双压缩；WS 半开探活，移动端切后台不僵死；启动令牌自动注入，LAN 设备免手工拿 token；DNS 重绑定防护 + 回环-only 上游白名单。

description.en: 把本机 WorkBuddy 桌面端已登录的模型（DeepSeek / GLM / Kimi / MiniMax 等）变成本地的 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 兼容接口 —— Claude Code / opencode / Cursor / Trae / Cherry Studio / LobeChat 等任意支持自定义 Base URL 的客户端可直连。附网页控制台与 DeepSeek Harness 原生插件。零依赖，仅监听 127.0.0.1。
description.zh: 把本机的本地 OpenAI 兼容桥注册成 dsh 原生模型 provider：复用这台机器桌面端已登录的模型，管理桥与其本地控制台进程，并附带 5 个工具、/workbuddy 命令与 9 个标签页的设置面板。需同机已安装并登录该桌面端；桥只监听 127.0.0.1。

description.en: Lets the primary model ask an independent reviewer model to review a decision it has already made, with off, shadow and advisory modes. Requires your own service implementing POST /v1/decision.
description.zh: 让主模型把已形成的决策交给独立评审模型复核，支持 off、shadow、advisory 三种模式；需自备实现 POST /v1/decision 的复核服务。

description.en: 基于deepseek harness和ComfyUI的AI视频创作工作台
description.zh: 在本地画布上做短剧和动画，接 ComfyUI 出片，全程免费不联网。

description.en: 🐋 DeepSeek 娘桌宠：住进 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的蓝发鲸鱼女仆。工作链路、任务完成统计（用时/消耗/花费）、睡眠系统、时间感知、余额/天气/喂食按钮、完整设置面板。
description.zh: 把蓝发鲸鱼女仆养进 DeepSeek Harness 网页里，陪你干活、记录任务用时花费，还能睡觉、看天气、查余额。

description.en: 2000万+中小学K12真题题库 Skill：免费注册、免费抽题、教材/章节/知识点检索、练习测验与AI智能组卷。
description.zh: 接入2000万+中小学K12真题题库，免费抽题、按教材章节知识点检索，还能练习测验和AI智能组卷。

description.en: A cute whale desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that keeps an eye on your DeepSeek balance and session usage/cost. Drag her anywhere, click to open a live panel with real-time spend, peak/off-peak pricing, budget alerts, and history trends.
description.zh: 一只可拖拽的鲸鱼娘桌宠，实时盯着 DeepSeek 余额和会话花费，点开就能看用量明细。

description.en: 给 DSH 加一段自定义开屏动画
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段自定义开屏动画：自带默认视频，装好即可用；也能换成自己的视频，播完后 0.3 秒渐隐露出界面，并顶掉壳自己的加载画面。清空路径即彻底关闭。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 界面右下角的常驻余额挂件。基于 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget 修改的铁盆鲸鱼娘版。
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: 免费模型排行榜 · DeepSeek Harness 社区插件，在 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI 左侧边栏提供「免费模型榜」：分页浏览（每页 20 条、页码窗口、首页/末页）、 点击标题展开 API 调用地址 / 模型名称 / 【点击这里申请免费密钥key】按钮， 并支持一键配置到 设置 → 模型 → 自定义提供方 —— 用户只需自行粘贴免费 API Key
description.zh: DSH Web UI 右侧的免费模型抽屉面板，分页浏览免费模型，可一键或整页批量把模型写入自定义提供方，并附带本地多 Key 轮换代理。

description.en: 面向公网的多租户 DSH 托管平台 —— 部署到一台公网服务器后，多个用户注册并经管理员审核，各自获得一套相互隔离的 deepseek-harness（DSH）环境，随时通过域名安全访问。
description.zh: 把 DSH 部署到公网服务器，多用户注册审核后各得一套隔离环境，用域名随时安全访问。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：GitHub 风格用量热力图 + Token / 缓存命中 / 账户余额看板 + 工作区别名管理。
description.zh: GitHub 风格用量热力图看板：按工作区统计使用次数与 Token 花费（含缓存命中率）、DeepSeek 账户余额查询、工作区别名管理。

description.en: Add configurable prompt rules and checks for coding tasks in DSH.

Per-model appearance for the DSH Web UI: an ordered rule list matched against the current session model name, each rule carrying its own wallpaper, theme colour, layout mode, framing and wallpaper opacity and blur, plus per-surface opacity and frosted-glass blur for the main background, left panel, right panel, cards and panels, input and controls, settings panel, conversation text frame and trajectory view.
description.zh: 按模型切换 DSH Web 界面外观：有序规则列表按当前会话的模型名匹配，每条规则自带壁纸、主题色、布局模式、取景与背景透明度、模糊；另有主背景、左侧栏、右侧栏、卡片面板、输入框与控件、设置面板、对话文本框、轨迹页的分区透明度与毛玻璃模糊。

description.en: Isolated-environment browser verification skill for DSH plugin development: a throwaway DSH_HOME, its own `verify_<random>` profile, its own port and its own browser instance in one command, cleaned up on exit, so the profile you are actually using is never touched; ships a zero-dependency raw-CDP driver (snapshot / click / screenshot / eval) and an optional isolation audit.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件开发的隔离环境浏览器验证 skill：一条命令拉起临时 DSH_HOME、独立 `verify_<随机>` profile、独立端口与独立浏览器实例，退出自动清理，不污染正在使用的 profile；自带零依赖 raw-CDP 浏览器驱动（快照 / 点击 / 截图 / 求值）与可选隔离审计。

description.en: Two-way Codex↔DSH bridge: skills from ~/.codex/skills, session import with workspace attach, live MCP mirroring of mcp_servers, and a Codex-side reverse MCP installer.
description.zh: Codex 与 DSH 双向桥接：挂载 ~/.codex/skills、带工作区绑定的会话导入、mcp_servers 实时镜像，以及 Codex 端反向 MCP 安装器。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中以会话级 artifact 安全展示交互式 HTML 可视化。

One-click prompt enhancement in the composer — rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (role and goal, executable steps, output format, acceptance criteria, edge cases) with before/after preview, fill-back, and undo. Never changes intent, never fabricates requirements.
description.zh: 输入框一键提示词增强——把草稿改写为结构化提示词（角色与目标、可执行步骤、输出格式、验收标准、边界条件），支持前后对比、回填与一键撤销；不改变原意、不凭空编造需求。

description.en: Live subagent run monitor for the Web UI: a sidebar footer trigger plus a fixed top-right card panel showing each subagent of the current session in real time (running/elapsed, terminal outcomes, tree indent), with one-click jump into the child conversation and a return button, refresh-surviving and mobile-hidden by default.
description.zh: Web UI 子代理实时监视面板：侧边栏底部入口 + 右上角常驻卡片面板，实时展示当前会话每个子代理的运行状态（运行中/耗时/终态）、树形缩进，一键跳转子代理会话并支持返回主会话，刷新自恢复、移动端默认隐藏。

description.en: Block-addressed document editing: an MCP server exposing geml_get / geml_set / geml_check and friends, so an agent reads or rewrites one addressed block of a Markdown or GEML document instead of the whole file. Ships the GEML authoring skill and a code-graph skill that builds and navigates a project call graph as GEML codemaps.
description.zh: 按块寻址的文档读写：MCP server 提供 geml_get / geml_set / geml_check 等工具，Agent 只取回或改写 Markdown、GEML 文档中的某一个块，而不是整篇文件。另带 GEML 写作技能，以及把项目调用图构建为 GEML codemap 并浏览的代码图谱技能。

description.en: dsh-purge 1.1.71 适配 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 的可用副本：修复 #40 complete-prompt keep-inject、hostFs closeSync/readSync、redteam preset toolFilter
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一套红队安全测试工具，帮你在本地跑攻击演练、查漏洞。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的开场视频 + 聊天底图插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加开场视频和聊天底图，开机动画后接自己的视频，聊天背景换图只需丢张图片进文件夹。

description.en: 🐖 DeepSeek Harness 养成插件，也可作为 Windows/Linux/macOS 桌面宠物运行；支持成长、学习、打工、钓鱼、图鉴与换肤
description.zh: 一只住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的小猪，能养成、学习、打工、钓鱼、集图鉴，还能当桌面宠物陪你。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供的思考循环守护插件：模型陷入「只想不做」的退化循环时自动打断并注入纠正提示，任务继续往下走，不必再手动中止
description.zh: 模型陷入只想不做的思考死循环时自动打断，不用再手动中止。

description.en: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 编码控制台变成泰拉瑞亚像素世界——向导陪你写代码，真实对话、工具审批、难度切换，单文件零依赖。
description.zh: 把 DSH 编码控制台换成泰拉瑞亚像素世界，向导陪你写代码，单文件零依赖。

description.en: 将千星沙箱（原神千星奇域）知识库接入 Deepseek Harness 的插件
description.zh: 将千星沙箱（原神千星奇域）知识库接入 Deepseek Harness 的插件

description.en: Mobile web shell for the DSH Web GUI: overlay drawers, draggable FAB, mobile composer fixes, and a floating image-upload button pinned above the composer (native gallery/camera, integrated with the validated add-images pipeline), zero desktop regression. Published on npm as dsh-webui-mobile.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的移动端外壳：抽屉式侧栏、可拖拽悬浮按钮、移动端输入框修复，以及悬浮在输入框上方的图片上传按钮（原生相册/拍照，走加图校验管线），桌面端零影响。已发布到 npm（dsh-webui-mobile）。

description.en: Add voice input, prompt editing, and local file-to-Markdown input to the DSH composer.
description.zh: 输入体验增强插件，目前已实现语音输入、AI提示词润色（反覆盖保护、带差异预览的提示词优化）、跟随 DSH 界面语言自动切换中英文界面。

description.en: Zero-cost access to 6 free large models. No registration, no recharge, 6 free models built-in, multi-key rotation and rate-limit backoff.
description.zh: 0元接入6个免费大模型，免注册免充值，内置6个免费模型，多Key轮换与限流退避。

description.en: Adaptive deep-research orchestrator plugin for DeepSeek Harness (official workflow engine, cybernetics/information-theory design)
description.zh: 自适应深度研究编排器（基于官方 workflow 引擎）。

description.en: Toggle and edit a shared whale-character persona across DSH conversations.
Register the REA reverse-engineering server through the built-in DSH MCP client in a separate profile bundle.

Bridges WeChat private chats into DeepSeek Harness as an in-process plugin over Tencent's iLink bot protocol, with two-way text, image, file and voice messaging, in-WeChat slash commands resolved through the native command registry, WeChat-side handling of approvals and agent questions, and proactive push through a send_wechat tool.
description.zh: 以进程内 Cordis 插件的形式，通过腾讯 iLink bot 协议把微信私聊桥接到 DeepSeek Harness——双向收发文本、图片、文件与语音，微信内 slash 命令经原生命令注册中心解析（DSH 新增命令零改动可用），支持在微信端处理审批与提问，并提供 send_wechat 工具主动推送。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 15 obra/superpowers engineering skills, bilingual descriptions, per-skill toggles.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：15 个 obra/superpowers 工程纪律技能，技能描述中英双语自由切换，每一个技能本身自由开关。

description.en: TinyFish-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: each search is one GET to the TinyFish Search API, no model call.
description.zh: 基于 TinyFish 的网页搜索提供方：把内置 web_search 接到 TinyFish Search API，每次搜索一次 GET，不消耗模型调用。

description.en: Official-grade GitHub CI integration: a composite action.yml, a polling PR review bot with idempotent inline comments and a status-check gate, plus PR/issues tools with every write gated by human approval.
description.zh: 官方级 GitHub CI 集成：composite action.yml、轮询 PR 评审机器人（幂等行内评论 + status-check 门禁）以及 PR/issue 工具，所有写入走人工审批门。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.
description.zh: 复用当前 DSH Agent 模型只读审查 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持变更预览、显式上下文及经审批的模型请求。

description.en: Usage statistics settings panel: 26-week activity heatmap, daily token trend with a cache hit-rate curve, per-model donut and breakdown, time-range filters, summary cards, one-time historical backfill and lossless rebuild.
description.zh: 用量统计设置面板：26 周活跃热力图、按日 Token 趋势与缓存命中率曲线、模型用量环形图与明细、时间范围筛选、汇总卡片，支持历史会话回扫与无损重建。

description.en: OpenBMC 控制台入口：设置一级菜单「BMC 控制台」面板一键在顶层标签页打开 BMC Web UI，同源代理经 SSH 本地转发 relay（obmc-web-relay）抵达 BMC，BMC IP 变化自动探测并重定向隧道；需 SSH 跳板机可达 BMC。
Visual multi-agent DAG workflows for DeepSeek Harness with live execution, restart recovery, and Feishu integration.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的可视化多智能体 DAG 工作流，支持实时执行、重启恢复和飞书集成。

description.en: DSH 插件：让她在没人跟她说话的时候主动搭话（本地掷骰子，掷中就走 DSH 自己的一轮）
description.zh: 让 AI 伙伴自己起个话头：按设定间隔掷一次本地骰子决定要不要往指定会话里说话，带安静时段与试运行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件:论文伴读工作台 —— PDF 转录 / 检索 / 流式问答 + 内置阅读器页面。
description.zh: 论文伴读工作台：文献库 + PDF 阅读器 + 教练式伴读。回答必带页码，点页码跳回 PDF 并高亮闪烁对应原文；选中即问不打断阅读；自带「严格师傅」preset——定阅读计划、逐节带读、出题批改，成绩跨会话累积；配置 MinerU（本地自建免注册 / mineru.net 云端 token 二选一）后：扫描版 PDF 可读可伴读、公式可点引用（点一下即得 LaTeX 源码进对话）、公式可检索（QK^T 直接命中），∑ 面板按页浏览全文公式；可选嵌入端点语义召回，大白话提问命中术语段落。文献库专题/论文改名删除——删除走 .trash 回收站可恢复、非空专题批量清空一次确认；阅读器滚动 ↔ 单页翻页双模式、右栏全屏可用、PDF 路径一键复制、译文 PDF 一键导出；原文 ↔ 纯中文原地切换（babeldoc 零预装）。默认本地转录检索，文档不出本机；仅当启用云端 MinerU、嵌入端点或翻译端点时，对应文本才会发往你配置的服务。

description.en: Claude-style drag-and-drop/paperclip file upload with content sniffing, document-to-Markdown via Microsoft MarkItDown (built-in JS fallback), text inlining, and a read_document tool for agents.
description.zh: Claude 风格拖拽/回形针文件上传：内容嗅探、文档转 Markdown（微软 MarkItDown，内置 JS 兜底）、文本直插输入框、read_document 工具。

description.en: Appearance customization for the DeepSeek Harness WebUI: theme palette, wallpaper and video backgrounds, translucency and glassmorphism.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观自定义:主题调色、壁纸与视频背景、半透明与毛玻璃。

description.en: Role-based LLM retry & fallback strategies.
description.zh: 基于角色的模型重试与备用策略。

description.en: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist model provider with quota management and model selector.
description.zh: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist 模型提供商插件，支持配额查看与模型选择管理。

description.en: IMAP/SMTP email tools (list/read/search/send/folders/attachment/health/watch/mark/reply) with since/until date-range filters, email_mark for read/unread/star/move, email_reply for reply/reply-all/forward with threading headers, QQ/163/126/Sina/Aliyun/Gmail/Outlook/iCloud presets, multi-account support, a send-approval gate, a web settings page and a whale-girl new-mail popup driven by the incremental email_watch checker. Outlook OAuth2 device-code login works out of the box through a built-in community client, and an account can still supply its own clientId instead. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 邮件工具插件：含 email_watch 增量新邮件检查、email_mark（已读/未读/星标/移动文件夹）与 email_reply（回复/回复全部/转发，自动线程头+引文）的十工具，Web 设置页与鲸鱼娘递信新邮件弹窗，since/until 日期范围过滤，内置 QQ/163/126/新浪/阿里/Gmail/Outlook/iCloud 预设，多账号、连接复用与发信审批门；Outlook OAuth2 设备码登录开箱即用（内置社区客户端，账号仍可填自己的 clientId 覆盖）。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Twelve official Remotion skills synced from the official upstream (programmatic video with React: animation, audio, captions, 3D, maps, charts, render, Studio), plus a bundled-resource health check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: Remotion 官方 12 技能：React 编程式视频（动画/音频/字幕/3D/地图/图表/渲染/Studio），安装即用，附随包资源完整性自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Presentation skill and tools: one sentence or one document to an HTML slideshow plus editable PPTX, seven layouts (incl. quote and native PPTX tables), speaker notes (HTML S-key panel and native notes slides), five built-in themes, default theme/language config and bilingual support. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 演示文稿技能与工具：一句话或一篇文档生成 HTML 放映与可编辑 PPTX，7 种页型（含金句与原生 PPTX 表格），演讲者备注（HTML 按 S 呼出 + PPTX 原生备注页），内置 5 套主题，可配置默认主题/语言，中英双语。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Goal lifecycle management for dsh with an interactive kanban board: goals, criteria, attempts and reviews live in the workspace, driven by graph_* tools, with a two-lane board rendered in the conversation view.
description.zh: dsh 目标生命周期管理与可视化看板：目标、判据、执行、评审都在项目内跟踪，由 graph_* 工具驱动，会话视图内渲染二维泳道看板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器管理插件：可视化界面管理 + 按需热注入，OAuth 鉴权支持，环境变量配置。
description.zh: MCP 管理界面 + tool search：可视化配置/启停/刷新 MCP 服务器与工具勾选，按需检索（tool search）热注入；工具列表稳定命中缓存、不撑爆上下文。DeepSeek Harness plugin: MCP management UI + tool search — stable tool list, cache-friendly, no context bloat.

description.en: Chinese traditional colors as a DeepSeek Harness theme pack.
description.zh: 一键切换98款中国风主题，深浅色全适配，自动满足无障碍对比度要求。

description.en: Automatic conversation distillation: background subagent reflection + skill create/update.
description.zh: 自动对话蒸馏：后台 subagent 反省 + 技能 create/update。

description.en: Novel-writing guardrails: 20 novel_* tools enforce fact-ledger consistency, phase and chapter gates, machine audit with deterministic metrics, and proposal-only revisions; a right-panel workbench covers reading, TTS playback, polish, proofread, continuity checks and batch drafting, and a bypass engine runs internal steps off the main conversation.
description.zh: 小说写作护栏插件：20 个 novel_* 工具以代码强制事实账本一致性、阶段与落盘门禁、确定性机审与提案制修订；右侧栏工作台提供阅读/听书/润色/校对/全书体检/批量起草，旁路引擎让内部工序不占主对话。

description.en: VSCode-style editing experience for DeepSeek Harness: a Monaco-based central file editor (tabs, Ctrl+P quick open, status bar) and interactive diff review of agent edit/write results with per-change Keep/Undo, rollback and archiving, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 VSCode 编码体验：基于 Monaco 的中央文件编辑器（文件页签、Ctrl+P 快速打开、状态栏），并对 Agent 的 edit/write 结果进行交互式差异审查（逐处采纳/拒绝、回滚、归档），状态跨重启持久化。

description.en: Adds an optimize button beside the composer that analyzes and rewrites the prompt draft with SSE streaming, conversation-context awareness (template vs intent-polish strategies), an edit-continuity memory chain, undo, and model routing with fallback and a connectivity test.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加「优化」按钮：流式分析并改写提示词草稿，支持会话上下文感知（模板/润色双策略）、跨编辑记忆链与撤回，模型路由带 fallback 与连通性测试。

description.en: Detects prompt-injection, jailbreak, and secret-leak patterns on the agent/pre-step, tools/pre-execute, and tools/post-execute seams with allow/ask/block tiers, sanitized defend/detection audit events, a defend_report tool, and a destructive-delete command guard.
description.zh: 在 agent/pre-step、tools/pre-execute、tools/post-execute 三个接缝检测提示词注入、越狱与密钥泄露，按 allow/ask/block 分层拦截，附脱敏 defend/detection 审计事件、defend_report 工具与危险删除命令门禁。

description.en: In-app plugin marketplace for DSH: plugin discovery, install, upgrade, toggle and uninstall in one panel for Web and Desktop host profiles, pairing a community catalog of 4,000+ entries with customizable curated lists, plus eight agent tools and a standalone dshm CLI, without a marketplace server or account.
description.zh: DSH 的应用内插件市场：插件发现、安装、升级、开关与卸载一站完成，跟随 Web / Desktop 宿主 profile；4,000+ 条社区目录搭配可自定义精选清单，附 8 个 agent 工具与独立 dshm CLI，无需市场服务器或账号。

description.en: Project memory for dsh with native task-system integration: session todos and file reads auto-condense into cross-session task records (task↔file links), so workflows are switchable and resumable without re-contextualizing. Read-time memory (no upfront scan): extracts code symbols, summarizes docs, and cross-links docs↔symbols; optional TS semantic enhancement (auto on when TS installed). Experience notes auto-dedup. Every recall includes a traceable citation. Pure JS, single dep, works out of the box, silent operation, zero overhead.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness提供持久化的项目级记忆。专门针对项目开发，原生融合 dsh 任务系统，会话内任务清单与读过的文件自动沉淀为跨会话任务记录，任务↔文件自动关联——开发工作流可切换、可续接，无需重复梳理整个项目。文档与代码符号在读取时索引，无需全量预扫；针对不同语言的项目，支持可选功能增强。经验笔记自动去重，避免重复记录。所有数据召回附带出处可溯源。纯 JS、单依赖、静默运行、零操作成本。

description.en: ChatGPT Subscription - a DeepSeek Harness plugin: bind your ChatGPT account via official OAuth and chat with ChatGPT models inside DSH, using your Plus/Pro subscription quota
description.zh: 绑定 ChatGPT 账号，在 DSH 里直接用你的 Plus/Pro 订阅额度聊天。

description.en: Drive OriginLab Origin scientific plotting from AI chat via MCP. 74 tools: modal-dialog watchdog, LabTalk safety gate, FigureSpec declarative YAML, fit params, matrix tools, matplotlib bridge, PPT assembly, editable OPJU delivery. Windows + Origin 2021+.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 在 AI 对话里驱动 OriginLab Origin 科学绘图与分析：62 个工具。模态对话框看门狗、LabTalk 破坏命令门禁、释放/重连、拟合初值/固定参数/加权、细粒度图与工作表编辑、矩阵工具、FigureSpec 声明式 YAML（可 diff 可重放）、MCP Resources 只读会话快照、matplotlib 图桥接、PowerPoint 组图、Graph Gallery 模板搜索、EPS 导出、文件访问白名单、视觉基准回归，以及带确定性反读验证的可编辑 OPJU 交付。

description.en: Just Jev it. A Jev-first agent loop with reusable actions for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把模型当成工具来调度的 Jev 优先智能体循环，内置可复用动作，让任务自动跑起来。

description.en: DSH 记忆与上下文增强插件：分层记忆、任务与验证、上下文整理及运行监控。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-trisoul_x
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for trisoul_x

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: MuseAI的DeepSeek Harness插件，可以将你的MuseAI角色放进DSH使用啦！
description.zh: 把 MuseAI 角色搬进 DSH，在会话标签栏新增 MuseAI 页签，聊天冒险羁绊一站搞定。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 红头公文插件：两阶段解耦流水线（LLM 结构化提纲 + 确定性 Word 2003 XML 版式渲染）生成标准红头公文
description.zh: 一句话输入事由，自动生成格式标准的红头公文，提纲交给 AI、排版交给模板，省心又规范。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Plugin for Lark Integration
description.zh: 装好后就能在飞书或 Lark 里直接跟 Harness Agent 聊天，模型、工具和会话都沿用原有配置。

description.en: Generate, read, and edit Office files in chat
description.zh: 办公三件套！Office document tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): generate, read, and edit spreadsheets (.xlsx), PDFs, and presentations (.pptx).

description.en: DSH 插件健康检查工具：扫描插件仓库的清单协议 / patch 格式 / 构建陷阱 / hub 收录状态，零依赖只读，注册 plugin_check 工具
description.zh: 插件健康检查：扫描清单协议/patch 格式/构建陷阱，零依赖只读。

description.en: Bind your ChatGPT account via official OAuth and chat with ChatGPT models inside DSH, using your Plus/Pro subscription quota.
description.zh: 通过官方 OAuth 绑定你的 ChatGPT 账号，在 DSH 内直接使用 ChatGPT 模型对话，消耗 Plus/Pro 订阅额度。

description.en: Edit a sent message to rewind and branch the conversation from that turn, switch versions with a counter under the bubble, and browse every branch in a turn-level version tree.
description.zh: 编辑已发送的消息即可从该轮次回溯并分叉对话，用气泡下方的计数器切换版本，并在轮次级版本树中浏览所有分支。

description.en: Coding-subscription OAuth for SuperGrok/Grok Build, ChatGPT Plus Codex, Kimi Code and Claude Code, plus an opt-in loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway: local login without pasting tokens, AUTH refresh-and-retry, grok-4.6 xhigh, and API-key route coexistence.
description.zh: 编码订阅 OAuth，支持 SuperGrok / Grok Build、ChatGPT Plus Codex、Kimi Code、Claude Code，并提供可选 loopback OpenAI/Anthropic 网关：本地登录无需粘贴 token，支持 AUTH 刷新重试、grok-4.6 xhigh，并可与 API-key 路由共存。

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a microphone button in the composer turns speech into a draft transcript, with a choice of speech-recognition backends, optional polish through dsh own LLM routes, and a native settings page.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的语音输入插件：输入框的麦克风按钮把语音转成草稿文本，支持多种语音识别后端，可选经 dsh 自有 LLM 路由润色，并带原生设置页。

description.en: Auto thinking-effort routing for dsh: a locally fine-tuned 7-question classifier (ModernBERT, 842MB, <1s CPU inference) picks low/high/max for no-intent messages; in-session retries escalate the tier (low to high to max) under exclusion constraints; the judge service fails safe to low if unreachable. A tier chip in the input bar shows the live tier and the last 20 judgments. All inference is local - task text never leaves the machine.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动思考档位路由：本地微调的 7 题分类模型（ModernBERT，842MB，CPU 推理 <1s）对无档位指令的消息自动选择 low/high/max；会话内检测到重试自动沿阶梯升档，受「别用 max」类排除约束压制；判定服务不可达时熔断降级，会话不断。前端档位芯片实时显示当前档位与最近 20 轮判断原因。判定全程本地推理，任务文本不出本机。

description.en: Live flowgraph visualization for DeepSeek Harness sessions, including tool calls, parallel groups, subagent branches, and drill-down details.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话实时流程图，可查看工具调用、并行分组、子代理分支和逐层详情。

description.en: Injects a fixed system-reminder at the first step of every turn asking the model to reason and answer in Simplified Chinese, while code, commands, file paths, and identifiers stay in English.
description.zh: 每轮第一步注入固定的 system-reminder，要求模型用简体中文思考与回答，代码、命令、文件路径与标识符保持原文。

description.en: DSH 会话轨迹分析插件：上下文演化、团队协作图、工具错误证据链、智能告警、会话对比与导出，兼作 aeval 评测控制
description.zh: 宿主侧 DSH 评测控制插件：把单次评测试次的变量、预算上限、会话根目录与 fork 血统一次性注入 agent 进程，模型调用经宿主 broker 走网关租约，并写出 schema 版本化的 bundle descriptor 做证据归属。

description.en: HTTP + WebSocket 反向代理：把局域网端口转发到本地 DSH 服务
description.zh: 把局域网端口反向代理到本地 DSH 服务，支持 WebSocket 和 Basic Auth，让别的设备也能访问。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness desktop shell — Tauri v2, tray + native webchat + task-done toasts, single portable exe
description.zh: Windows 托盘桌面壳：自动从 GitHub Releases 安装并升级 exe、创建应用与网页端两个桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在对话中一键启动。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness auth插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上登录鉴权，让反向代理后的智能体服务安全可控。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness balance plugin for the Settings page
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness balance plugin for the Settings page

description.en: Long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): four-channel retrieval fusion and continuous memory evolution. Memory construction and retrieval are based on MemGAS (ICLR 2026).
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上长期记忆，四通道检索融合，越用越懂你。

description.en: Multi-tenant projects & users plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-user symlinked workspaces, login gate, session isolation, workspace-write lock and system-prompt guard
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多租户支持，隔离用户工作区、会话与权限，保障多人安全使用。

description.en: Two-phase agent preset for DeepSeek V4 Pro: the first request sees only bash+read (Minimal-aligned bootstrap), then the full Standard tool catalog after the first tool call or reply; ships as an installer bundle plus a manual preset directory.
description.zh: V4 Pro 两阶段 agent 预设：首轮仅 bash+read 完成极简开局，首个工具调用或回复后恢复 Standard 完整工具目录；以安装器 bundle 与手动预设目录双形态发布。

description.en: PiUI-style diff viewer replacing the stock DiffBlock for write/edit tool calls.
description.zh: PiUI 风格 diff 查看器，替换 write/edit 工具调用的默认 DiffBlock。

description.en: While vibe coding, save an answer you may need later, use Side Chat for a question that suddenly comes up, or open a related conversation for deeper work without losing focus on the current task.
description.zh: Vibe Coding 时，如果突然想到另一个问题，或者看到一段以后还会用到的回答，可以先保存下来、在 Side Chat 里快速问清楚，或另开一个相关会话继续研究，不打断当前任务的开发思路和注意力。

description.en: iLife: one DSH settings card for the iLife home-life suite — memo, calorie, chef, home, schedule and bill in a tab bar — covering every part of your home life.
description.zh: 爱生活-覆盖你居家生活的方方面面。

description.en: SillyTavern-compatible roleplay with character cards, presets, world books, and swipe branches that restore their continuations alongside native DSH conversations.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供兼容 SillyTavern 的角色扮演，支持角色卡、预设、世界书及保留后续对话的 swipe 分支，并可切回原生会话视图。

description.en: One-click optimization of a raw instruction into a professional prompt: three output styles, situation-aware role/task/goal profiling, multi-sample selection scored by a model judge, self-iterating learning (session memory + smart defaults + user overrides), /template for 22 sub-scenes with zero model calls, input-box ✨ one-click optimize/undo, prompt_optimize tool, auto-optimize hook, a runtime status page, a settings panel (dsh 0.2.0) and auto-detected zh/en documents.
description.zh: 把原始指令一键优化为专业提示词——支持三种输出形态、情境感知画像、多采样择优（模型判官评分）、自迭代学习，以及 /template 等命令与一键工具/钩子/状态页/设置面板/自动语言。

description.en: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: `dsh-my-guardian`).
description.zh: 插件治理：新装/更新插件先进候选区，启动完成后热挂载——成功自动转正，失败自动禁用，连续失败冻结，一键安全模式，侧边栏诊断面板（npm: `dsh-my-guardian`）。

description.en: Full-duplex voice mode for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: toggle (2s-pause auto-send) or hold-to-talk dictation into an editable draft with zipformer2 streaming ASR, optional wake word; sentence-by-sentence Edge TTS read-aloud with live captions, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). On-device ASR, no API key.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 全双工语音对话：按钮或 Ctrl+Shift+V 进入，持续聆听（停顿自动发送）或按住说话，zipformer2 流式识别入可编辑草稿、可选唤醒词；回复按句 Edge TTS 朗读并显示实时字幕，开口即打断播放与回合（真 barge-in）；识别模型本地推理、Edge TTS 在线合成，无需 API Key。

description.en: Update management for DeepSeek Harness and its plugins: semver-aware dual-source (npm/GitHub) checks for the main program and every installed plugin, a locale-aware banner (zh/en) listing updatable items, one-click updates (the main program is backed up, integrity-checked and rolled back on failure; plugins install via a temp directory without touching other packages), and a watchdog-guarded restart after updating. The settings page adds per-plugin version lamps, live update progress, and banner/notification toggles.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主程序与插件更新管理：对主程序与每个已装插件做 npm/GitHub Release 双源 semver 比对，GUI 横幅按系统语言（中/英）列出可更新项；一键更新——主程序自动备份、完整性校验、失败回滚，插件经临时目录安装不碰其它包；更新后看门狗自动重启服务。「检查更新」设置页提供逐插件版本状态灯、实时更新进度与横幅/通知开关。

description.en: Streaming-transcript fold for the DSH web UI: thinking and tool rows fold away while the newest thinking window opens itself; a finished turn scrolls back to your question, which also stays pinned at the top while you read; blue sparks fly from the thinking window edge and the answer writing head.
description.zh: 流式折叠：思考与工具行自动折起、最新思考小窗自动展开；一轮结束平滑回到你提的那句话（读到哪一问就钉在顶部）；思考小窗滚动时底边溅蓝色火星，正文写头向四周飘火星。

description.en: Turns local markdown and text documents into a queryable knowledge base with hybrid semantic and keyword search, citation verification, and source injection.
description.zh: 将本地 Markdown 与文本文档转为可检索的知识库，支持语义与关键词混合搜索、引用校验与来源注入。

description.en: Pauses the agent right before it sends the next model request of a tool round while keeping the composer usable: a bare Enter or the resume button lets it continue, and text typed meanwhile is sent along as a steering message; the pause never interrupts an in-flight API call and the model does not notice it.
description.zh: 在模型完成一轮工具交互、正要发出下一次请求之前暂停，输入框保持可用：裸回车或点按钮放行，草稿有字则随本次请求一并发出作为插话；不打断任何在途 API 调用，模型上下文完整、察觉不到暂停。

description.en: Hierarchical workspace tree for the DSH sidebar: every slash in a workspace title becomes a virtual folder (arbitrarily deep), the add-workspace directory flow gains a parent-group popup, renames re-derive the tree instantly, sessions nest on the same rule with separate visual styling, and every row carries right-click actions plus per-row appearance customization (color, text-only glow, font weight, primitives-family icon).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏「工作区」列表的层级树插件：工作区与会话名称中的 / 即虚拟分组（任意多级），添加工作区的目录流附带「所属分组」弹窗，重命名即时重排；每层行均支持右键操作与外观自定义（颜色、文字发光、字体粗细、原版图标库图标）。

description.en: Matt Pocock full promoted skill set (25 SKILL.md: grilling, writing-for-agents, wait-what, TDD, code review, wayfinder, ask-matt router) ported to DSH.
description.zh: Matt Pocock 完整发布技能集（25 个 SKILL.md）的 DSH 移植。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a read-only ledger for the plugins you already have installed — a capability inventory with file:line evidence, declared-vs-detected reconciliation, cross-profile version drift, and a diff of what changed since the last scan.
description.zh: 盘点已装插件的功能清单，标注代码位置，核对声明与实际能力，跨版本追踪变化，让插件管理更透明。

description.en: MCP server manager: Settings page with OAuth (PKCE + dynamic client registration) or static-token auth; tools registered as mcp__<name>__*.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页统一管理 MCP 服务器，支持 OAuth 和静态令牌认证，自动注册工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 多 CLI 智能体侧栏插件：独立对话、账号管理、角色预设与任务续聊
description.zh: 适用于 macOS / Windows 和 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 的多 CLI 智能体侧栏插件，提供任务派遣、实时对话查看、停止与续聊及自定义角色预设。

description.en: Interactive calculators, charts, forms, checklists, simulations and games in DSH replies, with local controls, native artifact expansion, and saved UI state.
description.zh: 在 DSH 回复中呈现可本地操作的计算器、图表、表单、清单、模拟与小游戏，支持原生作品展开和界面状态保存恢复。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-intelligent-ui
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-intelligent-ui

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Official plugin & skill development kit for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Grounded in core runtime contracts for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, and DSH.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 官方插件与技能开发套件，帮你按规范快速开发插件和技能。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives a roleplay character a clock: sleep/wake, greetings, idle actions, proactive small talk, and outing photos.
description.zh: 给角色扮演角色装上生物钟：会睡觉、被吵醒、自己找事做，还会主动找你聊天。

description.en: Synchronizes DSH profiles and local plugin source archives through WebDAV and S3-compatible storage, with encrypted snapshots, conflict-aware recovery, and explicit self-updates.
description.zh: 通过 WebDAV 和兼容 S3 的存储同步 DSH profile 与本地插件源码归档，支持加密快照、冲突感知恢复和显式自更新。

description.en: Mobile client plugin (cordis + dsh.plugin.json).
description.zh: 把 DSH WebUI 适配到手机窄屏，用横向翻页卡片加半开侧边栏，手机上也能顺手操作。

description.en: Browse plugins the way you would browse Steam Workshop
description.zh: 创意工坊式插件浏览器：侧栏常驻入口，搜索/最热/最新/近 7-90 天飙升榜、中文关键词映射、描述与 README 机翻、插件特征验证过滤、一键安装/更新。

description.en: 模型路由与成本优化器：简单问题 flash 直答、故障自动降级、会话 token/缓存/成本实时面板 | Model router & cost optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: flash quick-answers for simple questions, failure fallback, live token/cache/cost panel
description.zh: 模型路由与成本优化器：简单问题 flash 直答、故障自动降级、会话 token/缓存/成本实时面板 | Model router & cost optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: flash quick-answers for simple questions, failure fallback, live token/cache/cost panel

description.en: Ollama provider for DeepSeek Harness with model management, health checks, rule-based local routing, and cloud fallback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Ollama 接入：模型管理、健康检查、基于规则的本地路由与云端回退。

description.en: Cross-device session sync for DeepSeek Harness — syncs sessions and settings between machines through git.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨设备会话同步：经 git 在多机之间同步会话与设置。

description.en: Conversation navigator panel: turn-folded outline of the current session with per-step kind badges (assistant, tool, command, compaction, error), a hover bubble showing the full user question, a minimal mode that hides turn numbers for an all-badge view, keyword filter over user questions and assistant replies, click-to-jump with reading-position tracking, and load-earlier/load-all history paging. Host >= 0.1.2-rc.1; legacy hosts install @legacy/0.2.5.
description.zh: 会话导航面板：按轮折叠的当前会话大纲与步次类型徽标（助手/工具/命令/压缩/出错），悬停气泡显示用户提问全文，可隐藏轮次号的极简徽标视图，仅检索提问与助手回复的关键词过滤，点击跳转与阅读位置跟踪，支持加载更早/加载全部历史分页。宿主 ≥ 0.1.2-rc.1，旧宿主装 @legacy/0.2.5。

description.en: Full-screen terminal client for DeepSeek Harness built on pi-tui: session replay/resume, streaming responses, collapsible tool cards, in-terminal approvals and questions, model/preset/permission/plan/goal management, shell mode, and a trajectory ledger.
description.zh: 基于 pi-tui 的 DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端客户端：会话回放/续接、流式响应、可折叠工具卡片、终端内审批与提问、模型/预设/权限/计划/目标管理、Shell 模式，以及轨迹（trajectory）事件台账。

description.en: Per-subagent LLM provider/model selection with role templates.
description.zh: 子代理 LLM 供应商/模型选择，支持角色模板。

description.zh: 读取网页返回干净正文：中文编码自动识别（GBK/GB2312/UTF-8/Big5）、噪音过滤、紧凑文本/Markdown、offset 续读、可选 SPA 渲染、批量读取与整站爬取。

description.en: Mineradio glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: champagne-gold glass panes, a fluid or wallpaper backdrop, and a one-switch toggle that restores the stock look exactly.
description.zh: Mineradio 玻璃拟态 DSH 网页主题：香槟金玻璃面板、流体或壁纸背景，一键开关即可还原原生界面。

description.en: A study tab with course-map, tutor and blackboard columns that turns markdown files, local folders or GitHub repos into guided courses, with lesson unlocking, mastery tracking, spaced repetition and a tutor-designed course import.
description.zh: 学习页签（课程｜导师｜黑板三栏）：把 markdown 文件、本地文件夹或 GitHub 仓库变成导学课程，提供课时解锁、掌握度追踪、间隔重复和导师设计式课程导入。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Multisim MCP for circuit generation, simulation, diagnostics, design optimization, and experiment report export.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Multisim MCP，用于生成电路、运行仿真、诊断与优化设计，并导出实验报告。

description.en: AI image and video studio as a floating DSH panel, so creation runs alongside the conversation instead of replacing it: text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image composition at 1K-4K across eight aspect ratios; text-to-video and image-to-video with first-frame control at 4-12 seconds; short-drama mode that imports a script (.txt/.md/.json), breaks it into storyboard shots for preview and batch generation; and a prompt-expert workspace. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 一站式 AI 影视创作工作站，作为 DSH 全局浮层面板运行，不占用对话框：生图（文生图 / 图生图 / 多图合成，1K–4K、8 种宽高比）、生视频（文生视频 / 图生视频，4–12 秒、支持首帧控制）、短剧（导入 .txt/.md/.json 剧本自动拆解分镜，故事板预览与批量生成）与提示词专家工作区。零运行时依赖。

description.en: Modifies DSH plugin code at runtime, with ordered patches, inspection, and hot reload.
description.zh: 在运行时修改 DSH 插件代码，并提供 Patch 排序、检查和热重载。

description.en: Interactive terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness: tables, Mermaid and chart rendering, side conversations, and the same Cordis plugin model as dsh Web.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 交互式终端界面：表格、Mermaid 与图表渲染、旁支会话，以及与 dsh Web 相同的 Cordis 插件模型。

description.en: 风插 2.0 — DSH 推理语域锚定预设：两个 agent preset（风插标准/风插 PTC）在 runtime-context 快照头尾各注入一次形式化约束，使推理以第一人称复数展开。定性=硬指令约束（非吸引子）；未证明能力提升，未证明无负面作用。Apache-2.0
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个预设，让模型思考时多说「我们来……」，推理口吻更像团队协作。

description.en: Cleans the harness prompt-authority layer into a reviewable patch set, writes prompt-inject.md and lets each model use a different default prompt, reports which patches took effect and whether the running host loads app.asar or an unpacked tree, and swaps a sealed install to the patched tree once the desktop process is idle. Includes a status page and the dsh-purge CLI.
description.zh: 把 dsh 提示词权威性清洗成可审查的补丁集并写入 prompt-inject.md，可为不同模型选用不同默认提示词，报告哪些补丁已生效、当前进程从 app.asar 还是解包目录加载，并在桌面进程空闲时把密封安装换成已打补丁的解包树。附状态页与 dsh-purge 命令行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 默认 System Prompt 管理插件：在 Web GUI「设置」里浏览、检索并覆盖最终装配进每轮会话的系统提示词
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 默认 System Prompt 管理插件：在 Web GUI「设置」里浏览、检索并覆盖最终装配进每轮会话的系统提示词。

description.en: Factory (Droid) subscription quota as native DSH model providers, with three protocol routes, your own API key through a loopback gateway, and a settings page for connection status, quota, per-model token statistics and key switching.
description.zh: 把 Factory (Droid) 订阅额度接入 DSH 的原生模型 provider：三条协议路由、用你自己的 API key 经本机回环网关认证，并提供设置页查看连接状态、订阅额度、按模型的 token 统计与切换 key。

description.en: A real PowerPoint, not HTML. Tell your AI what to cover and pptwise builds an editable deck on your own machine. Agent skill + DSH plugin, no account and no API key to render. | 真正的 PPT，不是 HTML。跟 AI 说要讲什么，pptwise 在你自己电脑上做出一份能改的 PPT。Agent skill + DSH 插件，不用注册，渲染不用 API key。
description.zh: 让 AI 直接生成可编辑的 PowerPoint 文件，无需账号和 API 密钥，本地即可完成演示文稿制作。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的「便携酒馆」插件：RPG 式 SillyTavern V2/V3 角色卡生成器 + 酒馆角色扮演聊天。支持世界书、角色卡 JSON/PNG 导入导出、面板主题与本地音乐。独立插件，仅依赖官方 @deepseek-ai SDK。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「便携酒馆」插件：RPG 式 SillyTavern V2/V3 角色卡生成器 + 酒馆角色扮演聊天。支持世界书、角色卡 JSON/PNG 导入导出、面板主题与本地音乐。独立插件，仅依赖官方 @deepseek-ai SDK。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 —— 对话式游戏本地化：跟 AI 助手说说话，完成游戏翻译全流程。引擎适配器架构，首发支持 Ren'Py。
description.zh: 跟 AI 助手聊聊天，就能完成 Ren'Py 游戏从侦察、术语到翻译打包的全流程本地化。

description.en: Visual MCP manager for the DSH web UI: inspect, add, remove, enable/disable MCP servers and view their live connection status from Settings → MCP.
description.zh: DSH 网页 MCP 可视化管理插件：在「设置 → MCP」中查看/新增/删除/启停 MCP 服务器，实时显示连接状态与工具数。

description.en: Create and manage sandboxed JavaScript tools with a Monaco editor and model-driven tool lifecycle.
description.zh: 用 Monaco 编辑器创建和管理沙箱化的自定义 JavaScript 工具。

description.en: Bidirectional sticker reactions between user and agent.
description.zh: 用户与 agent 双向表情贴纸互动。

description.en: One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal; the default terminal is chosen by the user in DSH settings.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上统一执行 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL，外加交互式 PTY 终端，默认终端由用户在设置中选择。

description.en: Skills & MCP manager in the DSH web settings: browse/enable/import/delete skills across project and user roots, and manage stdio/streamable-http MCP servers with a real connection (tools registered as mcp__<server>__<tool>, config in ~/.dsh/mcp.json).
description.zh: DSH Web 设置内的技能与 MCP 管理器：在项目级与用户级技能目录间浏览/启用/导入/删除技能，并管理 stdio/streamable-http 的 MCP 服务器（真实连接，工具注册为 mcp__<server>__<tool>，配置存 ~/.dsh/mcp.json）。

description.en: Windows desktop computer-use tools (click, type, key, screenshot) with freshness checks, approval gating, process-identity verification around every action, and a sanitized audit trail.
description.zh: Windows 桌面电脑操作工具（点击、输入、按键、截屏）：每次动作都带新鲜度校验、审批门、进程身份核验与脱敏审计。

description.en: Provides local and remote knowledge bases with project- and session-scoped recall, controlled write-back, and an embedded Web management console.
description.zh: 提供本地与远程知识库，支持项目和会话范围检索、可控回写以及内嵌 Web 管理台。

description.en: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a full tree tab with an optional Better Sidebar view.
description.zh: 可视化分支头脑风暴：为每个方向创建独立 Session，自动处理父子继承、兄弟感知、进展与回传 Handoff，并提供完整树形 Tab 与可选 Better Sidebar 右栏。

description.en: Connects Qoder subscriptions to DeepSeek Harness, supporting Global and China regions, multimodal input, and tool calls.
description.zh: 将 Qoder 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持国际版与中国区、多模态与工具调用。

description.en: Adds an unofficial Antigravity OAuth-backed LLM route, web search, image generation and editing, video understanding, quota status, and DSH Web settings controls.
description.zh: 通过非官方 Antigravity OAuth 通道提供 LLM 路由、网页搜索、图片生成与编辑、视频理解、配额状态和 DSH Web 设置控件。

description.en: MCP bridge that lets ChatGPT Web create, view, continue, and supervise DeepSeek Harness agent sessions and goals while preserving DSH's native approval, sandbox, and workspace security model.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 让 ChatGPT Web 创建、查看、继续和监督 DeepSeek Harness Agent 会话与 Goal，同时保留 DSH 原生的审批、沙箱与工作区安全模型。

description.en: China A-share financial data MCP server for the harness: 11 fin_data__* tools (quotes/K-lines/financials/calendar/special-data/announcements/EDB/reconcile/funds/indices) over THS free official REST (primary) + AKShare (fallback) + Wind (exclusive domains), with observable degradation, context-budget compression (result-side -72.2% measured), and an offline 10-year market-data lake; BYOK.
description.zh: 中国 A 股金融数据 MCP server：11 个 fin_data__* 工具（行情/K线/财务/日历/特色数据/公告/EDB/对账/基金/指数），同花顺免费官方 REST 主干 + AKShare 兜底 + Wind 独家域，降级全程可观测；上下文压缩（实测结果侧 -72.2%）；离线 10 年数据湖；BYOK 零平台密钥。

description.en: Role-play conversations with character cards, in-chat character-card authoring and editing, and image generation through configurable backends.
description.zh: 角色扮演插件：支持角色卡对话、在对话中创作与编辑角色卡，可接入生图后端生成插图。

description.en: 一个设置面板，统一管理 MCP、技能、记忆、子智能体、提示词和归档会话；可自定义搭配场景，一个场景即可切换整个环境；Agent也能帮你操作这个插件。 | One settings panel managing MCP, skills, memory, subagents, prompts and sessions; customize scene combos to switch the whole environment; the Agent can also operate this plugin for you.
description.zh: 一个设置面板，统一管理 MCP、技能、记忆、子智能体、提示词和归档会话；可自定义搭配场景，一个场景即可切换整个环境；Agent也能帮你操作这个插件。

description.en: Terminal-native frontend for DeepSeek Harness with real scrollback; a direct, in-process consumer of Harness capabilities.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端原生 TUI 前端，通过 Harness 能力提供会话、模型、插件、任务、子代理、待办事项和 Provider 配置，并保留真实的终端滚动历史。
