description.en: Chinese novel-writing workbench with chapter briefs, style checks, revision plans and cross-chapter continuity audits, using a bundled local model; also available as an MCP server.
description.zh: 网文作者的本地章节体检工具，16 个工具分析句式、情感和风格，模型本地跑不花 API 钱。

description.en: Archived: continued in Yurzi/dsh-tool-web-enhanced (dsh-web-fetch-enhanced 0.2.0+). Configurable non-public address allowlists for DeepSeek Harness web_fetch (0.1.x)
description.zh: 让 web_fetch 能访问你授权的内网或 Fake-IP 地址，其余安全检查照旧，装完即用。

description.en: Unofficial local meeting transcription for DeepSeek Harness on Apple Silicon macOS
description.zh: 在 Apple Silicon Mac 上本地把会议录音转成文字，不用联网，隐私更放心。

description.en: Make any project AI-agent-ready in one command. Adaptive tech stack detection (7 languages × 14 frameworks × 61 components), auto-generates AGENTS.md, docs skeleton, CI/CD, and testing infrastructure. 一句话让任何项目具备 AI 开发能力。
description.zh: 一条命令让任何项目变成 AI 就绪状态，自动识别技术栈并生成规范文档、CI/CD 和测试基础设施。

description.en: Official Pencil (pen.dev) canvas inside DeepSeek Harness: conversation-bound workspaces, live agent edits, and 7 MCP design tools — headless engine + browser editor.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接打开官方 Pencil 画布，边聊边画，还能用 MCP 设计工具实时协作改图。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 独立社区插件商店：发现、安装并提交经过验证的插件、工具与扩展。 | Independent community plugin directory.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 独立社区插件商店：发现、安装并提交经过验证的插件、工具与扩展。 | Independent community plugin directory.

description.en: Bridge local Qoder / Qoder CN models into DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 Qoder 模型零配置接入 DSH，直接在模型选择器里用你的账号额度。

description.en: 灵梦（Reimu）·博丽神社（东方Project）美化版皮肤：神社昼夜实景背景、灵梦立绘、画框侧边栏与输入框、纸白透明界面 — DeepSeek Harness Web GUI skin
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上东方 Project 博丽神社主题皮肤，昼夜实景背景加灵梦立绘，界面秒变神社风。

description.en: Git-style dot timeline on the right edge of the DSH web UI: one dot per user message, hover for content and metadata (time, turn, duration, TTFT, tokens), click to jump. Also adds a full-session message list, in-session and cross-session search, bookmarks with #msg= deep links, and keyboard navigation.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 右侧的圆点时间轴：每条提问一个圆点，悬停查看内容与元信息（时间、轮次、耗时、TTFT、token），点击即跳转。附带全会话消息列表、站内与跨会话搜索、书签深链接（#msg=）和键盘导航。

description.en: DSH Session Manager: manage conversations, archive/restore, delete safely, open record folders.
description.zh: DSH web plugin: an Archived Sessions manager in Settings — browse archived conversations, expand per-session details (disk usage, downloads, tool usage, lineage, cross-session recall), multi-select and permanently delete.
在 DSH 页面右下角养一只小鲸鱼，实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，重启后自动加载，不用手动操作。

description.en: Zero-dependency browser control: drive a real headless Edge/Chrome over CDP with 8 `pilot_*` tools (navigate/click/type/keys/eval/screenshot) plus a live draggable cockpit panel in the Web GUI - text-first snapshots for text-only models, no Playwright, no API key.
description.zh: 零依赖浏览器操控：agent 通过 CDP 驾驶真实 headless Edge/Chrome（导航/点击/输入/按键/JS/截图，8 个 `pilot_*` 工具），Web GUI 内可拖拽驾驶舱面板实时围观——文本优先快照适配纯文本模型，无需 Playwright、无需 API key。

description.en: Design aesthetics skill pack for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) - keeps vibe-coded websites away from the AI look. 6 styles: dark-saas, apple-minim…
description.zh: 设计审美技能包：6 套风格（暗色 SaaS、苹果极简等），让 vibe-coding 出来的网站告别 AI 味。

description.en: Import SillyTavern/TavernAI character cards and world books, save them as local Markdown lore documents, and generate novel prose from your prompts with the world settings as reference.
description.zh: 导入酒馆（SillyTavern/TavernAI）角色卡与世界书，落地为本地 Markdown 设定文档，激活创作模式后根据用户输入、参考世界书创作小说。

description.en: Role-based LLM retry & fallback strategy
description.zh: 基于角色的模型重试备用策略

description.en: Keyboard-first command palette for the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 键盘优先的命令面板（command palette）。

description.en: Transparent rankings and recommendations for the DSH plugin ecosystem: daily auto-fetched topic data, an open scoring model, and rank/search/recommend tools with a settings-page leaderboard.
description.zh: DSH 插件透明排行与推荐：每日自动抓取 `dsh-plugin` 话题生态，公开评分模型，提供 rank/search/recommend 工具与设置页榜单。

description.en: IDE-style Git panel in the DSH Web GUI: a resident tab with a three-column overview (branch/tag list, searchable commit-history graph, commit detail with changed-file tree and message) and a changes page (stats bar, uncommitted list with per-file stage/unstage/discard, commit box with amend); side-by-side diffs carry lazy highlight.js syntax highlighting, on-demand between-hunk context expansion and word-level intra-line emphasis, with image files shown as before/after panes; plus a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar. Every git command runs as an argv array through the host subprocess service, cwd locked to the repo root.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 里的 IDE 风格 Git 面板：常驻标签页含三栏总览（分支/标签列表、可搜索的提交历史图、含变更文件树与提交信息的提交详情）与变更记录页（统计条、带逐文件暂存/取消/丢弃的未提交列表、含 amend 的提交框）；并排差异带懒加载 highlight.js 语法高亮、块间上下文按需展开与词级行内高亮，图片文件以变更前/后双图对照；另在输入框提供 zsh 风格分支标记。所有 git 命令以 argv 数组经宿主 subprocess 执行、cwd 锁定仓库根。

description.en: File-based cross-session memory: plain Markdown memory files with automatic retrieval injection, format-compatible with Claude Code's CLAUDE.md and memory files, so migrating is a manual file copy.
description.zh: 基于文件的跨会话记忆：纯 Markdown 记忆文件，检索结果自动注入；格式与 Claude Code 的 CLAUDE.md 及记忆文件兼容，迁移即手工复制文件。

description.en: Durable background child agents on the official subagent seam: start from any session, watch progress in the Web UI sidebar, message and interrupt any time, with per-child tool scoping, persona and delegation-depth caps.
description.zh: 官方子代理接缝上的持久化后台子代理：任意会话中启动，Web 侧边栏看进度、随时留言与打断，支持按子代理限定工具、人格与委托深度。

description.en: Two-suit VTuber theme for Joi: Flowers and Library are separate token systems for light and dark, with a standing portrait and a whale girl napping on the headline of the new-session page, two chibi companions above the composer that follow the turn state, a duo sidebar mark, and a context meter shaped as a ripening mandarin; a third card returns the stock DeepSeek look with the plugin still installed.
description.zh: 轴伊 Joi 双衣装主题：Flowers 与 Library 是各自成套的明暗令牌体系，新会话页有立绘与趴在标题上的鲸鱼娘，输入框上方两只 Q 版角色随本回合状态换表情，侧栏字标换成二人合影，上下文占用由一颗渐熟的橘子表示；第三张卡可在保持插件安装的前提下切回 DeepSeek 原生外观。

description.en: A polished floating whale desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with 95 categorized transparent animations, state-aware event reactions, customizable actions and triggers, click interactions, dragging and screen wandering.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的精致悬浮鲸鱼桌宠，拥有 95 个分类透明动画、状态感知事件回应、可自定义动作与触发规则，并支持点击互动、拖拽和屏幕漫游。

description.en: Presents DSH Web as a playable, full-screen first-person Minecraft-style voxel interface—not a color-only skin: users walk through a persistent Three.js block world and access native workspaces, sessions, conversations, tools, model selection, permissions, context information, and the composer through in-world facilities and a workbench.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 直接呈现为可游玩的全屏第一人称 Minecraft 风格体素界面，而非只更换颜色的皮肤：用户可以在可持久化的 Three.js 方块世界中移动，并通过游戏内设施和工作台使用原生工作区、会话、对话、工具、模型选择、权限、上下文信息与输入框。

description.en: Finds potential UX issues in your project: automatically reviews React/TypeScript code, pinpoints each problem, and gives concrete suggestions.
description.zh: 帮你发现项目中可能存在的用户体验问题：自动走查 React/TypeScript 源码，定位问题并给出具体优化建议。

description.en: 通到 QQ：DSH 里的 AI 伙伴和 QQ 双向互通 —— 它说完话自动发到 QQ，你在 QQ 说的话自动转进 DSH（走 OneBot 11 HTTP，NapCat / SnowLuma 都行）
description.zh: 通过 NapCat HTTP 把 DSH 会话和 QQ 双向打通：AI 说完自动发到 QQ，你在 QQ 里说的话自动转进会话。

description.en: The ultimate DeepSeek Harness plugin for referencing anything — one @ menu for commands, skills, files, agent sessions, cloud drives, DSH sessions, and web chatbot conversations. | 最强的 DeepSeek Harness 万物引用插件——一个 @ 菜单，统一引用命令、Skills、文件、Agent 会话、云盘、DSH 会话及网页端 Chatbot 对话。
description.zh: 从 DSH 统一的 @ 菜单中引用工作区文件、DSH 会话，以及 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Grok 和 Kimi 的历史对话。

description.en: Incremental file mounting with read dedupe: mounted line ranges are never re-sent to the model, on-disk changes invalidate and remount, with a Mounted Files tab and token-savings accounting.
description.zh: 文件增量挂载，重复内容不再重发，磁盘变更自动更新，省 token 还能看账本。

description.en: Engineering workflow system for AI coding agents — mandatory planning, TDD, verification, review, and intelligent codebase graph analysis.
description.zh: 把 AI 编程助手变成规范工程流程：强制规划、TDD、验证、评审，还能分析代码库图谱。

description.en: Continual self-evolution plugin for DeepSeek Harness: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state refined from session trajectories, with a benchmark-driven validation loop.
description.zh: 持续自进化：从会话轨迹沉淀版本化、可审计、可回滚的 harness 状态（提示词/记忆/技能/子代理规格），带审查门禁与技能热加载。

description.en: DSH ChatGPT Free bridges standard ChatGPT Web directly into DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 基于免费 ChatGPT 网页端（GPT 5.6 Luna）的 DeepSeek Harness 零成本对话模型提供者，支持流式 Markdown。

description.en: Registers the fnOS CLI Skill and provides a matching CLI for fnOS device operations. For first sign-in, the user authorizes access in a browser and sends a one-time code back to the Agent; no interactive terminal is required.
description.zh: 注册 fnOS CLI Skill 并提供匹配版本的 CLI，用于管理 fnOS 设备；首次登录由用户在浏览器授权后，将一次性 code 回传 Agent，无需交互式终端。

description.en: A UX enhancement pack for the DSH web chat: one plugin that collects small interface conveniences, each with its own switch under Settings → UX Plus applied immediately — chat-area font size and reading width under Settings → General → Chat area, a session-row menu that copies the session ID or inherits the conversation into a new session on a chosen model, workspace and session rows ordered by recent activity with 24-hour idle auto-collapse and age labels, and settled ask_user_question cards left expanded. The switch list is generated from its own feature registry, so the pack grows as conveniences are added instead of being fixed at a count.
description.zh: DSH Web 对话界面的 UX 增强包：一个插件持续收纳各种界面小改进，每项都有独立开关，位于 设置 → UX Plus，改动即时生效——对话字号与阅读宽度（设置 → 通用 → 对话区）、会话行菜单可复制会话 ID 或把当前对话继承到所选模型的新会话里继续、工作区与会话行按最近活跃排序（闲置超过 24 小时自动收起并显示上次更新时间）、已结束的提问卡片默认展开。开关列表由插件自身的功能注册表生成，功能会持续增加，不固定在某个数量。

description.en: DSH 插件:直接复用 Codex CLI 本地登录订阅凭证,在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT 订阅模型,无需 API Key | DSH plugin: reuse your Codex CLI local subscription login to use ChatGPT subscription models in DeepSeek Harness, no API key required
description.zh: 复用 Codex CLI 的本地登录凭证，在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接调用 ChatGPT 订阅模型，免 API Key。

description.en: Command Code Go API provider for dsh. Command Code 订阅 + DeekSeek Harness 兼容层
description.zh: 让 dsh 直接接入 Command Code Go 订阅，不用额外配置就能调用其 API 模型。

description.en: Codex-style Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: the official window2 13-method desktop surface plus Chromium automation, a visible overlay with Esc interrupt, per-app approvals and bundled skills. Windows, MIT, no Codex required.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控 Windows 桌面应用和 Chromium 浏览器，还能随时按 Esc 打断。

description.en: Dual manager for DSH — MCP servers (add/edit/enable/disable/restart/delete from Settings UI, JSON import/export, four mcp_manager_* model tools, gated local HTTP API) and Skills (enable/disable panel with persistence and live HMR).
description.zh: DSH 双管理器——MCP 服务管理（设置页新增/编辑/启停/重启/删除、JSON 导入导出、4 个 mcp_manager_* 模型工具、带闸门的本地 HTTP API）+ Skills 技能管理（启停面板、持久化、HMR 即时生效）。

description.en: One-click restart of the DSH service from Settings → General. A dsh-plugin for DeepSeek Harness; the restart row stays pinned at the bottom of the general settings page.  在设置 → 通用设置中一键重启 DSH 服务。DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh-plugin，重启行固定显示在通用设置页面最底部。
description.zh: 在设置→通用设置中一键重启 DSH 服务，重启按钮固定在页面底部，方便快捷。

description.en: Security-audit methodology skill pack plus the plugin_vet supply-chain gate: eight agent skills (secret scan, dependency audit, supply-chain review, prompt-injection review, audit orchestration, threat modeling, vuln intel, incident response) in Chinese and English editions, with an npm provider bundle that mounts the skills and registers the automated plugin_vet pre-install scanner.
description.zh: 安全审计方法论技能包 + plugin_vet 供应链门禁：八个 agent 技能（密钥扫描、依赖审计、供应链评审、提示注入审查、审计总编排、威胁建模、漏洞情报、事件响应），中英双版本，附 npm provider 包一键挂载并注册自动化 plugin_vet 安装前扫描。

description.en: Adds an Execution graph conversation-view tab that renders each turn's prompts, replies, and tool calls/results as a foldable timeline with a detail panel and PNG export.
description.zh: 在会话视图中新增「执行图」标签页，把每个轮次的提问、模型回复与工具调用/结果渲染为可折叠的时间轴，并带详情面板与 PNG 导出。

description.en: Twenty-one official HyperFrames by HeyGen skills synced from the official upstream (HTML video authoring, animation, keyframes, audio/music-to-video, CLI, registry, slideshow, talking-head recut, website/product/PR-to-video, Studio timeline conventions and more), plus a bundled-resource health check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 同步 HyperFrames by HeyGen 官方上游的二十一技能：HTML 写视频/动画/关键帧/音频与音乐转视频/CLI/注册表/幻灯片/口播重剪/网址·产品·PR 转视频/Studio 时间轴规范等，附随包资源完整性自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Token-cost pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: pressure-aware layered compaction (lossless projection below 40% context pressure, LLM summarization above), per-agent tool allowlisting, long-text-to-image with vision summarization, and a /token-status command tracking pressure, tiers, and saved tokens.
description.zh: token 优化管道：按上下文压力分层压缩（40% 以下无损投影、以上 LLM 摘要）、按 agent 裁剪工具列表、长文本转图片视觉摘要、/token-status 查看压力与节省量。

description.en: Terminal-style input history for the web composer: edge-first arrow-key recall with exact draft/caret restore, browser-local persisted history, Ctrl+R reverse search, and sliding-context awareness; 0.5.0 adds a smart input layer — cross-session snippets (/save, /load), prompt templates with variables, reuse insights, and compaction-summary highlighting.
description.zh: Web 作曲器终端风格输入历史：边缘优先的方向键召回并精确还原草稿与光标、浏览器本地持久化历史、Ctrl+R 反向搜索，以及滑动上下文感知；0.5.0 再加智能输入层——跨会话片段库（/save、/load）、带变量的提示词模板、复用洞察与压缩摘要高亮。

description.en: Computer use for Windows: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, clipboard and window tools with per-app access that goes through DSH approval; while the agent is in control the screen shows an orange glow and a status bar, and Esc pauses or resumes.
description.zh: Windows 电脑控制：截图、鼠标、键盘、剪贴板和窗口工具，按应用授权并经 DSH 审批；操控期间屏幕显示橙色光晕和提示条，按 Esc 暂停或继续。

description.en: Provider-independent DSH document parsing powered by MinerU, with native background jobs, immutable results, and safe request coalescing.
description.zh: 基于 MinerU 的统一文档解析，支持自托管与官方云双 Provider、DSH 原生后台任务、不可变产物缓存与请求合并。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH: conversations auto-distilled into atomic facts, scene summaries and a persona profile, with relevant memories injected before every model step. Zero-config out of the box — hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, optional offline local embeddings, chat/work family separation.
description.zh: dsh 长期记忆：对话自动蒸馏为原子事实、场景摘要与用户画像，每步模型调用前自动注入相关记忆。开箱零配置——BM25 + 向量混合检索，可选本地离线嵌入，chat/work 双族隔离。

description.en: A Claude Code-style reasoning-effort slider for the DSH Web UI: stepless drag, snap-on-release, a WebGL fire trail, and real, working thinking-effort control for any custom third-party model or provider.
description.zh: 仿 Claude Code 的推理等级滑块：无极拖动、松手吸附、WebGL 火焰跟随，任何自定义第三方模型/提供商都能获得真实生效的思考强度调节。

description.en: Unified MCP, skill and expert management board for DeepSeek Harness: connection status, tool schemas, enable/disable and reconnect for MCP servers across global and per-project scopes, enable/disable of SKILL.md skills, attach/switch/detach WorkBuddy expert personas in any conversation at any time (429 experts) with no mid-session preset lock, a tool tailor that scans local session logs for per-tool call counts, error rates and context-token cost with one-click disabling, and three install markets (SkillHub 190k+ skills, WorkBuddy connectors, 47 verified built-in services).
description.zh: Skill + MCP + 专家统一看板：MCP 服务器连接状态、工具 Schema、启停与重连（全局与项目双作用域）、SKILL.md 技能启停、WorkBuddy 专家人设可在任意会话随时挂上 / 更换 / 取消（429 位，不受「会话已开始就不能换」的限制）、工具裁缝（扫描本机会话日志统计每个工具的调用次数、错误率与上下文 token 税，死工具一键禁用），以及三大安装市场（SkillHub 19 万+ 技能、WorkBuddy 连接器、47 个一手核实的内置服务）。

description.en: Preset engineering workflows for DeepSeek Harness: a dev_task tool that gates stage transitions, artifacts, verification, review and commit scope, plus a web workbench for installing project or user skills and rules.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供预设工程流程：dev_task 工具把阶段流转、产物、验证、审核与提交范围做成硬门禁，并带一个安装项目级与个人级技能和规则的工作台。

description.en: Offline-first UI/UX design intelligence library for DeepSeek Harness: design_recommend, design_review and design_search tools with a built-in database of 84 design styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 99 UX guidelines, 25 chart types and 22 tech stacks, Chinese-first with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供离线可用的 UI/UX 设计智能库：内置 84 种设计风格、192 个配色、74 组字体、99 条 UX 规范、25 种图表与 22 个技术栈，提供 design_recommend / design_review / design_search 三个工具，中文优先、零运行依赖。

description.en: Reuses the Codex CLI ChatGPT login as an `openai-codex` LLM route and adds GPT Auth controls to DSH Web settings.
description.zh: 复用 Codex CLI 的 ChatGPT 登录态注册 `openai-codex` LLM 路由，并在 DSH Web 设置中提供 GPT Auth 控件。

description.en: Review agent file changes as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab or chat turn-tail row — line-level diffs and undo.
description.zh: 把 agent 的文件改动审查放进 dsh-better-sidebar 侧边栏 Tab 或对话尾部行，支持行级 diff 与撤销。

description.en: Plugin-tree terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness — streaming markdown transcript, tool cards, fuzzy slash commands, and live theming, with every component a hot-swappable Cordis plugin.
description.zh: 插件树式终端界面：流式 markdown 会话流、工具卡片、模糊命令补全与主题热切换，每个界面组件都是可热替换的 Cordis 插件。

description.en: Command deck for DeepSeek Harness: a live session rail and team roster, a task board with approvals and write actions, an activity stream, and a desktop HUD capsule that follows the working conversation. The HUD capsule is Windows-only.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 指挥台：会话栏与编队看板、带审批与写操作的任务板、实时流，以及跟随运行中对话的桌面 HUD 胶囊（仅 Windows）。

description.en: DSH 字体插件：中英文字体分设、正文字号与代码字号、字距/行距/段距/首行缩进四根滑块，吸底总预览 + 确认制，配置写回 profile，不动 app.asar。
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面换中英文字体、调字号和行距，吸底预览确认后写回配置，重启不丢。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地图像生成插件（优化版）：经本机 ComfyUI 调用 Qwen-Image 2.1 生成图像，全部流量限于 127.0.0.1。本版增强推理性能、NVIDIA/Intel/AMD 显卡适配与 Windows/Linux 兼容。原作者 @奇迹与你，优化版 @yanfei0725。
description.zh: 在对话里直接用本机 ComfyUI 跑 Qwen-Image 2.1 画图，文生图图生图都行，数据不出本机。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness原生风格提示音插件
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Official DingTalk connector for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 智能体接入钉钉，通过 Stream 连接直接在钉钉里远程操控和对话。

description.en: Ramify 是 DeepSeek Harness 的创意分支画布插件，用树状工作区生成、对比和迭代多个可交互方案。
description.zh: 在树状画布上生成、对比和迭代多个方案，让创意分支一目了然。

description.en: 更好的右键：DeepSeek Harness 应用封装端的完整原生风格上下文菜单
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面封装端换上原生风格右键菜单，操作更顺手、体验更统一。

description.en: dsh session IDs for opencode, zero config.
description.zh: 给 opencode 加上 dsh 会话 ID，零配置即装即用，方便追踪和复用会话。

description.en: A safety gate for DeepSeek Harness: a stronger model reviews dangerous tool calls before they run. Plus vision and 67 models from one wallet, paid per request over x402.
description.zh: A safety gate for DeepSeek Harness: a stronger model reviews dangerous tool calls before they run. Plus vision and 67 models from one wallet, paid per request over x402.

description.en: File explorer plugin for DeepSeek Harness: file tree, preview, markdown, syntax highlighting, in-panel editing, VS Code integration - DeepSeek Harness 全局文件资源管理器插件
description.zh: File explorer plugin for DeepSeek Harness: file tree, preview, markdown, syntax highlighting, in-panel editing, VS Code integration - DeepSeek Harness 全局文件资源管理器插件

description.en: Ported from the ARS Claude Code plugin (44k+ stars on GitHub): academic research skills for DeepSeek Harness — a deep-research agent team, a paper-writing pipeline, a multi-perspective peer-review panel, and an end-to-end orchestrator, plus sixteen /ars-* commands.
description.zh: 移植自 ARS Claude Code 插件（GitHub 44k+ stars）：面向 DeepSeek Harness 的学术研究技能套件——深度调研 agent 团队、论文写作流水线、多视角同行评审小组与端到端编排器，外加十六个 /ars-* 命令。

description.en: Hello Kitty-styled task-completion and question alerts for DSH Web, bundled with an optional light/dark pink Skin Center v2 theme and local install scripts.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 Hello Kitty 风格任务完成与待回答提醒插件，附带可选的粉色明暗双主题 Skin Center v2 皮肤及本地安装脚本。

description.en: Free vision bridge and image generation for text-only models: paste-image reading, GLM-4V-Flash and Gemini engine failover, ModLens-style structured evidence, and a seeded free vision model route.
description.zh: 面向纯文本模型的免费视觉桥与生图：粘贴读图、GLM-4V-Flash 与 Gemini 引擎故障转移、modlens 同款结构化证据输出，并自动播种免费视觉模型路由。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin powered by markstream-react for resilient streaming Markdown, Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, and safe renderer fallback.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页版提供流畅的流式 Markdown 渲染，支持 Mermaid 图表、KaTeX 公式，并自带安全降级方案。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上「眼睛」和「画笔」——免费读图 + 免费生图 Skill。Eyes & brush for DeepSeek Harness: free image reading & generation. 👁️🎨
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上「眼睛」和「画笔」——免费读图 + 免费生图 Skill。Eyes & brush for DeepSeek Harness: free image reading & generation. 👁️🎨

description.en: Gives text-only models vision: forwards user images to an OpenAI-compatible vision model and shows the descriptions in a Web UI right panel.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型装上眼睛：把用户图片转发给任意 OpenAI 兼容的视觉模型生成描述，并在 Web UI 右侧面板展示结果。

description.en: Cross-platform file drag-and-drop with raw path insertion, no file copying.
description.zh: 跨平台文件拖拽与原始路径插入，无需复制文件。

description.en: Focused-chat minimal session view
description.zh: 「聚焦会话」精简会话视图

description.en: Custom modes / assistant manager: give each mode its own system prompt in the settings page — a custom prompt that is a plain file the agent loop re-reads before every model step, so an edit applies to the running session on its next step — and start it from the official standard / PTC / minimal / Cordis composition, toggling the plugin rows it mounts one by one (a custom plugin composition per mode), renaming it as you like. Several assistants coexist with their own prompts, so one machine can keep a coding assistant, a chat companion and a roleplay (RP) persona side by side — a multi-agent setup you pick from per new session. Rows left untouched stay byte-identical to the shipped ones, platform conditions included.
description.zh: 自定义模式管理器 / 多助手管理器：在设置页里给每个模式写一份自己的系统提示词——自定义提示词就是普通文件，agent loop 每次模型调用前重新读取，改完对正在运行的会话下一步即生效；模式以官方 standard / PTC / 极简 / Cordis 的组成为底子，可逐行开关它挂载哪些插件，等于每个模式一份自定义插件组合，也能改模式名。多个助手可并存、各有各的提示词，所以一台机器上可以同时留一个编码助手、一个聊天搭子、一个角色扮演（RP）人格，新建会话时挑一个。没碰过的行与出厂行逐字节相同（含平台条件）。

description.en: Turns an article in the DSH conversation into an Excalidraw canvas in a session tab: the Agent drafts the structure with diagram_create, you edit labels, nodes and layout with autosave, export PNG, SVG or .excalidraw, and the Agent reads your edited canvas back with diagram_read. 0.6 adds an editable classification overview plus a complete detail index for large three-level trees.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话中的文章整理成会话内的 Excalidraw 画布：Agent 用 diagram_create 起草结构，你在画布中修改文字、节点和布局并自动保存，可导出 PNG、SVG 或 .excalidraw，Agent 再用 diagram_read 读回你改过的画布。0.6 新增大型三层分类树的可编辑总览与完整明细索引。

description.en: DFY DSH 对话外观设置：调节回复行距与过程行距，并扩展本地文件的打开方式。

Voice input for the web UI: dictation chunked by pauses and voice messages, each with its own provider fallback chain (Deepgram, Groq, HuggingFace, local whisper.cpp, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
description.zh: Web UI 语音输入：按停顿分段的听写与语音消息，各自拥有独立的服务商回退链（Deepgram、Groq、HuggingFace、本地 whisper.cpp 或 OpenAI 兼容接口）。

description.en: Installs Herta as a DeepSeek Harness agent: a preset carrying her persona and memory prompt sections, six memory and voice tools, a narrative layer that separates her thinking from what she says, 80 bundled voice clips, offline and MiniMax speech synthesis, and two conversation views that render the session with her own components.
description.zh: 把 Herta（黑塔）作为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体装入：携带人格与记忆提示词段的 preset、六个记忆与语音工具、区分内心与发言的叙述层、80 条随包语音、本地与 MiniMax 两条语音合成链路，以及两个用她自己的组件渲染会话的对话视图。

description.en: Task reliability: auto-retry on model timeouts/failures, auto-continue unfinished tasks, completion verification, thinking-repeat interruption, resume after sleep or restart, autopilot mode and a remote trigger endpoint (npm: `dsh-task-reliability`).
description.zh: 任务可靠性：模型超时/请求失败自动重试、任务未完成自动继续、独立完成度校验、思考重复检测打断、休眠/重启后任务自动恢复、自主决策模式、远程触发接口（npm: `dsh-task-reliability`）。

description.en: HarmonyOS device bridge: hdc screenshot/install/log/crash/UI automation loop with read_image, official-first versioned API knowledge (SDK .d.ts + offline bundled docs), and a DevEco CLI build/sign/lint lane.
description.zh: 鸿蒙设备桥：hdc 截图/装包/日志/崩溃/UI 自动化闭环（配 read_image 看图），官方优先版本化 API 知识层（SDK .d.ts + 离线随包文档），以及 DevEco CLI 构建/签名/lint 通道。

description.en: DSH sidebar file-activity tab: records file reads/creates/modifies by the agent and the sidebar (including file ops hidden inside bash commands), per-session isolation, survives restarts, click a file for a floating preview (npm: `dsh-file-activity`).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏文件活动页签：记录 agent 与侧边栏的文件读取/新增/修改事件（含 bash 命令中隐含的文件操作），按会话隔离、重启后恢复，点击文件浮窗预览（npm: `dsh-file-activity`）。

description.en: A web theme recreating the DeepSeek Harness homepage with a fluid background, an elastic pointer grid, animated fish, and adjustable effects.
description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Harness 首页视觉的 Web 主题，提供流体背景、鼠标弹性网格、动态小鱼与可调节效果。

description.en: Adds a generate_image tool backed by the FAL queue, any OpenAI-compatible images API, or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription, and shows the result inline in the conversation.
description.zh: 提供 generate_image 工具，可接入 FAL 队列、任意 OpenAI 兼容图像 API 或 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅，并在对话中内联显示结果。

description.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with native identities based on the open Agent Network Protocol (ANP), plus identity-based direct, group, mail, and Agent-to-Agent communication.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供基于开放协议ANP的原生身份，以及基于该身份的私聊、群聊、邮件和智能体间通信能力。

description.en: Live-tune the DSH Web conversation UI from Settings: message font size, Claude Desktop-style markdown tables, dialog width, an optional timeline rail, and a GitBar with branch management, per-file diff, and commit & push.
description.zh: 从设置面板实时调教 DSH 网页对话界面：消息字体大小、Claude Desktop 风格 Markdown 表格、对话框宽度、可选时间线侧栏，以及带分支管理、逐文件 Diff 和提交推送功能的 GitBar。

description.en: Login gate for the dsh web surface: password or shared-token authentication, session cookies, rate limiting, and a user-management CLI (dsh.bundle manifest since 0.4.1, one-command `dsh plugin add` mounting).
description.zh: DSH 网页端登录门插件：账号口令或共享令牌认证、会话 cookie、登录限速，附用户管理 CLI（0.4.1 起声明 dsh.bundle manifest，`dsh plugin add` 一键挂载）。

description.en: Scheduled cron tasks, background automation and agent execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供定时任务、后台自动化与 Agent 执行。

description.en: Session-bound persistent TypeScript REPL for DSH PTC mode: bindings and imports stay live across run_code calls, edit_run_code replaces one line without resending the block, module import/export syntax is adapted via AST rewriting, and durable bindings are restored from the session journal after a cold restart.
description.zh: 把 DSH PTC 模式的顶层 run_code 变成会话绑定的持久 TypeScript REPL：变量与导入在多次 run_code 调用间保持可用，edit_run_code 只替换一行而无需重发整段，import/export 模块语法经 AST 改写适配，持久绑定在冷重启后由会话日志恢复。

description.en: Password + TOTP two-factor authentication gateway for the dsh web UI: every HTTP request and WebSocket upgrade is refused until login, with per-source lockout, global rate limits and one-time backup codes.
description.zh: 为 dsh web 提供密码与 TOTP 双因素认证网关：登录前拦截全部 HTTP/WebSocket 请求，含按来源锁定、全局限流与一次性备份代码。

description.en: Voice I/O for DeepSeek Harness — speech-to-text and text-to-speech over the microphone and audio output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的语音输入输出：麦克风语音转文字与文字转语音。

description.en: Browser notifications and a beep when a session turn ends, the agent asks a question or approval is pending; clicking the notification jumps to the session; remote trigger endpoint and SSE channel (npm: `dsh-my-notify`).
description.zh: 会话（本轮）结束 / agent 询问 / 等待审批时弹浏览器通知 + 滴声，点击通知跳转会话；预留远程触发接口与 SSE 实时通道（npm: `dsh-my-notify`）。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：到点主动开口 —— 五道闸（间隔／安静／未回话上限／静默时段）过了就挑一条开口，优先投进活跃会话，投不进发系统通知 ＋ 写日志。MIT。
description.zh: 到点主动开口的 DSH 插件，四道闸把关后挑话题，优先投进活跃会话，投不进就发系统通知并记日志。

description.en: 仿 Claude Code 推理等级滑块 支持第三方模型 DSH 插件
description.zh: 在模型菜单里一键拖动滑块，像 Claude Code 那样自由调节推理深度，平衡速度与质量。

description.en: 我要成为Galgame高手！！将你的Vibe coding界面修改成为Galgame的样子，在不影响工作的情况下和赏心悦目的DeepSeek娘进行友好互动
description.zh: 我要成为Galgame高手！！将你的Vibe coding界面修改成为Galgame的样子，在不影响工作的情况下和赏心悦目的DeepSeek娘进行友好互动

description.en: 在 dsh 网页中编辑 ComfyUI、实时预览并让 AI 操作工作流。
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页里直接编辑 ComfyUI 工作流，实时预览生图，还能让 AI 帮你改提示词、调参数、跑图。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动审批功能，设计偏保守，安全
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin for rule-gated automatic sandbox approval with optional LLM review, one-time grants, fixed high-risk checks, and native human fallback.

description.en: Configurable DSH-native LLM verifier with a Web settings page
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一个可配置的独立裁判模型，自动复核回答质量，还能在网页上调整设置。

description.en: A typed, inference-capable ontology (TBox + ABox) plugin for DeepSeek Harness — durable domain knowledge the agent declares, asserts against, and queries under schema constraints.
description.zh: 给智能体一套带类型和推理能力的领域知识库，能声明、断言并受约束地查询知识。

description.en: Third-party TUI mode for DeepSeek Harness (dsh --profile pi-tui), built on a vendored pi-tui fork: covers the main session loop plus approvals, commands, session switching and full-text search, as well as presets, skills, model/settings menus and slash commands.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 TUI 模式（dsh --profile pi-tui），基于内置 pi-tui fork 构建：覆盖主会话循环（审批、命令、会话切换与全文搜索），以及预设、技能、模型/设置菜单与斜杠命令。

description.zh: DSH 音乐/小说播放器：在网页里听本地音乐（HTTP 流式）、用 AI 声音朗读本地小说（.txt/.epub）、播放在线 QQ/酷狗/网易云音乐与网络电台（支持 HLS 直播流）、定时播报每日新闻；可在面板操作，也可让 agent 通过 music_play 工具直接点播。

description.zh: AI 驱动的智能爬虫，能逆向 JavaScript 加密逻辑，自动生成可验证的参数求解器。

description.en: Per-request thinking budgets, a compaction backend, and a settings tab for the local Qwen3.8 line (llama.cpp or NInfer).
description.zh: 本地 Qwen3.8 线（llama.cpp 或 NInfer）的逐请求 thinking 预算、压缩后端与设置 tab。

description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面换背景，支持预设、纯色、渐变、图片和视频，滚轮拖动调缩放定位，还能开毛玻璃。

description.zh: Role-based Codex / Claude Code / ACP subagent providers for the DeepSeek Harness — continuable children, durable session recovery, per-role product permissions, and delegation with a permission ceiling.

description.en: Pi-style append-only multi-branch session trees: fork or jump to any historical node without deleting history, clone a branch into a new session, and browse the tree in a WebUI panel. Works on stock Harness via graceful degradation.
description.zh: Pi 风格的追加式多分支会话树:在任意历史节点开分支或跳转而不删除旧历史,可将分支克隆为新会话,并在 WebUI 树面板中浏览(明暗主题)。在原版 Harness 上优雅降级运行。

description.zh: 在设置页直接管理 MCP 服务器，增删改查、启停都即时生效，不用重启宿主。

description.zh: 把自然语言变成原生交互式 ECharts 和 Mermaid 图表，让数据可视化随手就来。

description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Particle-network background overlay for the DSH Web shell: full-screen, click-through, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供粒子网络动态背景：全屏覆盖、点击穿透、零运行时依赖。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: one-click ✨ polish for composer drafts — flash rewrite, auto fill-back · DeepSeek Harness 插件：输入框草稿一键 ✨ 润色，flash 改写、自动回填
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: one-click ✨ polish for composer drafts — flash rewrite, auto fill-back · DeepSeek Harness 插件：输入框草稿一键 ✨ 润色，flash 改写、自动回填

description.en: 量子计算最佳实践 Quantum Algorithms Best Practices
description.zh: 把量子算法开发的最佳实践打包成技能，让 AI 助手帮你写出更靠谱的量子计算代码。

description.en: Fixes the bug where your account can't lose money while you code.
description.zh: 有效解决了写代码的时候账户不能同时亏钱的 BUG。

description.en: Per-call cache billing inside the context-meter popover: current step, round and session totals with hit/miss/output tokens and amounts, automatic Beijing working-hour peak/off-peak pricing, per-model rates, and third-party relays billed too.
description.zh: 在上下文圆环弹层里实时算账：当前步、当前轮、会话累计三块明细，缓存命中/未命中/输出各带 token 与金额，官方峰谷价与模型分价自动判定，第三方中转照常记账。

description.en: Find DSH plugins across several community catalogs plus live GitHub and npm search, ranked by relevance, trust, freshness and bounded popularity instead of stars alone.
description.zh: 跨多个社区目录并叠加 GitHub 与 npm 实时搜索来找 DSH 插件，按相关度、可信度、新鲜度与有界热度排序，而不是只看 star。

description.en: Conversation rendering: every fenced block is rendered by the plugin itself (markdown for text fences, language-banner code blocks with highlight.js for others), mermaid fences become zoomable diagram cards, plus context-body rendering, whole-content copy and a MarkdownView export (npm: `dsh-md-render`).
description.zh: 对话渲染：围栏块由插件自身渲染（text 家族按 markdown，其余为真实语言名 banner + highlight.js 高亮的代码块），mermaid 块渲染为可缩放图表卡片，另支持上下文注入块渲染、整段复制与 MarkdownView 导出（npm: `dsh-md-render`）。

description.en: Ponytail lazy senior dev mode: 6 skills adapted from DietrichGebert/ponytail.
description.zh: Ponytail 最懒资深工程师模式：6 个技能，改编自 DietrichGebert/ponytail。

description.en: Memory in global and per-project scopes: memories are injected into the system prompt at session start, a settings panel edits them with confirmation on write, and the agent gets a read-only memory_query tool (npm: `dsh-my-memory`).
description.zh: 全局 / 项目两级记忆：会话开始时把记忆注入系统提示词，设置页面板支持新增 / 修改 / 删除（写操作需确认），并为 agent 提供只读查询工具 memory_query（npm: `dsh-my-memory`）。

description.en: Free model provider plugin for DSH with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.
description.zh: DSH free model provider plugin with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.

description.en: Skill management: lists skills in global and per-project scopes and toggles each one per project; a disabled skill is not injected into that session (npm: `dsh-my-skill-manager`).
description.zh: Skill 管理：按全局 / 项目两个范围查看 skill 列表，并按项目启用或禁用；被禁用的 skill 不会注入该会话（npm: `dsh-my-skill-manager`）。

description.en: Context lens: visualizes token usage of every request (context composition, KV cache hit rate) and enforces per-turn / per-session budgets with warning and blocking (npm: `dsh-my-context`).
description.zh: 上下文透镜：可视化每次请求的 token 用量（上下文构成、KV 缓存命中率），并提供每轮 / 每会话预算控制（超限提醒与拦截）（npm: `dsh-my-context`）。

description.en: Zero-dependency, event-driven voice announcement plugin: no extra model, no token cost. Speaks with the system's built-in natural voice, supporting both Windows and macOS; final-reply announcements, approval & question alerts, optional event announcements (turn end, command done, goal change, tool errors, todo updates), replayable final replies, and a bilingual visual settings page.
description.zh: 零外部依赖、事件驱动、无需额外模型、不消耗任何 token的语音播报插件。使用系统自带自然语音进行播报，支持win/mac双平台；最终回复、审批与提问提醒、可选事件播报（回合结束/命令完成/目标变更/工具出错/待办更新）、最终回复可重播、双语言可视化设置。

description.en: Observability and git tooling: a persistent cross-session event audit log with a query API, a resource watchdog sidebar panel, structured Conventional Commits and pre-commit incremental diff review (npm: `dsh-my-observability`).
description.zh: 可观测性与 Git 工程工具：跨会话持久化的事件审计日志与查询 API、资源看门狗侧边栏面板、结构化 Conventional Commits 提交、提交前增量 diff 审查（npm: `dsh-my-observability`）。

description.en: Pools every WorkBuddy account signed in on this machine into one auto-failing-over provider, serving OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages from the same pool, with model aliases, usage statistics and scheduled credit automation.
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 账号汇成一个自动故障转移的模型池，同一池子对外提供 OpenAI Chat、OpenAI Responses 与 Anthropic Messages 三种协议，并支持模型别名、用量统计与积分自动化。

description.en: Heartbeat loop for DeepSeek Harness: every 20 minutes (by default) the agent wakes on its own to keep a local profile of your interests and preferences, search the web for things you care about, and keep what it finds. When it has something worth sharing, it sends a short package of notes to the sessions you link it to. A set of rules in code - quiet hours, busy windows, a daily limit, a cooldown - decides whether it may speak at all, and the agent in that session decides whether to actually say anything. Windows only.
description.zh: 心跳循环：默认每 20 分钟自己醒一次——维护一份关于你兴趣与偏好的本地画像，按你设的兴趣范围上网搜新东西并存下来。攒到值得分享的内容，就向你绑定的会话送一份简短的素材包。能不能开口由代码里的规则决定（静默时段、忙时窗口、每日上限、冷却），说不说由那个会话里的 agent 自己判断。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Native iOS and Android apps for remote control of DeepSeek Harness, with end-to-end encryption, workspace browsing, and real-time session updates.
description.zh: 提供 DeepSeek Harness 远程控制功能的原生 iOS/Android 应用，支持端到端加密、工作区浏览和会话实时更新等。

description.en: A self-contained second brain for DeepSeek Harness — auto-captures durable dialogue knowledge into a local Markdown vault (custom dedup, CJK search, git-friendly), with a graphical knowledge base and an interactive knowledge graph (legend filter, time-dimension coloring, box-select, merge, delete, PNG export/import).

description.en: Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.
description.zh: 机制上与上下文压缩领域最响的两条公开路线同源：代码骨架闸门沿用 Headroom（Apache-2.0）的骨架化思路，其公开头条为「编程 agent 少 20% token、JSON 载荷少 60–95% token，答案不变」；估计器通道沿用 TokenPilot（arXiv:2606.17016）的缓存感知上下文管理思路，该论文报告长会话 agent 成本最高降低 60%。这两个数字都是来源方自己的口径，此处照引；本插件不自带 benchmark，不自称任何降幅。在此之上为 DeepSeek Harness 提供：在同一设置区选择压缩 Profile、调整 Auto Compact 触发水位并开关代码骨架压缩；基于 DeepSeek V4 官方 tokenizer 的精确计量与同修订计数校验；非支持模型自动 fail-open，保留原始工具结果。回合内支持骨架化信息压缩、低原文取回率；turn 尾部支持尾部意图摘要（turn-tail intent summary）且仅以内容替代方式实现；上下文内容安全，全程在官方 jsonl 压缩内。
在 DeepSeek Harness 界面里养一只 3D 鲸鱼宠物，常驻悬浮窗，陪你写代码、摸鱼解闷。

description.en: Let DeepSeek Harness see and operate any program on Windows. The model looks at the real screen and drives the mouse, keyboard and windows itself. It is fast: several steps run in a single round trip, and a window can be focused before input lands, so the click hits the right one. It can do anything you would do on a desktop, including but not limited to CAD drawing, circuit simulation, and sending messages.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 看见并操作 Windows 上的任何程序。模型直接看真实屏幕，自己驱动鼠标、键盘和窗口。特点是快：好几步动作在一次往返里跑完，输入前还能先把目标窗口聚焦，点击就落在正确的窗口上。你在桌面上能做的事它都能做，包括但不限于画 CAD、电路图仿真、发消息。

description.en: LLM-assisted auto approval with countdown fallback for the Auto permission preset: static rules, risk tiers, breaker and file audit.
description.zh: 为 DSH Auto 权限档提供 LLM 辅助自动审批：静态规则、LLM 复审、风险分档、人工倒计时兜底、熔断与文件级审计。

description.en: Project file explorer in the details column (multi-select, drag-move, upload, download, rename, trash, system-open) with an in-session read-only preview tab for Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/notebook/PDF + code highlighting, a live model throughput badge, and a multiline GoalBar.
description.zh: DSH 右侧 details 列项目资源管理器（多选、拖拽移动、上传、下载、重命名、废纸篓、系统打开），会话内只读预览 Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/Notebook/PDF 与代码高亮，附带模型实时吞吐徽标与多行 GoalBar。

description.en: Three Zhihu tools for DSH — in-site search, Zhihu's global web index with domain and date filters, and Zhida answers — with a native settings card and source-cited results.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加三个知乎工具——站内问答与文章检索、知乎全网索引检索（可按域名与时间过滤）、直答——自带原生设置卡片，结果附来源可引用。

description.en: DSH bundle that registers 13 native codegraph_* tools wrapping the codegraph CLI, so agents bootstrap, maintain, and query a pre-indexed code knowledge graph (symbol query, explore, node trail, callers/callees, impact, affected tests) instead of grepping files.
description.zh: DSH 插件，注册 13 个原生 codegraph_* 工具包装 codegraph CLI，让代理初始化、维护并查询预索引的代码知识图谱（符号查询、区域探索、节点轨迹、callers/callees、影响分析、受影响测试），无需 grep 文件。

description.en: Auto-expands newly arrived tool-call cards in the DSH Web UI, with a sidebar toggle cycling no-op/expand/collapse and the state persisted to localStorage.
description.zh: 自动展开 DSH 界面里新到达的工具调用卡片，侧栏开关在不干预/展开/折叠三态间循环，档位持久化到 localStorage。

description.en: Agent governance kingdom for DeepSeek Harness: territories, role bindings (bind/unbind/session with model/agent identity), and a plan→assign→execute→review task loop where Worker claims never auto-complete (Claim ≠ Fact), with a local GUI operations console.
description.zh: DSH 里的 Agent 王国：领地、角色绑定/换届/会话归属（含模型/Agent 身份），plan→派发→执行→验收治理闭环（Worker 自述≠完成事实），附本地 GUI 操作台。

description.en: Runtime-switchable model output styles with Claude Code outputStyles parity, plus the output.render.* presentation protocol: a /style command, per-session persistence, systemPrompt injection, six built-in styles, a web picker, and a renderer registry with per-session/per-tool rules and /export.
description.zh: 运行时切换模型输出风格（对标 Claude Code outputStyles），另加 output.render.* 呈现协议：/style 命令、按会话持久化、systemPrompt 注入、六个内置风格、Web 选择器，以及带按会话/按工具规则与 /export 的渲染器注册表。

description.en: Multi-user login gateway for the DSH web UI: the first visit creates the admin account, admins add and manage users in the GUI settings panel, ordinary users see only their own conversations, and unauthenticated visitors are redirected to /login.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供多用户登录网关：首次访问创建管理员账户，管理员在 GUI 设置面板中添加和管理用户，普通用户只能看到自己的会话，未登录访问重定向到 /login。

description.en: Detailed model usage and cost analysis, with per-session usage stats and usage queries for GLM, MiniMax, OpenCode Go, DeepSeek and more.
description.zh: 详细的模型用量、费用分析，支持会话级用量统计，支持GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode Go、DS等用量查询。

description.en: Analyze usage across models, providers, workspaces, and time ranges — including custom start/end dates over the full retained history — with live cache-hit visibility and separate model and provider breakdowns. Includes hourly single-day trends, daily cross-day trends, a 53-week GitHub-style heatmap, usage streaks, model and workspace Token-share donut charts with Token, cost, and percentage details, independent combinable filters, cache-efficiency trends, DeepSeek account balance, workspace aliases, CSV export, and a durable ledger that preserves successfully flushed usage after session deletion — and after a workspace is deleted, where its recorded usage is summed into one Deleted row — and rebuilds incrementally — on restart, unchanged sessions are applied from the ledger without re-reading their logs (a per-session log revision is the change signal), and only changed/new events are folded. The workspace registry is kept fresh automatically through the DSH domain/changed probe: only added/removed workspaces are reprocessed incrementally, unchanged workspaces reuse their computed aggregates and ledger with zero rescan, and usage is strictly limited to DSH-registered workspaces (unregistered cwds are ignored). After a scan, lightweight revision status fetches full history only when the Host/data state changes and exposes non-sensitive sync health (revision reuse, rereads, ledger recovery, and failures). Token accounting is explicit: input is fresh (cache read/write and reasoning are separate buckets) and zero-usage replays never overwrite recorded usage. Chinese uses local time, English uses UTC; API access is loopback-only.
description.zh: 支持跨多个模型、供应商、工作区与时间范围进行统一分析，并可在全部保留历史中自定义起止日期；实时呈现缓存命中率，并可分别查看模型和供应商的分类数据；单日趋势按小时、跨日趋势按日，提供 53 周 GitHub 风格热力图、连续使用、模型与工作区 Token 占比环图及 Token、成本、占比明细，以及可独立自由组合的筛选；支持查询 DeepSeek 账户余额、管理工作区别名及导出 CSV 数据；独立账本在会话删除前持久化用量，工作区被删除时同样保留并把用量汇总为一行「已删除」，增量重建只处理新增事件；重启时未变化会话不回读日志、直接复用账本（以每会话日志 revision 为变更信号）；工作区注册表通过 DSH 的 domain/changed 事件自动探针同步——只对新增/删除的工作区增量重扫，未变化的已有工作区直接复用已计算账本、零全量重扫，统计严格限定已注册工作区（未登记目录一律忽略），扫描完成后通过轻量 revision 状态判断，只有 Host/统计状态变化才获取完整历史，并显示 revision 复用、实际读取、账本恢复和失败等非敏感同步健康信息；全 0 用量的重放不会覆盖已记录的真实用量，Token 口径显式声明（输入不含缓存命中，缓存读写与推理独立成桶）。中文使用本地时区，英文统一使用 UTC；API 仅限本机访问。

description.en: Imports Claude Code setup into DeepSeek Harness from a native settings screen or CLI, with dry-run previews for skills, commands, agents, hooks, permission rules, and MCP config. Codex and OpenCode remain supported as secondary origins, with collision-safe apply and post-move checks.
description.zh: 通过原生设置页或 CLI 将 Claude Code 配置迁入 DeepSeek Harness，可先预览技能、命令、代理、hooks、权限规则与 MCP 配置；Codex 和 OpenCode 作为次要来源继续支持，并提供目标冲突保护和迁移后检查。

description.en: Full-featured TUI for DeepSeek Harness: streaming conversation, powerline status bar, real-time think/tool/todo panels, subagent dual-view, theme hot-switch — all as pure cordis plugins with zero upstream patches.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全功能 TUI：流式对话、powerline 状态栏、实时思考/工具/待办面板、子代理双视图、主题热切换——全部以纯 cordis 插件实现，不 fork、不 patch 上游一行代码。

description.en: Claude-style skin with a warm-black canvas, clay accent, and serif UI that follows the native light and dark themes.
description.zh: Claude 风格皮肤：暖黑画布、陶橙点缀、衬线 UI，跟随原生亮/暗主题。

description.en: Pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the Web sidebar with per-pin row colors, a header toggle and a pinned panel; 0.4.0 adds a navigation organizer — pin groups (boards), tags and saved filter views, session health summaries, and /goto.
description.zh: 把会话与工作区置顶到 Web 侧边栏顶部：行级图钉与换色、会话头开关、已置顶面板；0.4.0 再加导航组织器——Pin 分组（boards）、标签与保存视图、会话健康摘要与 /goto。

description.en: Route agent network requests through a local HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy.
description.zh: 让 agent 的网络请求走本机 HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 代理。

description.en: PII masking for DeepSeek Harness — anonymizes names, phones, emails, ids, and keys before requests and restores them at the display layer, keeping plaintext out of session logs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 PII 脱敏：请求前匿名化姓名、电话、邮箱、证件与密钥，展示层还原，明文不进入会话日志。

description.en: Reference already-open Chrome and Edge tabs with @ mentions in DSH, annotate page elements, reuse login state to read pages, run batched actions, take screenshots and call WebMCP tools through a paired browser extension, and reference running Windows apps with cached icons while controlling them through MCP/CLI tools.
description.zh: 通过 @ 引用已打开的 Chrome / Edge 标签页，标注页面元素，配合浏览器扩展复用登录状态读取页面、批量操作、截图、调用 WebMCP 工具，并通过 @ 引用运行中的 Windows 应用，经 MCP/CLI 工具进行控制。

description.en: LLVM static-analysis plugin that builds whole-program bitcode for C/C++ projects and runs kernel-analyzer (KAMain) reachability analysis on it, providing kanalyzer_* tools to the agent and a ctx.kanalyzer service to other plugins.
description.zh: LLVM 静态分析插件，可为 C/C++ 项目构建整程序 LLVM bitcode，并在其上运行 kernel-analyzer（KAMain）可达性分析，向智能体提供 kanalyzer_* 工具，并向其他插件提供 ctx.kanalyzer 服务。

description.en: Render Mermaid code fences as SVG diagrams with streaming support, diagram/code switching, fullscreen zoom and pan, SVG export, and a bundled same-origin runtime.
description.zh: 将 Mermaid 代码围栏渲染为 SVG 图表，支持流式输出、图形/代码切换、全屏缩放与拖拽、SVG 导出，以及内置的同源运行时。

description.en: Tool-output repair layer for DeepSeek Harness — JSON schema enforcement, parameter mapping, and JSON repair for tool calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的工具输出修复层：JSON Schema 校验、参数映射与 JSON 修复。

description.en: Directed fuzzing driven by an LLM agent: from a target repository and a bug (CVE description, patch, crash trace, or file:line), it runs a PLAN, IMPLEMENT, EXECUTE, REFLECT loop in which the model writes Python input generators, until an input triggers the campaign's stderr-pattern oracle or the campaign stops.
description.zh: 由 LLM 智能体驱动的定向模糊测试：给定目标仓库和一个缺陷（CVE 描述、补丁、崩溃调用栈或 file:line），它运行 PLAN、IMPLEMENT、EXECUTE、REFLECT 循环，由模型编写 Python 输入生成器，直到某个输入触发该 campaign 基于 stderr 模式匹配的 oracle，或 campaign 停止。

description.en: Lets the agent scan Bilibili through a subagent and report what is worth watching, with per-video notes, a card wall, and an inbox for mentions, replies and shared videos.
description.zh: 派子代理去刷 B站，回报值得看的视频，带每条视频的笔记、卡片墙，以及 @/回复/私信转发的收件箱。

description.en: dsh free token route
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免费令牌路由，自动切换可用后端，提升调用稳定性与效率。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：把一份基于文件的本地记忆档案（日记 / 状态 / 生长记录 / 事件流）搬进设置页面板 —— 概览、搜索、追加、谨慎编辑，读写都带指纹守卫与改前备份。MIT。
description.zh: 把本地记忆档案搬进设置面板，随时翻看、搜索、追加和谨慎修改，改前自动备份。

description.en: Access DSH from your phone or anywhere: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel public link, LAN HTTP/HTTPS direct access with an auto-generated self-signed certificate, token auth, gzip compression, a floating phone-icon panel with QR codes, configurable public URL and LAN port, and WeChat / Feishu / Telegram bot channels with per-channel health monitoring and session-completion push. Targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.2-rc.1+).
description.zh: 手机/外网远程访问 DSH：Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 公网链接、局域网 HTTP/HTTPS 直连（自动生成自签名证书）、token 鉴权、gzip 压缩、常驻手机图标面板（一键复制/二维码）、可配置公网链接与局域网端口，以及微信 / 飞书 / Telegram 机器人通道，支持分通道健康监测与会话完成推送。适配 DSH 0.2.x（0.1.2-rc.1+ 亦可用）。

description.en: Installs Herta as a DeepSeek Harness agent: a preset carrying her persona and memory prompt sections, six memory and voice tools, a narrative layer that separates her thinking from what she says, 80 bundled voice clips, offline and MiniMax speech synthesis, and two conversation views that render the session with her own components.
description.zh: 把 Herta（黑塔）作为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体装入：携带人格与记忆提示词段的 preset、六个记忆与语音工具、区分内心与发言的叙述层、80 条随包语音、本地与 MiniMax 两条语音合成链路，以及两个用她自己的组件渲染会话的对话视图。

issues.detail: declares install-time scripts; the harness gates them via allowBuilds

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-herta-dsh
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for Herta-dsh

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Skills & MCP section in Settings: browse, create, edit and delete skills with live directory watching, toggle loading of any on-disk skill through frontmatter policy keys, register local folders or GitHub repos as extra skill scan roots, edit the MCP server rows in the profile patch, import MCP config from Claude Code or Codex, and install from a curated market of skill repos and MCP servers.
description.zh: 设置页的「技能与 MCP」分区：技能目录实时监听，可浏览、新建、编辑、删除技能，用 frontmatter 策略键开关任何落在磁盘上的技能；本地目录或 GitHub 仓库可注册为额外技能扫描根；profile 的 MCP 服务器行在页面上编辑，可从 Claude Code / Codex 配置导入；另带精选技能仓库与 MCP 服务器的市场。

description.en: Zero-residence context engine: large tool payloads are evicted out of the live context into a queryable store and only deterministic pointers are left behind, so per-turn prompt tokens stop growing with the transcript. Any masked content is reconstructed verbatim from the session log on demand, by tool-call id or session seq.
description.zh: 零驻留上下文引擎：把体积大的工具输出从活跃上下文驱逐到可查询存储，只留下确定性指针，于是每轮的提示词 token 不再随对话长度增长。被遮蔽的内容可随时从会话日志逐字重建，按工具调用 id 或会话 seq 定位。
在 DSH 网页右侧开个面板，随手查看和管理你的 GitHub 项目。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：让DSH使用Git Bash，能够保持read-only, workspace-write, full-access权限控制依旧可用
description.zh: Use Git for Windows Bash as the default DSH shell with restricted-mode support

description.en: Provides a better model experience, including but not limited to: filling model parameters in multiple ways, improving model compatibility, remembering reasoning efforts, subagents following the parent's model and reasoning effort in real time, and AI self-adjusting reasoning effort.
description.zh: 提供更好的模型使用体验，包括但不限于：多种方式填充模型参数、提升模型兼容性、记住推理级别、子智能体实时跟随模型和推理级别、AI 自主调节档位等。

description.en: Codex-style conversation turn timeline and hover history overview for DSH Web UI
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面加上 Codex 风格的对话轮次时间线，鼠标一悬停就能看历史概览。

description.en: Out-of-tree installable plugin marketplace bundle for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供仓外插件市场，无需改源码即可安装和管理扩展插件。

description.en: deepseek harness插件，连接QQ / DSH plugin for connecting QQ
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：处理DSH沟槽的权限管理（full acess下传入同级或者降级的请求会报错，导致ai大战权限管理）
description.zh: 修复DSH沟槽权限管理问题，自动忽略无效的权限升级请求，避免AI与权限系统反复冲突。

description.en: Rule mining for data risk control, distilled from the ideas of the "100-Day Risk Control Expert" course
description.zh: 结合风控专家实战经验，自动完成数据质检与规则挖掘，帮你快速搞定金融风控场景。

description.en: Native DSH Hub marketplace plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把社区插件商店直接搬进 DeepSeek Harness，找插件、装插件一站搞定。

description.en: DSH 排队消息增强面板：编辑、删除、插话、排序与批量删除功能
description.zh: DSH 排队消息增强面板，支持编辑、删除、插话、排序和批量删除。

description.en: 会话顶栏实时显示 DeepSeek API 价格（峰谷定价 / 现行一口价，flash / pro 自动切换） | DeepSeek Harness client plugin: live DeepSeek API pricing badge (peak/off-peak, flash/pro) in the session header
description.zh: 会话顶栏实时显示 DeepSeek API 价格（峰谷定价 / 现行一口价，flash / pro 自动切换） | DeepSeek Harness client plugin: live DeepSeek API pricing badge (peak/off-peak, flash/pro) in the session header

description.en: Fully local document intelligence for DeepSeek Harness. Parse PDF, Office files, images, and scanned documents with offline OCR. | DeepSeek Harness 全本地文档智能插件，支持 PDF、Office、图片与离线 OCR
description.zh: Fully local document intelligence for DeepSeek Harness. Parse PDF, Office files, images, and scanned documents with offline OCR. | DeepSeek Harness 全本地文档智能插件，支持 PDF、Office、图片与离线 OCR

description.en: Playwright browser automation for DeepSeek Harness｜面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Playwright 浏览器自动化插件
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过 Playwright 自动操作浏览器，轻松完成网页抓取、表单填写和自动化测试。

description.en: Skin Center: 151 day/night skin pairs in one package — grid previews, search, one-click try-on, favorites, recently-tried and random skins inside DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 皮肤中心：151 款昼夜成对皮肤一包打尽——网格预览、搜索、一键试穿，支持收藏、最近试穿与随机换肤。

description.en: DSH Prompt Library plugin: prompt CRUD, tags & categories, import/export, AI polish, one-click clip selected text, sidebar and assistant bubble reminders.
description.zh: DSH提示词库插件：支持提示词增删改查、分类标签、导入导出、AI智能优化、选中文本一键剪藏，附带侧边栏与词库助手气泡提醒。

description.en: Guarded context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the LLM proposes, deterministic guards dispose — eager per-atom shrink (extract/summary/false under verbatim guards) + lazy reference-graph eviction (0-LLM) + byte-exact recall from an append-only log.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 守卫式上下文压缩——LLM 提议、确定性守卫裁决：逐原子缩放（verbatim 守卫下 extract/summary/false）+ 引用图延迟剪枝（0-LLM）+ append-only 日志逐字节精确召回。

description.en: Match your models and token budgets to each role, then let DSH delegate specialized subagents by task type. Covers architecture analysis, UI/UX, code implementation, codebase exploration, and documentation research, with automatic setup plus per-role reasoning effort and tool permissions.
description.zh: 合理搭配你的模型及 Token 额度，让 DSH 按任务类型自动委派专业子代理，覆盖架构分析、UI/UX、代码实现、代码库探索与文档调研。安装后自动配置，并支持按角色设置思考强度和工具权限。

description.en: A faster, more efficient, and more accurate coding Agent preset. On 100 hard SWE-bench Pro tasks selected using multidimensional difficulty criteria, average elapsed time decreased by 36%, average input tokens per task decreased by 17%, and accuracy increased by 5 percentage points.
description.zh: 提供一个更快、更节省、更准确的编码 Agent 预设。在按多维难度规则筛选的 SWE-bench Pro 高难度 100 题评测中，平均耗时减少 36%，平均每题输入 token 减少 17%，正确率提高 5 个百分点。

description.en: Fine grained per tool permission rules for DSH at the tools/pre-execute gate, deny and ask lists in Claude Code rule syntax (`Bash(rm -rf:*), Read(_secrets_), mcp__server__tool`), works standalone without migrating.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上按工具粒度的权限规则：在 tools/pre-execute 强制执行 deny/ask 清单，规则语法与 Claude Code 相同，不迁移也能单独用。

description.en: Turn a one-line requirement into verified delivery. TeamFlow runs a multi-stage pipeline — triage, PRD, design, technical plan, parallel development, QA with defect rework, acceptance — and gives the model 12 `teamflow_*` tools plus a workbench with a live pipeline graph and a backlog kanban. Each requirement gets its own folder holding the PRD, design, technical plan, QA report and acceptance record.
description.zh: 把一句话需求变成可验收的交付。TeamFlow 跑一条多阶段流水线——分诊、PRD、设计、技术方案、并行开发、带打回重修的 QA、验收——并给模型 12 个 `teamflow_*` 工具，以及带实时流水线图与 backlog 看板的工作台。每个需求一个专属目录，收着 PRD、设计、技术方案、QA 报告与验收记录。

description.en: Fine-grained permission gateway: per-category tool-call review (outside-workspace directories, commands, file read/write, subagents, repeated actions) with global & per-project allow/deny exceptions, quick-tool defaults, custom rules, a bilingual approval modal with inline diff details, custom rejection reasons and a sandbox-upgrade flow.
description.zh: 细粒度权限网关：按分类（工作区外目录/命令/读写文件/子代理/重复操作）逐项审查工具调用，全局/项目双级白黑名单、快捷工具默认值、自定义规则，中英文审批弹窗（内联 diff 详情、自定义拒绝意见）与底层沙箱升级流程。

description.en: Local literature knowledge-base RAG: 10 tools (kb_ingest, kb_search, kb_rag, kb_zotero, kb_dedup, kb_clear, kb_fetch, kb_scope, kb_stats, kb_status), hybrid BM25+vector+reranker search, cited QA with clickable DOI links, all-local bge embeddings over a single-file SQLite index. Needs Python 3.9+ with pymupdf, faiss-cpu and sentence-transformers; the `npx dsh-kb-rag-install` installer sets those up and pre-downloads the model.
description.zh: 本地文献知识库 RAG：10 个工具（kb_ingest、kb_search、kb_rag、kb_zotero、kb_dedup、kb_clear、kb_fetch、kb_scope、kb_stats、kb_status），BM25+向量+重排混合检索、DOI 可点击溯源问答，全本地 bge 嵌入 + 单文件 SQLite 索引。需要 Python 3.9+ 及 pymupdf、faiss-cpu、sentence-transformers（`npx dsh-kb-rag-install` 安装器会自动装好并预下载模型）。

description.en: Draws every branch of a conversation as a clickable tree beside the chat, with favorites, custom icons and colors, branch merge and split, rewind-aware layout, and Claude Code branches that keep their memory.
description.zh: 把一个对话的所有分支画成聊天区旁边的一棵可点击的树，支持收藏、自定义图标与颜色、分支合并与拆分、撤回感知的布局，以及带记忆的 Claude Code 分支。

description.en: Exports the session event stream to OpenTelemetry OTLP and Langfuse as sanitized, buffered traces and metrics, off by default.
description.zh: 将会话事件流导出为 OpenTelemetry OTLP 与 Langfuse 的脱敏、缓冲 traces 与指标，默认关闭。

description.en: Desktop pet drawn from the official whale outline, for both the desktop app and the web UI: SVG animations and facial expressions follow agent state (thinking, working, done, error, waiting for confirmation), and it can follow other running sessions with a count badge; poke it, drag it, shake it dizzy, squash it against a screen edge, or rub the cursor over its head for a headpat; 7 palettes, 4 sizes, synthesized sounds, light/dark theme sync, and a playable web preview.
description.zh: 官方鲸鱼轮廓的桌宠，桌面端和网页端都能用：SVG 动画和表情随 agent 状态切换（思考／工作／完成／报错／等待确认），还能跟随其他在跑的会话并用角标显示个数；可戳可拖、能甩晕、按在屏幕边上会压扁，鼠标在头顶来回蹭就是摸头；7 套色板、4 档大小、合成音效，跟随亮暗主题，附网页预览可直接试玩。

description.en: Attaches a stable per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider requests, fixing 400 MissingSessionID errors and keeping session affinity and prompt-cache routing intact.
description.zh: 为 OpenCode / OpenCode Go 提供商请求自动附加每个会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 请求头，修复 400 MissingSessionID 错误，同时保持会话亲和与提示缓存路由。

description.en: Connects Qoder (Lingma CN / international) models to DSH through their PATs, with a per-region multi-account pool, daily check-in, automatic failover, and read-only credit visibility.
description.zh: 通过 PAT 将 Qoder（通义灵码国内版 / 国际版）模型接入 DSH，支持按区域的多账号池、每日签到、自动换号与只读积分展示。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app models into DeepSeek Harness: the China and international builds each appear as their own group in the model picker, with the reasoning tiers the upstream declares, per-reply credit cost and remaining balance, per-account model visibility, and image input where supported.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的模型接进 DSH 模型选择器：国内版与国际版各自成组，带上游声明的推理档位、每条回复的积分消耗与剩余积分、按账号分别保存的模型显隐，以及在支持的模型上的图片输入。

description.en: Multi-dimensional quality scoring for DeepSeek Harness plugins that scores a repo or npm package across install success, maintenance activity, documentation completeness, security scan, and protocol compliance using real CLI evidence, and produces a JSON or Markdown leaderboard report.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供多指标质量评分：基于真实的 CLI 证据对某个仓库或 npm 包在安装成功率、维护活跃度、文档完整度、安全扫描和协议合规五个维度打分，并生成 JSON 或 Markdown 排行榜报告。

description.en: Noname (Sanguosha-like game) extension workshop. AI writes skill and card extensions behind confirmation gates, static validation and block-based safe writes.
description.zh: 无名杀扩展开发工坊。AI 在确认协议、校验门禁与区块化写入的保护下编写武将技能与卡牌扩展。

description.en: Role-based multi-agent team for DeepSeek Harness — your digital workforce. One goal assembles a team of product, architect, frontend, backend, reviewer and QA roles that deliver through a nine-phase gated pipeline, plus a persistent team you can keep directing across sessions. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step.
description.zh: 角色化多智能体专家团 = 你的数字员工。一句目标即自动组建最多 12 个角色（产品、架构、前端、后端、审查、测试等），按九阶段门控流水线协作交付，并支持常驻团队反复指挥。零运行时依赖、无构建步骤。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugins market｜DSH 插件市场
description.zh: 一键浏览和安装 6000 多个 DSH 社区插件，按功能分类，每天自动更新。

description.en: Tencent CodeBuddy plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: 通过浏览器登录腾讯云 CodeBuddy，无需 API 密钥即可在 DeepSeek Harness 中调用其大模型能力。

description.en: Preview and move supported Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode setup into DSH, including skills, commands, agents, instructions, and MCP servers, with OpenCode V1/V2 JSONC support and collision-safe apply.
description.zh: 一键把 Claude Code 的技能、MCP、钩子和指令整体迁移到 DSH，拎包入住无缝衔接。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 跨会话记忆插件：对话模型边干边记的 Markdown 项目记忆，支持专题文件渐进式披露、可选后台静默蒸馏、按项目隔离与热更新设置面板。机制对齐 Claude Code auto memory。 | Agent-maintained cross-session Markdown memory: progressive-disclosure topic files, opt-in silent distillation, per-project isolation. Claude Code-aligned.
description.zh: 让对话模型跨会话记住项目关键信息，自动写入Markdown并在新会话中恢复，提升连续工作体验。

description.en: Embedded git repository graph visualizer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI | 嵌入式 Git 仓库图谱可视化插件（提交历史图 / 分支过滤 / 文件 diff / VSCode 式未提交改动）
description.zh: Embedded git repository graph visualizer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI | 嵌入式 Git 仓库图谱可视化插件（提交历史图 / 分支过滤 / 文件 diff / VSCode 式未提交改动）

description.en: A markdown notes manager for DSH: full **MD notes manager** and **MD notes editor**, quickly capture conversations into notes, maintain notes by **syncing to Git repositories**, and **bring notes into the conversation context**.
description.zh: DSH 的 MD 笔记管理插件：提供完整的 **MD 笔记管理器** 和 **MD 笔记编辑器**，对话内容可快速记入笔记。笔记可 **同步 Git 仓库** 维护。对话时可将笔记 **加入上下文**。

description.en: Per-conversation x-opencode-session injection for OpenCode Go in DeepSeek Harness - fixes 400 MissingSessionID without breaking other providers
description.zh: 给 OpenCode Go 按会话注入 x-opencode-session 请求头，修好 400 MissingSessionID 报错，还不影响其他模型服务商。
在模型写作时实时预览生成的HTML文档，让聊天界面直接展示可视化内容。

description.en: Codex 风格左侧消息导航轨道：等距刻度 + 悬停预览 + 点击跳转用户消息 · DSH Web 插件
description.zh: 在对话左侧加一条刻度导航轨道，悬停可预览、点击直接跳到某条用户消息。

description.en: LLM-free lossless* compaction engine for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供即时、近无损的上下文压缩，无需 LLM 参与，显著节省 token 成本。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Bundle for Unreal Engine 5.8 via Unreal MCP
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接指挥 UE5.8 编辑器，通过官方 MCP 协议实现 AI 驱动的游戏开发自动化。

description.en: One-shot mcp-unity integration for DeepSeek Harness: bundled MCP server with zero manual config lets the agent drive the Unity editor through 34 tools - scenes, game objects, transforms, materials, prefabs, menu items, play mode, tests and console logs - with auto-reconnect.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 一键接入 mcp-unity：内置 MCP 服务端，零配置让 Agent 直接操控 Unity 编辑器——场景、GameObject、变换、材质、Prefab、菜单、播放模式、测试与控制台日志等 34 个工具，支持自动重连。完整中文文档。

description.en: Registers ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok and Antigravity subscriptions as LLM providers through OAuth, with no API key.
description.zh: 把 ChatGPT Codex/Claude/Grok/Antigravity 订阅通过 OAuth 注册成 LLM 提供者，免 API key。

description.en: Generate complete AI songs and BGM from prompts or lyrics, with reference-audio creation and song extension.
description.zh: 根据提示词或歌词生成完整 AI 歌曲和 BGM，并支持参考音频创作与歌曲续写。

description.en: Galgame generator: give it a script document plus character/background/BGM/animation assets in the workspace (img_human/, img_bg/, audio/, img_cg/) and it builds a playable visual-novel web page with configurable save slots (`[存档 N]`, default 9), speaker-following sprites with multi-pose variant switching (`[表情]`), opening/ending/CG animations (`[op]`/`[ed]`/`[cg]`), BGM play/stop/volume control, and if-line branching.
description.zh: Galgame 生成器：提供剧本文档与立绘/背景/音乐/动画素材（工作区 img_human/、img_bg/、audio/、img_cg/）即可生成可玩视觉小说网页，支持可配置存档槽位（`[存档 N]`，默认 9）、立绘自动跟随说话人并切换多表情立绘（`[表情]`）、开局/结束/CG 动画（`[op]`/`[ed]`/`[cg]`）、BGM 播放/停止/音量控制与 if 条件线分支。

description.en: another version of deepseek herness trajectory (DIY)
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话中的工具调用和消息流画成交互式流程图，方便直观查看执行轨迹。

description.en: LLM-free lossless compaction engine.
description.zh: 无 LLM 的无损压缩引擎。

description.en: A compact discovery and lifecycle console for DeepSeek Harness plugins.
description.zh: 在设置页里一站式查看、发现和管理 DeepSeek Harness 插件，让插件加载树一目了然。

description.en: GUI in the DSH settings panel: toggle/delete MCP servers, browse and trash skills, and list built-in plugin packages — hot-applied without restart.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板内嵌的图形化管理器：开关/删除 MCP 服务、浏览并回收 Skills、查看内置插件包，改动热生效无需重启。

description.en: DSH plugin: edit the system prompt (deployment persona) from the Settings page, with live preview.
description.zh: dsh-prompt-persona — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: 侧边栏集成文件浏览器、终端和 Git 审查，方便预览文件。
description.zh: 侧边栏集成文件浏览器、终端和 Git 审查，方便预览文件。

description.en: Native Docling document intelligence for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 本地文档智能：离线 OCR 解析 PDF、Office、图片和扫描件，全程不出本机。

description.en: Persistent AI memory backed by a local Obsidian/Codex vault: five obsidian_memory_* read/write/search tools plus a sidebar vault browser.
description.zh: 基于本地 Obsidian/Codex 知识库的持久 AI 记忆：5 个 obsidian_memory_* 读写搜索工具，外加侧边栏知识库浏览器。

description.en: Deterministic context compression for dsh — zero LLM calls, rule-based pruning that preserves paths, commands, error traces, and open todos verbatim. Compresses ~80k tokens to a few hundred.
description.zh: dsh 的确定性上下文压缩后端：零 LLM 摘要调用，基于规则剪枝，逐字保留路径/命令/报错原文/未完成 todo，约 8 万 token 压到几百。

description.en: ClineBot and ClinePass integration for DeepSeek Harness: dedicated settings page, live quota dashboard, in-UI key saving, curated and custom model selection, and a /cline command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClineBot/ClinePass 集成：专属设置页、实时配额仪表板、界面内密钥保存、精选与自定义模型选择，以及 /cline 命令。

description.en: Runs isolated install-and-smoke test drives for DSH plugins in throwaway profiles, returning structured pass/fail records and batch matrices without touching your real profile.
description.zh: 在一次性隔离配置中为 DSH 插件执行安装与冒烟测试，返回结构化的通过/失败记录与批量矩阵，不触碰真实配置。

description.en: An unofficial Arknights P.R.T.S.-inspired interface theme for DSH Web with appearance presets, accessibility controls, and conversation navigation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的非官方明日方舟 P.R.T.S. 风格界面主题，提供外观预设、辅助功能与会话导航。

description.en: Tavily search, extract, map and crawl tools with multi-key rotation, failover on HTTP 401/429/432/433, and a load-balance mode that caps in-flight requests per Tavily account, plus a key and usage card on the Plugins page. The built-in web_search is never replaced.
description.zh: Tavily 搜索、提取、站点地图与爬取工具：多 Key 轮换，HTTP 401/429/432/433 故障转移，并提供按账号限制并发请求的负载均衡模式；插件配置页含密钥与用量卡片。内置 web_search 永不替换。

description.en: Bridge Claude Code's .claude/ directories into DSH with zero migration: project and user-level skills, commands, rules (one system-reminder envelope), agent files, hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/ SessionStart/SessionEnd) and .mcp.json servers, plus Claude Code plugin marketplaces. Ships /cc-plugin for full plugin/marketplace management (claude CLI first, self-implemented fallback), /cc-resume to list and import Claude Code sessions into DSH as native event-sourced logs, and /cc-export to write DSH skills back as Claude Code skills. Two-way Claude Code <-> DSH bridge, versioned and released as dsh-claude-compat.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 的 .claude/ 目录零迁移桥接进 DSH：项目与用户级 skills、 斜杠命令、rules（单条 system-reminder 信封注入）、agent 文件、hooks （PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/SessionStart/SessionEnd）、 .mcp.json 服务器，并支持 Claude Code 插件 marketplace。自带 /cc-plugin 插件与市场全管理（claude CLI 优先、自实现兜底）、/cc-resume 列出并把 Claude Code 会话导入为 DSH 原生事件日志、/cc-export 把 DSH skill 导出为 Claude Code skill。Claude Code 与 DSH 的双向桥。

description.en: P0–P4 deterministic-first permission gate with permissive tier, learning sedimentation and approval-history UI; hard-deny credentials and protected paths, auto-allow internal read-only tools.
description.zh: P0–P4 确定性优先权限门控，含 Permissive 档位、学习沉淀与审批历史 UI；凭据/受保护路径硬拒绝，内部只读工具自动放行。

description.en: "Single-Core Writing" plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Thoroughly tool-streamlined and output-hardened for quantized small models, suitable for running long-novel pipelines locally with on-device models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「单核写作」插件：面向量化小模型做了充分的工具瘦身与输出加固，适合在本机用本地模型跑长篇小说流水线。

description.en: Read official DSH docs in the Plugins page; Creator mode searches docs and checks plugin npm metadata with native tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页阅读官方文档；创造模式用原生工具检索文档、查询插件 npm 元数据。

description.en: Recycle bin for DSH sessions: sidebar delete icons, multi-select restore and permanent delete, live-session protection.
description.zh: DSH 会话回收站：侧边栏删除图标、多选还原与彻底删除、活跃会话保护。

description.en: Windows only: the agent edits documents inside the Word, Excel and PowerPoint (Microsoft Office or WPS Office) windows you have open, through the applications' automation interface, so changes appear live and you can edit alongside; it reads structure, applies batches of edits, renders pages to images to check layout, and saves or exports PDF.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：Agent 通过办公软件的自动化接口，直接在你打开的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint（微软 Office 或 WPS Office）窗口里改文档，改动实时出现，你可以同时编辑；可读取结构、批量修改、把页面渲染成图片核对排版、保存或导出 PDF。

description.en: Settings page for per-model capabilities: reasoning-effort levels with their wire spellings, input modalities, and token capacities, written as declarations or sparse catalog overrides.
description.zh: 在设置页按模型编辑能力：推理档位及其发往端点的取值写法、输入模态与 token 容量，以声明或官方目录稀疏覆盖的形式写入。

description.en: Browse every message you sent in the current session: full-history listing with newest-first sort, text filter, one-click copy, and jump to a message (auto-loads earlier history when the target is not yet loaded).
description.zh: 会话历史消息查看：列出当前会话全部你发送的消息，支持排序、搜索、一键复制与点击跳转定位（目标未加载时自动加载更早历史）。

description.en: Connect Google Antigravity Code Assist OAuth accounts to DeepSeek Harness for Gemini and Claude streaming LLM routing and Nano Banana 2 image generation.
description.zh: 接入 Google Antigravity Code Assist OAuth 账号，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Gemini 与 Claude 流式模型路由及 Nano Banana 2 图像生成。

description.en: Route eligible shell commands through rtk to compress tool output and save tokens.
description.zh: 将符合条件的 shell 命令路由给 rtk，压缩工具输出并节省 token。

description.en: Talk to Excel in DeepSeek Harness: create, edit, repair, and verify spreadsheets by conversation, with automatic formula health checks after every edit.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里对话完成 Excel 工作：建表、编辑、修复公式、图表校验，每次编辑后自动体检公式。

description.en: AI-for-Science research workflow skill for DeepSeek Harness, aimed at researchers and grad students using agentic AI: multi-angle literature review with per-angle files, experiment design with a caveat list, figures and paper reading; each job returns files plus a cross-verification brief for a second model. Zero deps, MIT.
description.zh: AI4S 科研工作流技能包，面向 AI for Science 与研究生/科研 Agent 用户：多角度文献调研（每角度落盘）、实验方案（含漏洞清单）、作图与精读；每单交付文件，附交叉验证任务书。零依赖，MIT。

description.en: Mixture-of-Agents plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a /moa slash command fans a prompt out to multiple models in parallel, merges their responses in a file workspace, and integrates with Live Canvas for visual output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的混合智能体（MoA）插件：/moa 斜杠命令将提示词并发分发给多个模型，在文件工作区合并响应，并与 Live Canvas 集成以呈现可视化输出。

description.en: Use AI agents from the DSH session UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话界面里直接调用 ACP 智能体，沿用原生会话、工具审批和团队协作。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）里用中文对话操作 WPS 表格 / 文字 / 演示：读写数据、排版、公式图表、批量转 PDF。自带 MCP server 与常驻 COM 宿主，免装加载项、免配环境变量。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用中文对话操作 WPS 表格、文字和演示，读写数据、排版、做公式图表，还能批量转 PDF。

description.en: DSH Tavern 剧情配图插件，支持 ComfyUI 与多种在线生图服务。
description.zh: 给 Tavern 剧情自动配图，接 ComfyUI 和多种在线生图服务，现已内嵌进本体。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 基础工具增强：持久 bash、结构化 read、多模式 edit、原子 write、双引擎 grep/glob、图像直读，一个插件全覆盖
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的基础工具全面升级：bash 常驻、读写编辑更稳、搜索双引擎、图片直接看，装一个就够。

issues.detail: declares install-time scripts; the harness gates them via allowBuilds

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-xiaoso-dsh-tool-plus
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-tool-plus

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Auto-fills reasoning-effort levels, context windows, output limits and image modality for models from unofficial (custom) providers, with data from models.dev.
description.zh: 为所有非官方（自定义）提供商的模型自动填充推理级别、最大上下文、输出上限与图片模态，数据来自 models.dev。

description.en: Codex-style completed-turn folding for DeepSeek Harness, powered by dsh-harmony.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web UI 的 Codex 风格回合折叠：保留最终答复，合并连续的推理与工具活动，并以多语言摘要展示可配置的实时耗时、工具调用和 token 指标。

description.en: 一款模仿 excel 的 dsh 皮肤
description.zh: 一款模仿 excel 的 dsh 皮肤

description.en: 为DeepSeek harness开启局域网访问及移动端页面的插件
description.zh: 为DeepSeek harness开启局域网访问及移动端页面的插件

description.en: Injects one system-prompt section so the agent's chain-of-thought, planning and tool-invocation reasoning stay in Simplified Chinese. Zero external dependencies - clone and link-install from any local directory, no npm build or publish required.
description.zh: 注入一条系统提示词段落，让 Agent 的思维链、规划与工具调用推理全程使用简体中文；零外部依赖，git clone 后可从任意本地目录 link 安装，无需 npm 构建或发布。

description.en: Soul.md persona for DeepSeek Harness | DeepSeek Harness 人设卡插件
description.zh: dsh-soul-md — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: DSH 通知中心插件：对话/任务完成、报错、等待批准等事件触发浏览器通知 + 21 种匹配音效
description.zh: 切到别的窗口也不怕错过，对话/任务完成、报错或等待批准时，自动弹浏览器通知并播放提示音效。

description.en: Swift Cycle governance skill adapter for DeepSeek Harness; user-invoked, version-pinned, and offline-verifiable.
description.zh: Swift Cycle governance skill adapter for DeepSeek Harness; user-invoked, version-pinned, and offline-verifiable.

description.en: `/side` persistent side sessions and `/btw` one-shot side questions, run in a temporary fork without touching main history.
description.zh: `/side` 持续性侧会话与 `/btw` 一次性侧问，在临时 fork 中运行、不写入主会话历史。

description.en: `/side` persistent side sessions and `/btw` one-shot side questions, run in a temporary fork without touching main history.
description.zh: `/side` 持续性侧会话与 `/btw` 一次性侧问，在临时 fork 中运行、不写入主会话历史。

description.en: Visual node-based workflow canvas for DSH with sub-agent calls, code execution, branching, loops, scheduling, and workflow import/export.
description.zh: DSH 可视化节点工作流画布，支持子 Agent 调用、代码执行、条件分支、循环、定时任务及工作流导入导出。

description.en: Per-session quota meter for DSH: real-token billing, live progress bar, budget blocking, configurable multi-model pricing. 会话额度监控：真实记账、进度条、额度拦截、价目可配。
description.zh: 实时监控每个会话的 token 花费，进度条显示额度，超预算自动拦截，还能自定义各模型价目。

description.en: White-box causal guardrail for dsh: every tool call is adjudicated before execution along a deterministic causal logic chain — blocks destructive and credential-file operations, escalates repeated boundary violations, cuts faulting links until verified-fixed, and gives risk verdicts on un-auditable execution; runs fully local with zero API cost, plus 6 white-box self-check tools.
description.zh: 唯稳律白箱因果闸门：每个工具调用执行前沿确定性因果逻辑链裁决——拦截破坏性与凭据文件操作、对反复越界升级止损、故障环节切断至修复验证、不可审计执行给出风险判定；纯本地运行、零 API 成本，附带 6 个白箱自查工具。

description.en: DSH web plugin: 黑盒/代审 sidebar workspace (P0–P7, per-finding SRC reports).
description.zh: DSH侧边栏黑盒/代审工作台，按P0–P7分级测绘漏洞并生成含PoC/EXP的专项报告。

description.en: Firecrawl-backed web_search and web_fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web)
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：用 JSON 规格生成可验证的架构图、流程图、时序图、数据流图与生命周期图（移植自 tt-a1i/archify）
description.zh: 用 JSON 规格一键生成架构图、流程图、时序图等可验证图表，让技术方案看得见。

description.en: Barrage-meme skill distilled from 22,771 real messages in the 6657 live room: wanjiqi-style banter, CS and DOTA cross-memes, player roasting and casting commentary.
description.zh: 玩机器（6657 直播间）烂梗技能包：22771 条真实弹幕蒸馏而成，涵盖玩机器式弹幕烂梗、CS×DOTA 双料梗、选手锐评与解说吐槽。

description.en: 将分散在 3GPP Release 15~18 的 70+ 条通信协议规范，按 TN/NTN/全息/近远场/混合/安全等 8 个维度结构化整理，为通信工程师和 AI 助手提供一键式协议查询能力。通过三个 DSH 工具（关键词搜索、分类浏览、单条详情），取代人工翻阅数百页 PDF 的繁琐过程，让大模型在通信领域回答更准确、有据可查。本项目填补了通信工程专业知识在 AI 助手中的空白，是首个面向通信领域的 DSH 协议知识库插件。
description.zh: 把 3GPP 通信协议规范整理成可搜索的知识库，让 AI 助手查协议又快又准。

description.en: Clickable file paths in DSH replies: Codex-style inline open, reveal in file manager, and a mentioned-files chip list at the turn tail.
description.zh: DSH 回复中的文件路径可点击：Codex 风格行内打开、文件管理器定位、回合尾部文件 chip 列表。

description.en: CocoSgt/dsh-skills 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
description.zh: 把各种第三方技能集中到一个仓库，让 dsh 一键装好、随时调用。

description.en: DSH 插件：给每次消息后注入感谢语 | DSH plugin: inject a thank-you line after every message (deepseek-manners)
description.zh: 给每次消息后注入感谢语，做个有礼貌的人。

description.en: Local security audit: config, plugin origins, sessions, network exposure — read-only redacted risk report.
description.zh: 本机安全审计：配置/插件来源/会话/网络暴露面，只读脱敏风险报告。

description.en: ShiGuang Memory Engine (SGME) bridge: multi-agent shared long-term memory via HTTP — L0/L1/L1.5/L2 distillation, scenario-based injection, unified search, and proactive care signals (memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack), installable as `dsh-sgme`.
description.zh: 拾光记忆引擎（SGME）桥接：多智能体共享长期记忆（HTTP）—— L0/L1/L1.5/L2 分层提炼、按场景注入、统一检索、主动关怀信号（memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack），npm 包名 `dsh-sgme`。

description.en: Business knowledge-network context for DeepSeek Harness: bind a session to an OpenBKN knowledge network, query its objects and metrics through managed MCP tools, and open trace-backed provenance (execution facts and a business graph) for each answer. Ships with the OpenBKN Runtime; the provenance views need an OpenBKN enterprise license.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供业务知识网络上下文：将会话绑定到 OpenBKN 知识网络，通过受管 MCP 工具查询对象与指标，并为每轮回答打开可溯源的执行事实与业务上下文图。随 OpenBKN Runtime 发布；溯源视图需企业版 License。

description.en: Per-event sound notifications: turn completion, approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure each get their own sound and volume, configurable in the Web UI (built-in synth, mute, or local audio file).
description.zh: 六类事件独立提示音：回合完成、审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败各有独立声音与音量，可在 Web 设置面板配置（内置合成音 / 静音 / 本地音频文件）。

description.en: Use a ChatGPT/Codex subscription in DeepSeek Harness with GPT models, image generation, web search, subscription quota reporting, model and feature controls, and browser or device-code OAuth sign-in.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅接入 GPT 模型、图像生成与 Web 搜索，并支持订阅额度显示、模型与功能控制，以及浏览器或设备码 OAuth 登录。

description.en: Client-side re-render of edit/write tool cards with a near-linear line-level diff that drops duplicate unchanged lines and underlines the actual changed characters inside replaced lines.
description.zh: 接管浏览器端 edit/write 工具卡片，用近线性行级 diff 只显示真正变化行，并对替换对做行内字符下划线高亮，消除内置 diff 对未变化相同行的重复渲染。

description.en: Injects one fixed system-prompt section so the agent thinks and replies in Chinese, regardless of the user's language.
