description.zh: 注入一条固定 system-prompt 段落，让 Agent 无论用户使用什么语言都始终用中文思考和回复。

description.en: Android real-device debugging workbench for the DSH Web GUI: auto-attached logcat with severity/keyword filters and crash snapshots, live on-device screen casting with remote tap/swipe/text control, memory/proc/frida reverse-engineering toolset, 30 agent tools.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 安卓实机调试工作台：自动附加 logcat 流（级别/关键词过滤、崩溃自动快照），真机屏幕实时投屏与远程点击/滑动/文字操控，内存/进程/frida 逆向工具链，30 个 agent 工具。

description.en: A better fold bar: automatically folds tool calls and Think segments into step fold bars, and collapses each finished turn into a single turn header with live metrics (duration, TTFT, token, tok/s, cache hit) — only the final summary stays visible; customizable leading icons with animated poker cards built in (suit-cycling card animation while running, a deck when collapsed, a fan when expanded), a settings row for the official fold mode, compatible with both new and old DSH versions. Zero intrusion into DSH source.
description.zh: 更好的折叠栏：将工具调用与 Think 段自动折叠为步骤折叠栏，回合结束后整回合收拢为带实时指标（耗时/首字/token/tok/s/缓存命中）的回合折叠栏，只保留最终总结正文；前导图标可自定义，内置动态扑克牌（运行中花色循环卡牌动画、收起牌堆、展开扇形），提供官方折叠方式设置行，适配 DSH 新旧版本。零侵入 DSH 源码。

description.en: File encoding guard: byte-exact read/write/edit for GBK, Big5, Shift-JIS, EUC-KR, Windows-125x, UTF-16 and UTF-32 files, so editing a legacy file leaves it in its original encoding instead of silently rewriting it as UTF-8; UTF-8 BOM preserved exactly as it was, line endings (CRLF/LF/CR) kept, characters the encoding cannot represent refused rather than written as "?", and non-UTF-8 files listed with candidate encodings so the model can re-read them explicitly.
description.zh: 文件编码守护：为 GBK、Big5、Shift-JIS、EUC-KR、Windows-125x、UTF-16、UTF-32 文件提供字节级无损读写与编辑，改完仍是原编码而不是被悄悄转成 UTF-8；UTF-8 BOM 原样保留，CRLF/LF/CR 换行符保持，编码表示不了的字符拒绝写入而不是写成「?」；非 UTF-8 文件会列出候选编码，模型可显式指定重读。

description.en: Edit the global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md rules from the web settings panel, live on save.
description.zh: 在设置面板中编辑 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 全局规则，保存后实时生效。

description.en: Not another memory plugin: ODR is an evolving-worlds self-improvement loop (Dream-RSI) — attempts are recorded into a Discovery Tree, and between runs thousands of strategy variants are replayed against that recorded world; a strategy, recipe or lesson is promoted only after surviving counterfactual replay, never on the model's word alone, and Sentinel gates tool calls before the budget burns; the LLM stays frozen, installable from npm as dsh-open-dream-rsi.
description.zh: 不是又一个记忆插件：ODR 是“演化世界”式（Dream-RSI）自我改进回路——每次尝试都记入发现树（Discovery Tree），任务间歇将数千个策略变体在这棵记录下来的世界上回放；策略、配方或经验只有通过反事实回放的考验才会晋升，绝不因模型自己说好就获得信任，Sentinel 还会在预算耗尽前拦截工具调用；LLM 保持冻结，可从 npm 安装 dsh-open-dream-rsi。

description.en: DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。

GitHub Copilot LLM adapter: OAuth device-flow sign-in, live model discovery from the Copilot API, vision support for image-capable models (gpt-4.1, gpt-4o), and two wire protocols (Chat Completions and Responses API) with automatic endpoint routing per model.
description.zh: GitHub Copilot LLM 适配器：OAuth 设备码登录、从 Copilot API 动态发现模型、视觉模型图片输入支持（gpt-4.1、gpt-4o），以及 Chat Completions 与 Responses 双协议，按模型自动路由。

description.en: Continual self-refinement loop: persistent memory, periodic review-and-refine, cross-session shared knowledge, and automatic rollback through a model-callable harness_refine tool.
description.zh: 持续自我优化闭环：持久记忆、周期评审与自动优化、跨会话共享知识、失败自动回滚，由模型可调用的 harness_refine 工具驱动。

description.en: Branch switching and isolated git worktrees as real workspaces, from the Web UI composer.
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框切换分支、以真实工作区方式创建隔离的 git worktree。

description.en: LAN access for the Web GUI: 0.0.0.0 bind plus a crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure (LAN HTTP) contexts.
description.zh: 局域网访问：Web GUI 绑定 0.0.0.0 + crypto.randomUUID polyfill（修复非安全上下文下 RPC 崩溃）。

description.en: Agent2Agent protocol v1.0 for DSH: run a standard A2A server to let other agents call this instance, connect to remote A2A agents as clients, and manage both from a visual settings page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 实现 Agent2Agent 协议 v1.0：以标准 A2A server 接收其他 Agent 的调用，以 A2A client 连接远程 Agent，并在可视化设置页统一管理连接。

description.en: Dedicated model routes, tools, and system guidance for vision, compaction, reviews, subagents, titles, and image generation.
description.zh: 为视觉理解、上下文压缩、审批审查、子代理、会话标题与图片生成提供独立的模型路由、工具与系统提示。

description.en: Per-plugin usage budgets and cost caps on the llm/stream waterfall: per-model usage accounting, session and monthly budgets with warn/block transitions, latency windows, and a carbon-footprint estimate.
description.zh: 在 llm/stream 瀑布上做按插件粒度的用量预算与费用上限：按模型用量记账、会话与月度预算的预警/阻断、延迟窗口与碳足迹估算。

description.en: Bottom-right quota capsule that auto-discovers every configured provider (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, GLM, one-api/new-api, coding plans) and shows balance or rolling 5-hour and weekly usage, with per-provider visibility, alert thresholds and proxy support; also queries Volcengine Ark Agent Plan / Coding Plan usage via AK/SK-signed OpenAPI, and ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription usage via in-plugin device-code login or the Codex CLI auth file.
description.zh: 右下角额度胶囊：自动发现所有已配置 Key 的供应商（DeepSeek、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow、GLM、one-api/new-api、各类 Coding 套餐），显示余额或 5 小时/周滚动用量，支持按供应商设置可见性、告警阈值与代理；另支持火山方舟 Agent Plan / Coding Plan 用量查询（AK/SK 签名 OpenAPI）与 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 订阅用量（插件内设备码登录，或读取 Codex CLI 登录态）。

description.en: MCP management page in DSH Settings: list, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers, edit them in form or JSON mode, expand a server to see the tools it registers, and paste-import MCP configs from 14 tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and more) in one go.
description.zh: DSH 设置中的 MCP 管理页：列出、启停、重启、删除 MCP 服务器，表单与 JSON 双模式编辑，展开可查看各服务器注册的工具，并支持一次粘贴导入 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、VS Code 等 14 种工具的 MCP 配置。

description.en: One-stop visual management of DSH Skills & MCP: on-demand MCP loading, in-session hot reload, SKILL & MCP descriptions viewable in the plugin.
description.zh: 一站式可视化管理 DSH 的 SKILL 与 MCP：MCP按需加载、会话内热重载、SKILL与MCP描述可在插件内直接查看

description.en: Union workspaces: merge multiple directories into one session, manage unions from a settings panel, and read/write member files via uw_read/uw_write/uw_edit/uw_delete/uw_move tools.
description.zh: 联合工作区：将多个目录合并到一个会话中，通过设置面板管理联合工作区，使用 uw_read/uw_write/uw_edit/uw_delete/uw_move 工具读写成员目录文件。

description.en: Configurable default model for subagent delegations via settings.yaml, with single-model and multi-model round-robin or random strategies.
description.zh: 通过 settings.yaml 为子代理派发配置默认模型，支持单模型与多模型轮换/随机分配策略。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration layer for DeepSeek Harness — autopilot/ralph/team execution modes, 19 role cards, 40 bilingual skills, and a bundled MCP state server, ported from oh-my-claudecode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的多智能体编排层——autopilot/ralph/team 三种执行模式、19 张角色卡、40 个双语技能与内置 MCP 状态服务，移植自 oh-my-claudecode。

description.en: Usage tiers and shareable stats cards: 🐟→🐳 ranks by monthly token burn with a locally-computed estimated percentile, precise pricing for 46 models across 6 vendors (including size-tiered Chinese pricing), backfill of pre-install sessions, and old-vs-new comparison across the 2026-08-17 rate change. Local-only, no telemetry.
description.zh: 用量段位与战绩卡片：按本月 token 消耗评 🐟→🐳 五档段位，分位本地估算（零上报）；6 家厂商 46 个模型精准计价，支持国内厂商按输入长度分档；自动回填安装前的历史会话；8·17 调价前后同一份用量的新旧价对比。数据全在本机，无遥测。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop-style theme for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with compact sidebar and chat layouts, light and dark themes, model and reasoning-effort controls, and an interactive pixel whale with spout, hop and tail-wag reactions on new sessions.
description.zh: 面向 macOS 与 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 的 Claude Code Desktop 风格主题，提供紧凑侧栏与会话布局、浅色与深色主题、模型与推理强度控件，以及支持随机喷水、轻弹和摆尾互动的新会话页像素小鲸鱼。

description.en: Cline Pass for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one pi-ai provider route pinned to the DeepSeek upstream channel, key entered on Settings → Models. Share-only snapshot — 分享性质，非长期维护。
Langfuse observability for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): exports agent sessions as OpenTelemetry trace trees (GenAI semconv) to Langfuse's OTLP endpoint
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体会话导出为 OpenTelemetry 追踪树，接入 Langfuse 做 LLM 可观测性分析。

description.en: Cline Pass for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one pi-ai provider route pinned to the DeepSeek upstream channel, key entered on Settings → Models. Share-only snapshot — 分享性质，非长期维护。
description.zh: 把 Cline Pass 接进 DSH，注册一条 OpenAI 兼容路由，还能看清聊天响应到底来自哪个上游。

description.en: DSH Web 工作区侧栏替代，顶部全局最近会话 + Workspace→Session 二级菜单 + 面包屑 | DSH Web workspace sidebar replacement: top global recent sessions + Workspace→Session two-level menu + breadcrumbs
description.zh: DSH Web 工作区侧栏替代，顶部全局最近会话 + Workspace→Session 二级菜单 + 面包屑 | DSH Web workspace sidebar replacement: top global recent sessions + Workspace→Session two-level menu + breadcrumbs

description.en: A chibi blue-haired maid desktop pet for the DSH Web UI with 106 hand-drawn transparent animations, desktop wandering, chat through local Ollama or the DSH online models, and optional screen watching.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的 Q 版蓝发小女仆桌宠：106 个手绘透明动画、桌面漫步、本地 Ollama 或 DSH 在线模型陪聊，可选看屏幕吐槽。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness的壁纸管理插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换个壁纸和主题，一键切换外观预设，还能深度定制界面风格。

description.en: dsh-dock · DeepSeek Harness 功能坞插件：一张面板统一注册/开关所有小功能——用量记账（自定义单价·分时价）、模型设置与余额、19 种任务动画、任务通知（钉钉/飞书）、运行状态、图片理解代理、账号密码远程访问、10 款小游戏。每个功能独立模块，可开关、错误隔离、即插即用。
description.zh: 一张面板管住所有小功能：用量记账、模型余额、任务动画通知、小游戏，随开随关。

description.en: Cline 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 Cline 的免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，白嫖 AI 能力，省下 API 费用。

description.en: 东方玄学人生工作台 — DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件：排盘算事实，规则标信号，DSH 写解读
description.zh: 在 DSH 里排八字紫微、自动建会话写解读，东方玄学命理工作台。

description.en: Agent teams: spawn named long-lived teammates, coordinate them with a shared task list, member mailbox, and virtual workspaces, and watch the team live in a team-room tab.
description.zh: Agent 团队：派生具名常驻队友，用共享任务列表、成员邮箱与虚拟工作区协作，并在协作室页签里实时观察团队。

description.en: Quickly view, search, and jump to all the messages you sent in a long conversation.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Deepseek Harness插件，可以直接在Deepseek Harness中使用网页版deepseek进行聊天，并将聊天过程直接迁移到Deepseek Harness进一步进行开发。主要目的是节省前期方案讨论时的token
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness内直接调用网页版DeepSeek聊天，聊完一键将上下文迁入本地继续开发，省下前期规划Token。

description.en: Skin plugin for the DSH Web UI: 4 built-in skins plus custom image skins with the photo as a full-interface background and the palette following its dominant hue.
description.zh: DSH Web 换肤插件：4 套内置皮肤 + 自定义图片皮肤，图片作为全界面背景，配色自动跟随图片主色调。

description.en: A Vibe Learning Plugin made for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在会话里和 AI 一起搭大纲、上课答疑、安排复习和小测，还能随手记笔记。

description.en: tencentcloud-agentobs-sdk-dsh 是一个 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 可观测插件，直接将 GenAI trace 数据上报到腾讯云日志服务 (CLS)。  它观察 DSH 原生的 session、agent loop、LLM stream 和 tool 生命周期，将其转换为 腾讯云AI Agent可观测规范的 5 层 span 层级模型（entry → agent → step → chat → tool），并通过 tencentcloud-cls-sdk-js 直接上报到 CLS，无需额外部署 OTLP 收集器或 sidecar。
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 GenAI 追踪数据直接上报到腾讯云日志服务，实现 AI 应用的可观测性。

description.en: A Codex-like effort switcher for Deepseek Harness.
description.zh: 为DSH添加一个类似于Codex的推理强度切换器。

description.en: Telegram mobile remote that attaches the phone to a live DeepSeek Harness Web session: workspace-then-session picker (/sessions), /last for the previous Q/A, /model switch, and native Rich Message replies.
description.zh: Telegram 手机遥控器：附着本机正在跑的 Web 会话，支持 /sessions 工作区→会话选择、/last 查看上次问答、/model 切换模型，以及原生 Rich Message 回复。

description.en: Live2D desk pet for DSH: 8-state AI status lamp, web widget, and always-on-top transparent Electron pet window with expressions, motions, and chat bubbles.
description.zh: DSH 的 Live2D 桌宠：8 态 AI 状态灯 + 网页挂件 + 置顶透明 Electron 桌宠窗，表情/动作/气泡齐全，换模型自动适配。

description.en: Portable Agent Skill for developing and auditing DeepSeek Harness plugins, with an optional profile-installable DSH bundle adapter.
description.zh: Portable Agent Skill for developing and auditing DeepSeek Harness plugins, with an optional profile-installable DSH bundle adapter.

description.en: 改配置+重启才能加 MCP？DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件「技能配置」解决：设置页粘贴 JSON 即连 MCP 服务器、热加载免重启；上传 zip/.skill 自动识别 SKILL.md，创建/编辑/启停技能，即点即用
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页直接管理 MCP 服务器和技能包，粘贴 JSON 即可热加载，无需重启，还支持上传 .skill 文件自动解析。

description.en: Expert-mode agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (v0.9.2, npm dsh-expert-mode, bilingual EN/ZH): a chief coordinator plus 17 domain-expert subagents with automatic task delegation. Features: taskboard scheduler (file-system task state machine pending/ready/running/done/failed, dependency DAG, atomic claim, retry, crash recovery), quality gates (5-stage pipeline for high-risk tasks: requirement clarity, implementation, verification, independent review, integration, with 2-round rework limit), Five-Anchor constraint (review/convergence/anti-drift/collaboration-check/resource-awareness per turn), Near-distance Guidance (identity/task/output template per expert), progressive disclosure (~28% token savings), expert persistence, inter-expert file message bus (direct P2P comm, zero coordinator relay), cross review, experience pool, fast-track for simple tasks, fault recovery with auto-retry. Experts: data analyst, copywriter, legal review, product manager, frontend, UI/UX, architect, social media ops, growth hacker, quant finance, finance, backend, DevOps, database, QA, security.
description.zh: 专家模式 agent preset（v0.9.2，npm 包 dsh-expert-mode，双语双份）：首席协调官 + 17 位领域专家子代理，按任务特性自动委派。特性：任务调度器（文件系统任务状态机 pending/ready/running/done/failed + 依赖DAG + 原子认领 + 重试 + 崩溃恢复）、质量门禁（高风险任务五段式：需求澄清→实现→验证→独立评审→集成，最多回炉2轮）、五锚约束（每轮回顾/收敛/反跑题/协作检查/资源感知自检）+ 近距离引导（身份/任务/输出格式模板）+ 渐进式披露（省token约28%）+ 专家持久化 + 专家间文件消息总线（P2P直连，零协调官中转）+ 交叉评审 + 经验沉淀 + 简单任务快速通道 + 故障自动重试。专家：数据分析/文案/法务/产品/前端/UI-UX/架构/社交运营/增长/量化/财务/后端/DevOps/数据库/QA/安全/生图短视频。

description.en: SSH remote-execution: ProxyJump chain, SFTP
description.zh: SSH 远程执行：ProxyJump 链、SFTP

description.en: Session change-review plugin for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls per session and renders line-level diffs with customizable colors, with session isolation, subagent aggregation, and SSE live updates.
description.zh: 会话修改审查插件：追踪会话内 write/edit 工具调用并展示 diff 对比；会话隔离、子代理聚合、SSE 实时推送、角标与颜色自定义。

description.en: The most complete GitHub integration for dsh: repo overview, releases, issues, pull requests, contributors, search, and a deep repo report with TTL caching — no API key needed.
description.zh: 目前最完整的 dsh GitHub 整合：仓库概览、Release、Issue、PR、贡献者、搜索与一键深度报告，内置 TTL 缓存，无需 API Key。

description.en: Wallpaper plus optional Liquid Glass islands for the DSH Web UI: Ice/Deepwater presets, import, wallpaper opacity, and per-island blur on official light/dark/system.
description.zh: DSH Web 液态玻璃皮肤：冰原/深水壁纸、可导入、壁纸透明度，以及叠在官方浅色/深色/跟随系统上的分岛模糊。

description.en: 害怕插件装了就崩溃？用这个插件帮你检测插件是否正常/是否含木马！
description.zh: 害怕插件装了就崩溃？用这个插件帮你检测插件是否正常/是否含木马！

description.en: Git Bash shell tool for Windows: runs commands through the bash bundled with Git for Windows, with timeout, sandbox, output truncation, and background jobs, replacing the slow pwsh tool and the WSL-only bash tool.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 Git Bash 工具：通过 Git for Windows 自带的 bash 执行命令，支持超时、沙箱、输出截断与后台任务，替代卡顿的 pwsh 工具与仅限 WSL 的 bash 工具。

description.en: Evaluation harness for DSH plugins: YAML cases drive real headless agent runs, assert on tool calls, args, results and token usage, with a baseline gate for CI regression.
description.zh: DSH 插件评测框架：YAML 用例驱动真实 headless agent，断言工具调用/参数/返回与 token 用量，baseline 门禁做 CI 回归。

description.en: Replay sessions on a playable timeline with per-step token usage, audit sensitive operations, estimate cost, view fork lineage, compare sessions, and export standalone HTML replays.
description.zh: 在可播放的时间线上回放会话并显示逐步 token 用量，审计敏感操作，估算成本，查看 fork 血缘，对比会话，并可导出独立 HTML 回放。

description.en: Multi-platform research and deep search pipeline: harvest_scout for parallel discovery across GitHub, Web, Twitter, Reddit, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, and YouTube, harvest_deep_research for automated comprehensive research reports, plus extract, cross-source verification, and credibility auditing.
description.zh: 多平台调研与深度搜索流水线：harvest_scout 并行发现（覆盖 GitHub、Web、推特、Reddit、小红书、B站、YouTube 等通道），harvest_deep_research 自动化长篇综合研报生成，外加穿透抓取、跨源交叉验证与五维来源可信度审计。

description.en: Automatic session retrospective: after a conversation wraps up, distills useful experience into reusable skills stored in the skill library for the model to call, with signal-accelerated triggers, manual runs, an approval mode, and skill-library governance (archive/restore, never deletes directly).
description.zh: 自动复盘：对话收尾后自动把有价值的经验蒸馏成可复用的技能（skill）存入技能库，支持信号加速触发、手动立即复盘、审批模式与技能库治理（归档/恢复，永不直接删除）。

description.en: A whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro: it watches the reasoning fingerprint of every thinking block and pulls the model back when it slips from focused "We will / I will" mode into scattered "let me" mode.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的鞭子：实时监听每个思维块的指纹，当模型从专注的 We will / I will 模式滑向发散的 let me 模式时把它拉回来。

description.en: Low-cost video understanding tool: a video_understand tool turns a Bilibili link / BV / local video into an AVIS info layer (ASR + scene structure + object tracks + YOLO labels) and returns summary + Q&A. Question-driven dynamic routing across layers (L0 ASR / L1 object tracks / L2 key-frame VLM), semantic-layer reuse for repeat questions, per-question budget cap. Python engine: core layer needs faster-whisper / opencv / yt-dlp (~200-300MB); the optional semantic layer adds ~2GB of torch / transformers / ultralytics. A bundled doctor --fix sets up the venv and installs both.
description.zh: 低成本视频理解工具：video_understand 把 B站链接/BV号/本地视频转成 AVIS 信息层（ASR+场景结构+对象轨迹+YOLO 标签）并输出摘要+问答。问题驱动动态路由分层（L0 ASR / L1 对象轨迹 / L2 关键帧 VLM）、语义层复用（重复提问直接查层）、单次问题预算上限。Python 引擎：核心层需 faster-whisper / opencv / yt-dlp（约 200-300MB）；可选语义层另需约 2GB 的 torch / transformers / ultralytics。内置 doctor --fix 一键建 venv 并装齐两者。

description.en: Multi-engine text-to-image generation (OpenAI Images and Zhipu CogView presets) with per-session quota tracking, engine failover, credential-safe config, and a result card with regenerate.
description.zh: 多引擎文生图（OpenAI Images 与智谱 CogView 预设）：按会话配额、引擎故障切换、凭证安全配置，结果卡片支持重新生成。

description.en: Computer use through an external USB HID device: name a target in plain language, a vision model locates it in a cropped window screenshot, and a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 moves the real mouse and types on the real keyboard. 7 tools. Windows has window listing, per-window cropping and automatic window raising; macOS needs pyobjc and has neither; Linux is unsupported.
description.zh: 通过外接 USB HID 硬件做电脑控制：用一句话描述目标，视觉模型在裁剪后的窗口截图里定位，树莓派 Pico 2 驱动真实鼠标和键盘完成动作。7 个工具。Windows 支持窗口枚举、按窗口裁剪与自动抬窗；macOS 需 pyobjc 且不支持这两项；Linux 不支持。

description.en: Self-hosted DSH Web operations panel for safe restart and upgrade, health diagnostics, model-usage statistics and provider quota lookup, backup and session management, task notifications, skill controls, subagent model routing, and Linux permission maintenance.
description.zh: 面向自托管 DSH Web 的运维面板：安全重启与升级、健康诊断、模型用量统计与供应商额度查询、备份和会话管理、任务通知、技能控制、子代理模型路由与 Linux 权限维护。

description.en: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
description.zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

description.en: Notifies you when a conversation finishes: plays a sound and shows a Windows notification when the agent goes idle (configurable sound file, volume, debounce/throttle).
description.zh: 对话完成提醒：Agent 空闲（idle）时播放提示音并弹 Windows 原生通知，可配 ding.mp3、音量与防抖节流。

description.en: Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the model selector.
description.zh: Codex 风格推理等级滑块，内嵌于模型选择器，拖动切换推理档位。

description.en: Adds OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness as one provider, backed by a managed, isolated OpenCode runtime, with a Settings page that lists each model and tests it.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型作为一组 provider 接入 DeepSeek Harness，底层是受管、隔离的 OpenCode 运行时，并在设置页列出每个模型并可逐个检测。

description.en: Plugin manager with a rescue center: grouped enable/disable by necessity, multi update sources (npm / dshfind market / GitHub), browser-first downloads with an auto-install folder, P2P fallback, pre-boot self-check and broken-bundle quarantine.
description.zh: 插件管理器与救砖中心：按必要程度分组启停、多更新源（npm / 插件超市 / GitHub）、浏览器下载优先与目录自动安装、P2P 兜底、启动前自检与坏包隔离。

description.en: Live progress for long-running DSH tasks: a script appends JSON lines to a per-session progress file, the Web UI draws them in a floating overlay and a right-sidebar tab that also lists background jobs which reported nothing, and `dsh-progress run -- <cmd>` wraps a command that cannot report for itself.
description.zh: DSH 长任务的实时进度：脚本往该会话自己的进度文件追加 JSON 行，不能自报进度的命令可用 `dsh-progress run -- <cmd>` 包装，Web 界面用悬浮窗与右侧栏 tab 展示，未上报的后台任务也会列成任务行。

description.en: Authentication gateway for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the login gate covers pages, /api, /plugins and WebSocket upgrades; PBKDF2 password hashing with per-user salts, HttpOnly SameSite session cookies named per DSH_HOME and IP-based login lockout; invite-code registration; two-factor login with TOTP or passkeys (WebAuthn: several keys per account, phone enrolment by QR, username-less sign-in, and a step-up before any login factor is added or removed); a user-management settings panel (users edit their own profile and manage their own TOTP and passkeys, admins add or remove users, reset passwords, manage invites and clear the passkeys of a lost device); per-user model and API-key configuration whose private entries are encrypted with a key derived from the login password and stay unreadable by any admin, with admin sharing to selected users (usable, balance visible, key never shown, revocation immediate) and unconfigured users blocked rather than falling back to the deployment configuration; per-user isolation on the REST and list APIs and per-frame ownership filtering on the WebSocket mux; session persistence across restarts; a JSONL audit log; and a fail-closed gateway. Requires the DSH 0.2.0 line (the 0.1.1-rc.2 transport line was removed in 0.7.0); passkey login needs a localhost or HTTPS origin because browsers require a secure context.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 认证网关：登录门禁覆盖页面、/api、/plugins 与 WebSocket 升级；PBKDF2 口令哈希（每用户独立盐）、HttpOnly SameSite 会话 Cookie（名字按 DSH_HOME 唯一）、按源 IP 登录锁定；邀请码注册；两步验证可用 TOTP 动态码或通行密钥（WebAuthn：一个账号可绑定多个密钥，手机可扫码添加，支持免用户名登录，改动登录因子前必须二次验证）；设置面板内置用户管理（普通用户可修改本人资料与密码并管理自己的 TOTP 与通行密钥，管理员可新增/删除用户、重置密码、管理邀请码、清除丢失设备的通行密钥）；模型与 API Key 按用户隔离管理，私有配置用登录口令派生的密钥加密、任何管理员都无法读取，管理员可把自己的模型分享给指定用户（可用、可看余额、看不到 Key、撤销立即生效），未配置的用户被阻断而不是回退到部署级配置；REST/列表接口按用户隔离，WebSocket 主通道逐帧按归属过滤；会话重启后免登录恢复；JSONL 审计日志；存储故障时保持 fail-closed。仅支持 DSH 0.2.0 线（0.1.1-rc.2 传输线已在 0.7.0 移除）；因浏览器要求安全上下文，通行密钥需通过 localhost 或 HTTPS 访问。

description.en: DSH Web GUI right sidebar: VS Code-style file explorer plus source control (git status, stage/unstage/discard, commit, diff, commit graph, fetch/pull/push sync, branch and remote management, git init, multi-repo switch, color-coded file status, file-type icons), an editor view that opens every file reached from the chat, the file tree or source control (Markdown/HTML/PDF/image previews, 15-language syntax highlighting, hunk-level diff editing, Ctrl+S save), file operations (new/move/copy/delete, reveal in file explorer), a collapsible icon rail, a multi-tab bottom terminal (ConPTY), and commit messages generated from the staged diff by a host-configured model.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 右侧边栏：VS Code 风格文件浏览器加源代码管理（git 状态、暂存/取消暂存/放弃变更、提交、差异、提交图形、抓取/拉取/推送同步、分支与远程管理、Git 初始化、多仓库切换、文件状态着色、文件类型图标），并提供打开会话/文件树/源代码管理里任一文件的编辑器视图（Markdown/HTML/PDF/图片预览、15 种语言语法高亮、逐块差异编辑、Ctrl+S 保存）、文件操作（新建/移动/复制/删除、在文件管理器中显示）、可折叠图标窄条、多标签底部终端（ConPTY），以及由宿主已配置模型基于暂存差异生成提交信息。

description.en: Connects WeChat, QQ, DingTalk, Lark, and Telegram to DeepSeek Harness with unified configuration, private-chat and group access controls, and channel-side Agent chat and session commands.
description.zh: 将微信、QQ、钉钉、飞书和 Telegram 接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供统一配置、私聊与群聊访问范围管理，以及渠道内 Agent 对话和会话指令。

description.en: Visual round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness — expert nodes on a ring with directed edges, an aggregation gateway, proxy thinking for black-box worker models, and adversarial review (red-team) of settled plans with per-viewpoint endorse/reject.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话变成可视化圆桌会议：环形专家拓扑、连线协作、汇聚网关、代理思考，以及「针锋相对」红队评审（观点支持/驳回）。

description.en: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加入更好的流式文字动画。

description.en: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech that reads DeepSeek Harness assistant replies aloud, with a draggable mascot toggle and a one-click installer. Requires Python 3.10–3.12 preinstalled (the installer only locates it, it does not install Python); about 5 GB of disk and a GPU are recommended.
description.zh: 用本地 GPT-SoVITS 把 DeepSeek Harness 的助手回复读出来，带可拖动的挂件开关与一键部署。需预装 Python 3.10–3.12（安装器只负责定位，不负责安装）；建议约 5 GB 磁盘与 GPU。

description.en: Settings card for the DSH LLM auto-retry engine: tune retry count, backoff and jitter live from Settings -> General, with configurable retryableCodes chips - defaults add INVALID_REQUEST so OpenAI-style HTTP 400 reasoning_text errors in thinking mode get retried automatically.
description.zh: LLM 自动重试设置卡片：在设置页实时调整重试次数、退避与抖动，并可勾选额外可重试错误码（retryableCodes）—— 默认补入 INVALID_REQUEST，OpenAI thinking 模式 HTTP 400 reasoning_text 报错开箱即自动重试。

description.en: Forces context compression when running low-context llama.cpp models such as Qwen3.8-27B, improving model efficiency and usage smoothness, together with well-refined compaction prompts.
description.zh: llama-cpp qwen3.8-27b 低上下文时，强制上下文压缩插件，提示模型使用效率和使用流畅度，外加完善的压缩提示。

description.en: VS Code-style local workbench for DSH with a file explorer, Monaco editor, full-text search and a Git panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 VS Code 风格的本地工作台，含文件资源管理器、Monaco 编辑器、全文搜索与 Git 面板。

description.en: Ten video tools (probe/cut/concat/encode/subtitle/extract/gif/frames/adjust/health) on the official subprocess service: probe summaries, batch frame extraction, speed/volume/mute/rotate adjust, shell-free argv, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 视频处理十工具（探测/剪辑/拼接/转码/字幕烧录/抽帧/批量抽帧/GIF/调整/健康自检）：探测摘要、变速/音量/静音/旋转调整、官方 subprocess 服务、argv 无 shell 注入、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Multi-machine sync: keeps multiple dsh replicas consistent through one private GitCode repository — skills, sessions, settings and plugin manifests each with an independent switch; changes go through branch, PR and merge, remote-only additions are pulled back before every push so nothing is deleted, and an AI smart-align step semantically merges files both sides changed (plus one-click conflict resolution); private repos enforced, pull never overwrites local edits.
description.zh: 多机同步：让多台机器上的 dsh 通过一个私有 GitCode 仓库保持一致——技能、会话、设置、插件清单四类内容各有独立开关；变更走分支 → PR → 合并，推送前自动回填远端新增防误删，支持 AI 智能对齐（语义合并双方改动）与一键解决冲突；强制私有仓库，pull 不覆盖本地改动。

description.en: Signs in to a ChatGPT account over OAuth and serves that plan's models as a DeepSeek Harness provider route, calling api.openai.com/v1/responses with the account's plan scope rather than the Codex backend.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 登录 ChatGPT 账号，把该套餐的模型作为 DeepSeek Harness 的 provider 路由提供；调用 api.openai.com/v1/responses 并使用账号的套餐授权范围，而非 Codex 后端。

description.en: PPT workbench: eleven ppt_* tools create, edit, reverse-engineer, QA-check and export slides from a plain-text PPTD project; five design-system families, themes, animations, posters and infographics.
description.zh: PPT 制作插件：十一个 ppt_* 工具创建、编辑、逆向、质检与导出演示文稿，内置五族设计系统与主题模板，支持幻灯片动画、海报与信息图。

description.en: Human-readable Markdown memory for DeepSeek Harness: user-level (~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md) + workspace-level memory injected every turn, auto daily-log writing with distillation, bridges existing WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy memory dirs, memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read tools with built-in dedup, and a bilingual settings page. Plain-text storage, no database.
description.zh: 人类可读的 Markdown 记忆插件：用户级（~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md）+ 工作区级双层记忆，每轮自动注入提示词，回合结束自动写日志并按期蒸馏沉淀；可桥接已有 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 记忆目录；内置 memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read 三个工具（自动去重）与中英双语设置页。纯文件存储、无数据库，记事本即可编辑。

description.en: Bilibili-style danmaku overlay for the DSH Web chat area: scroll, top and bottom tracks driven by agent events, three preset packs, optional LLM-generated comments, a draggable control ball, per-session pools with replay, and a settings card.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 对话区叠加 B 站风格弹幕：按 agent 事件生成滚动/顶部/底部三轨弹幕，三套预设包、可选 LLM 生成吐槽、可拖动控制球、分会话弹幕池与历史回放，以及完整设置卡。

description.en: DSH 桌面端 Claude 风格主题插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端换上 Claude Code 风格皮肤，支持明暗主题和模型、强度选择。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness Agent 拥有操作 GitHub 的原生手脚！零 Token 泄露复用宿主机 gh 凭据，内置 18 大领域工具矩阵（104 Action，覆盖率 87%）：支持 PR 自动审查合并、CI 报错秒级修复、Copilot 智能体调度、Discussions 社区讨论、Projects v2 看板及 SWR 0ms 秒开全景工作台。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接用 gh 打通本地 Git 和 GitHub，PR、Issue、CI 诊断、代码审查一站搞定。

description.en: DSH 插件：内含 ppt-maker 技能与十一个 ppt_* 工具。创建 / 编辑 / 逆向 / 质检 / 导出 PPT，本地纯 TS 引擎直出 .pptx
description.zh: 在 DSH 里就能创建、编辑、复刻和导出 PPT，纯本地导出不用联网。

description.en: Codex-style Side Chat for DeepSeek Harness — select text, ask follow-up questions in a focused side conversation, and keep the main chat uninterrupted.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中开启侧边对话，选中代码即可追问，不打断主聊天流程。

description.en: DSH Desktop 右上角电源菜单：关闭 / 重启整个应用。Windows only, MIT.
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面版右上角加个电源按钮，一键关闭或重启应用，改完插件不用再翻系统托盘。

description.en: SSH remote development for DeepSeek Harness: native files and terminals, remote editing, @ references, port forwarding, resumable transfers, and in-app updates. Powered by your OpenSSH config.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接连 SSH 远程工作区，浏览读写远程文件、跑远程命令，还能看连接状态。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的软工作流插件：在画布上设计流程，编译成计划提示词，由模型按计划执行；运行状态由模型自己记，没有执行引擎
description.zh: 在画布上拖拽设计流程，编译成计划提示词让模型照着执行，状态由模型自己记，不用执行引擎。
让配置好的请求头（比如 User-Agent）真正传到 pi-ai 接口，解决 OpenCode ZEN 免费模型 429 报错。

description.en: Tavily search with multiple API keys, key rotation/failover, usage gauge, and a settings card for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Tavily 网页搜索，支持多 API 密钥自动轮换与故障切换，并实时显示用量。

description.en: Manage DSH conversations: one cross-workspace table with batch archiving, body search over message text, and recycle-bin deletion you can undo.
description.zh: DSH 对话管家：跨工作区总表与批量归档、正文搜索，以及可恢复的回收站式删除。

description.en: Unofficial DSH plugin: drive AI web UIs (DeepSeek/Qwen/...) in a REAL browser via DSH's own Chromium webview guest — real login, real typing, real send, reply captured by observing the page's own SSE. Includes tool calling.
description.zh: 用真实浏览器操作 DeepSeek、通义千问等 AI 网页版，自动输入并抓取回复，无需调 API。

description.en: An AI-native browser workspace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), combining multi-tab browsing, live page annotations, lightweight code editing, workspace previews, and Agent-assisted iteration across Web and Desktop.
description.zh: DSH Web 与 Desktop 端的内置浏览器：为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供的 AI 原生浏览器工作区，融合了多标签浏览、实时页面批注、轻量级代码编辑、工作区预览，以及跨网页和桌面的智能助手辅助迭代功能。

description.en: DSH 插件：Host 半边接收交接请求 → 建新会话 → 交接包作为第一条消息。（已弃用 2026-10-17：换会话整条退役——续航交给 DSH 官方上下文压缩，跨重启续跑交给 dsh-memory-board）
description.zh: 把当前会话的交接包自动送进新会话，让 AI 换个窗口接着干活，不丢上下文。

description.en: Dispatch self-contained tasks from DSH to 11 external agent CLIs (Codex, Claude Code, TraeCode, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor, Kimi, Qwen, Copilot, WorkBuddy, Grok): a host-only bundle registering the conductor_dispatch tool plus an auto-triggered conductor skill.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里派活给 11 种外部 agent CLI（Codex、Claude Code、TraeCode、OpenCode、Gemini、Cursor、Kimi、Qwen、Copilot、WorkBuddy、Grok）：host-only bundle 注册 conductor_dispatch 工具，附自动触发的指挥家技能。

description.en: Log directly into your Cursor account within DeepSeek Harness and use your Cursor subscription — no API Key required, and no dependency on Cursor IDE or Cursor CLI. 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接登录 Cursor 账户并使用 Cursor 订阅，不需要 API Key， 也不依赖 Cursor IDE 或 Cursor CLI。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接登录 Cursor 账号，免 API Key 用上订阅，无需装 Cursor 客户端。

description.en: Local-first four-bucket Token observability: persistent session/provider/model/day dashboards, trends, budget and anomaly signals, public-rate estimates, safe aggregate exports, and explicit opt-in usage or session-trajectory analysis.
description.zh: 本地优先的四 bucket Token 可观测性：持久会话/provider/model/日期仪表盘、趋势、预算与异常信号、公开费率估算、安全聚合导出，以及显式触发的用量/会话轨迹分析。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 多对话面板：并排查看并与多个 Agent 会话同时交互。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里并排打开多个对话面板，同时查看和操控多个 Agent，像指挥中心一样高效协作。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app experts into DSH: a settings-page market scans the local WorkBuddy expert directory (experts land there after you summon them in WorkBuddy) read-only for browsing, search and category filtering, with one-click install (exported to ~/.dsh/experts/ as role prompt + skills + avatar), update and uninstall; a picker capsule next to the input box switches the current session's expert — swapping role prompt, skills and an optional tool whitelist wholesale while keeping full session history, applied at the next model-request boundary.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面端召唤落盘的本地专家带进 DSH：设置页市场只读扫描本地专家目录，卡片浏览/搜索/分类，一键安装（导出到 ~/.dsh/experts/，含角色描述、skills 与头像）、更新与卸载；输入框旁的专家胶囊为当前会话切换专家——整组替换角色描述与 skills（可选工具白名单），保留全部会话历史，在下一个模型请求边界生效。

description.en: Encrypted credential vault for DeepSeek Harness — AES-256-GCM + TOTP, model tools + Settings UI
description.zh: 加密凭据保险库：AES-256-GCM + TOTP，模型工具加密存取密钥。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：让自定义 llm-pi-ai provider 伪装成 Claude Code / Codex 客户端（伪造客户端身份请求头）。A DeepSeek Harness plugin: masquerade a custom llm-pi-ai provider as Claude Code / Codex clients (spoofed client identity headers).
description.zh: 让自定义模型伪装成 Claude Code / Codex 客户端，绕过网关的客户端身份校验。

description.en: @deepseek-ai/dsh-deepresearch 把证据优先的 Codemini 研究工作区带到 DSH。它提供持久工作流状态、模型工具、生成的 deepResearch Remote namespace 和“深度研究”Web 工作区，同时组合宿主已有的 Web 与 subagent 能力。
description.zh: havingautism/dsh-deepresearch 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。

description.en: Private Tailscale access for DeepSeek Harness Web: exact user allowlists, loopback-only gateway, and guarded Serve setup

Host-resident cron engine with a web jobs board and a timer_agent tool: fires real agent sessions on schedule, continuing a pinned session for context or starting fresh ones in a chosen project workspace.
description.zh: 常驻宿主的定时引擎，带 Web 任务面板与 timer_agent 工具：按 cron 计划触发真实 Agent 会话，可固定已有会话保持上下文连续，也可在指定项目目录新开会话。

description.en: Structural code intelligence for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — gives the agent codegraph and codegraph_index tools to find where a symbol is declared, what calls it, and what a change   reaches, from a tree-sitter index it builds itself. Compatible with the codegraph CLI's on-disk format.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码结构分析工具，快速定位符号声明、调用关系及变更影响范围。

description.en: Run a code review bot natively inside DSH
Private loopback DSH Web gateway for Tailscale Serve, Cloudflare Access, and Headscale TCP Serve, with exact principal allowlists and guided fail-closed setup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供仅回环的私有网关，支持 Tailscale Serve、Cloudflare Access 与 Headscale TCP Serve，精确主体白名单，引导式 fail-closed 配置。

description.en: DSH 插件：大图切 800×800 无损小块 + 坐标标注 + 分块聚合逻辑，直连 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 识别；仅用纯官方 DSH 功能，零依赖第三方插件，不统计 token/费用。
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Infinite-canvas e-commerce visual workspace for product photography, virtual try-on, background edits, and video, synced live with the Harness conversation.
description.zh: 电商可视化工作区：在无限画布上完成产品图、虚拟试穿、背景处理与视频生成，并与 Harness 对话实时同步。

description.en: Repair DeepSeek Harness sessions that refuse to load, with a sidebar Session surgeon overlay and dry-run repair.
description.zh: 修好打不开的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，侧栏「会话医生」可查看对话并默认 dry-run 修复。

description.en: Dispatch self-contained tasks from DSH to 11 external agent CLIs (Codex, Claude Code, TraeCode, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor, Kimi, Qwen, Copilot, WorkBuddy, Grok): a host-only bundle registering the conductor_dispatch tool plus an auto-triggered conductor skill.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里派活给 11 种外部 agent CLI（Codex、Claude Code、TraeCode、OpenCode、Gemini、Cursor、Kimi、Qwen、Copilot、WorkBuddy、Grok）：host-only bundle 注册 conductor_dispatch 工具，附自动触发的指挥家技能。

description.en: Closed-loop trajectory policy plane for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek pro 模型提供闭环轨迹控制，实时管理任务阶段与信息增益，避免重复无效调用。

description.en: Adds a configurable vision model to text-only main models: a vision_read_image tool, a composer-bar vision-model selector, and automatic image-to-text conversion for text-only routes.
description.zh: 给纯文本主模型加可配置识图模型：vision_read_image 工具、输入框识图模型选择器，以及纯文本路由的图片自动转文字。

description.en: Use wallpapers downloaded in Wallpaper Engine as the DeepSeek Harness web background: video wallpapers play in place, image wallpapers use the highest-resolution standalone artwork, with cover/contain fit modes and a 0-100 panel dimmer.
description.zh: 将 Wallpaper Engine 中已下载的壁纸用作 DeepSeek Harness 的背景：视频壁纸原位播放，图片壁纸优先使用最高分辨率原图，支持铺满/完整显示适配与 0–100 面板暗化。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件:OpenCode Go 用量与花费悬浮仪表盘(配额、逐请求成本、模型/来源分布)
description.zh: OpenCode Go 用量与花费面板 — DeepSeek Harness 插件:可拖拽缩放的悬浮仪表盘,实时展示 OpenCode Go 配额、逐请求用量与花费

description.en: 对话自动注入，可用于高概率破甲模型
description.zh: 新对话自动注入可编辑历史，支持隐藏带入，能高概率绕过模型限制，让对话更自由。

description.en: Expose DeepSeek Harness agent capabilities as an MCP server, letting any MCP client (e.g. Hermes) drive Harness to execute coding tasks.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的编码能力封装成 MCP 服务，让 Hermes 等任意 MCP 客户端直接调用它干活。

description.en: DSH bundle 插件：V4 Flash 神模式（opencode-go）agent preset 分发包，dsh plugin add 安装后自动同步 router-flash preset。DSH agent preset bundle for DeepSeek V4 Flash godmode.
description.zh: 一键把 DeepSeek V4 Flash 的 router-flash 神模式预设装进 DSH，重启即用，不用手动复制。

description.en: Select browser elements directly during Vibe Coding and send structured visual feedback to the DeepSeek Harness Agent.
description.zh: 面向 Vibe Coding 的浏览器元素标注插件：直接选取页面元素，并将结构化视觉反馈发送给 DeepSeek Harness Agent。

description.en: OpenAI Codex OAuth login and usage card plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: dsh-openai-codex-auth — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: Skill pool manager in the Settings sidebar: enable/disable, folder batch import with rename-conflict prompts, state-driven one-click DSH-spec check & auto-fix, system/project scope labels.
description.zh: 设置侧边栏的 Skill 管理器：池与启用目录启停、文件夹批量导入（重名询问）、状态驱动一键规范检查与自动修复、系统级/项目级来源标识。

description.en: Self-evolution: the agent hot-mounts/removes persistent plugins on itself mid-session.
description.zh: 自进化：agent 在会话内给自己热挂载/卸载持久化插件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness record macOS desktop workflows by demonstration and turn them into agent skills (open-record-replay skill + orr_* tools)
description.zh: 在 macOS 上录制你的桌面操作，自动生成可复用的 AI 技能，让智能体学会你的工作流程。

description.en: Plugin template repo (based on the official turtle-ui repo).
description.zh: 插件模板仓库（基于 turtle-ui 官方仓库）。

description.en: Secondary working directories for a DSH project: the agent keeps the primary workspace as cwd and gains equal read/write/exec permissions on configured secondary directories, configurable from the session header and the new-session page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 项目提供副工作目录：agent 保持主工作区为 cwd，同时对已配置的副目录获得同等读写/执行权限，可在会话头部与新会话页配置。

description.en: Registers the RainSkills bootstrap skill in DeepSeek Harness for deploying, troubleshooting, and verifying applications on Rainbond.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 RainSkills 引导技能，用于通过 Rainbond 部署、排障和验证应用。

description.en: SSH remote workspace — run bash, file tools, glob and grep on a remote machine over plain sshd (exec + SFTP), zero remote install, purely additive.
description.zh: SSH 远端工作区——在远端机器上执行 bash、文件读写、glob 与 grep（基于 sshd 的 exec + SFTP），远端零安装，纯附加。

description.en: Chat-operated multi-database admin plugin for DeepSeek Harness: query and manage MySQL, PostgreSQL, GaussDB, MongoDB, Redis, Oracle, DM and SQLite from the conversation with project-scoped ro/rw grants, a sidebar management panel, schema browsing and data preview, and confirmation-gated dangerous operations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区插件：在对话中直接管理多数据库（MySQL、PostgreSQL、GaussDB、MongoDB、Redis、Oracle、达梦、SQLite），支持项目级 ro/rw 授权、侧边栏管理面板、结构浏览与数据预览，危险操作需确认后执行。

description.en: Connect multiple Overleaf projects to DSH through OverleafMCP for browsing, analysis, and Git-based file updates.
description.zh: 通过 OverleafMCP 将多个 Overleaf 项目接入 DSH，支持浏览、分析和通过 Git 写回 LaTeX 文件。

description.en: Scheduled tasks: run a prompt on cron schedules, each run opens a new agent session to do the work, with workspace binding, manual run, session auto-naming, and a fullscreen task management page.
description.zh: 定时任务：用 cron 表达式定时执行提示词，到点自动开一个新 agent 会话替你干活，支持绑定工作区、手动立即执行与会话自动命名。

description.en: Live token stats under the DSH Web composer: streamed tokens/s, output token and first-byte latency, plus per-step estimate-vs-actual reconciliation using the official BPE tokenizer, to tell a slow stream from a stalled one.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时渲染 token 状态带：基于 DeepSeek 官方 BPE 分词表显示流式 token/s、输出 token 与首字延迟，并对比每次 step 的估算与实际偏差，用于判断生成是慢还是卡住。

description.en: Mobile-first Web UI quality-of-life pack for the DeepSeek Harness: a Chrome-style active-session tab bar, full-screen sidebar swipe open/close, overlay sidebar, collapsed-sidebar recents, keyboard-suppressing session switching, viewport/IME keyboard adaptation, touch feedback, code/table inner scrolling, hidden permission dropdown, a full-screen settings rewrite with tab memory, and a compositor-driven status pulse, no-touch-drag long-press protection — 14 features, each independently toggleable from the Settings QoL section with instant effect, persisted per browser in localStorage; pure client-side CSS/JS, mobile rules locked to viewports of 768px and below so desktop stays untouched.
description.zh: 面向 dsh Web GUI 的移动优先体验优化包：Chrome 式活跃会话标签页（Tab Bar）、全屏侧栏滑动开合、侧栏浮层与折叠态最近会话、切换会话不拉起输入法、viewport/键盘安全区适配、按钮触摸反馈、代码块表格内滚、隐藏权限下拉、设置页全屏重写与页签记忆、合成器线程状态动画、长按拖拽卡死修复——14 项功能均可在设置页 QoL 分区独立开关、即时生效，并按浏览器持久保存在 localStorage；纯客户端 CSS/JS，移动规则锁定 ≤768px 视口，桌面端零影响。

description.en: SearXNG-backed web_search provider for the web seam: free, self-hosted, key-less metasearch through your own instance's JSON API, with a bundled loopback-only docker-compose example.
description.zh: 基于 SearXNG 的 web_search provider：通过自建实例的 JSON API 实现免费、免密钥的元搜索，附仅绑定回环地址的 docker-compose 示例。

description.en: Lets one session read, write and run bash across several folders, not just the primary root — additional roots are registered from a sidebar Folders panel or the /workspace-folders command (inherit/read-only/read-write) and share the primary root's file-fence + OS-sandbox authorization; adds no new tools.
description.zh: 让单个会话在多个文件夹中读写并运行 bash，而不限于主目录——附加根经侧栏 Folders 面板或 /workspace-folders 命令登记（inherit/read-only/read-write），与主根共享同一套文件围栏 + 内核沙箱授权；不新增工具。

description.en: Qingxiao (Wuthering Waves) themed skin for the DSH web GUI, with ice-blue/jade/moon-white palette, sword-light motes and user-swappable backgrounds.
description.zh: 以《鸣潮》清宵为主题的 DSH Web 界面皮肤，冰蓝·青碧·月白配色，含剑气流光与可更换背景。

description.en: Early-stage plugin connecting DeepSeek Harness to a separately deployed, self-hosted OwnDsh server for team identity, model access control, quotas, and usage auditing.
description.zh: 早期开发中的团队管理插件，将 DeepSeek Harness 接入独立部署的自托管 OwnDsh 服务端，提供团队身份、模型授权、配额与用量审计。

description.en: Auto-resume for interrupted agent sessions: an ordered rule table routes by failure type (rate limit, quota, auth, context overflow, crashed orphan) to automatic backoff retry, model switch, resume after context compaction, or a stop-loss notification, with a visual rule editor and a full activity log.
description.zh: 自动续跑：agent 会话中断后自动续上，规则表按失败类型（限流/额度/鉴权/上下文超限/崩溃孤儿）路由——自动退避重试、换模型继续、压缩上下文后继续或止损通知，规则可视化编辑，全程活动日志。

description.en: Local code intelligence for DSH: Impact X-Ray visualizes potential change impact with inspectable source evidence and uncertainty; also provides symbol navigation, bounded Context Packs and ArkTS support.
description.zh: DSH 本地代码智能插件：Impact X-Ray 可视化展示潜在变更影响、源码证据与不确定性，并提供符号导航、有界 Context Pack 和 ArkTS 支持。

description.en: From chat to canvas to artwork — drive ComfyUI as a visual workflow IDE inside DSH. Embed ComfyUI (local or cloud) as a split-screen canvas in DeepSeek Harness Web: the agent sparks ideas, writes prompts and scripts right in the chat, applies them live to the canvas in front of you, and produces images, music, video, and 3D. From idea to finished output without ever leaving the conversation or switching front-ends: Canvas ops — compose and arrange pipelines, read/write workflows, edit nodes, wire links, run, tune parameters, and debug errors, all live and WYSIWYG on the exact canvas you are looking at; Production tasks — batch parameter sweeps (batch_run) and automatic output-image retrieval back into the chat (get_outputs), powering multi-modal creative and batch generation across images, music, video, and 3D; Environment upkeep — one-click launch of ComfyUI and one-click upgrade of the core plus every custom node (upgrade), keeping the stack healthy without interruption. This package is the DSH-side plugin, and it ships the ComfyUI-side bridge node too.
description.zh: 从对话到画布再到作品——DSH 里驾驭 ComfyUI 的可视化工作流 IDE。把 ComfyUI（本地或云端）以画布分屏嵌入 DeepSeek Harness Web，agent 在对话里激发创意、书写提示词与脚本，实时落到你眼前的画布上，产出图像、音乐、视频、3D。从灵感到成品，全程不离开对话，不用切换任何前端工具：画布操作——搭建编排、读写工作流、修改节点、连线、运行、调整参数、工作流查错，所见即所得，实时落在你眼前的画布上；生产任务——批量扫参（batch_run）、自动取回出图（get_outputs）带回对话，实现图像、音乐、视频、3D 等多任务智能创作与批量生产；环境维护——一键启动 ComfyUI、一键升级核心与全部自定义节点（upgrade），省心维护不间断。本仓库集成了 DSH 侧插件（画布副驾）+ ComfyUI 侧桥接节点，无人值守/规模化执行时可配合官方 ComfyUI MCP 服务器使用。

description.en: A web-novel writing engine for DeepSeek Harness: parallel drafting, outlining and brainstorming with a separate DeepSeek key, lore and foreshadowing management, semantic vector retrieval, a corpus library, usage ledger, mechanical proofreading, and a local serialization plan.
description.zh: 写文引擎：用独立 DeepSeek key 分流并发生成草稿/细纲/点子，设定与伏笔管理、语义向量检索、书库（饲料区）、用量总账、机械校对与本地连载计划。

description.en: Manage the DeepSeek Harness skill catalog from Settings: list what DSH actually resolves, enable or disable a skill by policy without touching its source file, read and edit SKILL.md, and create, import, or permanently delete skills.

Preset workbench for editing per-agent personas, system prompt sections and tool descriptions, selecting tools and skills, previewing request context, and importing or exporting JSON/YAML configurations.
description.zh: 预设工作台：逐方案编辑人设、系统提示词段和工具描述，选择工具与技能，预览请求组成，并通过 JSON / YAML 导入导出配置。

description.en: Agentic answer reviewer for DeepSeek Harness: each final assistant turn is re-reviewed by a separate LLM graded 1-100; below-threshold scores steer the agent back with concrete feedback. The score is shown as a chip on the answer's action row (green pass / red needs-work, with retry count and reason on hover). Live gate config from the Reviewer 配置 tab in the conversation view ring above the composer (对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置), from a 127.0.0.1 HTTP server, or from an optional right-sidebar tab via dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 智能体回答审查器：每一轮 agent 的最终输出由独立 LLM 重新打分（1-100），低于阈值时携带具体反馈引导 agent 自我修正；评分以角标形式展示在该回答的操作行上（通过=绿、未达标=红，悬停可见重试次数与原因）。闸值配置可从输入框上方视图栏的「Reviewer 配置」标签页（对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置）、本机 127.0.0.1 HTTP 服务或 dsh-better-sidebar 侧栏标签页实时修改。

description.en: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory.
description.zh: 带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动注入 boot 块（默认提问后才注入、且只注入当前激活会话），含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能、pack/unpack 迁移工具，以及空闲时以第一人称主动追忆（recall nudge）的拟人化能力。同时补上记忆库原先缺的“可观测 + 可维护”：按文件分配 boot 预算（索引路由表不再被截断）、自动戳记 last_access（salience 衰减真正生效）、只读记忆健康看板（体量/新鲜度/与 lint 同源的体检）、声明式索引编译器（页面声明 summary:，一条命令重写索引行），可拖动、可滚轮缩放的记忆图谱（页间链接 + 共享 tag）、结构化检索（tag/type/salience/hot/stale 过滤）、针对「尚无内容关系」页面的补链建议，以及以「最该做的 N 件事」收尾的 `checkup` 体检报告。同时把操作细节移到按需加载的技能，boot 注入体量减少约 23%。设置区块现在还有专属侧栏图标（半脑 + 节点——因为设置 shell 不给插件留图标位）和直达本仓库的反馈入口。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:memory。

description.en: Engineering intelligence for coding agents — persistent, evidence-aware, project-isolated engineering memory with unified hybrid search (memory + RAG documentation) for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向编程代理的工程智能——为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、证据感知、项目隔离的工程记忆，以及统一的混合搜索（记忆 + RAG 文档）。

description.en: Sidebar session search that builds its own index instead of reusing DSH's full-text one: title to content toggle in one entry, results grouped per session with the strongest snippet and user/reply/tool tags, plus watermark-based incremental sync, archive-driven pruning of archived sessions, and a shadow rebuild that never blocks the live index.
description.zh: 自带独立索引的侧边栏会话搜索（不再复用 DSH 官方全文索引）：一处入口在标题与内容检索间切换，结果按会话聚合，附最强命中片段与 用户/回复/工具 类型标签；水位驱动增量同步、按归档集合清理已归档会话，整理走影子索引不阻塞在用索引。

description.en: Reproducible science workbench: agent-driven cells, inline figures with feedback/rerun, manifest provenance, environment snapshots, and publication-grade figure skills (9 bio_* tools + workbench UI).
description.zh: 可复现科学分析工作台：agent 驱动的 cell、内联图形与反馈重画、manifest 溯源、环境快照与出版级出图技能（9 个 bio_* 工具 + 工作台界面）。

description.en: DeepSeek usage dashboard for DSH Web: days-left estimate from recent average spend, daily/monthly/cumulative costs with period-over-period comparison, per-model cost ranking, cache savings, peak/off-peak pricing impact, and a draggable floating balance widget.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 DeepSeek 用量仪表盘：按近期日均消耗估算可用天数，今日/本月/累计花费环比对照，分模型成本排行、缓存节省、峰谷定价影响，以及可拖动的悬浮余额窗。

description.en: FormatForge: forge 30+ file formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, EML, EPUB, TOML, archives) into AI-readable text via a drag-and-drop inbox, ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result tools and a CLI; scanned PDFs fall back to local OCR or an enhance hint for the session model.
description.zh: FormatForge：把 30+ 种文件格式（PDF、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX、EML、EPUB、TOML、压缩包）锻造成 AI 可读文本——网页拖拽入箱自动转换，提供 ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result 工具与 CLI；扫描件回退本地 OCR 或交给会话模型增强。

description.en: A right-side file workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web with source previews, captured DSH diffs, tabs, and a workspace tree.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 右侧文件工作区，提供源码预览、DSH 捕获差异、多文件标签页和工作区文件树。

description.en: Patent-writing gatekeeper for dsh - screens the idea against Chinese prior art first, then runs five-party alignment interviews, eight-chapter disclosure drafting, figures and simulation runs, seven-dimension review and docx/PDF export. Skills work out of the box; the search, export and experiment tools come from a bundled Python MCP service that ships disabled - one line in ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml enables it, and uvx fetches the wheel from PyPI.
description.zh: dsh 专利撰写把关人：动笔前先检索中国专利给出三档结论，再走五方对齐访谈、八章交底书、附图与仿真实验、七维审查与 docx/PDF 导出全流程。技能开箱即用；检索、导出与实验工具来自内置的 Python MCP 服务，默认关闭——在 ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml 里开一行即启用，uvx 会从 PyPI 自动拉取。

description.en: Header quota badge plus a usage-monitoring tab: live balance/quota remaining and reset countdown per provider, with requests, tokens (input/output/cache-read/cache-write), cache hit rate, estimated cost and average latency tracked per session, provider, model and client, stored locally in SQLite with cross-device import/export.
description.zh: 会话头部余量徽标 + 用量监控页签：实时展示各供应商余额/额度余量与重置倒计时，按会话/供应商/模型/客户端统计请求量、Token（输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写）、缓存命中率、预估费用与平均时延，本地 SQLite 留存历史，支持跨设备导入导出。

description.en: Role-based AI swarms for DeepSeek Harness: an architect plans, parallel builders execute, reviewers gate quality, and an integrator ships. Per-role model pinning with fallback chains, review loops, evidence contracts, human-gated reviews, quota-aware pause/resume, and a live kanban + flow chart in the web GUI. 40 tests; installs from GitHub or npm.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的角色化 AI 蜂群：架构师规划、多个建造者并行执行、评审代理把关、集成代理收尾。按角色钉选模型（含回退链），支持评审循环、证据合约、人工评审门、配额耗尽自动暂停与恢复，Web GUI 内置实时看板与任务流程图。40 个测试用例；支持 GitHub 或 npm 安装。

description.en: Wraps work in named tasks and, once a task closes, folds its whole span of messages into one summary at the next step boundary; the original content can be restored on demand.
description.zh: 用命名任务包住工作过程；任务结束后，在下一个步骤边界把整段消息折叠成一段摘要，原文可随时还原。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DSH Web: workspace-grouped list, FTS5 full-text search over session content with per-session snippets, restore-and-open, and hard delete.
description.zh: 归档会话管理插件：按工作区分组浏览，FTS5 全文检索会话内容并展示多条命中摘要，支持恢复并打开与彻底删除。

description.en: Pluggable design canvas inside DSH — standalone Excalidraw board, session image tools (edit, erase, background removal, OCR, vectorize, PSD/text rebuild), project asset library, and a Photoshop/Illustrator ⇄ canvas bridge.
description.zh: DSH 内的可插拔设计画布——独立 Excalidraw 画布、会话图片工具（修图、擦除、去背景、OCR、转矢量、PSD/文字重建）、项目素材库，以及 Photoshop/Illustrator ⇄ 画布桥接。

description.en: DSH plugin: an IDE-grade Git tool window as a native dsh-better-sidebar tab — branch tree, commit graph, changes, commit details, JetBrains-style actions, in the right sidebar and the bottom panel. | DSH 插件:IDE 级 Git 工具窗口,以 dsh-better-sidebar 原生 Tab 挂载——分支树 / 提交图谱 / 变更与提交详情 / JetBrains 风格操作,右侧栏与底部面板双布局自适应。
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏装一个 IDE 级 Git 工具窗口，分支树、提交图谱、变更详情一屏看全，操作像 JetBrains 一样顺手。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 主题体验插件：OKLCH 主题提案 + 主题设计器（跨重启持久化）
description.zh: 把 DSH 界面调成你喜欢的样子，四轴配色加实时预览，主题还能存下来跨重启保留。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin: process-discipline system-prompt section + deterministic progress nudge for silent tool steps
description.zh: 让 AI 干活时别闷头狂跑工具，主动汇报进度，过程更透明可控。

description.en: DSH 插件：把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 里的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，零配置直接用。（原生嵌入"设置-插件-插件配置"）
在 Windows 环境中为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git Bash 与 WSL 2 bash 工具,含 bwrap 沙箱、审批模式、后台任务
description.zh: 在 Windows 环境中为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git Bash 与 WSL 2 bash 工具,含 bwrap 沙箱、审批模式、后台任务

description.en: [Slow down]Allow Mobie Developer to use DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Your DeepSeek Harness web UI, rebuilt for the phone in your hand. Built for developers who code in Termux on Android: single-column layout, sidebar drawer, one-line composer, fullscreen scrollable settings & trajectory details, tap-to-open session stats. Desktop untouched.

description.en: 小说作家智能体预设，用于在DeepSeek Herness里让AI写小说。
description.zh: 装上它，AI 就能帮你写中文网络小说，长篇连载也不怕断更。

description.en: Windows notifications, zero dependencies.
description.zh: Agent 需要你关注时，自动弹出 Windows 系统桌面通知，零依赖即装即用。

description.en: 一个 DSH 网页插件，Codex 式侧边聊天的强化版本： 在右侧面板提供按主会话隔离的独立聊天，具备 Codex 式的智能体能力——继承主会话的 工具集、模型、思考难度与权限预设，能感知所在工作目录；选中对话内容即可提问，AI 回复 也能带回主会话（直接带回或摘要后带回，写入草稿或注入为折叠提示行）。  在 Codex 式能力之上，它额外支持：当主会话的智能体弹出问题弹框向你提问时，可以 把问题与各个选项带入侧边聊天、让 AI 帮你分析，不必打断当前流程——想清楚后把答案 带回，再回答弹框即可。
description.zh: 在对话中选中内容，即可在右侧边栏开启独立聊天，针对选中部分提问，不打断主对话。
把教材 PDF 自动加工成 AI 教学蓝本，六步流水线跑完，你只管上传、确认和拍板。

Optional panel account cycling and separately authorized daily warm-up; multi-account startup/5h-full triggers remain unavailable.

description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入由 OOMOL 管理的应用与服务，支持渐进式发现并执行 Connector Actions，并提供用于管理 Provider 连接的应用内面板。

description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上 Jev 系统一决策模型，帮 AI 助手做安全护栏和类型化工具调用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 内置可视化插件市场 — 极速秒开、官方 dsh:// 联动、深度本地管理与原子化彻底卸载
description.zh: 内置可视化插件市场，秒开浏览、一键安装，支持dsh://协议联动和深度本地管理，卸载干净彻底。

description.en: Codex-style archived session manager for DSH Web UI — view, search, restore, and delete archived sessions from the settings page
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页里查看、搜索、恢复和删除归档会话，还能预览对话内容。

description.zh: 本地开发工作台，集成项目树、Git 审查、终端和插件市场，桌面与网页都能用。

description.zh: untranslated

description.zh: 写作工具：去除 AI 腔并贴合个人文风。8 个确定性工具扫描文本、从样本提取文风指纹，并返回改写 brief。

description.en: Kuikly DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns your AI agent into a Kuikly cross-platform app development expert.
description.zh: 将你的 AI 助手变成 Kuikly 跨平台应用开发专家，提供四项专业技能，助力高效开发。

description.en: DeepSeek 峰谷提醒插件：北京时间梁文峰/梁文谷实时播报、切换前提前提醒、省 token 小贴士、自由拖动
description.zh: 按北京时间实时播报 DeepSeek 峰谷时段，切换前提前提醒，还能顺手教你省 token。
