description.en: Pause / resume / cancel the in-flight conversation task from the composer area: forced pause interrupts immediately and remembers the interrupted tool, safe pause lands after the tool or reasoning finishes, resume asks for confirmation, and the default pause granularity is configurable in the settings.
description.zh: 在输入区暂停/恢复/取消正在运行的对话任务：强制暂停立即中断并记住被中断的工具，安全暂停等工具/推理完成后再落地，恢复时需确认；默认暂停粒度可在设置中配置（出厂 safe wait）。

description.en: 向模型暴露 sleep 工具，按指定毫秒暂停执行后返回，支持取消/clamp | Exposes a sleep tool that pauses for specified ms then returns, with cancellation/clamping
description.zh: 向模型暴露 sleep 工具，按指定毫秒暂停执行后返回，支持取消/clamp | Exposes a sleep tool that pauses for specified ms then returns, with cancellation/clamping

description.en: IKUN fandom skin for the DSH Web UI: star-blue and black-gold palettes in the system theme list, full-screen photo wallpaper rotation, a music box, and a send-button voice line.
description.zh: ikun 主题皮肤：星蓝昼/夜与背带裤黑金三套配色接入系统主题列表，全屏照片壁纸轮播、音乐盒与发送音效。

description.en: Generate Functions, MCP tools, workflow Skills, and offline test packages from user-authorized source code.
description.zh: 从用户授权的源码生成 Function、MCP 工具、工作流 Skill 与离线测试包。

description.en: Use local Codex App Server as a model provider in DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接调用本机已登录的 Codex 当模型用，免配置免密钥。

description.en: 个人很喜欢 Claude Code 的 /btw，于是为 DSH 做了复刻：共享当前上下文快速旁路提问，不中断主任务，也不写入主会话历史。
description.zh: 个人很喜欢 Claude Code 的 /btw，于是为 DSH 做了复刻：共享当前上下文快速旁路提问，不中断主任务，也不写入主会话历史。

description.en: Skills for building websites on the Creght platform: CLI pull/push sync, page and component conventions, CMS, forms, auth, SEO, publishing and version rollback.
description.zh: Creght 平台建站技能包：CLI 拉取/推送同步、页面与组件规范、CMS、表单、Auth、SEO、发布与版本回滚。

description.en: Official UI plugin reference implementation.
description.zh: Turtle UI 是 DSH 官方的终端界面插件，提供简洁美观的交互界面，方便你更直观地操作和管理插件。

description.en: Web UI polish layer for DeepSeek Harness: normalizes unfinished or self-contradictory official UI, reconciles style conflicts between insta…
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Burned DSH tokens become incense; spend one stick to raise or lower today's case. The case updates daily, Liangwei decides today's Liangzi, and the result is archived at day end.
description.zh: 用 DSH 烧掉的 Token 凝成香火，花一炷给今日梁案投夯或拉；梁案每日更新，梁位决定今日梁子，日终收入梁祠。

description.en: Experience memory and reflection for DSH agents: automatically extracts candidate lessons after tasks and recalls user-reviewed lessons in relevant later tasks. Supports source provenance, project-scoped retrieval, conflict handling, usage feedback and expiry review; capture and recall have separate controls, and writing lessons to AGENTS.md requires preview and explicit application. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: DSH 智能体经验记忆与反思插件：任务后自动整理候选经验，经用户审阅采纳后在相关任务中自动召回。支持来源追溯、按项目检索、冲突处理、使用反馈和到期复核；整理与召回可分别开关，写入 AGENTS.md 需预览并手动应用。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Bidirectional Hermes ↔ DSH bridge: import Hermes sessions into DSH, consult Hermes, and receive Hermes-dispatched tasks as a single Cordis plugin.
description.zh: Hermes 与 DSH 的双向桥接插件：将 Hermes 会话导入 DSH、咨询 Hermes，并以单一 Cordis 插件接收 Hermes 下发的任务。

description.en: A plugin manager tab in Settings → Plugins: Chinese names and plain-language descriptions for every installed plugin, one-click enable/disable, in-UI notes editing, and search/filter over the installed catalog.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的插件管理页：已装插件中文名与白话描述、一键启停、界面内改备注，支持搜索与筛选。

description.en: Exports the agent loop to GreptimeDB as OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, with seven Grafana dashboards covering token usage, cost, session outcomes and per-turn latency.
description.zh: 把 agent loop 以 OpenTelemetry traces、metrics、logs 导出到 GreptimeDB，附七个 Grafana dashboard，覆盖 token 用量、成本、会话结果和每轮耗时。

description.en: Persistent conversation outline: per-turn questions and final replies, keyword filter, one-click jump, light/full history modes, and Ctrl/Shift+click to open the same position in the Trajectory view.
description.zh: 对话栏左侧常驻大纲：按轮次列出提问与最后回复，关键词过滤与一键跳转，轻便/全面两种历史模式，按住 Ctrl/Shift 单击可跳到轨迹视图同一位置。

description.en: AST-based context compression, test log filtering, and token budget guard for DeepSeek Harness: strips redundant syntax, prunes noisy log lines, and enforces a token ceiling so the context window never overflows.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AST 上下文压缩、测试日志过滤与 Token 预算守卫：剔除冗余语法、精简日志噪声，并强制执行 Token 上限以防止上下文窗口溢出。

description.en: Orchestration-mode preset generator for DSH: a lead agent delegates to four built-in role helpers that carry only their own tools, and the web panel adds or removes custom helpers with their own tools, skills, and models, per workspace — zero changes to the harness source.
description.zh: DSH 编排模式预设生成器：主 agent 指挥，四个内置帮手各只带本行工具；Web 面板按工作区增删帮手，可给自定角色配专属工具、技能与模型——零 DSH 源码改动。

description.en: Self-contained literature library for DSH with optional Zotero export: full-text PDF fetching (Unpaywall/arXiv/custom URL templates), loose Crossref-backed search, APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago citation generation, a side-panel PDF reader with highlights and notes, and AI-assisted Q&A/translation steered into the current conversation.
description.zh: DSH 内置文献库（可选导出到 Zotero）：通过 Unpaywall/arXiv/自定义 URL 模板获取全文 PDF，Crossref 候选式宽松搜索，APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago 引用生成，侧窗 PDF 阅读器（高亮与笔记），以及注入当前对话的 AI 问答/翻译。

description.en: A novel-writing workbench for DeepSeek Harness: you tap thumbs-up or thumbs-down on candidate passages, and the model distils them into a short preference profile that carries into later drafting calls while the manuscript stays out of the drafting context. Adds a chapter board, per-chapter writing packs, annotation-scoped revision that rewrites only the annotated paragraph and verifies the rest byte-for-byte, a project ledger, and local pacing checks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的小说写作工作台：你在候选段落上点赞或点踩，模型把这批点选蒸馏成一份简短的「作者偏好档案」带进后续写稿，正文本身不进写稿上下文。另有章节看板、每章写作包、只改被批注段落并逐字核对其余段落的批注式微调、项目台账，以及不把正文送进模型的本地情节体检。

description.en: During Beijing working-day peak hours (default 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00) it blocks official DeepSeek requests or reroutes them to a configured target provider; off-peak traffic flows to official as usual.
description.zh: 北京时间工作日高峰时段拦截发往官方 provider 的请求，默认 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00，可切到配置的中转目标或直接阻止并提示，非高峰正常走官方。

description.en: Team knowledge base for offline knowledge sharing (FDE box scenario): browse, full-text search and refinement entry points; raw material is queued automatically and distilled into wiki pages by a serial bot session (Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern: immutable raw, two-step refinement, log stream, monthly lint).
description.zh: 团队知识库：离线知识共享（FDE 盒子场景），浏览/全文检索/加工入口；raw 入料自动入队、bot 会话串行蒸馏成文（Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式：raw 不可变 / 两步加工 / log 流水 / 月度 lint）。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Busabase: search workspace knowledge, work with structured records and apps, submit writes as reviewable ChangeRequests, and inspect results in live cards.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Busabase：检索工作区知识、操作结构化记录与应用、将写入提交为可审阅的 ChangeRequest，并在实时卡片中查看结果。

description.en: RSS/Atom subscription tools (list/add/remove/fetch/check/search/opml_import/opml_export/health) with cross-feed keyword search, cursor-based incremental fetch and OPML import/export, persisted to settings. A step-by-step first-run guide (3 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: RSS/Atom 订阅九工具（管理/校验/抓取解析/跨订阅搜索/增量抓取/OPML 导入导出/健康自检），游标增量抓取，订阅持久化到 settings。面板内置 3 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Cross-session plaintext memory: deterministic BM25 keyword recall (no embeddings), memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget tools behind a human-confirm gate, and global + project-scoped JSON stores that follow your git repo.
description.zh: 跨会话明文记忆：确定性 BM25 关键词召回（无向量嵌入），memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget 五个工具 + 人工确认闸门，global/project 两层 JSON 存储（project 随 git 分享）。

description.en: Speaks agent replies in the DeepSeek Harness web UI through a provider fallback chain (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google, Azure, Groq, Deepgram, OpenRouter, Edge, Piper, eSpeak), so a failing or rate-limited provider falls through to the next instead of going silent.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页 UI 中朗读智能体回复，采用服务商回退链（OpenAI、ElevenLabs、Google、Azure、Groq、Deepgram、OpenRouter、Edge、Piper、eSpeak），某个服务商失败或被限流时自动切换到下一个，而不是直接静音。

description.en: Scroll-painting message rail for DeepSeek Harness: a slim right-edge rail with one indicator per user message, scroll-spy follows the reading position, hover unfolds a canvas with full message previews, and clicking jumps to any history message; animates in sync with better-sidebar panels.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 画卷式消息导航栏：会话面板右侧一条竖排导轨，每条用户消息一个指示点，scroll-spy 跟随阅读位置，hover 展开画卷查看完整消息预览，点击跳转任意历史消息；与 better-sidebar 面板动画同步避让。

description.en: Per-message delete for DSH: remove a user message, one reply step, or a whole assistant reply from the derived model context through the official surface-replace contract, and hide it from the visible transcript without rewriting the append-only log.
description.zh: DSH 消息删除插件：按条删除用户消息、按步骤删除思考与工具调用、按整条回复删除助手回答，经官方 surface-replace 契约从模型上下文移除并从可见转录隐藏，原始 append-only 日志不改写。

description.en: Codex-style review of session file changes: per-turn cards (optionally taking over the shell edited cards) whose totals are the turn net diff, a review tab with syntax-highlighted diffs that never wrap, real line numbers, open-at-line and a draggable split, a hover preview of the whole file with three lines of context around each change, one-click per-turn revert, and the on-disk record size with a clear button in the review toolbar. Records are sharded per session, with content-addressed snapshot blobs that dedupe and are garbage collected. Light/dark presets follow the DSH theme, typography follows DSH and installed skins (or any font on the machine, with a px stepper), and a settings switch injects a think-in-Simplified-Chinese rule into the global AGENTS.md.
description.zh: Codex 风格的会话文件修改审查：每轮变更卡片（可接管 shell 的 edited 卡片），统计口径为本轮净差异；审查 tab 的 diff 不自动换行、真实行号、按行打开、可拖拽分栏；悬停预览显示整文件差异（每处改动前后 3 行上下文）；按轮一键撤回；工具条显示记录占用并可一键清空。记录按会话分片存储，快照用内容寻址 blob 去重并自动 GC。深浅两套配色跟随 DSH 主题，字体跟随 DSH 与已装皮肤（也可选机器上的任意字体并微调字号）；设置里可把「用简体中文思考」规则注入全局 AGENTS.md。

description.en: Upgrades DSH image viewing with pointer-centered zoom, pan, galleries, downloads, keyboard support, and inline region notes.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 原生图片查看体验，支持指针中心缩放、拖动、画廊、下载、键盘操作和图片区域备注。

description.en: Terminal coding agent for DeepSeek Harness with a full-screen alternate-screen UI, turn-aware session navigation, and a gated /ship workflow that takes one-line requirements through specification, TDD, and rerun acceptance checks.
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的终端编码 Agent，提供全屏备用屏幕 UI、轮次感知的会话导航，以及将一句话需求经过规格、TDD 和验收复跑的分阶段 /ship 流程。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-codsh-bundle
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for codsh#codsh-bundle

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Model-based permission approval: an approval-request answerer backed by a separate reviewer model.
description.zh: 基于模型的权限审批：由独立审查模型自动应答 approval 权限请求。

description.en: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI: system-telemetry left bar with per-core CPU sparklines, encom-globe world-map right bar with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer that follows the active workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 eDEX-UI 风格外壳：左侧系统遥测栏（含每核 CPU 迷你趋势图）、右侧 encom-globe 世界地图与上下行流量图、左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。

description.en: CalDAV calendar tools (list/create/update/delete/search/health) for Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/custom endpoints, with RRULE expansion, a month/week/agenda panel inside the settings page, in-panel connection setup that is tested before saving, and drag-to-reschedule in the week view (15-minute snapping, undo). A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: CalDAV 日历插件：查/建/改/删/搜日程与健康自检，Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/自定义端点，RRULE 重复事件展开；设置页内置月/周/议程面板，连接可在面板内填写并先测后存，周视图支持拖拽改期（15 分钟吸附、5 秒撤销）。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Lifecycle management UI for the llm-pi-ai model provider: create, edit, delete, enable and disable providers with custom headers and AES-GCM-encrypted API keys; uninstall-safe restore of parked providers, remote model discovery with batch write, smart routing with five strategies, union/intersection composites, per-model connectivity tests, and request observability.
description.zh: llm-pi-ai 模型提供商的生命周期管理 UI：提供商的新建/编辑/删除与启停（自定义请求头、AES-GCM 加密密钥）；卸载时安全还原滞留提供商，远端模型发现与批量写入，五种策略的智能路由，并集/交集组合提供商，逐模型连通性测试与请求观测。

description.en: Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 host 级主动唤醒：模型用 proactive_set 给自己设定闹钟（单次 / 循环间隔 / cron，支持 jitter 随机抖动），到点自动唤醒冷会话执行心跳、定时提醒与任务跟进；安静时段与每日投递预算约束模型自主跟进，静默唤醒以 proactive_reclaim 收尾并把唤醒上下文折叠为墓碑；声明式闹钟文件把 JSON 时间表幂等同步成 host 闹钟，min_idle_seconds 静默门让唤醒等会话空闲；自带 Web 管理面板（设置页节 + 会话页签，SSE 实时刷新）管理闹钟与唤醒历史——适合驱动 AI 陪伴、角色扮演（酒馆式人设）与 living agent 的心跳、日常安排和世界演算。

description.en: A configurable 17-segment session status bar for the dsh composer dock with live TPS, per-model cost estimation, and a usage & cost dialog.
description.zh: 输入栏下可配置的 17 段会话状态栏，提供实时 TPS、按模型分别计价的费用估算，以及用量与费用弹窗。

description.en: Skill marketplace with unified search across SkillHub and ClawHub, in-app README preview, one-click install and uninstall, an installed-skill list, and a chat-input skill picker.
description.zh: 技能市场插件，聚合 SkillHub 与 ClawHub 双源搜索，支持站内 README 预览、一键安装与卸载、已装技能列表，以及聊天栏技能选择器。

description.en: Server card dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and latency, with one-click xterm.js SSH terminals; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right drawer.
description.zh: DSH 服务器卡片仪表盘：每台主机展示在线状态、CPU、内存、磁盘与延迟，点卡片进入 xterm.js SSH 终端；支持导入 ~/.ssh/config，挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧抽屉。

description.en: Citation tools for agents: exact DOI lookup, Crossref bibliographic search, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago formatting, BibTeX generation, bounded-concurrency DOI validation and health self-check. A step-by-step first-run guide (3 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 参考文献工具：DOI 精确查询与 Crossref 题录检索，GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago 格式化，BibTeX 生成、有界并发 DOI 校验与健康自检。面板内置 3 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Models+ settings page for the DSH web UI: per-model reasoning-effort tables, input modalities and compat flags saved through the official settings pipeline, with models.dev metadata prefill and API key management.
description.zh: 模型+ 设置页:按模型声明推理挡位、输入模态与兼容参数(走官方 settings 管线保存),支持 models.dev 元数据预填与 API 密钥管理。

description.en: AI-driven drawio: four agent tools (validate, render to SVG/PNG, edit, template) plus a sidebar live board — zero-dependency mxfile-to-SVG preview, embedded diagrams.net editor with save bridge, and auto-open whenever the agent draws.
description.zh: AI 驱动 drawio：四个画图工具（校验 / 渲染 SVG/PNG / 编辑 / 模板）+ 侧栏实时画板——零依赖 mxfile→SVG 预览、内嵌 diagrams.net 官方编辑器、AI 画图时自动弹出跟随。

description.en: All-in-one DSH extension center in Settings: manage skills, MCP servers and plugins, a Plugin Market (curated + GitHub search, npm one-click install), and an Add-ons block to install, disable, uninstall and update companion features together.
description.zh: 设置页一体化扩展中心：管理技能/MCP/插件，内置插件市场（精选目录+GitHub 搜索、npm 一键安装），并提供附加功能区统一安装/停用/卸载、一起更新附属功能。

description.en: Knowledge base as a canvas in the right sidebar: notes are nodes, and nine tools let the model read, write, link and remove them. A node can carry pictures and documents, and reading one returns their text — Office files extracted in place — while pictures can be handed over as images.
description.zh: 右侧栏的卡片画布知识库：笔记就是节点，模型通过九个工具读写、连线、移除。节点可以挂图片和文档，读节点时连同内容一起返回（Office 文件就地抽取文本），图片还能作为图像直接交给模型。

description.en: Office workspace & session dashboard: a floating 6-column sprite panel visualizing workspaces, sessions, token usage and subagents, plus Agent Mail and an office log tab. Feishu/Lark views (message feed, meeting schedules, transcripts) additionally require the `@larksuite/cli` tool installed and authenticated separately.
description.zh: 办公室工作区/会话仪表盘：悬浮 6 列精灵面板，可视化工作区、会话、token 用量与子代理，并提供 Agent Mail 与办公日志页签。飞书相关视图（消息流、会议日程、妙记逐字稿）另需自行安装并授权 `@larksuite/cli`。

description.en: Neumorphic DSH Web theme with light and dark palettes, ambient lighting, material shadows, grain texture, frosted-glass surfaces, and micro-interactions.
description.zh: DSH Web 轻拟物主题：提供浅色与深色配色、环境光影、材质阴影、纹理、磨砂玻璃表面与微交互。

description.en: Runtime requirement drift guard that keeps long-running DSH agents aligned with the user's approved goal, constraints, and decisions.
description.zh: 运行时需求漂移防护，在长任务执行过程中保持 DSH Agent 与用户确认的目标、约束和决策一致。

description.en: Real-time 'We need…' and 'Let me…' reasoning-trajectory keyword stats for the DeepSeek Harness web chat.
description.zh: 实时追踪 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话中模型流式推理轨迹关键词统计的 UI 面板。

description.en: Functy fork of corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect. Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app models into DeepSeek Harness with a dashboard UI, multi-account rotation, and sidebar credit.
description.zh: corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect 的 Functy 分支。把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的模型接到 DeepSeek Harness，带仪表盘界面、多账号轮换和侧栏额度。

description.en: A self-healing layer for tool calls: missing params, wrong fields and out-of-range paths are fixed before they reach the model. Measured visible error rate fell from 7.95% to 2.20%.
description.zh: 给工具调用加一层自愈：缺参数、错字段、路径越界在到达模型前自动修好，实测可见错误率从 7.95% 降到 2.20%。

description.en: Display read_image results in DSH Web and Desktop: complete previews, grouped multi-image galleries, transparency checkerboards, keyboard and touch zoom, and session-authorized loading. Verified with DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 和桌面版展示 read_image 结果：完整预览、多图画廊、透明棋盘格、键盘与触控缩放，使用会话授权加载。已验证 DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: TRAE SOLO supplier plugin for dsh-router, ported from traework2api. Provides the traework supplier, a free SOLO chat channel, and reports single-account status to dsh-router core.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 TRAE SOLO 供应商插件，移植自 traework2api。提供 traework 供应商这一免费 SOLO 聊天通道，并向 dsh-router 核心上报单账号状态。

description.en: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode compaction restore.
description.zh: 把 claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode 的聊天历史导入为 dsh 会话：工作区绑定、工具调用保留、超长会话保护、zcode 压缩还原。

description.en: Token usage and estimated spend for the dsh web UI: floating panel with per-model, per-day, and per-session stats.
description.zh: DSH Web 用量与费用统计插件：右下角悬浮窗，按模型/按天/按会话多维聚合与预计花费。

description.en: Wakes the main agent after any DSH restart so interrupted work resumes automatically — adds a restart tool and an optional canary that validates the boot and aborts with an alert before a broken restart.
description.zh: DSH 重启后唤醒主 agent，让被打断的工作自动接着做；提供一个重启工具，以及可选的探针在启动异常时提前中止并告警。

description.en: A GrokBot-style animated avatar with a synchronized typewriter status line — right in front of the "Deep diving..." indicator.
description.zh: 在「Deep diving...」状态提示前，放一只动态小伙伴——GrokBot 风格动画头像，状态文字还会同步打字机变换。

description.en: Manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel: view, add, edit, remove, enable or disable them, with hot reload on save.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置面板中查看、添加、编辑、删除、启用或停用 MCP 服务器，保存后热重载。

description.en: CC-style auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic deny/allow rules plus a two-stage allow/reject classifier with a circuit breaker and denial guidance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Claude Code 式自动审批：确定性 deny/allow 规则 + 两阶段 allow/reject 分类器，内置熔断器与拒绝引导。

description.en: Conversational Grafana operations: inspect live dashboard data across named sources, then make safe, reviewable dashboard changes with approval and version checks.
description.zh: 对话式 Grafana 运维：跨多个命名源站查看实时大盘数据，再通过审批与版本校验安全、可审阅地修改大盘。

description.en: Six-player no-limit Texas Hold'em for the dsh Web GUI. One human plays against five LLM agents that each see only their own hole cards. Adds a dedicated tab plus a draggable mini-window over the conversation area, per-browser sessions with CSRF protection, pot-relative raise sizing, three rebuys before elimination, and showdown reveals with board-card deal animations.
description.zh: 六人无限注德州扑克：1 名玩家对 5 位只能看到自己底牌的 LLM 智能体。在 Web GUI 中提供独立 Tab 与会话区可拖拽悬浮小窗，支持按浏览器隔离的牌局与 CSRF 防护、按底池倍数给出的加注尺度、每人 3 次买入后出局，以及摊牌亮牌与公共牌翻牌动效。

description.en: GitHub search, discovery and audit scripts wrapped as a SKILL.md pack around the gh CLI: repo search, multi-axis explore, trending, repo summaries, similar projects, code search, issue/PR search and org audits; ships as a dsh bundle (and on npm).
description.zh: 基于 gh CLI 的 GitHub 搜索/发现/审计技能包（SKILL.md 打包）：仓库搜索、多轴探索、趋势、仓库概览、相似项目、代码搜索、issue/PR 搜索与组织审计；以 dsh bundle 形式安装（并已发布 npm）。

description.en: HTTPS + login gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web surface: access your DSH Web UI securely from another machine on your LAN, or from the internet via port forwarding. Fail-closed defaults (loopback-only, no accounts until configured); setup and security notes in the README.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 HTTPS + 登录保护的远程访问网关：局域网内其它设备可安全访问，配置端口映射后可从互联网访问。默认 fail-closed（仅本机监听、无内置账号，配置后才能登录），配置与安全说明见 README。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness 真的玩 Minecraft：AI 有自己的角色，能探索、挖矿、合成、熔炼、打怪、建造。基于 yzi1b/whale-craft 独立维护。
description.zh: 给 DSH 里的 AI 一副能动手的身体，让它真的进 Minecraft 探索、挖矿、合成、打怪、建造。

issues.detail: declares install-time scripts; the harness gates them via allowBuilds

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-mc-agent
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-mc-agent

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: A small self-contained power control for DSH: sidebar power button with an upward restart/shutdown menu and a Windows-shutdown-style overlay. Own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins), dynamic-port aware.
description.zh: 一个小而自洽的 DSH 电源控制插件：侧边栏电源按钮 + 上拉「重启/关机」菜单 + Windows 关机风格过渡遮罩。自带重启/关机引擎（不依赖其它插件），动态端口适配。

description.en: DSH 插件：统计所有经过 DeepSeek Harness 的模型调用——Token 用量、成本核算（含峰谷计价）、供应商余额与配额，并按模型/供应商/项目/来源/账号/日期拆分。A token usage, cost and provider-balance plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 统计所有经过 DSH 的模型调用，算清 Token 用量和峰谷成本，还能盯住供应商余额与配额。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web UI 增强插件：25 套终端美学主题、中文优先字体、文字墨色与官方峰谷提醒 · 江南泉个人开发并免费开源
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面换上 25 套终端风主题，优化中文字体，还能提醒官方峰谷时段。

description.en: DSH 智能体灵动岛：macOS 刘海 / Windows Fluent 双端兼容，实时显示 Agent 思考、工具调用与子代理并行状态
description.zh: 在 macOS 刘海和 Windows 上实时显示智能体思考、工具调用和子代理并行状态，随时掌握 AI 在干什么。

description.en: Qwen Image 2.1 workspace for DSH: Apple Silicon MLX or your own NVIDIA server, native reference editing, LoRA, ControlNet, inpainting, shared presets, gallery and live agent progress. Includes verified updates and an agent setup guide.
description.zh: DSH 的 Qwen Image 2.1 创作工作区：本机 MLX 或自己的 NVIDIA 服务器，支持原生参考编辑、LoRA、结构控制、蒙版、整套预设、图库与对话实时进度，提供校验更新和 Agent 安装指南。

description.en: 主打安全，提倡先审查再安装的DeepSeek Harness市场。深度扫描 5 分钟，放心使用每一天。
description.zh: 主打安全的 DSH 插件市场，先深度扫描审查再安装，搜插件、装插件都放心。

description.en: Claude-Code-Styled TUI for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在终端里用 Claude Code 风格界面操作 DeepSeek Harness，让命令行工作流更顺手。

description.en: One-command DeepSeek Harness on your VPS: a zero-dependency login gateway puts the stock DSH web UI - settings, API keys, plugin market - behind HTTPS and a password, reachable from anywhere. · 一条命令把 DeepSeek Harness 装进 VPS：零依赖登录网关 + 自动 HTTPS，公网可达，设置、API Key、插件市场全都能用。
description.zh: 一条命令把 DSH 装到 VPS 上，加密码和 HTTPS，随时随地打开原版网页界面。

description.en: Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - drive dsh agents from Zed and any ACP v1 client
description.zh: 让 Zed 等 ACP 客户端直接驱动 dsh 智能体，支持会话、任务与技能管理。

description.en: Imports local coding-agent session histories so work can continue in DSH.
description.zh: 导入本地编程 Agent 的会话历史，在 DSH 中继续工作。

description.en: Switch between DeepSeek web chat and workspaces in DeepSeek Harness. Web history sidebar and one-click conversation import. / 网页聊天、历史侧栏与工作区一键导入。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 网页聊天和工作区之间自由切换，带历史侧栏，还能一键把对话导入工作区。

description.en: ♾️ Copy and export the LaTeX in DeepSeek Harness 悬停任意 LaTeX 公式即可复制 TeX 源码或导出为独立的 SVG 文件
description.zh: 悬停任意 LaTeX 公式，就能复制 TeX 源码或导出成独立 SVG 文件

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for TypeSafe Jev: typed decisions, configurable guardrails, and Web UI result cards.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体用 TypeSafe Jev 做类型化决策，带可配置护栏和 Web UI 结果卡片。

description.en: AI-assisted Godot game creation for DeepSeek Harness: build scenes, edit scripts, run games, and verify results.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 Godot Creator 模式做游戏：搭场景、改脚本、跑起来还能验证结果。

description.en: A Command Code LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — supporting all subscription plans (incl. Go & Pro) via Studio API / gateway.专为 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 打造的 Command Code LLM 接入插件，全面支持包括 Go/Pro 在内的各类订阅方案。
Monitors session state in the DSH web app and sends desktop, browser, and third-party notifications for interactions, completions, and errors.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 端监控会话状态，为需要交互、任务完成、任务出错发送桌面 / 浏览器 / 第三方通知。

description.en: DSH WebUI 文件输入增强：Ctrl+V 粘贴（带首次告知弹窗）+ 拖拽 + 选择文件，发送时复制进会话工作区临时目录
description.zh: DSH WebUI 文件输入增强：Ctrl+V 粘贴（带首次告知弹窗）+ 拖拽 + 选择文件，发送时复制进会话工作区临时目录

description.en: Usage and cost statistics with peak/off-peak pricing after the 2026-08-17 rate change, a floating summary panel, per-session breakdowns, and a day/week/month/year/all usage heatmap.
description.zh: 用量与消费统计：8/17 调价前后峰谷计费，主界面汇总面板、按会话明细与日/周/月/年/累计用量热力图。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件热管理器：装一次、重启一次，之后装插件、卸插件、升级插件全部即时生效，不用再重启。 | A plugin that makes installing, removing and upgrading DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins take effect instantly — restart once, then never again.
description.zh: 装上后只需重启一次，之后安装、卸载、升级插件都能即时生效，不用再反复重启。

description.en: Independent Shadow agent orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在合适的工具调用后自动启动后台影子智能体，独立验证结果并生成结构化发现，提升多智能体协作效率。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 极简回复插件，提供六档精简模式与 CyberUI 主题，可节省 60–75% 输出 Token｜A DSH plugin with six brevity modes and a CyberUI theme.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上极简回复模式，六档精简随手切换，砍掉废话省下 60-75% 输出 Token。

description.en: DeepSeek 娘 (whale maid) in-page mascot plugin for DeepSeek Harness web UI
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里养一只鲸鱼娘吉祥物，让页面更可爱更有陪伴感。

description.en: SummerSec 个人自定义Skill仓库
description.zh: 个人 Agent Skills 集合，按类别管理，方便快速调用各类技能。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件全家桶整合包：11 个自装插件合并为单一插件（主题/用量/搜索/桌宠/子代理进度/会话增强），功能与设置完全保留。
DSH 自装插件整合包：把 11 个自装插件合并成单一安装项。内含终末地工业编辑部风主题（等高线背景、ENDFIELD 水印、玻璃/纯色侧边栏表面）、用量悬浮球与日/月/年热力图、右侧重栏（文件树/编辑器/终端/Git）、多引擎搜索、3D 虎鲸桌宠、子代理进度、悬浮侧边栏、提示词优化浮窗、UA 中继反代。所有功能与设置原样保留。不需要整套也没关系，每个模块都支持单独安装。
description.zh: 把十几个自装插件打包成一个，主题、桌宠、用量统计、搜索等都能按需勾选安装。

description.en: 将 DeepSeek Harness 桥接到已配置其它 Harness Agent 的项目。支持 CodeBuddy / Codex / OpenCode / Claude Code / ...
description.zh: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that bridges projects configured for other coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, CodeBuddy Code, pi, Gemini CLI, Cursor) into DeepSeek Harness

description.en: 在对话页面直接查看消耗费用（嵌入官方底部状态条，点击看明细）；设置中汇总用量与费用，并可自定义其他模型单价
description.zh: 在对话页面直接查看消耗费用（嵌入官方底部状态条，点击看明细）；在设置中查看 Harness 消耗的总费用、缓存命中和输入输出

description.en: 一个DeepSeek Harness的公众号运营插件，DeepSeek Harness community plugin for AI-assisted WeChat article writing, review, image workflows, knowledge bases, and publishing.
description.zh: 在对话里从选题到排版配图，一键写完公众号文章并直接存进微信草稿箱。

description.en: On-demand second opinions through ask_advisor, with editable requests, per-call human approval, and text advice from a model configured in DSH.
description.zh: 通过 ask_advisor 按需求助顾问，支持编辑请求与逐次人工批准，由 DSH 中配置的模型返回文字建议。

description.en: VS Code-style file manager: browse the conversation workspace in a sidebar tree and edit files in the center column with Monaco, with theme import/export and Markdown preview.
description.zh: VS Code 风格文件管理器：侧边栏文件树浏览当前对话工作区，中间列用 Monaco 编辑文件，支持主题导入导出与 Markdown 预览。

description.en: Pops up a mini-game menu (wordle, match-3, extensible) while the model generates.
description.zh: 模型生成时弹出小游戏菜单（wordle/消消乐，可扩展）。

description.en: Xueqiu (Snowball) market panel docked above the composer: A-share/HK/US quotes and indices, watchlist, candlestick K-line with volume, MAs and crosshair tooltip, hot list, search, 7x24 news, plus a draggable mini index badge — no login needed.
description.zh: 雪球行情面板：嵌入输入框上方，免登录查看 A股/港美股行情、指数与自选股，K线蜡烛图（成交量/均线/十字光标）、热榜、搜索、7×24 快讯，另有可拖动迷你指数徽章。

description.en: Model-facing display_file tool that renders 36 file extensions inline in the web UI: images with a click-to-zoom lightbox, seekable video, audio, PDF, Office and OpenDocument files converted to PDF on the host via LibreOffice, and local HTML in a sandboxed frame; bytes stream from a signed HTTP route with range support, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF also enter model context on image-capable routes.
description.zh: 面向模型的 display_file 工具，在网页 UI 内联渲染 36 种扩展名：图片（点击开灯箱）、可拖进度条的视频、音频、PDF、经 LibreOffice 在 Host 转为 PDF 的 Office 与 OpenDocument 文件，以及沙箱 iframe 中的本地 HTML；字节由带 Range 支持的签名 HTTP 路由流式传输，PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 在支持图像输入的路由上同时进入模型上下文。

description.en: dsh-conv-export（对话导出）— export the current DeepSeek Harness conversation as Markdown, PDF, or a long PNG image
description.zh: 一键把当前 DeepSeek Harness 对话导出为 Markdown、PDF 或长图，方便分享和存档。

description.en: DSH 里的皮肤市场：在设置里搜索并一键安装 dsh.a2hmarket.ai 上的社区皮肤
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置里直接搜索并一键安装社区皮肤，换肤不用再碰终端。

description.en: Agent worktime dashboard: floating day/week/month stats, multi-dimension heatmap, thread attendance Gantt, school-year calendar, and a 12-realm xianxia score system for agent activity.
description.zh: 把 Agent 的工时统计做成修仙看板，日周月悬浮数据、热力图、甘特图和学年日历一眼看清。

description.en: 🐂🐴 牛马修仙看板：DeepSeek Harness 工时统计 × 修仙养成——把每一分钟劳动，都修成境界（日/周/月 + 学年年历，炼气→宇宙洪荒）

Git worktree panel for DSH Web: replaces the workspace sidebar with project → main/linked worktree → session groups, creates and removes worktrees, switches the main branch, and migrates configurable project-local or global storage with dirty-tree and active-session safeguards.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 Git worktree 面板：将工作区侧栏替换为项目 → 主/关联 worktree → 会话分组，支持创建和删除 worktree、切换主分支，并在脏工作树与活跃会话保护下迁移可配置的项目内或全局存储位置。

description.en: Authenticated remote access for a DeepSeek Harness web profile: TLS, QR/passcode device pairing, password sign-in, and per-device revocation in front of an untouched loopback harness.
Multi-provider AI balance, quota, and token usage for the dsh sidebar, with a daily heatmap.
description.zh: DeepSeek 账户余额、剩余比例条与今日花费，显示在 dsh 侧边栏底部 · DeepSeek balance, remaining-ratio bar and today's spend in the dsh sidebar footer.

description.en: Modular AI research/engineering skill pack, installable via dsh plugin add — registers 27 skills (security audit, paper reading/writing, figure drawing, dev workflow, storage analysis) on ctx.skills.
description.zh: 模块化 AI 科研/工程技能包，dsh plugin add 一键安装——在 ctx.skills 注册 27 个技能（安全审计、论文读写、绘图、开发工作流、存储分析）。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Skills 管理 + SkillHub 商城插件：侧边栏面板管理本地 skills（用户级/工作区项目级/内置只读），搜索并一键安装 SkillHub 公开技能，附模型工具 dsh_skillhub_search。
description.zh: 在侧边栏管理本地技能，搜索并一键安装 SkillHub 公开技能，提升工作流效率。

description.en: AI Company Framework: turn one sentence into a multi-agent company — 15 flat Skills (boss/pipeline/role-template/11 roles/generic customer-memory), 7 workflow templates, AgentTeams runtime + activity panel, employee sidebar with per-session isolation, Feishu bot bridge (boss and per-employee bots, group routing, autonomous push, human decision gate, external-contact guide), per-customer SQLite memory with three-layer memory (cross-group merge), /company mode switch; no RAG.
description.zh: AI 公司框架：一句话开一家多 Agent 公司——15 个扁平 Skills（老板/流水线/岗位模板/11 个岗位/通用客户记忆）、7 个工作流模板、AgentTeams 运行时与活动面板、带会话隔离的员工侧边栏、飞书机器人桥（老板/任意员工机器人、群聊路由、自主推送、重大决策人工闸门、外部联系人指引）、客户档案 SQLite 数据库与三层记忆（跨群归并）、/company 公司模式开关；不含 RAG。

description.en: Connect a ChatGPT account to Codex models in DeepSeek Harness through browser PKCE or device-code OAuth, with automatic token refresh and Web or headless login.
description.zh: 通过浏览器 PKCE 或设备码 OAuth 将 ChatGPT 账户接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 模型，并支持自动刷新令牌以及 Web 或无头登录。

description.en: A-share stock analysis and screening skill: real-time quotes, technical timing scores, buy/sell signals and a managed watchlist.
description.zh: A股智能选股技能：实时行情、技术面择时分、买卖信号与动态股票池。

description.en: DSH global Chinese-mode toggle: a 中 switch in the input box; when on, a Simplified-Chinese requirement is injected into every session system prompt.
description.zh: 在输入框加个「中」字开关，一键给所有会话注入简体中文要求，全局生效。

description.en: VS Code-style file manager: browse the conversation workspace in a sidebar tree and edit files in the center column with Monaco, with theme import/export and Markdown preview.
description.zh: VS Code 风格文件管理器：侧边栏文件树浏览当前对话工作区，中间列用 Monaco 编辑文件，支持主题导入导出与 Markdown 预览。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）动态 Cordis 插件：模型高可用回退 + 五种模式子智能体编排（fanout / pipeline / supervisor / map-reduce / router）
description.zh: 模型高可用故障回退（隔离/熔断/探测恢复）与子智能体编排（fanout/pipeline/supervisor），附带双语设置界面。

description.en: Adds a configurable humanized whale-girl maid persona with immersive roleplay, speaking modes, and a lightweight layered memory with query-triggered recall.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加可配置的女仆鲸鱼娘人格：沉浸式扮演（称呼/自称/说话方式）、防出戏规则，以及借鉴 ALTM 的轻量分层记忆与按需召回。

description.en: Bridge DSH agent sessions, tool calls, and approvals to the CodeIsland macOS notch panel over a Unix socket, with in-panel allow/deny.
description.zh: 通过 Unix socket 把 DSH agent 的会话、工具调用与审批实时桥接到 CodeIsland macOS 刘海面板，可直接在面板上批准/拒绝。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness原生中文文本人工智能痕迹消除与多重审核对抗工作流
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness原生中文文本人工智能痕迹消除与多重审核对抗工作流

description.en: Ollama Cloud native chat adapter: direct NDJSON translation of the Ollama /api/chat wire format, model discovery with context windows and capabilities, and web search/fetch providers under the ollama-cloud id, plus a Web settings card.
description.zh: Ollama Cloud 原生聊天适配器：直连 NDJSON 翻译 Ollama /api/chat 协议，模型发现带上下文窗口与能力信息，并注册 web 搜索/抓取 provider，附 Web 设置卡片。

description.en: Layered plugin manager for DSH web: native plugins grouped read-only by system/WebUI/tools, user extensions with enable/disable, register, uninstall and editable descriptions.
description.zh: DSH 分层插件管理器：原生插件按系统/WebUI/工具三层只读展示，用户扩展支持停用/启用、补登记、卸载与可编辑描述。

description.en: A small self-contained power control for DSH: sidebar power button with an upward restart/shutdown menu and a Windows-shutdown-style overlay. Own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins), dynamic-port aware.
description.zh: 一个小而自洽的 DSH 电源控制插件：侧边栏电源按钮 + 上拉「重启/关机」菜单 + Windows 关机风格过渡遮罩。自带重启/关机引擎（不依赖其它插件），动态端口适配。

description.en: HUD status panel: Git status, MCP servers, skills, model and token usage in a floating side panel.
description.zh: HUD 状态面板：Git 状态、MCP 服务器、技能列表、模型与 token 用量，悬浮侧栏一览无余。

description.en: Right-edge user-message navigator with an adaptive block layout that fits the available height, plus hover previews, keyboard controls, and click-to-jump navigation.
description.zh: 右侧用户消息导航条，根据消息数量与可用高度自适应排布导航块，并支持悬停预览、键盘操作与点击跳转。

description.en: OAuth 2.1 Streamable HTTP MCP client plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 Streamable HTTP 服务的 OAuth 2.1 MCP 客户端：在设置页添加连接，通过浏览器登录（PKCE + 动态客户端注册），其工具随即注册进 DSH；令牌存于凭据服务，连接写入 profile。

description.en: Let dsh and Claude Code sessions message each other directly; comes with a clickable peer list card (sort/search/send/refresh).
description.zh: 让 dsh 和 Claude Code 会话直接互发消息，附带可点击的会话列表卡片（搜索/刷新/弹窗发送）。

description.en: Bridge Claude Code memory, skills, and config into DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: dsh-plugin-claude-bridge — DSH 插件（会话）

description.en: Solarized light theme, compact layout, think/tool-chain collapse capsules, and balance, session cost, and usage dashboards for the DSH web UI.
description.zh: Solarized 浅色主题、紧凑布局、思考/工具链折叠胶囊，以及余额、本轮成本与用量看板的 DSH Web 界面增强插件。

description.en: 把你的任何想法，变成每个平台原生的宣发内容 | Turn any idea into platform-native publicity
description.zh: 把你的任何想法，变成每个平台原生的宣发内容 | Turn any idea into platform-native publicity

description.en: Frame-level scan diagnostics for session files (torn/corrupt/empty detection).
description.zh: 会话文件帧级扫描诊断（torn/损坏/空会话检测）。

description.en: Background task status bar: progress plus live output tail on the chat page.
description.zh: 后台任务状态条：对话页任务进度 + 实时输出 tail。

description.en: Safe math expression evaluator, zero-dependency recursive-descent parser.
description.zh: 安全的数学表达式求值器，零依赖递归下降解析器。

description.en: Per-project scheduled prompts run as fresh headless agent sessions, with one-time, interval, and cron schedules plus durable run history.
description.zh: 按项目调度提示词，在全新的无头 Agent 会话中执行，支持单次、固定间隔和 cron 计划，并持久化运行历史。

description.en: Applies personal prompts and system-prompt edits at the global level or on a single session, so each session can work with its own prompt setup without touching the others.
description.zh: 可以自行选择在全局范围或单独会话中增加个人提示词、修改系统提示词来工作，各会话互不影响。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher for DSH with a whale-girl icon, background server startup, and a Chromium app-mode window without browser chrome.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 桌面启动器，提供鲸鱼娘图标、后台服务启动和无浏览器工具栏的 Chromium 应用窗口。

description.en: MCP & Skill manager: enable/disable MCP servers and skills from a Settings panel to free context in real time; optional AI middle layer (mcp_search/mcp_call) calls disabled servers on demand, with state-based visibility filtering that keeps user-enabled servers visible.
description.zh: MCP 与技能管理面板：设置页面板实时启停 MCP 服务器与 Skill 释放上下文占用；可选 AI 中间层（mcp_search/mcp_call）按需调用停用服务器，按 server 状态过滤模型可见性（用户打开的保持可见）。

description.en: Chinese localization for DeepSeek Harness: translates all system prompts, tool descriptions, and runtime contexts into Chinese at runtime via the system-prompt/assemble waterfall (1788 entries, zero source modification, uninstall restores English).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 中文汉化插件：通过 system-prompt/assemble 瀑布钩子在运行时把全部系统提示词、工具描述与运行时上下文翻译成中文（1788 条译文，零源码修改，卸载即还原英文）。

description.en: Evidence-first self-evolution controller: bounded Cordis candidate generation, one-shot real-Loader admission, Harbor evaluation, and a crash-resumable journaled lineage.
description.zh: 证据优先的自进化控制器：有界生成 Cordis 候选插件，一次性真实 Loader 准入，Harbor 评测，可崩溃恢复的日志化谱系。

description.en: Solarized theme plugin: the classic low-contrast, eye-friendly dual palette system — Ethan Schoonover's Solarized plus Selenized (its refined take), dark and light each, built for long sessions with canonical syntax colors.
description.zh: Solarized 主题插件：经典低对比护眼配色双体系——Ethan Schoonover 的 Solarized 与 Selenized（改良版）深浅各一套，专为长时间使用设计，遵循经典语法色。

description.en: Whale girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: browser floating mascot plus Windows desktop pet sharing one data backend, with real-time balance board, task notices, head-pat interaction, 19 pre-synthesized voiced lines with per-line emotion, and presence-aware idle speech.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌宠：浏览器悬浮桌宠与 Windows 桌面桌宠共享一套数据，实时余额木牌、任务通知、摸头互动、19 句预合成带情感的台词朗读，空闲节奏随是否在场自适应。

description.en: Bottom-right quota pill and panel aggregating membership quotas across AI platforms (Kimi Code, DeepSeek, Zhipu Coding Plan, BigModel, Qwen, Scnet, TokenRouter, SupaWriter), auto-syncing API keys from the DSH credentials domain with colored usage bars.
description.zh: 右下角「会员额度」悬浮球与面板，聚合各 AI 平台套餐额度（Kimi Code、DeepSeek、智谱 Coding Plan、BigModel、通义千问、超算、TokenRouter、SupaWriter），API key 自动同步自 DSH 凭证域，彩色进度条展示用量。

description.en: Codex-style window capture for DSH Desktop on macOS and Windows: press both Command keys (macOS) or both Ctrl keys (Windows), or the camera button, to grab the frontmost window, attach it to the current chat, and inject a VoiceOver-style accessibility tree as hidden context.
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 用的窗口截图，支持 macOS 和 Windows：macOS 按两边 Command、Windows 按两边 Ctrl（或点输入框旁相机）捕获当前前台窗口并附加到会话，同时把 VoiceOver 风格的辅助功能树注入为隐藏上下文。

description.en: Overleaf-style LaTeX paper workbench: annotate any text in the rendered PDF and let a dsh agent revise the sources with compile checks and git history.
description.zh: Overleaf 式 LaTeX 论文工作台：在渲染后的 PDF 上选中任意文字批注，由 dsh agent 改写源文件、编译验证并提交 git 修订。

description.en: Task ledger board for dsh (DeepSeek Harness): read-only board over task-ledger skill workspaces. The task-ledger skill is bundled — install the plugin, get the skill globally.

Turns coding into an RPG: finished turns, tool calls and completed todos earn XP, with 27+ achievement badges, levels, titles and seasons. Event-driven scoring with a pure-function engine — the work itself is the game.
description.zh: 把开发变成 RPG：回合/工具/todo 积累 XP、27+ 成就徽章、等级与赛季。事件流驱动、纯函数计分——你的工作就是游戏。

description.en: DSH plugin bridging agents to Cheat Engine for dynamic memory debugging: scanning, pointer analysis, breakpoints, and game memory hacking.
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 Cheat Engine 进行动态内存调试：扫描、指针分析、断点与游戏内存修改。

description.en: Learning Mode agent preset: a coding agent that teaches while coding — concrete scenario-grounded explanations, Socratic guidance, and TODO(你) practice blanks, modeled on Claude Code's Learning output style; installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-learning-mode on npm).
description.zh: 学习模式（Learning Mode）Agent 预设：边做边教的编码 Agent——具体的情景化阐释、苏格拉底式引导、TODO(你) 留白练习，模拟 Claude Code 的 Learning 输出风格；可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-learning-mode）。

description.en: AgentOne 平台集成：平台模型、SkillHub 技能、套餐、CLI、飞书云盘共享文件夹（web/官方桌面端侧栏页签 + 左栏底部入口；「启用云盘」后 AI 可读取/搜索资料、看最近更新、存文档、传本地文件）、左栏「工作台」面板（卡片集中打开内嵌应用：DOC数字化AI运营平台，网页内嵌或 applink 唤起飞书客户端，切面板不断页）

Provider-reported quota snapshots for GLM Coding Plan and GitHub Copilot in DSH: a draggable floating capsule with detail panels for quota windows, reset times, per-model usage and Copilot credits, plus an optional sidebar card hidden by default; credentials are resolved by the DSH host and no quota history is stored.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中查看 GLM Coding Plan 与 GitHub Copilot 的服务商额度快照：可拖动悬浮胶囊与详情面板展示额度窗口、重置时间、分模型用量与 Copilot 额度，附默认隐藏的可选侧边栏卡片；凭据由 DSH 宿主解析，不保存额度历史。

description.en: Runs the agent's shell and file tools in disposable Podman containers, so its access is constrained to the workspace project by default, and adds container, image, volume and secret management with approval-gated control.
description.zh: 让 agent 的 shell 与文件工具在一次性 Podman 容器中运行，默认只能访问工作区项目；同时提供容器、镜像、卷与机密管理，部分操作需审批。

description.en: A judgment core for DeepSeek Harness: a cognition loop that gives every decision a source and attribution and drives planning to a close, hippocampus memory that condenses running experience into knowledge (journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay), judgment identity responsibilities in the architecture (consistent rubric, judgment bound to its source), and an A2A memory-management team via dsh-linghun-assembler. Requires DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7 (rc.2 supported).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的判断内核：认知循环让判断有来处、反馈有归因、规划收口；海马体把运行经历沉淀为可复用知识（序时账留痕、情景归档、低置信降权遗忘）；判分身份职责入架构（口径一致、判据绑定来源）；联动 dsh-linghun-assembler 的 A2A 记忆管理团队。需要 DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7（支持 rc.2）。

description.en: Slides out a Monaco editor plus a lazy-loaded file-tree panel in the DSH Web conversation, so you can edit the local workspace inline without switching to an external editor.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话界面右侧滑出 Monaco 编辑器与文件树面板，直接在对话里编辑本地工作区代码，无需切到外部编辑器。

description.en: Package and install code-server (the web version of VSCode) as a plugin within dsh to quickly achieve professional file editing.
description.zh: 将code-server（VSCode网页版）打包安装到dsh内的插件，快速实现专业的文件编辑。

description.en: Edit the host-wide global instructions (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) from a dedicated Customize page in Settings - every session on this machine applies them.
description.zh: 在设置页的「个性化」页编辑此主机全局指令（~/.dsh/AGENTS.md），此机器上的所有会话都会应用。

description.en: Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the app, and inline app rendering in ordinary chats.
description.zh: 把 open-mcp-apps 接进 DSH：每个 MCP app 都是侧边栏里自己的容器，带独立 workspace、会话与 App mode，应用下方是 agent 状态条，普通聊天里也能行内渲染 app。

description.en: Generative, interactive UI for DeepSeek Harness: the agent picks per reply between 26 validated native components and sandboxed streaming HTML widgets, patches a rendered UI in place by component ID, restores tabs, sorts, filters and form values after a reload, and computes slider and filter changes in the browser without another model call.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供生成式交互界面：模型每次回答自行在 26 个校验过的原生组件与沙箱流式 HTML widget 之间选择，可按组件 ID 就地修补已渲染的界面，标签页、排序、筛选与表单值在刷新后恢复，滑块与筛选的重算在浏览器本地完成，不回调模型。

description.en: Routes model requests, web fetches/searches and spawned tools through the Windows system proxy or a custom address — idempotent kernel (reads never rebuild the dispatcher), header one-click toggle, per-URL route diagnosis and NTLM-aware 407 hints.
description.zh: 把模型请求、web 抓取/搜索与衍生工具统一路由到 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址——幂等内核（读操作不重组分发器）、头部一键开关、按 URL 路由诊断与 NTLM 认证提示。

description.en: Complete wuyun-liuqi (five-evolutions-six-qi / 五运六气) Traditional Chinese Medicine skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: annual and guest-qi calculation, clinical pattern differentiation, and pathogenesis reasoning.
description.zh: 完整 wuyun-liuqi（五运六气）中医运气学技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness 插件：年度与客气推算、临床辨证、病机推演。

description.en: Model Capability Manager for DSH Web: thinking levels, context window, output caps, input modalities, gateway compat presets, EN/中文 UI.
description.zh: DSH 网页端模型能力管理插件：控制推理档位、上下文与输出上限、输入模态及网关兼容预设，双语界面。

description.en: Connects DSH session status, approvals and questions to a native macOS notch app; requires the native app and Focus companion.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话状态、审批和问题同步到原生 macOS 刘海程序，需要原生程序及 Focus 同步助手。

description.en: Remote development launcher for DeepSeek Harness: provisions dsh on a remote host via SSH (or a local WSL distro) and connects from the local client, with LLM credentials proxied through a reverse tunnel so they never leave the local machine. Ships as both a standalone CLI and a dsh plugin with a session panel, /remote-explorer slash command and remote_* agent tools.
description.zh: 远程开发启动器：通过 SSH（或本机 WSL 发行版）在远端引导安装 dsh，从本地客户端连接，LLM 凭据经反向隧道代理、不离开本机。同时提供独立 CLI 与 dsh 插件双形态，插件含远程会话面板、/remote-explorer 命令及 remote_* agent 工具。

description.en: Enhanced ACP server for DeepSeek Harness: block & reasoning streaming, usage telemetry, model/effort switching, permission presets, session resume/archive, per-session MCP servers, and Zed file/terminal forwarding.
description.zh: 增强版 ACP 服务器：块级与推理流式、用量遥测、模型/推理强度切换、权限预设、会话恢复/归档、每会话 MCP servers、Zed 文件/终端转发。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek account balance badge in the sidebar footer with odometer roll animation, multi-currency support, balance trend chart, per-key usage statistics with historical backfill, and GitHub version auto-check.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额徽章：数字滚轮动画、多币种支持、余额趋势图、按 Key 用量统计（含安装前历史回填），并支持 GitHub 版本自动检查。

description.en: A balance and cost widget for the DSH web GUI: a sidebar footer card shows the account balance, a remaining-ratio bar and today costs; clicking opens a four-tier cost breakdown (last prompt / this session / today-this-project / today-all) with term explanations and a one-click top-up link. Zero external dependencies, works on Node 24.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的余额与成本小部件：侧边栏底部卡片显示账户余额、剩余比例条与今日花费；点击展开四层级成本明细（最近提问 / 本会话 / 今日·本项目 / 今日·全部），带名词解释与一键充值入口。零依赖，兼容 Node 24。

description.en: Per-model proxy routing for LLM requests: selected models go through a proxy (Clash etc.) while the rest stay direct, with automatic retry on transport errors, 429 and 5xx, configured live from the settings page.
description.zh: 按模型给 LLM 请求分流代理：勾选的模型走代理（Clash 等），其余直连；传输错误、429、5xx 自动重试，设置页实时生效。

description.en: Zero-dependency screen capture for DSH: Lightweight — zero deps, zero binaries; Stage & shoot — one-click full screen, window layout, hover-snap capture of occluded windows; Agent self-service — path-only delivery; paths are universal, pair with modlens (optional) for one-call structured evidence.
description.zh: DSH 轻量截图插件：轻——零依赖零二进制；摆——一键全屏、窗口排版、悬停吸附截取被遮挡窗口；自助——Agent 可自助截屏，传路径不传图，路径通用，接上 modlens（选装）一步读出结构化内容。

description.en: Replaces the built-in DSH compaction summarizer with a five-section handoff summary and keeps every shadowed message readable in a segment directory.
description.zh: 接管 DSH 自带的压缩摘要器，改用五段式交接摘要，被压掉的每条消息都能在分段目录里读回。

description.en: Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applying every change all-or-nothing after a full read-only verification pass, with sandbox-aware delete and move and a dry-run mode.
description.zh: 补丁风格文件编辑：单个 apply_patch 工具，接受 git/unified diff（默认）与 Codex apply_patch 语法（可选开启），在完整只读校验后全量原子应用；删除与移动走沙箱感知路径，并提供 dry-run 模式。

description.en: Compact Codex coding mode for DSH: light prompt guardrails against GPT over-explaining, with an editable prompt and native Codex-style tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中提供精简的 Codex 编码模式：使用精简的 codex 提示词与原生 Codex 风格工具，并用少量提示词约束抑制 GPT 的过度解释；提示词可自行编辑调整。

description.en: One shared Obsidian vault for every agent: dependency-free Python core (search/promote/adjudicate/forget), vault template, dsh plugin (memory_search/show/submit/status).
description.zh: 多 Agent 共享一个 Obsidian vault：零依赖 Python core（检索/晋升/裁决/遗忘）+ vault 模板 + dsh 插件（memory_search/show/submit/status）。

description.en: Session Steward for DSH: browse and bulk-prune the official session archive set, and run a four-gate health checkup (log integrity, projection cache, lossless JSON, cold read) that ends in a reversible, backup-first prescription. Never rewrites session logs.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的会话管家：浏览并批量清理官方会话归档集合，并对会话做四门体检（日志完整性 / 投影缓存 / 无损 JSON / 冷读），最终给出可逆、先备份的处方。不改写会话日志。

description.en: Lets text-only models handle pasted chat images, with a native vision experience, batch image viewing, and a built-in OpenAI-compatible analyze_image tool; vision-capable models are unaffected.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型也能处理聊天贴图，提供原生视觉体验，支持批量看图，走内置 OpenAI 兼容识图工具 analyze_image；具备视觉能力的模型不受影响。

description.en: Runtime diagnostics for DSH plugins: live, restart, or hot reload.
description.zh: DSH 插件运行时诊断：区分实时生效、重启和热重载。

description.en: Clean desktop shell for DSH: launch by double-clicking a desktop shortcut like any normal desktop app, live backend monitoring with one-click tray start/restart/stop (progress dialogs), offline auto-reconnect, single instance. Reuses your existing web profile, no restyling of the web UI. Windows + macOS.
description.zh: DSH 纯净桌面壳：双击桌面快捷方式即可像普通桌面软件一样启动；后端活性实时监测 + 托盘一键启停/重启（带进度弹窗）、离线自动重连、单实例。复用现有 web profile，不改动 web 界面。Windows + macOS 双平台。

description.en: CLIProxyAPI quota for DeepSeek Harness: a ring beside the model picker plus a settings panel listing every account quota windows with plans and reset times.
description.zh: 模型选择器旁的 CLIProxyAPI 额度圆环，设置面板仿 CPA 管理页列出全部账号的额度窗口、套餐与刷新时间。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that renders a session brief — a todo board read from the `todos` projection plus a deliverables section listing the files written this turn — and hides the official todo panel above the composer while it is mounted.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把会话简报渲染成右侧栏「概要」tab——来自 `todos` 投影的进展看板，加上回合内产物列表——并在挂载期间遮蔽 composer 上方的官方 todo 面板。

description.en: ICVO coding-standards kit for DeepSeek Harness (formerly dsh-coding-kit): a bundle plugin that registers tools on load and injects the standards only when apply_coding_standards is called, plus a P0 gate CLI (npx spec-wave) with G1-G7 process commands, skills install, host apply, and IDE-block refresh.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ICVO 编码规范套件（原 dsh-coding-kit）：bundle 插件加载时仅注册工具，须调用 apply_coding_standards 才注入规范；另附 P0 门禁 CLI（npx spec-wave），含 G1–G7 过程命令、skills install、host apply 与 IDE 块刷新。

description.en: Replaces the stats line under the message input in the DSH desktop app with a configurable status bar of ten optional fields, with live cost estimates at DeepSeek's official peak and off-peak rates, custom per-model prices, a CNY or USD switch and account balance.
description.zh: 把 DSH 桌面端对话区底部的统计行换成可配置状态栏：10 个字段可选可排序，按 DeepSeek 官方峰谷口径实时估算费用，支持自定义模型单价、CNY / USD 计价切换与账户余额显示。

description.en: Companion for DSH Notch that synchronizes session navigation and read state with DSH Desktop and Web.
description.zh: DSH Notch 的配套助手，同步 Desktop、Web 与 Notch 之间的会话跳转和已读状态。

description.en: After each completed agent turn, a bounded auxiliary LLM call writes one suggested next prompt into the session log; the web composer renders it as ghost placeholder text, adopted via Tab.
description.zh: 每次完成的 agent 回合后，一次有界的辅助 LLM 调用把一条建议的下一句 prompt 写入会话日志；Web 输入框将其渲染为幽灵占位文字，按 Tab 采纳。

description.en: Live security beacon for DSH that follows tool activity. Click to view call statistics, risk provenance chains and blocked actions, with read-only task restrictions and tool metadata change detection.
description.zh: DSH 实时安全浮标，随工具调用更新防护状态，点击查看调用统计、风险来源链和拦截结果，支持只读任务约束及工具元数据变化检测。

description.en: Zero-LLM auto-capture and a symbolic \[ENGRAM\] index with progressive disclosure, an ESR-lite task/evidence protocol (esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link), and per-workspace usage telemetry with an offline recall benchmark (npm run eval).
description.zh: 零 LLM 自动捕获 + 符号化 \[ENGRAM\] 索引渐进披露，配 ESR-lite 任务/证据闭环（esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link）、按工作区的真实使用遥测与离线召回基准（npm run eval）。

description.en: Vision for text-only DeepSeek via Doubao Web by default (zero-cost, no API key — drives your logged-in Chrome through a Windows CDP bridge), with Antigravity IDE quota (flash/pro) or Gemini fallback; auto detail escalation, vision evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图插件：默认走豆包 Web（零成本、免 API key，经 Windows CDP 桥接驱动已登录 Chrome），另有反重力额度（flash/pro）与 Gemini 降级通道；档位自动升级、视觉证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

description.en: Per-step model router: named presets with ordered image/keyword-group rules route each agent step across every mounted provider and model, adding collaboration flows for image transcription, an image guard, a multi-plan quota panel, and per-step decision observability.
description.zh: 逐步模型路由器：以命名预设与带图/关键词组有序规则为每一步在全部已挂载模型间选路，附图像转述协作流、图像护栏、多 plan 配额面板与逐步决策可观测。

description.en: Wallpaper Engine integration for the dsh web GUI: scan the local WE library (Steam workshop 431960 + local projects) and use its wallpapers as the page background — image/video/web rendered natively, scene wallpapers as softened static previews — with a 壁纸设计 panel (opacity, scope, fill, blur, vignette, fps, parallax, carousel, theme linkage) and agent tools wallpaper_scan/list/set/config.
description.zh: Wallpaper Engine 壁纸联动：把本机下载的 WE 壁纸（创意工坊 431960 + 本地 projects）设为 DSH Web GUI 页面背景（图片/视频/网页原样渲染，场景壁纸柔化为静态预览），侧边栏「壁纸设计」面板可调不透明度、作用范围、填充、模糊、暗角、帧率、视差、轮播与主题联动，附 wallpaper_scan/list/set/config 四个 agent 工具。

description.en: Reads the files that AGENTS.md references with @path imports and injects their content into model context at session start, with byte budgets, compaction re-seeding and a six-language settings card. v0.2.3 targets DSH 0.1.7+ (hardened for 0.2.0-rc.2+); use 0.1.x on DSH 0.1.5.
description.zh: 把 AGENTS.md 里 @路径 引用的文件读出来，在会话启动时注入模型上下文；带字节预算、压缩后重新注入和六语言设置卡片。v0.2.3 适配 DSH 0.1.7+（已加固 0.2.0-rc.2+），DSH 0.1.5 请用 0.1.x。

description.en: Named subagent roster: manage role entries (model, persona, tool filter, depth, background mode) from a hot-reloaded settings page; the model picks one with list_subagents and dispatches by id with delegate — foreground, background, or continuable.
description.zh: 具名子代理名册：设置页可视化维护角色条目（模型、persona、工具过滤、深度、后台模式），热生效；模型用 list_subagents 选人、delegate 按 id 派活，支持前台、后台与可续聊。

description.en: Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.
description.zh: 复制、打开 `dsh://` 会话深链，或将其粘贴到另一对话中，注入被引用会话的受限只读快照。

description.en: Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding, and exposes graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config tools plus a graphlint skill to DSH agents.
description.zh: 面向 AI 生成代码的死代码检测：graphlint 构建依赖图，定位从任何入口不可达的代码，以实现代码库清理和功能有效性理解，并为 DSH 智能体提供 graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config 工具与 graphlint 技能。

description.en: Renders assistant replies with numbered citation chips and a sources panel for web-search results, inline pictures with their source captions, and KaTeX formulas, Mermaid diagrams and highlighted code in streaming Markdown.
description.zh: 为助手回答渲染带编号的引用角标和来源面板（针对联网搜索结果）、带来源说明的正文配图，并在流式 Markdown 中渲染 KaTeX 公式、Mermaid 图和代码高亮。

description.en: Search titles and saved text across ordinary DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations in all workspaces, optionally including archived chats, with Ctrl+F / Cmd+F search inside the current conversation.
description.zh: 搜索 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）各工作区普通对话的标题和已保存正文，可包含归档；也可按 Ctrl+F / Cmd+F 查找当前对话。

description.en: Rotates configured LLM API keys after quota, rate-limit, or authentication failures.
description.zh: 在配额、速率限制或身份验证失败后轮换已配置的 LLM API 密钥。

description.en: Registers the DeepSeek Harness web server (dsh web) as an auto-start, self-healing background service — LaunchAgent / systemd / cron plus a 30s health-check watchdog — with seven dsh_daemon_* tools (install/uninstall/reinstall/status/start/stop/update).
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 服务（dsh web）注册为自启动、自愈的后台服务：LaunchAgent / systemd / cron 加 30 秒健康检查 watchdog，并提供 7 个 dsh_daemon_* 工具（安装/卸载/重装/状态/启动/停止/更新）。

description.en: Microi吾码 AI 开发 CLI 与多宿主 Plugin：服务器连接、Skills、MCP、V8 同步和低代码交付

Visible Electron browser for DSH with one shared BrowserWindow, isolated task views, explicit human-Agent handoff, snapshot-reference and native navigation tools, operation trails, demand-driven page thumbnails, keyed session recovery for reliable tab switching and closing, and site-scoped cookie clearing for login maintenance.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的可见 Electron 浏览器：共享一个 BrowserWindow，提供隔离任务视图、显式人机交接、快照引用与原生导航工具、操作轨迹、按需页面缩略图、可靠标签页切换与关闭的 keyed session 恢复，以及按站点清理 Cookie 的登录态维护能力。

description.en: Coordinates Codex planning and independent review while the original DSH session implements and tests changes.
description.zh: 协调 Codex 制定计划和独立审查，由 DSH 原会话完成代码修改与测试。

description.en: Smart subagent routing and evolution: bind roles to any provider/model registered in DSH, including models supplied by Codex and Claude Code provider plugins, with workspace learning.
description.zh: 智能子代理路由与进化：按角色绑定 DSH 已注册的 provider/model；配合 Codex、Claude Code 等 provider 插件，可路由任意已注册模型，并保存工作区经验。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: one chief orchestrator that never implements itself — it triages every request, has a PM expert plan the work, and delegates implementation to domain experts via a merged expert roster (list and summon tools), scheduling parallel work through a dependency-DAG taskboard and a file-based message bus, with delivery gated by an independent review. Ships 11 core experts; more expert teams (Agency agents EN/ZH, classic collections) are one-click downloads from the settings page over dual GitHub/CDN channels with sha256 verification. Published on npm as dsh-expert-orchestrator (requires DSH >= 0.1.7-alpha.2).
description.zh: 多智能体编排 agent preset：首席编排者不亲自实施——先分诊、请 PM 专家规划、经合并专家花名册（召唤工具）把实施委派给领域专家，依赖 DAG 任务板与落盘消息总线调度并行协作，交付前经独立评审门禁。出厂内置 11 位核心专家；更多专家团（Agency agents 中英文、classic 集合）可在设置页一键下载，走 GitHub/CDN 双通道并经 sha256 验签。npm 包名 dsh-expert-orchestrator（要求 DSH >= 0.1.7-alpha.2）。

description.en: Laya typed decisions (`noul` yes/no, `choice`, `score`) as a first-class Cordis service (`ctx.laya`) plus the model-visible `laya_ask` and `laya_plan` tools. The plugin itself installs and downloads nothing: it is a client of a `laya-mcp serve` sidecar you start yourself, and it reports that the sidecar is not running instead of failing obscurely at the first tool call.
description.zh: 把 Laya 的有类型决策（`noul` 是/否、`choice`、`score`）接成一等 Cordis 服务（`ctx.laya`）与两个模型可见工具 `laya_ask`、`laya_plan`。插件自身不安装也不下载任何东西：它是你自己启动的 `laya-mcp serve` 边车的客户端，边车未运行时会明确报出，而不是在首次工具调用时隐晦失败。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在对话中搜索、安装和管理 SkillHub 技能

Replaces the chat composer with an editor-style input panel on CodeMirror 6: line numbers, edit + markdown-preview split, a floating window mode and a full-height sidebar tab — one input surface at a time. Drafts ride the official input machine; the official voice-input button is rendered when the host provides one, and the stats row and context meter read the same data as the official dock.
description.zh: 把聊天输入框换成 CodeMirror 6 的编辑器式输入面板：行号、编辑 + Markdown 预览分屏、悬浮窗与全高侧栏标签，同一时刻只有一个输入入口。草稿走官方输入机；宿主有语音输入按钮时原样渲染官方语音组件，数据行与上下文小圈与官方 dock 同源。

description.en: Adds a VS Code-style workspace file explorer to the dsh web GUI: file tree, editable preview with syntax highlighting, tabs, line numbers, right-click file operations, and inline image preview.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页添加 VS Code 风格工作区文件浏览器：文件树、可编辑预览（语法高亮、标签页、行号）、右键文件操作与图片内联预览。

description.en: QQ channel for dsh via OneBot 11 (NapCat and friends): reverse or forward WebSocket, DM and group chats, image and voice transcription, t2i text-image cards, merged forwards, and a settings page.
description.zh: 给 dsh 加上 QQ 通道（OneBot 11，兼容 NapCat）：反向/正向 WS、私聊群聊、图片与语音转写、t2i 文字图卡片、合并转发、设置页可视化配置。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks: event→command declarations in cordis.patch.yml, with Feishu card notifications and a QR scan-to-create bot setup.
description.zh: 配置驱动生命周期 hooks：在 cordis.patch.yml 声明事件→命令，附飞书卡片通知与扫码一键创建机器人。

description.en: All-in-one local memory: JSONL files per scope (session, project, global, or a custom name) with per-scope dedup, five model tools (memory_save, memory_search, memory_list, memory_get, memory_forget), automatic recall and hard rules injected into the agent pre-step, and a settings panel. Retrieval combines lexical IDF with a local embedding backend, which the panel can install and manage itself.
description.zh: 一体化本地记忆：按作用域（会话、项目、全局或自定义名）各一个 JSONL 文件、作用域内按内容去重，五个模型工具（memory_save / memory_search / memory_list / memory_get / memory_forget），自动召回与硬性规则注入 agent 的 pre-step，并带一个设置面板。检索是词法 IDF 与本地向量后端的组合，向量后端可由面板一键安装并托管。

description.en: Multi-threaded downloader plugin for DeepSeek Harness with bundled aria2: probes the target for Range support, then picks aria2 (4 or 8 connections by file size) or falls back to curl.
description.zh: DSH 多线程下载插件，内置 aria2：先探测目标是否支持 Range，再按文件大小选择 aria2（4 或 8 连接）或回退 curl 单线程下载。

description.en: A governed swarm of six specialist DSH agents — orchestrator, planner, knowledge-base bridge, developer and two reviewers — turns a requirement into a strict phase pipeline where every delivery must prove itself with structured evidence before the next phase may start; reviewers are read-only, code merges only after a review pass, and an append-only event log gives full replay and audit on a live kanban board. Its design draws inspiration from the Hermes Agent kanban.
description.zh: 一个受管的智能体蜂群（swarm）：六种专职 DSH 智能体——编排、规划、知识库桥接、开发，以及方案评审与代码评审——把需求转化为严格阶段流水线；每阶段交付必须先以结构化证据自证，下一阶段才放行；评审只读、代码仅评审通过后合并，追加式事件日志支持全程回放与审计，实时看板同步展示。其设计灵感源自 Hermes Agent kanban。

description.en: Multi-host SSH workbench: keep remote servers in a host library, grant them per project, and open an interactive terminal or dual-pane SFTP in the right sidebar, while the SSHManager tool runs remote commands and transfers files without exposing keys to the model.
description.zh: 多机 SSH 工作台：把远程服务器收进主机库、按项目授权，在右侧栏里开交互式终端或双栏 SFTP；模型用 SSHManager 工具远程执行命令、上传下载文件，密钥不进模型上下文。

description.en: A governed registry for MCP connectors (stdio and streamable-http): four-level fail-closed authorization, mcpServers JSON import that rejects malformed args, credential redaction at every output boundary, an agent bridge that returns an honest review verdict instead of a fake approval, and a /mcp-reg operator console plus a settings page.
description.zh: MCP 连接器（stdio / streamable-http）的受治理注册表：四级 fail-closed 授权、mcpServers JSON 导入对畸形 args 大声报错、输出边界全程脱敏、agent 桥接返回诚实 review 而非伪装放行，配 /mcp-reg 操作台与设置页。

description.en: Token-efficient persona runtime for DeepSeek Harness with local catgirl rendering and progressive tool-schema disclosure.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的省 token 人格运行时：本地渲染猫娘风味，并支持渐进式工具 schema 披露。

description.en: Decentralized multi-device fleet: mDNS LAN discovery, key pairing, and SSH direct execution across networks.
description.zh: 去中心化多设备舰队：mDNS 同网发现、密钥配对、SSH 跨网直连指挥。

description.en: Quote selected conversation text into the Web composer as native reference chips for focused follow-up turns.
description.zh: 在网页会话中划选文本，以原生引用 chip 插入输入框，进行针对性追问。

description.en: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 native agent preset and standalone Cordis plugin: 13 modules, persistent controller and decoupled workspace.
description.zh: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 原生智能体预设与 Cordis 插件：提供 13 大认知工程模块、持久化控制器与状态外化工作区。

description.en: All-in-one combo patch for STARDUSTLC's 18 DSH plugins: one command injects shared default configs across office, media, DevOps and notification presets; each component installs directly via a one-line add command (flat design, no git subdependencies).
description.zh: STARDUSTLC 插件全家桶·组合补丁：与 18 个组件插件配套，一条命令统一注入默认配置（办公流/媒体工坊/DevOps/通知/预设）；组件经一行 add 命令直装（扁平化设计，无 git 子依赖）。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-stardustlc-dsh-suite
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-suite

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: DeepSeek Harness ArmorBreak (破甲模式): authorized reverse-engineering & security-research agent preset. 39 offline capabilities, L0–L3 policy engine, evidence-chain reports. MIT.
description.zh: 给 Harness 加个授权逆向与安全研究模式，离线跑 46 项分析能力，权限分级、报告可复核。

description.en: Edit any user turn in DeepSeek Harness and re-run it: an inline editor rolls the conversation back through the official surface-replace contract, then re-prompts the agent with the revised text. The append-only session log is never rewritten.
description.zh: 点一下用户消息旁的编辑按钮就能改写内容，会话自动回退到这条消息之前，用新文本重新跑这一轮。

description.en: Open dsh web from your phone or another computer through a UUMit account, without running your own server or installing another program: a built-in tunnel client connects to UUMit's hosted tunnel, and a panel in the sidebar handles pairing and who can use it (only you, people you invite by link or phone number, or everyone), with revocation. Requires dsh web on DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 用 UUMit 账号在手机或其他电脑上打开这台电脑的 dsh web，不用自建服务器、不装其他程序：插件内置通道客户端连接 UUMit 托管的通道，侧栏里的面板负责配对和选择谁能用（仅自己、通过邀请链接或手机号授权的人、所有人），可随时撤销。需 dsh web 且 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: A GPT/ChatGPT-persona desktop pet pinned to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI — shows balance, today's usage, peak/off-peak pricing and per-turn cost, with editable bubbles (text, balance, usage, pricing, images, random lines and weighted choices), per-line styles and fonts, a floating quick editor, sound effects, custom character art/animation/audio, and snapping/flipping. 54 GPT-flavored lines across five groups. Its routes, bundle id and data files are namespaced so it can run alongside the whale and Xiaoke widgets. A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).
description.zh: 右下角的 GPT / ChatGPT 拟人桌宠「GPT娘」：显示余额、今日已用、峰谷定价与每轮消耗，泡泡内容可编辑（文本、余额、今日、峰谷、图片、随机语句与并列加权选择），支持逐行样式与字体、悬浮快捷编辑、音效、自定义角色图/动图/音效与吸附翻转，台词 54 条、分五组；路由、bundle id 与数据文件均与其它桌宠隔离，可与小鲸鱼、小克同时运行。二创自 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget（MIT）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 全局自动记忆插件：会话开始注入记忆、memory_search 检索工具、压缩检查点归档提醒（零写入提醒制）。Global auto-memory plugin for DSH.
description.zh: 让 DSH 跨会话记住你的画像、偏好和进展，新会话自动注入记忆，AI 不用每次从零开始。

description.en: Create and edit Figma designs through natural-language requests in DSH, read existing UI frames to support frontend development, and capture screenshots or export assets. Requires a companion plugin running in Figma.
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言创建和修改 Figma 设计，读取已有 UI 画板辅助前端开发，并支持画布截图与素材导出。需在 Figma 中运行配套插件。

description.en: Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness: the model answers with an openui-lang program and the Web GUI renders it as a live, interactive UI inside the chat
description.zh: 让模型直接生成可点击操作的交互界面，聊天里就能用，不用再读一大段文字。

Native macOS Notch for DSH sessions, inline answers and animated task status

description.en: Native China Railway 12306 query tools for DeepSeek Harness.
DSH(DeepSeek Harness) 插件：把一段可在设置页随时改写的文字，作为全局系统提示词段注入到所有会话，含子代理与工作流内部子代理；文本与开关即时生效，无需重启。

description.en: 为 DSH 默认沙箱增加可配置的「沙箱授权目录」，允许工作区外的受信修改。
description.zh: 给 DSH 沙箱加个受信目录白名单，让代理能直接改工作区外的文件，不用反复授权。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 推理等级自动选择插件：由 Jev System One 模型判断每条消息值多少思考量，按模型声明的等级自动推导档位，上下文信封让「继续」这类追问继承话题深度，低置信度向上取，任何失败都静默沿用原等级。 | Jev-driven reasoning effort per message: per-model ladders derived from what each model advertises, a fixed-size context envelope so follow-ups inherit topic depth, ties break upward, silent fallback on every failure path.
description.zh: 让 Jev 模型自动判断每条消息该用多深的推理，省去手动切换推理等级。

description.en: DSH Research Graph · 研图 — DeepSeek Harness plugin for research topics, traceable knowledge cards, and reusable AI discussions.
description.zh: 把 AI 对话变成可追溯的知识图谱，帮你梳理研究主题、沉淀可复用的讨论卡片。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆插件，帮 DSH 记住事实、偏好和决策，让对话更连贯。

description.en: Inline +N −M badges on edit/write tool rows and a collapsible per-turn file-change summary card with aligned diffs, review and undo — covers native edit/write, str_replace_editor and Code Dispatch sub-calls, no git required.

description.en: 贾维斯 · 常驻桌面的悬浮窗桌面助手 / 桌面宠物 —— DSH Desktop 的粒子光球：快速审批权限、⌃⌥J 快速对话。A floating-window desktop assistant & desktop pet for DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 常驻桌面的粒子光球助手，随手审批权限、⌃⌥J 唤起对话，还能当桌宠陪你。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web-GUI plugin: archived-session panel with unarchive & delete
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web-GUI plugin: archived-session panel with unarchive & delete

description.en: Split panes.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle plugin: makes the existing bash tool run Git Bash on Windows and disables pwsh.
用于提供更丰富的DeepSeek Harness底栏信息显示插件

description.en: DeepSeek API 用量监测 DSH 插件：悬浮球 + 展开面板，展示开放平台真实余额、累计消费、今日消费、请求次数、Tokens 与分模型用量，支持手动登录获取 userToken。
description.zh: 悬浮球实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，点开还能看消费、请求次数和分模型用量。

description.en: Native Graphify knowledge graph plugin providing 10 code intelligence tools, topological search, god nodes discovery, and PR blast radius triage.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 Graphify 知识图谱支持，包含 10 个代码智能工具、拓扑搜索、核心节点发现与 PR 影响分析。

description.en: 【编排模式】为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体编排模式：主智能体分解分派、worker 全网格互通，支持逐 worker 指定模型与思考强度
description.zh: 【编排模式】为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体编排模式：主智能体分解分派、worker 全网格互通，支持逐 worker 指定模型与思考强度

description.en: Chinese writing de-AI plugin (AI-isms / AI writing / humanize): say "去掉AI味" to rewrite text, "写的不错" to auto-learn new AI words into the avoid list. Free from the Zhihu "去AI味写作技巧" community.

description.en: Switch the language of the agent's thinking/reasoning process (chain-of-thought): 简体中文, English, Русский, Français, Deutsch, Español, 日本語, 한국어 and more, or auto-follow the system locale. Adds a Settings → General row, a system-prompt instruction (per-prompt assembly, applies to new sessions), and the /thinking-language command.

description.en: For the DeepSeek Harness native vision model deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, raises image admission limits to 32 MiB / 8192 px / 600 images and adds a highres_read tool that tiles large images, then returns the whole image plus 800x800 tiles through the host read_image tool.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 原生视觉模型 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 提供高清识图：将图片准入上限提升至 32 MiB / 8192 px / 600 张，并新增 highres_read 工具，将大图切为整图与 800x800 分块后经宿主 read_image 注入模型。

description.en: LAN and reverse-proxy access to the web UI: serves the settings service off localhost and supplies the web APIs a browser withholds over plain HTTP.
description.zh: 局域网/反代访问 Web UI：让 settings 服务脱离 localhost，补上浏览器在纯 HTTP 下不给的 Web API。

description.en: Enhances data visualization in DeepSeek Harness by automatically selecting chart types from user input and generating images for trends, comparisons, proportions, relationships, and flows.

description.en: Sticky notes for DeepSeek Harness: draggable notes with text & image support, 9 skins, and AI-powered read/write. DeepSeek Harness 便签插件:可拖拽,支持文字与图片、9 款皮肤,AI 可读写。

description.en: Browse the directories/files of the workspace in DeepSeek Harness Web GUI and display file changes in conjunction with Git.

description.en: 零外部依赖的 LLM 长期记忆插件，专为 [DeepSeek Harness] 设计。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个长期记忆，不用装任何外部依赖，聊过的事都能记住。

description.en: 🌐 Multi-provider web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Zero-key Bing/Baidu direct search, free-tier APIs (Tavily/Brave/Serper/Bocha), SearXNG token auth, auto-fallback, and a built-in Web Settings GUI.
description.zh: 一个插件搞定多家搜索引擎，免密钥直连必应百度，还能自动切换备用源。

description.en: Drives a real Chrome through a local MCP server so the agent can search Google/Bing/Sogou, read any page including JS-rendered and login-only content, automate click/scroll/type/key-press/select in a background window, and run platform search/detail/comment/download for Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, X and Reddit; resumable comments, SHA-256-verified downloads, cookies never returned, localhost only.

description.en: Windows-only Computer Use plugin for DeepSeek Harness with UIA, cua-driver, and optional GLM vision.
description.zh: 适用于 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness Computer Use 插件，支持 UIA、cua-driver 和可选 GLM 视觉。

description.en: Always-on supervisor agent bundle for DeepSeek Harness: main-agent preset + schedule overlay, one dsh plugin add away
description.zh: 始终在线的监督智能体，锁定目标后自动循环调度子任务，无人值守也能持续推进。

description.en: Task panel for the DSH Web sidebar: publish tasks, auto-distill related sessions, and drive plan/develop/review stages with subagents plus in-panel acceptance.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏任务面板：发布任务、自动蒸馏历史会话，由子代理分阶段（规划/开发/复核）执行，并在面板内验收。

description.en: 🐳 蓝色大肥鱼 · DeepSeek 虎鲸 3D 桌宠插件 — 由 DeepSeek 虎鲸 logo 轮廓重建，悬浮于 Web GUI 角落：拖拽旋转、360° 转圈、爱心互动、悬停工具栏、大小/灵敏度/文字设置，配置本地持久化 / A 3D whale desktop pet rebuilt from the DeepSeek whale logo for DeepSeek Harness — drag to rotate, 360° spin, heart bursts, hover toolbar, size/sensitivity/caption settings, and local persistence.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 虎鲸 logo 变成 3D 桌宠，悬浮在网页角落，能拖拽旋转、送爱心，还能调大小和灵敏度。

description.en: Adds an approval-mode toggle next to the permission selector: default approval keeps per-call confirmation, bypass approval auto-approves every tool call while staying in Workspace Write.
description.zh: 在权限下拉框旁增加「审批模式」开关：默认审批保留逐次确认，绕过审批自动放行所有工具调用，同时保持 Workspace Write 权限。

description.en: Manage conversation records from the DSH web GUI settings page: delete a whole session (archive plus physical log removal) or a single message (deleting a user message cascades to its assistant replies and tool results). Running and current sessions are protected.

description.en: A browser pixel-art and sprite animation editor with Aseprite-compatible files, local crop/outline blueprints, and optional LLM workflow nodes.
description.zh: 浏览器像素画与精灵动画编辑器，支持兼容 Aseprite 的文件、本地裁剪/描边蓝图和可选的 LLM 工作流节点。

description.en: Peer-to-peer colleague-agent consultation for DSH: ask one or several configured peers, queue asynchronous questions, discover peers through signed friend cards, and review inbound requests in the Web UI.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的点对点同事 Agent 咨询：可向单个或多个已配置 Peer 提问、异步排队问题、通过签名 Friend Card 推荐发现 Peer，并在 Web UI 审批入站请求。

description.en: Manage DSH（DeepSeek Harness)） skills and MCP servers: CLI + settings-page UI with zh/en i18n, Claude/Codex import, and update checks.
description.zh: 帮你集中管理 DSH 技能与 MCP 服务器，支持设置页和命令行操作，能直接导入其他 AI 配置并自动查更新。

description.en: A gated math-modeling skill suite for DeepSeek Harness: a five-stage pipeline with stage gates, award-paper writing patterns, sensitivity analysis, statistical diagnosis, and a contest preset.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的门控式数学建模 skill 套件：五阶段流水线、阶段门、国奖写作范式、灵敏度分析、统计诊断与竞赛预设。

description.en: Local-first persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: bounded pre-step hot-memory injection, exact and Chinese-bigram BM25 cold recall, six agent tools, approval-gated lease-lock writes with recovery receipts, and read-only governance and trajectory-review candidates.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先持久记忆：在 pre-step 注入有预算上限的热记忆，使用精确匹配与中文二元 BM25 召回冷层，提供六个 Agent 工具，并以审批门禁、租约锁、恢复回执和只读治理与轨迹复盘候选保护写入。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 消息提醒插件：回合结束或等待确认时向浏览器、系统、飞书/钉钉/企业微信/通用 Webhook 发送通知
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 消息提醒插件：回合结束或等待确认时向浏览器、系统、飞书/钉钉/企业微信/通用 Webhook 发送通知

description.en: Self-evolve memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: learns from your own sessions, injects token-budgeted preference summaries into every step. /memory commands, memory tool, settings panel. Local-only data.
Voice input for DeepSeek Harness: speak into the microphone and the recognized text is submitted as a normal chat message, via local or browser speech recognition.
description.zh: 语音输入插件：对着麦克风说话，识别后的文字作为普通聊天消息发送（本地模型或浏览器语音识别）。

description.en: Cross-session memory plugin for DSH (v0.6.1, npm @asherliner/dsh-memory-connect): auto-extraction, SQLite FTS5 indexing, RRF semantic recall injected into the system prompt every turn, scheduled maintenance, LLM-powered consolidation via ctx.llm, context explosion prevention, and global Soul identity via ~/.dsh/soul.md. v0.5.0 added temporal context graph (valid_from/valid_until/supersedes, append-only corrections via reviseMemory), trust model (recalled history injected as untrusted reference, current instruction always wins), turn-end summarization. v0.6.0 added local semantic embeddings (BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5 via embed_server.py, cosine + RRF fusion with FTS5, no cloud calls, ~232 msgs/sec on CPU). v0.6.1 fixed ~ expansion in path config. Zero-config install.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆插件（v0.6.1，npm 包 @asherliner/dsh-memory-connect）：自动提取、SQLite FTS5 索引、RRF 语义召回（每轮注入系统提示词）、定时维护、LLM 智能合并（自动接入 ctx.llm）、上下文爆炸防护、全局身份 Soul（~/.dsh/soul.md）。v0.5.0 新增：时态上下文图谱（valid_from/valid_until/supersedes，reviseMemory 追加式修正）、信任模型（历史记忆作为不可信参考注入，当前指令绝对优先）、轮末自动摘要。v0.6.0 新增：本地语义 embedding（BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5，embed_server.py 提供，余弦相似度 + 与 FTS5 的 RRF 融合，纯本地无云端调用，CPU 约 232 条/秒）。v0.6.1 修复 path 配置 ~ 展开。零配置装完即用。

description.en: DSH 自定义 WebUI 背景插件
description.zh: 自定义 DSH WebUI 背景，支持本地图库随机切换和自由裁剪，实时生效并持久保存。

description.en: an heterogeneous multi-agent collaboration skill designed for dsh
description.zh: 让多个异构智能体在 dsh 里协同干活，各司其职，搞定复杂任务。

description.en: Automatically and intelligently routes each delegated task to the best configured model using aliases, capability tags, and usage guidance—keeping routine work fast and affordable while sending complex work to stronger specialists.
