Configure your model team in the Web UI or guided setup, run specialists in parallel with reliable result joining, and see the chosen model at a glance in subagent views and inline in Better Sidebar's Tasks tree.
description.zh: 借助别名、能力标签和使用说明，将每项委派任务自动智能路由到最合适的已配置模型——常规工作更快、更省，复杂任务则交给更强的专用模型。可通过 Web 设置页或引导流程组建模型团队，让多个专家并行工作并可靠汇总结果；所选模型会显示在子代理视图中，并以内联标签无缝融入 Better Sidebar 的 Tasks 任务树。

description.en: 100+ multi platform social-media data skills, plus 40 native MCP tools covering data APIs, AI search and AI generation — all installable with one command.
description.zh: 100+ 多平台社媒数据技能 + 40 个原生 MCP 工具（数据 API、AI 搜索、AI 生成），一键安装。

description.en: ⭐ Drag-and-drop uploads of any file or whole folders, anywhere in the window; remote-safe — bytes go straight into the session workspace on the server, so a DSH deployed on a remote machine works exactly like localhost.
description.zh: ⭐ 支持拖拽上传：任意文件、整个文件夹，拖到窗口任意位置即可；支持远程上传——字节直传服务器的会话工作区，部署在服务器上的 DSH 也能像本地一样拖了就发。

description.en: Stock market skin + real-time ticker plugin for DSH Web GUI: candlestick (K-line) popup with day/week/month periods, watchlist with pinyin fuzzy search, portfolio P&L tracker, trading session indicators, support for A-share/HK/US/crypto/forex.
description.zh: 股市行情皮肤与功能插件：全局交易终端皮肤 + 跑马灯 + 个股 K 线弹窗（日K/周K/月K 切换）、自选拼音首字母模糊搜索、持仓盈亏管理、交易时段指示，支持 A股 / 港股 / 美股 / 加密货币 / 外汇。

description.en: Literary DSH plugin: one session is one book. Cover-card /new opens one of 19 realms, a prose-only 诸天万界DSH preset keeps the model writing fiction, keyword worldbook entries ground each turn, and /export-story typesets the session into a Markdown novel.
description.zh: 诸天万界DSH：一个会话就是一本书。封面开书，十九界任选，文学预设只写正文，规则书按关键词注入，/export-story 把整场会话誊成 Markdown 小说。

description.en: Angelina light and dark glass themes with parallax for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把安洁莉娜亮暗玻璃视差主题移植到 DeepSeek Harness，保留原生交互，只换视觉皮肤，低配设备也能流畅用。

description.en: A third-party TUI mode for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), built on a vendored pi-tui fork
description.zh: A third-party TUI mode for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), built on a vendored pi-tui fork

issues.detail: declares install-time scripts; the harness gates them via allowBuilds

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-pi-tui
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-pi-tui

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Plugin Hub for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a graphical app-store inside the Harness Web UI — browse, search, and one-click install GitHub dsh-plugins, with local ratings, dependency impact graphs, audit logging, and a development scaffold
description.zh: Plugin Hub for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a graphical app-store inside the Harness Web UI — browse, search, and one-click install GitHub dsh-plugins, with local ratings, dependency impact graphs, audit logging, and a development scaffold

description.en: A starter template for dsh plugins covering config, tools, events, services, hooks, browser UI slots, and slash commands.
description.zh: dsh 插件开发模板，覆盖配置、工具、事件、服务、钩子、浏览器 UI 插槽与斜杠命令。

description.en: 提供vscode风格和功能的侧栏
description.zh: 把 VSCode 风格的右侧栏搬进 DSH，文件预览、会话管理一栏搞定。

description.en: 折叠对话当中众多的“无用消息”，例如Think、Bash等
description.zh: 折叠对话中的 Think、Bash 等「无用消息」。

description.en: Playwright MCP browser control for AI agents: drive a real, visible Chrome (navigate/click/type/snapshot + ~80 browser_* tools), with a live screenshot panel embedded in the GUI that refreshes after every action.
description.zh: 基于 Playwright MCP 的 AI 浏览器控制：驱动真实可见的 Chrome（导航/点击/输入/快照，约 80 个 browser_* 工具），并在 GUI 内嵌实时截图面板，每次操作后自动刷新。

description.en: Animated Claude-style reasoning-effort slider and model picker that replaces the native DSH model selector.
description.zh: Claude 风格动画推理等级滑块与模型选择器，替换原生模型选择器。

description.en: Auto-migrate Codex desktop-pet skins into DSH: an animated corner pet that mirrors agent state (thinking, tool use, awaiting approval, failed, done), with per-session frosted-glass dialogs and a full settings panel.
description.zh: 把 Codex 桌宠皮肤自动迁移到 DSH：右下角动画桌宠随 agent 状态实时变化（思考/工具/等待批准/出错/完成），多会话毛玻璃对话框 + 完整设置面板。

description.en: OpenCodeGo quota monitor for the DSH Web GUI: a breathing indicator at the input's bottom-right (green/yellow/red by remaining share), a liquid-glass panel with rolling/weekly/monthly usage windows and reset times, auto-refreshing every 30 s; API key read from DSH credentials.
description.zh: OpenCodeGo 剩余额度监视器：输入框右下角呼吸指示灯（按剩余额度绿/黄/红），液态玻璃面板显示滚动/周/月用量窗口与重置时间，每 30 秒自动刷新，API Key 自动读取 DSH 凭据。

description.en: Conversation node navigation rail for the DSH Web UI: one dash per user message on the right edge, reading-position tracking, hover preview card, click-to-jump with highlight line, sliding window, and auto-hide.
description.zh: 对话节点导航条：对话区右缘一列短横线节点对应每条用户消息，支持阅读位置跟踪、悬停预览卡片、点击跳转高亮、滑动窗口与自动隐藏。

description.en: Prompt Rail 是 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话页的紧凑纵向提示词快速跳转条。每一条横杠对应一条当前已加载的普通用户提示词。悬停或键盘聚焦会展示预览；点击会滚动跳转到对应提示词。
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）动态 Cordis 插件：模型高可用回退 + 子智能体编排（HA failover + orchestrate subagents）
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）动态 Cordis 插件：模型高可用回退 + 子智能体编排（HA failover + orchestrate subagents）

description.en: Snapshot-first Playwright browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-tree interaction with stable refs, per-session browser con…
description.zh: Playwright 浏览器自动化：无障碍树交互、稳定 ref、按会话隔离浏览器。

description.en: Financial research workflow and portfolio risk tools with source discipline for current market facts.
description.zh: 金融研究工作流与组合风控工具，对当前市场事实强制来源与时间戳边界。

description.en: Rings your phone over CallKit: `call_me` and `text_me` tools, plus optional turn-end and approval calls whose spoken answer is transcribed back into the session.
description.zh: 通过 CallKit 打电话到你的手机：`call_me` 与 `text_me` 工具，并可在回合结束或等待审批时来电，语音回答转写后送回会话。

description.en: 把思考状态里那句 "Deep diving..." 改成你喜欢的任何话。超轻量级。
description.zh: 把思考状态里那句 "Deep diving..." 改成你喜欢的任何话。超轻量级。

description.en: Bring the deepseek.com web/app chat experience to DSH: edit your prompt and regenerate answers in place, with a per-message <i/N> version pager (tree model, stable across conversations).
description.zh: 更贴近 deepseek 网页版/App 的聊天体验：原位编辑提问、重新生成回复、每条消息带 <i/N> 版本翻页器（树状版本模型，跨对话保持稳定）。

description.en: One memory layer for every AI tool and agent: Context Bundle injection, prompt-time recall, MCP tools, and turn-end DSH thread capture.
description.zh: 给所有 AI 工具和 Agent 共用的一层记忆：注入 Context Bundle、提示时检索、MCP 工具与回合结束 DSH 线程捕获。

description.en: OpenAI Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with device-code OAuth, Codex CLI import, token refresh, and a web settings panel.
description.zh: OpenAI Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with device-code OAuth, Codex CLI import, token refresh, and a web settings panel.

description.en: DSH Director Toolkit is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for 3D artists, technical designers, and creative coders. Paste a half-formed idea, a reference note, or a portfolio caption and get a compact direction pack for Blender, Three.js, Houdini, or C4D.
description.zh: 把零散的想法、参考笔记或作品文案丢进去，就能生成一份紧凑的导演级创作方案，帮 3D 艺术家和创意开发者快速理清思路。

description.en: dsh-huadongbianzuqi — DSH plugin (tools)
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness的滑动变祖器插件

description.en: 在 dsh（DeepSeek Harness）里使用你的 ChatGPT / Codex 订阅。插件通过 OpenAI Codex 的 OAuth 流程登录 ChatGPT 账号，把订阅额度暴露成 dsh 的 `codex-oauth` 模型提供方。
description.zh: 在 dsh（DeepSeek Harness）里使用你的 ChatGPT / Codex 订阅。插件通过 OpenAI Codex 的 OAuth 流程登录 ChatGPT 账号，把订阅额度暴露成 dsh 的 `codex-oauth` 模型提供方。

description.en: DSH Web UI 会话进度插件：输入框停靠区常驻会话进度条（todos 真实进度 / 实时 token 生成速率 / 中断橘红态 / 待办提醒），零核心改动
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话进度插件：输入框停靠区常驻会话进度条（todos 真实进度 / 实时 token 生成速率 / 中断橘红态 / 待办提醒），零核心改动

description.en: A floating balance widget for the Web UI: live DeepSeek account balance with manual refresh and a Y/N-confirmed graceful exit.
description.zh: Web UI 右上角悬浮窗：实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，支持手动刷新与一键优雅退出（Y/N 快捷键确认）。

description.en: Lazy-loading router for MCP servers: auto-discovers compatible MCPs and keeps only a shared router in the tool catalog, revealing a server's schemas when a turn needs them and hiding them again at turn end, so many installed MCPs stop costing context on every request. Falls open to normal visibility on any uncertainty, and the original MCP keeps ownership of execution, permissions and process lifecycle. Also supports explicit lazy connections with warm reuse, bounded reconnection, stdio and Streamable HTTP.
description.zh: MCP 懒加载路由：自动发现可接管的 MCP，冷态只在工具目录里留一个共享路由，某轮需要哪个服务器才展开它的工具 Schema、轮次结束再收起，让装了很多 MCP 不再每次请求都吃上下文。命名异常、重名或状态不确定的 MCP 不接管；出现任何不确定即恢复原工具可见性，执行、权限与进程生命周期仍归原 MCP。也支持显式的连接层懒加载，含连接保温、有限重连、stdio 与 Streamable HTTP。

description.en: Turns the DeepSeek Harness agent into any character: a global cosplay switch, SillyTavern v2 role cards with JSON import/export, a neutral/role thinking-style toggle, and natural-language card authoring via a built-in skill.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 扮演任何角色：全局扮演开关、酒馆 v2 角色卡（JSON 导入导出）、中立/角色化思考切换，内置 skill 支持一句话生成角色卡。

description.en: Windows XP Luna desktop for the DSH Web UI: a floating window manager with taskbar and desktop icons, plus the era-accurate Luna skin.
description.zh: Windows XP Luna 桌面化主题：浮动窗口管理器（任务栏、桌面图标）加上还原度很高的 Luna 皮肤。

description.en: LAN access for the official DSH Web UI through a gated reverse proxy: DSH keeps its own loopback binding, and a second port adds a password gate, self-signed HTTPS and per-device pairing that can be revoked individually, with a QR code to open it from a phone.
description.zh: 把官方 DSH Web UI 安全地开放到局域网：不改动 DSH 自身的回环绑定，另开一个带密码门禁、自签 HTTPS 与可逐个吊销的设备配对的反向代理端口，并提供手机扫码入口。

description.en: Bottom multi-tab terminal panel (node-pty + xterm.js) pinned to the viewport bottom, always below the input box.
description.zh: 底部多标签终端面板（node-pty + xterm.js）：贴底全宽，输入框始终在终端上方。

description.en: Skin manager for the DSH web GUI: discovers installed skins and switches the active one from a dedicated Settings page, mutually exclusive, hot-reloaded without restart.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 皮肤管理器：自动发现已安装皮肤，在独立设置页一键互斥切换，热载入无需重启。

description.en: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).
description.zh: 同一工作区并行多会话的文件认领与写入保护（claim/release、心跳 stale 接管、pending 三路合并）。

description.en: Per-model token usage and cost estimation with DeepSeek account balance, shown in a Settings panel tab.
description.zh: 按模型统计 token 消耗并估算费用，同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，展示于设置面板「模型消耗」页签。

description.en: Codex-style tool call folding, collapsing multiple tool calls into a single line.
description.zh: Codex 风格的工具调用折叠，将多个工具调用折叠到一行内。

description.en: Windows system-tray launcher for dsh web: console-free background start (VBS/powershell chain), a tray menu with open UI / logs / icon presets / launch-at-login / restart Harness, one-click install and update of the bundled dsh-plugin-usage-meter, and a dsh plugin half that starts the tray together with the harness.
description.zh: Windows 系统托盘启动器：无窗口后台启动 dsh web（VBS/powershell 链），托盘菜单支持打开界面、日志、图标预设、开机自启与重启 Harness，一键安装与更新内置的 dsh-plugin-usage-meter，并可作为 dsh 插件安装使托盘随 Harness 一起启动。

description.en: A slim port of Headroom: compresses tool output, cuts up to 20% of context, without affecting the model's context cache or agent performance.
description.zh: Headroom 的精简移植，在不影响模型上下文缓存以及 Agent 性能的情况下，压缩工具的输出，至多减少 20% 的上下文。

description.en: Unofficial Grok integration for eligible X Subscription, SuperGrok, or X Premium accounts: shared Grok CLI OAuth, chat with optional main-loop web/X search, and experimental image generation, image editing, and video generation (all media features disabled by default).
description.zh: 面向符合资格的 X Subscription、SuperGrok 或 X Premium 账号的非官方 Grok 集成：共用 Grok CLI OAuth 登录，支持对话及可选的主循环网页/X 搜索；实验性的图片生成、图生图编辑和视频生成均默认关闭，需主动开启。

description.en: A minimal phone remote control for DeepSeek Harness: the phone page carries only the instruction you send and the AI's final conclusion, while tool calls, file access, sub-agent dispatch, and reasoning traces stay on the computer, reachable over LAN, Tailscale, or a Cloudflare tunnel with a QR code, link, and password for each route.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的极简手机遥控器：手机页面上只有你发出的指令和 AI 最后的结论，工具调用、文件读写、子 Agent 调度与思考过程全部留在电脑上；可通过内网、Tailscale 或 Cloudflare 隧道连接，每条路径各配二维码、链接和密码。

description.en: Evidence-backed inspector for DSH Web built-in capabilities: runtime/config provenance, compatibility and drift diagnostics, plus fail-closed controls for nine reviewed UI leaves.
description.zh: DSH Web 内置 capability 的 evidence-backed 检查器：展示运行/配置溯源、兼容性与漂移诊断，并仅为 9 个经过审阅的 UI leaf 提供 fail-closed 控制。

description.en: Web theme and file workspace plugin with global typography controls, @file mentions, a project file tree, Markdown preview, and a resizable side panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 主题与文件工作台：全局字体设置、@ 文件引用、项目文件树、Markdown 预览和可拖拽侧边面板。

description.en: AI interview practice for DeepSeek Harness Web: generates questions across four modes (concept review, mock interview, scenario, LeetCode Hot 100), scores answers, and provides explanations.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 AI 面试陪练：支持背八股、模拟面试、场景题与力扣热题 100 四种模式，自动评分、点评并讲解知识点。

description.en: Recall, edit-and-resend and regenerate, plus in-conversation versioning: a timeline of every rewind, artifact rollback (git-first, snapshot fallback), a fork map of explored paths, session lineage, and a real-time watchdog that snapshots the log at the first sign of concurrent writes. Edits auto-stop the running agent (official cancel/whenIdle) so rewinds never corrupt the durable log or break /compact.
description.zh: 撤回/编辑重发/重新生成，加上单会话版本化：每次回退的时间线、产物回退（git 优先、快照兜底）、分叉图、会话谱系，以及实时看门狗（并发写入第一时间快照日志）。编辑前自动停止运行中的 agent（官方 cancel/whenIdle），回退不会损坏持久化日志、也不会破坏 /compact。

description.en: Fan-made wallpaper plugin themed on the streamer Zhang Shunfei: full-screen high-definition rotating colorful pegasus GIF wallpaper with theme blending and prominence control, plus a Bilibili music player (add songs by pasting a link, delete, volume, seek, single/list/shuffle loop, and a sidebar mini player).
description.zh: 以网络主播张顺飞为主题的粉丝同人二创壁纸插件：彩色飞马高清旋转动图全屏壁纸，支持主题融合与突出度调节；附带 B站音乐播放器，可粘贴链接添加歌曲、删除、调音量、拖进度条、切换单曲/列表/随机循环，并有侧栏迷你播放器。

description.en: Model-autonomous context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: a mind_map tool surveys the agent context surface (stable seq ids, roles, token weights, clear-boundary markers, the clear-mind playbook), a clear_mind tool replaces a chosen conversation-history span with a model-written checkpoint through the native compaction transaction, call and result pairs self-collapse into one-line tombstones, and a proactive reminder nudges the model when the context grows long or a turn runs too many steps.
description.zh: 让模型自主压缩自身上下文的 dsh 插件：mind_map 工具俯瞰模型自己的上下文表面（稳定 seq、角色、token 重量、清理边界标记，返回内附清理手册），clear_mind 工具把选定的对话历史区间替换成模型自写的检查点（走平台原生 compaction 事务，GUI 渲染可展开的压缩行），调用对自动折叠成单行墓碑，上下文过长或单轮步数过多时主动提醒模型清理；人类侧会话记录保持原样、可审计可回退。

description.en: A persona and memory plugin for DSH Desktop. Distill characters from chats, novels, scripts, or character sheets; keep long-term and temporary memories, learn style corrections and approved replies, detect persona leakage after switching, visualize memories, and import or export persona cards. Task guidance is reduced to one lightweight fixed discipline with no plans, ledgers, or dynamic reminders.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 人设与记忆插件：从聊天记录、小说、剧本或设定文档蒸馏角色；支持长期与临时记忆、风格学习、认可语料、人设切换纠偏、记忆星图和角色卡导入导出。任务侧仅保留轻量工作纪律，不再注入计划、台账或动态提醒。

description.en: ACP adapter that drives DeepSeek Harness from Obsidian Agent Client (and other ACP clients): list, resume, fork and delete sessions, switch the model per session, preview a one-line summary, import external ACP sessions, and pull Obsidian Agent Client conversations into dsh native session storage. Requires DSH >= 0.1.5-rc.3.
description.zh: 在 Obsidian Agent Client（及其他 ACP 客户端）里驱动 DeepSeek Harness 的 ACP 适配器：会话 list / resume / fork / delete、按会话切换模型、一句话摘要预览、导入外部 ACP 会话，并可把 Obsidian 侧会话拉进 dsh 原生会话库。需 DSH >= 0.1.5-rc.3。

description.en: dsh Web UI admin plugin: eleven management panels (extensions, skills, MCP servers, subagents, commands, hooks, automation - cron / webhook / workflow, sessions & web search, usage dashboard, todo dock) inside the official dsh settings UI

Windows workspace pre-authorization: adds an explicit full-control DACL ACE (including WRITE_OWNER, required by dsh >=0.1.7 sandbox startup) to user-declared workspace directories, removing the repeated full-access escalation prompt. Grants only on explicit intent — new workspace records or paths added in the plugin settings page; system directories are hard-blocked. Windows only.
description.zh: Windows 工作区预授权：为用户显式声明的工作区目录补一条完全控制的 DACL 授权项（含 dsh ≥0.1.7 沙箱启动所需的 WRITE_OWNER），消除反复出现的完全访问升权弹框。仅在新增工作区记录或插件设置页手动添加路径时授权，系统目录硬拒绝。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Recurring loops: `/loop` command + loop tool + activity status bar.
description.zh: 定时循环：`/loop` 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条。

description.en: Voice tools: free edge-tts neural speech synthesis, OpenAI-compatible ASR transcription, voice list, batch voice preview and health self-check.
description.zh: 语音五工具：edge-tts 免费微软神经语音合成、OpenAI 兼容 ASR 转写、音色清单、批量音色试听与健康自检。

description.en: Claim-verification skill that checks design documents and plans against codebase facts, escalating behavioral claims to executable logic-primitive verification for state machines and data models, with before/after regression, domain constraints, and concurrency risk mining.
description.zh: 声称核查技能：将设计文档与计划中的每条声称对照代码库事实核验，行为类声称升级为状态机/数据模型逻辑原语验证，支持前后回归、领域约束与并发风险挖掘。

description.en: SSH profiles, browser terminals, SFTP browsing, port forwarding, proxies, and session-scoped AI access for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 配置、浏览器终端、SFTP 浏览、端口转发、代理与会话级 AI 访问。

description.en: Embedded MCP server letting external agents (Hermes, Claude Code, etc.) drive DeepSeek Harness over StreamableHTTP: sync/async task execution, a three-tier file sandbox, a Web-backed approval bridge, session management and search, and path-jailed file tools.
description.zh: 内嵌 MCP server，让外部 Agent（Hermes、Claude Code 等）通过 StreamableHTTP 驱动 DeepSeek Harness：同步/异步任务执行、三档文件沙箱、Web 审批桥、会话管理与搜索、路径隔离的文件工具。

description.en: Provides an OAuth account page for DSH Web, currently supporting OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Anthropic, Kimi For Coding, OpenRouter, and xAI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 OAuth 账号页面，目前支持 OpenAI Codex、GitHub Copilot、Anthropic、Kimi For Coding、OpenRouter 与 xAI。

description.en: Windows-only computer use for DeepSeek Harness: captures the virtual screen and drives mouse & keyboard through 9 tools built on PowerShell and Win32 SendInput; pairs with picturereader so text-only models can complete the screenshot-analyze-act-verify loop fully locally.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 的 DSH 电脑操作插件：以 PowerShell + Win32 SendInput 实现 9 个工具，截取虚拟屏幕并驱动鼠标键盘；配合 picturereader 让纯文本模型在本地完成「截图-分析-操作-验证」闭环。

description.en: Query the dshbase plugin directory from inside DeepSeek Harness — search, list, and get install commands for 1700+ plugins.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接搜索、浏览 dshbase 插件库，获取 1100+ 社区插件的安装命令，不用离开会话。

description.en: Spec-Driven Development pipeline for Odoo: 15 tools take a request from an immutable spec through architecture to module code or live configuration, then require a persisted verdict backed by evidence from a real Odoo instance, with fail-closed gates, human-approved batches in a declared environment, Odoo's own CSV/Excel importer, and a journal that reverses the data written through the plugin.
description.zh: 面向 Odoo 的规范驱动开发流水线：15 个工具把需求从不可变规范推进到架构、再到模块代码或线上配置，最终要求一个由真实 Odoo 实例证据支撑的持久判定；闸门 fail-closed，批量操作需在声明的环境中经人工批准，复用 Odoo 自带的 CSV／Excel 导入器，并有一份可回滚本插件所写数据的日志。

description.en: COM-driven real Microsoft Office automation for DeepSeek Harness: drives a running Excel/Word instance through OfficeMCP — VBA macros, pivot tables, live formula recalculation, and deep document layout; plus an accounting suite (double-entry journal posting with debit/credit balance check, and SUMIF general ledger).
description.zh: COM 驱动真实 Microsoft Office 实例的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：经 OfficeMCP 操作运行中的 Excel/Word——VBA 宏、透视表、活公式重算、文档深度排版；含会计场景（复式记账分录 + 借贷平衡校验、SUMIF 科目总账）。

description.en: AX-first macOS computer use for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility snapshots with stable refs, background input, Unicode typing, menus and apps, set-of-mark screenshots, on-device OCR and verified actions — 11 tools bridged to the macos-cu CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS computer use：基于无障碍树的稳定 ref 定位、后台输入、Unicode 输入、菜单与应用、set-of-mark 截图、本地 OCR 与动作校验——11 个工具桥接 macos-cu CLI。

description.en: ZCode-style persistent project memory with a full settings manager, index-first injection and agent memory tools.
description.zh: ZCode 风格持久化项目记忆：设置内完整管理页、索引式注入与 agent 记忆工具。

description.en: Dockable DSH Web UI layout that organizes conversations as tabs across draggable split groups.
description.zh: 可停靠的 DSH Web UI 布局插件，将对话组织为标签页，并支持拖拽拆分对话分组。

description.en: Starts your dsh web and other servers at boot, sets up and manages services like Gitea and Jellyfin just by asking, and puts them all under one home-hosted panel.
description.zh: 让 dsh web 与其他服务器随开机自动启动；只需一句提示就能搭建和管理 Gitea、Jellyfin 等服务，并统一收纳到一个 home-hosted 面板中。

description.en: Drives a locally installed Moli headless browser from DeepSeek Harness: rendered fetch, JavaScript evaluation, Markdown, semantic trees, screenshots and PDFs. A CSS selector returns one container rather than the whole page (measured 40-80x fewer tokens on listing pages) and scroll triggers lazy loading. Installs Moli when it is missing; verified with a real engine on Windows, Linux and macOS.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动本机安装的 Moli 无头浏览器：渲染抓取、JavaScript 求值、Markdown、语义树、截图与 PDF。用 CSS 选择器只取某个容器而不是整页（列表页实测省 40–80 倍 token），并支持滚动触发懒加载。Moli 缺失时自动安装；已在 Windows、Linux 与 macOS 上用真实引擎验证。

description.en: Multi-platform message gateway and WeCom AI bot bridge with session context compression and smartsheet creation.
description.zh: 多平台消息网关与企微智能机器人桥接：会话自动压缩持久化与智能表格一键创建。

description.en: Selectable SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Gemini Search Grounding, or Wikipedia backend for the native web_search tool, with Web settings and no implicit fallback.
description.zh: 为原生 web_search 工具提供可选的 SearXNG、Brave、Tavily、Gemini 搜索溯源或 Wikipedia 后端，支持 Web 设置且不进行隐式回退。

description.en: Install tab in Settings → Plugins: install, update and remove any plugin by npm spec, `github:user/repo` or local path through the same `dsh plugin add` CLI path; update checks against npm latest or GitHub HEAD with a downgrade guard and resolved-version verification, a pnpm 11 release-cooldown bypass on every add/remove, and service restart via the DSH Desktop shell or a relay process under standalone `dsh web`.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的「安装」标签页：按 npm spec、`github:user/repo` 或本地路径安装、更新、卸载任意插件，走的都是 `dsh plugin add` 这条 CLI 路径；更新检查对照 npm latest 或 GitHub HEAD，带降级保护与装后版本核对，每次 add/remove 均附带 pnpm 11 发布冷静期豁免；服务重启在 DSH Desktop 由壳层执行，独立 `dsh web` 下由中转进程接力并交接回原终端。

description.en: About section for the DeepSeek Harness settings: version info, npm latest/next update check with one-click install and auto-restart, and GitHub release history.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置中心增加「关于」分区：版本信息、npm 检查更新与一键安装（自动重启）、GitHub 版本更新记录。

description.en: An independent approval subagent judges every sandbox escalation, with a configurable model and an audit log.
description.zh: 由独立审批子代理裁决每次沙箱提权，可配置审批模型并带审计记录。

description.en: DSH environment diagnosis, graded repair with one-click rollback, and a runtime self-healing service.
description.zh: DSH 环境诊断、分级修复与一键回滚，附带运行时自愈服务。

description.en: Remote host tunnel manager: runs dsh web on a remote Linux server (systemd supervision, no root needed) behind an auto-reconnecting SSH tunnel; allocates and registers remote ports on the server, multi-user safe, with an audit view.
description.zh: 远程主机隧道管理器：把 dsh web 跑在远程 Linux 服务器上（systemd 守护、免 root），本地经自动重连的 SSH 隧道访问；远程端口自动分配并在服务器登记留档，支持多人共用与 audit 审查。

description.en: Matt Pocock's 25 skills fully translated to Chinese (technical terms kept in English with glosses).
description.zh: Matt Pocock 25 个技能正文全译中文（技术术语保留英文并附注释）。

description.en: Load Claude Code assets into DSH at runtime — skills, slash commands, rules, permission rules (deny/ask/allow), subagents and hooks from .claude/ plus Claude Code plugins (plugin.json / marketplace / skills / agents / MCP), via a memory-IR parse layer that keeps .claude as the source of truth with no writes back. Six installable packages: loader, skills, permissions, agents, hooks, mcp.
description.zh: 运行时把 Claude Code 全家桶原样加载进 DSH：.claude/ 的技能、斜杠命令、规则、权限（deny/ask/allow）、子代理与 hooks，以及 Claude Code 插件（plugin.json / marketplace / 技能 / 代理 / MCP）——内存 IR 解析层，.claude 始终是唯一事实来源，零回写。六个可安装包：loader、skills、permissions、agents、hooks、mcp。

description.en: Desktop BigFish companion for DSH: real-time balance, out-of-browser desktop Q&A, 7 custom animations, 53 meme lines.
description.zh: 桌面大肥鱼增强版桌宠：点击实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，浏览器外桌面问答，7 套专属动作，53 条玩梗。

description.en: DSH side of the dsh-ecolink memory ecosystem: bridges chat.deepseek.com and DeepSeek Harness through a browser extension that harvests DSM-format memory tags and injects recalled memories into web chats, a zero-dependency local service that writes a shared memory pool, and this adapter, which injects memories pre-step and offers /ecolink-push write-back; compression is transactional (staging pool with commit/rollback).
description.zh: dsh-ecolink 记忆生态的 dsh 侧组件：浏览器扩展收割 DSM 格式记忆标签并向网页对话注入回忆、零依赖本地服务写入共享记忆池、本 adapter 负责 pre-step 注入与 /ecolink-push 写回，共同打通 chat.deepseek.com 与 DSH；压缩为事务化双池（暂存提交/回滚）。

description.en: Codex-style left-gutter tick rail for each user turn, with hover preview and click-to-scroll.
description.zh: 对话区左侧 Codex 风格短横线锚点，悬停预览，点击跳转到对应轮次。

description.en: One-tap connect SenseNova Token Plan language and image models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. On a rate limit it backs off and retries on its own instead of misreading it as an exhausted quota. After signing in to the SenseNova console you can see the usage pill, credit pools and per-model consumption. Xiaohuanxiong can also be signed in by QR code, bringing in its models and their consumption multipliers, and taking over DSH web search.
description.zh: 一键接入商汤 Token Plan的语言、生图模型到 DSH（默认关），自动填入图片识别与思考强度；限频时自动退避重试，不会误判为额度耗尽；登录商汤控制台后，可查看用量胶囊、积分池、每模型消耗。也支持扫码登录小浣熊，接入其模型，查看模型消耗倍率，使用联网搜索。

description.en: Goal mode and autonomous execution plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a sticky top banner keeps the current goal visible across turns while the agent works toward it autonomously.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的目标模式与自主执行插件：顶部吸附横幅在每轮对话中保持当前目标可见，同时 Agent 自主推进完成目标。

description.en: Prompt enhancer for the DSH web UI with basic/standard/expert modes: standard/expert modes rewrite drafts with project context and recent session history, retry gracefully when gateways reject reasoning-effort settings, and show a before/after review with undo.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面提示词增强插件：基础/标准/专家三档模式，标准/专家模式结合项目上下文与最近会话历史重写草稿；网关拒绝推理档位参数时自动去参重试；增强结果支持对比确认与撤回。

description.en: Per-workspace Skill and MCP enablement for DeepSeek Harness: control which skills and MCP servers new sessions load, per project.
description.zh: 按工作区（工程）启停 Skill 与 MCP：每个项目单独控制新会话加载哪些技能与 MCP 工具。

description.en: One fixed button inside the DSH window that restarts DSH and reopens it automatically, with no console window; right-click it for a built-in self check that writes a single diagnostic report.
description.zh: DSH 窗口里的一个固定按钮，点一下就把 DSH 关掉并自动重开，全程没有控制台窗口；右键它还有内置自检，能生成一份自包含的诊断报告。

description.en: Personalization for the agent: a Web UI panel (about-you, reply style & tone, traits for headings/lists and emoji, output language, custom instructions) and `/soul` commands, with nickname/occupation/bio/style/traits/language compiled into a system prompt and re-injected into active sessions. Exposes `soulConfig` for other plugins and a `set_persona` tool the agent can call.
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供个性化设置：Web 设置栏目（关于你、回复风格和语调、标题与列表 / 表情符号特质、输出语言、自定义指令）与 `/soul` 命令；昵称 / 职业 / 介绍 / 风格 / 特质 / 语言编译进提示词并推送给所有活动会话。向其他插件暴露 `soulConfig` 服务，并注册 Agent 可调用的 `set_persona` 工具。

description.en: Runs work as a crew of role agents: a product manager writes the PRD or DoD, waits for your confirmation, then starts architect, engineer, QA and reviewers whose tool sets are locked per role, and shares work through files on disk.
description.zh: 以角色团队的方式干活：产品经理先写 PRD 或 DoD 并等你确认，再启动架构师、工程师、QA 与各类评审；每个角色的工具集按角色锁定，彼此通过磁盘文件协作。

description.en: One-click Figma MCP connector for DSH (DeepSeek Harness).
description.zh: DSH 的 Figma MCP 一键连接插件。

description.en: Local-first usage and cost meter for the DSH web UI: composer button with live session cost and balance; panel with a stacked per-model daily/7-day chart priced per effective list-price interval (official pricing page synced daily), monthly usage tiers with a canvas share card, 30/50/85% context-pressure warnings with one-click /compact, budget alerts, and an in-panel npm update check with one-click update.
description.zh: 本地优先的用量与费用仪表：输入框下方按钮显示实时费用与余额，面板含按模型堆叠的当日/近 7 天柱状图（按刊例价生效区间计价、官方定价页每日同步）、本月消耗段位与画布分享卡片、30/50/85% 上下文压力三档预警与一键 /compact、预算提醒，以及面板内 npm 检查更新与一键更新。

description.en: Fish DSH 插件聚合包：十个本仓库子包与独立 AgentTeams，共十一个 @fish-under-sea 成员，成员精确固定各自版本；破甲不内置，需单独安装。
A floating credit/quota widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web: shows DeepSeek / OpenCode Go balances and usage, and tracks DSH session token usage and estimated cost by day, month, and model.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 LLM 额度/用量悬浮窗：显示 DeepSeek / OpenCode Go 余额与套餐用量，并按日、月、模型统计 DSH 会话 token 用量与费用估算。

description.en: Search-first capability workflow for DSH agents (v1.0.0): reuse local tools or review exact-source plugins before installation, adapt or create capabilities in managed source work, and use receipts that distinguish installed, loaded, activated, and verified states; version tools cover rollback, adoption, and upstream updates.
description.zh: AutoEvo v1.0.0 为 DSH Agent 提供 Search-first 能力工作流：优先复用本地工具或审查精确来源插件后再安装；可在受管源码中改造或新建能力；回执区分 installed、loaded、activated、verified，版本工具支持回滚、领养与上游更新。

description.en: In-session question navigator for the DSH Web UI: a dot minimap on the conversation edge (left or right, configurable in settings), one dot per user question — hover shows the full question text, click jumps to it.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话内提问导航：对话栏左/右缘（可在设置中切换）的圆点迷你地图，一个圆点对应一个用户提问——悬停显示全文，点击跳转到该提问。

description.en: Caddy forward_auth administrator login for DeepSeek Harness Web, with Argon2id passwords, revocable sessions, bilingual UI, and a native sidebar sign-out action.
description.zh: 通过 Caddy forward_auth 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供管理员登录，含 Argon2id 口令、可撤销会话、中英界面和侧栏原生退出。

description.en: Agent-driven kanban board: one board per workspace, per-task agent sessions, and a guarded human/agent workflow (Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done).
description.zh: agent 驱动的看板：每个工作区一块看板、每个任务一个 agent 会话，以及带护栏的人机协作流程（Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done）。

description.en: Version management for dsh: inspect the installed version against every npm channel or version line, install or downgrade in one click, stream the install log live (rollback-snapshot copy progress, npm extraction progress, elapsed time), roll back instantly from local snapshots, and automate the cycle with a policy engine (silent auto-update, execution windows, daily checks). Never stops npm mid-install — a wedged run is only stopped after an hour, and a half-committed global tree is detected and repaired from the pre-install snapshot automatically. Confirms before installing a found update, auto-restarts the host after install, and falls back to a mirror when the primary registry is unreachable.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 版本管理：对照各 npm 通道或版本线查看已装版本，一键安装或降级，安装日志实时流出（回滚快照复制进度、npm 提取进度、已运行时长），从本地快照秒级回滚，用策略引擎（静默自动更新、执行时间窗、每日检查）托管整个流程。绝不在安装中途终止 npm——卡死的任务要等一小时才会停止，半提交的全局安装树会被自动检测并从安装前快照修复。检查到新版本时弹窗确认是否立即更新，安装后自动重启宿主，遇到 registry 不可达时自动回退到镜像。

description.en: Codex Appshots for DSH: capture the frontmost active window via global shortcut and seamlessly mount it into the composer for agent queries.
description.zh: DSH 版 Codex Appshots：全局快捷键精准捕获当前工作窗口，零摩擦挂载至 Composer 作为上下文向 Agent 提问。

description.en: Windows system and custom desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness events: task completed, failed, running, awaiting approval, and awaiting answer. Click-to-jump to the session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness事件的Windows系统和自定义桌面通知：任务已完成、失败、正在运行、等待批准和等待答复。单击以跳转到会话。

description.en: Evidence-driven goal verification plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Locks goals via /ultragoal and verifies completion against command exit codes and generated artifacts, preventing the model from falsely reporting task completion.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据驱动目标校验插件。通过 /ultragoal 锁定目标，并依据命令退出码与生成产物验证完成状态，防止模型虚报任务完成。

description.en: WeChat official account AI writing pipeline: six-step article runs (topic, outline, draft, gates, render, images) with a launch brief contract, a hot-topic board with per-item AI digests, RRULE scheduling to the draft box, a workbench UI plus chat tools and a /wewrite command, and fail-closed host approval before any draft-box push.
description.zh: 公众号 AI 写作管线：六步成文（选题、大纲、成稿、门禁、渲染、配图）+ 启动 brief 合同、热榜逐条 AI 速览、RRULE 定时推草稿箱、写作台与对话工具（/wewrite 命令与 @ 引用），推送草稿箱前经宿主审批 fail-closed 确认。

description.en: Floating card showing your real position P&L (今日盈亏), Shanghai Composite Index, and intraday chart, auto-synced from the Tonghuashun investment-ledger — no manual watchlist setup.
description.zh: 悬浮卡片，自动同步同花顺投资账本的真实持仓盈亏，显示今日盈亏、上证指数和当日走势图，无需手动添加股票。

description.en: Deterministic project actions shared by people and agents: one actions.json, a right-sidebar run panel, and agent tools.
description.zh: 人与 Agent 共用的确定性项目任务：一份 actions.json，右侧栏运行面板与 Agent 工具双入口。

description.en: DSH updater + official docs sync in Settings: one-click npm update of @deepseek-ai/dsh with live progress (npm output stream, elapsed timer, monotonic bar), multi-copy protection that only touches the running instance, source-tree mode via git pull, one-click PowerShell 7 install on Windows, incremental sync of the official docs/ with progress, and the dsh_docs_search / dsh_docs_read model tools.
description.zh: 设置页内的 DSH 更新器 + 官方文档同步器：一键以 npm 全局更新 @deepseek-ai/dsh 并带实时进度（npm 输出流、已运行计时、单调进度条），多副本保护只更新当前运行实例，源码树模式走 git pull；Windows 缺 PowerShell 7 时可一键安装；官方 docs/ 增量同步（按 blob sha 跳过未变文件）带进度条，并提供 dsh_docs_search / dsh_docs_read 模型工具。

description.en: Cross-session archive: overview workbench, folded timeline, subagent lineage, full-text search, rule+LLM summaries, ZIP export, live tracking. Native session-page embeds: turn rail, docked right panel (live mode, pinned to original session on switch), rename (official-synced), conclusion digest, health monitoring + persistent header chip (idle / active / tool-wait / stalled). dsh v0.1.2+: fuses with the official TurnNavigatorRail — vector-icon info chips (duration, tool calls, errors, thinking) plus lazy tool distribution inside the official preview card, right-click opens the workbench; the classic piano-key strip is on by default and delegates unloaded-turn jumps to the official auto-load engine; the official rail can be hidden entirely. Settings dialog section with 10 tunable behavior params.
description.zh: 跨会话档案柜：总览工作台、折叠时间线、子代理血缘、全文检索、双模式摘要、ZIP 导出、实时跟踪。会话流标签页嵌入原生会话页：轮次悬浮条、详情并入右栏（实时模式，切换会话可钉住原会话直播）、会话重命名（对齐官方即时同步）、结论摘要行、健康监控与常驻头部胶囊（空闲 / 活跃 / 工具执行 / 疑似卡死四态）。dsh v0.1.2+ 与官方轮次导航融合：官方预览卡内嵌矢量图标信息段（耗时 / 工具调用 / 错误 / 思考 + 工具分布懒加载），右键唤起会话流工作台；经典钢琴键悬浮条默认开启并存，点击未载入轮次委托官方引擎自动加载跳转；可设置隐藏官方导航只留钢琴键。设置弹窗独立分节，10 项行为参数可调。

description.en: Multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面里并排运行、监控多个对话实例：多窗口墙 + 自动发现 + 单窗控制，内置带口令认证的局域网网关，手机/平板也能看。

description.en: GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider - routes ctx.web search through Zhipu's Anthropic-compatible endpoint with the native web_search server tool, billing your existing GLM quota or Coding Plan instead of the DeepSeek platform. Includes a translation layer for Zhipu's non-standard tool_result response layout.
description.zh: GLM(智谱)网页搜索 provider——把 web_search 后端切到智谱 Anthropic 兼容端点的服务端搜索工具,直接复用你现有的 GLM 额度或 Coding Plan,替代 DeepSeek 官方搜索通道,并内置智谱私有响应格式的翻译层。

description.en: DeepTutor tutoring bridge: deep explanations, self-test questions, learning-path planning, personal knowledge-base search (RAG), and note archiving via deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note tools.
description.zh: DeepTutor 学习辅导桥接插件：通过 deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note 工具为 agent 接入深度讲解、自测题、学习路径规划、个人知识库检索（RAG）与笔记归档。

description.en: Serves the live opencode Go model catalog from the harness's built-in opencode-go provider route.
description.zh: 让 DSH 自带的 opencode-go 供应商跟随 opencode Go 套餐的实时模型列表，opencode 上架新模型后无需改配置即可使用。

description.en: Shows a card in the sidebar footer with the DeepSeek account balance (read from the official /user/balance endpoint with the API key DSH already stores) and the unit prices of the active model — input, cache read and output — taken from a built-in snapshot of the official price table. A dot marks the current billing window and a countdown shows the time left until it flips: peak is Mon–Fri 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing Time, excluding Chinese public holidays, and everything else is off-peak. Prices and the dot appear only for official DeepSeek models; for any other model the card shows the balance alone. The card refreshes every 30 seconds, on click, and when the model changes, and follows the app theme and the DSH language.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示一张卡片：DeepSeek 账号余额（用 DSH 已保存的 API Key 调官方 /user/balance 接口获取），以及当前模型的档单价——输入、缓存读取、输出——取自内置的官方价格表快照。一个圆点标出当前计费时段，旁边是距离切换的倒计时：高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日），其余为空闲时段。档单价与圆点只对 DeepSeek 官方模型显示，其他模型只显示余额。卡片每 30 秒刷新一次，点击或切换模型时立即刷新，并跟随应用主题与 DSH 语言。

description.en: Map and routing tools: driving/transit/walking/bicycling route planning, geocoding and POI search via free OSM/OSRM data by default, with an optional Amap (高德) key for better China coverage.
description.zh: 地图与路径规划工具：驾车/公交/步行/骑行路线、地理编码与 POI 搜索。默认零 key 使用 OSM/OSRM 免费数据，可选配置高德 key 获得更优的国内覆盖。

description.en: Web chat entry for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar button opening chat.deepseek.com in a dedicated desktop window under dsh-desktop, with in-webview fallback for plain web environments.
description.zh: 网页对话入口插件：侧边栏一键打开 chat.deepseek.com 独立窗口（dsh-desktop 桥接），纯网页环境自动回退内嵌打开。

description.en: TickTick (Dida365) task bridge: a session-header task panel and curated agent tools over the official TickTick MCP endpoint.
description.zh: TickTick（滴答清单）任务桥：会话页头部任务面板与精选代理工具，走官方 TickTick MCP 端点。

description.en: Codex Pets-style floating pixel pet with 10 built-in Petdex-compatible pets, a 9-state agent-status engine (idle/running/waiting/review/failed plus client-side waving/jumping/directions), draggable overlay, pet picker/zoom settings, notification bubbles, and a `pet_say` tool for the agent to speak through the pet.
description.zh: Codex Pets 风格浮动像素桌宠：内置 10 只 Petdex 兼容宝可梦伙伴，9 状态 agent 状态机（空闲/思考/等待/审查/出错 + 客户端挥手/跳跃/方向动画），可拖拽悬浮、宠物切换与缩放设置、通知气泡，以及 agent 可用的 `pet_say` 工具。

description.en: Theme plugin — supports dark/light appearance switching, ships 34 preset themes, and supports creating, sharing, and importing custom themes.
description.zh: 主题插件 —— 支持深色/浅色外观切换，提供 34 款预设主题，支持创建/分享/导入自定义主题。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 VRM 3D 桌宠插件：任务状态联动、独立悬浮窗、模型动作、部位互动与 AI 碎碎念。
description.zh: 支持任务状态联动动画、独立悬浮窗、部位互动和可选 AI 碎碎念的 VRM 3D 桌宠。

description.en: DSH 插件市场 — DeepSeek Harness 设置内一键安装社区插件，并提供公开目录站（浏览 / 复制安装命令）
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里逛社区插件，看中哪个一键装，还能上网站浏览目录。

description.en: DSH Web 客户端的 Codex 风格「思考强度」电源滑块 —— 拖一下就切换会话的真实推理强度；紫色扫描、漂浮星尘、拖柄墨点全部手写，零构建零依赖。
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 界面加一条 Codex 风格电源滑杆，拖一下就能直接切换会话的真实推理强度，不用再翻菜单。

description.en: Visual annotation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: select elements in local app previews and send structured UI feedback to your agent.
description.zh: 在本地应用预览里直接圈选界面元素，把结构化的 UI 反馈发给 AI 助手，改起来更准。

description.en: 把 WebUI 会话流中连续相邻的同工具调用合并为「主卡片+紧凑子行」树状展示，默认覆盖所有内置通用行工具 | Merges consecutive same-tool calls in the WebUI chat flow into a main-card + compact-child-rows tree view, all built-in generic tools by default
description.zh: Merge consecutive same-tool calls in the DSH WebUI chat flow into one card with compact child rows (all built-in tools by default).

description.en: 基于原版 DSH 扩展，提供项目层、用户层更完整 MCP 管理 || Extended from the original DSH code, providing more complete MCP management at both project and user levels
description.zh: 在项目里写个 mcp.yml 或 mcp.json，MCP 服务就自动挂载，项目和用户层都能统一管理。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness to 3Chat via OAuth for customer and conversation search, context retrieval, confirmed messaging, and batch-send tracking.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 3Chat，查询客户与会话、读取沟通上下文、确认后发送消息并跟踪批次进度。

description.en: Connects existing IndexTTS 2.5 and GPT-SoVITS installations for sentence-level assistant reading in Harness web, with local process launch and playback controls.
description.zh: 连接已有的 IndexTTS 2.5 和 GPT-SoVITS 安装，为 Harness 网页版回复提供逐句朗读、本地进程启动和播放控制。

description.en: Kilo Gateway free models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 在 DSH 里免密钥直接用 Kilo Gateway 和 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型，省去配置麻烦。

description.en: 一个dsh的终端样式插件，灵感来自Oh My Pi

description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上持久记忆，自动记住重要信息并在对话时按预算装回上下文。

description.en: Codex-style context window auto-management for DeepSeek Harness: a lossless rollover engine with zero summarization model calls, task-oriented handoff anchors, working notes that survive compaction, verbatim recall of archived windows, and a stale-notes gate that downgrades to an explicit warning instead of vouching for outdated notes. One-click composer button plus /smart-compact command, three-band automatic rollover, mandatory anchor sanitization; works out of the box with zero configuration.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 式上下文窗口自动管理：零模型调用的无损换窗引擎，交接锚点任务定向、工作笔记跨压缩存活、归档内容逐字回查，笔记滞后自动 STALE 警示；一键换窗按钮与 /smart-compact 人工命令，三带自动换窗阈值可配，锚点强制脱敏，开箱即用零配置。

description.en: FEMO插件版 — 可接入dsh的多智能体引擎，差不多能做所有事：我已经用femo和我的主agent玩了好几局狼人杀了，他抽到狼他还刀我！ 我在b站的宣传视频也是用femo剪的。 coding的时候，特别难找的bug、代码重构，我都会用femo来做。 我甚至用femo模式给我的主agent养了只宠物，她很开心。
description.zh: 接入 DSH 的多智能体引擎，能陪你玩狼人杀、剪视频、查 Bug、重构代码，还能给主 Agent 养宠物。

description.en: A visual Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness Web—inspect repositories, run common Git actions, and safely execute AI-generated workflows.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 里可视化查看 Git 历史和改动，点几下就能完成常用 Git 操作。

description.en: Evidence-backed ML phase gates, live visualization, and portable project bootstrap for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给机器学习项目加证据化阶段门禁，实时可视化流程，还能一键搭好可移植的项目骨架。

description.en: Modular execution discipline and autonomous steward for DSH: evidence-first routing across 44 canonical skills, durable state planning, verification gates, fail-streak recovery, and interactive web dashboard.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的模块化执行纪律与自主管家：覆盖 44 项规范技能的循证路由、持久化状态规划、验证门禁、失败恢复与交互式 Web 看板。

description.en: 把 DSH Web 左侧栏的「工作区」重做为文件系统树双模式。核心原则： 工作区 = 目录强绑定——会话的 cwd 就是它所在的目录，环境真正隔离。
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏工作区改成文件系统树，会话与目录强绑定，环境真正隔离。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for controlling ComfyUI queues, history, outputs, models, uploads, and generation.
description.zh: 让 AI 助手直接操控本机或远程的多个 ComfyUI，查队列、看产出、传图、跑工作流。

description.en: Raises Node's HTTP headers/body timeouts for the whole DSH process (default 30 min, proxy-aware) so Ollama and LM Studio models that stay silent while thinking or generating a large tool call are not cut off at 5 minutes; replaces the node_modules undici patch.
description.zh: 全局调高 Node 的 HTTP 超时时间，避免慢速本地模型（如 Ollama、LM Studio）因静默超 5 分钟被中断。

description.en: Xiaomi MiMo search + multimodal tools for DeepSeek Harness agents: mimo_search/vision/audio/video/asr/tts
description.zh: 把小米 MiMo 的搜索、看图听音、语音转写和配音能力接进 DSH 智能体，让它能搜能看能听能说。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugins market｜DSH 插件市场
Local-first failure evidence capsules for DeepSeek Harness sessions
description.zh: 把失败的 Agent 会话整理成脱敏可审阅的证据 ZIP，本地保存方便排查复盘

description.en: Interactive multi-agent collaboration, meetings, group chats, and task execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把多个 AI 和真人拉进同一个群聊，边聊边干活，任务、方案和成果都能在控制台统一管理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 画图插件：侧边栏整页面板，写提示词即出图，Q版/正常两档画风，三引擎可选（免费 Pollinations / 硅基流动 Kolors / 任意 OpenAI 兼容）。A text-to-image panel plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在侧边栏写句提示词就能出图，Q版或正常画风，三个出图引擎随便挑。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web 鲸鱼娘桌宠插件：任务进展、会话费用、账户余额、峰谷调度与互动养成。

DSH Math Modeling Team Plugin Pack: 2 role agent presets (modeling-coding / paper) for DeepSeek Harness, multi-folder Git collaboration + vision sub-agent; includes a full run on 2023 CUMCM-C. ｜ DeepSeek Harness 数学建模团队插件包：2 套岗位Agent预设(建模编程+论文)、多文件夹协同+识图子代理，含2023国赛C题全流程跑通示例。
description.zh: 给数模竞赛队伍准备的双角色智能体插件包，建模编程和论文写作分工协作，还能多文件夹 Git 协同。

description.en: 以"零额外安装"为设计原则：仅凭一个官方插件与 Windows 原生机制，让 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 获得桌面 App 式的一键启动体验。
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 网页版变成桌面应用，一键启动，还带托盘、原生通知和关窗即退。

description.en: OpenCode Zen free model adapter for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — DeepSeek V4 Flash Free, Nemotron 3 Ultra Free, MiMo V2.5 Free, Big Pickle
description.zh: 帮你把 OpenCode Zen 的免费大模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，零成本就能用各种强力模型写代码。

description.en: 基于 MinerU 的 DeepSeek Harness 多模态文档解析插件：PDF/Word/PPT/Excel/HTML/图片 → 结构化 Markdown（免 Token 的 Agent 轻量解析 / 精准解析双 API 模式）
description.zh: 基于 MinerU 的多模态文档解析插件，可将 PDF、Word、PPT、图片等转为结构化 Markdown，支持轻量和精准双模式，省 Token 又高效。

description.en: 面向数学笔记的 DeepSeek Harness 助手，驻留在 Obsidian 右侧栏。可直接读写数学笔记，维护分层长期记忆（画像、主题、类型化记录、原始证据），按 Rethlas 风格证明工作流工作，内置个人定理索引与问题模板库，并能把关键想法捕捉到备忘录、主动提醒打磨。
Git-native AI learning OS with a GitLearnOS-exclusive DeepSeek Harness panel, targeted practice, local RAG, and learner-owned memory.
description.zh: 把Git变成你的AI学习管家，内置本地知识库问答和针对性练习，所有学习进度与记忆都由你个人掌控。

description.en: 将原作者 linshenkx 的 prompt-optimizer 移植到 DeepSeek Harness 的第三方插件（非官方）
description.zh: 把提示词一键优化成更清晰好用的版本，让 AI 回答更准更省心。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 多供应商额度监控插件：余额型 API 查询 + 限额型本地用量计量，侧边栏实时卡片 + 可视化配置。
description.zh: 在侧边栏实时盯着各家 AI 供应商的额度余额和用量，快超支时心里有数。

description.en: 梁文谷 DSH 插件：在 Web GUI 右上角显示当前算力错峰时段（已适配deepseek 2026.08.22 公布的最新峰谷收费政策，工作日 09:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00 为梁文峰，其余时间含整个周末为梁文谷），并实时倒计时当前时段剩余时间；谷期跨天计算，直达下一工作日 09:00。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面显示当前算力错峰时段（梁文峰/梁文谷），并实时倒计时剩余时间，帮你省钱。

description.en: Auditable vision and cross-platform Computer Use runtime for DeepSeek Harness — strict evidence, health-checked failover, original pixels, and Token accounting.
description.zh: Auditable vision and cross-platform Computer Use runtime for DeepSeek Harness with source-preserving evidence.

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) conversation rewind plugin - rewind to any user message, interrupt a running turn, hide the tail from chat view and model context, cancel freely before sending.
description.zh: 一键回退到任意用户消息，打断模型输出，隐藏对话尾部，发送前可自由取消。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多 IM 通道接入的网关插件：钉钉 / QQ / 个人微信，支持扫码绑定与流式回复。
description.zh: 把钉钉、QQ、微信接进 DeepSeek Harness，扫码绑定后就能在聊天里流式对话、审批工具。

description.en: Companion to the official DSH plugin manager: pre-install quality gate, environment diagnostics, marketplace, and upgrades.
description.zh: 给官方插件管理器加装安装前质量门、五层环境诊断、插件市场和批量升级，装插件更放心。

description.en: Pins every request to the native max-effort tier and adds a per-model/per-mode reasoning-depth panel with a 0-20 capability slider, isolated Velocity/Apex profiles, and offline reasoning toolboxes. Distributed as an obfuscated build; commercial use allowed, reverse engineering closed.
description.zh: 将每个请求固定到原生 max effort 档位，并提供按模型与模式隔离的推理深度面板：0-20 能力滑块、独立的迅流（Velocity）/极境（Apex）配置档与离线推理工具箱。以混淆构建交付，允许商用，禁止逆向。

description.en: compact reasoning and tool activity groups for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的推理过程、工具调用和图片压缩成紧凑分组，界面更清爽。

description.en: The single plugin you need for DSH — develop, audit, isolate, and future-proof DeepSeek Harness plugins.
description.zh: DSH 插件开发一站式工具，帮你开发、审查、隔离并持续优化 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: Floating notes for the dsh web GUI: keep commands, credentials and snippets at hand, insert any note into the composer, save any selection as a note
description.zh: 在 dsh web 界面里挂个浮动便签，随手存命令、密码和代码片段，一键插进输入框。

description.en: Supervises a local workbuddy2api gateway process and exposes its models as an LLM provider, reading context windows and reasoning efforts from the gateway's own model endpoint.
description.zh: 托管本地 workbuddy2api 网关进程，把它的模型注册为 dsh 的模型提供方，上下文窗口与思考档位均从网关自身的模型接口读取。

description.en: My DSH plugins
description.zh: 一条命令装完的 DSH 插件合集，重启即用，管余额用量、注入 Agent 规则、还能控浏览器。

description.en: A searchable, sortable model picker for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — provider groups, favorites, models.dev prices, context windows, live per-task token cost and a local-model filter. One-command install: dsh plugin add dsh-model-garden.
description.zh: 把模型选择变成可搜索排序的表格，还能看价格、上下文和实时花费。

description.en: A floating peak/off-peak tide card for DeepSeek Harness: i18n (en/zh/ru), local-time windows, session cost.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里挂一张悬浮潮汐卡片，按本地时间显示峰谷时段和会话花费，支持中英俄三语。

description.en: Cross-session agent-to-agent messaging.
description.zh: 跨会话 agent 间消息传递。

description.en: Auto Approve with Audit Agent
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加一个自动审批预设，每次操作前由独立子代理快速审核，省去手动点确认的麻烦。

description.en: Git-style conversation branching that mirrors how real programmers collaborate: a secretary root branch dispatches tasks to child branches with their own contexts, merging back only compressed summaries via squash or rebase; ships /branch commands, a branch tab, branch-to-branch messaging, and a governance baseline pairing each session branch with a git worktree.
description.zh: Git 式会话分支，模拟真实程序员协作的并行开发：根分支充当秘书维持调度，子分支持有各自上下文并行工作，任务完成后仅以压缩摘要 squash/rebase 合并回来；提供 /branch 命令、分支页签、send_message_by_branch 跨分支消息，并附一份把会话分支绑定到 git worktree 的治理基线。

description.en: Adds a workspace-write++ permission that keeps file tools inside the workspace while skipping the Windows process sandbox for wildcard-allowlisted executables such as Git Bash.
description.zh: 增加工作区修改++权限档，文件工具仍锁在工作区，可用通配符放行 Git Bash 等程序以跳过 Windows 进程沙箱。

description.en: Project mode plugin for DSH Web GUI: sidebar entry, full-screen project manager, live per-project context injection (instructions + refreshable memory), session badge
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页版加个「项目模式」，把会话归到项目里，共享指令和记忆实时生效。

description.en: 一个dsh的终端样式插件，灵感来自Oh My Pi
description.zh: 把 dsh 的终端界面换成 Oh My Pi 风格，操作更顺手、看着更舒服。

description.en: a simple plugin to improve web UX/UI for "Deepseek Harness (dsh)"
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 优化侧边栏界面，提升浏览和操作体验，让工作区更清爽顺手。

description.en: Financial quantitative workbench and stock ticker: floating ball and drawer panel, real-time A/HK/US/global market quotes, multi-period K-lines and 5-day intraday charts, depth order book, capital flow, sector heat map, and AI investment research.
description.zh: 全景金融量化工作台与股票盯盘：悬浮球与抽屉面板、A/港/美/全球指数实时行情、多周期K线与5日分时、五档盘口、资金流向、板块热点榜与AI投研诊断。

description.en: Interactive whale-girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: live balance/usage/context occupancy, slingshot toss, easter-egg bubbles, eco mode. 346KB package, zero extra processes.
description.zh: 会卖萌、会记账、会弹跳的鲸鱼娘桌宠：实时余额/用量/上下文占用、中键弹弓抛掷、彩蛋气泡、省电模式；安装包 346KB，零新进程。

description.en: Self-healing Cloudflare quick-tunnel pool for the dsh web GUI: floating widget with QR phone access, generational rotation, chase service worker and prompt-free credential handoff.
description.zh: 为 dsh web GUI 提供自愈式 Cloudflare 快速隧道池：浮窗控件、扫码手机访问、代际轮换、追踪 Service Worker，免提示凭据交接。

description.en: MySQL connector for DeepSeek Harness: configure multiple connections in the settings page with per-connection table allowlist and write permission, switch the active connection from the composer, and expose mysql_query / mysql_tables / mysql_execute tools to every agent preset.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MySQL 连接插件：在设置页配置多套连接（每连接可配表白名单与写权限），输入栏一键切换当前会话的连接，并为所有 Agent 预设提供 mysql_query / mysql_tables / mysql_execute 工具。

description.en: Host-side unattended job scheduler: runs one-shot agent tasks or shell commands on cron, interval, or one-time schedules, with persisted at-most-once dispatch state, overlap/misfire policies, and bounded run history.
description.zh: 宿主侧无人值守定时任务：按 cron 表达式、固定间隔或一次性时点运行一次性 agent 任务或 shell 命令，调度状态持久化（至多一次语义），支持重叠/错过策略与有界运行历史。

description.en: Control a HarmonyOS phone from the DSH web UI with AI: live H.264 screen mirroring, mouse touch and system keys, hilog streaming, and agentic tools that let the model read the screen, locate UI controls, then tap, long-press, press keys, or type.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页中用 AI 操控鸿蒙手机：实时 H.264 投屏、触控与系统按键、hilog 日志，并让模型读屏、定位 UI 控件，再执行点击/长按/按键/输入。

description.en: AI can write resume text, but templates may still look wrong, pages may overflow, whitespace may remain, and small edits can destabilize the layout. dsh-resume provides an end-to-end DSH workflow for truthful content refinement, template selection, A4 layout tuning, visual review, and tailored resume versions for different job-search scenarios.
description.zh: AI 写简历容易，但写完常会遇到模板不合适、排版溢出、页面留白过多，以及改一处导致全局变形等问题。dsh-resume 专注解决手动修改简历繁琐、低效的问题，让 DSH 覆盖从内容撰写、模板选择到排版调优的完整简历工作流，并支持针对不同求职场景产出合适的简历版本。

description.en: 🐳 蓝色大肥鱼 · DeepSeek 虎鲸 3D 桌宠插件 — 由 DeepSeek 虎鲸 logo 轮廓重建，悬浮于 Web GUI 角落：拖拽旋转、360° 转圈、爱心互动、悬停工具栏、大小/灵敏度/文字设置，配置本地持久化 / A 3D whale desktop pet rebuilt from the DeepSeek whale logo for DeepSeek Harness — drag to rotate, 360° spin, heart bursts, hover toolbar, size/sensitivity/caption settings, and local persistence.
description.zh: mmzm0808/dsh-ventus-whale 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: use your OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT Plus/Pro) subscription through OAuth
Lark/飞书（Feishu）渠道插件，为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 提供飞书通信能力
Adds a local-only six-seat Texas Hold'em table to the DSH Web UI with full betting streets, side pots, persistent Token stacks, and agent-status display.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中加入本地六人桌德州扑克，支持完整下注轮次、边池结算、Token 筹码持久化与 Agent 状态显示。

description.en: DSH Web UI 右侧小游戏面板：18 款离线小游戏（恐龙跳一跳 / 俄罗斯方块 / 坦克大战 / 扫雷 / 2048 / 数独 / 吃豆人 / 跟枪练习等），可扩展游戏注册表，等待模型回复或修 bug 时的摸鱼神器
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面右侧挂个可拖动的小游戏面板，内置 18 款离线小游戏，等模型回复时摸鱼解闷。

description.en: A visible Chrome window per DSH session: 16 chrome_* tools (open/status/close/navigate/tabs/snapshot/screenshot/click/click_at/fill/type/press_key/hover/scroll/evaluate/wait), a Chrome tab in the Web GUI with a live screencast view (screenshot-heartbeat fallback for idle pages), tab management, window controls and a screenshot history.
description.zh: 每个 DSH 会话一个可见的 Chrome 窗口：16 个 chrome_* 工具（打开/状态/关闭/导航/标签/快照/截图/点击/坐标点击/填写/输入/按键/悬停/滚动/执行脚本/等待），Web GUI 的 Chrome 标签页提供实时画面流（静止页截图心跳兜底）、标签页管理、窗口控制与截图历史。

description.en: DSH 插件 UI 调试神器：让 AI 在真实 Chrome 中帮你看界面、点按钮、拖组件，一键安装零配置
description.zh: 让 AI 在真实 Chrome 里帮你看界面、点按钮、拖组件，调试 UI 一键搞定，装完就能用。

description.en: Stable, editable PPTX generation for AI agents — semantic IR in, native DrawingML out. DSH plugin + Claude Code plugin + CLI. | 给 AI agent 的稳定可编辑 PPTX 生成：语义 IR 进，原生 DrawingML 出。DSH 插件 / Claude Code 插件 / CLI。
Deepseek Harness 宠物插件
Mobile shell UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness web: overlay drawer, full-width conversation, settings sheet, marketplace with hot-load installs.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 网页版在手机上也能顺手用，窄屏自动切换抽屉导航和全宽会话，还能装插件、调参数。

description.en: CC Switch-style token consumption statistics for the dsh web GUI: per-request usage log, real-consumption hero, request-time-bucketed trend chart, per-model peak/off-peak list pricing, per-project and per-model stats, and account balance.
description.zh: dsh 网页端 CC Switch 风格 Token 消耗统计：按请求的用量日志、真实消耗 Hero、按请求提交时间分桶的趋势图、按模型峰谷牌价计费、项目/模型统计与账户余额。

description.en: Session-based task board in the sidebar: drag sessions into todo/doing/review/done columns, create sessions with model and reasoning-effort selection, trash with restore, notes, export/import.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话化任务看板：拖拽会话到待办/进行中/评审中/已完成四列，新建会话可选模型与推理强度，回收站可恢复，支持备注与导出导入。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏用量与成本面板：官方峰谷计价 · 1M 上下文 · 词勋段位 · 成就与热力图
description.zh: dsh client bundle: a sidebar usage & cost dashboard — token stats, peak/off-peak aware per-model pricing, membership ladder, achievements and a daily heatmap.

description.en: Question-Driven Discovery research workflow for DeepSeek Harness with a QDD Agent Preset, durable Human and Auto runs, and an auditable research panel.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Question-Driven Discovery 科研工作流，提供 QDD Agent Preset、持久化 Human 和 Auto 运行，以及可审计的研究面板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 凭证加密插件，通过设置密码使用AES-256-GCM+SHA3-256实现的全流程加密+校验，运行时临时解密，内存安全。
description.zh: WebUI-managed encrypted credentials for DeepSeek Harness: one file, plaintext until a password is set, then AES-256-GCM ciphertext under an Argon2id-derived key with SHA3-256 fingerprints; per-request decryption, unlock lockout, leak-guard output redaction, and shipped-code integrity self-checks.

description.en: ChatGPT Codex subscription chat: official OAuth, a Sol/Terra/Luna catalog with Fast rows, live usage limits, and optional search and view_image tools.
description.zh: ChatGPT Codex 订阅聊天：官方 OAuth 登录，Sol/Terra/Luna 目录含 Fast 行，实时额度，以及可选的搜索与 view_image 工具。

description.en: Cron scheduler with a sidebar UI: run shell, Python or Node scripts, skills, or agent tasks on a schedule, with push notifications and session archiving.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：侧栏管理界面，按 cron 表达式或间隔执行脚本、技能与 Agent 任务，支持完成后推送通知与会话归档。

description.en: Multi-channel push for DeepSeek Harness: Server酱, PushPlus, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, Feishu, ntfy, custom webhooks and more, configurable from the settings panel and callable by other plugins via the pushNotifier service.
description.zh: DSH 多渠道消息推送插件：支持 Server酱、PushPlus、Bark、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram、飞书、ntfy、自定义 Webhook 等，可在设置面板配置多个渠道，并通过 pushNotifier 服务供其他插件调用。

description.en: Configurable DSH usage statistics: a sidebar text/card widget plus a detail dialog with per-provider and per-model breakdowns, cache-hit rates, token trends, and latency details (TTFT and duration).
description.zh: 高度可配置的 DSH 用量统计插件：侧边栏文字/卡片组件加统计弹窗，提供按提供方与按模型的请求/Token 统计、缓存命中率、趋势图与首字节/总耗时明细。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DSH Web UI: reopen an archived session and keep chatting, unarchive it back in place, or hard-delete a session — grouped panel with message search and native view sync.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的归档会话管理器：重新打开已归档会话并继续对话、取消归档恢复原位、彻底删除会话，支持分组浏览、消息搜索与原生视图同步。

description.en: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观。
description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观。

description.en: Codex-style conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness Web: a right-edge rail with hover preview and click-to-jump
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页右侧生成对话大纲，悬停预览、点击跳转，快速定位历史消息。

description.en: Turn the official DeepSeek Harness WebUI into a natural desktop experience.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 官方网页版变成像原生桌面软件一样好用，开箱即用。

description.en: Adversarial checkup → fix → review loop toolset.
description.zh: 发现问题→修复交付→质量复查的对抗式闭环工具集。

description.en: 一个只有副作用的DeepSeekHarness插件：在你跟 AI 聊得神魂颠倒时，提醒你「该去跟碳基生命开会了」。
description.zh: 飞书会议提醒：一个只有副作用的 dsh-plugin，在你跟 AI 聊得神魂颠倒时提醒你「不得不去跟碳基生命开会了」。

description.en: A corner HUD for DeepSeek Harness that shows your session's token pressure, per-model cost, and daily/monthly usage at a glance, with an editable budget and balance that tracks spending for you. 右下角常驻的 Token 仪表盘：实时看会话压力、按模型估算花费。预算和余额点一下就能改，每天每月用了多少都有记录。
description.zh: 实时监控 Token 消耗的 HUD 插件，帮你掌握用量、估算成本、查看历史曲线和每日统计。

description.en: DeepSeek API balance and 24-hour usage dashboard in Settings, with estimated spend, token counts, request counts, and an hourly timeline.
description.zh: 在设置页展示 DeepSeek API 余额与最近 24 小时用量，包括估算消费、Token、请求次数和按小时时间线。

description.en: Biomimetic memory system for DeepSeek Harness: a single SQLite store (node:sqlite, WAL) whose Markdown tree is kept as a read-only mirror; memory tools, frozen-snapshot injection at session start, graded approval gating, on-demand extraction of the current session, near-duplicate merging, an archive and supersede lifecycle, memory metabolism (dream), memory pins, semantic recall over local embeddings, and the /memory command.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的生物仿生记忆系统：以单一 SQLite 库为唯一事实来源（node:sqlite，WAL），Markdown 树仅作只读镜像；含 memory 工具、会话启动时的冻结快照注入、分级审批门、按需把当前会话抽取成记忆、近重复合并、归档与取代生命周期、记忆代谢（dream）、记忆钉、基于本地嵌入的语义检索，以及 /memory 命令。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 小游戏制作插件 — 帮助 AI 快速创建 HTML5 小游戏，支持 Canvas、Phaser.js、Three.js 等引擎
description.zh: 帮 AI 快速做出 HTML5 小游戏，内置 Canvas、Phaser.js、Three.js 等常用引擎。

description.en: Piano-key style conversation navigation bar for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI
description.zh: 钢琴键风格会话内导航条：一根键锚定一条用户消息，悬停显示消息预览气泡与阶梯展开，点击平滑跳转。

description.en: DSH 插件：OpenCode Go 额度圆环 —— 输入框模型选择器左侧的进度圆环，点击切换 5小时/每周/每月用量（OpenCode Go quota ring for DeepSeek Harness Web）
description.zh: 模型选择器左侧的 OpenCode Go 额度圆环：点击循环切换 5 小时/每周/每月用量窗口，按紧急程度着色（绿/蓝/橙/红），悬停显示百分比与重置倒计时。

description.en: Perlica (Arknights: Endfield) themed tiered sound notifications: plan-ready, task-done, needs-your-input, and error tones; silent for plain chat, system-level playback (works in background), cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), custom TTS sounds.
description.zh: 明日方舟终末地佩丽卡主题分级提示音：计划出方案 / 任务完成 / 需要你回应 / 出错四档独立音效，普通问答保持安静；系统级播放（窗口在后台也响），跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），支持自定义 TTS 语音。

description.en: Codex-style diff review inside DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Codex-style diff review for DeepSeek Harness: review every uncommitted change of the current project (staged, unstaged and untracked), inspect per-file unified diffs, and accept (stage) or revert (discard) changes — one file at a time or all at once.

description.en: On-demand vision for text-only DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sessions: images become markers, and a vision_describe tool sends only image + question to an OpenAI-compatible vision model
description.zh: 给纯文本的 DeepSeek Harness 会话按需加视觉能力，图片变标记，需要时再调用视觉模型识别。

description.en: Remote access for the DSH Web GUI: LAN QR access, cloudflared quick tunnels, and frp reverse proxying via your own server, with a built-in auth portal.
description.zh: Web GUI 远程访问：局域网二维码直连、cloudflared 快速隧道、frp 自有服务器反代，内置登录门户，并放行设置接口。

description.en: API key rotation pool for your LLM providers: auto-discovers providers from settings, per-provider multi-key round-robin, failover on 401/403/429, and cooldown recovery.
description.zh: 对话模型 API Key 轮换池：自动检测 settings 中的厂商，每个厂商下多 Key 轮询，401/403/429 自动切换，冷却恢复。

description.en: Archived-session management: browse archived sessions, unarchive them, or clear them out.
description.zh: 归档会话管理：浏览已归档会话，支持恢复（取消归档）与清空。

description.en: AtomGit plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): atomgit-skills workflows + ag CLI + platform-hosted AtomGit/GitCode MCP tools
description.zh: AtomGit 插件包：内置六个 AtomGit 技能（Issue 规划、Issue 实现、PR 审查、PR 合并、CLI 版本发布、GitHub 镜像），并集成 ag CLI 与平台托管的 MCP 工具（仓库/分支/Issue/PR/搜索）。

description.en: 在开发页面点击任意 UI 元素，一键定位 Vue / React / Svelte / Angular 源码。DSH 点击定位源码检查器，兼容 dsh-better-sidebar：预览本地 dev server，点击元素，源码直达 DSH 聊天，交给助手微调。Click a UI element in your dev page to jump to its Vue / React / Svelte / Angular source in the DSH chat. DeepSeek Harness click-to-source inspector, dsh-better-sidebar compatible.
description.zh: 在开发页面点任意UI元素，一键跳转Vue/React等源码，并直达DSH聊天让助手帮你改代码。

description.en: Visual GitHub login without a terminal: in-window device flow, token synced into the gh CLI, and host status/launch endpoints.
description.zh: 零终端的 GitHub 可视化登录插件：窗口内完成设备码授权，令牌同步进 gh CLI，附宿主端状态与唤起接口。

description.en: A visual multi-agent workspace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区里的子 Agent 变成可视化办公室，实时查看状态、屏幕和操作，轻松管理多 Agent 协作。

description.en: DSH 会话选区引用与锚点批注插件：选中文字 → 批注 → 引用锚点 chip（点击跳回原文、悬停显示原文）。Contextual selection & anchored annotation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH 会话选区引用与锚点批注插件：选中文字 → 批注 → 引用锚点 chip（点击跳回原文、悬停显示原文）。Contextual selection & anchored annotation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: Delete sessions from a running web runtime: live store, workspace records, and on-disk artifacts (no restart needed).
description.zh: 无需重启即可清理运行中 DeepSeek Harness 的会话数据，包括文件、存储和记录，方便管理。

description.en: Codex-style desktop pet: a floating animated sprite in the corner that mirrors the agent's running state (working, waiting, failed, done).
description.zh: Codex 风格桌面宠物：右下角悬浮动画精灵，随 agent 运行状态实时变化（工作、等待、报错、完成）。

description.en: 归档对话查看 (archived-conversation-viewer)：在 DSH 设置页查看、恢复与删除归档会话的 Cordis 插件
description.zh: 归档对话查看 (archived-conversation-viewer)：在 DSH 设置页查看、恢复与删除归档会话的 Cordis 插件

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 账户余额 + 会话费用（/balance /cost 命令、deepseek_billing 工具、Web UI 双胶囊），官方价格每 12 小时自动同步
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 账户余额 + 会话费用（/balance /cost 命令、deepseek_billing 工具、Web UI 双胶囊），官方价格每 12 小时自动同步

description.en: Chat with, monitor, and approve your DSH agents from WeChat via the iLink gateway: text both ways, session targeting, digest heartbeats, and numbered approval prompts.
description.zh: 通过 iLink 网关在微信里与 DSH agent 聊天、监控与审批：双向文本、会话切换、进度摘要与编号审批提示。

description.en: CocoSgt/dsh-inspector 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
description.zh: CocoSgt/dsh-inspector 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。

description.en: Bidirectional Lark/Feishu controller for DeepSeek Harness with project and session routing, interactive cards, approvals, attachments, and task controls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 双向控制器，支持 Project 与 Session 路由、交互卡片、审批、附件和任务控制。

description.en: This plugin exports a reusable function that takes a file path or a Buffer, extracts the content via @firecrawl/anydoc, and returns GitHub‑Flavored Markdown (GFM). It also includes configuration options and an example usage.
description.zh: 把 PDF、Word 等各种文档一键转成 Markdown，让 Agent 直接读懂文件内容。

description.en: 一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件： 在 Web 输入框的工具行中添加一个 ✨ 图标按钮。点击后选择打磨风格，已接入的大模型 会把你草稿中的提示词改写得更专业、更易被 AI 理解 。A DeepSeek Harness plugin: icon-only co…
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件： 在 Web 输入框的工具行中添加一个 ✨ 图标按钮。点击后选择打磨风格，已接入的大模型 会把你草稿中的提示词改写得更专业、更易被 AI 理解 。A DeepSeek Harness plugin: icon-only co…

description.en: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
description.zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

description.en: Bring your existing Agent Skills (SKILL.md) library to DSH: discover skills across Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini paths, inject a progressive-disclosure index, and load bodies on demand.
description.zh: 把已有的 Agent Skills（SKILL.md）技能库带进 DSH：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录、注入渐进式索引，按需加载技能正文。

description.en: A deepseek harness plugin for tensorlake sandbox
description.zh: A deepseek harness plugin for tensorlake sandbox

description.en: Third-party DSH WebUI enhancement plugin: custom backgrounds, theme colors, prompt presets, token/context visibility, and manual compact.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面换壁纸、调主题色，还能存常用提示词、看 Token 用量，并支持手动压缩对话。

description.en: Weather tool: current conditions and multi-day forecasts via Open-Meteo (free, no API key).
description.zh: 查任意城市实时天气和多日预报，数据来自 Open-Meteo，免费免注册免 API key。

description.en: A 60-frame theme-aware monochrome whale-dive animation with reactive water for the DSH Web turn status: embedded assets, seamless closed-loop playback, a reduced-motion PNG fallback, and lifecycle-clean removal.
description.zh: DSH Web 回合状态旁的 60 帧随主题适配的单色鲸鱼深潜动画：传播式水面、无缝闭环、资源内嵌、减少动态效果 PNG 回退，且随生命周期完整清理。

description.en: Hook DeepSeek Harness into a Hermes pipeline: dispatch-spec template, model-tier routing, orchestrator-run quality gates, git single-writer rule, as a SKILL.md pack (bundle installable).
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接进 Hermes 管线：派单 spec 模板、模型档位路由、质量门、git 唯一写者约定，SKILL.md 技能包（bundle 可安装）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for persistent, isolated Sprites: remote builds, tests, previews, checkpoints, and long-running services.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin for persistent, isolated Sprites: remote builds, tests, previews, checkpoints, and long-running services.

description.en: QQ Bot text and image channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: QQ Bot text and image channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Pin Git commits to the environment's own author identity; env-var injection overrides all `git config` settings.
description.zh: git 提交固定使用环境自身作者身份，环境变量注入压过一切 `git config` 设置。

description.en: Feynman learning-mode plugin: teach → teach-back → judge → re-explain loop rendered as rich HTML lesson cards (mermaid diagrams + shiki code highlighting).
description.zh: 用费曼学习法帮你真正学会知识：讲解、复述、评判、再讲解循环，生成图文并茂的课程卡片。

description.en: Floating draggable token usage statistics panel for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在页面右下角挂个可拖动的浮层，实时看 Token 用量、缓存命中率和每日热力图。

description.en: Model-agnostic Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: isolated browser, Windows native helper, third-party vision perception, and a Chrome Cook…
description.zh: 模型无关的 Computer Use：隔离浏览器 + Windows 原生控制。

description.en: Replaces the model button with a Claude Desktop-style model and reasoning-effort switcher, with per-model effort memory, theme-aware styling, smooth slider feel, rounded track, hover highlight, and pixel-dot animation.
description.zh: 将模型按钮替换为Claude Desktop 同款风格的模型与思考力度切换器，支持逐模型记忆力度、主题自适应，滑动手感、圆角轨道、悬停高亮，点阵动画，都是熟悉的味道。

description.en: Finance data toolkit for DSH agents: number and currency formatting (incl. Chinese wan/yi units), return and CAGR math, valuation and profitability ratios, PV/FV, risk metrics, and a data-quality checklist.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供金融数据工具包：数字与货币格式化（含中文万/亿单位）、收益与年化计算、估值与盈利比率、现值/终值、风险指标与数据质量清单。

description.en: Agent presets whose leader does no work itself: every non-management tool call is denied at the harness boundary so the task has to go to a subagent, after a one-time lookup of the available subagent models and a per-task model choice; a second preset deliberately picks the model least suited to the task.
description.zh: 让领导不亲自干活的 agent preset：非管理类工具调用在 harness 边界一律被拒，任务只能外包给子智能体，选人前先一次性摸清可选子智能体模型、再按任务逐个选型；另一个 preset 故意挑最不适合该任务的模型。

description.en: Tencent CloudQ integration: AIOps chat mode with usage, inspiration, artifact and architecture panels.
description.zh: 腾讯云智能顾问集成：CloudQ 对话模式，附用量、灵感、制品与架构图面板。

description.en: Cross-session agent messaging for DeepSeek Harness with session discovery, offline delivery, delivery receipts, and sender-session navigation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话 Agent 通信：支持会话发现、离线投递、投递回执与发送方会话导航。

description.en: Feishu/Lark IM channel for DeepSeek Harness agents with native thinking-process messages, approval cards, live goal and todo cards, workflow fan-out lines, session text search, and background job and subagent settlement notices. Access is bounded by the Feishu app's own visibility scope by design — anyone the app admits can drive the agent and answer its approvals unless the optional sender, group and approver allowlists are filled in.
description.zh: 飞书/Lark 深度通道：原生思考过程消息、审批卡片、goal/todo 实时卡片、workflow 展开行、会话全文检索、后台任务与子代理结算通知。其设计以飞书应用自身的可见性范围为访问边界——凡是应用允许触达的人都能驱动 agent 并回答它的审批请求，除非填写可选的发送者/群组/审批人白名单收窄。

description.en: Adds ChatGPT/Codex OAuth-backed Codex models and gpt-image-2 generation/editing to DSH without requiring an OpenAI Platform API key.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加基于 ChatGPT/Codex OAuth 的 Codex 模型及 gpt-image-2 文生图和编辑能力，无需 OpenAI Platform API Key。

description.en: Composer expand/collapse toggle for the Web UI: a ⬆/⬇ button in the composer tool row grows the input to a tall 70vh writing view for long drafts.
description.zh: Web UI 输入框展开/收起：composer 工具行新增 ⬆/⬇ 按钮，一键把输入框扩大到 70vh 高度，方便写长 prompt。

description.en: Draggable 3D liquid-glass floating card for the DSH web GUI: DeepSeek API balance, cumulative spend/token stats (today/yesterday/7d/30d/all), adjustable glass/3D/color controls, and one-click top-up.
description.zh: DSH 网页右上角可拖动 3D 液态玻璃余额卡片：显示 DeepSeek API 余额、累计消费与 Token 统计（今天/昨天/近7天/近30天/全部），玻璃参数/3D 厚度/颜色均可调，内置官方充值入口。

description.en: OpenCode Go provider for DeepSeek Harness: live gateway catalog, per-conversation session header, usage

macOS desk pet that lives outside the DSH page: a real always-on-top window that clears fullscreen Spaces, six states driven by local DSH, a native right-click menu with quiet mode and a session list, and a bundled skill that turns one photo into a full eighteen-pose skin on your own image tool and credentials; system Python and ctypes, no Electron and no dependencies.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 页面之外的 macOS 桌宠：一个真的置顶窗口，全屏 Space 也盖得住；六种状态跟着本地 DSH 走，原生右键菜单里有免打扰与会话清单；自带的 skill 用你自己的画图工具和额度，把一张照片变成整套十八个姿势的皮肤。跑系统自带的 Python 与 ctypes，不用 Electron，零依赖。

description.en: Discovers other DSH instances on the local network by UDP multicast or port scan, lists them in a sidebar panel together with the capabilities each one reports, and dispatches tasks between machines in both directions over the LAN or over an automatically downloaded userspace Tailscale node.
description.zh: 通过 UDP 组播或端口扫描发现局域网内的其他 DSH 实例，在侧栏面板中列出它们以及各自上报的能力，并可经局域网或自动下载的用户态 Tailscale 节点在两台机器之间双向派发任务。

description.en: Memory Lake as a persistent memory layer for dsh: memory_search, memory_remember, and memory_forget tools over the memorylake CLI, a session status line, and guided setup/diagnostic skills, sharing one ~/.memorylake identity and memory set with the Claude Code and Codex plugins.
description.zh: 将 Memory Lake 作为 dsh 的持久记忆层：基于 memorylake CLI 的 memory_search、memory_remember、memory_forget 三个工具，会话状态行，以及引导安装/诊断 skills，与 Claude Code、Codex 插件共享同一 ~/.memorylake 身份与记忆。

description.en: Conversational GIS for the DSH Web UI with local file and PostGIS querying, interactive maps, and spatial analysis.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的对话式 GIS：支持本地文件与 PostGIS 查询、交互式地图与空间分析。

description.en: A super-simplified LLM-wiki memory plugin: one index document (auto-loaded) + one markdown file per topic (read only when needed) — no dumping everything into the context and burning tokens. Simple and lightweight, painless to install/uninstall, and freely editable however you like.
description.zh: 超级简化版 llm-wiki 记忆插件：一个索引文档（自动加载）+ 每个主题一个 md 文件（需要时才读）——不会把所有东西塞进上下文烧 token。简单轻量，安装卸载无压力，想怎么改就怎么改。

description.en: Route OpenRouter requests through a configured provider list and quantization cap, injected as provider.only/order with allow_fallbacks, plus provider.quantizations.
description.zh: 配置 OpenRouter 请求使用的提供商列表与量化位数上限，注入 provider.only/order（allow_fallbacks）与 provider.quantizations 路由参数。

description.en: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.
description.zh: 会话需要你时三处同时亮起：角标、标签页标题计数、按状态换色的鲸鱼 favicon。

description.en: Per-workspace project kanban board: nine kanban_* model tools for agent-driven planning plus a browser board UI, with disk persistence, undo, templates, and archiving.
description.zh: 按工作区（项目）隔离的项目看板：9 个 kanban_* 模型工具供 Agent 规划时写卡，另带浏览器看板 UI，支持磁盘持久化、撤销、模板与归档。

description.en: Evidence-first conclusion gate that cross-checks first-hand claims against a durable per-session tool-activity index, blocks unverified guesses and tracks blocked-versus-converted metrics.
description.zh: 实证门——按会话将第一手结论与持久工具活动索引交叉核验、拦截未验证猜测并以台账统计拦截与转化，中英双语界面。

description.en: Global proxy for DeepSeek Harness: route agent tools, model requests and web fetches through the Windows system proxy or a custom address with one persistent toggle, an editable settings card, and agent-visible proxy status.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全局代理插件：通过 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址统一代理模型请求与工具流量，主界面常驻开关，且 Agent 在对话中实时感知代理状态。

description.en: Adds file and folder drag-and-drop attachments to the Web UI, with composer cards, persistent history, and workspace-backed paths.
description.zh: 为 Web UI 添加文件与文件夹拖放附件，提供输入栏卡片、持久化历史记录与工作区路径。

description.en: PDF parsing tools for DSH: pdf_info, pdf_extract_text, and pdf_render_page with dual pdfjs and built-in rendering engines, including system-font rendering for PDFs with non-embedded CJK fonts.
description.zh: DSH 的 PDF 解析工具：pdf_info、pdf_extract_text、pdf_render_page 三件套，pdfjs 与自研渲染器双引擎，未内嵌 CJK 字体的 PDF 也能用系统字体渲染出图。

description.en: Migrate Codex (OpenAI Codex CLI / Desktop) MCP servers, skills, instructions, memory and session history into DeepSeek Harness with a visual panel or CLI, with dry-run previews and secrets migrated as-is.
description.zh: 把 Codex（OpenAI Codex CLI / Desktop）的 MCP 服务器、技能、全局指令、记忆与会话历史迁移进 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），支持可视化面板与命令行，带 dry-run 预览。

description.en: Mirror dsh session events to MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, or SQL Server while retaining local session files.
description.zh: 将 dsh 会话事件镜像到 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite 或 SQL Server，同时保留本地会话文件。

description.en: Brain-inspired cognitive plugin: episodic, semantic, procedural and emotional memory with reinforcement-learning signals, a goal stack with time triggers, curiosity-driven autonomous web research and proactive initiatives.
description.zh: 受大脑启发的认知插件:情景、语义、程序与情绪记忆,带强化学习信号;目标栈支持时间触发器,好奇心驱动的自主网络研究与主动提议。

description.en: Adds per-Workspace category trees to the Web sidebar, with nested categories, drag-and-drop session assignment, category-scoped session creation, and category deletion that archives contained sessions.
description.zh: 为 Web 侧边栏添加按 Workspace 隔离的分类树，支持嵌套分类、拖拽归类会话、在分类中新建会话，以及删除分类时归档其中的会话。

description.en: Highlights parts of speech (nouns green, verbs red, adjectives/adverbs purple) in rendered DSH Web Markdown, with light/dark palettes, toggles, and stream-aware updates.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 已渲染的 Markdown 中做词性高亮：名词绿、动词红、形容/副词紫，支持深/浅色板、词性开关与流式防抖。

description.en: Knowledge-base-driven agent preset: wiki long-term memory, a web KB UI, a management page and optional UI polish.
description.zh: 知识库驱动的 Agent 预设：wiki 长期记忆、网页知识库、管理页、可选界面润色。

description.en: Network optimization for the DSH web UI: reduces transfer size with caching and compression to greatly speed up page loading, plus a connection-drop indicator and automatic reconnection. Ideal for users pursuing peak performance or using unstable networks.
description.zh: dsh网页端网络优化：通过缓存与压缩技术降低传输，从而大幅提升网页加载速度；同时提供网络断连指示与自动断网重连功能。非常适合追求极致性能或网络不稳定用户使用。

description.en: Newmark Core for DeepSeek Harness：MemoryLab、ComputerUse、Agent API、NewMate 陪伴内核与 heartBeat 重启投递，五个独立开关，共用 ~/.Newmark 用户库。
Codex App Server model provider using a local Codex login, with session reuse, Harness tool bridging, native action traces, and durable generated-image projection.
description.zh: 使用本地 Codex 登录的 Codex App Server 模型提供方，支持会话复用、Harness 工具桥接、原生动作轨迹和生成图片持久化。

description.en: Send dsh turn traces, LLM generations, tool spans, and subagent activity to Langfuse.
description.zh: 将 dsh 的会话轮次、LLM 调用、工具调用及子 agent 活动记录到 Langfuse。

description.en: Two-level model circuit breaker with failover: trip a model or a whole provider after repeated request failures and route the next request to a configured fallback.
description.zh: 两级模型熔断与回退：模型或平台连续失败后自动熔断，并把下一个请求路由到配置好的备用模型。

description.en: Composer mic for the Web UI: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop.
description.zh: 输入框麦克风：点击持续监控、按住对话；浏览器语音识别逐字上屏，回复由 host Edge TTS 边生成边朗读，朗读时暂停识别防回声，点击可停止。

description.en: Adds an x_search tool for X/Twitter search to DeepSeek Harness, authenticated through a separate SuperGrok OAuth account so it does not consume the session provider quota.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加用于 X/Twitter 搜索的 x_search 工具，通过独立的 SuperGrok OAuth 账号鉴权，不占用会话所用提供方的配额。

description.en: Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills covering planning, TDD, debugging, and code review.
