description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能，覆盖规划、TDD、调试与代码评审。

description.en: Reference verification for DeepSeek Harness (参考文献真实性检查器): the reference_checker model tool checks a paper's bibliography (.pdf/.bib/.tex/.txt or pasted text) against Crossref, OpenAlex and arXiv, reports found / partial / not_found / error per entry, and emits corrected citations in the input's style (APA, GB/T 7714, IEEE, Vancouver, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, ACS, BibTeX).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供参考文献真实性检查：reference_checker 工具将论文（PDF/BibTeX/tex/文本/粘贴列表）的每条文献对照 Crossref / OpenAlex / arXiv 核对，逐条判定 found / partial / not_found / error，并按输入样式生成可直接替换回论文的更正版引用（APA、GB/T 7714、IEEE、Vancouver、MLA、Chicago、Harvard、ACS、BibTeX）。

description.en: Gaokao countdown blackboard: counts down the days to the gaokao on a desktop blackboard widget that collapses into a slim bar on double-click, and quizzes random knowledge cards while the agent works; open Markdown knowledge-card framework — drop .md files under subject/category folders and they load automatically, with cross-links, favorites, priority subjects and importing your own knowledge base.
description.zh: 梦回高三：桌面小黑板高考倒计时（双击收成竖条），AI 干活时随机抽背知识点卡；Markdown 开放知识卡框架——按学科/分类放 md 即自动加载，支持关联跳转/收藏/重点学科/导入自己的知识库。

description.en: Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when engines fail so a thin result set is not read as a thin web.
description.zh: 把 web_search 指向自建的 SearXNG 实例而非原生搜索路由：自动翻页直到满足 maxResults，并在引擎失败时报告覆盖不全，避免把稀少的结果误读成网上本就没有内容。

description.en: Turns a one-line DSH draft into a complete task brief (role / goal / constraints / output format). The engine is a byte-verified port of linshenkx/prompt-optimizer (three modes, 10 templates identical to upstream); history is consent-gated with version chains and structural comparison; every run reports its token usage. Nothing is written back or sent without a click.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里的一句话补成完整任务书（角色/目标/约束/输出格式）。引擎是 linshenkx/prompt-optimizer 的逐字节移植：三种优化模式、10 个模板与上游一致；历史为授权制、带版本链与结构对比；每次润色的 token 消耗可见。未经点击不写回、不发送。

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: bidirectional sessions, conversation steering, home-channel routing, and TTS voice notes sent as Telegram audio messages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 桥接：双向会话、对话引导、主频道路由，以及以 Telegram 语音消息发送的 TTS 语音笔记。

description.en: Apply configurable allow, deny, and approval rules to dsh tool calls, including shell command patterns.
description.zh: 根据可配置的允许、拒绝和审批规则控制 dsh 工具调用，包括对 shell 命令的匹配。

description.en: Deep research as an agent mode: one reviewed loop that plans, researches in adaptive parallel rounds driven by the gaps the researchers themselves declare, synthesises a cited report and then reviews it adversarially, instead of a script the model rewrites per call. Questions the round budget never reached are named in the report rather than dropped.
description.zh: 把深度研究做成一种代理模式：一条经过审阅的固定循环——先规划，再按研究员自行声明的缺口进行自适应并行轮次，综合出带引用的报告，最后对其做对抗性审阅——而不是让模型每次现写脚本。轮次预算未能覆盖的问题会在报告中被逐一点名，而不是被悄悄丢弃。

description.en: Creates and inspects RecoWork local-agent-project workspaces through two bounded DSH tools and a web workspace card.
description.zh: 通过两个受限的 DSH 工具和网页工作区卡片，创建并检查 RecoWork local-agent-project 工作区。

description.en: Progressive tool disclosure: a deferred tool group costs one catalog line instead of its full schemas until the model loads it with tool_search, with one switch per group in Settings and each group measured against the live registry.
description.zh: 渐进式工具披露：被延后的工具组在每次请求中只占目录里的一行，模型用 tool_search 加载后才拿到完整 schema；设置页为每个组提供一个开关，各组开销按当前工具注册表实测。

description.en: A2A protocol server for dsh agents, with JSON-RPC tasks, SSE streaming, cancellation, and an agent card.
description.zh: 为 dsh agent 提供 A2A 协议服务，支持 JSON-RPC 任务、SSE 流式输出、取消任务和 agent card。

description.en: Git view for DeepSeek Harness: status, commit graph, branches and tags in one picker, diff, staging/commit, push/pull and blame.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 视图：状态、提交图、分支与标签（合并为同一个下拉框，可切换分支或检出标签）、差异、暂存提交、推送拉取与逐行溯源。

description.en: Rewrites the Chinese copy of a market-installed plugin into English using a model already configured in the harness — automatically when the plugin is installed, then live-reloaded. Each file is translated in one whole-file pass, validated by a real parser where one exists (node --check for JavaScript, JSON and YAML parsers otherwise) and handed back to the model with the error for up to three repair attempts; files above 48 KB, or that never parse, fall back to a line-range pass that checks every returned line against the original for structure. Trigger phrases and locale tables can optionally be preserved rather than translated, and the untouched original is kept beside the file as a .zh.bak.
description.zh: 用你已经配置好的模型，把从市场安装的插件里的中文文案改写成英文——安装时自动运行，随后热重载。每个文件整体翻译一遍，凡是有解析器的都会实际校验（JavaScript 用 node --check，其余用 JSON、YAML 解析器），失败时把报错交回模型，最多修复三次；超过 48 KB 或始终无法解析的文件，回退到按行区间翻译，逐行与原文做结构比对。触发短语与本地化表可以选择保留而不翻译，未改动的原文件保留在同目录下的 .zh.bak。

description.en: A guarded local fetch provider for the ctx.web seam — the backend dsh does not ship for its own web_fetch tool. Every redirect hop is re-resolved and checked against the non-routable ranges, with a streamed size cap and a content-type allowlist.
description.zh: ctx.web 接口的本地受控抓取提供方——dsh 自带完整的 web_fetch 工具，却没有随附后端。每一跳重定向都会重新解析并对照非公网地址段校验，另有流式大小上限与内容类型白名单。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks, including context injection: declare event, handler and outcome in YAML, where the handler is an in-harness tool (MCP included), a shell command or an HTTP endpoint, and the outcome is model-visible context, a denied tool call, or fire-and-forget.
description.zh: 以配置驱动的生命周期钩子，并支持上下文注入：在 YAML 中声明事件、处理器与结果——处理器可以是进程内工具（含 MCP）、shell 命令或 HTTP 端点，结果可以是模型可见的上下文、拒绝该次工具调用，或触发即忘。

description.en: Identity-gated Tailscale access to the Web GUI with dsh still bound to loopback: a 127.0.0.1 proxy published by `tailscale serve` admits a request only when the Tailscale login it stamps is allowed, with an optional per-device allowlist, so the privileged /api methods behind the loopback check — Settings, Models, Plugins — answer without dsh being told to trust a remote host.
description.zh: 在 dsh 仍绑定回环地址的前提下，为 Web 界面提供基于身份的 Tailscale 访问：由 `tailscale serve` 对外发布的 127.0.0.1 代理，仅当其标记的 Tailscale 登录账号在允许列表内时才放行请求，并可另按设备白名单限制；这样受回环检查保护的特权 /api 方法（设置、模型、插件）无需让 dsh 信任远程主机即可正常响应。

description.en: A thinking level stored per provider and model, so reasoning effort outlives the session it was set in and also reaches subagents, which dsh never asks. The in-session picker still wins, and a model with no row keeps its provider default.
description.zh: 按提供方与模型保存思考等级：推理强度不再只属于设置它的那次会话，还会应用到 dsh 从不询问的子代理。会话内的手动选择依然优先，没有配置的模型保持提供方默认值。

description.en: Two-way WeChat bridge for DeepSeek Harness via the iLink protocol: bind your personal WeChat with a QR scan and chat with a local DSH agent from the chat box (text, images, voice-to-text, files); a web settings panel handles binding/start/stop/status, project-session binding continues the conversation on desktop, proactive wechat_notify pushes include throttling, and the pure-Node daemon runs on Windows/macOS/Linux.
description.zh: 基于 iLink 协议的 DSH 微信双向桥：扫码绑定个人微信后在聊天框直接与本机 DSH Agent 对话（文字/图片/语音转文字/文件），Web 设置面板管理扫码绑定/启停/状态，支持绑定项目会话跨端续聊，agent 可主动 wechat_notify 推送（内置节流），纯 Node 守护进程，Windows/macOS/Linux 三端通用。

description.en: Cross-session TODO board as a draggable floating panel: tasks are grouped by working directory and reorderable by drag, each one carries a run mode (remind only, continue in the current session, or open a new session in the same directory), up to four attached images sent to the model as real image attachments, and an optional local time it may run at; two checkboxes track AI-done and user-verified, and the agent picks up the next unfinished task in that directory when it finishes one.
description.zh: 跨会话 TODO 板：可拖动浮窗按工作目录分组、拖拽排序，每条待办带一个执行模式（仅提醒 / 在当前会话续跑 / 在同目录新开会话）、可附最多 4 张图片（派发时作为真正的图片附件发给模型）、以及一个可选的定时执行时间；两个勾选框分别记录 AI 已完成与用户已验收，AI 完成一项后自动接续该目录下一条未完成待办。

description.en: Per provider/model generation concurrency, with a settings card: a cap on how many sessions may stream at once, enforced at the stream and again at subagent spawn, where a fan-out past the cap waits in a FIFO queue instead of failing.
description.zh: 按提供方/模型限制并发生成，并附带设置卡片：限定同时进行流式生成的会话数，在流式调用与子代理派生两处强制执行；超出上限的扇出会进入 FIFO 队列等待，而不是直接失败。

description.en: Auto-saves large pasted text as an attachment file in the DeepSeek Harness web input box; with dsh-better-sidebar installed, the paste pill opens the file in the sidebar editor and saves it back.
description.zh: 在输入框粘贴大段文本时自动保存为附件文件；装了 dsh-better-sidebar 时，药丸上的「查看」可在侧栏编辑器打开并保存回原文件。

description.en: Password-gated public access for the DSH Web GUI through quick or named Cloudflare Tunnels, with HTTP/WebSocket proxying and an in-app directory picker.
description.zh: 通过快速或命名 Cloudflare Tunnel 为 DSH Web GUI 提供密码保护的公网访问，并代理 HTTP/WebSocket 流量、改用应用内目录选择器。

description.en: DSH web-GUI pet runtime that renders any Codex spritesheet-atlas pet (v1/v2) as a draggable overlay: drag/wave/jump, v2 mouse-tracking eyes that follow the active mouse, live agent-status poses, progress bubbles, and an in-GUI atlas importer; ships one original CC BY-NC demo pet (nastya), and user pets live in ~/.dsh/pets.
description.zh: DSH 网页 GUI 实时桌宠：可把任何 Codex 桌宠图集（webp/png/gif，v1/v2 自动识别）转换为 DSH 中可拖拽的悬浮桌宠。支持拖拽/挥手/跳跃，v2 桌宠的眼睛实时追踪活动鼠标，随 agent 状态切换姿势；进度气泡反映工作状态；「设置 → 桌宠」图形界面可导入、切换与调整桌宠；内置一只原创示例桌宠（娜斯佳），用户桌宠存放在 ~/.dsh/pets。

description.en: Honcho memory plugin by Plastic Labs: injects the user profile, session summary and relevant conclusions at session start, uploads each turn to Honcho in the background with secrets redacted, and adds honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember tools plus a /honcho status command; configured through the ~/.honcho/config.json shared with the other Honcho integrations, against hosted honcho.dev or a self-hosted instance.
description.zh: 由 Plastic Labs 维护的 Honcho 记忆插件：会话启动时注入用户画像、会话摘要与相关结论，后台脱敏后逐轮上传对话到 Honcho，提供 honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember 工具及 /honcho 状态命令；通过与其他 Honcho 集成共用的 ~/.honcho/config.json 配置，支持托管的 honcho.dev 或自建实例。

description.en: Image generation through a local ComfyUI server: one generate_image tool covering text2img, img2img, inpaint and background removal.
description.zh: 用本地 ComfyUI 出图：一个 generate_image 工具覆盖文生图、图生图、局部重绘与去背景。

description.en: Anime game banner and event schedule lookup: sidebar button with current banners, events, and countdowns for 11 gacha games, auto-refresh, and per-game selectable sources.
description.zh: 二游卡池/活动排期速查：侧边栏按钮展示 11 款二游的当期卡池与活动起止（含倒计时），支持自动刷新与各游戏独立来源切换。

description.en: MC 资产面板 + 「MC 模组工作室」模式 + mc-mod / mc-art 两个 skill：3D+物品栏、像素/结构编辑器、出错的报告自动放进输入框、GameTest 判定闭环。原生 Windows 可用（不需要 WSL），不绑定任何具体 mod。
Grok-compatible web search with retained source pagination, Context7 and Exa documentation lookup, bounded page extraction, site mapping, offline research planning, and read-only diagnostics.
description.zh: 提供 Grok-compatible 网页搜索、保留来源分页、Context7 与 Exa 文档检索、有界网页提取、站点映射、离线研究计划和只读诊断。

description.en: Bidi-safe RTL rendering for mixed Arabic and English text, a full Arabic interface pack (3,307 strings) registered through the DSH locale service, and three thmanyah cuts — Sans for the interface, Serif Text for reading, Serif Display for headings — placed behind whatever font the app itself is set to.
description.zh: 让 DSH 界面说阿拉伯语：混合阿拉伯文与英文的双向文本排版，通过 DSH 官方语言服务注册完整阿拉伯语界面包（3,307 条），并内置三款 thmanyah 字体（界面 Sans、正文 Serif Text、标题 Serif Display），置于应用自身字体设置之后。

description.en: Routes images to a vision model of your choice - auto-rewrite, explicit tools, or hybrid - so a text-only chat model does not fail a turn that contains a picture.
description.zh: 将图片交给所选的视觉模型处理（自动改写、显式工具或混合模式），使纯文本聊天模型也能处理包含图片的对话。

description.en: Pomodoro focus-and-break timer for DSH Web with configurable cycles, a draggable mini panel, and in-app, sound, and browser notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web 番茄钟：提供可配置专注/休息循环、可拖动迷你面板，以及站内提醒、提示音和浏览器通知。

description.en: Network proxy settings page for DeepSeek Harness: set a global HTTP(S) proxy with bypass hosts, or give each LLM provider its own proxy or a direct connection; changes apply on save without a restart.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网络代理设置页：配置全局 HTTP(S) 代理及免代理主机，或为单个 LLM 提供商单独指定代理或直连；保存即生效，无需重启。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin: exposes the newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding-plan models (e.g. glm-5.3) on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled pi-ai catalog catches up.
DeepSeek Harness adapter for Qwen Token Plan CN with Responses tools, GLM Chat routing, and a versioned official catalog
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的千问 Token Plan 个人版 Responses API 提供方，保留 Qwen 服务端内置工具与 DSH 本地函数工具，多轮文本/推理/工具调用历史与图片附件均被支持，官方模型目录按 npm 版本冻结快照发布。

description.en: Drive your local DSH from WeChat: a self-hosted iLink bridge over a persistent ACP session (context lives in DSH and is resumable), phone conversations grouped into the desktop workspace, with image recognition, file messages (Excel/Word/PDF, parsed by the agent itself) and voice transcripts. Tool approvals are answered inside WeChat itself (numbered card; ask/allow/reject policy; 120s timeout means reject), and any process can push a message to your phone through the outbox helper. Access defaults to strict (only registered devices are served); the phone channel's permission preset is configurable - see the README security section before sharing the bot.
description.zh: 手机微信驱动本机 DSH：自建 iLink 桥 + 常驻 ACP 原生会话（上下文归 DSH、可 resume），手机会话自动登记进桌面工作区；支持图片识别、直接发文件（Excel/Word/PDF，由会话里的 agent 自行解析）与语音转写。审批可在微信里应答（编号卡片，ask/allow/reject 策略，超时按拒绝），任何进程也能通过 outbox 推送把消息发到手机。准入默认 strict（只服务已登记设备）；手机通道权限预设可配置，详见 README 安全基线。

description.en: Polishes the draft in the composer into a clearer, better-structured prompt from the ✨ button or Alt+O; streams the result live over SSE with reasoning shown first, and follows the session's default model with zero configuration or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: 在输入框按 ✨ 或 Alt+O 一键把草稿润色成更清晰、更结构化的 prompt；默认零配置复用当前会话模型（SSE 真流式、推理过程先出），也可自配任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: Renders image, video, and audio paths and URLs from DSH conversations inline, with workspace-confined local reads and an optional ComfyUI proxy.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中内联显示图像、视频和音频路径及 URL，并提供工作区受限的本地读取与可选的 ComfyUI 代理。

description.en: Plugin trust pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic static scan with verdicts, opt-in runtime guard with honeypot lures, agent audit-protocol skill, and a browser shield status light. Alarm-only, never an enforcer.
description.zh: DSH 插件信任流水线：确定性静态扫描判定、可选运行时守卫与蜜罐诱饵、agent 审查协议技能与浏览器盾牌状态灯，只报警不执法。

description.en: Start and detach standalone chats without a mandatory workspace, keeping DSH's native workspace UI intact.
description.zh: 无需强制绑定工作区即可新建和分离独立会话，同时保留 DSH 原生的工作区界面。

description.en: Session bridge for DeepSeek Harness: drive other real DSH sessions straight from your prompt — create top-level sessions in any workspace, message or steer any session, wait for replies and stream them segment-by-segment (chain-of-thought included), resume offline sessions, find sessions across workspaces, run a background watchdog that monitors and schedules a main task (nudge when stalled, correct drift, cancel when stuck), and archive sessions with one command.
description.zh: 会话桥：让当前 agent 直接用提示词驱动其它真实的 DSH 会话——跨工作区创建主会话、向任意会话发消息或注入 steering、等待并逐段读取回复（含思维链）、恢复离线会话、按名称或 id 跨工作区查找会话；还能用后台看门狗监控并调度主任务（卡住催办、偏离纠偏、卡死终止），一键归档会话。

description.en: Runs one-time and RFC 5545 recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with visual schedule editing and session-linked history.
description.zh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或 RFC 5545 周期 Agent 任务，支持可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。

description.en: Keeps plugins you have edited (third-party or built-in) as local git repos: deploys an exact commit only after it builds and passes checks, reverts a change that crashes dsh right after it is applied, merges origin updates (npm or git) into your edits, and can open an agent session that squashes your edits into one commit on top of the original release (backup branch first).
description.zh: 把你改过的插件（第三方或内置）保存为本地 git 仓库：只部署已构建并通过检查的指定提交，应用后导致 dsh 崩溃时自动回滚，把 npm 或 git 源的更新合并进你的修改，并可打开智能体会话，把你的修改压缩为原始发布版本之上的一个提交（先建备份分支）。

description.en: Keep declared workspace subpaths (e.g. .git) read-only, honor a read-only rules file at the workspace root, grant extra writable roots under workspace-write, and let the model request session-scoped write access; enforced for sandboxed CLI commands and the write/edit tools.
description.zh: 为 DSH 沙箱增加工作区子路径只读保护 (例如 .git), 支持工作区根下的只读规则文件, 可在 workspace-write 下声明额外可写根, 并允许模型申请本会话的可写授权; 命令沙箱与 write/edit 工具都生效.

description.en: Terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness on jump hosts and high-latency links: plain ANSI, incremental repaint, and a session that survives a dropped SSH connection (resume it from the log).
description.zh: 跳板机与高延迟 SSH 上的 DeepSeek Harness 终端：纯 ANSI、增量重绘；SSH 掉线后会话不丢，可用 --resume 接回。

description.en: Database explorer panel for DeepSeek Harness: connect SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Elasticsearch and Qdrant from a third Conversation tab — browse schemas, page through data, edit cells, insert rows, design and drop tables, run SQL, import/export CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown, and draw editable E-R diagrams. Read-only connections enforce statement-level allowlists, agent tools ship read-only by default with an opt-in write flag, and every write (including refused attempts) lands in an auditable log. Ships an MCP stdio server exposing the same connections to external AI clients.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据库浏览器：在对话区第三个页签连接 SQLite、MySQL/MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、MongoDB、ClickHouse、Redis、Elasticsearch 与 Qdrant——浏览结构树、分页查看数据、编辑单元格、插入行、建表/改表/删表、执行 SQL、CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown 导入导出，以及可编辑的 E-R 关系图。只读连接按语句白名单硬拒绝写路径，agent 工具默认只读、写工具需显式授权，所有写操作（含被拒尝试）进入可查可删的审计日志；附带 MCP stdio 服务器，把同一份连接暴露给任意外部 AI 客户端。

description.en: Local OCR fallback for text-only routes: when the session model declares it cannot accept images, the attached image is cached locally and its path injected so the model can call ocr_image — PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime on CPU, no API key, images never leave the machine. Silent when the model can see images.
description.zh: 纯文本路由的本地 OCR 兜底：会话模型明确声明不接受图片时，把附件的图片存入本地缓存并注入路径，模型调 ocr_image 用 PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime 在纯 CPU 上离线识别，无需 API key，图片不出本机；模型能看图时静默。

description.en: Chrome and Edge browser control that drives the real logged-in profile, tabs and cookies through an MV3 extension and a loopback Bridge, exposing browser_* tools, a Skill and /chrome commands.
description.zh: 通过 MV3 扩展和本地 loopback Bridge 驱动用户已登录的真实 Chrome/Edge Profile、标签页与 Cookie，为 DSH 提供 browser_* 工具、Skill 和 /chrome 命令。

description.en: Ports poteto's pstack engineering playbooks to DSH, covering planning, review, verification and release workflows.
description.zh: 将 poteto 的 pstack 工程工作流移植到 DSH，涵盖规划、审查、验证与发布。

description.en: File explorer for the dock workbench: tree browsing of the session workspace with create/rename/copy-paste/delete, drag-and-drop import and paste of local files and clipboard images.
description.zh: dock 系列文件浏览插件：侧边栏目录树浏览会话工作区，支持新建/重命名/复制粘贴/删除、拖放导入、粘贴本地文件与剪贴板图片。

description.en: Honest merge of two community plugins into one calmer display: the streaming reading view from dsh-better-display (fork) and the message rail from dsh-tidychat. For theme lovers it wraps reasoning prose and tool-call output in translucent message bubbles, so text no longer sits directly on busy wallpapers or skins where it is hard to read. Cross-version rc adaptation attempted across DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 (all rc); no obvious problems so far.
description.zh: 诚实说明：将两个社区插件合并为一个更安静的显示层——流式阅读视图来自 dsh-better-display（fork），消息轨道来自 dsh-tidychat。为主题爱好者把思考正文与工具调用输出包裹进半透明消息泡泡框，避免文字直接铺在复杂壁纸或皮肤上难以分辨。已在 DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 各 rc 版本间尝试跨版本适配，目前无明显问题。

description.en: Select text in the DSH web UI to stream a translation and an explanation of what it means in that specific context, read against the conversation it came from; the panel keeps a replayable history and can be promoted into a full session.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面划词，小窗流式给出翻译，并结合这段文字所在的会话上下文解释它在这里的具体含义；面板带可回放的历史记录，也能一键升格为正式会话。

description.en: Replaces the terminal tool on Windows with Git Bash.
description.zh: 可将 Windows 环境下的终端工具替换为 Git Bash

description.en: Personal finance plugin for DSH with structured Beancount ledger tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的个人记账插件，基于结构化的beancount账本工具。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-moneypal
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for MoneyPal#dsh-moneypal

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Adds Windows-native toast notifications and a system tray icon to dsh: alerts when the agent finishes, stops, or errors, with a tray menu to reopen the web page or quit the background process.
description.zh: 为 dsh 添加 Windows 原生 Toast 通知与系统托盘图标：agent 完成、停止或出错时弹通知，托盘菜单可重新打开网页或退出后台进程。

description.en: DeepSeek-styled cross-session token usage, request count, and tiered cost analytics dashboard.
description.zh: 仿 DeepSeek 官方 Token 统计，跨会话 Token 消耗、请求次数与峰谷分时费用统计看板。

description.en: Read-only Web client file-preview panel with image, PDF, CSV/TSV, text, source-code, Markdown, JSON and YAML renderers, large-file range loading, and a provider API for non-local content.
description.zh: Web 客户端只读文件预览面板，支持图片、PDF、CSV/TSV、文本、源代码、Markdown、JSON 与 YAML 渲染、大文件分段读取，以及面向非本地内容的 provider API。

description.en: Passcode marketplace inside DeepSeek Harness: enter a six-character code to unlock and install plugins shared by creators, plus themes, backup, updates and diagnostics.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 口令插件市场：输入 6 位口令解锁并安装创作者分享的插件，附带主题、备份、更新与诊断。

description.en: Installs a Web-profile helper that diagnoses and writes MCP config so Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code can spawn dsh --profile codex.
description.zh: 在 Web profile 中安装适配层，检测并写入 MCP 配置，供 Codex、Cursor 或 Claude Code 拉起 dsh --profile codex.

description.en: Ask-before-act approval for every edit and every bash command: a red/green line diff before a file is touched, a description+command panel before a command runs — approve once or reject, each gate with its own master switch in Settings → General.
description.zh: 每次 edit 与 bash 调用前都会询问：编辑前展示红绿行级 diff，命令前展示描述与命令面板——同意一次或拒绝，两个 gate 各带独立总开关（Settings → General）。

description.en: Embedded dsh bundle for dsh-plugin-ops: a settings-page health panel (scan, plugin rows, diagnosis chat) over the shared engine
description.zh: dsh 插件树的启动前体检与修复——十条跟随启动器运行时解析的静态规则、启动失败后的故障归因、先在隔离实例复验再落地的白名单可逆修复、点名目标版本会跳过哪些插件的升级预演，以及带插件行管理面板与历次故障 RAG 知识库的设置界面。

description.en: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) MCP services in DeepSeek Harness: dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
description.zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入企查查 MCP 服务：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖全部企查查数据服务。

description.en: Consolidated toolkit for session identity, global & workspace prompts with referenced files, session auto-resume, UAC-free web restart, and peer-session messaging.
description.zh: 整合工具包：会话身份、全局/工作区提示词（含引用文件）、会话自动上线、免 UAC 网页重启、会话间消息。

description.en: Host-neutral durable DAG workflows for Agents with CLI, MCP, on-demand Skills, triggers, replay, and a visual Canvas.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的 Host-neutral 持久化 DAG 工作流，提供 CLI、MCP、按需 Skill、Trigger、重放和可视化 Canvas。

description.en: Brings the models included in the Xiaomi MiMo desktop app (free during beta) into DeepSeek Harness, with zero configuration in the DSH conversation window.
description.zh: 将 mimo桌面端包含的模型（内测有免费额度）自动接入 DeepSeek Harness，在 DSH 对话窗口里零配置使用。

description.en: Windows desktop notifications for DSH that speak the turn result by default: Windows TTS needs no download, and 13 VOICEVOX voice packs can be installed from the settings page. A completed alert waits until running subagents and background jobs finish; approval, question and error alerts fire immediately. Voice packs are downloaded from GitHub after a terms confirmation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面通知，默认把回合结果读出来：Windows TTS 零下载即可用，另有 13 个 VOICEVOX 语音包可在设置页下载。完成提醒会等子代理与后台任务结束后再响；审批、提问、出错立即提醒。语音包从 GitHub 下载，下载前需确认使用条款。

description.en: Context-aware next-message suggestions in the DSH composer, with repeated Trigger cycling and explicit user review before sending.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的上下文感知下一句建议：重复 Trigger 可持续换一条，发送前始终由用户确认。

description.en: Telegram duty gateway: phone-message task loop on a dedicated duty session, global approval forwarding with inline approve/reject buttons, telegram_ask choice questions, duty/local toggle with a web duty banner, zh/en messages, zero idle tokens.
description.zh: Telegram 值班网关：手机消息任务闭环（专属值班会话）、值守模式全局审批转发（内联同意/拒绝按钮）、telegram_ask 选项提问、值守/本地切换与网页横幅、中英双语消息、空闲零 token。

description.en: Hot-switches in-process DSH fetch traffic among direct, manual HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 proxy, and ambient system-proxy modes, with no-proxy rules and optional proxy-environment export for newly spawned child processes.
description.zh: 在直连、手动 HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 代理和环境/系统代理模式间热切换 DSH 进程内 fetch 流量，支持免代理规则，并可为之后启动的子进程导出代理环境变量。

description.en: Tripo 3D generation skills driving the tripo-cli through the shell: text-to-3D, image-to-3D, rigging with locomotion clips, decimation and LOD chains, and export to GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF, with headless device login for both China-mainland and international accounts; installable as `tripo-dsh`.
description.zh: 通过 shell 驱动 tripo-cli 的 Tripo 3D 生成 Skill：文生 3D、图生 3D、绑骨与走跑动画、减面与 LOD 链，导出 GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF，支持国内站与海外站账号的无头设备码登录；npm 包名 `tripo-dsh`。

description.en: One-click prompt improvement for the DSH composer: press the sparkle button to rewrite the draft into an agent-ready prompt, replaced in place and undoable, with a deterministic fidelity check that keeps every path, identifier, number, URL and backticked token verbatim, plus a length ceiling that blocks inflation.
description.zh: DSH 输入框一键增强提示词：点 ✦ 把草稿改写成 Agent 可执行的提示词，直接替换并可一键撤回；保真闸机械校验硬事实（路径、标识符、数字与版本、URL、反引号代码）逐字存活，长度闸防止把一句话需求膨胀成规格书。

description.en: Renders HTML, React (JSX/TSX), Vue, SVG, Mermaid and Markdown written by the agent in an isolated iframe sandbox with SSE hot-reload, and adds a DOM click inspector, side-by-side visual diff, a responsive device matrix and one-click Vite ZIP export.
description.zh: 在隔离的 iframe 沙箱中实时渲染 Agent 生成的 HTML、React (JSX/TSX)、Vue、SVG、Mermaid 和 Markdown，支持 SSE 热重载，并提供 DOM 点击检查器、并排视觉对比、响应式设备矩阵和一键 Vite ZIP 导出。

description.en: Takes over the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers with Tavily, each behind its own toggle: a key pool with balance-aware scheduling that reads real credit balances from /usage, failover with hard exclusion of cooling or exhausted keys, and call history with a 14-day credit chart.
description.zh: 用 Tavily 接管内置的 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供方，两者各有一个开关：密钥池按余额调度（从 /usage 读取真实余额），失败自动切换，冷却中与额度耗尽的密钥硬排除，并记录调用历史与 14 天额度图表。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and current-session spend estimate in a top-bar chip and settings card, with pause-aware auto-refresh, an editable official price table, a `deepseek_balance` model tool, and a bilingual UI.
description.zh: 顶栏徽章与设置卡片展示 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前会话预估花费：暂停感知的自动刷新、可编辑官方价格表、`deepseek_balance` 模型工具与中英文界面。

description.en: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆库：remember / recall / forget 工具、每轮提示注入与设置页条目浏览。

description.en: Roll back to before any of your questions or edit the last one and resubmit, with the workspace files of the discarded turns restored.
description.zh: 回退到任意一条提问之前，或编辑上一条问题重新提交；被丢弃轮次产生的工作区文件会一并还原。

description.en: Brings SenseNova (日日新) models into dsh with a per-key rotation pool: paste any number of API keys and requests rotate across them, a 429 rate-limit immediately retries on the next key with per-key exponential-backoff cooldown, local RPM pre-throttling avoids the limit instead of reacting to it, and an exhausted pool answers 503 with Retry-After so a 429 never reaches the caller. Ships a built-in model catalogue that works offline and refreshes from /v1/models, plus a settings card with masked keys, per-key probing and removal.
description.zh: 把商汤日日新（SenseNova）模型接入 dsh，并提供按 Key 轮换的 Key 池：粘贴任意多把 API Key，请求在多把 Key 之间轮转；遇 429 限流立即换下一把 Key 重试，每把 Key 独立指数退避冷却；本地 RPM 预限流从源头避开限流，池子耗尽时回报 503 与 Retry-After，使 429 不会传到调用方。内置可离线使用的模型目录并从 /v1/models 刷新，设置卡片提供脱敏 Key 列表、单把探活与删除。

description.en: Image and video wallpapers for the DSH web workspace: auto-detected GIF/APNG/animated WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM backgrounds with blur, brightness and dimming, tint-following UI, per-component transparency, and one-click preset wallpapers.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供图片/视频壁纸背景：GIF/APNG/动图 WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM 魔数自动识别，压暗/亮度/高斯模糊，界面色调与字体颜色自动跟随背景，各组件独立透明度，预置壁纸一键应用。

description.en: Omni-modal workstation for DSH: analyze_image over an ordered multi-card VLM failover chain, a six-tool vision toolkit (zoom, colour sampling, pixel diff, OCR, element detection, inline display) sharing the same image resolver, generate_image over OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI protocols, multi-card async generate_video with a /build-video-tool builder, and speak/clone_voice TTS over seven providers, all driven by one auto-saving settings page.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的全模态工作站：analyze_image 走有序多卡片 VLM 故障转移链；六个视觉工具箱工具（局部放大、色调采样、像素比对、OCR、元素检测、内联展示）共用同一套图片来源解析；generate_image 支持 OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI 协议；多卡片异步 generate_video 配 /build-video-tool 构建器；speak/clone_voice 语音合成覆盖七家供应商；全部由一个自动保存的设置页驱动。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek account balance at the bottom of the sidebar, with a configuration card on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并在插件页提供配置卡。

description.en: Registers codex-web-search-mcp as native DSH MCP tools (mcp__codex-web-search__codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch) for model-independent Codex and Grok web search and deep research.
description.zh: 将 codex-web-search-mcp 注册为 DSH 原生 MCP 工具（codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch），提供与模型无关的 Codex / Grok 联网搜索与深度研究。

description.en: Adds specification artifacts, skills, commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.
description.zh: 增加规格工件、技能、命令、由 goal 驱动的实施流程和任务进度上下文。

description.en: IM channel bridge: WeChat (ilinkai) / QQ / Feishu with proactive push — wake the channel bot from scheduled tasks and deliver AI replies to your phone.
description.zh: IM 渠道桥：微信（ilinkai）/ QQ / 飞书接入，支持主动推送——定时任务可唤醒渠道 bot 并把 AI 回复推送到手机。

description.en: Search, monitor, interrupt, and batch-archive workspace subagents, featuring real-time activity streaming and an active-agent floating panel.
description.zh: 搜索、监控、打断与批量归档工作区子代理，支持实时活动/思考流式展示与活跃浮窗。

description.en: Fetches up-to-date, version-pinned library documentation and code examples from context7.com for DSH agents via context7_search and context7_get_docs tools.
description.zh: 通过 context7_search 与 context7_get_docs 工具，为 DSH 智能体从 context7.com 获取最新、可锁定版本的库文档与代码示例。

description.en: Card-style plugin manager in Settings: enable/disable each plugin through the profile patch layer, install-source details, npm update check with one-click update, uninstall, search, and load-error badges.
description.zh: 设置页卡片式插件管理：经 profile 补丁层启停插件（跨重启保留）、安装来源详情、npm 更新检查与一键更新、卸载、搜索与加载失败标识。

description.en: Conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness: the Markdown headings of the whole session, grouped by turn, in a side panel or a full-width curtain; hover previews can be pinned for comparison, bookmarks keep the places you come back to, and a right-click jumps to a section or copies a heading and the levels below it. Six theme colours and a translucent material, title/prompt/full-text/cross-session search, reading-position follow and a Chinese/English interface.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话大纲：按回合整理整段会话的 Markdown 标题，侧边面板与全屏「幕布」两种视图；悬停预览可钉住对照，书签留住常回看的几处，右键即可跳转到某一节或复制标题及其下面所有层级。支持六种主题色与半透明材质、标题/提问/全文/跨会话搜索、阅读位置跟随与中英双语界面。

description.en: Adds Codex-like projectless drafts with per-project draft switching and date-and-topic directories created on first send; supports Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 without an archive patch or external installer.
description.zh: 提供类似 Codex 的无项目草稿、各项目草稿切换及首次发送时按日期和主题创建目录的功能；支持 Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2，无需归档补丁或外部安装器。

description.en: Use a SuperGrok or X Premium Grok Build subscription in DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接用 SuperGrok 或 X Premium 订阅，写代码、看图、切换模型都行。

description.en: Renders live multi-agent session activity as a pixel-art office in a Web UI side panel - each session is an ox/horse worker typing at its desk when busy or wandering off when idle, with click-to-view work monitors and in-place approval cards.
description.zh: 把多 agent 会话的实时活动渲染成 Web UI 侧边栏里的像素风办公室--每个会话是一名牛/马员工，忙时伏案敲键盘、闲时起身摸鱼，支持点击查看工位监控、就地处理审批。

description.en: Universal skill adapter that registers any GitHub repo containing a SKILL.md as a DSH skill by cloning and symlinking into the official skills root.
description.zh: 通用 skill 适配器，将含 SKILL.md 的 GitHub 仓库克隆并 symlink 到官方 skills 根目录，注册为 DSH skill。

description.en: Switches the running session's persona and speaking style in place with `/role <id>`, adds the persona as its own prompt section after the deployment persona (it never overrides the host identity line) without touching tools or skills; roles are plain `ROLE.md` files and each switch is announced in the transcript.
description.zh: 用 `/role <id>` 就地切换当前会话的人设与说话风格，以独立的 prompt section 追加在部署人设之后（不替换宿主身份行），不动工具与技能；角色是角色库里的 `ROLE.md` 纯文本文件，切换后会在会话里声明一次。

description.en: Shell tool with four Windows backends (PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2) plus an interactive PTY terminal; the MSYS2 backend starts bash.exe with -lc so /etc/profile puts /usr/bin and /mingw64/bin on PATH, and injects MSYSTEM=MINGW64 into the PTY environment. Written in TypeScript, targets DSH 0.1.2+.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上支持 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2 四种后端，外加交互式 PTY 终端；MSYS2 后端以 bash.exe -lc 启动，让 /etc/profile 把 /usr/bin 与 /mingw64/bin 带进 PATH，并为 PTY 环境注入 MSYSTEM=MINGW64。TypeScript 编写，面向 DSH 0.1.2+。

description.en: Academic literature search and citation tools for DeepSeek Harness: paper search via Crossref and OpenAlex with no API key, related-works discovery, and citation formatting in GB/T 7714, APA and BibTeX.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的学术文献检索与引用工具：基于 Crossref 与 OpenAlex 检索论文（无需 API key），支持相关工作发现，并可按 GB/T 7714、APA 与 BibTeX 格式生成引用。

description.en: An Obsidian-style knowledge base: ingest sources, let the LLM build and maintain an interlinked wiki, and ask questions grounded in it.
description.zh: 一个 Obsidian 风格的知识库：摄取资料，让 LLM 构建并维护互联 wiki，并基于它提问。

description.en: Use Kimi Code as the DSH agent loop over ACP, with approvals, slash commands, and local/remote (ssh+tmux) session attach.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 agent loop 换成 Kimi Code（ACP 直连）：审批、斜杠命令、本地与远程（ssh+tmux）会话接入。

description.en: A jar in the corner of the DSH web UI that picks what to watch on Bilibili: instead of the platform feed it searches your own interest axes, ranks by like, coin and favourite rate rather than view count, keeps a pool that accumulates across days, and has an LLM curate five picks with reasons that describe the content rather than the metrics.
description.zh: DSH 网页角落里的一只罐子，替你挑今天看哪几条 B 站视频：不走平台推荐流，照你自己写的兴趣轴去搜，按点赞、投币、收藏率而不是播放量排序，攒进一个跨天累积的池子，最后让模型挑出五条并写一句讲内容、不讲数据的理由。

description.en: Provide notebook‑style workbench and local shell for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
Provide notebook‑style workbench and local shell for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧边栏里直接打开、编辑和运行 Jupyter 笔记本，写代码跑结果不用切窗口。

description.en: OpenCode on DeepSeek Harness — DSH plugin that keeps OpenCode Zen + Go free-tier models working: session affinity, gateway origin headers, and tool-schema fallback.
description.zh: 让 OpenCode 免费模型在 DSH 上稳定可用，自动处理会话粘性、网关请求头和工具结构兼容。

description.en: 为会话增加管理菜单、归档会话管理、轮次级删除、重新生成，以及右侧话题快捷导航。Add a management menu for conversations, archive conversation management, delete by round, regenerate, and a quick topic navigation on the right.
description.zh: 给会话页加上管理菜单、归档、按轮次删除和重新生成，右侧还有话题快捷导航，日常管理更顺手。

description.en: Native iPhone companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, approvals, questions, notifications, and secure remote access.
description.zh: iPhone 原生伴侣插件，让你在手机上随时查看会话、处理审批、接收通知，还能安全远程访问 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Collapses global sidebar navigation into an icon grid with inline name hints, animated transitions, and drag-to-reorder.
description.zh: 将全局侧栏导航折叠为图标网格，提供即时名称提示、过渡动画和拖动排序。

description.en: Qoder CN adapter plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 帮 DeepSeek Harness 直连 Qoder 国内服务，自动搞定签名和加密传输，让你轻松调模型。

description.en: Archived: continued in Yurzi/dsh-tool-web-enhanced (dsh-web-search-enhanced 0.2.0+). Multi-protocol web_search provider for DeepSeek Harness (0.1.x)
description.zh: 给每个会话单独选网页搜索方式，免密钥也能用，还能接自己的密钥或 DeepSeek 搜索。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 AI 翻唱插件：9 个工具串起分离 → 换声 → 移调 → 混音 → 验收，JavaScript 零运行时依赖，重活交给 MSST / DDSP 两套 Python 工程。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用 9 个工具把歌曲分离、换声、移调、混音到验收一条龙跑完，本地就能做 AI 翻唱。

description.en: DSH Web plugin: web ui
description.zh: 给提问自动加锚点并优化提示词，还能自定义指令、随手调用 DeepSeek API。

description.en: RigorQuant preset + skill pack: unattended walled multi-agent research for empirical and computational mathematics (economics, finance, portfolio), with a four-part pre-implementation check battery and a jacobian/Lean escalation lane.
description.zh: RigorQuant 预设与技能包：面向实证与计算数学（经济学、金融、组合）的无人值守隔离多智能体研究，内置四重实现前校验与 jacobian/Lean 升级通道。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-rigorquant
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-rigorquant

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: A contract-preserving context runtime for long-horizon agents on DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让长任务智能体不丢上下文：压缩对话历史的同时守住关键约定，跑得久也不跑偏。

description.en: Local-first voice conversations for DSH. Run speech recognition and speech synthesis on your own machine, with optional external providers.
description.zh: 在本地跑语音识别和语音合成，让 DSH 支持实时语音对话，也可接入外部服务。

description.en: OpenAI Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with ChatGPT OAuth, native settings, and account usage.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenAI Codex 模型，支持 ChatGPT 账号登录、原生设置与用量查看，开箱即用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: OAuth / subscription-plan LLM providers (Grok, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Anthropic, OpenRouter)
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入订阅制 LLM 服务，支持 Grok、GitHub Copilot、OpenAI Codex 等，用 OAuth 登录即可调用。

description.en: Edits assistant replies and thinking chains in DSH sessions so the model sees the edited text, live via message projection or on disk.
description.zh: 编辑 DSH 会话中的助手回复与思维链，让模型采信改后的内容：在线经 message projection 立即生效，或落盘改写会话记录。

description.en: Bring the WorkBuddy accounts signed in on this machine into DSH, managing CN and international accounts separately. Supports automatic failover between accounts, one-click refresh of model catalogs and credits, the CN daily check-in, and a togglable OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: 将本机登录的 WorkBuddy 多账号接入 DSH，国内版与国际版分开管理。支持账号故障自动切换、一键刷新模型目录与积分、国内版每日签到，以及可开关的 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: Zotero library in a read-only sidebar panel: browse collections, search items, read metadata and full text, and insert a single citation, a selected excerpt, or a whole collection into the conversation draft. A self-hosted bridge connects to the local Zotero integration MCP and registers its tools to the model as mcp__zotero__*, each one individually toggleable.
description.zh: 把 Zotero 文献库放进只读右侧栏面板：浏览分类树、搜索条目、查看元数据与 PDF 全文，并把单条目引用、划词摘录或整目录引用写进会话草稿。插件自持连接本机 Zotero 集成 MCP，把工具以 mcp__zotero__* 注册给模型，可按工具逐个启用 / 禁用。

description.en: Adds Delete to the DSH sidebar session menu, moving the session — and its whole descendant tree when it has subagents — into a recycle bin that relocates the directory on disk (an atomic rename, never a copy), plus a sidebar bin panel with title and full-text search, workspace filter, sorting, per-session chat-log viewer, restore and permanent delete. Deleting also clears the workspace slot, the pin, the archive flag and the projection-cache row, so a restore puts the session back at its original sidebar position; permanent deletion also clears the schedules bound to it and removes the emptied project directory. Verified on DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2, with a whole-profile residue scan coming back clean.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单中加入「删除」，把会话——带子代理时连同整棵后代树——搬进回收站（目录在磁盘上整体 rename 迁走，原子操作，不做复制），并提供侧栏回收站面板：标题与正文搜索、工作区筛选、排序、查看对话记录、恢复与彻底删除。删除时同时摘掉工作区槽位、置顶与归档标记以及投影缓存行，恢复时把会话放回侧栏原位置；彻底删除时清掉绑定该会话的定时任务并删除空掉的工程目录。已在 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 上真机验证，删除后全盘无残留。

description.en: dsh-plugin: OKF v0.2 topic memory for dsh - local-first git-tracked bundle, hot-path LLM-free injection, two-stage observer with background distill
description.zh: 把工作记忆整理成本地知识包，自动提炼重点，让AI随时记住上下文，无需重复说明。

description.en: Novel writer plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让一群 AI 智能体帮你写长篇小说，写完还能一键生成带插图的网站发布。

description.en: Rust 实现的 Windows 原生 POSIX bash 执行器：给 DSH 提供一个真正的 bash（brush 引擎，不依赖 WSL 或 MSYS兼容层），支持 DSH 的三档权限策略、提供持久化终端工具
description.zh: 在 Windows 上直接跑真正的 bash，不用装 WSL 或 MSYS，支持权限策略和后台作业。

description.en: DSH 会话可读导出：把 DeepSeek Harness 会话导出成可读的 Markdown / HTML / 纯文本 / ZIP 文字稿（思考块、工具调用与结果、代码块、图片、时间戳、标题与用量）
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话导出成能直接读的 Markdown、HTML 或 ZIP 文字稿，思考、工具调用、代码和图片都保留。

description.en: Cross-session persona and diary for DeepSeek Harness: a local gate decides whether a turn is worth remembering, then one extra model call turns it into a first-person diary entry plus an impression of the user, where every impression carries the specific moment that produced it. Later conversations inject about 2000 tokens of that as a self-memory block in three registers: a persona core, a section for judgements the model wrote itself, and the diary. There is a tool for the model to record a judgement in its own words, and a plain markdown hand-note file the human can write into which the plugin only ever reads. A sidebar panel lets you read, forget or export the archive, and forgetting demotes an entry rather than deleting it, so an old one still surfaces on a strong topical match. Local-only, secrets are stripped before anything is sent, and the archive is a plain folder you can read, edit or carry to another account. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话人格与日记：本地闸门判断一轮值不值得记，值得才追加一次模型调用，产出一条第一人称日记加一份对用户的印象 —— 每条印象都带着产生它的那个具体瞬间。之后的对话把约 2000 token 的自我记忆注入系统提示词，分三种声音：人格内核、以及「我自己想的」那一栏（模型自己写下的判断）、还有日记。模型有一个工具能用自己的话记下判断；人则有一个纯 markdown 的手记文件可以手写，插件只读它、永不覆盖。侧栏面板能看、能删、能带走；遗忘是降级而不是删除，所以强相关的旧事仍然会被想起来。全程本地、发送前先拦掉密钥、档案是一个可读可改、能换账号带走的普通文件夹。零运行时依赖，无构建步骤。

description.en: A customizable widget rail for the right side of DeepSeek Harness: 61 cards covering session stats, tokens and cache, context, background jobs, subagents, machine metrics, OpenCode Go and Command Code quota, session cost, peak pricing and the GitHub review queue. Cards install from an in-rail market into 1-4 column grids and 2x2 or 2x4 tiles, with per-instance settings, a magnification wave under the pointer and a one-click hide. Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x, web UI and desktop app.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧的可自定义部件栏：61 个部件覆盖会话统计、token 与缓存、上下文、后台任务、子代理、机器指标、OpenCode Go 与 Command Code 额度、会话成本、峰谷定价与 GitHub 待审队列；部件可在栏内市场安装，支持 1-4 列网格与 2x2 / 2x4 尺寸、逐实例配置、指针划过放大波峰与一键整栏收起。支持 DSH 0.1.x / 0.2.x，网页版与桌面端通用。

description.en: Provider-neutral dual-subagent orchestrator preset for DeepSeek Harness

Host-side degeneration guard for DSH: strips garbage code points, detects repetition collapse and discards the attempt before it enters history, and can retroactively decontaminate a poisoned session.
description.zh: 在模型输出跑偏复读时及时掐断，避免垃圾内容污染上下文，还能清理已被带坏的会话。

description.en: Agent-first DeepSeek Harness plugin intelligence: verify existing plugins, identify missing capabilities, and generate build-ready briefs.
description.zh: Run a read-only capability preflight before changing or building for DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个侧边问答面板，随手提问、快速查资料，不用离开当前界面。

description.zh: 一只蓝色大肥鱼桌宠，会跟着 Harness 的工作状态变化，陪你用官方桌面版。

description.en: Lifecycle notification layer for AI coding agents — DeepSeek Harness plugin for turn, job, review & failure notifications
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness task-completion reminder plugin

description.en: Intelligent token optimization via Jev System One triage, dynamic tool pruning, and subagent routing.
description.zh: 基于 Jev System One 分流、动态工具裁剪与子代理路由的智能 Token 优化插件。

description.en: Rotates the DSH app background wallpaper from a folder on a timer with cross-fade transitions; falls back to four bundled SVG gradients when no folder is set, and adds background-opacity, wallpaper-dimming, blur and text-shadow controls so panels and text stay readable.
description.zh: 按设定间隔从指定文件夹轮换 DSH 应用背景壁纸（带交叉淡化）；未配置文件夹时使用随插件分发的 4 张 SVG 渐变壁纸，并提供背景不透明度、壁纸压暗、毛玻璃模糊与文字阴影四个可读性调节，让面板与文字在花哨的图上仍然看得清。

description.en: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的钉钉群聊常驻个人助理插件
description.zh: 把钉钉群聊接上 DeepSeek Harness，让 AI 助理常驻群里帮你干活、自动处理任务。

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 AG-UI 协议网关，让智能体工具交互更顺畅。

description.zh: 本地一次算完108种术数合盘，模型只读结果，省时省钱还不出错。

description.zh: 给 DSH 加一层本地记忆，靠触发信号在对的时候想起该记的事，数据全存本地单文件。

description.zh: 让 agent 改完代码先跑构建测试再重启，起不来自动回滚，自托管运维更省心。

description.en: Detects which conversation model an account is being served: launches concurrent throwaway probe conversations, scores each streaming chain-of-thought by how its paragraphs open, and cancels probes that read as the older model within seconds. Includes an offline self-check that replays 13 hand-labelled chains-of-thought through the same classifier.
description.zh: 检测账号当前被分配到哪个对话模型：并发发起一次性探测会话，按段落开头的写法为流式思维链打分，读起来像旧模型的在数秒内中止。附带离线自检，用同一分类器回放 13 条人工标注的思维链。

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中为每次工具调用执行策略检查，确保操作安全合规。

description.zh: 把 Codex CLI 的对话记录、MCP 服务器和记忆一键迁移到 DeepSeek Harness，无缝切换开发环境。

description.en: Nested (tree-shaped) todo_write tool plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — the mutually-exclusive alternative to the flat dsh-tool-todo
description.zh: 把待办事项按树形层级嵌套管理，让复杂任务的分支和子任务一目了然。

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 侧边栏的「新会话」拆成两种模式：「日常聊天」在专属工作区里用插件自己安装到 harness home 的 `daily` 预设开一个只有人格、网页检索/抓取、提问和上下文压缩的轻量会话（没有文件、Shell、计划模式和子代理），侧边栏只列这些日常会话；「开始工作」保持原有编码 Agent；原生「新会话」按钮被隐藏，其余「新会话」入口按当前模式路由，模式存在 localStorage。

description.en: Claude Code integration plugin for DeepSeek Harness, providing native Claude conversations powered by the Claude Agent SDK, with approvals, session continuity, and DSH tool support.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 接入 DeepSeek Harness，让你在 DSH 里直接和 Claude 对话，支持审批、会话续聊和 DSH 工具调用。

description.en: DSH web UI 悬浮面板：OpenCode Go 月度/滚动/每周额度余额 + 用量监控（key 本地读取，各自显示自己的余额）
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面挂个悬浮窗，实时看 DeepSeek、OpenCode Go 等四家额度余额和用量。

description.en: Cristiano Ronaldo desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: a chibi Portugal number 7 mascot in a bottom-right overlay whose animation follows the agent state — dribbling while tools run, thinking during a turn, waiting at approvals, diving on errors — and jumping in a SIU celebration with a host-process sound when a turn completes; it can be dragged, looks at the cursor on hover, dives on a triple click, and a settings panel manages several pets and imports custom spritesheets. It also runs as a borderless, always-on-top native Windows window that keeps living after the browser is closed: hovering shows the current workspace and conversation title, double-clicking opens the Harness page in Edge, and dragging, mouse-wheel resizing and a right-click menu work there too, sharing position, size and behaviour with the web panel. Pet sheets may use any cell resolution and scale preserving aspect ratio (atlas.scaling: smooth | pixelated). v2.2 adds a video route — feed it a clip (green screen or ordinary footage) and its real motion becomes the pet animations, via automatic backdrop sampling, chroma keying with spill suppression, motion-based segment splitting and union-bbox alignment; already-extracted PNG frames work too, with no video decoder installed, and the clip audio can be cut into per-action sounds. Pets can also be published to the community gallery under the DPSL-1.0 sharing declaration, and installed from it in one click. v2.3 adapts it to DSH 0.2 desktop clients — the celebration sound now falls back to spawning PowerShell when the host no longer provides the shell service — and makes a single click play a short, configurable taunt animation (`interactions.clickAnim`).
description.zh: DSH 桌宠：Web 界面右下角的 C 罗精灵，动画随 Agent 状态切换——工具执行中颠球、回合中思考、等待审批、出错假摔——回合完成时跳起 SIU 庆祝并由宿主进程播放提示音；支持拖动、悬停注视光标、连点三次假摔，设置面板可管理多只宠物并导入自定义 spritesheet。同时提供一个无边框、始终置顶的原生 Windows 窗口，关掉浏览器也还在：悬停显示当前工作区与对话名，双击用 Edge 打开 Harness 页面，拖动、滚轮改大小、右键菜单都可用，位置/大小/行为与网页设置面板共用同一份状态。素材单格分辨率不限、等比缩放（atlas.scaling: smooth | pixelated）。v2.2 新增视频路线：喂一段视频（绿幕或普通素材都行），里面的真实动作直接变成宠物动作——自动取幕布色、色度抠像带溢色抑制、按运动量切分动作、并集包围盒对齐落格；也支持直接喂已经抽好的 PNG 帧（不需要装视频解码器），并能把视频原声按动作切成音效。宠物还可按 DPSL-1.0 分享协议发布到宠物社区，并从社区一键安装。 v2.3 适配 DSH 0.2 桌面版——宿主不再提供 shell 服务时，庆祝音效改为直接启动 PowerShell 播放——并让单击播放一段可配置的挑衅动作（`interactions.clickAnim`）。

description.zh: 描述统计/百分位数/频数分布/相关性。
