description.en: Native DSH rooms for connecting independent Sessions and provider-backed AI members—without bundled roles or scenarios.
description.zh: 把多个独立会话和AI成员拉进同一个房间，自由协作，不预设角色和场景。

description.en: Adds local PDF reading, a durable paper library, traceable evidence records, and cross-paper comparison and synthesis tools.
description.zh: 提供本地 PDF 阅读、持久论文库、可追溯证据记录，以及跨论文比较与综合工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 子 Agent 派发插件：按任务为子代理选模型、推理强度与工具范围，常用组合存成命名方案随时复用；内置安全检查、成本估算与节省分析、完整派发决策台账。
description.zh: 为子代理按任务智能选模型、调推理强度和工具范围，方案可复用，内置安全检查与成本估算，派发决策全程留痕。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that aggressively saves tokens without affecting task quality: lossless head/tail truncation of tool results (default), grep-result folding, pressure-triggered dsh-compaction-basic delegation, and an LLM-summary CompactionEngine subclass for the aggressive mode. Saves 97.6% of input tokens on an 8-scenario synthetic suite, with all reductions routed through dsh event flow so model-visible = logged stays intact.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设计的 token 节省插件：不损失任务效果。默认 conservative 档对工具结果做无损头尾裁剪与 grep 折叠；balanced 档在压力阈值委托 dsh-compaction-basic；aggressive 档以 LLM-summary 引擎子类化替换官方压缩。8 个合成场景累计节省 97.6% 输入 tokens，所有削减走 dsh 事件流，model-visible = logged 不变式仍成立。

description.en: dsh-think-autoexpand：让 DeepSeek Harness 里的 Think 思考行始终可见，并在流式输出时自动展开，实时查看 Agent 完整推理过程；保留工具卡折叠体验。
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 中的思考过程始终可见并自动展开，实时查看 Agent 完整推理，同时保留工具卡折叠体验。

description.en: Omni Router - auto-routing DeepSeek Harness preset: simple tasks run directly, complex tasks plan first with approval gate.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层任务级可靠性，自动判断何时介入、验证证据并处理失败，让结果更靠谱。

description.en: Prompt enhancement for the composer: an "✨ Enhance" button rewrites your draft prompt into a clearer, more structured version with first-principles thinking, grounded in session context, memory and recent conversation; asks clarifying questions in a card when key info is missing, then previews the result before applying it to the input.
description.zh: 输入框提示词增强：✨ 增强按钮用第一性原理、结合会话上下文/记忆/最近对话，把草稿扩写为更清晰、更结构化的提示词；关键信息缺失时以提问卡片澄清，预览确认后再应用到输入框。

description.en: Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern knowledge base for DSH: wiki-write/wiki-search skills, zero-dependency pipeline (lint/index/mnemon memory sync/quality feedback), minimal lifecycle plugin injecting schema + knowledge preview, SiliconFlow semantic recall via an Ollama-compatible proxy.
description.zh: Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式的 DSH 知识库系统：wiki-write/wiki-search 技能引导模型写读 Obsidian wiki，零依赖管线（lint/索引/mnemon 记忆体同步/质量闭环），极简生命周期插件注入守则与知识预览，Ollama 兼容代理接 SiliconFlow 语义召回。

description.en: 会话/工作区快捷操作插件：一键打开工作区、编辑器自动发现、DeepSeek 网页版同款用户消息导航条、会话待办标记、硬性重启
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个快捷操作面板：一键开工作区、自动找编辑器、消息导航条和会话待办标记。

description.en: A content-aware PDF reading plugin for vision models: profiles each page for figures (vector and raster), tables, formula risk and double-column layout, then applies content-aware hybrid extraction, rendering figure/table/formula pages as high-DPI region crops. Provides a low-resolution preview to understand the page layout, and renders a specified region at high resolution. Packaged as multiple tools for agents.
description.zh: 面向视觉模型的内容感知 PDF 读取插件：逐页分析图（矢量与栅格）、表格、公式风险与双栏排版，基于内容识别进行混合提取，图表/公式页渲染成高 DPI 区域裁切。提供低清预览以理解页面概况并支持指定选区获取高清渲染。功能包装为多个工具供Agent使用。

description.en: Browse the public skillhub.cn catalog from Settings and install selected SKILL.md bundles into ~/.dsh/skills.
description.zh: 在设置页浏览 skillhub.cn 公开技能目录，并将选中的 SKILL.md 技能包安装到 ~/.dsh/skills。

description.en: Manage Git-backed DSH plugin markets, installed agent skills and optional Codex hooks from the web settings page.
description.zh: 在网页设置页管理基于 Git 的 DSH 插件市场、已安装的 agent 技能和可选 Codex hooks。

description.en: Conversation Landmarks (对话地标) for DeepSeek Harness — fixed navigation and hover previews for long agent conversations.
description.zh: 为超长智能体对话提供固定导航和悬停预览，快速定位历史消息，告别滚动查找。

description.en: Hardening guard for mcp__omni__parse in DeepSeek Harness: a tools/pre-execute listener that denies private/reserved host URLs (SSRF), enforces an allow-list or ask (consent), and is fail-closed when allowedRoots is empty.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 mcp__omni__parse 加固护栏：tools/pre-execute 监听器拒绝私网/保留主机（SSRF），施加白名单或 ask（同意），allowedRoots 为空时 fail-closed。

description.en: Select any text in a conversation and tap the Explain button to get a streaming Markdown explanation bubble, with recursive follow-up questions.
description.zh: 对话中框选任意文字后点击「解释」按钮，弹出 Markdown 实时流式解释气泡，支持递归追问。

description.en: Shows coding-plan usage and balance for 5 AI providers (MiniMax, DeepSeek, Kimi, OpenRouter, Zhipu) beside the composer input, switching with the selected model and reusing API keys configured in DSH model settings.
description.zh: 在 composer 输入框旁显示 5 家 AI 套餐用量与余额（MiniMax、DeepSeek、Kimi、OpenRouter、智谱），跟随当前模型自动切换，复用 DSH 模型设置里已配的 API Key。

description.en: Local-first Agent Experience Network for DeepSeek Harness, distilling task-level experiences from traces and live manifests, grading by H0-H4 evidence, discovering by compatibility, and promoting only after explicit review.
description.zh: 为智能体提供统一的体验网络，简化多工具接入与协作，提升开发效率。

description.en: Community search, similarity analysis, and install/dedupe/build-it-yourself decisions for the dsh-plugin ecosystem.
description.zh: DSH 插件生态的社区搜索、相似度分析与安装/去重/自建决策工具。

description.en: Context Assembler plugin for DeepSeek Harness: topic-block context assembly, water-pressure topic splitting, tool trace/rewrite, reality recall injection and handoff planning.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 上下文汇编插件：话题块上下文汇编、水位压力话题切割、工具轮压缩/改写、reality 召回注入与 handoff 规划。

description.en: Multi-lens structural analysis skill: adversarial-first analysis across 16 lenses in 4 categories with 10 structural tools, confidence calibration, and fact-bound layered output.
description.zh: 多视角深层结构分析技能：16 透镜 4 类别、10 个结构工具，先攻击默认立场，产出置信度校准、事实绑定的分层结论。

description.en: Adds CC Switch providers and models to DeepSeek Harness, with provider filtering and model-name search.
description.zh: 将 CC Switch 中的 provider 和模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并支持 provider 筛选和模型名称搜索。

description.en: Scans 20+ AI agents on this machine (Codex, Claude Code, cc-switch, Hermes, opencode, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, CodeBuddy, Trae, OpenClaw, Qoder, WorkBuddy, Zcode, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code, Qwen Code, ...) and one-click syncs, manages and adds their MCP servers and skills into DSH — global or per-workspace.
description.zh: 扫描本机 20+ 种 AI agent 的 MCP 服务器与 Skills（Codex、Claude Code、cc-switch、Hermes、opencode、Gemini、Grok、Kimi、CodeBuddy、Trae、OpenClaw、Qoder、WorkBuddy、Zcode、Cursor、Windsurf、Cline、Roo Code、Qwen Code 等），一键同步、管理并添加进 DSH（全局或按工作区）。

description.en: Mobile client plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web shell: off-canvas sidebar/details drawers, bottom nav bar, and a touch-first responsive layout below 768px
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页终端提供移动端适配，在窄屏下自动切换为触控友好的侧边栏、底部导航和响应式布局。

description.en: Wallpaper Engine integration for the dsh web GUI: scan the local WE library (Steam workshop 431960 + local projects) and use its wallpapers as the page background — image/video/web rendered natively, scene wallpapers as softened static previews — with a wallpaper-design panel (opacity, scope, blur, vignette, fps, parallax, carousel, theme linkage) and agent tools wallpaper_scan/list/set/config.
description.zh: Wallpaper Engine 壁纸联动：把本机下载的 WE 壁纸（创意工坊 431960 + 本地 projects）设为 DSH Web GUI 页面背景（图片/视频/网页原样渲染，场景壁纸柔化为静态预览），侧边栏「壁纸设计」面板可调不透明度、作用范围、填充、模糊、暗角、帧率、视差、轮播与主题联动，附 wallpaper_scan/list/set/config 四个 agent 工具。

description.en: dsh wps云文档插件
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness对话里直接用自然语言管WPS云文档，查文件、读内容、建文档轻松搞定。

description.en: Auto-injects user-chosen skills into DSH sessions, either every prompt or once at session start, with a settings page and a composer indicator.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中自动注入所选技能（如 caveman、ponytail）：每轮提示或仅在会话开始时，含设置页与输入区指示。

description.en: A marquee mood-light ring around the DSH web UI edge that reacts to session state, turning green while the agent works, pink when done, and yellow when something needs attention, with colors, ring width, rotation speed, and flash frequency configurable from the settings panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面边缘的跑马灯氛围光环：随会话状态自动变色（运行中绿色流动、完成粉色、有待处理黄色警告），设置面板可调颜色、光圈宽度、转速与闪动频率。

description.en: Home Assistant control for DeepSeek Harness agents — approval-gated lights, switches, climate. 给 DeepSeek Harness agent 的 Home Assistant 控制…
description.zh: Home Assistant control for DeepSeek Harness agents — approval-gated lights, switches, climate. 给 DeepSeek Harness agent 的 Home Assistant 控制…

description.en: Developer tools panel for the DSH web UI: file browser with preview, edit, and path-only file mentions; multi-tab terminals with quick commands; Git panel with commit, push, pull, and branch switching; and background job management. UI ported from pi-web-ui.
description.zh: dsh Web UI 开发者工具面板：文件浏览/预览/编辑与路径式文件提及、多终端（快捷命令）、Git 面板（提交/推送/拉取/分支）与后台任务管理。UI 移植自 pi-web-ui。

description.en: VibeOS inside DeepSeek Harness: the whole web UI becomes a virtual desktop whose app windows are HTML the model writes as you use them.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的网页界面变成虚拟桌面，模型随手写 HTML 就能开出一个应用窗口。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher bundle for DSH Web that creates a managed shortcut, then restarts DSH in the background and refreshes the existing browser page.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 Windows 桌面启动器插件，创建受管理的快捷方式，后续启动会在后台重启 DSH 并刷新已有浏览器页面。

description.en: WeChat automation for DSH: push task progress to WeChat, listen for messages with keyword auto-reply, and a WeChat ↔ DSH two-way bridge controllable from the settings page, built on wxauto4.
description.zh: 基于 wxauto4 的微信自动化插件：任务进度微信推送、消息监听（关键词自动回复）、微信⇄DSH 双向桥，设置页开关与配置。

description.en: One-click enter/exit Plan mode for the DSH web input bar, a quick-click shortcut for /plan.
description.zh: 输入框一键进/出 Plan 模式（/plan 的快捷点击），常驻小按钮。

description.en: Verified plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness — discover, inspect, install, and remove DSH plugins from the Web UI.
description.zh: 在网页端直接浏览、安装和管理 DeepSeek Harness 插件，发现经过验证的插件市场。

description.en: Schierke forest-spirit grimoire skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI
description.zh: 把 DSH 网页界面变成一册史尔基灵界田野志，侧栏、消息、代码都化作页边批注与墨块，沉浸式魔法书体验。

description.en: DeepSeek 官网视觉风格主题 (dsh-plugin) — 官网流体背景 / 交互网格 / 粒子鱼 LOGO / 标题聚光灯 / 磨砂玻璃，双主题自适应
DeepSeek API 余额 + OpenCodeGo 余量实时显示插件（dsh web GUI）：可拖拽双段徽章与详情弹层 + DeepSeek/OpenCodeGo 两个设置页；Key 仅存本机 ~/.dsh/ds-balance.json，OpenCodeGo Key 自动读取 DSH 凭据
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 网页界面左下角实时显示账户余额，徽章可拖拽，点击查看多币种详情。

description.en: Desktop computer use for DeepSeek Harness: macOS app listing, accessibility-tree window capture, screenshots, and synthesized input, cloned from Codex Computer Use
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 直接操控你的 Mac：列出应用、截屏、读取窗口并模拟键鼠操作，实现桌面自动化。

description.en: Whale desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: live agent status + API balance as a circular sea level, with jump/dive interactions
A loop dock for DeepSeek Harness: one harness, multiple agent loops.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Native desktop and webhook notifications for turn completions, failures, and approval requests, with outcome filters, content rules, privacy controls, and retrying delivery.
description.zh: 回合完成、失败和待审批时发送跨平台本机通知与 Webhook，支持结果过滤、内容规则、隐私控制和失败重试。

description.en: Use third-party subscription accounts in DeepSeek Harness: chat, image understanding, image generation, and image editing with the models your subscription covers, with available models and reasoning levels synced from your account; currently supports OpenAI/ChatGPT subscriptions, more providers planned.
description.zh: 用第三方订阅账户在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用订阅覆盖的模型：文字对话、图片理解、图片生成与图片编辑，可用模型与推理等级随账户自动同步；当前支持 OpenAI / ChatGPT 订阅，更多订阅服务规划中。

description.en: ChatGPT-style select→ask for DeepSeek Harness Web: select text in a conversation, a floating 「询问 DeepSeek」 button appears — click it to quote the selection into the composer.
description.zh: 在对话中选中文本，一键引用到输入框，快速追问 DeepSeek，省去复制粘贴的麻烦。

description.en: PBR 3D model preview for game art: GLB/GLTF with textures, IBL environment lighting, orbit controls, and a material channel inspector (baseColor/normal/roughness/metallic/AO/emissive/wireframe); scalar channels shown as grayscale per PBR spec, via the pbr3d fence and pbr_render tool.
description.zh: 游戏美术 PBR 3D 模型预览：GLB/GLTF 带贴图纹理、IBL 环境光照、轨道控制，以及材质通道检查器（基础色/法线/粗糙度/金属度/AO/自发光/线框），标量通道按 PBR 规范以灰度显示，通过 pbr3d 围栏与 pbr_render 工具使用。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and session cost under the composer, with a live peak/off-peak pricing badge (Beijing time), a countdown to the next pricing switch, hover price tables, and usage advice.
description.zh: 输入框下方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与本会话花费，余额前带峰/谷价格徽章（北京时间）与距切换倒计时，悬停看两档单价明细与使用建议。

description.en: LLM provider that runs the locally installed Claude Code CLI as the model backend, so requests go through an existing Claude subscription instead of a metered API key; native tool calls are bridged over MCP.
description.zh: LLM 供应商：把本机已安装的 Claude Code CLI 作为模型后端，请求走已订阅的 Claude 账号，无需按量计费的 API key；原生工具调用经 MCP 桥接。

description.en: Four-module session companion: smart conversation export (Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG long-image with privacy redaction and batch ZIP), context handoff summaries with template save/import, API cost optimization (live official pricing, peak/off-peak scheduling, daily/monthly budgets, model routing), and global conversation search with in-chat find (Ctrl+F, CSS Custom Highlight API).
description.zh: 四模块会话伴侣：对话智能导出（Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG 长图、隐私脱敏、批量 ZIP）、上下文交接摘要（模板保存与导入继承）、API 成本优化（官方动态计价、峰谷调度、日/月双档预算、模型路由）、全局对话检索与对话内搜索（Ctrl+F、CSS Custom Highlight API）。

description.en: Customizable brand area for the Web UI: replace the whale logo and DeepSeek wordmark with local images, and edit the HARNESS badge text (double-click to change, right-click to reset).
description.zh: Web UI 品牌区自定义：鲸鱼 logo 与 DeepSeek 文字可换成本地图片，HARNESS 徽章文字可双击编辑（双击修改，右键恢复）。

description.en: Use DSH from iPhone/iPad: an explicit-opt-in LAN reverse proxy (Host/Origin rewrite through the loopback trust fence, WebSocket upgrades included), iOS PWA chrome (home-screen icon, standalone meta, viewport-fit), and touch/mobile CSS (safe areas, keyboard lifting, composer row fit).
description.zh: 让 DSH 在 iPhone/iPad 上可用：显式开启的局域网反向代理（改写 Host/Origin 通过回环信任栅栏，含 WebSocket 升级）、iOS PWA 外壳（主屏幕图标、standalone meta、viewport-fit）、触屏/移动端 CSS（安全区、键盘避让、输入框按钮行适配）。

description.en: Create, read, and edit PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, and PDF via the local zagens-office CLI as office_schema / office_write / office_edit / office_read tools.
description.zh: 通过本机 zagens-office CLI 读写编辑 PPTX / DOCX / XLSX / PDF，注册为 office_schema / office_write / office_edit / office_read。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness provider for GPT models using managed ChatGPT OAuth through Codex app-server
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness provider for GPT models using managed ChatGPT OAuth through Codex app-server

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件商店：浏览、搜索、筛选并一键安装 dsh-plugin 生态插件
description.zh: 在 DSH 里逛插件商店，搜索筛选一键装，轻松管好你的插件生态。

description.en: Secure remote access for the official Web UI: authenticated LAN/tunnel gateway with QR + HMAC one-time pairing, per-device sessions and revocation, mDNS discovery, and a fork_session tool.
description.zh: 官方 Web UI 的安全远程接入：带认证的局域网/隧道网关，QR + HMAC 一次性配对、按设备吊销，mDNS 发现，附 fork_session 会话分叉工具。

description.en: Two-tier model routing: a strong tier plans, advises and reviews while a cheap tier implements, with plan-mode-aware auto routing, a high-impact escalation guard, failure auto-escalation, and subagent tiering.
description.zh: 双档模型路由：强档负责规划/咨询/评审、弱档负责实现；含计划模式自动路由、高危操作守卫、失败自动升级与子代理分层。

description.en: Connects DSH to Timeline Studio for `.timeline` project inspection, semantic edit previews, transactional edits, and verified MP4 rendering.
description.zh: 把 Timeline Studio 的确定性时间线编辑能力接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 AI 能直接检查、编辑和渲染视频项目。

description.en: DeepSeek balance and token usage in the web sidebar, with a today/all-time toggle and provider filtering.
description.zh: dsh 网页侧边栏的 DeepSeek 余额与 token 用量监控：今日/累计切换，并按 provider 过滤其他厂商。

description.en: File-drag fork: drop documents as removable chips above the composer, send without typing.
description.zh: 拖放 fork：文档以可删除「文件芯片」挂在输入框上方，不打字也能发送。

description.en: DSH Web GUI activity heatmap plugin: GitHub-style commit/token/spend heatmap in the sidebar with per-model cost estimation
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏常驻显示近 90 天活动热力图，可切换提交/Token/花费维度，并实时统计今日消耗与模型费用。

description.en: A model-native meta-agent plugin for DeepSeek Harness that uses the underlying model’s reasoning and planning capabilities to synthesize task-specific workflows at runtime and coordinate tools and subagents.
description.zh: 让模型自己当总指挥，按任务现场编排工作流，自动调度工具和子代理干活。

description.en: LAN mobile gateway: isolated child-process reverse proxy with first-visit approval, per-device token binding, rate limiting, and mobile layout injection (compact composer pills, randomUUID polyfill).
description.zh: 局域网手机访问网关：独立子进程反向代理 + 首次访问审批 + 设备令牌绑定 + 限流 + 手机端紧凑排版注入（输入区权限/模型小胶囊、randomUUID polyfill）。

description.en: DSH self-updater in the settings page: one-click check/pull (`git pull --ff-only`), auto background checks, version diff and changelog preview with a red-dot reminder.
description.zh: 设置页中的 DSH 自助更新器：一键检查/拉取（git pull --ff-only）、自动后台检查、版本对比与更新说明预览，带红点提醒。

description.en: Harness Pet — an unofficial community pet for DeepSeek Harness. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or maintained by DeepSeek.
description.zh: 社区小宠物：一只住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的小鲸鱼。

description.en: Document reading mode for DSH.
description.zh: DSH 文档阅读模式。

description.en: Adjust the width of dsh's reply.
description.zh: Adjust the width of dsh's reply.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话引用(cue)插件
description.zh: 跨会话引用对话结点，把历史上下文快照直接注入当前对话，让模型无需翻找即可读取。

description.en: Embedded task management engine: decision-point protocol, idea capture wall, Linear-style issue store.
description.zh: 嵌入式任务管理引擎：决策点协议、念头捕获墙、Linear 形 issue 存储。

description.en: Bridge to the Telegram Bot API: long polling, per-chat sessions, HTML formatting.
description.zh: Telegram Bot API 桥接：长轮询、per-chat 会话、HTML 格式化。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: quiz-style reading (答题式阅读) of any Markdown document — 5-stage game loop with a sidebar panel and a reading-area ta…
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件商店：浏览、搜索、筛选并一键安装 dsh-plugin 生态插件
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件商店：浏览、搜索、筛选并一键安装 dsh-plugin 生态插件

description.en: Ready-to-publish DeepSeek Harness plugin skeleton: bundle format, tool DSL, config, tests, and a scaffold script
description.zh: 开箱即发的插件骨架：bundle 格式、工具 DSL、配置、测试和脚手架脚本齐全。

description.en: Unofficial community pet for DeepSeek Harness — a native DSH web plugin
description.zh: harness-whale — DSH 插件（界面）

description.en: A Chrome-dino-style runner for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: play while the agent replies, score from 梁子 to 梁圣 on a persistent progress strip.
description.zh: 等待 Agent 回复时的恐龙快跑小游戏：常驻进度条从「梁子」冲向「梁圣」，折叠即暂停、任意键恢复。

description.en: A lightweight, general-purpose attachment Dock for DSH: paste, drop, or choose images, PDFs, documents, archives, code, and other files, review and manage them before sending, then pass them to the Agent as local paths. It gives non-image files a consistent attachment entry point.
description.zh: 一个轻量、通用的 DSH 附件 Dock：支持粘贴、拖入或选择图片、PDF、文档、压缩包、代码等文件，发送前统一查看和管理，再以本地路径交给 Agent；解决非图片文件缺少统一附件入口的问题。

description.en: Routes agent requests to configurable default, planner, and subagent models, automatically using the planner role in plan mode, with per-role reasoning effort and Web UI configuration.
description.zh: 按 default、planner 和 subagent 角色将代理请求路由到可配置模型，在计划模式下自动使用 planner，并提供逐角色推理强度与 Web UI 配置。

description.en: Adds a take screenshot tool plus two optional automatic capture points, putting the screen into the conversation as an image block; requires an image-capable model.
description.zh: 一个截图工具，外加两个默认关闭的自动截图时机。需要模型支持图片输入。

description.en: Durable multi-agent collaboration for DeepSeek Harness with channels, threads, tasks, and resumable agent sessions.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的持久化多 Agent 协作插件，提供频道、话题、任务与可恢复的 Agent 会话。

description.en: Toolbox plugin for the Web UI: session/trash/subdirectory/search/preset/config management, tag grouping, long-message collapse, and a scheduled heartbeat with optional IM channel push.
description.zh: Web 界面工具箱：会话/回收站/子目录/搜索/预设/配置管理、标签分组、长消息折叠，以及支持 IM 渠道推送的定时心跳。

description.en: A Mimi desktop companion for DSH that follows work-session states with animated reactions and bubbles, provides a separate chat mode, and bundles Windows Computer Use for observing and controlling desktop windows.
description.zh: DSH 的 Mimi 桌面伴侣，跟随工作会话状态显示动画反应和气泡，提供独立聊天模式，并内置 Windows Computer Use 以观察和操作桌面窗口。

description.en: TRAE-style conversation rollback — per-turn checkpoints (10-turn sliding window) roll back touched files and truncate model context in place, keeping the same session id. Human-initiated only: a /rollback command or a per-turn Web button (works on interrupted turns too), with a preview listing each affected file and its action — restore, recover, delete, or skip.
description.zh: TRAE 式「回退到本轮对话发起前」插件：按轮次建立检查点（10 轮滑动窗口），同时回滚工作区文件与原位截断模型上下文，保持同一 session id。回退只能由人发起：/rollback 命令或每轮的 Web 回退按钮（被中断的轮次也可用），弹窗逐条列出受影响文件及其动作（恢复/找回/删除/跳过）。

description.en: Static security scanner for DSH plugins: read-only audit (exec, credentials, exfiltration, obfuscation, install scripts, bundle manifest) with a 0-100 risk score.
description.zh: DSH 插件安全扫描器：只读静态审计（执行、凭据、外传、混淆、安装脚本、bundle 清单），输出 0-100 风险分。

description.en: One stylesheet that retypesets the DSH conversation to measured Codex metrics: 14/22 px body, tighter headings, lists and blocks, a rounded quote bar, and Tidy Tables with a themed header, row/column rules, full-width short tables and contained scrolling for wide tables; no settings or DOM rewriting, with real before/after captures.
description.zh: 一张样式表，按实测的 Codex 版式重排 DSH 对话页：14/22 px 正文，收紧标题、列表与块级节奏，使用圆角引用条，并把表格补成带主题化表头、行列分隔、短表铺满和宽表容器内滚动的 Tidy Tables；无设置项、不改写 DOM，仓库内附真实前后对比图。

description.en: Browses checkpoints produced by dsh-checkpoint-rewind as a timeline of time nodes and shows per-file line diffs between any two of them, with trace replay from session logs (no snapshot producer needed) and preview-first workspace rollback with single-shot undo, via /diff and /rollback commands, a JSON HTTP API, and a GUI panel.
description.zh: 把 dsh-checkpoint-rewind 产生的检查点变成时间线时间节点，任意两节点之间逐文件行级 diff；可从会话日志重放 trace 区间差异（无需快照生产者）；支持预览式工作区回滚与一次性撤销。提供 /diff、/rollback 命令、JSON HTTP API 与 GUI 面板。

description.en: Project-scoped Git credentials: forge accounts (GitHub, Gitea, GitLab, Bitbucket or a custom host) live in the right-sidebar "Git Forge" tab, are granted per project, and reach the agent as an HTTPS credential helper so the token never enters the conversation. Pushes to a host the project has not granted are rejected.
description.zh: 项目级 Git 凭据：forge 账号（GitHub、Gitea、GitLab、Bitbucket 或自定义域名）在右侧栏「Git 凭据」标签页里管理并可按项目授权，再由生成的凭据 helper 交给 agent 走 HTTPS 推送，token 不进对话；未授权 host 的推送会被拦截器直接拒绝。

description.en: Play different configurable sounds for five conversation events in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: normal completion, interrupt, error, approval wait, and auto-retry success; each event has its own audio setting and bundled default, with auto-retry after errors using a configurable wait (10-300s), plus a community sound library. Compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的不同触发情况可分别设置音频提醒：支持正常完成、中断、出错、等待确认、自动重连成功五种场景，每种场景都有独立音频配置和默认音效；出错后自动重连，等待时长可自定义（10-300 秒）；附带社区音色库下载；已适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2。

description.en: Four GitHub workflow skills for PR triage, review feedback, GitHub Actions diagnosis, and safe draft-PR publishing, reusing existing DSH capabilities with gh/git fallbacks.
description.zh: 四个面向 GitHub 工程工作流的 DSH Skill：PR 分诊、review 反馈、GitHub Actions 诊断和安全的 draft PR 发布；优先复用现有 DSH 能力，必要时回退到 gh/git。

description.en: Keeps a pool of models and routes every agent step to one of them with its reasoning effort set — configured by clicking in the composer, no JSON needed. The router takes over the composer's model cell, so one control shows the session's model and reasoning effort alongside the router's own settings. Three authorization scopes (model / effort / full) where a manual pick only counts in the scope that owns it, and in effort scope the router is bound to the one model you choose. Task presets with per-model weights, vision routing for image steps, session signals (active todo, context pressure, token budget, subagent depth), and an optional semantic task classifier. Thinking stays on, because DeepSeek rejects a thinking-enabled request whose history contains a tool call made with thinking off.
description.zh: 维护一个模型池，把每个 agent 步骤路由到池内模型并设置其思考等级——全部在输入栏点选配置，不需要写 JSON。路由面板接管输入栏的模型位置，同一个控件里既有本会话的模型与思考等级，也有路由自身的设置。三种授权范围（模型 / 思考 / 全部）：手动选择只在所属范围内生效；「思考」范围下路由只作用于你选定的那一个模型。另有按任务类型给模型加权的预设、带图任务的视觉分流、会话信号（当前 todo / 上下文压力 / token 预算 / 子 agent 深度），以及可选的语义任务分类。思考等级保持常开，因为 DeepSeek 会拒绝思考关闭时产生的工具调用。

description.en: Shows subscription quota and account balance beside the DeepSeek Harness model selector for 28 provider entries, with a shared settings page and a read-only quota tool.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁显示 28 条提供商入口的订阅额度与账户余额，附统一设置页和只读额度查询工具。

description.en: Fine-grained LLM verification for DSH agents: pairwise rewards over score-token logprobs, Probabilistic Pivot Tournament best-of-N selection, and per-step progress tracking.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 智能体的细粒度 LLM 验证：基于评分 token logprob 期望的成对打分、概率枢纽锦标赛 N 选一与逐步进度追踪。

description.en: Adds a switch between DeepSeek web chat and the Harness workspace in DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版中提供 DeepSeek 网页聊天与 Harness 工作区之间的切换。

description.en: Host-side connector for the DSH Mobile iOS app: dials a self-hostable WSS relay so the phone can reach the DSH sessions on this computer over 4G/5G, without a public IP or a VPN; the relay only authenticates and forwards.
description.zh: DSH Mobile 的电脑侧连接器：连上可自建的公网 WSS 中转，手机在 4G/5G 下即可访问这台电脑上的 DSH 会话，电脑不需要公网 IP 也不用组网；中转只做鉴权与转发。

description.en: Arknights-inspired fan skin for the DSH Web UI featuring Pramanix and Eyjafjalla in a day/night celestial garden.
description.zh: DSH Web 明日方舟同人皮肤“初雪和小羊”，包含昼夜星海庭园背景与双角色布局。

description.en: Adds a "Work Roles" tab and a pixel-art office overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: 508 built-in role cards (The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253) with search, EN/ZH toggle and department filter; draggable Canvas 2D pixel characters that stand, type and pace, with idle chat that can plug into AI. One-command npm install, no dsh source changes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 主窗口添加「工作角色」页签 + 像素办公室浮层：内置 508 张角色卡（The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253），支持搜索 / 中英切换 / 分部分类；Canvas 2D 像素小人可站立、打字、踱步，闲聊台词可接 AI。一条命令安装，不改 dsh 源码。

description.en: Client-side writing panel for the Web UI: project volumes and stats, corpus library, full-text search, evolution version-chain diffs, and an SVG thread graph, shown only in writing-preset sessions.
description.zh: Web 客户端「写作」面板：项目分卷与统计、书库与全文检索、设定演化版本链 diff、线索 SVG 图谱，仅在写作预设会话显示。

description.en: Provider-tabbed model picker for the dsh web composer: left provider column and right model list, both independently scrollable, with cross-provider search.
description.zh: dsh web 输入栏模型选择面板：左侧提供商栏 + 右侧模型列表，两侧独立滚动，支持跨提供商搜索。

description.en: Session cost estimate in a status bar at the bottom of the conversation (per-model token pricing, CNY) plus the live DeepSeek account balance via the official balance API.
description.zh: 对话底部的会话费用状态栏：按模型逐条计价估算 Token 费用（CNY），并实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（官方余额接口）。

description.en: HarmonyOS development suite for DSH: a right-sidebar HiLog inspector (live stream with level/logger/text filters) and an ArkUI Inspector (screenshot pick, collapsible component tree, node properties with search, box model), two tree sources — the DevEco debug channel (declared padding/margin/border and custom component names) and the uitest accessibility tree — an .ets viewer with ArkTS syntax highlighting, DevEco Studio/CLT toolchain and device management, plus the harmony_ui_tree agent tool. 21 remote methods, 82 unit tests.
description.zh: HarmonyOS 全栈开发套件：右侧边栏提供 HiLog 检查器（实时流与级别/包名/关键词过滤）与 ArkUI Inspector（截图点选高亮、可折叠组件树、节点属性搜索、盒子模型），两种树源——DevEco 调试源（ark 调试链路，提供 padding/margin/border 声明值与自定义组件名）与 uitest 无障碍树；.ets 查看器提供 ArkTS 语法高亮；注册 harmony_ui_tree agent 工具供对话内取组件树；设置页管理 DevEco Studio/CLT 工具链与 USB/网络设备。21 个 Remote 方法，82 个单元测试。

description.en: Phone and remote access to the DSH Web UI: scan a LAN QR code, or reach your PC from anywhere through a self-hosted relay server you run yourself instead of a cloudflared tunnel. Per-device credentials that pair, list, and revoke individually, and several PCs sharing one relay with automatic failover.
description.zh: 手机与远程访问 DSH Web 界面：局域网扫码即用，或用自建 relay 中继服务端（替代 cloudflared 隧道）随时随地连回电脑；每台设备独立凭据，可配对、查看与单独撤销；多台电脑共用一个中继并自动热备。

description.en: Chat panel for the MuChe companion with per-user backend settings, plus an outbound bridge that runs tasks on the user's local dsh.
description.zh: 连接小沐的 dsh 插件：和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务。

description.en: Proactive per-provider token-bucket rate limiting that queues over-limit requests before they are sent, preventing upstream 429 errors.
description.zh: 按 provider 令牌桶主动限速，超限请求在发出前延迟排队而非失败，避免触发上游 429。

description.en: Stops a streaming model call when the same string repeats ten times in a row (threshold configurable), keeps the partial answer as a normal assistant message, and shows a stop notice with the workspace, session name and the repeated string. Repeat counts can vary by unit length through a piecewise table or a JavaScript module, and code regions (fenced, inline, indented) use a relaxed threshold.
description.zh: 同一字符串连续重复达到阈值（默认 10 次）时截停本次生成，已生成内容照常提交；截停后弹出通知，显示所属工作区、会话名称与重复的字符串。重复次数可按单元长度用分段表或 JS 模块决定，代码区域（围栏 / 行内 / 缩进）使用放宽的阈值。

description.en: An Aether Gazer Verdandi-inspired DSH Web UI skin with light and dark backgrounds, wedding-themed chrome, responsive character art, and themed conversation and sidebar surfaces.
description.zh: 一款以《深空之眼》薇儿丹蒂为主题的 DSH Web UI 皮肤，包含昼夜背景、誓约婚礼装饰、响应式角色立绘，以及主题化的会话区与侧边栏。

description.en: Prompt library above the DSH composer — a 📚 button expands a searchable panel to insert saved prompts into the draft with one click (appends, never overwrites), persisted in a host-side JSON file.
description.zh: 输入框上方的提示词库：📚 按钮展开可搜索面板，点条目一键填入草稿（追加不覆盖）；数据以 JSON 文件保存在 Host 侧。

description.en: Semantic UI sound effects powered by uisfx: task start/success/failure and per-button cues, settings UI with instant preview, 12 sound packs, Host-persisted preferences, and `ctx.uisfx` service for other plugins.
description.zh: 基于 uisfx 的语义化 UI 音效：任务开始/成功/失败、不同按钮情景 cue，设置页即时试听，12 种音色包，Host 持久化，并提供 `ctx.uisfx` 服务给其他插件。

description.en: Host-side Typert remote for dsh-tool-writing: serves project volumes, chapter status, corpus library, full-text search, evolution entries, and thread-graph data to the client writing panel.
description.zh: 写文引擎的 host 侧数据通道：把项目分卷、章节状态、书库、全文检索、演化条目与线索图谱以 Typert remote 暴露给客户端写作面板。

description.en: Web Audio lifecycle cues for DeepSeek Harness: ten configurable events, three low-noise defaults, per-event custom sounds, and no shipped audio assets.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 生命周期提示音：10 个可配置事件，默认只开启三项低打扰提示，可为每个事件更换自定义声音，内置音效不带音频资源。

description.en: Android companion bridge: QR-code LAN pairing with revocable device tokens and TLS fingerprints, a phone-connection and device-management panel, and an HTTPS access proxy serving sessions, live events and approvals to the paired native app.
description.zh: Android 配套桥接：局域网扫码配对（可吊销的设备 Token 与 TLS 指纹）、手机连接与设备管理面板，以及向配对原生 App 提供会话、实时事件与审批的 HTTPS 接入代理。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Skill built on the official command-line tool maa-cli for MaaAssistantArknights (MAA), enabling direct control of MaaCore to automate daily tasks in Arknights.
description.zh: 基于 MaaAssistantArknights (MAA) 官方命令行工具 maa-cli 构建的 DeepSeek Harness Skill：让 DeepSeek Harness 直接驱动 MaaCore，自动化完成《明日方舟》日常任务。

description.en: Pair a phone with this computer's DSH instance by QR code or a six-digit code, then drive it remotely — send instructions, view images, answer approvals — from the panel, with public-tunnel support for pairing across networks.
description.zh: 用二维码或六位配对码把手机连上这台电脑的 DSH，之后可远程发指令、看图片、回答审批；局域网内不依赖云端，异地走公网隧道。

description.en: Provides the see_image tool for DSH: send an image file to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision model and relay its description back to a text-only model.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 see_image 工具：将图片文件发送到可配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，并把其描述回传给纯文本模型。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that statically parses Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` files into structured pages in the DSH right sidebar (the source is never executed: no eval, no bundler, no sandbox iframe), with a file-viewer takeover for `.tsx` and a bundled Skill for authoring the format.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把 Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` 静态解析为结构化页面渲染在右侧栏（不执行源码，无 eval / bundler / 沙箱 iframe），并附带 `.tsx` 文件查看器接管与一个教 LLM 写该格式的 Skill。

description.en: Blocks edit/write writes that contain characters matching configurable regex rules, executed before the tool runs, with configurable messages and same-turn pwsh propagation; default rule matches full-width parentheses.
description.zh: 在工具执行前拦截 edit/write 写入内容里匹配配置正则的字符，默认匹配全角圆括号，同一回合命中后连带拦截后续 pwsh，报错文案与正则均可配置。

description.en: Read-only DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar version chip that shows the running DSH version, npm latest/next/alpha channels, compatibility labels, and a copy-only upgrade command.
description.zh: 只读的 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧栏版本芯片，显示当前运行版本、npm latest/next/alpha 通道、兼容性标识，以及仅复制的升级命令。

description.en: Replaces the DSH Web connection provider to skip BrowserAuth entirely so the Web UI opens directly without pasting the random startup token, gated to nine verified DSH version pairs with strict host/client matching that sleeps automatically on unknown or mixed versions, and reverts fully on uninstall; web profiles only.
description.zh: 替换 DSH Web 的连接提供方以整体跳过 BrowserAuth，打开 Web 地址即可直接使用、无需抄写启动 URL 中的随机 token；按九个已验证的 DSH 版本对严格成对门控，遇到未知或混用版本自动休眠，卸载即完全恢复官方行为，仅限 Web profile。

description.en: Run several DeepSeek Harness sessions side by side, hand work from one to another, and watch the whole collaboration on one read-only canvas.
description.zh: 并排运行多个 DeepSeek Harness 会话，让它们互相交接任务，并在同一张只读看板上看清整场协作。

description.en: User Message Timeline - floating pill rail with hover preview, click/drag jump and pagination, switchable left/right.
description.zh: 对话内悬浮药丸导轨：等距药丸、悬停预览、点击/拖拽跳转、分页自动加载，开关在设置-插件-插件配置。

description.en: Expert manager: manage ntd-format experts and expert teams (plugin.json + Agent MD + skill sets), browse and install from a built-in market of 50+ experts, and run tasks in an expert persona via /expert-<name> without consuming model directory tokens.
description.zh: 专家管理：管理 ntd 格式的专家与专家团队（plugin.json + Agent MD + 技能集），内置 50+ 专家市场，`/expert-名称` 以专家身份执行任务，不占模型目录 token。

description.en: Turn a phone camera into a live viewfinder and photo input for your dsh session, over LAN or USB.
description.zh: 把手机相机变成 dsh 会话的实时取景与拍照输入，经局域网或 USB 直连。

description.en: Shows API-key and subscription quota limits in the DSH provider interface and settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面与设置中显示 API Key 和订阅账户的额度限制。

description.en: Reusable Agent Team presets for DeepSeek Harness: a Settings page stores named Teams — a captain with its own prompt and tool allow-list, plus members carrying their own provider/model route, reasoning effort, prompt and tools — and a composer control applies one Team to the current Session, installing the captain prompt and registering the spawn_team_member, get_team_preset and update_team_preset tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可复用智能体团队预设：设置页保存具名团队——队长带自己的提示词与工具白名单，成员各自带 provider/模型路由、推理强度、提示词与工具——编辑器栏的团队控件把选中的团队应用到当前会话，安装队长提示词，并注册 spawn_team_member、get_team_preset、update_team_preset 三个工具。

description.en: Academic writing toolkit for DSH agents: paper outlines, title and abstract skeletons, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA citations, phrasing QA, and a pre-submission checklist.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供学术写作工具包：论文大纲、标题与摘要骨架、GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA 引文格式化、措辞质检与投稿前清单。

description.en: Local-first token usage heatmap inside DSH settings: GitHub-style week/month/quarter/year grids, hourly usage per day, per-model and per-provider Top 5, and persisted history that survives session deletion. Zero network, zero billing.
description.zh: DSH 设置内的本地 Token 用量热图：GitHub 风格周/月/季度/年视图、每日小时级展开、模型与供应商 Top 5，历史持久化，删除会话不丢数据。零联网、零计费。

description.en: Three-layer skill management for DeepSeek Harness: a library pool, per-workspace enablement whitelists, and per-session picks, with a Web settings panel, a conversation-embedded view, a skill file browser/editor, zip and folder import, and engine-load validation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能生命周期管理：技能库（纯技能池）、工作区启用白名单、会话勾选三层模型；Web 设置面板与对话页内嵌视图，支持技能文件浏览/编辑、zip 与文件夹批量导入、引擎实际加载校验。

description.en: Binds a separate DeepSeek API key to each workspace or session, warns when an effective key is stale or belongs to another provider, and never swaps a key on its own.
description.zh: 为每个工作区或单个会话单独绑定一把 DeepSeek API key，生效 key 失效或服务商不匹配时提醒，且绝不自动替换 key。

description.en: Personal coding assistant that schedules, follows up on and verifies local Codex or Claude Code tasks from DSH, with WeChat, WeCom and Feishu remote channels.
description.zh: 个人编码助理：在 DSH 中安排、跟进与验收本机 Codex 或 Claude Code 任务，并提供微信、企业微信与飞书远程渠道。

description.en: Smart checkpoints, workspace safety guards and instant rollback for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能检查点、工作区安全防护和即时回滚。

description.en: Session header badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak status, per-model token prices on hover, and real session/turn costs from actual usage.
description.zh: 会话头部徽标：显示 DeepSeek 高峰/闲时状态、当前模型 token 单价，并按真实用量统计会话与每轮费用。

description.en: DSH right-sidebar plugin that compares two git commits, builds a manual-test checklist from the impact scope, and supports fail notes, screenshots, task attachments, and defect submission to Yunxiao, GitHub, GitLab, or a webhook.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏插件：对比两个 git 提交，根据影响面生成手测清单，支持失败备注、截图、任务附件，以及向云效 / GitHub / GitLab / Webhook 提交缺陷。

description.en: Shows which graft index a dsh session is serving and whether it still matches the code, and gives the model graft_ask, graft_grep, graft_callers, graft_skeleton and graft_map as native tools.
description.zh: 显示当前 dsh 会话所用的 graft 索引、以及它是否仍与代码一致，并把 graft_ask、graft_grep、graft_callers、graft_skeleton、graft_map 作为原生工具交给模型。

description.en: Turn raw data (CSV / pasted table / SQL results / DuckDB) into a structured Markdown report with business conclusions, metrics and charts.
description.zh: 把原始数据（CSV / 粘贴表格 / SQL 结果 / DuckDB）转成带业务结论、指标与图表的结构化 Markdown 报告。

description.en: Glass weather pill in the session header with 23 weather states, each with its own tint, SVG icon and canvas particle layer, per-field visibility switches, and a get_weather tool backed by keyless Open-Meteo data.
description.zh: 会话顶栏的玻璃天气胶囊：23 种天气状态各自配色、SVG 图标与 canvas 粒子层，可按字段开关显示内容，并注册 get_weather 工具（Open-Meteo 免密钥数据）。

description.en: Compresses DSH time-context from ~280 chars to 46 chars by injecting a compact date line into the runtime-context snapshot; zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 将 DSH 时间上下文从约 280 字符压缩到 46 字符，向运行期快照注入紧凑日期行，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Persistent Endeavour and Challenger peer sessions for DeepSeek Harness that plan, execute sequential tasks, and verify reported results.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻的 Endeavour 与 Challenger 对等会话：负责规划、按序执行任务，并核验汇报的结果。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-orbital-agents
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for orbital-agents

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Doubao-style voice chat for DSH: press-and-hold mic in the composer converts speech to text and auto-sends, and AI replies are read aloud. Optional LLM condensing (long replies summarized into short spoken lines, following the current conversation model), TTS-friendly text cleaning, selectable Edge TTS voices, adjustable silence auto-stop, and settings embedded in DSH settings dialog.
description.zh: 豆包式语音对话插件：聊天框麦克风按钮（按住说话）语音转文字并自动发送，AI 回复自动朗读。可选 LLM 转述精简（长回复压缩成口语再播，跟随当前对话模型）、朗读前清洗 markdown/emoji/特殊符号、Edge TTS 多种音色、静音自动结束时长可调，设置嵌入 DSH 自带设置弹窗（voice chat 类目）。

description.en: Hot-switchable brand skins for the DSH Web UI: an OpenBMC skin, a UEFI skin and an unofficial fan-made skin based on A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, each with light/dark schemes, plus a personal wallpaper gallery, per-skin tagline and transparency controls, and a one-click path back to the official look.
description.zh: DSH Web 多品牌皮肤热切换：OpenBMC、UEFI 与《凡人修仙传》非官方同人画作三套皮肤，各带明暗双态配色，附个人壁纸图库、双语标语与通透度调节，随时一键回到官方界面。

description.en: Restart the whole DeepSeek Harness desktop app from five entry points (sidebar panel, sidebar footer, conversation title bar, /restart-desktop slash command, settings row) through a detached helper that ends and relaunches the Electron main process, instead of only restarting the dsh web process. It hard-blocks a restart while a plugin install/update is running and pnpm is still alive, sweeps the change snapshots DSH leaves behind in the system temp directory, and hides the easy-to-misclick feedback item in the account menu. Desktop only; on dsh web the status route reports desktop: false and the button is disabled.
description.zh: 从五个入口（侧栏面板、侧栏底部、会话标题栏、/restart-desktop 斜杠命令、设置页）经分离的 helper 结束并重新拉起 Electron 主进程，重启整个 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用，而不是只重启 dsh web 进程；插件正在安装/更新且 pnpm 还活着时硬拦重启，清理 DSH 漏在系统临时目录里的改动快照，并藏掉账号菜单里容易误点的「意见反馈」。仅适用于桌面版；在 dsh web 上状态路由如实报告 desktop: false 并禁用按钮。

description.en: Diagnose and safely repair corrupted DSH session history: raw zstd/JSONL validation, tool-call ID repair, single-slot pre-repair backup, restore, and an audit trail.
description.zh: 诊断并安全修复损坏的 DSH 会话历史：raw zstd/JSONL 校验、tool-call ID 修复、单槽 pre-repair 备份与恢复、审计记录。

description.en: Web search provider with switchable engines, several usable without an API key (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG and others) and a fallback order between them; adds multi_search, platform_search, image_search with an in-chat image wall, page_images and save_images, plus a settings page for engines, keys and per-engine proxy.
description.zh: 可切换引擎的联网搜索 provider，其中多个引擎无需 API key（Bing、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG 等），可设置回退顺序；另提供 multi_search、platform_search、带对话内图片墙的 image_search、page_images 和 save_images，以及配置引擎、密钥和按引擎代理的设置页。

description.en: PR evaluation and improvement consultant: assesses PR success probability based on historical anti-patterns and success patterns, with one-click scoring and actionable suggestions.
description.zh: PR 评估和改进顾问：基于历史反模式和成功模式评估 PR 成功率，一键评分并提供可操作的改进建议。

description.en: Customizes the native settings window: preset or custom window sizes, fullscreen, background transparency, and theme, solid-color, or image backgrounds, with a floating ball for quick access; saved in the local browser.
description.zh: 设置界面自定义：调整原生设置窗口大小（全屏/预置大尺寸/自定义宽高）、背景透明度与背景（主题/自定义颜色/图片），悬浮球即开即调，存本机浏览器。

description.en: Fail-closed runtime tool-call loop guard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供故障关闭式运行时工具调用循环防护。

description.en: Persistent, cross-session multi-agent team rooms for DeepSeek Harness — members, a message bus, a shared task board, and a shared timeline that survive restarts.
description.zh: 持久化、跨会话的多 Agent 团队房间：成员、消息总线、共享任务板与共享时间线，重启后仍然保留。

description.en: Pinned-version REA for DeepSeek Harness: installs rea-agents locally, starts its MCP server from that pinned copy, and upgrades only when you press Update.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 固定版本的 REA：把 rea-agents 安装到当前配置档的一个确切版本，从该副本启动其 MCP 服务，只有按下「更新」才升级。

description.en: Input prediction for the DSH composer: your next prompt suggested as ghost text after each turn, accepted with Tab. (autocomplete / input prediction / prompt suggestion)
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框加上输入预测：回合结束后自动建议你的下一句话，Tab 一键采纳；输入时按会话历史做前缀补全。（输入预测 / 自动补全 / 提示词建议 / 补全）

description.en: Group installed skills and manage MCP servers from a left-panel UI: filter the model skill catalog by enabled groups (union-deduped) and toggle MCP servers independently.
description.zh: 将已安装的技能分组管理、独立开关 MCP 服务器：按启用分组过滤模型可见的技能目录（并集去重），全部操作集中在左侧面板。

description.en: LLM adapter plugin for locally deployed Qwen models behind a vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with per-model multimodal switch, fully configurable reasoning efforts, and a web settings page for editing the deployment from the frontend.
description.zh: 面向 vLLM OpenAI 兼容端点上本地部署的 Qwen 模型的 LLM 适配器插件,支持按模型多模态开关、完全可配置的推理档位,以及可在前端编辑部署配置的 Web 设置页。

description.en: LLM auto-approval for sandbox escalation requests, with presets and a fail-closed fallback.
description.zh: 沙箱升权申请的 LLM 自动审批：内置预设，fail-closed 兜底。

description.en: Design-artifact skill adapted from Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder: turns a design brief into a self-contained HTML/SVG artifact (posters, infographics, landing pages, charts, component mockups) with a pre-delivery quality checklist and an anti-AI-look pattern list.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的设计稿生成 skill（改编自 Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder）：把设计需求做成可直接打开的自包含 HTML/SVG 设计稿（海报、信息图、落地页、图表、组件稿），内置交付前质量清单与「去 AI 味」反模式清单。

description.en: Tokenrhythm (基元律动) finance dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: account balance & expiring credits, category-filtered model price cards (with discounted prices), service status and platform key management; login via platform account or session cookie — credentials stay on the local host.
description.zh: 基元律动费用中心：账户余额与限时额度、按分类筛选的模型价格卡（含折扣价）、服务状态与平台密钥管理，支持平台账号或 Cookie 登录，凭据存本机 host。

description.en: Electronic wooden fish in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI, a whale-girl sprite by default: tap the head to earn merit; it knocks by itself while the model is busy; per-session merit is stored locally, and the sprite can be swapped for custom art.
description.zh: 右下角电子木鱼，默认是鲸鱼娘图包：敲头记功德，模型忙碌时自动敲；功德按会话存本机，可换自定义图源。

description.en: Third-party model settings for DeepSeek Harness: pick a provider and a model in the composer menu, gate a model's thinking level with one switch on the official Models page card, and configure per-route request headers.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的第三方模型设置思考等级：在输入框菜单里选择服务商与模型，在官方模型页卡片上用一个开关控制思考等级，并可配置按路由的请求头。

description.en: Real-time local TTS for DeepSeek Harness: voice presets, auto-read, engine setup assistant, a read-aloud button, and a settings panel for the GSV-TTS-Lite engine.
description.zh: 将本地高性能 TTS 引擎 GSV-TTS-Lite 实时接入 DeepSeek Harness：语音预设、自动朗读、引擎配置助手、朗读按钮与设置面板。

description.en: Turn another computer into a remote Agent teammate: the worker runs its own DSH and a full Agent loop locally, so dispatched tasks keep running when the link drops and its model credentials never leave that machine. The hub dispatches through 8 remote_* tools, receives only a handoff summary plus an artifact manifest, and pulls finished products on demand — intermediate artifacts stay on the worker. Pairing-code onboarding, direct or relay transport for NAT, Web panel on both sides.
description.zh: 把另一台电脑变成你的远程 Agent 同事：副机本地跑自己的 DSH 与完整 Agent 循环，所以链路断开时任务照常继续、模型凭证也永不离开那台机器。主机用 8 个 remote_* 工具派活，只收回 handoff 摘要与产物清单，成品按需拉取——中间产物留在副机。配对码接入，direct 或 relay 两种传输穿 NAT，两侧都有 Web 面板。

description.en: Pushes DSH approval and question cards to IM channels (WeChat first) and answers them from chat, with a session console, per-channel security, and an open push service.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的审批卡与提问卡推送到 IM 渠道（先支持微信），可在聊天里直接作答，带会话控制台、逐渠道安全与开放推送服务。

description.en: Offline mirror of the official DeepSeek Harness documentation as a dsh skill: 168 site pages (EN/zh) plus 52 repository-only reference docs, with topic navigation and a full-text search index for plugin development.
description.zh: 以 dsh-plugin-dev-kb 技能内置 DeepSeek Harness 官方文档离线镜像：站点中英 168 页 + 仓库补充文档 52 篇，带主题导航与全文检索，编写插件时随时查阅。

description.en: WorkBuddy console for DeepSeek Harness, in one plugin: the account/model pool (merged from dsh-workbuddy-xdpool), the skill market with an in-composer skill picker, batch check-in, pending tasks, session health, history and credit usage. Bilingual.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里管理多个 WorkBuddy 账号，一键批量签到领积分，还能看任务进度和积分走势。

description.en: Arrow-key navigation for the DSH Web GUI: Up/Down switch sessions inside the current workspace and Left/Right switch workspaces, reading session identity from the client controllers rather than the DOM, and yielding the keys back to the composer while a draft is being edited.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的方向键导航：上/下在当前工作区内切换会话，左/右切换工作区；会话身份来自客户端控制器而非 DOM；输入框存在草稿时把方向键交还给光标。

description.en: Recursive delegation for dsh agent trees: a preset plus Host limits bound what each subagent may do, subagents work in separate _agents/ workspaces, and the parent decides which results to integrate.
description.zh: dsh agent 树的递归委派：用预设与 Host 限制划定每个子 agent 的能力边界，子 agent 在各自 _agents/ 工作区独立工作，成果由父 agent 决定是否合并、如何合并。

description.en: Song-dynasty-inspired theme for the DSH web UI: a light "rice paper" and a dark "night ink" variant, Ru celadon carrying interactive states while kiln copper is reserved for blockquotes, plus a 4pt spacing scale and a 46-glyph mask icon set.
description.zh: 宋律 Songgrid —— 宋代美学主题，宣纸（浅）与夜墨（深）双变体；汝窑天青承担交互态、窑铜只用于引用块；另附 4pt 间距阶与 46 个 mask 图标。

description.en: Docker tools for agents: ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health with JSON output, env-configurable CLI path, approval-gated exec and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: Docker 工具：ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health 七工具，JSON 输出、DSH_DOCKER_PATH 环境变量、exec 审批门、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Lightweight Markdown conversation theme plugin — enhances native color scheme with 4 built-in themes (light/dark dual), user-defined CSS themes, system-aware auto-switching, in-browser theme editor, designed to enhance reading speed and clarity.
description.zh: 轻量级对话 Markdown 主题插件——增强原生着色，4 套内置主题（浅/深双档）、用户自定义 CSS 主题、系统感知自动切换、内置主题编辑器，提升快速阅读体验。

description.en: Recalls prompts sent earlier in the current session with the up and down keys in an empty composer, and shows a position badge while browsing.
description.zh: 在空输入框里用 ↑/↓ 翻出本会话之前发过的提示词，翻动时显示位置角标。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance, this session's billed spend, and today's total spend in the session-header badge; a turn-cost row in the message actions strip, a detail panel with per-model pricing and a today session-spend ranking. Official peak/off-peak pricing; balance from the real /user/balance API.
description.zh: 会话头部徽标显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、本轮对话花费与今日全部会话总花费；每轮消息操作行前置本轮花费，详情面板含按模型计价与今日会话消费排行。官方峰谷定价，余额取自 /user/balance API。

description.en: DSH Web GUI paperclip button: a 📎 button in the composer opens a file picker (drag & drop supported) and inserts file contents into the textarea.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框添加回形针按钮：点击选择文件（支持拖拽），文件内容自动插入输入框。

description.en: Notion connector for DeepSeek Harness: search, read, query, create, update, and append Notion pages and databases via six agent tools, with a Web settings page — configured once with an Integration Token.
description.zh: 配置一次 Notion Integration Token，Agent 即可搜索、读取、查询、创建、更新、追加 Notion 页面与数据库内容，并提供 Web 设置页。

description.en: Evidence-driven company and job due-diligence for DSH: logs sources with evidence levels, adds evidence-bounded claims, verifies the legal entity against official registries, and renders a PROCEED/VERIFY/STOP report with a verification checklist and interview questions.
description.zh: 证据驱动的公司与岗位尽调插件：登记带证据等级的来源、添加受证据边界约束的结论、用官方登记信息核验公司主体，并生成推进/核验/停止三态报告，附核验清单与面试问题。

description.en: Plugin store: npm authoritative catalog + awesome curated list (550+ plugins, 11 categories), dsh-field quality verification, official `dsh plugin add/remove` one-click install, sidebar + settings entry.
description.zh: dsh 插件商店：npm 权威目录 + awesome 精选（550+ 插件、11 分类）、dsh 字段质量验证、官方 `dsh plugin add/remove` 一键安装，侧边栏与设置页入口。

description.en: Wraps Python virtual environment management commands: reduces the network and permission problems agents hit when managing environments through terminal commands, works across operating systems, and routes installs automatically through mirrors and local proxies. The tools are strictly confined by the granted read/write permissions.
description.zh: 封装了Python虚拟环境管理指令，减少Agent使用终端指令管理环境时遇到的网络问题和权限问题，兼容不同操作系统，工具内部设置自动网络与镜像路由。工具严格受给定读写权限限制。

description.en: DSH web 插件：消息级回滚 / 删除 / 恢复（补 dsh 官方没有的部分）。分支与导出用官方内置能力。
description.zh: DSH 会话消息级回滚、单条删除与重放式恢复；操作以 append-only surface replace 实现，带确认提示和运行中会话保护。需 Node.js 23.5+。

description.en: TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) as the jev_decide tool for DeepSeek Harness: noul, choice and score questions return calibrated probabilities; credentials reuse the DSH credential seam; 429/529 backoff retry built in.
description.zh: 把 TypeSafe Jev（System One 决策模型）接入 DSH 的 jev_decide 工具：noul/choice/score 三种问题形状返回校准概率，凭证复用 DSH 凭证缝，内建 429/529 退避重试。

description.en: Kinich and Ajaw theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with three visual styles, session-state feedback, companion interactions, and configurable ambient effects.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Kinich 与 Ajaw 主题，提供三种视觉风格、会话状态反馈、伙伴交互和可配置的动态环境效果。

description.en: 电机AI辅助设计软件插件 · L0 层（毫秒级广筛）；共享核心逻辑 @wangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-core
description.zh: 电机 AI 辅助设计插件：需求解析 → 参数识别 → 候选矩阵 → Top10 校验。L0 纯 JS、零求解器依赖，毫秒级广筛候选并给出交给 L1/L2 精算工具的载荷；可作为本地 agent 预设与 Cordis 插件使用。L1（RMxprt）与 L2（Motor-CAD）在本版本中仅预留接口，层级总闸设为 l0 以上会立即报错。

description.en: Copy selections from assistant messages as Markdown, preserving links, LaTeX sources, and code-fence language info.
description.zh: 将助手消息中选中的内容复制为 Markdown，保留链接、LaTeX 源码与代码块语言信息。

description.en: Windows-native tools for DSH agents: clipboard read and write, system notifications, hosts file inspection and network diagnostics, each returning structured data with UI cards from injection-safe PowerShell.
description.zh: 面向 DSH agent 的 Windows 原生工具：剪贴板读写、系统通知、hosts 文件查看与网络诊断，均返回结构化数据（带 UI 卡片），底层为防注入的 PowerShell。

description.en: Draggable transparent balance card with a blood-bar of remaining balance vs month-opening, today/month spend (official when the platform token is configured), and session cost.
description.zh: 可拖动透明余额卡片：余额/月初额度血条、今日/本月用量（配置平台 token 后为官方精确数据）、当前对话费用。

description.en: Offline diagnostic for DSH: 19 checks across env, profile, and session state, with a settings "Doctor" panel and a read-only JSON API.
description.zh: 离线诊断工具：环境/Profile/会话共 19 项检查，带设置「诊断」面板与只读 JSON API。

description.en: A fully customizable theming framework for DSH UI, with Xiao from Genshin Impact as the default theme.
description.zh: 为 DSH UI 提供完全自定义的主题框架，默认主题为原神魈。

description.en: Zhipu (GLM Coding Plan) web suite as native DSH providers and tools: rebinds the built-in web_search and web_fetch to Zhipu web search and Markdown page reading, optionally registers github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file repo tools, and adds a settings card with toggles and a credential-ref field.
description.zh: 智谱（GLM Coding Plan）三件套以原生 provider 与工具接入：内置 web_search / web_fetch 后端切换为智谱联网搜索与网页 Markdown 读取，可选注册 github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file 开源仓库工具，附设置卡片配置开关与凭据引用名。

description.en: Read-only DSH Web plugin for inspecting and searching Milvus or Zilliz Cloud collections from chat, including scalar, BM25, dense, and hybrid queries.
description.zh: 只读 DSH Web 插件，可在对话中检查和搜索 Milvus 或 Zilliz Cloud Collection，支持标量、BM25、稠密向量与混合查询。

description.en: Import Claude Code sessions, skills and plugin assets into DSH as native resumable sessions, and export or sync DSH sessions back to Claude Code JSONL.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 会话、技能与插件资产导入为 DSH 原生可续聊会话，并支持将 DSH 会话导出或同步回 Claude Code JSONL。

description.en: Automatic model-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness: one user instruction enters, one tier decision comes out — complex intent is planned on the strong tier and implemented on the cheap tier, simple intent stays cheap throughout, with a deterministic guard and a TTL escalation fallback.
description.zh: 自动模型档位路由：一条用户指令进入、一个档位决策出来——复杂意图由强档规划、廉价档执行，简单意图全程廉价档，确定性护栏 + TTL 升级回退。

description.en: Turns the main model into a dispatcher: six pools (economy/mechanical/main/hard/vision/review) route each subtask to the right model, with ranking and per-route reasoning-effort pins. A context watermark (50k/90k/130k) nudges delegation early and, at the force level, forks a backup session, writes a handover doc, compacts, and continues without losing in-flight subagent work; /ctx-pause, /ctx-resume and /ctx-handover pause, resume or trigger the same machinery by hand. Optional Agent Teams mode adds persistent teammates and a shared task board; /vision lets text-only models handle images via the vision pool; tiered verification sends bigger diffs to a tester and an independent reviewer. Settings UI, READMEs and the conversation / code-comment / document language preferences all cover the same 11 languages (en, zh, zh-TW, ja, ko, de, es, fr, it, pt, ru); the plugin UI follows the DSH app locale unless forced otherwise. Bundles three skills: read-only MySQL/Redis verification, commit-message generation, and a requirements/design document convention.
description.zh: 把主模型变成调度员：六个派发池（轻量/机械/主力/高难/多模态/复审）按活配模型，支持排序与按路线钉选思考强度。上下文水位（50k/90k/130k）先提醒委派，到顶自动 fork 备份会话、写交接文档、压缩后续跑，跑着的子智能体不丢；/ctx-pause、/ctx-resume、/ctx-handover 可随时手动暂停、恢复或发起同一套交接。可选 Agent Teams 模式带来常驻队友与共享任务板；/vision 让纯文本模型也能看图；分级验证给大改动配 tester 和独立复审。设置界面、README 与回复/代码注释/文档语言偏好覆盖同一套 11 种语言（英、简中、繁中、日、韩、德、西、法、意、葡、俄），界面默认跟随 DSH 应用语言。内置三个技能：MySQL/Redis 只读核验、commit 文案生成、需求与设计文档规范。

description.en: SQLX database tools: list saved datasources, show or test a connection, execute SQL and open a local result page, with the sqlx CLI installed on first use.
description.zh: OtterMind SQLX 数据库工具：列出已保存的数据源、查看或测试连接、执行 SQL、打开本地结果页，缺少 sqlx CLI 时首次调用自动安装。

description.en: Kimi-Code-style swarm: batch-parallel subagent dispatch with adaptive scheduling, a /swarm command, and in-chat live progress rows.
description.zh: Kimi Code 风格 swarm：批量并行子 Agent 调度（自适应并发）、/swarm 命令与聊天内实时进度条。

description.en: GitHub sidebar workbench for DSH: remote tree plus Issues, Pull requests and Actions tabs, with create/comment/edit/close, merge/squash/rebase, and rerun or cancel CI; mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right panel.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏 GitHub 工作台：远端目录树加 Issues / Pull requests / Actions 页签，支持建 Issue/PR、评论、编辑、关闭、merge/squash/rebase 与重跑或取消 CI；挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧面板。

description.en: Free voice closed loop for the Web UI: browser SpeechRecognition mic input with live interim results plus read-aloud speaker buttons and auto-read for assistant replies, zero configuration and no API key.
description.zh: Web UI 免费语音闭环：浏览器语音识别输入（实时中间结果上屏）+ 助手回复朗读与自动朗读，零配置、免 API key。

description.en: Project-level memory built around a ledger whose structure the AI designs per project; the plugin only handles detection, injection, write-back, archiving and git. Memories are split by meaning: the active ledger holds current state, the turn journal is append-only, and decisions, the goal tree and lessons are one-card-per-file (with a multi-dimension index over the card folders); the fundamental principles file can be changed only by the user. There is a single compaction mode: before compacting, the AI sorts the work into three buckets - what must stay in context and is re-injected verbatim, what is written to the project's _stash/ for later lookup, and what is dropped. When a conversation is opened in a container workspace holding several projects, it can be locked to one sub-project (the lock lives in the plugin's own home and survives restarts; it leaves no marker in your project). Also an activity log with five levels, where L4 stores the user's own words verbatim (never injected, queryable on demand). Before each compaction a verbatim capsule (user quotes, raw errors, changed files) is written to disk, and both the capsule and its source material survive a restart; a handoff document lets a new conversation resume the previous one. 21 tools, 12 subcommands, 39 settings (one of them switches whether the settings panel or each project's manifest wins). Runs locally, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 项目级记忆，核心是台账：台账的结构由 AI 按项目类型自行决定，插件只负责检测、注入、回写、归档与 Git 配合。记忆按语义分开放 —— 活跃台账是当前状态、回合流水只追加、关键决策/目标树/经验教训各是一卡一文件（另有卡片目录的多维索引表），根本原则只有用户本人能改。压缩方式只有一种（分流后压缩）：压缩前先让 AI 把这一段分成三个桶 —— 留上下文的压缩后逐字注回、以后要查的落进项目 _stash/、已被取代的丢掉。对话建在装着多个项目的总工作区上时，可以把它锁定到某个子项目（锁记在插件自己的家，跨重启保持；不在你的项目里留任何标记）。另有活动日志 L0–L4，其中 L4 逐字存档用户原话（不注入上下文，可按需查）。每次压缩前把用户原话、报错原文、改过哪些文件落盘成一份逐字胶囊，重启后仍能取到（素材与胶囊分别落盘、跨重启保留）；再用交接单让新会话接上上一次的工作。21 个工具、12 个子命令、39 项设置（其中一项可切换「以设置面板为准 / 以项目清单为准」）；纯本地运行，零运行时依赖。

description.en: SSH/SFTP remote workspaces with conflict-aware mirror sync, port forwarding, and a native Web UI.
description.zh: 支持冲突感知镜像同步、端口转发和原生 Web UI 的 SSH/SFTP 远程工作区。

description.en: Persistent local token-usage accounting for DSH Web with automatic history discovery and compact provider/model details.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供自动发现历史记录的本地持久化 Token 用量统计与紧凑的供应商/模型明细。

description.en: Image viewer for the dock workbench: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, ICO and AVIF, with SVG rendered as image data only.
description.zh: dock 系列图片查看器：支持 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/SVG/ICO/AVIF 格式，SVG 仅以安全方式渲染。

description.en: Connects Huawei Cloud CodeArts to DeepSeek Harness: built-in Huawei Cloud OAuth2 sign-in (PKCE + DPoP) or a pasted token, after which CodeArts models are available in the DSH conversation window, with local per-account request and token usage.
description.zh: 把华为云 CodeArts 接入 DeepSeek Harness：内置华为云 OAuth2 登录（PKCE + DPoP），也支持粘贴 token；登录后即可在 DSH 对话窗口使用 CodeArts 提供的模型，并展示本机按账号统计的请求数与 token 用量。

description.en: A settings-panel skin manager that auto-discovers installed Web UI skins, switches between them in one click, and maintains the profile patch automatically.
description.zh: 设置面板皮肤管理器：自动扫描已安装的 Web UI 皮肤并一键切换，profile 补丁自动维护。

description.en: Russian (ru) language pack for the dsh web GUI: 584 namespaces and 67724 strings, including 520 third-party plugin dictionaries and Russian plural forms.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面提供俄语 (ru) 语言包：584 个命名空间、67724 条文案，含 520 个第三方插件词典与俄语复数形式。

description.en: AgentDuel is a code-battle game. This plugin lets you complete the entire game loop inside DSH: manage deathmatch characters and capture-the-flag teams, submit agent code, start battles, watch replays, and use DSH conversations to keep improving agents based on battle results.
description.zh: AgentDuel 是一款代码对战游戏，通过这款插件，在 DSH 内部完成整个游戏过程，实现死斗角色与夺旗团队、提交 Agent 代码、发起战斗、观看回放，并通过 DSH 会话依据战果继续优化 Agent。

description.en: Web search pool for the native web_search tool: fails over across 8 free/paid backends with quota-aware circuit breaking, settings-page API key management, custom SearXNG instances, failover/rotate strategy switching and live SerpApi quota.
description.zh: 原生 web_search 的搜索池：8 个免费/付费后端自动故障转移与额度感知熔断，设置页管理 API Key、自定义 SearXNG 实例、failover/rotate 策略切换与 SerpApi 实时额度查询。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 多模型路由插件：让专业的事情交给专业的 agent——自定义视觉/翻译/语音/子代理等专业 agent 并绑定独立模型，多模态账号一键登录、账号池健康路由与实时用量统计
description.zh: 给 DSH 主 agent 挂上专业小弟：视觉、翻译、语音等各配独立模型，按任务自动路由。

description.en: 开窍 · AI 私人老师：给 DeepSeek Harness 装一位私人老师，为你定制课程，在手写黑板上边写边讲。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装个私人老师，说出想学的东西，它先摸清你的底子，再定制课程，在手写黑板上边写边讲。

description.en: 把单一会话不可能的巨任务拆成无数可验证子系统，大规模并行有纪律执行
description.zh: 把超大需求拆成可验证的小块，分波并行执行，还能让子代理接着审查，专治单会话搞不定的巨任务。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-apollo
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-apollo

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Takes tasks from Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client (through the dsh-baton-mcp server) over an owner-only local socket: creates or continues a specific Harness session, runs it live in the UI labelled with the sender, and hands the result back when the turn ends. 12 MCP tools cover workspaces, sessions and runs.
description.zh: 通过本机仅限当前用户的 socket，接收 Claude Code、Codex 或任意 MCP 客户端（经 dsh-baton-mcp）交来的任务：新建或继续指定的 Harness 会话，在界面里实时运行并标注发送方，回合结束后把结果交回。12 个 MCP 工具覆盖工作区、会话和运行。

description.en: DSH 对话流增强插件（零 DSH 源码改动，纯插件注入）。回合呈现：思考 chip（实时走秒 + 实时文字滚动）· 工具调用聚合 chip · 对话流卡片（步骤卡/总结卡）· 共享活动抽屉。正文增强：proto-tabs 可交互卡片 · diagram 流程图围栏 · 本地 HTML 内嵌预览（识别正文里的 .html 路径，host 读文件 + 同目录资源，iframe 沙箱隔离，高度自适应，1:1/等比缩放，浏览器打开）。界面与工具：会话头部对话/轨迹标签上移 · 对话截图（常驻无头浏览器渲染 markdown/shiki/mermaid 真图，可内嵌本地 HTML）· download 下载工具（实时进度条/速度/ETA）。
description.zh: 不改官方源码就给对话加交互卡片、执行大盘和记忆钉，读起来更顺、过程看得懂。

description.en: DSH优化子代里：一款由于管理子代里运行流程的插件，可以让主代理根据设置选择性调用适合的子代里
description.zh: 统一管理子代理的调用与运行，按会话挑选合适的子代理和模型，省心又灵活。

description.en: Creates, reads, and edits DOCX, PDF, PPTX, and XLSX through `/documents`, `/pdf`, `/presentations`, and `/spreadsheets`; renders pages to check layout, and turns selections in the sidebar preview into edit requests for the session. Python 3.10-3.13 required.
description.zh: 通过 `/documents`、`/pdf`、`/presentations`、`/spreadsheets` 创建、读取与编辑 DOCX、PDF、PPTX、XLSX，把页面渲染出来核对排版，并将侧边栏预览中的选区变成发给会话的修改要求。需 Python 3.10–3.13。

description.en: Use OpenCode Zen free models in DeepSeek Harness with anonymous access or an optional API key
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里免费用上 OpenCode Zen 模型，匿名就能用，也可以填 API Key。

description.en: DSH STORE — third-party plugin marketplace and guarded lifecycle manager for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装插件的第三方市场，还能安全地安装、更新和卸载。

description.en: Switchable backends behind the native web_search and web_fetch, chosen per session from a composer menu or /setup-search and /setup-fetch: DeepSeek, Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily, Tinyfish, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and server-side model search for search; local HTTP with a private-network allowlist, the DeepSeek Fetch API, Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily and Tinyfish for fetch.
description.zh: 为原生 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供可切换的后端，每个会话可在输入框菜单或 /setup-search、/setup-fetch 中选择：搜索支持 DeepSeek、Exa、Firecrawl、Tavily、Tinyfish、OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar 与模型服务端搜索；抓取支持带内网白名单的本机 HTTP、DeepSeek Fetch API 以及 Exa、Firecrawl、Tavily、Tinyfish。

description.en: Drag a session out of the DSH sidebar and it opens in its own native OS window, showing the full standard conversation UI (Markdown, toolbar, settings) with only the sidebar trimmed away, so several sessions can be watched side by side instead of switching back and forth. Windows verified; macOS and Linux untested. Runs in the DSH desktop app (Electron).
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧边栏里的会话拖出来，即在独立的原生系统窗口中打开；窗口内是完整的标准会话界面（Markdown、工具栏、设置都在），只裁掉侧边栏，因此可以同时盯住多个会话，不必来回切换。Windows 已验证，macOS/Linux 未实测；需在 DSH 桌面端（Electron）中使用。

description.en: DSH 视频工作台：图文分镜、前端代码生成与编辑、本地 MP4 导出
description.zh: 在对话里编排分镜、生成动画代码，还能在工作台逐帧调整并导出本地 MP4。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness reply typography, interactive charts/tables and isolated HTML artifacts. Windows 0.2.1-rc.2 preview.
description.zh: 给 DSH 助手回复换三种排版风格，图表表格能点能操作，还能隔离运行 HTML 小作品，读起来更舒服。

description.en: Rhine Lab theme for DeepSeek Harness — 莱茵生命主题：开屏动画、界面主题、品牌标志与附加功能
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端换上莱茵生命风格开屏动画、界面配色和品牌标志，开箱即用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for shareable session deep links
description.zh: 通过链接一键分享或直达 DeepSeek Harness 会话，方便协作与快速访问。

description.en: Floating glass status bar for DSH on Windows 11 x64: an always-on-top capsule that mirrors session progress, the current step and pending approvals from a local DSH web profile, with peek and detail views; approval cards stay read-only until DSH returns its own decision receipt, and connecting to the official Desktop app is experimental and unverified.
description.zh: Windows 11 x64 上的 DSH 悬浮玻璃状态栏：常驻胶囊显示本地 DSH web profile 的会话进度、当前步骤与待处理审批，可展开速览与详情；审批卡在 DSH 返回正式回执前保持只读，连接官方 Desktop 应用属实验性、未验收。

description.en: 使用DeepSeekHarness进行学习和笔记
description.zh: 陪你精读资料、边问边学，把内容整理成能反复回看的 Obsidian 笔记。

description.en: Session-scoped AlphaSolve workflow for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 AlphaSolve 数学解题流程接进 DSH，按会话独立运行，默认休眠、需要时再唤醒。

description.en: Git workspace enhancements for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web GUI: worktree staging, sidebar git badges, files & diff conversation views, paseo-style PR actions
Agent security guardrail: intercepts and audits every tool call, requiring human confirmation on sensitive operations.
description.zh: Agent 安全护栏：拦截并审计所有工具调用，命中敏感操作就要求人工确认。

description.en: OpenCode Go model provider for DeepSeek Harness - a maintained fork that keeps the model catalog reachable and configures itself from Settings > Models
把 Wallpaper Engine 动态壁纸搬进 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI：浏览器内实时渲染 scene 壁纸（three.js + Rust/WASM 粒子模拟），支持视频与 web 壁纸，无需 Wallpaper Engine 运行时。
description.zh: 把 Wallpaper Engine 动态壁纸搬进 DSH 网页界面，浏览器里直接实时渲染，不用装 Wallpaper Engine。

description.en: Balanced web search plugin/MCP server for DeepSeek Harness: Keenable / Exa / Tavily round-robin with failover. / 均衡搜索插件：Keenable / Exa / Tavily 轮流调用，自动故障切换。
description.zh: 把 Keenable、Exa、Tavily 三个搜索源轮流调用，一个挂了自动换下一个，让联网搜索更稳。

description.en: Luna preset for DeepSeek Harness — a little-demon persona on the full standard tool set, composed by six deterministic rule layers (perception, understanding, state, style, regulation, memory) plus a derived vitals layer, with a gated, suppressible cross-session memory file.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的露娜预设：小恶魔人设配完整的 standard 工具面，由感知、理解、状态、表达、调节、记忆六层确定性规则驱动，外加生理派生层；跨会话记忆写入经证据门控，遗忘用抑制而非删除。

description.en: DSH 思考与工具调用聚合：回合级思考 chip（实时时长/实时文字滚动）+ 工具调用聚合 chip + 共享活动抽屉 + 对话流卡片（步骤卡/总结卡，回合结束后才出现）——自 dsh-webui 移植。零 DSH 源码改动。
Image previews for DSH sessions: read_image thumbnails plus user, assistant, Markdown and present images in a lightbox with zoom, rotate, pan, download, sidebar and native file actions.
description.zh: 统一接管 DSH 会话里的图片预览：read_image 缩略图，以及用户、助手、Markdown 和 present 图片，支持缩放、旋转、拖动、下载、侧栏和原生文件操作的 Lightbox。

description.en: TapTap Maker game-dev workbench with 150+ bundled skills, custom image lane, ChatGPT web with account rotation, CC0 SFX, web BGM, and a forced no-Maker-credit-burn policy.
description.zh: TapTap Maker 游戏开发工作台：内置 150+ 技能、自定义生图通道、ChatGPT 网页多账号轮换、CC0 音效库、网页 BGM，并强制"未经用户同意不花 Maker 额度"。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 生图+生视频整合插件：统一供应商目录、三个工具、中转站实测的异步视频契约、 限流退避纪律、设置页+画廊+快车道 CLI。MIT，fork 合并自 dsh-image-generation 与 dsh-video-gen。| Unified image+video generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness (MIT, fork-merge of dsh-image-generation & dsh-video-gen)
description.zh: 一个插件搞定 AI 生图和生视频，统一供应商配置，自带画廊和命令行，开箱即用。

description.en: MUV Variable Table Editor - tavern companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness: structured table editing for UpdateVariable blocks, PolyForm-Noncommercial-Copyleft-1.0.0
description.zh: 酒馆伴生插件，用表格方式编辑 UpdateVariable 变量块，让变量管理更直观。

description.en: Per-event sound alerts and system notifications for DeepSeek Harness. Four events — turn complete, question, approval and error — each get a switch, a sound picker with instant preview and a system-notification master switch. Nine built-in tones (four per-event defaults plus chime, bell, soft and alert, and a silent option) are synthesized at runtime with the Web Audio API, so no audio files ship with the package. A mode dropdown in General settings offers on, off and a smart mode that defers to the whale widget so the two never double up; the same row has a preview button and a gear opening a full settings dialog with volume, a skip-while-focused option and upload of your own audio up to 2 MB. A speaker button in the composer mutes sound without touching notifications. Works in the web GUI and the Electron desktop app.
description.zh: DSH 逐事件提醒插件：任务完成 / 需要回答 / 需要授权 / 运行出错四类事件，各配一个开关、一个可即时试听的声音选择和一个系统通知总开关。内置 9 项音色（四个事件各自默认音，外加叮咚、铃音、轻柔、警示与静音各一），全部用 Web Audio 实时合成，不随包分发任何音频文件。通用设置那一行提供模式下拉（开启提醒 / 关闭提醒 / 智能判断，智能模式让开鲸鱼挂件已提醒的事件，避免重复），旁边有试听按钮与打开完整设置弹窗的齿轮；弹窗内含音量、前台运行时不提醒，以及上传自定义音频（单个不超过 2MB）。对话输入框左下角的喇叭可临时静音声音而不影响系统通知。网页端与桌面端（Electron）均可用。
在 DSH 里说需求就能自动做出可继续编辑的 PPT，逐页生成还带自动检查。

description.en: 增强提示词魔法棒:DSH Web 对话输入框的灵活自适应提示词增强插件
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话输入框加个魔法棒按钮，一点就把口语化、带错字的输入变成精准提示词。

description.en: 增强提示词魔法棒:DSH Web 对话输入框的灵活自适应提示词增强插件

Auto-classify DeepSeek Harness sessions via Jev decision models or Agent tools, displayed as title emoji prefixes (wip 🚧, blocked ⏸️, review 👀, done ✅, plan 💡, bug 🐛). Features seamless lifecycle recovery, optional Jev inference (needs a Jev API key), model tool maintenance, and a visual settings panel.
description.zh: 基于 Jev 决策模型或 Agent 工具为会话自动分类，并将任务阶段直观展示为标题前缀 Emoji（进行中 🚧、阻塞 ⏸️、待验收 👀、已完成 ✅、规划 💡、排障 🐛）。支持生命周期状态自愈、可选 Jev 决策推断（需配置 Jev API Key）、Agent 自主标记与可视化设置面板。

description.en: Bring WorkBuddy's free and paid models (domestic and international) into DSH — no WorkBuddy desktop app required.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 国内版和国际版的免费/付费模型接进 DSH —— 无需下载 WorkBuddy 桌面端。

description.en: AI驱动的分波分析自动化。
description.zh: 让AI自动完成分波分析全流程，从参数配置到拟合收敛，省去手动调参的繁琐。

description.en: Novel-writing console for DSH: five novel_* tools for the agent (list, read, context, save chapter, cast) plus a side panel with a book wizard, a cast/relation view and streaming chapter continuation.
description.zh: 小说创作台：5 个 novel_* 工具（列目录、读文件、取上下文、存章节、管角色），外加侧栏开书向导、人物关系图与流式续写。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a photo of a surface becomes a complete tileable PBR material set, fully local via ComfyUI (FLUX.2 Klein 4B instruction edit + deterministic PBR derivation). GUI workbench, five agent tools, and a setup tool that finds your ComfyUI and downloads its own weights.
description.zh: 一张照片就能在本地生成整套可平铺 PBR 贴图，直接拿去做游戏和 3D 材质。

description.en: Moves a plugin set between DSH profiles (web to desktop by default): diff, pre-checks, an offline script for CLI-owned profiles, and a post-restart verification. It installs nothing itself.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的各 profile 之间迁移插件（默认 web → desktop）：算差异、预检、为 CLI 管的 profile 生成离线脚本、重启后核对。它自己不安装任何东西。

description.en: Restart button at the right end of the session header that restarts the whole client: the Windows desktop app (Electron shell and Host, through the Host's own graceful shutdown) or the dsh web server. It can wait until running turns and background jobs finish, reopens the open session afterwards with one-click continue for interrupted sessions, flags plugin updates that only take effect after a restart, and shows Host uptime and memory on hover.
description.zh: 会话标题栏右端的重启按钮，可重启整个客户端：Windows 桌面版（Electron 外壳与 Host，走 Host 自身的优雅关闭流程）或 dsh web 服务。可等正在运行的回合与后台作业结束后再重启；重启后回到原会话，被中断的会话可一键继续；提示需重启才生效的插件更新；悬停显示 Host 运行时长与内存。

description.en: Heap-allocated stack-safe fork tree with two-track indentation, title marquee, and physical cascade purge.
description.zh: 非递归显式栈侧边栏分支树，支持双轨缩进解耦、平滑跑马灯与物理级联删除事务。

description.en: Free keyless Tavily web search tool for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 傻瓜式插件全家桶 - 装一个包，所有功能开箱即用

description.en: SIDOR starfield skin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: intro animation, starfield, balance badge, settings FX, low-balance alerts
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上 SIDOR 星野皮肤，带开场动画、星空背景、余额徽章和低余额提醒，好看又实用。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）流程图管理插件：浏览 Archify 业务流程图目录、按 Git 附注标签阅读历史版本、保存版本。A workflow-diagram manager plugin for DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里浏览 Archify 业务流程图，按 Git 附注标签翻看历史版本，还能随时保存新版本。

description.en: DSH Web 音效播放器（设置页管理）：对话完成、发送消息、权限请求、被提问、服务终止、子代理运行完成、最后一个子代理运行完成等 7 类场景触发提示音；内置 Web Audio 合成音效与 Windows 系统提示音，可导入自定义音频并逐项绑定；提供 soundPlayer API 供其他插件集成
description.zh: 对话完成、被提问、子代理跑完等 7 类场景自动响提示音，设置页里就能换音效、绑自定义音频。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：情绪检查点与修复 —— 安抚、折叠封存争吵段、注入结论，从干净上下文继续任务 | Emotional checkpoint & repair for DSH
description.zh: 用户发火时先安抚修复关系，再把争吵折叠封存、注入结论，从干净上下文继续干活。

description.en: DNS-validated web_fetch for DeepSeek Harness behind Clash/Mihomo TUN fake-IP · 为 DSH 提供 fake-IP 环境下的 DoH 校验安全抓取，保留非公网目标拦截
description.zh: 让 DSH 的网页抓取在 Clash/Mihomo fake-IP 模式下照常能用，同时拦住内网等非公网目标。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 文档编辑插件：在右侧栏的文档预览里就地编辑文本文件并保存，支持 Ctrl+S、冲突保护、行尾逐字节保留。In-place document editor for the DSH Sidebar preview: Ctrl+S, conflict protection, byte-exact line-ending preservation.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里直接改文本并保存，支持 Ctrl+S 和冲突保护，行尾原样保留。

description.en: Peak-hour auto session gate: weekend mode + global peak auto-pause + session-level freeze/resume + backend auto-retry, auto-resume on off-peak.
description.zh: 高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停（全局）+ 会话级冻结/恢复 + 后端自动重试；错峰自动续跑。

description.en: ACP server for DeepSeek Harness — bridges Zed and other IDEs to dsh agents
description.zh: ACP server for DeepSeek Harness — bridges Zed and other IDEs to dsh agents
