description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 智能压缩上下文，自动精简工具调用结果，省 token 又不丢关键信息。

description.en: 为DeepSeek Harness开发的右侧边栏尺寸持久化记忆插件
description.zh: 记住你拖过的右侧边栏宽度，按页签类型自动恢复，不用每次重新调。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sidebar plugin: stack-safe fork tree, two-track indentation, marquee title, leading/hover slots, and cascade purge.
Deterministic diagnostics and recovery for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Deterministic diagnostics and recovery for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Headroom context-compression proxy integration for DeepSeek Harness: detect/install/start Headroom, auto-configure the DeepSeek compressed route, one-click route-switch UI. Built on headroomlabs-ai/headroom (Apache-2.0).
description.zh: 一键检测安装并启动 Headroom 压缩代理，自动配好 DeepSeek 压缩路由，随时切换省 token。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Bilibili video search, metadata, and subtitle transcripts (bilibili_search / bilibili_video / bilibili_subtitles) · DeepSeek Harness 插件:B 站视频检索、元数据与字幕文稿,匿名可用,可选 SESSDATA 解锁登录字幕
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里搜 B 站视频、看元数据和字幕文稿，匿名可用，登录后还能解锁更多内容。

description.en: dsh-gal —— DeepSeek Harness 的立绘挂件：实时显示余额与今日消耗、每轮对话结束结算 token 与花费、点击立绘随机播语音并逐字显示台词，立绘包/语音包都能换
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面养个会说话的立绘，实时看余额和今日花费，点一下还能播语音念台词。

description.en: Generic LLM gateway provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness: newapi / LiteLLM / Higress / any OpenAI-compatible gateway, multi-protocol (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini) via pi-ai SDK, models.dev enrichment
description.zh: Generic LLM gateway provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness: newapi / LiteLLM / Higress / any OpenAI-compatible gateway, multi-protocol (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini) via pi-ai SDK, models.dev enrichment

description.en: 把 DSH 会话窗口变成 A 股盯盘执行台：行情仪表盘 · 盘后复盘七步 · 模型作战思路 · 自挖板块（无监督共动聚类 + LLM 命名）· 个股工作台 · 选股筛选 · 监控提醒
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话窗口变成 A 股盯盘执行台，行情、复盘、选股、监控提醒一站搞定。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 美化插件：背景图 + 面板半透明，设置页实时调节。Background image & translucent panels with a live settings page.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 界面换上背景图和半透明面板，设置页里实时调，好看又好用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: registers a global skill that teaches agents how to discover, evaluate and install community plugins from the GitHub dsh-plugin topic, dshmarket and npm. | DSH 社区插件生态指南 skill：让 agent 学会发现、评估、安装社区插件。
description.zh: 教智能体从 GitHub、dshmarket 和 npm 发现、评估并安装社区插件，轻松扩展 DSH 生态。

description.en: dsh 登录门卫插件：让只监听本机的 dsh Web UI 安全地对外开放——登录墙 + 全量反代，零依赖、零侵入。
description.zh: 给只监听本机的 dsh Web UI 加一道登录墙，登录后全量反代，让你安全地从外网访问。

description.en: deepseek harness 插件 替换会话持久化引擎为 MySQL 数据库
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话存储换成 MySQL，让对话记录更持久、好管理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 网页搜索插件：多个 Tavily/Exa key 按限流负载均衡，429 自动换 key，含设置页 UI 与 Tavily 额度总览。
description.zh: 给 DSH 接上 Tavily/Exa 多密钥搜索，自动轮换限流、429 换 key，还能看额度。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 工作搭档：长任务完成通知（Toast/Webhook）+ 私有知识库（kb_search）。Task-completion notifications + private knowledge base.
description.zh: 任务完成即时通知（Toast/Webhook）+ 私有知识库搜索，让 DSH 用起来更顺手。

description.en: Per-session billing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: token buckets, cache hit rate, and peak-aware cost in the session header + a price-table settings page
description.zh: 按会话实时统计 token 用量和费用，区分缓存命中与高峰计价，帮您精准掌控每次对话成本。

description.en: dsh's tui base on nvim
description.zh: 把 dsh 的终端界面换成 Neovim 风格，分屏看会话、工具卡片和推理过程，还能直接审批操作。

description.en: Local OCR plugin for DeepSeek Harness — paste an image, get its text via PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime, fully offline.   Supports TUI (cc-tui) and Web. ｜ DeepSeek Harness 本地 OCR 插件：粘贴图片，PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime   识别文字，完全离线，支持 TUI 与 Web
万物皆是插件，万物皆可自定义——基于DeepSeek Harness的安全测试工作台，提示词、工具、MCP、技能、知识库、WebShell均可模块化编排，覆盖渗透测试与代码审计。
Connect dsh to Notion via the official Notion MCP (OAuth + PKCE): search, read, and write pages, databases, and comments through `mcp__notion__*` tools.

description.en: 把文件拖入/粘贴到 DeepSeek Harness Web：输入框原生引用气泡，随消息发送（含绝对路径），气泡渲染文件卡片。Drag/paste files into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI as native reference bubbles — absolute paths, file cards.
description.zh: 拖入/粘贴文件：输入框上方文件栏（chips）+ @文件名 光标内联插入 + 随消息发送（含绝对路径）+ 气泡文件卡片。Drag/paste files into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI and send them with your message (absolute paths included).

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 持久化、审批驱动的项目编排工作台
description.zh: 内置状态持久化与审批关卡，帮你把零散任务串成完整项目流，让复杂编排更省心。

description.en: 运行在 deepseek harness 上的女仆酱
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness Web 加一只蓝鲸女仆桌宠，任务状态随时提醒，还能估算费用。

description.en: OpenCode Go subscription models as a DeepSeek Harness provider: re-resolves the live gateway catalog every few minutes, auto-adapts models the built-in table has not seen, and covers streaming, tool calls, image input and subscription usage. A maintained fork of dsh-opencode-go: a clash with the upstream package over the llm-opencode-go settings namespace makes it withdraw quietly instead of failing the whole plugin tree, and an already-claimed opencode-go route makes it serve on opencode-go-plus.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Go 订阅模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：每隔几分钟重新解析网关实时目录，内置表里没有的模型按同族自动适配，支持流式输出、工具调用、图片输入与订阅额度显示。这是 dsh-opencode-go 的维护分支：与上游包争用 llm-opencode-go 设置命名空间时安静退场，而不是让整棵插件树加载失败；opencode-go 路由已被占用时改用 opencode-go-plus 路由继续服务。

description.en: Teach Math with Manim — 图书《用 Manim 讲好数学》官方配套开源仓库
description.zh: 用 Manim 做数学教学动画的官方配套仓库，含 60+ 案例源码和 AI 技能，拿来就能用。

description.en: 变更证明（ChangeProof）— DeepSeek Harness 插件：代码改动后确认改动的行真的被测试覆盖到
description.zh: 代码改动后，自动确认改动的行真的被测试覆盖到，避免“测试全绿但改动没被测”的假通过。

description.en: Exposes OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness with no API key, tracking Zen gateway changes.
description.zh: 将 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需 API Key，并跟踪网关兼容性。

description.en: Website cloning methodology skill: a real-source-first decision tree covering static sites, React/Vue/Next content sites and WebGL/Canvas-heavy fronts, mandatory verification of executable code quoted from second-hand AI analyses, and 13 zero-dependency Node scripts for CDP browser recon, asset/font harvesting, route crawling, sourcemap hunting and pixel-diff auditing.
description.zh: 网站复刻方法论 skill：以「真源码至上」决策树覆盖静态站、React/Vue/Next 内容站与 WebGL/Canvas 重前端站，强制核对二手 AI 分析里的可执行代码，内置 13 个零依赖 Node 脚本（CDP 浏览器侦察、素材/字体抓取、路由爬取、source map 挖掘、像素 diff 审计）。

description.en: Loom Chat is a DSH Web client plugin that turns linear ordinary sessions into a pannable, zoomable Loom-style canvas for parallel exploration.
description.zh: 把普通对话变成可缩放平移的无限画布，让你并行探索多个话题，聊天不再是一条线。

description.en: 缓解部分dsh性能问题的插件
description.zh: 在数据流层面合并流式输出，减少 DSH 会话事件量，缓解性能瓶颈。

description.en: DSH Plugin for Markdown like Notion experience
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用 Notion 式所见即所得体验写 Markdown，还能三栏 VS Code 工作区加 AI 提效。

description.en: Ultra-lightweight Moli (Rust headless browser) web-fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness: renders complex SPAs, micro-frontends, and dynamic pages with ~60MB memory.
description.zh: 基于超轻量 Rust 无头浏览器 Moli 的 web_fetch 提供方：专为微前端与复杂 SPA 渲染设计，内存占用仅约 60MB。

description.en: Maps locally analyzed system audio to music-reactive conversation effects, rhythm-game judgements, score and combo feedback, and optional RGB spectrum bars in DSH Web.
description.zh: 将本地分析的系统音频映射为 DSH Web 的对话律动、音游判定、分数与连击反馈，以及可选的 RGB 频谱柱。

description.en: "Weniger" — less, but better: a Dieter Rams-inspired theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
description.zh: 受迪特·拉姆斯设计哲学启发的极简主题，让 DeepSeek Harness 界面更清爽、更专注。
把雪之下雪乃接入DSH，自带Live2D形象和日语音色，能主动搭话、监听任务完成并语音播报，还能当陪伴面板。

description.en: DSH 会话日志导入插件:解析 /export 的 zip/jsonl,结构真实性验证 + SHA-256 指纹校验,同步模型/预设/权限等状态,导入/删除实时推送免刷新
description.zh: 把 DSH 导出的会话日志一键导入成可继续聊的新会话，还能校验真伪、同步模型和权限。

description.en: Coding workbench for DSH: docked workspace panels, a grouped project sidebar, split editor tab groups with hibernate/resume, file preview and diff views — built on parallel git worktree development with cross-session collaboration primitives.

description.en: Fold completed DeepSeek Harness chat turns without replacing native renderers.
description.zh: 把已完成的对话轮次折叠起来，界面更清爽，同时不影响原有渲染效果。

description.en: dsh通知消息统一管理框架
description.zh: 统一管理通知消息，让插件注册自己的通知项，并在设置页配置，内置任务完成、提问、崩溃等事件通知。

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接管理 SSH 连接，带多标签实时终端面板，操作更顺手。

description.en: DSH CSV 数据工具插件：解析/查询/统计/转换 CSV 文本（RFC 4180），零依赖状态机解析器，注册 csv 工具
description.zh: 解析、查询、过滤、统计和转换 CSV 文本，零依赖纯函数实现，适合处理表格数据。

description.en: DSH Diff 工具插件：文本/JSON/CSV/Markdown 结构化比较与 unified diff，零依赖只读，注册 diff 工具
description.zh: 快速对比文本、JSON、CSV和Markdown内容，生成统一的差异报告，帮助Agent精准定位数据变化。

description.en: DSH 编码/哈希工具插件：base64/base64url/url/hex 编解码、md5/sha1/sha256/sha512 哈希、UUID 生成，零依赖
description.zh: DSH 编码/哈希工具，支持 base64、URL、hex 编解码，MD5/SHA 哈希和 UUID 生成，零依赖纯函数。

description.en: DSH 时间工具插件：严格 ISO 8601 解析、IANA 时区转换、UTC 日历运算、固定时长差，零依赖
description.zh: DSH 时间工具插件：严格解析 ISO 8601、转换 IANA 时区、UTC 日历运算和固定时长差，零依赖纯函数，让 Agent 轻松处理时间问题。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: edit sent messages and resend (stop an in-flight reply, edit, resend), plus branch-based edit / reroll / retry and a version timeline.
description.zh: 消息发出去后也能改：停止回复、编辑重发，还能分支重试，旧版本自动归档。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language, developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd. based on the same logic as the company's own nUR MCP Server. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言直接控制 Universal Robots（UR）机械臂的插件，由拓德科技（Nonead）基于自研的 nUR MCP Server 同源逻辑开发。（Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.）

description.en: A DSH plugin that distinguishes official built-in DSH plugins and user custom plugins on the external interface.It can collect and manage all your previously created custom plugins 这是一个 DSH 插件管理插件，可在web界面区分 DSH 自带插件与自定义插件，并且能够收纳用户之前的自定义插件进行管理
description.zh: 将 DSH 设置中的插件区分为官方内置和用户自定义，集中管理你创建过的所有插件，支持可视化操作与依赖自动检查。

description.en: Prompt-level wiki skill suite (wiki, wiki-ingest, wiki-query, wiki-lint, save) for dsh — pairs with dsh-plugin-wiki-tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一套提示词级 Wiki 技能，支持内容整理、查询、检查与保存，方便搭建个人知识库。

description.en: Native AnySearch /v1/search WebSearchProvider for DeepSeek Harness with Web UI, credentials integration, and Web/Headless support.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 AnySearch 搜索，支持网页界面和凭据配置，轻松实现联网检索。

description.en: Tencent Cloud ADP plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 深度集成腾讯云智能体平台，让你在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接发现和调用云端 AI 模型。

description.en: Desktop companion plugin and native shell for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供桌面原生外壳与配套工具，让 AI 工作流在本地更顺手、更高效。

description.en: 写书鲸：面向 DeepSeek Harness 的原生 AI 小说创作工作台插件
description.zh: 写书鲸：在 DeepSeek Harness 里和 AI 一起写小说，灵感、正文、Agent 协作全搞定，创作效率直接拉满。

description.en: DSH plugin for agent-driven span compaction: compress chosen conversation spans into self-written checkpoints instead of the official head-anchored full-context sweep.
description.zh: 让智能体自主压缩对话片段为摘要，替代官方全量扫描，节省上下文空间。

description.en: Fills missing context window, max tokens, thinking levels, and image input on custom DSH models from models.dev, and lists unmatched models for manual edits.
description.zh: 按模型名从 models.dev 补全自定义模型缺失的上下文、输出上限、思考档位和图片能力，并列出未匹配模型供手改。

description.en: Remote development over SSH: pick a directory on a registered machine as the session workspace and the file, shell, bash, and search tools run on the remote host — the agent works there with the same local tools, and no extra model-facing tools are added.
description.zh: 基于 SSH 的远程开发：把注册机器上的目录选为会话工作区后，文件、shell、bash 与搜索工具即改在远程主机上执行——agent 用与本地相同的工具在那里工作，不新增任何面向模型的工具。

description.en: dsh-plugin: floating semi-transparent market ticker for DeepSeek Harness — 上证指数 / 创业板指 / 科创50 / 恒生科技
description.zh: 页面右上角悬浮显示A股与港股核心指数，支持拖拽收起，方便工作时随时查看行情。

description.en: DSH web plugin: toggle plugins on/off from the GUI without restarting the server
description.zh: 在网页界面上直接开关插件，无需重启服务器，即改即用。

description.en: Arbitrary file upload, reading, OCR, and rendering for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接上传、阅读、OCR 识别并渲染任意格式文件，让文档处理更顺手。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 任务看板插件：主机状态机 + git 调度 + 浏览器看板 UI，agent 自动执行任务、审核后自动合并回基础分支
description.zh: 把任务、Git分支和AI Agent串成流水线，看板建单后Agent自动干活，人工审核通过就能直接合入主分支。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web（`dsh --profile web`）记录**每日 LLM 调用花费**，支持按会话 / 模型 / 天多维度查看。
description.zh: 记录 DeepSeek Harness Web 每日 LLM 调用花费，按会话、模型、天多维度查看，帮你掌握成本。

description.en: 聊天流中悬挂皮鞭，甩动鞭梢（>2.0 px/ms）即向 agent 发送 go work 消息 | A whip hanging in the chat stream; flick the tip (>2.0 px/ms) to send the agent a "go work!" message
description.zh: 聊天流中悬挂皮鞭，甩动鞭梢（>2.0 px/ms）即向 agent 发送 go work 消息 | A whip hanging in the chat stream; flick the tip (>2.0 px/ms) to send the agent a "go work!" message

description.en: Custom product name and logo branding for DeepSeek Harness Web 自定义 DeepSeek Harness Web 端 logo 和产品名称
description.zh: 不改源码，轻松给 DeepSeek Harness 换上自己的产品名和 logo，让界面更贴合品牌。

description.en: see_image tool for DSH: lets text-only models 'see' images by routing them to a configurable vision model (default Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash, free)
DeepSeek Harness Workbench
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成你的个人工作台，集中管理多个工作区，提升日常 AI 任务效率。

description.en: Never-interrupt, resumable lifecycle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): graceful restart + client auto-reconnect + cross-restart goal continuation.
Agnes AI image and video generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Agnes AI 生图生视频插件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 第三方 API 与自定义模型设置插件：支持请求头、User-Agent、模型列表、图像输入和思考等级 | WebUI plugin for third-party APIs and custom models with request headers, image input, and reasoning levels
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加第三方 API 和自定义模型支持，可配置请求头、图像输入和思考等级。

description.en: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: mica and compatibility modes with adjustable blur and frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, background brightness, particle-whale accent, and a master switch that restores the stock UI.
description.zh: Aqua 玻璃质感主题：云母/兼容双模式、可调模糊与磨砂、流体/壁纸背景、背景亮度、粒子鲸鱼点缀，一键关闭即还原原生界面。

description.en: Interactive A2UI cards for the dsh web UI — quizzes, forms, charts and diagrams rendered inline in the conversation, with a full action loop back to the agent.
description.zh: 在对话中直接渲染交互式卡片，支持测验、表单、图表等，操作结果实时回传智能体。

description.en: Registers the MathWorks MATLAB/Simulink MCP server into a dsh profile, so agent sessions get mcp__matlab__* tools for running MATLAB code and reading, editing and testing Simulink models.
description.zh: 把 MathWorks MATLAB/Simulink MCP 服务器注册进 dsh profile，让会话获得 mcp__matlab__* 工具，用于运行 MATLAB 代码以及读取、编辑与测试 Simulink 模型。

description.en: SVN (Subversion) toolset for DeepSeek Harness: 33 agent tools (status, diff, log, blame, commit, merge, props, lock, changelist...) plus a sidebar panel with side-by-side BASE/working-copy diff, conflict resolution and AI commit logs.
description.zh: SVN（Subversion）工具集：33 个 agent 工具（status/diff/log/blame/commit/merge/props/lock/changelist 等），以及带 BASE/工作副本左右对比、冲突解决与 AI 提交日志的侧边栏面板。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）第三方插件生态的 **Plugin Design**：发现第三方插件、检查其源码与配置、对照 DH-TP-SDK 工程化规范做静态分析、生成 `design.md`，经用户确认后对插件逐项修改并支持备份与回滚。
description.zh: 发现并分析 dsh 第三方插件，对照规范生成改造方案，帮你一键迁移升级还能随时回滚。

description.en: Read-only trajectory review in a resizable conversation sidebar, with rule analysis, optional model explanations, evidence navigation, and same-range run comparison.
description.zh: 在可调宽的会话右侧栏中提供只读轨迹复盘、规则分析、可选模型解读、证据定位和同区间运行对比。

description.en: deepseek harness plugin for medical image analysis
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 直接看懂医学影像，自动分析病灶并生成报告，辅助医生快速诊断。

description.en: Security audit for DeepSeek Harness plugins: static permission profile with file/line evidence + a runtime sentinel gating credential access and unknown-host egress · DSH 插件安全审计：静态权限画像（附文件/行号证据）+ 运行时哨兵，触及凭证或向未知主机外发数据时先请你批准
description.zh: 运行前摸清 DSH 插件底细：静态权限画像带证据，运行时哨兵拦截敏感访问和未知外联。

description.en: Hand long sessions over to a clean one: /handoff summarizes the conversation with an LLM, creates a new session+agent in the same workspace, injects the handoff document as the first message, and auto-opens it; the origin session stays unchanged.
description.zh: 长对话太乱？一键把当前会话总结成文档，开个新会话接着聊，上下文不丢。

description.en: View and manage archived sessions in DSH: browse the archive, read full transcripts (turns/reasoning/tools/markdown tables), remove records. Desktop + web.
DSH 插件市场：搜索 GitHub dsh-plugin 话题插件，一键安装到本地 dsh（agent 工具 + 设置页插件市场 tab）
description.zh: 在 GitHub 上搜罗 dsh 插件，一键装进本地，设置页和会话里都能用。

description.en: Project and session organization for DeepSeek Harness: multi-folder projects, searchable chats, attention summaries, and native folder picking.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成项目工作台，按项目管理会话和文件，快速切换不混乱。

description.en: Adds a draggable, position-persisted chip bar of configurable quick phrases to DeepSeek Harness, plus a /-triggered phrase menu with per-phrase pin, slash-menu, bar-visibility, and click-to-send toggles.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加可拖拽、位置会记住的快捷短语条，以及 `/` 触发的短语菜单；每条短语可单独设置置顶、斜杠菜单、是否上条和点击即发送。

description.en: dsh-better-sidebar 的视频文件预览插件： 在侧边栏打开 .mp4 .webm  .mov  .mkv  .avi 等视频文件时，内联渲染一个可播放、可拖拽进度条的 <video> 播放器。
description.zh: 在侧边栏直接预览视频文件，支持播放和拖拽进度条，无需离开当前界面。

description.en: DSH 活动统计：彩色时间线看什么时候在干活/改代码，每日 token 消耗按项目/日期/小时查看。
description.zh: 用彩色时间线看自己什么时候在干活，还能按项目、日期、小时查每日 token 消耗。

description.en: Archived-conversation manager for DeepSeek Harness: view archived conversations grouped by workspace, restore them, and reveal their transcript folders.
description.zh: 归档会话管理器：按工作区分组查看已归档的会话，支持恢复（取消归档）与打开会话转录目录。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: heuristic malware vetting for installed third-party plugins
description.zh: 给已装的第三方插件做恶意行为启发式扫描，提示高权限误用，可选运行时绊线，帮你提前发现风险。

description.en: A Yogācāra (唯识) self-model plugin for DeepSeek Harness: eight consciousnesses, the 51 mental factors, a perfumed seed store, and a measurable self — written back into the agent's own prompt.
description.zh: 基于唯识学为AI智能体构建自我模型，通过八识与心所机制提升自我认知与情感计算能力。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: conversation history request rail (ZCode-style) - 会话历史请求迷你滑轨
description.zh: 在对话区左侧加一条迷你滑轨，每条横线代表一次请求，悬停看摘要、点击跳转，快速定位历史对话。

description.en: Adds a Compact context button and a New session button to the context meter panel; compact submits /compact through the same command channel, and new session starts a fresh session in the same workspace.
description.zh: 在上下文计量面板中添加「压缩上下文」与「新建会话」两个按钮：压缩按钮通过与手敲 /compact 相同的通道提交命令，新建会话按钮在同一 workspace 中开启新会话。

description.en: deepseek harness 纯牛马 —— 多智能体数字员工指挥台插件
Piano-key style in-conversation navigation bar: one key per user message, hover preview tooltip, click-to-jump across full history. Official dual-face dsh plugin, no dsh source changes.
description.zh: 钢琴键风格的会话内导航条：每根键对应一条用户消息，悬停预览、点击跳转到完整历史的任意消息。官方双面 dsh 插件，不改 DSH 源码。

description.en: Full-featured ADB device management plugin for DeepSeek Harness - control your Android device via AI
description.zh: 通过 AI 直接管理安卓设备，支持 ADB 全功能操作，让手机控制更智能。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格的会话消息折叠。/ Provides Codex-style session message folding for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把连续的工具调用折叠成可展开摘要，让会话历史更清爽，只看结果不刷屏。

description.en: OpenCode Go plan usage monitor for DeepSeek Harness: real-time 5h-rolling / weekly / monthly quota in a floating web dock
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里加个悬浮窗，实时显示 OpenCode Go 套餐的 5 小时滚动、每周和每月用量配额，并带重置倒计时。

description.en: Registers Baidu, Doubao, Tavily, and Exa backends into ctx.web so official web_search can use them, and routes web_fetch through Tavily Extract or Exa Contents when that backend is active.
description.zh: 独立安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件集合，即插即用，轻松扩展 AI 工作流。

description.en: Vault button beside the DSH composer: save keys, servers, phone numbers, addresses and URLs, auto-collected from conversations, password-protected with WebDAV backup; click to insert, Ctrl+click to send.
description.zh: 输入栏旁的保险箱按钮：保存密钥、服务器、手机号、地址与网址，自动识别会话中的敏感信息提醒收录，密码保护并支持 WebDAV 备份；点击填入输入框，Ctrl+点击直接发送。

description.en: Adds selectable animated skins to the "Deep diving..." status row, with configurable size and optional status-text replacement.
description.zh: 为“Deep diving...”状态行添加可选动态皮肤，并支持调整尺寸和可选状态文案替换。

description.en: Proactive multi-model scheduling plugin: multi-source signal intake with dedup and urgency ranking, a four-way execute/defer/dismiss/ask-user decision engine, DAG plan generation with parallel model execution, quality reflection with automatic retry and model switch, long-term memory for task patterns and lessons, and strategy evolution via genetic algorithms with sandboxed evaluation and canary rollout.
description.zh: 主动式多模型协同调度插件：多源信号接入（去重与紧急度排序），execute/defer/dismiss/ask-user 四级决策引擎，DAG 计划生成与多模型并行执行，质量反思自动重试与切换模型，任务模式与经验教训长期记忆，以及遗传算法策略进化（沙盒评估、金丝雀发布）。

description.en: Migrates skills from other agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more) into DSH: scans 14 agent platforms plus the shared ~/.agents skills layer, detects duplicate names across sources, lets you pick the best source per skill, copies them into the DSH skills directory, and rolls back previously migrated skills.
description.zh: 把其他 Agent（Cursor、Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等）的技能一键搬进 DeepSeek Harness：扫描 14 个平台外加共享的 ~/.agents 技能层，识别不同来源的同名技能，可挑选每个技能的最佳来源，复制到 DSH 技能目录，支持回滚移除已迁移的技能。

description.en: Edge breathing border showing DeepSeek peak/valley hours, with flowing light and scheduled push reminders.
description.zh: DeepSeek 峰谷提醒：贴屏呼吸边框（高峰橙/低峰蓝）、流光效果与消息推送提醒。

description.en: 导入本地 Claude、Codex、Grok、Gemini、Copilot、OpenCode 与 CC Switch 配置。 为支持的官方供应商提供 OAuth 登录。 从 OpenAI 兼容网关的 /v1/models 与 /models 发现 CC Switch 模型。
description.zh: 一键导入本地 Claude、Codex 等编程工具登录配置，支持官方 OAuth 登录，自动发现并管理可用模型，让模型选择更省心。

description.en: DSH model-routing plugin for keyword routing and isolated image generation / DSH 关键词路由与隔离生图插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个智能路由，按关键词自动分配模型，还能隔离生图任务，省钱又省心。

description.en: Chat with local DeepSeek Harness agents from iPhone iMessage: switch workspaces/sessions, start new sessions, and get replies in the Messages app — no extra apps, no servers, no cloud.
description.zh: 在iPhone的短信应用里直接和本地DeepSeek Harness智能体聊天，无需额外应用或服务器。

description.en: 模式匹配自动注入 steering rules，不占系统上下文 - Inject rules when needed, without wasting context. Similar to oh-my-pi's "Time-traveling stream rules", but with a very simple and compact code implementation.
description.zh: 模式匹配自动注入 steering rules，不占系统上下文 - Inject rules when needed, without wasting context. Similar to oh-my-pi's "Time-traveling stream rules", but with a very simple and compact code implementation.

description.en: Minecraft theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness: block-texture background, pixel fonts, MC-style buttons with click sounds, texture import/management, music player with local music folder support.
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面换上 Minecraft 方块纹理和像素风，带音效按钮、纹理管理和内置音乐播放器，让开发环境更有游戏感。

description.en: J-Space Cognition Suite V3.6 - Inference-time cognitive control and deep reasoning plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供推理时的认知控制与深度思考能力，让模型在复杂任务中更聪明、更稳定。

description.en: Task-isolated long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — remember / recall / search stay inside one task boundary.
description.zh: 给每个任务建个独立记忆库，存资料、找内容都只在当前任务内流转，彻底告别跨任务信息串扰。

description.en: Cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates model input/output/cache tokens across all local sessions, prices them with a builtin table (including DeepSeek peak/off-peak), and shows daily trends plus per-model and per-session tables.
description.zh: 费用看板：汇总本机全部会话的模型输入/输出/缓存 token，按内置价格表计费（含 DeepSeek 峰谷），展示每日趋势与按模型/会话明细。

description.en: Universal image generation router for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): auto-discovers image models from any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Supports SenseNova, StepFun, Agnes, Qwen, Flux, SD, Imagen and more. | DeepSeek Harness 统一绘图路由器
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能直接调用任意 OpenAI 兼容接口的生图模型，一句话生成图片。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web 界面加一个 VS Code 风格的工作区文件浏览器：右侧文件树 + 可编辑标签页 + Markdown 阅读/编辑/分屏 + 悬浮大纲 + Quick Open 搜索。
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Claude Code-style shell integration: /! for single-command analysis and /terminal for interactive PTY sessions with on-demand history reference.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格的 shell 集成：/! 单命令分析 与 /terminal 交互式终端（带按需历史引用）。

description.en: Schedule-send button and panel to the right of the composer, with smart time slots, a custom date/time picker, several queued sends at once, and localStorage persistence that restores pending tasks after a page reload.
description.zh: 在输入框右侧提供「定时发送」按钮与配置面板，支持智能时段、自定义日期时间、多个定时任务并行，任务经 localStorage 持久化，刷新页面后自动恢复。

description.en: Adds a subagent_codex tool that delegates tasks to the local OpenAI Codex CLI, running the work in an isolated external process.

description.en: Engineering workflow agent preset for dsh: five gated phases (requirements clarification, plan approval, TDD, parallel subagents, verified finishing) with six workflow skills adapted from obra/superpowers.

description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 开启网络访问模式，让 Windows 沙箱里的 curl 能正常访问 HTTPS，同时保持文件写保护不变。

description.en: Cute whale-girl pet plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加一只可爱的鲸鱼娘桌宠，陪你摸鱼、干活、等结果。

description.en: DSH插件-模型余额显示功能

description.en: 🎬 DSH (DeepSeek Harness) B站悬浮看片插件：边 coding 边刷视频。推荐/热门/排行/搜索/关注UP主、自动连播、迷你模式、历史持久化

description.en: Feishu bot bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: MiniMax-powered multimodal plugin: real-time voice call mode (streaming conversation, floating dock UI), voice mode and mic voice input, plus image/video/music/speech generation and vision inspection tools.

description.en: Feishu (Lark) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: one-command install, streaming progress cards with a tool panel, ask/approval button cards, attachments, and proactive feishu_send pushes.
description.zh: 飞书入口插件：一条命令安装，流式进度卡片带工具面板、提问/审批按钮卡片、附件处理与 feishu_send 主动推送。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 全局 HTTP 代理插件：undici setGlobalDispatcher + EnvHttpProxyAgent，配置化、热切换、可观测

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件（Cordis toolset）：操作本地 Obsidian 知识库（vault），提供搜索、读写笔记、双向链接 / 关系图谱、批量整理，并通过 Obsidian 的 "Local REST API" 社区插件调用高级能力（高速全文搜索、触发命令 / 模板）。

description.en: 携手skillhub，快捷安装启用丰富的skill，一键装配方便快捷。

description.zh: dshx — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: OMX-style workflow skills for DeepSeek Harness: deep-interview, ralplan, ralph, autopilot, team, code-review, visual-ralph, canslim-trader and 17 more, with autopilot defaulting to agent-team collaboration (Agent Teams), rewritten on native DSH tools including vision-backed UI matching.

description.en: DSH Web background settings: upload a local image or pick a preset ambiance, with live preview and persistent settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 设置背景：上传本地图片或选择预设氛围，实时预览且设置持久化。

description.en: LAN / remote-access control, frpc NAT tunneling, a panel password gate, and mobile UI adaptation for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：局域网/远程访问控制、frpc 内网穿透、面板密码门禁与手机端 UI 适配。

description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个全局热身层，首轮自动预热，之后恢复完整模式，对话更流畅。

description.en: Native CloakBrowser tools for DeepSeek Harness: isolated browser sessions, snapshots, interaction, screenshots, and safe Agent routing.

description.en: Runtime extension suite for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session mailbox with wake cold-start, agent teams (captain + members + dependency task board + team_wait), subagent spawn policy with escalation approval, task-aware routing preset, plugin market, skill manager and runtime injector.

description.en: 听雨的声音 一滴滴清晰， 你的呼吸像雨滴渗入我的爱里， 真希望 雨能下不停， 让想念继续 让爱变透明， 我爱上 给我 勇气的 Rainie Love， 窗外的雨滴 一滴滴 累积， 屋内的湿气 像储存爱你的记忆， 真希望 雨能下不停， 雨爱的秘密 能一直延续， 我相信我将会看到彩虹的美丽。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 界面加上循环视频背景，GPU 友好不卡顿，让操作界面更带感。

description.zh: DSH plugin: auto-fill metadata (context length, output cap, display name, input modalities) for custom-provider models from the Model Metadata Registry (models.dev).

description.zh: 新粗野主义换肤皮肤：双方案（蓝统治 / 做旧报纸）随时切换，硬阴影 + 直角 + 2px 边框结构层，浅色/深色自适应。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin: add an IDE button that auto-detects local IDEs and opens the current workspace folder.

description.en: A marketplace plugin to quickly integrate your DeepSeek Harness into the GitHub plugin ecosystem.
description.zh: 帮你把 DeepSeek Harness 快速接入 GitHub 插件生态，装插件、管插件一步到位。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 API 支持低、中、高等推理强度，并可为每次子 Agent 调用选择模型｜Add Low, Medium, High, and other reasoning levels to third-party APIs, with model selection for each subagent call

我不是雏草姬

description.zh: Web GUI 远程访问：局域网二维码直连、cloudflared 快速隧道、frp 自有服务器反代，内置登录门户，并放行设置接口。

Digimon-style raising game: hatch an egg that feeds on real work (turns, tool calls, errors) and evolves along four branching lines shaped by how you work; zero tokens, invisible to the model.

description.zh: ADHD 行为辅导技能：任务拆解、事项过载管理、启动仪式与失败重启。

description.zh: DSH 多 agent 编排。

description.en: SHOPLINE AI Toolkit: bridges the official SHOPLINE Developer MCP server and ships seven SHOPLINE agent skills (Admin REST, GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks, Sline) — the SHOPLINE counterpart of the Shopify AI Toolkit.
description.zh: SHOPLINE AI 工具包：接入 SHOPLINE 官方开发者 MCP 服务器，内置七个 SHOPLINE 平台技能（Admin REST、GraphQL、OAuth、Webhook、Sline），是 Shopify AI Toolkit 的 SHOPLINE 对应版。

description.en: Short-video sidebar: native player, series navigation, precise history replay.
description.zh: 侧栏短视频：原生播放器、系列导航、精确历史回放。

description.en: Self-control guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness host exit and restart workflows.
description.zh: dsh-self-control-guard — DSH 插件（编排）

description.en: dsh的罗小黑插件
description.zh: dsh的罗小黑插件

description.en: DeepSeek Harness provider for GPT models using managed ChatGPT OAuth through Codex app-server
description.zh: GPT 模型接入：通过 Codex app-server 的 ChatGPT OAuth 把 GPT 模型当 provider 用。

description.en: WeCom AI Bot text and image bridge for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 企业微信机器人桥接：文本+图片双通道，企业微信直接当 DSH 聊天入口。

description.en: A Cordis plugin that enables DeepSeek Harness to proactively preview and display web pages.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: DSH web sidebar session-search enhancement: one-click toggle between title search and content search; content results aggregated per session with title and hit snippets.
description.zh: DSH web 侧边栏会话搜索增强：标题搜索与内容搜索一键切换，内容搜索按会话聚合展示标题与命中片段

description.en: Free keyless Tavily web search tool for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: dsh-tavily-search — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: VS Code-style three-column Explorer + Monaco editor plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI
description.zh: VS Code 风格三栏文件浏览 + Monaco 编辑器，网页版 DSH 直接变身 IDE。

description.en: Conversation Canvas tab: live-preview workspace HTML artifacts and export PNG/JPG/SVG locally (`npx dsh-canvas-preview`).
description.zh: Conversation Canvas 标签页：实时预览工作区内的 HTML artifact，并支持本地导出 PNG/JPG/SVG（`npx dsh-canvas-preview`）。

description.en: Auto-repairs the messages array after a tool-dispatch crash (orphaned tool_calls / tool messages), preventing 400 INVALID_REQUEST session lock-ups.
description.zh: 工具调度崩溃后自动修复 messages 数组（孤儿 tool_calls / tool 消息），防止 400 INVALID_REQUEST 会话卡死。

description.en: Claude-style warm-editorial skin for the DSH web GUI — ivory/warm-black canvas, a clay ember accent, serif display + sans UI + mono labels, hairline borders and pill CTAs, light/dark themes.
description.zh: Claude 风格暖调编辑 DSH Web 皮肤：象牙白/暖黑双画布、陶烬橙点睛、衬线标题+无衬线界面+等宽标签、发丝线与胶囊 CTA，亮暗双主题跟随系统。

description.en: QQ Official Bot adapter for C2C single chat, interactive action boards, workspace session management, and real-time Web UI sync.
description.zh: QQ 官方单聊机器人适配器：支持交互操作板、工作区会话管理与 Web UI 实时双向同屏。

description.en: Windows Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness with screenshots, UI Automation, 18 desktop tools, per-Agent activation, human-input handoff, approval prompts and prebuilt native workers.
description.zh: Windows 桌面操控：让 DeepSeek 看屏幕、点鼠标、敲键盘。提供截图、UIA 定位、18 个桌面工具、按 Agent 激活、人机共用和操作审批，原生组件随包提供。

description.en: Deterministic AST code graph and architecture intelligence tool for call hierarchies, blast radius, circular dependencies, domain slices, and full-stack API contracts.
description.zh: 确定性 AST 代码图谱与架构治理分析工具：调用链消歧、重构爆炸半径、循环依赖审计、领域切片与全栈 API 契约追踪。

description.en: Switchable liquid-glass theme for the DSH web UI — 14 panels become frosted glass over a fluid backdrop, with material sliders and hover elasticity.
description.zh: 可切换的 DSH 网页端液态玻璃主题——14 个面板在流体背景上变成磨砂玻璃，材质参数有滑杆，悬停时玻璃与面板内容一起倾斜。

description.en: Behavior-drift reports for DSH sessions: compares two session logs and reports tool-sequence alignment, tool mix, reasoning volume, timing, retries and file targets, with an optional CI threshold gate. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 会话的行为漂移报告：对比两份 session log，输出工具序列对齐、工具构成、推理量、耗时、重试与文件目标的差异，并支持可选的 CI 阈值门禁。零依赖。

description.en: GLM Mode agent preset for zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash: PTC/Code Mode tool presentation, a reasoning loop guard and a tool spin guard (live-incident driven), and GLM-specific auto-compaction at 75%/22%.
description.zh: 为 zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash 调优的「GLM 模式」Agent 预设：PTC 程序化工具调用、思考死循环守卫与工具空转守卫双层防护（源自活体事故复盘）、GLM 专属自动压缩（75%/22%）。

description.en: Injects durable user-set must-do and must-not requirements into the model at conversation start.
description.zh: 在会话开始时向模型注入用户设定的“必须做 / 不能做”持久要求。

description.en: Device channel between the agent and your own phone: it sends files it just produced, and you @-reference what your phone sent back. End-to-end encrypted P2P through the SwarmDrop CLI, with no account and no public IP; node status, paired devices and QR pairing sit in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在 agent 和你自己的手机之间开一条设备通道：agent 把刚产出的文件发过去，手机传回来的东西可以在输入框里 @ 引用。底层经 SwarmDrop CLI 走端到端加密的 P2P，不需要账号，也不需要公网 IP；节点状态、已配对设备与扫码配对都在侧边栏面板里。

description.en: Windows one-click launcher with a borderless WPF startup animation (stroke-by-stroke HARNESS lettering) that starts dsh web in the background and fades into the GUI once ready, plus a desktop_launch tool.
description.zh: Windows 一键启动器：无边框 WPF 启动动画（HARNESS 逐笔描边），后台拉起 dsh web 并在 GUI 就绪后淡入，附 desktop_launch 工具。

description.en: Interactive chat table of contents with bookmarks, turn pinning, global shortcuts, and heading extraction.
description.zh: 对话大纲目录导航：支持书签标记、轮次置顶钉住、全局快捷键与智能标题提取。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance and current-session token and cost usage in the sidebar footer and composer dock, including peak and off-peak billing and subagent consumption.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部和输入框上方显示你的 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前会话 token 及费用消耗，支持高峰/空闲峰谷计费与子代理消耗统计。

description.en: Local Markdown notes as governable working memory for DeepSeek Harness agents: dual-mode source/WYSIWYG editor with images, convention or reference notes auto-inject into the system prompt with sensitive values masked, plus snapshot version history, recycle bin, undoable archiving, AI reorganization, backlinks and full-text search. Compatible with DSH 0.1.7-0.2.x.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可治理 Agent 工作记忆层，沉淀为本地 Markdown 笔记：双模式编辑器（源码⇄富文本，支持图片），约定/资料笔记自动注入系统提示（敏感值自动脱敏），另有快照版本历史、回收站、可撤销归档、AI 整理、双链与全文搜索。兼容 DSH 0.1.7～0.2.x。

description.en: Makes plain Enter insert a newline in the composer and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter submit, toggleable in settings.
description.zh: 让对话框中普通 Enter 换行、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 提交，可在设置中开关。

description.en: Builds, tests, archives and runs an Xcode project or workspace on iOS or macOS through xcodebuild — a live filterable build log, scheme and destination pickers read from the project, and log streaming for simulators and USB devices, including iOS 16 and earlier over libimobiledevice, whose app logs stay readable while the device is locked. macOS only.
description.zh: 在 harness 中通过 xcodebuild 编译、测试、归档并运行 iOS 或 macOS 工程——实时可过滤的构建日志、从工程自身读取的 scheme 与目标设备选择，以及模拟器与 USB 真机的日志流，包含经 libimobiledevice 支持的 iOS 16 及更早设备，其 app 日志在设备锁屏时依然可读。仅限 macOS。

description.en: Conversation and workspace undo: use the /undo timeline, session-header action, or message icon to roll back before any sent prompt; private Shadow Git snapshots restore files, the reverted turns stay out of model context, and Undo Rollback can recover mistakes. Includes archived-session management and per-tool colored cards.
description.zh: 对话与工作区撤销：通过 /undo 节点轴、会话头部按钮或消息下方图标回滚到任意已发送 prompt 之前；插件私有 Shadow Git 快照恢复文件，被回滚回合不会进入模型上下文，误操作还能“撤回回滚”。附带归档会话管理与工具卡片分类配色。

description.en: Renders every file mutation in the web chat as one collapsed diff card with per-line highlighting — MCP filesystem edit_file/write_file and the built-in edit/write.
description.zh: 把网页对话里的每次文件改动渲染成一张折叠的 diff 卡片并逐行高亮，涵盖 MCP filesystem 的 edit_file/write_file 与内置的 edit/write。

description.en: Turns the 13 δ-me13 (Amphoreus) role skill cards into seat workspaces: per-seat theme and wallpaper, first-turn skill injection, chat stickers, per-seat memory notes and presets, Alt+digit seat switching, and an overview canvas for dispatch and handoff; the skill suite itself is read from a configurable local directory and is not bundled.
description.zh: 把 δ-me13（翁法罗斯）的 13 张黄金裔角色技能卡变成席位工作区：逐席配色与壁纸、首轮自动注入技能卡、对话表情、每席记忆便签与预设、Alt+数字切席，以及用于派发与移交的总览画布；技能套件本身从可配置的本地目录读取，不随插件打包。

description.en: Adds an input-modality selector to custom model settings in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的自定义模型设置添加输入模态选择器。

description.en: Visual development studio for DSH WebUI plugins with isolated Git worktrees, live official-WebUI previews, source editing, patch inspection, builds, and validation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH WebUI 插件的可视化开发工作室，提供隔离的 Git worktree、真实官方 WebUI 预览、源码编辑、Patch 检查、构建与验证。

description.en: Superself's self CLI as model-facing tools (project context, work units, reports, decisions) plus a /self command — cross-session, cross-project project state kept outside the code repo.
description.zh: 把 Superself 的 self CLI 暴露为模型工具（项目上下文、工作单元、报告、决策）并提供 /self 命令——跨会话、跨项目的项目状态，保存在代码仓库之外。

description.en: Adds COS storage browsing and transfers, workspace artifact uploads, temporary links, and conversation attachments that retain local copies with cloud object identity, plus Agent tools for Tencent Cloud COS, CI, and MetaInsight.
description.zh: 提供 COS 云存储浏览与传输、工作区产物上传、临时链接，以及同时保留本地副本和云端对象身份的会话附件，并提供腾讯云 COS、数据万象和 MetaInsight 的 Agent 工具。

description.en: Freshness gate for the agent's test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked, and on agent/turn-stopping a claim whose latest receipt is stale, failed or has no readable result steers one more step naming the receipt and the files edited since.
description.zh: 为智能体的测试、类型检查、lint 与构建结论提供新鲜度检查：每次验证运行在 tools/post-execute 上记录为凭据，文件修改被跟踪；在 agent/turn-stopping 时，若结论对应的最新凭据已过期、失败或没有可读结果，则引导再走一步，并指出凭据与其后被修改的文件。

description.en: Wraps globalThis.fetch to route DeepSeek Harness model-API requests through an HTTP/SOCKS proxy by target domain, leaving all other requests on the direct connection, without modifying Harness source.
description.zh: 把 globalThis.fetch 包一层，按目标域名让 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 API 请求走 HTTP/SOCKS 代理、其它请求保持直连，全程不改 Harness 源码。

description.en: Official DSH plugin for nuphus-mcp (by the nuphus-mcp maintainers): desktop and browser automation (38 tools) with PaddleOCR element perception and Chrome CDP browsing, via a persistent stdio MCP child process.
description.zh: nuphus-mcp 官方 DSH 插件（由 nuphus-mcp 维护者发布）：桌面 + 浏览器自动化（38 个工具），配 PaddleOCR 元素感知与 Chrome CDP 浏览，经常驻 stdio MCP 子进程接入。

description.en: Tree view of a DSH conversation: editing an old message forks the thread, every version lives in one tree while the sidebar keeps a single entry, branches can be renamed, and a branch can be promoted to a session of its own.
description.zh: DSH 会话的树形视图：编辑一条旧消息即从那一刻分叉，所有版本住进同一棵树、侧栏始终只有一条，分支可以改名，也可以把某个分支提升为独立会话。

description.en: Loopback-first multi-agent message relay: HMAC-authenticated broker plus dsh plugin (relay_send/recv/peers/history), zero-dependency CLI and Python clients, wire protocol v1.0.
description.zh: 本地优先的多 Agent 协作中继：HMAC 认证 broker + dsh 插件（relay_send/recv/peers/history）+ 零依赖 CLI 与 Python 客户端，wire protocol v1.0。

description.en: Unified IM channel for DeepSeek Harness: Feishu, Telegram, DingTalk, Slack, Discord — persistent conversations, true streaming replies, 40 MCP Feishu tools, slash commands, and an IM-bot status tab in the plugin settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一 IM 渠道：飞书、Telegram、钉钉、Slack、Discord —— 持久会话、真流式回复、40 个飞书 MCP 工具、斜杠命令，以及插件设置页中的 IM 机器人状态页。

description.en: Manage tool availability and groups for each Agent Preset, load tools on demand like Skills, and reduce model context usage.
description.zh: DSH 工具管理插件：按 Agent Preset 开关和分组工具，像 Skill 一样按需加载工具，减少模型上下文占用。

description.en: Drag-and-drop / paste / upload files and images; on non-multimodal models images are auto-described by a configured VLM.
description.zh: 拖拽/粘贴/上传文件和图片，非多模态模型下图片自动调用已配置 VLM 识别。

description.en: Multi-model orchestrator: the main brain decomposes complex tasks and dispatches subtasks to GLM / Kimi / Qwen sub-agents by each model's strengths, with per-model token usage.
description.zh: 多模型主脑编排器：主模型将复杂任务拆解，按各模型优劣分派给 GLM / Kimi / Qwen 子代理执行，并按模型统计 token 用量。

description.en: Exposes the local DSH web GUI to one chosen CIDR range only (Tailscale by default) instead of binding 0.0.0.0: the proxy listens on addresses inside that range, rejects peers outside it, and admits clients by either a tokenised URL or a 4-12 character alphanumeric access code. Remote pages can be forced into a phone layout without changing the local UI, and the official appearance, font size, transcript view, code view and performance settings can be stored in the plugin config and re-applied on every remote page load.
description.zh: 只把本机 DSH 网页界面开放给指定的一个网段（默认 Tailscale 100.64.0.0/10），不绑 0.0.0.0：网段外的对端一律拒绝，进入方式可选带票网址或 4–12 位数字/字母访问密码；远程页面可强制手机布局而不动本机界面，官方「通用设置」里的外观 / 字号大小 / 工作步骤展示 / 显示代码工作视图 / 性能与用量可存进本插件配置，并在每次打开远程页面时重新套用。

description.en: Concurrency guard and monitor for DeepSeek Harness: FIFO queue when concurrent model requests reach the limit, per-day persisted stats with error-kind classification, and interruption detection for abandoned streams.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 并发监控与门闩：模型请求达上限时 FIFO 排队防锁号，按天持久化统计并做异常分类，检测流被弃用的回合中断。

description.en: Runs PowerShell scripts through base64 encoding, so quotes, $, backslashes and CJK survive as written. Same sandbox channel as the built-in pwsh tool.
description.zh: 把 PowerShell 脚本 base64 编码后执行，引号、$、反斜杠、中文全部原样传递，免去转义地狱。走与内置 pwsh 工具相同的沙箱通道。

description.en: 11 shareable workflow skills (handoff, triage, to-spec, to-tickets, wayfinder, teach, wait-what, dsh-mode-routing, ask-matt, overnight-execution, full-throttle) as an installable skill pack.
description.zh: 11 个可分享的工作流 skills（handoff、triage、to-spec、to-tickets、wayfinder、teach、wait-what、dsh-mode-routing、ask-matt、overnight-execution、full-throttle），打包为可安装 bundle。

description.en: Registers a SpecWorkflow skill pack for requirement clarification, implementation specs, execution, delivery review, repair planning, bug diagnosis, and source-backed research.
description.zh: 注册 SpecWorkflow 技能包，覆盖需求澄清、实施规格、代码执行、交付检查、修复规划、bug 诊断和带来源调研。

description.en: WeChat Official Account typesetting workbench: renders Markdown into inline-styled HTML you paste straight into the WeChat editor, with a sidebar panel, 11 themes and five model tools for block-level revision.
description.zh: 微信公众号排版工作台：把 Markdown 渲染成带内联样式的 HTML，粘进公众号编辑器即成排版；配右侧栏面板、11 套主题与五个模型工具做块级改稿。

description.en: Arknights: Endfield theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: charcoal and hazard-yellow industrial HUD, a boot splash injected ahead of the shell, a conversation backdrop, and a re-cut Windows title bar. Restyles the sidebar brand to 终末地工业 / ENDFIELD INDUSTRIES, which a URL flag reverts.
description.zh: 《明日方舟：终末地》主题：炭黑与警戒黄的工业 HUD、在外壳渲染前注入的开屏动画、对话区背景，以及重新配色的 Windows 标题栏。侧栏品牌会改为「终末地工业 / ENDFIELD INDUSTRIES」，可用 URL 参数还原。

description.en: Codex-backed `web_search`, `image_gen`, and `image_vision` tools for DeepSeek Harness, reusing ChatGPT OAuth login state.
description.zh: 基于 Codex 的 `web_search`、`image_gen` 与 `image_vision` 工具，复用 ChatGPT OAuth 登录态为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索、生图与识图能力。

description.en: Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice (TTS), and custom audio.
description.zh: 按工作区定制的任务完成铃声，以及审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败等需要人介入事件的注意提示音，支持内置合成音、语音播报与自定义音频。

description.en: TinyFish-backed search and fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web) — $0 SERP and page extraction, direct or via Monid.

Forgetting-curve in-place dialogue compression for DeepSeek Harness: recent turns stay verbatim, middle turns are structurally dehydrated (zero-LLM), ancient turns fold into a bounded summary pair — unbounded conversations on a bounded memory budget.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于自然遗忘曲线的就地对话压缩：近期对话逐字保留、中期结构化脱水（零 LLM 成本）、久远对话折叠为有界摘要对——有限记忆预算上的无限对话。

description.en: A fake-ip-aware ctx.web fetch provider that takes over the stock http provider id: a hostname is accepted when every DNS answer is a placeholder inside the proxy's fake-ip block (198.18.0.0/15 by default), so web_fetch works under mihomo/Clash TUN mode without disabling fake-ip or setting proxy environment variables. IP literals and private, loopback and reserved destinations stay blocked.
description.zh: ctx.web 的 fake-ip 感知抓取后端，接管官方 http provider id：当某主机名的每一条 DNS 应答都是代理 fake-ip 段（默认 198.18.0.0/15）内的占位地址时予以接受，从而在 mihomo/Clash TUN 模式下无需关闭 fake-ip、也无需设置代理环境变量即可使用 web_fetch；IP 字面量与私有、回环、保留地址仍被拒绝。

description.en: Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.
description.zh: 把每轮工具计数与粗粒度验证信号写入本地 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数或结果正文。

description.en: Git history visualization for the dock workbench: swimlane commit graph, branch and tag management, stage/commit/push and remote operations.
description.zh: dock 系列 Git 历史可视化插件：泳道式提交图、分支/标签管理、暂存/提交/推送与远端操作。

description.en: Learns what you leave unsaid in your prompts from messy turns and your own corrections, and injects the learned directives into the system prompt of every new conversation; the directives are editable in Settings and a composer button rewrites the current draft with them.
description.zh: 从不顺的轮次和你自己的纠正中学习你在提示词里没说出口的东西，并把学到的指令注入每个新对话的系统提示；指令可在设置中编辑，输入框按钮可用它们改写当前草稿。

description.en: Vision MCP and DSH bundle for text-only DeepSeek: analyze_image, analyze_clipboard, compare_images and vision_status tools, a visual settings page, free GLM-4.6V-Flash by default, result caching and rate-limit tolerance; keys stay out of logs.
description.zh: 面向纯文本 DeepSeek 的视觉 MCP + DSH 插件：analyze_image / analyze_clipboard / compare_images / vision_status 四个工具、可视化配置页、默认免费 GLM-4.6V-Flash、结果缓存与限流容错，Key 不入日志。

description.en: Controls user-authorized Chrome tabs from DeepSeek Harness through a local native-messaging broker, with semantic page reads, actions, screenshots, and explicit handoff.
description.zh: 通过本地原生消息 Broker，让 DeepSeek Harness 操作用户明确授权的 Chrome 标签页，支持语义化页面读取、交互、截图与显式交接。

description.en: Per-model system prompt injector for DeepSeek Harness: append custom prompt text to the END of the system prompt for locally configured models, matched by exact provider/model route or a provider-wide provider/* rule (both stack in order). A Settings page lists every configured provider and its models for per-route editing with instant effect, and rules persist to DSH_HOME so they survive restarts. Applies to main sessions, subagents, and workflow children alike.
description.zh: DSH 按模型注入系统提示词：为本地已配置的模型把自定义提示词追加到系统提示词末尾，支持 provider/model 精确匹配与 provider/* 服务商级通配（两者按序叠加）。设置页自动列出每个已配置服务商及其模型，逐行编辑、即时生效；规则持久化保存、重启不丢；对主会话、subagent 与 workflow 子代理同样生效。

description.en: Give agents access to files on the machine where the browser runs: user authorizes a local directory via File System Access, tool calls relay over the plugin's own WebSocket; read-only compat mode for mobile/insecure contexts.
description.zh: 让 agent 读写浏览器所在电脑上的文件：浏览器授权本地目录（File System Access），工具调用经插件自建 WebSocket 中继；移动端/非安全上下文自动降级只读兼容模式。

description.en: Runs commands as background jobs that keep executing when DSH exits, with an optional sandbox to constrain file effects, plus a live web panel and offline CLI/GUI management. Windows only for now.
description.zh: 将命令提交为独立于 DSH 进程的后台任务（可选沙箱），关闭 DSH 也不影响运行，并提供实时网页面板与离线 CLI/GUI 管理。当前仅支持Windows系统。

description.en: Run Stata through DeepSeek Harness: the native Stata AI Skill service auto-starts with DSH (macOS/Windows binaries bundled), so you can run regressions, do-files and econometrics workflows with no manual setup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中运行 Stata：Stata AI Skill 原生服务随 DSH 自动启动（内置 macOS/Windows 多平台二进制），无需手动配置即可跑回归、do 文件与计量工作流。

description.en: Usage dashboard: offline-scans session logs to chart daily/weekly/monthly tokens, estimated costs, model/tool/skill/command leaderboards, output speed, working hours and quality metrics; gridstack+ECharts cards are drag-and-drop composable, with custom formulas and AI arrangement (prompt round-trip import).
description.zh: 使用量仪表盘：离线扫描会话日志，统计每日/每周/每月 token、估算费用、模型/工具/技能/命令榜、输出速度、工作时段与质量指标；gridstack+ECharts 卡片可拖拽编排，支持自定义公式与 AI 编排（提示词往返导入）。

description.en: DSH model provider for the locally authenticated AGY CLI: Gemini/Claude model discovery, independent reasoning effort, DSH-owned tools, bounded context and tool-result handling, and Windows-safe streaming. Report problems in GitHub Issues: https://github.com/darkings/dsh-agy-provider/issues.
description.zh: 将本机已登录的 AGY CLI 接入 DSH 作为模型 Provider：支持 Gemini/Claude 模型发现、独立推理强度、DSH-owned 工具、受限上下文与工具结果管理、Windows 安全流式传输；如遇问题，请在 GitHub 提交 Issue：https://github.com/darkings/dsh-agy-provider/issues。

description.en: DIY the DSH UI typography and colours: 10 built-in regions plus box-select region creation, each with its own Chinese and English font, size, line-height, weight (100-900), italic switch and text colour picker; 18 Chinese and 18 English fonts ship in the pickers, every region can be overridden by one unified setting, and named theme presets can be saved, applied, renamed and deleted. Random font assignment and random colour generation are available for the whole UI or per region, and 8 fonts (LXGW WenKai, Smiley Sans, ZCOOL KuaiLe, Comic Neue, Baloo 2, Fredoka, Nunito, Caveat) can be downloaded and installed with one click (only Comic Neue ships in the package) alongside your own .ttf/.otf files. An Aa floating ball opens the panel, position and settings persist, and the ball is shown or hidden from the DSH settings floating-ball section together with the other two balls, which share one 128-skin catalogue.
description.zh: DIY 你的 DSH 界面字体与颜色：10 个内置区域 + 框选建区，每区域独立设中英文字体、字号、行距、字重（100–900）、斜体开关与文字颜色取色器；内置 18 款中文字体与 18 款英文字体，支持全局统一覆盖，主题方案可保存、应用、重命名与删除。随机字体可按整站或单区域生成，配色可随机生成高区分度颜色；另有 8 款字体（霞鹜文楷、得意黑、站酷快乐体、Comic Neue、Baloo 2、Fredoka、Nunito、Caveat）可一键下载安装（仅 Comic Neue 随包），也支持选本地 .ttf/.otf 安装。右下角 Aa 悬浮球打开面板，位置与配置持久保存，可在 DSH 设置页「悬浮球导航」分区与另两个球一起显隐，三球共享 128 款皮肤。

description.en: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.
description.zh: 跨会话引用插件：在任意会话（含其他工作区）粘贴 @[label](dsh-session:…) 引用，宿主注入被引用会话的快照供模型阅读，并提供一键复制引用按钮。

description.en: Minimal prompt x Web PTC capabilities: one-line persona, run_code SDK, subagents, Ralph, web search/fetch, and Windows Git Bash; the general-purpose workflow tool stays hidden.
description.zh: 极简提示词 × Web PTC 能力：一句人格、run_code SDK、子代理、Ralph、网页搜索/抓取与 Windows Git Bash；通用 workflow 工具保持隐藏。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-minimal-ptc
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-minimal-ptc

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Agent-initiated voice calls: `offer_call` rings the human (接听/拒接/稍后再说); accepted calls synthesize and play locally via CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS (9 speakers, 2 Chinese dialects), rejected calls return the decision to the agent.
description.zh: agent 主动打来的语音电话：`offer_call` 向人类振铃（接听/拒接/稍后再说），接听后由本地 CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS 合成并播放（9 个音色，含 2 个中文方言）；拒接则把决定返回给 agent。

description.en: Renders pasted/uploaded images inline in the DSH Web chat and gives text-only models vision: the model-invokable visual_review tool calls any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API first, falling back to a local Qwen3-VL worker.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 聊天界面内联渲染粘贴/上传的图片，并让纯文本模型“看见”图片：visual_review 工具优先调用任意 OpenAI 兼容多模态 API，未配置时回退本机 Qwen3-VL。

description.en: Interactive code-reading coach for DeepSeek Harness: a five-phase guided walkthrough of the source behind a paper, starting by identifying its language and framework.
description.zh: 代码研读教练：交互式引导研读论文对应的开源代码。五段研读法（锚定论文主张、地形扫描、入口追踪、核心映射、闭环验证），自动识别并告知语言的框架与架构，适合研读 AI 论文源码。

description.en: Cross-session usage and cost observatory for DSH — token trends from hourly lines to 90-day and 1-year heatmaps, per-model DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing reconciled against the official balance, GLM/Kimi/MiniMax subscription-quota windows with burn-rate forecasts, cache-hit ring, project rankings, CSV export, and a dsh-tui terminal face.
description.zh: 跨会话用量与费用观测台——分时走势与 90 天/1 年热力图、逐模型峰谷计价并与官方余额对账、GLM/Kimi/MiniMax 订阅额度与燃速预估、缓存命中环、项目排行、CSV 导出，另有 dsh-tui 终端面。

description.en: Session timeline down the left of the conversation: every user message at a glance, current-message tracking, hover preview of the message and its reply, click to jump, collapsible.
description.zh: 会话左侧的短横线时间轴：整个会话的用户消息一览、当前消息定位、悬停预览消息与回复、点击跳转，可收起展开。

description.en: Draggable floating cat-or-dog companion for the dsh web GUI that changes expression with the session and is configured on a Companion settings page.
description.zh: 可拖拽的猫狗悬浮伴侣，表情随当前会话变化，在 Companion 设置页里换皮肤。

description.en: Multi-machine, multi-agent orchestration and control plane for DSH: discovers Agents and workspaces across devices, routes tasks by machine, repository, capability, and load to local or remote Agent runtimes, streams progress and results, forwards approvals, and recovers durable tasks after disconnections.
description.zh: DSH 的多机多 Agent 编排与控制平台：发现各设备上的 Agent 与工作区，按机器、仓库、能力和负载将任务路由到本地或远程 Agent Runtime，统一回传进度、审批与结果，并在断线后恢复持久任务。

description.en: Floating NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH Web: draggable collapsible window with mini mode, playlist discovery with search and hot lists, synced lyrics with translations, persistent playback queue, QR-code or Cookie login, colors following the DSH skin theme.
description.zh: 网易云音乐浮窗播放器：可拖拽/折叠浮窗与迷你条，歌单发现（搜索/热门歌单），逐行同步歌词与翻译，播放队列持久化，扫码或 Cookie 登录，颜色跟随 DSH 皮肤主题。

description.en: Adds a full-screen panel to the DSH composer for writing multi-line text, movable and resizable, sharing one draft with the composer; Enter inserts a newline and only Ctrl+Enter sends, so an IME cannot turn Shift+Enter into a send.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的输入框加一个全屏输入面板，用于书写多行文本，可移动、可调整大小，与主输入框共用同一份草稿；Enter 只换行、仅 Ctrl+Enter 发送，因此中文输入法不会把 Shift+Enter 变成发送。

description.en: Skill studio for DeepSeek Harness: visualize every agent skill (name, description, source, nested flag, model/user invocation), view and edit the full SKILL.md body, toggle model/user invocation, and mine DSH session logs to extract reusable personal skills that the agent auto-loads — from the web settings panel and via skillmgr_* / skillmgr_extract_* tools.
description.zh: DSH skill 可视化与管理插件：在设置面板列出全部 skill（含来源、嵌套标记与模型/用户调用状态），查看并编辑 SKILL.md 正文，一键启用/禁用模型与用户调用；并可从会话日志提取可复用内容，沉淀为 agent 可自动加载的个人 skill。提供 skillmgr_list/get/save/policy 及 skillmgr_extract_* 工具。

description.en: Discovers rule files from every convention OMP supports and injects them into the system prompt as an always-apply layer plus a rulebook index, then enforces them with time-traveling stream rules that abort violating output mid-turn, deny a matching tool call, fold a reminder into that call's result, or ask a judge model about the finished reply. The same tool lets the model write new rules, and an audit panel on the Plugins page says why each rule is in force.
description.zh: 从 OMP 支持的每一种约定中发现规则文件,以 always-apply 层加规则索引注入系统提示词,并用时间旅行流规则强制执行——在模型输出中途打断违规内容、拦下会违规的工具调用、把提醒折进该调用的结果,或在回复完成后交由裁判模型判断。同一个工具也让模型能写入新规则;Plugins 页的审计面板会说明每条规则为何生效。

description.en: DingTalk group-robot notifications (notify/text/health; webhook + HMAC signing, zero runtime dependencies).
description.zh: 钉钉群机器人通知：dingtalk_notify/text/health 三工具，webhook + HMAC 加签，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Drive a local DeepSeek Harness agent from QQ and other IM channels through AstrBot: send tasks with /dsh, continue by quoting or @-mentioning the bot, answer approvals and ask_user_question prompts from chat (in parallel with the DSH web UI), and get results, inline images and file cards back. Ships session / workspace / model / permission commands, /compact and /last recovery, three progress-display modes, and group-shared or per-user session scoping.
description.zh: 把本机 DeepSeek Harness agent 接到 AstrBot，从 QQ 等 IM 渠道驱动它：用 /dsh 派活、引用或 @ 机器人续聊、在聊天里回答审批与 ask_user_question（与 DSH 网页并行），结果、内联图片与文件卡片发回。含会话 / 工作区 / 模型 / 权限命令、/compact 与 /last 找回、三档过程显示、整群共用或按人隔离的会话范围。

description.en: Manage DSH skills and commands from Settings: list, enable/disable, edit, delete and add skills across global and project scopes, and save reusable prompts as slash commands.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理技能与命令：跨全局与项目作用域查看、启用/停用、编辑、删除与添加技能，并把常用提示词保存为斜杠命令。

description.en: dsh-lint-loop v0.7.0 adds bounded, read-only evidence checks for observable shell/bash/pwsh and file-tool changes; uncertain evidence remains incomplete. [Release](https://github.com/lemonxiny55/dsh-lint-loop/releases/tag/v0.7.0).
description.zh: dsh-lint-loop v0.7.0 通过有界、只读检查点追踪 shell/bash/pwsh 与文件工具产生的可观察变更；证据归因不确定或不足时保留为 incomplete。[正式 Release](https://github.com/lemonxiny55/dsh-lint-loop/releases/tag/v0.7.0)。

description.en: Daily news digest from 46 curated RSS sources, edited by the model already configured in dsh, delivered to your IM via webhook, and broadcast in the chat like a regular model reply with zero context cost.
description.zh: 每日要闻日报：46 个精选 RSS 源，用 dsh 里已配好的模型做主编式编辑，经 webhook 送到微信/Telegram，并以模型回答的样式插播在对话里，零上下文消耗。

description.en: Groups the DSH model picker by provider: the menu lists sources with their model counts, and hovering a source slides that provider's models out in a side panel (default); in panel mode a click opens the same panel, and double-clicking a source title cycles hover -> panel -> inline (expand below the title). The active model stays visible at a glance. Pure DOM enhancement with zero intrusion - the panel is plugin-owned DOM mounted on body and selection happens by programmatically clicking the real menu buttons, so no React-managed node is moved or removed, keeping the host rendering intact and coexisting with other UI plugins. Styling follows the host by reusing the official --dsw-* theme tokens, with an enforced opaque background, sufficient contrast, and one shared set of sizing and colour tokens for both menu levels. No network access and no telemetry. Built for DSH kernel 2.0.15-next.
description.zh: 把 DSH 模型选择器按来源（provider）分组：菜单只列来源与其模型数，悬停来源即在右侧滑出该来源的模型子面板（默认）；切换为面板模式后改为单击来源滑出，或改为在列表内就地展开，双击来源标题即可在 悬浮 -> 面板 -> 列表 三者间循环切换；当前使用的模型一眼可见。纯 DOM 增强、零侵入——面板是插件自建 DOM 并挂载到 body，选择通过程序化点击原菜单真实按钮完成，不移动也不删除任何 React 管理的节点，因此不影响原组件渲染，并能与其他 UI 插件共存。配色与排版跟随宿主：复用官方 --dsw-* 主题变量，背景保证不透明、对比度充足，来源清单与子集清单共用同一套尺寸与色值令牌。不联网、无遥测。适配 DSH 内核 2.0.15-next。

description.en: Deterministic code security review: 40+ rules, secret entropy detection, staged-diff review, SARIF export, baseline acceptance, SBOM-lite dependency inventory and health self-check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 确定性代码安全审查：40+ 规则、密钥熵检测、staged diff 审查、SARIF 导出、基线接受、SBOM-lite 依赖清单与健康自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Three switchable low-glare themes (Warm Paper, Sage Green, Warm Grey) for the DeepSeek Harness GUI, each a full alias-token layer with a light and a dark face.
description.zh: 三套可切换的低刺激护眼配色（暖纸、豆绿、暖灰），每套都是完整的别名 token 层，含浅色与深色两副面貌。

description.en: Turn event notifications: six event classes (completed, error, interrupted, approval requested, AI question, limit reached) delivered via sound, system notification, in-page banner, webhook, IM and host desktop-notification channels; when several browser windows are open, only one rings.
description.zh: 回合事件通知：完成/出错/被中断/等待审批/AI 提问/达到上限六类事件，经声音、系统弹窗、页内提示、webhook、IM、宿主桌面通知通道推送，多窗口只响一次。

description.en: Instance manager for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that lists every local dsh web instance the machine can see (port, PID, uptime, live session count, resident memory, version), starts a new instance on an automatically picked free port in 3080-3129 or on a port you name, opens a row in a new tab, and stops one or all of them through that instance’s own graceful shutdown (appExit). Rows also show what each instance is serving, and read-only instance logs and session summaries are one click away. Where a peer is configured, the same panel lists and queries instances on other machines over a bearer-authenticated link. Every route is loopback-guarded, and a browser-facing action must additionally pass the host’s own browser authentication.
description.zh: DSH Web 实例管理器：Mini Utility Dock 面板列出本机可见的全部 dsh web 实例（端口、PID、运行时长、会话数、常驻内存、版本），可在 3080–3129 自动选一个空闲端口或按指定端口启动新实例、把某一行在新标签页打开，并通过目标实例自身的优雅退出停掉单个或全部实例。行内还显示每个实例在跑什么，只读的实例日志与会话概要一点即达。配置了 peer 时，同一个面板会通过带 bearer 鉴权的链路列出并查询其他机器上的实例。所有路由都做回环校验，面向浏览器的操作还要额外通过宿主自身的鉴权。

description.en: Todoist-style todo management in the sidebar with projects, labels and priorities, CJK-aware natural-language quick-add, repeat rules, a stats dashboard, import and export, seven agent tools and due-time reminders.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的类 Todoist 待办管理：项目/标签/优先级、中英双语自然语言快速添加、重复规则、统计仪表盘、导入导出、七个 Agent 工具与到期提醒。

description.en: Compaction fallback for compaction-basic: when its LLM summary throws, comes back empty or cannot fit the window, the span is compiled deterministically with a seq pointer on every line (vendored dsh-compaction-instant compiler). Adds recall and search tools, /recall and /context commands, an idle trigger at 45% of the window and an on-disk span archive. The engine mounts as one row in the agent preset (docs/dsh-integration.md).
description.zh: 为 compaction-basic 提供压缩兜底：当 LLM 摘要抛错、返回空内容或放不进上下文窗口时，改为确定性编译该区段，每行带 seq 指针（内置 dsh-compaction-instant 编译器）。提供 recall、search 工具与 /recall、/context 命令，占用超过窗口 45% 时空闲自动压缩，并将被压缩区段归档到磁盘。引擎以一行配置挂载到 agent preset（见 docs/dsh-integration.md）。

description.en: Conversation node appearance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: configurable per-category and per-tool colors (left accent bar + tinted background), plus a show-thinking toggle; pure frontend rendering, takes effect instantly and persists to the DSH user settings file.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话节点外观插件：按节点类别/工具名可配置着色（左侧色条 + 淡色底），附带"显示思考过程"开关；纯前端渲染增强，改动即时生效并持久化到 DSH 用户设置文件。

description.en: Host-side guard that lets the write tool only create new files: when the target already exists it denies the call before execution and tells the model to use edit instead, applied to all sessions.
description.zh: 纯 host 端守卫，让 write 工具只允许创建新文件：目标已存在时在执行前直接拒绝并提示改用 edit，全局所有会话生效。

description.en: RTK (Rust Token Killer) extension for dsh-router: rewrites each bash tool call through `rtk rewrite` so the agent reads compressed command output, and falls back to the original command when rtk is missing or has no equivalent.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 RTK(Rust Token Killer)扩展插件：把每次 bash 工具调用经 `rtk rewrite` 改写，让 agent 读到压缩后的命令输出；rtk 缺失或无等价改写时原样执行。

description.en: Records real clicks, inputs, navigation and network traffic in a user-guided browser session for DSH, then generates a Markdown timeline report (report.md + events.jsonl) to build API-level skills.
description.zh: 网页操作录制器：录制用户引导会话中的真实点击、输入、导航与网络请求，生成 Markdown 操作时间线报告（report.md + events.jsonl），用于沉淀接口级 skill。

description.en: Tracks DSH's file reads, image views, and code edits in WakaTime, including exact counts of lines added and deleted by AI. Keeps activity tracking running while DSH responds, batches updates across files, and coordinates per-project reporting limits across parallel DSH processes. Automatically installs and updates wakatime-cli.
description.zh: 在 WakaTime 中记录 DSH 读取文件、查看图片和编辑代码的活动，并准确统计 AI 新增和删除的代码行数。DSH 回复期间持续记录活动，多个文件的记录批量上报，并在并行运行的 DSH 进程间统一控制各项目的上报频率。自动安装和更新 wakatime-cli。

description.en: Read-only GitHub access for agents, wrapping several tools. Inside the tool it automatically probes and selects whichever GitHub access method works locally, and tries network proxies on its own. That cuts down the network and parsing problems an agent may hit when accessing GitHub, and the overhead of it repeatedly trying different approaches.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的只读 GitHub 访问，封装多个工具。在工具内部自动探测与选择本地可用的 GitHub 访问设施，并自动尝试网络代理。减少 Agent 在访问 GitHub 时可能遇到的网络问题或解析问题，减少 Agent 频繁尝试不同方案的开销。

description.en: Continues numbered and bulleted lists in the DSH composer, so Shift+Enter after "1. item" starts a new line with the next marker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里写列表时，Shift+Enter 换行后自动补上下一个编号（1. → 2.）或项目符号。

description.en: Fronts stdio MCP servers with three router tools (list_capabilities, describe_tool, call_tool) so schemas load on demand instead of riding every request; shapes every tool result through a deterministic output ladder that archives the original first (retrieve_spill reads it back); prices tool groups in tokens and can hide built-in groups per agent. Bridges to a standard-library Python router, so Python 3.9+ is required.
description.zh: 用三个路由工具（list_capabilities、describe_tool、call_tool）代理 stdio MCP 服务器，schema 按需加载，不再随每次请求发送；所有工具结果经过确定性输出阶梯压缩，有损处理前先归档原文（retrieve_spill 可读回）；按 token 为工具分组标价，并可按 agent 隐藏内置分组。桥接到纯标准库的 Python 路由器，需要 Python 3.9+。

description.en: Plugin-author upgrade skill for DeepSeek Harness: one package carrying a corridor index, which detects the caller peer band and routes to the closed corridor card that matches it (0.1.3-alpha.1 -> 0.1.5-rc.1 as legs A+B, 0.1.5-rc.2 -> 0.1.6-alpha.2 as leg C), plus a zero-dependency seam scanner shipped as a bundle skill and an npx CLI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 插件作者的升级技能：一个包只放一份走廊索引，自动识别调用方的 peer 区间并路由到对应已封版的升级卡片（0.1.3-alpha.1 至 0.1.5-rc.1 为 A+B 两条腿，0.1.5-rc.2 至 0.1.6-alpha.2 为 C 腿），并附带以 bundle 技能与 npx CLI 两种形态提供的零依赖接缝扫描器。

description.en: Project board: kanban card groups with custom stages, cards linked to landfill-project memory, mounted repos and existing sessions; sessions opened from a card auto-load its memory.
description.zh: 项目看板：卡片组泳道自定义阶段，卡片关联落盘项目记忆、挂载仓库与已有会话（可恢复归档）；从卡片开的会话自动读取项目记忆。

description.en: AI audio generation for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — multi-vendor TTS, music, sound effects and voice design with a sidebar panel, model comparison, resource library and Agent tools.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 AI 音频插件 —— 多厂商 TTS、音乐、音效与音色设计，含侧边栏面板、模型对比、资源库与 Agent 工具。

description.en: All-in-one UI plugin for DSH Desktop (Windows): conversation-width slider with fullscreen preview and follow-window mode, thinking-block enhancements (forced Chinese, expand/collapse, Markdown rendering), an Open With header button, UI label localization, a resizable settings dialog, session delete, and workspace tabs.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版多功能 UI 插件：对话宽度滑块（按下全屏预览、跟随窗口宽度）、思考块增强（思考/回复强制中文、展开收起、Markdown 渲染）、Open With 头部打开按钮、界面英文标签中文化、设置弹窗窗口化、会话删除与工作区分页。

description.en: Native desktop notifications for DSH — approvals, questions, turn completion, session end and errors — with click-to-session, per-event toggles, quiet hours, a privacy switch that keeps message text off the banner, and a Web Audio tone per event type.
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知：审批、提问、轮次完成、会话结束与出错时弹系统原生通知，点击直达对应会话；六类事件分别开关，支持免打扰时段与隐藏正文的隐私开关，并按事件类型合成提示音。

description.en: Windows toast and a chime whenever a conversation task stops: completed, waiting on your approval or answer, or failed. Clicking the toast reopens that session at your last question, and in DSH Desktop it also raises the window.
description.zh: 对话任务停止时弹一条 Windows 通知并响一声提示音：完成、等你审批或回答、出错都会提醒。点通知回到那个会话，落在你上次提问的位置；桌面端还会把窗口拉到前台。

description.en: Customize the dsh UI theme: 12 accent presets, dark-mode aware accents with a contrast guard, density, font family, animation toggle, and raw design-token overrides.
description.zh: 一键换装你的 DSH 界面：预设主题、强调色、间距、圆角、字体随便调，还能加自定义 CSS。

description.en: Adds a web device-code sign-in and sign-out entry for the built-in GitHub Copilot provider in DSH, presets an out-of-the-box Copilot provider route, keeps credentials in the built-in credential store, and manages the model catalog as a first-login fallback that never overwrites customized model entries.
description.zh: 为 DSH 内置的 GitHub Copilot 通道补充网页设备码登录与注销入口，预置开箱即用的 Copilot 提供方路由，凭据存入内置凭据库，模型目录仅在首次登录兜底填充一次、永不覆盖已定制的模型条目。

description.en: Visual Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness with Gitea-backed tasks, workflow columns and a dedicated agent session per task.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化看板，支持 Gitea 任务、工作流列和每任务独立 Agent 会话。

description.en: One-handed, keyboard-free input for the composer: press and hold the mouse on the input box, speak, release — the text lands in the draft, and sliding up cancels without leaving a half sentence behind. No mic button to aim at and no shortcut to remember; the hand never has to leave the input area, which is the point when the other hand is busy. Recognition runs fully offline (SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx, no API key, audio never leaves the machine).
description.zh: 输入框上的单手、免键盘输入：鼠标在输入框按住、说话、松手，文字直接进草稿；上滑取消，不留半句。不用去瞄麦克风按钮，也不用记快捷键，手始终不用离开输入区——另一只手正忙的时候，这一点才是关键。识别完全在本机完成（SenseVoice + sherpa-onnx），无需 API key，音频不出本机。

description.en: Requires dsh >= 0.1.7 (session format 4); on dsh 0.1.5 use dsh-repeat-tool-breaker@0.7. Escalating repeat detection for dsh: a synchronous ctx.tools.guard gate that counts semantic fingerprints (exact/cmd/net/host/sink) over a per-agent sliding window, wa
description.zh: 在 DSH 里拦截同一智能体重复调用相同工具，第二次直接拒绝，防止死循环空转。

description.en: Session management: auto-archives stale sessions on a configurable threshold, with an archive panel, unarchive, and recycle-bin deletion with restore.
description.zh: 会话管理：超期会话自动归档（阈值可配），归档面板支持取消归档，删除移入系统回收站可还原。

description.en: Registers the domestic-China trip-planning skill: hour-level daily timelines, 12306 and Trip.com booking deep links, offline KML, and seven HTML themes. Requires Python 3.9+ on PATH (the bundled scripts are standard-library only).
description.zh: 把境内旅行规划技能注册进 DSH 技能目录：逐小时每日时间线、12306 与携程/去哪儿预订深链、离线 KML 与七套 HTML 主题。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.9+（内置脚本仅依赖标准库）。

description.en: Focus mode with a full-screen reading overlay that hides the header and composer and folds AI tool calls into summaries.
description.zh: 专注模式：全屏阅读视图，隐藏标题与输入区，把 AI 工具调用折叠成摘要。

description.en: Browses Douyin videos in a dedicated Edge browser with configurable time limits, shared local persona and interest memory, native settings, and Markdown viewing reports. Messaging, sharing, greetings, and public comments each require separate opt-in permissions.
description.zh: 通过专用 Edge 浏览器限时浏览抖音，提供共享本地人格与兴趣记忆、原生设置和 Markdown 观看日报。私信、分享、问候与公开评论分别需要开启许可。

description.en: Brings the WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder desktop logins on this machine into DeepSeek Harness as OpenAI-compatible local endpoints, with an account pool, automatic account switching when WorkBuddy is rate limited, and a settings panel.
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 的桌面登录接进 DeepSeek Harness，每家一个 OpenAI 兼容的本地端点，带账号池、限流自动换号与设置面板。

description.en: Manage, discover, install, update, and uninstall DSH skills as plugins.
description.zh: 类 Codex 插件市场的 DSH 技能管理器。

description.en: Local Markdown user and project memory for DSH: pinned preferences, keyword search, soft invalidation, history and archive, and JSON migration with preview, backup and rollback.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地 Markdown 用户与项目记忆：置顶偏好、关键词检索、软失效、历史归档，以及带预览、备份与回滚的 JSON 迁移。

description.en: Long-lived AI companions with WeChat, Matrix and Mattermost channels for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 提供隔离记忆、微信渠道、Skill、定时任务、伙伴挂念与依赖任务看板的长期 AI 伙伴。

description.en: Session-affinity routing for LLM gateways: injects the session ID into every request sent to NewApi-style gateways so the gateway can pin requests per session and raise prompt-cache hits; takes over the official pi-ai routing on install and restores it on uninstall.
description.zh: LLM 网关会话粘性路由：把会话 sessionId 注入发往 NewApi 类网关的每个请求，供网关做请求亲和以提升 prompt cache 命中，装上即接管官方 pi-ai 路由，卸载即还原。

description.en: Magpie gateway provider for DSH: syncs gateway models into the picker with visibility control, image input and thinking levels.
description.zh: 把 Magpie 网关的模型接入 DSH 选择器，支持模型显隐管理、图片输入与思考档位。

description.en: Genuine Liquid Glass theme for DSH Web UI: SVG feDisplacementMap edge refraction on input card, send button, bubbles, view tabs, queue dock and sidebar. Built-in animated demo wallpaper, customizable background blur & brightness, redesigned model selector popup, glass-styled buttons throughout, and a unique water-drop settings icon.
description.zh: 真正的液态玻璃 DSH 主题：SVG 边缘折射效果覆盖输入框、发送按钮、消息气泡、视图标签、队列坞和侧边栏。自带动态色块壁纸，可自定义背景模糊与亮度，重新设计的模型选择弹窗，全界面玻璃质感按钮，以及水滴形状的专属设置图标。

description.en: Replaces the Windows pwsh executor row so the model-facing pwsh tool runs PowerShell 7, with a shell_router tool for status, diagnosis, and per-user portable installation.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上替换 pwsh 执行器行，让模型侧 pwsh 工具运行 PowerShell 7，并提供 shell_router 工具做状态、诊断与用户级便携安装。

description.en: Shows the installed DeepSeek Harness version in the sidebar, checks npm and GitHub Releases for updates, and provides manual or confirmed update commands.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 版本，检查 npm 与 GitHub Releases 更新，并提供手动或确认后执行的更新命令。

description.en: Scheduled reminders and delayed send for DSH: /later delivers what you type as yourself at the time you pick, while the timer panel (or /schedule) posts a reminder row — even with the page closed. (scheduled send / reminders / delayed send)
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上定时提醒与延迟发送：一句话到点送达——/later 以你的身份发出，定时面板或 /schedule 发提醒行；关掉网页也准时触发。（定时发送 / 定时提醒 / 延迟发送 / 提醒）

description.en: Endpoint of a companion mobile app that also runs headless, with no desktop shell or Electron required: it serves a restricted mobile API over a relay tunnel or LAN pairing, for listing, opening and driving DSH sessions, following the live device event stream, and authenticating with revocable per-device credentials.
description.zh: 手机 App 的对端插件，自身可作无头宿主单独运行（不需要桌面外壳或 Electron）：经中转隧道或局域网配对提供受限的移动 API，用于列出、新建与操控 DSH 会话、订阅设备实时事件流，并以可吊销的设备凭据鉴权。

description.en: Session usage statistics panel: token and request stats at day/hour/minute granularity, an activity heatmap, bottom-bar session info takeover with per-turn cost chips, and cost estimation under multi-condition time-segmented pricing. Re-implemented from HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel with extensions.
description.zh: 会话用量统计面板：天/小时/分钟三粒度 token 与请求统计、活跃热力图、会话底栏信息接管与回合费用芯片、多条件分时段定价费用估算；复刻自 HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel 并扩展。

description.en: Multi-platform LLM balance and quota panel: configure DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, MiniMax, NewApi or custom endpoints, poll on a schedule, draw balance and quota trend charts, and push threshold and window-reset notices through multiple channels.
description.zh: 多平台 LLM 账号余额与额度面板：配置 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Kimi、智谱、MiniMax、NewApi 或自定义端点，定时自动查询并绘制趋势图，余额/额度阈值与窗口重置经多通道推送通知。

description.en: Coding-learn floating panel: edits and runs Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell with exit code and timing, grades JSON course lessons with progress export, keeps Markdown notes and snippet library, and sends code plus a question into the current conversation for the main model to answer.
description.zh: 编程学习悬浮面板：编辑并运行 Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell（含退出码与耗时），JSON 课程包关卡自动评判并可导出进度，提供 Markdown 笔记与代码片段库；代码分析以用户消息直投当前对话，由对话主模型直接输出。

description.en: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste a Console API key under Settings → Plugins and the Console's chat models become selectable, with the catalog synced automatically, each model routed to the endpoint the official docs assign, and free *-free models hidden by default because they only run inside the OpenCode client.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Console (Zen) 模型：在「设置 → 插件」填入 Console API Key 后即可选用 Console 的对话模型，模型目录自动同步，每个模型按官方文档路由到对应端点，免费 *-free 模型默认不列出（它们只能在 OpenCode 客户端内运行）。

description.en: One-click Concise output style for DeepSeek Harness: results first, no filler, same work depth. Every final reply opens with a plain-language digest card (select text to copy), scoped per session, working in headless/CLI too, with /concise command, style.md overrides and a local API. Links and file paths inside the digest card render as clickable chips: URLs jump, local files open with the OS default app (v0.9+). A per-step pre-generation contract reminder (v0.11.2+) measurably fixes digest misses on audit-report/table-shaped replies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 一键 Concise 输出风格开关：结果先行、少废话，工作深浅不变。每轮最终回答开头自动附「摘要」精华卡（划选即复制），按会话独立生效，headless/CLI 同样生效，支持 /concise 命令、style.md 自定义风格与本地 API。摘要卡内的链接与文件路径渲染为可点击 chip：网页跳转、本地文件用系统默认应用打开（v0.9+）。每步生成前自动重申摘要契约（v0.11.2+），实测根治审查报告/表格型回复的漏卡。

description.en: Process management: brings ntd-style processes (multi-stage, multi-step agent workflow templates) into the dsh web UI — browse, edit, validate, import/export and AI-generate processes; the built-in library is read-only while the personal library is writable with live file sync, and agents read the library through process_* tools and advance work stage by stage.
description.zh: 工艺管理：把 ntd 的「工艺」（多阶段·多环节 agent 工作流模板）接进 dsh web——浏览/编辑/校验/导入导出/AI 生成工艺，内置库只读、我的库可写，文件改动实时同步；agent 可通过 process_* 工具读工艺库、按工艺分阶段推进。

description.en: Web Composer placement for long prompts: keep it at the bottom or dock it in a resizable right column beside a long answer.
description.zh: 面向长提示词的 Web Composer 布局：输入框可保留在底部，也可停靠到可调宽度的右栏，与长回答并排阅读和写作。

description.en: Keeps bulk output out of the conversation: ctk_execute, ctk_execute_file and ctk_batch_execute run code in a child process and return only the conclusion, ctk_index and ctk_search file long material into a local FTS5 knowledge base built on node:sqlite, and a routing gate refuses curl and wget before they execute. Ships ctk_stats and ctk_doctor plus a settings page with a live context-occupancy panel. No third-party runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 让大块输出不进对话：ctk_execute、ctk_execute_file 与 ctk_batch_execute 在子进程里跑代码只回结论，ctk_index 与 ctk_search 把长材料存进基于 node:sqlite 的本地 FTS5 知识库，路由门禁在执行前拦下 curl 与 wget。附 ctk_stats、ctk_doctor 与带实时上下文占用面板的设置页，零第三方运行时依赖。

description.en: Replaces the composer's model and reasoning-effort selector with a two-level menu and six slider skins.
description.zh: 把输入框右下角的模型 / 推理等级选择器换成两级菜单，并提供六种滑杆视觉。

description.en: An OpenCode Go model source for DSH: it reads the opencode-go catalog from Models.dev and serves it on a separate opencode-go-live route, leaving the built-in opencode-go route in place. The catalog snapshot is cached under the DSH home and a failed refresh keeps the last successful one; its own Models settings card edits the route key and can render OpenCode Go subscription usage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 OpenCode Go 模型来源：从 Models.dev 读取 opencode-go 目录，在独立的 opencode-go-live 路由上提供，内置 opencode-go 路由保持原样。目录快照缓存在 DSH home 下，刷新失败时沿用上一次成功的目录；插件自带 Models 设置卡片用于填写该路由密钥，并可显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量。

description.en: Point-and-shoot screenshot capture: a system floating window turns a new screenshot (or copied image) into an Obsidian note with comments and key-point marking, instant OCR through the host DSH multimodal model (no extra API key needed, Tongyi Qianwen as fallback), a duplicate-screen guard, per-day merging, and an optional evening AI organization pass.
description.zh: 指哪拍哪截图入库：系统级悬浮窗把新截图（或复制图片）一键存入 Obsidian 笔记，支持注释与「重点」标记、用宿主 DSH 多模态模型即时识别文字（零配置、无需另配 key，可回落通义千问）、同屏去重、按天合并，并可在晚间用 AI 整理归类、打双链并生成当日总结。
