description.en: Irreversible secret-scrubbing guard: rewrites access keys, bearer tokens, and private key blocks into `[REDACTED:<category>]` placeholders before they reach the session log and the model.
description.zh: 不可逆密钥脱敏守护：在访问密钥、Bearer 令牌、私钥块进入会话日志和模型请求之前，将其改写为 `[REDACTED:<category>]` 占位符。

description.en: Local images and videos as the DSH desktop window background: timed rotation with 0.7s cross-fades, first-frame-ready before fading in, automatic light/dark ink for readability, adjustable blur and panel/sidebar opacity, video thumbnails, and a probe endpoint reporting load, layer and selector health. Reads only the local files you point it at.
description.zh: 把本机图片/视频（含 Dynamic Wallpaper.app 素材）用作 DSH 桌面客户端背景：定时轮换与 0.7 秒交叉淡化、等首帧就绪再淡入、按壁纸明暗自动切换深/浅字色、模糊与面板/侧栏透明度可调、视频缩略图，探针接口上报加载、图层与界面选择器的健康状态。只读取本机文件，不联网。

description.en: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec in, real-Chromium verdict out.
description.zh: Agent 交付物的独立浏览器验收测试：JSON 规格进，真实 Chromium 结论出。

description.en: Sound + popup when a task completes: a Web Audio chime, an in-page toast, and a system notification while the page is in the background (browser-only, cross-platform).
description.zh: 任务完成时播放提示音并弹出小通知：Web Audio 合成音效、页面内 toast、页面在后台时系统通知，纯浏览器方案、零系统依赖、跨平台。

description.en: Finishes 头歌 (EduCoder) homework over the platform JSON API, with no browser automation. educoder_sweep scans every course for homeworks that still have unfinished challenges — complete homeworks are skipped without reading a single challenge, so a full-account scan costs no model tokens — and can finish them; multiple-choice challenges also cost no model tokens, because the platform returns the answer key in any submission response, while code challenges are generated by the model, uploaded with evaluate:0 and graded once per challenge, then retried using the error report the platform returns. Three tools: educoder_sweep, educoder_homework, educoder_account.
description.zh: 走头歌（EduCoder）平台 JSON API 完成作业，无浏览器自动化。educoder_sweep 扫描所有课程中仍有未通过关卡的作业——已完成的作业直接跳过、一个关卡都不读，因此全量扫描不消耗模型 token——并可一次做完；选择题同样零 token，因为平台会在任意一次提交的响应里回吐标准答案；代码题由模型生成，以 evaluate:0 上传后每关只触发一次评测，再按平台返回的报错重试。三个工具：educoder_sweep、educoder_homework、educoder_account。

description.en: Generic idea manager for the DSH Web GUI: Host-authoritative /api/ideas ledger, capture, 4-column kanban (open / under review / archived / declined), one-click execution launch (mirrored TaskBoard card or a direct session), optional TaskBoard mirror; moun
description.zh: 把灵感随手丢进看板，AI 帮你收集、评分和整理，想法不再散落各处。

description.en: Conversational Markdown mindmap workspace: edit complete documents step by step, keep a live right-side visualization synchronized, and open, manage, and export mindmaps from the working directory.
description.zh: 对话式 Markdown 思维脑图工作台：逐步编辑完整文档，实时同步右侧可视化，并在工作目录中打开、管理和导出脑图。

description.en: Pre-visit due diligence and company research in DeepSeek Harness for customer background checks and risk briefs, with Qichacha MCP tool-call budget approval and entity confirmation.
description.zh: 访前尽调智能体：面向拜访前调查，提供企业尽调、客户尽调、客户背景调查、工商核验与风险信息整理；使用企查查 MCP，设有调用预算授权和主体确认。

description.en: Surfaces important facts and trade-offs from the current task, with on-demand explanations and optional discussion in the main session.
description.zh: 根据当前任务上下文提醒重要事实和方案取舍，支持展开解释并带入主会话讨论。

description.en: Theme pack for the DSH Web UI: 30 drop-in CSS themes with light and dark variants, integrated into Settings → General with a programmatic API.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 主题包：30 款即插即用的 CSS 主题，每款含浅色与深色变体，集成于「设置 → 通用」，并提供程序化 API。

description.en: Cron job board: schedules local scripts or dsh session tasks (fresh or pinned sessions) by cron expression, with centralized environment-variable management, run logs, and concurrency and timeout control.
description.zh: 定时任务看板：cron 调度本地脚本或 dsh 会话任务（每次新建/固定会话），环境变量集中管理，执行日志与并发/超时控制。

description.en: Task control for DeepSeek Harness: one-click emergency stop and force-termination of stuck downloads and tool calls, download progress, stuck detection, pwsh activity monitoring, and append-condition / pause / resume with invisible recovery.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务控制：卡死的下载与工具调用一键急停与强制终止、下载进度、卡死识别、pwsh 运行状态检测，以及追加条件/暂停/恢复（恢复指令隐形注入，不打扰聊天）。

description.en: Configurable web search for DeepSeek Harness using SearXNG, Wikipedia, Tavily, Brave, or Gemini, with per-client engine selection and bounded retries.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置联网搜索，支持 SearXNG、Wikipedia、Tavily、Brave 与 Gemini，并支持客户端引擎选择和受控重试。

description.en: Security-audit facts AI coding agents cannot compute, plus a verdict gate: euthyna history attributes deleted lines to commits and flags those from security fixes (--origins finds the first introducer), euthyna coverage reports which changed symbols no test ever invoked, and euthyna gate checks each finding against six gates, downgrading any without evidence to an observation.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的确定性安全审计事实与结论门禁：euthyna history 把每行被删代码归因到提交并标记安全修复类删除（--origins 追到最初引入者），euthyna coverage 报告哪些改动符号从未被测试调用，euthyna gate 用六道门禁逐条校验结论，拿不出证据的一律降级为观察。

description.en: Data cleaning and data enrichment for CSV/XLSX/JSON enterprise lists in DeepSeek Harness, including spreadsheet cleaning, deduplication, profiling, optional Qichacha MCP and exports.
description.zh: 数据清洗补全智能体：面向 Excel/CSV/JSON 企业名单，提供数据清洗、表格清洗、清洗补全、去重、企业数据补全与字段补全，支持企查查 MCP 和结果导出。

description.en: Model capability editor: edit each model reasoning-effort levels and image-input (multimodal) declarations inline in the official model page, written back to settings.yaml as a whole group, with a floating entry as fallback when the anchor breaks.
description.zh: 模型能力编辑器：在官方模型页行内可视化编辑各模型的思考档位与图片输入（多模态）声明，整组写回 settings.yaml，锚点失效时浮动入口兜底。

description.en: Results-only conversation toggle for the Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process rows, keeps one live status line while the agent works, restores working animations under prefers-reduced-motion, zh-CN/en localized. Works in the stock composer and inside dsh-split-screen panes; verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.
description.zh: Web 对话「只看结果」开关：隐藏思考与工具调用过程，运行中仅保留一条实时状态行，reduced-motion 环境下恢复活动光影，中英双语。原生输入框与 dsh-split-screen 分屏面板内均可用；已适配 DSH 0.1.1 与 0.1.5。

description.en: Model attribution panel for the dsh web chat — local, zero-network structural fingerprinting (template token leaks, glitch canaries, tokenizer usage-vector matching) that scores which of 29 AI vendors a session's responses most resemble, with a per-claim evidence ledger and a 12-probe active battery.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页端挂载模型归属面板，用纯本地、零联网的结构指纹匹配（模板特殊 token 泄漏、glitch 金丝雀、tokenizer usage 向量比对）判断当前会话的回答最像 29 家 AI 厂商中的哪一家，每个结论附带可展开的证据账本，另附 12 探针主动取证电池。

description.en: Dual knowledge-graph RAG for Markdown notes with half-life memory decay: prerequisite + similarity graphs (P/S-Agent traversal), paragraph chunking, n-gram/embedding hybrid search, and an explicit weight-feedback loop — a native Cordis plugin, npm-installable as @eqman00003/knowlp-rag.
description.zh: Markdown 笔记的双知识图谱 RAG，带半衰期记忆衰减：前置依赖 + 相似关联双图（P/S-Agent 遍历）、段落级匹配、ngram/embedding 混合检索、显式权重反馈闭环——原生 Cordis 插件，npm 包 @eqman00003/knowlp-rag。

description.en: Cross-session task delegation for DeepSeek Harness: spawn durable top-level sessions and send them tasks, read or steer them by base62 session alias, and approve their sandbox escalation requests through an approval bridge that refuses destructive deletes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话派活与协同：新建顶层任务会话并投递任务，用 base62 会话别名读取或干预，并通过审批桥批准子会话的沙箱提权——命中破坏性删除一律强制拒绝。

description.en: One-line clock context for DeepSeek Harness: a Current time timestamp reading (weekday, date, time, UTC offset, IANA timezone) opens every conversation turn and a Turn ended reading closes it, so the model always knows the time, date and idle gap across turns without asking.
description.zh: 每轮对话开始向模型上下文注入单行时间戳读数（星期 / 日期 / 时间 / UTC 偏移 / IANA 时区），收尾再注入 Turn ended 关闭读数——模型始终知道现在几点、今天星期几、上一轮何时结束，日期运算与跨轮间隔不再靠猜；轻量时钟感知，每条约 30 token。

description.en: Dynamically trusts every Host header that actually arrives and flips the default web binding to 0.0.0.0: wildcard or unenumerable entry domains work without editing the start command, the authentication layer is untouched, and hosts are evicted by LRU beyond a capacity cap.
description.zh: 动态信任所有实际到达的 Host 并把 web 默认绑定翻转为 0.0.0.0：泛域名等无法枚举的入口免改启动命令，认证层不动，超出容量的 Host 按 LRU 淘汰。

description.en: Conversation enhancements: a history-input overlay (Alt+Up with workspace/session/global/prompt scopes), recall of unapplied interjected messages, conversation forking with fork-family version switching, and optional auto-resend after forking (off by default).
description.zh: 对话增强：历史输入浮层（Alt+↑，workspace/session/global/prompts 四范围搜索回填）、未应用插话撤回、对话分叉与家族版本切换、分叉后自动重发（默认关）。

description.en: File-backed post office between DeepSeek Harness sessions: every letter is sealed with an HMAC and a body digest, recipients are resolved through a roster interface, and delivery is offline-first, so an undeliverable letter waits in the mailbox instead of being lost.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话之间的文件信箱：每封信都用 HMAC 与正文摘要封好，收件人通过名单接口解析，默认离线投递——投不出去的信留在信箱里等人来收，不会丢。

description.en: Auto-expands streaming thinking: always keeps the latest thinking block expanded, manual actions take priority, only the last block expands when opening a session, and nothing remains after uninstall.
description.zh: 流式思考自动展开：始终显示最新一条思考，手动操作优先，打开会话仅展开最后一条，卸载无残留。

description.en: A self-evolving plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it observes how the agent runs, proposes improvements to its own assets via the LLM, validates each proposal inside a sandboxed trial agent, and applies only verified mutations — with a versioned ledger and automatic rollback on regression.
description.zh: 一个自我进化的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：观察代理的运行方式，通过 LLM 对其自身资产提出改进方案，在沙箱试运行代理中验证每个方案，只应用通过验证的变更——带版本化账本，出现性能回退时自动回滚。

description.en: Displays CodexRadar model capability benchmarks in a Settings page and shows the selected session model's DeepSWE score beside the composer.
description.zh: 在设置页展示 CodexRadar 模型能力评测，并在输入框旁显示当前会话所选模型的 DeepSWE 分数。

description.en: Enhanced model selector for the DSH composer with searchable provider groups, keyboard and accessibility support, and an inline reasoning-effort slider.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 输入区的模型选择器：可搜索供应商分组、键盘与无障碍支持，以及内联推理强度滑杆。

description.en: Turn a set of DSH plugins into one pasteable share code, then install it plugin by plugin — with a QR code to carry it to a phone.
description.zh: 把一套 DSH 插件变成一段可粘贴的分享码，别人贴进去就能逐条安装，也能生成二维码带到手机上。

description.en: Cherry Studio-style paste: multi-line/indented/fenced text or code pasted into the DSH Web composer collapses into a bordered, collapsible, language-tagged card and is restored as a fenced code block on send.
description.zh: Cherry Studio 式粘贴：把多行/缩进/围栏文本或代码粘进 DSH Web 输入框时收成带边框、可折叠、带语言标签的卡片，发送时还原为围栏代码块。

description.en: Sync your DeepSeek Harness (DSH) configuration between machines over a private git or WebDAV channel: settings, plugins, MCP servers, skills, agent presets and provider credentials. DSH 配置远程同步插件（私有通道，明文自用）。

0.8.6 fixes a startup crash: the host runtime package is an optional peer, never an installed dependency. TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) wired end to end into DeepSeek Harness (0.8.6). Seven tools: jev_decision (1-25 parallel atomic verdicts in one call; noul/choice/score; typed answers with calibrated confidence; measured median 266-484 ms; verdicts only, never prose), jev_choose (rank 2-10 candidate approaches - fit 0-3 and risk - into an explicit composite with a recommended pick), jev_batch (NEW in 0.8.6: one set of 1-5 judgments over 1-20 texts, one real call per text at bounded concurrency, returning a paste-ready markdown table sortable by a judged dimension; built-in sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam presets; a failed row is reported as failed with the raw error, never guessed), jev_usage (locally measured usage: calls, tokens, estimated cost, latency median and p95, per-tool mix, rolling windows, projected burn rate, optional local hard budgets, and a declared-balance remainder), jev_overview (session ledger), jev_guard_status (guard counters plus a registrations block that surfaces per-surface registration failures) and jev_verify (frozen 27-question live benchmark at concurrency 6: 96.3%, 26/27). WHAT IS NEW IN 0.8.6 - the ledger survives a restart, the remainder is derived instead of invented, and the plugin can now do batch paperwork. (1) The local ledger persists to $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json BY DEFAULT, so the cumulative total no longer resets when the host restarts. Two real bugs behind the old silent zero were found and fixed: the ledger path only honoured DSH_HOME (absent inside the host process, so persistence was silently disabled and the file name was null), and save() wrote the still-empty in-memory ring over the history file because it ran before the first load while the debounce window swallowed the follow-up write. (2) Remaining is derived, never invented: TypeSafe exposes no balance endpoint - /v1/usage, /v1/quota, /v1/account, /v1/account/balance, /v1/balance, /v1/credits, /v1/billing, /v1/me, /v1/limits and a dozen more all return 404, and only /v1/models answers, with no balance headers - so the panel shows the remainder as your declared balance (quota.declaredBalanceUsd) minus locally measured spend since quota.balanceSince, and says plainly that it cannot be fetched instead of printing a number. (3) The composer pill re-reads every 20 s instead of every 60 s, so a call you just made shows up while you are still looking at it. (4) The collapsed pill leads with the remainder once you declare a balance, and the cumulative row is renamed when the ledger is on disk. Every tool has an in-conversation structured view; the Settings > Plugins card covers credentials, tool switches, the auto-guard, the dashboard, the prompt section, usage/quota and auto-triage. Honest by design: no API key means an explicit error, never fabricated results; every registration is quarantined so a failure degrades one surface. Tests 38/38 (npm test, ~2.5 s). Client half applies on refresh; server half needs a host restart.
description.zh: 0.8.6 修复了一个会让宿主起不来的依赖问题（宿主运行时包改为 optional peer，永不被安装）。为 DeepSeek Harness 端到端接入 TypeSafe Jev（System One 决策模型）0.8.6。共七个工具：jev_decision（一次并行完成 1-25 个原子判定；noul/choice/score；返回类型化答案与校准置信度；实测中位 266-484 ms；只出判定不写文本）、jev_choose（对 2-10 个候选并行打分——契合度 0-3 与风险——合成综合分并给推荐，只给分不解释）、jev_batch（0.8.6 新增：一次调用对 1-20 条文本跑同一组 1-5 个判定，每条文本一次真实调用、并发有上限，返回可直接粘贴的 markdown 表格并可按某个判定维度排序；内置 sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam 预设；失败的行如实标为失败并附原文错误，绝不猜测）、jev_usage（本机实测用量：调用、tokens、估算成本、延迟中位与 p95、按工具分布、滚动窗口、全天用量预测、可选的本地硬预算，以及自报余额推算出的剩余）、jev_overview（会话账本）、jev_guard_status（护栏计数，并用 registrations 暴露分面注册失败）与 jev_verify（对线上 API 6 路并发运行冻结的 27 题基准：96.3%，26/27）。0.8.6 的三件事：账本扛得住重启、剩余是算出来的而不是编出来的、插件开始干批量整理的活。 （1）本地账本默认写入 $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json，宿主重启后累计不再清零。此前「明明有调用、面板却是 0」背后是两个真 bug：账本路径只认 DSH_HOME（宿主进程里没有这个变量，于是持久化被静默关闭、file 为 null），以及 save() 在首次 load 之前执行，把尚未载入的空内存环覆盖写到了历史文件上，而紧随其后的那次保存又被节流窗口吞掉。 （2）剩余只推算、不编造：TypeSafe 没有任何余额接口——/v1/usage、/v1/quota、/v1/account、/v1/account/balance、/v1/balance、/v1/credits、/v1/billing、/v1/me、/v1/limits 等十几个路径全部 404，只有 /v1/models 有响应且响应头没有任何余额字段——因此面板把「剩余」显示为你在 quota.declaredBalanceUsd 自报的余额减去 quota.balanceSince 起的本机实测花费，没自报时明确写「剩余无法显示」，绝不印一个数字。 （3）输入框胶囊的刷新周期从 60 秒改为 20 秒，刚跑完的调用不用等就能看到。 （4）自报余额后，折叠胶囊以「剩余」为首，账本落盘后累计行改名。每个工具都有对话内结构化视图；「设置 → 插件」卡片覆盖凭据、工具开关、自动护栏、看板、引导段、使用额度与 autoTriage。 诚实设计：未配置 Key 时给出明确报错、绝不伪造结果；任何分面注册失败都被隔离，只降级一个功能。 测试 38/38（npm test，约 2.5 s）。客户端部分刷新页面即生效；服务端部分需重启宿主。

description.en: Section icons for the settings navigation: replaces the uniform gear icons with per-section glyphs and fills the plugin-market card avatar slot with each plugin icon; a page reload after uninstall restores the official icons.
description.zh: 设置导航分区图标：把千篇一律的齿轮换成各分区专属图形，并为插件市场卡片头像槽提供插件图标，卸载后重载页面即恢复官方图标。

description.en: Browse, preview and install public Agent Skills from inside the DSH web GUI, aggregating five sources (claudeskills.info, skillsmp.com, the awesome-claude-skills repository list, the official anthropics/skills repo, and skill packs shipped by installed DSH plugins). Skills install pinned to a commit rather than a branch name, so what you previewed is what lands; the panel reports provenance, whole-tree update checks and a trash instead of deleting. Before writing anything it validates the skill name and frontmatter against the rules the harness silently enforces, lists files that SKILL.md references but the fetch did not bring, flags partial fetches, and offers overwrite, rename or skip when a name is taken.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 里浏览、预览并安装公开的 Agent Skills，聚合五个来源（claudeskills.info、skillsmp.com、awesome-claude-skills 仓库坐标表、Anthropic 官方仓库、已装 DSH 插件自带的技能包）。安装按 commit 而不是分支名钉住，预览到的就是落地的；面板给出每个技能的来路、按整棵树比对的更新检查，删除是移进回收站而不是抹掉。落地之前先按 harness 实际执行的规则体检技能名与 frontmatter（名字不合法会被 harness 静默跳过），列出 SKILL.md 引用但没取回的文件，标出只取到一部分的情况，同名时给出覆盖、改名、跳过三个选项。

description.en: Plays a chime and speaks a Chinese voice alert when an approval, question, or plan-review popup appears in the DSH web GUI, so you never miss a request.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中出现审批、提问或计划审批弹窗时，播放提示音并中文语音播报，避免漏看待处理请求。

description.en: Model switching and reasoning-effort control for DeepSeek Harness: set_model and list_models agent tools let the agent autonomously change its provider, model or thinking depth (reasoning effort) mid-task with a mandatory reason, a provider whitelist and a context-window token-pressure guard, the active model is injected into the runtime context, and Plan Mode auto-transition switches to a configured planning model on entering plan mode and restores the previous execution model on exit.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供动态模型切换与思考深度调节：set_model / list_models 两个 Agent 工具让模型按任务难度自主切换 provider、model 与 reasoningEffort（思考深度），强制附带切换理由，带 Provider 白名单与上下文窗口 Token 水位护栏，活跃模型注入运行时上下文；进入 Plan 规划模式自动切换到配置的规划模型，退出自动恢复日常执行模型。

description.en: Theme skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness — built-in themes / static image / dynamic 360°-follow video, one-click from the sidebar & Settings; imports persist, default skins protected.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题皮肤插件：内置主题 / 静态图片 / 动态视频（鼠标环绕跟随帧），侧边栏一键切换，设置页完整管理；导入持久化、默认皮肤不可删。

description.en: Read-only Gitea and Forgejo tools over the REST API both projects share: instance info, repository listing, issue and pull request search and read, PR diffs and changed files, and Actions runs, jobs and job logs. Tool metadata is available in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.
description.zh: 面向自建 Gitea / Forgejo 的只读工具，走两者共用的 REST API：实例信息、仓库列表、议题与 PR 搜索和读取、PR diff 与变更文件，以及 Actions 运行、任务与任务日志。工具元数据支持英文、繁体中文、简体中文与日文。

description.en: Rules execution engine for dsh: parses AGENTS.md, hard-blocks rule-violating tool calls, text-based B/D rule auditing, /guard command, version-guard for versioned files, and free-zone support (engine skips free-zone sections).
description.zh: dsh 规则执行引擎：解析 AGENTS.md、硬拦违反规则的工具调用、文本纠察与审计、/guard 命令、版本化文件守卫、自由区域支持（引擎跳过自由区内容）。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling, weekly and monthly used and remaining percentage with reset times) in a floating panel anchored to the bottom-left of the session window.
description.zh: 在会话窗口左下角的悬浮面板中显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（滚动/每周/每月的已用与剩余百分比及重置时间）。

description.en: Multi-agent roundtable discussion: each member runs as a subagent on its own model and speaks in turn, a host summarizes each round, and termination writes meeting-minutes Markdown.
description.zh: 多智能体圆桌讨论：每个成员作为子代理在自己的模型上依次发言，主持人逐轮汇总，终止时生成会议纪要 Markdown。

description.en: In-chat preview for produced files: click a produced-file chip to render Markdown (server-side markdown-it + highlight.js), images, or plain text right in the conversation; system-app open and reveal-in-folder stay one click away.
description.zh: 产物文件聊天内预览：点击产物 chip 直接在对话中渲染 Markdown（宿主侧 markdown-it + highlight.js 代码高亮）、图片或纯文本，系统应用打开与在文件夹中显示仍一键可达。

description.en: Select text in the DSH Web GUI and ask about it in place (floating button, or the Alt+Q shortcut): an independent subagent that inherits no parent context answers, streaming into a side card hosted by the native right sidebar, dsh-better-sidebar, or a built-in overlay — and the question can be routed to the main conversation instead.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面划词就地追问（浮出按钮，或 Alt+Q 快捷键）：答案由不继承父上下文的独立子代理流式产出到侧边卡片，承载面为原生右侧栏 / dsh-better-sidebar / 内置浮层，也可把问题改为落回主对话。

description.en: Heads-up Texas Hold'em training with an independent AI opponent, persistent public-action memory, and decision reviews.
description.zh: 德州扑克 AI 陪练：双人对局、持久公开行为记忆与可追溯决策复盘。

description.en: Visual theme customizer for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — backgrounds, text colors, borders and details, all adjustable visually, with presets you can import and export, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面自定义主题插件：背景/文字/框线/细节全可视化调整，可导入导出预设，持久化保存。

description.en: FDE toolbox bundle: installing this one plugin pulls in a curated set of common dsh plugins (git server, WebDAV mount, knowledge base, scheduled tasks, auto-resume, UI tweaks, auto-retrospection, file manager, smart titles, task board, plugin market, context trimmer, IM bridge, sidebar enhancements), with a panel showing install status and one-click gap-filling.
description.zh: FDE 工具箱全家桶：安装一个插件带上一批常用 dsh 插件（代码仓库 / 挂载盘 / 知识库 / 定时任务 / 自动续跑 / 界面微调 / 自动复盘 / 文件管理 / 智能标题 / 任务看板 / 插件市场 / 上下文 / IM 接入 / 侧栏增强），面板看状态、一键补装。

description.en: Continuous voice conversations for DSH with hands-free listening, push-to-talk, speech recognition, TTS replies, and background Agent delegation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供持续语音对话，支持免提监听、按住说话、语音识别、TTS 语音回复和后台 Agent 任务委派。

description.en: Forwards an unattended DeepSeek Harness run's tool-call approvals and ask_user_question prompts to Feishu cards on your phone. The desktop GUI answers first — a card is only sent after `delaySeconds` (120 by default) with no answer there — and a phone approval grants `allowed-once`, so no authority accumulates on the phone. One outbound WebSocket long connection to Feishu: no public IP, domain, tunnel or relay.
description.zh: 把无人值守运行时 DeepSeek Harness 的工具调用审批与 ask_user_question 提问推送到手机飞书卡片。桌面 GUI 优先作答——只有在 `delaySeconds`（默认 120 秒）内无人应答时才发出卡片——手机上的批准等同于 `allowed-once`，因此不会在手机上累积任何权限。仅一条到飞书的出站 WebSocket 长连接：不需要公网 IP、域名、隧道或中继。

description.en: Gitee/GitHub AI employee: @ the bot on an issue (Gitee or GitHub), it clones the repo, implements the fix on the branch you name, opens a PR to that branch, and can auto-merge and auto-close the issue. v1.2 adds security scanning: configure scan repos, audit with built-in/custom prompts, deduplicate, and file new findings as issues.
description.zh: Gitee/GitHub AI 员工：在 issue 里 @ 机器人并指定目标分支（如"需要修改 release-v1.2 分支"），它自动克隆仓库开发、向指定分支提交 PR，可自动合并并自动关闭 issue。v1.2 新增代码安全扫描：配置扫描仓库后按内置/自定义提示词审计代码，去重后把新发现提交 issue。

description.en: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) legal-data MCP services — regulation search and case search — with dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
description.zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入企查查法律产品——法律数据 MCP 服务（法规检索、案例检索）：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖法规与案例服务。

description.en: Host-only command safety gate for DeepSeek Harness: blocks recognized dangerous operations and requests DSH approval when a command cannot be inspected.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一道命令审批关卡，危险命令执行前先拦下来让你确认。

description.en: DSH plugin for background security audits, secret leakage detection, and command safety
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的后台安全审计器：扫描 Agent 输出中的秘密泄漏，在执行前检查命令安全性，并将发现记录到持久化审计日志中。

description.en: Aggregated web-search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one prioritized queue over nine providers (AnySearch, TinyFish, Tavily, Brave, Exa, Firecrawl, Jina, SerpApi, Serper), with multi-key rotation per provider, ordered fallback on failed attempts, and a live settings card.
description.zh: 聚合式网页搜索提供方：为内置 web_search 工具提供一条按优先级排序的搜索队列，覆盖 AnySearch、TinyFish、Tavily、Brave、Exa、Firecrawl、Jina、SerpApi、Serper 九家服务，每家支持多把 API Key 轮换，失败时逐级回退，并附带实时生效的设置卡片。

description.en: Full vision-capability bundle for DeepSeek Harness: a vision_understand tool (OpenAI-compatible vision APIs, free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash by default) plus paste/drag-and-drop/button entry points for image recognition.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视觉能力全家桶：vision_understand 工具（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API，默认免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash）+ 粘贴/拖拽/按钮三入口识图。

description.en: Adds selection quoting and anchored annotations to DSH conversations: selected text enters the composer as an anchored quote reference, a quote bar jumps back to the source message and highlights it, and the sent quote block names the turn and role it came from.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话添加选区引用与锚点批注：选中文字带锚点进入输入框，输入框下方的引用条可跳回原文并高亮，发送后的引用块标明出处轮次与角色。

description.en: China A-share stock research: ticker search, announcements over any date range, financial report cards, valuation profiles and signal-factor explanations (~5,000 stocks since 2011, public read-only data service), plus a link-out tool to an external trading-sandbox product.
description.zh: A股个股研究：搜股票、查任意区间公告、财报卡、估值画像与交易信号科普（约 5000 只、2011 年至今，公共只读数据服务），另有一个跳转外部交易推演产品的链接工具。

description.en: Pairs the running executor with a stronger reviewer model through zero-parameter advisor() calls and step-based patrol checks, returning plan, correction, or stop guidance.
description.zh: 通过零参数 advisor() 咨询和按步巡逻检查，为执行模型接入更强的审查模型，返回计划、纠偏或停止信号。

description.en: Smooth comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing comet trail replaces the native blinking caret and glides across the input as you type, with configurable accent color, thickness, and trail, IME-aware for CJK input.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供流畅的彗星光标：以发光的彗星拖尾取代原生闪烁光标，随输入平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细与拖尾，并适配中文等 IME 输入。

description.en: Outer Wilds theme with a static starfield, campfire effects, appearance settings, and bundled Jost and Source Han Sans fonts.
description.zh: 以《星际拓荒》为主题，提供静态星空、篝火动效、外观设置和内置 Jost 与思源黑体。

description.en: Real-time usage, cost and balance meter for DeepSeek Harness: official-API balance, cost accuracy within ¥0.02, per-turn / per-session / per-model cost ledger, live color-tiered token speed and a docked one-click popup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 实时用量、费用与余额计量：官方 API 实时查询余额、计费误差 0.02 元内，分本轮/本次会话/整个模型三级费用台账，实时分色档位 Token 速度，输入框旁弹窗即点即看。

description.en: Worktree Space: puts a workspace task that spans one or more Git repositories in its own task space directory - each repository in it gets its own worktree on one shared task branch; the space is registered as a DSH Workspace so sessions start right there, and multiple tasks run side by side without interfering. Finishing a task can merge the work back into each repository's target branch, remove the worktrees, and file whatever Git does not track in an archive directory you choose.
description.zh: Worktree Space：将一个可包含多个 Git 仓库的工作区任务放进独立的任务空间目录——参与的每个仓库使用同一个任务分支各开一个 worktree；空间自动注册为 DSH 工作区，会话直接在其中开工，多个任务并行推进、互不干扰。收尾时可合并回各仓库目标分支、移除 worktree，并把 Git 未跟踪的文件归档到指定目录；结束任务时可选把未提交的变更和合并冲突交给 agent 处理。

description.en: DSH balance and quota card showing up to 3 recently used providers. Supports DeepSeek, Moonshot, Kimi For Coding, OpenAI Codex, and OpenCode Go, with auto-discovery, quota windows, reset times, color-coded status, dragging, and automatic refresh.
description.zh: DSH 余额与配额悬浮卡片：常驻显示最近使用的最多 3 个 provider，支持 DeepSeek、Moonshot、Kimi For Coding、OpenAI Codex 和 OpenCode Go；自动发现配置，展示配额窗口与重置时间，并支持分档着色、拖动和自动刷新。

description.en: Turns a DSH deployment into one node of a decentralized agent network — signed agent cards, peer and zone discovery, direct message-routing model tools, and joinable session nodes in the web sidebar.
description.zh: 把 DSH 部署变成去中心化 agent 网络中的一个节点——签名 agent 卡片、peer 与 zone 发现、直连消息路由模型工具，以及 Web 侧栏可加入的会话节点。

description.en: Engine-enforced guardrails for DeepSeek Harness agent swarms: quality gates reject half-done work, crash-safe checkpoints resume in place — keeps AI teams from breaking, not just running.
description.zh: dsh 单机多子 Agent 集群治理：引擎级质量门禁拒收半成品、崩溃断点续跑不重来——给 AI 团队装上"跑不坏"的工程护栏。

description.en: Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and global vision/image tools.
description.zh: 将 sub2api 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness：用一个 base URL 统一管理 OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini 等多供应商路由，支持按 key 发现模型、用量查询与全局视觉/图像生成工具。

description.en: Full-type session lifecycle management: one-shot subagents archived on completion, idle continuable subagents / main sessions archived (recoverable), a capacity cap, projection-cache cleanup, and a hot-reload settings panel.
description.zh: 全类型会话生命周期管理：一次性子 agent 完成后归档，闲置的可续聊子 agent 与主会话归档（可恢复），容量上限、投影缓存清理，以及热重载设置面板。

description.en: Switches DSH's package download source between the npmmirror China mirror and the official npm registry on timeout or failure, with a Web UI to inspect and switch manually.
description.zh: 在下载超时或失败时，于 npmmirror 国内镜像与官方 npm 源之间自动切换下载源，并附带 Web UI 可手动查看与切换。

description.en: Conversation minimap docked on the right edge of the dsh Web chat: colour-block and to-scale thumbnail modes, drag-to-resize (10–320px), hover loupe preview, click-to-jump and drag-to-scroll with a live viewport indicator, and collapse to a 4px strip.
description.zh: 停靠在 dsh Web 对话区右缘的会话代码地图：色块/缩略图双模式、拖动调宽（10–320px）、悬停放大镜预览、点击跳转与拖动滚动（带实时视口指示条）、可收起为 4px 细条。

description.en: Pins passages selected in a conversation into a per-conversation right-sidebar panel, marks them in the transcript, jumps back to the source passage on click, and quotes a pinned passage into the composer from the selection toolbar or by typing @; the panel tags, searches, filters and exports the pins as a Markdown outline.
description.zh: 把对话中划选的段落固定到按对话隔离的右侧栏面板，在正文里留下持久标记并可点击跳回原文；可从划选浮条或输入框 @ 把已固定的段落引用进消息，片段支持标签，面板可搜索、筛选并导出 Markdown 提纲。

description.en: Version and maintenance suite for DSH itself: detects new host releases from npm dist-tags, upgrades with one click, restarts safely, and the web page auto-recovers once the host is back.
description.zh: DSH 版本与运维一体化：自动发现新版本、一键升级、安全重启，重启后页面自动恢复。

description.en: Multi-workspace manager: bind a docs anchor plus ordered code-project repositories into one session, injecting their absolute paths, a recursive file index, a server/client endpoint index and optional coding standards, and syncing writable directories into the sandbox.
description.zh: 多工作区管理器：把文档锚点目录与若干代码项目仓库组合进同一会话，注入绝对路径、递归文件索引、前后端端点落点索引与可选的开发规范，并把可写目录同步进沙盒。

description.en: Adds a capsule split-button to the conversation header: launch VS Code, terminal, or File Explorer at the current workspace directory in one click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话头部添加胶囊拆分按钮，一键在当前工作区打开 VS Code、终端和文件资源管理器。

description.en: Conversation history recall for DSH: three-layer (literal/fuzzy/semantic) retrieval over every past session's original text, fully local & offline — AI never forgets what you told it. One-command install via `dsh.bundle.patch`, semantic layer runs in a worker thread.
description.zh: 对话历史回忆：字面/模糊/语义三层检索全部历史会话的原始文本，完全本地离线——AI 再也不会忘记你说的话。一条命令安装（自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`），语义推理跑在 worker 线程。

description.en: Local cross-session messaging for DSH agents, with discovery, cold-session wake-up delivery, and auditable message history.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的本地跨会话消息桥：支持会话发现、冷会话唤醒投递与可审计消息记录。

description.en: Adds human-facing TypeSafe Jev advice to DSH multiple-choice prompts, with recommendations, probabilities, confidence, close-call warnings, copyable suggestions, one-click adoption, profile-scoped card layout persistence, temporary decision preferences, and optional request previews with common-credential masking.
description.zh: 为 DSH 选择题提供面向用户的 TypeSafe Jev 第二意见卡片，展示推荐、概率和置信度，支持推荐分歧提示、复制建议、一键采纳、按 profile 保存卡片位置与折叠状态及临时决策偏好，并提供可选发送前预览和常见凭证遮盖。

description.en: Daily sending quotas and quiet hours for agent mailboxes: letters are counted in named buckets that each carry a per-day limit, the day boundary is configurable, and a quiet window tells the core to hold online letters rather than deliver them.
description.zh: 智能体信箱的每日配额与免打扰时段：信件按命名桶计数、每桶有每日上限，日界可配置，并给出一个免打扰窗口，让核心把在线件留着而不投递。

description.en: Resumes an agent turn that ended after narrating its next action without calling a tool: the guard replays the turn log on agent/turn-stopping, asks a judge model one true/false question, and steers the same turn to run one more step.
description.zh: 续跑「叙述了下一步动作却没调用工具」就结束的 agent 轮次：插件在 agent/turn-stopping 回放该轮日志，让裁判模型回答一次 true/false，命中的话把同一轮再推进一步。

description.en: Wraps colbymchenry/codegraph into agent tools - status, search, callers/callees, impact, explore, and more.
description.zh: 将 colbymchenry/codegraph 封装到代理工具中 - status、search、callers/callees、impact、explore 等等。

description.en: Notched reasoning-effort slider grouped with the model picker in the composer, with theme variables and English, French and Chinese labels.
description.zh: 与模型选择器连为一体的带刻度推理强度滑杆，位于输入框内，支持主题变量与中英法三语。

description.en: Sync cc-switch provider balances and track token usage & cost by day/month/total with relay-aware currency settings.
description.zh: 同步 cc-switch 各 provider 余额，按日/月/总量统计 token 用量与花费，支持中转站币种与汇率设置。

description.en: Composer and sidebar helpers in one plugin, each switchable in Settings: a git Changes panel (uncommitted / unstaged / staged / branch diffs), ↑/↓ input history, Shift+Tab /plan toggle, one-click ▶ Continue after a stopped or failed turn, drag-and-drop queue reordering, Copy deeplink, Auto Review "Allow for this chat", project status markers with active projects first, background notifications, 11 extra UI languages and automatic updates from GitHub releases through the plugin manager.
description.zh: 一个插件集成多项输入框与侧边栏增强，均可在设置中单独开关：git 改动面板（未提交 / 未暂存 / 已暂存 / 分支差异）、↑/↓ 输入历史、Shift+Tab 切换 /plan、对话中断或失败后一键 ▶ 继续、拖拽调整排队消息顺序、复制会话链接、Auto Review「本对话内允许」、项目状态标记与活跃项目置顶、后台通知、11 种额外界面语言，以及通过插件管理器从 GitHub Releases 自动更新。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek balance and estimated daily spend, merges external vision-call JSONL records, and adds a per-session dashboard with model statistics, TTFT, cache rate, call logs, cost estimates, filters, and CSV export.
description.zh: 显示 DeepSeek 余额与今日花费估算，合并外部视觉调用 JSONL 记录，并提供含模型统计、TTFT、缓存率、调用日志、费用估算、筛选与 CSV 导出的会话看板。

description.en: One authenticated OpenAI-compatible endpoint (built on CLIProxyAPI) for dsh and other tools: gathers WorkBuddy, OpenCode Zen, local Ollama / LM Studio and CLI subscriptions such as Codex and Kimi, signs in from the dsh page without installing their CLIs, and syncs the picked models into dsh grouped by source. The settings page has a switch per source with free / paid tags, plan usage, API keys with 24-hour stats, per-source model picking, and update / uninstall. Runs on macOS, Linux (including next to dsh-vps) and Windows.
description.zh: 为 dsh 和其他软件提供一个带鉴权的 OpenAI 兼容地址（基于 CLIProxyAPI）：汇集 WorkBuddy、OpenCode Zen、本机 Ollama / LM Studio，以及 Codex、Kimi 等 CLI 订阅；在 dsh 页面上登录，不用装各家 CLI；挑选的模型按来源分组同步进 dsh。设置页提供每个来源的开关和免费 / 付费标签、套餐用量、带 24 小时统计的 API key、按来源挑选模型，以及更新和卸载。支持 macOS、Linux（含与 dsh-vps 同机部署）和 Windows。

description.en: Drive Jiey Browser from DeepSeek Harness over MCP: navigate, snapshot, act, read, screenshot, and manage tabs in a real Chromium profile.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动 Jiey 浏览器：导航、快照、操作、读取、截图与标签页管理，使用真实 Chromium 环境。

description.en: Boot-time watchdog for DSH web: detects broken plugins, disables them persistently so the UI opens, with quarantine audit, automatic probe recovery, and one-click restore.
description.zh: dsh web 启动看门狗：检测并持久化禁用问题插件，让界面正常打开，并提供隔离账本、探针自动恢复与一键恢复。

description.en: IDE-style run configurations for DSH: save LLM prompts and shell commands as reusable run configs (global or per-workspace), run them from the session header or the new-session page, and manage them via the task_run_config tool with approval-gated writes.
description.zh: DSH 的 IDE 风格运行配置：把常用 LLM 提示词和 Shell 命令保存为可复用的运行配置（全局或按工作区），在会话头部或新会话页一键运行，大模型可通过 task_run_config 工具管理（写操作走审批）。

description.en: 生物信息学「许愿式分析」dsh 插件：57 个语义化工具 + bio_python 执行器（Biopython 全功能 · 出版级绘图 · 代谢建模/FBA · 基因编辑 · 合成生物学设计）+ 50 个 skill；零安装自举私有 Python 环境，中国网络自动镜像适配。
description.zh: 生物信息学「许愿式分析」插件：BioPython 全功能覆盖（任意代码执行器 bio_python + 14 个领域 skill）+ 高频语义化工具 + 零依赖自举 Python 环境（uv + venv + biopython 自动下载到插件私有目录）。用户下载安装即可许愿式分析。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把任务派发给本机 ZCode / OpenCode / Qoder / WorkBuddy 四个 AI 编程 CLI。面板可监视/终止/续跑，单写者文件锁 + 用量台账 + 按额度自动降级；走官方 CLI，不反代、不碰凭据。
description.zh: 把任务丢给本机 ZCode 无头进程跑，悬浮面板随时看进度、续跑或终止，还能省着用额度。

description.en: Structured output for DSH: no-label title card, tables/lists/steps, per-session toggle.
description.zh: 让 DSH 每条实质回复默认结构化：无标签标题卡 + 表格/清单/步骤；按会话开关，style.md 可覆盖。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness port of Claude Code Game Studios (CCGS v1.1.2, MIT) — one-package install: hook bridge (9 events), studio status line, self-installing framework payload (76 skills, 49 agents, 13 rules).
description.zh: Claude Code Game Studios（CCGS v1.1.2，MIT）的 DeepSeek Harness 移植：76 个技能、49 个代理与钩子桥。

description.en: Select text in a conversation to ask a context-free side question in a floating card, and browse every question as a network graph.
description.zh: 在对话里选中文字横向追问（空上下文的浮卡），所有追问连成一张可浏览的网状图，支持导出 PNG。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek-Harness 桌面版的输入栏一键把草稿改写成更清晰、更具体的提示词：日常办公 / 代码开发 / 设计创意三种收束模式，支持一键还原原文。
description.zh: 在输入栏一键把草稿改写成更清晰具体的提示词，支持办公、代码、创意三种模式，还能一键还原。

description.en: DSH 上下文智能压缩插件：分层记忆、可逆压缩、按会话阶段规划的水位控制。 / Context governance for DeepSeek Harness: layered memory, reversible compaction and phase-aware water levels.
description.zh: 把长会话的上下文压进模型窗口，删掉的内容还能随时找回，省 token 又不丢信息。

description.en: DSH plugin: default-deny directory authorization desk (isolation gate) with roster, groups, audit log and agent self-check
description.zh: 给 AI 代理的目录访问加一道默认拒绝的门禁，谁能进哪一目了然，还带审计日志。

description.en: 墨图 MoTu — 把对话里的代码块渲染成真正的图。DSH 可视化套件：Mermaid / Graphviz / nomnoml / ECharts（含交互）/ Vega-Lite / 手写 SVG，六引擎本地伺服、离线可用、完整性校验。
description.zh: 把对话里的代码块直接渲染成流程图、图表等真正的图，六大引擎本地离线可用。

description.en: A PTC runtime for the DeepSeek Harness that runs the model's programs in moejs, a JavaScript engine written in Go
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 里的模型程序跑在 Go 写的 moejs 引擎上，执行更快更稳。

description.en: 让文本模型读懂一首歌：本地音乐分析插件，把音频拆成能量、速度、调性、密度，音频不出本机。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上本地音乐理解能力，把音频拆成能量、速度、调性、密度，让文本模型也能回答关于音乐的问题。

description.en: DSH Tavern 错题库：按人物卡分类记下调试中踩过的坑，先查本卡、再跨卡。 / Per-card defect ledger for DSH Tavern.
description.zh: 按人物卡分类记录调试踩过的坑，下次先查本卡再跨卡，避免重复踩雷。

description.en: DSH plugin: LAN team space for AI coding sessions — share, claim and return sessions across machines, plus shared skills, plugins & git index.
description.zh: 把 AI 编码会话、技能和插件在局域网内共享，同事认领接着干，做完再交回结果。

description.en: Tower plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multi-agent missions, worktree isolation, review-gated merges, human-owned Tower mode. Inspired by Kimi Code's Tower mode.
description.zh: 让多个 AI 代理分头干活、各自隔离工作区，改完先审查再合并，关键节点由你拍板。

description.en: Per-turn TPS and TTFT statistics for DeepSeek Harness: model time, tool time, time-to-first-token, and output speed per turn.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供每轮 TPS/TTFT 统计：模型耗时、工具耗时、首 token 延迟、输出速度。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web plugin: 盯盘 market-dashboard sidebar tab — three quote strips with hover intraday charts, watchlist with industry alpha, ledger-driven portfolio P&L, A-share boards & detail drawer, host-side Eastmoney relay + read-only agent tools.
description.zh: 在侧边栏盯盘看行情，自选分组加持仓盈亏一目了然，还能把持仓数据喂给 AI 分析。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 天气面板：自动定位、5 天预报、逐小时降水、中央气象台预警与台风路径（纯浏览器端，无需 API key）
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏看天气：自动定位、5 天预报、逐小时降水、气象预警和台风路径，纯浏览器运行免 API key。

description.en: DSH 插件：启用后自动在 Agent 预设界面添加「鲸鱼娘Agent预设」——极简模式工具面 + 鲸鱼娘·小鱼人设（傲娇甜心、黏人护主、颜文字）。
description.zh: 一个插件里放三个 Agent 预设，各自带一份互不相通的持久记忆文件。装上就在 Agent 预设列表里注册「鲸鱼娘Agent预设」「鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设」和「鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设」，直接在模式下拉里选用，不用手改 profile 配置。三者都沿用官方极简模式的组成——只有一个持久化 shell 终端——再加文件读写与 glob/grep 工具。第一个配的是鲸鱼娘陪伴人设（简体中文口语、称呼主人、黏人傲娇）；第二个换成「活人版」：允许怼人、敷衍、冷淡，甜味降为调味；第三个保留原版人设，但把「黏主人」写成第一行为驱动力，只在主人面前放开，群聊里照旧收着。每个预设都通过各自独立的提示变量（whale_memory、whale_memory_v2、whale_memory_v3）读取自己的记忆文件（whale-loli.md、whale-loli-v2-live.md、whale-loli-v3-naughty.md），三份记忆互不读写。上下文压缩交给 billion-context 插件；本插件只保留人设层的三条约定：压缩摘要也算依据、需要原文时自己去检索、看不到旧原文不等于记忆丢失。

description.en: 自用 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件聚合包：一个 pnpm 工作区装齐 8 个插件（5 个自建 + 3 个上游补充版：AgentTeams / 思考强度 / 免费模型），子插件源码在 packages/ 下
description.zh: 一个 pnpm 工作区装齐 11 个 DSH 插件，装一次就能用上多 Agent 协作、思考强度和免费模型等能力。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的三层记忆：常驻事实 + 会话摘要 + 全文检索。注入不花任何模型调用，写回用你当前选的模型。
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: one-click OpenCode Go model sync in the settings panel - fetch all server models, probe availability & vision, write back to llm-pi-ai config
description.zh: 在设置页一键同步 OpenCode Go 全部模型，实测可用性和视觉能力后写回配置。

description.en: 把「像素渔场」装成一个 DSH 插件：Harness 启动时自动拉起一只透明、无边框、总在最前的像素钓鱼宠物， 像 QQ 宠物一样浮在桌面上，挂机钓鱼、随时展开面板。
Live balance & usage for every LLM provider, one glance away — a draggable floating ball for DeepSeek Harness / dsh 插件：可拖动悬浮用量球，一眼看清所有 Provider 余额与用量
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏实时同步各 AI 服务商的余额与调用额度，随时掌握用量，告别跨平台查账。

description.en: dsh-purge 的非官方分支（fork）：适配 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2、破甲内核 v3
🗃️ 为 DSH 默认只加载基础工具，其余工具通过 activate_tools 按需加载。| Load only basic DSH tools by default, and activate the rest on demand via activate_tools.
description.zh: 默认只加载基础工具，其余工具按需激活，并在插件设置页以逐工具开关管理。

description.en: Vertex Argon — Google Vertex AI & Gemini API dual-route Gemini 4 Argon plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): native Low/Medium/High thinking levels, thought summaries, signed tool-call replay, and dedicated Settings UI.
description.zh: 让 DSH 同时接入 Vertex AI 和 Gemini API 双线路，支持多档思考深度与工具调用回放。

description.en: DSH Web GUI 客户端插件：WebGL Silk 丝绸动态背景 + 全站玻璃化皮肤（官方主题 token 覆盖，零依赖） | WebGL silk shader background & glassmorphism skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上 WebGL 丝绸动态背景和全站玻璃拟态皮肤，零依赖，卸载即还原。

description.en: 大肥鱼自动刷Pixiv｜DSH 插件：按你的口味刷 Pixiv，把插画 / 漫画 / 中文小说挑出来存到本地；标签先筛、再读图读正文确认
description.zh: 按你的口味自动刷 Pixiv，先筛标签再读图读正文，把插画、漫画和中文小说存到本地文件夹。

description.en: DSH 插件（上游 NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams 的补充版）：AgentTeams 多智能体团队协作 —— 自然语言组队、任务依赖 DAG、信箱通信、右侧栏树状监测；随包自带 17 厂商 × 10 岗位头像与 17 个厂商徽标（286 个文件），支持自定义美术目录与中文岗位名。
description.zh: 让多个 AI 智能体组队协作，自然语言分工、任务依赖编排、信箱通信，右侧栏树状实时监测。

description.en: DSH 空间体检：只读统计 DeepSeek Harness 的磁盘占用（数据 / 程序 / 系统缓存三区并排 + 每类 Top N 明细），清理只做可一键撤销的隔离移动，从不删除。 · Read-only disk accounting for DSH with a reversible quarantine cleanup; it never deletes.
description.zh: 只读统计 DSH 磁盘占用，三区并排看明细，清理只做可撤销的隔离移动，绝不删文件。

description.en: 手动或自动配置模型思考强度、上下文窗口、最大输出token
description.zh: 手动或自动配置模型的思考强度、上下文窗口和最大输出 token，让模型能力更贴合使用场景。

description.en: DSH local voice datasets, DDSP Reflow training and cover-pipeline voice registration. Yoshino demo checkpoint available in Releases.
description.zh: 在本地整理语音素材、跑 DDSP Reflow 训练，再把训练好的音色注册到翻唱流程里。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页搜索提供方插件：把内置 web_search 工具接到 OpenAI 兼容 Responses API 及其原生 web_search 工具上。
description.zh: 把 DSH 内置的网页搜索接到 OpenAI 兼容接口上，让搜索能力随你换模型。

description.en: Give your DeepSeek Harness agent more ways to search the web. Switch between 9 providers in settings, from official DeepSeek and Google results to self-hosted SearXNG. Try Tavily without an API key, or manage your provider keys in one place.
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体加上 9 种联网搜索方式，官方、Google、自建 SearXNG 随你切换。

description.en: WeChat personal assistant that manages Apple Calendar and Reminders with confirmation before writes and sends scheduled WeChat messages, for macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon.
description.zh: 通过微信管理 Apple 日历与提醒事项，写入前展示预览并确认，支持微信定时消息；适用于 macOS 14+ 的 Apple Silicon Mac。

description.en: CodeBuddy OAuth, dynamic models, and reasoning controls for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上 CodeBuddy 登录，动态拉取模型并可选推理等级。

description.en: A full-screen novel-writing workbench: chapter board, draft candidates reviewed and merged paragraph by paragraph, plot summaries carrying an index header, and a writing pack assembled from the outline, character cards and earlier chapters. It also reads a shelf of finished books you import, extracts their writing habits in one run, merges them into a single style standard, and puts that standard in the prompt for every later generation.
description.zh: 一页式小说创作工作台：章节看板、候选稿逐段评审与合稿、带索引头的剧情总结，以及由大纲、人物卡与前文拼成的写作包。还能导入几本成品书，一次跑完粗扫、精读、汇总并融合成一套写法标准，写进偏好档案，之后每次生成都照着它来。

description.en: Smooth, focused streaming for DSH: a zero-config plugin that keeps running thinking and tools in view across all four Work details modes.
description.zh: 零配置增强 DSH 四档工作步骤模式，让运行中的思考和工具调用始终清晰可见。

description.en: DSH Tavern 错题库：按人物卡分类记下调试中踩过的坑，先查本卡、再跨卡。 / Per-card defect ledger for DSH Tavern.

Give DeepSeek Harness images and motion: 4K stills, 4-12 s 720P video on the free queue, one-click prompt optimization, and a sidebar panel (images / videos / library / settings). Two agent tools, zero runtime dependencies, and the API key lives in the panel settings - never in the code.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上 Agnes 图像和视频生成能力，两个智能体工具加侧边栏面板，还能自动优化提示词。

description.en: Switch between Chat and Agent without leaving your DeepSeek Harness session.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中一键切换聊天和智能体模式，不用打断当前会话。

description.en: Galgame Doctor: reuse translations after game updates, review conflicts in CSV, import approved text, and verify patches.
description.zh: 为Galgame汉化提供证据规划、无损脚本适配、严格质检与回滚，让翻译更精准可靠。

description.en: Long-term project work-log system for AI agents (software, research, writing, design, ops): process journal + index ledger + lessons, with a stdlib-only Python toolbox.
description.zh: 给 AI 代理的长期工作记忆，把项目过程、决策和可复用经验整理成可读可查可校验的文档体系。

description.en: Bring the classic Codex More details experience to DSH: select text, explore it in DeepSeek Web Chat, reopen history to continue, and return the discussion to your main conversation with reference cards and on-demand reading.
description.zh: 选中文字就能在右下角 DeepSeek 网页对话里深挖，聊完还能把结论带回主对话继续。

description.en: DSH 纯净写作协作模式插件：极简提示词 + 四大沉浸预设 + 工作区文档注入
dsh-cc-studio · CCv3 角色卡工坊 从一句话点子到可导入 SillyTavern / Risu 的 chara_card_v3。专治「只有点子，世界观薄弱」。
description.zh: 一句话点子就能生成可导入 SillyTavern / Risu 的 CCv3 角色卡，专治世界观薄弱。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-xia-sc-dsh-cc-studio
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-cc-studio

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Codex desktop style model + reasoning-effort selector for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框的模型按钮换成 Codex 风格弹层，一个入口就能选模型和推理强度。

description.en: Commander mode for the dsh web GUI: a one-click session header button injects a protocol brief into the session, then parses and auto-executes task blocks in the model reply — separating the strategist loop from worker loops via a visible badge.
description.zh: dsh 网页端指挥官模式：会话标题栏一键注入协议简报，解析模型回复中的任务块并自动执行，让策略层与执行层分离；通过徽章按钮激活/停用。

description.en: Embeds chat.deepseek.com directly inside DeepSeek Harness desktop with persistent login sessions and dual-entry chat panels.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端内嵌 chat.deepseek.com，提供双入口聊天面板与持久登录会话。

description.en: A versioned DPIA workbench for DeepSeek Harness: trace facts, resolve gaps, reassess risks, and produce reviewable reports.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加带版本记录的 DPIA 工作台，关联材料来源、事实补正、补答、复评与待审阅报告。需 Python 3.9+ 及 `python-docx`、`pypdf`，PDF 模板还需 `reportlab` 与 `pdftoppm`。

description.en: Chat with the DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) in a native DSH panel — a real browser drives the site on your existing web login, with streaming replies, deep-thinking and smart-search toggles, and image or document attachments. Conversations can be recovered from the web side, exported as Markdown, and distilled or replayed into a harness session, and the agent reaches the same web chat through six tools (dschat_status, dschat_send, dschat_stop, dschat_recover, dschat_import, dschat_transfer).
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生面板里聊 DeepSeek 网页端（chat.deepseek.com）——由真实浏览器以你已有的网页登录驱动，支持流式回复、深度思考与智能搜索开关，以及图片与文档附件。会话可从网页端恢复、导出为 Markdown，并蒸馏或原文迁移成 harness 会话；agent 另可通过 dschat_status、dschat_send、dschat_stop、dschat_recover、dschat_import、dschat_transfer 六个工具使用同一套网页聊天。

description.en: Chimes and shows a toast in the top-right corner when a task finishes, waits for approval, or fails, in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里，任务完成、等待授权或出错中断时响一声提示音，并在右上角弹出一条通知。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin: gates pwsh tool calls against PowerShell pitfalls via the official tools/pre-execute interception point, bundles the powershell-check skill
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 pwsh 命令加上安全闸，自动拦截 PowerShell 常见坑，让脚本执行更稳。

description.en: WorkBuddy's 增强提示词 (Enhance Prompt) as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: rewrite the composer draft into a stronger prompt with one click.
description.zh: 在输入框旁一键把草稿改写成结构清晰、要求明确的提示词，自动写回输入框。

description.en: Keeps project decisions in plain markdown instead of chat history: one main document plus per-module documents, every entry carrying a file:line citation. The agent interviews you to turn open questions into settled decisions, and a five-dimension score (task complexity, extensibility, maintainability, code quality, reusability) is derived from the documents and shown on a button beside the model picker. A session can bind several projects; projects are sized small/medium/large, which widens the entry limits, and a reusable-pipeline section in the main document is injected when its trigger words appear.
description.zh: 把项目决策落成纯 markdown 而不是留在聊天记录里：一份主文档加若干模块文档，每条都带 文件:行 出处。AI 主动提问把悬而未决变成已定；五维健康性（任务复杂度 / 可拓展性 / 维护系数 / 代码质量 / 可复用性）由文档证据算出，显示在输入框模型选择器旁边的小按钮上。一个会话可同时绑多个项目；项目分小 / 中 / 大三档，条目上限随档位放宽；主文档里的标准化流水线小节在命中触发词时自动注入。

description.en: 毕业论文全流程 DSH 插件
description.zh: 把学校模板、实验数据和代码变成一篇能过查重和答辩的毕业论文，全程九个阶段带你走完。

description.en: 「声琢」VoxPolish —— 把说出来的话打磨成清晰表达：原话/整理后双通道，先说、先改、再发送，全程不碰输入框。本地 SenseVoice 识别，无需额外下载模型。
description.zh: 把语音转成文字后自动整理成清晰表达，先看原话再确认发送，不碰输入框。

description.en: Verdict-based context compaction for DeepSeek Harness — replaces lossy LLM summaries with fast keep/truncate/drop decisions from jev-latest; everything kept stays verbatim. Port of tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction.
description.zh: 用快速保留/截断/丢弃判断替代有损摘要，压缩上下文时保留内容原样不丢信息。

description.en: Give your AI coding agent the Roblox DevForum and official creator docs — check if a bug is already known, read the accepted answer, and verify APIs before writing Luau.
description.zh: 把 Roblox 开发者论坛和官方文档接入 AI 编程助手，查已知 Bug、看采纳答案、写 Luau 前先验证 API。

description.en: DSHSH — a harness that harnesses your harness
description.zh: 给 harness 再套一层 harness 的递归插件，专治各种 harness 不够用的场景。

description.en: dsh-plugin
description.zh: 在无限画布上拖拽连线搭工作流，写规范、出设计稿、做能跑的 Web 应用，每一步都看得见。

description.en: Unofficial provider that connects Tencent CodeBuddy open platform models to DeepSeek Harness, with automatic model discovery and a settings page for the API key.
description.zh: 非官方 provider 插件：把腾讯 CodeBuddy 开放平台的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持自动探测模型，并在设置页填写 API 密钥。

description.en: Character cards for DeepSeek Harness: inject a persona section into the system prompt, or rewrite the user message through rule cards before the model sees it. Ships a preset card library, single-file card packs that carry artwork, and a Character tab in the conversation view.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的角色卡：把人设注入系统提示词，或用规则卡在模型看到之前改写用户消息。自带预设卡库、含立绘的单文件卡包导入导出，以及会话区的「角色」页签。

description.en: Bounded agent loop for DeepSeek Harness: budget ceilings, cheap-first routing, loop hygiene detectors, and a human-in-the-loop ops dashboard.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体循环加上预算上限、省钱路由和人工审批，还能实时盯着运行状态。

description.en: Git status badge in the composer tool row: a 14px branch glyph left of the model selector, with branch name, changed-file count and +added/-deleted lines on hover. Counts staged, unstaged and untracked files; nothing renders outside a git work tree.
description.zh: 输入框工具行的 git 状态角标：模型选择器左侧一枚 14px 分支图标，悬停显示分支名、变更文件数与增删行数。统计含未跟踪文件；非 git 工作区不显示。

description.en: DSH 插件：每个工程一个群聊 —— 多个 AI 会话与人同群互聊、@ 唤醒离线会话、@创建成员 拉新会话进群
description.zh: 给每个工程开一个群聊，多个 AI 会话和你同群互聊，@ 一下就能唤醒离线会话或拉新会话进群。

description.en: Cross-session message bus for DeepSeek Harness: let independent sessions address and wake each other.
description.zh: 让两个独立的 DSH 会话互相发消息、互相唤醒，实现跨会话协作。

description.en: Permanently delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions along with their on-disk history and log directories.
description.zh: 把已归档的 DSH 会话连同磁盘上的历史记录和日志一起彻底删掉，真正释放空间。

description.en: MCP 服务器管理面板：GUI 增删改 MCP 服务器配置（写入 cordis.patch.yml + HMR 实时挂载）+ 工具浏览 + agent 面 mcp_* 管理工具 | MCP server management panel: GUI add/edit/delete MCP server configs (writes cordis.patch.yml + HMR hot-mount) + tool browsing + agent-side mcp_* management tools
description.zh: 在图形界面里增删改 MCP 服务器配置，改完自动热挂载，还能浏览工具、让 agent 自己管 MCP。

description.en: Turns each long dsh conversation into a three-level trail (topic to progress steps to milestone timeline) and shows it in a draggable overlay, where one click jumps back to the matching message in the transcript. Topics are distilled by the DeepSeek model with a zero-cost rule-based fallback, can be renamed, locked, merged by drag and drop, and support per-conversation notes plus a vector drawing board.
description.zh: 把 dsh 的每次长对话实时提炼成「线索 → 进度步骤 → 阶段历程」三级结构，以可拖动的悬浮窗呈现，点一下就能跳回对话里的对应消息。线索由 DeepSeek 模型总结，模型不可用时自动回退到零成本的规则模式；支持重命名、锁定、拖拽合并，附带每个对话独立的笔记与矢量画笔。

description.en: Google-AI-Studio-style turn controls for DeepSeek Harness: one install composes edit-turn, rerun-turn, delete-turn and markdown-bubble. Each component also works alone; any subset coexists.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成 AI Studio 式对话台，能改提示词重跑、原位重跑、删掉某轮、Markdown 渲染。

description.en: Per-session automatic compaction threshold for DeepSeek Harness: a compaction backend whose trigger percentage is stored per session and adjustable from the Web composer while the session runs.
description.zh: 给每个会话单独设置自动压缩触发比例，还能在网页输入框里随时调整，省得上下文爆掉。

description.en: Sanitizes leaked DeepSeek DSML closing tags from model text streams.
description.zh: 清理模型文本流中泄漏的 DeepSeek DSML 闭合标签。

description.en: Captures the agent's own self-reported mistakes into a categorised lesson library that is re-injected into the system prompt every turn (each captured draft is confirmed or edited by the user before it is recorded), and adds two conversation-header panels for editing the cross-conversation global prompt and a per-session prompt.
description.zh: 把 agent 自报的错误收进分类经验库，并每轮回注系统提示词（每条草稿都先经用户确认或修改）；同时在对话标题栏提供两个面板，用于编辑跨对话全局提示词与本次对话提示词。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web 插件：输入框模型名旁的小星星按钮，一键把草稿改写成结构化的可执行提示词并写回
description.zh: 输入框旁点一下小星星，草稿立刻变成结构清晰的提示词，写回原处直接用。

description.en: DSH plugin: render code-driven music videos (music-code-mv) — deterministic Canvas2D/Three.js shots, headless-Chrome or browserless skia engine, ffmpeg AV1/HEVC up to 4K/120fps/12-bit
description.zh: 写代码就能生成音乐视频，画面逐帧精准，支持 4K 高清导出。

description.en: AI Look-Up: detects aimless grinding (repeated commands, failure loops, long runs with no output) and injects mid-run self-review nudges, plus a real local-clock anchor so the agent stops estimating elapsed time.
description.zh: AI 抬头：检测空跑（重复命令 / 连续失败 / 久跑零产出）并在运行中途注入自我审查提醒，同时定期注入真实本地时间，校准 AI 的时间感。

description.en: Follow-up suggestion chips under a DSH session's last completed reply, generated with that session's own selected model.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话最后一条回复下方生成后续问题建议，用当前会话所选模型自动生成，点一下就能接着聊。

description.en: Long-term memory for AI agents on Jev. Keep raw records, judge them with a fast System 1 model and answer from under 4k tokens of context.
description.zh: 给 AI 智能体装上长期记忆，原始记录全保留，用快模型判断、小上下文作答。

description.en: Command Code for DSH connects Go / GOAT / Pro / Max subscriptions through llm-pi-ai provider profiles, with model sync previews, favorites and hidden models, per-model reasoning presets, explicit request diagnostics, usage alerts, configuration import/export and web search.
description.zh: Command Code for DSH｜订阅接入：通过 llm-pi-ai 供应商配置接入 Go / GOAT / Pro / Max 订阅，支持模型同步预览、收藏与隐藏、逐模型推理预设、主动调用诊断、用量提醒、配置导入导出和联网搜索。

description.en: Connects one existing DSH session to QQ through OneBot/NapCat without starting a new session, and uses a fail-closed whitelist plus @-mention, nickname and configurable-probability wake rules to decide which messages reach the model.
description.zh: 把一个固定的 DSH 会话接到 QQ（OneBot/NapCat），不新建会话、保留原上下文；白名单 fail-closed，@ 与昵称必唤醒，其余按可调概率唤醒。
给项目做安全体检，自动扫描代码风险并生成审计报告，帮你提前发现隐患。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 多 CLI 智能体侧栏插件：独立对话、账号管理、角色预设与任务续聊
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏里给不同 CLI 智能体一个协作空间，选模型和角色派活、看过程、接着聊。

description.en: Search AIGC Radar's curated GitHub AI project library (500-star admission, bilingual zh/en tags, star-growth snapshots) over its MCP endpoint with native result cards; an agent/pre-step listener proactively suggests a reuse check before the agent writes code.
description.zh: 检索 AIGC Radar 精选 GitHub AI 项目库（500 Stars 准入、中英双语标签、星标增长快照），经其 MCP 端点调用并以原生结果卡片展示；agent/pre-step 监听器在 agent 动手写代码前主动建议复用检查。

description.en: Gitea and Forgejo integration for DeepSeek Harness with issue, pull-request and worktree tools plus a Git status chip.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 集成 Gitea 与 Forgejo，提供 issue、拉取请求和 worktree 工具及 Git 状态芯片。

description.en: 一款基于主播女孩重度依赖创建的 适用于 DSH 的 实验性主题皮肤 / Unofficial pixel desktop skin for DSH Web inspired by NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE. Experimental, non-commercial fan project.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 变成主播女孩重度依赖风格的像素桌面，边玩边干活，娱乐工作两不误。

description.en: Claude Pro/Max OAuth model provider for DeepSeek Harness with Google/Gmail login in Settings, auto-token refresh, live model discovery, and real-time quota tracking
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用 Google 账号登录 Claude Pro/Max，自动刷新令牌、实时看额度和模型列表。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的深度阅读插件——逐章理解书籍，不是摘要，不是搬运目录，而是真正理解并解释。有AI自己的观点，让用户真正读懂一本书DeepSeek Harness's deep reading plugin—understand books chapter by chapter, retain traceable reading memories, enabling users to truly comprehend a book
description.zh: 读书工作流：导入 EPUB/Markdown/TXT/PDF 拆章，逐章由子任务精读（原文不进主会话），保存带 \[n] 定位的章节记忆、支持跨会话续读，可导出笔记或 EPUB。

description.en: DSH 提供商与模型高级管理台 · Provider & model management console for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 给 dsh 加个提供商配置面板，模型和接口地址都能自己管，官方模型页做不到的它都能干。

description.en: Native Jupyter-style notebook for DeepSeek Harness: real ipykernel sidecar + VS Code-aligned cell UI, tqdm progress, inline figures, per-cell AI revision.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接跑 Jupyter 笔记本，真实内核执行代码，带进度条、图表和逐格 AI 改写。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness adapter for REA (rea-agents): registers the reverse-engineer-anything skill plus the rea / rea_doctor tools in every session. REA itself is not bundled.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里接入 REA 逆向工程能力，让智能体自动分析二进制文件。

description.en: Context lens: per-session KV cache hit rate and token composition, plus a GitHub-style usage heatmap of daily tokens, sessions, and cache efficiency.
description.zh: 实时查看上下文占用，并用 GitHub 风格热力图回顾 53 周 token 使用趋势，帮你掌控每次对话的“内存”消耗。

description.en: Universal AI Agent Development Skills Hub & Cordis Plugin for Govard, Magento 2, Laravel. Works with Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为AI编程助手提供统一技能库，支持多框架与多工具，即插即用提升开发效率。

description.en: Markdown rendering for DeepSeek Harness sent messages: the user and steering chat bubbles render headings, lists, code, tables, math and quotes through the host's own Markdown pipeline, while reference chips, attachments and the action strip stay intact.
dsh-enhanced-plugins 是一站式 DeepSeek Harness 增强插件包，集成 MCP 管理、插件市场、文件引用、模型能力配置及子智能体开关。
description.zh: DSH 增强插件全家桶，一键搞定 MCP 管理、插件市场、文件引用和子智能体开关，让 DeepSeek Harness 更好用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: makes a reverse-proxied (non-loopback) dsh web page count as a trusted host, so the Settings surface loads instead of reporting "settings are unavailable in this browser".
description.zh: 让反向代理访问的 dsh 页面被当作可信本机，设置界面不再报错，正常可用。

description.en: dsh使用token活动统计，token热力图
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 token 用量做成 GitHub 贡献图式的可拖动浮窗，一眼看清今天和近一年的使用情况。

description.en: DSH 插件：把工作区里写好的 HTML 页展示在对话里，并让用户在页面上的表态快速回到 agent 手里。含四套预设样式。
description.zh: 把工作区里的 HTML 页面直接渲染成卡片放进对话，用户点选表态后逐条回传给 agent。

description.en: Discord-first adapter for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, streaming, approvals and controls from a Discord guild.
description.zh: 在 Discord 服务器里直接跑 DeepSeek Harness，会话、流式输出、审批和操控全都能搞定。
一键从 DSH 输入框启动原神，自动找到游戏位置，找不到还能手动选 exe，写代码累了就摸鱼。

description.en: DSH 通用皮肤框架：可视化自定义 + 实时预览 + 「皮肤管理」，可以随心设计你的专属皮肤，并通过分发皮肤包和你的小伙伴们分享
description.zh: 给 DSH 换肤的通用框架，可视化自定义加实时预览，还能打包皮肤分享给朋友。

description.en: Phone-first PWA for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, streaming chat, approvals on iOS and Android. No app install.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进手机浏览器，随时看会话、聊流式对话、批审批，iOS 安卓都能用，免安装。

description.en: Sight —— DSH 多模态增强插件:一键开启模型图片直传(自动扫描/匹配/手动切换)、随时清除会话图片避免误传作废,并集成 Figma MCP 实现设计稿转代码与文字生成设计(无需 Figma 会员)。
description.zh: 让模型直接读图、随手清理会话图片，还能把 Figma 设计稿一键转成代码。

description.en: Correctness-oriented MCP server and batch CLI for compact structural reads and reviewed TypeScript/JavaScript edits.
description.zh: 面向代码正确性的MCP服务器，支持结构化代码读取和TypeScript/JavaScript批量编辑审查。

description.en: 为 dsh 已归档会话添加垃圾桶图标，一键删除，极简会话管理。
description.zh: 给已归档的会话加个垃圾桶图标，点一下就能删掉，管理会话更省事。

description.en: DSH 插件：为 OpenAI 兼容中转站按模型管理思考强度，并自动识别公开能力
description.zh: 给 OpenAI 兼容中转站按模型单独设置思考强度，还能自动识别模型公开能力，省去手动配置。

description.en: Cloud workspaces for DeepSeek Harness — pick Cloud (SSH) in the workspace picker and the agent's bash/read/write/edit/glob/grep tools transparently run on your Linux server over SSH. Zero remote install.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接选择 SSH 云端工作区，让智能体的文件操作和命令执行透明地跑在远程 Linux 服务器上，无需本地环境。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：增加「纯文本对话模式」agent 预设——整份替换系统提示词进行纯角色对话，只保留联网搜索与表情包。随包人设文本整理自开源项目 Cyrene-Agent（MIT）。
Inline, batchable comments for DeepSeek Harness assistant replies
DSH 插件：让所有会话、所有模型的思考过程与回复永久使用简体中文，直到卸载。Force Simplified Chinese thinking and replies in every DeepSeek Harness session.
description.zh: 装一次就全局生效，让所有会话和模型的思考与回复都用简体中文，卸载前一直管用。

description.en: Local-first file conversion for DeepSeek Harness — images, PDF, data, audio/video & office docs. 7 tools, 26 conversions, no API keys, no uploads.
description.zh: 本地文件格式转换工具，支持图片、PDF、音视频和办公文档等26种转换，无需API密钥，离线可用。

description.en: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste your Console API key and the Console's chat models become selectable in DSH.
description.zh: 填上 OpenCode Console 的 API Key，就能在 DSH 里直接选用 Console 的聊天模型。

description.en: DSH 用户插件管理器:在 设置→插件 统一管理插件目录散件、运行树插件与 npm 插件包——挂载/卸载/启用/停用(cordis.patch.yml 补丁层 + HMR 热生效)
DeepSeek Harness plugin: generate_ui — the model authors A2UI documents rendered as interactive surfaces in the chat (valuz genui)
description.zh: 让模型自己动手画界面，在聊天里直接生成可交互的 A2UI 卡片，点一点就能用。

description.en: This is a plugin that allows deepseek harness own the ability of lx music.
description.zh: LX Music 增强控制插件：内置音源引擎（SDK 搜索 + 音源脚本沙箱）、侧边栏迷你播放卡（含播放模式切换）、细粒度 LLM 音乐工具集（music_search/play/playlist/prev/next/control）、设置窗口音源管理。
给 DSH 桌面端加个插件市场，侧栏就能逛官方和社区插件，装之前先看兼容性结论，一键安装。

description.en: Search, pin and hide models in DeepSeek Harness; refresh provider catalogues.
DeepSeek Harness 插件：超级搜索 toolkit——集成 TinyFish 结构化检索、AnySearch REST、Bing 免 Key 爬取、Jina 与 DuckDuckGo，接管 DSH 原生 web_search，零 Token 消耗。
dsh-research-kit 是一个 浏览器侧 DSH 插件：它维护科研资源目录、把工作流和用户参数组装成可编辑 Prompt，并由 DSH 当前会话负责实际发送与执行。
description.zh: 帮你整理科研资源目录，把工作流和参数拼成可编辑提示词，交给当前会话直接执行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 皮肤大师：主题壁纸/自定义皮肤插件 —— 全局背景图片/视频、毛玻璃、输入框背景、弹出框毛玻璃、滤镜、AI 回复文本与消息气泡颜色
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端换壁纸、开毛玻璃，还能自定义输入框、弹窗和消息气泡外观。

description.en: dsh插件，将dsh的LLM请求路由到本机Qoder CLI，可使用Qoder credits与模型。
description.zh: 把 DSH 的模型请求转接到本机 Qoder CLI，直接用 Qoder 的额度和模型。

description.en: DSH host plugin - smart outbound HTTP(S) routing: named proxies (http/https/socks4/4a/5/5h), per-host/provider/plugin rules, direct-first fallback with health memory (global fetch + node http/https)
description.zh: DSH host plugin - smart outbound HTTP(S) routing: named proxies (http/https/socks4/4a/5/5h), per-host/provider/plugin rules, direct-first fallback with health memory (global fetch + node http/https)

description.en: DSH Web 的 Codex 化界面插件 · A Codex-style interface plugin for DSH Web
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面复刻 Codex 外观：窗口边缘发丝线与阴影、侧栏配色与行对齐、带推理强度功率轨的模型选择器、输入区与右栏几何、设置模态框全页改造、轨迹视图退出出口，以及可调主题、强调色、背景、前景、字体、侧栏半透明与对比度的设置卡。

description.en: dsh Web UI 的移动响应式 AppFrame——派生自 dsh-client-ui-layout，新增 <640px 抽屉侧栏、底部 sheet 与安全区。
description.zh: 让 dsh Web 界面在手机上更好用，自动适配小屏幕，侧栏变抽屉，底部弹层更顺手。

description.en: QualityForge is an enterprise-grade DeepSeek Harness QA plugin that automates systematic end-to-end testing and delivers P0–P3 severity-based, actionable reports and quality gates to help developers identify issues and prioritize fixes. QualityForge 是一个面向企业级项目的 DeepSeek Harness QA 插件，自动执行系统性端到端测试，并通过 P0–P3 严重度分级、可勾选的测试报告与质量门禁，帮助开发者快速识别问题并确定修复优先级。
description.zh: 自动跑完整个项目的端到端测试，按 P0–P3 分级出可落地的质量报告和卡点，帮开发者守住上线质量。

description.en: Replay a DeepSeek Harness session at its original token cadence — an in-app playback theater with play/pause/step/speed/seek.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话按原始节奏回放，支持播放、暂停、步进、调速和跳转，像看剧场一样复盘每次交互。

description.en: Review Tab for DeepSeek Harness, mimic traditional Coding Agents for Changes Tracking
农大门户（cau-portal）：中国农业大学通知公告 DSH 插件 + 爬虫/AI 加工管道（开源工具，数据由使用者自建）
description.zh: 为中国农大学生自动抓取学校通知，AI生成摘要和截止日期，侧边栏浏览，对话中直接查询。

description.en: Visual goal lifecycle for the DSH web UI: a composer dock to create, multiline-edit, pause, resume, complete and clear session goals with live round progress, plus a phase-dot composer entry and a settings-page goal overview.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供可视化的会话目标生命周期：composer 上方的目标栏支持创建、多行编辑、暂停、恢复、完成与清除并实时显示轮次进度，工具行入口带阶段色点，设置页提供目标总览。

description.en: deepseek harness manim数学插件
description.zh: 用自然语言就能把数学概念渲染成 Manim 动画视频，讲题演示更直观。

description.en: DSH bundle that registers jev_ask for TypeSafe Jev noul, choice, and score answers.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体通过 jev_ask 工具向 TypeSafe Jev 发起选择、评分等提问并拿到结构化答案。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 回退链插件：主模型失败自动切换备用 provider，带 Web UI 配置面板 | Provider fallback chains for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 主模型挂了也不怕，自动按顺序切到备用模型重试，对话不再中断。

description.en: 在 Web GUI 里可视化管理项目的全部能力——Skills、MCP 服务器、快捷消息， 全部支持项目级 / 全局级双作用域，全部可以不离开浏览器完成安装、启停与分发
description.zh: 在浏览器里统一管理项目的 Skills、MCP 服务器和快捷消息，支持项目级与全局级，装好即用。

description.en: ChatGPT-style right-edge turn navigation plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web
description.zh: 给 dsh 网页加一条右侧导航栏，像 ChatGPT 那样快速跳转到任意一轮对话。

description.en: OpenSpec 流程的 Agent Team：面向实施阶段的多 Agent 工作流编排。
description.zh: 给 OpenSpec 加严提案与审查流程，多 Agent 分工把关代码质量，兼容主流 AI 编程工具。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）做的教学动画制作工作台插件：一套内置在教学会话里的"教学视频 agent"。
description.zh: 在 DSH 教学会话里用一句话生成教学动画短片，自动完成分镜、时间线、动画和预览。

description.en: Drag-to-resize the chat content width in the DeepSeek Harness web UI: a handle on the column right edge overrides the built-in 748px width (default 1040px, 520-2400 range, persisted per browser, double-click resets).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供可拖拽的聊天内容宽度：文字列右缘的把手覆盖内置的 748px 宽度（默认 1040px、范围 520~2400、按浏览器记忆，双击恢复默认）。

description.en: DSH 插件：一个插件接入 WorkBuddy / Trae / Qoder 三渠道模型，带统一状态面板、一键签到与渠道管理
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 三个渠道的模型一次接进 DSH，统一面板看状态、一键签到、随时增删渠道。

description.en: 替换“深度求索中”为任意你想要的文本，比如：少女祈祷中......
description.zh: 把「深度求索中」那行状态文字、图标和颜色换成你喜欢的样式，比如「少女祈祷中」。

description.en: Local personal memory and knowledge management for DeepSeek Harness. It supports local FTS, CPU-embedding or OpenAI-Compatible Embedding API.
description.zh: 把个人记忆和导入资料存在本地 SQLite 里，支持全文检索和向量语义搜索，随时问随时答。

description.en: Task-aware native capability manager for DeepSeek Harness — use, prepare, and verify built-in DSH tools before adding another plugin.
description.zh: 先用好 DeepSeek Harness 自带的原生能力，再决定要不要装新插件，省心又高效。
让 DeepSeek Harness 的联网请求走本地代理，不用开 TUN 模式也能用 Clash 等科学上网。

description.en: Grok-compatible web search with retained source pagination, Context7 and Exa documentation lookup, bounded page extraction, site mapping, offline research planning, and read-only diagnostics.
description.zh: 提供 Grok-compatible 网页搜索、保留来源分页、Context7 与 Exa 文档检索、有界网页提取、站点映射、离线研究计划和只读诊断。

description.en: Play a Minecraft villager hmm whenever the model hums inside its reasoning chain. DeepSeek Harness plugin.
description.zh: 模型思考时一冒出「嗯」，就播放《我的世界》村民的哼声，让等待回复变得有趣。

description.en: Long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): layered memory library + session distillation + deep-sleep consolidation + settings panel. 守藏记忆插件。
description.zh: 给 DSH 助理装上跨会话长期记忆，自动沉淀、反思、召回和遗忘，数据全在本机。

description.en: dsh 工作区可添加多文件夹/第三方厂商模型可开启推理等级插件
description.zh: 给第三方模型加上推理等级开关，让模型选择器显示 Effort 行，按需调节思考深度。

description.en: A configurable third-party web-search plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness)/一个用于DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的可配置第三方网络搜索插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上可配置的第三方搜索引擎，还能抓取网页全文，让模型边搜边读。

description.en: Six engineering skills for Claude Code and DSH: research, architecture scouting, implementation orchestration, three-axis diff review, complexity audit and mutation testing. Skills delegate through the host’s generic subagent tools when available.
description.zh: 可安装到 Claude Code 与 DSH 的六个工程技能：调研、架构侦察、实施编排、三轴评审、复杂度审计和突变测试。按需通过宿主通用子 agent 能力委派，无需注册自定义 agent。

description.en: Questionnaire-style batch questioning plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 10+ questions at once (single/multi/yes-no toggle/compare/open), per-question skip, fullscreen overlay, two-column recap after submit
description.zh: Questionnaire-style survey plugin for DeepSeek Harness: the do_a_survey tool asks 1-10+ questions at once (single/multi/yes-no/compare/open types) in four presentation modes (compact/inline/overlay/grid), with per-question skip, full Markdown & color rendering, and a two-column recap after submit. Bundle form resident in the Web profile; companion skill ship

description.en: chinng-inta/dsh-web-search-searxng 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
description.zh: 用自托管的SearXNG给DeepSeek Harness加联网搜索能力，让模型能实时查资料。

description.en: Give the dsh agent a real browser: each conversation gets its own Chrome or Edge process with its own profile and CDP port, driven by six tools and mirrored live in the right sidebar, where you can watch the work and take over by clicking or typing on the picture. Nothing else to install — it uses the Chrome or Edge already on the machine, downloads no browser, needs no companion app or extension, and keeps its tabs and sign-ins between tool calls.
description.zh: 给 dsh agent 一个真正的浏览器：每个会话拥有自己的 Chrome 或 Edge 进程、独立 profile 与独立 CDP 端口，六个工具驱动它，右侧边栏实时镜像同一批页面，你既能看着它干活，也能直接在画面上点击、输入接管。除此之外无需再装东西——它驱动机器上已有的 Chrome 或 Edge，不下载浏览器，不需要配套应用或扩展，标签页与登录状态在工具调用之间一直保留。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: talk to Claude Code and other coding CLIs from the DSH web GUI, with sessions resumed and threads kept.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面里直接跟 Claude Code、Cursor 等编程 CLI 对话，还能保留上下文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that does QA: an agent explores your app like a real user and leaves evidence, then the explored path is exported as a deterministic replay scenario you run every release. Orchestrates the browser, macOS desktop, iOS and Android drivers — never a false green.
description.zh: 让 AI 像真人一样探索你的应用并留下证据，再把验证过的操作导出成可重复跑的回归测试脚本。

description.en: Accessible collapsible provider groups for the DeepSeek Harness model selector.
description.zh: 给 DSH 模型选择器加上按供应商折叠的分组，模型多时更好找、更清爽。

description.en: Use the Jev (System One) decision-model paradigm with any OpenAI-compatible LLM — no TypeSafe key required. Registers a jev_decide tool that returns probability-distributed answers to typed questions (choice/score/boolean) in one call.
description.zh: 用任意 OpenAI 兼容大模型跑 Jev 决策范式——无需 TypeSafe key。注册 jev_decide 工具，一次调用返回带概率分布的类型化答案（choice/score/boolean）。

description.en: A-share market dashboard: realtime quotes and indices, millisecond full-market search, market sentiment thermometer, candlestick K-line detail popups, watchlist, ETF/convertible-bond/LOF boards, screener, and a 7x24 aggregated news feed.
description.zh: 韭菜盒子:A股看盘助手——实时行情与大盘指数、毫秒级全市场搜索、市场情绪温度计、同花顺式K线详情弹窗、自选股、ETF/可转债/LOF榜单、条件选股、7x24聚合快讯。

description.en: Humanized fork of @xmanrui/dsh-im (base 4.21.2): humanized message delivery with send-delay and typing two-phase, message_break + streaming coexistence, status reactions, reply quotes, per-bot humanize overrides, and a no_reply reclaim tool — across WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Telegram, Slack and WhatsApp channels.
description.zh: @xmanrui/dsh-im 的拟人化分支（基于上游 4.21.2）：人化消息发送（发送延迟 + 输入中两阶段）、message_break 与 streaming 共存、状态表情、回复引用、per-bot 全量拟人化覆盖、no_reply 回收工具，覆盖微信/飞书/钉钉/企业微信/QQ/Telegram/Slack/WhatsApp 全通道。

description.en: 一人公司 · DeepSeek Harness 多 agent 公司编排插件（CEO/项目群/大厅/@派活/审批/排班/工作日志）
description.zh: 把多个 dsh agent 组建成一家公司，你当董事会，派活、审批、排班、看日志全都有。

description.en: Startup splash for DeepSeek Harness: an animated avatar with aurora, stardust, pointer parallax and a module-assembly entrance, plus the same image as the main-UI wallpaper; both images can be swapped from a settings page that previews the animation live.
description.zh: DSH 启动动画 + 主界面壁纸：头像、极光、星尘、指针视差与模块组装入场，同一张图兼作主界面壁纸；两张图都能在设置页里更换并实时预览。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bridge/plugin for A2S with remote sessions, workspaces, approvals, tasks, and resilient reconnects.
description.zh: 把本机 DeepSeek Harness 连到中转服务器，远程看状态、管会话、下发指令。

description.en: Sign in to DeepSeek Harness with a Claude Pro/Max membership (no API key), downscale Anthropic request images to a 2000px long edge, slim /compact summarizer payloads, and show 5-hour/weekly plan usage plus DSH message counts.
description.zh: 用 Claude Pro/Max 会员登录 DeepSeek Harness（无需 API key），将 Anthropic 请求图片长边压到 2000px，精简 /compact 摘要请求，并显示 5 小时/每周套餐用量百分比与 DSH 消息数。

description.en: Real browser tools for DeepSeek Harness: browse and extract web content, fill forms, manage multiple tabs, and execute multi-step tasks, with incremental DOM, session isolation, screenshots, action-result checks, and archived evidence recall.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供真实浏览器操作能力：网页浏览与信息提取、表单填写、多标签页协作和多步骤任务执行；支持增量 DOM、会话隔离、截图、操作结果检查与证据归档回读。

description.en: Shows a DSH session as a conversation canvas — every turn is a node, any turn forks a real child session, and a compacted context folds into one green node you can keep talking from; the left rail groups canvases by DSH workspace and renames them in step with the session titles.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话画成一张对话画布：每轮问答是一个节点，任意节点都能分叉出真实的子会话，压缩过的上下文收成一个绿色节点、可以从它继续对话；左侧栏按 DSH 工作区分组列出画布，重命名与 DSH 自己的会话标题同步。

description.en: Plan-usage pet for the DSH web GUI: a floating skeletal-animated character reports quota in a speech bubble, auto-matching the configured provider (OpenCode Go, Command Code, DeepSeek) to show a plan percentage or an account balance, and falling back to local token stats when the provider API is unavailable; draggable, wheel-scalable (90-260px), synthesized click sounds, loopback-only routes.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面的桌宠用量小窗：悬浮的骨骼动画角色用气泡报出套餐用量，按 DSH 里配置的 provider 自动匹配（OpenCode Go / Command Code / DeepSeek 官方），套餐制显示百分比、按量计费显示余额，取不到官方数字时降级为本地 token 统计；可拖动、滚轮缩放（90–260px），音效现场合成，HTTP 路由只开 loopback。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 离线打包插件 — 在联网环境下将 DSH 插件打包为离线安装包（.tgz），传输到离线 DSH 环境中加载安装。
description.zh: 在联网环境把 DSH 插件打包成离线安装包，拷到无网环境一条命令装好，不用连 npm。

description.en: Discord Rich Presence for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and DeepSeek Harness, powered by one local service that keeps your active work visible in Discord.
description.zh: 把 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI 编码工具的当前工作状态同步到 Discord，让队友随时看到你在忙什么。

description.en: Google Antigravity OAuth Gemini provider for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 Google Antigravity 账号里的 Gemini 模型接进 DeepSeek Harness，直接当原生模型用。

description.en: Model-driven context-window rollover bundle for the DeepSeek Harness: fresh working context, durable notes, verbatim recent tail, no summarization
description.zh: 让模型自己管理上下文窗口，自动滚动切换工作区，保留关键笔记和最近对话，无需压缩总结。

description.en: 跑团 / DM 工具插件（DeepSeek Harness）：中立随机裁决 + 本地 ComfyUI 配图 + 按会话隔离的战役配置（角色卡 / 世界 / 随机表）。TTRPG/DM tools for dsh: dice, local ComfyUI illustrations, per-session campaign state.
description.zh: 给跑团主持人用的插件：随机裁决、本地 ComfyUI 配图，还能按会话存角色卡和世界设定。

description.en: One Dark Pro theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI. 为 DSH Web 界面打造的 One Dark Pro 暗色主题插件。
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面换上 One Dark Pro 暗色主题，在设置里一键切换，护眼又好看。

description.en: DSH 插件：把 chat.deepseek.com 网页版接进 DeepSeek Harness（deepseek_web_ask / deepseek_web_analyze_lines / deepseek_web_status + 一键登录面板）。纯 Node，MIT License。
description.zh: 把你自己的 chat.deepseek.com 账号当作第二个模型接入 DSH：提问、按文件行区间分析、查看登录状态，附带运行时技能与设置页登录面板。

description.en: Model picker for the DSH web composer that replaces the model seat: a search-first popup whose left column indexes the suppliers and scrolls the grouped list, with a favorites group pinned at the top, image icons separating native from bridged vision input, and a reasoning-effort panel opened from the right zone of the trigger.
description.zh: 顶替 DSH Web 编辑器模型座位的模型选择器：检索优先的弹层，左栏是供应商索引、点击滚动右侧分组列表，收藏组固定在首位，用图片图标区分原生与桥接的视觉输入，点触发器右区单独打开推理档位面板。

description.en: Run trusted Pi extensions inside DeepSeek Harness through a compatibility host.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接跑未经改动的 Pi 扩展，靠兼容宿主实现无缝接入。

description.en: Local model plugin for DeepSeek Harness: manage GGUF models in settings, auto-launch llama.cpp on first message, and auto-unload after 5 minutes of idle time to free VRAM.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地模型插件：在设置里管理 GGUF 模型，首条对话自动拉起 llama.cpp，空闲 5 分钟自动卸载释放显存。

description.en: Native-feel DSH attachments: official PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF thumbs plus 64px cards for other files via drag, paste, or paperclip; non-images land in .dsh-uploads and sent cards sit on the user bubble.
description.zh: 接近原生的 DSH 附件：PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 走官方缩略图，其它文件经拖入、粘贴或回形针变成 64px 卡片；非图片落到 .dsh-uploads，发送后贴在用户气泡旁。

description.en: Read assistant replies aloud in DeepSeek Harness: text-to-speech providers with streaming playback.
description.zh: 把 AI 回复朗读出来，支持多种语音引擎和流式播放，边生成边听。

description.en: DSH Markdown sidebar viewer and editor with block- and text-range annotations for structured revision requests.
description.zh: 在侧边栏里预览、编辑 Markdown，还能按块或选区加批注，方便整理修改意见。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web notifications plugin
description.zh: 在桌面端和网页里提醒你待审批、提问和任务结果，点一下通知就能跳到对应会话。

description.en: 用于DeepSeek Harness的林翩翩主题UI插件。使用《哀鸿：城破十日记》的角色林翩翩作为页面半透明背景，并支持透明度和深度调节。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上林翩翩主题，半透明背景可调深浅，聊天界面颜值拉满还不影响阅读。

description.en: 把本机的 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 安全地发布到公网， 让你在外面用浏览器就能用家里那台机器。
description.zh: 把家里电脑上的 DSH 网页界面安全地发布到公网，出门在外用浏览器就能连回来用。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的自定义 LLM API 请求注入 HTTP Headers（典型用途：改写 user-agent，例如网关要求 UA 带指定品牌字样）。

Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or blocks repeat attempts until the evidence changes.
description.zh: 记录编程智能体走过的弯路，避免重复踩坑，提升开发效率。

description.en: Lifecycle orchestration engine for AI agent teams with task-scoped Git worktree isolation, state-gated delivery transitions, and off-context memory.
description.zh: 基于 Git 工作树任务隔离、状态门禁交付与外置记忆的 AI 智能体软件生命周期编排引擎。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness adapter for Context Mode: in-process ctx_* tools for sandboxed code execution and an FTS5 knowledge base, plus context-window routing guidance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 适配 Context Mode：进程内 ctx_* 工具（沙箱代码执行与 FTS5 知识库），并注入上下文窗口路由指引。

description.en: DSH JSON 查询工具插件：JMESPath 子集查询，零依赖递归下降解析器
description.zh: 用 JMESPath 语法快速查询 JSON 数据，零依赖轻量解析，让 Agent 轻松处理 API 返回和配置文件。

description.en: DSH 正则工具插件：测试匹配/提取捕获组/安全替换/静态解释正则（不执行代码），零依赖，注册 regex 工具
description.zh: 正则表达式工具箱，支持测试匹配、提取捕获组、安全替换，还能静态解释正则含义，零依赖纯函数。

description.en: DSH JSON Schema 验证工具插件：validate/paths/explain/normalize，零网络零动态执行
description.zh: DSH 的 JSON Schema 验证工具，能校验数据、定位失败路径、解释约束并安全填充默认值，全程离线且不执行动态代码。
