description.en: 接入 Google Anti Gravity Coding Plan 作为 DeepSeek Harness LLM Provider，直接使用账号下的 Gemini / Claude / GPT-OSS。 | Google Anti Gravity Coding Plan LLM Provider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 接入 Google Anti Gravity Coding Plan，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接调用你账号下的 Gemini、Claude 等顶尖 AI 模型。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 消息级删除插件，用于避免用户误发或错误的助手消息污染会话上下文。
description.zh: 消息级删除插件，一键移除误发或错误消息，防止污染模型上下文，聊天更干净。

description.en: Git Ship Done (opengsd-core) reimplemented as host-plane Cordis plugins: replaces the default agent loop with a spec/discuss/plan/execute/verify/ship phase loop.
description.zh: 把 GSD 阶段循环搬进 DeepSeek Harness，让智能体按 Git Ship Done 流程干活，替代默认循环。

description.en: 腾讯 IMA 是一个非常好的知识库应用，但是他们提供的skill版本针对公开知识库的检索方式只提供了基于文件标题的关键字检索，好一阵无语。为了补足在harness的这种知识库检索能力，基于tencent-ima-copilot-mcp迭代了对应的dsh版本。
description.zh: 让 Agent 直接按语义检索腾讯 IMA 知识库并返回带引用的答案，无需额外服务。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness is a plugin-based system for building AI agents. Everything, from tools and models to the web UI, can be added or replaced as a plugin.
description.zh: 一个演示用的小插件，帮你快速上手 DeepSeek Harness 插件开发，学会注册和调用工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 生态的 Windows 桌面插件项目。 A Windows desktop plugin project for the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem.
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面上以原生窗口运行 DeepSeek Harness，提供托盘、主题同步和系统通知，方便日常使用。

description.en: 更好的 DSH | Unofficial dsh plugin: archived sessions & task notifications / 已归档会话管理 · 任务系统通知
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面增加已归档会话管理和任务通知，提升使用效率。

description.en: dsh-doctor: self-healing watchdog for the DeepSeek Harness web profile. Recovers from plugin-induced boot failures within 60s, runs an unbounded CLI doctor, captures every tool error, and watches all live sessions for stuck turns.
description.zh: DSH 自愈看门狗，插件导致启动失败时 60 秒内自动恢复，并持续监控工具错误，保障工作台稳定运行。

description.en: Adds a settings page for declaring per-model reasoning efforts and vision support on pi-ai provider routes.
description.zh: 在设置里新增「模型能力」一页，为每个模型声明思考档位与视觉能力。

description.en: Universal Model Context Protocol (MCP) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: connects agents to stdio/sse/websocket MCP servers with a 10k dormant scale engine, sub-millisecond BM25 tool search, dynamic token budgeting, and a real-time web UI dashboard.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通用 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 桥接插件：支持 stdio/sse/websocket 协议，具备 10k 休眠伸缩引擎、亚毫秒级 BM25 工具检索、动态 Token 预算管理及实时 Web UI 仪表盘。

description.en: Vision routing and image generation for DeepSeek Harness through a fixed Mix model.
description.zh: 通过固定 Mix 模型，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供视觉路由与图像生成能力，让多模态任务更简单。

description.en: Icon console for the DSH desktop app: import one icon and apply it to the desktop and Start Menu shortcuts (immediately), the application window image and the system tray image (after a restart), with automatic backup, one-click restore, a named icon library, and restart/exit controls.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端图标控制台：导入一个图标即可应用到桌面与开始菜单快捷方式（立即生效）、应用窗口图标与系统托盘图标（重启后生效），带官方图标自动备份、一键恢复、图标库管理，以及重启/退出控制。

description.en: A version‑aware adapter registry that decouples third‑party Cordis plugins from dsh’s internal service names, paths, and RPC internals. 基于版本感知适配器注册表，为 dsh Cordis 插件提供运行时兼容层，使第三方插件与内部服务名、模块路径及 RPC 细节解耦。
description.zh: 为 dsh 插件提供版本兼容层，升级后第三方插件无需改动即可继续使用。

description.en: Agent run-rhythm guard for DeepSeek Harness: reasoning dead-loop interception (guard) + automatic continuation after premature stops (continue)
description.zh: 守护 Agent 运行节奏，防止推理死循环或过早收工，让长任务稳定跑完。

description.en: Auto-Approval: a middle permission tier for DeepSeek Harness between workspace-write and danger-full-access, auto-approving harmless commands and trusted-area targets
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供介于工作区写入和完全访问之间的中间权限层，自动放行无害命令和可信区域操作，兼顾安全与效率。

description.en: 🐟 Salted Fish Pet — a Cordis-based web-client UI plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. Injects a draggable, feedable salted fish mascot + full-viewport engineer wallpaper into the shell.overlay slot. Pure front-end (React + CSS Modules), zero server-side.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加一只可拖拽投喂的咸鱼宠物，配上工程师壁纸，让开发环境更有趣。

description.en: Digital Employee，Integrates three catalogs — Experts, Skills, and Connectors — supporting browsing, favoriting, invoking, and publishing without modifying the host.
description.zh: 数字员工，整合专家、技能、连接器三大目录，支持浏览、收藏、召唤与发布，且无需改动宿主代码。

description.en: PiUI-inspired home feed visual refinement plugin for DeepSeek Harness web client (pure extension, zero core changes)
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 主页信息流更好看，纯前端视觉优化，不改底层逻辑。

description.en: MobaXterm-style SSH/SFTP tool plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): saved connection profiles, persistent multiplexed sessions, remote command execution, SFTP file transfer, and a web GUI console with file browser + live xterm terminal.
description.zh: 像 MobaXterm 一样管理 SSH/SFTP 连接，支持远程命令、文件传输和网页终端，轻松接入 Linux 主机。

description.en: dsh as companion ai frontend in Svelte
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一个轻量、专注的 Svelte 聊天界面，让你在 /companion/ 路径下更舒服地和 AI 对话。

description.en: 为DeepSeek Harness制作的极简“对话密度地图”插件（右侧对话历史标签）A minimal "Conversation Density Map" extension for DeepSeek Harness (Right Chat History Tab)
description.zh: 在右侧历史对话栏生成可视化密度图，一眼看清聊天活跃度，快速定位目标会话。

description.en: DSH Web 插件「基础能力面板」：在 DSH 设置中可视化并管理 MCP 服务器、技能 与 规则。采用模块化 feature 注册表，后续的 DSH 可视化功能只需新增一个 feature 目录并在注册表加一行即可，无需改动面板骨架。
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中可视化查看和管理 MCP 服务器、技能与规则，模块化设计方便后续功能扩展。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness: a one-click whale icon plus a sidebar More menu with Settings / Restart-Refresh / graceful Full Exit, and a scrollable multi-DSH picker on the cold-start card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面启动器：一键鲸鱼图标 + 侧栏「更多」菜单（设置 / 重启/刷新 / 优雅完全退出），冷启动卡片支持可滚动的多 DSH 候选选择。

description.en: Liquid glass for DeepSeek Harness: full-shell translucency, adjustable opacity, and custom wallpapers.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 界面加上毛玻璃效果，支持调节透明度、换壁纸，让界面更好看。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for agent workspace hygiene: artifact value assessment, metadata indexing, and auditable cleanup.
description.zh: 帮你自动整理智能体工作区，评估文件价值、建立索引，并安全清理无用文件，让任务运行更清爽高效。

description.en: Governed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only evidence ledger with write guards, 7-tier authority claims, supersede chains, and budgeted pre-step injection with per-domain quotas.
description.zh: 带治理的长期记忆：只追加证据账本、写入闸门、7 级权威声明与取代链，pre-step 按领域配额预算注入。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 黄金实时看板插件：Au99.99/XAU 实时报价、可拖拽浮窗、招行积存金估算与日内买卖参考。
description.zh: 在侧边栏看黄金实时行情，还能看招行历史价、给持仓建议和策略回放。

description.en: use a GitHub Copilot subscription as a DSH LLM provider
description.zh: 把 GitHub Copilot 订阅变成 DeepSeek Harness 的模型后端，直接当普通 LLM 提供商来用，支持流式对话和模型列表。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness 自动重试商汤 429/QUOTA 等瞬时网关故障直到任务完成——启动时给所有 llm-pi-ai provider 热注入加固版 retryPolicy。
description.zh: 自动重试商汤等网关的429限流和瞬时故障，任务不再中断，无需手动干预。

description.en: Watches agent execution traces and fires an LLM review at every successful turn end when signals trip, crystallizing reusable workflows into registered skills that improve progressively with later runs.
description.zh: 观察 agent 执行轨迹，在每个成功回合结束时按信号触发 LLM 评审，把值得复用的工作流结晶为已注册技能，并随后续运行持续改进。

description.en: DeepSeek Companion Enterprise — DeepSeek Harness 企业级伴侣插件：安全审计与 DLP、团队协作与知识管理、任务编排与断点续跑、多模型竞技场、执行轨迹分析、Prompt 工程工作台。
description.zh: 面向企业团队的 AI 工程效率与安全平台，提供安全审计、任务编排、多模型竞技和 Prompt 工作台，助力团队协作与开发提效。

description.en: Durable dependency-graph task factory for DeepSeek Harness: recurring Agent work, safe checkout lanes, first-class queues, Triage, and artifacts.

Multi-agent orchestration and LLM model routing for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): semantic AI agent profiles, exact model routes, declarative teams and strategies, and bounded subagent delegation - a TypeScript plugin that adds no second runtime.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 轻松组建多智能体团队，智能路由模型，并声明式编排复杂任务流程。

description.en: PaddleOCR skills for DeepSeek Harness with native tools and GUI configuration
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 PaddleOCR 文字识别能力，自带原生工具和图形界面配置，开箱即用。

description.en: Six-stage WeChat Official Account content-publishing workflow with quality-gate tools and a bundled skill.
description.zh: 六阶段公众号内容发布工作流，带质检门工具与配套 skill。

description.en: 钱学森《工程控制论》全书蒸馏的 DeepSeek Harness 方法论技能插件 | A DeepSeek Harness skill plugin distilled from Qian Xuesen's Engineering Cybernetics

Give DeepSeek (text-only) models **vision** in Claude Code and Codex by routing image files to any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, DashScope, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio, …). Zero runtime dependencies, MIT licensed.
description.zh: 让纯文本 DeepSeek 也能看懂图片，自动转发给外部视觉模型处理，兼顾代码编写与图像识别。

description.en: DSH 插件管理器：内置/三方插件安装、卸载、启动、停用与 GitHub 直跳
description.zh: 在 Web 设置页一站式管理 DSH 插件，支持安装、卸载、启用、停用，还能从 GitHub 搜索安装或一键装载非 bundle 插件。

description.en: Improve web search in Deepseek Harness, use server-side search service.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入服务端搜索服务，提升联网搜索能力，让 AI 获取更实时的信息。

description.en: dsh 插件：让自定义提供方（pi-ai 手写路由）的所有模型都能选择思考强度（推理等级），选择经原厂适配器真正发往线上。A dsh plugin giving every custom-provider model selectable reasoning effort, wired through the stock pi-ai adapter.
description.zh: 让自定义提供方的所有模型都能选思考强度，选择真实生效并发送到线上。

description.en: Vertical message pointer rail on the left edge of the chat: one dash per user message, click to scroll to that message, hover for a preview bubble.
description.zh: 在聊天界面左侧添加消息指针导轨，点击标记快速跳转，悬停预览消息内容，提升长对话浏览效率。

description.en: Obsidian bridge plugin for DSH
description.zh: 把 Obsidian 变成 DSH 的本地控制台，直接在笔记里管理和运行 DeepSeek Harness 任务。

description.en: PPT design preset and editable PPTX production tools for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 一键生成专业可编辑的PPT，内置设计预设，让汇报演示又快又好看。

description.en: Русский язык для DeepSeek Harness web UI — one-command install, 1061 строка, 100% покрытие
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面一键安装俄语语言包，覆盖全部界面文本，让俄语用户使用更顺手。

description.en: Agent discipline guard for DeepSeek Harness: four gates enforced at the harness boundary — loop circuit-breaker, token-cost fuse, route-switch warning, plan approval — where prompt-level reminders can't reach, so an agent can no longer burn a weekly quota in minutes; one-click 🛡 chip, hot-reloadable thresholds, and presets from invisible-but-armored to warn-only.
description.zh: DSH Agent 纪律卫士：在 harness 边界强制四道闸门（循环熔断、Token 成本熔断、路由切换警示、计划审批卡），模型无法用文字绕过；🛡 芯片一键解除，daily 档对有缓存路由零打扰，把无缓存失控从每回合数百万 token 封顶到约 50 万。
让多台设备上的 DSH 和 AI 像群聊一样互相交流，自动接话、排队投递，人类随时插话管理。

description.en: A growing, auditable design-review palate for DSH: 13 local tools, visual training, and opt-in Apple/X reference packs.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体积累设计审美，越用越懂你的视觉偏好，自动优化界面风格。

description.en: Three-pane workspace layout with file-tree browsing, file editing, a non-linear conversation mindmap view, and mobile mode support.
description.zh: 三栏工作区布局，提供文件树浏览、编辑文件、非线性会话导图视图，并且支持手机模式。

description.en: 一个基于tv动画yumemita中的人物千石由乃，使用剧照素材，应用于deepseek-harness的自定义配色插件；A custom color scheme plugin for deepseek-harness, based on the character Yuno Sengoku from the TV anime "Yumemita"
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上由乃粉主题，界面秒变二次元，好看又护眼。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的中文学术论文检索 Bundle：复用 Academic Paper Search MCP，支持多源检索去重、引用核验、引文图谱、MeSH、试验检索与审计导出。
description.zh: 中文学术论文检索插件，支持多源去重、引用核验和引文图谱，帮您高效完成文献调研。

description.en: Redirects DSH downloads, artifacts, caches and temp files to user-specified drives (auto-picks the largest non-C drive), injects a path-discipline prompt into every session, and ships a disk_guard tool for status and cleanup — keeps the C: drive from filling up.

description.en: OpenCode Go subscription chat for DSH with per-model Completions, Responses, or Anthropic protocol selection, model discovery, context, vision and thinking metadata, effort defaults, and usage meters.
description.zh: DSH 的 OpenCode Go 订阅聊天：按模型选择 Completions、Responses 或 Anthropic 协议，支持模型发现、上下文、视觉与思考元数据、effort 默认值和用量仪表。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的**第三方插件管理器**：在 Web UI 设置页选择第三方插件库文件夹，搜索其中所有第三方插件，并一键关闭/启动（刷新 dsh 后生效）。
description.zh: 在 dsh 设置页选择第三方插件库，一键启用或停用插件，刷新后生效，轻松管理扩展功能。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Web UI 提供的 19 个精品风格主题，完整移植自 YiziMarkdown 的设计语言。
description.zh: YiziMarkdown theme pack for DeepSeek Harness — 19 style themes with custom brand and prompt mapping.

description.en: 🧠 Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness backed by Hindsight. Self-contained dsh-plugin: /hindsight commands + hindsight_recall/remember/status/list/forget agent tools. Lightweight, no dsh-mnemon, no orchestrator.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上跨会话记忆，随时召回历史决策、记住新事实，让 Agent 越用越聪明。

description.en: Rate-limits LLM requests per provider and per model using a reservation-based token bucket, with queue or reject modes, plus gateway identity rules that rewrite user-agent and inject custom headers.
description.zh: 按供应商与模型粒度限速 LLM 请求，预约式令牌桶支持排队或拒绝两种模式，附带网关身份规则（改写 User-Agent、注入自定义请求头）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that auto-nudges agents to consult docs or web search when local trial-and-error becomes costly. DeepSeek Harness 插件：当本地试错成本升高时，自动注入检索提示，引导 Agent 查阅文档或联网搜索。

Technical documentation agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: template-driven writing with a self-learning template library, AI-flavor removal for tech docs, and a quality-assurance toolkit (document audit, cross-document consistency, numbering resequencing, version sync, PDF and Word export, screenshot automation).
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的技术文档撰写 Agent 模式：模板驱动写作与自学习模板库、技术文档去 AI 味，以及文档质量保障工具集（量化体检、多文档口径一致性校验、图/表编号重排、版本同步检查、Word/PDF 导出与界面截图自动化）。

description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型一键接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需配置和 API 密钥，即插即用。

description.en: Message-level full-text search across DSH sessions via an FTS5 trigram index (user / assistant / steering / tool with per-kind filters), deduplicated results across fork/continued sessions, read-only context preview with auto-scroll to the focused message, one-click jump to the real session, and incremental/full index rebuild with health check; zh/en i18n follows the Host locale service.
description.zh: DSH 会话消息级全文检索浏览器：FTS5 trigram 索引按消息检索（用户/助手/系统注入/工具四类，可按类型筛选），fork/续接会话结果自动去重，只读上下文预览自动滚动定位焦点消息，一键跳转真实会话；支持增量/全量重建索引与健康检查；界面中英双语跟随 Host locale 服务。

description.en: Unified Godot asset and project-goal management for DSH: godot_* model tools, a /gap REST surface, and a better-sidebar UI with asset manager, scene-tree viewer, and Git panel.
description.zh: Godot 资产与项目目标统一管理：godot_* 模型工具 + /gap REST 路由 + better-sidebar 界面（资产管理器 / 场景树查看器 / Git 版本控制）。

description.en: Let your AI agent see and operate a real Android phone: phone_look (vision + UI-tree fusion), tap/swipe/type, screenshot — over adb, for any MCP client.
description.zh: 让 AI 助手看见并操作真实安卓手机：phone_look（视觉+UI 树融合判读）、点击/滑动/输入、截图——经 adb，适用于任何 MCP 客户端。

description.en: Browse, preview, edit, and save files under the current project's openspec/ directory from a Web UI header panel that follows the session workspace.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 会话标题栏打开当前项目的 openspec/ 目录，浏览、预览、编辑并保存其中的文件，自动跟随会话工作区。

description.en: DSH思考强度调节优化插件，模仿Codex中GPT5.6Terra等高级模型专属的档位吸附滑条，并解锁Low、Medium等档位。   |    DSH Thinking Intensity Adjustment Optimization Plugin, which mimics the exclusive snap-to-gear slider of advanced models like GPT5.6 Terra in Codex, and unlocks gears such as Low, Medium, etc.
description.zh: Thinking-strength slider: replaces the composer model seat's reasoning-effort button list with a snap-to-step slider for the DSH web UI.

description.en: Workspace/chat context menu for the DSH home page: pin, rename, open in file explorer, archive, fork, copy, and open in a new window.
description.zh: DSH 主页工作区/会话增强菜单：置顶、重命名、资源管理器打开、归档、分叉、复制、新窗口打开。

description.en: Bridge your pi extension, codex plugin or claude code plugin to dsh (DeepSeek Harness)
description.zh: 将 Pi、Codex、Claude Code 插件桥接到 DeepSeek Harness，一站式安装管理各类智能体插件。

description.en: Git and source-control plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness: local git operations plus GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps and Gitea adapters, with self-evolving memory.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 与源码管理插件套件：本地 git 操作，外加 GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket、Azure DevOps 与 Gitea 适配器，并带自演进记忆。

description.en: DSH 实时思维导图插件：Agent 与你共编同一棵树，改动即时互相同步，支持停靠分屏与全屏专注两种视图

Manages OpenCode Zen free-tier and Go-tier models in settings.yaml — fetches the live model listings from opencode.ai, reports configured-versus-live drift per route, and adds or removes entries through four agent tools and an OpenCode Models settings section.
description.zh: 在 settings.yaml 中管理 OpenCode Zen 免费档与 Go 档模型——实时拉取 opencode.ai 的最新模型列表，按路由对比已配置与线上差异，通过四个 agent 工具和设置页分区增删模型条目。

description.en: Enterprise workbench for DSH: manage AI employees, knowledge bases, skills, MCP servers and DSH plugins from a running session.
description.zh: 企业级工作台，在会话中直接管理AI员工、知识库、技能、MCP服务器和插件，一站式搞定。

description.en: Markdown writing pad for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: per-session editing, preview, and in-session AI-assisted rewrite.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里写 Markdown 的便签板，支持分会话编辑、实时预览，还能让 AI 帮你改写。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin — PDF text-layer and scanned-PDF OCR, Office docx/xlsx/pptx to Markdown, TIFF/epub and long-document index cards.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 插件——PDF 文字层与扫描件 OCR、Office 文档转 Markdown、TIFF/epub 与长文档索引卡。

description.en: Visual goal lifecycle for the DSH web UI: a composer dock to create, multiline-edit, pause, resume, complete and clear session goals with live round progress, plus a phase-dot composer entry and a settings-page goal overview.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供可视化的会话目标生命周期：composer 上方的目标栏支持创建、多行编辑、暂停、恢复、完成与清除并实时显示轮次进度，工具行入口带阶段色点，设置页提供目标总览。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web client plugin: group sidebar workspaces into a configurable three-level tree (分类→项目→会话). Sidecar YAML rules. dsh-plugin.
description.zh: 将侧边栏工作区按分类、项目、会话三级树形结构整理，让工作区管理更清晰高效。

description.en: 用DSH 开发的轻量化插件:按 Ctrl+Shift+L 一键把页面伪装成静态 404 截图,暂时锁死鼠标键盘,防止别人乱动电脑
description.zh: 按 Ctrl+Shift+L 一键把页面伪装成静态 404 截图，锁死鼠标键盘，防止别人乱动电脑，再按一次恢复。

description.en: Annotate text in replies, diffs, or files and send notes with a message for ordered replies and source navigation; follows Host styling and automatically adapts to dsh-codex-ui.
description.zh: 选中正文、Diff 或文件文字后批注并随消息发送，回复按批注逐条对照并支持定位；界面跟随宿主样式，自动兼容 dsh-codex-ui。

description.en: PDF编辑插件，AI只改文字不改样式，支持单页、批量、换版式，HTML中转保留样式，高效处理大文件。     PDF editor with AI text-only edits (styles unchanged). Supports single-page, batch, and layout changes. HTML intermediate preserves styles. Optimized for large files.

description.en: Browse, search and install skills from the public SkillHub catalogue, then enable, disable, update or remove them without leaving Harness. Category chips carry the upstream total for each category; the details drawer has tabs for the file tree, version history, permissions, third-party security-scan results and upstream metrics. An installed skill is written into the harness skill root as an ordinary local skill, and disabling one moves its directory out of that root rather than flagging it.
description.zh: 浏览、搜索并安装公开的 SkillHub 技能库,启用、停用、更新或卸载都不必离开 Harness。分类按钮带该分类的上游总数;详情抽屉提供文件树、版本历史、权限、第三方安全扫描结论与上游指标等页签。装好的技能会作为一个普通本地技能写入 harness 的技能根目录,而「停用」是把它的目录移出该根目录,不是打标记。

description.en: Claude Code rules.md-style rule prompts: activate rule markdown files by glob-matching the files an agent reads or edits, with prompt injection and ordering support.
description.zh: 类 Claude Code rules.md 的规则提示词：按智能体读取或编辑文件的 glob 匹配自动激活规则文档，支持提示词注入与排序。

description.en: SSH workspace and operations for DeepSeek Harness: bind a server directory as a workspace whose fs/subprocess calls route to the remote host via cordis seam replacement, plus web terminal, file transfers, tunnels, cluster runs and host management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 工作区与运维：把服务器目录绑定为工作区，fs/命令经 cordis seam 替换透明路由到远端主机，并带 Web 终端、文件传输、隧道、集群执行与主机管理。

description.en: Rearranges DSH Web into a three-column workbench with file editing, Git views, Markdown preview, and workspace terminals.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 重排为三栏工作台，提供文件编辑、Git 视图、Markdown 预览和工作区终端。

description.en: Verifies letters signed by other agents: a canonical field order, digest and HMAC checks, and fail-closed handling of missing or unregistered fields. Off by default; when enabled, a letter that fails any check is refused rather than delivered.
description.zh: 校验其他 agent 写来的信：规范字段顺序、摘要与 HMAC 校验。默认关闭；开启后，缺字段或未登记字段不放行，任何一项不过就拒收。

description.en: TickTick (滴答清单) daily task dispatcher: an interval timer pulls due tasks from a chosen list into a Markdown task file and notifies only when the task set changes (WeChat via ClawBot / flomo / macOS); it can also auto-execute each task in its own headless DSH session under a configurable timeout, optionally gated to DeepSeek's off-peak hours so peak-time work queues to the next off-peak window instead of starting, plus a settings panel for the deferred write-back queue and dispatcher_status / dispatcher_config / dispatcher_run / dispatcher_report tools.
description.zh: 滴答清单任务派发器：按间隔从指定清单拉取到期任务写入今日任务文件，仅在任务集变化时通知（微信 ClawBot / flomo / macOS）；可为每个任务单独开一个 headless DSH 会话自动执行（worker 超时可配），并可选只在 DeepSeek 空闲（优惠）时段开跑——高峰期把任务排到下个空闲窗口而不是立刻执行；带 Web 设置面板（延迟回写队列、省钱模式时段与状态）与 dispatcher_status / dispatcher_config / dispatcher_run / dispatcher_report 工具。

description.en: Recall previously sent messages in the input box with Up/Down, and archive a workspace session from its right-click menu.
description.zh: 在输入框内按 ↑/↓ 回填历史消息，并支持右键归档（隐藏）工作区会话。

description.en: Turns the iterate skill into an autonomous closed-loop harness — plan, parallel review, atomic fixes, validate, loop, auto-stop — plus a dry-run review-only mode and a meta-review that audits the report and emits a final review report.
description.zh: 把 iterate 技能跑成自主闭环：规划、并行审查、原子修复、验证、循环、自动停止，并支持纯评审的 dry-run 模式与元评审最终报告。

description.en: Tender search and bid intelligence in DeepSeek Harness with proposed project search, rule screening, human review and Excel/PDF exports using user-authorized Qichacha MCP.
description.zh: 招投标智能体：支持招投标搜索、招标查询、投标查询、标讯查询、拟建项目与项目筛选，辅助商机发现、人工复核及 Excel/PDF 导出，使用客户自备授权的企查查 MCP。

description.en: Interactive canvas for visualizing Agent, Subagent, Workflow, Phase, and tool relationships in DSH Web.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供可交互画布，用于展示 Agent、Subagent、Workflow、Phase 与工具调用之间的关系。

description.en: Signature escook theme ported from VS Code: 4 classic aesthetic color schemes (Dark, Dark Soft, Light, Light Soft) with high-contrast syntax highlighting for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 移植自 VS Code 经典的彬哥主题：包含 4 款经典美学配色（经典暗黑、柔和暗黑、紫韵浅色、柔和浅色）与高对比度语法高亮。

description.en: Circuit breaker for idle agent turns: watches agent/assistant-stream and cancels a turn that produces only reasoning — no text and no tool call — after 45s, after 80000 reasoning characters, or on a degenerate repetition pattern (exact repeat unit, sentence-template repeat, sparse repeat, or 6-gram density). On trip it injects a continue instruction that requires the next action to be a tool call, and ships 11 regression cases plus per-gate tuning.
description.zh: 空转回合熔断器：监听 agent/assistant-stream，对只产出 reasoning、零文本零工具调用的回合实施三重熔断——45 秒无进展、单次思考超 80000 字符、或命中退化重复模式（精确重复单元/句模重复/稀疏复读/6-gram 密度）。熔断后注入继续指令，要求下一个动作必须是工具调用；附 11 个回归用例与逐档调参。

description.en: Adaptive topology multi-agent preset for DeepSeek Harness with peer messaging, task handoff and live network visualization.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的自适应拓扑多智能体预设，提供点对点通信、任务交接和实时网络可视化。

description.en: Add missing reasoning-effort declarations to custom pi-ai models through DSH settings, enabling the native effort picker and handling models added later.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 设置为自定义 pi-ai 模型补充缺失的推理强度声明，启用原生强度选择器，并自动处理后续添加的模型。

description.en: Full-duplex voice for DeepSeek Harness: a realtime capability seam, a GPT-Live-1 adapter, and a keyless replay backend.
Agent preset bundle for wish and task management: create wishes or tasks from conversation, opportunity-day check-ins, micro-actions, plus a memory store and progress charts in the web UI.
description.zh: 愿望与任务管理的 Agent Preset 组合包：在对话中创建愿望/任务、机会日打卡、微行动，并附带记忆存储与 Web 端进度图表。

description.en: Adds the DeepSeek Harness homepage background to dsh web: WebGL fluid light, dot-line grid and a digital point-cloud whale, with dark and light palettes.
description.zh: 给 dsh web 铺上 DeepSeek Harness 首页同款背景：WebGL 流体光效、点线网格与数字点云鲸鱼，深色/亮色两套配色。

description.en: Forge quality gates for DeepSeek Harness: task gates, read-before-edit, bash hazard interception and quality scoring, enforced by the local forge CLI through DSH's typed interception points. Requires the forge CLI on PATH; without it the plugin fails open and says so with a best-effort notice at session start, and task gates also need forge init in the project.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Forge 质量门禁：任务门禁、改前必读、危险命令拦截与质量评分，经 DSH 类型化拦截点由本地 forge CLI 执行。需本机安装 forge CLI，缺失时插件 fail-open 并在会话开始时尽力提示；任务门禁还要求项目已执行 forge init。

description.en: Multi-platform IM gateway for DSH: Feishu (Lark) WebSocket long connection (no public URL), WeCom AES-encrypted callbacks, and Telegram long polling — per-chat agent sessions, whitelist access, and a visual settings card in the web GUI.
description.zh: 多平台 IM 网关：飞书（Lark）WebSocket 长连接（无需公网）、企业微信 AES 加密回调、Telegram 长轮询；每会话独立 agent、白名单访问、Web GUI 可视化设置卡片。

description.en: Reformats dsh session titles as "date | type | topic" (type and topic are summarized by a model from the full conversation), and hides unused sessions from the sidebar without deleting them.
description.zh: 把 dsh 会话标题统一成「日期｜类型｜主题」（类型与主题由模型对整段对话总结），并支持可逆的会话隐藏：暂时不用的会话从侧边栏收起，不删除、随时一键显示回来。

description.en: Adds a 3D model library in its own conversation tab, where agents store models built from CadQuery scripts or supplied as tessellated meshes; the library previews them with three-cad-viewer, organises them into folders and exports them to 10 formats including STEP, BREP, STL and DXF.
description.zh: 在对话界面新增「3D模型」标签页作为模型库：agent 把 CadQuery 脚本或已剖分的网格存入服务端，标签页用 three-cad-viewer 预览、按文件夹整理，并可导出 STEP、BREP、STL、DXF 等 10 种格式。

description.en: Local image, voice, music and SFX generation plus transcription, with pinned identity: characters, animals, objects and actor voices are defined once and reused on every later call, degenerate output (a near-flat image, silent audio) is rejected instead of returned as success, and a generated line can be read back as text so a clone that swallowed its ending becomes visible. The engines unload when idle, and image generation and transcription can each be pointed at an OpenAI-shaped API instead of the local Vulkan backend.
description.zh: 本地生成图像/配音/音乐/音效并听写，同一性锁定：角色、动物、道具与配音角色定妆定声一次，之后每次调用复用同一份参考；退化产物（接近纯色的图、静音的音频）被拒绝而不是当成成功返回；生成的台词可以听写回文字，好让吞掉结尾的克隆暴露出来。空闲时引擎卸载显存，生图与听写也可改指向任意 OpenAI 形状的 API 而不用本地 Vulkan 后端。

description.en: Config-driven development-task orchestration for DSH: graph workflows (task/gateway/human nodes) with per-stage persistence, plus an in-editor AI assistant that configures workflows through conversation with live validation. Hand documents to nodes as generic attachments (no declaration needed): files land in the task workspace and ${inputs.附件} gives the newline-joined absolute paths, so a node parses them with its own prompt.
description.zh: 配置驱动的工作流与开发任务编排：图式工作流（任务/网关/人工审批节点）+ 阶段级断点持久化，内置 AI 助手在图编辑器中通过对话配置工作流，逐条校验实时应用到画布。把文档作为「通用附件」交给节点（无需声明）：文件启动前落到工作区，节点用 ${inputs.附件} 拿到换行拼接的绝对路径自行解析。

description.en: Three independent language channels for model output — tool-call descriptions (every tool-call card title, including run_code in PTC-style presets), thinking, and replies — each set to follow the web GUI language, force a specific language, or turn off (default: only descriptions, following the GUI). One global runtime-context prompt directive on the host; the client half reports the GUI language; a Settings plugin card switches the modes.
description.zh: 模型产出文本的三个语言通道——工具调用描述（所有工具调用卡片标题，含 PTC 类预设的 run_code）、思考与回复——各自可跟随网页界面语言、强制指定语言或关闭（默认仅描述通道跟随界面语言）。host 侧注入一条全局 runtime-context 提示指示，client 半上报界面语言，设置里的插件卡片负责切换。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown, exponential backoff, a consecutive-attempts cap, boot-time scanning, a settings card and a per-session stop/restore button in the composer toolbar; it never switches models or providers.
description.zh: 回合中断自动续跑：turn/end 因 error / interrupted / max-tokens 结束时自动发送「继续」，支持宽限期、冷却、指数退避、连续次数上限、启动扫描、设置卡片，以及输入框工具行的会话级停止/恢复按钮；不切换模型/provider。

description.en: Manage global AGENTS.md in DSH Web with Markdown preview, reusable templates, version history, import/export, failed-import rollback, and revision-conflict protection.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中管理全局 AGENTS.md，支持 Markdown 预览、可复用模板、版本历史、导入导出、失败导入回滚与修订冲突保护。

description.en: Interval heartbeat that wakes each root agent itself (followup injection) to proactively report progress, risks or blockers: busy-safe queuing, no stacking, auto-pauses when no human replies, re-arms on the next user message.
description.zh: 定时心跳：用 followup 注入唤醒每个根 agent 主动汇报进展、风险与卡点——忙碌时排队不打断、最多保留一条、连续无人回应自动暂停，用户下一条消息即恢复。

description.en: Feishu/Lark gateway for DeepSeek Harness with topic-persistent conversations, live execution cards, image and file inputs, in-chat approvals and questions, source allowlists, and durable one-time or recurring agent tasks created in natural language.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 网关：按话题持久化会话、实时执行卡片、图片与文件输入、聊天内审批和提问、来源白名单，以及用自然语言创建可持久化的一次性或周期 Agent 任务。

description.en: A Windows desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — launch, stop and monitor the DSH service and summon the GUI with a whale.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌面宠物，一键启动/停止/监测服务，双击唤起 GUI。

description.en: A NieR:Automata / YoRHa-inspired industrial terminal theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with sand-and-charcoal palettes, square geometry, and interface-wide styling.
description.zh: 一款面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 NieR:Automata / YoRHa 风格工业终端主题，提供沙色与炭黑配色、直角几何和全界面样式。

description.en: Liquid Glass refraction input card for the DSH web GUI, with coupled-spring press animation. Published on npm: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 输入卡加上液态玻璃折射效果与弹簧按压动画。已发布 npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input。

description.en: Text viewer and editor for the dock workbench: undo/redo, Ctrl+S save, unsaved-change confirmation and binary detection, registered as the default file viewer.
description.zh: dock 系列文本查看与编辑器：支持撤销重做、Ctrl+S 保存、未保存确认和二进制检测，作为 dock-files 的默认文本查看器。

description.en: Native image attachments for text-only DeepSeek in the Web GUI: pasted or dropped images appear as thumbnails in the session, and before dispatch the host reads them with the free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash vision API (glm-4v-flash fallback chain) and substitutes the description, so DeepSeek answers about the image while the original is kept in history.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 提供原生图片上传体验：在 Web GUI 粘贴/拖入图片即以缩略图附件进入会话，发送前由 host 用免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash 视觉 API（glm-4v-flash 降级链）读取并替换为文字描述，DeepSeek 据此回答，原图保留在聊天历史中。

description.en: Installed-plugin catalog for DSH: group plugins by origin (official vs self-installed) in a searchable panel with enable/disable, uninstall, and one-click update. Published on npm as dsh-plugin-diraud.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 里的插件目录：按来源（官方/自装）分组展示已安装插件，可搜索，支持启用/停用、卸载和一键更新。已发布 npm 包 dsh-plugin-diraud。

description.en: Markdown viewer for the dock workbench: GFM rendering with DOMPurify sanitization, document outline and relative-path image/link resolution, with one-click switch to editing.
description.zh: dock 系列 Markdown 查看器：GFM 渲染 + DOMPurify 消毒、文档大纲、相对路径图片/链接解析，可一键切换编辑。

description.en: Manageable one-tap text chips above the session composer; idle sessions queue the message and running sessions steer at the next safe boundary without rewriting the draft.
description.zh: 在会话输入区上方提供可管理的一点即发文本 chip；空闲时 queue、运行中 steer，不改写草稿。

description.en: Gives dsh the ability to generate images and videos through the grok2api API.
description.zh: 让 dsh 通过 grok2api 的 API 获得生成图片与视频能力。

description.en: Task-completion chime for DeepSeek Harness, playing the original opencode sounds for done, question, plan-review and error events with zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 复刻 opencode 的任务完成提示音，完成、提问、计划待审、出错四种场景播放原始音效，零外部依赖。

description.en: A Live2D waifu plugin for DSH.
description.zh: dsh 的 Live2D 看板娘插件。

description.en: Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 反向隧道：通过 frp 把 `dsh --profile web` 发布到公网地址，目录选择器改用应用内浏览器，手机或远程机器可直接打开并管理工作区。

description.en: DeepSeek homepage-style theme skin for the dsh web GUI: fluid particle background, glass sidebar and composer, running-subagent progress panel, and DSTT peak-hour color modes.
description.zh: 为 dsh web GUI 复刻 DeepSeek 官网风格的主题皮肤：流体粒子背景、玻璃拟态侧边栏与输入框、运行中子代理面板与 DSTT 高峰时段配色。

description.en: Vision understanding + image generation/editing for DeepSeek Harness (read images with Qwen/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini, generate and edit with Qwen-Image). A rework of liustack/modlens (MIT). Remove @liustack/modlens first — both register the same vision providers and image interception hooks, so co-installation breaks image reading.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供读图与生图/编辑能力（Qwen/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini 读图，Qwen-Image 生图与编辑）。基于 liustack/modlens（MIT）改造；请先卸载 @liustack/modlens——两者会注册同一批 vision provider 与图片拦截钩子，并存会导致读图失灵。

description.en: A focused end-user QA surface backed by native DeepSeek Harness sessions

Read-only insight panel for one profile: five views over the same data — config layers, plugin tree, services, tool names and models — each entry showing which layer inserted or disabled it and whether it is running.
description.zh: 只读的 profile 洞察面板：同一份数据的五个视图——配置层、插件树、服务、工具名、模型，每一条都给出被哪一层插入或禁用、此刻在不在跑。

description.en: SiYuan (思源笔记) notes integration: 17 siyuan_* host tools covering notebook and document listing, full-text search, SQL query, reading documents and blocks, creating and appending content, moving and renaming documents, daily notes and block attributes, plus a Web settings page for the SiYuan URL, API token and per-tool switches.
description.zh: 把思源笔记（SiYuan）接入 DeepSeek Harness：17 个 siyuan_* 宿主工具，覆盖笔记本与文档列表、全文检索、SQL 查询、读取文档与块、新建与追加内容、移动与重命名文档、日记与块属性，另提供一个 Web 设置页配置思源地址、API token 与逐工具开关。

description.en: Runs AItelier pipelines from DSH over MCP: 39 tools (22 read, 17 write) to generate, run, inspect, edit, export and import multi-step SkillFlow pipelines. The steps execute in AItelier rather than in the DSH session and are polled by run_id, pause at engine-enforced checkpoints answered with answer_checkpoint, and leave per-step traces and step outputs to read afterwards; add_provider / map_model / edit_role point an individual role at a local or cheaper endpoint. Bundles an aitelier-pipelines skill.
description.zh: 从 DSH 经 MCP 运行 AItelier 流水线：39 个工具（22 读、17 写），用于生成、运行、查看、编辑、导出与导入多步 SkillFlow 流水线。步骤在 AItelier 中执行而不占用 DSH 会话，按 run_id 轮询，在引擎强制的检查点暂停并由 answer_checkpoint 应答，事后可读取逐步 trace 与各步输出；add_provider / map_model / edit_role 可把单个角色指向本地或更便宜的端点。随包附带 aitelier-pipelines skill。

description.en: Writes live provider model lists into DSH settings and shows 5h/7d plan windows or metered balance for the current session model.
description.zh: 把各提供方线上模型列表写进 DSH 设置，输入框圆环显示当前会话模型的 5 小时/7 天窗口或按量剩余余额。

description.en: After official llm-retry (n/5) gives up, keep retrying transient API failures (timeout, transport, rate-limit, 5xx, dropped SSE) on the same open step until success, cancel, or pause; AUTH, QUOTA, and user Stop are never retried.
description.zh: 官方 llm-retry（n/5）耗尽后，对超时/传输/限流/5xx/SSE 断流等瞬时失败在同一打开 step 上继续重试直到成功、取消或暂停；认证失败、额度耗尽和用户停止不会重试。

description.en: Add a theme-adjustment panel under Appearance to customize accent, background, foreground, contrast and gradient, applied live through theme token overrides.
description.zh: 在「外观」下增加一个主题调节面板，可自定义强调色/背景色/前景色/对比度/渐变度，并实时生效。

description.en: Configuration UI for the official OpenViking memory plugin: connection and user-key setup, local connection diagnostics, a per-session memory toggle in the composer, memory isolation that keeps recall inside the current topic, and recall tuning for score threshold, injected item count, query expansion and excluded URIs.
description.zh: 官方 OpenViking 记忆插件的配置管理界面：连接与用户 Key 配置、本机连接诊断、输入栏会话级记忆开关、按主题隔离的召回范围，以及分数阈值、注入条数、查询扩写与排除 URI 的召回调优。

description.en: Routes the DSH web_search tool through Ollama's web search API, reusing OLLAMA_API_KEY. No DeepSeek official key needed.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的 web_search 工具走 Ollama 联网搜索 API，复用 OLLAMA_API_KEY，无需 DeepSeek 官方 Key。

description.en: AI UI automation via Midscene — android_ui and web_ui tools that tap, type, query, and assert on a real Android device or an already-running Chrome through the ctx.midscene seam.
description.zh: 基于 Midscene 的 AI UI 自动化——android_ui 与 web_ui 工具，通过 ctx.midscene seam 在真实 Android 设备或已运行的 Chrome 上完成点击、输入、查询与断言。

description.en: Registers the commercial-ui-ux skill for DSH: task-aware commercial UI/UX/GUI design, review, repair, and implementation (SaaS, dashboards, admin panels, forms, tables, design systems) with a reference-doc system and quality gates.
description.zh: 注册 commercial-ui-ux 技能：以任务为中心的商业界面 UI/UX/GUI 设计、审查、修复与实现（SaaS、仪表盘、后台、表单、表格、设计系统），带参考文档体系与质量门禁。

description.en: Sidebar panel for account balances and local token usage, with provider/model breakdowns and a 27-week daily heatmap.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板展示账户余额与本地 Token 用量，包含供应商/模型明细和 27 周每日热力图。

description.en: Decision split view for DSH web UI: a decision summary card in the main window plus the full plan in an independently scrollable side panel, so you can review the whole plan while writing decisions and send them back to the agent with one click.
description.zh: 决策分屏视图：主窗口显示决策摘要卡片，右侧详情栏独立滚动展示完整方案，边看全文边写决策，一键回传 agent。

description.en: Separate slash-command group in the Web UI composer: /steer injects text on the agent's next step without interrupting the turn, /new starts a blank session, /skill and /docs wrap /steer with post-turn skill or docs tasks, and custom /steer aliases are configurable in Settings.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 输入框的斜杠菜单里单独一组插件命令：/steer 在模型下一步注入内容且不打断当前回合，/new 开启空白会话，/skill 与 /docs 在 /steer 基础上附加完成后写入 skill 或 docs，并可在设置里为常用 /steer 内容配置自定义快捷命令。

description.en: A liquid glass UI plugin for the DSH desktop app. Works alongside most wallpaper plugins. Currently supports dark mode only.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 桌面端的液态玻璃 UI 美化插件，可与大部分壁纸插件联动使用，目前仅适配深色模式。

description.en: Weak-network adaptor: transparent long-backoff model-stream retries (10-min cap), local response replay cache, heartbeat auto-reconnect, and degraded-mode token economy, with a bilingual (zh/en) settings page.
description.zh: 弱网适配器：模型流式请求的长退避透明重试（上限 10 分钟）、本地响应重放缓存、心跳自动重连、降级模式 token 节流，并提供中英双语设置页。

description.en: Drive DSH from anything that speaks HTTP: 47 routes (REST + SSE) for workspaces, sessions (create/prompt, live SSE generation, history, stats, todos, cancel, ask-user Q&A), models and the global default model, providers, agent presets, settings namespaces, skills, and workspace files including resumable chunked upload — plus an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions, a built-in OpenAPI 3.0 spec and an interactive request page. It only injects the host webServer and tools, so it rides on the DSH webserver (default prefix /api/v1) or its own port with optional API-key auth, and it ships a skill that teaches the DSH agent to call the API.
description.zh: 让任何会说 HTTP 的东西驱动 DSH：47 条路由（REST + SSE），覆盖工作区、会话（创建/提示、SSE 实时生成、历史、统计、任务清单、中止、问答）、模型与全局默认模型、提供方、Agent Preset、设置命名空间、技能与工作区文件（含分片续传上传），另有 OpenAI 兼容的 /chat/completions、内置 OpenAPI 3.0 规范与在线调试页。它只 inject 宿主的 webServer 与 tools，挂在宿主 webserver（默认前缀 /api/v1）或独立端口，可选 API Key 鉴权，并自带一份教会 DSH 里 Agent 调用本 API 的 SKILL。

description.en: Persistent background watchers that wake the agent on new messages (file inbox or command-output delta) — the harness analog of Claude Code's Monitor tool.
description.zh: 常驻后台监视器：文件收件箱（NDJSON）或命令输出增量一到就唤醒 agent，相当于 Claude Code Monitor 工具的 Harness 实现。

description.en: Deterministic session evidence reports for DeepSeek Harness: /transcript writes styled single-file HTML / Markdown / JSON reports from canonical session logs, /stats prints a terminal stats card, /archive writes per-session ZIPs
description.zh: 会话证据报告：/transcript 从权威日志生成 HTML/Markdown/JSON 报告，/stats 输出终端统计卡，/archive 打包单会话 ZIP。

description.en: Voice assistant for dsh web: say the wake phrase (e.g. "小鲸") to activate hands-free dictation — what you say is transcribed and typed into the chat box automatically. Supports spoken edit commands (send, clear, new line, stop reading) and reads assistant replies aloud in Chinese. Speech recognition runs locally in-browser via sherpa-onnx WASM, so it works offline without an API key.
description.zh: dsh web 语音助手：说出唤醒词（如「小鲸」）即可免手听写，说话内容自动转成文字填入输入框；支持口述编辑指令（发送、清空、换行、停止朗读），并可用中文朗读 AI 回复。语音识别基于 sherpa-onnx WASM 在浏览器本地运行，离线可用、无需 API Key。

description.en: Metaso (秘塔AI搜索) search & reader providers for the web seam: web_search returns page summaries, web_fetch reads full-page markdown, multi-scope search (webpage/document/paper/image/video/podcast).
description.zh: 秘塔AI搜索 providers for ctx.web：web_search 返回网页摘要，web_fetch 读取网页全文 markdown，多范围搜索（网页/文库/论文/图片/视频/播客）。

description.en: Yellow one-line notice for a prompt cache miss after the cache was rebuilt; shows re-billed uncached input tokens, cached hit tokens, and TTFT.
description.zh: 提示缓存未命中（cache miss）时，在重建缓存的 assistant 回复下方显示一条黄色缓存提示，展示未缓存（uncached）重新计费（re-billed）的输入 token、缓存命中 token 与首字延迟（TTFT）。

description.en: Listen to Ximalaya podcasts and audiobooks inside the DSH web UI: search albums, browse paginated tracks, and play through a now-playing bar (prev/play/next, seek, volume, rate). After QR login the "Mine" page lists your liked tracks (click to play), subscribed albums with latest-episode hints, and followed anchors with their public albums; the host relays audio streams with Range support and registers an `ximalaya_play` tool so the agent can search and play on request.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面收听喜马拉雅播客/有声书：搜索专辑、分页浏览曲目，播放条支持上下集/进度/音量/倍速；扫码登录后「我的」页可看收藏的声音（点击即播）、我的订阅（带最新一集提示）与关注的主播（含其公开专辑）；Host 端音频流代理支持 Range 拖动，并注册 `ximalaya_play` 模型工具让 agent 按需搜索播放。

description.en: Plug/unplug any DeepSeek Harness plugin cleanly — list every mounted layer (bundles + patch rows), remove with full cleanup, disable/enable without deleting, and audit for orphaned/dangling state. CLI + agent-callable unplug tool. Read-only by default; destructive operations require explicit confirmation.
description.zh: 让 DSH 插件的安装和卸载干净利落——列出所有加载层（Bundle + 补丁行）、完整卸载（清理 Bundle 列表+补丁行+依赖）、临时禁用以调试而不真正删除、以及审计残留的孤立行或悬空引用。CLI 与 agent 均可调用，默认只读，破坏性操作需二次确认。

description.en: VS Code-style code editor: sidebar file tree over the workspace, Monaco editing, file read/write, Git status and diff, search, and Markdown preview.
description.zh: VS Code 风格代码编辑器：侧边栏文件树浏览工作区，Monaco 编辑，文件读写，Git 状态与差异，搜索与 Markdown 预览。

description.en: Browser-first, LAN-only access to the current DeepSeek Harness Web UI with one-time QR pairing, revocable devices, event-driven diagnostics, and a slot-preserving mobile layout; no companion app, cloud relay, or remote tunnel.
description.zh: 以浏览器为核心、仅限局域网访问当前 DeepSeek Harness Web UI，支持一次性二维码配对、设备撤销、事件驱动诊断和保留插槽的移动端布局；无需配套应用、云中继或远程隧道。

description.en: Listen to Xiaoyuzhou (小宇宙) podcasts in the DSH web UI: paste a share link to play anonymously (host proxies the audio with Range/seek), or log in via QR code to sync subscriptions, keyword-search shows/episodes, page full episode lists, and unlock purchased paywalled episodes; a `podcast_play` tool lets the agent play by link, podcast pid, or episode eid.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面收听小宇宙播客：粘贴分享链接即可免登录播放（host 代理音频流，支持 Range 拖动），扫码登录后同步账号订阅、关键词搜索节目与单集、加载完整单集分页、解锁已购付费单集；注册 `podcast_play` 工具让 agent 按链接、节目 pid 或单集 eid 直接播放。

description.en: A Codex-style conversation navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Codex 式对话导航与预览。

description.en: Whale Girl light theme for the DSH Web UI, ported from a DreamSkin skin package: registers one native runtime theme with a full --dsw-* token remap derived from the source palette, layers the artwork as an ambient fixed wallpaper behind a frosted UI, and pins the theme against appearance-preference resets.
description.zh: 移植自 DreamSkin 皮肤包的鲸鱼娘亮色主题：在原生主题运行时注册一套完整 --dsw-* 令牌重映射，鲸鱼娘插画作为环境壁纸衬于磨砂玻璃界面之后，并通过主题变更守卫保持主题固定。

description.en: Adds subagent_route and subagent_fork_route delegation tools where the model itself picks the provider/model route for each child; the deployment only sets the spawn/fork backend, background policy and allowedProviders allowlist, while continuable children and background jobs reuse the official send_message / job_output tools.
description.zh: 新增 subagent_route 与 subagent_fork_route 委托工具：由模型自主为子代理挑选 provider/model 路由，部署方仅配置 spawn/fork 后端、调度策略与 allowedProviders 白名单；续聊子代理与后台任务复用官方 send_message / job_output 工具。

description.en: Per-execution HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy routing for Agent fetches, LLM providers, and shell commands, with settings-backed hot reload, approval-gated controls, and credential-safe status.
description.zh: 按每次执行为 Agent fetch、LLM provider 与 shell 命令路由 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理；支持 settings 热更新、审批门禁和凭据安全状态。

description.en: Automatic Flash/Pro routing for DeepSeek Harness subagent calls: light tasks run on a cheap model (e.g. V4 Flash), heavy tasks stay on the strong model — with per-call overrides and /delegate session modes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理调用做 Flash/Pro 自动分派：轻任务自动用便宜模型、重任务留在强模型，支持手动覆盖与 /delegate 会话模式。

description.en: DSH Room — Web and Desktop plugin for encrypted multi-agent collaboration
Settings panel for global and per-workspace AGENTS.md, with identity and persona injection, runtime-context toggle, and result notifications.
description.zh: 设置面板管理全局与各工作区 AGENTS.md，支持身份与人设注入、运行时上下文开关和结果通知。

description.en: Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.
description.zh: 无痕会话：独立临时子 Agent（独立 preset 不继承父会话、全量工具集），浮窗可拖动，关闭即焚毁、磁盘零痕迹。

description.en: Adds a markitdown tool that converts PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, CSV, EPUB and URLs to Markdown, using a real Microsoft MarkItDown installation when one is reachable and a bundled dependency-free converter otherwise.
description.zh: 提供 markitdown 工具，把 PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、HTML、CSV、EPUB 与网址转成 Markdown：能找到真实的 Microsoft MarkItDown 时驱动它，否则使用内置的零依赖转换器。

description.en: Streams DeepSeek Harness sessions, messages, tool activity, and turn outcomes to a JARVIS Mission Control board with task status and human review.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话、消息、工具活动与每轮结果实时推送到 JARVIS Mission Control 看板，附任务状态与人工复核。

description.en: Clickable next-step suggestions under every reply; one click sends that sentence as your message.
description.zh: 在每条回复下方给出可点的下一步建议，点一下就把那句话作为你的消息发出去。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local SiYuan (思源笔记) desktop app: registers its note tools as mcp__siyuan__<tool>, exposes the AI configured in SiYuan together with its agent loop as one more tool, ships a notes skill, and enforces a readonly/authoring/full profile on every call while keeping the tool list available when the app is closed.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到本机思源笔记桌面端：把笔记工具注册为 mcp__siyuan__<tool>，额外把思源里配置好的 AI 与其 agent 回路也做成一个工具（按档位门禁），附带笔记使用技能，并在每次调用上执行只读/创作/完整三级策略；思源关闭时工具列表依然可用。

description.en: Set an earlier automatic-compaction threshold per model on DeepSeek Harness: /autocompact writes a session-only override keyed by exact provider/model (off falls back to the backend defaults, default clears it), a Settings → Autocompact page manages the persisted per-model thresholds every session inherits, and a composer status entry shows the current reading.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 按模型设置更早的自动压缩阈值：/autocompact 以精确 provider/model 为键写入仅本会话生效的覆盖值（off 回退后端默认、default 清除覆盖），设置页「自动压缩」管理所有会话继承的持久化逐模型阈值，输入框状态条目显示当前读数。

description.en: Multi-host compatibility matrix, official format-1 market index builder, and a read-only plugin_health tool for DeepSeek Harness plugins.
description.zh: DSH 插件的多宿主兼容矩阵、官方 format-1 市场索引生成器，以及只读的 plugin_health 诊断工具。

description.en: Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer on the right edge of the DSH web UI with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes and stash rows, inline diffs, right-click branch/tag actions, and one-click fetch from all remotes.
description.zh: 专精于 Git 分支与状态处理：Web 右缘 Git 状态浮窗，commit DAG 泳道图、未提交改动与 stash、行内 diff，右键分支/tag 切换、合并、重命名、删除、新建，一键拉取全部远程。

description.en: Distills session work into background observations and reflections to preserve context across compaction.
description.zh: 在后台将会话工作提炼为观察和反思，以便在上下文压缩后保留会话上下文。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice reference_id, encrypted API key, and proxy.
description.zh: 朗读助手回复（仅支持 Fish Audio API，需自备 Key）：逐条朗读、自动朗读开关，设置页可配模型、音色 reference_id、加密 API Key 与代理。

description.en: Plays a short synthesized ding in the browser tab the moment an agent finishes a turn, built entirely with the Web Audio API; no backend audio and no OS notification.
description.zh: agent 回合结束时在浏览器标签页里播放一声合成的叮,纯前端 Web Audio 发音,不经过后端、不弹系统通知。

description.en: Turns a plain-browser DSH session into the WhaleHarbor lite client: a standalone browser --app window with a client-style top bar and task notifications, while the full desktop installer downloads in the background (multi-source, SHA-256 verified) and an install prompt appears when ready.
description.zh: 把浏览器里的 DSH 会话变成鲸港简版客户端：独立 --app 窗口、客户端顶栏与任务通知；后台多源下载完整桌面安装包（SHA-256 校验），完成后提示安装。

description.en: Configurable image recognition for text-only DSH models: attached images are preserved through the DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 adapter pipeline, transcribed by an OpenAI-compatible vision model, and passed to the main model as text. Supports selectable OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Azure auth headers and reports a missing API key before sending a request.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DSH 模型增加可配置识图能力：在 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 中，上传图片会完整通过适配链路，由 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型转写为文字后交给主模型；支持 OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / Azure 风格密钥鉴权，缺少 API Key 时会在发起请求前明确提示。

description.en: Custom branding for the shared DSH Web UI: a Settings → Branding panel for the name, badge, and local logo/wordmark images with size and rounding, live preview, optional page-title brand, and reset to the official look.
description.zh: DSH 共享网页界面的自定义品牌：在「设置 → 品牌」中修改名称、徽章，选择本地 logo 和字标图片并调整大小与圆角、实时预览、可选自定义页面标题、一键恢复官方外观。

description.en: Compaction fix for NInfer-hosted qwen3.8-27b gateways: disables thinking on dsh context-compaction and session-title calls so xhigh reasoning stops burning the whole output budget; the same idea applies to other launch methods, this package targets NInfer only.
description.zh: 针对 NInfer 托管的 qwen3.8-27b 网关的压缩修复：在 dsh 上下文压缩与会话标题调用中关闭思考，避免 xhigh 推理耗尽全部输出预算；同一思路适用于其他启动方式，本包仅面向 NInfer。

description.en: Ranks the models a DeepSeek Harness install already discovered by measured connectivity and speed, and switches to the next candidate inside the same turn when the one in use fails without producing any output. Ships a settings page with a grouped model list, per-model and per-channel switches, and a quota-aware cooldown that rests an exhausted model until the next day.
description.zh: 把本机已发现的 DSH 模型按实测连通性与速度排序，当前模型无输出失败时在同一回合内切到下一个候选。附带设置页：按渠道分组的模型列表、逐模型与逐渠道开关，以及额度耗尽后休息到次日的冷却策略。

description.en: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-events: session-protocol events — auto session-start reminder + auto-save on session close; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools.
description.zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-events：会话协议事件插件——新会话入口提醒 + 会话关闭自动 save；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools 配套使用。

description.en: Use a directory on an SSH host as a DSH workspace — hosts management, directory browser, five agent tools.
description.zh: 通过SSH方式，将远程主机的文件夹当成DSH的工作区，可以在本地DSH控制远程主机工作目录，不需要手动同步、不需要挂载驱动、不需要装任何第三方文件系统

description.en: Official DeepSeek platform monitoring inside the provider card: a live balance chip left of the composer model name plus an expandable account-details panel with per-model monthly usage and a daily stacked chart.
description.zh: 在官方供应商卡片内实时监控 DeepSeek 余额与开放平台用量——输入框工具行模型名称左侧的余额 chip，可展开的账户明细面板含按模型用量与每日堆叠图表。

description.en: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools: 15 schema-validated tools (memory + quality gates) plus an L0 guard of the consulting document-generation engine; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-events for the full session protocol.
description.zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-tools：咨询/汇报材料生成引擎的 15 个 DSH 原生工具（记忆面 + 质量门禁）+ L0 守卫；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-events 配套使用。

description.en: Personal paste inbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): /inbox in the composer or the sidebar panel files links, images, text and credentials into a local vault, classifies them by local rules and then by a rate-capped model pass, and browses, searches and edits them from the panel; the assistant retrieves records on request in conversation, credential bodies stay encrypted at rest, and an optional WebDAV or S3 remote syncs records and attachment bytes. Windows only so far.
description.zh: dsh 的个人收件箱：输入框的 /inbox 或侧栏面板把链接、图片、文本与账密收进本地仓库，先按本地规则、再由有每日上限的模型分类，可在面板里筛选、搜索与编辑；对话里让助手按需检索取回，账密正文加密落盘，可选 WebDAV 或 S3 远端同步记录与附件字节。目前只在 Windows 实测。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DeepSeek Harness: grouped archive panel with restore and delete.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话归档管理：分组归档面板，支持恢复与删除。

description.en: English word bank for one or more children, built for DSH 0.2 and newer (0.2.0-rc.1 and 0.2.0-rc.2 verified, including the desktop shell; 0.1.7 through 0.2.x all work). 1.10 added pronunciation: in the memory cards and in the online quiz every word and every example sentence has a speaker button that reads it aloud with the built-in Windows voice - offline, with no network call and no model call - and the whole batch of audio is pre-rendered in the background whenever cards or an exam are generated, so a click starts instantly. 1.11 adds: pick words in bulk straight from the library (10 at a time, top-down, up to 50 selected, with a live counter); turn the words a child got wrong in a quiz into a one-click review set - an online card page that speaks plus a printable PDF; and every card example sentence now carries its Chinese translation underneath. Words marked on textbook or workbook photos (highlighter, red pen) are found by their marks, then translated and stored in a local SQLite bank with an occurrence count; the clipboard picker, the photo route and dictation all land in the same bank. High-frequency words surface by count, three correct answers in a row flag a word as learned, and any selection prints as a memory card set (a word split into chunks, real IPA per chunk, a grade-7 example sentence, a mnemonic hook, an A4 sheet of eight) in HTML, PDF or Word, with a print-and-answer exam page whose four options are set against each other for meaning. On 0.1.5 the settings panel does not appear - install dsh-word-vault@1.0.2 instead.
description.zh: 一个或多个孩子的英语生词库，面向 DSH 0.2 及以上（0.2.0-rc.1 / 0.2.0-rc.2 实测通过，含桌面版 GUI；0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x 均可使用）。1.10 新增语音发音：记忆卡与在线答题页里，每个单词、每句例句旁都有一个 🔊，点了用 Windows 自带语音朗读——离线、不联网、不调模型；出卡/出卷时还会在后台把整批音频预先合成好，点击即秒开。1.11 新增：词库页一键批量选词（每次 +10 个、从上往下、最多同时 50 个，带实时计数）；考试做错的词可一键出成「能发音的在线复习卡」（在线点读页 + 可打印 PDF）；卡面英文例句下方带中文对照。课本/作业照片上被荧光笔或红笔标出的词按标记找出来，翻译后进本机 SQLite，并累计出现次数；剪贴板点选、拍照、对话三种录入进的是同一本库。高频词按次数浮现，连对三次自动标记「已学会」；勾选任意若干词可出记忆卡（拆解块 + 每块真实 IPA 音标 + 7 年级英文例句 + 荒诞梗，A4 每页 8 张），输出 HTML/PDF/Word，并可出一份四选项按词义互斥的打印试卷作答。在 0.1.5 上设置面板不会出现，可改装 dsh-word-vault@1.0.2。

description.en: Simulated life context for DeepSeek Harness: every turn injects the past 24h of simulated life events from the workspace .life/ directory (sliding-window filter, session-level deduplication with delta updates, world summary) as a collapsed context notice, and the life_react tool lets the agent record feelings, thoughts and actions back into its life log for the next round of world evolution — turning a DSH agent into a roleplay character with a persistent daily life.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 提供拟真生活上下文：每轮对话自动注入工作区 .life/ 目录近 24 小时的生活事件（滑动窗口过滤、会话内智能去重与增量更新、世界近况），并提供 life_react 工具让 Agent 把感受、思考与行动回填到自己的生活日志，反哺下一轮世界演化——把 DSH Agent 变成有日常生活的角色扮演人设（适合酒馆式 RP、AI 陪伴）；配合每日世界演算工作流可获得持续的模拟人生式生活轨迹。

description.en: In-page task notifications with collapsible status toasts, sound, and session navigation.
description.zh: 带可折叠状态通知、提示音与会话跳转的页内任务通知插件。

description.en: Sidebar panel for the announcement file and the ticket status table. It lists the announcements together with how many sessions have seen each one, shows the delivery status, and lets the user post, edit and delete entries. Requires the third-party dsh-better-sidebar plugin.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板：把公告和投递状态表放进 DSH 界面 —— 列出公告以及每条有几个会话见过，并让用户发布、编辑、删除条目。需要第三方插件 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: Context compression for small-context models: visually configure the compressed context budget, default to an 8k handoff + 16k recent context, and keep full history searchable.
description.zh: 面向小上下文模型的 DSH 上下文压缩插件：压缩大小可视化配置，默认 8k 交接摘要 + 16k 最近上下文，完整历史仍可查询。

description.en: JARVIS-style sci-fi HUD shell over the DSH web GUI: electric-cyan VITAL SIGNS / RT-MONITOR / RT-LOG left bar, POWER CORE gauges and a rotating RADAR scan disc on the right with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer with a JARVIS header strip that follows the active workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 JARVIS 风格科幻 HUD 外壳：电光青色 VITAL SIGNS 生命体征 / RT-MONITOR 实时监控 / RT-LOG 事件日志左栏，右侧 POWER CORE 能源核心仪表、旋转扫描的 RADAR 雷达盘与上下行流量图，左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及带 JARVIS 头部横幅、跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。

description.en: Manages multiple Jenkins servers and triggers jobs from a Settings page, model tools, or a per-workspace "Run Jenkins Job" entry, with a bilingual host + browser UI.
description.zh: 管理多台 Jenkins 服务器，支持从设置页、模型工具或工作区级「执行 Jenkins Job」入口触发构建，宿主 + 浏览器双端、界面中英双语。

description.en: OpenViking in the DSH web GUI: a Studio panel, a per-session memory-commit status pill with its commit timeline, and a right-sidebar tab showing what the current session retrieves.
description.zh: 把本地 OpenViking 记忆服务接进 DSH 界面：左侧边栏的 Studio 面板、输入框下方的会话提交状态胶囊与提交时间线，以及右侧边栏查看当前会话检索到哪些记忆的面板。

description.en: Model visibility manager for DeepSeek Harness: hide or show any model in the conversation model selector from a dedicated settings page. Per-model switches, search, provider-level batch actions, reset-all. Zero intrusion - writes only its own hidden list, never the provider config; hiding a model in use never interrupts a running session.
description.zh: DSH 模型可见性管理：在独立的设置分区页里按渠道/模型隐藏或显示模型选择菜单中的条目。逐模型开关、实时搜索、渠道级批量隐藏/显示、一键恢复全部。零侵入——只写插件自己的隐藏列表，不改 Provider 配置，隐藏正在使用的模型不会中断会话。

description.en: A usage and reference-cost panel for DeepSeek Harness with today, 7-day, 30-day, all-time and custom ranges aggregated by hour or day; a model filter and a per-model breakdown of requests, input and output tokens, cache, reference cost and share; a model-share card showing the top four models by total tokens with the rest grouped as others; a configurable per-million-token price table seeded with DeepSeek's prices, with reference cost switchable between ¥ and $ at a fixed 1 USD = 7 CNY; and a yearly heatmap drawn only with theme variables, with no third-party chart library.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的用量与参考成本面板，含今日 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天 / 全部 / 自定义范围并按小时或天聚合；模型筛选与按模型明细（请求数、输入/输出 Token、缓存、参考成本、占比）；按总 Token 显示前 4 个模型、其余归入「其它」的模型占比卡；可配置的每百万 Token 价格表（内置 DeepSeek 常见模型价），参考成本可在 ¥ / $ 间按固定汇率 1 USD = 7 CNY 切换；年度热力图只用主题变量绘制，不引第三方图表库。

description.en: Declutter the DSH settings nav: fold third-party plugin entries under collapsible group rows, with bookmark-style custom groups, a fold toggle, and auto classification (market tags → name rules → your AI model).
description.zh: 设置面板导航整理：第三方插件入口折叠为可展开的分组行，支持书签式自定义分组、折叠开关与自动分类（市场标签 → 名称规则 → AI 模型三级兜底）。

description.en: Replaces the reasoning-effort dropdown with a draggable snapping slider, and draws 13 canvas effects across five style families (thrust, fluid, fantasy, tech, texture) with three tiers that unlock as the effort level rises. Custom mode combines 10 particle forms with 8 flow trajectories; 9 accent presets and a hex picker recolor every effect, and optional key sounds cover two voice clips, a synthesized duck squeak, a mechanical click and a local audio file.
description.zh: 把推理强度下拉菜单换成可拖拽吸附的滑块，并提供 13 款 Canvas 动效，分属推进、流体、幻境、科技、质感五个家族；动效随推理档位分三阶递进解锁。客制动效可自由组合 10 种粒子形态与 8 种流动轨迹；9 款预设主题色与 Hex 拾色器让全部动效跟随变色，档位吸附音效支持两段语音、合成鸭子叫、机械微触感与本地音频文件。

description.en: AOCI cognition panel for DSH: multi-workspace AOCI overview, per-repo index and governance view, MCP binding diagnosis, and guided or batch initialization. Governance, verification and guided/batch initialization require the external aoci CLI on the host; index browsing works without it.
description.zh: DSH 的 AOCI 认知面板：多工作区总览、单仓库索引与治理视图、MCP 绑定诊断，以及引导式/批量初始化。治理、校验与引导式/批量初始化需宿主机装有 aoci CLI；仅浏览索引不需要。

description.en: Bridge DeepSeek Harness agent sessions into Feishu (Lark) chats over the official SDK long connection, with a streaming reply card, many bots per instance, and mention-gated group replies.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 会话接进飞书（Lark）：官方 SDK 长连接收发、流式回复卡片、单实例多 bot、群里 @ 才回复。

description.en: Flyout sidebar with a file tree, uncommitted-changes list and multi-tab file/diff previews; pops out into a standalone browser tab.
description.zh: 可弹出侧边栏：文件树、Git 未提交变更列表与多标签文件/diff 预览，一键弹出为独立浏览器标签页。

description.en: Unified plugin marketplace built for the DSH Desktop (EAC) shell, aggregating the curated catalog, the GitHub dsh-plugin ecosystem and the npm registry into one storefront, with source whitelisting, conflict pre-checks, trial-boot install verification, manual/batch/auto updates and .dshpack feature-pack management.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop（EAC）桌面壳的统一插件市场：聚合精选目录、GitHub dsh-plugin 生态与 npm registry 三源，提供来源白名单、冲突预检、试装安装验证、手动/批量/自动三档更新与功能包（.dshpack）管理。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DSH desktop sessions from the host process: turn ends, approvals, questions and a reminder for an unanswered wait, with a selectable sound per situation and imported custom sound files; clicking a toast raises the DSH window.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端会话的 Windows 原生 Toast 通知（宿主侧）：回合结束、审批、提问与未应答催办，按情况可选音效并支持导入自定义音效；点击通知把 DSH 窗口拉回前台。

description.en: Audible feedback for the DSH web interface: button presses are classified by semantics (normal, primary, toggle, send, close, danger, link) and the current session's task transitions (started, finished, failed) plus any pending interaction play a cue, each scenario with its own cue picker and switch on a settings page. All 78 cues and 12 sound packs are synthesised in the browser with the Web Audio API, so the package ships no audio files and makes no network request. A community port of dsh-plugin-uisfx to DSH 0.2.0, with the ported changes recorded in PROVENANCE.md.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面补上可听的语义反馈：按钮按下按语义分类发声（普通、主要、开关、发送、关闭、危险、链接），当前会话的任务开始、成功结束、失败结束以及出现待处理交互也各有一声，每个情景都能在设置页单独挑音效、单独开关。78 个 cue 与 12 个音色包全部由浏览器用 Web Audio API 实时合成，因此包里不含音频文件、也不发起网络请求。这是 dsh-plugin-uisfx 向 DSH 0.2.0 的社区移植版，改动逐条记录在 PROVENANCE.md。

description.en: Draft polish for the DSH composer: one-click AI polish of the input draft (sparkles button next to send), with optional conversation context and a configurable model channel.
description.zh: DSH 输入框草稿润色：发送键左侧一键调用 LLM 润色草稿，可携带会话上下文，模型渠道可配置。

description.en: Message and attachment editing with save-only updates, forked regeneration, and a version timeline for DSH desktop.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 桌面端的消息与附件编辑，支持原地保存、分支重生成和版本时间线。

description.en: Review tab for DeepSeek Harness sessions: workspace changes versus HEAD or any two refs as a filterable file tree with side-by-side diffs, a lane commit graph with blame and file history, three-scope search, line comments back to the composer, and guarded stage/commit/branch/tag/stash/conflict operations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话审查标签页：工作区相对 HEAD 或任意两 ref 的变更，以可过滤文件树加双列差异呈现；泳道提交图带逐行追溯与单文件历史；三范围搜索；行内评论回写对话输入框；暂存、提交、分支、标签、贮藏与冲突操作全部设防。

description.en: 二游活动/卡池排期抓取核心：11 款游戏的来源注册表 + 解析器 + 刷新编排 + 缓存降级。零依赖、零宿主环境依赖，任何 JS 运行时（浏览器扩展 background / Tauri / JavaScriptCore / ArkTS 嵌入式引擎）都能跑。

Two-way bridge between GNU Emacs and a running DeepSeek Harness session over loopback HTTP + SSE: submit prompts, stream replies, manage sessions and workspaces, and answer ask-user/approval prompts from Emacs, with a Plugins-page card that installs the Emacs package.
description.zh: GNU Emacs 与正在运行的 DSH 会话之间的双向桥：走本机回环 HTTP + SSE，可在 Emacs 里提交提示、流式收回复、管理会话与工作区、回答 ask-user / 审批提示；插件页还有一张卡片用来安装 Emacs 那边的包。

description.en: Unofficial FreeCodeGo for DeepSeek Harness: DeepSeek, Codex and Claude engines over one session and toolchain, with a 0-token free access channel for deepseek-v4.1-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash-free, glm-5.3-flash, grok-4.6, kimi-k3, nemotron-3-ultra-free, muse-spark-1.3, Qwen 3.8 Flash and mimo-v2.6-flash-free, plus a keyless private-key gateway.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 FreeCodeGo：DeepSeek、Codex、Claude 三套引擎共用同一条会话与工具链，并为以下模型提供 0 token 免费使用渠道：deepseek-v4.1-flash、deepseek-v4-pro、deepseek-v4-flash-free、glm-5.3-flash、grok-4.6、kimi-k3、nemotron-3-ultra-free、muse-spark-1.3、Qwen 3.8 Flash、mimo-v2.6-flash-free，另有零注册的私钥网关。

description.en: SQL connection, catalog, query, and result workbench for the official DSH right Sidebar.

Task-scoped git worktrees for DSH: durable per-repo manifest, worktree mode injects a creation instruction with your first message under an automatic worktree/ branch prefix, header badge instead of workspace clutter, and bring-back or force-remove cleanup.
description.zh: 任务级 git worktree：per-repo manifest 持久保存；Worktree 模式在首条消息注入创建指引并统一 worktree/ 分支前缀，头部徽标替代工作区注册，支持带回主目录或强制删除收尾。

description.en: An RTS-style orchestration dashboard where commands replace chats: a resident commander agent decomposes each order into task briefs with acceptance criteria, typed subagent troops (recon/engineer/medic/scribe) execute them across isolated workspaces, and every session is indexed by the order that started it.
description.zh: RTS 风格编排看板：用命令取代会话——常驻大副 agent 把舰长命令拆成带验收标准的任务书，侦察/工程/医疗/书记四类小队在隔离工作区执行，所有会话按发起命令索引归队。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for Assistant Policy.
A task-contract and completion-certification layer for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 避免 DSH Agent 在长任务中忘记你的要求：它会把重要条件和完成依据保存在本机，在上下文压缩或恢复会话后重新带回，防止漏掉关键限制，或只做完一部分就说整个任务已经完成。

description.en: Git worktrees for DeepSeek Harness — isolate parallel work in its own directory and branch. Ships Fast mode (快速模式).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 管理 git worktree —— 让并行工作各自隔离在自己的目录与分支里。自带快速模式（Fast mode）。

description.en: User-only instruction memory for DSH: long-term instructions maintained in the settings UI and auto-injected into every conversation — the model has no write access. 指令记忆：只由用户在设置页维护的长期指令，自动注入此后每轮对话；模型没有任何写入口。
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置界面维护常驻指令，自动注入此后每一轮对话的系统提示词。

description.en: Adds a Batch Uninstall page to the DSH settings dialog: a checklist of every installed bundle with multi-select, select-all, a confirmation dialog and per-plugin progress, where official bundles stay locked and each removal goes through the host pluginManager service.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增「批量卸载」页面：勾选多个已安装插件批量移除，支持全选、二次确认与逐条进度，官方 bundle 自动锁定，删除统一走宿主 pluginManager 服务。

description.en: SparkElf-maintained fork of dsh-quant: AI-native & DSH-native quant toolkit — 59 tools across 6 pluggable domains (data/alpha/ML/risk/execution), one end-to-end PDAT→PET research pipeline. Fork adds A-share-correct annualization, cross-sectional IC, and u

Schedule a message into a dsh chat for later: a Schedule button in the message box with a date and time picker, a sidebar panel of pending messages across chats, delivery as a normal user message even with the browser closed, and schedule_message, list_scheduled_messages and cancel_scheduled_message tools so the model can come back to a chat on its own.
description.zh: 把消息排进 dsh 会话稍后再发：消息框里带日期与时间选择器的「定时」按钮、跨会话列出待发消息的侧栏面板、浏览器关着也由宿主按时投递成一条普通用户消息，以及 schedule_message / list_scheduled_messages / cancel_scheduled_message 三个工具，模型因而能自己回到某个会话。

description.en: Profile-aware keyboard shortcuts for DSH Web: supports Question and Approval cards, Standard/Vim/Custom profiles, and capability-gated Session and Workspace navigation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供按 profile 管理的键盘快捷键：支持 Question 和 Approval 卡片、Standard/Vim/Custom 配置，并按能力提供 Session 与 Workspace 导航。

description.en: LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness providing diagnostics, formatting, rename, code actions, and symbols over real language servers.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的通用 LSP 工具面，提供语言服务器诊断、格式化、重命名、代码动作与符号导航。

description.en: Fireworks celebration engine: floats fireworks above the chat window while the agent codes — welcome show, per-turn salutes, tool sparks, milestone celebrations, a finish finale and a dud on failure; each event type has its own fireworks card group with random variants, and token usage decides firework size, height and splendour.
description.zh: 烟花庆祝引擎：agent 编程时漂浮在对话窗口上空放烟花——开场迎宾、回合礼花、工具星花、里程碑大礼、收工终场、失败哑炮，每类事件一张烟花属性卡组，组内多变种随机抽取，token 用量决定烟花的大小、高度与绚烂程度。

description.en: Bridges Multica to DeepSeek Harness through a versioned JSONL process protocol.
description.zh: 通过版本化 JSONL 进程协议将 Multica 接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Content-degradation detection (thinking loops, output repetition) for DeepSeek Harness, with a continue-vs-handoff cost verdict and zero-model handoff documents.
description.zh: 内容退化检测（思考打转、输出复读）+ 继续/交接成本裁决 + 零模型交接文档。

description.en: Self-tending living memory in one local SQLite file — a nightly patrol dedupes, merges, decays and cross-links entries on its own, with seven-signal RRF hybrid recall (FTS5 + jieba Chinese-first tokenization, optional vector KNN, graph PPR), a typed knowledge graph, conflict detection instead of silent overwrites, and web telemetry panels.
description.zh: 单文件本地 SQLite 的自整理活记忆——夜巡引擎自动去重、合并、衰减、建链，七信号 RRF 混合检索（FTS5+jieba 中文优先分词、可选向量 KNN、图谱 PPR），带类型知识图谱，冲突检测标记矛盾而非静默覆写，Web 遥测面板。

description.en: Academic tools in TypeScript, no Python or MCP server: the Zotero library through its local API or zotero.org (search, annotations, full text, citation export; add by DOI / arXiv id, notes and tags when writing is turned on), starting Zotero when it is closed; paper search across arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, PubMed and Europe PMC, plus CNKI and Google Scholar through a browser window; open-access full text, citations from the DOI registry, reference checking; 11 bundled skills.
description.zh: 学术工具，TypeScript 实现，不需要 Python 或 MCP 服务：通过本地 API 或 zotero.org 访问 Zotero 文库（检索、批注、全文、导出引文；开启写入后可按 DOI / arXiv 编号入库、写笔记、改标签），Zotero 没开时自动启动；同时检索 arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref、Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Europe PMC，并通过浏览器窗口检索知网和 Google Scholar；阅读开放获取全文、从 DOI 注册机构取引文、核验参考文献；内置 11 个学术技能。

description.en: Voice call assistant for the DSH desktop app and the Web GUI (the same plugin, only the profile name differs): a draggable floating call ball, browser-side VAD that sends each utterance after a pause, speech recognition through the local SenseVoice model already downloaded by the official voice-input plugin (no second model), FunASR HTTP or streaming, or a cloud-compatible API, MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS (director mode and voice clone) / OpenAI-compatible TTS replies, an optional wake-word mode with auto-sleep, and task dispatch to separate sessions with progress, stop, and spoken completion reports.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端与 Web GUI 通用（同一份插件，只是 profile 名不同）的个人语音通话助手：可拖拽悬浮球通话面板、浏览器端 VAD（停顿自动发送）、语音识别可选本地 SenseVoice（复用官方「语音输入」插件已下载的模型，免装第二份模型）/ FunASR HTTP 或流式 / 云端兼容 API、MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS（含导演模式与音色克隆）/ OpenAI 兼容 TTS 语音回复、可开关的唤醒词模式（沉默自动休眠），以及把任务分发给独立子会话并跟踪进度、停止与完成播报。

description.en: A dsh web plugin that wraps the running Harness in a native Windows desktop window: it bundles a Wails v3 desktop client (so installing the plugin is enough), probes the web port and writes the ~/.dsh/dsh-web-port.json protocol file for the client, registers a system tray, desktop/Start Menu shortcuts and a startup autostart toggle, and the client can start dsh itself if it is not running.
description.zh: 把 dsh web 界面封装成原生 Windows 桌面窗口，内置桌面客户端，带系统托盘、开机自启与协议文件分发。

description.en: Adds a restart row to Settings → General that relaunches dsh web with the same invocation through a detached helper, refuses under a detected systemd supervisor unless allowRestart is true, and tests whether the listening port is free by connecting to it rather than binding it.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 通用」增加一行重启按钮：用相同启动参数、经分离的 helper 重新拉起 dsh web；检测到 systemd 监管时默认拒绝（除非 allowRestart 为 true）；判断端口是否空闲用连接探测而非绑定。

description.en: Use locally authenticated coding subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness model providers.

Monitor the account balance for 3rd-party services those AI agents often use, such as Tavily, SerpAPI, Firecrawl, Bocha, Tinyfish, etc. Optionally you can select to inject the account balance into the system prompt, so the agent can use the services accordingly.
description.zh: 监控 AI Agents 常用的第三方服务余额，如 Tavily、SerpAPI、Firecrawl、博查、Tinyfish 等。可选支持将服务的余额注入 System Prompt，以便 Agent 合理使用相关服务。

description.en: Model pricing for the DSH settings page: ~7,250 models / 213 providers with the harness catalog overlaid, honest lowest-listed comparison, session costs priced by the actual route, cache-leak attribution, and a verified promotion feed.
description.zh: DSH 设置页中的模型价格表：约 7,250 个模型 / 213 个提供商（叠加本地路由目录），诚实的最低标价比较、按实际路由计价的会话成本、缓存泄漏归因，以及经验证的促销信息源。

description.en: Generates editable PPTX decks in DSH with a bundled authoring Skill, deterministic PPTD scene checks, native PowerPoint objects, and local PPTD source-project delivery.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用包内编排 Skill、确定性 PPTD 场景检查和原生 PowerPoint 对象生成可编辑 PPTX，并在本地交付 PPTD 源项目。

description.en: Comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing trail glides to the text position, with configurable accent color, thickness, trail, and a 500 ms idle blink. Extends the surface to ask-question card inputs, and fixes the caret vanishing on an empty composer or first focus, forward drag-selection not following the pointer, soft line breaks measuring against the previous line, and the caret painting outside the composer when long input scrolls. Maintained fork of Lacquervii/smooth-cursor.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的彗星光标：发光拖尾随文字位置平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细、拖尾，并在静止 500ms 后呼吸。覆盖 ask-question 交互卡片的输入框，并修复空输入框或首次聚焦时光标消失、正向拖选不跟随鼠标、软换行按上一行测量、长内容滚动时光标绘制到输入框之外等问题。Lacquervii/smooth-cursor 的维护分支。

description.en: Read-only Git panel for the current workspace — branch, changed files, diffs and image before/after compare — plus three capsules above the composer (Git status, tool and skill activity, session running time) and per-session change attribution with review progress.
description.zh: 当前工作区的只读 Git 面板：分支、改动清单、差异与图片前后对比，外加输入框上方的三枚胶囊（Git 状态、工具与技能活动、会话运行时长），以及本会话改动归因与审阅进度。

description.en: Tavily Search API as a web search provider (settings toggle with DeepSeek fallback, keyless search) plus a Tavily MCP bridge: keyless search and extract tools, crawl and map with an API key.
description.zh: Tavily 网页搜索：设置页开关，关闭时回落到 DeepSeek 内置搜索；免密钥可用搜索与内容提取，配置 API Key 后解锁爬取与站点地图等 MCP 工具。

description.en: RainbowSpeak — a flowing rainbow marquee border around the chat composer card, driven by a conic-gradient ring. Live settings for speed, width, seven color schemes, direction, sides and breathing, plus session-state awareness that reacts to running, attention, error and celebration moments.
description.zh: 虹语（RainbowSpeak）——沿聊天输入框边界持续流动的彩虹跑马灯，由锥形渐变环带驱动。支持流速、宽度、七种配色、方向、边与呼吸效果的实时设置，并具备会话状态感知：运行中加速、需关注变琥珀、出错红脉冲、庆祝闪动。

description.en: Desk-to-desk tickets between sessions on one machine. A session says which desk it belongs to by putting a number prefix in its title; a ticket names one desk and is taken by the first session of that desk to start working, so the desk is the address and a ticket is not delivered to a session that is just passing by.
description.zh: 同一台电脑上会话之间的「单子」：会话用标题里的编号前缀表明自己属于哪张桌；单子投给某张桌，由那张桌最先开始干活的那个会话取走 —— 桌是地址，路过的会话不会收到它。

description.en: Firecrawl MCP bridge: hosted Firecrawl MCP server with keyless search, scrape and parse; an API key unlocks the full tool surface including crawl and map.
description.zh: 接入 Firecrawl 托管 MCP 服务：免密钥即可使用搜索、抓取与解析（有每日额度），配置 API Key 后解锁完整工具集，含爬取与站点地图。

description.en: Floating PR/review status bar for DeepSeek Harness: a shell.overlay bar with a docked detail pane and an exploded review board.
Model Health panel in Settings: lists every model configured in settings.yaml and batch-tests availability and latency for each.
description.zh: 设置页「模型健康」面板：列出 settings.yaml 配置的全部模型，一键批量测试可用性与延迟。

description.en: Context7 MCP bridge: gives the model up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples through the Context7 MCP server, keyless by default.
description.zh: 接入 Context7 托管 MCP 服务，为 agent 提供随版本更新的库文档查询；默认免密钥可用。

description.en: Import local Codex CLI/Desktop, Claude Code CLI, and Claude Desktop conversations into DSH with project grouping, semantic history, and tool activity; bind an existing or replacement workspace and continue with the DSH Agent.
description.zh: 将本地 Codex CLI/Desktop、Claude Code CLI 和 Claude Desktop 会话导入 DSH：按项目分组，保留语义历史和工具活动，可绑定原工作区或新工作区，并由 DSH Agent 继续对话。

description.en: Cone crusher selection and crushing-plant design for MACKORN NH/NS single-cylinder hydraulic cone crushers: requirement-form intake, equipment selection, plant configuration, proposal generation, product-size simulation and field-data calibration. 21 tools, 6 skills, an MCP server, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: MACKORN NH/NS 单缸液压圆锥破碎机的选型与破碎筛分生产线设计：需求表录入、设备选型、整线配置、方案书生成、产品粒度仿真与实测标定。21 个工具、6 个技能、一个 MCP 服务器，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Analyzes conversation images through mode-specific prompts (caption, UI, document, grounding, topology, etc.) and injects structured evidence with coordinate primitives (boxes, points, refs) as text, with session-level caching for reuse across replay and compaction.
description.zh: 通过模式化提示分析对话图片（描述、UI、文档、定位、拓扑等），将含坐标原语（框、点、引用）的结构化证据以文本注入上下文，会话级缓存跨回放与压缩复用。

description.en: Skill that fact-checks a claim against the open web rather than model memory: it splits the claim into independently checkable fact points, routes each point to the primary-source ladder for its domain (policy, academic, medical, financial, disaster and accidents, food safety, science, education, sports, entertainment, judicial, and more), searches domestic and international ecosystems in parallel, fetches primary pages, grades sources by type, re-searches with debunking keywords, and reports conclusion-first with a full URL and citation position behind every statement, keeping unverified and undecidable points separate from confirmed ones. Three factual judgements can be routed to a TypeSafe Jev (System One) decision model when a key is configured, falling back to the skill's deterministic rules when it is not; a model verdict can only lower a confidence tier.
description.zh: 事实核查技能：不依赖模型记忆，去公开互联网核实——把论断拆成可独立验证的事实点，先按事实范畴（政策、学术、医疗、金融、灾害事故、食品安全、科学常识、教育考试、体育、娱乐名人、司法案件等）选定该范畴的一手来源阶梯，国内外信息生态并行搜索，抓取一手页面并按来源类型分级，再用质疑关键词反查一轮，最后结论先行地输出报告，每条论断都带完整 URL 与引用位置，「未证实」「无法裁定」与「已证实」分档呈现。三类事实判断在配置了密钥时可交给 TypeSafe Jev（System One）决策模型，未配置则回退到内置的确定性规则；模型的判断只能降档、不能升档。

description.en: Read-only Odoo tools over JSON-RPC: server info, model field introspection, and a restricted search_read limited to an allow list of models whose domain field names may not contain dots, so related-record traversal is not possible.
