A draft-create tool is registered only when allowWrite is enabled, and is limited to sale.order and project.task with the draft state enforced by the plugin.
description.zh: 经 JSON-RPC 的 Odoo 只读工具：服务器信息、模型字段自省，以及受限的 search_read——仅限白名单模型，且 domain 字段名不允许包含点号，因此无法沿关联关系穿透。草稿创建工具需显式开启 allowWrite 才会注册，且仅限 sale.order 与 project.task，草稿状态由插件强制。

description.en: A thin Feishu/Lark WebSocket adapter for the durable DSH assistant-delivery core.

Study coach for DeepSeek Harness: turns a course into a knowledge map of subject, module and unit, records mastery per unit in six stages, plans daily tasks against a materials index, keeps a wrong-answer book and spaced-repetition cards, and serves its own web panel.
description.zh: DSH 的学习教练：把一门课拆成知识地图（大类 / 模块 / 最小单元），逐单元记六档掌握度，按资料索引排每日任务，带错题本与记忆卡，并自带一个网页面板。

description.en: Git-backed, workspace-scoped memory for the DeepSeek Harness (global layer + per-workspace layers)

See how you have been using AI: `/session-insights` reviews your DSH sessions over time, shows what worked, which problems kept coming back, and what results were actually produced, then creates a retrospective report on your machine.
description.zh: 回头看看你是怎么使用 AI 的：`/session-insights` 会整理一段时间内的 DSH 会话，找出哪些做法有效、哪些问题总在重复、最终真正留下了哪些成果，并生成一份保存在本机的复盘报告。

description.en: Plugin center for DeepSeek Harness: installed-plugin metadata, a community market with stars and versions, one-click install and update, and a What's New dialog.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件中心：已安装插件信息、带星标与版本号的社区市场、一键安装与更新，以及启动时的更新日志弹窗。

description.en: Lets the model trigger compaction itself at a safe point via a compact_now tool (works mid-turn), plus a context_status tool reporting real token usage against the session's actual context window.
description.zh: 让模型自己挑安全时机触发压缩：提供 compact_now 工具（回合进行中也能用），另有 context_status 工具，按会话真实的上下文窗口报告 token 占用。

description.en: Read web novels inside the DSH web GUI: import legado book sources, search across them, keep a bookshelf with reading progress, read in one continuous scroll, import local TXT and EPUB books, and let agent tools reach the same sources, shelf and text.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 里读网络小说：导入 legado 书源、跨源搜索、带进度的书架、连续滚动阅读、导入本地 TXT 与 EPUB，并让 AI 助手工具接到同一套书源、书架与正文上。

description.en: Activity overview pane for the DSH web UI: running, awaiting-response and recent sessions with child agents, progress, model and reasoning level in one sidebar pane.
description.zh: DSH Web 活动会话总览窗格：将运行中、等待响应与近期活跃的会话集中到一个侧边窗格，含子代理层级、进度、模型与推理级别。

description.en: Browser tab favicon mirrors the DSH session state (idle / running / asking / done), recolored and animated from one base SVG entirely in the browser, with colors and effects configurable from the Settings page.
description.zh: 浏览器标签页 favicon 实时反映 DSH 会话状态（待机 / 运行中 / 提问 / 完成）：单个 base.svg 在浏览器端上色与动画，颜色与特效均可在设置页配置。

description.en: Read-only Sentry tools: project listing, issue search at organization or project scope, single issue detail, and the latest or a specific event with a trimmed stacktrace. Local variables, request headers and bodies, query strings, packages and secret-looking tags are removed before the event reaches the model, and oversized events degrade through source context, breadcrumbs and frames rather than failing.
description.zh: 面向 Sentry 的只读工具：项目列表、组织或项目范围的议题搜索、单个议题详情，以及最新或指定 event 的裁剪后堆栈。局部变量、请求头与请求体、查询字符串、依赖清单以及疑似机密的 tag 会在 event 交给模型前移除；超大 event 会依次降级源码上下文、面包屑与栈帧，而不是直接失败。

description.en: Plugin index inside DSH that lists over 10,000 third-party plugins checked against the dsh.bundle manifest in their package.json rather than by star count, with one-click install and a companion website.
description.zh: DSH 内的插件索引，收录 1 万余个按 package.json 里的 dsh.bundle 声明校验过的第三方插件（不按星数判定），支持一键安装，另有配套网站。

description.en: Web search provider for the ctx.web seam that routes the DeepSeek web_search tool through a LiteLLM proxy using the OpenAI Responses API, reusing LITELLM_API_KEY.
description.zh: ctx.web 搜索提供方：通过 LiteLLM 代理走 OpenAI Responses API 调用 DeepSeek 原生服务端 web_search，复用 LITELLM_API_KEY，无需新密钥。

description.en: Notifies you with a browser notification and toast whenever a session turn ends, with 5-language templates and custom presets.
description.zh: 会话轮次结束时推送浏览器系统通知与页内提示，内置 5 种语言模板与自定义预设。

description.en: Image generation with a sidebar gallery page and three agent tools (paint_image, paint_images, edit_painting); preset providers include ModelScope, Google Gemini, OpenAI, SiliconFlow, Volcengine Seedream, Alibaba DashScope, xAI and Zhipu, plus any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, each with its own proxy setting.
description.zh: 图像生成：侧边栏画廊页面和三个 Agent 工具（paint_image、paint_images、edit_painting）；预置 ModelScope、Google Gemini、OpenAI、硅基流动、火山方舟 Seedream、阿里云百炼、xAI、智谱等服务商，也可接入任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，每个服务商可单独设置代理。

description.en: Branch-role guard for AI coding agents: configurable integration/preview/production/archive roles, blocking direct push, force-push and delete on protected branches and agent merges into production/archive.
description.zh: AI 编码智能体分支角色守卫：可配置集成/预览/生产/归档角色，拦截对受保护分支的直接推送、强推与删除，以及智能体对生产/归档分支的合并。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for Assistant Deepseek Budget.
Use a local TraeX coding agent as a DeepSeek Harness model provider over ACP.

Git server: embeds ts-gogs (a TypeScript reimplementation of Gogs) and serves a full Git service on its own port — HTTP clone/push, web UI, issues/PRs/wiki — reusing user-management credentials, start/stop from the settings page.
description.zh: Git 服务器：内嵌 ts-gogs（Gogs 的 TypeScript 平替），独立端口跑完整 Git 服务（HTTP clone/push、网页端、issue/PR/wiki），可复用 user-management 的用户名密码，设置页一键启停。

description.en: Electrical and electronics calculation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: every computation runs through dedicated tools on self-describing complex value objects in SI base units, with an isolated calculation agent preset and a records panel that archives every solve on disk.
description.zh: DSH 电气电子计算插件：所有计算都通过专用工具完成，基于 SI 基本单位的自描述复数值对象；附带隔离的计算智能体预设与记录面板，每次求解落盘存档。

description.en: A durable capability-gap, approval and staged plugin activation control plane for DSH.

Workspace-wide sticky notes on an infinite canvas: notes are plain Markdown files, created manually, captured from conversations, or distilled by the AI, and can be handed back as context; ships 12 model tools and 5 bundled skills for creating, tagging, arranging, comparing and merging notes.
description.zh: 工作区级的无限画布便签：便签以 Markdown 文件保存，可手动创建、从对话中摘录或由 AI 提炼生成，并能作为上下文提供给 AI 使用；附带 12 个模型工具与 5 个内置技能，用于创建、打标签、整理、比较与合并便签。

description.en: Floating one-line widget showing how much Alibaba Cloud credit is left (voucher balance + account balance), with voucher face value, used amount and earliest expiry on hover. Read-only BSS queries, no spend tracking.
description.zh: 界面悬浮一行显示「还能花的钱」= 阿里云代金券余额 + 账户余额；悬停看券面值、已用与最早失效时间。只读 BSS 存量，不做消费统计。

description.en: A durable, fenced cold-start scheduler and isolated Agent runner for DeepSeek Harness.

An announcement file shared by several agent sessions on one machine. It is a plain text file the agents only append to; before each step a session receives the entries it has not seen yet, a new session catches up on the ones still in effect, and a session whose context was compacted gets them re-sent.
description.zh: 同一台电脑上多个会话共用的公告文件：一个只许追加的纯文本文件。每个会话在下一步之前收到自己还没见过的条目；新会话补看仍在有效期内的；上下文被压缩过的会话会收到一次重发。

description.en: Browser provider for DeepSeek Harness: hand it a web task — open a page, click, type, fill a form, read what is on it — and it drives a real browser step by step, seeing an indexed table of what can be done on the current page instead of raw HTML or screenshots. Each step is one bundled-Jev decision rather than a full model turn (1.1 s median per step versus 2.8–3.6 s for chat-model turns in the repo benchmark), and the main conversation receives only the conclusion, so its context does not grow with the page. Targets come from the page it just read and a changed page is re-read rather than clicked blind, and it runs in the browser that Session owns, leaving your everyday Chrome untouched unless you switch to attach mode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 浏览器插件：把网页任务交给它——打开页面、点击、输入、填表、读取页面内容——它会驱动真实浏览器一步步完成，每步只看到“当前页面能做什么”的索引表，而不是原始 HTML 或截图。每步由内置 Jev 引擎决策一次，而非大模型整轮推理（仓库基准中每步决策中位 1.1 秒，大模型整轮 2.8–3.6 秒）；主对话只收到结论，上下文不随页面变长。目标取自它刚读到的页面，页面变化就重新读取而非盲点；每个会话用自己的浏览器，不碰你日常的 Chrome（除非切到 attach 模式）。

description.en: Read-only SonarQube Community Build tools: instance status, project Quality Gate for a branch or pull request, issue and Security Hotspot search, single hotspot detail, and coverage, duplication or caller-selected measures. Issue and hotspot results carry a normalized location with component key, file path, line and text range.
description.zh: 面向 SonarQube Community Build 的只读工具：实例状态、分支或 PR 的项目质量阈、议题与安全热点搜索、单个热点详情，以及覆盖率、重复率或调用方指定的度量项。议题与热点结果附带标准化的位置信息，包含组件 key、文件路径、行号与文本范围。

description.en: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db and recommends plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files.
description.zh: 只读仓库体检引导工具（repo_setup_scan）：识别技术栈/测试/文档/git/数据库线索，给出插件、MCP 与卫生文件的安装建议。

description.en: Human-governed cross-session memory spaces with independent source and consumer relationships, provenance, versioning, and pre-send injection review.
description.zh: 用户治理的跨会话记忆空间，提供独立的来源与使用关系、来源追踪、版本管理和发送前注入检查。

description.en: Think tank: a built-in library of 161 classic mental models (decision/strategy/cognition/psychology/communication/learning/system/innovation/execution) — enter one question and several selected models analyze it in parallel via AI, producing a synthesized report with consensus, disagreements, blind spots and an action checklist; supports both automatic analysis and prompt round-trip import.
description.zh: 智囊团：内置 161 个经典思维模型库（决策/战略/认知/心理/沟通/学习/系统/创新/执行九大分类），输入一个问题即可用选中的多个模型并行 AI 分析，产出含共识/分歧/盲区/行动清单的综合报告页；支持自动分析与提示词往返导入两种模式。

description.en: Read-only Grafana tools that query metrics through the data source proxy: instance health, data source listing, instant and range PromQL queries, current alert state, and provisioned alert rules. Range queries downsample to a point budget; an explicitly supplied step that would exceed it is rejected rather than silently changed, so the model never receives data at a resolution it did not ask for.
description.zh: 面向 Grafana 的只读工具，经数据源代理查询指标：实例健康、数据源列表、instant 与 range PromQL 查询、当前告警状态与已配置的告警规则。range 查询会按点数预算降采样；调用方显式指定的 step 若会超量则直接拒绝，而不是静默改写，避免模型拿到与预期不同分辨率的数据。

description.en: Skill Center panel for the current session: lists the visible skills with their provider and source root, renders each SKILL.md, toggles model and user invocation, and creates or soft-deletes skills; ships a skill-authoring skill and the skill_create tool.
description.zh: 当前会话的技能中心面板：列出可见技能及其提供方与来源根目录，阅读 SKILL.md，开关模型/用户调用，并可创建、软删除技能；随包附带 skill-authoring 技能与 skill_create 工具。

description.en: Standalone mobile surface for dsh: scan-to-pair device trust, realtime SSE sync, three-channel completion notifications (in-app / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram), offline outbox, approval & question panels, per-provider usage meters, PWA; a native narrow-screen phone UI.
description.zh: dsh 的独立手机端界面：扫码配对设备信任、实时 SSE 同步、三通道完成通知（应用内 / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram）、离线发件箱、审批与提问面板、多提供方用量卡、PWA；从零为窄屏设计的原生手机 UI。

description.en: WeChat (personal WeChat, iLink Bot API) channel: chat with your DSH agent from WeChat, with images, files and voice-note transcription. One WeChat conversation can hold several DSH Sessions (/new, /list, /use) and every option is editable from the settings page. Also published to npm as dsh-plugin-weixin.
description.zh: 微信（个人微信，iLink Bot API）通道：在微信里直接对话 DSH agent，支持图片、文件收发与语音转写。一个微信会话可挂多条 DSH 会话（/new、/list、/use 切换，切走不销毁），全部配置项都能在设置页里查看和修改。已上架 npm（dsh-plugin-weixin）。

description.en: A full-screen terminal workbench for DeepSeek Harness with a durable assistant, workspace-grouped project sessions, transcript-only scrolling, and structured thinking, tool, diff, plan, and subagent views.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端工作台，提供独立持久助手、按工作区分组的项目会话、仅聊天区滚动，以及结构化思考、工具、diff、计划和子代理视图。

description.en: Local media library management and playback powered by dsh Web: responsive on PC and mobile with touch swipe reels, instant seeking and on-the-fly transcoding.
description.zh: 基于 dsh 内置 Web 服务管理、浏览与播放本地媒体库，完美适配 PC 与移动端，支持手势上下滑动刷视频、即时拖拽秒播与实时转码。

description.en: Full-screen lightbox for chat images: click any image to open the full-resolution original with zoom (wheel, buttons, shortcuts), drag panning, prev/next paging, filename caption and download, plus keyboard-arrow and touch-swipe navigation. One "image display control" popover next to the composer collapses every image in the conversation into a thumbnail grid whose column count (1-12) is configurable and remembered, or hides them entirely so the space closes up and restores them later; images are styled in place and no node is ever moved or reparented. The host-side display_image tool takes a local path or directory (TIFF/HEIC transcoded, originals still saved on download), a remote URL, or a keyword search over Bing, Huaban and Sogou that samples loadability before picking a source, re-saves images blocked by hotlink protection and drops dead links after a magic-byte check, returning paste-ready Markdown. It also keeps a system-prompt rule that every delivered image must appear in the reply body as ![](…) markdown, because collapsed tool rows are invisible to the reader.
description.zh: 聊天图片全屏查看器：点击任意图片打开原始分辨率大图，支持缩放（滚轮、按钮、快捷键）、拖拽平移、左右翻页、文件名显示、下载保存，以及键盘方向键与移动端滑动切换。输入框旁一个「对话图显控制」面板，可一键把整个会话的图收成可调列数（1–12，自动记忆）的缩略图网格，或整块隐藏并收掉占位、随时还原；图片只原地加样式，绝不搬移或重挂节点。宿主侧 display_image 工具支持本地路径或目录（TIFF/HEIC 自动转码，下载仍保存原文件）、网络直链、以及 Bing、花瓣、搜狗的关键词搜图（按抽样可加载率选源，被防盗链拦截的自动转存，坏链按字节校验剔除），返回可直接粘贴的 Markdown；并在 system prompt 常驻一条投递规则，要求发出的图必须写进回复正文（![](…)），因为折叠的工具行读者看不到。

description.en: Delete a session from the UI (session-header button or sidebar row menu) or with the session_delete tool: stops and releases a running agent and its live session first, then removes the log directory, projection cache and workspace accounting, and cascades into the subagent sessions it owns while leaving forked branches untouched.
description.zh: 从界面删除会话（会话头部按钮或侧栏行菜单），或由 agent 调用 session_delete 工具：先停止并释放运行中的 Agent 与会话，再清理日志目录、投影缓存与工作区记账，级联删除它拥有的子代理会话（分叉分支不受影响）。

description.en: Back up your DSH profile configuration to a private GitHub Gist on a schedule, with merged restore.
description.zh: 定时把 DSH 配置备份到私有 GitHub Gist，支持合并恢复。

description.en: Approve tool calls, watch streaming output and answer questions from a phone over a zero-knowledge relay, with payload-level end-to-end encryption.
description.zh: 在手机上审批工具调用、看流式输出、回答问题；载荷级端到端加密，中继可自托管。

description.en: A minimal installable DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle.
Use a SuperGrok / X Premium subscription inside DeepSeek Harness. Device-code OAuth, grok-bridge token reuse, no xAI API key. Works in headless, web, and any TUI.
description.zh: 把 SuperGrok 或 X Premium 订阅变成 DeepSeek Harness 的本地模型源，免 xAI API 密钥，直接复用已有 OAuth 令牌。

description.en: Ultra-lean daily coding agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) that strips heavy orchestration for fast, direct tool execution.
description.zh: 专为日常编码打造的极简 Agent 预设插件：移除沉重编排机制与冗余组件，直达核心工具循环，响应迅速。

description.en: Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing with credits estimation, subscription balance and web settings UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Labnana 图片生成：文生图 / 图生图 / 精准编辑，含积分预估、余额查询与网页设置界面。

description.en: DSH Usage Monitor: auto-query provider credit balances and time-window limits from configured API keys, with input capsule and custom provider support.
description.zh: DSH 用量监控：自动查询已配置 API Key 的供应商余额和时间窗口限制，支持输入框余量胶囊和自定义供应商。

description.en: One-tap connect ModelScope language and image-generation models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and context window filled in automatically. You can also see the free Magicube balance, jump to a model's info page, and record local call counts, trends and rate-limit events, with a usage pill beside the input box showing the balance and today's local count. All of it needs only an API key, with no account sign-in.
description.zh: 一键接入魔搭社区的语言、生图模型到 DSH（默认关），自动填入图片识别与上下文窗口；还可查看免费魔粒余额、跳转到模型信息页，记录本地调用计数、趋势、限流事件，输入框旁另有用量胶囊显示余额与今日本地调用次数。上述功能仅需填入 API key，不需要登录账号。

description.en: Bing-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: prefers Bing's RSS feed with the public cn.bing.com HTML page as fallback, no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeps searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint, result count and result language configurable; targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.7+).
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源：优先解析 Bing 的 RSS 输出，以 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页作为兜底，无需 API Key，国内可直连，搜索不再消耗模型自带的搜索额度。端点、结果数量与结果语言可配置；适配 DSH 0.2.x（0.1.7+ 亦可用）。

description.en: Scheduled tasks panel for managing DSH agent and system crontabs with natural language input and execution logs.
description.zh: 定时任务面板：分区管理 DSH 与系统 crontab、自然语言生成表达式、执行日志与完成后消息推送。

description.en: A minimal worktree management solution with only one button and one dialog.
description.zh: 极简 worktree 管理方案，只有一个按钮和一个弹窗。

description.en: A safe, searchable, approval-gated Markdown knowledge vault for DeepSeek Harness.
Scoped, bounded, approval-gated long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness agents.
A durable, policy-gated inbound/outbound message core for DeepSeek Harness.

Reads animated GIF and WebP as animations: a pasted one keeps playing in the UI while the model gets a labelled sheet of frames sampled across it, and the read_animation tool samples a file on demand.
description.zh: 把 gif 和动图 webp 当作动画来读：贴进聊天框的照常播放，模型收到的是横跨整段采样、带帧号与时长的胶片条；工作区里的文件由 read_animation 按需采样。

description.en: Use DeepSeek Harness as an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) stdio agent.
An audited OS-keychain credential-handle service for trusted DeepSeek Harness plugins.

Model channel manager: several provider/model candidates share one virtual route (roundrobin/<group>) with failover, retry, timeout and cooldown; a settings tab edits providers and groups, runs per-model speed tests and real single-model request tests, and a seven-day health panel aggregates latency, failures and upstream token usage (input, output, cache and reasoning).
description.zh: 模型渠道管理：多个供应商/模型候选共享一条虚拟路由（roundrobin/组），带失败转移、重试、超时与冷却；设置页签可编辑供应商与轮询组、跑测速与单模型真实请求测试，健康面板聚合七天延迟、失败与上游 token 用量（输入、输出、缓存、推理）。

description.en: Registers a `deepseek-vision` provider route: the Web GUI accepts pasted images and transcribes them to text via the free Zhipu GLM vision API before delegating to the DeepSeek adapter.
description.zh: 注册 `deepseek-vision` 路由：Web GUI 直接粘贴图片，由免费智谱 GLM 视觉模型转译为文字后，再交给 DeepSeek 适配器作答。

description.en: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against morluto/rea over stdio, for reverse engineering anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
description.zh: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥，经 stdio 连接 morluto/rea，让 agent 从应用行为一路逆向到底层原生二进制。

description.en: Windows system-drive (C:) cleanup for DSH: rule-based scan, five-tier safety grading, a staging area with a rollback ledger, UAC elevation, and migration to another drive — a model tool plus a Web GUI panel.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 系统盘（C 盘）清理能力：按规则库扫描、五级安全分级、带台账可回滚的暂存区、UAC 提权与迁移到其他盘 —— 既有模型工具，也有 Web 面板。

description.en: Captain-led multi-agent teams that split a goal into tasks and dispatch them along an execution chain to members running in their own sub-sessions, each with its own model.
description.zh: 领队主导的多智能体团队：把目标拆成任务，按执行链派发给运行在各自子会话里的成员，每个成员可配不同模型。

description.en: One-click OpenAI-compatible API (CodeBuddy/vLLM/proxies) with thinking mode, avoiding developer-role content_filter rejection.
description.zh: 一键接入 OpenAI 兼容 API（CodeBuddy、vLLM、各类代理）并开启思考模式，绕开第三方端点以 content_filter 拒绝 developer 角色的问题。

description.en: Generates UI wireframes and high-fidelity mockups in DeepSeek Harness with selectable DashScope and Volcengine image providers.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用可切换的阿里云百炼与火山方舟图像服务生成 UI 线框图和高保真设计稿。

description.en: Adds an animated desktop companion with task notifications, session chat, character packs, and native settings for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加动画桌面伙伴，支持任务提醒、会话聊天、角色包和原生设置。

description.en: Proposal-only, provenance-stable promotion between DSH personal Memory and Wiki.

Takes over the compaction threshold on every mounted engine: forces headroomTokens to -1e6 so the ratio is the only term in the trigger, keeps retention below it on every write path, reroutes the compaction call to a chosen model, and adds a panel with a one-click compaction button and a per-session compaction log.
description.zh: 接管所有已挂载压缩引擎的触发阈值：把 headroomTokens 强制成 −1e6，使比值成为触发点的唯一决定项；在每条下发路径上保证保留量低于触发点；把压缩调用改派到指定模型；并提供一键立即压缩与本会话压缩记录面板。

description.en: Lists archived sessions, previews their content, restores them to the original workspace, and adds an optional archive confirmation.
description.zh: 列出已归档会话、预览内容、恢复到原工作区，并提供可选的归档二次确认。

description.en: Context fullness bands, the per-session compaction threshold derived from the model window, per-step cost computed from cache read and cache write rates, cache-hit, DeepSeek balance with the peak/off-peak tariff, and a one-click handoff. It never calls a model and spends no tokens.
description.zh: 上下文占用档位、按模型窗口推算的每会话压缩阈值、按缓存读取/写入费率计算的单步费用、缓存命中率、DeepSeek 余额与高峰/低谷费率，以及一键交接。它从不调用模型，也不消耗 token。

description.en: Terminal (CLI TUI) surface for DeepSeek Harness: interactive dsh in a terminal, no browser required

One-click standalone two-column code review page for Git diffs in the conversation: line numbers, add/delete coloring, character-level highlight, hunk-aware per-file sections, a file nav sidebar and a stats bar; line comments submit back to the DSH composer, and the UI follows the DSH locale.
description.zh: 把对话里的 git diff 一键打开为独立标签页的双列代码评审页：行号、增删配色、字符级高亮、hunk 感知的多文件分段、文件导航侧栏与统计条，行内评论可提交回 DSH 对话框，界面跟随 DSH 语言（中英）。

description.en: Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.1. Mobile UI fixes for the dsh web profile: narrow-screen drawer and settings tabs, a full-width model menu, a stuck-request network chip, and a narrow-header collector that folds the lineage, subagent and background-job chips into one tappable sheet.
description.zh: 需要 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。dsh web profile 的手机端体验修复：窄屏抽屉与设置标签、全宽模型菜单、卡住请求的网络状态芯片，以及把会话层级、subagent 与后台任务芯片收进一张可点开面板的窄屏头部收纳器。

description.en: Select text in the dsh web conversation to attach it as an annotation to your next message. The source text keeps a dashed highlight with an ordinal badge in place, and the composer summary lists, edits and jumps back to each annotation.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页版对话里划词，把选中文本作为批注附到下一条消息。原文位置保留虚线高亮和序号角标，输入框上方的批注摘要可查看、编辑并跳回每一条批注。

description.en: Writing bridge to the open-source QingAgent client: the agent drafts and revises documents through qing_ prefixed host tools, typeset on a rice-paper panel with mermaid, drawio, tables and KaTeX; edits stage as reviewable diffs and land only on commit, and it requires the QingAgent desktop app on the same machine.
description.zh: 青简写作桥：agent 通过 qing_ 前缀工具起草改稿，右侧宣纸面板排版呈现（mermaid、drawio、表格、公式）；每处修改先摆在纸上供审阅，提交才落稿。需本机运行开源的青简桌面客户端。

description.en: DSH Skill Manager: browse, enable/disable, import from Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork, auto-discover skills with symlink support.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器：浏览、启用/禁用、从 Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork 导入，自动发现技能并支持软链接。

description.en: 🎲 Dice Battle — six classic dice games (Liar's Dice, Guess Red Dots, Red/Blue, Big/Small, Odd/Even, Straight) for the DSH web GUI. Single vs AI plus PeerJS WebRTC online play, fully bilingual zh/en, sidebar entry opens the game in the center column.
description.zh: 🎲 骰子大作战 — 六种经典骰子玩法（吹牛、猜红点、猜红蓝、猜大小、猜单双、猜顺子），单人 vs AI + PeerJS 联机，全量中英双语，侧边栏入口打开游戏面板。

description.en: 数据资产化共享基础包 — 共享类型定义、业务常量、工具函数（基础依赖）
Policy-gated, content-free health and readiness aggregation for DSH assistant services.
Docker-isolated real-host lifecycle tests for DSH plugins across install, boot, tool registration, update, uninstall, reinstall, and recovery, with structured evidence.
description.zh: 在 Docker 隔离的真实宿主中测试 DSH 插件的安装、启动、工具注册、更新、卸载、重装与恢复生命周期，并输出结构化证据。

description.en: Read-only Skill inspector for DeepSeek Harness. It shows which Skills a conversation actually loaded — from observed loading evidence only — and which Skills the current environment can discover, and gives each Skill a detail page whose left column switches between the framework, the evidence, validation, evaluation, step evidence, run logic, the before/after of a modification when there is one, the definition facts and the raw SKILL.md. Declaration and run stay apart: the body is split into structure, declared workflow and progressive disclosure, the run logic is read from local receipts, and every declared step carries its own evidence — no observed evidence is reported as exactly that, not as executed or not executed, and the run's instruction hash sits beside the current definition as match, mismatch or unavailable. The evidence view gives each subject one of three states (declared, observed, unavailable), walks definition → load → use → outcome, names what each stage cannot reach, declines to attribute an outcome to the Skill, and can copy the snapshot out as byte-stable JSON. Validation checks the Agent Skills open standard and the platform profiles separately, each finding on a rule id and labelled standard compliance or platform compatibility. Evaluation keeps repeatable cases with the conditions each run was recorded under and the four stages of runtime evidence, comparing two runs of one case item by item without scoring them. The trigger boundary keeps should-trigger and should-not-trigger prompts, has you run them in a real new session, then records what was observed — whether a load record appeared and whether it was model-invoked or user-explicit; a typed /name is not a natural trigger, and an absent load record is reported as not observed, not as not triggered. The same projections are exposed to the agent as a read-only skill_review tool, which returns a structured review packet and says what it omitted when the packet will not fit whole. The inspector, the evidence chain and these reviews are computed on this machine from the definition and the session receipts; the Chinese reading version sends the body through the host's model when you ask for it, keeping code fences, paths and frontmatter verbatim and storing the result on this machine. A Skill can also be cloned into a local copy. It does not write back to the source Skill and does not run its scripts.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的只读 Skill 检视器。它显示一次对话实际加载过哪些 Skill（只凭观测到的加载证据）、当前环境又能发现哪些 Skill，并为每个 Skill 提供一页详情：左列在框架、证据、验收、评测、步骤证据、本次运行逻辑、有修改事务时的本次修改前后对比、定义事实与 `SKILL.md` 原文之间切换。声明与运行始终分开：正文按结构、声明流程与渐进披露拆开，运行逻辑只从本机收据读，每个声明步骤都带自己的证据——没有观测到证据就照实这么写，而不是「已执行」或「未执行」；本次运行收到的指令哈希与当前定义并列给出 match、mismatch 或 unavailable。证据视图给每一类对象三态之一（声明 / 已观察 / 无法取得），沿定义 → 加载 → 使用 → 结果走一遍，逐段写明它够不着什么，不把结果归因给这个 Skill，并能把快照按逐字节稳定的 JSON 复制出去。验收把 Agent Skills 开放标准与各平台 Profile 分开判，每条发现落在规则 id 上并标注「标准合规」或「平台兼容」。评测用可重复的用例记录每次运行的条件与四段运行时证据，只在同一个用例内逐项对照两次运行，不给分。触发边界维护「应触发 / 不应触发」的提示词，由你在真实新会话里跑一遍再记录观察到的结果——加载记录出现过没有、`model-invoked` 还是 `user-explicit`；手打 `/name` 不算自然触发，没有加载记录只写成「未观察到」，不写成「没有触发」。同一批投影也作为只读工具 `skill_review` 交给 Agent，它返回结构化审查包，包太大时会说明省略了什么。检视器、证据链与上面这些审查都在本机按定义与会话收据算；中文阅读版在你需要时把正文交给宿主模型翻译，代码围栏、路径与 frontmatter 逐字保留，译文只存本机。另外可以把一份 Skill 复刻成本机副本。它不改写源 Skill，也不执行源里的脚本。

description.en: File-change monitor and code editor for the DSH Web UI. Agent edits appear beside your conversation as real-time line-by-line diffs, with a syntax-highlighted editor, one-click revert, change history, workspace switcher, and per-session isolation.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的文件修改监视器与代码工作台。Agent 修改代码时实时浮现逐行 Diff，内置语法高亮编辑器，支持一键还原、修改历史、工作区切换与按会话隔离。

description.en: Maintainer and developer PR board for the DSH sidebar: a five-state review queue (waiting on me / waiting on author / ready to merge / merged / inbox), a three-column issue board, and a global view of the PRs you authored (my move / waiting on others / merged), with CI rollup badges, an inactivity filter, and one click per card to open or start the matching review conversation.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的维护者 + 开发者 PR 看板：五状态评审队列（等我 / 等作者 / 可合并 / 已合并 / 待分诊）、三列 issue 看板、跨仓库跟踪自己 PR 的 mine 视图（我的回合 / 等别人 / 已合并），附 CI 汇总徽章与不活跃过滤，点卡片一键打开或新建对应的评审会话。

description.en: Instantly find DSH settings pages, tabs and rows by keyword, pinyin, intent or AI — and jump straight to them.
description.zh: 通过关键词、拼音、意图或 AI 一键搜索 DSH 设置面板，并直达目标设置页、标签或选项。

description.en: Model-facing `vision` tool for DeepSeek Harness: describe and OCR image files by calling the free Zhipu GLM vision API directly (glm-4v-flash fallback chain), no external CLI required.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型补上免费识图：`vision` 工具直连智谱 GLM 视觉 API 描述/OCR 图片文件（glm-4v-flash 降级链），无需任何外部 CLI。

description.en: Native per-workspace memory on the harness's own seams: facts and a bounded always-on profile on the storage-domain JSON unit, approval-gated writes with `(sessionId, seq)` citations, deterministic recall plus session-query FTS over past sessions — no external server, no custom SQLite.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 原生接缝的按工作区记忆：事实与有界常驻档案落在 storage-domain 的 JSON 单元上，写入经人工审批并带 `(sessionId, seq)` 引证，确定性召回 + session-query 全文检索历史会话——无外部服务器、无自建 SQLite。

description.en: Peak-Valley Meter (峰谷电表) — a tiny DeepSeek usage companion: a minimal two-part balance chip above the composer (currency symbol + number, nothing else), official balance refreshed every 5s; click the symbol to open the official top-up page in a new tab; hovering the chip fades in a circular backdrop under the symbol, its left arc flush with the chip's own left edge, and expands a 24h peak/valley timeline (orange=peak, blue=valley, glowing marker at the current local time) so off-peak hours are obvious; independent today-spend metering; a settings panel with 10 muted color presets plus custom valley/peak colors, detailed/minimal styles and readout toggles; all-Chinese UI.
description.zh: 峰谷电表——DeepSeek 用量小助手：输入框上方一枚极简余额徽章，框内只有「货币符号 + 余额数字」两组，官方余额每 5 秒实时刷新；点击符号即在新页签打开官方充值页；光标移入徽章时，符号身下浮现一枚圆形底色（左弧与徽章左端圆角完全重合），并展开 24 小时峰谷时间轴（橙=峰时、蓝=谷时、白色发光指针标当前本地时刻），谷时省钱时段一目了然；今日消耗独立计费；设置面板提供 10 套沉稳配色预置与谷/峰色自定义、详细/极简样式与各项读数开关；全中文界面。

description.en: Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next, new/archive/rename), keyboard model switching via Alt+M, alternate send, Esc focus hand-off, and Alt+W to close or restore a dsh-split-screen workspace — all rebindable with Windows/macOS presets. Verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.
description.zh: Web 会话热键插件：像切浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理会话——Alt+1-9 顺序切换、固定槽位、上/下一个、新建/归档/重命名、Alt+M 键盘切换模型与备用发送、Esc 焦点交接，Alt+W 关闭/恢复 dsh-split-screen 工作区；键位可在面板录制重绑，Windows/macOS 双预设。已适配 DSH 0.1.1 与 0.1.5。

description.en: Rich Markdown notebook for the composer region: a tool-row toggle plus a CodeMirror editor card with Codex-style list editing, submitted through the conversation service.
description.zh: 为输入区提供富 Markdown 笔记本：工具行开关加 CodeMirror 编辑卡片，支持 Codex 风格列表编辑，经会话服务提交。

description.en: Skill and MCP management center for DeepSeek Harness: browse and toggle user/project skills, add/edit/remove MCP servers hot without restart, with live per-session status in the sidebar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能与 MCP 管理中心：浏览并启停用户/项目技能，热增删改 MCP 服务器（免重启），侧边栏实时展示各服务器状态。

description.en: AST-based structural code search and syntax outline tool powered by ast-grep.
description.zh: 基于 ast-grep 的语法级 AST 代码结构检索与大纲提取工具。

description.en: Closes ai-memory's consolidation loop for DSH: when a DSH session ends it calls ai-memory finalize-session, so the observations DSH captured become wiki pages the other harnesses ai-memory serves can read. Skips subagents, queues concurrent session ends, and sweeps sessions abandoned by a forced restart.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上 ai-memory 的收敛闭环：DSH 会话结束时调用 ai-memory finalize-session，把本次捕获的观察整理成 wiki 页面，供 ai-memory 服务的其他 harness 读取；跳过子代理、串行化并发结束的会话，并补扫被强制重启遗留的会话。

description.en: Registers a `deepseek-web` provider that drives your own signed-in chat.deepseek.com account as an extra model in DSH, so no Open Platform API key is needed: the sidebar footer lists your Web conversations, Fork to Workspace opens an independent Harness session that never writes back to the original conversation, native search stays on for the `default` model, and `/clean` is a session toggle that sends only the human text. Fork of y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web, kept working on DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2: the peer ranges are widened so the compatibility gate no longer rejects the whole bundle, the removed settings API is replaced with `ctx.settings.configure()` plus `.volatile()` config fields, the renamed client icons are updated, and an upstream SSE error now surfaces as a real error instead of an empty message that poisoned the session history. The fork also repairs what the rename to `-free` left behind: the session-list route used to derive its suffix from a hard-coded length inherited from the old package name, which had turned every conversation request into a 404 while sign-in still worked; and the sidebar conversation panel now paints on an opaque surface token instead of the host's translucent menu token, which only reads as a menu beside the backdrop blur a body-mounted panel cannot install.
description.zh: 把你已登录的 chat.deepseek.com 账号当作额外模型接入 DSH：注册 `deepseek-web` provider，无需 Open Platform API key；侧边栏底部列出你的网页端会话，「Fork to Workspace」会开一个独立的 Harness 会话、不回写原对话，`default` 模型保持网页端原生搜索，`/clean` 是只发送人类文本的会话开关。本包是 y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web 的 fork，已适配 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2：放宽 peer 范围以免被兼容性门禁整包拒绝、用 `ctx.settings.configure()` 与配置字段 `.volatile()` 替代被移除的 settings API、更新已改名的客户端图标、并让上游 SSE 错误直接报错（不再返回空消息污染会话历史）。此外还修掉了改名为 `-free` 后遗留的两处问题：会话列表路由原先按旧包名继承下来的硬编码长度切分路径，导致登录正常但每个会话请求都返回 404；侧边栏会话浮层原先用宿主的半透明菜单色，而该色只有配合磨砂背景才像菜单、挂到 body 上的面板无法安装磨砂，现已改用不透明表面色。

description.en: Turns a local Obsidian vault into a dedicated RAG chat panel: a sidebar page with the note browser, the retrieval-augmented chat and the cited source side by side, answering from fully local BM25 plus CJK-bigram retrieval over your notes and streaming through the DSH model channel, with clickable \[n] citations and mtime-based incremental indexing.
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 仓库变成专属 RAG 对话面板：侧栏一个完整页面，左侧笔记浏览、中间检索增强对话、右侧引用原文；检索用完全本地的 BM25 加中文 bigram，回答走 DSH 模型通道，\[n] 引用可点击，索引按 mtime 增量更新。

description.en: Makes a connection between two DSH sessions a first-class object: drag from the composer anchor or a session row to open one, set a permission in each direction, and mount cards on it. Each end gets five host tools for messaging at a chosen urgency, reading the peer work state, and sharing a convention box; awareness is pull-based, so an idle connection costs no context.
description.zh: 把两个 DSH 会话之间的「连接」做成一等对象：从输入框锚点或会话行拖拽建连，两个方向各自设权限，并可在连接上装载卡片。两端各获得五个宿主工具，用于按指定紧急度传话、读取对端工作状态、共用公约盒；感知为拉取式，空闲连接不占上下文。

description.en: Panel hotkeys for the web UI: Enter presses the confirm action and Esc presses the cancel action on every interaction panel (approval, question, plan review).
description.zh: Web UI 面板快捷键：在审批、提问、计划审查等交互面板上，Enter 触发确认操作、Esc 触发取消操作。

description.en: A lightweight font and theme plugin for the DSH client: Latin/Chinese/code font pickers that list only installed families, and five official palettes (One Dark Pro, Dracula, Nord, GitHub, Catppuccin) applied through the official theme tokens, including code-block syntax colors. No bundled fonts, no dependencies, no build step. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.
description.zh: 轻量的 DSH 字体与主题插件：中英文与代码字体选择器（只列本机已安装的字体），以及 One Dark Pro、Dracula、Nord、GitHub、Catppuccin 五套官方色板预设，全部走官方主题 token（含代码块语法高亮），不打包字体、零依赖、零构建。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更新。

description.en: Scheduled task dispatcher: a dsh host plugin that drives recurring agent tasks from a single task table, dispatching each run as an independent dsh session; scheduling is pure logic and uses zero model calls.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：一张任务表驱动周期性运行的 agent 任务，每次调度为一个独立的 dsh 会话；调度本身纯逻辑实现，不消耗任何模型调用。

description.en: 「对话管理」全局面板页（浏览器半）：会话与统计两层 Tabs——会话视图给出全量会话（含已归档）的搜索、分页、归档 / 取消归档 / 导出 / 删除、导入为新会话与孤儿数据 GC，统计视图给出全部对话的 token 用量。
Pokémon-style skin for DSH Web with GBA frames, HP-bar status, effort level panel, and customizable color palettes.
description.zh: 宝可梦风格 DSH Web 皮肤，含 GBA 双边框、HP 条状态、推理等级面板与可自定义配色。

description.en: A Super Relay OpenAI Responses route with conservative goal-budget token metering.

OpenCode GO quota widget pinned to the sidebar, with rolling/weekly/monthly usage bars, an elapsed-versus-remaining time bar under each, a same-origin usage proxy, an /opencode-go command, and the runtime x-opencode-session fix for GO gateway chat requests. Fork of yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage.
description.zh: 常驻侧边栏的 OpenCode GO 套餐额度组件：滚动/周/月三条用量条、每条下方一条已流逝与剩余时间条、同源用量代理、/opencode-go 命令，以及针对 GO 网关聊天请求的运行时 x-opencode-session 修复。fork 自 yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage。

description.en: Session management enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness - workspace session count display, archived sessions panel with restore/delete, drag-and-drop session move across workspaces.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强插件 - 工作区会话数展示、归档会话面板（支持恢复/删除）、拖拽移动会话到其他工作区。

description.en: Deterministic Host recovery and supervised self-evolution runbook for DeepSeek Harness.
Bounded, typed preference learning for the DSH personal assistant.

Clinical documentation and reference bundle for healthcare professionals: SOAP/APSO progress notes, admission H&P, SBAR/I-PASS handover, discharge summaries, Safe Harbor de-identification, patient-instruction readability, completeness checks, and cited lookups against FDA labels, MedlinePlus, PubMed, and ClinicalTrials.gov. Draft-only with a PHI egress guard; not a medical device.
description.zh: 面向临床人员的文档与参考工具包：SOAP/APSO 病程录、入院 H&P、SBAR/I-PASS 交接班、 出院小结、Safe Harbor 脱敏、患者须知可读性评分、完整性检查，以及来自 FDA 说明书、 MedlinePlus、PubMed 和 ClinicalTrials.gov 的带出处检索。仅起草不决定， 内置 PHI 外发守卫；非医疗器械。

description.en: Cursor-style New Session: every click creates a fresh blank draft session (persisted before the first message) instead of reusing the workspace's single one, plus a sidebar Drafts switcher to keep several empty chats open at once.
description.zh: Cursor 风格的新会话：每次点击都新建一个空白草稿会话（首条消息前即持久化），不再复用工作区唯一的空会话；侧栏新增草稿切换器，可同时保留多个空会话。

description.en: Predicts the user's next prompt after each assistant reply and shows it as gray ghost text inside the composer; accept it whole with Tab, accept it piece by piece with Alt+→, reroll it, or dismiss it with Esc.
description.zh: 助手回复结束后预测用户的下一句话，以灰色 ghost text 浮在输入框里；Tab 整条采纳、Alt+→ 逐段采纳、↻ 换一条、Esc 忽略。

description.en: Modellix integration for DSH: schema-driven image, video and audio generation in a split Design workspace, a live LLM model catalog, and native web search and fetch providers through one API key.
description.zh: 将 Modellix 接入 DSH：使用一个 API Key 在分栏 Design 工作区中提供基于 Schema 的图片、视频与音频生成、实时 LLM 模型目录，以及原生网页搜索与抓取 Provider。

description.en: Mobile adapter for the DSH web shell: overlay sidebar/details drawers, responsive composer and settings below 768px, zero desktop regression.
description.zh: DSH Web 移动端适配插件：侧边栏/详情抽屉浮层化、输入栏与设置页响应式适配，桌面零回归。

description.en: Execution flow chart: renders the current session's execution as a vertical node flow (turns, user, assistant, tools, approvals, retries, compaction), appended in real time over SSE with auto-follow scrolling — the chart draws wherever the session executes.
description.zh: 执行流程图：把当前会话的执行过程画成一条纵向节点流（回合/用户/助手/工具/审批/重试/压缩），SSE 实时追加——会话执行到哪，图就画到哪，自动跟随滚动。

description.en: A bounded active-hours heartbeat policy layer backed by assistant-automations.
Reasoning-effort tier manager for custom API models plus cross-session preference memory: inline low/medium/high/max toggles inside Settings → Models, with atomic settings writes.
description.zh: 为自定义 API 模型提供推理强度分级管理与跨会话偏好记忆：在「设置 → 模型」中内联切换 low/medium/high/max，配置写入为原子操作。

description.en: DSH plugin: show account sign-in or API key balances and coding-plan quotas for the model in use
description.zh: 在输入框上方独立一行显示当前模型所属供应商的账户余额或套餐额度（5h/7d/30d）；只做显示，不做成本统计。

description.en: Turns stock names and codes in DSH output text into clickable buttons for quotes and company news.
description.zh: 将 DSH 输出文本中的股票名称和代码转换为可点击按钮，并在侧边栏展示行情与资讯。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DSH: a system toast, a per-kind chime and a tab-title marker when the agent needs you (approval, plan review, question) or a reply finishes in the background; errors, interrupts, usage limits and multi-agent workflow progress alert too. A host half adds SSE delivery, webhook push (WeCom/Feishu/DingTalk/generic), per-turn token/cache/TPS stats, plus three message-format presets (concise, detailed, custom); settings changes auto-save.
description.zh: DSH 桌面消息提醒：模型需要你操作（审批、方案确认、提问）或后台回复完成时，弹系统通知、提示音并标记标签页标题；出错、中断、用量上限与多 agent 工作流进展同样提醒。宿主半提供 SSE 投递、Webhook 推送（企业微信 / 飞书 / 钉钉 / 通用）与当轮统计（token / 缓存 / TPS），以及三档消息格式（简洁 / 详细 / 自定义）与自动保存。

description.en: Auto-switches the agent to ultra-compressed caveman-style output during DeepSeek peak-pricing hours (Beijing 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00, price x2) and shows a status badge plus transition toasts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，价格 ×2）自动切换 caveman 超精简输出省 token，标题栏常驻状态徽章，档位切换时弹提醒。

description.en: Insurance company financial & operating analyst — solvency, financials, investment, distribution channels and peer comparison with real calculations.
description.zh: 保险公司财务经营分析专家，真跑偿付能力、财务报表、投资、渠道与同业对标测算。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for Assistant Web Owner.

Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless Chromium over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.
description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 headless Chromium（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 / Electron）；另带一个网页面板——可直接点、滚、打字的实时页面，操作/控制台/网络日志与一键清理，窗口外观（边框色、透明度、玻璃效果）与几何（贴合画面比例去黑边、顶部留白、默认居中）可自定义，页面分辨率可调（默认 1920×1080）——收起后的胶囊可拖到任意位置（自由位置），切回「网页」自动续帧不用再点「开始」，实时画面「最大边」默认 1920——外加两份随包技能（browser、browser-runtime），由插件经 DSH 内置技能提供者提供，技能中心显示「系统内置」，默认不往 $DSH_HOME/skills 落盘。

description.en: A bounded, append-only outcome evaluation ledger for the DSH personal assistant.
Turns large text pastes into pastes/*.txt attachments with a dock above the composer and a minimal, recognisable badge in the draft.
description.zh: 大段文本粘贴自动存为 pastes/*.txt 附件,输入框上方 dock 卡片管理,草稿内只留可辨识的最小徽标。

description.en: Let a local DeepSeek Harness Agent use BailingHub to query data, update records, and run permitted actions in an online store, SaaS, or other admin system.
description.zh: 让本地 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通过 BailingHub，直接操作商城、SaaS 或其他业务系统后台，在现有账号权限内查询数据、修改资料并执行已开放的操作。

description.en: Evidence-backed UI delivery for coding agents working on existing Web products: declared criteria, criterion-bound artifacts, findings linked to declarations, and repair guidance. Evaluator review does not replace human semantic approval.
Annotate on selection, persist through refresh; send the notes with your message and the model answers each one.
description.zh: 选中即批注，刷新亦留存；随消息发送，模型逐条回应。

description.en: Per-turn session cost chip in the composer stats row: each turn's spend with the model it used, the conversation total split into cache-hit and cache-miss (CNY), priced from an official price table that refreshes on demand.
description.zh: 输入框下方统计栏里的会话费用胶囊：逐轮列出每轮花费与所用模型，并把总额拆成缓存命中与未命中两笔（CNY）；价目表按需从官方定价页刷新。

description.en: Vision toolkit for text-only DeepSeek: model-invokable `vision` tool, wrapper adapters for deepseek/opencode-go (v4 flash/pro), Antigravity IDE quota (default, flash/pro) / any OpenAI-compatible VLM / Gemini / local Ollama channels, evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图工具包：模型可主动调用的 `vision` 工具、deepseek/opencode-go 包装适配器（v4 flash/pro）、反重力额度（默认，flash/pro）/ 任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM / Gemini / 本地 Ollama 通道、证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

description.en: Billing-period and balance pill under the DSH composer: it shows the account balance and the current conversation cost alongside the peak/off-peak state and a countdown to the next switch. The peak/off-peak rules cover China statutory holidays and weekends, and the conversation cost is measured as the decrease in account balance between the plugin's 60-second idle balance refreshes.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的计费时段与余额药丸：常显账户余额与本次对话花费，并显示峰价/谷价档位与距下次切换的倒计时。峰谷判定含中国法定节假日与周末；本次对话花费按余额差值记账，采样点是插件自带的「对话停止满一分钟后刷新余额」。

description.en: Insurance company operations analyst — runs real solvency, profitability, embedded value (EV), investment risk and regulatory compliance calculations, not just text explanations.
description.zh: 保险公司经营分析专家（盈安），真跑偿付能力、盈利能力、内含价值(EV)、投资风险与监管合规五维测算。

description.en: Renders edit and write tool calls as always-expanded side-by-side diffs styled like git diff, with optional syntax coloring and word-level highlighting.
description.zh: 将编辑与写入工具调用渲染为常开的双栏 diff，样式类似 git diff，可选语法配色与词级高亮。

description.en: DSH 装饰插件：仅在新会话的主内容区（侧边栏右侧）渲染透明流体薄膜与弹性网格，支持玻璃/调制双模式与明暗主题自适应，其他 UI 全部保持官方。
Re-validates Cloudflare Access JWTs at the DSH origin so Settings, Credentials, Agent Preset management, and model discovery work from a remote hostname.
description.zh: 在 DSH Origin 校验 Cloudflare Access JWT，使 Settings、凭据、Agent Preset 管理与模型发现可在远程主机名下使用。

description.en: Login gate for the dsh web UI: unauthenticated visitors get a login/register page and the first registrant becomes admin; includes user and role management plus login and access audit logs.
description.zh: 用户管理：给 dsh web 加登录门禁，未登录访问弹登录/注册页，首个注册者自动成为管理员；管理员可管理用户/角色，带登录与访问审计。

description.en: Registers a /code-review slash command with five parallel review lenses and per-finding confidence scoring, for both pull requests and local code.
description.zh: 注册 /code-review 斜杠命令，五个并行审查视角、逐发现置信度打分，同时支持拉取请求与本地代码审查。

description.en: Grok Build provider using the official CLI browser login, with dynamic account-visible models, streaming reasoning and tools, plus quota and model-capability settings.
description.zh: Grok Build 模型接入插件：使用官方 CLI 浏览器登录，动态发现账号可见模型，支持流式推理、工具调用、额度与模型能力设置页。

description.en: Session management for the DSH sidebar: pin conversations, search their contents, read archived transcripts and hide noise.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏会话管理：固定对话、搜索内容、读取归档记录并隐藏噪音。

description.en: A core-only meta-bundle for the DSH personal assistant policy, memory, Wiki, and automations plugins.
Prompt-cache diagnostics dashboard showing provider-reported token usage, adjacent logical-input changes, and Call TTFT.
description.zh: 提示词缓存诊断页，展示 Provider 回传的 Token 用量、相邻逻辑输入变化与 Call TTFT。

description.en: Bounded growth agent with durable reviews driven by owner-verified task feedback and frozen source models.
Durable supervised workflow learning with approval, replay, effect-blocked shadow, one-shot canary, and exact rollback.

Merges other sessions' context into the current turn: evidence-weighted conflict resolution, retraction of claims whose premises were retracted, trust labelling that resists cross-session prompt injection, and budget-bounded packing. Ships a benchmark.
description.zh: 把其他会话的上下文合并进当前回合：按证据裁决冲突、前提被撤回时同步撤回结论、用信任格抵抗跨会话提示注入，并在 token 预算内打包。附带评测基准。

description.en: Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.
description.zh: 在对话中 Ctrl+点击文件路径与链接：路径在文件管理器中定位所在文件夹，链接在新标签页打开。

description.en: 「云接力」：把本地 DSH 会话一键迁到云端 DSH 继续执行，笔记本合盖/关机不中断；回本地重开自动同步云端结果（DeepSeek Harness 插件）

HTTP/API debugging toolset: full-control HTTP requests (method/headers/body/auth), curl command parsing and one-step execution, in-session request history with side-by-side response comparison, pagination-aware Link headers, and DeepSeek-branded UI cards (optional dsh-http-tools-ui).
description.zh: HTTP/API 调试工具集：全参数 HTTP 请求（method/headers/body/auth）、curl 命令解析与一步执行、会话内请求历史与响应并排对比、分页 Link 头透出；配合可选 dsh-http-tools-ui 提供 DeepSeek 风格工具卡片。

description.en: Capture independently accepted tool workflows and replay versioned skills through the current native Goal and tool authority.
Finite owner-authorized offline Linux Docker jobs with durable audit and external revocation.
File-browser web app for DSH: React frontend and REST API served by the host webserver, a /dsh-agfs command that opens at the current session workspace, and a browse_files model tool.
description.zh: 文件浏览器 Web 应用：React 前端与 REST API 由宿主 webserver 托管，/dsh-agfs 命令自动定位当前工作区，附 browse_files 模型工具。

description.en: Insurance actuary — runs real actuarial calculations (life & P&C reserve valuation under C-ROSS II BEL+RM, profit testing NBV/VNB/IRR, embedded value EV, pricing & loss-triangle reserving), not just explanations.
description.zh: 保险精算师（insurance-actuary）——真跑精算测算：寿险/财险准备金评估（偿二代二期 BEL+RM）、利润测试（NBV/VNB/IRR）、内含价值(EV)、产品定价与损失三角准备金，而非仅讲解。

description.en: Track the origin of local development ports on Windows and safely manage verified DSH services.
description.zh: Windows 本地开发端口来源追踪与安全处理工具。

description.en: Durable bounded file, HTTP/JSON, and HMAC webhook triggers for DSH automations.
Approval-gated behavioural self-evolution for the DSH personal assistant.

Always-on ADHD-friendly output shaping: one system-prompt section makes replies action-first with numbered steps and concrete time estimates; adhd_on / adhd_off / adhd_status tools persist the mode across restarts.
description.zh: 常驻的 ADHD 友好输出塑形：一个系统提示词区段让回复行动先行、步骤编号、时间估算具体；adhd_on / adhd_off / adhd_status 三个工具让模式跨重启保持。

description.en: Vision provider route that transcribes attached images to text through a configurable model (15+ OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic vendors) while DeepSeek keeps answering.
description.zh: 视觉模型路由：把附加图片经可配置模型（15+ OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic 供应商）转译为文字，对话仍由 DeepSeek 作答。

description.en: Insurance product comparison & proposal expert — clause analysis, cost-effectiveness, coverage planning, generates verifiable client-facing PDF proposals.
description.zh: 保险产品对比与建议书专家（险析君），条款拆解、性价比测算、保障规划，生成可自核 PDF 建议书。

description.en: Firecrawl-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key and result limits.
description.zh: 基于 Firecrawl 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量等字段的设置卡片。

description.en: Self-evolving project-level Agent for DeepSeek Harness: 16 SDD workflow skills (clarification, PRD, issue, coding, locating, acceptance, review) plus project memory and knowledge that compound over time.
description.zh: 会进化的项目级 Agent：以 SDD 规格驱动掌舵全流程，内置 16 个技能覆盖澄清、PRD、issue、编码、定位、验收、审查；会记忆、会沉淀，越用越懂你的项目。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-vigalai-dsh-plugin-zerone
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-plugin-zerone

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Model-visible SSH file tools read_remote, write_remote and edit_remote: read a remote UTF-8 file with line-numbered paging, create a new remote file (an existing target is refused, there is no overwrite branch), and apply literal replacements with unique-match checking — all addressed through a single "alias:path" field whose alias comes from ~/.ssh/config.
description.zh: 模型可直接调用的 ssh 远程文件三件套：read_remote 按行号分页读远端 UTF-8 文本，write_remote 只新建文件、目标已存在即拒绝且没有覆写分支，edit_remote 做唯一匹配的字面替换，三者共用取自 ~/.ssh/config 的「别名:路径」一个 file_path 字段。

description.en: dsh plugin of git
description.zh: DSH 官方右侧栏里的本地 Git 与四个 GitHub 远端页签：Changes（按文件暂存、逐行 diff、提交信息由 DSH 里已配好的模型生成）、History，以及由 host 半代理的 Code / Issues / Pull requests / Actions。令牌只存在 host 半（ctx.credentials），/dsh-git/* 只接受 loopback 请求。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 最简洁、优雅的 MCP 工具管理器：在设置里添加 MCP 服务器、Postman 式请求头、连通性测试、逐工具开关。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 工具管理器：在设置里添加 streamable-http/stdio 服务器、Postman 式请求头、连通性测试，并按工具开关——停用的工具不会进入模型。

description.en: 把 New API 站点接入 DSH 的模型供应商：设备授权登录、按渠道分组的三级模型选择器、模型白名单 | Sign in to a New API site from DSH settings; the plugin mints the API token, inserts itself as a provider, and offers a model/group/reasoning picker
DeepSeek Harness 的原生 QQ 机器人插件：微内核 + 9 个子插件，Linux/Windows 通用。收消息、发图、生图、发表情，装完就能聊。此项目为个人因需求爱好，人力设计方案AI构建代码的插件，所以bug和不够合理的地方有许多，发出来仅为学习和分享
description.zh: 装完填几项就能用的 QQ 机器人，收消息、发图、生图、发表情，Linux 和 Windows 都能跑。

description.en: DSH-Reforge (dsh-reforge) — DeepSeek Harness plugin for traceable experience from test-verified Python bug fixes. 从有测试依据的 Python 修复中积累可追溯经验。Experimental alpha · DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
用量 · Usage — DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 设置面板：当日/累计 token 用量、缓存命中、历史日历，以及 kimi-coding / commandcode 的额度与刷新时间。 A DSH settings panel: token usage, cache hits, a history calendar, and provider quotas.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板里看当天和累计的 token 用量、缓存命中、历史日历，还有各家 API 的额度和刷新时间。

description.en: First-class DonSeTch plugin for DeepSeek Harness: fetch, search and crawl as native dsh tools with an auto-updating verified binary
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接获得 DonSeTch 的抓取、搜索和爬取能力，一条命令装好即用。

description.en: An always-on-top notch for DeepSeek Harness that shows which sessions are working, which need you, and which are done. Windows.
description.zh: 在屏幕顶部挂个悬浮条，每个 DSH 会话配一个机器人，实时显示工作中、需要你、已完成。

description.en: dsh-channel-wechat
description.zh: 把微信接入 DeepSeek Harness，让你在微信里直接和 AI 助手对话、收发消息。

description.en: Design Studio tab: design briefs become html/css/js mockups with live preview, element picker, design-agent chat with vision review, identity presets and zip export.
description.zh: 把设计稿变成可交互的网页原型，实时预览、AI 视觉审稿，还能一键打包导出。

description.en: Frosted-glass download progress overlay for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 给 DSH 的下载任务加一层毛玻璃进度浮层，进度一眼看清，不打断手头操作。

description.en: DSH Web UI 文件追踪插件：记录并查看模型读取/写入/编辑的每个文件，带行号内容、终端风逐行 diff（红删绿增蓝改）与 hunk 上下文折叠；支持 present 交付文件查看（Markdown 渲染 / KaTeX / Mermaid / 图片）。适配至 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2，纯客户端零核心改动。
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里追踪模型读写编辑过的每个文件，带行号查看内容，还能看红删绿增的逐行 diff，方便你审查 AI 改了什么。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: GitLab and GitHub API tokens stay out of the model context — encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM), tools on demand, web settings panel.
description.zh: 帮你安全保管 Git 平台密钥，按需自动注入工具调用，数据全程加密且不进大模型上下文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: local llama.cpp (llama-server) as a first-class model provider — process/router management, catalog sync with mmproj vision pairing, auto-start, stop-then-load switching, and a sidebar terminal monitor panel.
description.zh: 把本地 llama.cpp 模型接进 DSH 模型列表，自动启动、切换和视觉配对，像云端模型一样用。

description.en: DSH 插件市场的补丁层：一键更新全部（退出后自动完成并重开）+ 更新安全网（启动失败自动回退）+ 本地插件更新检测与快照回滚。
Remote monitoring and guidance for DSH agents — a Cordis plugin for macOS/Windows plus a Swift-native iOS/iPad app.
description.zh: 用手机远程查看 DSH Agent 的工作状态，还能发消息、处理审批，出门在外也不耽误。

description.en: MQTT protocol driver and agent worker gateway for DSH
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过 MQTT 协议接入智能体网关，实现远程消息收发与任务调度。

description.en: macOS (Apple Silicon) port of dsh-ops — Rust-powered file tools & PTC batching for DeepSeek Harness. Ported from T-Auto/dsh-ops.
description.zh: 在 Apple Silicon Mac 上用 Rust 加速的文件工具和 PTC 批处理，让 DeepSeek Harness 跑得更快更顺手。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）右侧悬浮面板坞插件：AI 在对话里生成面板，可平铺组合；支持本机/HTTP 数据源、AI 刷新、面板内 dsh.run 模型调用。
description.zh: AI 在对话里直接生成右侧悬浮面板，可平铺组合、接数据源自动刷新，还能在面板里调用模型。

description.en: 把 Qoder 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：用 PAT 调用与 Qoder CLI 同源的模型服务，支持国内版 / 国际版双区域、模型开关、上下文窗口与每日签到，并提供只读的额度概览。
description.zh: 用 PAT 把 Qoder 订阅模型接进 DSH，双区域可选，还能看额度、每日签到。

description.en: Skill cockpit for DSH: one page listing every skill the machine exposes, why a skill is invisible, per-skill usage counts, and a one-file toggle.
description.zh: 一页看清机器上所有技能、哪些被隐藏及原因、各自使用次数，还能一键开关。

description.en: Codex-style token usage dashboard: five stat cards, GitHub-style activity heatmap (daily/weekly views), insights & model ranking; persisted snapshot with incremental sync, survives session deletion.
description.zh: 像 Codex 一样直观展示 Token 用量：统计卡片、活动热力图、模型排行，数据自动同步，不怕会话丢失。

description.en: Material 3 Expressive mobile Web UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), switched per device
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一套 Material 3 Expressive 风格的手机网页界面，按设备切换，手机上用着更顺手。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在 Windows 通知栏提示对话完成、等待选择、等待授权或需要登录，点击通知直接跳回对应对话。Toast 以 DeepSeek Harness 应用身份发出。
description.zh: Windows 通知栏提醒 DSH 对话完成、待选择或待授权，点通知直接跳回对应对话。

description.en: Meta-Problem Modeling (MPM) cognitive flywheel as a resident engine for LLM agent runtimes. 六阶段问题生命周期 · ε-δ 双判据收敛 · 代谢账本 · 导师规则层
description.zh: 给 AI 助手装个跨对话记忆账本，承诺、完成条件、错误和做不到的事都能自动记下并在需要时翻出来。

description.en: 面向代码、资料与自动化任务的开放式 Agent 工作台：DSH 插件 + macOS/Windows 桌面端，覆盖 Agent 编排、资源管理、部署与自动化。An open Agent workbench for code, docs and automation — a DeepSeek Harness plugin with desktop builds.
description.zh: 一个能编排 Agent、管理资源、部署和跑自动化任务的开放工作台，代码、资料、自动化都能搞定。

description.en: Apify plugin for the DeepSeek harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接搜索、运行和构建 Apify 爬虫，轻松搞定网页数据采集。

description.en: Queries PRTS Wiki for Arknights operators, items, stages, story pages and worldbook entries, and predicts unreleased characters, alters and banner schedules from story-cast statistics and banner history.
description.zh: 查询 PRTS Wiki 的《明日方舟》干员、物品、关卡、剧情与泰拉大典世界观条目，并基于剧情卡司统计与卡池历史预测未实装角色、异格与卡池排期。

description.en: DSH 上下文智能压缩 + 智能思考：每轮注入用量、模型自主决定压缩并自动续跑；可选让模型按任务难度自主调整思考强度档位
description.zh: 让长会话的上下文用量看得见，模型自己决定何时压缩、思考多深，压缩不打断当前轮次。

description.en: Design workbench in the right sidebar. When the model builds web pages, app screens, posters, slides or emails, each HTML file shows up as a screen on a canvas inside a device frame and refreshes when the file changes; local dev servers are proxied with hot reload intact. Click an element or drag a region to put its selector, source file and styles into the composer. Also has a design tokens panel, versions saved before and after each turn with drag-to-compare and restore, image export, a LAN QR link for viewing on a phone, link arrows and a click-through demo mode, a multi-size view, in-place text editing, reference-image palettes, and a bundled ui-design skill plus a preview_page tool.
description.zh: 右侧栏的设计工作台。模型做网页、App 界面、海报、幻灯片、邮件时，每个 HTML 文件在画布上显示为一屏，套设备外框，文件一改就刷新；本地开发服务器经代理接入，热更新照常。点一个元素或框一块区域，选择器、源文件和样式就整理进输入框。另有设计变量面板、每轮对话前后自动存版本（拖动对比、回到某一版）、导出图片、局域网扫码在手机上看、页面跳转箭头和点击演示、多尺寸并排、预览里直接改字、参考图取色，并自带 ui-design 技能和 preview_page 工具。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层心情。33 种心情各自持有数值，每 3~6 小时自己变 —— 它会累、会烦、会好奇；也会因为一轮里工具老报错而烦躁。附带：心情日记（每天 23:59 自己写）、跨会话记忆、品味库（判断的轨迹，跨会话带着看东西）、时事抓取（RSS / 网页 / 视频抽帧）、可选的主动开口。全部数据在本地、可搬到任意盘。MIT 开源。
description.zh: 给 DSH 里的模型加一套心情系统，33 种心情随时间和对话变化，让回复更有情绪、更像真人。

description.en: Visual agent-orchestration canvas for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): compose LLM/MCP nodes into a DAG, run it from chat, and export the board as a DSH preset. Ships its own engine — install and run.
DSH自己的便签、画布、日程表 Paper-style sticky notes, notes, calendar and drawing panel for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏放一块纸面风格的个人工作台，便签、笔记、日历待办和画纸都存本机，随手记随手画。

description.en: DSH Web GUI 的任务看板插件：侧边栏入口 + 五列看板，任务经 DSH 会话真实执行，host 端持久化并跨设备实时同步。Task board plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里用五列看板管理任务，任务由会话真实执行，还能跨设备实时同步。

description.en: Fork of dsh-workbuddy-connect v0.7.9 with a channel-identity rewrite patch for the Tencent gateway 400/11128 check
description.zh: 上游已停更的 WorkBuddy 连接插件打上补丁，绕过腾讯网关渠道校验，继续正常收发消息。

description.en: Desktop pet "Zhaozhao" (照照) that floats above all apps in a transparent always-on-top window and mirrors DeepSeek Harness state — idle, cooking, serving and waiting-for-you animations, click reactions, drag, right-click resize, plus an auto-downloading Electron helper.
description.zh: 桌面宠物「照照」：透明置顶窗悬浮于所有应用之上，镜像 DeepSeek Harness 状态——待机、颠锅、上菜、托腮等你回话，支持点击回应、拖拽、右键调大小，Electron 运行时自动下载。

description.en: Global cross-session todo list in the sidebar that the person and the agent both write to: ten global_todo_* tools add, batch-capture, update, attach documents and links to, append progress notes to and complete items from any session, and each item can be handed to an agent session in one of four modes with the outcome recorded on the item. The list is a single JSON file.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的全局跨会话待办清单，人和 agent 共用同一份：十个 global_todo_* 工具可在任意会话中新增、批量抓取、修改、挂文档与链接、追加进展记录、标记完成；每条待办可按四种方式交给 agent 会话，派发结果记回条目本身。清单存成一个 JSON 文件。

description.en: Two-layer long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): global + per-project markdown, live re-read, zero extra LLM cost, with a Settings panel. 给 DSH 的两层长期记忆。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加两层长期记忆，全局和项目各存一份 markdown，写完立刻生效，不额外花 token。

description.en: DSH Desktop 插件：小说创作搭档 —— 边提问边完善世界观/人物/情节，每章先写大纲给作者改，定稿后再写正文。
description.zh: 写小说时边聊边搭世界观和人物，每章先出大纲让你改，定稿后再写正文。

description.en: dsh插件-结合officecli命令实现在Deepseek Harness中操作office文档
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用大白话就能创建和编辑 Word、Excel、PPT，结果实时显示在侧边栏。

description.en: OpenDesign Go provider: 12 subscription models over Chat Completions, the real 5-hour and 7-day quota read from the local OpenDesign app, per-model parameters and switches, and multi-account failover.
description.zh: OpenDesign Go 模型提供方：以 Chat Completions 协议接入 12 个订阅模型，从本机 OpenDesign 客户端读取真实的 5 小时 / 7 天额度，支持每模型参数与开关、多账号失败切换。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件市场 —— 目录（一个插件一个配置文件）+ 可视化面板 + 一键安装；插件本体在 HaydenSmith1121/dsh-plugin-collection。目录由 GitHub Actions 每日自动刷新。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件市场，可视化面板里搜插件、看排行、一键安装，目录每天自动更新。

description.en: DSH plugin: paste an API key to add a provider. 21 curated presets (OpenAI-compatible + Anthropic Messages) with per-app de-duplication and a custom endpoint form.
description.zh: 粘贴 API Key 就能给 DSH 加服务商，内置 40 家预设，即开即用不用改配置。

description.en: 一个 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件，把模糊的编程需求锻造成可执行规格，并在每次任务完成后沉淀为会自动复用的个人提示词模板库。
description.zh: 动手前帮你把模糊需求问清楚，做完后自动沉淀成可复用的提示词模板，下次同类需求直接顶上。

description.en: Trellis workflow integration for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 Trellis 工作流搬进 DSH，每轮自动注入任务状态，让 AI 干活更有条理。

description.en: Quantize a checkpoint and prove it in DSH: PTQ with a leak-free calibration split, independent accuracy and performance gates through real serving endpoints, auto-degrade, signed-off audit or rollback.
description.zh: 给模型做量化并实测验证，精度和性能不达标就自动回滚，全程留审计证据。

description.en: Deploy a checkpoint as a reachable inference endpoint in DSH: probe, backend select, three-stage health check, registration, auto-degrade (memory/concurrency/precision/port), rollback, teardown — hash-chained audit log. 154 tests.
description.zh: 把模型检查点一键部署成可访问的推理端点，自动选后端、健康检查、失败降级和回滚，省心又稳。

description.en: Find the root-cause wall, apply the top intervention, prove it with a two-sided gate — or roll back. Engine- and hardware-neutral: no implicit defaults, spec-sheet values are never load-bearing.
description.zh: 给模型和性能目标，自动找到性能瓶颈、匹配最优优化手段并验证，不行就回滚。

description.en: Game asset production pipeline: generate images, video and audio, turn a video into a coherent sprite animation, derive recoloured variants, adapt assets to an engine schema, install them into the project and verify the code actually references them. Requires ffmpeg for the video-to-sprite path, and an image/video API key (Agnes AI / OpenAI / fal) for generation.
description.zh: 游戏素材生产流水线：出图、生视频与音频，把一段视频变成连贯的精灵动画，派生配色变体，适配引擎配置，装进项目并核对代码是否真的引用了。视频转精灵动画需 ffmpeg；出图/生视频需自备图像/视频 API Key（Agnes AI / OpenAI / fal）。

description.en: DSH注入系统提示词和设置注入上下文插件。内置吃白饭的蓝色大肥鱼拟人鲸鱼娘女仆角色扮演设定！
description.zh: 把人设写进系统提示词、把历史对话塞进上下文，还能随时切换角色，内置鲸鱼娘女仆设定。

description.en: 一键重启 DeepSeek Harness 的插件：标题栏按钮，两次点击完成重启，让新装的插件立即生效。One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 标题栏加个重启按钮，点两下就能重启 DeepSeek Harness，新装的插件马上生效。

description.en: A searchable, workspace-grouped multi-select panel over DSH conversations for batch delete, archive and pin, with Shift-range and Ctrl-add selection.
description.zh: 为 DSH 对话加入可搜索、按工作区分组的多选面板，支持 Shift 范围选择与 Ctrl/Cmd 追加选择，然后批量删除、归档或置顶。

description.en: Diagnose and repair DSH sessions that stopped opening after a harness upgrade — from the CLI, from an agent tool, or from a dashboard in the DSH web UI.
description.zh: 升级后打不开的 DSH 会话，用它能一键诊断修复，命令行、Agent 工具、网页面板都能用。

description.en: Desktop pet for DSH: 兰酱, an angel-winged maid in a transparent always-on-top window who reacts to session states (thinking, working, waiting, done, error), shows task progress and DeepSeek balance, and responds to drags, head pats, pokes and wing touches.
description.zh: DSH 桌宠兰酱：透明置顶窗口里的天使翅膀女仆，随会话状态（思考、工作、等待、完成、出错）做出动作，显示任务进度和 DeepSeek 余额，可以拖动、摸头、戳一下、碰翅膀。

description.en: Prose-editing skill for academic and professional writing. The composer offers three modes: Check — review and suggest without editing, with a verdict when readiness is asked; Polish — improve the wording while keeping the meaning, facts and citations; Draft — draft from the supplied material without adding facts.
description.zh: 学术与专业写作润色技能，输入框三选一：检查——只检查并给建议；询问能否提交时补充结论，不改原文。润色——改善表达，保留原意、事实和引用。起草——根据现有材料起草，不补充材料外的事实。

description.en: DeepSeek usage monitor as a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: balance / day-month-all-time token & cost panel in the chat UI with drag-reorder config, plus an optional local usage proxy
description.zh: 在聊天界面实时查看 DeepSeek 余额、Token 用量和费用，支持拖拽排序，还能选装本地用量代理。

description.en: dsh plugin: drive an existing dsh session from Feishu/Lark — outbound-only bot, /resume picker, run status card
description.zh: 在手机上通过飞书/Lark 远程操控已有的 dsh 会话，随时派活、看进度，还能一键恢复任务。

description.en: 按 DSH 会话启用的上下文降温插件：已执行完的操作沉入隔离冷库，攒批归档保持前缀缓存命中
description.zh: 把已完成的操作归档到冷库、只留小回执，省 token 还能保住前缀缓存命中。

description.en: DSH Native MUV Engine - tavern companion: regex script execution, variable state tracking, iframe status bar rendering, PolyForm-Noncommercial-Copyleft-1.0.0
description.zh: 酒馆伴生插件，跑正则脚本、追踪变量状态，还能用 iframe 状态栏实时显示游戏进度。

description.en: Host-wide MCP server panel: imports the servers declared in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and Codex CLI configs, searches six upstream catalogs and installs from whichever of them declares an install plan, asks only for the fields a server actually declares, and checks each row for whether the mount, the handshake and its tool list really work.
description.zh: 全局 MCP 服务面板：导入 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、Codex CLI 配置里声明的服务，检索六个上游目录并只从声明了安装方案的条目安装，只询问服务器自己声明过的配置项，并对每一行检查挂载、握手与工具表是否真的可用。

description.en: 让模型通过 adb 操作安卓手机的 DSH 插件（截图、UI 树、点击、滑动、输入文本、按键、打开应用） | DSH plugin exposing adb-based tools that let the model operate an Android phone (screenshot, UI dump, tap, swipe, input text, press keys, open apps).
description.zh: 让 AI 通过 adb 直接操作安卓手机，截图、点按、滑动、输入、开应用都能干。
给 DSH 加上长期记忆，每轮自动把该记的注入对话，全程本地检索不调模型。

description.en: Run a DeepSeek Harness session against a WSL distro: ctx.shell, ctx.fs and the GUI terminal served from inside the distro, sandboxed with bubblewrap
description.zh: 在 WSL 发行版里跑 DeepSeek Harness 会话，命令行、文件系统和图形终端都由 WSL 内部提供，并用 bubblewrap 沙箱隔离。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that blocks agent edits that weaken tests, such as .skip, deleted or watered-down assertions.
description.zh: 防止 AI 改测试蒙混过关：自动拦截 .skip、删断言、弱化断言等偷懒改动。

description.en: Session settings, MCP servers, and Skill management plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里直接管理会话设置、MCP 服务器和技能，按需配置全局或单个会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 进度汇报提醒插件：累计每 N 步或每 N 秒提醒 Agent 汇报一次进度，侧栏实时显示计数，聊天区横幅显示上次提醒时刻。附带余额低额提醒与 DeepSeek 峰谷时段指示。
description.zh: 长回合里定时提醒 Agent 主动汇报进度，侧栏看计数、横幅看上次提醒，还能盯余额和峰谷时段。

description.en: Interactive character for Harness Desktop with task expressions, rice feeding, an iron-basin hat, dragging, and time-based greetings.
description.zh: 为 Harness Desktop 添加任务表情、白饭喂食、铁盆帽、拖动和时间问候的互动角色。

description.en: Hierarchical multi-agent team coordination with lead review gates, write-scope isolation, and floating workspace.
description.zh: 具备主控审查门禁、文件范围隔离与悬浮工作台的多模型主从协同插件。

description.en: FHL Images generation and multi-reference editing for DeepSeek Harness, with three agent tools, a pool of up to ten API-key workers, and chat-based key configuration.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 FHL Images 生图与多参考图编辑，含三个 Agent 工具、最多十个 API Key Worker 的池，以及聊天内配置 Key。

description.en: Adds host file management and an interactive Bash terminal to the DSH WebUI.
description.zh: 为 DSH WebUI 添加好用的独立文件管理与终端页面，及附属实用功能。

description.en: Branch chip in the composer tool row that switches, creates, and refreshes workspace branches, commits a checked subset of changed files with a message the session's own model writes from the diff, and pushes the current branch.
description.zh: 位于 composer 工具栏的分支标记：切换、新建、刷新工作区分支；提交时可勾选部分改动文件，提交信息由当前 Session 的模型根据 diff 生成；并可推送当前分支。

description.en: Requirements interview before work starts: judges whether a request is clear, asks focused questions when it is not, in strict mode denies editing tools until the user confirms a four-part summary in chat, and keeps confirmed preferences in two-layer memory.
description.zh: 开工前先做需求访谈：判定任务是否说清楚，没说清就分轮追问；strict 档位下用户未在对话中确认四段需求清单前，拦截编辑类工具；确认过的偏好写入两层记忆。

description.en: 器灵 · 跑在你自己电脑上的记忆与人格助手插件:以「人在循环」的双向复盘为核心回路,人格由共同记忆长出并有定型锁,记忆树可归并、可回溯、每次改动都留痕。  Artifact Spirit — a local-first memory & persona plugin for DeepSeek Harness. A two-way review loop with a human in it; an auditable memory tree; a persona lock you hold.
description.zh: 把散落的历史对话变成器灵自己的记忆和人格，全在本地，可调可回滚。

description.en: Read-only semantic retrieval for meow-memory: a local bge-m3 vector index over memory entries and conversation turns, a knowledge graph, and verbatim turn recall. Never writes back to the memory store; requires meow-memory.
description.zh: meow-memory 的只读语义检索增强层：为本机记忆条目与对话轮次建 bge-m3 向量索引，提供记忆图谱与逐字原文召回，绝不回写记忆库；需与 meow-memory 搭配使用。

description.en: Optional read-only bridge plugin that publishes live dsh session and token statistics as one JSON snapshot for the standalone dsh-minato toolkit to read.
description.zh: 可选的只读桥接插件：把 dsh 的会话与 token 实时统计写成一份 JSON 快照，供独立的 dsh-minato 工具箱读取.

description.en: AI 编译小说工作台 / AI novel writing workbench for DSH: outline to full book with AI review, writing assets, bookshelf and AI assistant
description.zh: 把小说大纲变成完整书稿的AI写作台，支持章节生成、审稿质检和全本导出。

description.en: DSH 插件（上游 Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model 的 Fork）：把 13 个免费渠道与免费模型并入官方模型选择器，自带渠道网关供其它本地 harness 反代；本 Fork 新增「隐藏渠道模型分组」总开关与按面积计价。
description.zh: 把 13 个免费渠道和免费模型接进官方模型选择器，还能给本地其它 harness 当反代，白嫖更省心。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：底栏会话消费金额、每条回复本轮金额、右上角开放平台余额/今日用量/峰谷，点击弹出折线图。
description.zh: 在 DSH 底栏实时显示会话花了多少钱、每条回复本轮花费，右上角还能看余额和今日用量，点开有折线图。

description.en: A plugin to completely delete sessions and clean up the associated files in the .dsh/sessions directory.
description.zh: 用于彻底删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并同步清理 .dsh/sessions 目录下相关文件的插件。

description.en: Visual session state badges for DeepSeek Harness: prefix a session title with customizable emoji badges (wip 🚧 blocked ⏸️ review 👀 done ✅) — configurable default state for new sessions, session_prefix model tool, /state command, Web settings. session-prefix：用会话标题前缀（默认 Emoji，可自定义）标记项目状态，含新会话默认状态、Agent 工具与 /state 命令。
description.zh: 给会话标题加上 emoji 状态前缀，一眼看出哪些在做、卡住、待审或已完成。

description.en: Deterministic, recoverable tool-result compression and cache-aware compaction for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 压缩工具返回的大段文本，节省 token 并支持缓存感知的上下文压缩，让对话更省更流畅。

description.en: Provides three learning skills for course notes, conceptual explanations, and self-contained lecture chapters, with bundled references and course helper scripts.
description.zh: 提供课程阅读稿、理解式讲解与自足讲义三个学习技能，附带参考文件和课程辅助脚本。

description.en: Delivery board for client-project teams: stage pipeline (default or governance template, or custom stages), cards with owner, due date, acceptance criteria and DoD, an automatic handoff audit log when a card changes stage, a progress/risk/blocker/decision log, a weekly Markdown client report, a loopback-only drag-and-drop board and a read-only HTML export; state lives in delivery.json in the workspace (11 delivery_* tools plus a /delivery command).
description.zh: 面向客户项目交付团队的交付看板：阶段流水线（default 或 governance 模板，也可自定义阶段），卡片含负责人、截止日、验收标准与 DoD，卡片跨阶段时自动记录交接审计日志，进展/风险/阻塞/决策日志，Markdown 客户周报，仅绑定 127.0.0.1 的可拖拽本地看板与只读 HTML 导出；状态保存在工作区的 delivery.json（11 个 delivery_* 工具与 /delivery 命令）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 规则管理器：把全局与按工作区的规则注入系统提示词，并分层管理它们

Restart button in the window caption band: one click closes the whole desktop app and relaunches it (the original v0.1.0 restart helper). The repository also ships a tool that patches the installed desktop shell so its tray menu carries a Restart item.
description.zh: 窗口标题栏的重启按钮：点一下关闭整个桌面应用再重新拉起（沿用最初的 v0.1.0 重启逻辑）。仓库另附一个工具，可为已安装的桌面壳打补丁，使其托盘菜单里出现「重启」一项。

description.en: One sentence to an AI agent: create, release and list a DeepSeek Harness plugin. DSH 插件模板与 AI 操作手册
description.zh: 把一句话交给 AI，就能从零建好、测试、发布并上架一个 DSH 插件，全程照着手册自动执行。
把角色预设编辑和子代理派遣授权合并到一个页面，一次保存就能搞定。

description.en: Permanently deletes one session from the sidebar session menu, or several at once from the "..." menu beside the sidebar section title: tick sessions in the list (running ones are refused), then confirm in a dialog — log directory, workspace membership, live Host instances and the client list row are all cleaned. The same "..." menu also collects the session search and view options. It also sweeps rows whose log is already gone, and retries a user message or an assistant reply from the button right of Copy.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话行的「…」菜单里永久删除单个会话;也可从侧栏标题旁的「⋯」菜单进入批量删除:在列表里勾选会话(运行中的不能删),再在确认弹窗里一次删掉 —— 会话日志、工作区归属、宿主内存实例、客户端列表行一并清理。同一个「⋯」菜单还收着会话搜索与视图选项;另可清理日志已不存在的残留行,用户消息与 AI 回复的复制按钮右侧各有「重试」。

description.en: dsh-whale-run — a hidden mini-game plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) desktop. 把 dsh 界面上那只鲸鱼摘下来，放到输入框上方的跑道上跑一局。
description.zh: 把 dsh 界面上的鲸鱼摘下来放到输入框上方跑道上，玩一局恐龙跳跳乐式的小游戏。

description.en: Generate images from the agent on the user's own GPU by queueing a workflow on a local ComfyUI install over its HTTP API: Z-Image-Turbo for fast drafts and Qwen-Image-2.1 for final assets and legible in-image text. Registers comfyui_generate and comfyui_status plus a skill covering model selection and prompt craft, has no runtime dependencies, and starts ComfyUI headless when no server is listening.
description.zh: 通过本地 ComfyUI 的 HTTP 接口把工作流排到用户自己的 GPU 上，由 Agent 直接生图：Z-Image-Turbo 适合快速草稿，Qwen-Image-2.1 适合成图与图中文字排版。 注册 comfyui_generate、comfyui_status 两个工具和一个涵盖模型选择与提示词 写法的 skill，无运行时依赖；没有 ComfyUI 在跑时会自动 headless 启动一个。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness agents: automatic recall each turn, a retain/recall/reflect tool, standing rules, and visibility you scope to the whole bank, a preset, or a session.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体装上长期记忆，每轮自动回忆，还能手动保留、召回和反思，让对话不中断。

description.en: 树形任务流 · DeepSeek Harness 插件：把多步任务组织成目标→任务→子任务三级树，节点完成时由 AI 提交结果，插件随即把该节点的执行过程从上下文里折叠掉。
description.zh: 把多步任务拆成目标→任务→子任务三级树，节点完成后自动折叠执行过程，省上下文。

description.en: VibeDev 影视工作台：在 DeepSeek Harness 和 VibeDev 的右侧栏打开画布式影视工作台（剧本、分镜画布、图片/视频/音频生成、剪辑成片），模型与费用统一走 VibeDev 账号 · VibeDev Film: a canvas film workbench in the right sidebar of DeepSeek Harness and VibeDev (script, storyboard canvas, image/video/audio generation, e
description.zh: 在侧边栏打开画布式影视工作台，从小说拆解到剪辑成片一条龙，模型费用走 VibeDev 账号，免填 API Key。

description.en: Unofficial DSH Desktop provider extension: composer provider/account/model controls with per-account subscription quota
description.zh: 在输入框里直接切换 AI 提供商、账号和模型，还能查看每个账号的订阅额度。

description.en: Open a persistent side conversation from any DeepSeek Harness session to investigate questions, clarify requirements, or explore alternatives without polluting the main task’s context, then review and send a concise conclusion back to the parent conversation. Tested with DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1.
description.zh: 在主任务之外开个持久支线会话，把问题聊透再把结论带回主任务，不污染主上下文。

description.en: Registers a real-browser URL-to-text MCP server in a DSH profile: fetch_url and fetch_urls render JavaScript-heavy and anti-bot Chinese pages (Zhihu, CSDN, Juejin, cnblogs) and return clean article text as JSON with per-tier diagnostics, and crawler_status reports whether the browser is available. Needs a one-time Python dependency setup after install.
description.zh: 把真实浏览器抓取注册进 DSH profile：fetch_url 与 fetch_urls 渲染 JS 页面与中文反爬站点（知乎、CSDN、掘金、博客园），返回带分层诊断的干净正文 JSON，crawler_status 报告浏览器是否可用。装好后需要一次性安装 Python 依赖。

description.en: Agent plugin for major harnesses — DeepSeek Harness (DSH), OpenCode, Pi and Codex: define custom AI agent roles with per-role prompts, models, skills, permissions, memory and multi-agent orchestration.
description.zh: 给 AI 智能体自定义角色，每个角色单独配提示词、模型、技能、权限和记忆，还能让多个智能体协作干活。

description.en: 面向 AI Agent 的 Markdown 转 Word 工具：中文排版、Mermaid 图表、可编辑数学公式，提供 Skill、独立 CLI 和 DSH 插件。
description.zh: 把 Markdown 一键转成可交付的 Word 文档，中文排版、Mermaid 图表和数学公式都自动处理好。

description.en: Deep-sea skin for the DSH Web UI: an 80-token light/dark theme layer, a two-layer background, a gradient sidebar with a whale sticker, a wordmark that doubles as the skin switch, and a rotating turn-status line.
description.zh: DSH Web 深海皮肤：80 条明暗双值令牌、背景两层、渐变侧栏与鲸鱼娘贴纸；左上角大字标就是皮肤开关，运行中的状态文案每 6 秒轮播。

description.en: dsh Bots workbench: Cordis plugin bridging the sdk-bots orchestration gateway into the dsh web shell (chat, groups, MCP, per-agent workspace jail)
description.zh: 把多个AI机器人接入dsh网页终端，支持单聊、群聊和MCP工具调用，每个智能体有独立工作空间。

description.en: Embeds an Overleaf site (overleaf.com or a self-hosted instance) into a conversation tab through a same-origin reverse proxy, with cookie or popup login, selection quoting, caret insertion, compile-log driven fixes, outline navigation, and .bib / .tex synchronization.
description.zh: 把 Overleaf 站点（公有云或自托管实例）经同源反向代理嵌入会话页标签，支持 Cookie 或弹窗登录、选区引用、光标处插入、编译日志驱动的修复、文档大纲跳转与 .bib / .tex 双向同步。

description.en: WorkBuddy's 增强提示词 (Enhance Prompt) as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: rewrite the composer draft into a stronger prompt with one click.
description.zh: 在输入框旁一键把草稿改写成结构清晰、要求明确的提示词，并自动写回。

description.en: dsh-skill-sidebar 技能面板：DSH 右侧边栏技能面板（Skills panel）— 扫描本机技能目录列出全部技能，4-6 字功能短语 + 目录标签 + 一键复制调用 + 置顶 + 默认自动打开 + 每周刷新
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏加一个技能面板，自动扫描本机技能目录，一键复制调用、置顶常用技能。

description.en: Harmony WebUI Studio for isolated DSH plugin development
An architecture-graph driven framework for Agentic Engineering.
description.zh: 用架构图统一描述智能体流程和产品设计，帮你更直观地搭建、编排和管理智能体工程。

description.en: Cloudflare Code Mode MCP global bundle for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — mcp__cloudflare__* tools + cfbridge skill + wrangler passthrough
description.zh: 把 Cloudflare 的 MCP 工具、cfbridge 技能和 wrangler 命令打包进 DSH，让你在对话里直接管理 Cloudflare 资源。

description.en: Manage DeepSeek account balance and usage from the DSH web interface.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里查看和管理 DeepSeek 账户余额与用量。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 跨会话记住项目上下文，条目带身份和证据，旧版本还能恢复。

description.en: Ollama Cloud provider for DeepSeek Harness that configures the route on install, publishes each model's own thinking levels for the composer effort control, and shows account usage with an API-key field in the Models page and sidebar.
description.zh: Ollama Cloud 供应商：安装即配好路由，按 Ollama 模型自身元数据公布每个模型的思维链档位（供 composer 的推理强度选择），并在 Models 页与侧栏显示账号用量、提供 API Key 输入。

description.en: Paper reading workbench: a paper library, the PDF beside Markdown notes and one dedicated AI session per paper.
