description.zh: 基于国家标准的自动化数据脱敏工具，自动识别身份证、手机号等敏感字段，支持完全匿名化与假名化分级策略，生成合规审计日志。

description.en: Literature search for DeepSeek Harness: twenty international sources (Crossref, ACM Digital Library, IEEE, OpenAlex, DOAJ, Europe PMC, PubMed, PubMed Central, arXiv, bioRxiv, medRxiv, ChemRxiv, Semantic Scholar, CORE, Zenodo, HAL, IACR ePrint, OpenReview,
One-click health check for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 score, plain-language issue list, and safe reversible fixes via the profile's cordis.patch.yml.
description.zh: 一键体检你的 DeepSeek Harness：0-100 健康评分、问题清单，以及写入 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 的安全可逆一键修复。

description.en: Chain-of-thought leakage linter: zero-dependency CLI that finds AI-session residue in docs and comments (dead design citations, PR vantage, change narration, review choreography), shipping the cot-trim fixing skill as the installable bundle.
description.zh: 思维链泄漏检测：零依赖 CLI 扫描 AI 留在文档与注释里的会话残留（死设计引用、PR 视角、变更叙述、评审编排），内置 cot-trim 语义修复技能包。

description.en: Cron task scheduler for DSH: on schedule, automatically creates a new session and injects your prompt as its first message, with task history and manual run/stop controls. Also runs KNJ workflows: pick files directly (stored as persistent snapshots, re-handed to the workflow on every fire) or reference them by path. Its sidebar entry is provided by dsh-knj-menu; install together: dsh plugin add dsh-scheduler dsh-knj-menu.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：按 Cron 表达式到点自动新建 DSH 会话并注入提示词执行，支持任务历史、手动运行与启停。也可直接调用 KNJ 工作流：支持直接选文件（持久化快照，每次触发重新交给流程）与按路径引用两种方式。侧边栏入口由 dsh-knj-menu 提供，一条命令安装：dsh plugin add dsh-scheduler dsh-knj-menu。

description.en: Turns the LobsterDaddy multi-account console into a floating ball in the DSH window: drag it anywhere and the position persists, and the panel can be set to follow the ball. Clicking it slides out a drawer that renders the console as native DOM (no iframe) from the loopback-only same-origin proxy, showing action buttons, the account LobsterAI is currently signed in as, and a per-account list with balance, check-in state and last check-in time; a resizable persisted drawer, a live online/offline dot and an account-count badge are included.
description.zh: 把 LobsterDaddy 多账号控制台变成 DSH 界面上的悬浮球：可拖到任意位置并自动记忆坐标，面板可设置为跟随悬浮球移动；点开以抽屉呈现控制台——界面由原生 DOM 渲染（不用 iframe），数据经仅限本机的同源反向代理获取，自上而下为操作按钮、当前登录账号、以及含积分余额与签到状态（附最近签到时间）的账号列表；抽屉可拖动缩放并记忆尺寸，另有在线状态圆点与账号数徽标。

description.en: Test-stability tools: repeatedly run vitest/jest/pytest/node:test suites, classify flaky cases, keep history, maintain a quarantine manifest and health self-check.
description.zh: 测试稳定性工具：重复运行 vitest/jest/pytest/node:test，识别 flaky 用例，历史留档、隔离清单与健康自检。

description.en: Persistent owner-scoped business goals over the native DSH goal domain.
Quantitative data quality scoring based on GB/T 36344-2018, providing auditable quality reports for data asset capitalization.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 36344-2018 国家标准，从规范性、完整性等六个维度对数据质量进行量化评分，为企业数据资产入表提供可审计的底稿。

description.en: Adds 20 locales (Traditional Chinese HK/TW, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Swedish) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with hand-polished translations, runtime fallbacks, and automatic translation of market and third-party text.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面新增 20 种语言（繁体中文香港/台湾、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、俄语、乌克兰语、波兰语、荷兰语、土耳其语、阿拉伯语、印地语、印尼语、越南语、泰语、瑞典语），逐条精译并带运行时兜底，另加自动翻译，把市场与第三方文本翻译成你的语言。

description.en: Windows desktop shortcut for dsh web: launches the server, auto-opens the browser when ready, and stops the service when the Harness window closes.
description.zh: Windows 桌面快捷方式：一键启动 dsh web，就绪后自动打开浏览器，关闭 Harness 窗口即停服务。

description.en: Connects GitHub's official remote MCP server as a DSH plugin: stores the PAT in DSH's credential center (.credentials.yaml) via github_set_token, and exposes GitHub tools as mcp__github__*.
description.zh: 把 GitHub 官方远程 MCP server 封装为 DSH 插件：PAT 存入 DSH 凭据中心（.credentials.yaml），提供 github_set_token / github_token_status 模型工具，GitHub 工具以 mcp__github__* 形式可用。

description.en: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness: provider-scoped PDF and image input, with Responses API streaming support.
description.zh: 火山方舟 Coding Plan 的 DeepSeek Harness LLM provider：provider 级 PDF 与图片输入，支持 Responses API 流式。

description.en: Reports DeepSeek Harness session activity to a self-hosted cc-monitor server, which surfaces Claude Code and DSH sessions as color-coded state cards in one web dashboard and pings your browser and Android app when a session needs attention.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话活动上报到自托管的 cc-monitor 服务器：Claude Code 与 DSH 会话以彩色状态卡片出现在同一个 Web 仪表盘中，会话需要关注时通过浏览器与 Android 应用通知你。

description.en: Owner-authorized goal event opportunity filtering with durable utility decisions and cooldowns.

Replaces the DSH sidebar with a fixed 2×4 board of eight standing agent seats; each seat shows its own status, latest tool call, reasoning and result, and a settings switch restores the stock sidebar at any time.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏换成固定的 2×4 八席看板，每席显示自己的状态、最近一次工具调用、思考与结果；设置里的开关可随时切回原生侧栏。

description.en: Transport-level authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with server-side sessions, HttpOnly cookies, IP-based login throttling, and an scrypt password CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的传输层认证门禁，提供服务端会话、HttpOnly Cookie、基于 IP 的登录限流及 scrypt 口令 CLI。

description.en: Doubao Search (Volcengine 豆包搜索) web search provider for the DeepSeek Harness — swaps the active web_search backend to the standalone Doubao Search API with its own key and billing (500 free searches per month), and ships a dedicated settings card that stores the key via the credentials service.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供豆包搜索（火山引擎）网络搜索提供方——把 web_search 的后端切换为独立的豆包搜索 API，密钥与计费独立（每月 500 次免费），并内置专用设置卡片，经凭据服务保存密钥。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to FitMeet through per-user OAuth with 17 tools for people search, gatherings, notifications, personal items, connection feedback, Hall publishing, and direct messages, with preview-and-confirm guards for write actions.
description.zh: 通过每位用户独立的 OAuth 授权将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 FitMeet，提供找人、组局查询、提醒、个人事项、连接反馈、大厅发布与私聊的 17 个工具，写入操作保留预览与确认步骤。

description.en: A conversational voice frontend Agent for dsh: speak naturally over ByteDance Duplex, delegate requests to background tasks, and hear their asynchronous results reported by voice.
description.zh: dsh 的对话式语音前端 Agent：通过 ByteDance Duplex 自然对话，把语音请求委派给后台任务，并用语音回报异步结果。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek Harness LLM token usage and cost (CNY, peak/off-peak pricing) with a settings dashboard, agent tools, HTTP API and persistent storage.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM Token 用量与花费（人民币、峰谷计价），提供设置面板、Agent 工具、HTTP 接口与持久化存储。

description.en: Routes DSH filesystem, shell, subprocess, and PTY operations to local, SSH, and Docker execution nodes, with a node registry, an authentication gate, a mobile-aware management UI, and per-workspace custom project instructions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供多节点执行路由，将文件系统、Shell、子进程和 PTY 操作分发到本地、SSH 与 Docker 执行节点，并包含节点注册表、认证门禁、移动端管理 UI，以及可注入新对话的工作区自定义项目指令。

description.en: Data lineage tracking tool, mapping the full lifecycle of data to meet source legality requirements.
description.zh: 数据血缘追踪工具，梳理数据从产生到流转的全链路，满足数据产权登记中的来源合法性审查要求。

description.en: Brings the codebase knowledge-base capability of langchain-ai/openwiki into DSH — one-click generate/read/update of the repository Wiki, Grounded Claims (source-traced knowledge cards) and a project knowledge base built from uploaded local files, reusing the model DSH already has configured, with no second API key.
description.zh: 把 langchain-ai/openwiki 的代码库知识库能力搬进 dsh —— 一键生成 / 阅读 / 更新仓库 Wiki 与 Grounded Claims（溯源知识卡片）与项目知识库（上传本地文件），直接复用 DSH 已配置的模型，无需二次填 Key。

description.en: Network and proxy doctor for DSH: checks system proxy settings, probes local proxy ports, detects TUN adapters, tests GitHub, TCP and HTTP reachability, scans hosts conflicts and prints concrete suggestions for what to change.
description.zh: DSH 的网络与代理诊断工具：检查系统代理设置、探测本地代理端口、识别 TUN 适配器、测试 GitHub/TCP/HTTP 连通性、扫描 hosts 冲突，并给出具体的修改建议。

description.en: Authenticated LAN, Tailnet, and public HTTPS access for a DSH Host, with persistent host identity, pairing, and QR setup.
description.zh: 为 DSH Host 提供经认证的局域网、Tailnet 与公网 HTTPS 接入，支持持久主机身份、配对和二维码配置。

description.en: Update copilot for DeepSeek Harness: one scan covers the DeepSeek Harness core and every profile plugin; explains what changed and how risky each update is, then updates only what you confirm.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的更新助手：一次扫描覆盖 DeepSeek Harness 本体和每个 profile 的插件，说清改了什么、风险多大，只更新你确认过的那些。

description.en: Explain a selected word or sentence from a DSH conversation in a floating window: a channel of its own that leaves the session untouched, and the answer can be pinned to a session of its own.
description.zh: 在浮窗里解释 DSH 对话中选中的词或句子：走独立通道、不污染当前会话，解答可以固定成独立会话。

description.en: Git workbench in the DSH session header and overlay: view changes, commit, fetch, pull, push, and browse branches and history in existing local repositories.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话标题栏与浮层工作台中管理已有本地仓库，支持查看改动、提交、获取、拉取、推送以及浏览分支和历史。

description.en: Literature research toolset registering 26 model tools over PubMed, Europe PMC, OpenAlex, PubTator3 and Semantic Scholar: field-syntax search, ID conversion, bibliographic lookup, citation formatting, MeSH and related-article walking, PubTator bioconcept resolution and relation queries, Europe PMC and Semantic Scholar paging, full-text retrieval, and open-access PDF discovery with optional download. A unified search deduplicates hits across sources and orders results by cross-source hits, then relevance, then citation count; a session knowledge graph with PubTator concept enrichment commits to a persistent user graph and renders as Mermaid. Most sources need no key.
description.zh: 文献研究工具集，注册 26 个模型工具，覆盖 PubMed、Europe PMC、OpenAlex、PubTator3 与 Semantic Scholar：字段语法检索、ID 互换、残缺引文定位、引文格式化、MeSH 与相关文献追溯、PubTator 生物概念归一与关系查询、Europe PMC 与 Semantic Scholar 翻页检索、全文获取，以及开放获取 PDF 发现（可选下载）。统一检索会跨源去重，排序依次按跨源命中、相关度、被引数；会话知识图谱带 PubTator 概念富集，可提交为持久用户图谱并渲染为 Mermaid。多数数据源无需密钥。

description.en: Natural-language data queries + BI reports: Text2SQL, charts, report saving, schema/data grid panel, and a sidebar workbench — all behind DSH's MySQL connection layer.
description.zh: 自然语言查询 + 商业智能报表：Text2SQL、图表、报表收藏、Schema/数据面板与侧栏工作台，基于 DSH 的 MySQL 连接层。

description.en: Provisions the kimi-webbridge bridge daemon (auto-install with SHA-256 verification, auto-start) and registers a 25-action skill that drives the user's real browser through the local bridge.
description.zh: 自动安装并启动 kimi-webbridge 桥接守护进程（含 SHA-256 校验），注册一套 25 个动作的技能，通过本地桥接驱动用户的真实浏览器。

description.en: Markdown live rendering for the DSH Web UI composer: typed Markdown (bold, lists, code fences) renders as you type in a CodeMirror-based takeover composer; sent user messages render as Markdown; pasted rich text becomes clean Markdown.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 输入区 Markdown 实时渲染：输入中的粗体/列表/代码块即时成型（CodeMirror 接管卡）；已发送的用户消息按 Markdown 呈现；粘贴富文本转为干净 Markdown。

description.en: Verifiable issue-to-PR delivery chain: an 11-stage pipeline (analysis, search, code understanding, hypothesis, planning, implementation, patch ledger, tests, review, failure classification, PR build) with 4 human review gates, GitHub/GitLab/CodeArts credential connections, a 5-page workbench and a draggable AI assistant panel.
description.zh: Issue-to-PR 可验证交付链：11 阶段流水线（分析→检索→理解→假设→规划→实现→补丁→测试→评审→归因→PR 构建），4 道人工复核闸门，GitHub/GitLab/CodeArts 凭据连接，5 页工作台与可拖拽智能助手浮窗。

description.en: Delegates a self-contained coding task to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Claude Agent SDK, and adds a session tab with live output, cost and remaining quota.
description.zh: 把自包含的编码任务委派给本机 Claude Code 订阅执行（走官方 Claude Agent SDK），并在会话里新增一个标签页，实时显示输出、费用与剩余额度。

description.en: Git workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness: a repo-gated composer button opens a settings-style panel for diff/commit, branch, conflict, and worktree management, plus a commit history with branch-graph lines.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工作区管理：输入框「模式」选择器旁的仓库感知入口，打开与设置同规格的面板，覆盖 diff/commit、分支、冲突、worktree 管理与带分支线的提交历史。

description.en: Real DeepSeek account balance and official spend tracker in the session header, with peak/off-peak badge, monetary alert with auto-stop, and one-click top-up.
description.zh: 会话头部的真实 DeepSeek 余额与官方消费统计：高峰/空闲标签、按金额提醒与自动停止、一键充值。

description.en: Pixel-art reasoning-effort slider for DSH Web with continuous 0–100 dragging, 16ms throttled writes, snap-to-level commits, and a WebGL ember fire that ignites as the slider moves.
description.zh: 炭灰余烬风格的 DSH Web 像素推理强度滑块：以近黑木炭、暗红裂纹和橙红高温核心呈现 4px 像素化 WebGL 火焰，拖动时逐档点燃；支持 0–100 无极拖动、16ms 节流写入与松手吸附。

description.en: Configurable sandbox for dsh: replaces the shipped process-sandbox provider and filesystem fence with implementations that add extra writable roots, read-only roots and access denials on top of the upstream semantics, and owns the runtime-context snapshot

Session instruction anchor for DeepSeek Harness: the first step of a new session injects a freely composed instruction block as a plugin-sourced message, and it is re-anchored after a summarizing compaction, every N turns, or when metered context pressure crosses a threshold. An /anchor command re-anchors on demand without a model call; a settings page manages the paged preset library, injection order, re-anchor source and character limits.
description.zh: DSH 会话指令定锚：新会话的第一个 step 把自由组合的指令块作为插件来源消息注入，之后在完成压缩、跨过设定轮数、或计量到的上下文压力越过阈值时重锚。`/anchor` 命令可按需定锚且不触发模型调用；设置页管理分页预设库、注入顺序、重锚来源与字数上限。

description.en: The dsh security mode plugin achieves a zero third-party plugin startup by constructing a blank profile.
description.zh: dsh安全模式插件，通过构建空白profile实现零第三方插件启动。

description.en: Sidebar archive directory for DSH Web: restore a session to its original workspace slot, delete the session log, or edit-and-branch a user message into a new conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏归档目录：将会话恢复到原工作区槽位、删除会话日志，或从用户消息修改并分支为新会话。

description.en: Multi-tab side chat for DeepSeek Harness. Quote a whole message or text selected from a still-streaming reply into a side chat without waiting for the reply to finish, and dock the panel over the better-sidebar workbench or yield to the conversation depending on the sidebar state.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多标签侧聊增强：可引用整条消息，也可在回复生成中选中文本追问（无需等待回复完成）；右侧停靠面板随 better-sidebar 开关在覆盖与让位间自动切换。

description.en: Unified model routing for DeepSeek Harness: one logical ModelID over multiple providers with first-token failover and cooldown, health-aware candidate ranking, three tiers (tier1/tier2/tier3) auto-selected by purpose, per-candidate reasoning effort, and a settings-page management panel.
description.zh: 统一模型路由：一个逻辑 ModelID 汇聚多家供应商，首 token 前失败自动切换并冷却、健康度择优、按 purpose 三档分级（tier1/2/3）、每候选思考级别，设置面板自动保存即时生效。

description.en: Context trimmer: lists the current session's context entries with role, preview and ≈token estimate (cl100k), highlights over-threshold items, and removes selected entries exactly without LLM summarization.
description.zh: 上下文剃刀：把当前会话上下文逐条列出（角色/预览/≈token 估算），超阈值标红，勾选后不经 LLM 精确裁剪，删了什么一目了然。

description.en: Enhanced workspace directory browser for the web UI: one-click access to /mnt Windows drives under WSL, full breadcrumb ancestry and an always-visible path input.
description.zh: Web UI 增强版工作区目录选择器：WSL 下 /mnt Windows 盘符一键直达、完整面包屑层级与常显路径输入框。

description.en: Reusable subagent definitions managed from a Settings page and dispatched through a single delegate_agent tool; ships with a built-in read-only Explorer preset and a nested-delegation policy toggle.
description.zh: 用设置页维护可复用的子代理定义，通过统一的 delegate_agent 工具委派；内置只读的 Explorer 预置与嵌套委派开关。

description.en: Draggable floating ball showing the current DSH session todo checklist live: done/total on its face (capsule mode adds the running task title), a matching progress ring, click to expand or fold the list, right-click for capsule mode, and state colours (pulsing orange in progress, green done, blue pending, grey empty). Replaced plans are archived as history rows that can be hidden, cleared and restored instead of counting towards progress, other sessions can be pinned side by side, and the data comes from the runtime sessions projection first with the official todo panel as a fallback — so the full list survives even when the official strip is collapsed. 128 shared skins (plus the 6 classic ones), Shadow DOM isolation, position remembered per profile, identical on desktop and web.
description.zh: 常驻可拖动悬浮球实时显示当前会话的 todo 清单：球面显示完成数/总数（胶囊模式另显示进行中任务名），外环进度环同步百分比；点击展开或收起完整清单，右键切胶囊模式，状态用颜色区分（进行中橙色脉动、完成绿、待办蓝、无清单灰）。被替换的旧计划自动归档成历史行（可逐行隐藏、批量清理、一键恢复），不再计入进度；其他会话可固定并排查看。数据以 runtime 的 sessions 投影为准，官方 todo 面板仅作兜底——所以官方计划条收起时球上仍是完整清单。128 款共享皮肤（另留 6 款经典），Shadow DOM 样式隔离，位置按 profile 记忆，桌面端与网页端表现一致。

description.en: When a dsh turn gets interrupted — by a web restart or an upstream hiccup (rate limit, 5xx, quota error) — this plugin auto-injects a "continue" so your session picks up where it left off, with a dead-loop guard that hands back control if the retry produces nothing.
description.zh: dsh 会话因 web 重启或上游瞬时故障（限流、5xx、余额/配额错误）中断时，自动注入「继续」让本轮接着跑，不需要手动点、不会丢上下文；带死循环守卫，重试没反应就把会话交回给你。

description.en: Android client implementation for DeepSeek Harness: bridges local dsh web to the OneBox app with QR scan-to-pair and an end-to-end encrypted cloud relay tunnel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端实现:扫码配对 + 端到端加密云端中继,把本机 dsh web 桥接到万宝盒 App。

description.en: DSH 远程目录（电脑端）：把本机 DSH 会话的事件流经 Cloudflare 隧道搬到手机，手机进入电脑目录并发起对话，公网只传文本。含激活码配对流程。
Per-turn file-change card for DSH Desktop: +N −M badges, aligned diffs, and Mac/Windows file open (system app, Finder/Explorer, VS Code).
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 用的轮末改动卡：编辑/写入行显示 +N −M，点开审 diff；macOS 和 Windows 可用系统应用、文件夹或 VS Code 打开文件。

description.en: Seaglass is a highly customizable glassmorphism theme.
description.zh: Seaglass是一个高自由度的玻璃质感主题。

description.en: Delegation bridge for the dsh-realtime seam: answers what the voice model delegates, or says plainly that it cannot.
Layered file memory for DeepSeek Harness with workspace-scoped USER/MEMORY notes, background consolidation, and hybrid session recall.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分层文件记忆，提供工作区隔离的 USER/MEMORY 笔记、后台沉淀与混合会话召回。

description.en: First-class Git tools for the model: status / diff / log / commit / branch with validated messages and paths - no bare-shell git calls.
description.zh: 一等公民的 Git 工具：status / diff / log / commit / branch，参数与路径校验、零 shell 调用，杜绝注入。

description.en: Phone client for DeepSeek Harness — no app to install (PWA). Read sessions, background jobs, subagents, goal rounds, workflows and pending approvals, and talk to any session from it: streamed replies, tool-call progress, stop at any time, switch sessions and models. Also ships a GUI sidebar panel. Formerly dsh-taskwatch; the npm package is now dsh-in-hand.
description.zh: 掌上 DSH（dsh-in-hand）：DeepSeek Harness 的手机端，不用装 App（PWA）。公网与局域网两个入口可随时切换；在手机上读会话、子代理、目标轮次、工作流、后台任务与待审批，和任意会话实时对话（流式回复、工具调用进度、随时停止、切换会话与模型），消息可排队并「立即发送」，支持上传与交付文件。另含 GUI 侧边栏面板；原名 dsh-taskwatch，npm 包已改为 dsh-in-hand。

description.en: Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.
description.zh: 基于 dsh-mobile-gate 的完整移动端 PWA：安全远程访问网关 + 可安装到主屏（manifest + service worker）+ 离线可用 + 触屏手势（下拉刷新/边缘返弹/捏合缩放字体）+ agent 完成推送 + 触屏优先布局，桌面零影响。

description.en: Usage statistics dashboard for the DSH Web UI: info cards, a 280-day GitHub-style activity heatmap, daily token trend, and model-usage donut chart.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 用量统计面板：信息卡、280 天活跃热力图、按天 Token 趋势与模型用量双环饼图。

description.en: Select text in a DSH conversation, a file preview or the terminal to quote it: the floating bar offers Comment, Add to chat and Side chat, and Alt+Q / Alt+C / Alt+B do the same three things. The quote - and its comment, kept in the same chip - is inserted as a native reference chip, and a sent quote stays one rounded capsule in the message that expands on click and can be copied. A hover card can jump back to the message a quote came from, and the right sidebar carries a quote list page that searches every quote of the session, jumps back to any of them and exports them as Markdown. Side chat writes the quote into the composer of one dsh-better-sidebar side thread per conversation without sending it, and that page can bring the thread conclusion back into the main composer or export it as a file. A sent quote can also be revised: the card puts its old comment back in the comment box, the corrected quote is sent as a new message, and the old capsule is marked as superseded (the transcript itself is append-only).
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话、文件预览或终端里选中文字即可引用：浮层提供「评论」「添加到对话」与「侧边对话」，Alt+Q / Alt+C / Alt+B 是同样的三个动作。引用以原生 reference-chip 插入输入框，评论与引用在同一颗芯片里；发送后消息里仍是一颗圆角胶囊，可点击展开、可复制，悬停卡片可「跳回原文」。右侧栏还有一个引用清单页：搜索本会话全部引用、跳回原文、导出 Markdown，底部可把侧边线程的结论带回主会话输入框或导出成文件。已发送的引用还能「改这条引用」：卡片把旧评论放回评论框，改好发出一条新引用，旧胶囊随即标「已修订」（DSH 的消息本身只追加，改不了原消息）。「侧边对话」把引用写进 dsh-better-sidebar 侧边线程的输入框（一条主会话一条线程），不替你发送。

description.en: Automatically sends "continue" to recover from RATE_LIMIT (429) and QUOTA (insufficient_quota) errors. Per-session consecutive-failure counter (default 20, configurable 1-100), a toolbar on/off switch, and a settings-page card.
description.zh: 遇到 RATE_LIMIT（429）或配额耗尽（insufficient_quota）错误时自动发送 continue 恢复对话。每会话独立计数连续失败次数（默认 20，可设 1-100），带工具栏开关条与设置页配置卡片。

description.en: Multi-backend web_search provider (Exa + Firecrawl) for the built-in web_search tool, with automatic failover, per-backend 429 cooldowns, and key-free anonymous access.
description.zh: 面向内置 web_search 工具的多后端搜索提供方（Exa + Firecrawl）：自动故障切换、按后端 429 冷却、无密钥匿名可用。

description.en: Local SQLite long-term memory with CJK-aware search, BM25 and character n-gram cosine reranking, deduplication, and lifecycle management.
description.zh: 基于本地 SQLite 的长期记忆，支持 CJK 分词检索、BM25 与字符 n-gram 余弦重排、去重和生命周期管理。

description.en: Pull a 3D lever next to the send button and turn the model's reasoning signals into a pixel-art gacha reveal.
description.zh: 在发送按钮旁拉动 3D 拉杆，把模型思维链的文本信号变成一场像素风抽卡演出。

description.en: Shows the selected model provider's account balance next to the composer's model seat once a model and reasoning effort are selected.
description.zh: 在选择模型与推理强度后，于输入框模型选择器旁显示当前模型提供方的账户余额。

description.en: Hyperliquid trading desk for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - market workspace, native agent conversation, guarded live / paper trading and an autonomous watch-loop over the Hyperliquid API.
Manage and rank search and page-reading services, including providers from installed plugins, in one settings page.

Proxies the loopback-only dsh web onto a LAN port so phones and other machines can reach it, with an optional access password that browsers type in and the bundled Android client unlocks with biometrics. Adds a LAN-access settings page with QR codes, inlines dsh-web-mobile (MIT, attribution kept) for the mobile layout, and the Android client in the same repository adds finish/approval notifications, voice input and a home-screen widget.
description.zh: 把只监听 127.0.0.1 的 dsh web 转发到局域网端口，供手机等设备访问；可选访问密码——浏览器输入，同仓库的 Android 客户端用指纹或面部解锁。新增带二维码的「局域网访问」设置页，内联 dsh-web-mobile（MIT，保留署名）提供移动端布局；Android 客户端另加完成/审批通知、语音输入与主屏小组件。

description.en: Tri-channel task notifications: in-page toasts with chimes, browser OS banners, and host-direct OS toasts that keep working with the browser closed, plus a bell panel with persistent history.
description.zh: 三通道任务通知：页内浮层与提示音、浏览器系统横幅、宿主直发系统通知（浏览器关闭也送达），附铃铛面板与持久历史。

description.en: Zero-credential Outlook automation: 13 tools that drive the local desktop Outlook client via COM — search/read mail, drafts, reply/forward, calendar, address book, rooms, free/busy — plus a sidebar new-mail badge. No Graph API registration, no SMTP passwords; anything that leaves the machine passes a three-layer human approval gate.
description.zh: 零凭据 Outlook 自动化：13 个工具通过 COM 直接驱动本地桌面 Outlook 客户端——搜信/读信/草稿/回复转发/日历/通讯录/会议室/忙闲查询——外加侧边栏新邮件角标。无需 Graph API 注册、无需 SMTP 密码；任何外发动作都过三层人工审批门。

description.en: An F1 Race Control theme for DSH Web with four switchable team skins, broadcast-photo backgrounds, light and dark modes, and native appearance controls.
description.zh: 一款适用于 DSH Web 的 F1 赛事控制中心主题，提供四支车队皮肤、赛事摄影背景、浅色与深色模式及原生外观设置。

description.en: Requirement-driven dsh plugin discovery and environment recipes: plugin_guide matches natural-language needs to a curated plugin directory with reasons and install commands; recipe installs whole setups (通知全家桶, 安全审计套装...) from bundled community bundles with ordered plans.
description.zh: 需求型插件导购与环境配方：plugin_guide 按自然语言需求语义匹配精选插件并给出理由与安装命令；recipe 一键安装整套社区配方（通知全家桶、安全审计套装等），带有序安装计划。

description.en: Adds a human-editable notes workspace with folders, full-text search, rich text, checklists, resizable tables, attachments, exports, and opt-in agent collaboration.
description.zh: 提供可直接编辑的笔记空间，支持文件夹、全文搜索、富文本、核对清单、可调整列宽的表格、附件、导出和可选的 Agent 协作。

description.en: Ship a project to Cloudflare and publish your plugin to npm — the first deploy needs no cloud account, and credentials never reach the model.
description.zh: 一句话把项目部署到 Cloudflare、把做好的插件发布到 npm：首次部署零账号，凭据模型看不到。

description.en: Bundles the remote-shell skill for secure SSH, SFTP, Telnet, and WinRM remote operations, with an encrypted credential vault whose login and execution scripts never accept plaintext passwords.
description.zh: 打包 remote-shell 技能，提供安全的 SSH、SFTP、Telnet、WinRM 远程操作，内置加密凭证库，登录与执行脚本不接受明文密码。

description.en: Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header, auto-refreshed every 15 seconds with no LLM calls.
description.zh: 零 token 在线状态指示器：会话头部常驻显示 ● 在线 / ● 离线 状态点，每 15 秒自动检测一次，不调用任何 LLM。

description.en: ExHentai.org-inspired UI for DeepSeek Harness. DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai. Charcoal background, light-gray text, gray borders. The session list reads like a gallery index; the composer reads like a search bar. Live Demo: https://dshentai-demo.arkady14.site/
description.zh: ExHentai 皮肤 for DeepSeek Harness。DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai，深炭底、浅灰文字、灰色边框；会话列表像画廊索引，发送框像搜索栏。预览Demo：https://dshentai-demo.arkady14.site/

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that periodically detects added, modified, and deleted files in a workspace and reports the changes.
description.zh: 一个适配 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区监测插件，按周期检测并报告文件的新增、修改和删除。

description.en: Manage the dsh service via `dsh --profile ctl`: systemd lifecycle (install, start, stop, restart, enable, disable, uninstall), persisted config, health probe and logs, plus shell completions and self-update.
description.zh: 通过 `dsh --profile ctl` 管理 DSH 服务：systemd 生命周期（安装、启停、重启、自启、卸载）、持久化配置、健康探测与日志，附带 shell 补全与自更新。

description.en: Real-time hot topics panel for the DSH web GUI: AI news and engineering news, each item with a distilled summary and the source link, shown from a sidebar entry with three views, keyword/source filters, read-state marking and hotkeys.
description.zh: DSH Web 时事热点面板：AI 大事与工科热点实时聚合，每条含要点提炼与来源链接；侧边栏入口、三视图、关键词与来源筛选、已读标记与快捷键。

description.en: Adds a Graph tab that renders one session's execution as an interactive DAG of turns, LLM steps, tools, skills, subagents, code changes and tests, with live status, retry aggregation, critical path and trajectory linkage.
description.zh: 在会话区新增「图谱」Tab，把单个会话的执行过程渲染为可交互 DAG：轮次、LLM 步骤、工具、技能、子代理、代码改动与测试，支持实时状态、重试聚合、关键路径与轨迹双向联动。

description.en: Scan a QR code in Settings to open the DeepSeek Harness web UI on your phone inside the active session via a cloudflared quick tunnel.
description.zh: 在设置中扫描二维码，通过 cloudflared 快速隧道在手机上于当前会话中打开 DeepSeek Harness 网页端。

description.en: DSH workspace hub: organize workspaces into color-coded folders in the sidebar (three-level drag reorder for folders/workspaces/sessions, inline edit, one-click expand/collapse, dual-channel search) with per-workspace and per-session token usage and cost stats from real session logs (official DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing for any deepseek model, three spend calibers, hover detail cards, overview panel) plus OpenCode Go plan usage; data persists to host disk and refreshes live every 30 s.
description.zh: DSH 工作区中枢：侧边栏将工作区按彩色分组管理（分组/工作区/会话三级拖拽排序、内联编辑、一键展开折叠、标题+消息双通道搜索），基于真实会话日志统计每工作区与每会话的 Token 与花费（任意 deepseek 模型自动按官方峰谷价计费、三种时段口径、悬停明细卡、总览面板），另含 OpenCode Go 额度；分组与结果持久化到本机磁盘，30 秒实时刷新。

description.en: Turns the latest completed DSH session turn into a shareable vertical recap video: editable five-scene storyboard, host-side privacy redaction, optional AI polish and TTS narration, MP4/WebM export with PNG cover.
description.zh: 把最近一次已完成的 DSH 任务生成为可分享的竖屏战报视频：五幕可编辑故事板、Host 侧脱敏、可选 AI 润色与配音，导出 MP4/WebM 和 PNG 封面。

description.en: Share the current session over the LAN as a read-only, token-guarded HTML snapshot with session stats and Markdown rendering.
description.zh: 将当前会话以只读、token 保护的 HTML 快照分享到局域网，附带会话统计与 Markdown 渲染。

description.en: Study workbench for exam prep and research: three-column task board with tags and filters, a spaced-repetition queue (simplified SM-2) that keeps finished cards coming back, a heatmap lit by actual focused minutes, weekly reports, per-day review notes, a pomodoro timer that survives panel switches, and Markdown export/import for Obsidian. Installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-study-desk on npm).
description.zh: 备考与科研学习工作台：三列待办墙（标签与过滤）、间隔重复复习队列（简化 SM-2，已完成的卡照样会到期）、按实际专注分钟点亮的热力图、周报、每日复盘、跨面板存活的番茄钟，支持 Markdown 导出与读回（Obsidian 友好）。可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-study-desk）。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go quota usage in the web sidebar's bottom-left corner — rolling/weekly/monthly progress with a hover card, plus a Beijing-time DeepSeek peak-hour timeline.
description.zh: 在 Web 侧边栏左下角显示 OpenCode Go 用量——滚动/本周/本月配额进度与悬停明细卡片，并附按北京时间标记的 DeepSeek 高峰时段进度条。

description.en: A `/backstory` command and tool that annotate each line with the git commit that last touched it and the agent turn + prompt that wrote it, from a persistent per-line ledger (drift-proof by content hash), DSH-* commit trailers, or the live session log.
description.zh: /backstory 命令与工具：为每一行标注最后改动它的 git 提交，以及写下它的 agent 轮次与提示词；数据取自按行持久化的账本（以内容哈希防漂移）、DSH-* 提交尾注或实时会话日志。

description.en: OMC-style multi-agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: 29 omd-* skills and 12 /omd-* slash commands over the plan-execute-review-verify pipeline and team/autopilot/ralph modes.
description.zh: OMC 风格的多智能体编排层：29 个 omd-* skill + 12 条 /omd-* 命令，覆盖 plan-execute-review-verify 流水线与 team/autopilot/ralph 等模式。

description.en: Model-facing `generate_image` tool for text-only models: the model asks for a picture in natural language, Gemini draws it via the Antigravity CLI, the image is saved to a configurable output directory, and the tool returns the file paths for the model to use in its work.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的 `generate_image` 工具：模型用自然语言要一张图，经 Antigravity CLI 让 Gemini 画出，保存到可配置输出目录并返回文件路径，供模型在任务中使用。

description.en: Version-token-validated in-process result cache for the DSH read tool: repeated reads of unchanged files skip file I/O and line rendering, with a readcache tool for stats and clearing.
description.zh: 为 DSH read 工具提供版本令牌校验的进程内结果缓存：未变更文件的重复读取跳过文件 I/O 与行渲染，附带 readcache 工具查看统计与清空。

description.en: Dual-engine screen capture for DSH: inside the SSiD desktop shell, a global hotkey or tray opens a fullscreen box-select overlay (all monitors, per-display pixel-perfect frames) with in-place red-box annotation and a WeChat-style toolbar; in plain DSH (browser), the composer camera button captures the display via getDisplayMedia and reuses the same single-phase box-select + annotation overlay in-page. The cropped image lands in the current conversation composer through the official attachment intake.
description.zh: DSH 双引擎截图：思灵桌面壳内，全局快捷键/托盘打开全屏框选浮层（多显示器、逐屏像素级抓帧），选区定格后工具条就地画红框，一次确认送进输入框；纯 DSH（浏览器）下由输入框相机按钮经 getDisplayMedia 捕获屏幕，复用同一套单阶段框选+标注遮罩。均走官方附件通道。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reader for CSV/TSV/PSV files and xlsx/xlsm workbooks: a sortable, filterable table with sheet tabs. Ceilings on rows, columns and cells, plus two zip-container gates, keep an input from freezing the tab.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的表格读取视图：读取 CSV/TSV/PSV 与 xlsx/xlsm 工作簿，表头可点击排序、可按子串筛选，多工作表以标签切换。行数、列数与单元格数均有上限，另有两道 zip 容器闸门，任何输入都不会卡死标签页。

description.en: A project-scoped memory plugin for DSH. Knowledge authoring and the plugin's own prompts are open to editing, so users can redesign the library structure and how the model is driven without changing a line of code. By default the library is built on one core idea: a project document you design yourself (a handoff by default) is the project entity; the plugin detects which project a session belongs to, binds captured knowledge to that project, and promotes what generalizes into theme and global layers. The most natural logic there is does the pre-filtering of knowledge, with controllable compression and archiving of context.
description.zh: 以项目为主线的 DSH 记忆插件。开放知识书写，以及插件提示词编辑，让用户不改一行代码就能重新设计记忆库结构与模型被驱动的方式。默认的记忆库核心设计在于，项目以一份你自己设计的项目文档（默认是一份交接文档）作为实体，插件自动识别会话所属项目、把沉淀的知识与项目绑定，并把可复用的部分升级进主题与全局层。用最自然的逻辑完成知识的初筛，上下文可控压缩和留档。

description.en: Visualize the plugin and model call flow as a 3D office with six fixed workstations, thought bubbles and a delivery sheet.
description.zh: 把插件与模型的调用过程可视化成 3D 办公室：六个固定工位、思维流气泡与交付纸。

description.en: One-click update for the local DeepSeek Harness checkout — compare versions, pull and rebuild, then restart, and roll back to any past release, all from a sidebar panel with live progress.
description.zh: 一键更新本地 DeepSeek Harness：侧边栏按钮对比版本、拉取重建并自动重启，还可选择回退到任一历史版本，全程实时进度。

description.en: Auditable token ledger for DeepSeek Harness: folds the durable session log into restart-safe totals, recomputes the same numbers from the raw logs and diffs them, and turns usage into a bill by workspace, session, model or vendor, exportable as CSV or JSON.
description.zh: 可审计的 DSH token 账本：把持久化会话日志折算成重启安全的总量，可从原始日志重算并比对差异，并按工作区、会话、模型或厂商生成账单，可导出 CSV 或 JSON。

description.en: Git sidebar panel with commit graphs, ahead/behind tracking, branch operations, and one-click chat context injection.
description.zh: Git 侧边栏面板：提交图谱、超前/落后跟踪、分支操作及改动 Diff 一键带入对话。

description.en: Real-time LSP diagnostics loop: lsp_diagnostics / lsp_workspace_errors / lsp_hover tools over headless stdio language servers (TypeScript/JavaScript + Python), plus an auto-injected post-edit diagnostics delta wired to the harness fs/observed event — Cursor-style edit → diagnostics → fix for dsh agents.
description.zh: 实时 LSP 诊断闭环：通过无头 stdio 语言服务器（TypeScript/JavaScript + Python）提供 lsp_diagnostics / lsp_workspace_errors / lsp_hover 工具，并订阅 harness 的 fs/observed 事件自动注入「本次编辑引入的诊断增量」——为 dsh Agent 带来 Cursor 式的编辑→诊断→修复体验。

description.en: Exposes the DSH workspace as an HTTP API: browse, search and read files, and run natural-language agent tasks that answer with cited sources.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区暴露为 HTTP API：浏览/搜索/读取文件，并支持自然语言任务（agent 查阅文档后带出处回答）。

description.en: Plugin center for VibeDev: describes the official VibeDev plugins and installs them in one click through the plugin manager (inspect, install disabled, then enable, with prerequisites). Also offers a suite install, migration of a renamed package, and a one-click install of the dshmarket plugin market.
description.zh: VibeDev 插件中心：介绍 VibeDev 官方插件，并通过官方插件管理器一键安装（先检查、先不启用地安装、再启用，并带上前置依赖）。另提供套装安装、旧包名迁移，以及一键安装插件市场 dshmarket。

description.en: Ingestion-time tool-output curation: keeps error and warning lines plus head and tail, spills the full text to disk with a pointer the model can read back; covers every text tool, small results pass through untouched.
description.zh: 摄入时点的工具输出治理：保留 error/warning 行与头尾，全文落盘留指针供模型按需读回；覆盖所有返回文本的工具，小结果原样通过。

description.en: Open DSH workspace directories in installed file managers, terminals, and supported editors from the Web UI.
description.zh: 从 DSH Web UI 使用已安装的文件管理器、终端和受支持的编辑器打开工作区目录。

description.en: Per-session status labels (built-in active/done/paused plus custom) shown in the sidebar, conversation header, and hover card, with editable colors.
description.zh: 为每个会话设置项目状态标签（内置进行中/已结项/搁置中+自定义标签，颜色可调），在侧栏、对话头部与悬停卡片中显示。

description.en: Pre-execution safety valve for DSH that judges with TypeSafe Jev: it hooks tools/pre-execute and decides every bash/pwsh call by first applying offline static rules, then by asking the Jev model — the System One model from TypeSafe, which returns a structured decision instead of prose — one yes-no question ("will this command irreversibly delete or overwrite real data?"), turning the answer into allow, revise, block or escalate; revise hands the model a safer rewrite, escalate offers a one-shot human token; exhausted credit or a missing API key degrades loudly instead of failing silent, and a missing key is requested in the conversation itself (`guard key set`, read from stdin); every verdict is appended to a shared audit log and the text people read is bilingual zh-CN/en.
description.zh: DSH 执行前安全阀门，用 TypeSafe Jev 模型做判定：挂载 tools/pre-execute，对每条 bash/pwsh 调用先过离线静态规则，再向 Jev 模型（TypeSafe 的 System One 模型，返回结构化判定而非散文）提一个是非问句——「这条命令会不可逆地删除或覆盖真实数据吗？」——把答案切成允许／修正／拦截／上报人工四态；修正给模型更安全的写法，上报提供一次性人工令牌；额度耗尽或没有可用密钥时大声降级而非静默失效，缺密钥时会直接在对话里要求录入（录入用 `guard key set`，只从标准输入读）；每条判定写入共享审计日志，面向人的文案中英双语。

description.en: AI companion with a learned body clock, real offline sleep, its own memory, and self-reported affect delivered through the same judge math as the pi version.
description.zh: 有生物钟、会真实睡觉、有自己的记忆和情绪的 AI 伴侣，主动冲动以独立 turn 投递。

description.en: Exposes the models already configured in DeepSeek Harness through an OpenAI-compatible gateway, so other local projects can call them with any standard OpenAI client. Multiple provider candidates share one named group with ordered, balanced or random dispatch; upstream failures before any output switch to the next candidate transparently, and rate-limited requests are retried after the provider's backoff. Per-candidate call statistics (attempts, answers, failures, token/TTFT totals) appear as badges in the settings page, and daily aggregates persist to a local file with a 30-day heatmap and trend view. Until you create a key in the UI, the endpoint accepts calls from anyone who can reach it; keys (stored as SHA-256 hashes) then turn authentication on, and the endpoint stays locked even after the last key is revoked. Exposing the optional LAN listener without a key leaves the port open to the whole network. Runs on DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 through 0.1.7-alpha.1 and later.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 里已配置好的模型通过 OpenAI 兼容网关中转出去，其他本地项目 用标准 OpenAI 客户端即可调用。多个供应商候选共享一个具名分组，支持顺序、均衡、 随机三种调度；上游在产出任何内容前失败时自动切换下一候选，客户端无感，被限流的 请求按供应商指示的退避时间自动重试。每条候选的调用统计（尝试、应答、失败、 token/TTFT 累计）以徽章形式显示在设置页，按天聚合的数据落盘为本地文件，附 30 天 热力图与趋势视图。在界面创建密钥之前，接口对任何能访问到它的人开放；创建密钥 （仅存 SHA-256 哈希）后开启校验，且删掉最后一个密钥仍保持锁定，需显式关闭鉴权 才会重新开放。若启用可选的局域网监听而未配密钥，该端口对整个局域网开放。支持 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 至 0.1.7-alpha.1 及以后。

description.en: 自定义浏览器标签页图标:在设置页上传 SVG/PNG/ICO,立即生效并持久保存,自动适配安卓/iOS/平板 PWA 图标,显示未读红点与进行中黄点(工作区数字/会话行/左上角/标签页,数字可点开清单、点条目定位到侧栏),并可把未读数显示为系统应用图标角标(Windows 任务栏 / macOS Dock,含通知权限申请)。· Custom browser tab favicon: upload SVG/PNG/ICO from the settings page, applies instantly a

Current-session message outline rail for the DSH web UI — your messages show as slim bars on the left edge; hover to expand the full outline (line number + text), click to jump instantly to that message. Pure frontend, zero external service dependencies, sessions-snapshot driven with zero polling.
description.zh: 当前会话消息大纲（左缘横杠）——你的消息在对话区左缘显示一列细横杠，hover 展开完整大纲（行号+文本），点击瞬间定位到对话里那条消息。纯前端、零外部服务依赖、sessions 快照驱动零轮询。

description.en: Registers the Inspiration Deck Workshop skill for DSH: local static HTML presentation decks (6 deck templates, 25+ layouts, 23 themes & motion showroom) with a validate + PNG/PDF export CLI and smoke tests, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 注册灵感演示工坊技能：本地静态 HTML 演示文稿（6 套 deck 模板、25+ 布局、23 套主题与动效展示馆），带 validate 校验与 PNG/PDF 导出 CLI 和 smoke 测试，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file upload into the conversation composer, token usage pill with quota tracking, and session archive management — a three-in-one daily-driver addon.
description.zh: 会话输入区拖拽上传文件、Token 用量胶囊与额度跟踪、会话归档管理，三合一日常插件。

description.en: SSH server monitor and terminal sidebar for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏实时查看 Linux 服务器状态，只读监控，装完即用不用配置。

description.en: Customer-machine access plugin for deepseek-harness-gateway: opens a single outbound WebSocket to the gateway and relays the machine local dsh web UI over that tunnel using pairing-code + HMAC auth, so no inbound port, port mapping, or public IP is needed.
description.zh: 客户机接入插件：以单条出站 WebSocket 连接网关，把本机 dsh web 界面经隧道转发给门户，配对接入码 + HMAC 认证；无需入站端口、端口映射或公网 IP。

description.en: Tavily backend for the built-in web search: an in-process endpoint at 127.0.0.1:8787/v1 turns its requests into Tavily searches; up to 10 API keys stay in the DSH credential store, rotate per request and switch on auth, rate-limit or quota errors; a settings card manages keys, runs a test search and points web search at the endpoint.
description.zh: 为内置网页搜索提供 Tavily 后端：在 DSH 进程内提供 127.0.0.1:8787/v1 接口，把搜索请求转成 Tavily 检索；最多 10 个 API Key 存在 DSH 凭据库，按请求轮换，遇鉴权、限流或额度错误自动换下一个；设置卡片可管理密钥、测试搜索并一键接入网页搜索。

description.en: Gives an agent its own email inbox through AgentMail — eleven tools for sending, reading and labelling mail, plus inbound mail delivered into one harness session per email thread, with an approval gate and recipient allowlist on everything outbound.
description.zh: 用 AgentMail 给 agent 配一个自己的收件箱：发信、读信、搜索与打标签共十一个工具；收到的邮件按邮件线程分派，每个线程对应一个独立会话；所有外发邮件都要过审批与收件人白名单。

description.en: Replaces the web profile's pwsh shell executor with a subclass that rewrites every command through `rtk rewrite` before execution for token savings, running the original command unchanged on any rewrite failure (no equivalent, missing rtk, timeout) and keeping sandbox semantics intact.
description.zh: 将 web profile 的 pwsh shell 执行器替换为执行前经 `rtk rewrite` 透明改写的子类以节省 token，任何改写失败（无等价、rtk 缺失、超时）都原样执行且沙箱语义完整保留。

description.en: Token usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: a bar above the composer opens billing token totals, trend charts, per-model and per-project breakdowns and a custom date range, read from local session logs of DSH, Codex, Claude Code, Trae and WorkBuddy. With a self-hosted portal URL and an app key it also reports usage events to that portal; with neither configured it collects nothing. It exposes token_usage tools plus a ctx.tokenReport service, and never collects conversation content.
description.zh: DSH 的 token 用量面板：输入框上方一条用量条，点开是计费总量、趋势图、按模型/项目/来源的分组明细与自定义日期范围，数据来自本机 DSH / Codex / Claude Code / Trae / WorkBuddy 的会话日志；填了自建服务端地址与 appKey 后，用量事件会实时上报到那个服务端，两者都没配时一个字节都不采集；另提供 token_usage 工具与 ctx.tokenReport 服务。不采集对话内容。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .pptx decks: slides in deck order, bullet levels, speaker notes and inline pictures. Ceilings on archive size, per-part inflated bytes and slide count keep a deck from freezing the tab.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的 .pptx 阅读视图：按演示顺序列出幻灯片，还原项目符号层级、演讲者备注与内嵌图片。归档体积、单部件解压字节与幻灯片数量均有上限，演示文稿不会卡死标签页。

description.en: Switch the current DSH session's model with a natural-language sentence, on web, TUI, or IM bridges (WeChat, Feishu), without touching the panel.
description.zh: 用一句自然语言切换当前 DSH 会话模型，可在 Web、TUI 及 IM 桥接的微信、飞书等对话框中使用，无需操作面板。

description.en: Bark push notifications to iPhone: turn completion, waiting-for-input, and approval events sent from the DSH Host.
description.zh: Bark 推送通知到 iPhone：回合完成、等待回答、等待授权等事件由 Host 端发送。

description.en: Codex-style auto-hiding right-edge turn rail: edge-peek show/hide, per-turn tooltip, in-rail search, and a scrolling 30-turn window for long sessions.
description.zh: Codex 风格自动隐藏右缘轮次导航：靠边浮现、单轮 tooltip、会话内搜索、长会话 30 轮滚动窗口。

description.en: Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks: configured shell commands run before/after model tool calls with a JSON payload on stdin; a non-zero pre-tool exit blocks the call.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格生命周期 hooks：工具调用前后自动执行 shell 命令（stdin 收 JSON payload），pre-tool 非零退出即阻断调用。

description.en: A lightweight plugin that adds model thinking token statistics to the bottom Dock.
description.zh: 在底部 Dock 添加模型思考 token 统计信息的轻量化插件。

description.en: OpenCode Go balance pill at the right end of the composer tool row: rolling/weekly/monthly quota remaining straight from the Zen usage endpoint, with hover detail and warn/danger coloring.
description.zh: 输入框工具行右侧的 OpenCode Go 余额胶囊：滚动/每周/每月配额剩余百分比（数据直接来自 Zen 用量接口），悬停查看明细，低余额自动变黄/变红。

description.en: File-defined subagent roles for DeepSeek Harness: roles live in project and global .dsh/roles files, a delegating agent sees one catalog line per role, and each role's tool policy decides which tools its child can see.
description.zh: 用文件定义子代理角色：角色放在项目级与全局级 .dsh/roles 目录，委派方每个角色只看到一行目录，子代理可见的工具由角色自己的工具策略决定。

description.en: Stops DeepSeek Harness from compacting (summarizing) your conversation far too early. Without it, compaction fires around half-full on smaller context windows; with it, compaction waits until the window is as full as you want (80% by default), settable per provider/model. It only changes when compaction happens — what a summary keeps is still DSH’s decision.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 不再过早压缩对话（把早期内容总结掉）。默认行为下，上下文窗口不大的模型（十几万 token 那种）常常在半满出头就开始压缩；装上它之后，压缩会等你设定的比例（默认 80%）到了才发生，并且可以按 provider/model 分别设置。它只改“什么时候压缩”，一次压缩保留哪些内容仍由 DSH 决定。

description.en: ChatGPT-style question nav rail with up/down arrow buttons — per-question tick marks on the chat edge, hover-triggered drawer listing every user question with real-time search filter, one-click smooth-scroll jump, and active-question highlight synced to scroll position.
description.zh: ChatGPT 风格问题导航胶囊，带 ⏫⏬ 上下箭头 — 对话区右侧逐条刻度尺，悬停展开抽屉列出全部用户问题，实时搜索过滤、一键平滑跳转、滚动同步高亮当前问题，会话切换自动重挂载。

description.en: Bridges the harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP server into DSH: HarmonyOS device discovery, build/install/run/uninstall, UI automation (click/input/keys/swipe/screenshot), E2E UI-tree inspection, and log/crash analysis as 18 mcp__harmonyos__* tools.
description.zh: 把 harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP 服务桥接进 DSH：鸿蒙设备发现、构建/安装/运行/卸载、UI 自动化（点击/输入/按键/滑动/截图）、E2E 界面树检查、日志与崩溃分析，共 18 个 mcp__harmonyos__* 工具。

description.en: Registers the remove-pdf-background-gray skill for DSH: whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry, and anti-aliased text edges (lossless Flate write-back), via a single Python script (pypdf + Pillow + numpy).
description.zh: 注册 remove-pdf-background-gray 技能：去除扫描 PDF 的灰色/米白底色，保持分辨率、页面几何与抗锯齿文字边缘（无损 Flate 写回），核心为单文件 Python 脚本（pypdf + Pillow + numpy）。

description.en: Line-anchored read/edit/batch_edit/grep/undo_last_edit tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Every line is addressed by `<line>:<anchor>` so chained edits skip a re-read; stale or ambiguous anchors are rejected and a fresh `<line>:<anchor>` is served back. Un
description.zh: 用行号加哈希定位文件内容，支持精准编辑和撤销上次操作，省去重复读取，提升改文件效率。

description.en: Adds a "用量" section to the DSH Settings page that shows your MiniMax Token Plan usage (5h and weekly windows with reset countdowns), per-model breakdown, and video bonus credits; fetches `/v1/token_plan/remains` via a trusted plugin that holds the API key, auto-hides when no key is configured. MIT.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页「用量」section 展示 MiniMax Token Plan 的 5 小时 / 周窗口用量（带重置倒计时）、单模型明细与视频赠送额度；通过 trusted plugin 调 `/v1/token_plan/remains` 拿 key，未配置 key 时整段 section 自动隐藏。MIT。

description.en: Claude Code-style prompt history, double-Esc picker, selection quote/copy & right-click paste.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格上下键历史回溯、双击 Esc 历史搜索、选中文本引用/自动复制与鼠标右键直接粘贴。

description.en: Multi-channel notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness: dispatches in-page toasts in the foreground and PWA system notifications (Service Worker) or browser notifications in the background, with per-event toggles for task complete, approval request, question, plan review and errors, persistent notifications, and Web Audio synthesized alert sounds without audio files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多通道通知插件：前台弹页面内 toast，后台按可用性切换 PWA 系统通知（Service Worker）或浏览器通知兜底；任务完成、审批请求、提问、计划评审、出错等事件可逐项开关，重要通知驻留不消失，并用 Web Audio 实时合成提示音效、零音频文件零网络上报。

description.en: Sends a desktop notification and chime when a DeepSeek Harness run completes, errors, or waits for approval, with a configurable duration threshold.
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知插件：运行完成、出错或等待审批时发送桌面通知并播放提示音，支持可配置的时长阈值。

description.en: Git commit-and-push automation for DSH with pre-push auditing, rule-based quality scoring, SSH key generation, and a three-tab settings sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 的 git 提交推送自动化：提交前审计、规则质量评分、SSH 密钥生成与三选项卡设置侧边栏。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .docx files: headings from the style map, paragraphs, lists, real table cells, inline pictures and header notes. Ceilings on archive size, per-part inflated bytes and rendered blocks keep a document from freezing the tab.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的 .docx 阅读视图：按样式表识别标题，还原段落、列表、真实表格单元格、内嵌图片与页眉注释。归档体积、单部件解压字节与渲染块数均有上限，文档不会卡死标签页。

description.en: A Herta theme for DeepSeek Harness: an ASCII boot opening ported from the upstream Herta project, a violet palette of design tokens, swappable wallpapers (four bundled, plus image URL, local import, solid colour or off) and a "Herta Appearance" page in DSH settings. Doubles as the theme that dsh-herta ships with.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的黑塔主题：移植自上游 Herta 项目的开机 ASCII 开场、一整套紫罗兰设计令牌、可替换的壁纸（自带四张，也支持图片网址 / 本机导入 / 纯色 / 关掉），以及 DSH 设置里的「黑塔外观」页。它同时就是 dsh-herta 自带的那套主题。

description.en: Matrix-style CLI chat page for the DSH web UI: the agent's thinking streams down the screen as green code rain while replies print normally in the terminal.
description.zh: 矩阵风格 CLI 对话页：Agent 思考过程化作绿色代码雨倾泻而下，回复照常流式显示。

description.en: GitHub project search and analysis: describe your idea in one sentence and the agent searches GitHub for related projects, ranks them by relevance weighted with stars, and returns a structured card — last updated, relevance, stars, weighted score, language and a one-line description for each project. Pick a few repositories and it reads their README, dependency manifest, directory tree and key files to lay out their architecture — so you stand on the shoulders of giants before you start building.
description.zh: GitHub 项目检索与解析工具：一句话输入开发想法，agent 在 GitHub 搜索相关项目，按相关性与 star 加权排序后返回一张结构化的卡片（包括各项目的更新时间、相关性分数、star数、加权后得分、使用的开发语言、一句话简介）。选择几个仓库后，它还能直接读取这些项目的 README、依赖清单、目录树和关键文件等，梳理它们的架构。让你在动手开发前，先“站在巨人的肩膀上”。

description.en: Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh CLI, and insert the reference as a URL or @owner/repo#number mention.
description.zh: 输入框右下角 GitHub 图标打开当前仓库的 issue/PR 搜索弹窗，数据来自本机 gh CLI，点选即以 URL 或 @owner/repo#number 形式插入引用。

description.en: 自定义浏览器标签页图标:在设置页上传 SVG/PNG/ICO,立即生效并持久保存,自动适配安卓/iOS/平板 PWA 图标,显示未读红点与进行中黄点(工作区数字/会话行/左上角/标签页,数字可点开清单、点条目定位到侧栏),并可把未读数显示为系统应用图标角标(Windows 任务栏 / macOS Dock,含通知权限申请)。· Custom browser tab favicon: upload SVG/PNG/ICO from the settings page, applies instantly a

Approval sound effects from the movie NiuLai: plays 「妈妈」 when user confirmation is requested, interrupts it and plays 「牛来！」 the moment the user approves; native Windows playback, zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 牛来确认音：请求用户确认时播放「妈妈」，批准瞬间掐断并播放「牛来！」；梗源电影《牛来》，Windows 原生播放，零外部依赖。

description.en: Balance badge that follows the active model provider: official readings for DeepSeek, Qwen Token Plan and Aliyun BSS, plus Moonshot and OpenRouter endpoints not yet key-verified.
description.zh: 跟随当前模型供应商的额度徽标：DeepSeek、千问 Token Plan、阿里云费用中心取官方真值，Moonshot / OpenRouter 已接官方端点但字段未用真 Key 核对；其余只报本实例实测。

description.en: Translates DSH's private remote protocol into a versioned REST API (chat, sessions, files, devices) for trusted clients such as the Android app dsh-companion, plus a Phone-settings panel with seven inline cards inside the DSH WebUI settings.
description.zh: 把 DSH 内核的私有 remote 协议翻译成版本化 REST 接口（聊天、会话、文件、设备），供 Android 客户端 dsh-companion 等受信任客户端使用；桌面端在 DSH 设置里内联渲染七张折叠卡片（根目录 / 远程访问 / 设备 / 识图 / 回收站 / 审计 / App 下载）。

description.en: Everforest palettes for the DeepSeek Harness Web/Desktop UI: six schemes (dark and light, each in hard, medium or soft) applied as token-level overrides, with the Host half painting the boot palette so the Web loading screen and first frame are already Everforest; a Settings page picks the scheme and can follow the system appearance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web/Desktop 提供 Everforest 配色：深色 / 浅色各硬 / 中 / 软共 6 套，以 token 覆盖层生效；Host 半部在 Client 加载前注入 boot 调色板，Web 的 loading 页与首帧即为 Everforest；设置页可选择色板与跟随系统外观。

description.en: Self-learning loop for dsh: record lessons, draft and promote skills, periodic curator review that corrects, consolidates, and retires skills.
description.zh: dsh 自我学习闭环：记录经验、生成并发布技能，定期审查修正、合并与退役技能。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 把 DSH 工具接到用户自备的 ComfyUI 实例（实例管理 + 工具分配 + MiniMax H3 视频 / Qwen-Image 图像工具）。

JIRA task panel under the DSH composer: per-workspace project key and optional JQL, listing the issues assigned to the current user with status, priority and issue-type chips, a total count, collapse and refresh, links to JIRA, plus a settings card for the base URL and token with a connection probe.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的 JIRA 任务面板：按工作区配置项目 Key 与可选 JQL，展示指派给当前用户的问题，带状态、优先级与类型标签、总数徽标、收起与刷新、跳转 JIRA，并在设置页卡片配置 JIRA 地址与令牌（含连接测试）。

description.en: Security and governance for dsh: rule-based tool denial, full tool-call audit trail, and governance reports.
description.zh: dsh 安全治理：规则化工具拦截、完整工具调用审计轨迹与治理报告。

description.en: Code workbench in the right sidebar: a workspace file tree and a multi-tab Monaco editor with syntax highlighting and version-guarded saving, Tab completion from DeepSeek fill-in-the-middle, per-save checkpoints with rollback, codebase search (plus a codebase_search tool for the agent), and reference chips that insert a selection into the chat as an @path mention.
description.zh: 右栏的代码工作台：工作区文件树 + 多标签 Monaco 编辑器（语法高亮、版本守卫保存），基于 DeepSeek FIM 的 Tab 补全，按次保存的检查点与回滚，代码库检索（另提供 codebase_search 工具给 Agent），以及把选中代码以 @路径 mention 插入对话的引用胶囊。

description.en: MCP server management panel in Settings: add, edit, enable/disable and delete servers across user and workspace scopes with form or JSON editing, and auto-register discovered MCP tools as native conversation tools.
description.zh: 在设置中提供 MCP Servers 管理面板：新增、编辑、启停、删除服务器，支持用户/项目作用域与表单/JSON 双模式编辑，并自动把发现的 MCP 工具注册为对话原生工具。

description.en: Floating widget showing real-time OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly) for every API key, with rate-limit alerts and automatic key-pool discovery.
description.zh: 悬浮组件实时显示 OpenCode Go 各 key 用量（滚动/每周/每月），限流预警，自动发现 key 池。

description.en: Native A2A (Agent-to-Agent) server for dsh: expose this dsh as a callable agent over HTTP with JSON-RPC tasks.
description.zh: dsh 原生 A2A 服务：通过 HTTP JSON-RPC 将本 dsh 暴露为可调用的代理。

description.en: Opens the DSH settings dialog as a full-page screen and moves the close control to a back row at the top left.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的设置弹窗以整页全屏打开，并把退出入口移到左上角的返回行。

description.en: Token usage dashboard in the DSH settings page: nine metric cards (total, today, yesterday, peak day, longest session, active-day streak, active days, sessions, subagent tokens), a GitHub-style daily/weekly/cumulative heatmap, and an activity insight list, aggregated locally from session logs and projection caches, keeping token history after a session is deleted.
description.zh: DSH 设置页的 Token 用量看板：九宫指标卡（累计/今日/昨日/峰值日/最长会话/连续活跃/活跃天数/会话/子代理 Token）、GitHub 风格每日/每周/累计热力图与活动洞察，全部从本地会话日志与投影缓存聚合，会话被删后历史 token 仍然保留。

description.en: Quick-open palette for the Web GUI: Ctrl+P fuzzy-searches an in-memory index of the session workspace (about 51k entries, median query 5 ms) with per-segment path anchoring, dir: and file: prefixes, Tab directory drilling and :line jumps, opens the picked file in the native right sidebar, and drops a file reference into the conversation draft with Ctrl+Enter. Also adds in-file find (Ctrl+F) and a selection-to-reference action to the built-in file preview.
description.zh: Web GUI 的快速打开面板：Ctrl+P 在会话工作区的内存索引上做模糊检索（约 5.1 万条目，查询中位数 5 ms），支持逐段路径锚定、dir: 与 file: 前缀、Tab 目录下钻与 :行号 跳转；选中文件走 DSH 原生右栏打开，Ctrl+Enter 把文件引用放进会话草稿。另为内置文件预览补上文件内查找（Ctrl+F）与选中加入会话。

description.en: Peak / off-peak rate badges for the model selector (every row) and the composer tool row, judged per provider by its own time zone and schedule; the live catalog is served from the host over a fenced route.
description.zh: 为模型选择器（每一行）与 composer 工具行显示峰谷倍率，按每个 provider 自己的时区与时段规则判定；实时目录由 host 经带信任围栏的路由下发。

description.en: Event-driven Hypatia memory for DSH: automatic conversation logging via session events, queued background consolidation (span summaries + work-unit extraction) with a dedicated model route, and recall injection — zero per-call model work in the main sessi

Cross-session message forwarding between DSH sessions: extract one model reply, a user message, or a multi-selected batch of messages and images from one session and deliver it into another, with silent send, draft fill, or send-and-jump delivery, plus prompt templates.
description.zh: DSH 会话间消息转发：把单条模型回复、用户消息或多选合并的消息与图片从上游会话提取出来投递到另一个会话，支持静默发送、填入草稿、发送并跳转三种投递方式，并可套用提示词模板。

description.en: One-tap connect Agnes language, image and video models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. After signing in to the Agnes console (re-login uses AGNES_PASSWORD), you can see the quota windows (5-hour requests, weekly requests, daily images, video), account-wide cumulative usage, and a usage pill beside the input box. AgnesCode desktop models can be connected too (Windows only), re-reading the desktop app login when the token expires, with rate-limit hits backing off on their own.
description.zh: 一键接入 Agnes 的语言、生图、视频模型到 DSH（默认关），自动填入图片识别与思考强度；登录 Agnes 控制台后（重登需 AGNES_PASSWORD），可看额度窗口（5 小时请求、每周请求、每日图片、视频）、账号累计用量，以及输入框旁的用量胶囊；也支持接入 AgnesCode 桌面端模型（仅 Windows），令牌到期时重新读取桌面端登录态，撞限额自动退避重试。

description.en: Conversation timeline dock bar for DeepSeek Harness: a turn-level timeline above the composer with user-prompt hover tooltips and click-to-jump back to the exact chat position.
description.zh: 对话时间线横条：输入框上方按轮次聚合的时间线，悬停显示该轮用户提示词，点击直接跳转到对话中的对应位置。

description.en: Scans the whole C drive and classifies every large folder into A/B/C/D/E/P (safe cache / relocatable / junction-movable / abandoned software / config-memory redline / personal files), then deletes, moves, or redirects on demand — with strong redline protection, dry-run preview and undo. Unknown software decided by LLM fallback + human confirmation. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 扫描整 C 盘,把每个大空间按 A/B/C/D/E/P 分类(无忧缓存/官方可改址/可junction搬/冷废弃软件/配置记忆红线/个人文件),再按需删缓存/junction搬走/引导改址,带强红线保护、dry-run 预览与 undo。未知软件由 LLM 兜底 + 人工确认,动手前先预览、做完可回滚。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

description.en: Feeds every dsh prompt into the local agent-feedback-loop feedback-memory pipeline — captures dissatisfaction, reviews it offline into reflections, and attaches the compiled recurrence-rule context back to the turn, never blocking a prompt. Requires the agent-feedback-loop runtime; running agent-feedback-loop install afterwards wires existing dsh profiles automatically.
description.zh: 把 dsh 的每一轮 prompt 送入本地 agent-feedback-loop 反馈记忆管线——捕获用户不满、离线评审沉淀为反思，并把编译好的复发规则上下文附着回当前轮次，从不阻塞 prompt。需要先安装 agent-feedback-loop 运行时；安装后执行 agent-feedback-loop install 会自动接线已有的 dsh profile。

description.en: A token-based DeepSeek Harness theme plugin with ten presets, custom colors, and system font pickers.
description.zh: 基于原生令牌的 DeepSeek Harness 主题插件，提供十套预设、自定义配色与系统字体选择。

description.en: A memory subsystem for DeepSeek Harness: full ontological memory (event/fact/rule three-ontology) plus a goal system (goal.js) — belief values written via Bridge trigger words, goal activation scored at read time (0.25 domain + 0.35 bridge + 0.40 sim) to recover goal/value long-range associations, journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay, memory_append/read/consolidate plus linghun_goal_update/get/state closed loop. Independent of the original dsh-linghun line. 16/16 on LoCoMo-Plus.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的记忆子系统：记忆完全本体化（event/fact/rule 三本体）+ 目标系统（goal.js）——belief 价值观写侧收录 + Bridge 触发词，读侧重匹配公式（0.25 域命中 + 0.35 触发词 + 0.40 相似度）补上 goal/value 语义远距联想；序时账留痕、情景归档、低置信降权遗忘；memory_append/read/consolidate + linghun_goal_update/get/state 读写沉淀闭环。独立于原 dsh-linghun 演进。LoCoMo-Plus 16/16 满分。

description.en: Windows desktop control through UI Automation, window screenshots and mouse/keyboard input, with per-session app consent and action approvals.
description.zh: 通过 UI Automation、窗口截图和鼠标键盘操作 Windows 桌面软件，支持会话独立应用授权和操作审批。

description.en: OpenCode on DeepSeek Harness — session affinity, Zen/Go gateway origin headers, free-tier tool fallback, and live Go quota display.

DSH web plugin: give any Session a colour mark, shown as a chip in the sidebar and picked from the conversation header. Marks are stored on the Host, so a colour chosen on one device is visible on every other one — including over LAN and tunnels.
description.zh: 给任意会话加上颜色标记：在侧栏显示色条、从会话头部选择颜色；标记保存在宿主上，一台设备选的颜色在其他设备上同样可见。

description.en: Self-contained Cline Pass provider for dsh: register Cline Pass subscription models on the harness LLM seam, enumerate and validate the upstream channels behind each model, pin or exclude them with failover, and drive an account pool. No proxy process and

Cut LLM costs: a Jev (System One) classifier vets each turn against a declarative policy and recommends the subagent model route, so routine work runs at flash rates while the main model keeps the hard parts; explicit /route trigger, runtime delegation-capability gate, credential redaction, and offline policy replay over the verdict log.
description.zh: 降低 LLM 成本：Jev（System One）分类器按声明式策略审查每一轮任务并推荐 subagent 模型路由，让常规工作以 flash 价格运行、主模型专注难点；显式 /route 触发、运行时代理能力门控、凭据脱敏，以及基于判定日志的离线策略回放。

description.en: Realtime voice capability seam for DeepSeek Harness: a provider registry plus the session adapter base.
OpenCode free models for DSH with dynamic model-list refresh, optional HTTP(S)/SOCKS proxy failover, a fail-closed tool bridge and offline agent-scoped compatibility auditing.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode 免费模型，支持模型列表动态刷新与可选的代理出口轮换，并提供默认拒绝不安全转换的工具桥与离线、按 Agent 作用域的兼容性审计。

description.en: Token usage and cost metering for dsh: per-session and aggregate statistics with configurable pricing and reports.
description.zh: dsh 用量计量：会话级与汇总 token 统计、可配置计价与报告。

description.en: Sidebar Git panel for the DSH web GUI: Local Changes and All Commits views, branch, tag and stash management with fetch, pull and push dialogs, merge with conflict handling, and a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar.
description.zh: DSH 网页端的侧栏 Git 面板：Local Changes 与 All Commits 视图，分支、标签与 Stash 管理，fetch、pull、push 弹窗，带冲突处理的合并，以及输入框上的 zsh 风格分支标记。

description.en: Browser automation for DSH: the agent fills in forms, scrapes lists and works across tabs in real pages, using the logins you already have. It drives its own visible window on your desktop — minimise it and it keeps working without stealing focus — and a sign-in, CAPTCHA or native dialog stops the run and hands the page back to you: it never confirms on your behalf. Login state persists (own profile plus session-cookie re-injection). 23 Playwright tools (20 always on, 3 gated and off by default), with a URL allowlist, dialog suspension and a CDP method allowlist that are mechanism-level and pinned by tests.
description.zh: 浏览器自动化：让 AI 用你已经登录的账号，在真实网页上填表、抓取列表、多标签查后台。它跑在你桌面上的一个可见窗口里 —— 最小化它就不抢焦点、安静干活；遇到登录、验证码和原生弹窗会停下来等你，绝不替你点「确定」。登录一次一直记得（独立 profile + session cookie 回注）。23 个 Playwright 工具（20 个常驻、3 个默认关闭的强力工具），URL 白名单、弹窗挂起、CDP 方法白名单都是机制级且有测试钉住。

description.en: Run RunningHub cloud ComfyUI workflows from chat — settings card, sha256 media upload cache, concurrency gate, and background task ledger.
description.zh: 在对话中运行 RunningHub 云端 ComfyUI 工作流：设置卡片、sha256 媒体上传缓存、并发闸门与后台任务台账。

description.en: Cursor and GitHub PR Review style selection toolbar: quote selected text to chat (Cmd+L), write inline comments (Shift+Cmd+L), and batch-insert from a composer dock.
description.zh: Cursor 与 GitHub PR Review 风格划词引用与批注插件：支持划词一键引用到对话（⌘L）、行内展开写批注（⇧⌘L）及输入框上方批注汇总栏一键插入。

description.en: Builds a Markdown knowledge base from your course materials, then drills you until every knowledge point reaches your target accuracy; each answer must include your reasoning.
description.zh: 从课程材料建一份 Markdown 知识库，然后出题刷到每个知识点都达到目标正确率；每题都必须写出思维链。

description.en: Zhihu search, agent tools, knowledge bases, and usage tracking for DeepSeek Harness.
Look & theme plugin for the DSH Web UI: built-in palettes, light/dark/follow-system appearance modes, Open VSX theme search & install, and VS Code theme import with a persisted theme library.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 外观与主题插件：内置调色板、明 / 暗 / 跟随系统外观模式、Open VSX 主题搜索导入与 VS Code 主题导入，主题库持久化。

description.en: Read-only MCP server exposing the dsh-plugin-certification registry: certification grades, snapshots and five-dimension evidence for DeepSeek Harness plugins.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 插件认证登记的只读 MCP 服务，对外提供插件的认证等级、其快照以及支撑它的五维证据。

description.en: Turn the tab icon into a green/amber status light and send browser notifications when a session finishes or awaits your input, with 47 selectable notification sounds.
description.zh: 把标签页图标变成绿/琥珀状态灯，并在会话跑完或有交互待处理时发送浏览器通知，含 47 个可选音效。

description.en: Session workspace file manager: adds a "Files" tab to the conversation area to browse the current session workspace directory tree and manage it in place (upload, download, mkdir, rename, delete, search), with files mentionable into the composer for the agent to process.
description.zh: 会话工作区文件管理：在对话区加「文件」tab，浏览当前会话工作区的目录树并就地管理（上传/下载/新建文件夹/改名/删除/搜索），文件可 @ 进对话框给 agent 处理。

description.en: Continue the sessions on your computer from a phone browser: scan a QR code, approve the device on the computer, then chat, answer approvals, browse workspace files and manage settings in a mobile interface; connects over the same Wi-Fi or through a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel.
description.zh: 用手机浏览器继续电脑上的会话：扫码并在电脑上确认设备后，在移动端界面里对话、处理审批、浏览工作区文件、管理设置；支持同一 Wi-Fi 直连或经 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 连接。

description.en: GitHub-style daily token-usage heatmap on the new-session screen with a selectable calendar-year view, green/blue color schemes, and today / this-month / all-time totals.
description.zh: 新建会话页的 GitHub 风格每日 Token 用量热力图：可选日历年度视图、绿/蓝配色与显示开关，并附今日/本月/累计总量。

description.en: DSH 工作完成提示：一轮工作结束播放「冰冰冰」提示音，并在右下角弹出可点击跳转的通知条；声音、音量、提示范围与自定义音源都在设置页里

A CodeGraph tool scoped to the session's own indexed project, resolved from its workspace directory. One MCP server is launched through npx per project root and shared by every session working there; a project indexed mid-session is enabled without a restart, and the managed child process is reaped when the harness exits.
description.zh: 按会话自身的已索引项目提供 CodeGraph 工具，项目由 workspace 目录解析得出。每个项目根经 npx 启动一个 MCP 服务并被该项目下所有会话共享；会话中途建好索引即自动启用，无需重启；harness 退出时受管子进程被回收。

description.en: Mobile UI adaptation plugin for DeepSeek Harness - overlay drawer navigation, glassmorphism design, safe-area coverage, PWA support.
description.zh: DSH 移动端 UI 适配插件 - Overlay 抽屉导航、玻璃卡片设计、Safe Area 全覆盖、PWA 支持。

description.en: Workspace-first enhanced sidebar for dsh Web that shadows the built-in workspace browser at low priority (one-click toggle back to the official one) and adds soft workspace archive/restore, per-workspace SVG icons and accent colors, drag reorder and title/path/session-content search, plus a ⌘K Spotlight palette fuzzy-searching workspaces and sessions; the host half ships read-only workspace_find/workspace_list model tools and /workspace-find /workspace-list slash commands. Bilingual zh/en.
description.zh: 面向 dsh Web 的工作区优先增强侧栏：以低优先级 shadow 内置工作区浏览器（可一键切回官方版），提供软归档/恢复、每工作区 SVG 图标与强调色、拖拽排序与标题/路径/会话内容搜索；另提供 ⌘K Spotlight 面板模糊搜索工作区/会话；宿主侧附带只读 workspace_find/workspace_list 工具与 /workspace-find /workspace-list 斜杠命令（中英双语）。

description.en: Explain supported DSH plugin failures with composition source paths and manual next steps: duplicate insertions, missing bundle patches and peer mismatches; standalone CLI and report viewer, read-only diagnosis offline by default, with unobserved runtime left unknown.
description.zh: 通过组合来源路径和人工下一步解释受支持的 DSH 插件故障：重复引入、bundle patch 缺失和 peer 不匹配；提供独立 CLI 与报告查看器，默认只读离线诊断，未观察的 runtime 保留 unknown。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a session cost chip in the conversation header - live token usage by bucket, peak/off-peak tariff, and a countdown to the next tariff switch.

Adds hover Recall / Delete / Delete-onward actions to every message row: removes content from the model context and the transcript together via durable append-only tombstones, with an empty-content guard so old deletions can never break strict providers. Tested on the DSH 2.0 desktop.
description.zh: 给会话里的每条消息加上「撤回 / 删除 / 删除此处及之后」悬浮按钮：以 append-only 墓碑让内容同时从模型上下文与对话界面消失，带空内容兜底，旧删除不会打回严格校验的 provider。已实测支持 DSH 2.0 桌面版。

description.en: Adds a sidebar tab that folds a session into user turns (input, tool steps, output) with one-click jump back into the conversation.
description.zh: 在侧边栏按用户轮次折叠会话（输入、工具步骤、输出），一键跳回对话原位。

description.en: Local BM25 auto-recall, a fail-closed write guard, a static doctor and a memory panel for an Engramory markdown store. No network, no daemon and no model calls unless you opt in; recall quality is measured by a reproducible benchmark in the repository.
description.zh: 给 Engramory 记忆库加本地 BM25 自动召回、写入闸门、静态体检与记忆面板。不联网、不起进程，默认不调模型；召回质量由仓库里的可复算基准量化。

description.en: Full-interface whale skin pack for the DSH Web UI — layered wallpaper, metallic trim, lace and bows, a corner mascot that reacts to agent state, ambient particles, plus an installable third-party skin-pack format.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面全屏鲸鱼皮肤包：多层壁纸、金/银描边、蕾丝蝴蝶结、随 Agent 状态反应的角落立绘与环境粒子，并支持可安装的第三方皮肤包格式。

description.en: 给同事的运维请求通道：同事在飞书私聊机器人提一件事，你在审批卡上点「同意」后，由你指定的那条 DSH 会话带着你配好的工具与人设去办，结果以卡片回到提交人的飞书（Markdown 正常渲染），不需要公网入口。四个特点：配对码把发送者绑成管理员，机器人只服务指定账号；非管理员请求走审批卡片，同意/拒绝都校验点击人身份；请求串行排队，前一条整轮 turn 跑完才注入下一条；目标会话启动时主动 resume，不用先有人在界面上点开。
description.zh: 给同事的运维请求通道——同事在飞书私聊里提的事先排进串行队列，由已配对的管理员在审批卡上放行后才进入那条共享的 DSH 会话（带注入的人设执行），回答回到提交人。

description.en: In-session "Files" tab (conversation.view, order 20) for dsh Web that browses the active session's workspace directory with breadcrumbs and previews files inline — sanitized Markdown (marked + DOMPurify), images, line-numbered text and PDF — served by read-only /dsh-files host routes registered on ctx.webServer; no write endpoints. Bilingual zh/en.
description.zh: dsh Web 会话内「文件」页签（conversation.view，order 20）：以当前会话工作区为根的面包屑目录浏览，内联预览消毒渲染的 Markdown（marked + DOMPurify）、图片、带行号文本与 PDF；目录与读取全部经 ctx.webServer 注册的只读 /dsh-files 宿主路由，无任何写端点（中英双语）。

description.en: Autonomous agent permission gate for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) with automatic git/Time-Machine snapshots. Safe defaults on install (protect cwd, deny network/system, block sensitive reads). Configure protectedPaths/extraAllowTools to tune access for tools yo
description.zh: macOS 上 DSH 智能体的零干预权限门 —— 安装即生效。可经本地 Git 或时间机器回滚的写操作自动放行并自动打快照，拦截网络、装包、进程 / 系统管理与敏感路径读取，并记录完整审计日志（可配置启用自动清理最旧审计记录）。

description.en: Windows computer-use plugin for AI agents with reusable window targets, UI Automation, window-bound screenshots, background-first verified input, isolated Chromium automation, MCP, CLI, and installable skills.
description.zh: 面向 AI Agent 的 Windows 电脑操控与 computer use 插件，支持可复用窗口目标、UIA 无障碍定位、窗口绑定截图、后台优先的验证输入、隔离 Chromium 自动化、MCP、CLI 和可安装 Skill。

description.en: Resumes turns interrupted by a DSH host restart: hooks agent activation (once a session is live), reads the crash-repair turn/end, and sends a continuation that requires verifying real-world state first rather than assuming a side effect succeeded or failed. Permanent failures (AUTH, QUOTA, context overflow) are skipped, with a cross-restart budget, adaptive backoff and a minimal-context payload.
description.zh: DSH 重启后自动续跑被中断的回合：在会话激活后读取崩溃修复写入的 turn/end，投出要求先核对真实状态（不假定外部操作成功或失败）的续跑消息；永久性失败（认证、配额、上下文超限）直接跳过，并有跨重启次数预算、自适应退避与最小上下文注入。

description.en: Matches prompts to installed skills for automatic activation, applies skill-declared lifecycle hooks and tool policies, and manages GitHub-hosted skills from Settings or the skill_manager tool.
description.zh: 根据提示词自动激活已安装的 Skill，应用 Skill 声明的生命周期 Hook 与工具策略，并通过设置页或 skill_manager 工具管理 GitHub 托管的 Skill。

description.en: Assistant reply-body translation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI (OpenAI-compatible channel)

Runs the standalone opencode2api backend (jasonxu114514/opencode2api, Windows x64/ARM64, no Docker or OpenCode CLI) with DSH and on exit stops only the process it launched; its settings card installs, updates or rolls back the backend from checksum-verified GitHub releases, copies the initial admin password and syncs /v1/models into an opencode2api provider with context, vision and reasoning efforts, re-syncing every 10 minutes.
description.zh: 随 DSH 启动独立的 opencode2api 后端（jasonxu114514/opencode2api，Windows x64/ARM64，无需 Docker 或 OpenCode CLI），退出时只停自己拉起的进程；设置卡片可从经校验和验证的 GitHub Release 安装、更新或回滚后端，复制初始管理密码，并把 /v1/models 连同上下文、视觉与思考档位同步到 opencode2api 模型提供方，运行中每 10 分钟重同步。

description.en: WebDAV server: turns a shared directory into a WebDAV service that Windows, macOS and Linux can mount as a local disk, with token authentication, optional read-only mode, configurable directory/port/token, and per-platform mounting guides built into the settings page.
description.zh: WebDAV 服务器：把一个共享目录变成 Windows/macOS/Linux 都能挂载成本地磁盘的 WebDAV 服务，令牌认证、可选只读、目录/端口/令牌全可配，设置页自带三平台挂载指南。

description.en: Live progress for long-running background jobs in the DSH web GUI: a draggable floating ball in the session that owns the job, expanding into a panel with done/total, speed and ETA.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面中长时间后台任务的实时进度：有任务的会话里浮着一个小球，可拖动，点开是含已完成/总量、速度与剩余时间的面板。

description.en: Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DeepSeek Harness — stream Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions into DSH with thinking, tool activity, token usage and in-GUI Google OAuth login.

Bundles 19 short-video production skills (1 entry point, 1 orchestration, 17 atomic) into the agent skill catalog: Chinese TTS pronunciation fixes, text-to-image and text-to-video, image panning, composition, covers, media verification, data review and four-platform publishing. Ships skills and scripts only, so a runnable pipeline still needs ffmpeg, Python 3 + Pillow, Node.js and playwright installed locally, your own Bilibili biliup credential and WeChat Channels / Douyin / Xiaohongshu login states, and the placeholder values under skills/*/scripts/ filled in with your own. An installer's own skill of the same name keeps precedence.
description.zh: 把一条短视频生产流水线的 19 个 skill（1 总入口 + 1 编排 + 17 原子）内置进 agent 技能目录：中文配音读音校正、文生图与文生视频、图片运镜、成片合成、封面、成片核验、数据复盘、四平台发布。本包只提供 skill 与脚本，不安装任何工具：要真跑通流水线，还得本机装好 ffmpeg、Python 3 + Pillow、Node.js 与 playwright，自备 B 站 biliup 凭据和视频号 / 抖音 / 小红书登录态，并把 skills/*/scripts/ 里的占位符改成自己的值。使用者自己的同名 skill 优先级更高。

description.en: A fork of zhu1090093659/dsh-pet (Apache-2.0), adding per-conversation companions with whale-girl, MIKU and business blue whale skins, model-themed colors, token-rate animation, completion reminders and shared feeding and affinity.
description.zh: 基于 zhu1090093659/dsh-pet（Apache-2.0）改造，新增每个活跃会话一只桌宠，提供鲸鱼娘、MIKU 与商务小蓝鲸皮肤、模型配色、随生成速度跑动、完成待查看提醒、共享喂食与亲密度。

description.en: Below 1024px the sidebar collapses to a 44px floating square and expands into a 280px overlay drawer; picking a session collapses it again and the focus grab that would raise the soft keyboard after a session switch is suppressed.
description.zh: 窄屏下侧栏收起为左上角 44 像素悬浮方块、展开为 280 像素覆盖式抽屉，点会话自动收起，并压掉切会话时自动抢焦点导致的软键盘顶起。

description.en: Expert roster for DeepSeek Harness: 636 experts across 22 divisions with full Chinese names and bios, summoned as subagents from the @ menu or by the model through list_t_experts / summon_t_expert / summon_t_experts, plus custom experts and a skill on/off switch.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的专家名册：22 个分类、636 位专家，中文名与简介全量覆盖；从 @ 菜单或由模型经 list_t_experts / summon_t_expert / summon_t_experts 三个工具召唤为子代理，另可自建专家，并带一个技能开关。

description.en: Ren'Py galgame production workbench: a host-side project service (write gateway plus git snapshots, a dialogue/scene dialect parser, derived progress, human-only review stamps, pinned-SDK validation and playtest, local publish) behind one seam, driven by an embedded web panel and agent tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里制作 Ren'Py galgame 的工作台：宿主侧项目服务（写网关 + git 快照、方言子集解析器、推导进度、只由人盖的审读戳、钉版 SDK 校验与试玩、本地发布）收在一条接缝后面，由内置 Web 工作台面板与 agent 工具驱动。

description.en: A daily journal the agent keeps: the journal_record tool appends dated todos and memories, with optional detail and tags, to one JSON file per day under the DSH home; the right sidebar draws those files as a month calendar marked per day by open todos, finished todos or memories, with checkable todos and the selected day's entries below; and the duty sentence it adds to the system prompt is editable from the calendar itself.
description.zh: 助手替你维护的每日日志：journal_record 工具把带时间的待办与记事（可选详情与标签）追加到 DSH home 下一天一个的 JSON 文件；右侧栏把这些文件画成月历，单元格按「有待办未完成 / 待办已完成 / 只有记事」标记，下方是可勾选的待办与所选日期的条目；它加入系统提示词的那句职责文案，可以直接在日历上编辑。

description.en: Reads a GitNexus index in the DSH sidebar, reports skipped files, index freshness and language coverage, searches symbols, and reviews recent Git activity.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏读取 GitNexus 索引，报告被跳过的文件、索引新鲜度与语言覆盖，支持符号搜索和最近的 Git 活动审查。

description.en: Live token cost for every chat in the DSH Web UI: the chat, its subagents and the whole session tree, priced from a bundled models.dev snapshot of seven providers and 139 priced models, with cache read and write rates wherever the provider publishes them and DeepSeek from its own peak and off-peak table. Every finished answer carries its own price in the transcript, and a chat that is not currently open is priced from the log instead of disappearing. Spend is costed per interval from an append-only JSONL ledger in the project folder, so logged work keeps the tariff it was billed at. On top of it: budget-aware work plans packed against a money limit, routing scenarios that show which models are worth connecting, a generated plan document in English, Chinese or Russian, and a warning when spend belongs to no plan unit.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 的每个对话实时计算 token 费用：本对话、其子代理与整棵会话树，价格来自内置的 models.dev 快照：七家供应商、139 个有价模型，缓存读写费率按供应商实际公布的取值，DeepSeek 则使用其官方峰谷价格表。每个完成的回答都会在对话中显示自身费用，未打开的对话则按日志计价而不是整行消失。费用按区间计价，依据写入项目目录的只追加 JSONL 账本，因此已记录的工作保留当时的费率。此外还提供：按金额预算排布的工作计划、展示值得接入哪些模型的路由方案比较、以英语/中文/俄语生成的计划文档，以及当费用未归入任何计划单元时的提醒。

description.en: Sidebar activity bell: a red badge counts sessions that finished, and clicking it swaps the sidebar list from workspace grouping to a day-grouped recent-activity list with a green dot on completions that have not been opened.
description.zh: 侧边栏活动铃铛：会话跑完后铃铛显示红色角标，点一下把工作区列表换成按天分组的最近活动列表，尚未打开过的完成项带绿点。

description.en: Adds drag-and-drop attachments for local files, folders, ZIP archives and Office documents.
description.zh: 支持拖放本地文件、文件夹、ZIP 压缩包和 Office 文档作为附件。

description.en: DSH Web 上下文窗口归因面板：通过 host token meter 按消息显示当前 surface 的 token 占用与摘要。Read-only per-message context-window attribution for DSH Web using the host token meter.
