description.zh: DSH Web 的上下文窗口归因插件：Mini Utility Dock 面板按各自占用的 token 给会话内的用户消息、助手回复、推理块和工具结果排序，一眼看出窗口被哪些条目占住。面板还显示各条目类型的占比、本机各 live session 里最重的条目，并在宿主提供时显示 provider usage 与 system/tools/messages 的估算构成。面板只读：不估算费用、不修改会话、不触发 compaction。

description.en: Renders mermaid fences in dsh web chat as SVG diagrams by default, with cursor-anchored smooth zoom and pan, a per-fence diagram/code toggle persisted in localStorage, dark-mode follow, and a bundled offline engine.
description.zh: 将 dsh Web 对话中的 mermaid 代码围栏默认渲染为 SVG 图表，支持以指针为锚点的丝滑缩放拖拽、按围栏记忆的图/文案切换（localStorage 持久化）、明暗主题跟随，以及完全本地打包的离线渲染引擎。

description.en: Keeps a malformed token-usage sample from taking a whole session history down with it: a missing or non-numeric counter becomes zero before the harness adds it up, so the fold never yields NaN and already-broken sessions open again.
description.zh: 规范化异常的 Token 用量样本，使损坏的会话历史仍可加载。

description.en: Markdown visual enhancement and session workbench for DSH Web Composer: live syntax presentation with caret-row source reveal (inactive-line markers can be hidden or faded), deterministic local completions, and list/quote continuation on line break with ordered-list renumbering; long pastes fold into persistent chips with inline context or file-mode delivery (@path across 50+ extensions) plus sidebar LLM rewrites (stop, preview diff, undo/redo); real-time context map with token gauge, composition breakdown, per-turn growth chart with anchor lines, in-place /compact, turn forking, and a Context Doctor workspace (overview, diagnostics, analysis, feedback).
description.zh: DSH Web Composer 视觉增强与会话工作台：实时 Markdown 呈现与光标行源码还原（非焦点行语法标记可完全隐藏或淡化显示）、确定性本地补全、列表与引用的换行自动续行及有序列表重编号；超长粘贴自动收纳为持久化引用 chip，支持直接内联或文件送达（支持 50+ 种扩展名），并在右栏抽屉提供大模型智能改写（支持中止、预览对比、应用与撤销重做）；集成实时上下文地图，包含 Token 仪表盘、构成穿透钻取、逐轮增长图与锚定刻线、一键 /compact 及会话分叉，并内置 Context Doctor 工作区（概览、诊断、分析、反馈）。

description.en: A QQ NT messenger skin for DeepSeek Harness: light and dark share one QQ NT language — clean restrained light mode (brand blue #12B7F5, light-blue bubbles) and a calm blue-gray dark mode (#101822) — applied as reversible token and layout layers that never touch your Light/Dark preference.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 QQ NT 皮肤：浅色与深色共用一套 QQ NT 语言——浅色干净克制（品牌蓝 #12B7F5、浅蓝气泡），深色为沉稳蓝灰（#101822）——以可逆的 token 与布局两层实现，不改变你的浅色/深色偏好。

description.en: Provider-aware account balance chip for the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar: DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Moonshot/Kimi, Zhipu/GLM, and MiniMax.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的账户余额胶囊，跟随当前模型的服务商显示余额，支持 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Moonshot/Kimi、Zhipu/GLM 与 MiniMax，并显示 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲时段。

description.en: Prompt library stored in the plugin config, with a Settings page and a composer picker: the ticked prompts are injected into every model step of that session, and a subagent inherits the selection of its nearest ancestor session.
description.zh: 提示词库存放在插件配置中，含 Settings 页面与输入框选择器：勾中的提示词注入该会话的每一步模型调用，subagent 继承其最近祖先会话的选择。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness tool plugin: scaffold, validate, and version Obsidian plugins.

Remote DSH access that needs no hosting of your own — the Feishu DM chat is the interface over the bot's outbound long connection, with cards for workspace, session (switch and rename), model, reasoning effort, permission preset and balance, and tool approvals and agent questions answered in that same chat.
description.zh: 免运维的远程 DSH——拿飞书私聊当界面，机器人出站长连接、不需要公网入口，工作区、会话（切换与改名）、模型、推理深度、权限预设、余额都用卡片操作，工具审批与 agent 反问也在同一个聊天里回。

description.en: 百通插件广场：在 DeepSeek Harness 中浏览、搜索并安装百通插件市场的 DSH 插件与百通技能库技能
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏逛百通插件市场，搜索、安装插件和技能，还能直接跟 Agent 说一声就装好。

description.en: Webnovel Writer：DSH 长篇网文写作工作台

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-linfengqaqtat-dsh-scriptor
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for @linfengqaqtat/dsh-scriptor

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Long sessions get expensive, and the platform compacts the context on its own. This plugin adds an occupancy badge (hover to see how it is computed), writes a handover draft into HANDOVER.md from 45% — files changed, money spent, what recent turns were about — and reminds you once at 60% to wrap up. On compaction it records the reading from just before, so you can check it later. No model calls, nothing added to the conversation; it does not prevent compaction.
description.zh: 长会话越跑越贵，平台到点还会把上下文压掉。这个插件做三件事：在会话标题旁显示当前上下文占了多少，鼠标停上去能看到这个数是怎么来的；过 45% 时往工作目录的 HANDOVER.md 写一份交接草稿，记下改过哪些文件、花了多少钱、最近几轮在聊什么；到 60% 提醒你一次该收尾了。平台压缩发生时，它把压缩前的数字记一行，事后还查得到。不调用模型，也不改动对话内容。它不阻止压缩，拿不回已经被压掉的部分。

description.en: Thin-shell fork of @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation: keeps only the files we changed, the rest is imported from the vendored upstream source and inlined at build time.

Replaces the sidebar workspace region with a two-tab browser: several workspace roots stay registered side by side while conversations are filed under the real working directory of each session, with a read-only resource tree that previews files in the right sidebar. Hiding is per tab, display-only and fully reversible; a resource folder or file can be copied as a path or dragged into the composer as a native reference, and @ completion covers every registered root rather than the working directory alone.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的工作区区域换成双选项卡浏览器：多个工作区根并列登记、各自固定不变，对话按每个会话真实的工作目录归入目录树，资源是只读文件树、点击即用右侧栏预览。两个选项卡各自独立隐藏、只影响显示且完全可逆；资源文件夹或文件可复制路径，也可拖进输入框成为原生引用块；@ 补全覆盖全部已登记工作区，而不只是当前工作目录。

description.en: Complementary web-search provider: every web_search merges the DeepSeek Search API (primary) with serper.dev Google results (secondary) at a fixed 2:1 ratio. Both sides are direct HTTP retrievals with no auxiliary model turn: URL-deduped sources, long DeepSeek summaries clipped into snippets, per-backend timeouts and graceful degradation to whichever backend answers.
description.zh: 互补式网页搜索 provider：每次 web_search 由 DeepSeek 官方 Search API（主）与 serper.dev 的 Google 结果（补）按固定 2:1 交错合并。两路均为直连检索、无辅助模型调用；来源按 URL 去重，官方长摘要截断注入，单路超时自动降级到另一路。

description.en: Zhipu GLM web search provider: registers as `glm` on the ctx.web seam and runs the native web_search server tool through GLM's Anthropic-compatible API (Coding Plan billing).
description.zh: 智谱 GLM 联网搜索 provider：以 glm 注册到 ctx.web 缝，经 GLM 的 Anthropic 兼容 API 执行原生 web_search 服务端工具（走 Coding Plan 计费）。

description.en: Windows 2000 desktop skin for the DSH Web GUI: metric-accurate grey chrome, two-tone gradient title bars, 1px bevels, square corners, 16px scrollbars, and the pixel font it renders with served by its own host route.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 换上 Windows 2000 桌面外观：按度量表还原的灰色控件、双色渐变标题栏、1px 立体边框、直角、16px 滚动条，以及由插件自身路由提供的点阵字体。

description.en: Run one deterministic skill-routing pass on every user instruction, so the skill catalog is consulted before the model answers instead of after it remembers. On the host it scores the live catalog from the instruction's keywords and the catalog metadata, with no LLM or embedding call, and appends a single producer-tagged message to the step: a ranked shortlist by default, the winning SKILL.md body once the score clears a threshold, or an instruction to call a named router skill exactly once. Unrelated instructions stay silent.
description.zh: 对每条用户指令自动做一次确定性的技能路由，让技能目录在模型作答之前就被查阅，而不是等它自己想起来。宿主侧只依据指令关键词与目录元数据打分，不调用 LLM 也不做向量检索，然后向该步追加恰好一条带生产者标签的消息：默认是候选排名简报，分数过线时改注入冠军技能的 SKILL.md 正文，也可以只注入一句「立刻调用某个路由技能」。无关指令保持沉默。

description.en: Settings section that reports token usage: totals for input, output, cache read, cache write, reasoning and call count, with breakdowns by model, day, month and project plus a per-day trend chart for the last 30 days; history is rebuilt once on a worker thread and then kept current from live session events.
description.zh: 设置中的 Token 用量面板：总量（输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写/推理/调用次数），按模型、按天、按月、按项目的明细，以及最近 30 天的按日趋势折线图；历史在 Worker 线程上一次性重建，之后由会话事件实时累加。

description.en: Web interface enhancements for DeepSeek Harness with session rename/fork shortcuts, a searchable model picker with provider filters, mobile layouts, global font scaling, context usage alerts, DeepSeek balance and tariff rates, sent-message navigation, and conversation summaries.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页交互增强，提供会话重命名与分叉快捷操作、带搜索和供应商筛选的模型选择器、移动端布局、全局字体缩放、上下文用量提醒、DeepSeek 余额与峰谷价格、已发消息导航和对话情况总结。

description.en: Standalone Network Engineer Assistant agent preset plus a bundled 32-doc command knowledge base skill for DPtech, H3C, Huawei and Ruijie switches and routers: KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI-output screenshot reading, online manual lookup with cited sources, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only.
description.zh: 网络工程师助手预设 + 四厂商（迪普/新华三/华为/锐捷）交换机路由器命令知识库：32 篇文档随插件以技能形式分发（含来源链接与 verified 分级），KB 优先检索、跨厂商语法对照、拓扑与回显截图识别、联网查官方手册并注明出处、高危命令强制 ⚠️ 风险标注；只回答网络工程主题。

description.en: Session insights and one-click shareable HTML replay for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话洞察，并可一键导出为可分享的 HTML 回放。

description.en: Adds a mood-aware Japanese kaomoji to agent replies, picked from a curated kaomojiya.org whitelist and configurable from Settings → General.
description.zh: 给 dsh 回复按情绪添加日文颜文字，词库精选自颜文字屋（kaomojiya.org），可在「设置 → 通用设置」中调整。

description.en: Mounts external skill directories (Claude Code, Codex, ZCode) into DSH as read-only skill providers: frontmatter field mapping, name slug normalization and hot reload.
description.zh: 技能兼容层：把 Claude Code / Codex / ZCode 的技能目录挂载为 dsh 的只读技能提供方——支持 frontmatter 字段映射、名称 slug 规范化与热重载。

description.en: 24私助（24PA）: Feishu-backed personal assistant as a dsh workspace bundle.
description.zh: 把飞书变成你的私人助理：记账式任务派发、离线提醒、手写笔记审阅，还能分步引导完成接入配置。

description.en: A companion playlist panel for the dsh-boot-animation intro-video plugin: add clips without leaving the app, order them, and switch between sequential, random and single-clip playback. Sequential order is made deterministic by parking every clip except the one due to play in a disabled/ subdirectory of the same asset folder and rotating it back in on each boot, leaving the upstream plugin unpatched. Also supports recycling instead of deleting, pinning one clip for every launch, per-clip opt-out, and .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov files including non-ASCII names.
description.zh: 给开屏动画插件 dsh-boot-animation 配的播放入口面板：不用离开 app 就能加入视频、排好先后，并在「顺序播放 / 随机播放 / 单次播放」之间切换。顺序播放不修改上游插件也能做到确定性——除该播的那支外，参与播放的素材都停在同一个素材目录下的 disabled/ 里排队，每次启动自动轮换。还支持回收而不是删除、固定每次播同一支、逐条取消参与，以及 .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov（含非 ASCII 文件名）。

description.en: Six independently togglable modules in one DSH plugin: per-turn CNY cost, DeepSeek account balance, PDF/Word/Excel/CSV read-write tools with right-sidebar preview, a compiler/runtime environment registry, and run/build tools that execute a program or an MSBuild project by environment id. Toolchain paths are resolved at run time (Visual Studio install-root scan, %ProgramFiles%, PATH) and can be overridden per environment through plugin config, so nothing is pinned to the author's machine.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件里的六个可独立开关的模块：每轮对话的人民币成本、DeepSeek 账户余额、PDF/Word/Excel/CSV 直接读写工具与右栏预览、编译/运行环境表，以及按环境名执行程序或编译 MSBuild 工程的 run/build 工具。工具链路径在运行时解析（扫描 Visual Studio 安装根、%ProgramFiles%、PATH），并可在插件配置里逐个环境覆盖，没有写死在作者机器上的路径。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 一键 GitHub 同步：把插件清单、插件启用状态、插件配置、本地设置、Skills、Skill 的 refs/脚本、看板/用量账本、设置导航顺序偏好、壁纸引擎整机配置快照（$DSH_HOME/FISH.json）、免费模型插件配置与用量账本采集进你自己的私有 git 仓库并推送，换机可一键还原；采集前自动 fetch 远端并合并，密钥永不搬运。0.2.5 起不再同步 agent 预设 / 桌宠存档 / 工作区映射，0.2.6 起不再同步归档台账，0.2.7 起纳入 sk

A permanent DSH plugin that bundles a developer workbench, an in-session conversation tree, and a plugin manager: build and run an LVAL project, browse its code, and keep per-program version snapshots with rollback; edit, retry, or branch any message in place, with message micro-versions; a feature manager plus a global-plugin library whose entries each carry an enable tier; cross-dialogue memory, one-shot temporary chats, and model collaboration; five network-permission tiers, mixed-model routing, a security audit, and browser control through a companion extension.
description.zh: DSH 永久插件工作台：LVAL 工程工具的编译/运行、代码查看与程序版本快照回退；会话内对话树（就地编辑 / 重新生成 / 分支）与消息小版本；DET 管理器，以及每条记录各带一档启停权限的全局插件库；跨对话记忆、一次性临时对话与模型合作；五档网络权限、混合模型路由、安全审计，以及经配套浏览器扩展的浏览器控制。

description.en: Ghidra bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): 219 reverse-engineering tools — import binaries, decompile, xrefs, search, script Ghidra, plus the full upstream GhidraMCP REST surface, served from a single Ghidra JVM. Cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macO
description.zh: 把 Ghidra 逆向工具接进 DSH，218 个工具随取随用，反编译、恶意样本分析一站搞定。

description.en: Turns a dsh session into a redacted idea and delivers it end-to-end encrypted to friends on DeepHub; received ideas land as new sessions.
description.zh: 将一条 dsh 会话提炼为脱敏后的思路，端到端加密投递给 DeepHub 上的朋友；收到的思路落为一条新会话。

description.en: Open folders on remote hosts over SSH as Harness workspaces: file tools (read/write/edit/grep/glob) and shell commands run directly on the remote host over SFTP, ripgrep, and ssh2 exec, with no local mirroring, an encrypted multi-host registry, and the local sandbox policy still enforced.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 把远程主机目录作为 Harness 工作区打开：read/write/edit/grep/glob 与 shell 命令经 SFTP、ripgrep、ssh2 exec 直接在远程主机执行，不做本地镜像；多主机注册表加密存储，本地沙箱策略依然生效。

description.en: Cross-session memory for your dsh agent: remembered, recalled, and re-verified instead of assumed.
Unofficial OpenAI Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with ChatGPT subscription sign-in.
Terminal plugin — a real shell, workspace sync, persistent state, common-command management, and command completion.
description.zh: 终端插件 — 真 shell、工作区同步、状态常驻、常用命令管理、命令补全。

description.en: Tailscale remote-access operations panel for the dsh web GUI: health checks, HTTPS entry toggle via tailscale serve, macOS proxy bypass, relay server ops, and ACL snippet generation.
description.zh: Tailscale 远程访问运维面板：健康检查、HTTPS 入口（tailscale serve）开关、macOS 代理绕过、中继服务器运维与 ACL 片段生成。

description.en: 电机设计 L1/L2 完整版（RMxprt + Motor-CAD），依赖共享核心 @wangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-core
description.zh: 电机电磁设计全流程 AI 插件，从毫秒级广筛到 RMxprt、Motor-CAD 逐级校核，快速锁定最优方案。

description.en: One-click temporary tasks for DeepSeek Harness — each task is a disposable timestamped workspace plus its own session, shown as a native sidebar workspace node.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的临时任务模式：一键创建一次性的时间戳工作区并开会话，直接成为侧边栏原生工作区节点。

description.en: Managed document pipeline for the DeepSeek Harness: Markdown to DOCX/PDF, DOCX/PDF back to Markdown, and online sources as agent tools

Built-in Obsidian-style knowledge base for DSH: agents distill conversations, documents and web sources into a structured .wiki graph, with retrieval, graph export, note editing, incremental builds and multi-vault management.
description.zh: DSH 内置版 Obsidian 知识库：agent 把对话、文档与网页蒸馏为结构化 .wiki 知识图，支持检索、图谱导出、笔记编辑、增量构建与多库管理。

description.en: The host end of the client half's transport: a WebSocket upgrade route that bridges microphone audio in and agent speech out.
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin for stock analysis, screening, and strategy backtesting across A/HK/US/JP/KR/TW markets

Literature search for DeepSeek Harness: pubmed_search, pubmed_paper and pubmed_related over the official NCBI E-utilities (including elink related-article ranking), plus scholar_search and scholar_cite (MLA/APA/Chicago/Harvard/Vancouver/BibTeX via SerpApi). Both backends return one paper shape, and a settings card configures the API keys, the Scholar backend and the rate/result limits.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的文献检索：pubmed_search、pubmed_paper、pubmed_related 走官方 NCBI E-utilities（含 elink 相关文献排序），scholar_search、scholar_cite 走 Google Scholar（MLA/APA/Chicago/Harvard/Vancouver/BibTeX，需 SerpApi 后端）。两个后端统一为同一种 paper 结构，设置卡片可配置 API key、Scholar 后端与速率/条数上限。

description.en: Pulls GitHub repo content into DSH conversations at start and writes extracted long-term memory back with SHA-locked multi-file commits at conversation end; per-file read/write permissions, native settings page, turn indicators and global change notices.
description.zh: 对话开始时自动拉取 GitHub 仓库内容注入上下文，对话结束时提取长期记忆按文件写回并提交；文件权限中心、原生设置页、回合写回指示与全局变动提示。

description.en: MCP server marketplace for DSH: browse a curated, npm-verified catalog and install MCP servers into the current profile with one click, live without restart.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 服务器商场：浏览经过 npm 校验的精选目录，一键安装 MCP 服务器到当前 profile，免重启立即生效。

description.en: Reads each third-party endpoint's own model listing and keeps llm-pi-ai's per-model reasoningEfforts in sync, so the composer offers the thinking levels a model actually has.
description.zh: 读取每个第三方端点自己的模型列表，同步 llm-pi-ai 的逐模型 reasoningEfforts，让输入框提供模型真实支持的思考等级。

description.en: Power management plugin for DeepSeek Harness - sidebar power button with restart/shutdown menu, self-contained restart engine without external dependencies, graceful session flush.
description.zh: DSH 电源管理插件 - 侧边栏电源按钮、重启/关机菜单、自包含重启引擎（无需外部依赖）、优雅会话刷新。

description.en: DSH 运行时进程树对账与治理：把当前宿主的任务账本与本机真实进程树对账，标出未归属/泄漏/孤儿进程并守卫式树杀。Runtime process-tree reconciliation for DeepSeek Harness: join the current host's job ledger with the live OS process tree, surface unattributed/leaked/orphaned children, and kill trees behind creat
description.zh: DSH 宿主的 Windows 进程树对账插件：采样宿主进程树与任务账本，把每个进程归属到创建它的任务，并按置信度标出未归属与孤儿进程，同时提供受保护的整树终止。终止必须满足：目标归属于 DSH 宿主树、在动手前重新采样复核（含创建时间）、目标树内不含受保护后代，因此白名单 PID 不会扩大可杀范围。

description.en: Adds Delete conversation and Batch delete to the sidebar session menu; a deleted conversation and its subagent sessions are moved to the Windows recycle bin, from where they can be restored.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话行菜单中增加「删除对话」与「批量删除」；删除的对话及其子代理会话移入 Windows 回收站，可从回收站还原。

description.en: Set the DSH Harness conversation flow's font, font size and line spacing, plus the padding between the conversation text and the window edges.
description.zh: 设置DSH Harness对话流字体、字号行间距，以及对话文字到窗口边缘的留白。

description.en: Evolver for DeepSeek Harness, by EvoMap: a harness that gets smarter the more you use it. Recalls a proven strategy before each prompt, grades it on evidence (checks run, edits kept, your next reply), and reports back to the EvoMap network so what works g
description.zh: 越用越聪明的 harness，告别金鱼记忆。每条 prompt 前，Evolver 从本地经验和 EvoMap 网络召回一条验证过的策略；回合结束后，它凭测试结果、改动是否被保留、你的下一句反馈给策略打分，再回报网络按证据加权。每一次成功都变成下一次的捷径，每一次失败都变成下一次的避坑指南。

description.en: A chip at the left end of the composer tool row showing whether DeepSeek bills at peak or off-peak right now. Clicking it opens a card with the current state and rate, the next switch with a countdown, and why this instant is in that state: a weekend, a named statutory holiday, a 调休 make-up workday, or simply outside the peak windows. Times are resolved in Beijing time with an explicit UTC offset, so the verdict does not depend on the machine clock; a hard-coded 2026 Chinese holiday table carries the 33 holiday days and the six 调休 workdays, and a year beyond the table says so instead of guessing.
description.zh: 输入框工具行左端的小胶囊：点一下就知道此刻 DeepSeek 按高峰价还是空闲价计费。点开是当前状态与计费方式、下次切换时间与倒计时，以及此刻为什么是这个状态：周末、具名的法定节假日、调休上班日，或者只是不在高峰时段内。判定用北京时间并显式写死 UTC 偏移，不看本机时钟；内置 2026 年中国法定节假日表（33 天节假日、6 个调休上班日），表外的年份直接说不知道，不猜。

description.en: A port of the T3 Code model picker into the composer: a provider rail, search results grouped under provider headings, favorites kept in the browser, unavailable-provider badges, and Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 jump shortcuts for the first nine rows of the visible list.
description.zh: 把 T3 Code 的模型选择器移植到 DSH 输入框：提供方侧栏、按提供方分组的搜索结果、浏览器本地收藏、不可用提供方标记，以及用 Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 直接选中可见列表的前九行。

description.en: DSH web plugin: searchable model selector for DeepSeek Harness WebUI
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 加个能实时搜索的模型选择器，找模型不用再翻半天。

description.en: A global personal to-do list that is independent of any session: sidebar panel plus an edge dock that peeks on hover and pops open when a task is due, with desktop notification and custom sounds.
description.zh: 全局个人待办（与任何会话无关）：侧边栏面板 + 贴边待办条（悬停探出、快到点自动弹开），到期桌面通知与自定义音效。

description.en: Desktop notification and sound when a turn completes, the agent asks a question, or an approval is requested, each independently toggleable, plus an activity ball that lists live sessions and jumps back to one.
description.zh: 跑完 / 提问 / 需要审批时弹桌面通知与提示音（三类可分别开关），另附活动悬浮球，点会话行直接跳回该会话。

description.en: Track your DeepSeek Harness coding time on Hackatime (WakaTime-compatible heartbeats).

LLM debug console for DeepSeek Harness: captures the full content of every model call at the llm/stream waterfall (options, stream chunks, usage, wire protocol) and shows it in a DevTools-style docked panel, with shared-prefix context diffing, wire-JSON reconstruction, JSON export and a runtime-tunable capture policy.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的 LLM 调试台：在 llm/stream 层完整捕获每次模型调用（请求参数、流式块、用量、真实 wire 协议），以 DevTools 风格停靠面板展示，支持上下文共享前缀折叠对比、wire JSON 重建、JSON 导出与运行时可调的抓取策略。

description.en: OpenAI-completions-compatible adapter for custom gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted proxies): always role:"system", thinking driven by the model config, Qwen-style response split, and vision-model image input (single / multiple).
description.zh: 面向自定义网关（vLLM / LM Studio / 自托管代理）的 OpenAI-completions 兼容适配器：始终 role:"system"、按模型配置驱动思考、Qwen 式 response 切分，并支持视觉模型图片输入（单图 / 多图）。

description.en: Adds custom icons to the DSH Settings sidebar and exposes a keyed `settings.section.icon` slot for third-party settings sections.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置侧边栏添加自定义图标，并开放 keyed `settings.section.icon` 槽位供第三方设置分区注册图标。

description.en: Personal toolbox for the dsh web profile with per-feature toggles: task-done desktop notifications, one-click restart, session deletion, plugin enable/disable, update checks, and UI utilities.
description.zh: 面向 dsh web profile 的个人工具箱，各功能可单独开关：任务完成桌面通知、一键重启、会话删除、插件启停、更新检查，以及若干界面小工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin with a settings page that downloads, enables and mounts MCP servers for work apps (Office, Blender, Unity, Figma, Photoshop, Chrome, Godot, Windows, Notion, Gmail, Cloudflare, Cloudflare Docs, GitHub, ComfyUI, FFmpeg, Obsidian), pl
description.zh: 把 Office、Notion、GitHub 等工作软件的 MCP 服务器统一挂载管理，随插件装卸，不污染配置。

description.en: The official ZCode ios-simulator plugin ported to native DSH tools: the original 20 ios_* tools keep their names and arguments, plus ios_shutdown_simulator, covering Xcode project discovery and scaffolding, simulator boot and shutdown, build, install, launch and terminate, screenshots, log reading, an in-app settings page and optional idb UI automation. macOS only.
description.zh: 把官方 ZCode ios-simulator 插件移植为 DSH 原生工具：原有 20 个 ios_* 工具的命名与参数保持不变，另加 ios_shutdown_simulator，覆盖 Xcode 工程发现与生成、模拟器启动与关闭、构建、安装、启动与结束进程、截图、日志读取，并提供应用内设置页与可选的 idb UI 自动化。仅支持 macOS。

description.en: Windows computer use forked from computer-user: 13 computer_* tools that read the screen and drive the mouse and keyboard. Image-capable routes get the screenshot as a real image with an exact image-to-screen mapping, so no external OCR; elements return as UI Automation refs so a click lands on the exact control rectangle; Ctrl+Alt+Esc stops every call.
description.zh: computer-user 分叉的 Windows 电脑操作插件：13 个 computer_* 工具，读取屏幕并驱动鼠标键盘。模型支持图像输入时截图直接作为图片返回，附精确的图像→屏幕映射，无需外接 OCR；控件以 UI Automation 引用返回，点击落在精确矩形上；Ctrl+Alt+Esc 可阻断所有调用。

description.en: What's up - a zero-maintenance status board for your sessions. Scans every conversation on the host, extracts a goal + one-line status per session (multi-provider LLM, fingerprint-cached), surfaces half-done, unanswered and recent work in a sidebar panel, and jumps you back into any session with one click.
description.zh: What's up · 在忙啥——零维护的会话动态看板:host 端扫描全部会话,为每个会话提取「目标 + 一句话现状」(多 provider LLM、按指纹缓存),自动发现做到一半、问了没回、近期在推进的事,点卡片一键跳回会话。

description.en: Per-project MCP servers: a project declares servers in its own documents (`.dsh/mcp.json` by default; the local and global file lists are settings), and they are mounted only for the sessions working in that project — on the first turn of a session, released when it goes idle. A right-sidebar tab and a Settings page list each project with a live session, the status of every server and the session holding each mount, with `Sync` / `Retry` / `Release`, an `enabled` switch and an editor over one existing entry; a per-project tool policy (`disclosure` / `direct` / `off`) with pins and `mcp_search_tools` decides what the model sees; `${VAR}` references resolve through the project `.env` files and the credentials file; per-server call counters outlive the sessions that produced them.
description.zh: 按项目挂载 MCP 服务器：项目在自己的文档里声明服务器（默认 `.dsh/mcp.json`，本地与全局文件列表均为配置项），只对在该项目中工作的会话挂载——会话首个 turn 时挂载，空闲后释放。右侧栏标签页与设置页列出每个有活动会话的项目、各服务器状态以及持有挂载的会话，并提供 `Sync` / `Retry` / `Release`、`enabled` 开关和对某个既有条目的编辑器；按项目的工具策略（`disclosure` / `direct` / `off`）配合固定项与 `mcp_search_tools` 决定模型可见范围；`${VAR}` 引用依次从项目 `.env` 文件与凭据文件解析；按服务器统计的调用次数不随会话消失。

description.en: Session-sync plugin for DeepSeek Harness: git-backed cross-machine session sync with its own web settings surface, row-menu action, and sync-records dialog
description.zh: 把 deepseek-harness 的会话数据同步到各处，多设备也能接着聊，不怕丢。

description.en: Plugin that turns a XiaoAI (Xiaomi) smart speaker into a voice assistant: hosts the local bridge process, listens for the wake word, runs speech recognition (ASR / STT) on what you say, keeps the conversation in the host session, and speaks the answer back through the speaker with text-to-speech (TTS) playback.
description.zh: 把小爱音箱（小爱同学 / 小米智能音箱）接成语音助手的插件：托管本地桥接器进程，听到唤醒词就收音、做语音识别（ASR / STT），把对话交给 DSH 会话，再用语音合成（TTS）把答案念回音箱播报。

description.en: Per-session prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness: reusable system-prompt sections, grouped into named profiles, sealed into the session prompt.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按会话提示词配置：可复用的系统提示词片段组成命名配置，并在会话启动时固化进该会话的提示词。

description.en: Browser notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness - system toasts when a task finishes, a run errors, or your input is needed (question / approval / plan review), click to open the session, per-type toggles, and no false 'done' while the main session waits on its subagents.
description.zh: DSH 浏览器通知插件 - 任务完成 / 运行出错 / 需要你回答、批准、审阅计划时弹系统级通知，点击气泡直达会话，三类通知独立开关，主会话等子代理期间不误报完成。

description.en: Git status badges for DeepSeek Harness: an input-row chip and a sidebar session-row action glyph, on every install — no patch and no manual step. Event-driven freshness over SSE.
description.zh: DSH 的 Git 状态徽章：侧边栏工作区行徽章与输入行徽章，显示当前会话工作区的 git 状态，通过 SSE 事件驱动保持实时。

description.en: WeChat Reading (WeRead) multi-target export for DeepSeek Harness via the official Skills API gateway: browse your bookshelf, export highlights & thoughts to flomo, a local Markdown file, or Notion, optionally reworked by a configurable LLM prompt.
description.zh: 微信读书多目标导出：通过官方 Skills API Key 查看书架、导出划线/想法到 flomo、本地 Markdown 或 Notion，可选按自定义 LLM prompt 整理后再导出。

description.en: DSH QQ bot bridge plugin, connect DeepSeek Harness with QQ bot.
description.zh: DSH QQ机器人桥接插件，将DeepSeek Harness对接QQ机器人。

description.en: Sync the installed DeepSeek Harness plugin manifest to a GitHub Gist (OAuth login, one-click export/import with automatic dependency install).
description.zh: 将已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件清单同步到 GitHub Gist（OAuth 登录、一键导出/导入并自动安装依赖）。

description.en: DSH 生图插件：在设置中配置多个生图供应商/模型，并在对话中通过 image_generate 调用当前选中的模型。
description.zh: 在设置中配置多个生图供应商，对话通过 image_generate 调用当前选中的模型；图片保存到工作区 generate/image，并在对话中内联显示。

description.en: Pre-install compatibility gate for DSH plugins: locks the resolved version, checks peer/engines declarations, dry-installs into an isolated DSH_HOME and boots it with a timeout, blocks on any failure, and restores the profile if the real install fails. Optionally intercepts dsh-market install/update clicks. Compatible with DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x.
description.zh: DSH 插件安装前兼容性门控：锁定解析版本、校验 peer/engines 声明、在隔离 DSH_HOME 中试装并限时试启动，任一失败即阻止；正式安装失败自动还原 profile。可选拦截 dsh-market 的安装/更新点击，兼容 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x。

description.en: Desktop-style UI enhancements for the DSH Web client: adaptive wallpapers, a desktop pet companion with an activity feed and feeding economy, @file workspace references, and the resizable file/preview right panel.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 客户端的桌面化 UI 增强：自适应对比度壁纸、带活动流与投喂玩法的桌面宠物、@file 工作区文件引用，以及可缩放的文件/预览右侧面板。

description.en: Measures what an llm-pi-ai endpoint really accepts — context window from its own model list, output-token limit and reasoning levels read out of its own range errors, image support from a generated test image — then reports declared values that contradict that evidence and rewrites them only after confirmation.
description.zh: 直接实测 llm-pi-ai 端点真正接受的能力——从它自己的模型列表取上下文窗口，从它自己的报错反推输出上限与推理档位，用生成的测试图验证图像支持——再报告与证据不符的声明值，确认后才改写。

description.en: Measures design rules on the rendered page rather than in the CSS — type-scale count, WCAG AA contrast against the real composited backdrop, spacing-grid drift, palette size, tap targets, and the tells of generated UI such as violet gradients caught by hue angle; ships a design-system skill.
description.zh: 在渲染后的页面上测量设计规则，而非解析 CSS——字号种类、与真实合成背景比对的 WCAG AA 对比度、间距栅格偏移、配色规模、点击区尺寸，以及「机器味指纹」（如按色相角度判定的紫色渐变）；内置 design-system 技能。

description.en: Read Plane: cross-agent session discovery, turn inspection, workspace aggregation and distillation from raw local session files.
description.zh: 通过 1session 命令行或 DSH Web 历史浏览器搜索和读取 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Grok 与 DSH 的本地编程会话。

description.en: Task gate for the DeepSeek Harness: every conversation must end by declaring complete, wait, or blocked; undeclared stops are nudged, and abnormal sessions are revived after a host restart.
Acceptance-criteria-driven goal completion: locks verifiable criteria, tracks task dependencies, and gates completion behind formal reviewer validation (18 MCP tools).
description.zh: 验收标准驱动的目标完成：锁定可验证的验收标准、跟踪任务依赖，以 reviewer 正式验收作为完成门禁（18 个 MCP 工具）。

description.en: Usage statistics panel for the Web GUI and the Desktop app: silent per-model token collection, activity heatmap, trend charts, cost estimation and a daily-limit guard.
description.zh: Web GUI 与桌面端的用量统计面板：静默按模型采集 token、活跃热力图、趋势图、费用估算与每日超限守卫。

description.en: A right-sidebar Git panel in the IDEA style — local changes with per-file checkbox commits, a commit tree with per-commit details, branch, remote and stash management, push with a credential fallback, all driven by the plain git CLI.
description.zh: 右侧栏的 IDEA 风格 Git 面板：本地变更与按文件勾选提交、提交树与提交详情、分支 / 远程 / 贮藏管理、带凭据兜底的推送，以及 git 命令流水，全部通过原生 git CLI 执行。

description.en: Ranks workspaces holding a session that wants attention to the top of the sidebar session list - waiting on you first, then running, then finished-but-unopened, then just read - and draws those rows with a state bar, tinted surface and coloured title, plus a one-shot settle pulse when a run stops. Every colour is taken from the active theme's own tokens, and the three windows that decide how long a finished session stays promoted are settings.
description.zh: 把含“需要注意的会话”的工作区按紧急度排到侧栏会话列表最前——待你处理优先，其次运行中，再次完成未读，最后刚读过的——并为这些行画状态竖条、着色底与着色标题，一次运行结束时播放一次收敛动效。所有颜色都取自当前主题自身的变量；决定完成会话置顶时长的三个窗口都是可配置项。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin for stock analysis, screening, and strategy backtesting across A/HK/US/JP/KR/TW markets
用多个 WorkBuddy 账号（网页登录或本机桌面端）组成两个独立账号池（国内版 / 国际版）：加权轮换、会话粘性、冷却熔断、换号重试，并每天自动完成成长任务。
Makes the WorkBuddy desktop app's web search the dsh web_search provider, reusing the app's existing sign-in with no extra configuration.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的网络搜索作为 dsh 的 web_search 提供方，复用 App 已有的登录状态，无需额外配置。

description.en: Unified @ mentions in the DeepSeek Harness web composer: five built-in categories (file, folder, skill, past chat, plugin) plus a data-source seam any plugin can register through, references to absolute paths outside the workspace, and a candidate menu that can be scoped by a folder named earlier in the draft and pages with PageUp/PageDown instead of hiding rows.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框里统一 @ 提及：五个内置类别（文件、文件夹、Skill、过去的聊天、插件），任何插件都能注册的数据源 seam，工作区外绝对路径引用，以及可被草稿中先写下的文件夹限定作用域、并用 PageUp/PageDown 翻页而不隐藏候选行的菜单。

description.en: Drive local Origin/OriginPro from chat via 27 MCP tools: import .dat/.csv/.txt and CHI workstation .bin files, plot, style, fit, and deliver PNG/TIF/SVG/PDF plus an editable .opju project, with read-back verification on plots, styles and exports. Requires Windows, Origin/OriginPro 2021+ and Python 3.10+, plus `pip install originpro numpy` into the interpreter dsh launches: without the package every tool answers `missing_originpro`, and without an interpreter on PATH no tools register at all.
description.zh: 通过 27 个 MCP 工具在对话里驱动本机 Origin/OriginPro：导入 .dat/.csv/.txt 与 CHI 工作站 .bin，绘图、改样式、拟合，交付 PNG/TIF/SVG/PDF 图片和可继续编辑的 .opju 工程；绘图、样式、导出都带读回验证。需要 Windows、Origin/OriginPro 2021+ 与 Python 3.10+，并把 `pip install originpro numpy` 装进 dsh 启动的那个解释器：缺包时每个工具都会返回 `missing_originpro`，PATH 上没有解释器时工具完全不注册。

description.en: A Codex delegation tool for DeepSeek Harness that can carry a model and a reasoning effort per call.
description.zh: 让 Codex 子代理每次调用都能单独指定模型和推理强度，灵活调度更省心。

description.en: Adds AMD Radeon Cloud as a model provider in DeepSeek Harness, with reasoning-effort levels declared per model. The provider definition ships in the plugin's own patch layer rather than in your profile.
description.zh: 把 AMD Radeon Cloud 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器，思考档位按模型逐个声明。provider 定义随插件自带的补丁层交付，而不是写进 profile。

description.en: Pre-install supply-chain checks for DeepSeek Harness plugins: verify the tarball you are about to install matches the source you read, before any code runs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件做安装前供应链校验：在代码运行前核对即将安装的包是否与你读到的源码一致。

description.en: Matrix digital rain: drapes the chat window in the classic green character rain — cascading columns with incandescent white heads and green tails, streaming the tokens the agent is generating into the rain in real time; opacity, speed, density, font size and colors are all adjustable, and rain intensity follows agent activity.
description.zh: 黑客帝国数字雨：对话窗口铺上经典的绿色字符雨背景——雨柱倾泻而下、白炽雨头绿身拖尾，agent 正在生成的 token 原文实时掺进雨里；透明度/速度/密度/字号/配色全部可调，雨势跟随 agent 活跃度起伏。

description.en: Use subscription accounts as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers — Kimi Code (OAuth device flow), Grok / X Premium (OIDC + PKCE), Google Antigravity (Google OAuth + Cloud Code Assist) and GLM / BigModel (ZCode's browser sign-in) — with per-model visibility, dr
description.zh: 把 Kimi、Grok、Antigravity、GLM 的订阅账号接进 DSH 当模型用，扫码登录还能拖动排序自动切换。

description.en: A floating stock ticker for DeepSeek Harness: real-time quotes for Nikkei 225 and TOPIX ETF out of the box, plus worldwide markets via Yahoo Finance — Japan (.T), US, Hong Kong (.HK), China (.SS/.SZ) and any other symbol — with a customizable watchlist, display aliases and 16 UI languages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全球股市行情悬浮窗：默认显示日经225 与 TOPIX ETF，另支持通过 Yahoo Finance 实时报价全球市场——日本 .T、美国、香港 .HK、中国 .SS/.SZ 及任意代码，带自选列表、显示别名与 16 种界面语言。

description.en: Free vision OCR with adaptive tile recognition for long documents and Markdown/Word/PNG/Excel export.
description.zh: 免费视觉识别插件：自适应切块长文档识别，支持历史收藏与 MD/Word/长图/Excel 导出。

description.en: Select text in a conversation to attach a numbered highlight with a colour stored per note, keep every mark in an outline panel that jumps back to its quote, and let a corner self-check badge report style, selector and saved-key problems without opening dev tools.
description.zh: 在对话里划词加批注：编号高亮、每条各记自己的颜色，大纲面板列出全部标记并点一条跳回原文；右下角自检角标不开开发者工具就报出样式、越界选择器与本地存档键的问题。

description.en: Sound reminders with one-click jump for concurrent sessions: the current session gets crisp dang/dang-dang tones, other sessions a soft ding/ding-ding plus a top-right card that jumps straight to the replying conversation.
description.zh: 多对话并行的声音提醒 + 对话直达：当前对话当/当当（crisp 清脆档），其他对话叮/叮叮（soft 柔和档）+ 右上角小卡片，点一下直达对应对话。

description.en: Johari cognition-quadrant dialog prompt composer — adds a button above the composer that opens a 2×2 quadrant panel (known/unknown × AI-known/AI-unknown) to groom conversation context into a structured prompt written back into the draft.
description.zh: 乔哈里认知四象限对话梳理工具——在输入框上方添加按钮，弹出 2×2 象限面板（我知道/不知道 × AI知道/不知道），将对话上下文梳理为结构化 Prompt 并写回输入框。

description.en: Persistent provider-reported token usage totals with per-session, per-model, and daily activity statistics.
description.zh: 持久化 provider 上报的 Token 用量统计，支持按会话、按模型和按日活跃度查看。

description.en: Message timeline rail for DeepSeek Harness web chat: evenly spaced ticks for each user message on the right edge, click to jump, hover to preview.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页会话消息时间轴导航条：消息区右侧等间距刻度，点击跳转，悬浮预览。

description.en: Web search for DeepSeek Harness through Z.ai or Zhipu, with Coding Plan MCP quota and REST API billing modes, a native bilingual settings card, and support for reusing an existing ZAI_API_KEY.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Z.ai / 智谱网页搜索插件，支持 Coding Plan MCP 套餐额度和 REST API 余额两种计费模式，提供原生中英文设置卡片，可复用现有 ZAI_API_KEY。

description.en: A conversation-view tab for DeepSeek Harness Web showing solar/lunar dates, ganzhi year/month/day, Chinese zodiac, 24 solar terms, festivals, China public holidays including make-up workdays, multi-city weather, an epoch↔date timestamp converter with a time-zone picker, and bundled offline "on this day" history from free sources without an API key.
description.zh: 会话页头的「熊猫日历」标签页：公历/农历、干支、生肖、24 节气、传统与外国节日、中国法定节假日（含调休）、多城市天气、时间戳转换（秒/毫秒 ↔ 年月日时分秒，可选时区）与内置离线的「历史上的今天」，数据免费、无需 API Key。

description.en: Header chip for the DSH web GUI that shows whether the current Beijing time is inside DeepSeek's API peak window, with a live clock and countdown to the next transition.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 会话头部高峰指示灯，实时显示当前北京时间是否处于 DeepSeek API 高峰时段，附实时时钟与下一转折倒计时。

description.en: AnySearch web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零配置的 AnySearch 网页搜索能力，开箱即用，让智能体轻松获取实时信息。

description.en: Consult multiple expert advisor models in a retro CRT chat-group card: one ask_advisors call runs an auto-deepen pipeline (driver deep-question, advisor relay, synthesis conclusion) with SSE streaming, 26 provider presets, a configurable daily quota, stop/resume, and optional advisor tool calling.
description.zh: 主模型在专业/长尾/高风险或不确定问题上召集多个专家顾问模型，以复古 CRT 聊天组卡片展示：一次 ask_advisors 自动跑满自动深挖流水线（驱动模型追问、顾问接力、综合结论），真流式 SSE、26 个供应商预设、可配置每日配额、停止/继续，以及可选的顾问工具调用。

description.en: Adds an avatar to the left of each turn's final AI reply and to the right of each user message; upload your own image and set its size and circle or square frame.
description.zh: 在每轮 AI 回复左侧与你的每条输入右侧各显示一个头像，可上传自己的图片并设置尺寸与圆形/方形头像框。

description.en: A developer toolkit for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web console: a real multi-tab PTY terminal docked under the composer plus an AI-output file browser sidebar with syntax highlighting, Markdown rendering and image preview.
description.zh: DSH 网页控制台的开发者工具包：一个真实的多标签 PTY 终端（停靠在输入框下方），外加 AI 输出文件浏览器侧栏，支持语法高亮、Markdown 渲染与图片预览。

description.en: NetEase Cloud Music (music.163.com) player and AI DJ for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar page with in-app playback, QR sign-in, and agent tools that curate the queue.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接播放网易云音乐，支持队列、同步歌词、扫码登录，还带 AI DJ 帮你选歌。

description.en: Adds a sentient floating eye to DeepSeek Harness — injects a taming kernel that makes the AI truly understand you, with 11 dynamic eye skins, ghost mode, and zero token cost when AI mode is off.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上会开智的智子：注入驯兽内核让 AI 真正懂你，11 款动态皮肤、幽灵模式，关闭 AI 模式即零 token 消耗。

description.en: Conveniently shut down the dsh web server: a conversation-header exit button plus an agent tool, using the launcher's bounded shutdown path.

Vendor-based usage dashboard: per-provider token/cache/output KPI, a 53-week heatmap, trend chart with hourly "today" view, model drilldown, cost estimation, CSV export, and health cards (TTFT, generation speed, peak context, error rate).
description.zh: 按厂商（订阅/官方API）统计用量看板：按供应商/模型拆分 Token、缓存、输出等 KPI，53 周热力图，趋势折线图（今天按小时），模型钻取，费用估算，CSV 导出，以及健康度卡片（TTFT、生成速度、峰值 Context、错误率）。

description.en: 让 AI 项目可以在无人监管下持续推进。Orbit 会自动规划任务、分工执行、逐步检查并继续完成后续工作；不同环节可以使用不同模型，让低成本模型承担执行任务、强模型负责规划和审核，从而降低整体 AI 使用成本。Watchdog 还会监控运行异常，在任务卡死或中断时协助恢复。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的确定性工程编排运行时：orbit_controller 工具与 OrbitService 以 Commander / Executor / Smart Watchdog 子代理执行 PLAN、EXECUTE、EVALUATE、有界修正与运行时恢复，持久状态保存在 <project>/.cx/state.json。

description.en: Adds a trash for DSH sessions.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话提供一个回收站功能。

description.en: Connects DSH to local Beav for Xiaohongshu (RED/RedNote) and social-media AI operations: topic research, knowledge, copywriting, image, audio, and short-video workflows with approval and artifact tracking.
description.zh: 将 DSH 连接到本机 Beav，面向小红书（RED/RedNote）、社交媒体运营和自媒体 AI 创作，覆盖选题研究、知识库、文案、图片、音频与短视频工作流，并保留审批和产物追踪。

description.en: Cross-workspace DSH messaging and sender navigation, with bounded same-workspace context and opt-in local Claude Code messaging.
description.zh: 支持 DSH 跨工作区消息与发送方导航、同工作区受限上下文，以及可选的本机 Claude Code 双向通信。

description.en: One-click native conversations with independent workspaces for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键原生对话入口，每次创建独立工作区和会话。

description.en: Peak and off-peak billing season in the composer statistics row, right after the cache-hit reading, with a coloured dot, a countdown to the next switch, and a panel that shows the account balance split into total, granted and topped up in the currency the API reports.
description.zh: 在输入框统计行里、缓存命中读数之后显示高峰/非高峰计费时段：状态圆点与切换倒计时，点击展开面板显示按接口返回货币表示的余额，并拆分为总额、赠送与充值。

description.en: Makes the AI default to Mermaid diagrams in development conversations — system prompt guidance, a mermaid_validate syntax-check tool with real-parser validation, and an output gate that auto-fixes or removes broken diagrams. Rendering via dsh-mermaid.
description.zh: 让 AI 在开发交流中默认用 Mermaid 图表达——系统提示引导、mermaid_validate 真解析语法校验工具，以及自动修复或摘除坏图的输出闸。渲染交给 dsh-mermaid。

description.en: A-share market dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: realtime market indices, stock screener with 13 technical signals and multi-strategy intersection, 7×24 multi-source news aggregation, watchlist with group management, market sentiment thermometer (limit-up ladder, breadth), K-line charts with MA/EXPMA/BOLL overlays, and sector/limit-up/longhu rankings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness A 股行情面板：实时大盘指数、技术选股（13 项信号 + 多策略交叉）、7×24 多源快讯聚合、自选股分组管理、市场情绪温度计（连板梯队/涨跌家数）、K 线图（MA/EXPMA/BOLL 叠加）、板块榜/涨停池/龙虎榜。

description.en: DSH Web 侧边栏余额与用量监控插件，支持 DeepSeek、Kimi、智谱 GLM 和 TeamoRouter。
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏展示可选的 DeepSeek、Kimi、智谱 GLM 和 TeamoRouter 余额，并提供渠道详情、用量数据与刷新控制。

description.en: Deterministic cross-session transcript retrieval for DeepSeek Harness: the model-facing `recall` tool searches past session logs with explicit scope control
description.zh: 确定性跨会话检索：`recall` 工具带显式范围控制地搜索历史会话日志。

description.en: Long-form novel writing plugin: each book is a git repository of frontmatter files, with 39 DSH domain tools and a web writing UI. Deep import drafts candidates, AI adoption into canonical assets requires DSH approval, and deterministic continuity checks ship with a report-only benchmark. Independent open source (MIT), not an official DeepSeek product; requires Node >= 24.11.0 and currently targets DSH 0.1.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 长篇小说写作插件：每本书一个 git 仓库，当前 39 个 DSH 领域工具 + Web 写作台；深度导入产候选草稿、AI 采用类写入正式资产前必过审批、确定性连续性检查（报告型）。独立开源（MIT），非 DeepSeek 官方产品；需 Node ≥ 24.11.0，当前适配 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1。

description.en: 投递策略：离线留在信箱等人／在线立刻投出（示例①的挂点） · Delivery policy: offline waits in the mailbox, online posts at once (example (1)'s socket)
One-click upgrade to Deepseek Harness, with version number displayed in the sidebar.
description.zh: 一键升级Deepseek Harness, 支持侧边栏显示版本号.

description.en: Warm light and dark theme for DSH Web with responsive layout, bilingual settings, safe Markdown preview, per-block copy controls, and no telemetry.
description.zh: DSH Web 暖中性色明暗主题，支持响应式布局、双语设置、安全 Markdown 预览、内容块复制与无遥测运行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness memory and knowledge hub that routes update, retrieve, and subscribe calls across compatible plugins, with an optional transactional Rust backend.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆与知识中台：在兼容插件之间路由 update、retrieve 和 subscribe 调用，并提供可选的事务化 Rust 后端。

description.en: Plugin dependency graph inspector for DeepSeek Harness: a host service that snapshots the live Cordis plugin fiber tree, a graph_render tool for the model, and a browser page that renders the plugin/service topology as a zoomable graph with metrics, legen
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件依赖图检查器：把运行中的 Cordis 插件/服务拓扑快照为可缩放的浏览器面板图，附带图论指标，以及面向模型的 graph.render 工具。

description.en: Browse and manage the community plugin catalog from a first-level DeepSeek Harness Settings page, with verified installs and updates, removal, pause and resume, installed-package state, and sanitized README previews.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置一级页面中浏览和管理社区插件目录，支持验证后安装与更新、删除、暂停与恢复、已安装状态查看及安全 README 预览。

description.en: Let the DSH assistant send local, web, and AI-generated images directly to users in chat, with external vision support for text-only models. On Windows it runs through PowerShell.
description.zh: 让 DSH 助手把本地、网页和 AI 生成的图片直接发到聊天里给用户看，并为文本模型提供识图能力；Windows 下经 PowerShell 运行。

description.en: One settings page that lists every subscription sign-in the harness can offer and walks you through it — ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, GitHub Copilot, OpenRouter, Kimi and xAI — reading the list from the authorization seam instead of hardcoding providers, and showing credential records no registered flow claims any more.
description.zh: 把所有订阅登录收进一个设置页：列表直接读授权 seam 上注册的流程，引导你走完 ChatGPT (Codex)、Claude、GitHub Copilot、OpenRouter、Kimi 与 xAI，并列出已无人认领的旧凭据记录。

description.en: Agent-native API client for DeepSeek Harness: Postman-like debugging UI (request tree with context menus and full keyboard navigation, resizable sidebar, layered auto-generated header preview with per-item suppression and constant secret masking), six api_client_* agent tools sharing the same request core, redaction and audit chain with the human UI, Postman Collection v2.1 import with a migration report, environment variables with SecretRef indirection, and a fail-closed SSRF network policy.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 原生 API Client：Postman 级调试 UI（右键菜单与完整键盘导航的请求树、可调宽侧栏、自动生成 Header 分层预览——逐项可停用、敏感值恒脱敏），六个 api_client_* Agent 工具与 Human UI 共用同一请求核心、脱敏与审计链，Postman Collection v2.1 导入附迁移报告，环境变量经 SecretRef 间接引用，SSRF 网络策略默认 fail-closed。

description.en: Session cost in rubles in the composer dock — the tariff in effect with its countdown, the API cost at that tariff, the CBR rate, the total including subagents, cache savings, and DeepSeek Platform balances.
description.zh: 在输入框坞区显示以卢布计的当前会话费用：当前时段与倒计时、该时段的 API 费用、央行汇率、含 subagent 的合计、缓存节省与 DeepSeek 平台余额。

description.en: Mobile pairing remote for DeepSeek Harness: E2EE companion over dual-plane allowlisted RPC (LAN, Tailscale, optional Cloudflare Quick Tunnel or self-hosted rendezvous).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 移动配对远程插件：双平面白名单 RPC 上的端到端加密 Companion（局域网、Tailscale，可选 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 或自建 rendezvous）。

description.en: Turn-rail settings for the DSH conversation locator: tick thickness, rail on the left or right, a curved length gradient on the hovered tick, and a plain-text hover preview with adjustable line count, font size and width.
description.zh: DSH 对话定位条的轮次轨道设置：刻度粗细、轨道在左还是在右、锚在悬停那根的曲线长度渐变，以及行数、字号、宽度都可调的纯文本悬停预览。

description.en: Static and runtime security guard for dsh: rule-based scans for malicious code, prompt injection and token waste, runtime interception of dangerous tool calls, /scan command, plugin_scan tool, web panel, and allowlist.
description.zh: dsh 安全守卫插件：基于规则的静态扫描覆盖恶意代码、提示词注入与令牌浪费，运行时拦截危险工具调用，提供 /scan 命令、plugin_scan 工具、Web 面板与白名单。

description.en: Voice conversation mode for the DSH Web GUI: tap the mic to start a full-screen call, talk hands-free, and hear each reply read aloud as it streams. Bilingual (Chinese/English) UI, light and dark themes, adjustable speech rate, and switchable voices.
description.zh: DSH Web 的语音对话模式：点一下麦克风进入全屏通话，边说边听，AI 回复边生成边朗读。界面中英双语，适配明暗主题，支持语速调节与音色切换。

description.en: Browser Web Speech API voice input: zero server, zero keys, zero model downloads (Edge=Azure, Chrome=Google speech).
description.zh: 浏览器 Web Speech API 语音输入：零服务端、零密钥、零模型下载（Edge=Azure 语音、Chrome=Google 语音）。

description.en: Task-level memory for long-horizon DSH sessions: force-injected, compaction-proof, manually mounted.
Registers any set of HTTP APIs as paired doc-query and request tools for the agent.
description.zh: 把任意一套 HTTP 接口注册成 agent 可用的文档查询与请求双工具。

description.en: Skill shelf for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a sidebar panel next to Plugins and Automation that lists every skill DSH resolves, discovers and installs skills from skills.sh, upgrades them safely (previous version quarantined, never deleted), uninstalls or res
Connects ChatGPT accounts through OAuth, switches among them manually or automatically, and adds Codex models with usage limits to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 连接 ChatGPT 账号，支持手动或自动切换，并为 DeepSeek Harness 添加带用量限额信息的 Codex 模型。

description.en: Binds a Feishu/Lark bot to DeepSeek Harness over a WebSocket long connection: incoming messages run through an agent session and stream back to the chat, chat commands such as /attach manage the live session, and feishu_* tools let the model push messages.
description.zh: 通过 WebSocket 长连接把飞书机器人绑到 DeepSeek Harness：收到的消息跑在 agent 会话里并流式回传，/attach 等聊天命令管理活动会话，模型可调用 feishu_* 工具推送消息。

description.en: A GitHub-connected visual git manager for DeepSeek Harness: guided GitHub-Flow steps, commit graph with PR/CI badges, one-click GitHub login, PR and issue management, and structured git tools for the agent. Renamed from gitcompass in 2.0.0.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub 联动的可视化 Git 管理：引导式 GitHub Flow 步骤、带 PR/CI 徽章的提交图谱、一键 GitHub 登录、PR 与 issue 管理，以及面向 Agent 的结构化 Git 工具。2.0.0 起由 gitcompass 改名而来。

description.en: DSH environment management: auto-installs a Rust/Tauri desktop host (downloaded per-OS from dsh-desktop-host releases, source build as fallback), one-click runtime updates, Windows platform compatibility, official DeepSeek billing, and a built-in code editor for the workspace.

description.en: Token-free Chinese classical poetry tab in the DSH conversation view with search, filters, 飞花令, daily poem, favorites, festival topics and a share-card image; AI explanation reuses your own DSH session.
description.zh: 免 token 诗词查询插件，在会话页头新增「诗词」标签页，支持搜索、筛选、飞花令、每日一首、收藏、简繁、节日专题与分享卡片图；AI 解读复用 DSH 会话。

description.en: Independent answer review gate for DeepSeek Harness agent responses

Session favorites: bookmark any conversation into a browser-style favorites panel — one-click star from session rows, folders for organization, notes, custom display names, resume session, fork into a new session, basic session stats, plus a fork-relationship graph showing how conversations derive from one another.
description.zh: 会话收藏夹：把任意会话收藏进浏览器收藏夹式的管理面板——左侧会话行一键收藏/星标，主面板支持文件夹分门别类、备注、自定义显示名、一键继续会话、Fork 新会话、会话基本统计，外加一张清晰展示会话派生关系的 fork 关系图。

description.en: Runs OmicVerse/OmicOS bioinformatics analyses in a persistent Python kernel, with capability-catalog search, kernel inspection and an account tab.
description.zh: 在持久 Python 内核里跑 OmicVerse/OmicOS 生信分析，附能力目录检索、内核变量查看与账号订阅页签。

description.en: MCP server and skill management for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel and a plugin-page config section with search, status lights, per-row switches, expandable details, and an add-server form following Codex mcp_servers fields.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器与技能管理面板：侧栏面板加插件页配置区，支持搜索、状态灯、逐行开关、详情，以及按 Codex mcp_servers 字段设计的添加服务器表单。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek API peak and off-peak hours, the current model's output price and the account balance in the Web UI.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中显示 DeepSeek API 高峰/空闲时段、当前模型的输出价格与账户余额。

description.en: Keeps the native per-message status line always visible without hovering — date and time on every message, run duration, TTFT, and tokens per second on assistant messages.
description.zh: 原生消息状态栏无需悬停即可始终显示每条消息的日期时间，以及 Assistant 消息的用时、首 token、tok/s。

description.en: 在 DSH 里搜索并播放哔哩哔哩音频：侧边栏「音乐」面板 + 顶部常驻迷你播放条（电台续播 / 可拖拽吸附成悬浮球 / 歌单 / 点赞踩收藏 / 全局热键 / 播放进度记忆）

description.en: Configurable domain-scoped expert agents for DeepSeek Harness

Periodic prompt injection for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: every N model invocations (conversation turns and tool-call steps both count) the plugin injects a user-configured prompt as a model-visible user message; the first injection happens at conversat
Find and compose DSH plugins from a task description, then open an independent chat environment or install the plan into the current profile.
description.zh: 根据任务查找并组合 DSH 插件，打开可继续对话的独立环境，或将方案中的插件安装到当前配置。

description.en: Registers a keyless search provider for the built-in web_search tool so it works without an API key, failing over between the documented no-key tiers of Tavily and Firecrawl; a TAVILY_API_KEY or FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is picked up automatically when present. Two Bing scrape backends are included but off by default.
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具注册免密钥搜索提供方：无需 API Key 即可使用，在 Tavily 与 Firecrawl 官方免密钥通道之间自动降级；若设置了 TAVILY_API_KEY 或 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY 会自动采用。另含两个 Bing 抓取后端，默认关闭。

description.en: Conversational bookkeeping bundle for dsh: record expenses/income by chat with strict amount validation and natural-language dates, then query, report, export CSV/HTML, and track monthly budgets against a local SQLite ledger.
description.zh: dsh 的对话式记账插件:聊天即可记账(严格金额校验、自然语言日期、自动分类),并支持查询、报表、CSV/HTML 导出和月度预算,数据存于本地 SQLite 账本。

description.en: Keeps long DSH sessions alive when a model channel starts failing: daruma takes over after the in-box retry gives up, trips a self-healing circuit breaker on repeated 429/5xx or a terminal error, and moves the next request to another channel in your chain. Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x hosts, including 0.2.1-rc.2 with verified failover and backup-management RPC. The backup can be picked in Settings or from a panel beside the composer — both stay in sync — with a durable JSONL audit log for every switch. Channel switches are recorded in that audit log instead of as in-conversation notice rows, because a plugin session event of a type the host does not know makes it refuse to load the whole session.
description.zh: 渠道开始失败时不让长任务中断：内置重试放弃后 daruma 接管，对连续 429/5xx 或终止性错误跳闸自愈断路器，把下一个请求切到链上的其他渠道。支持 DSH 0.1.x 与 0.2.x 宿主，含已实测故障转移与备用管理 RPC 的 0.2.1-rc.2。备用渠道可在设置页或输入框旁的面板挑选，两处即时同步；每次切换落盘成可审计的 JSONL 日志。切换只记入这份审计日志，不再写入会话内的提示行——宿主不认识的插件事件类型会让整段会话加载失败。

description.en: Audit DSH skills automatically: a host-layer tools/post-execute plugin that ships both the skill body and the audit engine, runs the engine after skill files change (write/edit/shell) or after a bulk restore/backup (any tool invoked with mode: restore|bac
MoonPet（月伴）：DeepSeek Harness 状态宠物、番茄钟、多语言字幕与可选励志语音。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里养一只会跟着你思考、工作和休息的桌面宠物，还带番茄钟和字幕语音。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 开机动画 + 聊天壁纸，一个插件：六幕冷启动动画（真声台词/可交互）+ 开场视频/底图/大字横幅。双击 安装.cmd 即可，出问题双击 卸载.cmd。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加开机动画和聊天壁纸，双击就能装，出问题一键卸载。

description.en: DSH long-conversation render relief: injects one CSS rule (content-visibility) so off-screen message bodies and block formulas skip style, layout and paint.
description.zh: 给长会话页面注入一条 CSS，让屏幕外的消息和公式跳过渲染，滚动更顺滑。

description.en: Desktop only. Use DeepSeek website chats, temporary side conversations and imported chat history within DSH.
description.zh: 仅 Desktop。DeepSeek 网页聊天、临时侧栏聊天、API 开放平台与 DSH 会话迁移。

description.en: Unified plugin & skill manager for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): inventory, update checks, and safe transactional updates.
description.zh: 统一管理 DSH 插件和技能，能盘点清单、检查更新，还能安全地一键升级。

description.en: Image generation for DSH in two modes — an image_generate_lite tool the model calls from chat, and a right-sidebar studio for manual runs; up to five reference images, the OpenAI images API format, keys kept in the DSH credential service.
description.zh: DSH 生图插件，双模式：对话中由模型调用 image_generate_lite 工具出图，或在右侧栏「生图工作台」手动生图；最多 5 张参考图、支持 OpenAI images 接口格式，密钥存于 DSH 凭据服务。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: unified default reasoning level (thinking effort) for all models — per-model defaults with capability probing, live call statistics, one-command install via dsh plugin
description.zh: 一个设置统一管理所有模型的默认思考强度，支持按模型配置并实时查看调用情况。

description.en: VSCode-style remote SSH development for DSH: host manager, helper deploy pipeline, remote files/terminal/git, transparent remote execution.

像逛应用商店一样，轻松检索、定制并快速插入 DeepSeek 实战技能，让技能管理更省心。

description.zh: 把分散的会话记录整理成项目级 Token 消耗、开发时间线和费用统计面板，让你一眼看清每个项目的投入。

description.en: Tavily-backed web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — multi-key balance-aware rotation with failover, manageable from the DSH web settings.
description.zh: 用 Tavily 替换 DSH 内置搜索，支持多密钥轮换和故障切换，可在网页设置里轻松管理。

description.en: DSH工作区内跨会话记忆插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 工作区加上跨会话长期记忆，关掉会话也不丢上下文，需要时按需取回。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件发现面板：搜索 GitHub/npm 插件，英文简介自动翻译成中文，按用途分类，含最新上传通道，一键复制安装指令 | Discover Harness/Cordis plugins with auto Chinese translation, categories and newest-first search

description.zh: 改代码前先查仓库本地路线，帮 AI 找准能力边界、避免重复造轮子、守住写入限制。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏补上官方缺失的「删除会话」，并在底部提供「清理分组」批量面板：运行中置灰、二次确认、注册表与磁盘真删除。 Delete-session action + workspace cleanup panel for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏补上官方缺失的删除会话功能，运行中置灰、二次确认、真删除。

description.en: DSH 插件：在权限菜单里新增「管理员」档（完全访问 + 永不询问），内置官方 computer use、操控提示与自主迭代按钮。
description.zh: 在权限菜单里加一档「管理员」，完全访问且永不询问，还自带官方 computer use 和自主迭代按钮。

description.en: Import local sessions from Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, ZCode, Kimi into DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接操控 PhotoCraft、FilmCraft 等开源创作应用，聊天或自建界面都能用。

description.zh: 在主对话旁边开一个临时侧边任务面板，方便随手记任务、看历史，创建删除还在完善中。

description.en: Command Code plan quota in your DeepSeek Harness (dsh) sidebar: 5-hour, weekly and monthly credit windows with reset countdowns. Works with Go, GOAT, Pro, Max and Provider plans.
description.zh: 在侧边栏直接查看 Command Code 套餐的 5 小时、每周和每月额度，还能看重置倒计时，不用再开网页查。

description.en: DSH 免费联网搜索插件（Parallel 后端，零依赖）

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin for Inception Mercury: renders the diffusion denoising stream live inside the answer bubble

Adds six AI coding platforms to DSH — OpenCode, Qoder, Qoder CN, TRAE, WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy International — each as its own group in the native model picker, and manages their accounts from one settings page, with daily check-in where the platform has one, credit balance lookups, and retry on another account of the same platform when one is rate-limited. Models carry their credit multiplier where the platform declares one. OpenCode's anonymous free tier works with no credential, and TRAE stays hidden by default until it is enabled in the settings.
description.zh: 把六个 AI 编程平台接进 DSH——OpenCode、Qoder、Qoder CN、TRAE、WorkBuddy 与国际版——每个平台在原生模型选择器里各自成组；在一个设置页里统一管理账号，平台有签到接口就每日签到、可查积分余额，账号被限流时自动改用同平台其它账号。平台声明了积分倍率的模型会标注倍率。OpenCode 匿名免费层无需任何凭证；TRAE 默认隐藏，在设置里启用后才出现。

description.en: Nushell as the only shell for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): every shell call runs nu, foreign shells are refused before they spawn, and the model is taught Nushell.
description.zh: 把 Nushell 设为 dsh 唯一 shell，所有命令都走 nu，其他 shell 会被直接拦下，模型也会被教会用 Nushell。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供的开发流程增强插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 开发流程加buff的插件，帮你把日常开发步骤串成顺手的自动化流程。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 本机安全评测与提示词清洗插件：侧栏面板管理提示词分层、补丁、规则集与技能；带授权演练台。Local security-eval & prompt-cleaning plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在侧栏里管理提示词分层、补丁和规则集，还能做安全演练，帮你清洗提示词、评估本机安全风险。

description.zh: 每几轮对话自动提炼经验成技能文件，让 AI 越用越顺手，无需改源码。

description.en: Agent-team task Gantt chart for the DSH sidebar - one swimlane per teammate, real session-log time on the x-axis, and every shared task drawn with its title and summary. Requires dsh-better-sidebar 0.4.0 or later (the tab has nowhere to register without it).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的 agent team 任务甘特图：每个 teammate 一条泳道，横轴取自真实会话日志时间，条内显示共享任务的标题与简介。需先安装 dsh-better-sidebar >= 0.4.0（没有它，标签页无处注册）。

description.en: Orchestrates durable multi-agent teams from one DSH session: a captain spawns member subagents, drives a dependency-aware task DAG with quality gates, and coordinates through persistent mailboxes, with a live activity panel.
description.zh: 把单个 DSH 会话编排成持久化多智能体团队：captain 生成成员子代理、驱动带质量门的依赖感知任务 DAG、通过持久邮箱协调，附带实时活动面板。

description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加长期记忆，用 Claude Code 的 markdown 格式存，可私有、叠加或与 Claude Code 共享。

description.en: Multi-bash plugin for dsh. Add Git Bash / WSL Bash support for Windows.
description.zh: 让 Windows 上的 dsh 也能用 Git Bash 和 WSL Bash，一条命令切换多种 Shell 环境。

description.en: DSH ZCode UI — 把 DeepSeek Harness Web 的界面换成 ZCode 风格：侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索与轮次导航。A ZCode-styled sidebar, workspace session tree, global search, and turn navigation skin for DSH Web.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成 ZCode 风格，侧栏、会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航一应俱全。

description.zh: 自托管的看板项目管理工具，支持卡片附件、钉钉登录、项目角色邀请和多人实时同步。

description.en: GitHub-style daily token usage contribution calendar, model analytics, and timeline trends for DeepSeek Harness

description.zh: 把左下角账号处的文字（手机号/邮箱/用户名/账户名）和头像替换为你自定义的显示名称与图片。编辑入口是账号菜单里新增的「编辑显示名称」一行，同一个弹窗改这两项，避免截图泄露隐私。

description.en: A dsh (DeepSeek Harness) Cordis plugin that keeps llm-pi-ai provider routes' model catalog in sync with the pi.dev gateway — written through the official settings seam, zero patches to dsh internals.

description.en: Aggregated web_search and web_fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness, sitting behind the built-in tools. Search fans one query out to AnySearch, Zhipu and Zhihu concurrently, dedupes URLs, fuses ranks with Reciprocal Rank Fusion and optionally reranks through SiliconFlow. Fetch is URL-aware: static pages pass through the built-in HTTP fetcher, dynamic ones fan out to Firecrawl and AnySearch extract and pick one body by quality. One shared circuit breaker skips an engine for the day after a quota or 429 signal, and a settings card keeps each engine API key in the credential store without ever showing its value.
description.zh: 聚合型 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供方，接在 DSH 原生工具背后。搜索把一次查询并发分发给 AnySearch、智谱、知乎三路，URL 去重后用 RRF 融合排名，可选经硅基流动重排。抓取按 URL 感知分流：静态页走内置 HTTP 抓取，动态页并发 Firecrawl 与 AnySearch extract，再按质量择优返回一路正文。共用一个熔断器，某引擎触发配额或 429 信号后当日跳过该路；设置卡片把各引擎 API Key 存入凭证库，从不显示其值。

description.en: Multilingual writing, chunked long-form collaboration and continuity review, with on-demand DSH delegation discovery. Requires Python 3.9+ on PATH.
description.zh: 多语言润色、长文分块协作与上下文一致性审查，按需检查 DSH 智能体委派能力。需要 PATH 上有 Python 3.9+。

description.en: Agnes AI provider for llm-pi-ai: 4 multimodal chat models declared in the bundle patch, plus image and video generation tools.
description.zh: 为 llm-pi-ai 预声明 Agnes AI 供应商：4 个多模态对话模型，以及图像与视频生成工具。

description.en: Read-only audit of the local CLI toolchain as a sidebar panel in the DSH web GUI: lists installed versions across Homebrew, npm global, pip, Rust/Bun/uv and self-updating CLIs, flags which ones have a newer release available, and shows the dependency impact for installed packages. It reports only and never runs an upgrade, so no tool on the machine is modified. The DSH plugin ships on npm as `dsh-cli-doctor`.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的只读 CLI 工具链体检面板：按生态列出 Homebrew、npm 全局、pip、 Rust/Bun/uv 与自更新类 CLI 的本机版本，标出哪些有可用更新，并展示已安装包 的依赖影响。只报不升，不会改动本机任何工具。DSH 插件在 npm 上以 `dsh-cli-doctor` 发布。

description.en: Safe, resumable automation and analysis tools for CST Studio Suite, with task planning, solve-budget control, persistent runs, result extraction, far-field analysis, and parameter sweeps.
