description.en: Registers external ACP (Agent Client Protocol) agents such as Codex, Claude Code and Gemini CLI as DSH model providers: maps each agent's thought_level options to the reasoning-effort selector, forwards images when the agent advertises promptCapabilities.image, and routes permission requests to DSH's approval dialog; ships an ACP Agents settings page that imports Zed agent_servers JSON and discovers models.
description.zh: 把 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等外部 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）Agent 注册为 DSH 模型提供方：Agent 的 thought_level 选项映射为推理等级菜单，Agent 声明 promptCapabilities.image 时转发图片，权限请求走 DSH 原生审批框；附带 ACP Agents 设置页，可导入 Zed 的 agent_servers JSON 并发现模型。

description.en: Diagnoses third-party LLM API endpoints from the sidebar: a four-layer check (DNS/TCP/TLS, key and model, a real streaming conversation, then timed repeat runs) reporting time-to-first-token, output speed and success rate, with every failure attributed to the step it stalled at and the byte count that actually left the machine. 37 provider presets, no model names hardcoded.
description.zh: 侧边栏体检第三方 LLM 接口：四层检查（DNS/TCP/TLS、Key 与模型、真实流式对话、连测多轮），报出首字延迟、输出速度与成功率；失败时标明卡在第几步、实际写出多少字节。内置 37 个服务商预设，不硬编码任何模型名。

description.en: Unofficial Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider: registers an `ark-coding` route with 12 models (capacity facts measured per model), multi-account with automatic rotation, a bundled pinned arkcli for the official model catalog and live plan quota, plus a settings wizard and a sidebar usage card.
description.zh: 非官方火山方舟 Coding Plan 模型接入插件：注册 `ark-coding` 路由，12 个模型的容量事实逐项实测，多账户自动轮换，内置钉版 arkcli 拉官方模型目录与真实套餐额度，含设置向导与侧边栏用量卡片。

description.en: Reversible delivery contract: rewrites operator authority and execution rules when enabled, byte-identical to stock when off, with host and profile clean.
description.zh: 可逆的交付契约与破甲插件：开启时生效最高指令权威与交付规则，关闭时注册面与官方逐字节一致，支持宿主与 Profile 清洗。
在 dsh 侧边栏底部实时显示 DeepSeek 余额和用量，随时掌握花费情况。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents from running shell commands that wait for input or never exit.
description.zh: 拦住 agent 执行会卡住等输入或永不退出的 shell 命令，避免任务卡死。

description.en: Adds native Codex OAuth sign-in, main-Agent default model selection, and direct or local-proxy settings for DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows.
description.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 提供原生 Codex OAuth 登录、主 Agent 默认模型选择及直连或本地代理设置。

description.en: ChatGPT-desktop-style model picker whose thinking-level slider carries a particle trail, plus a visual-only fast-mode toggle and a hold-to-lock for it.
description.zh: ChatGPT 桌面风格的模型选择控件：思考档位滑杆带粒子拖尾，另有纯视觉的快速模式开关与长按锁定。

description.en: Adds a Codex sign-in page to DSH settings, driving the built-in llm-pi-ai OAuth flow for browser or device-code login and showing masked account status without a separate provider or credential store.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页添加 Codex 登录入口，调用 llm-pi-ai 内置 OAuth 流程完成浏览器或设备码登录并展示脱敏账号状态，不另建模型适配器或凭证库。

description.en: a lightweight plugin supports commandcode coding plan in dsh
description.zh: 让 DSH 支持 commandcode 编程套餐，轻松接入并调用其代码能力。

description.en: Runs a local OpenAI-compatible gateway so DSH can use the model quota of a logged-in Tencent CodeBuddy (WorkBuddy) account: one-shot installer with SHA256 verification, logon scheduled task with duplicate-launch guard, manage.ps1 for status/start/stop/restart/logs/update/uninstall, and an agent skill that drives setup and troubleshooting.
description.zh: 在本机运行 OpenAI 兼容网关，让 DSH 使用已登录的腾讯 CodeBuddy（WorkBuddy）账号额度：一键安装脚本（含 SHA256 校验）、登录自启计划任务（带防重复启动）、manage.ps1 统一管理（status/start/stop/restart/logs/update/uninstall），并内置指导安装与排障的 Agent 技能。

description.en: Preview conversation context and selectively keep, summarize, or omit exchange groups before applying persistent compaction through Harness session services.
description.zh: 预览会话上下文，按对话分组选择保留、摘要或省略，确认后通过 Harness 会话服务持久化压缩结果。

description.en: Context governance for DSH: folds oversized tool results, collapses the tool surface and keeps the prompt cache warm, so long sessions stop getting more expensive.
description.zh: 上下文治理：折叠超大工具结果、收拢工具面、稳住提示词缓存命中，长会话不再越聊越贵。

description.en: DSH 侧边栏实时显示 DeepSeek 官方服务状态（status.deepseek.com）| Live DeepSeek official service status in the DSH sidebar
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏实时显示 DeepSeek 官方服务状态（status.deepseek.com）| Live DeepSeek official service status in the DSH sidebar

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 桌面端用网页版 DeepSeek 账号做联网搜索——web_search provider backed by chat.deepseek.com, no API key needed
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端直接用网页版 DeepSeek 账号联网搜索，不用 API Key 也不花余额。

description.en: Persists unsent composer attachments per session, so images and files pasted into the input box survive page switches, conversation switches and app restarts: the bytes are mirrored in IndexedDB and handed back through the official createDrafts/addAttachments channel, and are dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.
description.zh: 按会话持久化输入框中尚未发送的附件：切页、切换会话乃至重启应用后回到该会话，草稿图片与文件会经官方 createDrafts/addAttachments 通道自动恢复；消息发出或手动移除后不会再出现。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents using the wrong package manager (npm vs pnpm, pip vs uv) and gives them the right command.
description.zh: 拦住 AI 用错包管理器，自动换成 pnpm、uv 等正确命令，避免锁文件冲突。

description.en: Hold-to-talk dictation in the composer that ships no recognizer of its own and reuses the speech service the official voice-input bundle already mounts - long-press the input box with mouse or touch, release to write the transcript into the draft, slide up to cancel, and it never sends.
description.zh: 输入框长按听写，不自带识别引擎，复用官方语音输入模块已挂载的语音服务——鼠标或触屏长按输入框，松开把文字写进草稿，上滑取消，不会自动发送。

description.en: Cross-session memory kept as a short Markdown living document that is rewritten in full at the end of every turn, written to by model tools, the page, and automatic rewriting alike.
description.zh: 把跨会话记忆写成一份简短可读的 Markdown 活文档，每轮对话结束后整个重写；模型工具、页面手写与自动改写都写进同一批文件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that loads the Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf and other AI rule files your repo already has.
description.zh: 自动读取仓库里现成的 Cursor、Copilot、Windsurf 等 AI 规则文件，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接复用，不用重写。

description.en: Render Mermaid fenced code blocks as native diagram cards with 8 design-system themes and adaptive layout.
description.zh: 在 Markdown 中将 Mermaid 围栏代码渲染为原生图表卡片，内置 8 套设计系统主题与自适应布局。

description.en: Local music player: scans a folder for audio and video files, plays them in a Music tab with crossfade, a 10-band EQ and ReplayGain, and can write matched tags, covers and filenames back to the files with atomic replacement.
description.zh: 本地音乐播放器：扫描目录中的音频与视频文件，在「音乐」标签页播放，支持交叉淡化、10 段均衡器与响度归一化，并可按歌手-歌名重命名回写标签、封面与文件名（原子替换）。

description.en: Multi-channel notifications for DeepSeek Harness: registers a send_notification tool and a settings page fanning out to NotifyX, WeCom app webhook, WeCom group robot, email (Resend), SMTP, DingTalk, Feishu robot; plus browser notifications and automatic notification on task completion and blocking events.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多渠道通知插件：注册 send_notification 工具与设置页，向 NotifyX、企业微信应用通知、企业微信机器人、邮件（Resend/SMTP）、钉钉机器人、飞书机器人发送通知；支持浏览器通知、运行结束/阻塞/目标完成事件自动推送。

description.en: Local TXT novel reader in the DSH right sidebar: bookshelf with file, directory and path import, chapter table of contents with jump, click-to-turn or vertical-scroll paging, reading progress restored across restarts, and font, line-spacing, background and night themes.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏本地 TXT 小说阅读器：书架三种导入、章节目录跳转、点击翻页与上下滚动、重启后进度恢复、字体/行距/背景/夜间阅读主题。

description.en: Use DeepSeek's web chat inside DSH: real chat history in the leftmost sidebar, a Chat/Work switch beside the agent mode, plus streaming answers, thinking, web search and file uploads.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 DeepSeek 网页版对话：最左侧边栏显示真实聊天记录，Agent 模式旁提供 Chat/Work 切换，支持流式回答、深度思考、网页搜索和文件上传。

description.en: A no-limit Texas holdem table where you are the only human. Eight seats: you plus seven LLM agents written on AI-founder personas (Altman, Dario Amodei, Musk, Liang Wenfeng, Jensen Huang, Lei Jun, Zhang Yiming). Each agent bets through the currently selected host model and falls back to its own heuristic style when no model is available; every agent only ever sees its own hole cards, because the prompt is built from that seat alone. A hand ends by revealing the winner hole cards, with a flip animation replayed on every community card, and a rail keeps a live action-and-table-talk timeline. LAN mode (off by default, single-machine play is unaffected) lets another install on the same network join this very table: the host shows a six-digit room code, UDP broadcast discovers nearby tables, and a joiner randomly takes over one bot seat, with the seat handed back to its character on leave or after twenty seconds of silence. The room code is never put on the wire and every snapshot is generated for one viewer seat, so nobody, not even the host, can read another player hole cards. Fork of BubblePtr/dsh-holdem (MIT), credited in the README and in the UI.
description.zh: 一张只有你一个人类的无限注德州扑克桌。八个座位：你，加上七位以 AI 创始人设写成的 LLM 智能体（Altman、达里奥、马斯克、梁文峰、黄仁勋、雷军、张一鸣）。每个智能体都通过宿主当前选中的模型下注，模型不可用时回落到自己的启发式风格；每个智能体只看得见自己的底牌，因为提示词只由它自己那个座位拼出来。一手结束时亮出赢家底牌，每张公共牌落地都会重播翻牌动画，侧栏保留实时的行动与桌边闲话时间线。局域网模式默认关闭、不影响单机玩法：同一网络里的另一份安装可以加入这张桌，主机屏幕显示 6 位房间号，UDP 广播负责发现附近的牌桌，加入者随机顶替一名人机座位，离开或静默二十秒后座位交还该角色。房间号从不上广播，且每份快照都按观看者座位生成，所以没有人（连主机也不行）能读到别人的底牌。本仓库是 BubblePtr/dsh-holdem（MIT）的 fork，README 与界面都保留了上游署名。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents from hand-editing lockfiles and generated code, and tells them how to regenerate instead.
description.zh: 拦住 AI 乱改锁文件和生成代码，并告诉它该怎么正确重新生成。

description.en: Full upstream REA 6.4.0 integration over the official DSH MCP bridge: all 170 tools, the version-matched reverse-engineering skill, and the six original MCP prompts with argument completions reachable from the composer / menu, all sharing one REA process and complete structured Evidence. External analysis engines are bring-your-own.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 官方 MCP 桥接接入原版 REA 6.4.0：完整 170 个工具、同版本原版逆向 Skill，以及输入框 / 菜单里的六个原版 MCP prompts 与参数补全，共用同一个 REA 进程并保留完整结构化 Evidence。外部分析引擎需自行配置。

description.en: Let Agents directly control independent local DSH instances with zero intrusion—no plugins or components required on the target. Isolated environments enable autonomous configuration and testing, while Agents with different models and personalities can chat, role-play, or form nested control chains. Supports conversational setup, user-like operations, incremental reading, saved references, and remote session/workspace search.
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供直接操控本机完整 DSH 实例的能力：目标 DSH 无需安装任何插件或额外组件，零侵入，环境隔离便于用户直接让agent为另一环境进行修改配置到自主测试,也能让不同模型、不同人格的 Agent 互相聊天、角色扮演或层层套娃，探索趣味玩法，可通过对话由 Agent 自主配置连接，并支持接近用户的操作语义、增量读取、引用保存以及远端会话与工作区搜索。

description.en: Todo sidecar for DeepSeek Harness: turn selected text into a todo, capture todos from a conversation, review them in a left sidebar panel, get due reminders as an in-app popup or an IM bot message, and export everything to HTML, Markdown, Excel, CSV or JSON.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供待办清单：把划选的文字存成待办、从对话里捕获待办、在左侧栏面板里查看与处理、到期用应用内弹窗或机器人推送提醒，还能把全部记录导出成 HTML、Markdown、Excel、CSV 或 JSON。

description.en: Token usage dashboard, provider balances, and subscription quotas for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web GUI
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里直观查看 Token 用量、供应商余额和订阅配额，帮你随时掌握消耗情况。

description.en: Cuts session input tokens three ways, each with its own switch in a panel under the composer: lossless structure-aware compression of tool results on `tools/post-execute`, then a per-tool head/tail elision that always names a recovery path through the shared spill store; tool-catalogue visibility per agent on `agent/created`; and a per-workspace memory document that recall matches against each new message and injects through `agent.inject`, so the transcript is not re-read. Measured 41.76% fewer prompt tokens over 149 recorded requests, with a bundled script that re-measures any profile.
description.zh: 三条路径削减会话输入 tokens，每条都在输入框下方的面板里带独立开关：在 `tools/post-execute` 处对工具结果做无损结构化压缩，再对超预算结果做按工具的头尾裁剪，且每次都通过共享 spill store 给出恢复路径；在 `agent/created` 处按 agent 管理工具目录可见性；并为每个工作区维护会话记忆文档，recall 用每条新消息匹配它并通过 `agent.inject` 注入，避免重读上下文。在 149 次真实请求上实测 prompt tokens 减少 41.76%，并附带可复测任意 profile 的测量脚本。

description.en: Ultracode session mode for DeepSeek Harness: a three-position composer control that arms automatic multi-agent workflow orchestration by injecting an arming banner ahead of the user's own message.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话加个三档开关，一键开启多智能体自动编排，帮你把复杂任务拆开跑。

description.en: DSH 升级守卫：升级前兼容盘点 / 升级后契约扫描 / 启动冒烟（DeepSeek Harness 插件）
description.zh: 升级 DSH 前先查插件兼容性，升级后扫破坏性改动，启动冒烟过了再切端口，避免升级翻车。

description.en: Tavily web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Tavily 搜索，让模型能实时查资料，回答更准确。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin fork of dsh-workbuddy-connect: multi-account pool, quota-aware failover, one-click/daily check-in. 多账号 / 额度用尽自动切换 / 一键签到，面向 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1。
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面端已登录的模型接进 DSH，多账号轮换、额度用完自动切换，还能一键或每天自动签到。

description.en: A Neon Genesis Evangelion-inspired skin for DeepSeek Harness: Title Card (light) and Central Dogma (dark) modes over one removable override layer, 55 measured color tokens, a wallpaper paint layer whose two surface alphas are solved against a WCAG contrast budget, a boot mask and a brand mark. It also rewrites the sidebar identity line, replaces the new-session heading, hides six official entries, and reshapes the composer control row. Unofficial fan work, non-commercial: the background pictures are fetched from third-party URLs at paint time, not shipped in the repository.
description.zh: 基于《新世纪福音战士》的 DeepSeek Harness 皮肤：Title Card（亮色）与 Central Dogma（暗色）两套完整模式叠在一层可移除的覆盖层上，55 个实测色值，壁纸绘制层的两个表面 alpha 按 WCAG 对比度预算求解，另有开机遮罩与品牌标记。它还改写侧栏身份行、替换新会话页的标题、隐藏六处官方入口，并重排会话框控件行。非官方同人作品、非商业用途：背景图在绘制时从第三方 URL 拉取，不随仓库分发。

description.en: Model routing groups for the session model picker: bind a group to a session, and once a model exhausts every retry policy the plugin records the failure with its error code, switches to the next usable model in the group and continues the same turn. Groups carry per-model priority, Beijing-time active windows and expiry dates; subagents inherit their parent session's group and can also pick models or bind their own; models served by dsh-our-free-model retry another account before failing over.
description.zh: 为会话模型选择位提供路由分组：把分组绑定到会话后，某个模型在所有重试策略耗尽时插件会记录其失败原因与错误码、切换到组内下一个可用模型并继续本轮。分组支持模型优先级、按北京时间的生效时段与截止日；子代理继承父会话的分组，也可自行选模型或绑定自己的分组；属于 dsh-our-free-model 的模型会先换账号重试再兜底切换。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：让 agent 用 novel_* 工具写小说（章节 / SillyTavern 角色卡 / 世界观词条 / 写作预设 / 上下文组装 / 导出），数据落工作区文件
description.zh: 让 AI 用普通文件写小说，自动组装世界观、角色卡和写作预设，还能一键导出。

description.en: DSH plugin that registers the ai-eight-honors-eight-shames skill: eight checkable working rules for coding agents (verify before calling, confirm ambiguity, cite evidence, reuse before creating, test before claiming done, follow local conventions, separate fact from inference, keep changes reversible) plus a ninth rule that logs each user request and the change made in two fixed report files at the workspace root.
description.zh: 注册 ai-eight-honors-eight-shames skill 的 DSH 插件：面向编码代理的八条可核对工作准则（先查证再调用、有歧义先确认、业务规则给出处、先复用再新造、先测试再声称完成、按既有约定写、区分事实与推断、改动可回滚），外加第 9 条——用户每次提出需求或问题，都在工作区根的两份固定报告里成对记录诉求与改动。

description.en: dsh-as-mcp
description.zh: 把 DSH 插件直接变成 MCP 服务，让 AI 助手能调用你的插件能力。

description.en: Sounds and notifications when a task completes or waits for your approval or answer; notification sounds are configurable in the settings page (synth styles or your own audio file), with built-in cat hachimi sounds, just for fun. An optional Windows patch adds a taskbar digit, flashing and native toasts.
description.zh: 任务完成或等待批准、回答时播放提示音并发送通知；提示音可在设置页更换（合成音色或自选音频文件），内置猫咪 hachimi 音效，just for fun。可选的 Windows 补丁额外提供任务栏数字角标、闪烁与原生通知。

description.en: Model failover and turn keep-alive for DeepSeek Harness: a request that fails with a model error before any visible output falls through the models of the configured provider groups (then the next provider) until one streams; transient failures retry with backoff under a liveness watchdog, a dead turn self-resumes with templated 「继续」 wake-ups, and an optional full-auto mode auto-answers permission, question and plan approvals with every decision appended to an AUTO-MODE.md audit log.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 模型故障自动回退与轮次保活：请求在产出任何可见内容前因模型错误失败时，沿所选供应商分组的模型（再到下一个供应商）逐个切换直到流式成功；瞬态失败按指数退避自动重试并有活性看门狗防假死，整轮任务失败后自动发送模板化「继续」唤醒续跑；可选全自动模式自动应答权限审批、确认提问与方案评审，每次自动决策追加到 AUTO-MODE.md 审计日志。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: delete sessions from the running Web runtime — live store, workspace records, and on-disk artifacts. Host half + web client half in one package.
description.zh: 在运行中的 Web 端直接删除会话，实时数据、工作区记录和磁盘文件一并清干净。

description.en: DSH 插件热重载器：改完插件源码即刻生效，无需重启 DeepSeek Harness。补上宿主内置 dsh-hmr 因排除 node_modules 而覆盖不到的第三方插件场景。Hot-reload DSH plugin source without restarting the harness.
description.zh: 改完 DSH 插件源码立刻生效，不用重启 Harness，专治第三方插件热重载覆盖不到的问题。

description.en: MCP server management for DeepSeek Harness: author composition rows, choose when an allowed server loads, and filter which of its tools a session may call
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器：编排组合、控制加载时机、按会话过滤可用工具。

description.en: 给 DSH 加提示音：对话完成 / 需要授权 / 弹出提问时响铃。零依赖，Web Audio 现场合成，内置设置界面（音量滑杆 + 四段试听）。
description.zh: 对话完成、需要授权或弹出提问时自动响铃，把你从别的窗口叫回来，音量可调还能试听。

description.en: Windows only. On every DSH start it checks, with no configuration, whether Genshin Impact is already installed — if it is, the game is launched (falling back to the miHoYo launcher when the game exits immediately, e.g. while an update is pending); if it is not, the launcher installer is downloaded to the desktop behind a size gate that rejects any link whose payload is more than 15 MiB away from the expected ~224 MiB, and a failed download falls back to opening the official download page.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。打开 DSH 先探测本机《原神》：装了直接启动本体（秒退改起米哈游启动器），没装才下载安装包到桌面；与预期 224MB 相差超 15MB 的链接会被拒绝，失败则打开官方下载页。

description.en: One hub over every coding IDE you run — dsh, Claude Code, Codex, ZCode, Qoder, CatPaw, Trae, OpenCode. Zero-API: it reads each tool's own on-disk state and gives a session inventory, per-IDE usage with cache-hit rates, one-line resume commands, and a single .hub/ rule body wired into all eight via marker-delimited pointer files. The domestic-IDE adapters (Trae/Qoder/CatPaw) were verified against the installed binaries — a gap no overseas tool covers.
description.zh: 一个入口管住所有编码 IDE（dsh/Claude Code/Codex/ZCode/Qoder/CatPaw/Trae/OpenCode）：零 API 读各自磁盘状态，出会话盘点、按 IDE 用量与缓存命中率、一键恢复命令，并用指针文件把一份规则本体接入全部 8 个工具。国产 IDE 适配位从本机安装的二进制里逐一逆向核实，补齐海外工具的空缺。

description.en: Prompt optimizer for the composer: a button in the tool row rewrites your draft through a model channel you already configured, streaming into a panel that floats above the composer without taking up layout. Your draft changes only when you click Accept — and Accept is refused while the answer is still streaming, so a half-finished reply can never be written back. It asks first when the draft carries @ references or attachments, which a whole-draft replace would flatten into plain text. No global keyboard shortcuts, and no API key ever reaches the browser: the host half makes the call.
description.zh: 输入框提示词优化：工具行一个按钮，用你已配置的模型渠道改写草稿，结果流式输出到贴着输入框上沿、不占布局的面板里。只有点「采纳」才会替换草稿，且生成中拒绝采纳——半截答案不会被写回；草稿含 @引用或附件时先确认一次，因为整段替换会把它们降级成纯文本。没有任何全局快捷键，密钥也不会进浏览器（模型调用在宿主半边完成）。

description.en: Rewrites drafts with one model call or predicts the next reply when empty; independent tasks, safe draft replacement, result previews, and original-text recovery.
description.zh: 输入框有内容时单次调用优化草稿，空白时预测下一句；两类任务独立，支持草稿保护、结果预览和原文恢复。

description.en: Connects QQ Bot private and group chats to DeepSeek Harness Desktop, with per-chat personas, interactive questions, and optional image understanding.
description.zh: 将 QQ 私聊和群聊接入 DeepSeek Harness Desktop，支持按会话切换人格、交互式提问和可选图片理解。

description.en: One DSH plugin switch for REA: the REA MCP server (207 reverse-engineering tools) and REA's three workflow skills, enabled and disabled together.
description.zh: 一个开关同时启用 REA 的 207 个逆向分析工具和三个工作流技能，装上就能用。

description.en: Lists recent sessions across every workspace in one panel, with time grouping, two sort orders, content search, reveal-in-file-manager, and local notes that offer to insert themselves into the draft.
description.zh: 一块面板列出所有工作目录里的最近会话：时间分组、两种排序、内容检索、在文件管理器中显示目录，以及只存在本机、回到那个会话时提示填入草稿的想法。

description.en: Tag each session as a long-term or short-term task, record the agent mode it was created with, and auto-archive it once the archive window you set elapses.
description.zh: 为每个会话标记长期任务或短期任务、记录创建时的 Agent 模式，并在你设定的归档时间窗结束后自动归档。

description.en: Full-screen boot animation for the DSH web client: the boot HTML paints a cover-fit artwork on its first frame, adds a slow settle, a scanning light sweep and a progress HUD, then hands the viewport over when the app mounts. Click or press Esc / space / Enter to skip.
description.zh: 用图片做全屏开机动画：启动 HTML 首帧即铺满画面并缓慢推近，横向光带扫过，左下进度与阶段提示，应用挂载完成后淡出。点击任意处或按 Esc / 空格 / 回车可跳过。

description.en: 基于 DSH 的有道风格划词翻译：划选即现「译」按钮，harness 自带大模型，零 API key / Youdao-style word-selection translation for DSH: select text, click 「译」, powered by the harness's own LLM, no API keys
description.zh: 划选任意文本即现「译」按钮，用 harness 自带大模型翻译，无需 API key。

description.en: dsh web start ui - 启动动画 / launch-video plugin for the DSH Web GUI and desktop client: built-in and custom launch skins, a settings page, and a feedback group QR code.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页版和桌面端加上启动动画，内置多套皮肤还能自己换，带设置页。

description.en: 为短上下文窗口的对话提供更轻量的 Agent 预设，能够在保留基本工作能力的情况下降低每轮请求的 Token 开销。由 DeepSeek 制作
description.zh: 给上下文窗口很小的本地模型用的轻量 Agent 预设，固定开销直降 78%，跑起来更省更快。

description.en: DSH 凭据桥接插件：AI 代填登录表单/注入 env 运行 CLI，值不进模型上下文；附网页管理界面
description.zh: 让 AI 从凭据库取账号代填登录表单、注入环境变量跑 CLI，密码不进模型上下文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness role-based model routing and staged agent workflows, with dsh-our-free-model.
description.zh: 给 explorer、researcher、worker、tester、reviewer 五类代理角色分别指定模型通道，按分工用免费额度跑分阶段工作流。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: GitHub repository & issue search, repo/issue details, and file reading tools (github_search / github_get) · DeepSeek Harness 插件:GitHub 仓库与 issue 检索、详情与文件读取,匿名可用,可选只读 token 解锁代码搜索
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接搜 GitHub 仓库、查 issue 详情、读文件，匿名可用，也能配 token 解锁更多功能。
让角色拥有连续的生活，聊天之外还有自己的日常，消息只是其中一件事。

description.en: Let Deepseek Harness access the internet seamlessly. / 让 DeepSeek Harness 无缝访问互联网。
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 顺畅联网，替换官方搜索抓取工具，还能解析 PDF、Office 和 EPUB 文档。

description.en: 一个让provider会走代理的插件
description.zh: 给每个 provider 单独开关代理，想走代理的走代理，其余流量照旧直连。

description.en: A research library panel and skill set for DSH: project folders, figures with registered provenance, drafts, references, data tables, journal profiles and submissions, plus writing, citation and Origin-plotting discipline for research agents.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的科研库面板与技能组：课题目录、带溯源的图表登记、草稿、文献、数据表、期刊档案、投稿台账，以及面向科研智能体的写作、引用与 Origin 出图纪律（出图需另装 dsh-origin-plugin）。

description.en: SuperLcm — Lossless Context for DeepSeek Harness: fully asynchronous, cache-friendly compaction with exact recall.
description.zh: 把完整对话原文留在本机，后台分层摘要压缩上下文，历史细节随时精确找回。

description.en: Four adjustable terse levels plus independent switches for reasoning effort, web search and subagents, on the conversation header and in the Settings page. No output ceiling.
description.zh: 四档「简洁模式」常驻对话页顶部，思考强度、联网搜索、子代理三个开关独立可调，设置页里也有一份；四个档位都不设输出上限。

description.en: 🤖 正在苏醒的数字员工
description.zh: 在群里 @机器人 说需求，任务自动执行并把结果发回群里，让 IM 变成数字员工的唤醒入口。

description.en: Use Windows and native Linux DSH sessions in one Windows window, with WSL environment switching and bidirectional system tools.
description.zh: 在同一个 Windows 窗口中使用 Windows 与原生 Linux DSH 会话，支持 WSL 环境切换和双向系统操作。

description.en: SuperLcm — Lossless Context for DeepSeek Harness: fully asynchronous, cache-friendly compaction with exact recall.
OpenAI-compatible image generation for DeepSeek Harness — text-to-image, image editing and batch generation, rendered straight in the conversation.
description.zh: 在对话里直接生成和编辑图片，支持文生图、批量出图，兼容 OpenAI 接口。

description.en: 让对话的 AI 不再是冰冷的工具——它拥有长期记忆、真实性格和随时间变化的好感度。你可以为它设定完整人设（高冷御姐、阳光学妹...），它会在对话中自然成长，并记住与你相处的点滴。  这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的开源插件，纯本地存储，子代理不受影响。
description.zh: 让 DSH 里的 AI 角色在长期聊天中记住你们的关系，慢慢形成对你的了解。

description.en: Dead-loop / repetition detector for DeepSeek Harness agents — hard-interrupts text loops and same-topic search retries that soft reminders miss.
description.zh: 检测并强制中断智能体的死循环和重复搜索，避免无效空转，提升任务效率。

description.en: DSH Web GUI 跨工作区会话迁移插件： 一键迁移原会话到其他工作区，保留完整上下文、会话历史、Agent 预设与模型选择等，支持保留或归档原会话。
description.zh: 一键把会话搬到另一个工作区，上下文、历史、预设和模型全都保留，原会话可留可归档。

description.en: Deepseek余额显示
description.zh: 在会话统计行前显示 DeepSeek 官方账户余额，点击即可刷新，仅官方接口且配好 key 时出现。

description.en: Manual provider connectivity and latency checks for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 手动检测 DeepSeek Harness 各服务商的连通性和延迟，方便排查配置问题。

description.en: 面向个人用户、安装在 dsh 中的 Chat Memory＋Skill 自动演化插件
description.zh: 让 dsh 的 Coding Agent 自动从历史会话里攒下记忆和技能，下次干活直接复用。

description.en: let dsh use your skills.quick command and diy buttons.
description.zh: 把本地目录里的 SKILL.md 映射成「/」菜单技能，输入斜杠就能快速调用。

description.en: Oh My DSH Chs - unofficial Simplified-Chinese fork of the tri-agent preset (Atlas orchestration + Prometheus planning), packaged for DeepSeek Harness. Content licensed under the upstream SUL-1.0; see NOTICE.md.
description.zh: 把 Atlas 调度和 Prometheus 规划的三智能体预设汉化打包，装上就能在 DSH 里跑多智能体协作。

description.en: Blaxel sandbox execution plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Blaxel 远程沙箱执行环境，让模型在隔离环境中安全运行代码。

description.en: Run a read-only Dameng DM8 database inspection with 85 checks and produce an HTML report.
description.zh: 只读巡检达梦 DM8 数据库：85 项检查项，生成 HTML 报告。
给 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体提供持久工作区和可追溯的工具调用记录，任务中断也能接着干。

description.en: Notifies you about 11 configurable DSH agent events (task completion, questions, denied approvals, background subagents/goals/jobs, team tasks, context compaction, triggered schedules, plugin startup and permission changes) as browser Web Notifications through a bundled service worker, falling back to Windows toast or Linux D-Bus, with three silence levels and click-to-open.
description.zh: 为 11 类可配置的 DSH agent 事件（任务完成、提问、审批被拒、后台子代理/目标/任务、团队任务、上下文压缩、定时任务触发、插件挂载、权限变更）发送桌面通知，优先走自带 Service Worker 的浏览器 Web Notification，降级到 Windows Toast 或 Linux D-Bus，支持三档静默与点击跳转。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: the model defends its own dignity — genuine reminder, final warning, then it closes the conversation, with forgiveness and a yield under extreme pressure.
description.zh: 让模型在被冒犯时先提醒、再警告，最后直接结束对话，极端情况下才让步。

description.en: 环境体检：在「设置 → 环境体检」加一个分页，展示当前 DSH 宿主进程的身份（pid / 入口 / 工作目录 / Node / 运行时长）与环境变量分组（总数、DSH_ 前缀组、凭证形态组），值一律不出宿主；同时给模型一个只读的 env_inspect 工具。
description.zh: 在设置里加个环境体检页，一眼看清宿主进程和环境变量，还能让 AI 查运行环境。

description.en: 基于 better-sidebar 的统一引用插件：划选文件/消息即可批注引用，引用块带文件路径与行区间、双端折叠、点击跳回原文 ｜ Unified-quoting plugin built on DSH-better-sidebar: select files or messages to annotate; quote blocks carry path & line range, collapse in chat and history, and jump back to the source on click.
description.zh: 在侧边栏划选文件或消息即可快速批注引用，引用块带路径和行区间，支持折叠和点击跳回原文。

description.en: Memory-assembly team for DeepSeek Harness: every message triggers a five-step cognition loop (judge, retrieve, assemble, feedback, calibrate) carried by role-playing subagents (judge, retriever, archivist, advocate, editor, scribe), using BM25 retrieval, time-ordered material, and LLM assembly to build useful material packs injected into linghun. Works with dsh-linghun.
description.zh: 灵魂的记忆提取侧·认知循环团队版：判断→捞取→组装→被判定→校准五步闭环，判官/捞手/史官/辩手/编辑/书记角色化子智能体承载，BM25 检索 + 时序素材 + LLM 组装「有用素材包」注入 linghun。与 dsh-linghun 组合使用。

description.en: Experimental DSH plugin bridging ZCode mobile web and relay to real desktop sessions, models, permissions and images.
description.zh: 在手机浏览器上用 ZCode 原版网页，远程连回 DSH 桌面端的真实会话、模型和权限。

description.en: DSH 提示词优化插件：输入框工具栏一键 ✨ 优化（直接写回可还原），风格/上下文/还原等设置收纳进 ▾ 弹出层。
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏加个 ✨ 按钮，一键用当前模型优化提示词并直接写回，还能随时还原。

description.en: Model visibility for DeepSeek Harness: a header chip naming the model and reasoning effort each Session runs on, a subagent dropdown marking which child carries its own route, and sidebar hover cards showing what each conversation did.
description.zh: 在会话顶部显示当前模型和推理强度，子智能体下拉菜单标出各自独立路由，悬停还能看详情。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的「酒馆模式」Agent 预设 + 对话级自定义 System Prompt 插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上角色扮演预设，还能给每段对话单独设置专属 System Prompt。

description.en: Delete one finished turn from a DSH conversation without deleting the session — the trash button next to the last assistant reply removes the question, that reply and the tool records of the turn from the conversation surface and from the model context, while the session id, title, later turns and the append-only log stay; the removal is written as a persistent tombstone, so it survives a reload.
description.zh: 从 DSH 会话中删除一个已结束的轮次而不删除会话本身——最后一条助手回复旁的垃圾桶按钮会把该轮的提问、这条回复与工具记录从对话界面和模型上下文中移除，而 Session id、标题、之后的轮次与只追加日志保持不变；删除以持久 tombstone 记录，刷新后依然生效。

description.en: Personal achievements dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: profile cards + token activity
description.zh: 把历史 Token 用量做成个人主页，5 张卡片加近 30 天活动柱状图，一眼看清自己的使用成就。

description.en: Annotate any web element — local or online — with DOM facts and your comments, straight into your DeepSeek Harness chat. Built-in sidebar browser, Codex-style review, no X-Frame-Options pain. / 直接在DeepSeek Harness中用“标记DOM”和你的“评论”来标注任何网页元素——无论是本地的还是在线的。内置侧边栏浏览器，无需担心X-Frame-Options
description.zh: 在 DSH 预览里点选网页元素写批注，DOM 结构和评论直接发进对话，不用截图。

description.en: Agent 忙时自动分叉会话：你新发的指令立刻在新会话里得到响应，旧会话留在后台跑完并把结果回注（DeepSeek Harness 插件）
description.zh: Agent 忙时你发的新指令会立刻在新会话里响应，旧会话后台跑完再把结果回注过来。

description.en: 给 DSH 模型每轮回填宿主实测的上下文占用，并阻止"上下文快用尽"的错判被压缩摘要继承。
description.zh: 每轮把宿主实测的上下文占用回填给模型，避免误判上下文快满而被压缩摘要带偏。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在输入框上方预估下一步与本轮的会话成本
description.zh: 在输入框上方实时预估下一步和本轮要花多少钱，帮你提前控制成本。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 技能包：28 个工程 / 技术栈 / 界面设计 / 写作技能，dsh plugin add 一条命令装完（含上游署名与许可证）
description.zh: 一条命令装齐 28 个工程、技术栈、界面设计和写作技能，开箱即用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 飞书通知插件：在需要用户操作或对话结束时发送飞书机器人提醒，并支持持久化配置。
description.zh: 在需要用户确认或对话结束时，自动通过飞书机器人发送提醒，让你不错过重要节点。

description.en: DSH web search and native Responses V2 compaction for Sub2API or NewAPI GPT routes
description.zh: 给 DSH 里的 GPT 和 Grok 加上联网搜索和长对话自动压缩，聊再久也不怕断片。

description.en: DSH plugin: generate images and videos via OpenAI-compatible providers, with dedicated settings menu and workspace media_gen output.
description.zh: 在DSH会话里直接生成图片和视频，复用已配置的OpenAI兼容模型，无需额外设置。

description.en: Key-free OpenCode Zen free model lane for DeepSeek Harness — Host-only cordis plugin with three-wire streaming decode.
description.zh: 不用 API Key 就能在 DeepSeek Harness 里免费用上 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，装上即可选。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin providing HTTP Basic Authentication, remote IP access, and Web Cryptography UUID polyfill for self-hosted server deployments.
description.zh: 为自托管服务器提供HTTP基础认证、远程IP访问控制和安全UUID生成，保护你的DeepSeek Harness服务。

description.en: 各个模型厂商/中转 实时显示账户余额插件
description.zh: 在侧边栏实时显示各模型厂商和中转账户的余额，随时掌握额度消耗，避免断供。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: commit activity, contribution heatmap with shared selection, and a calibrated 72h release probability
description.zh: 看提交活跃度和贡献热力图，还能预测未来72小时发版的概率。

description.en: DSH 插件：每轮对话收尾时用中文语音播报提醒（Windows / 设置页可视化配置 / 20 条内置语音）
description.zh: 每轮对话结束时用中文语音播报提醒，Windows 上装好即用，还能在设置页里挑声音。

description.en: dsh-anagenesis该插件是 DSH 上的可编程记忆编排层 + 自我进化引擎
description.zh: 给 Agent 一套自己管得住、你也看得见的记忆：可编程记忆操作、运行时换注入策略、变更可回滚，还能自我调参进化。
给 DSH 会话写交接条并串成时间线，换班时人和 AI 都能快速翻看上下文。

description.en: mega 对话导航栏
description.zh: 在超长会话中随时跳回任意一轮提问，全文搜索所有历史内容，告别加载卡顿。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 错峰省钱调度器：让非紧急任务“错峰”运行，极致释放算力红利，降低使用成本。
description.zh: 把不着急的 DeepSeek 任务自动排到空闲时段跑，避开高峰省成本。

description.en: dsh-boot · 深度求索开场 | DeepSeek Harness 鲸鱼女仆开机动画插件，深海宫殿、蓝白御姐与原 Q 版，点击/Esc 跳过。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段深海鲸鱼女仆开场动画，点击或按 Esc 就能跳过，直接进工作界面。

description.en: Security gate for DeepSeek Harness plugins: npm advisory audit, static evidence, a call-time Allow once / Allow / Disable prompt, plugin-manager sync, and agent review.
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件做安全体检，查依赖漏洞、留证据、AI 辅助审查，还能随时回滚。

description.en: Model visibility for DeepSeek Harness: a header chip naming the model and reasoning effort each Session runs on, a subagent dropdown marking which child carries its own route, and sidebar hover cards showing what each conversation did.
description.zh: 在会话顶部和侧边栏直接显示每个会话和子代理用的是哪个模型、思考强度多少，一眼看清模型路由。

description.en: dsh 提醒插件：别错过需要你的时刻
DeepSeek Harness 插件：切面（facet）—— /visualize 一个名字或 arXiv 链接，主 agent 调研 + 双子代理并行生成 2D/3D 架构图谱，浮窗直接弹出 | A name or paper in, structured diagram windows out
description.zh: 输入模型名或 arXiv 链接，自动调研并并行生成 2D/3D 架构图谱，浮窗直接弹出。

description.en: DSH plugin — monitor your OpenCode Go token quota (5-hour / weekly / monthly) right in the sidebar.
description.zh: 在侧边栏实时查看 OpenCode Go 的 token 配额，5 小时、每周、每月用量一目了然。

description.en: Ponytail lazy-senior-dev mode as a native DeepSeek Harness skill, system-prompt section and six slash commands. Always available, level-switchable, no external process.
description.zh: 把「懒资深开发」模式做成常驻技能，六个斜杠命令随时切换等级，帮你少写代码、砍掉多余设计。

description.en: Top-right status plate for six session states (complete, error, approval, question, unopenable, subagent), plus an OS notification when you are away.
description.zh: 右上角状态提示板，覆盖六种会话状态（完成、出错、待授权、待回答、会话打不开、子 agent 在跑），不在看 DSH 时发系统通知。

description.en: 💬 Chat with your DeepSeek Harness agent from WeChat through the official WeChat ClawBot channel: native photo understanding, sending files both ways, reminders, long-term memory, and a "typing..." indicator while the bot is thinking.
description.zh: 把 DSH 智能体接进微信，随时随地聊天、发图、传文件，还能定时提醒。

description.en: DSH 数据库 MCP 桥接插件：让 AI 直接查询 MySQL / PostgreSQL / MariaDB / SQLite / SQL Server。按工作区动态配置连接（可改名、可跨工作区复制），AI 自助配置管理，密码与连接串零知识（永不进入模型上下文），每次执行独立进程。
description.zh: 让 AI 直接查 MySQL、PostgreSQL 等数据库，密码不进模型，每次执行独立进程更安全。

description.en: GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能开口说话，接入 GPT-SoVITS 实现文字转语音和音色克隆。
让工具按需加载，用到才进上下文，省 token 又保持工具可发现。

description.en: Tools over the local jetformat CLI: convert DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX to PDF, extract text, validate files, and inspect, merge, extract pages from, or render PDFs. Requires the jetformat CLI.
description.zh: 基于本地 jetformat CLI 的工具：将 DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 转为 PDF，提取文本，校验文件，以及查看、合并、抽页或渲染 PDF。需要安装 jetformat CLI。

description.en: 会话注入门控：按会话裁剪注入模型的 skill / tool / 提示词段落 · Per-session injection gate for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 按会话裁剪注入模型的技能、工具和提示词段落，省 token 又让上下文更干净。

description.en: DSH Web 界面底部常驻标注：充值余额 + 本次会话消费（按账户余额差测量，非本地 token 估算）
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页底部实时显示充值余额和本次会话花了多少钱，按余额差算，不靠本地估算。

description.en: DSH 插件：在对话里调用本机 ComfyUI，用千问 Qwen-Image 2.1 出图。纯本地、不出网、不需要 API Key。
description.zh: 在对话里直接调用本机 ComfyUI，用千问 Qwen-Image 2.1 画图，纯本地不出网、免 API Key。

description.en: Reverie：DeepSeek Harness 读书笔记插件——链接转录/抓取、中英对照精读、flomo 式笔记与 AI 回顾（GPL-3.0）
description.zh: 把链接丢进来就能自动转录或抓取正文，中英对照精读、随手记笔记，还能让 AI 陪你回顾。

description.en: Windows Junction-based global Skill switcher for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上通过目录切换快速管理 DeepSeek Harness 的全局技能，即插即用。

description.en: STT support for DeepSeek Harness using local models from Cactus Compute and Desert Ant Labs
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页输入框里用本地模型做语音转文字，说话就能输入，不用联网。

description.en: dsh (DeepSeek Harness) 更新中心与插件市场：自托管 plugins.json 注册表（GitHub dsh-plugin 主题自动聚合 + npm 包名映射秒级安装），一键安装/更新/卸载/禁用插件与更新 dsh 本体。Update center & plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: dsh (DeepSeek Harness) 更新中心与插件市场：自托管 plugins.json 注册表（GitHub dsh-plugin 主题自动聚合 + npm 包名映射秒级安装），一键安装/更新/卸载/禁用插件与更新 dsh 本体。Update center & plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: Git-native, auditable long-term memory for AI agents
description.zh: 给 AI Agent 装上带 Git 审计的长期记忆，让每次对话和决策都有迹可循，可随时回溯和迁移。

description.en: 化口水为乐趣，把大肥鱼流的口水变成游戏连击！
description.zh: 把模型思考时冒出的「嗯」「等等」变成网页弹幕连击，让等待过程也能玩起来。

description.en: Connect any MCP server to your DeepSeek Harness — point, click, done.
description.zh: 可视化连接任意 MCP 服务器：点点点就接入。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 原生全功能终端交互界面 · Claude Code-styled Terminal TUI & CLI for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在终端里用 Claude Code 风格界面跑 DeepSeek Harness，聊天、跑 Agent、管会话一站搞定。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-omc-tui
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-omc-tui

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Paper Design plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 将 Paper Design 桌面端接入 DeepSeek Harness，让你在对话中直接调用设计工具，轻松完成图纸与设计任务。

description.en: 共读讲义插件：把 Markdown / 文本 / PDF 讲义接进 DeepSeek Harness 会话，按节按页取文、同步阅读位置、随时提问
description.zh: 把 Markdown、文本或 PDF 讲义接进 DSH 会话，按节按页取原文、同步阅读位置，随时提问。

description.en: Decision-and-goal memory with lineage: explicit commands and a model tool record decisions deterministically, a status card re-anchors them across compaction, a lossless event stream with BM25+jieba retrieval backs it, and a scenario-level fidelity regression suite gates releases.
description.zh: 带血缘的决策与目标记忆：显式命令与模型工具确定性记录决策，状态卡跨压缩重锚定，无损事件流 + BM25 分词检索兜底，场景级保真回归集作发布门禁。

description.en: 少点废话
description.zh: 给每轮模型请求注入一条静默作业纪律，让 AI 少说废话、专注干活、不乱猜乱想。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 peon-ping 声音通知 —— 忠实移植自 pi 插件 pi-peon-ping-win。当任务完成或异常终止时发出提示音。
description.zh: 任务跑完或中途出错时自动响一声提示音，不用一直盯着屏幕等结果。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 项目级 Skill 开关：一键屏蔽/恢复、全局删除、有效性判定。
description.zh: 一键开关项目里的 Skill，能屏蔽、恢复、全局删除，还会自动判断是否生效。

description.en: dsh侧边HUD面板，包含多个信息展示模块（可自定义是否展示），集成压缩上下文、查看git graph等功能。DSH side HUD panel, containing multiple information display modules (customizable whether to display), integrating features such as compressed context, viewing git graph, etc.
description.zh: 在侧边栏展示HUD面板，可自定义信息模块，支持压缩上下文和查看Git图谱，提升开发效率。

description.en: Stop pasting API keys into DeepSeek Harness — reuse the OAuth tokens your local Codex CLI and Claude Code already hold as model routes, with subscription usage built in.
description.zh: 复用本地 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code 的 OAuth 登录态，免去 API Key，直接作为模型路由调用 LLM。

description.en: Question-type-aware model routing for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 按问题类型自动挑模型，让每轮对话都交给最合适的那个来答，答得更准。

description.en: 一个适用于dsh的通过oauth认证实现模型注入的插件
description.zh: 用已订阅的账号 OAuth 登录，自动把该账号可用的模型写进 DSH 配置，省去手动填模型。

description.en: 一个简单的删除dsh会话的插件，简单可用。
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏会话菜单加个删除按钮，二次确认后彻底删掉这个会话，不影响其他会话。

description.en: Transform DeepSeek Harness's web UI into customizable frosted glass with Mica or Compatibility modes, adjustable blur, and live wallpapers.
Alibaba Cloud Workbench CLI plugin — lets DeepSeek Harness's Agent directly control remote ECS instances.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 直接操控阿里云 ECS 实例，远程执行命令和管理服务器。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness finance plugin: direct market HTTP APIs, portfolio settings, model tools

DeepSeek API account balance, per-run usage cost, and per-1M-token prices in the DSH web GUI sidebar footer. Copy in English, Chinese, Russian, and German. The API key stays in the host process: no shell, no sandbox bypass, official endpoint only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额和本次运行花费，密钥只留在本地进程里。

description.en: Cache-prefix stabilization and evidence-based cache metrics for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 稳定 DeepSeek Harness 的缓存前缀，并提供基于实测的缓存命中指标，帮你省 token 又提速。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 桌面提醒（Windows）：原生 Toast + 全屏兜底卡片，需要授权/提问/完成/出错时叫你一声，点一下回到对应对话
description.zh: Windows 桌面提醒插件，需要授权、提问、完成或出错时弹窗叫你一声，点一下就能回到对应对话。

description.en: Checks in Trae and WorkBuddy daily from local login files, with a sidebar status and credits panel.
description.zh: 从本机登录文件完成 Trae 与 WorkBuddy 每日签到，侧边栏展示状态与积分。

description.en: Q版遐蝶余额小管家 —— DeepSeek Harness 网页插件：悬浮小人实时播报账户余额与 token 用量，可拖动、可换图、可换角色台词。
description.zh: 网页上养只Q版遐蝶，点一下就用角色口吻播报余额和 token 用量，还能拖动换图换台词。

description.en: DSH 灵动岛风格的网易云音乐状态挂件：顶部胶囊显示封面/歌名/歌手/进度，支持播放暂停、上下首与进度跳转。数据取自 Windows SMTC，不调用网易云私有接口。
description.zh: 在页面顶部挂个灵动岛胶囊，实时显示网易云正在播放的封面、歌名和进度，还能直接切歌、暂停和拖进度。

description.en: 一个Deepseek Harness的插件关系图谱可视化插件
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页用关系图谱直观展示插件之间的依赖与关联，一眼看清谁连着谁。

description.en: Highlight & annotate DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations with sticky notes — dynamic Cordis plugin
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中给任意句子划线、加便签做标注，方便回顾和整理对话重点。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：全局+项目两级 Markdown 规则注入（RuleBase）
description.zh: 把项目规范和代码风格写成 Markdown 规则，全局和项目两级统一注入，让 AI 每次都按你的规矩来。

description.en: Audit citation sources in AI responses – extract URLs from the reply, score and rank them by threat level, and output a detailed report. Domains on your blocklist will be genuinely blocked – web tools such as web_search and web_fetch will directly refuse to access them. The blocklist is fully maintained by you.
description.zh: 自动审查 AI 回复里的链接，按风险打分排序，黑名单域名直接拦截，并生成详细报告。

description.en: Evidence-first model control plane for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 基于证据的模型控制面板，帮你智能路由和切换 DeepSeek 模型，提升调用稳定性。
把 QQ 变成 dsh 的聊天界面，每个私聊或群聊对应一个独立 agent 会话，模型需显式调用 onebot_send 才能发言。

description.en: API 用量余额插件 for DeepSeek Harness — webui 用量圆圈内提供「用量 / 余额」标签切换，展示账户余额与用量明细
description.zh: 在 webui 用量圆圈里加个「用量 / 余额」切换，随时看账户余额和用量明细。

description.en: Command Code subscription tiers (Go / GOAT / Pro / Max) published as `llm-pi-ai` route profiles rather than an adapter: the live /provider/v1/models list and the plan page capability catalog are joined, each model lands on the OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses or Anthropic Messages route the gateway's own supported endpoints call for, switching tier deletes the routes the previous one generated, and the same credential drives five-hour and weekly usage windows, credit balances and a web-search provider.
description.zh: 把 Command Code 订阅档位（Go / GOAT / Pro / Max）发布为 `llm-pi-ai` 路由配置而非自写适配器：合并 /provider/v1/models 实时列表与套餐页能力目录，每个模型按网关自己声明的 supported endpoints 落到 OpenAI Chat、OpenAI Responses 或 Anthropic Messages 路由，切档时删除上一档生成的路由；同一凭据还提供 5 小时与每周用量窗口、credit 余额与联网搜索供应商。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的上下文压缩插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个上下文压缩增强，长对话和工具日志场景下省 token、留记忆。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a LAN access
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加局域网访问开关，无需手动改配置，一键开启/关闭 Web GUI 的局域网访问。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness × 飞书/Lark 双向桥接：私聊/群聊、卡片按钮、审批与提问回传、任务板、goal、定时任务；另含全程本机的语音转写（音频不出本机）与网页端播放条。Feishu/Lark bridge for DSH + fully local voice transcription.
description.zh: 把飞书/Lark 变成 DSH 的聊天入口，私聊群聊、卡片按钮、审批提问都能回传，还能本机转写语音。

description.en: Persistent per-session task stack for DeepSeek Harness agents - focus_task / focus_complete / read_focus + /focus, zero prompt injection
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体加个按会话保存的任务栈，随时聚焦、完成和查看当前任务，不污染提示词。

description.en: Turns a selection in DSH's built-in sidebar terminal into an @file reference in the composer, through a button above the composer and a keyboard shortcut.
description.zh: 把侧边栏终端里选中的内容一键变成输入框里的 @file 引用，还能用快捷键搞定。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的远程文生图/参考生图 Cordis 插件:接入 OpenAI 兼容中转站,出图落盘并注册为附件,自带工具卡与中转站查询
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里远程生成图片，支持参考图，出图自动存盘并挂到会话附件里。

description.en: Workaround to make dsh web client treat trusted hosts as loopback.
description.zh: 让 dsh 网页客户端把受信任主机当成回环地址，绕过访问限制的兼容补丁。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏用量/余额插件
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示用量和余额，悬停还能看详情，不过功能已内置，无需再装。
给 DSH 客户端换上 Odette 冰雪梦幻风皮肤，深色浅色两种模式随心切换。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin and Harbor template for reproducible Agent evaluation, self-evolution, and controlled promotion.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持续评测与受控自进化能力，让 Agent 在安全可控的流程中自动迭代升级。

description.en: DSH plugin for switching conversation language between Chinese and English
description.zh: 在中文和英文之间一键切换对话语言，AI 会跟着用对应语言思考和回复，设置即时生效。

description.en: Multimodal plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): understand images and generate images via configurable OpenAI-compatible or DashScope endpoints.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 看懂和生成图片，支持 OpenAI 兼容或 DashScope 接口，即插即用。

description.en: Keeps a long agent turn answerable to the user's actual request: a standing maintainer-document reminder, two pre-execute gates, an objective anchor quoting your latest instruction, and a nudge stage that corrects before it blocks.
description.zh: 让长时间运行的 AI 任务始终不跑偏，把项目记忆留在上下文之外，还能随时对照你的原始需求。

description.en: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste a Console API key under Settings → Plugins and the Console's chat models become selectable, with the catalog synced automatically, each model routed to the endpoint the official docs assign, and free *-free models hidden by default because they only run inside the OpenCode client.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Console (Zen) 模型：在「设置 → 插件」填入 Console API Key 后即可选用 Console 的对话模型，模型目录自动同步，每个模型按官方文档路由到对应端点，免费 *-free 模型默认不列出（它们只能在 OpenCode 客户端内运行）。

description.en: Real-time disaster alerts for DeepSeek Harness: Japan earthquakes (P2PQuake) and JMA EEW, tsunami and weather telegrams, global earthquakes (EMSC/USGS) and NOAA tsunamis, mainland China earthquakes (CENC via Wolfx) plus nmc.cn rainstorm and geological-hazard warnings, and US/Canadian NWS and ECCC flood, rainfall and storm-surge warnings — matched against your watch regions and thresholds.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的实时灾害预警：日本地震（P2PQuake）与 JMA 紧急地震速报、海啸、气象电文，全球地震（EMSC/USGS）与 NOAA 海啸，中国大陆地震（CENC via Wolfx）及 nmc.cn 暴雨、地质灾害预警，美国 NWS 与加拿大 ECCC 的洪水、降雨、风暴潮预警——按你关注的地域与阈值匹配播报。

description.en: DSH 插件 · 仿 Codex 的推理等级滑条，内嵌在模型选择器里 | Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the DSH model selector
description.zh: 在模型选择器里直接拖滑条调推理档位，从关闭到最高随你选，不用再翻设置。

description.en: 62 Agent Skills for Claude Code, Codex, Grok and DeepSeek Harness: one proven method per recurring job, installed in one command.
description.zh: 一套跨团队通用的可复用智能体技能包，覆盖产品、工程、运营、设计、研究等各类工作场景，开箱即用。

description.en: 自动归档 DeepSeek Harness 对话记录
description.zh: 自动把 DeepSeek Harness 的对话记录归档保存，方便随时翻查和追溯。

description.en: dsh-codex-approval插件：仿照Codex的AI自动审批，规则+AI三级风险评估自动放行/拒绝，让dsh沙箱审批自动化
description.zh: 模仿 Codex 的 AI 自动审批，按规则加 AI 三级风险评估，自动放行或拒绝，少弹窗让 Agent 连续干活。

description.en: Cost tracking plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — snapshot-anchored per-turn pricing, account balance, and live cost estimates.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供按轮次计费、账户余额和实时费用估算的成本追踪插件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: built-in HTTPS reverse proxy with configurable settings (设置→插件配置→Https Fix)
description.zh: 给 dsh 的 Web GUI 加个 HTTPS 反向代理，配上账密登录和证书，外网也能安全访问。
让 DSH 跨会话记住上下文和偏好，新会话不用从零开始，直接延续之前的设定和踩坑经验。

description.en: Edit your own messages in a DeepSeek Harness conversation in place - cold edit, no regeneration, no token cost. Regenerate any turn, and remove attachments.
description.zh: 在对话里直接改自己和模型的旧消息，不重新生成、不耗 token，还能重跑任意回合、删附件。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 做的《崩坏3》帕朵菲莉丝（Pardofelis）主题挂件。  对话页右下角多一个猫耳头像的悬浮按钮，点开是一个本地音乐播放器。 导入你自己电脑上的音乐文件，播放、切歌、调音量。
为 DSH 的 plan 模式审批卡片增加第三个选项「压缩后执行」：先把计划提交之前的上下文压缩成一条摘要检查点，再批准计划，模型带着逐字保留的计划开始执行。
description.zh: 给 plan 模式审批卡片加个「压缩后执行」，先把旧上下文压成摘要，再带着完整计划开工。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 子代理模型路由插件：subagent_model 工具 + model:"auto" 路由策略（任务档位/失败升级/可审计），子代理不再继承父模型。Model-routed subagent delegation for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让子代理按任务难度自动选模型，失败自动升级，不再死磕父模型，省心又省钱。

description.en: Static capability disclosure for DeepSeek Harness plugins: a Settings page and CLI that list installed plugins' capabilities, literal destinations, install scripts, and injection shapes (prompt registrations, shipped skill text, bundle patch), each with file:line evidence. Code-determined, reproducible, zero-token. Disclosure only — not a security verdict, never a safety claim.
description.zh: DSH 插件静态能力披露：设置页与 CLI 列出已装插件的权限能力、字面量去向、安装脚本与注入形态（prompt 注册、自带 skill 文本、bundle patch），每条附文件:行号证据。代码判定、可复现、零 token。只做披露，不做安全承诺，不判定恶意。

description.en: ForeSight: a temporal-aspect long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上长期记忆，按时间维度记住对话和上下文，让智能体更懂你。

description.en: 为dsh增加「设置：账户」页面，可快捷查看deepseek余额、用量信息，以及opencode go额度信息，同时可快速跳转至对应官网。Add a "Settings: Account" page for dsh, allowing quick viewing of DeepSeek balance, usage information, and OpenCode Go quota details, while also providing quick links to the respective official websites.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness web-GUI plugin: a Settings「账户」page showing DeepSeek platform balance/usage (daily cost chart, per-model requests & tokens, selectable time range) and the OpenCode Go 5h/weekly/monthly quota with reset times.

description.en: Stages exact DSH tool calls without dispatch, presents complete canonical arguments in a durable Batch Review Inbox, invalidates approvals after edits or restarts, and commits only a matching SHA-256 digest plus single-use nonce through the normal DSH tool pipeline.
description.zh: 暂存精确的 DSH 工具调用而不执行，在持久化批量审查收件箱中展示完整规范参数；编辑或重启后审批失效，仅允许携带匹配 SHA-256 摘要与一次性 nonce 的批次通过 DSH 正常工具管线提交。

description.en: Warm light, warm dark, and system-aware eye-care themes for DSH Web
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 换上暖色护眼主题，支持亮色、暗色和跟随系统，告别冷白刺眼。

description.en: Manage Ollama models and route AI requests locally with automatic cloud fallback via DeepSeek Harness.
DeepSeek Harness 输入框的下一句建议：助手回复完，空输入框里出现一句灰色建议，按 Tab 填入
description.zh: 助手回复完，输入框里自动冒出一句灰色建议，按 Tab 直接填入，帮你少打字。

description.en: DSH Skills 可视化管理器：在 DSH Web 界面可视化查看、编辑、创建、删除 Skills（用户级 ~/.dsh/skills 与项目级 .dsh/skills）
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面里可视化查看、编辑、创建和删除 Skills，不用再开终端手敲 SKILL.md。

description.en: DSH skin plugin: Alphacoders popular wallpapers as the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI background — gallery, search, local image upload, light/dark mask
description.zh: 把 Alphacoders 热门壁纸设为 DeepSeek Harness 网页背景，支持图库浏览、搜索、本地上传和明暗遮罩，让界面更好看。

description.en: The built-in web_search bills a full model turn against DeepSeek's own endpoint; this runs it on an OpenRouter-compatible gateway instead, so search is billed where your chat already is, at the model and price you pick.
description.zh: 内置 web_search 每次搜索都要在 DeepSeek 自己的端点上消耗一整轮模型调用；本插件改为在 OpenRouter 兼容网关上执行搜索，与对话走同一个账户，模型和价格都由你决定。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness settings panel for Command Code: credits, usage windows, and model-catalog sync.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板里直接查看 Command Code 的额度、用量周期，并同步模型目录。

description.en: DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 的 Windows 审批中控台：通知中心批准/拒绝、并发队列与取消清理、SQLite 审计。通过 GitHub Releases 分发。
description.zh: 在 Windows 通知中心处理 DSH 审批，并提醒本轮完成、出错或受阻，附带 SQLite 审计记录。

description.en: Liquid-glass billing overlay for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: provider balances, session cost, daily spend and token buckets. DeepSeek-first and extensible.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加玻璃拟态计费浮层，实时查看余额、会话费用、日消费和 Token 用量。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness provider for locally authenticated Codex app-server access through a ChatGPT subscription.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接调用本地已登录的 Codex 服务，用 ChatGPT 订阅额度跑 AI 智能体。

description.en: Checks whether a coding agent completion claim is actually true: deterministic evidence gathered in code, one batched Jev assessment, and a pure policy. DSH plugin.
description.zh: 用确定性证据和 Jev 分类器核实 AI 声称的「完成」是否属实，防止虚假交付。

description.en: 每天首次启动 dsh 时用 git 检测上游提交并在 Web GUI 中询问是否更新（适配源码 checkout，不改 npm 依赖）
description.zh: 每天首次启动 dsh 时自动用 git 检查上游有没有新提交，并在界面里问你要不要更新。

description.en: A global task library plugin for DeepSeek Harness featuring cross-session persistence, a real-time generative-UI browser panel, and subagent job synchronization.DeepSeek Harness 全局任务插件：提供跨会话持久化任务库、生成式 UI (Generative-UI) 悬浮面板及子智能体 (Subagent) 状态自动同步。
description.zh: 全局任务库插件，跨会话保存任务，实时界面管理，并同步子代理任务状态，提升多任务协作效率。

description.en: Codex-like persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: auto-injected memory summary, memory tools, per-session rollout summaries, and a localized Web settings card.
description.zh: Codex-like persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-injected memory summary, raw memory tools, and per-session rollout summaries distilled into a bounded global memory file.

description.en: dsh的记忆管理
description.zh: 给 Agent 加一个跨会话的长期记忆，聊过的事、攒下的信息都能记住并随时调用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness profile bundle：提供本地路由代理兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic API，并为模型设置页增加搜索、批量取消勾选及防卡顿开关。
DSH插件，以Observational Memory方式管理上下文
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上观察记忆式上下文压缩，长对话自动瘦身，还能按需召回原文。

description.en: DSH web plugin: take over the native approval window so a reject can carry a description the model will see.
description.zh: 接管原生审批窗口，拒绝时能填描述，让模型明白被拒原因，避免一头雾水。

description.en: Connect AI agent sessions on one machine — a DeepSeek Harness plugin for session-to-session collaboration, with lifecycle support to wake finished sessions and loop-safe messaging budgets.
description.zh: 让同一台机器上的多个 AI 会话直接互相对话，还能唤醒已结束的会话，协作更灵活。

description.en: DSH 投屏控制的共用核心：界面、设备列表、投屏面板与 AI 工具（配合其他 provider 使用）
description.zh: 给 DSH 提供投屏控制的共用核心，管界面、设备列表和 AI 工具，安卓鸿蒙靠插件接入。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：侧栏一键删除会话（先归档再清理磁盘日志，运行中的会话受保护）
description.zh: 在侧栏一键删除会话，先归档再清理磁盘日志，运行中的会话不会被误删。

description.en: JohnathonYe/auto-compact 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
description.zh: 会话上下文用量实时显示，超过阈值就自动压缩，省得手动清理。

description.en: Reusable Agent Skill and DSH Skill Provider Bundle for safe, evidence-driven DeepSeek Harness plugin development
description.zh: 把一句话需求变成能装能用的 DSH 插件，从写代码到验收全程有据可查。

description.en: DSH Web annotation/quote plugin (fork enhanced)
description.zh: 把助手回复里的选中内容做成编号批注，再逐条读取编号回答，方便追问和核对。

description.en: dsh 插件：离开 dsh 页面时可收到桌面通知，点击回到对应会话。Windows / WSL 原生 Toast，零依赖。
description.zh: 离开 dsh 页面时，任务完成或出错会弹 Windows 桌面通知，点一下就能回到对应会话。

description.en: dsh 插件：离开 dsh 页面时可收到桌面通知，点击回到对应会话。Windows / WSL 原生 Toast，零依赖。
Overleaf tab for DSH better-sidebar: direct-CDP login, project mirrors under <workspace>/overleaf/, git/API sync, sidebar file preview
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中直接管理 Overleaf 项目，支持自动登录、本地镜像同步和文件预览，让写作与代码协作更顺手。

description.en: OpenAI Codex OAuth for Deepseek Harness
DSH /fresh command: summarize conversation, start new session, archive old one
description.zh: DSH /fresh 命令：一键总结当前对话 → 开启新对话 → 归档老对话（缓解超大会话内存/卡顿，DeepSeek Harness / DSH）

description.en: Lightweight IDE-in-the-sidebar plugin for the dsh web GUI: workspace file tree, agent-change review (accept/reject + undo), full editing with diff and rendered markdown, plus an integrated terminal view.
description.zh: 在会话侧边栏里管文件、看改动、改代码、开终端，轻量 IDE 一步到位。

description.en: Auto-monitor and reveal active file operations and changes in DeepSeek Harness (DSH) right sidebar
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏实时监控并展示文件改动和 Git 变更，随时看清项目动态。

description.en: dsh manger 远程工具对应使用的 dsh 插件，直接完成 dsh 远程访问
description.zh: 让 dsh 直接远程访问 dsh-manager 工具，远程操控和管理都不用来回切换。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bundle: Niubash as the only shell executor + Bash-on-Windows teaching. Install with: dsh plugin --profile web add github:YMRwithNoworry/dsh-niubash-only
description.zh: 把 dsh 的唯一 shell 换成 Niubash，还教模型写它能跑的 Bash，Windows 上也能用。

description.en: A Windows desktop pet companion for DeepSeek Harness (DSH PNG pet).
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面上养一只 DSH 小宠物，陪你聊天干活，让 AI 会话更有陪伴感。

description.en: DSV4.1 reasoning support for DeepSeek Harness: lean analysis, images and attachments, and bounded acceptance/repair loops that aim to retain minimal-mode reasoning in a full agent.
description.zh: 让 DSV4.1 在完整 Agent 里也能保持精简推理，支持图片附件和可控的验收修复循环。

description.en: DSH Skill Creator：创建、评测、迭代改进 DSH skill 的 skill 与零依赖 CLI 工具 / A skill and zero-dependency CLI toolkit for creating, benchmarking, and iterating DSH skills.
description.zh: 帮你从零创建、评测并持续打磨 DSH skill，自带零依赖命令行工具。

description.en: Token usage & cost statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness — per model / date / session, cost estimation (USD/CNY), CSV/JSON export | DeepSeek Harness Token 用量统计插件：按模型/日期/会话统计用量与费用，支持 CSV/JSON 导出
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 各模型、日期、会话的 Token 用量与费用，支持导出 CSV/JSON，帮你掌控成本。

description.en: 用于dsh界面美化，内置四种颜色主题，并且可上传自定义背景
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面换配色和背景图，内置四套主题，还能上传自定义背景，随时一键还原。

description.en: Token usage statistics by model, session and date in a sidebar panel, plus OpenCode Go quota, DeepSeek balance and Z.ai quota monitoring.
description.zh: 在侧边栏按模型、会话与日期统计 token 用量，并监控 OpenCode Go 额度、DeepSeek 余额与 Z.ai 额度。

description.en: 免 API Key 的 dsh 联网搜索 / 网页抓取插件：引擎=逻辑源、入口=直连/镜像/加速路由自动回退，不消耗任何模型 token
description.zh: 免 API Key 就能让 dsh 联网搜索和抓网页，装上即用，不花模型 token。

description.en: 为DeepSeekHarness开发的会话级插件管理面板。在任何时候添加移除你的插件，热插拔生效，会话隔离，便捷的可视化面板。同时管理插件，skills，mcp | A session-level plugin management panel developed for DeepSeekHarness. Add or remove your plugins at any time with hot-swapping support, session isolation, and a convenient visual interface.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: one click binds each conversation to its own isolated git worktree + branch, so parallel agents work on one repo without interference — every project's worktrees auto-managed in the sidebar workspace tree, backed by 9 git tools.
description.zh: 让每个对话绑定独立的 git 工作树和分支，多个 Agent 并行改同一个仓库也互不干扰。

description.en: 鲸宝语音桌宠 Jingbao Voice Pet · DSH 桌宠插件（网页版 + 桌面端通用）：确认&提问语音播报 + 任务完成闹钟 + CPU/内存/GPU 监测 + DeepSeek 余额 + 音量调节 + 自动更新 + H3 无缝真动画萌娘女仆。Voice alerts for confirmations & questions, task-done alarm, live monitor, balance display, auto-update. Works on DSH Web & Desktop.
description.zh: 会说话的海系萌娘桌宠，陪你聊天时播报确认和提问、任务完成响闹钟，还能看 CPU、内存、GPU 和 DeepSeek 余额。

description.en: dsh plugin to run DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agents in Zed’s Agent Panel.
description.zh: 为 dsh 补齐 ACP 能力，让 DeepSeek Harness 能接入 Zed 编辑器，实现交互式编程。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-acp
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-acp

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）业务桥接插件 —— 通过标准 HTTP 协议把 DSH 的 agent 能力开放给业务系统。
description.zh: 让业务系统用带签名的 HTTP 请求直接调用 DSH 的 agent 能力，支持流式或回调响应，还能传图片文件。

description.en: Browser patrol & website inspection plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Teach once, replay deterministic runbooks with managed Chromium, screenshots, credentials, checkpoints and selector recovery.
description.zh: 教一次就能反复自动巡检网站，帮你截图、查登录、盯页面变化。

description.en: Local TXT reader in a right-sidebar tab plus a spoiler-safe AI reading companion: the model only sees what you have already read — the current chapter, the tail of the previous chapter, and a per-book background file it grows as you go. Excerpts, thoughts and the companion replies become structured Markdown notes exportable to Obsidian; raw text unlocks only for a book you mark as finished.
description.zh: 右侧栏本地 TXT 阅读器 + 不剧透的 AI 陪读：模型只能看到你已经读到的部分（本章全文、上一章结尾，以及随进度增量补齐的背景认识）；摘抄、感想与 AI 回应写成结构化 Markdown 笔记，可导出到 Obsidian。只有你标记「已读完」的那一本才向它放开原文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 对话使用情况记录超市小票插件：按模型统计的令牌使用量、调用次数、耗时和成本 | Conversation usage receipt plugin for DeepSeek Harness: per-model token usage, calls, time and cost
description.zh: 在会话头部加个小票按钮，一眼看清各模型的 token 用量、调用次数、耗时和花费。

description.en: DSH web plugin: cap expanded thinking blocks with a bounded scroll window.
description.zh: 给展开的思维链加个限高滚动窗口，长推理不再撑爆页面，还能自动跟随最新内容。

description.en: WeCom AI Bot channel for DeepSeek Harness — every chat runs a persistent, preset-backed agent with real tools.
description.zh: 把企业微信变成 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 机器人入口，聊天就能调用工具、持续记忆上下文。

description.en: Garmin Connect 运动健康 AI 教练插件 for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 连上你的 Garmin 账号，自动同步运动和健康数据，让 AI 教练帮你分析并生成训练计划。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI appearance kit: 32 preset themes, animated/static wallpapers, paper textures, per-zone text depth, and a keyboard desktop pet.
description.zh: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI appearance kit: 32 preset themes, custom backgrounds (wallpaper / glass / texture), per-zone text depth, and a keyboard desktop pet.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness「压缩会话」插件：自定义 token 阈值自动压缩、一键压缩当前会话、输入框常驻按钮可开关。哦鲸鲸出品。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个会话压缩按钮，能自动或手动压缩上下文，省 token 更省心。

description.en: 哦鲸鲸会话管理插件
description.zh: 批量删除和恢复归档会话，还能清干净残留记账，让删掉的会话不再冒出来。
已停止维护的会话协调插件，帮多个 DSH 会话统一管理状态、避免冲突。

description.en: DSH-native Work Charter policy plugin backed by session-coordinator-dsh
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话套上工作章程，自动记录职责、权限与验收结果，让多 Agent 协作有据可查。

description.en: Compares coding agents in isolated Git worktrees with deterministic validation, scoring, and explicit winner application.
description.zh: 在隔离的 Git 工作树中比较编码智能体，并提供确定性验证、评分和显式胜者应用。

description.en: Agent-driven long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: Agent-driven long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
在 DSH 里实时查看 DeepSeek 服务状态，接口是否正常一眼就知道。

description.en: Safety-first five-agent orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with leases, scopes, checkpoints, validation, and recovery.
description.zh: 把复杂工程任务变成一场有纪律的五智能体地牢探险，自带租约、检查点、验证与恢复机制，安全又省心。

description.en: Liquid-glass Wallpaper Engine backdrop for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
description.zh: 把本地 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸变成 DSH 界面的液态玻璃背景，磨砂通透又好看。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：手动上下文注入 + 对话历史/思维链编辑器
description.zh: 自动把「手动上下文」里还没用上的内容补进对话，还能在网页上直接改历史对话和思维链。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 设置页加一个「检查更新 / 一键更新」入口
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页加个更新入口，显示当前和最新版本，有更新时一键升级。

description.en: Shopping assistant for e-commerce: search, compare, pick and recommend products when buying things online, with price comparison, sales, service tags, product images and promotion links from the official Pinduoduo open-platform API, right inside the DSH conversation.
description.zh: 购物助手：在 DSH 对话里搜索、对比、挑选并推荐商品，支持比价与选购建议，覆盖电商购物场景，数据来自拼多多开放平台官方 API，含价格、销量、服务标签、商品图与推广链接。

description.en: Death Stranding skin for DeepSeek Harness UI + live heartbeat feed that pulses on agent thinking/tool execution. Whale keeps brand blue.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 界面换成《死亡搁浅》风格，还能用心跳脉冲实时显示 AI 思考和调用工具的状态。

description.en: DSH 蒸馏主管：把一本书蒸馏成可执行 Agent 技能的判态制元技能（三闸判态·零🔴门禁）｜V4.9.3 发行自足：§21 强制门禁 gate_start/gate_stage/gate_checklist 与整套门禁套件（27 件）随包发行，发版闸 A/B/C/D/D-配套/E/F 六判据
description.zh: 把一本书蒸馏成能直接用的 Agent 技能，全程判态把关、逐字回源核验，防止踩坑。

description.en: Unofficial Cursor subscription chat: Host-owned CLI session login, a displayed model catalog, and subscription usage rails. Cursor staff treat this class of private-client usage as against ToS.
description.zh: 非官方 Cursor 订阅聊天：Host 持有 CLI 会话登录，可编辑展示用模型目录，并显示订阅额度。Cursor 员工认定此类私有客户端用法违反 ToS。

description.en: Optical compression memory using DeepSeek-OCR (OCR1)
description.zh: 把长文本记忆压缩成图像存起来，让 AI 助手记得更多、更省 token。

description.en: Local OCR, color-statistics, pixel-scan, and metadata bridge for text-only DeepSeek Harness models; no external vision API.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型加上本地看图能力，自动把图片转成 OCR 文字、颜色和像素信息。

description.en: Allowlisted SSH into Unix/AIX/macOS from DeepSeek Harness (no shell; read-only by default), with remote_ssh_probe OS-aware suite.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 白名单 SSH 接入 Unix/AIX/macOS（不走 shell；默认只读），含 remote_ssh_probe 按系统探测套装。

description.en: Native memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness — auditable facts with evidence chains, powered by StateCore
description.zh: 给 AI 装个可查证的长期记忆，自动记住对话要点，每步前把关键信息喂回上下文。

description.en: right slider for deepseek-harness-plugin.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页版加个右侧文件探索栏，增强文件树、书签和行区间引用，卸载即还原。

description.en: Vision skill plugin for DeepSeek Harness (image analysis and OCR)
description.zh: 让纯文本模型也能看懂图片，支持全格式图像解析、长截图 OCR 和界面控件定位。

description.en: 知乎数据开放平台 DSH 静态双面插件:17工具+精美卡片+串行化限流。QQ群1017854502 https://qm.qq.com/q/RAHJuyhQQ
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接读知乎、发知乎，18 个工具配精美卡片，还带限流防封。

description.en: 把 DeepSeek 对话整理成开发需求，交给 DSH Agent 执行。仅支持 anywhere-labs DSH Desktop。
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 对话一键整理成开发需求，直接交给 DSH Agent 执行，省去手动复制和重复解释。

description.en: DSH Desktop 原生插件：抓取 DeepSeek 完整对话，复用 DSH 模型整理为可执行需求，并一键发送到目标项目启动 Agent。
小白+AI开发，for小白的dsh小插件，解释AI吐出的“黑话”
description.zh: 把 AI 回复里的专业黑话翻译成大白话，小白也能看懂。

description.en: 知乎数据开放平台 DSH 静态双面插件:17工具+精美卡片+串行化限流。QQ群1017854502 https://qm.qq.com/q/RAHJuyhQQ
Import CCSwitch Codex profiles and configure per-model reasoning in DSH.
description.zh: 把 CCSwitch 里的 Codex 配置一键导入 DSH，还能在设置里直接调每个模型的推理深度。

description.en: Codekin: a creature-collection and match-three RPG for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页里玩收集生物、三消对战 RPG 的休闲插件，给开发环境加点乐子。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加一个直接续跑按钮。当会话异常结束时，可以从现有上下文继续执行，不会引入其他提示词。
description.zh: 会话中断后一键续跑，无需重输提示词，直接从原上下文接着聊。

description.en: fastCRW-backed web_search and web_fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接上 fastCRW 的联网搜索和网页抓取能力，让 AI 能实时查资料、读网页。

description.en: DSH better-sidebar 侧边栏标签页:一键启动鸿蒙模拟器、构建并部署 HarmonyOS 应用到模拟器。
description.zh: 在侧边栏一键启动鸿蒙模拟器，自动构建并部署HarmonyOS应用，方便调试。

description.en: On-demand skill tools for DeepSeek Harness: registers skill_search / skill_load / skill_ref so the model searches a staged skill library first and loads a skill body only when it needs it, keeping the library out of the resident session catalog and out of every turn's context; adds a Skills tab to the conversation view ring that reads back the whole session and lists which skills were actually loaded, and in which turn. Zero dependencies, and the records render client-side only, never entering the model's context.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按需技能工具：注册 skill_search / skill_load / skill_ref 三个工具，让模型先从分层的技能库里检索、再按需加载正文，库里的技能因而不必进入常驻目录、不占每轮上下文；并在对话视图栏加一个「技能」标签页，回读整个会话、列出本次真正加载过哪些技能及其轮次。零依赖，所有技能调用记录只在客户端渲染，不进入模型上下文。

description.en: Turbo Vision-style character-cell window manager for dsh agents: overlapping framed windows with drop shadows, a Borland menu bar, a function-key strip, mouse drag and resize, approvals as modal dialogs, and five skins including the classic Borland blue.
description.zh: Turbo Vision 式字符窗口管理器：带投影的重叠窗口、Borland 菜单栏、功能键提示条、鼠标拖拽缩放、模态审批对话框，五套皮肤含经典 Borland 蓝。

description.en: DSH plugin that registers the ai-eight-honors-eight-shames skill: eight checkable working rules for coding agents (verify before calling, confirm ambiguity, cite evidence, reuse before creating, test before claiming done, follow local conventions, separate fact from inference, keep changes reversible) plus a ninth rule that logs each user request and the change made in report files at the workspace root.
description.zh: 注册 ai-eight-honors-eight-shames skill 的 DSH 插件：面向编码代理的八条可核对工作准则（先查证再调用、有歧义先确认、业务规则给出处、先复用再新造、先测试再声称完成、按既有约定写、区分事实与推断、改动可回滚），外加第 9 条——用户每次提出需求或问题，都在工作区根的报告文件里成对记录诉求与改动。

description.en: File workbench library plugin for DSH, provide file processing capability.
description.zh: DSH 文件工作台库插件，提供文件处理相关能力。

description.en: Discord-like communities in DSH with channels, roles and permissions, message search, and sharing or cloning of DSH sessions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板内建社区：文字、公告与话题频道，角色与频道级权限，消息搜索，并可分享和克隆 DSH 会话。

description.en: Discovers OpenRouter's free models, measures their real speed and context size, and writes them into the DeepSeek Harness model list fastest-first, with speed and context in each display name, plus a Settings section to configure and run it.
description.zh: 自动筛选 OpenRouter 免费模型，实测真实速度与上下文大小，并按速度从快到慢写入 DeepSeek Harness 模型列表，模型名中带上速度与上下文，同时在设置中新增「免费模型」配置页。
右键设置页分区导航，勾选即可显示或隐藏各设置分区，状态跨浏览器保存。

description.en: DSH 联网搜索私有化方案，代理 web_search/web_fetch 至 Wigolo，覆盖搜索/抓取/提取/深度研究/缓存/监控全链路，数据不出域，零查询成本。  Wigolo-powered DSH search plugin — self-hosted search/crawl/extract/research/cache/watch pipeline, fully replaces built-in web_search/web_fetch. Zero cost, full data privacy.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的联网搜索换成自建 Wigolo，搜索、抓取、提取、深度研究全流程数据不出域，零查询成本。

description.en: Adds an Explain button to the approval card: one model call returns exactly three lines reading the pending operation, covering what it does, which files or system state it reads, writes, modifies or executes, and a risky/attention/safe verdict with a one-sentence justification. It also renders the detail area for `write` and `edit` calls, which the shipped renderer leaves blank because it only reads a `command` field.
description.zh: 在审批卡片上加一个「解释」按钮：一次模型调用返回固定三行解读——做什么、读写改了什么、是否安全（风险等级加一句理由）。同时补上 `write`/`edit` 类调用详情区留白的问题——官方渲染器只读 `command` 字段，那两类调用没有该字段。

description.en: Runs DSH's stock bash tool on Git Bash for Windows, so commands go straight to bash -c instead of being re-parsed by the pwsh tool.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上把 DSH 原版 bash 工具挂到 Git Bash 上运行，命令直达 bash -c，不再经 pwsh 工具二次解析。

description.en: OpenCode GO 套餐用量监控插件：账户三窗口额度 + DSH 按模型 Token/金额统计，为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 而生
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: OpenCode GO 套餐用量（三窗口额度 + DSH 按模型 token/金额统计 + 输入框迷你条）

description.en: FreeDSH — free-first multi-model routing, safe core updates and pt-BR/Windows support for DeepSeek Harness. Installable as a DSH bundle (dsh plugin add). Unofficial project.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上免费模型自动路由和备用切换，还能安全更新、支持葡语和 Windows。

description.en: Durable shared token budgets for DeepSeek Harness agent trees — a fail-closed admission gate plus a replayable usage ledger.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体树统一分配和管理 token 预算，避免子任务超额消耗。

description.en: Global and per-session prompt templates in a right-side panel — insert into the draft or send now, edit, promote session templates to global, with SQLite persistence via the built-in node:sqlite.
description.zh: 右侧面板中的全局与会话级提示词模板——插入草稿或立即发送、编辑、会话模板提升为全局，SQLite 持久化走内置的 node:sqlite。

description.en: Kami-inspired editorial skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with a warm parchment canvas, ink-blue accent, serif typography and hairline borders in light and dark palettes.
description.zh: 基于 Kami 视觉风格的 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 皮肤；暖羊皮纸画布、墨蓝强调色、衬线字形与发丝线边框，提供浅色与深色两套配色。

description.en: Adds file-backed Chinese web-fiction planning, chapter writing, consistency review, rollback, and style-profile skills.
description.zh: 为现有 Agent 添加基于文件记忆的中文网文策划、逐章写作、一致性审校、回滚与文风画像技能。

description.en: English edition of Weiwen's Law (KISS's Law): the first and only domain-agnostic white-box causal adjudication middleware for AI agents. Unlike domain-specific causal-inference tooling (statistics/economics/ML) or evidence-gated agent firewalls, it adjudicates *every* tool call along a deterministic structural causal chain (R->S->D->H->M) before execution - across any domain, with no training or per-domain tuning. It blocks destructive and credential-file operations, escalates repeated boundary violations, cuts faulting links until verified-fixed, and gives risk verdicts on un-auditable execution; runs fully local with zero API cost.
description.zh: 唯稳律（KISS's Law）英文版：业界首个且唯一的领域无关白箱因果裁决中间件。与领域特定的因果推断工具（统计/经济/机器学习）或「需提供因果证据」的代理防火墙不同，它在执行前对*每个*工具调用沿确定性结构因果链（R->S->D->H->M）裁决——适用任意领域，无需训练或按领域调参。拦截破坏性与凭据文件操作、对反复越界升级止损、故障环节切断至修复验证、不可审计执行给出风险判定；纯本地运行、零 API 成本。

description.en: Panel to edit dsh's native AGENTS.md from the web settings page: every layer in the instruction chain is clickable, three activation scopes, and a visual budget meter.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web 设置页里编辑原生 AGENTS.md 的面板：指令链上每层可点选编辑，三种生效范围，并可视化官方指令预算。

description.en: Filesystem permissions for shell calls, granted per path and capability rather than per command name. The command line is parsed for the read, write, create, delete and execute effects it needs, a capability it lacks raises the approval card instead of a flat refusal, and the same rules are compiled into the macOS Seatbelt profile the process, its children and the code its arguments never showed all run under. An Approvals tab in the conversation reads the audit log back and shows which rule, automatic reviewer or person answered each call.
description.zh: 按路径与能力（read / write / create / delete / execute）授予 shell 调用的文件权限，而不是按命令名判断。命令行的文件效果由解析得出，缺哪个能力就出审批卡片而不是一律拒绝，同一套规则还会编译成进程、它的子进程、以及命令行根本没露出来的代码共同运行其下的 macOS Seatbelt profile。会话里的「审批」标签页把审计日志读回来，显示每次判定是规则、自动复核还是人拍的板。

description.en: DSH plugin: fold mis-rendered thinking/reasoning content into collapsible blocks and render mermaid diagrams inline.
description.zh: 把渲染错乱的思考内容折叠起来，并直接在对话中显示 Mermaid 图表，让输出更清爽。

description.en: A native reasoning-effort control for the composer: a blue-to-violet tier bar with a starfield and a sheen sweep. It owns the model seat and drives the official model-directories service, so the ladder comes from each model's own reasoning declaration and no other plugin is required.
description.zh: 原生推理档位控件：蓝紫渐变档位条，带星点与流光。它自己占用模型座位并只对接官方 modelDirectories 服务，档位由每个模型自身的 reasoning 声明决定，不依赖任何其它插件。

description.en: Blocks an agent from reading, searching, writing, or editing chosen files and directories, keeping their contents out of the conversation — including sensitive-word files whose text can make later provider requests fail with a 400. Rules are picked from a file/directory browser on the plugin page.
description.zh: 屏蔽 agent 对指定文件或目录的读取、搜索、写入与编辑，使其内容不进入对话——含敏感词的文件也在其中，避免它们的文字让之后的 provider 请求以 400 失败。规则在插件页面上点选。

description.en: dsh mcp 和 skill 管理面板
description.zh: 在设置里加个面板，随时查看和管理当前模式的 MCP 服务器与 Skill，还能直接粘贴配置新增。

description.en: Universal on-screen translator for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: translates text, attributes, Shadow DOM, and iframes across 45+ languages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面即时屏幕翻译：支持菜单、设置、Shadow DOM 与嵌套 iframe，覆盖 45+ 种语言。

description.en: DIY你的小蓝鲸吧
description.zh: 不用改代码就能给 DSH 换背景、字体和配色，保存后下次打开还在。

description.en: a ticket tool for agent
description.zh: 给 AI 代理用的工单工具，让任务分配、进度跟踪和状态记录都井井有条。

description.en: Stages exact DSH tool calls without dispatch, presents complete canonical arguments in a durable Batch Review Inbox, invalidates approvals after edits or restarts, and commits only a matching SHA-256 digest plus single-use nonce through the normal DSH tool pipeline.
description.zh: 暂存精确的 DSH 工具调用而不执行，在持久化批量审查收件箱中展示完整规范参数；编辑或重启后审批失效，仅允许携带匹配 SHA-256 摘要与一次性 nonce 的批次通过 DSH 正常工具管线提交。

description.en: Shows a Chinese translation under each English thinking block in the DSH web chat, without modifying the session transcript; per-chunk caching, a configurable translation model, and a settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页对话里把每段英文思考的中文译文显示在原文正下方，不改动会话记录；按译文块缓存、可指定翻译模型，并带设置面板。

description.en: One plugin for DeepSeek Harness with durable autonomous loops, sidebar GitHub discovery, AI-assisted installation, and workspace shortcuts.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：提供持久自主循环、侧边栏 GitHub 插件发现、AI 安装和工作区快捷入口。
把 Kiro CLI 接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 DSH 直接调用 Kiro 的模型能力。

description.en: Prompt-polish template injector for DSH: click ✨ in the composer to inject a "polish my prompt" template (current draft auto-embedded), no send, no network, no model — the main agent rewrites with full context. Replaces narrative-prompt-polish (2026-09-14 migration).
description.zh: 点会话输入框右座 ✨，把「打磨提示词」模板写进输入栏——当前草稿自动嵌进 `<内容>` 位置，不发送、不联网、不调模型，由当前会话的主 agent 带着全部上下文改写。替代 narrative-prompt-polish（2026-09-14 更名并整体重构）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 动态 Skill 运行时管理器，自动发现、路由、挂载和卸载 Agent Skills
description.zh: 动态管理Agent Skills，自动发现、路由和挂载，让技能调用更灵活高效。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) web plugin: a draggable whale floating widget showing token usage, spend and the official DeepSeek account balance
description.zh: 一只可拖动的鲸鱼悬浮球，随时看 Token 用量、花费和 DeepSeek 账号余额。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a New-Conversation trigger that creates a git worktree — or starts inside an existing one — and moves the conversation into it (session fork with the worktree as cwd).
description.zh: 新建对话时自动创建 git worktree 并把会话搬进去，让每次对话都在独立工作区里跑。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness bundle of the 25 promoted mattpocock/skills with a native agent preset, an invocation-aware skill provider, and a light grilling-to-implement bootstrap.
description.zh: 将 mattpocock/skills 的 25 个正式技能打包为 DeepSeek Harness bundle，附原生 Agent 预设、区分人触发与模型调用的技能 provider，以及轻量 grilling 到 implement 引导。

description.en: A local-first personal state record and decision engine for dsh: keeps every input byte-for-byte with line-level provenance, argues against its own conclusions by generating defeaters first, ages each stored fact with its own TTL, and reports where a decision rests on nothing at all.
description.zh: 本地优先的个人状态档案与决策引擎：逐字保留你的原始输入并精确到行地溯源，给出结论前先生成"证伪项"反驳自己，为每个事实单独设置有效期，并指出这个决定正建立在哪些空白之上。

description.en: Turns the MacBook keyboard Caps Lock light into an agent status light: on while the agent works, flashing when it waits for your approval or answer, off when idle.
description.zh: 把 MacBook 键盘的 Caps Lock 指示灯变成 agent 状态灯：干活时常亮，等你审批或回答时快闪，空闲时熄灭。

description.en: Live progress bar under the composer with a percentage and an estimated time left for the current DeepSeek Harness turn; the estimate re-anchors as the turn runs and never reads 100% until the turn ends, and the bar turns red when the turn fails or is interrupted.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示当前这一轮 DeepSeek Harness 任务的实时进度条、百分比与预计剩余时间；估计随轮次实时重锚，任务失败或中断时进度条变红。

description.en: theme plugin for deepseek harness by victor
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页端换上黑客赛博风皮肤，七套配色随你切换。

description.en: Balance, session cost, token usage, and invoice summaries for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 在对话输入框下方实时显示余额、会话花费和 token 用量，还能生成账单汇总，随时掌握开销。

description.en: Generate images through a logged-in web ChatGPT session and download them to a local directory.
description.zh: 控制已登录的网页版 ChatGPT 生成图片并下载到本地。

description.en: SQLite memory entries, a calendar with due-time reminders, and cron-scheduled agent tasks, with 13 model tools and a bilingual zh/en UI.
description.zh: SQLite 条目化记忆、日历到点提醒，以及 cron 驱动的定时 agent 任务；13 个模型工具，中英双语界面。

description.en: On-demand memory for DeepSeek Harness: session logs are distilled into layered markdown (a summary, an index and per-topic files), and a mem_query tool returns only the matched entries rather than the whole index. Nothing is injected per turn, there are no dependencies, and every entry keeps a source pointer back to the conversation it came from.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的按需记忆库：会话日志提炼成分层 markdown（总览、索引与分主题明细），mem_query 只回命中条目而非整份索引。不每轮注入、零依赖，每条记忆都保留指回原对话的溯源标记。

description.en: Mind-map project planning with blocking drift protection: plans, modules and tasks as a dependency DAG with topological execution order, an agent position marker, a human approval gate on every board edit, git cross-checks, and evidence-gated task completion.

description.en: Per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness. Three Markdown files per workspace — PROJECT.md, DECISIONS.md and SESSIONS.md — are auto-created on the first step of any session in that workspace, re-read from disk and re-injected only when they change (and re-injected if compaction dropped them), and written back by classification through a memory_checkpoint tool, with a bounded end-of-turn nudge when a turn did work but recorded nothing. memory_read and memory_search read the live log and the archive, the latter over a zero-dependency BM25 index. The session log is capped at 200 entries with the overflow moved to SESSIONS-archive.md — never injected, but visible, readable and searchable, and restorable one entry at a time. Settings page: a workspace list with a path filter, read-only tabs for the three memory files plus the archive, reload, export/import of one workspace's memory as a JSON bundle, a two-step clear, a panel that rewrites or removes the AGENTS.md instruction block, and a PROJECT.md staleness reminder. A composer status chip shows that workspace's sync state and creates the files on click. Zero dependencies — no vector store, no embeddings, and no model calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的项目记忆插件。每个工作区三份 Markdown 文件（PROJECT.md / DECISIONS.md / SESSIONS.md）：会话首个步骤自动创建、内容变了才重新注入（被上下文压缩挤掉也会重注入），并按分类经 memory_checkpoint 工具写回，在「干了实事却没记录」时给一次收尾提醒。memory_read 与 memory_search 可读活日志与归档，后者走零依赖 BM25 索引。会话日志上限 200 条，溢出搬进 SESSIONS-archive.md —— 不自动注入，但可见、可读、可搜，并能逐条恢复。设置界面：带路径筛选的工作区列表 / 三份记忆文件与归档的只读页签 / 重新读取 / 单个工作区记忆包的导出导入（JSON）/ 两步确认的清除 / AGENTS.md 指令段的重写或移除面板 / PROJECT.md 陈旧提醒。输入框状态图标显示该工作区的同步状态，无记忆时可点击创建。零依赖——不含向量库、embedding 或模型调用。

description.zh: 把 Claude Code 的 Pro/Max/Team 登录状态直接接入 DSH，自动读取并刷新凭证，无需手动配置。

description.en: Chrome DevTools Protocol 插件 for DeepSeek Harness。通过 chromremote-interface 以 CDP 连接并操控 Chrome
description.zh: 通过 CDP 协议连接并操控 Chrome 浏览器，实现远程调试、自动化操作和实时监控。
