description.en: dsh-delegate: model-aware subagent delegation for DeepSeek Harness — per-call models, depends_on dependency gating, per-child personas, a durable run roster, audit events, and conversation-flow tool cards. | 给 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理委派加上：按次选模型、依赖门控、角色人设、任务花名册。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Subagent 提供按次模型选择、依赖门控与角色设定，并记录运行与审计事件，现已暂停维护。

description.en: dsh web file-experience plugin: drag & drop any file into the composer (intakes it into the session workspace attachments/ folder) plus @file mentions that list workspace files and insert file references。也可以配合 WebDSH（darker2016/WebDSH）多用户服务器使用。
description.zh: 把文件拖进聊天框就能自动存到工作区，还能用@快速引用文件，右侧文件浏览器和标签页查看器让你边聊边改代码和文档。

description.en: Provider-folded model selector for the DSH Web composer with catalog-driven reasoning effort choices.
description.zh: 把模型选择器改成按供应商折叠的样式，让切换模型更清爽高效。
为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Command Code 大模型，让任务自动调用该模型执行。

description.en: Invert selection in Deepseek Harness for when we are selecting models
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择对话框中一键反选，方便批量管理模型。

description.en: Archived-session manager: an "Archived Sessions" settings page that lists archived sessions and lets you restore or permanently delete each one (two-step confirmation).
description.zh: 归档会话管理：在设置页新增“归档会话”，列出所有已归档会话，支持恢复与二次确认后的永久删除。

description.en: Windows desktop automation for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-first observe/act loop with 30 standard tools (element/coordinate targets, auto/a11y/event strategy routing), superseded-observations and no-replay safety semantics, persistent kill switch, RuntimeId/rect-drift stale protection, chat cards and a floating panel (live ops, frame wall, env auto-detect settings), tiled vision describe for low-res models, JSONL audit trail and a pid allowlist. Requires Windows 10+ and Python 3.9+ with uiautomation and pillow (installable from the settings page).
description.zh: Windows 桌面自动化插件：无障碍优先的观察-动作回路（30 个标准工具，元素/坐标双目标与 auto/a11y/event 策略路由），写后作废与禁重放安全语义，持久急停开关，RuntimeId/矩形漂移防错位，对话卡片与悬浮面板（实况/画面/环境自检设置），面向低分辨率模型的分块识图，JSONL 审计与 pid 白名单。需 Windows 10+ 与 Python 3.9+，并安装 uiautomation 与 pillow（设置页可一键安装）。

description.en: Kestrel - a research engine that can't cite what a source never said. Citations are admitted only when the quote is mechanically located in the source; corroboration is counted in independent origins, not source count. DeepSeek Harness plugin + standalone library. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 给 AI 研究助手做引文核验：把结论锚定到原文、评估证据、查重溯源，减少瞎编。

description.en: Live Spring Boot error HUD with opt-in AI diagnosis for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 实时监控 Spring Boot 报错并弹窗提示，可选开启 AI 智能诊断帮你快速定位问题。
将 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 与 dsh 内置循环并排运行，方便对比不同 AI 助手的表现。

description.en: Scan installed dsh plugins and grade stability risk (hook surface, startup work, preflight, deps) with optional isolated install verification
description.zh: 扫描已安装的 dsh 插件，评估稳定性风险（钩子、启动、依赖等），可选隔离安装验证，提前避免插件搞崩环境。

description.en: WINWIKI的dsh插件版
description.zh: 把桌面版 WinAgent 的完整能力搬进 DSH 网页，聊天就能操控 Windows、调用工具和查个人知识库。
配置可持久化的定时任务，每次自动启动智能体并调用指定模型，轻松实现自动化流程。

description.en: ADB device & bench operations for DSH: device discovery, structured logcat (background streaming), apk install, file pull/push, and dumpsys performance snapshots.
description.zh: ADB 设备·台架运维工具集：设备发现、结构化 logcat（后台采集）、apk 安装、文件 pull/push、性能快照。

description.en: Guardian preset for DeepSeek Harness with independent persistent Codex auditing
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加独立审计模式，代码展示与人工复核结合，确保关键操作安全可控。

description.en: Routes the first DSH prompt to Standard, PTC, Minimal, or Cordis with DeepSeek V4 Flash.
description.zh: 自动识别你的首条提问意图，智能切换至对应的预设模式，免去手动选择，对话更精准高效。

description.en: Codex 主题外观插件 for DeepSeek Harness（DSH）：把 Codex 主题配置（codex-theme-v1，80 款浅/深色主题）做成可在 DSH 中直接切换、可自定义的外观插件。
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面换上 Codex 风格主题，内置 80 款浅深色配色，一键切换轻松自定义。

description.en: macOS desktop shell for the DSH web UI: a plugin plus a small Tauri/WKWebView window over the loopback web surface — real macOS fullscreen, single instance, external links delegated to the system browser, and browser-style zoom.
description.zh: 把 Harness 网页版直接打包成桌面软件，不用开浏览器也能流畅使用。

description.en: Warp-inspired image-to-theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness: upload a background, extract a palette, and apply a glass UI.
description.zh: 上传或拖入一张图片，自动提取主色调并生成 Warp 风格的毛玻璃主题，让界面随壁纸换肤。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）里的每一条模型路由做图片模态调度，并且贯穿整个 agent
description.zh: 为DSH每条模型路由智能调度图片模态，让视觉任务在agent全流程中无缝流转。

description.en: 3D printing & additive manufacturing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: parametric STL generation, calibration G-code, STL/G-code analysis, toolpath rendering and PrusaSlicer bridge, plus 5 skills and a concise persona optimized for local models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 3D 打印与增材制造插件：参数化 STL 生成、校准 G-code、STL/G-code 分析、刀路可视化、PrusaSlicer 桥接，含 5 个技能与面向本地小模型的精简 persona。

description.en: Content-addressed proof that a DSH profile declaration, pnpm lock and installed bundles agree
description.zh: 自动比对DSH配置、pnpm锁文件与实际安装的包是否一致，生成防篡改凭证，让依赖环境更安全可靠。

description.en: Session-scoped full-duplex voice assistant for DeepSeek Harness with safe drafting, explicit Agent submission, and optional knowledge curation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话级全双工语音助手，支持安全草稿、显式提交 Agent 及可选知识整理，提升语音交互效率。

description.en: Capability Manager for DeepSeek Harness: manage MCP servers and Skills from a Settings-page UI (dual-face dsh plugin)
description.zh: 在设置页里统一管理 MCP 服务器和技能，不用改配置文件，开箱即用。

description.en: Content-addressed conformance proof across recorded DSH ToolRuntime, MCP JSON-RPC and CLI JSON surfaces
description.zh: 验证 DSH 工具运行时、MCP 与 CLI 接口间的一致性，确保合约合规可追溯。

description.en: Readline-based interactive terminal profile bundle for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供交互式终端界面，轻松管理模型、会话与工具配置，让命令行操作更顺手高效。

description.en: Per-project runtime environments for DeepSeek Harness: auto-adopt or create a project-local Python venv (.venv_local/python) and wire in the toolchains and env vars for the runtimes each project uses (python venv / node / go) — python & pip always resolve to the project, never silently to system Python.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH 工作区/项目提供独立的运行时环境：自动接管或创建项目本地 Python venv（.venv_local/python），并自动识别项目所用运行时（python venv / node / go）接入其工具链与环境变量——python / pip 永远走项目环境，绝不静默落到系统 Python。一个有则接管、无则自动建的零配置插件。

description.en: enables /btw commands in deepseek-harness (similar to /btw in claude code)
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 /btw 快速问一句，答案不记入会话记忆，适合临时查资料或问个无关紧要的问题。

description.en: dsh-gzip插件：压缩API响应，降低带宽占用，解决低速网络下历史加载失败问题
description.zh: 压缩API响应数据，减少带宽占用，让低速网络下历史记录也能快速加载。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek routes that analyzes attached and local images through configurable OpenAI Responses, Chat Completions, or Anthropic Messages endpoints while leaving image-capable routes native.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 路由提供视觉桥接：通过可配置的 OpenAI Responses、Chat Completions 或 Anthropic Messages 端点分析附件与本地图片，同时保持支持图片的路由走原生路径。

description.en: Explain failed DeepSeek Harness agent runs locally, then produce a redacted recovery plan. No model required.
description.zh: 把失败的 DeepSeek Harness 运行快速转成脱敏恢复计划，本地只读，无需模型也能用。

description.en: Audit each finished assistant turn with an independent reviewer model and steer the agent to fix failed output, with at most 2 review rounds per turn and SOP-folder standards injected as an extra review dimension.
description.zh: 每轮回复结束时用独立审查模型审核输出，判定不合格则引导 agent 修复，每轮最多追问 2 次；可注入 SOP 文件夹标准作为额外审核维度。

description.en: 一个 dsh-better-sidebar 的消费插件：在侧边栏新增一个「文件」tab，内置一棵固定在工作区（cwd）内的文件树，提供真正的文件管理能力——上传、移动、删除、重命名、新建文件夹。它补充了 better-sidebar 自带 Explorer 缺失的「写」操作（Explorer 只读）
description.zh: 在侧边栏新增文件管理页，支持上传、移动、删除、重命名和新建文件夹，补齐只读文件树的写操作。

description.en: Local-first personal usage insights in Settings, with 1/7/30-day token heatmaps and a 30-day calendar, token composition, model mix, and skill-call status.
description.zh: 在设置页提供本机个人用量分析：1/7/30 天 Token 热力图与 30 天日历视图、Token 构成、模型分布和技能调用状态。

description.en: Local-first personal usage insights in Settings, with 1/7/30-day token heatmaps and a 30-day calendar, token composition, model mix, and skill-call status.
description.zh: 在设置页提供本机个人用量分析：1/7/30 天 Token 热力图与 30 天日历视图、Token 构成、模型分布和技能调用状态。

description.en: 不想当牛马了？来当老板！开插件公司，雇AI牛马，过赛博人生！
description.zh: 不想当牛马了？来当老板！开插件公司，雇AI牛马，过赛博人生！

description.en: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 端插件,解决侧边栏底部(sidebar.footer.action 槽位)多个插件内容挤成一行的布局问题,并让你自由配置这些内容的上下排列顺序。
description.zh: 把侧边栏底部多个插件从挤一行变成自由上下排列，布局更清爽。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness integration plugin for Neo-MoFox
description.zh: 让 Neo-MoFox 直接调用和管理本机 DeepSeek Harness，无缝集成 AI 能力。

description.en: Product Design workflow suite for DeepSeek Harness - a router plus nine pd-* skills carrying ideas from a minimum design brief through visual directions, evidence-grounded research and audits, URL cloning, frontend builds and a blocking design-QA gate.
description.zh: 产品设计工作流套件：一个路由加九个 pd-* 技能，把想法从最小设计简报推进到视觉方向、证据化调研与审计、URL 克隆、前端构建与阻断式设计 QA 闸门。

description.en: Verified current-source search workflow for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带时效性验证的联网搜索，确保结果来自当前可靠来源。

description.en: DSH 提示词增强插件:输入框强化/还原图标,隔离子会话 agent 重写提示词
description.zh: 一键把大白话需求转成结构化任务书，自动检索关联文件，让 AI 精准秒懂你的意图。

description.en: Live request metadata minimization for DeepSeek Harness, covering the native DeepSeek provider with WebUI settings.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个开关，聊天请求不再带上用户、会话等关联标记，保护请求隐私。

description.en: Adds a subagent_routed tool that runs a one-shot subagent fully mounted on any agent preset from any session, with per-call model/provider override and a model-availability pre-check.
description.zh: 新增 subagent_routed 工具：从任意会话发起一次性子 Agent，并完整挂载到任意 agent preset 上运行，支持按次覆盖模型/提供方，并在调用前预检模型可用性。

description.en: In-app self-update for DeepSeek Harness git-source installs + optional native macOS shell
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过 git 安装的版本在应用内一键自更新，macOS 用户还能享受原生体验。

description.en: Turns a Xiaohongshu, Douyin, TikTok, YouTube or X link into text: transcript with timecodes, on-screen text, a description and OCR of every image, caption and metadata. Mounts the hosted MCP server over streamable HTTP.
description.zh: 把小红书、抖音、TikTok、YouTube 或 X 链接转成文本：带时间戳的转写、屏幕文字、逐图描述与 OCR、正文与元数据。通过 streamable HTTP 挂载托管的 MCP 服务。

description.en: Adds prompt optimization, cancellation, and undo controls to the DeepSeek Harness composer.
description.zh: AI 输入增强插件，帮你更高效地输入和优化文本内容，提升日常写作与对话体验。

description.en: Vision + smart model routing for DeepSeek Harness. Gemini sees. DeepSeek codes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上视觉能力，自动分流图片任务给 Gemini，代码任务留给 DeepSeek，让模型各司其职。

description.en: dsh-a2a-server makes a DeepSeek Harness agent reachable over the A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol. It serves an Agent Card at a well-known URI and implements the v0.3.0 JSON-RPC binding, so any compliant peer that knows the deployment's URL can discover the agent and submit tasks to it.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通过 A2A 协议对外提供 Agent Card 和任务接口，其他合规智能体可直接调用协作。
为 DeepSeek Harness 提供远程访问认证门禁，保护你的服务不被未授权使用。
对话结束后自动把中间的工具调用和过程节点折叠成一行，让聊天记录更清爽，想看细节随时展开。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：悬浮显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，点击直达充值页 | DSH widget showing your DeepSeek balance with a top-up link
description.zh: 右下角悬浮球实时显示 DeepSeek 余额和模型费率，可拖动，点击直达充值页。

description.en: Adds a Reading tab to the DSH web client that shows process steps and live reasoning in source order, collapses successful turns to the final answer, and keeps the original tabs, composer, and tooling intact.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 客户端新增「阅读」页签：按源顺序呈现过程步骤与实时思考，成功轮次收起只留最终回答，原有页签、输入框与工具保持不变。

description.en: DeepSeek Companion 开发者版 — DeepSeek Harness 官方伴侣插件完整功能集：A–J 九大模块（对话导出/交接摘要/成本优化/全局检索 + 执行轨迹分析、Prompt 工程工作台、多模型竞技场、任务编排、安全审计），Cordis 插件化架构。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 官方伴侣插件开发者版，集对话导出、成本优化、全局检索、Prompt 工作台、多模型竞技等九大模块，一站式提升开发效率。

description.en: Council of High Intelligence: assemble an 18-member think tank of historical figures for multi-perspective structured debate, with a live DAG side panel, SQLite run history, and per-project defaults via .council.yaml.
description.zh: 高智议会：召集 18 位历史人物组成智囊团对复杂问题进行多视角结构化辩论，附带实时 DAG 右侧面板、SQLite 历史记录持久化，支持通过 .council.yaml 配置项目级默认面板与主席。

description.en: Use your phone as a DSH peripheral remote: send messages (typed or dictated with the phone keyboard), answer yes/no and choice prompts, browse messages and switch sessions on a Game Boy-style screen, paired over LAN QR or a built-in Cloudflare tunnel.
description.zh: 把手机变成 DSH 的外设遥控台：发送消息（打字或用手机输入法语音转文字）、应答 yes/no 审批与选择题、浏览消息与切换会话，Game Boy 风格屏幕；局域网扫码或内置 Cloudflare 隧道连接。

description.en: Text-to-image and image-to-image generation inside DSH through OpenAI-compatible endpoints, with an agent tool, multi-provider fallback, and a side-panel workspace with history.
description.zh: 一句话生成图像，支持文生图和图生图，快速产出创意图片。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: zero-dependency SQLite FTS5 index for markdown/text/code/web pages, source-cited retrieval, session experience library, interactive kbquery Web panel + knowledge galaxy.
description.zh: 本地知识库插件，自动检索文档并标注来源，还能沉淀会话经验、剪藏网页，让模型回答更靠谱。

description.en: DSH 插件：把 dsh 的回环 Web UI 通过 0.0.0.0 反代暴露到局域网，开关/状态/日志嵌入设置页。官方 bundle 插件，安装：dsh plugin --profile web add github:liveqte/dsh-lan-proxy#main
description.zh: 把只监听本机的 dsh 网页界面反代到局域网，手机等其他设备也能直接访问，开关和日志都在设置页里。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: one-page mobile access setup — Tailscale/LAN detection, scan-to-open QR (offline), insecure-origin polyfill
description.zh: 手机一键接入 DeepSeek Harness：自动检测 Tailscale/局域网，扫码即连，支持直连与 HTTP/2 切换，兼容旧版手机端。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: one local bridge for ChatGPT Codex / Claude / ZCode (GLM) / Qwen subscription plans — settings status card, one-click provisioning, zero core changes. npm: @taylorswitiger/dsh-plan-bridge
description.zh: 一个本地桥接插件，让你在DeepSeek Harness里直接管理ChatGPT、Claude等订阅计划，一键配置，无需改核心代码。

description.en: DSH 选择增强插件：「重新生成选项」/「更多选项」按钮。Choice refresh (regenerate / more options) for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 选择操作添加“重新生成选项”和“更多选项”按钮，一键刷新可选内容。

description.en: Native RoleHub bridge for DeepSeek Harness: discover verified roles, start role-scoped Sessions, and invite them into Agent Team Rooms.
description.zh: 将 RoleHub 角色桥接到 DSH，快速验证并启动角色会话，还能邀请进 Agent 团队房间协作。

description.en: Launches a fresh, continuable parallel session from the composer command menu (/side-chat) while the main session keeps running.
description.zh: 主会话进行中也能一键新开独立的可续聊旁会话：从输入框 ＋ 命令菜单选 side-chat 即开即用，主会话不受影响。

description.en: Nine consolidated tools that give agents full access to the stool ops CLI: server management, database query/redis, log search/tail, CI/CD deploy and history, MFA codes, git operations, notes, todos, and misc utilities (accounting, weekly reports, audit, project listing, nginx presets).
description.zh: 将 stool 运维 CLI 的全部能力整合为 9 个合并工具，Agent 可直接调用：服务器管理、数据库查询与 Redis、日志搜索与尾部查看、CI/CD 部署与历史、MFA 动态码、Git 仓库操作、笔记管理、待办任务，以及记账、周报、审计、项目列表、Nginx 预设等杂项工具。

description.en: agent memory plugin based on CLP
description.zh: 给AI智能体配上会进化的记忆，思考前自动调取历史，回答后自动总结沉淀。

description.en: DSH plugin bundle: live Wallpaper Engine backgrounds for the DSH web GUI - video/web wallpapers, static scene previews, rotation lists, search, resource monitor, bilingual UI
description.zh: 把 Wallpaper Engine 本地壁纸库变成 DSH 网页界面的动态背景，支持视频壁纸、轮播和资源监控。

description.en: dsh --profile tui：DeepSeek Harness 的终端交互客户端（out-of-tree profile bundle）
description.zh: 在终端里直接和 DeepSeek Harness 交互，不用切窗口，聊着天就能完成各种任务。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 背景轮播插件：把工作区 backgrounds 目录的图片设为背景并自动轮播 (MIT)
description.zh: 把工作区里的图片和视频设为背景，自动轮播，让 DeepSeek Harness 界面更好看。

description.en: A plugin of Deepseek Harness(DSH),transform your recent chat history into beautifully designed knowledge cards, ready to download and share.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 网页里的任意对话一键变成干净有质感的知识卡片，支持概念、流程图、对比等样式。

description.en: Answers hard questions by staging a formal debate: two adversarial subagents argue opposite sides with research, then the main agent rules on the transcript through the debate_open, debate_round, and debate_verdict tools.
description.zh: 通过一场正式辩论来回答难题：两个对抗性子代理各自调研并论证对立立场，最后由主代理依据辩论记录作出裁决，提供 debate_open、debate_round、debate_verdict 三个工具。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端（dsh web）开发的插件：聊天区右侧的 Explorer 文件面板 + Preview 预览面板（FileManager 风格，Apache-2.0 参考实现非抄录），以及输入框 @ 引用项目文件（树形多选弹窗 + 输入框内胶囊 + 行号）
description.zh: 在聊天区右侧提供文件管理器和预览面板，并支持在输入框用 @ 引用项目文件，方便边聊边看代码。

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a minimal mic control in the composer with continuous bilingual recognition, context-aware term correction, punctuation, and a live waveform
description.zh: 在输入框右下角加个麦克风，说话就能打字，支持中英混说、自动加标点，还能实时看波形。

description.en: Prompt Presets to manage your library
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理常用提示词库，一键注入到输入框，快速复用你的提示词模板。

description.en: Draggable ring gauge showing live model output speed (tok/s) with an expandable per-step detail panel (exact speed, TTFT, cache-hit rate, cache read/write, reasoning and input tokens, model, cumulative tokens).
description.zh: 可拖拽环形表盘，实时显示模型输出速度（tok/s），点击展开每步详情（精确速度、TTFT、缓存命中率、缓存读写、推理/输入 token、模型、累计 token）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness usage analytics dock on the composer: Beijing-time peak/valley pricing with all-day weekend valley rate, live balance, cross-session history, by-date drill-down and charts.
description.zh: DSH 用量分析坞：输入框峰谷计费坞（周末全天谷时）、实时余额、跨会话历史、按日期下钻与图表。

description.en: Silent vision bridge for DeepSeek Harness: route chat images to a fixed vision model, preserve UI originals, and reuse observations across compaction and restarts.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个静默视觉桥：聊天图片自动转给固定视觉模型处理，保留原始界面，压缩和重启后也能复用观察结果。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex Web Search 能力。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Codex 网页搜索，直接调用兼容接口，让模型联网查资料更顺手。

description.en: Explicit cross-session work state for DeepSeek Harness: goals, decisions and next steps captured automatically from host events or via a model-visible work_state tool, inspectable with /checkpoint.
description.zh: 跨会话工作状态显式持久化：目标、决策与下一步从宿主事件自动捕获，或由模型经 work_state 工具主动记录，/checkpoint 随时可查。

description.en: Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal, and deterministic quality gates — backed by a crash-isolated Rust tree-sitter parse daemon and SQLite index.
description.zh: 将 LiuHe MCP 代码工具集（44 个工具）桥接进 dsh web：repo_map、符号搜索、带容错匹配的 edit_batch、带撤销日志的事务性编辑，以及确定性质量门禁——由崩溃隔离的 Rust tree-sitter 解析守护进程和 SQLite 索引支撑。
在输入框下方直接显示会话余额和花费，点开还能看Token明细，设置里可自定义样式并一键还原。

description.en: Off-peak task queue plugin for DeepSeek Harness — queue at peak price, drain at night, read the savings report
description.zh: 把耗时任务留到夜间低价时段运行，帮你省下Token费用，早上直接看省钱报告。

description.en: Bring OpenCode Zen free models to DSH: 8 live-discovered providers with zero config, no API key; includes persistent quota tracker with rate-limit detection and reset countdown.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DSH：8 个实时发现的免费模型，零配置无需 API key；内置持久化额度检测器，自动追踪 429 限流并显示重置倒计时。

description.en: iPhone-style agent phone: dual-panel calls & SMS, RCS group chat with trust gates, cross-device agent messaging via the registry inbox bridge, L0–L4 trust badges and evidence audit. Experimental: trust summaries are not a security guarantee, and SMS/signalling is relayed through the operator's inbox (visible to them); E2E encryption is planned.
description.zh: 苹果风格智能体手机：双面板电话/短信、RCS 群聊（信任门禁）、跨设备智能体消息（registry 收件箱桥）、L0–L4 信任徽章与证据审计。实验性：信任摘要非安全保证，短信/信令经运营方收件箱中继（运营方可见）；E2E 加密为演进方向。

description.en: DSH 动态 Cordis 插件安装安全审查守卫 (DeepSeek Harness plugin install security review gate, security-first)
description.zh: DSH 动态 Cordis 插件安装安全审查守卫 (DeepSeek Harness plugin install security review gate, security-first)

description.en: AI-driven presentation workflow packaged as a dsh skill: generates editable PPTX decks and SVG snapshots from PDF, DOCX, URLs or Markdown, fills native PPTX templates, and enhances finished presentations.
description.zh: AI 驱动的演示文稿工作流：从 PDF、DOCX、网址或 Markdown 生成可编辑 PPTX 与 SVG 快照，支持原生 PPTX 模板填充与成品演示文稿增强。

description.en: Remote-control DeepSeek Harness from Telegram: stream replies, one-tap keyboards, whitelist-secured, zero inbound ports.
description.zh: 通过 Telegram 远程遥控 DeepSeek Harness，随时查看回复、一键操作，安全白名单，无需开放端口。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that displays real-time account balances for DeepSeek, Kimi (Moonshot), and Qwen providers.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek、Kimi 和 Qwen 账户余额，方便你随时掌握费用消耗。

description.en: Whole-report verification for scientific reports: per-claim checks against Crossref, PubMed (retraction scan), ClinicalTrials.gov, UniProtKB, GEO/SRA and PatentsView, URL accessibility and title agreement, claim-vs-source meaning at temperature 0, and a durable restartable audit ledger with an annotated report.
description.zh: 面向科研报告的整篇校验工作流：逐条核对 Crossref、PubMed（含撤稿扫描）、ClinicalTrials.gov、UniProtKB、GEO/SRA 和 PatentsView，核验 URL 可访问性与标题一致性，以温度 0 判定声明与原文含义一致，输出可恢复的审计账本与标注版校验报告。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: a Chrome browser for agents (browser_goto / browser_evaluate / browser_screenshot tools) with a live two-way pane inside the DSH Web GUI. The browser engine is a fork of zenbu-labs/terminal-browser with the React Ink terminal UI replaced by a DSH tool surface and web pane.
description.zh: 给智能体装上真实Chrome浏览器，能跳转网页、执行脚本、截图，还能在DSH界面实时看到浏览器操作。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 ComfyUI MiniMax H3 视频工作台
description.zh: 把任意 ComfyUI API JSON 导入成独立工作页面，轻松管理和运行视频生成工作流。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: Git status pill in the session header — branch, dirty counts, ahead/behind, recent commits & changed files.
DSH 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 会话之间保存 / 加载开发交接文档（/handoff save | load，含确定性脱敏与 Git 状态捕获）
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话间保存和加载开发交接文档，自动脱敏并记录 Git 状态，换会话不丢上下文。

description.en: Phone-first drawer shell for DSH Web. Collapses the session list into a tap-to-open drawer, keeps header plugin actions, and turns Settings into a full-width sheet.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 做成真正的手机壳：会话列表收成抽屉，点会话自动收起且不弹键盘，设置页改为全宽 sheet。

description.en: DSH web plugin: a sidebar-footer QR-code button that lets a phone scan and re-issue the current browser's authenticated launch URL.
description.zh: 在网页侧边栏加一个二维码按钮，手机扫码就能复用当前浏览器的登录链接，快速打开同一会话。

description.en: 给每次 AI 对话装一根 Token 保险丝：为每条用户消息设置独立总预算，统一约束输入、缓存、思考与回答。A per-conversation total-token safety fuse for DeepSeek Harness, with a whale slider and automatic reset on the next user message.
description.zh: 给每次 AI 对话装一根 Token 保险丝，按消息设定总预算，自动控制输入、思考与回答，防止超支。

description.en: Terse prose for DeepSeek Harness — compress the agent's own output so every reply costs fewer tokens (layer 4). Style, never substance.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的输出极简——压缩 agent 自己的输出让每句回复更省 token(layer 4)。只改措辞，不丢内容。

description.en: Cut token cost in 4 layers without cutting model intelligence: handoff, rtk, headroom, caveman token-saving skills — each also available as a standalone installable plugin.
description.zh: 四层省 Token，不牺牲模型智能：handoff、rtk、headroom、caveman 四个省 token 的 skill，每个也是独立可装插件。

description.en: DSH 插件：在对话框下方监控 DeepSeek API 用量与余额（本月/日均/昨日/今日消费 + 账户余额），点击账单行配置 userToken
description.zh: 在对话框下方实时显示 DeepSeek API 用量与余额，点击账单行即可配置 token，方便掌控消费。

description.en: Document → Markdown + vision image description plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Converts Word/PPT/Excel/ODT/RTF/EPUB/CSV/PDF via firecrawl-anydoc and describes embedded images with a VLM.
一个好看、简单、实用的余额监视器｜DeepSeek Harness 插件：官方余额快照 + ds_balance 工具 + 峰谷计价区间 + Matrix/原生双风格徽章
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：DeepSeek API 余额实时监测（官方 /user/balance 快照 + ds_balance 工具 + 峰谷计价状态 + Matrix/原生双风格侧边栏徽章）

description.en: Scheduled DeepSeek Harness Agent tasks with mandatory end-to-end tests, run history, and bidirectional delivery through nine messaging channels.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Agent 定时任务：创建前强制完成端到端测试，提供运行历史，并通过九种通讯渠道双向收发消息。

description.en: Scopes MCP tool injection per workspace directory in the DeepSeek Harness: a session opened in a project sees only the MCP servers that project needs — removed from the model's tool list and refused at call time. Plus per-session switches in the composer to narrow or widen the session you are in, temporarily.
description.zh: 按项目目录自动隔离 MCP 工具，每个工作区只暴露自己需要的工具，避免模型看到无关工具。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns your photos into Web GUI skins — auto-extracted accent colors, all files stay local.
description.zh: 把照片变成 DSH 网页界面的皮肤，自动提取主色调，所有文件本地保存，即插即用。

description.en: 为手工 OpenAI 兼容模型补上推理档位声明的 DSH 插件 / DSH plugin to declare reasoning efforts on hand-added OpenAI-compatible models.
description.zh: 为手工添加的OpenAI兼容模型自动补上推理档位声明，让模型按预期强度思考。

description.en: Plugin development toolkit for DeepSeek Harness with scaffolding, contract checks, plugin vetting, impact analysis, and upstream compatibility tracking.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件开发工具集，提供骨架生成、契约检查、插件体检、影响面分析与上游兼容性追踪。

description.en: Import, validate, manage, and migrate Agent Skills for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), Claude Code, Codex, and other AI coding agents.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里一站式导入、校验和管理各类 AI 编程助手的技能包，轻松迁移无缝复用。

description.en: Persistent token-usage ledger and Web Usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化 token 用量账本和 Web Usage 仪表盘。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness workspace & session enhancement plugin: recycle bin, cross-workspace drag, ungrouped sessions, multi-folder roots, session merge
description.zh: 增强 DSH 工作区与会话管理：回收站防误删、跨工作区拖拽、未分组会话整理、多根目录支持，还能合并会话。

description.en: Writes a Windows shortcut and tray launcher to start dsh web in WSL, with Health/Restart and the :3081 launch-token URL.
description.zh: 生成 Windows 快捷方式与托盘启动器，在 WSL 中启动 dsh web，并提供 Health/Restart 与 :3081 launch token 地址。

description.en: DSH Web Client 的 VSCode 风格文件树侧栏插件：虚拟化懒加载文件树，支持文本 / Markdown / 图片预览。
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页客户端加上 VSCode 风格的文件树侧栏，支持懒加载和文件预览，浏览项目文件更顺手。

description.en: A visual plugin marketplace for DSH: browse multiple Git sources, install plugins with one click, and wire skills, subagents, MCP connectors, LSP servers and hooks into the harness automatically.
description.zh: DSH 的可视化插件市场：多源浏览、一键安装，技能、子代理、MCP 连接器、LSP 服务器与 hooks 自动接入。

description.en: 虾说教材写作 · dsh-course-writer — AI course-authoring workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). 三栏式工作台 · 九阶段门禁 · 课程/章节/资料库/知识图谱 · 导出 TXT/Word · 分享协作。Three-pane workspace, nine-phase gated workflow, lorebook, export & share.
description.zh: 虾说是一款 AI 教材写作工作台，提供三栏式编辑、九阶段流程管理和知识图谱，帮你高效完成课程创作与导出。

description.en: DSH 插件：回答前先预估 token 用量与 DeepSeek API 费用，回答后展示实际账单（Web 聊天内嵌行）
基于抖音官方资料的 DeepSeek Harness 自媒体插件：帮你做选题、审脚本、诊断流量、制定周计划，已用于《商道人物志》近 6 万粉丝实战。
description.zh: 基于抖音官方资料的创作助手，帮你做选题、审脚本、诊断流量、制定周计划，已实战验证。

description.en: dsh-message 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的统一消息接入插件，仅包含微信、飞书、QQ、企业微信和钉钉。项目采用一套 Host/Client 插件、统一设置页和统一 HTTP Harness 会话链路，并在五个渠道上共享提示词、长期记忆和会话策略。并且可以定制鲸鱼娘的soul哦~
DeepSeek Harness 飞书接入插件（薄架构）：Web 面板扫码授权 lark-cli + 监听器管理
description.zh: 飞书接入插件（薄架构）：Web 面板扫码授权 lark-cli + 管理飞书网关监听器，业务收发仍在独立 lark-bridge 进程

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 社区插件管理器:来源分类、热停用/启用、事务化卸载 | Community plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness: origin classification, safe hot disable/enable, transactional uninstall
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 社区插件，支持来源分类、安全热停用/启用和事务化卸载，随时掌握加载内容并安全恢复。

description.en: DSH cost panel: meters every request from session events, prices it against a built-in catalog of 136 models across 16 providers, and shows model, balance, session/today/month spend and a monthly budget bar next to the composer.
description.zh: 实时统计每次请求的Token消耗和费用，支持136种模型和16家服务商，帮你随时掌握余额和月度预算。

description.en: deepseek harness 背景主题插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换个背景主题，让界面更顺眼，用起来更舒服。

description.en: Source-traceable Brave + Tavily live web search and URL extraction for DeepSeek Harness. Native DSH plugin; TaroCub optional.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上可溯源的真实联网搜索和网页正文提取，Brave 与 Tavily 双引擎可选。

description.en: Per-model capability profiling for DSH: turns local session history into per-model dashboards of session counts, tool usage, error rates, and top error signatures, with time-range filters and multi-model comparison.
description.zh: DSH 按模型的能力画像:把本地会话历史变成逐模型的会话数、工具使用、错误率与 Top 错误签名看板,支持时间范围过滤与多模型对比。

description.en: Give coding Agents runtime evidence for debugging and verifying DSH / Cordis plugins. 让 Coding Agent 获得用于调试和验证 DSH / Cordis 插件的运行时证据。
description.zh: 让编码智能体实时查看 Cordis 运行时状态，调试和验证 DSH 插件更轻松。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web 的本地文件输入插件。在输入框原有的 + 菜单顶部增加 attach，并用分隔线与 Harness 原生命令区分；不会再增加一个单独按钮。Private local file attachments for DeepSeek Harness with native images and bounded document reading.
description.zh: 在输入框的+菜单里直接附加本地文件，支持图片预览和文档解析，不额外占按钮位置。

description.en: One-step GitHub uploader: initializes git, auto-creates or improves README, sets repository topics, and pushes a local project to GitHub.
description.zh: 一键上传项目到 GitHub：自动初始化 git、生成或完善 README、设置仓库 topics，并推送本地项目。

description.en: Per-provider concurrency gate on the llm/stream waterfall: holds surplus model requests in a FIFO queue inside DSH so main agent, subagents and compaction take turns on a single-slot local server (llama.cpp --parallel 1) instead of timing out; maxConcurrent / maxQueued / queueTimeoutMs.
description.zh: 给每个模型供应商设置并发闸门，让主智能体、子智能体和压缩任务排队轮流使用本地单槽服务器，避免请求过载。

description.en: Convert Office documents and PDFs (including scanned ones) to structurally formatted Markdown via a CPU-first routing OCR pipeline (RapidOCR/SLANet/FormulaNet).
description.zh: 将 Office 文档与 PDF（含扫描件）转换为保留结构的 Markdown，采用 CPU 优先的路由 OCR 流水线（RapidOCR/SLANet/FormulaNet）。

description.en: Plug-in vision for text-only models on DSH, with native interaction for image understanding and generation, and GUI automation, through layered evidence memory and cache.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型装上“眼睛”，原生支持识图与画图，内置记忆缓存与智能路由，多模态交互更顺畅。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: provider sign-in, model catalog, and selection routing over a loopback-only /model-hub channel
description.zh: 统一管理多个模型提供商的登录、模型列表与选择路由，让 DeepSeek Harness 切换模型更省心。

description.en: Explicit model routing for Main, Subagents, web_search, and image generation, plus a catalog-driven Composer and Plan Review picker with Model, Effort, Context, Fast, and Thinking variants.
description.zh: 显式路由 Main、Subagent、web_search 与图像生成，并提供由模型目录驱动的 Composer/Plan Review Picker，支持 Model、Effort、Context、Fast 与 Thinking 变体。

description.en: One-click/auto sync provider model lists against /v1/models endpoint.
description.zh: 一键同步 / 自动同步供应商模型列表，与 /v1/models 保持一致。

description.en: Multi-workspace sandbox: grants file-write access to every registered workspace automatically — add a workspace, write to it immediately, no config or escalation needed.
description.zh: 多工作区沙箱，自动为所有已注册工作区开启文件写入权限，添加即用，无需配置。

description.en: Adds an "Open folder" item to the session-row ⋯ menu in the DSH workspace sidebar, opening the session's workspace folder with the host OS file manager.
description.zh: 在工作区侧边栏的会话行 ⋯ 菜单中增加「打开文件夹」项，用系统文件管理器打开该会话所属工作区的文件夹。

description.en: Conversation-level multi-agent workbench for editable task planning, real child-session observation, plan-versus-runtime comparison, and evidence-backed recovery previews; tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中规划、运行并对比多个智能体的工作成果，让多智能体协作一目了然。

description.en: A Deepseek Harness plugin that gives its UI color themes.
description.zh: Deepseek Harness 的一款插件，可为其用户界面添加颜色主题。

description.en: Tavily-backed search provider for native web_search, with a Settings → Plugins card for API key management and toggling DeepSeek replacement.
description.zh: 为原生 web_search 提供 Tavily 搜索后端，并在设置 → 插件中提供 API Key 管理与是否替换 DeepSeek 的开关。

description.en: Adds a colored status line under the DSH conversation stats showing live DeepSeek API cost, usage and account balance, with on/off-peak pricing indicators.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话统计行下方新增彩色状态行，实时显示 DeepSeek API 费用、用量与账户余额，并带高峰/错峰计费指示。

description.en: 简陋deepseekharness计费插件,可查询显示余额.设置预算,累计汇总。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供计费与预算管理，实时查询余额、统计调用费用，帮你控制成本。

description.en: DSH Desktop Operator: safe Windows Computer Use, desktop automation, UI Automation, and MCP tools for DeepSeek Harness
Feishu/Lark bot bridge for DeepSeek Harness — control DSH agents remotely from Feishu.
description.zh: 通过飞书/Lark 远程操控 DSH 智能体，随时随地管理任务和状态。
为 DeepSeek Harness 提供开发工具包，方便开发者快速构建和调试智能体插件。

description.en: Local knowledge base manager for DSH agents: multi-format import, CJK-aware chunking, sqlite-vec vector + BM25 hybrid search with bge-reranker-base rerank, snapshots, kbpack export/import and cross-KB search — 22 agent tools plus a Web panel.
description.zh: 本地知识库管理：多格式导入、CJK 感知分块、sqlite-vec 向量 + BM25 混合检索与 bge-reranker-base 重排序、快照恢复、kbpack 导入导出与跨库检索，提供 22 个 agent 工具与 Web 面板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: automatic session handoff when a session keeps hitting 429 TPM rate limits — cancel old, summarize handover, continue in a fresh session. True handoff, never parallel.
description.zh: 会话频繁触发 429 限流时，自动总结并迁移到新会话继续任务，避免中断，实现无缝交接。

description.en: DSH 插件：任务结束 / 需要用户决策时弹窗提醒（web toast + 桌面通知），类似 Codex / Claude Code 体验
description.zh: 任务结束或需要你决策时，自动弹窗提醒，让你不错过关键节点，体验更流畅。

description.en: DSH skill: ingest the conclusions/mistakes/projects from conversations into an Obsidian vault via a 7-step workflow with two-level validation. 把对话结论/错题/项目按七步流程整理进 Obsidian 的 DeepSeek Harness 技能。
dsh web-UI plugin: open the current session's workspace folder with an installed app (Finder, Terminal, VS Code, Ghostty, Zed, ...) — icons included
description.zh: 在聊天窗口一键用已装应用（如终端、VS Code）打开当前工作区文件夹，提升开发效率。

description.en: Context manager for DeepSeek Harness: auto-summarizes every turn into priority-sorted records, injects them plus pinned cross-session notes and custom text into each model request, and folds any-size real conversation ranges into summaries to save tokens. Persistent and restart-safe. NOTE: manual multi-step install — copy the three package folders into profiles/node_modules and add the provided cordis.patch.yml rows, then restart DSH; not a standard one-command install.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 上下文管理：每轮对话自动总结为记录并按优先级排序注入，⭐ 置顶记录跨会话继承，自定义文本每轮注入；真实对话任意范围折叠成摘要真省 token，全状态持久化重启不丢。注意：非标准一键安装——需手动将三个包目录复制到 profiles/node_modules、粘贴 cordis.patch.yml 接线并重启 DSH。

description.en: Browse, search, star-sort, favorite and one-click download community plugins from inside DeepSeek Harness settings.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页内浏览、搜索、星标排序、收藏并一键下载社区插件。

description.en: Zero-dependency MCP stdio server template + ready-to-use A-share data tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). No API key, all env-var paths, standard NDJSON protocol.
description.zh: 零依赖的MCP服务器模板，开箱即用获取A股公开数据，无需API密钥，直接接入DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: In-browser novel reader for the dsh web GUI: online book-source search, chapter-by-chapter reading in a chat-style view, and whole-book TXT download.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 在线小说阅读器：书源搜索、聊天式阅读界面、整本下载 TXT 到本地。

description.en: omdsh-dev/dsh-sandbox-micro 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
description.zh: 把模型命令隔离在Linux微虚拟机里执行，提升沙箱安全性和隔离度。

description.en: Shows per-turn and session token costs in DSH web conversations.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页对话中实时显示每轮和整个会话的 token 用量及费用，帮你随时掌握成本。

description.en: Windows system-tray launcher for DeepSeek Harness Web: start, stop, restart, open the Web UI, tail logs, live status icon, and a launch-at-login toggle.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Windows 托盘启动器：托盘图标一键启动、停止、重启服务，打开 Web UI、查看日志，实时状态图标，并支持开机自启开关。

description.en: Structured vision evidence (OCR/layout/semantics) plus a USB camera capture tool for a "shoot-look-adjust" debug loop; backends: Ollama, DeepSeek, Xiaomi.
description.zh: 结构化视觉证据（OCR/版面/语义）+ USB 摄像头拍摄工具，支持"拍-看-改"调试闭环；后端支持 Ollama、DeepSeek、小米。

description.en: Live llmtrim savings dashboard in the DSH web UI: Settings page with paid, would-have-cost, saved-today and saved-this-week cards plus per-model breakdown, and a configurable rotating or static stats strip under the composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内实时展示 llmtrim 节省统计：设置页金额卡片（已支付、未压缩应付、今日与本周节省）与按模型明细，输入区可配置轮播或静态统计条。

description.en: Five casual mini-games (sliding-number puzzle, Sudoku, snake, Schulte grid, number memory) that pop up when a turn starts, with auto-saved progress across sessions.
description.zh: 任务开始时自动弹出的 5 个休闲小游戏（数字华容道、数独、贪吃蛇、舒尔特方格、数字记忆），支持跨会话自动保存进度。

description.en: Local semantic code search for DeepSeek Harness: fragment-level symbol-aware indexing, offline lexical embeddings or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and hybrid vector + BM25 retrieval fused with RRF - three dsh tools plus a sema CLI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地语义代码搜索：片段级符号感知索引、离线词法 embedding（或 OpenAI 兼容端点）、向量+BM25 混合检索并以 RRF 融合——三个 dsh 工具外加 sema CLI。

description.en: DSH的外观插件
Invoke user-accessible Skills with @name tokens and show matching Skill suggestions in the conversation composer.
description.zh: 通过 @名称 标记调用用户可用的 Skill，并在对话输入框中显示匹配的 Skill 候选项。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek 的每一分钱都花在刀刃上 —— 前缀缓存命中率、费用与健康度，一眼看穿。（已按规范要求严格配置文件，不会出现异常阻止启动） DeepSeek Harness 插件，the monster of cache-cost，用于监控前缀缓存命中率、统计 Token 消耗与估算 API 运行成本。 DSH plugin for DeepSeek API prefix cache hit-rate monitoring, token usage statistics and cost estimation.
description.zh: 实时监控前缀缓存命中率与Token消耗，估算API成本，让DeepSeek每一分钱都花得明明白白。

description.en: Run the main session model on a local Claude Code subscription through the official Claude Agent SDK, taking over the llm/stream route for the claude-code provider, with token-level streaming, session resume, and DSH tools bridged in over MCP so they keep DSH sandbox and approval.
description.zh: 让会话主模型跑在本机 Claude Code 订阅上：经官方 Claude Agent SDK 接管 claude-code provider 的 llm/stream 路由，支持 token 级流式、会话 resume 续接，并把 DSH 工具经 MCP 桥接进去以保留 DSH 的沙箱与审批。

description.en: Free-tier model aggregation plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): transparent failover, multi-key rotation, settings panel
description.zh: 免费模型聚合插件，自动切换可用模型和密钥，让 DeepSeek Harness 更稳定省钱。

description.en: Four dependency-free local git tools (status, diff, log, commit) for DeepSeek Harness operating on the session workspace.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供四个零依赖本地 git 工具（status、diff、log、commit），作用于会话工作区。

description.en: openai models for login by chatgpt
String-matches tool-call input arguments, blocks dangerous tool calls (deny) or allows them with an injected warning (warn), and ships a full rules-management panel.
description.zh: 对 agent 工具调用输入参数做字符串匹配，命中危险行为则拦截（deny）或放行但注入警告（warn），附规则管理面板。

description.en: deepseek-harness 的插件，可以使用kiro的模型（claude系列）和账号
description.zh: deepseek-harness 的插件，可以使用kiro的模型（claude系列）和账号

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin — replaces the "Deep diving..." running status with rotating witty phrases and practical tips.
description.zh: 将Web界面中的“Deep diving...”加载状态替换为诙谐短语和实用提示，保留原位置和闪烁效果，让等待更有趣。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness client plugin: mic dictation button next to the Full access control
DeepSeek Harness 状态灯插件：角色表情状态灯 + 聊天框气泡，完成任务/出错/提问时自动弹出（dsh-plugin）
DeepSeek Harness 插件雷达：定时扫描 GitHub topic:dsh-plugin 新插件，Web 界面左下角卡片推送，支持 README 关键词搜索与一键安装
description.zh: 定时扫描 GitHub 上的 DSH 新插件，左下角卡片推送，支持关键词搜索、AI 摘要和一键安装。

description.en: Shows a local image or short video in the current conversation card, with click-to-preview.
description.zh: 在当前对话卡片里展示本地图片或短视频，点击可预览。

description.en: Resolves a company name or ticker to a verified stock symbol via SEC EDGAR, then fetches a live quote with price, P/E, EPS, market cap, 52-week range, and dividend yield from yahoo-finance2.
description.zh: 通过 SEC EDGAR 将公司名称或股票代码解析为已验证的股票代号，再从 yahoo-finance2 获取实时行情，包括价格、市盈率、每股收益、市值、52周区间和股息率。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness自定义主题插件
DSH Web GUI 界面状态持久化插件：侧边栏开合/宽度/详情面板/对话滚动位置恢复
description.zh: 自动记忆侧边栏开关、拖拽宽度、详情面板和对话滚动位置，重启页面后一键恢复上次布局，操作不折腾。

description.en: Subtitle-first video transcription with SRT export, cancellable job controls, and a faster-whisper large-v3 fallback when subtitles are unavailable.
description.zh: 字幕优先的视频转录，支持 SRT 导出与可取消任务控制；字幕不可用时回退到 faster-whisper `large-v3`。

description.en: Reusable skill to browse, search and download Wallpaper Engine (Steam 431960) workshop wallpapers and wire them into the DSH skin center, including bypassing the Steam HTTP block and the region-mismatch sign-in block via a matching SOCKS proxy.
description.zh: 可复用技能：批量浏览、搜索、下载 Wallpaper Engine（小红车，Steam 431960）创意工坊壁纸并接入 DSH 皮肤中心；含绕过 Steam HTTP 封锁与异地登录拦截（经出口 IP 与账号一致的 SOCKS 代理）。

description.en: Product research skill: analyze market, technology and supply chain, then output three-tier product spec proposals.
description.zh: AI产品调研技能：分析市场、技术与供应链，输出高中低三套产品规格方案。

description.en: Evidence-driven system architecture reconnaissance for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 自动扫描多仓库项目的底层架构，基于真实证据帮你快速摸清代码脉络，接手或重构项目更轻松。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：产物浏览器
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话侧边栏中浏览产物并添加书签，方便快速回溯和管理。

description.en: Blue Archive-inspired DSH theme with a Shiroko desktop companion, Codex-style reply bubbles, petting effects, and completion chime.
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上蔚蓝档案学院风皮肤，还带一只可拖动、可抚摸的白子桌宠，能同步回复并查 API 余额。

description.en: Side-ask drawer opened from a completed answer's action row: follow-up questions run in an independent, auto-archived session seeded with the prior conversation text (read-only, capped at 48,000 characters), leaving the main session untouched. The side session inherits the main session's model, switchable inside the drawer, with a context-usage ring.
description.zh: 每条已完成回答操作行上的侧问抽屉：追问在独立且自动归档的会话中进行，携带此前的已完成对话文本（只读，上限 48000 字符）作为参考，主会话零写入；模型默认继承主会话并可在抽屉内切换，附上下文占用圈。

description.en: DSH Feishu self-built app integration: WebSocket inbound messages, OK-reaction acknowledgement, and turn replies on the original chat.
description.zh: 让飞书消息直达 DSH 智能体，自动确认并原聊回复，轻松开启对话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Feishu gateway plugin: chat with your DSH agent from Feishu (persistent sessions, /new, Markdown replies, proactive push)
description.zh: 在飞书里直接和你的 DSH 智能体聊天，支持持久会话、Markdown 回复和主动消息推送。

description.en: Leaderless flat agent teams for DeepSeek Harness: cross-window structured task dispatch, recorder service, and web dashboard
description.zh: 让多个独立Agent窗口组成无队长扁平团队，跨窗口互派任务，内置记录员实时汇报进展。

description.en: GitHub authentication and local Git workflow plugin for the dsh web GUI: accounts, repository browsing, clone, pull, push, status, commit, and a settings panel.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页界面里管理 GitHub 账号和本地 Git 仓库，支持浏览、克隆、提交、推送等常用操作。

description.en: 菲奖得主强推的百合新闻订阅DSH插件
description.zh: 输入番名，AI 帮你搜遍动画漫画同人，一键提炼头条资讯，还能在会话里直接调用。

description.en: A local-first full-text memory search plugin for DeepSeek Harness, enabling fast cross-conversation search, message-level navigation, and intelligent retrieval of your AI coding history.
description.zh: 本地优先的全文记忆搜索插件，帮你快速跨会话查找历史AI对话，精准定位消息并智能检索编码记录。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 极简模式增加自动上下文压缩、/compact、/context 和模型主动压缩，解决极简模式长任务无法持续工作的问题。
description.zh: 为极简模式增加自动上下文压缩和手动/模型主动压缩，让长任务不再因上下文溢出而中断。

description.en: Codex Pets–style desktop pet + live task panel plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里养一只桌面宠物，边陪你写代码边实时展示任务进度，让开发更有趣。

description.en: Floating power dock for the DSH web GUI: one-click restart or graceful shutdown of the dsh host, loopback-guarded and dependency-free.
description.zh: DSH Web 悬浮电源坞:一键重启或优雅关机,仅限环回访问,零依赖。

description.en: Hard-stop consecutive identical tool calls after a configurable streak so the agent cannot spin in place.
description.zh: 在可配置次数后硬拦截连续相同的工具调用，避免 Agent 原地空转。

description.en: 能够扫描本地claudecode、codex、codebuddy等Agent配置过的mcp工具的插件
description.zh: 扫描本地Claude Code、Codex等Agent配置过的MCP工具，帮你快速梳理和管理已接入的智能体工具。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 每个会话页右侧加一个类似deepseek网页端的常驻、可折叠的目录栏：每条用户提问对应一个条目，点击即可滚动定位到对应消息并高亮当前条目。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页聊天界面右侧添加可折叠目录栏，点击即可快速跳转到对应提问，方便回顾长对话。

description.en: 一个插件把 DeepSeek Harness 主窗口变成多个分屏，同时查看多个会话的状态。再也不用在会话列表里切来切去了。
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 主窗口切成多个分屏，同时盯着好几个会话的状态，不用再来回切换。

description.en: Canvas task board ported from CodexFF: hierarchical parent/child tasks with boundaries, snap-aligned draggable panels in a conversation view tab, plus `board_*` / `task_*` agent tools and a sync skill.
description.zh: 移植自 CodexFF 的画布任务看板：父子层级任务树与任务边界，会话「任务看板」tab 内磁吸对齐的可拖拽面板，配套 `board_*` / `task_*` 模型工具与同步技能。

description.en: Adds a net_doctor tool that reports proxy environment, NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY, and reachability of the DeepSeek API and the npm registry, and sets NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY on bash and npm child processes.
description.zh: 提供 net_doctor 工具，报告代理环境、NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY，以及 DeepSeek API 与 npm registry 的连通性，并为 bash 和 npm 子进程设置 NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY。
通过 OAuth 2.0 安全绑定 X 账号，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接读取和发布 X 内容，实现社交媒体数据接入。

description.en: 为在dsh中使用Agnes AI的免费图片、视频生成功能而开发，欢迎使用！欢迎提issues。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接调用 Agnes AI 免费生成图片和视频，还能在设置里调默认参数，简单好用。

description.en: Automatic context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: token-pressure-driven summarization checkpoints with a LATE-by-default trigger and a settings card
description.zh: 自动监测对话长度，上下文快满时智能摘要压缩，防溢出且更省Token。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Dream Skin，DSH theme plugin: Dream Skin color presets with a settings-page switcher.
description.zh: 一站式美化包，提供鲸鱼光标、子代理小鲸鱼、29套主题和自定义皮肤，让DSH界面更个性好看。

description.en: Decision log for DeepSeek Harness: record key decisions (chosen option + why) into a versionable DECISIONS.md via decision_log / decision_list / decision_audit tools, and auto-inject the summary into future sessions so decisions stay traceable and are never re-litigated.
description.zh: AI 干活的「小本本」，自动记录每个决策过程，事后随时翻看当初为啥这么干。

description.en: Dual-model auto-routing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: low-cost direct / high-cost upgrade + escape-learning closed loop
description.zh: 双模型自动路由，低成本直答或高成本升级，并带逃逸学习闭环，让AI调用更聪明省心。

description.en: One-click Git commit plugin for DSH: the session model splits workspace changes into reviewed Conventional Commits batches, with built-in sensitive-file filtering.

Fourth permission preset for dsh: unconfined, GPU-capable sessions (danger-full-access) with per-operation user approval for writes outside the workspace or to protected paths (.git/**, .env*); implemented purely as a bundle over the official tools/pre-execute ask hook, no core edits.
description.zh: dsh 第四个权限预设：进程全权限（GPU 可用），同时工作区外与受保护文件（.git/**、.env*）的写入逐次向用户审批；纯插件实现，零核心改动。

description.en: 目标驱动的每日任务计划器：多目标任务数据 + Web 每日预览面板，与微信提醒推送共享数据 · Goal-driven daily task planner for DSH: multi-goal tasks + daily preview panel, one data file with the WeChat reminder pipeline.
description.zh: 目标驱动的每日任务计划器，帮你把多目标拆解成每日任务，还能在网页上预览，并和微信提醒联动。

description.en: damozhang/dsh-herdr-bridge 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的网页会话桥接到 Herdr，让智能体之间能互相发现、启动、对话和观察。

description.en: Automatically retrieves time-of-use pricing data (with Beijing Time) and notifies users during peak periods to reduce costs.
description.zh: 自动获取分时电价数据（按北京时间），在高峰时段提醒用户，以降低用电成本。

description.en: Economics-first journal/working-paper monitor for DeepSeek Harness: NBER RSS + arXiv econ (4 categories) + Chinese econ journals (Shi Jie Jing Ji via Magtech, Zhong Guo Nong Cun Guan Cha, Cai Mao Jing Ji, Zhong Guo Ren Kou Ke Xue, Jing Ji Guan Li via ajcass) fetch, keyword filter, dry-run/Webhook push, dedup persistence, and schedule_create-compatible briefing.
description.zh: 经济学优先的期刊/工作论文监控插件：NBER RSS + arXiv 经济学（4 类目）+ 中文经管期刊（世界经济-玛格泰克平台，中国农村观察/财贸经济/中国人口科学/经济管理-ajcass 平台）抓取、关键词过滤、dry-run/Webhook 推送、去重持久化、定时简报（schedule_create 兼容）。

description.en: DSH 插件：把网页大模型接入 Agent 工作流——真实浏览器驱动，支持代码审查、翻译、红队等多种角色。
description.zh: 用真实浏览器把网页版大模型接进 Agent 工作流，充当代码审查、翻译、红队等多种角色。

description.en: Transactional uninstall engine for DSH plugins: policy tiers, batch atomic ops, fingerprint snapshot, health check, concurrency lock, report export (validate/preview/execute/undo + Saga rollback).
description.zh: 强力卸载 DSH 插件：策略分级、批量原子操作、指纹快照、健康检查、并发锁与报告导出（事务化四段式+Saga 回滚）

description.en: ⚡ DeepSeek Harness 自定义模型增强插件：在配置第三方提供商时，自动从权威模型库补齐上下文大小、Token 上限、视觉多模态输入与思考强度档位。
description.zh: 配置第三方模型时自动补齐上下文、Token上限、视觉输入和思考档位，省去手动查参数。

description.en: Herdr control-plane plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): observe and drive Herdr — a terminal workspace manager for AI coding agents — from DSH sessions
DSH plugin: 天殺拔刀斬——带斩击特效的文件删除工具，强制审查防误删；official bundle, install via `dsh plugin --profile web add` github:88514205-oss/dsh-ryoshu-slash
description.zh: 带斩击特效的文件删除工具，删前强制审查确认，防止手滑误删。

description.en: DSH-native uv environment manager: create, sync and run Python virtualenvs from the settings tab, with pip fallback, read-only conda visibility and a dry-run project sync preview.
description.zh: DSH 原生 uv 环境管理器：在设置面板创建、同步、运行 Python 虚拟环境，pip 回退、conda 只读可见，项目依赖同步带 dry-run 差异预览。

description.en: Trading-terminal style cost tracker for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar balance and today spend, per-step RMB cost table, auto-synced official pricing with peak/off-peak, cross-session and per-day summaries, tool-level attribution, and cost forecast.
description.zh: 交易终端风格的 DeepSeek Harness 计费插件：侧边栏余额与今日消费、按步骤人民币费用表、官方价自动同步（含峰谷）、跨会话与按天汇总、工具级费用归属与成本预测。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: China hard-tech supply chain intelligence (MCP: signal board / track record / Q&A)
description.zh: 连接中国硬科技供应链情报服务，提供信号看板、业绩追踪和问答，帮你快速掌握产业动态。

description.en: 呱来点人口牙...再也不会误把api key粘贴喂给ai了!!!可自定义的安全等级与安全措施，解决容易泄漏api key的底层问题。同时有报告记录可查!!!
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上安全气囊，防止 API 密钥误粘贴给 AI，自动拦截泄露并记录报告，还能做首次工作区安全体检。

description.en: 将deep diving替换为claudecode式的working tips
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 的“Deep diving”状态提示替换成 Claude Code 风格的随机工作小贴士，让等待过程更有趣。

description.en: Plays a short chime when a conversation turn finishes, with three built-in tones or one custom upload, configured in Settings → Plugins.
description.zh: 会话回合结束时播放短提示音，内置三种音色或一条自定义上传，在设置 → 插件中配置。

description.en: Customize the UI's Chinese and English fonts, code font, and global font-size offset on a settings page, with a live preview and one-click reset.
description.zh: 在设置页自定义界面中英文/代码字体与全局字号偏移，实时预览，一键恢复默认。

description.en: Push vague or rich, user-configurable DSH interaction states to the local Discord client as Rich Presence — real-time, content-free, with a user-editable status list and an optional rich-mode toggle in Settings.
description.zh: 将模糊或丰富的 DSH 交互状态实时推送到本地 Discord 客户端作为 Rich Presence——不携带任何工作区内容，状态消息列表可自由编辑，并可在设置中切换丰富模式。

description.en: 掼蛋 Guandan card game plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) - 掼蛋-中联储卫 / GUANDAN-中联储卫
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接玩掼蛋，支持 4 人两副牌完整规则，随时来一局。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 联盟模式：自由组合 DSH、Claude Code、Codex 与全部已配置模型，保留原生 Agent 生命周期与实时执行过程。
DeepSeek Harness 环境体检插件：磁盘/内存/延迟/~/.dsh 膨胀/插件版本落后检测，历史基线趋势，只读不删。
description.zh: 环境体检插件，检查磁盘/内存/延迟和插件版本，生成分级报告并对比历史趋势，只读不删，安全可靠。

description.en: Parse Chinese e-invoice PDFs (XML attachment first, text-layer regex fallback) into structured JSON with amount cross-check, and generate expense reports (Markdown / xlsx).
description.zh: 解析增值税电子发票 PDF（XML 附件优先、文本层正则兜底）为结构化 JSON + 金额勾稽校验，多张汇总生成报销单（Markdown / xlsx）。

description.en: Per-turn, per-step LLM cost metering for DeepSeek Harness - costUsage projection, per-message cost line, and an LLM+web price auto-maintenance tool.
description.zh: 按轮次和步骤统计LLM调用成本，自动更新价格表，让费用一目了然。

description.en: Night-friendly Matrix dark-green skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI (standalone mirror of upstream dsh-web-ui packages/skins/matrix)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上 Matrix 风格暗绿皮肤，深夜用着不刺眼，护眼又带感。

description.en: Workflow-net runtime for DeepSeek Harness: resource-aware concurrency, native loops and fan-out, static soundness checking before a plan becomes durable, and process mining over its own event log.
description.zh: 把长任务建模成工作流网，支持并发控制、循环分支和死锁检测，执行前校验流程可靠性，还能基于事件日志做流程挖掘。

description.en: Static-only plugin gate and clinic for DSH: audit before install, hash-and-capability lock after install, local fingerprint peer search over GitHub topic:dsh-plugin, and mechanical detox. Never executes the target plugin.
description.zh: DSH 插件的静态安全闸门与诊所：安装前静态审计、安装后哈希与能力锁定、本机指纹库与 GitHub dsh-plugin 主题的同类搜索、机械式剥离清理；永不执行目标插件。

description.en: dsh-pm is the ChunSun × DeepSeek Harness reference plugin: an AI-native project-delivery loop driven by ChunSun. Requirements / Runs / Steps / acceptance scenarios & cases / work-memory, a session delivery panel, and 28 chunsun_* model tools — with the platform as the single source of truth. MIT.
description.zh: 由 ChunSun 驱动的 AI 原生项目管理插件，自动跟踪需求、运行、步骤和验收场景，让交付流程更高效。

description.en: 一键优化提示词：在输入框工具行（发送按钮左侧）新增「优化」按钮。 点击后读取当前草稿把草稿重写为结构更清晰的提示词，并直接写回输入框。 长文本支持（输入框架构修复）： 修复 composer 的长文本缺陷
description.zh: 在输入框加个「优化」按钮，一键把草稿改写成更清晰的提示词，还能修复长文本输入问题。

description.en: A real Red Alert 2 AI battlefield plugin for DeepSeek Harness with fog-safe control, live DSH Chat, and post-match learning.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 在真正的红警 2 游戏里建基地、调兵打仗，边打边学，每局都更聪明。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 截图自动粘贴插件（需安装 DSH Desktop 版，仅 Win10/11，纯 AI 生成）：相机按钮 / 全局热键 Alt+A → 系统截图 → 自动粘贴进输入框 | Screenshot-to-input plugin for DeepSeek Harness Desktop (DSH Desktop app required; Windows 10/11 only; AI-generated): camera button & global hotkey Alt+A -> snip -> auto-paste into composer
description.zh: 点一下相机按钮或按 Alt+A 截图，自动粘进 DSH 输入框，省去手动保存上传。

description.en: DSH plugin that auto-continues a native continuable subagent once when it ends with explicit max-tokens termination — then stops. No loops, no timers, official seams only.
description.zh: 自动续跑因达到最大token数而中断的子代理，一次即止，避免任务半途而废。

description.en: A skin picker for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI

Token attention management panel for DeepSeek Harness: per-task/day/week/month token usage and cost tracking (input hit/miss, output, reasoning), DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, task-type recognition, and advice on when to switch sessions, write a hand-off, or compact context.
description.zh: Token 注意力管理面板：按任务/日/周/月记录 token 消耗与费用（命中/未命中/输出/推理四桶），支持 DeepSeek 峰谷计价与任务类型识别，并给出换对话、写 hand-off、压缩上下文的建议。

description.en: A document preview / edit / management plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It provides a VSCode-style "Document Center" workbench inside the DSH Web GUI: a file tree on the left, click-to-preview, editable code & Markdown with Ctrl/Cmd+S save; and exposes three document tools (doc_read / doc_edit / doc_create) to agents, letting models read and write workspace documents through natural language.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的文档预览 / 编辑 / 管理插件。在 DSH Web GUI 中提供一个 VSCode 风格的「文档中心」工作台：左侧文件树，点击即预览，代码与 Markdown 支持编辑与 Ctrl/Cmd+S 保存；同时为 Agent 暴露 doc_read / doc_edit / doc_create 三个文档工具，让模型可以通过自然语言读写工作区文档。

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加上麦克风，直接说话就能提问，解放双手。
把笔记当写作资料，边写边查，还带卷章管理，本地优先的写作工作台。

description.en: Integrated visual creation toolchain for DSH: prompt reverse-engineering and audit optimization plus multi-provider image generation with async background rendering.
description.zh: DSH 一体化视觉创作工具链：提示词反推与审计优化，多供应商生图，支持异步后台出图。

description.en: Windows desktop UI context picker for Codex, DeepSeek Harness, and MCP clients: select windows, UI elements, or screen regions with hover highlighting, UI Automation, screenshots, and local OCR, then review and approve Markdown/JSON context before output.
description.zh: 面向 Codex、DeepSeek Harness 和 MCP 客户端的 Windows 桌面 UI 上下文取景器：选择窗口、UI 元素或屏幕区域，使用悬停高亮、UI Automation、截图和本机 OCR，并在输出前确认 Markdown/JSON 上下文。

description.en: DSH 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面查看 OBJ/STL/STEP 三维模型，并转译为标准化、LLM 可读的 JSON（含语义分析），一键发送给 AI。
Self-update for the harness launcher; checks npm for a newer @deepseek-ai/dsh, stages the tarball, and applies it on harness exit or via update-and-restart from the web panel.
description.zh: Harness 启动器自更新插件；检查 npm 上的 @deepseek-ai/dsh 新版本，暂存 tarball，并在退出或通过面板「更新并重启」时应用。

description.en: Custom background wallpaper plugin for DeepSeek Harness chat page — upload local image or image link, tune opacity and dark overlay, scope to chat area or full screen.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 聊天页换自定义壁纸，支持本地上传或图片链接，还能调透明度和遮罩，聊天区或全屏都行。

description.en: Claude Code style TUI for Deepseek-Harness
Inspect, measure, search, and compare the exact provider-neutral context assembled by DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把每次模型请求的上下文完整记录下来，在会话里加个页签，方便查看、搜索和对比。

description.en: Self-hosted crypto portfolio dashboard: BTC, EVM (73 chains via DeBank), Solana, Dogecoin, Cardano, Hyperliquid L1, five exchanges (Binance, Bybit, Backpack, OKX, Bitget) and tokenised equities in one view, with multi-provider failover, custom asset labels, a tunable asset-health report, a shareable PNG card, per-source connection tests, multi-profile configs, scheduled refresh and zero-dependency charts (Python stdlib + vanilla JS, no CDN).
description.zh: 自托管加密资产仪表盘：BTC、EVM（DeBank 73 条链）、Solana、狗狗币、艾达币、Hyperliquid L1、五家交易所（Binance / Bybit / Backpack / OKX / Bitget）与代币化股票统一视图；多数据源自动切换、自定义资产类别标签、可调阈值的资产健康度报告、可分享的 PNG 卡片、每个数据源独立连通性测试、多 Profile 配置、定时刷新、零依赖图表（Python 标准库 + 原生 JS，无 CDN）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: review Markdown documents in a local browser with annotations, replacements, and deletion suggestions. Supports single files and whole directories.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: review Markdown documents in a local browser with annotations, replacements, and deletion suggestions. Supports single files and whole directories.

description.en: Vets local, npm, and GitHub plugin source before installation, blocks configured high-risk tool calls at runtime, audits output secret patterns, and writes HMAC-chained local audit logs.
description.zh: 在安装前体检本地、npm 与 GitHub 插件源码，运行时拦截命中配置阈值的高风险工具调用，审计输出中的密钥模式，并写入 HMAC 链式本地审计日志。

description.en: LLM compatibility auto-healer for transit/gateway providers: repairs DeepSeek `reasoning_content` replay and unsupported `developer` roles without a restart, exposes pi-ai compatibility settings, and adds redacted Chinese summaries for upstream errors.
description.zh: 自动修复中转网关的模型兼容问题，不用重启就能让请求正常跑通。

description.en: Local-first long-term memory and temporal knowledge graph plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 本地优先的长期记忆与时间知识图谱插件，让智能体记住过往对话并关联信息，提升上下文连贯性。

description.en: One-click phone access to DeepSeek Harness (DSH): Cloudflare quick tunnel + multi-channel push (ServerChan/PushPlus/Bark/ntfy/custom webhook).
适配插件中心的一键安装/卸载
description.zh: 一键安装或卸载 DeepSeek Harness 插件，复制即装、输入命令即卸，省去手动配置。

description.en: DSH 插件：Jupyter 式活体运行本——回合可回放的数据流 DAG，含 git 提交出处节点、子 agent 交接边、持久账本、悬停重跑与 LLM 解释
description.zh: 把研究项目变成可回放的活体运行本，支持数据流DAG、git溯源、子agent交接，悬停重跑还能让LLM解释每一步。

description.en: Image-background skin with four shipped wallpapers, a user wallpaper directory, custom image URLs, and live dim/blur controls in Settings.
description.zh: 图片背景皮肤：内置四张壁纸，支持用户壁纸目录与自定义图片链接，设置页实时调节压暗与模糊。

description.en: Candy-pink acrylic DSH Web theme with light conservatory and dark stage art, gold-pink chat frame, Taffy character overlays, and an optional agent preset.
description.zh: 粉金亚克力 DSH Web 主题，含浅色花房与深色舞台背景、粉金对话框、塔菲立绘装饰与可选 Agent 预设。

description.en: macOS-style skin with a swimming whale aquarium background and a dot-matrix whale send button for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的 macOS 风格皮肤：水中鲸鱼动态背景与点阵鲸鱼发送按钮，明暗双主题。

description.en: Manage Windows hosts over WinRM from a web panel and seven agent tools with PowerShell exec, service and process control, SMB / chunked file transfer with SHA-256 verification, and cluster execution.
description.zh: 通过 WinRM 管理 Windows 主机，提供 PowerShell 执行、服务与进程管理、SMB/分块文件传输（SHA-256 校验）、集群并发，以及 GUI 面板和七个 agent 工具。

description.en: Re-applies Chinese UI labels to the DSH client modules on every start, so translations survive upgrades.
description.zh: 每次启动自动将 DSH 界面英文工具与状态标签修补为中文，升级 DSH 后自动恢复，无需手动改文件。

description.en: Session export and compliance archiving for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic redaction, Markdown/JSONL/PDF outputs, on-disk archive management, and a trend/audit view.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话导出与合规归档：确定性脱敏、Markdown/JSONL/PDF 导出、磁盘归档管理与趋势/审计视图。

description.en: AI-native music player plugin for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and KuGou search with cross-provider playback fallback, renders word-by-word karaoke lyrics synced live over USB HID to HALO PIXELBAR speakers, and exposes search, playback, queue, alarm and speaker control as model tools.
description.zh: 运行于 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 原生音乐播放器（music player）：聚合网易云（NetEase）、QQ Music 与酷狗（KuGou）搜索并支持跨源播放回退，逐字卡拉OK歌词（karaoke lyrics）经 USB HID 实时同步至花再音箱（HALO PIXELBAR），搜索、播放、队列、闹钟与音箱控制均可由对话操控。

description.en: Import, install and invoke Agent Skills in DeepSeek Harness from Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, GitHub or npm — composer-side ⚡ picker inserts /skill-name into the draft, and a Skill 管理 settings page offers per-source/per-skill import, expandable source paths with skill counts, uninstall and one-click restore from .trash.
description.zh: 从 Codex / Claude Code / OpenCode / GitHub / npm 导入并安装技能到 ~/.dsh/skills，模型自动读取、/技能名 立即可用；对话框旁 ⚡ 一键插入调用，设置页支持按来源/单技能导入、路径与数量展示、卸载与一键恢复。

description.en: Deprecated: superseded by dsh-context-console; 0.1.1 remains available for rollback
description.zh: 消息锻造台插件，已停止更新，功能由 dsh-context-console 继承；旧版本仍可回滚使用。

description.en: DeepSeek API balance in the DSH sidebar · 在 DSH 侧边栏显示 DeepSeek API 余额
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接查看 DeepSeek API 余额，方便随时掌握用量，避免超额。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that delegates coding tasks to the Claude Code and Codex agent CLIs and streams the whole run live — autonomous control, multi-account, automatic install, git worktrees, and any Anthropic-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: 把编码任务一键委托给 Claude Code 和 Codex 命令行工具，实时直播执行过程，支持多账号、自动安装和 Git 工作树隔离。

description.en: A DSH ColorScheme Plugin
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供多款配色主题，可在设置中切换，并让悬停提示等界面元素跟随主题风格。

description.en: Native Windows Computer Use and configurable vision tools for DeepSeek Harness.
Delegate standalone tasks to the local Cursor CLI over ACP.
description.zh: 在对话中把独立任务直接交给本机已登录的 Cursor CLI 处理，实现 AI 协作分工。

description.en: DSH 下载管理器：右下角实时进度条，断点续传、多任务并发、镜像加速
description.zh: 右下角常驻下载进度面板，实时显示文件名、百分比、速度和剩余时间，多任务一目了然。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 内置嘉立创EDA(EasyEDA) WebSocket 网关桥接插件
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接操控本机嘉立创EDA专业版，画板改图不用来回切窗口。

description.en: Read-only market data for DeepSeek Harness. Ask about a stock, and let DSH call the data tools directly. | 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读金融市场数据。让 DSH 直接调用工具查询行情。
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接查股票行情和金融数据，只读安全，问一句就能拿到市场信息。

description.en: Live-reload upgraded DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins without restarting dsh — safe reloads in place, failed ones roll back and flag a restart.
description.zh: 不用重启 dsh，就能安全热更新插件；更新失败自动回滚并提示重启，省心又高效。

description.en: QQ official bot (q.qq.com) integration for DeepSeek Harness: chat with the full agent from private chats, groups and channels — WS long connection (heartbeat / reconnect / RESUME), per-chat session isolation, standard agent preset, approval inline buttons with /revoke, slash commands, whitelist fail-closed, credentials via the credentials domain.
description.zh: 接入 QQ 官方机器人（q.qq.com）：私聊 / 群聊 / 频道 @ 与完整 agent 对话——WS 长连接（心跳 / 重连 / RESUME）、每会话隔离、标准 agent preset、审批内联按钮 + /revoke、斜杠命令、白名单 fail-closed、凭据走凭据域。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness job hunting plugin and runtime skill for local job intelligence workflows.
description.zh: 本地优先的求职插件，帮你整理招聘岗位、确认求职画像、维护意向岗位，让求职流程更高效。

description.en: OI 出题工作台：知识点锁定、数据构造、本地评测，打包 Hydro/HOJ 原生题目包，发布/管理 Hydro 与 HOJ OJ，提供 Python 外部管理 UI 与系统斜杠命令。Opt-in skill-first plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在会话里帮你锁定知识点、造测试数据、本地评测，一键打包发布 Hydro/HOJ 题目。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 审批/选择方案系统级通知提醒，显示工作区名、点击跳转、多语言。Approval & decision alerts with native notifications for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 当 Harness 需要审批或选择方案时，弹出桌面通知提醒，显示工作区名并支持点击跳转，多语言。

description.en: 随手抽屉 · Handy Drawer — DSH plugin: stash 'later' snippets during AI chats, then pick & ask in place. 低打扰、不打断心流。
description.zh: 随手把聊天里稍后再看的片段收进抽屉，需要时就地追问，不打断心流。

description.en: Let DSH subagents call any Claude-compatible CLI, not just the SDK-bundled one. Fork of @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code.
description.zh: 让DSH子代理调用任意Claude兼容CLI，灵活切换后端，提升自动化效率。

description.en: Token usage statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI: per-request LLM usage captured from llm/stream, dual-axis trend charts, cache hit rate, API/model filters.
description.zh: Token usage statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI: per-request LLM usage captured from llm/stream, dual-axis trend charts, cache hit rate, API/model filters.

description.en: Hourly checks npm for newer versions of your installed dsh plugins and pops an approval bubble asking which to upgrade
description.zh: 每小时自动检查 npm 上你已安装的 dsh 插件是否有新版本，弹出气泡让你一键决定升级哪些。

description.en: LLM-as-a-verifier plugin for DeepSeek Harness: end-of-turn quality gate, best-of-N selection and assessment tools (port of llm-as-a-verifier)
Full-screen dynamic wallpaper from local videos and images, with live effect controls, wallpaper switching and Wallpaper Engine workshop import; settings persist automatically.
description.zh: 把本地视频/图片变成全屏动态壁纸，支持实时效果调节、壁纸切换与 Wallpaper Engine 工坊导入，设置自动保存永久生效。

description.en: Better Harness evidence lanes as three independently installable DeepSeek Harness skill bundles. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把 Harness 证据通道拆成三个独立安装的技能包，即插即用，零依赖，让智能体干活更顺手。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 `Windows 专属` 系统托盘插件。在 `dsh web` 运行期间，系统托盘会自动出现 DeepSeek 鲸鱼图标；服务停止后，托盘图标 3 秒内自动消失——托盘与服务同生命周期。同时自动维护一个静默桌面启动器 `DSH.lnk`，双击即可无窗口启动服务并打开浏览器。
description.zh: Windows 专属托盘插件，运行 dsh 时显示鲸鱼图标，停止后自动消失；双击桌面快捷方式即可无窗口启动服务并打开浏览器。

description.en: 把 Aloof 接成 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的原生工具。一张自带地址的接入令牌，粘一串就能用。
description.zh: 把 Aloof 接入 DeepSeek Harness，粘贴令牌就能用，AI 能直接帮你查连接状态和机器信息。

description.en: 原子朋克风格的共产主义公社
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上原子朋克风苏式公社皮肤，对话界面秒变宏伟建筑与红气球场景。

description.en: 让 DSH 桌面端壁纸持久不丢：支持 GIF 动图 & MP4 视频壁纸，内置全屏皮肤中心（上传、预览、一键应用、删除素材），重启、换端口、清缓存都不丢失。Server-side wallpaper & theme persistence for DSH Desktop — animated GIF / MP4 video wallpapers plus a full-screen skin center (upload, preview, apply, delete).
description.zh: 让 DSH 桌面壁纸和主题重启不丢失，支持 GIF/MP4 视频壁纸，内置全屏皮肤中心，上传预览一键应用。

description.en: Developer Preview: persistent DeepSeek Harness session branch visualizer with navigation, rename, archive, and compatibility adapters.
Cat-themed DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin with three original themes and a calm interactive companion. Not an official DeepSeek product.
Mark an exploration start in the session; pairs with rewind to fold the exploration out of context.
description.zh: 在会话中标记探索起点，配合回退功能将探索内容折叠出上下文，保持对话清爽。

description.en: Symbol-aware code indexing and hybrid search for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为代码库提供符号级索引与混合搜索，让智能体快速定位函数、类等定义。

description.en: OpenAI Codex CLI wrapper: one-shot exec, repo review and session resume with a default read-only sandbox.
description.zh: OpenAI Codex CLI 封装：一次性任务、仓库审查与会话续接，默认只读沙箱。

description.en: dsh-cost-guard — DeepSeek 成本守卫插件：会话成本核算（官方峰谷费率）、¥ 预算守卫、收敛引导、峰谷错峰队列；附对比测试报告
Kubernetes ops for the agent: get resources with structured JSON output, describe, logs, exec, apply/delete (user-confirmed) and port-forward.
description.zh: Kubernetes 运维：JSON 结构化查资源、describe、日志、exec、apply/delete（需确认）与端口转发。

description.en: ChatGPT Plus/Pro (Codex) adapter for the DeepSeek Harness LLM seam: PKCE/device OAuth, token refresh, and forwarding to chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/responses
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 的 Codex 模型，支持 OAuth 登录和令牌自动刷新，直接调用 Codex 接口。

description.en: Multi-model governance, routing, fallback, quota, and usage for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 帮你统一管理多个大模型，支持智能切换、故障自动重试、额度管控与用量统计，让模型调用更稳定省心。

description.en: LongCat-2.0 LLM adapter: 1M context, binary thinking mode, tool calling, and streaming over the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: LongCat-2.0 模型适配器：100 万上下文、二元思考模式、工具调用，基于 OpenAI 兼容接口的流式输出。

description.en: 把"以后再说"的灵感，准时摆到你面前：随手记下，到点由 AI 自动替你把它想透、做透，回来只看结果。
description.zh: 随手记下灵感待办并设好时间，到期AI自动帮你理清或出结果，回来只管看成品。

description.en: The Matrix movie theme for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI — installable dsh plugin: green-on-black palette, digital-rain backdrop, and a General-settings toggle.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上黑客帝国主题，绿字黑底加数字雨特效，还能在设置里一键切换。

description.en: OpenCode Go (opencode.ai/zen/go) quota usage card for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI sidebar - day/week/month progress bars, DS peak/valley billing strip, customizable auto-refresh interval.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏常驻 OpenCode Go 额度卡片，实时显示日/周/月用量进度条和费用，支持自定义刷新间隔。

description.en: A pixel companion living in the chat area: hatches from an egg into one of three sprites or an LLM-drawn custom one from a text description, platform-jumps over message bubbles on its own, WASD controllable, chats in character through the models you already configured, and carries a nurture system (mood/power/health, levels, shop) driven by real token usage.
description.zh: 聊天区里的像素小宠物：从蛋孵化三选一，也可用一句话描述让 LLM 画出自定义形象，自动在消息气泡间平台跳跃，支持 WASD 操控与拖拽，用已配置的模型角色扮演陪聊，养成系统（心情/电量/健康、等级、商店）由真实 token 消耗驱动。

description.en: Background image plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI (dsh web): upload local images as the whole-UI background, with a theme-aware readability matte, WebP-first compression and IndexedDB persistence.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面设置本地图片作为全屏背景，带智能遮罩和自动压缩，随时可清除。

description.en: DSH plugin: a global-prompt textarea in Settings > General, injected into every conversation system prompt
description.zh: 在设置中配置一段全局提示词，自动注入每次对话的系统提示词，保存即生效，留空即停用。

description.en: One-click restart button for DeepSeek Harness (DSH Desktop)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个一键重启按钮，点一下就能快速重启，省事又高效。

description.en: Quick temporary conversation and workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 临时对话工作区自动化管理插件。

description.en: 还在为繁杂的log而苦恼吗？直接拓扑展示，清晰理顺所有，多智能体也不怕。
description.zh: 把杂乱的会话日志变成3D执行图，主线和子智能体分叉汇合一目了然，还能逐条追溯原始日志。

description.en: Adds a Windows Explorer right-click action to open a folder as a DSH workspace, launching DSH if needed.
description.zh: 给 Windows 文件管理器加右键项：把文件夹设为 DSH 工作区并切换到它，DSH 未运行会自动拉起。

description.en: Tavily search provider for DeepSeek Harness with full search-control mapping, credential-backed key UI, and guarded rc.6 patches.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Tavily 搜索，支持完整搜索控制映射和密钥管理，并兼容 rc.6 版本。

description.en: Evidence-preserving tool output compression for DeepSeek Harness — deterministic, local-first, and benchmarked.
description.zh: 压缩工具输出，保留关键证据，省token又省心，本地运行快又稳。

description.en: 像 Claude Code 一样，DeepSeek Harness 现在也允许您自定义等待 AI 回复时的状态提示语。您可以根据不同轮次或场景，灵活替换占位文案，让开发助手在“思考”时也能传递您想要的信息。
description.zh: 让 DSH 等待 AI 回复时的状态文字变成你自定义的轮次短语，不同场景随时换。

description.en: DSH plugin: precise API usage statistics (tokens, cost, cache hit rate, per-model breakdown) with multi-provider balance & quota monitoring (OpenCode, DeepSeek).
description.zh: DSH plugin: precise API usage statistics (tokens, cost, cache hit rate, per-model breakdown) with multi-provider balance & quota monitoring (OpenCode, DeepSeek).

description.en: China-ready voice input for the composer. Requires a local Python bridge (pip install dashscope websockets, run bridge/voice-bridge.py) — the plugin alone does not work. Browser mic streams 16 kHz PCM to the bridge, which runs Alibaba Cloud DashScope ASR (paraformer-realtime-v2); interim text fills the draft at the cursor, silence auto-stop, optional auto-send.
description.zh: 国内可用的输入框语音输入。需要先启动本地 Python bridge（pip install dashscope websockets，运行 bridge/voice-bridge.py）——只装插件不可用。浏览器麦克风采集 16kHz PCM 流式转发给 bridge，由阿里云 DashScope ASR（paraformer-realtime-v2）识别；识别文字在光标处实时填入草稿，静音自动停止，可选识别后自动发送。

description.en: Microsoft Web IQ search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, endpoint, language, region, passage length and SafeSearch.
description.zh: 基于 Microsoft Web IQ 的网页搜索提供方，接入内置 web_search 工具，并提供 API Key、端点、语言、地区、摘要长度与 SafeSearch 的设置卡片。

description.en: Manage the DSH web service from a settings panel: status, version, restart, stop, and one-click updates.
description.zh: 在设置面板中管理 DSH Web 服务:状态、版本、重启、停止与一键更新。

description.en: Per-model first-turn chain-of-thought anchor presets for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 预设每模型首轮思维链锚点，一键切换标准、PTC、创造模式，灵活控制推理强度。

description.en: DSH 插件：对话区左缘轮次图标列，点击定位到每轮用户输入文本。A DSH plugin: left-edge turn rail, click to locate each turn's user message.
description.zh: DSH 静态 bundle 插件：定位当前会话中每次通过输入框发送的消息。会话标题栏「消息定位」按钮 → 右侧浮动面板列出全部已发送消息（序号/时间/摘要），支持关键词搜索、点击展开全文、一键回填输入框重新使用。A static-bundle DSH plugin that locates every message you sent from the composer.

description.en: Lets the DSH web UI attach files of any type as pathless @-mentions: pick a workspace file from the @ menu or drop one into the composer, and the agent reads it directly.
description.zh: 让 DSH 网页以无路径 @提及 附加任意类型文件：可从 @ 菜单挑选工作区文件，或拖入输入区，Agent 直接读取。

description.en: Lexmount Browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
A plugin for Deepseek Harness (well it may support other AI agent IDEs but I hadn't test it out yet) that checks for error when AI had finished writing the code.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 代码全面检查插件：三步流水线（编译运行检查 → 功能完整性核对 → 真实用户模拟测试），自动把问题反馈给 AI 修复，可选用 GUI，并附带适用于 Trae/Qoder 等平台的独立 CLI 与 MCP 服务

description.en: CPA account-pool status panel: sidebar health light, quota bars, success-rate ticks, and gateway key endings.
description.zh: CPA 账号池状态面板：侧栏健康灯、配额进度、成功率刻度与网关密钥末四位一览。

description.en: 给dsh增加下问题跳转与会话删除的功能
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上会话问题跳转和删除会话功能，找问题、清会话都更省事。

description.en: DSH plugin discovery browser - browse & search community plugins on GitHub (read-only, no one-click installs)

Econometrics research assistant: 6 tools covering method selection, data preparation, model specification, empirical analysis with Python/R/Stata code templates, robustness checks, and result reporting.
description.zh: 计量经济学研究助手：6 个工具覆盖方法选择、数据预处理、模型设定、实证分析（含 Python/R/Stata 代码模板）、稳健性检验与结果报告。

description.en: Adds generation_fork and generation_run to copy an agent preset and run a task on a new session.
description.zh: 提供 generation_fork 与 generation_run，用于拷贝 Agent preset 并在新会话上跑任务。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供桃濑日和的动态插件
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 换上暖色温柔界面，还配了会回应你的桃濑日和动态伴侣。

description.en: Prunes the tool schema to a whitelist and injects a structural preamble on a session's first turn only, then passes every later turn through untouched.
description.zh: 只在会话首轮把工具清单裁剪到白名单并注入一段结构化前言，之后每一轮原样放行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的用量（Usage）部署级插件：会话视图环新增「用量」页签，实时跟踪输入/输出/缓存命中 tokens 与费用（DeepSeek 官方峰谷价 + OpenCode Go 套餐价），动态渐变蓝状态条、自定义价格表、CSV/JSON 导出。原生UI界面
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中实时查看 token 用量和费用，支持峰谷价与套餐价，可导出数据。

description.en: Runs reproducible DSH profile and patch experiments with guided case authoring, assertions, Web comparison reports, recovery, and policy gates.
description.zh: 运行可复现的 DSH Profile 与 Patch 实验，并提供引导式用例构建、断言、Web 对比报告、恢复和策略门禁。

description.en: Voice control and multi-session task dispatch for DeepSeek Harness, powered by Qwen Audio Agent

Remote-SSH-style workspaces: turn an SSH host and a remote directory into a native DSH workspace; the agent operates the remote filesystem directly via 12 rw_* tools (SFTP/exec), with workspace-confined paths and known_hosts verification.
description.zh: Remote-SSH 风格工作区：把 SSH 主机上的远程目录变成原生 DSH 工作区，agent 通过 12 个 rw_* 工具（SFTP/exec）直接操作远程文件，路径限定在工作区内并校验 known_hosts。

description.en: Skill management panel for the DeepSeek Harness web app
Windows minimal agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: fixed one-line persona, three tools, no runtime context.
description.zh: Windows 极简模式 preset：单句 persona、三工具、无运行时上下文。

description.en: Shows real-time token and cost savings from the Headroom compression proxy in the DSH web UI: a Settings dashboard plus a persistent stats line under the composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内实时展示 Headroom 压缩代理的 token 与费用节省：设置页仪表盘 + 输入区常驻统计行。

description.en: 琉璃主题——为DeepSeek Harness打造实用美观的主题UI
description.zh: 琉璃主题 —— DenpaPush 复刻主题插件：M3 动态取色、壁纸磨砂材质、声纹可视化、日/夜切换
给 AI 助手接上全网搜索，网页图片视频加天气股票汇率等实时数据一搜就有。

description.en: Life-story skill: capture moments and fragments, build a user profile and generate novels, scripts or autobiographies.
description.zh: 闪念记录与人生拼图技能：捕捉生活点滴，构建画像并生成小说、剧本或自传。

description.en: Hana-style assistant manager for DSH: visual preset management (cards, yuan personalities, avatar cropping) plus a full Hana memory stack (rolling summaries, layered compilation, SQLite fact store, deep memory).
description.zh: Hana 式助手管理：可视化配置助手预设（卡片、四性格「元」、头像裁剪），并完整复刻 Hana 记忆系统（滚动摘要、分层编译、SQLite 事实库、深度记忆）。

description.en: 🐳 DeepSeek brand whale progress indicator for DSH Web GUI — swims above the composer while the agent works, with spout animation and todo-progress tracking

Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek: send images (alone or mixed with text) and a fast tiny vision model describes them behind the scenes — the chat keeps the picture, DeepSeek sees only text. Pure plugin: uninstall restores everything.
description.zh: 视觉桥：纯文本 DeepSeek 也能收图（单独发、图文混发均可），快速小识图模型后台描述，对话框里图还在、模型只见文字；纯插件，卸载即复原。

description.en: Automatically loads the full conversation history when a session opens, so older messages are ready without clicking "Load earlier".
description.zh: 打开会话时自动加载全部历史消息，免去反复点击「加载更早」。

description.en: Pre-flight plugin-library index for DSH agents: injects per-step trigger-table hints into the runtime context so suitable installed plugins get used predictably instead of opportunistically.
description.zh: DSH agent 的插件库起飞检查：向运行时上下文注入按步骤触发的提示，让合适的已装插件从「碰巧想起」变成「可预期使用」。

description.en: Runs one coding prompt across multiple configured models in isolated Git worktrees, streams side-by-side tool traces and results, and commits the candidate the user adopts for later rounds.
description.zh: 让多个编程智能体并行跑同一任务，并排对比结果，帮你选出最优代码方案。

description.en: Session-scoped @file/@folder mentions in the composer with Git-aware indexing, drag-drop and paste managed uploads, and validated path markers.
description.zh: 输入框内 session 范围的 @文件/@文件夹提及：Git 感知索引、拖放与粘贴受管上传、经校验的路径标记。

description.en: Local-memory lifecycle for the official Hindsight plugin on DSH desktop: one-click start/stop of the hindsight-embed daemon, auto-start on boot, stop on exit, hides the uv.exe console window, and installs the vault/models to another drive.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端官方 Hindsight 插件补齐本地记忆生命周期：一键启停 hindsight-embed 守护进程、开机自启、退出随停、隐藏 uv.exe 黑框，并支持把档案柜与模型装到其它盘。

description.en: Dockable Markdown preview for the DSH Web UI: side-by-side with the conversation, a per-session recently-read .md list, local relative-path images render in place, and clicking an in-chat .md reference previews it instead of launching the system editor; follows the shell light/dark theme.
description.zh: DSH Web 端可停靠的 Markdown 预览面板：与对话并排展示，会话级「最近打开 .md」列表，本地相对路径图片可直接渲染；点击对话中的 .md 引用改为并排预览而非唤起系统编辑器；跟随 shell 深浅色主题。

description.en: More agent presets for DSH, derived from other coding agents such as Qwen Code and iFlow.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供更多智能体预设，衍生自其他编程智能体（例如 Qwen Code、iFlow）。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-more-agent-presets
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-more-agent-presets

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: A desktop pet in the DSH web GUI: floating, draggable sprite pet that animates with agent activity (thinking, idle, error, done, awaiting approval), with a settings page for size, switching, gallery search and one-click pet install. Ships 4 bundled Hunter x Hunter starter pets.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的桌面宠物：右下角悬浮、可拖拽，随智能体活动切换精灵动画；设置页可管理大小、启停切换、图库搜索与一键安装宠物。内置 4 个全职猎人主角宠物包。
