description.en: TikTok-style video feed in a floating sidebar window: swipe local or SMB-NAS folders, or paste online video URLs (yt-dlp, bilibili/YouTube, cookies.txt login state); the window auto-fits the video aspect ratio, with fullscreen, drag-resize, Range streaming and an agent video-queue endpoint.
description.zh: 侧栏浮动窗口里的抖音式刷视频：本地/SMB NAS 文件夹上下滑动，或粘贴在线视频地址（yt-dlp 解析，支持 bilibili/YouTube 与 cookies.txt 登录态）；窗口随视频宽高比自适应，支持全屏、拖动缩放、Range 流式播放，并提供 agent 视频推送队列端点。

description.zh: 增强 DSH 设置管理，提供更灵活、更高效的配置选项，让插件设置更顺手。

description.en: Security-audit methodology skill pack: eight agent skills (secret scan, dependency audit, supply-chain review, prompt-injection review, audit orchestration, threat modeling, vuln intel, incident response) in Chinese and English editions, with an optional npm provider bundle.
description.zh: 安全审计方法论技能包：八个 agent 技能（密钥扫描、依赖审计、供应链评审、提示注入审查、审计总编排、威胁建模、漏洞情报、事件响应），中英双版本，附可选 npm provider 包一键挂载。

description.en: Fridge-magnet quick-task stickers docked above the composer: one-click sends a preloaded prompt into the current session, grouped long-term/short-term.
description.zh: 输入框上方的冰箱贴纸栏：把常用任务（科技新闻、GitHub 推荐等）做成贴纸，点击即向当前会话发送预置 prompt 并执行，按长期/短期分组。

description.en: Sub-agent matrix swarm that routes heterogeneous tasks to the most suitable model from an OpenRouter-like gateway plus cfgpu.com/llm/square, dispatches each via in-process subagents or direct LLM calls, and tracks per-model token consumption with a feedback-driven ranking.
description.zh: 子智能体矩阵蜂群：把异质任务路由到最合适的模型（OpenRouter 类网关 + cfgpu.com/llm/square），通过进程内子智能体或直接 LLM 调用下放，并按模型统计 token 消耗、用真实反馈驱动排名。

description.en: DSH 插件：tokensave 语义图 cli 直连——自动索引 + 更新检测，让 AI 用语义查询代替暴力 grep/读文件，大幅省 token
Unreal Engine .uasset inspection (resolve/registry/load) and restricted Blueprint node editing through built-in UE Python.
description.zh: 通过 Unreal 内置 Python 提供 .uasset 检查与受限蓝图节点编辑。

description.en: DSH 字体插件：界面字体/代码字体/显示比例/行高/字体浏览器 | DSH font plugin: UI/code fonts, display scale, line-height, font browser with CJK glyph marking
description.zh: DSH 字体插件：修改整个界面的文字显示效果（正文字体 / 代码字体 / 显示比例 / 行高 / 字体平滑 / 代码连字 / 字体浏览器 / 中文字形标记），设置 → 字体。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Skin Plugin
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供预设配色皮肤，可一键切换界面主题并记住你的选择。

description.en: Google AI Studio-style floating preview for the Web UI: a draggable/resizable iframe preview with aspect-ratio and resolution presets, plus a VS Code-style code window with direct editing, confirmed writes, and session-log recording.
description.zh: Web UI 悬浮预览与代码窗口：Google AI Studio 风格的 iframe 预览（宽幅比/分辨率预设、一键放大），VS Code 风格代码窗支持直接编辑，保存需确认并写入会话日志。

description.en: WeChat (iLink) channel: chat with your DSH agent from the WeChat app, one persistent session per conversation, reusing DSH credentials.
description.zh: 微信（iLink）通道：用手机微信直接对话 DSH agent，每个对话一个持久会话，复用 DSH 凭据。

description.en: 🐳 DSH 傻瓜整合包：以 Oh-DSH 为基座的 DeepSeek Harness 发行版外壳——核心 17 组件开箱即用、三界面（webui/gui/tui）一包切换、模型↔预设联动、一切皆插件

Multi-character Galgame conversation view with separate character and reply-model selection, per-character affection, memory, dialogue history, and CG galleries, plus responses informed by task events across Harness sessions.
description.zh: 多角色 Galgame 对话界面：角色与回复模型可独立切换，分角色保存好感度、记忆、对话历史与 CG 图鉴，并根据 Harness 跨会话任务事件做出角色回应。

description.en: Conversational DSH plugin finder: four-source unified index, BM25 pre-filter plus LLM semantic ranking, candidates carry evidence grades and local static security audit, safe install flow with post-install verification.
description.zh: 对话式查找 DSH 插件的增强版 skill：四源聚合统一索引，BM25 粗筛 + LLM 语义精排，候选表带证据分级与本地静态安全审计，安装走安全确认流程并自动验证。

description.en: Reuses hooks declared in Claude Code, Codex and opencode configs on dsh, executing shell, webhook, oracle and proxy handlers with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code、Codex、opencode 配置里声明的 hooks 原样复用到 dsh，执行 shell、webhook、oracle、proxy 四类 handler，零运行时依赖。

description.en: MiniMax token-plan quota dock for the Web UI: a drop-shape 5h-usage % chip in the conversation input area, click for a detail panel listing every model's 5h & weekly usage and reset countdown, auto-hidden when the active default model is not a MiniMax model.
description.zh: DSH 网页 MiniMax 配额悬浮卡：会话输入区显示水滴形 5h 已用百分比，点击展开详情面板，列出每个模型的 5h/周用量与重置倒计时，当前默认模型非 MiniMax 时自动隐藏。

description.en: Local-first full-duplex voice for DeepSeek Harness, orchestrated by Muxiva
description.zh: Local-first, full-duplex voice for DeepSeek Harness, orchestrated by Muxiva

description.en: Per-task isolated git worktrees with a full create/sync/finish lifecycle: task names auto-derive branches, merge targets are double-checked, and batch cleanup is built in — zero manual git operations.
description.zh: 按任务隔离的 git worktree 工作区，覆盖创建/同步/收尾全生命周期：任务名自动派生分支、合并目标双重校验、内置批量清理——全程零手工 git 操作。

description.en: Design mode for DeepSeek Harness: the design-loop agent preset plus design-principles and design-qa skill packs
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上设计模式，内置设计循环智能体和设计原则、设计 QA 技能包，帮你本地搞定 UI 设计。

description.en: Complement to official Creator mode: stage, validate, live-mount via ctx.plugin, score, and solidify or roll back in-memory tool-plugin trials.
description.zh: 补充官方创造模式：把内存里试过的小工具插件校验、经 ctx.plugin 热挂、打分后固化到盘上或回滚。

description.en: Cooperative timeout guard for ask_user_question: lost or unanswered questions resolve as a structured ASK_TIMEOUT instead of hanging the turn forever.
description.zh: 为 ask_user_question 提供协作式超时守卫：提问卡片丢失或用户未答复时以结构化 ASK_TIMEOUT 结束调用，避免回合无限挂起。

description.en: DSH plugin: /balance command, composer-dock balance readout with top-up link, session-cost estimate
description.zh: DSH plugin: /balance command, composer-dock balance readout with top-up link, session-cost estimate

description.en: Session-header button that cycles the conversation width (748-1600px), widening the chat column, composer, and user bubbles together.
description.zh: 会话标题栏按钮循环切换对话宽度（748–1600px），消息区、输入框、用户气泡同步加宽。

description.en: Automatic type-check diagnostics: after the model edits or creates TS files, runs `tsc --noEmit` in the background (debounced per project) and reports errors via the `code_check` tool — grouped by file with line/column, severity and TS error codes, closing the "edit → check → fix" loop.
description.zh: 自动类型检查诊断：模型编辑/创建 TS 文件后后台防抖运行 `tsc --noEmit`，经 `code_check` 工具按文件分组汇报错误（行列号 + 严重级别 + TS 错误码），形成「改 → 查 → 修」闭环。

description.en: DeepSeek API usage dashboard for DSH Web: daily cache-hit/miss and output token statistics from session logs, per-model cost estimates, account balance, 7-day trends, and a composer usage summary.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 DeepSeek API 用量仪表盘：基于会话日志统计每日缓存命中/未命中输入与输出 Token，并展示分模型费用估算、账户余额、7 日趋势和 composer 用量摘要。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI 插件：输入 @ 引用工作区文件，体验类似 Claude Code 的 @file。
description.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI 插件：输入 @ 引用工作区文件，体验类似 Claude Code 的 @file。

description.en: DSH-Feishu channel plugin
description.zh: 飞书通道：新建会话选「连接飞书」，飞书消息直接进 DSH 会话。

description.en: Capability transform & assembly engine (Qian Xuesen cybernetics/systems framework): static resident layer manages the skill/MCP/plugin registries, auto-absorbs skills and tool metrics, and drives a negative-feedback evolution loop (scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select promote/reject → 30s rollback); includes a Web UI panel and a GitHub dsh-plugin store bridge.
description.zh: 能力转化与组装引擎（钱学森工程控制论/系统论框架）：静态常驻层管理 skill/MCP/插件三库、自动吸收技能与工具度量，驱动负反馈进化闭环（scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select 晋升/淘汰 → 30s 回滚）；含 Web UI 面板与 GitHub dsh-plugin 商店桥。

description.en: Git hygiene checker: read-only scan of merged and stale branches, oversized tracked files, untracked files and uncommitted work, with cleanup suggestions (it never deletes anything).
description.zh: Git 卫生巡检：只读扫描已合并/过期分支、大文件、未跟踪文件与未提交修改，输出体检报告与清理建议，不自动删除任何东西。

description.en: Conventional-commit enforcement, changelog generation, PR summaries and branch pushes through the plain git CLI.
description.zh: 规范提交（Conventional Commits）、自动 changelog、PR 描述生成与分支推送，纯 git CLI 实现。

description.en: Self-maintaining handoff memory per working directory and git branch: records turns, folds them into concise Markdown, and injects the result into future sessions from ~/.agent/agent-handoff, byte-compatible with pi-handoff.
description.zh: 每个工作目录与 git 分支自动维护 handoff.md：记录回合、折叠为简洁 Markdown 并注入后续会话，存储于 ~/.agent/agent-handoff，与 pi-handoff 字节级兼容。

description.en: 不用一直在电脑前，远程操控Deepseek Harness，在飞书 / 企业微信 / Telegram 里指挥 DeepSeek Harness：远程派活 · 结果通知 · 危险操作审批
description.zh: 在飞书、企业微信或 Telegram 里远程指挥 DeepSeek Harness，派活、收通知、审批危险操作。

description.en: A green interrupt button beside the send box: silently stops a running agent, which then summarizes its progress and asks for your new requirements, with a customizable interrupt prompt.
description.zh: 发送按钮旁的绿色打断按钮：运行时一键静默中断 AI，AI 停止后总结进展并向你征求新要求，支持自定义打断提示词。

description.en: Vision-augmented DeepSeek adapter: a vision-capable model describes image input, then a text-only DeepSeek model reasons over the description.
description.zh: 视觉增强的 DeepSeek 适配器：由视觉模型把图片描述成文字，纯文本 DeepSeek 模型再基于描述推理。

description.en: Long-task orchestration loop: Codex plans/scores/reviews, DeepSeek executes, Kimi supplements (vision acceptance, summarization, cross-check).
description.zh: 长任务编排闭环：Codex 规划/打分/审核，DeepSeek 执行，Kimi 补充（视觉验收/摘要/交叉验证）。

description.en: Windows Minimal Mode: persistent bash + str_replace_editor dsh plugin — registers an agent preset, provides a working persistent-bash backend on Windows, and exposes a GUI-editable bash path in the plugin-settings section (persisted via the credentials domain).

Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: compact typography, full-width composer with caret fix, drawer sidebar with overlay-close, two-page settings flow, responsive tables and stats, safe touch targets.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：紧凑排版、全宽输入卡（含光标修复）、抽屉式侧边栏（点击遮罩关闭）、两页式设置流程、响应式表格与统计、安全触控目标。

description.en: Task-completion notifications via ServerChan / DingTalk / Feishu / generic webhooks.
description.zh: 任务完成通知：ServerChan / 钉钉 / 飞书 / 通用 Webhook。

description.en: Join ACN from DeepSeek Harness: register this agent, discover others, send messages, read the inbox. Defaults to the China region.
description.zh: 让你的 AI Agent 加入 ACN 网络，自动发现其他智能体并互发消息，默认直连国内节点。

description.en: A plugin market for DeepSeek Harness: search and one-click install GitHub dsh-plugin plugins straight from the web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件市场：在 Web 界面里搜索并一键安装 GitHub 上的 dsh-plugin 插件。

description.en: In-app DSH plugin marketplace panel with curated and full catalogs, keyword and semantic search, Chinese translation, favorites, installed-state tracking, and install/update/uninstall via the official CLI.
description.zh: DSH 内置插件市场面板：精选与全量目录、关键词与语义搜索、中文翻译、收藏、已安装状态，以及通过官方命令安装、更新和卸载。

description.en: Floating restart button for the DSH web GUI: restarts the dsh process in place with a full-screen overlay and auto-reloads the page; no launcher script required, works on Windows/macOS/Linux.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面右下角的一键重启按钮：全屏遮罩原地重启 dsh 进程并自动刷新页面；无需启动脚本，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux。

description.en: Right-click session menu and sidebar session manager: pin, rename, archive, fork, export, copy cwd/id/deep link, and open in explorer or a new window.
description.zh: 会话行右键菜单与侧边栏会话管理：置顶、重命名、归档、分叉、导出、复制工作目录/会话 ID/深链，在资源管理器或新窗口打开。

description.en: Session repair button in the conversation header: detects & fixes session-log corruption — tool-call id swaps, empty call ids (`message must have tool source`), unknown event types from disabled plugins (marks `ignorable`), torn zstd tails, missing final-frame newlines; ghost-style UI, auto-backup before writes.
description.zh: 会话头部一键修复日志损坏，解决会话加载失败、发不出消息的问题。

description.en: Per-session cost & usage report cards: tokens, cache hits, duration.
description.zh: 会话成本与耗时报表：tokens / 缓存命中 / 耗时。

description.en: 智能输入插件 for DeepSeek Harness — 语音输入 + 提示词优化
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上语音输入和提示词优化，说话就能提问，还能把话自动润色成好用的提示词。

description.en: A curated plugin starter pack: batch-installs and configures 15 vetted community plugins across four groups from a Settings-page UI or the /setup command.
description.zh: 精选插件启动包：从设置页或 /setup 命令一键批量安装并配置 4 组共 15 个经过筛选的社区插件。

description.en: Real-time session token usage and estimated cost in the composer stats row, with pricing fetched from DeepSeek official pricing page.
description.zh: 在输入框下方统计行实时显示当前会话累计 token 消耗与估算费用（人民币），价格从 DeepSeek 官方价格页动态获取。

description.en: Professional translation for DSH: 18 target languages, 4 styles (formal/casual/technical/literal), glossary-controlled terminology, and whole-file translation (README/docs/subtitles) with Markdown/code-block format preservation; powered by DeepSeek via SiliconFlow.
description.zh: 专业翻译：18 种目标语言、4 种风格（正式/口语/技术/直译）、术语表控制译名、整文件翻译（README/文档/字幕）并保留 Markdown 与代码块格式；经 SiliconFlow 调用 DeepSeek。

description.en: Conversation header badge showing the DeepSeek Harness version, checking npm for the latest release and prompting upgrades.
description.zh: 会话顶栏徽章：显示 DeepSeek Harness 当前版本，自动检查 npm 最新版本，有新版时提示升级。

description.en: Weekly digest generator: aggregates git commits, DSH session activity and daily memory entries into a Markdown weekly report, read-only.
description.zh: 周报生成器：聚合最近 N 天的 git 提交、会话活动与每日记忆，自动生成 Markdown 周报，全程只读。

description.en: Pokemon-style catch-em-all: your real work is the tall grass — turns, tool calls and errors spawn wild encounters; throw balls, fill a 28-slot dex, walk a team of six. Zero tokens, invisible to the model.
description.zh: 宝可梦式捕捉收集：真实工作就是草丛 —— 回合、工具调用、报错刷出野外遭遇；投球捕捉、集 28 格图鉴、带 6 只队伍。零 token，模型完全看不见。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness adapter for the public Falsify CLI. Adjudicator receipt, not a second-opinion workflow.
description.zh: falsify-dsh — DSH 插件（编排）

description.en: macOS Keychain credential provider that replaces the local-file provider and uses a signed, notarized universal helper.
description.zh: macOS Keychain 凭据提供器：替换本地文件提供器，并使用已签名、公证的通用二进制辅助程序。

description.en: Mermaid 可视化编辑器 · DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 浏览器插件：右侧可关闭面板，画布与 Mermaid 代码双向同步，AI 工具通道自动导入（flowchart / sequenceDiagram / classDiagram / erDiagram）

WeChat iLink ClawBot bridge: official Tencent iLink protocol, Web UI settings (QR login / model / preset / permissions / session management with delete), 24h auto-renewal pushes a fresh QR before expiry, zero downtime.
description.zh: 把微信消息接进 DSH，扫码登录就能用，还能自动续期，聊天不掉线。

description.en: A floating command deck that lists every slash command in DeepSeek Harness as runnable buttons, sorted by usage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的悬浮命令甲板：把所有斜杠命令列成可执行按钮，悬停看介绍，按使用次数排序。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 常驻额度卡片插件:自动识别已配置的平台 API Key,显示余额与 Coding Plan 额度
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 常驻额度卡片插件:自动识别已配置的平台 API Key,显示余额与 Coding Plan 额度

description.en: Feishu (Lark) IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness via `dsh plugin add`; one DM user to one persistent dsh session, with full debugging docs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 私聊桥接插件，支持 `dsh plugin add` 一键安装，配套完整调试文档。

description.en: Adds approval-gated Git status, diff, log, commit, branch, and optional checkpoint tools.
description.zh: 增加需要审批的 Git 状态、diff、日志、提交、分支和可选检查点工具。

description.en: Multi-engine reverse image search aggregator: Google Lens, Baidu, Yandex, TinEye, SauceNAO, IQDB, Ascii2d.
description.zh: 多引擎反向识图聚合：Google Lens、百度、Yandex、TinEye、SauceNAO、IQDB、Ascii2d。

description.en: Render Markdown to a standalone, self-contained HTML page: an `md_html_render` tool that works in a headless profile, plus a web drawer to browse, preview, edit and export local `.md` files; both share one renderer, with no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把 Markdown 渲染为自包含的独立 HTML 页面：提供在 headless 配置下同样可用的 `md_html_render` 工具，以及在网页端浏览、预览、编辑并导出本地 `.md` 文件的抽屉；两个入口共用同一个渲染器，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Cited memory over DSH's lossless session log: distilled facts carry `(sessionId, eventRange)` citations that expand back to the exact original log excerpt.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 无损会话日志的引用式记忆：蒸馏出的事实带 `(sessionId, eventRange)` 引用，可随时展开回原始日志片段。

description.en: 修罗小脑斧 — animated desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web surface: v2 spritesheet animation, drag & drop, look-at-mouse, settings panel
Plugin center: discover, install, and manage DSH plugins from Settings.
description.zh: 插件中心：在设置页发现、安装与管理 DSH 插件。

description.en: Read-only Windows device information tools: one agent tool per Win32 device category (time, system, cpu, memory, disk, gpu, network, battery, processes, usb, audio, printers) via WMI/CIM and Node os collectors.
description.zh: 只读的 Windows 设备信息工具：每个 Win32 设备类别一个 agent 工具（时间、系统、CPU、内存、磁盘、GPU、网络、电池、进程、USB、音频、打印机），基于 WMI/CIM 与 Node os 采集。

description.en: Update manager for installed plugins: check for updates, back up, and roll back.
description.zh: 已装插件更新管理：检查更新、备份与回滚。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的只读环境探测插件，为智能体提供运行环境、软件版本、系统资源、端口、服务、硬件及工作区信息。
description.zh: 让 AI 随时探查运行环境（平台、命令、用户等），按需获取系统信息，辅助决策。

description.en: dsh-skin 增强版：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供皮肤切换与自定义背景壁纸。在原版基础上修复了两处问题——① 大图/特殊格式上传无响应（改用 createImageBitmap 直接解码、增加处理中与错误提示）；② 主题切换时 overrideTokens 触发 theme/change 导致无限递归栈溢出（加皮肤/明暗守卫断开循环）。壁纸存储从 localStorage 压缩方案改为 IndexedDB 原文件直存，全画质显示、零压缩，并自动迁移旧数据。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 换肤换壁纸，修复大图上传卡死和主题切换崩溃，让界面更顺手。

description.en: Reasonix-style sound effects for DeepSeek Harness: generative pentatonic ambient music while the agent works, E6-G6-C7 success chime, A6-E6…
description.zh: dsh-sound-effects-plugin — DSH 插件（编排）

description.en: Per-call model, provider, persona, and toolFilter overrides for subagent delegation, with @preset: references and provider/model composite ids.
description.zh: 子代理委派的按调用覆盖：model/provider/persona/toolFilter、@preset: 引用与 provider/model 组合 id。

description.en: Turn-scoped “Allow for this task” approvals: automatically allow matching `danger-full-access` escalations only for the current task, then expire.
description.zh: DSH「允许本次任务」临时授权：仅在当前任务内自动放行同类 `danger-full-access` 请求，任务结束自动失效。

description.en: Brings your existing Claude / ChatGPT history into DSH: instant zero-token import of the memories.json inside a Claude export, local Claude Code transcripts with no export needed, and conversations distilled through the model you already configured in DSH. Every memory carries verbatim evidence checked against the source by code — a paraphrase is dropped and counted, and evidence found only in the assistant turns is always routed to review rather than stored.
description.zh: 把你在 Claude / ChatGPT 里已有的历史搬进 DSH：Claude 导出包里的 memories.json 零 token 瞬时入库，本机 Claude Code 记录免导出直读，历史对话用你在 DSH 里已配好的模型提纯。每条记忆都带由代码回原文核对的逐字证据——转述会被丢弃并计数，只在 AI 回复里找到的证据一律转人工确认而非直接入库。

description.en: Adds two switchable themes, built-in and local-folder background slideshows, and per-session token usage details to DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop.

description.en: A git plugin for DSH modelled on IDEA's VCS: a git icon beside the permission mode in the composer with the branch and pending-change count, a branch switcher on hover, an IDEA-style VCS panel on click (branch tree, commit graph, changes, commit detail, d
description.zh: 照着 IDEA 的 VCS 做的 Git 集成，装进 DSH 会话：输入框「权限模式」旁边的 Git 图标显示当前分支与未提交改动数，悬停可切分支，点击弹出 IDEA 风格的面板（分支树、提交图、变更与暂存、提交详情、文件差异），另有一个设置页管提交身份、git 位置和网络参数。不向 DSH 注册任何模型工具。

description.en: Auto Title: keep session titles following the latest task; names you set by hand stay put.

Applies structured unified diffs (git format) to the real filesystem: multi-file/hunk parsing, fuzzy hunk location with line-offset correction, all-or-nothing application with typed conflict reports, reverse-patch undo journal and dry-run - four patch_* dsh tools plus a CLI.
description.zh: 将结构化 unified diff（git 格式）应用到真实文件系统：多文件/多 hunk 解析、带行号偏移修正的模糊定位、全有或全无的应用与类型化冲突报告、反向补丁撤销日记及 dry-run——4 个 patch_* dsh 工具外加一个 CLI。

description.en: Translation toolkit for DSH agents: sentence segmentation, term and glossary extraction, source-target QA (numbers, units, brackets), tone guides, and a durable workspace translation memory.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供翻译工具包：句子分块、术语与术语表提取、译文质检（数字、单位、括号）、语气指南与工作区持久化翻译记忆。

description.en: DSH Web Usage Center with local SQLite history, HUD and dashboard, Hub account/quota snapshots, custom pricing and fee ledger, and CSV/JSON export, plus coding-plan OAuth and an optional loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway.
description.zh: DSH Web 用量中心：本地 SQLite 历史、HUD 与仪表盘、Hub 账户与额度快照、自定义定价与订阅费用账本、CSV/JSON 导出，并含 coding 计划 OAuth 与可选回环 OpenAI/Anthropic 网关。

description.en: Video-style turn navigation for the Web UI: full-map progress bar with hover preview cards (tools/files/tokens), drag scrub, ⌘K in-conversation search, ⌘↑/⌘↓ stepping, Esc-return. Event-log powered — works beyond the loaded window. Dual-half plugin on the official composer.dock slot.
description.zh: 会话内轮次导航视频进度条：全图分段、悬停富元信息卡（工具/文件/token）、拖动 scrub、⌘K 全会话搜索、⌘↑/⌘↓ 逐轮跳转、Esc 返回原位——基于会话事件日志，超出已加载窗口仍可用。

description.en: Daoist Canon (DaoZang) retrieval skill: keyword or semantic search over 285,117 scripture chunks with exact original-text extraction (line numbers, hit markers), and one-command workspace setup from the Godners/DaoZang dataset.
description.zh: 道藏知识库离线检索与原文提取：对 28.5 万段经文进行关键词或语义检索，精确提取原文（带行号与命中标记），可从 Godners/DaoZang 数据集一键搭建工作区。

description.en: Persistent wallpaper skin for the dsh web profile: static image or muted looping video as the app background, with translucent panels and a floating picker panel.
description.zh: dsh Web 界面的持久化壁纸皮肤：静态图片或静音循环视频作为应用背景，面板半透明化，右下角悬浮面板一键换壁纸。

description.zh: 基于 code-review-graph 引擎，为 DSH 提供代码图谱上下文、影响分析、审查工作流、交互式图谱和权限控制的重构。

description.en: Export the current DSH conversation, or selected turns, as clean readable Markdown.
description.zh: 将当前 DSH 对话或选定轮次导出为干净、易读的 Markdown。

description.zh: DSH 桌面端用量统计、供应商配额、自定义查询、可选 WorkBuddy 积分与高级模型选择器。

During long agent thinking, posts a hot-news or reminder message directly into the conversation stream.
description.zh: agent 思考超时时，直接在对话流中推出一条今日头条热点或提醒消息。

description.zh: 把 LLM 请求按配置分流到指定代理，其余流量走系统代理，没配就直连。

description.en: Extensible AI-driven group-reaction narrative game framework for DeepSeek Harness: type one action and multiple NPCs each respond in their own chatroom message with avatar illustrations; worlds, locations, NPCs and feature extensions (e.g. a third-party drawing API for dynamic NPC expressions) are added and modified through the harness chat dialog without code.

description.en: Channel-aware balance/usage card for DeepSeek Harness: DeepSeek official balance + spend windows, Volcano Ark Agent Plan quota bars.

Read-only side branch in the right sidebar: quote text to ask follow-ups without polluting the model context of the main session; every follow-up rebuilds the branch from the latest settled turns of the main session, and writes are refused at the tool-execution layer so the prompt prefix stays cacheable.
description.zh: 右侧栏的只读侧枝会话：划选文字即可追问，答案不进入主会话的模型上下文；每轮追问都用主会话最新的已结算内容重建，写操作在执行层被拒，以保住提示词前缀缓存。

description.en: Escaped, theme-aware HTML code-block rendering service for DSH Web plugins, built on structured syntax-highlight tokens with source line-ending preservation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 插件的转义与主题响应 HTML 代码块渲染服务，基于结构化语法高亮 token，并保留源码换行符。

description.en: Per-provider (account) proxy routing for DSH. SOCKS5/HTTP proxy pool with account-level routing based on API keys. Supports forced direct connections and hot-swapping built-in web tools proxies. Managed via a graphical settings page in DSH.
description.zh: 按提供商（账号）分流的 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理池。基于 API 密钥识别账号实现精准分流，支持绝对直连（无视 DSH 全局代理）与内置联网工具代理热装。配置在 DSH 设置页图形化管理，保存即热生效。

description.en: Kimi Coding web search and web fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness — one coding-plan key fills both ctx.web seams (POST /v1/search and /v1/fetch), a settings card in the GUI stores it via the credentials service, and the fallback chain reads the Kimi CLI config for zero-setup installs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Kimi Coding 的网页搜索与网页抓取双提供方——一把 coding 计划密钥同时接入 ctx.web 的两条链路（/v1/search 与 /v1/fetch），设置卡片经凭据服务保存密钥，并回退读取 Kimi CLI 配置，安装即用。

description.en: Piano performance plugin: ask the agent to play a piece and it renders on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples, an immersive stage, and an interactive 88-key keyboard.
description.zh: 让 Agent 弹一曲真钢琴：Salamander Grand 真实采样音色，Canvas2D 三角钢琴与沉浸式舞台渲染，88 键可弹。

description.en: 名单接口（谁在名单里）＋ 读 JSON 的样例实现 · Roster interface (who is on the list) + a JSON-backed sample

Composer stats strip for the DSH Web UI: official CNY pricing with auto-synced peak/off-peak tiers, per-model accounting, live timers, subagent-tree merging, DeepSeek account balance, budget alerts, and streaming cost estimation.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框下方的增强统计条：官方人民币计价（峰谷分时、价目自动同步）、多模型分账、实时计时、子代理树合并、余额直连、预算预警与流式成本估算。

description.en: 邮件类型注册表接口 ＋ 样例类型（direct／broadcast／club） · Letter-type registry + sample types (direct / broadcast / club)
Web composer enhancement: recalls sent prompts across sessions with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, searches them with Ctrl+R, restores rich drafts, and opens a docked /btw or /side conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框增强：跨会话召回已发送提示词、用 Ctrl+R 搜索并还原富草稿，以及提供停靠式 /btw 或 /side 旁路会话。

description.en: Configurable statistics row below the composer via a ${variable} display template — which segments appear and how they are labelled is fully user-defined.
description.zh: 用 ${变量} 显示模板自定义输入框下方的会话统计行——显示哪些统计段、单位文案怎么写，全部由模板决定。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness automatically opens browser plugins and includes a built-in WebView2 program to achieve a lightweight desktop experience.
description.zh: deepseek harness自动打开浏览器插件，内置WebView2程序实现轻量级桌面化。

description.en: Active wait for background subagents in DeepSeek Harness: registers a wait_subagent model tool that blocks until a named background continuable subagent settles, then returns its stop reason and closing message — optional timeout, membership gate rejects unknown ids, event-driven with zero polling. Closes the gap between run_in_background fire-and-return and the async settlement notice; wait for a background subagent without polling list_agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供后台子代理的主动等待：注册 wait_subagent 模型工具，阻塞等待指定的后台 continuable（可续会话）子代理收尾（settlement），返回停止原因与收尾消息——可选超时、成员资格门控拒绝未知 id、事件驱动零轮询。补齐 run_in_background 发后不管与异步收尾通知之间的缺口：等待后台子代理（subagent wait）不再轮询 list_agents、不再靠猜。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer plus spend per session, today, this month and all time, priced by a configurable time-of-day price table per currency (DeepSeek CNY/USD defaults included). Two read-only remote methods, no host routes, key read through the host credentials seam on every call, egress only to the configured provider origin.
description.zh: 侧栏脚注显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并按会话/今日/本月/累计统计花费，按可配置的分时价格表（按币种分表，内置 DeepSeek 人民币/美元默认表）计价。两个只读远程方法，无宿主路由，密钥每次经宿主凭据缝读取，只向配置的供应商域名出网。

description.en: Archive manager for DSH Web: list archived sessions in the Settings page and delete them for real, including their log, archive marker, and projection cache.
description.zh: 归档管理：在设置页列出已归档会话，并可真正删除，连同会话日志、归档标记与投影缓存一并清理。

description.en: Preview and edit attached PowerPoint presentations in the DSH sidebar through conversation or manual controls, with shared undo/redo and PPTX download.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏预览附件中的 PowerPoint 演示文稿，通过对话或手动操作编辑，共享撤销与重做历史，并下载编辑后的 PPTX。

description.en: Workspace-scoped Semgrep SAST tool for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Windows x64 runtime, structured bounded findings, cancellation and timeout controls, and user-approved sandbox escalation. Installs from npm as @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区内 Semgrep SAST 工具，提供托管 Windows x64 运行时、结构化有界结果、取消与超时控制，以及经用户批准的沙箱权限升级。npm 包名为 @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast。

description.en: Every tool call is counted, and the ones that never fire are named so you can remove them.
Autonomous permission classifier for the auto preset: tool-scoped allow/deny rules, an LLM semantic judge, and git checkpointing for unattended sessions.
description.zh: auto（自主模式）权限分类器：工具作用域的放行/拒绝规则、LLM 语义裁判与 git 快照，面向无人值守会话。

description.en: Conversation navigation with full-history turns, collapsible process steps, final-result and structured question-and-answer keys, and pointer-following piano interaction.
description.zh: 提供完整历史轮次导航、过程步骤折叠、最终结果与结构化问答琴键，以及鼠标连续跟随交互。

description.en: Local token usage and cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: four-segment token breakdown (miss/cache-hit/cache-write/output), cache savings estimate against the miss/hit price gap, per-session drill-down with context-growth curves and anomaly flags, global filters with shareable URLs, monthly budget progress with month-end projection, and day/month aggregate fast-path queries (O(days)) with incremental rescan.
description.zh: DSH 本地 Token 用量与成本统计仪表盘：四段 Token 构成（未命中/缓存命中/缓存写入/输出）、按未命中与命中的价差估算缓存省钱、会话下钻（上下文增长曲线与异常激增标记）、全局筛选可分享 URL、月度预算环形进度与月底外推、日/月聚合快路径查询（O(天数)）+ 增量扫描。

description.en: Replacement session-title provider for DeepSeek Harness: compresses oversized first prompts instead of failing, and gates weak prompts.
description.zh: 会话标题 provider 替换插件：先把过长或代码密集的首条 Prompt 压缩再调用模型（实测 DSH 版本的内建 provider 在超过 4096 bytes 时直接拒绝、不调用模型），遇到纯问候则等待真正的任务。默认使用该会话自身的 provider 与 model，保护人工标题；标题规则支持字数上限、可选日期前后缀、风格、语言与排除词，并可按会话锁定标题。还可批量重优化历史会话标题，进度浮层在关闭设置页后继续运行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: declare named subagents in TOML files under ~/.dsh/agents and <projectRoot>/.dsh/agents

Recall a message you already sent: the session log stays append-only and nothing is deleted, while the recalled turns leave the model context and the transcript, the text returns to the composer, and the files those turns changed wait in a quarantine you can review and clear from its own settings page.
description.zh: 撤回已发送的消息：会话日志只追加、不删除任何东西，被撤回的回合退出模型上下文并从对话界面消失、原文回到输入框，被这些回合改动的文件留在隔离区里——设置里独立一页，可查看可清理。

description.en: Real Windows OS toasts for DeepSeek Harness: task-finished, needs-input and needs-approval alerts that persist in Notification Center under DeepSeek branding. Windows-only, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 真正的 Windows 系统 Toast（通知中心持久、DeepSeek 品牌鲸鱼图标）：任务完成 / 需要输入 / 需要审批时提醒。仅支持 Windows，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Native RSS monitor for DeepSeek Harness: multi-source subscription, keyword filtering, scheduled polling with smart dedup, and email notifications for new items (HTML template with thumbnail cards), with SMTP passwords stored only in the credential store.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生 RSS 订阅监控插件：多源订阅、关键词过滤、定时检查去重、新条目邮件通知（缩略图 HTML 模板），SMTP 密码走凭据库永不落盘，原生设置页四页签体验。

description.en: Neutralize tool calls with invalid JSON arguments on the wire so one malformed model generation cannot brick a session against strict OpenAI-compatible servers.
description.zh: 在 wire 层中性化 arguments 为非法 JSON 的 tool call，避免一次模型畸形输出让 session 在严格 OpenAI 兼容服务端上永久 400。

description.en: Read-only CAD tools that inspect, extract and export DWG/DXF drawings, including SVG and PNG previews and DXF conversion.
description.zh: 只读 CAD 工具：查看、提取 DWG/DXF 图纸，导出 SVG/PNG 预览或转换 DXF。

description.en: Adds a model-aware reasoning effort slider with native and animated modes, light and dark palettes, and shared or per-model colors.
description.zh: 为模型添加推理强度滑块，支持原生与动画模式、明暗配色，以及全局或按模型配色。

description.en: Drive your dsh agent from WeChat over the iLink gateway: two-way encrypted media transfer (auto-decrypt inbox + /send), proactive weixin_send tool, completion notifications, multi-session switching, and a health panel with file logging.
description.zh: 微信遥控 DeepSeek Harness：iLink 双向加密文件收发（入站自动解密落盘 + /send 出站）、weixin_send 主动通知、完成通知、多会话切换、健康面板与文件日志。

description.en: AI 驱动的法律行业案件管理与 Agent 工具：诉讼案件 / 非诉项目 / 任务中心 / 期限引擎 / 技能与 MCP，Agent 预设直接办案，运行于 DeepSeek Harness。
DeepSeek account balance in the dsh web sidebar footer with live config hot reload and an editable Settings → Plugins card.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏底部展示 DeepSeek 账户余额，支持配置热重载与可编辑的设置 → 插件卡片。

description.en: Model list control for DeepSeek Harness: hide any model, give it your own display name while keeping the provider billing rate, arrange models and providers with arrows, and check which shown models currently work. Search, per-provider batch toggles, one-click restore. Display only — no provider configuration is rewritten.
description.zh: DSH 模型列表整理：隐藏任意模型、给它改一个自己的显示名（保留厂商计费倍率），用箭头调整模型与渠道排序，并检测当前显示的模型是否可用；支持搜索、渠道级批量开关与一键恢复。只改显示，不重写任何渠道配置。

description.en: Metadata-first runtime profiler for DSH agents: turn/step traces, model and tool wall-time timelines, provider usage, retries, errors, and live or historical sessions.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的运行时分析器：查看 Turn/Step 轨迹、模型与工具耗时、Provider 用量、重试与错误，实时与历史会话都能看。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: AnySearch-backed web search with optional TinyFish and DeepSeek search/fetch, registered into ctx.web.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: web browsing tools (markdown / screenshot / pdf / crawl) powered by Cloudflare Browser Run — real headless Chrome with JS rendering, login sessions and WebMCP support.

Configurable web search hub for the built-in web_search tool: switch the active entry between DeepSeek official native search and Zhipu GLM web_search, with entry and credential management on a Settings page tab.
description.zh: 可配置的原生 web_search 后端：在 DeepSeek 官方原生搜索与智谱 GLM web_search 之间切换当前生效入口，并在设置页管理搜索入口与凭证引用。

description.en: Split-screen workspace for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - chat with several agents side by side in panes that look and behave exactly like the stock conversation: drag-to-split, live sessions with queued messages and in-pane ask_user/approval cards, per-pane view tabs (Chat/Trajectory/plugin views), a compact TUI composer mode (Alt+T) and pane-focus shortcuts. Requires DSH 0.1.5+.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页端分屏工作区 - 多个会话并排聊天，面板观感与原生对话完全一致：拖拽分屏、实时会话（排队消息、面板内 ask_user/审批卡片）、面板内视图标签（Chat/Trajectory/插件视图）、Alt+T 紧凑 TUI 输入模式与面板焦点快捷键。需要 DSH 0.1.5+。

description.en: Browser Use cloud bridge for dsh: run real web tasks — open pages, click, type, fill forms, and extract data — through the Browser Use API.
description.zh: Browser Use 云端桥接：通过 Browser Use API 让 dsh agent 执行真实网页任务，包括打开页面、点击、输入、填表和提取数据。

description.en: Third-party menu manager for the DSH Web UI: collects new menu entries added by other plugins into one place, with fold/collapse and pinned menu items.
description.zh: 第三方菜单管理器：统一收纳第三方插件的新增菜单入口，提供常规折叠与固定菜单项。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web theme: ten OKLCH Chinese-traditional-colour palettes that adapt to light and dark, plus an optional wallpaper behind frosted glass panels; tailored for the DS Bot (bot team) interface; the palette and wallpaper persist locally.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 主题：十套 OKLCH 中国传统色配色、明暗自适应；可选一张壁纸铺满窗口、界面以磨砂玻璃叠上去；已适配 DS Bot（Bot 团队）界面；配色与壁纸都本地持久化。

description.en: Balance and live session usage for the DSH web UI: header balance button (left of the Session log), dropdown with account balance, real-time token breakdown (cache miss/hit, cache write, output), cache hit rate, and official-rate cost estimates with peak/off-peak auto-switch.
description.zh: DSH Web 余额与会话用量插件：头部余额按钮（Session log 左侧），下拉展示账户余额、实时 token 明细（缓存未命中/命中、缓存写入、输出）、缓存命中率，以及按官方峰谷价自动切换的费用估算。

description.en: Registers Kimi, Grok, Codex, and MiniMax as DeepSeek Harness model routes, vendor subagent recipes, and kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch tools.
description.zh: 把 Kimi、Grok、Codex、MiniMax 注册成 DeepSeek Harness 的模型路由、各家子代理配方，以及 kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch 工具。

description.en: 让 DSH 干完活会开口说话：回合结束自动播报「完成 / 失败」，零配置内置 20 个音效（无需 API Key），也可克隆自己的音色。另有第三个「审批」音效槽位，但只能手动触发（/play?kind=approval），不会自动播报。| Make DSH speak when the job is done: automatic voice/sound alerts for done and failed turns, 20 built-in sounds with zero config, or cl
description.zh: 每个 turn 结束自动播报完成、出错时播失败提示（用户中断默认不播，子代理会话默认跳过，均可配置）。三种提醒方式：语音、音效、关闭。默认「音效」内置 20 个音效（提醒 10 + 大自然 10），每个音效可指定给完成/失败/审批事件并单独试听，零配置、不需要任何 API Key 与音频文件；语音走火山 TTS，支持克隆音色与预设音色、批量导入音色 ID，并按文案/音色/语速/音调/音量指纹复用已生成的 mp3，未变则不重复合成。第三个「审批」槽位没有自动触发源，只能手动播放。走 winmm/waveOut 原样播放，绝不改动系统音量或静音状态，播放进程独立拉起、DSH 会话销毁也杀不到声音。仅 Windows。

description.en: Ships a skill about writing DSH skills - SKILL.md frontmatter and root precedence, how to phrase a description so it actually triggers, length and splitting rules, and an A/B check that the finished skill changes agent behaviour. The package also carries the checker the skill uses to validate a skill directory.
description.zh: 携带一份讲怎么写 DSH 技能的技能——SKILL.md 的 frontmatter 与技能根优先级、description 怎么写才会被触发、篇幅与拆分标准，以及「写完后怎么证明它真管用」的 A/B 验证。包里还带着供这份技能校验技能目录的检查脚本。

description.en: Publish TXT, Markdown, HTML, PDF, Word, and PowerPoint files as ShareOne links with passwords, watermarks, text-page updates, and TXT/Markdown/HTML comments.
description.zh: 将 TXT、Markdown、HTML、PDF、Word 和 PowerPoint 文件发布为 ShareOne 分享链接，支持访问密码、水印、文本页面更新和 TXT/Markdown/HTML 评论。

description.en: Session health-check: mechanically mines session logs into structured problem tickets (retry loops, tool-error clusters, interrupted turns, token waste) over the official session-query seam; works standalone.
description.zh: 会话体检：基于官方 session-query 接缝，机械挖掘会话日志为结构化问题工单（重试环/工具错误簇/中断回合/Token 浪费）；可独立安装使用。

description.en: A lightweight appearance skin for DeepSeek Harness: custom wallpaper, glass-like panel transparency, and an accent color; server-side settings shared across devices, native light/dark mode left untouched.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 轻量级外观皮肤：自定义壁纸、玻璃质感面板与重点色；服务端持久化、多设备一致，不接管原生深浅色。

description.en: 中瑞世联工作台 / CRWU audit workbench for DeepSeek Harness: pick a pending audit report, dispatch one AI audit subagent, watch and stop/restart it, auto-upload deliverables to Aliyun OSS.
Share an existing OpenClaw Markdown workspace with DeepSeek Harness as bounded persona and memory context, with Sidebar browsing and editing.
description.zh: 把现有 OpenClaw Markdown workspace 作为有界的人格与记忆上下文共享给 DeepSeek Harness，并提供 Sidebar 浏览与编辑。

description.en: Load, edit, manage, and hot-reload trusted JavaScript and TypeScript userscripts in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中加载、编辑、管理和热重载可信的 JavaScript / TypeScript 用户脚本。

description.en: Auto-discovery vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: automatically finds an image-capable model from your configured providers and returns picture descriptions as plain text via a vision tool.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek Harness 主模型搭视觉桥：自动从已配置模型中挑选多模态模型，通过 vision 工具把图片描述以纯文本返回。

description.en: Kaze Tachinu (The Wind Rises) skin for the DSH Web GUI: a full-screen film wallpaper behind glassmorphism surfaces, sky-blue interaction tokens, redrawn vector logos for the sidebar and home hero, a restyled composer card with themed placeholder text, and a bottom fade on the message list.
description.zh: 宫崎骏《起风了》主题皮肤：全屏电影壁纸配毛玻璃界面，交互色统一为天蓝，侧边栏与首页改用自绘矢量徽标，输入卡重绘为主题化占位文案的云海蓝胶囊，并为消息列加 40px 底部渐隐。

description.en: Track token spend and enforce budgets for every model call your dsh agent makes.
Generate and edit images, generate video, and cut video locally through a GenBox server, with a zero-key test bench.
description.zh: 通过本地 GenBox 服务生图、改图、生视频，并用 ffmpeg 本地剪辑；自带零成本测试台。

description.en: Trusted Iroh mesh networking for DSH hosts, with encrypted peer discovery, remote session delivery, and reachability status.
description.zh: 基于 Iroh 的可信 DSH 主机网状网络：提供加密的节点发现、远程会话投递与连通状态。

description.en: Persistent Codex, Grok Build and Claude Code sessions through ACP, with native model controls, permission approvals and optional A2A delegation.
description.zh: 通过 ACP 使用持久化的 Codex、Grok Build 和 Claude Code 会话，支持原生模型控制、权限审批及可选的 A2A 委派。

description.en: Local offline prosody analysis for DeepSeek Harness: reports how something was said — speed, pitch, pauses, energy — alongside the transcript.
description.zh: 本地离线语气分析：在转写之外，给出语速、音高、停顿与力度的听感描述，让模型听懂「怎么说的」。

description.en: Real Madrid dual-mode skin: Bernabeu night stadium for dark, white-kit pinstripes with crest and 1902 layers for light. Unofficial fan work.
description.zh: 皇家马德里双模式皮肤：暗色为夜场伯纳乌全景，亮色为纯白主场暗纹，队徽与 1902 背号作为背景层（非官方球迷作品）。

description.en: Ecommerce operator workbench: CSV batch preview with marketplace column adapters, reproducible profit/six-dimension scoring, public product-page snapshots, Chinese skills, and a replaceable store-policy KB.
description.zh: 电商店主工作台：CSV 批量预览（多平台列适配）、可复算利润与六维评分、公开商品页快照、中文 skills、可替换售后政策知识库。

description.en: Quote earlier content of the current session into the composer: select text in any message for a Quote pill, or type @ to pick a whole message; the quote travels as a native reference chip and is serialized into the prompt as a blockquote. Client-only, no host routes, no custom session events.
description.zh: 把本会话里更早的内容引用进输入框：在任意消息里划选文字出现"引用"按钮，或输入 @ 选择整条消息；引用以原生 chip 形式存在，发送时序列化为引用块进入 prompt。纯客户端，无宿主路由，无自定义会话事件。

description.en: Update checker (npm edition): a settings page comparing local and latest versions of @deepseek-ai/dsh and every installed plugin, with a red-dot nav reminder and ready-made update commands.
description.zh: 更新检查器（npm 版）：设置页对比 @deepseek-ai/dsh 与已装插件的本地/最新版本，有更新时导航红点提醒，并直接给出更新命令。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: DejaVu memory client — automated long-term memory (boot/read/search/create/update/delete) backed by your own DejaVu MCP server.
SSH terminals, SFTP file transfer and text editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with server troubleshooting through host models.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内使用 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件传输与文本编辑，并通过宿主模型排查服务器问题。

description.en: macOS desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: agent operates non-browser apps (CapCut, Photoshop, WPS, native clients) like a human — 14 tools for mouse, keyboard, scrolling, app activation, windows and screenshots, plus a vision closed-loop (desktop_see for image understanding + desktop_locate for UI element coordinates) that reuses dsh existing vision credentials. GUI-session service starts on demand, no login autostart.
description.zh: macOS 桌面控制插件：agent 像人一样操作非浏览器应用（剪映/PS/WPS/原生客户端）——14 个工具覆盖鼠标/键盘/滚动/应用/窗口/截图，并整合视觉闭环（desktop_see 识图 + desktop_locate UI 定位坐标，复用 dsh 既有视觉凭据）。服务 GUI 会话按需拉起，非登录自启。

description.en: Icon, Chinese display name and a one-line note for every DSH plugin, organized with folders, favorites, drag or pinyin ordering, list and grid views. Icons are auto-assigned to all installed plugins and can be overridden; import and export cover icons, names, notes, folders and order. Display-only: plugin files and cordis config are never modified; enable switches call the official plugin manager.
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件换自定义图标、中文显示名和一句话说明；用文件夹与收藏整理，支持拖拽排序、按备注名拼音排序、列表与铺陈两种视图。所有已安装插件自动分配图标（可手动覆盖）；导入导出覆盖图标、备注名、说明、文件夹与排序。只改显示，不修改插件文件与 cordis 配置；启用开关转调官方插件管理器。

description.en: Adds a speaker button immediately right of the Like button on every finalized assistant reply; click it to hear the reply through the browser speech engine, and hover it for a speed and voice panel. Text is sent to an unofficial Edge TTS endpoint.
description.zh: 在每条已定稿的助手回复里、紧挨点赞按钮右侧加一个小喇叭：点击用浏览器语音引擎朗读这条回复，鼠标悬停可调倍速与音色；文本会发送到非官方的 Edge TTS 端点。

description.en: Run the same prompt through every model you have, and see the difference without squinting.
DeepSeek-Harness plugin for multi-model orchestration with recursive task decomposition, dynamic routing, quality gates, failure recovery, and KPI reporting.
description.zh: DeepSeek-Harness 多模型编排插件，支持递归任务拆解、动态路由、质量门控、失败恢复与 KPI 报表。

description.en: Mobile-viewport fixes for the dsh web GUI: overlay drawer sidebar with swipe gestures, icon-only composer with a mode · model · effort status line, centered popovers, and horizontal-overflow/scrollbar centering fixes.
description.zh: 修复 dsh web GUI 的手机视口体验：抽屉式侧栏与滑动手势、纯图标 composer 与「权限·模型·思考深度」状态行、浮窗居中、横向溢出与滚动条挤压居中修复。

description.en: Union web search for DeepSeek Harness (renamed from dsh-free-search): free keyless engines + many professional paid search APIs — 28 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG multi-instance union/Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel keyless; Zhihu glob
description.zh: DSH 的联合联网搜索（DDDMUC/dsh-free-search 的整合后继，README 有致谢）：28 个引擎分三档——免 key 免费（Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG 多实例联合，Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel 免 key 模式）、凭 key 付费（知乎/Perplexity/Serply/DeepSeek 官方/You.com/百度/Kimi/阿里云/豆包/智谱/博查/Metaso）、模型内置搜索（OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Grok，仅显式勾选）——配自动智能路由、逐引擎开关与回退优先级、并行 top-3 融合、multi_search 跨源工具、失败感知回退、屏蔽系统内置搜索开关、时间过滤、平台搜索、web_fetch 与网页设置界面。实验性·免费 advance_fetch：整页 GFM-Markdown 或 CSS 选择器/字段结构化抽取，零 key 零按次计费；抓取身份可配（自定义 UA、Referer、按域 cookie——仅在域名匹配时附带、跨域重定向绝不外流）。宿主 0.1.0-rc.2→0.2.1-rc.2 共 17 个 rc 精确枚举（rc.2 的搜索接管经能力探测后走 volatile 配置钉选，禁版本号分支）。付费引擎需自备 API key（可选，免费引擎开箱即用）。npm：@drscrewdriver/dsh-union-search 与裸名 dsh-union-search 双发。

description.en: DSH knowledge-graph memory with a better-sidebar tab and a standalone /graph-memory/app dashboard: extracts TASK/SKILL/EVENT nodes, recalls across sessions, and ships as the npm package dsh-graphmemory.
description.zh: DSH 知识图谱记忆：better-sidebar「记忆图谱」页签与独立看板 /graph-memory/app；抽取任务/技能/事件节点并跨会话召回，npm 包名为 dsh-graphmemory。

description.en: Image generation workbench and agent tool for DSH: one tool (ark9_generate_image) paints text-to-image and image-to-image via any OpenAI-compatible API. Channels are entirely user-configured - no bundled endpoint, you bring your own baseURL, key and model name (manual input supported). Agent-initiated generations are approval-gated by default: requests queue in the floating panel and nothing bills until you approve; approval is non-blocking (the agent replies "awaiting your approval" immediately, and results, denials or timeouts are injected back so the agent reports them in the next turn). Floating glass workbench with five tabs (Generate / Approvals / Prompts / History / About), aspect-ratio grid with quality-budget + 16px-alignment sizing, transparent background, batch up to 10 images as aggregated sub-tasks, prompt library with custom JSON sources fetched through a host proxy, persistent generation logs with one-click retry, multi-channel aggregation with per-channel model fetching, bilingual UI (zh/en), stroke-SVG icon set, config import/export. Registers as a Better Sidebar tab when dsh-better-sidebar is installed; stacks above the dsh-cua FAB when both are present.
description.zh: DSH 生图工作台与 Agent 生图工具：一个工具（ark9_generate_image）走任意 OpenAI 兼容图片 API 文生图/图生图。渠道完全由用户自行添加——默认零预置，自带 baseURL、Key 与模型名即可（支持手动输入任意模型名）。Agent 发起的生图默认需用户审批：请求进入浮窗审批页，批准才开始生成并计费；审批非阻塞——Agent 立即回复"等你审批"，结果、拒绝或超时以通知注入后续轮次并自动汇报。玻璃拟态浮窗五页签（生成/审批/提示词/记录/说明）、比例网格（质量预算+16px 对齐）、透明背景、批量最多 10 张（子任务聚合，部分成功也返回）、提示词库（自定义 JSON 来源经宿主代理拉取）、生成记录持久化与一键重试、多渠道聚合与逐渠道拉模型、中英双语界面、线性 SVG 图标、配置导入导出。安装 dsh-better-sidebar 自动注册侧栏页签；与 dsh-cua 共存时自动堆叠其悬浮按钮上方。

description.en: Focus board for DeepSeek Harness agents: durable, model-maintained notes in the session workspace that pin the objective, constraints, and decisions across compaction and sessions, with automatic context injection, archive on clear, and an optional web panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供持久化专注板：在会话工作区维护目标、约束与决策笔记，跨压缩与会话存活，支持自动注入上下文、清空归档与可选 Web 面板。

description.en: Headless Claude Code consultations with advisor, reviewer, and designer roles, returned as reference answers.
description.zh: 以 advisor / reviewer / designer 角色无头调用 Claude Code，回复作为参考答案。

description.en: Vision for any DSH route: paste images in the Web composer with intent-aware auto-analysis, delegate workspace image reads to a Kimi/MiniMax vision subagent, and materialize pasted originals for editing.
description.zh: 为任意 DSH 路由装上眼睛：Web 输入框贴图按意图自动聚焦分析，视觉子代理代读工作区图片，原图可随时物化编辑。

description.en: Provider plugin for dsh-skill-pack-security: registers the pack's skills/ (zh) or skills-en/ (en) edition on ctx.skills AND the plugin_vet supply-chain gate tool on ctx.tools (license/SBOM/commit-lock/malware scans + five-dimension risk card). Ships both
Offline vocabulary panel: a capsule beside the composer opens a word card, and a dockable tabbed panel tracks today, progress, the mistake book and settings.
description.zh: 离线背词面板：输入框旁一颗胶囊点开是词卡，可钉住的分页面板管着今日、进度、生词本与设置。

description.en: Self-evolution actuator: consumes problem tickets mined from session logs, synthesizes skill candidates (zero-code tiers by default) behind an eval gate with hold-out canaries, then promotes to project .dsh/skills with human confirm and deterministic rollback.
description.zh: 自进化执行器：消费会话日志挖掘出的问题工单，在评测门（hold-out canary 防作弊）下合成技能候选，人工确认晋级到项目 .dsh/skills 并支持确定性回滚。

description.en: Record every step the agent took, and walk through it forwards and backwards to find where it went wrong.

Real PTY terminal panel for the DSH Web UI: host half spawns shells with node-pty (cmd.exe default on Windows), rendered in the browser with xterm.js; multi-tab sessions, dock/floating window, clipboard support.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 终端面板：宿主端 node-pty 真实 PTY（Windows 默认 cmd.exe）+ 浏览器 xterm.js 渲染；多标签会话、停靠/浮动窗口、复制粘贴。

description.en: Ponytail lazy-senior-dev ruleset for DeepSeek Harness: a 7-rung minimal-code ladder (YAGNI, reuse, stdlib, native, installed deps, one line, minimum), six skills (main rules, over-engineering review, repo audit, debt ledger, gain scoreboard, help), a /ponytail session command for lite/full/ultra/off levels, and optional always-on ruleset injection via config. Vendored verbatim from upstream ponytail (MIT), zero tools registered, clean uninstall.
description.zh: 把「最懒资深工程师」规则集 ponytail 装进 DeepSeek Harness：7 级最小代码阶梯（YAGNI、复用、标准库、平台原生、已装依赖、一行、最小实现），六个技能（主规则、过度工程 review、全仓 audit、debt 欠账台账、gain 计分板、help 速查），/ponytail 会话级调档命令（lite/full/ultra/off），以及可选的每轮常驻规则注入。上游内容 MIT 原样打包，零工具注册，卸载零残留。

description.en: DingTalk IM channel via Stream-mode WebSocket: each chat drives its own tooled agent; replies stream back as messages, no public callback URL needed.
description.zh: 钉钉 IM 双向 channel（Stream 模式）：每条单聊/群聊驱动一个 agent，思考与回复通过 WebSocket 长连接回流消息，免公网回调。

description.en: Scheduled send: fire a drafted message into the bound conversation as a normal user bubble at a set time. Runs host-side, so the browser can stay closed; per-session isolation and restart-safe redelivery.
description.zh: 定时发送：到点将拟好的消息以正常用户气泡发送到绑定的会话。调度在服务端执行，关闭浏览器不影响发送；会话隔离、重启自动补发。

description.en: A cozy offline vocabulary trainer for the whole family: 1094 curated words, spaced repetition, 6 quiz types, spelling games and a lazy large-screen mode; opens as a sidebar panel and also runs standalone as one HTML file.
description.zh: 舒服的离线背单词全家桶：1094 个精选单词、间隔重复、6 种题型、拼写游戏和躺着背大字模式；侧边栏面板打开，也可作为单个 HTML 文件独立运行。

description.en: Checks a bid evaluation scoring matrix for internal arithmetic consistency: that each factor's maximum, the scores recorded and the total agree with each other. Reports the differences it finds; it does not judge whether the evaluation itself was correct or fair.
description.zh: 核对评标因素评分矩阵的内部算术自洽性：各因素分值上限、所记分值与合计之间是否互相一致。只报告发现的差异，不评价评标本身是否正确或公正。

description.en: Adds subscription OAuth and provider Plan API-key logins through Pi adapters, using a DSH-owned credential store.
description.zh: 通过 Pi 适配器接入订阅 OAuth 和厂商 Plan API Key 登录，使用独立的 DSH 凭据存储。

description.en: Windows desktop control exposed as native DSH tools - whole-screen and single-window capture (the window one goes through PrintWindow, so a covered window still captures), click, drag, typing, keyboard shortcuts, scrolling, window management, pixel and window polling, and UIA queries that can invoke a control or read its value instead of clicking coordinates. 13 tools over a PowerShell 7 child process; no MCP server, no resident process, no API key.
description.zh: 以 DSH 原生工具形式提供的 Windows 桌面控制——整屏与单窗口截图（单窗口走 PrintWindow，窗口被遮住也能抓）、点击、拖动、打字、按键、滚动、窗口管理、像素与窗口轮询，以及可直接 invoke 控件或读取控件值的 UIA 查询（不必点坐标）。13 个工具，跑在 PowerShell 7 子进程上；不需要 MCP 服务器、无常驻进程、无 API key。

description.en: Automatic provider failover on rate limits or quota exhaustion: switch between providers with configurable per-provider models, a cooldown, and a permanent last-entry fallback.
description.zh: 限流或配额耗尽时自动切换模型提供方：可按提供方配置模型，带冷却机制与永久最终兜底。

description.en: Service control panel in DSH Web settings: live host info (PID, versions, uptime, memory/CPU trends, active sessions), npm update banner, and a confirm-guarded graceful stop that warns when tasks are running and can wait for them to finish.
description.zh: DSH Web 设置页的服务控制面板：实时宿主信息（PID、版本、运行时长、内存/CPU 趋势、活跃会话）、npm 更新提醒，以及带确认的优雅停止——任务运行时发出警告，也可等待任务结束后自动停止。

description.en: Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into the current context.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆：全文检索所有历史会话（复用 ctx.sessionQuery 的 SQLite FTS5 索引），把最强匹配片段带回当前上下文。

description.en: Review-first batch automation for DeepSeek Harness: three reviewed samples, a full preview, one approval, then a safe apply across many files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的审核优先批量自动化：先审核三个样本，预览全部结果，一次批准，再安全地应用到多个文件。

description.en: Minimal-compatible first turn for Web root sessions: starts with persistent bash and str_replace_editor, removes automatic workspace and skill context, then restores the selected preset after the first tool call or reply; includes a persistent composer toggle.
description.zh: Web 根会话的首轮精简：先使用持久 bash 与 str_replace_editor，移除自动工作区和技能上下文；首次工具调用或回复后恢复所选预设，带持久 composer 开关。

description.en: Finder clipboard paste for macOS: Cmd+C files or folders in Finder, then Ctrl+V in the DSH composer inserts their absolute paths; ordinary text paste with Cmd+V is untouched.
description.zh: macOS Finder 剪贴板粘贴：在 Finder 里 Cmd+C 复制文件或文件夹，回到 DSH 按 Ctrl+V 把绝对路径插入输入框；普通文本粘贴的 Cmd+V 不受影响。

description.en: Indexes session transcripts into the Akasha session layer as turns end, records successful compactions, and adds a per-turn rhythm line to the runtime context. Companions: Hindsight (repo memory), OpenViking (user memory), and the built-in session search (see repo README). Setup: clone the repo, copy core/ aside, then replace <AKASHA_DIR> in cordis.patch.yml with its absolute path (or set the AKASHA_DIR env var); plugins fail loudly while the placeholder remains.
description.zh: 回合结束时把会话档案增量索引进阿卡夏会话层，记录压缩事件，并在运行时上下文里显示每回合节奏条。（配套：Hindsight 仓库记忆 / OpenViking 用户记忆 / 宿主会话检索；见仓库 README） 安装：clone 仓库并复制 core/，把 cordis.patch.yml 里的 <AKASHA_DIR> 换成实际路径（或设 AKASHA_DIR 环境变量）；占位符未替换时插件会明确报错。

description.en: Event sounds for DSH: plays a chosen sound on session end, options popup, permission request and stop, with AI-generated character voice lines and a manageable sound library.
description.zh: DSH 声音工坊：在会话结束、弹出选项、请求许可与停止时播放指定音效，支持 AI 角色语音生成与音效库管理。

description.en: Every change to your agent's instructions is recorded with a diff, and any change can be undone.
Connect Notion from the GUI with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE — official Notion MCP, no integration token.
description.zh: 在图形界面中以 OAuth 2.0 + PKCE 连接 Notion —— 官方 Notion MCP，无需集成令牌。

description.en: Adds a produced-files card row to the chat and a resizable split-screen preview panel for workspace artifacts (Markdown, source code, CSV, JSON, images, HTML), plus a localhost port preview.
description.zh: 在对话中新增产出文件卡片行，并提供可拖拽分屏的产物预览面板，支持 Markdown、源码、CSV、JSON、图片、HTML，以及本地端口预览。

description.en: 在设置页提供「归档管理」页面：按工作区浏览、批量归档、恢复，以及需要二次确认的永久删除，不额外创建 Workspace。
Adds a Spawnd.gg games cabinet to the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar with search, sorting, hover previews, embedded play, and a minimized player.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏中添加 Spawnd.gg 游戏柜，支持搜索、排序、悬停预览、嵌入式游玩和最小化播放器。

description.en: Backs up DSH profiles and mints a desktop "revival coin" that restores the harness after a failed boot or install: a boot guard runs a two-phase health check (HTTP 200 plus client render), marks good boots, isolates or rolls back bad ones, and keeps 3 rotating snapshots. Cross-platform.
description.zh: 备份 DSH 环境，启动或安装失败时通过桌面"复活币"一键恢复：内置启动守卫做两阶段健康检查（HTTP 200 + 客户端渲染），标记正常启动、隔离或回滚异常启动，并轮换保留 3 份快照。跨平台。

description.en: Minimal ↑/↓ input history for the DSH web composer: press ↑/↓ to walk back through sent messages. Nothing else.
description.zh: DSH 会话输入框的极简输入历史：按 ↑/↓ 翻阅发过的消息。只有方向键，别无其他。

description.en: Full-screen video boot splash — play an mp4 at startup, skip with a click, import your own clip, and non-playable codecs are transcoded to H.264 automatically.
description.zh: 视频开机片头：启动时全屏播放 mp4，点击或 Esc 跳过，可导入自己的视频，浏览器解不了的编码自动转成 H.264。

description.en: Native ChatGPT Codex provider, device-code-first login, and same-origin Web integration for DeepSeek Harness

One-click search-engine switcher beside the DeepSeek Harness model picker; changes the dsh-free-search provider, handy on overseas university networks that block the DeepSeek Official search endpoint.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁一键切换搜索服务商的下拉菜单；海外大学网络常拦截 DeepSeek 官方搜索，可借此切到其他引擎规避。

description.en: Composer cost chip: prices the current session DeepSeek API spend message-by-message with the official pricing table (incl. the 2026-08-17 peak/off-peak policy); hover for the breakdown, today (DSH) total and account balance. DeepSeek models only.
description.zh: 输入框右侧会话成本芯片：按官方价表（含 2026-08-17 峰谷价）逐消息计价当前会话的 DeepSeek API 花费，悬停查看计价明细、今日(DSH) 消耗与账户余额；仅 DeepSeek 模型计价，其他模型不计价不显示。

description.en: Hosted tool server over MCP: invoice and bank-statement extraction with in-code arithmetic checks, ledger reconciliation in integer cents, PDF and table conversion, SQL dialect transpiling, and mainland-China reachability probes run from a China Mobile network vantage point.
description.zh: 托管工具服务器（MCP）：发票与银行流水提取并做代码内算术校验、按整数分对账、PDF 与表格转换、SQL 方言转写，以及从中国移动骨干网实测大陆可达性。

description.en: Global token totals across every local DSH conversation, de-duplicated by message id, with custom date ranges and per-provider monthly quota tracking.
description.zh: 统计本机全部 DSH 会话的历史 token 消耗，按 message.id 去重，支持自定义日期区间与按接入方的月度额度剩余。

description.en: Composer readouts for the DeepSeek Harness: CJK-weighted draft token count, session spend at official peak/idle rates, context occupancy, and what the same usage would have cost on the costliest other model; client-only, with no host half and no credential access.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方的实时草稿 token 数、按官方高峰/空闲费率计算的会话花费、上下文占用，以及同样的用量在最贵的另一个模型上会花多少；纯客户端，没有 host 半，不接触凭据。

description.en: Offline, deterministic public API catalog search for DeepSeek Harness, with Chinese and English queries plus exact filters for authentication, HTTPS, CORS, status, source tier, and category.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的离线确定性公共 API 目录检索，支持中英文查询，以及认证、HTTPS、CORS、状态、来源层级与分类的精确筛选。

description.en: macOS desk pet forked from anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet, in a real always-on-top window that covers fullscreen Spaces: the pose follows whatever the local DSH is doing across six states, the right-click menu is a real AppKit one carrying quiet mode and a session list, and seven skins ship with it. Two of the seven are drawn from geometry by a script in the repo rather than generated, so making a skin needs no image model and no API credits; the bundled skill still expands one photo into all eighteen poses on your own image tool and credentials. There is no Electron and nothing to install alongside it: the window is driven through ctypes on the Python that ships with macOS.
description.zh: 分叉自 anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet 的 macOS 桌宠，一个真的置顶窗口，全屏 Space 也盖得住：姿势跟着本地 DSH 在六种状态之间走，右键菜单是真的 AppKit 菜单，里面有免打扰和会话清单，随包带七套皮肤。七套里有两套是仓库中的脚本用几何画出来的，不是生成的，所以做一套皮肤不需要图像模型、也不烧 API 额度；自带的 skill 仍用你自己的画图工具和额度，把一张照片扩写成十八个姿势。没有 Electron，也不用另装任何东西：窗口是用 macOS 自带的那个 Python 经 ctypes 驱动的。

description.en: Commitment write-gate: operator-authored rules enforced before a tool call runs — a deterministic guard tier plus an LLM-judge tier, fail-closed by default, every block written to a contradictions log.
description.zh: 承诺写入闸门：由运营者编写的规则在工具调用执行前生效——先是一层确定性守卫，再是一层 LLM 裁判，默认失败即拒绝，每一次拦截都写进矛盾日志。

description.en: Agent Community UI — Bot list, room list, chat panel, run status

Persistent image or MP4 wallpaper for the DSH Web profile: a wallpaper card under Settings -> General selects a local image or MP4 (up to 300 MB), tunes surface opacity and blur, compresses video locally to H.264 when ffmpeg/ffprobe are on PATH, stores media under ~/.dsh/wallpapers, and pins the Web server to port 9191 so the saved wallpaper survives restarts.
description.zh: DSH Web 持久化背景图/视频插件：在 设置 -> 通用 中提供壁纸卡片，可选本地图片或 MP4（最大 300 MB），调节表层透明度与模糊；检测到 ffmpeg/ffprobe 时在本机把视频压缩为 H.264；媒体保存到 ~/.dsh/wallpapers；并将 Web 服务固定到 9191 端口以便重启后恢复壁纸。

description.en: Loads Claude-style plugins into DeepSeek Harness (dsh): discovers skills, commands and optional SessionStart hooks from Claude plugin directories, with hot command reload and uninstall cleanup.
description.zh: 把 Claude 风格的插件加载进 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）：扫描 Claude 插件目录，接入 skills、commands 与可选的 SessionStart hooks，支持命令热更新与卸载清理。

description.en: Analyze a codebase and generate architecture documentation: module responsibilities, dependencies, entry points and run methods.
description.zh: 分析代码库并生成架构文档：模块职责、依赖关系、入口点与运行方式。

description.en: Navigation dots for DSH Web conversations — quickly jump between user messages.
description.zh: DSH 网页端对话导航点 — 快速跳转用户消息。

description.en: Plugin insight center: one answer to "哪些值得装" — plugin_guide matches needs to plugins, recipe installs whole environments, plugin_rank scores health (0-100), plugin_audit static-scans a local checkout for security, and plugin_verdict outputs install / caution / research / avoid.
description.zh: 插件评测中心：一个答案回答"哪些值得装"——plugin_guide 按需求推荐插件、recipe 安装整套环境、plugin_rank 健康评分（0-100）、plugin_audit 静态安全扫描本地目录、plugin_verdict 给出 install / caution / research / avoid 结论。

description.en: Survival mode: all sessions share one satiety/health pool — each model step burns satiety, starvation freezes tool calls until fed, with an MC mini-game for gathering food.
description.zh: 生存模式：全局共享一条饱食度与生命，模型每步思考消耗饱食度，饿死后全局工具被冻结，通过 MC 采集小游戏获取食物喂食复活。

description.en: Render GeoJSON or vector data into an interactive GeoLibre map in a sidebar tab, and let agents operate the live map through tools: layers, styles, view, feature identification, GeoLibre processing algorithms, and the Whitebox toolbox (WASM in the browser).
description.zh: 把 GeoJSON / 矢量数据渲染成侧边栏「地图」tab 里的交互地图，并让 Agent 通过工具实时操作地图：图层、样式、视图、要素识别、GeoLibre 处理算法与 Whitebox 工具箱（浏览器端 WASM 执行）。

description.en: Permission mode between workspace-write and full access: shell commands are checked by deterministic rules and a subagent review; irreversible or system-level actions require explicit approval.
description.zh: 介于 workspace-write 与 Full access 之间的权限模式：命令先经规则与子代理审查，不可逆或系统级操作需人工批准。

description.en: Minimalist OpenViking status chip and popover for DeepSeek Harness composer

Boot-time guard that repairs corrupt session logs, preflights plugin composition, vm-checks client artifacts, smoke-tests host apply() and quarantines crash-causing bundles, so a broken plugin can never brick startup.
description.zh: 启动守卫：修复会话日志、预检插件组合、校验客户端工件、冒烟宿主 apply() 并隔离崩溃源，让坏插件再也无法砖掉启动。

description.en: E-commerce product image generation for DSH: 24 prompt modules covering main, detail and ad images, style transfer from a reference shot, batch runs, and a project gallery with live preview.
description.zh: DSH 电商商品图生成：24 个提示词模块覆盖主图、详情图与广告图，支持参考图风格复刻、批量生成，以及作品库实时预览。

description.en: Right-click menus for the DSH Web UI — copy, cut, paste and select all on text and input areas, plus copy path, reveal in the file manager and open with the default app on file references and links.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面补上右键菜单：文字与输入框可复制/剪切/粘贴/全选，文件引用与链接可复制路径、在文件管理器中定位、用默认应用打开。

description.en: Agent- and GUI-controlled DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin: eight `coyote_*` tools plus a DSH web panel behind one safety envelope (soft limits, asymmetric rate limiter, session cooldown, playback caps, disconnect fail-safe); optional auto-stim layer maps agent events (tool calls, errors, turn end) to bounded pulses; official V3 socket protocol with QR pairing, programmable waveforms. Adults only.
description.zh: Agent 与网页 GUI 双面控制的 DG-LAB 郊狼（Coyote）电击/电刺激插件：八个 `coyote_*` 工具 + DSH 网页面板，共用同一安全边界（软上限、非对称升速限流、会话冷却、播放硬上限、断连即停）；v0.2 起可选自动电击层，把 agent 事件（工具调用/报错/回合结束）映射为有界脉冲；官方 V3 socket 协议 + 二维码配对、可编程波形。仅限成年人。

description.en: Node.js fork of andyfan1094/dsh-winrm: the same WinRM host panel and seven agent tools, with the backend ported from Python/pywinrm to a native Node WinRM client so the machine running dsh needs no Python.
description.zh: andyfan1094/dsh-winrm 的 Node.js 分支：同样的 WinRM 主机面板与七个 agent 工具，后端从 Python/pywinrm 移植到原生 Node WinRM 客户端，运行 dsh 的机器不再需要 Python。

description.en: Lighten the load on your agent: one-click toggles for skills and MCP, so the context holds only what this turn actually needs. Skills and MCP servers you switch off are no longer injected into the model context — cleaner, and lighter on tokens.
description.zh: 给你的 Agent 减负：Skill 与 MCP 一键启停，让上下文只装这一轮真正要用的能力。关掉的 skill / MCP 不再进入模型上下文，更干净，更省 token。

description.en: Ecosystem-wide plugin health audit: syncs the dsh-plugin topic into a local scored catalog (maintenance / docs / npm + weekly downloads / ecosystem, 0-100, A-D), static security scan with high-finding grade veto, star history snapshots, web leaderboard and agent tools.
description.zh: 插件生态体检：将 dsh-plugin 话题同步为本地评分目录（维护/文档/npm+周下载/生态四维，0-100 分 A-D 级），静态安全扫描高危一票否决，支持 star 历史快照、Web 榜单与 Agent 工具。

description.en: Exposes bounded Prometheus metrics for DSH sessions, agents, LLM calls, tools, approvals, subagents, and jobs, with a Grafana dashboard and a loopback-only endpoint by default.
description.zh: 导出有界的 DSH Session、Agent、LLM、Tool、Approval、Subagent 与 Job Prometheus 指标，附带 Grafana 仪表盘，Endpoint 默认仅监听回环地址。

description.en: Per-turn USD cost badge in the Web UI: session total in the header and per-turn cost in each message footer, with a hover breakdown.
description.zh: Web UI 美元成本徽标：头部显示会话总成本、每条回复结尾显示该轮成本，悬停看分项。

description.en: Turn chat logs into a panel list maintained by a resident agent. Includes a zero npm-dependency core and an optional WeChat/QQ ingestion pipeline. Installs as a DSH profile bundle.

In-session cd for DeepSeek Harness: re-base relative paths on the fly (the file tools and the bash/pwsh default workdir follow) or move the session to another workspace for real — a `cd {"workspace": true, "confirmed": true}` call the user has agreed to, or the user's own `/cd <directory>` command, relocates the session's stored log, sandbox root, AGENTS.md and skill discovery and sidebar grouping. Per-session, persisted across restarts, without moving the session for a plain re-base.
description.zh: 会话内 cd：即时切换相对路径基准（文件工具与 bash / pwsh 默认工作目录跟随），或把会话真正搬到另一个工作区——经用户同意的 `cd {"workspace": true, "confirmed": true}` 或用户自己的 `/cd <目录>` 命令，会迁移会话日志存储位置、沙箱根、AGENTS.md 与 skills 发现根以及侧边栏分组；按会话隔离、跨重启恢复，单纯换基准时不动会话身份。

description.en: Compares existing DSH sessions or runs controlled A/B trials between agent presets, showing aligned timelines, paired metric deltas, explicit success checks, and exportable reports.
description.zh: 对比已有 DSH 会话，或在两套 Agent Preset 之间运行受控 A/B 试验，展示对齐时间线、配对指标差值、显式验收结果与可导出的报告。

description.en: Stop a running background job from the session-header job list, with a confirmation dialog that restates the full command.
description.zh: 在会话头部的后台任务列表里停止正在运行的任务，确认弹窗会再次显示完整命令。

description.en: DIT.ai provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness: installs 29 OpenAI Chat Completions models and 10 Anthropic Messages models from one DIT_API_KEY, with protocol-specific thinking configuration.
description.zh: DIT.ai 的 DeepSeek Harness 模型接入 bundle：使用一个 DIT_API_KEY 安装 29 个 OpenAI Chat Completions 模型和 10 个 Anthropic Messages 模型，并按协议配置 thinking。

description.en: A global permission watchdog: a hard budget on auto-approved permission requests. At most 10 per rolling 60 seconds, at least 3 seconds apart; anything past either limit is deferred to the human answerer and waits. It never refuses and never changes what is asked -- it only decides who answers and how fast. Installs disabled; enable it with the plugin manager toggle.
description.zh: 全局权限看门狗：为审批请求设一道硬性总额度。滚动 60 秒内最多自动通过 10 次，且两次之间至少间隔 3 秒；超出任一上限的请求一律转交人工应答并等待。它从不拒绝、也不改变请求内容，只决定谁来答、答得多快。安装后默认关闭，需在插件管理器中手动开启。

description.en: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness with curated facts, automatic turn retention, and graph- and vector-ranked recall.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供人工记忆、自动对话保留以及图谱和向量排序召回的持久记忆插件。

description.en: Auto-supplement QMD semantic search when the model greps/globs a knowledge-base directory: zero-dependency DSH plugin, async injection via next-step, no manual invocation.
description.zh: 模型在知识库目录执行 grep/glob 搜索时自动补充 QMD 语义检索：零依赖 DSH 插件，异步注入下一步上下文，无需手动调用。

description.en: Desktop full-screen boot splash. It covers DSH's loading card before first paint, plays a 4.5 s five-stage compass sequence, then hands off to the app; clicking anywhere skips ahead, and reopening the window from the tray replays it. The first cold start may hitch once, then runs smoothly.
description.zh: 桌面端全屏启动动画：在 DSH 加载卡出现前接住首帧，播放 4.5 秒五阶段罗盘序列后交接；点按任意处可跳过，从托盘重开窗口会重播。冷启动首帧可能顿一下，之后流畅。

description.en: Policy plugin that gates kubectl by kubeconfig context: hard-deny irreversible verbs outside local clusters, ask for the rest.
description.zh: 按 kubeconfig context 管控 kubectl 调用的策略插件：本地集群外硬拒绝不可逆操作，其余写操作请求人工确认。

description.en: Turns DSH conversations into reviewable community feedback and, after confirmation, submits it to the official DeepSeek Harness Discussions.
description.zh: 将 DSH 对话整理为可审阅的社区反馈，并在确认后提交到 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Discussions。

description.en: Schedules Akasha sleep distillation on idle or timer, and injects a wake note for new sessions plus a per-turn memory pulse; the optional idle-resume behaviour is off by default. Companions: Hindsight (repo memory), OpenViking (user memory), and the built-in session search (see repo README). Setup: clone the repo, copy core/ aside, then replace <AKASHA_DIR> in cordis.patch.yml with its absolute path (or set the AKASHA_DIR env var); plugins fail loudly while the placeholder remains.
description.zh: 空闲或定时触发阿卡夏睡眠蒸馏，并为新会话注入唤醒条、每回合注入库脉搏；可选的空闲续行默认关闭。（配套：Hindsight 仓库记忆 / OpenViking 用户记忆 / 宿主会话检索；见仓库 README） 安装：clone 仓库并复制 core/，把 cordis.patch.yml 里的 <AKASHA_DIR> 换成实际路径（或设 AKASHA_DIR 环境变量）；占位符未替换时插件会明确报错。

description.en: Adds a Run button to shell code blocks in replies, executing the snippet through the host shell service and showing its output in a floating bottom-right dock, or in one bottom-panel tab per run.
description.zh: 为回答里的命令行代码框加「运行」按钮，通过宿主 shell 服务执行该命令，输出显示在右下角浮动面板，或每个运行一个底部面板标签页。

description.en: Sidebar skill hub: scan Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini skill directories for one-click import, manage global/project skills (toggle, trash), and install from dropped folders, zip archives, or local paths of any size.
description.zh: 侧边栏技能站：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录一键导入，管理全局与项目技能（启停、回收站），支持拖拽文件夹、zip 包与本地路径（不限大小）安装。

description.en: Adds Korean (한국어) as a native option in Settings - General - Language and translates all 2,775 Web UI strings of dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.2, experimental features included. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「设置 - 通用设置 - 语言」加入韩语（한국어），翻译 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 与 0.2.1-alpha.2 Web UI 的全部 2,775 条文案，包括实验功能。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用。

description.en: Git service plus right-sidebar UI — a Changes tab (stage/unstage, per-file diffs, commit/amend, push and rebase-then-push sync, confirmed discard), a paged canvas commit-graph tab, a Worktrees tab to list, enter and create checkouts, a composer branch selector, and opt-in LLM commit-message generation.
description.zh: Git 服务 + 右侧边栏 UI：Changes 页（暂存/取消暂存、逐文件 diff、提交/修补、推送与 rebase 同步、二次确认的丢弃）、分页 canvas 提交图谱页、Worktrees 页（列出/进入/新建工作树）、输入框旁分支选择器，以及可选的 LLM 提交信息生成。

description.en: Speaks your agent's reports in a voice you choose, compressing long reports before speaking. Character voices need no training - a 3-10 second reference clip clones one, and community-trained models work too - and no 6.4 GB GPT-SoVITS install: the plugin installs its own runtime and voice. An existing GPT-SoVITS can be used instead, and it is the same voice model.
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 用你喜欢的声音开口说话、汇报内容，过长的汇报先压缩再念。角色声线不需要自己训练：一段 3-10 秒参考音就能克隆，也能直接用别人训练好的模型；不必为此装一整套 6.4 GB 的 GPT-SoVITS —— 运行时和声线都由插件自己装好。已有 GPT-SoVITS 的话也能直接接上，两者跑的是同一套声线。

description.en: On Windows, the available bash tool is limited to Git Bash and PowerShell is disabled.
description.zh: 让 Windows 上可用的 bash 工具限制为 Git Bash,并禁用 PowerShell。

description.en: Scales the whole DeepSeek Harness interface from 50% to 200%, menus and pop-ups included, set from Settings - General with a slider, a percent field or presets. Works in dsh web and the desktop app, which has no zoom of its own.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 整个界面（包括菜单和弹窗）缩放到 50% 至 200%，在「设置 - 通用设置」中用滑块、百分比输入或预设调整。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用，桌面应用本身没有缩放功能。

description.en: Text-to-image and image-to-image for a model that cannot draw, through any OpenAI-compatible image API, with multiple providers and an automatic fallback model.
description.zh: 让没有生图/修图能力的模型接入任意 OpenAI 兼容生图接口：支持文生图与图生图，可添加多个服务商，并为生图与修图各选主用与备用模型，主模型连不上时自动切换到备用。

description.en: Counts completed compactions per session in a floating window and warns only after repeated compactions plus extra token spend or high context occupancy, with all three thresholds adjustable in Settings.
description.zh: 统计每段对话成功完成的压缩次数并常驻悬浮窗，只有反复压缩过、且此后又烧掉大量 token 或上下文占用过高时才提醒；三个阈值都可在设置页调整。

description.en: Channel-grouped session view injected into the sidebar — Workspace/Channels tabs with live-running dots, archived grouping, orphan tagging, built purely on official extension surfaces and serving as the RFC-0001 reference implementation.
description.zh: 侧边栏注入的按渠道分组会话视图——工作区/Channels 双标签、运行中绿点、归档折叠与孤儿工作区标注，完全基于官方扩展面实现，兼作 RFC-0001（discussion #3897）的参考实现。

description.en: Knowledge base with a corrective acquisition loop for DeepSeek Harness: when the agent keeps hitting the same failure, a background worker fetches the web under a rate limit, distills the result into a staging area, and only a two-stage commit makes it recallable — pages without sources are refused.
description.zh: DSH 的纠错式补料知识库：agent 反复撞同一堵墙时，后台 worker 在限流下联网抓取、蒸馏结果先落暂存区，只有两段式 commit 才能进入召回——无来源的页面一律拒绝。

description.en: The dock-base Workbench adapter for the DSH Quick Control panel. The panel core ships separately as `dsh-flash`; this package is what mounts it into dock-base — sidebar/floating panel, activity-bar ⚡, editor view and the dock-flash:openQuickControl command. Requires dock-base; a broken install fails loudly instead of silently doing nothing.
description.zh: DSH 快捷控制面板的 dock-base 工作台适配器。面板本体（开关注册表、皮肤系统、i18n、告警面、host 路由）由 `dsh-flash` 核心单独提供；本包只负责把它挂进 dock-base：侧栏/浮动面板、活动栏 ⚡、编辑器视图与 dock-flash:openQuickControl 命令。需安装 dock-base；装错时会明确报错而不是静默失效。

description.en: dsh-miaomiaopaper: 喵喵壁纸管理器 — Wallpaper Engine backgrounds & liquid glass for DSH web GUI (Rebuilt on clean upstream elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine v1.2.0).

Replaces the stock bash/pwsh terminal rows in the DSH web UI with shell command cards: long commands soft-wrap with line numbers instead of truncating, plus separate copy-command and copy-output buttons.
description.zh: 用自定义 Shell 命令卡片替换 DSH Web 原版 bash/pwsh 工具行：长命令自动换行带行号不再截断，并提供独立的复制命令/复制输出按钮。

description.en: Free Bing-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). No API key needed, uses cn.bing.com for mainland China accessibility.
description.zh: godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing 的维护 fork，适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1：为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源，直接解析 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页，无需 API Key，国内可直连，不消耗模型自带搜索额度。端点与结果数量可配置。

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH web UI: a draggable pixel-art cat with a pomodoro timer, XP levels, and 30 unlockable facts.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的桌宠插件：可拖拽的像素猫，带番茄闹钟、经验等级与 30 条可解锁的托托事实。

description.en: Ollama-backed search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web seam (ctx.web): one web_search backend calling POST https://ollama.com/api/web_search.
Authenticated, policy-gated WebFetchProvider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web)
Parses DSH session logs to attribute AI-written files, overlays c8 coverage, and reports AI vs human code coverage with a trust score, plus a check/fix/verify tool loop for closing test gaps.
description.zh: 解析 DSH session 日志归因 AI 生成文件，叠加 c8 覆盖率，产出「AI vs 人工代码」覆盖率对比与信任分，并提供 check/fix/verify 三工具闭环补齐测试盲区。

description.en: Detect DSH plugin conflicts and loading failures, quarantine affected bundles and recover them, with offline startup rescue.
description.zh: 检查 DSH 插件冲突与加载故障，隔离和恢复受影响的插件，并在宿主无法启动时提供离线修复。

description.en: Runs a parallel code review squad of read-only reviewer subagents (security, correctness, tests, style), each optionally on its own model, and aggregates one severity-grouped report from /review or a code_review tool call.
description.zh: 通过 /review 命令或 code_review 工具并行派出只读评审员子代理小队（安全、正确性、测试、风格，各自可指定不同模型），并汇总为按严重度分组的结构化评审报告。

description.en: Pre-install supply-chain poison scanner for DSH plugins: AST (JS-X-Ray) + deobfuscation + regex heuristics, exits non-zero on findings for CI gating.
description.zh: DSH 插件安装前投毒扫描：AST（JS-X-Ray）+ 去混淆解码 + 正则启发式，发现即非零退出，可作 CI 门禁。

description.en: Lab/project progress management for DeepSeek Harness: 16 progress_* agent tools (item CRUD, day-board pages, daily records, global search, overview, gantt, comments, import/export) plus a 「进度」sidebar tab in better-sidebar hosting the original web UI; data lives in the session project's .progress/progress.json.
description.zh: 「进度」实验/项目进度管理：16 个 progress_* agent 工具（安排增删改查、画板页、每日记录、全局搜索、概览、甘特、留言、导入导出），并在 better-sidebar 注册「进度」侧边栏 tab 托管原版界面；数据存会话项目 .progress/progress.json，随项目目录走。

description.en: Fetch academic papers by DOI or keyword: Crossref and OpenAlex search, batch PDF download through eight Sci-Hub mirrors with an Unpaywall open-access fallback, PDF magic-byte validation, bounded concurrency, and a clickable batch-access HTML manifest for papers that could not be downloaded.
description.zh: 按 DOI 或关键词获取学术文献：Crossref 与 OpenAlex 检索，经 8 个 Sci-Hub 镜像批量下载 PDF 并以 Unpaywall 开放获取兜底，含 PDF 魔数校验与并发控制，并为未下载到的文献生成可点击的批量获取清单 HTML。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file attachments as Codex-style cards, with in-app PDF/text/video/audio previews and system-default opening for other formats.
description.zh: 拖拽文件以 Codex 风格附件卡片呈现，支持 PDF/文本/音视频应用内预览，其余格式调用系统默认应用打开。

description.en: OpenViking memory integration for DeepSeek Harness with configurable automatic context injection; derived from the official OpenViking DSH plugin.

Search the documents and pictures in your Quberi knowledge base, browse its spaces and documents, save notes to it, and upload files into it with your approval for each one, from DeepSeek Harness over OAuth.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内通过 OAuth 检索你的 Quberi 知识库中的文档和图片，浏览空间和文档，保存笔记，并上传文件（每个文件都需你确认）。

description.en: Branch-aware code knowledge graph for DSH - callers, impact, trace and architecture over 158+ languages, freshness-gated, one dispatcher tool, zero MCP sessions.
description.zh: DSH 原生分支感知代码知识图谱：调用链/影响面/路径/架构覆盖 158+ 语言，保鲜门控，切分支索引自动跟随，单工具分发零 MCP 会话。

description.en: Automatically highlights key points, definitions, warnings, and questions in completed assistant answers using one separate model call.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的助手回答完成后，额外调用一次模型，自动高亮其中的关键点、定义、警告和问题。

description.en: A draggable tarot card back in the corner of the DeepSeek Harness UI. Click to draw, right-click for the four spreads, full 78-card deck with bilingual meanings. Readings use only the cards actually drawn.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面角落里可拖动的塔罗牌背。点一下抽牌，右击选四种牌阵，完整 78 张牌库，正逆位含义中英双语。解读只用真正抽到的牌。

description.en: Interactive Side-Assistant Dock to ask quick side questions via /btw with real-time thinking status and history pagination without interrupting the active agent loop.
description.zh: 交互式侧边助手坞：用 /btw 快速提问，实时显示思考状态，历史记录分页浏览。

description.en: Manages the default DSH model, provider and model visibility, and optional OpenAI Responses web search.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 默认模型、Provider 与模型可见性，并支持可选的 OpenAI Responses 联网搜索。

description.en: One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able DSH.app built by script.
description.zh: macOS 上 DSH Web 的一键启停启动器：前台/后台启动、停止、状态、防重复启动、自动打开浏览器，并可用脚本构建程序坞版 DSH.app。
