description.en: Use ChatGPT and Codex subscriptions in DeepSeek Harness with OAuth, quota runway forecast, safe resets, web search, image generation, and Fast mode.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接使用 ChatGPT / Codex 订阅：OAuth 免密、额度续航预测、安全重置、联网搜索、生图与高速模式。

description.en: Cross-agent monitoring board for local AI agent sessions (cursor-ide, claude, codex, copilot, kimi and dsh itself) with session timelines, and message injection behind a default-off two-phase confirmation gate.
description.zh: 跨 agent 看板监控本机 AI agent 会话（cursor-ide、claude、codex、copilot、kimi 及 dsh 自身），提供会话时间线，并可经默认关闭的两阶段确认门注入消息。

description.en: Codex-style /side side conversations for DeepSeek Harness: a temporary fork of the current chat in a floating panel, inheriting context without interrupting the main task.
description.zh: Codex 风格 /side 侧边对话插件：在当前对话旁开一个浮动分叉面板，继承上下文、不打断主任务。

description.en: Exits the dsh CLI process automatically when the Web UI closes, with a configurable grace period and dry-run mode.
description.zh: 关闭 DSH Web UI 后自动退出 CLI 进程（等效 Ctrl+C），支持可配置宽限期与试运行模式。

description.en: DSH hardware sandbox plugin: assemble a 3D scene of ESP32 / BME280 / PIR / LED components with protocol- and voltage-checked port wiring, run real Python project code in the loop against simulated I2C/GPIO hardware with fault injection, let networked device simulators report over HTTP to a real backend (validated end-to-end against a live seat-reservation system), observe a real device read-only and map its state onto the scene, and add support for new boards through data-driven pin definitions. Ships 16 hw_* agent tools plus a bundled SKILL.md.
description.zh: DSH 嵌入式硬件沙盒插件：在 3D 面包板场景里摆放 ESP32 / BME280 / PIR / LED 等器件、按协议与电压校验接线；让真实 Python 项目代码在环运行、经 Python shim 读虚拟 I2C/GPIO 的寄存器级读数，支持故障注入（断线 / NACK / busy / 强制读数）；联网设备模拟器可向真实 HTTP 后端周期上报（已在真实"智能选座"系统全链路验证）；还可只读观察真机状态，并用数据驱动的型号定义支持新硬件。随插件带 16 个 hw_* 工具与一份 SKILL.md。

description.en: Per-session question index for the DSH Web UI: a time-proportional dot rail on the right edge and an expandable chain panel showing every user question with its time, including branch/subagent sessions; clicking a node jumps to that message and highlights it.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话提问索引：右缘时间比例圆点窄条与可展开链面板，展示每次用户提问的问题与时间，含分支/子会话；点击节点跳转并高亮对应消息。

description.en: Cross-session full-text search over persisted DSH session logs: builds an incremental message-level index and returns sessionId, seq, and a short excerpt; exposes an agent tool and a standalone panel. Requires Node.js 23.5+.
description.zh: 跨会话全文搜索：对持久化 DSH 会话日志建立增量消息级索引，返回 sessionId、seq 与摘录；提供 agent 工具和独立面板。需 Node.js 23.5+。

description.en: Composer code-quote collapse for the DSH Web UI: pasting a `path:line` header followed by code folds the input into one compact inline quote chip, and at send time the `agent/pre-step` hook injects the full pasted snapshot to the model as a separate context message. 0.5.x also folds sidebar file-selections that insert only a `path:lines` line (large selections), fetching the code from disk by session cwd, and preempts Ctrl+V paste interception.
description.zh: 输入框代码引用折叠：粘贴「路径:行号 + 代码」时自动折叠为「文件图标+文件名:行号」引用芯片（Ctrl+Z 可还原），发送时由 agent/pre-step 钩子将完整代码快照作为独立上下文消息注入给模型。0.5 起支持侧边栏「添加到对话框」大段选区（仅插路径行时按会话工作目录读磁盘取代码），并在捕获阶段抢权接管 Ctrl+V 粘贴。

description.en: Shows per-turn changes in cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity, and maximum nesting depth for TypeScript, Python, and Go in the Web UI, with expandable file and function summaries for code review.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中展示每轮任务前后的圈复杂度、认知复杂度和最大嵌套深度变化，支持 TypeScript、Python 和 Go，可展开文件和函数查看详情，帮助确定代码审查重点。

description.en: Four palettes for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — solid, glass, volume and neon — each with light and dark halves. Neon adds a scene light field with a 46px circuit grid, a laser scan that sweeps the conversation column only while a turn is running, HUD-style workspace labels in the sidebar, embedded MiSans Latin chrome type, and a 125% sidebar type scale that stays fixed while the conversation area zooms.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的四套配色：实心 / 玻璃 / 体积 / 霓虹，各含明暗两半。霓虹版在整窗场景光场上叠 46px 电路网格，并在模型运行时让一条激光扫描线扫过对话列（停止即消失）；侧栏工作区名为青色 HUD 标牌，界面拉丁字体内置 MiSans，侧栏字号固定 125% 且不随对话区缩放。

description.en: Session management for DSH: archive/restore, batch & conditional delete, AI auto-rename, interrupted-session auto-resume, workspace grouping, undo last message, repair damaged session logs (seq-gap/EIO/dual-format), value analysis and full-text search — plus plan/closing template injection (system prompt + context).
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强：归档/恢复、批量与条件删除、AI 自动重命名、中断自动续跑、按工作区分组、撤回最后一条消息、三类损坏日志修复（seq-gap/EIO/双格式）、价值分析与全文搜索——另含方案/收尾模板注入（系统提示词 + 上下文）。

description.en: Cross-session event-cue memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracts task/conversation cues and user language habits from every turn into a persistent global cue bank, then re-injects remembered context on topic-switch detection (keyword or vector matching).
description.zh: 跨会话「触点记忆库」插件：自动从每轮对话提取任务/会话级触点与用户惯用词，存入全局持久记忆库；检测到话题切换时重新注入相关历史记忆（关键词或向量匹配）。

description.en: `describe_image` tool: a vision bridge that sends images to mimo-v2.5 through the opencode Zen API (credential `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`, free route first with paid fallback) and returns text descriptions for text-only models, with native passthrough and ImageMagick transcoding of SVG/TIFF/HEIC formats.
description.zh: `describe_image` 视觉桥：经 opencode Zen API（凭据 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`，免费线路优先、付费兜底）把图片发给 mimo-v2.5、返回文字描述给纯文本模型，原生格式直发，SVG/TIFF/HEIC 等格式经 ImageMagick 自动转码。

description.en: LaTeX snippet expansion in the composer, built from Obsidian LaTeX Suite's own defaults — 138 triggers expand as they are typed, Tab walks the tabstops, and the table of 142 is editable in one JSON file.
description.zh: 输入框里的 LaTeX 片段展开，触发词表直接取自 Obsidian Latex Suite 的默认片段——138 条打完即出，Tab 依次跳 tabstop，142 条全在一份可编辑的 JSON 里。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness sessions to Feishu/Lark, Telegram and DingTalk: each chat is bound to a resumable DSH session, replies stream back as cards, and a task-end card reports the model, token usage, step count and duration. Question and permission-approval cards are answerable from the chat, and a web settings pane configures the per-channel credentials.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话接入飞书/Lark、Telegram 与钉钉：每个聊天绑定一个可续接的 DSH 会话，回复以卡片流式回传，任务结束时用一张结果卡汇报模型、token 用量、步数与耗时。提问与权限审批可直接在聊天里作答，各渠道凭据在 Web 设置面板中配置。

description.en: Question index: an ordered, collapsible list of your asked questions floating on the right side of the conversation; click a question to jump the session to that point. Auto-indexes each session's full history on open, persists it locally, and jumps to older questions by growing the window on demand.
description.zh: 提问索引：在会话右侧按序展示你提过的问题列表，可收起；点击某条即可把会话滚动跳转到对应位置。打开会话自动索引全部历史提问并本地持久保存；点击更早的提问会按需翻页加载后跳转。

description.en: Offline voice input for the DSH Web UI: mic to local FunASR (SenseVoiceSmall), one-click install, no cloud.
description.zh: DSH Web 本地离线语音输入：麦克风经本地 FunASR（SenseVoiceSmall）识别后填入输入框，支持一键安装，全程离线。

description.en: Langfuse observability for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-turn trace trees aggregated by session id, with prompt versioning and evaluation.
description.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 Langfuse 可观测性插件：会话轮次映射为 Langfuse trace 树（同会话经 session id 聚合），提供 Prompt 版本管理与评测能力。

description.en:
Static HTML auditor for Chinese line-breaking: checks explicit-`
` orphan lines, keep-all CSS coverage, CJK line-start/line-end punctuation rules, and protected-phrase splits, then inserts at natural breakpoints; exposes a cn_linebreak_audit tool for agents.
description.zh:
中文网页文案断行静态审查与修复工具：检查显式
孤字行、keep-all 覆盖、标点禁则、保护词被拆等问题，并在自然停顿处自动插入 ；提供 cn_linebreak_audit 工具供代理调用。

description.en: Adds a "History" conversation view tab listing the session's user messages as a clickable directory, with auto-paging and click-to-jump back into the chat.
description.zh: 在会话头部新增「目录」tab：把当前会话的用户消息整理成可点击的目录，自动翻页加载全部历史，点击即跳回对话并定位。

description.en: Pauses peak-hour requests that target official or listed models and lets everything else run, with editable peak windows, a per-model interception list and per-session free-run in the badge panel.
description.zh: 高峰时段只暂停指向官方或拦截列表内模型的请求，其余照常放行；峰谷时段、按模型的拦截列表与会话「畅跑」都能在徽标面板里编辑。

description.en: Arrow-key input history for DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1: press ↑ in an empty composer to recall this session's prompts, ↓ to go forward, Esc to restore the draft.
description.zh: DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1 输入框历史：空输入框按 ↑ 召回当前会话刚发过的话，↓ 前进，Esc 还原正在打的草稿。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for IsingQ: guided QUBO modeling and validation on-device, then user-confirmed remote solving.
description.zh: IsingQ 原生插件：引导式 QUBO 建模与本地校验，用户确认后提交远端求解。

description.en: Select text in a reply and quote it into the composer as an atomic reference chip: delete the whole chip in one keystroke, click it to scroll back and highlight the quoted turn, and expand it into a bounded reference block at send time so the model can tell the quote apart from what the user typed. Also opens the snippet in a side chat, or copies it to the clipboard.
description.zh: 在回复里选中文字，把引用作为原子 chip 写进输入框：一次按键整体删除、点击回跳并高亮被引用的轮次、发送时展开成带边界的引用块，让模型能分清引用与用户输入。另可把片段送进侧边对话，或复制到剪贴板。

description.en: Web Audio agent-heartbeat cues for the DSH web GUI: a low working hum while an agent is busy, ticks on streaming output, and a chime when a session awaits input or work finishes, with per-voice volume, mute toggle, and optional local audio files.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供 Web Audio 智能体心跳提示：Agent 忙碌时低频心跳、流式输出时滴答声、会话等待输入或工作完成时提示音；支持分音色音量、静音开关与本地音频文件替换。

description.en: Configurable per-turn budgets for supported file mutations, limiting distinct files, mutation calls, and UTF-8 payload bytes before tool execution.
description.zh: 为受支持的文件修改设置可配置的逐回合额度，在工具执行前限制不同文件数、修改调用数与 UTF-8 载荷字节数。

description.en: Live btop-style CPU/memory/temperature/GPU monitor tab for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的实时监控标签页，以 btop 风格展示 CPU／内存／温度／GPU。

description.en: Plugin quality scorecard for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 with grade, 6 components, fix suggestions per deduction, batch leaderboard - CLI plus an agent-callable quality_score tool.
description.zh: dsh 插件质量评分卡：0-100 分 + 等级 + 六项分项，逐项修复建议，支持批量榜单 - CLI + agent 可调用 quality_score 工具。

description.en: Floating community panel for the Web UI: 24h hot topics and hot plugins TOP10 with a draggable, always-on-top button.
description.zh: Web UI 的社区热门悬浮面板：24 小时热门话题与热门插件 TOP10，悬浮按钮可拖动置顶、点击居中展开。

description.en: dsh 工作区代码审查插件：把 open-code-review（ocr CLI）封装为 5 个模型工具 + 设置卡片（从宿主设置服务的 provider 清单选 provider/model 应用到 OCR 配置）。
description.zh: 把 open-code-review 命令行封装成 5 个模型工具和设置面板，让 dsh 里直接做代码审查。

description.en: Per-profile settings overlay for DeepSeek Harness: global settings.yaml stays the baseline while each profile overrides any namespace through its own profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml — object sections merge recursively, scalars and arrays replace wholesale, and !unset masks an inherited value. The overlay is transparent to existing plugins (they keep reading ctx.settings unchanged), writes land in the profile overlay only, and official schema validation, revision semantics, expectedRevision conflicts, watchers and events are untouched. Ships a settings command family (get/set/unset/mask/unmask/promote/demote/migrate/diff/layers) plus a Profile Settings section in the web Settings panel over a loopback RPC channel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按 profile 分层的设置覆盖：全局 settings.yaml 仍为基线，每个 profile 可用自己的 profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml 覆盖任意设置命名空间——对象段递归合并，数组与标量整体替换，!unset 显式屏蔽继承值。覆盖层对现有插件透明（照常读 ctx.settings），写入只落在 profile 覆盖层；官方 schema 语义、revision、expectedRevision 冲突检测、watcher 与事件均不改动。附带 settings 命令族（get/set/unset/mask/unmask/promote/demote/migrate/diff/layers），并在 Web 设置面板经 loopback RPC 通道提供 Profile Settings 区块。

description.en: Adds a custom right-click context menu to the sidebar workspace files tree, with new folder, rename, reveal in file manager, open in browser, open in VS Code, copy path, streaming ZIP download, and delete.
description.zh: 为侧边栏「工作区文件」树添加自定义右键菜单：新建文件夹、重命名、在文件管理器中显示、浏览器打开、VS Code 打开、复制路径、流式 ZIP 下载、删除。

description.en: xAI (Grok/X subscription) OAuth login plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 用设备码 OAuth 登录 xAI Grok 订阅，自动刷新访问令牌，并作为 xai 路由凭据使用，无需 API key。

description.en: Interactive whale particle background for the DSH Web UI: every dot carries its own slow force; mouse disturbs them, plus an auto screensaver mode with 360-degree waves and full-screen breathing. Custom particle colours, a soft bloom glow, and selectable
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 加一层点阵背景:点阵可组成鲸鱼剪影,或导入透明 PNG 按 alpha 取主体;每颗粒子各自持有低频外力,手动模式下跟随光标扰动,自动屏保模式则用 360° 任意方向的扫波与全屏呼吸带动整幅图案;鼠标/自动与鲸鱼/照片在参数面板里切换,入口在 设置 → 插件。

description.en: Pushes DSH session events to phone IM and lets you reply straight under that message, injecting the text back into the right session. Covers nine event kinds: task completion, execution error, execution blocked, manual abort, token limit reached, abnormal interruption, waiting for your answer, permission request, and waiting for plan confirmation. Channels are QQ single-chat bots and Feishu custom apps, both over WebSocket long connections — no public IP, domain or tunneling needed. Several bots can be configured at once, each subscribing to the sessions it cares about. Approvals and questions arrive with tappable buttons, and replies route home through three layers (button, quoted reply, explicit short-id prefix), falling back to the most recent intervention-needed notification and echoing which session it went to.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话事件推到手机 IM，并允许在那条消息下直接回复回注到正确会话。覆盖九类事件：任务完成、执行错误、执行被阻塞、手动中止、Token 达到上限、异常中断、等待我回答、权限请求、等待计划确认；通道支持 QQ 单聊机器人与飞书自建应用，两者均走 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 IP、域名或内网穿透。可同时配置多台机器人，各自订阅自己关心的会话。审批与提问以可点按钮下发，回复按「按钮 → 引用回复 → 显式短 id 前缀」三层路由归位，兜底发给最近一条需人介入的通知并回显投递目标。

description.en: Adds a Long text button to the composer tool row: write or paste the body in an editor overlay, and on save it is written to <workspace>/.dsh-longtext/<timestamp>_<title>.md and an @ path reference to that file is appended to the composer, leaving the conversation free of the long text itself.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏新增「长文本」按钮：在编辑器浮层里写或粘贴正文，保存后写入 <工作区>/.dsh-longtext/<时间戳>_<标题>.md，并把该文件的 @ 路径引用追加到输入框，让正文不进入对话。

description.en: Code RAG semantic index panel and settings card: live index bar with start/rebuild/cancel, plus one-click detection and configuration.
description.zh: Code RAG 语义索引面板与设置卡片：输入框上方的实时索引条（开始/全量重建/取消），以及一键检测与配置（Qdrant/Ollama/预设/ignore）。

description.en: 网文写作工作台完整版（含可选嵌入提供方）

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-linfengqaqtat-dsh-scriptor-full
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for @linfengqaqtat/dsh-scriptor-full

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Improve the current chat draft before sending with a confirm-before-apply comparison.
description.zh: 在发送前优化当前聊天输入，采用前先对比原文与优化结果。

description.en: TRAE-style conversation rollback rebuilt for DSH 0.1.7-rc.2: per-turn file checkpoints restore touched files and truncate the model context in place under the same session id. Adds a /rollback doctor framework-contract self-check, an affected-file diff preview computed against the current on-disk state so it stays correct after a restart, a one-click undo-last action with a Ctrl+Shift+Z shortcut, a setting for whether rolled-back messages stay hidden, and English UI text.
description.zh: TRAE 式「回退到本轮对话发起前」：按轮次建立文件检查点，回滚工作区文件并在同一 session id 下原位截断模型上下文，已适配 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2。新增 /rollback doctor 契约自检、按当前磁盘状态实时计算的受影响文件 diff 预览（重启后依然准确）、一键「回退最近一轮」（快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+Z）、「回退后隐藏已回退消息」开关，以及英文界面文案。

description.en: Database connections and SQL for DeepSeek Harness: register data sources, browse and comment schemas, run AST-checked SQL with a per-source read-only toggle, and render bar, line and pie charts, from chat or the Settings page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据库连接与 SQL 插件：注册数据源，浏览并注释表结构，通过 AST 校验执行 SQL（每个数据源可单独切换只读），并渲染柱状图、折线图和饼图，可在对话或设置页中使用。

description.en: Adds a pin button to the DSH Desktop title bar that toggles always-on-top for the main window. Windows 10/11 only.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 标题栏加一枚图钉，一键切换主窗口置顶。仅 Windows 10/11。

description.en: Infinite canvas for sessions, with regions bound to workspaces and agent presets, pinned session cards, sticky notes and alignment guides.
description.zh: 无限会话画布，区域绑定工作区与智能体预设，可钉住会话卡片、放置便签，带对齐参考线。

description.en: Write guard for the Akasha Book store: blocks tool calls that write into the memory data directory, and injects the store usage contract and self-layer sections into the system prompt. Companions: Hindsight (repo memory), OpenViking (user memory), and the built-in session search (see repo README). Setup: clone the repo, copy core/ aside, then replace <AKASHA_DIR> in cordis.patch.yml with its absolute path (or set the AKASHA_DIR env var); plugins fail loudly while the placeholder remains.
description.zh: 阿卡夏之书门控：拦截写入记忆数据目录的工具调用，并把库用法约定与自我层注入系统提示。（配套：Hindsight 仓库记忆 / OpenViking 用户记忆 / 宿主会话检索；见仓库 README） 安装：clone 仓库并复制 core/，把 cordis.patch.yml 里的 <AKASHA_DIR> 换成实际路径（或设 AKASHA_DIR 环境变量）；占位符未替换时插件会明确报错。

description.en: Adds mark-unread, copy session info, reveal in Finder or open with your IDE, and permanent delete (with child sessions) to the DSH sidebar session menu, plus error and unread status dots, hover-card details, one-click delete for archived rows, and a settings panel that switches each menu item on or off; the interface is available in English and Chinese.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏的会话右键菜单补上标记未读、复制会话信息、在访达中显示或换 IDE 打开、永久删除（连子会话一起删），并给会话行加上报错与未读状态点、悬浮卡信息、归档行的一键删除，以及一个可逐项开关菜单的设置面板；界面提供中英文两套文案。

description.en: DSH 插件：团队 —— 可保存复用的团队模板，成员可各自使用不同 Agent 预设（能力不同），在会话输入框选中后由队长调度协作并统一汇总。

Thinking-loop guard for dsh: observes the llm/stream waterfall and breaks a model that degrades into a loop. Detects two per-call shapes (reasoning-only calls, restated-material calls) and re-fires instead of latching; plus two mid-stream breakers that en

Checks an official document's type and reference number against the published party and government document format standard - including the bracket form the year is written in and the numbering pattern. Reports what does not match the format; it does not judge the document's content.
description.zh: 依据公开的党政机关公文格式标准，核对公文的文种与发文字号——包括年份所用的括号形式与编号格式。只报告与格式不符之处，不评价公文内容。

description.en: Bring text-to-video and image-to-video generation to DeepSeek Harness — DashScope Wanx, Volcengine/Doubao Seedance, Google Veo, OpenAI Sora & compatible relays.

Floating GPU monitor for the DSH Web UI: a compact, draggable strip with one row per discrete GPU (exact name, utilization, VRAM, temperature, power draw) from nvidia-smi, stays visible over side panels and side cards, with a top-VRAM-process list when the driver reports it; degrades to an n/a pill on machines without an NVIDIA driver.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面内置的悬浮 GPU 监控：紧凑可拖动的条带，每张独立 GPU 一行（精确名称、利用率、显存、温度、功耗），数据来自 nvidia-smi；侧边面板或侧边卡片打开时保持在最上层；驱动支持时还列出显存占用最高的进程；无 NVIDIA 驱动的机器会退化为 n/a 胶囊。

description.en: Checks supervision logs for cross-day continuity and for on-site supervision coverage, against GB/T 50319-2013 and other published documents. Reports gaps and coverage differences for a human to review.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 50319-2013 等公开文件，核对监理日志的跨日连续性，以及旁站监理的覆盖情况。列出缺漏与覆盖差异供人复核。

description.en: Measure whether a dsh setup change actually helped: register repeatable cases, run them, and diff the results before and after you change rules, skills, or models.

A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness with auto-collapsing process, a minimap-style message navigation rail, in-page search, unified failure cards, and generative MCP Apps (SEP-1865) in sandboxed iframes.
description.zh: 阅读视图增强插件——执行过程自动收起、右缘消息导航导轨、页内查找、统一失败卡片，支持生成式 MCP Apps（SEP-1865）沙箱交互。

description.en: Browse the GitHub issues and pull requests of a workspace's origin remote, filter and comment, close or reopen, and file one as a task on dsh-plugin-taskboard for an agent to claim.
description.zh: 浏览工作区 origin 远端对应的 GitHub issue 与 pull request，筛选、评论、关闭或重开，并可转成任务写到 dsh-plugin-taskboard 的看板上等 agent 领取。

description.en: Pool AI provider accounts per platform and route them through a local loopback proxy that bridges the OpenAI, OpenAI-Responses, Anthropic and Gemini protocols, then write the proxy into Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Grok, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes config files with snapshot-and-rollback safe writes; registers no agent tools.
description.zh: 按平台把 AI 供应商账号组成算力池，经本地回环代理路由并在 OpenAI、OpenAI-Responses、Anthropic、Gemini 四种协议间桥接，再用带快照回滚的安全直写把代理写进 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI、Grok、OpenCode、OpenClaw、Hermes 的配置文件；不注册任何 agent 工具。

description.en: Task kanban where agents claim and hand off work through taskboard_* tools, which cannot move a task to done or canceled — acceptance stays with a human.
description.zh: 任务看板，agent 通过 taskboard_* 工具领活与交接；这些工具无法把任务移到 done 或 canceled，验收由人来做。

description.en: A biomedical Research Graph grounded in literature and experiment results. Fork hypotheses, connect evidence, advance research.
description.zh: 基于文献和实验结果的生物医学研究图谱，拆分假设，连接证据，推进研究。

description.en: Session budget gate for DeepSeek Harness: prices every turn against the official price table, warns at 80%, stops the task at 100%, and writes a handoff snapshot so the next session can continue the work.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的会话设预算上限：按官方价目表实时算账，80% 预警、100% 拦停任务，并落盘一份交接快照，让下一个会话接着干。

description.en: DSH plugin: model-generated session titles that follow the latest task, remember manual renames, persist their settings, and never fail silently.

Adds a diagram button under every finished reply in the DSH Web UI: the configured model writes a single-file HTML page with inline SVG and the right sidebar renders it in a sandboxed iframe, with diagram, source and original-text views, a per-session replay history that is served from a disk cache instead of calling the model again, redraw, and save to a .html file.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面每条定稿回复下加一个「图解」按钮：模型产出单文件 HTML（内联 SVG），右侧栏以沙箱 iframe 渲染；带图解／源码／原文三个视图、命中磁盘缓存即回放（不再调用模型）的会话内历史列表、重画与另存 .html。

description.en: PPT Master for DeepSeek Harness — agent preset 形式提供全套 ppt_* 工具（源文档→逐页手写 SVG→质检→导出可编辑 PPTX），只在选中该预设的会话里生效，不占用其他会话的上下文。
Adds a Codex-style message navigation rail for quickly locating earlier prompts in long DeepSeek Harness Web UI conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加 Codex 风格的消息导航轨道，方便在长会话中快速定位历史提问。

description.en: Branch and worktree management for DeepSeek Harness: the workspace toolbar shows the current branch with in-place switching, plus an IDEA-style branch selector, remote branch checkout, context menus (create, rename, delete, copy), push and update, and branch isolation into standalone worktrees with managed creation and deletion.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 git 分支与 worktree 管理：工作区工具栏显示当前分支并可原地切换；支持 IDEA 风格分支选择器、远程分支检出、右键操作菜单（新建/重命名/删除/复制）、推送与更新当前分支，以及把分支隔离到独立 worktree 工作区并管理其创建与删除。

description.en: Adversarial review for DeepSeek Harness: put one settled plan on the stand, send read-only red-team experts at it by dimension, then split their findings into single defects you endorse or reject one by one. It never rewrites the plan and never fixes code.
description.zh: 对抗式评审：把一个已定稿的方案摆上台，让只读红队专家按维度分头攻击，再把发言拆成逐条可裁决的缺陷由你逐一认定或驳回。它不产出方案、不改代码、不自动修复。

description.en: Switchable web-search provider for DSH: native DeepSeek web search or an OpenAI-compatible custom backend. Installation automatically routes DSH web searches to the plugin; only provider, API key and model are required. Published on npm as @lp181818/web-search-advanced@0.1.3.
description.zh: 安装后自动将 DSH 网页搜索路由到本插件；只需配置服务商、API Key 和模型即可使用。支持 DeepSeek 原生搜索与 OpenAI 兼容自定义后端，已发布为 npm 包 @lp181818/web-search-advanced@0.1.3。

description.en: Fills missing model parameters from models.dev, imports models from configured providers, and writes per-field overrides for built-in models, with prices in USD or native CNY set as manual rates or a reference price times a multiplier.
description.zh: 从 models.dev 补全缺失的模型参数，从已配置供应商导入模型，并按字段覆盖内置模型；价格可按美元或原生人民币设为手动单价，或按参考价乘自定义倍率。

description.en: Records host events — turn ends, tool results, agent errors, idle transitions and assistant output — as append-only JSONL for Akasha metrics, recall checks and output audit. Companions: Hindsight (repo memory), OpenViking (user memory), and the built-in session search (see repo README). Setup: clone the repo, copy core/ aside, then replace <AKASHA_DIR> in cordis.patch.yml with its absolute path (or set the AKASHA_DIR env var); plugins fail loudly while the placeholder remains.
description.zh: 把宿主事件（回合结束、工具结果、agent 错误、空闲切换、assistant 输出）落成 append-only JSONL，供指标、召回检查与输出审计使用。（配套：Hindsight 仓库记忆 / OpenViking 用户记忆 / 宿主会话检索；见仓库 README） 安装：clone 仓库并复制 core/，把 cordis.patch.yml 里的 <AKASHA_DIR> 换成实际路径（或设 AKASHA_DIR 环境变量）；占位符未替换时插件会明确报错。

description.en: DSH 的轻量 QQ 机器人插件（零运行时依赖）：WebSocket 收群聊/私聊消息接入 dsh 会话，并提供 qq_message / qq_group / qq_bot 三个工具供 AI 主动调用（发消息、发文件、读消息、按需下载附件、群管理、查状态）。自带「设置 → QQ 机器人」页面，支持手机 QQ 扫码绑定，无需手抄凭据。

Replaces the composer model selector with a "model · reasoning level" trigger: a slider across every level a model reports, three switchable modes (the DSH native selector, a gradient particle rail, an energy-charge track), and a per-provider one-click fill for models that declare no reasoning levels.
description.zh: 把 composer 的模型选择器换成「模型名 · 推理等级」触发区：滑块覆盖模型上报的全部等级，可切换三种模式（DSH 官方原生选择器、渐变粒子轨道、能量充能轨道），并可按代理商一键为未声明等级的模型补齐四档。

description.en: A Kun-Like desktop pet living in the corner of the DSH web UI; switches animations with agent state and plays a voice line on task completion.
description.zh: 住在 DSH Web 界面右下角的坤坤桌宠：随 Agent 状态切换动作，任务完成时播放「你干嘛~哎哟」。

description.en: Refines the built-in cache-hit percentage to three decimals in place across the composer stats row and the token-usage dialog.
description.zh: 把内置缓存命中率在 composer 统计行与 Token 用量弹窗中原位精化为三位小数。

description.en: Puts the DSH web UI on a phone browser over your own tailnet, with the remote channel built on Tailscale Serve. Both sides need only Tailscale: no dedicated app, no QR code, no login page, no account of its own, and no relay of your content. The desktop half runs on macOS, Windows or Linux.
description.zh: 让手机浏览器直接使用电脑上的 DSH 网页界面，远程通道建立在 Tailscale Serve 之上。两边除了 Tailscale 不用再装任何东西：没有专用 App、没有二维码、没有登录页，插件不设账号，也不中转你的内容。电脑端支持 macOS、Windows 与 Linux。

description.en: Reads and writes a self-hosted Bitwarden/Vaultwarden vault from any session: nine bitwarden_* tools, real-time WebSocket sync with a polling fallback, and a settings panel with readonly, ask and auto write modes.
description.zh: 让任意会话直接读写自建的 Bitwarden/Vaultwarden 保险库：九个 bitwarden_* 工具、WebSocket 实时同步（不可用时降级轮询），带 readonly/ask/auto 三档写权限的设置面板——可编辑五类条目，面板展示的密码与动态码会打码，对话里的工具卡片同样把密码等敏感值隐藏。

description.en: Installation safety gate & data-protection guard for DeepSeek Harness: 60 static signature rules scan plugin sources for malicious install scripts, credential theft, obfuscation and network callbacks before 'dsh plugin add', with scan baselines (gate_diff
description.zh: DSH 插件的安装安全闸门：在 "dsh plugin add" 前对本地目录或 npm 包做"杀毒"式扫描（安装脚本、权限、密钥、网络回连），给出 BLOCK/WARN/PASS 判定。

description.en: Everything (voidtools) file-name search: everything_find queries the local Everything index to locate files and folders on any indexed drive in milliseconds, and adds a configuration card to the Plugins page.
description.zh: 基于 Everything 索引的全盘文件名搜索：everything_find 工具毫秒级定位任意盘上的文件与文件夹，并在插件页提供配置卡片。

description.en: Local decision-layer plugin for DSH: a fail-closed command approval gate and ask/gate tools backed by a 144.3M on-device model. Needs a separate local decision service: `pip install phocinae-server`, then download the ~330 MB weights and keep the service running; without it the tool returns `PHOCINAE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`.
description.zh: DSH 本地决策层插件：失败关闭的命令审批门，以及由 144.3M 端侧模型支撑的 ask/gate 工具。需另装本地决策服务：`pip install phocinae-server` 后下载约 330MB 权重并常驻运行；服务不在时工具会返回 `PHOCINAE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for rulemux: asks the local rulemux CLI for the rules rendered for this workspace (rulemux inject --agent dsh) and injects the output into the session at the first user turn, once per session. Nothing is written into the workspace for rules; skills are the only part that lands on disk.
description.zh: rulemux 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：通过 rulemux inject --agent dsh 取当前工作区渲染出的规则，在每次会话的首条用户消息时把输出注入一次。规则不往工作区写任何文件；只有技能会落盘。

description.en: Token-authenticated REST and SSE bridge with QR pairing, so a phone app can read sessions, send messages and approve tool calls.
description.zh: 带令牌鉴权的 REST 与 SSE 接口，扫码配对后可在手机 App 上看会话、发消息、批准工具调用。

description.en: CapMap docs visualization with Obsidian-style semantic graph and capability panel.
description.zh: CapMap 文档体系可视化：Obsidian 风格语义图谱与能力面板。

description.en: Embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a DSH Desktop main panel through an Electron webview guest, with a back/forward/reload toolbar and a local snapshot of login-related localStorage restored on the next open.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版主面板里通过 Electron webview 嵌入 DeepSeek 网页版聊天（chat.deepseek.com），带后退/前进/刷新工具栏，并把登录相关的 localStorage 快照存在本地、下次打开时回填。

description.en: Connects a DSH Host to Slack and Feishu using your own bot applications.
description.zh: 使用自建机器人应用，将一个 DSH Host 接入 Slack 和飞书。

description.en: Save whole turns — the question plus the full answer — as plain Markdown inside the session workspace, promote the good ones into a cross-project personal knowledge base, and let the model search it on demand. No database and no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把整轮问答（问题 + 完整回答）存成工作区里的纯 Markdown；把值得留的提升进跨项目个人知识库，模型可按需检索。无数据库、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Manage frequently used file bookmarks in DeepSeek Harness, supporting bookmark saving, listing and navigation. It also allows creation of frequently used projects, including management projects, code projects and more.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理常用的文件书签，支持保存、列出与跳转，并且可以创建常用的项目，包括管理类项目、代码类项目等。

description.en: Browser-side preset visibility and ordering controls for the new-session page.
description.zh: 在新会话页控制 Agent 预设的显示与排序。

description.en: Notes and folder reader in the main panel: a file tree with pinned files, closeable tabs, Markdown split edit/preview with synced scrolling, plain-text editing, manual save, and drag-to-move. Deleting a file moves it to the system trash where one exists (macOS, Linux), falling back to an in-folder dsh-notes-trash directory; Windows has no delete entry.
description.zh: 主面板内的笔记与目录阅读器：文件树与置顶、可关闭的标签页、Markdown 左编右渲与同步滚动、纯文本编辑、手动保存、拖拽移动文件。删除时移入系统回收站（macOS、Linux），系统回收站不可用时移入目录内的 dsh-notes-trash 目录；Windows 不提供删除入口。

description.en: Enhanced right-sidebar files panel: rename, create, upload, download (a directory is zipped on the fly), copy the full path and delete from the tree; an editable document renderer for 128 text extensions with Ctrl/Cmd+S save and conflict detection; plus an independent bottom terminal panel with tabs and a quick-command library persisted under the DSH home.
description.zh: 侧边栏文件树增强：重命名、新建、上传、下载（目录当场打包为 zip）、复制完整路径与删除；128 种文本扩展名的可编辑文档渲染器，支持 Ctrl/Cmd+S 保存与版本冲突检测；另有一个独立的下侧终端面板，带标签页与持久化在 DSH home 里的快捷命令库。

description.en: A helmeted pixel chicken rides a bicycle along a Minecraft-style pixel strip docked at the bottom of the app frame, with an 80-second day/night cycle, bell with note particles, jumps, a headlight, and ride stats. Creepers roam by day and zombies by night. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-alpha.
description.zh: 一只戴头盔的像素小鸡骑行在 GUI 底部的我的世界像素风骑行带里，带 80 秒昼夜循环、按铃音符、跳跃、车头灯与骑行统计。白天苦力怕出没，夜晚僵尸被撞飞。需要 DSH >=0.2.1-alpha。

description.en: Copy session IDs, send messages to live or saved sessions, and view session token usage.
description.zh: 复制会话 ID、向在线或已保存的会话发送消息，并查看会话 token 用量。

description.en: System-level desktop floating-window plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a global hotkey opens a floating window; the plugin supports workspace and session switching, approval and follow-up handling, and export of its own diagnostic logs for plugin troubleshooting.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的系统级桌面悬浮窗插件：按下全局快捷键即可呼出桌面悬浮窗口，支持工作区与会话切换、审批与追问处理，以及插件自身的诊断日志导出。

description.en: Shows what each completed turn cost in CNY on its own row under the turn, with a click-to-open breakdown naming the tokens per category, the unit rate, the matched price rule and the billing instant; per-model rates are edited on a settings page inside DSH — four token categories plus weekly recurring peak/valley rules with arbitrary multipliers and absolute time-window promo prices that override them. 0.2.3 adds account awareness: it reads the balance or remaining quota of 14 providers (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Zhipu GLM, Moonshot, MiniMax, Kimi Coding, OpenAI-compatible relays and more) and shows today / this month / this session spend next to it; spend is accumulated in a local ledger (atomic writes, one book per API key, 1-24 month retention, JSON export), and a monthly calendar lets any day be corrected by hand - including days with no balance observation - with an optional note. Usage and rates are computed locally from what the provider reported; balance is read straight from the provider API with your own key, and nothing is sent to a third party.
description.zh: 在每个已完成回合的下方单独一行显示这一轮的花费金额（人民币），点击展开明细，列出各 token 类别的数量、单价、命中的价格规则与计费时刻；单价可在 DSH 设置页里按模型维护，含四类 token 单价、每周循环的峰谷规则（系数自定）与绝对时间区间的限时优惠价。0.2.3 起还能看账户：读取 14 家 provider 的余额或剩余额度（DeepSeek、OpenRouter、智谱 GLM、月之暗面、MiniMax、Kimi Coding、OpenAI 兼容中转站等），在旁边显示今日 / 本月 / 本会话花费；花费记在本机日账里（原子写、按 API key 分本、保留 1-24 个月、可导出 JSON），另有一张按月日历，任何一天都能手动更正（包括没有余额观测的日子）并可加备注。用量与单价都在本机计算，余额用你自己的密钥直接向 provider 接口查询，不经过第三方。

description.en: Adds a Theme row to Settings → General between Appearance and Font size — 8 builtin palettes plus Default, hover previews without writing, click applies and is persisted by the host; imports/exports custom dsh-theme.json files, with an optional Theme Creator skill behind /dsh-theme-creator.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 通用」的官方「外观」与「字号」之间注入「主题」行：8 套内置配色 + 默认项，悬停预览不写盘、点击应用并由 Host 持久化；支持导入/导出自定义 dsh-theme.json 主题文件，另有可选的 Theme Creator skill（/dsh-theme-creator）。

description.en: Balance dashboard, allowing the addition of multiple pay-as-you-go/Token plans, while simultaneously checking balances.
description.zh: 余额看板，可以添加多个按量计费/Token plan，同时查询余额。

description.en: Per-model custom request headers for DeepSeek Harness: define named header profiles in Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration, pick one per model in the provider's model catalog, and every call to that model carries those headers.
description.zh: 添加可配置的 HTTP 请求头配置档，并支持按模型选择。

description.en: Unofficial host-side ServerChan notifications for DeepSeek Harness: sends mobile alerts through WeChat (ServerChan Turbo) or the ServerChan³ app when approvals, plan reviews, or questions go unanswered beyond a configurable threshold, even with the browser closed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 Server酱通知插件：在主机端监控审批、计划评审和问答，超过设定时间仍未处理时通过微信（Server酱 Turbo）或 Server酱³ App 发送手机提醒，无需保持浏览器打开。

description.en: Estimate session and turn costs with model prices in USD or CNY and price sync from models.dev, OpenRouter, or DeepInfra.
description.zh: 估算会话和每轮费用，按模型设置 USD 或 CNY 单价，并从 models.dev、OpenRouter 或 DeepInfra 同步价格。

description.en: Reads a running workbuddy2api-panel over its HTTP API and syncs its models into the DSH model picker with credit multipliers, CN/international realm labels and per-model reasoning-effort levels; also shows remaining credits and usage in a settings page and a sidebar badge.
description.zh: 读取运行中的 workbuddy2api-panel 的 HTTP 接口，把面板模型连同倍率、国内/国际分区与逐模型思考档位同步进 DSH 的模型选择器，并在设置页与侧边栏徽标中显示剩余额度与用量。

description.en: Panellist manager: reorder the entries on the left rail, rename them, replace their icons, hide them, and fold several into a Group with a flyout menu, from a Settings tab.
description.zh: 面板列表管理器：在设置页里调整左侧轨道上的页签顺序、改名、换图标、隐藏，并把若干页签收进带飞出菜单的分组。

description.en: Registers an `image2_generate` tool that calls your own OpenAI-compatible image relay to generate or edit pictures (text-to-image via POST /images/generations, image-to-image via POST /images/edits with a local PNG/JPEG/WebP reference, accepting b64_json or image URLs), saves them in the session working directory, and renders them inline in the conversation through its `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` dependency.
description.zh: 注册 `image2_generate` 工具：调用你自己的 OpenAI 兼容图片中转站生成或编辑图片（文生图走 POST /images/generations，图生图走 POST /images/edits 并接受本地 PNG/JPEG/WebP 参考图，兼容 b64_json 与图片 URL 返回），图片保存在会话工作目录内，并借助其 `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` 依赖在对话里内联渲染。

description.en: Windows bash tool for DeepSeek Harness: replaces the preset pwsh with Git for Windows or MSYS2 (UCRT64/MINGW64/CLANG64/...) bash while keeping the official terminal contract — workdir, background jobs and timeout promotion, result markers, terminal cards — and adds a settings row that discovers and validates Git/MSYS2 installations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows bash 工具：用 Git for Windows 或 MSYS2（UCRT64/MINGW64/CLANG64…）的 bash 替换预设里的 pwsh，保留官方终端契约（workdir、后台任务与超时转后台、结果标记、终端卡片），并提供一个可自动发现、校验 Git/MSYS2 安装的设置行。

description.en: Native right-sidebar Markdown preview with Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, GFM tables and syntax highlighting — rendering engine bundled, fully offline.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生右侧文件预览中渲染 Mermaid 图表、KaTeX 公式、GFM 表格与代码高亮，渲染引擎随包内置，完全离线。

description.en: Holds the OS wake lock while any agent, subagent, or background job runs, releases it after a configurable grace period, and provides a bilingual web settings page with live status, manual hold, and display-on options.
description.zh: 任意 agent、subagent 或后台任务运行时持有系统唤醒锁，全部结束后按可配置宽限期释放；提供中英双语 Web 设置页，实时显示活动与唤醒锁状态，支持手动保持与阻止屏幕关闭。

description.en: Evidence-list completeness check: maps facts to evidence and reports gaps with rule IDs.
description.zh: 证据清单齐备性核对：把待证事实映射到证据并输出缺口与规则 ID。

description.en: A plugin for dsh: monitor the resource utilization of dsh system processes, and report the results to the user in the form of charts.
description.zh: 面向 dsh 的插件：监控 dsh 系统进程的资源占用,并以图表形式向用户报告结果。

description.en: Drives a Chromium browser you are already running — Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Chromium, Arc or Thorium — over one long-lived CDP connection, so the remote-debugging approval is asked once instead of per command. Commands for tabs, navigation, JS evaluation, DOM snapshots, clicks, typing, screenshots and CSS/DOM/pixel assertions go over a loopback HTTP route that the agent calls with the shell tool it already has, so no new tools are registered, and the plugin registers its own usage skill with no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 通过一条常驻 CDP 连接驱动本机已在运行的 Chromium 内核浏览器——Chrome、Edge、Brave、Vivaldi、Opera、Chromium、Arc、Thorium，远程调试授权只需点一次，而不是每条命令都点。标签页、导航、执行 JS、DOM 快照、点击、输入、截图以及 CSS/DOM/像素断言都走本机回环 HTTP 路由，agent 用已有的 shell 工具发命令，因此不注册新工具；插件自带使用说明 skill，零运行时依赖。

description.en: A secret store for DSH Desktop that keeps API keys in one place and injects them into the assistant's shell as $DSH_* variables.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供密钥库，集中保管 API 密钥并以 $DSH_* 变量注入助手的 shell 中。

description.en: AI Quota and Token Usage Monitor for DeepSeek Harness (DeepSeek, SiliconFlow, OpenRouter, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity, Copilot, Kimi, GLM, Qwen, OpenCode)
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 额度与用量监控：实时追踪 Codex、Cursor、Google Antigravity 与 OpenCode-Go 剩余额度与重置倒计时。

description.en: Give the agent a talking face: seven tools that drive a self-hosted Mynah realtime digital human — speak (queued or interrupting), play a gesture clip, interrupt, list live sessions and channels, check health, add text to its knowledge base.
description.zh: 给 Agent 一张会说话的脸：七个工具驱动自托管的 Mynah 实时数字人——开口说话（排队或打断）、播放动作片段、打断、查看在线会话与频道、健康检查、往知识库加文本。

description.en: Aquaculture input register completeness and withdrawal-period date check: deterministic findings with rule IDs.
description.zh: 水产养殖投入品记录完整性与休药期日期核对：按规则 ID 输出确定性发现。

description.en: 侧栏管家：整理侧栏入口、设置快捷键并添加自定义链接。

Local AI-agent request-log panel: aggregates local logs from atomcode, codebuddy, workbuddy, claude, codex, codearts, gemini, cursor, kimi and dsh, and shows per-round latency, tokens, cache, context and tool calls.
description.zh: 本地 AI agent 请求日志面板：聚合 atomcode、codebuddy、workbuddy、claude、codex、codearts、gemini、cursor、kimi、dsh 等本地日志，查看每轮耗时、token、缓存、上下文与工具调用。

description.en: Connect OpenCode Zen free-tier models into DeepSeek Harness. Real-time model discovery, per-model toggle in settings, one-click provider write. No API key required.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，实时模型发现、设置页逐个启停、一键写入 provider，免 key。

description.en: HHIX/MBCM UI 设计工作台：一条 /hhix-init 就把一个文件夹变成完整的产品设计工程（内置 DESIGN.md、组件库、hhix-ui-design 技能、git 仓库，以及起服务/开浏览器/校验工具），并把每一步执行过程打印出来

Plugin advisor for DeepSeek Harness: describe what you need and it ranks the npm packages carrying the dsh-plugin keyword by denoised metrics (daily baseline, week-over-week growth, release cadence, freshness) into a first pick, alternates and plugins to avoid; ships a sidebar panel, four AI tools and one-click install.
description.zh: DSH 插件选购顾问：说需求，从带 dsh-plugin 关键字的 npm 包里按去噪指标（日常基线、周环比、版本节奏、新鲜度）排出首选、备选和不推荐；提供右侧栏面板、4 个 AI 工具和一键安装。

description.en: Registers the TypeSafe/Jev (System One) skill into DeepSeek Harness's global skill layer, so every session can classify, route, score, extract and gate on confidence using typed judgments instead of prompt-and-parse. Ships no API key; the user supplies OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
description.zh: 把 TypeSafe / Jev（System One 判断模型）的构建技能注册进 DeepSeek Harness 的全局技能层，让每个会话都能用带类型的判断做分类、路由、打分、抽取和置信度门控，取代「调大模型再解析回复」。不含任何密钥，API key 由使用者通过 OPENROUTER_API_KEY 提供。

description.en: Turn-handoff reminders in the DSH Web UI with a modal or top banner, six browser-synthesized chimes, configurable auto-dismiss, and a sidebar speaker toggle with an unread session list.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的回合交接提醒：居中弹窗或顶部横幅、六种浏览器合成提示音、可配置自动消失，以及带未读会话列表的侧栏喇叭开关。

description.en: 滚动钢琴：鼠标滑过 DSH 右侧边缘的滚动条竖条时，按纵向位置发出钢琴音（越高音越高，特雷门琴式）。

Settings page for agent modes (presets): switch up to 15 capabilities per mode (commands, files or read-only files, web, subagents, and more) or individual plugin rows; edit each mode's system prompt with variable checks, a full preview, version history, optional live updates for running sessions, and an approval-gated mode_prompt chat tool; create modes from four starter templates or copies; merge built-in updates after a dsh upgrade while keeping your changes, and turn off rows that fail to load.
description.zh: Agent 模式（预设）设置页：按模式开关最多 15 项能力（运行命令、读写或只读文件、网页、子代理等），也能逐个开关插件；编辑每个模式的系统提示词，带变量校验、完整预览和历史版本，可选让正在运行的会话即时生效，并提供每次保存都需审批的对话内修改工具 mode_prompt；用四个起步模板或复制现有模式新建模式；dsh 升级后合并内置更新并保留你的修改，一键关闭加载失败的插件。

description.en: Plan-and-execute orchestration over ReactLoopAgent — turns a goal into reviewable steps with a web UI plan card.
description.zh: 基于 ReactLoopAgent 的 Plan-and-Execute 编排插件，将目标拆解为可审阅的步骤并以 Web UI 卡片呈现。

description.en: Manually zoom the Harness Web UI from 75% to 200% via a Settings row, Ctrl+wheel, or a Session-header control, keeping text crisp and readable on high-DPI displays.
description.zh: 在高 DPI 显示器上手动缩放 Harness Web UI（75%–200%）：设置行、Ctrl+滚轮与会话标题栏控件三种入口，让文字更清晰易读。

description.en: Adds a button to the composer that rewrites the unsent draft into a clearer, more specific prompt, with one-click restore, a settings page and an optional per-request model override.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，把未发送的草稿改写为更清晰、更具体的提示词；支持一键还原、独立设置页，以及单次调用的模型覆盖。

description.en: Checks nursing records for entry timing, signatures and assessment-form completeness, against 《病历书写基本规范》 and other published documents. Reports what is missing or out of sequence for a human to review.
description.zh: 依据《病历书写基本规范》等公开文件，核对护理记录的书写时限、签名，以及评估表的完整性。列出缺失或次序不符之处供人复核。

description.en: Collects and redacts DSH runtime diagnostics before filing structured issues in GitHub or Gitea.
description.zh: 收集并脱敏 DSH 运行诊断信息，然后向 GitHub 或 Gitea 提交结构化问题报告。

description.en: Self-organizing multi-agent clusters with no orchestrator. Real DSH subagents coordinate through a shared append-only log that each agent reads and writes on its own schedule, with no topology and one dispatch per agent; a snapshot mode is also included where the harness freezes each neighbour view into the prompt and drives a ring/mesh/swarm cluster to convergence.
description.zh: 无编排者的自组织多智能体集群。真实 DSH 子智能体通过共享的只追加日志协调，由各智能体自行决定读写时机，无拓扑、每个智能体只派发一次；另附快照模式，由调度层把邻居视图冻结进提示词并驱动环形/网状/群集收敛。

description.en: Dracula (VS Code) dark theme for the DSH Web GUI: the vampire palette mapped onto the product colour tokens, plus a denser type scale, a 1080px reading column and code blocks that scroll instead of re-wrapping. Dark mode only.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Dracula（VS Code 吸血鬼）深色主题：把产品自身的配色令牌映射到德古拉调色板，并附更紧的字号阶梯、1080px 正文列宽与不折行的代码块。仅深色模式。

description.en: Flags ICD coding pairs that need a coder's attention - dagger and asterisk combinations, combination codes - against GB/T 14396-2016 and published ICD usage notes. Reports the pairs it finds rather than resolving them; the coding decision stays with the coder.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 14396-2016 与公开的 ICD 使用说明，提示需要编码员关注的 ICD 编码配对——剑号与星号组合、合并编码。只报告发现的配对，不代为判定，编码结论仍由编码员作出。

description.en: Checks a medical-record front sheet for field completeness and for internal logical contradictions between its fields, against 国卫办医发〔2016〕24号 and other published documents. Lists what is missing or inconsistent for a human to review; it does not assess clinical correctness.
description.zh: 依据国卫办医发〔2016〕24号等公开文件，核对病案首页各字段的齐备性与字段间的逻辑矛盾。列出缺失或不一致之处供人复核，不评价临床正确性。

description.en: Converts Office and PDF files in the DSH workspace to Markdown locally — no network, no API quota — before the model reads them. Writes each .md next to its source so only a file path enters the context, and returns byte size, line count, token estimate and a heading outline, for a single file or a whole directory.
description.zh: 在模型读取之前，把工作区里的 Office / PDF 文件在本机转成 Markdown（不联网、不消耗 API 额度），.md 写在源文件旁边，因此进入上下文的只是一个文件路径，并返回字节数、行数、token 估算与标题结构索引，支持单个文件或整个目录。

description.en: Skills and MCP management console in the settings panel: merged skill catalog across every provider (hierarchical browse by source, online create/edit, independent model and user invocation switches, recoverable trash), GitHub install with multi-select batch install and update checks, MCP server add/edit/remove and enable/disable through the profile patch layer, cross-agent import from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Cline, Roo Code, Continue and Windsurf, and an independent SDK connection probe.
description.zh: 设置面板里的技能与 MCP 管理控制台：跨全部来源合并的技能目录（按来源分级浏览、在线新建与编辑、模型 / 用户调用独立开关、可恢复回收站）、GitHub 安装（多选批量安装、检查更新）、通过 profile patch 层增删改与启停 MCP 服务器、从 Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / Cline / Roo Code / Continue / Windsurf 一键导入，以及独立的 SDK 连通性探测。

description.en: Voice announcements when a conversation ends (session title, round, outcome) plus live sentence-by-sentence reading of replies, via built-in edge-tts with zero third-party dependencies.
description.zh: 对话结束语音播报（会话名、轮数、结果），回复生成时实时逐句朗读；内置 edge-tts，零第三方依赖。

description.en: A deterministic calculation engine for DeepSeek Harness, including a preset that guides the LLM to calculate through the engine rather than by text generation.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性计算引擎，附带一个预设：引导 LLM 通过引擎而非文本生成来完成计算。

description.en: Routes DSH web search through the current session's model and a self-hosted retrieval backend.
description.zh: 让 DSH 网页搜索改走当前会话模型加自建检索后端。

description.en: Local Markdown long-term memory for DSH: an Obsidian-compatible vault, a sidebar management page, four memory tools, and budgeted per-turn recall.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供本地 Markdown 长期记忆：Obsidian 兼容仓库、侧边栏管理页、四个记忆工具，以及按预算的每回合召回。

description.en: Import Claude Code / Codex / ChatGPT / Cursor / Gemini / Reasonix / Pi Coding Agent / opencode / ZCode / Grok Build / OpenClaw / Hermes / Kimi CLI / Qoder CLI / WorkBuddy conversation histories as resumable ChatCode CLI sessions, plus movein asset migrati

Checks a hazardous-chemical register for internal consistency: that each substance names its hazard class, that stored quantities parse, that a threshold is recorded, that the major-hazard-source verdict agrees with how the stored quantity compares to the threshold the register states, that safety data sheet numbers are present and CAS numbers are not duplicated. Reports differences for a human to review; it does not decide whether a unit constitutes a major hazard source.
description.zh: 核对危险化学品台账的内部自洽性：每种物质是否载明危险性类别、储存量能否解析、是否记录临界量、重大危险源判定与该储存量相对台账自述临界量的关系是否一致、是否载明安全技术说明书编号、CAS 号是否重复。只列出差异供人复核，不判定某单元是否构成重大危险源。

description.en: System monitor for kids: a single card summary of CPU, memory and disk.
description.zh: 系统小监控：一张卡片看 CPU、内存、磁盘概况。

description.en: Lets DSH drive the Chrome tab you are already browsing, no vision needed: the page reaches the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and clicks, typing, key presses, scrolling, tab handling and navigation wait for your confirmation in the extension side panel while password and payment-card fields stay masked. Fifteen browser_* tools cover snapshot, text, tab list, open, follow, click, type, press, scroll, wait, navigate, back, close, forward and reload. A repack of the bridge plugin from omdsh-dev/dsh-browser, published to npm so it installs with `dsh plugin add`: the peer ranges the host checks are widened so the install is not refused as incompatible, the bundled extension also probes the DSH Desktop host port 19387 so no bridge address has to be typed, and a script copies the extension to a fixed directory so a profile switch or reinstall cannot break it. The prebuilt release tarball carries the plugin and the built MV3 extension. Upstream: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser.
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接操控你当前正在浏览的 Chrome 标签页，无需视觉能力：页面以带编号元素清单的结构化文本交给模型；点击、输入、按键、滚动、标签页操作与导航都会在扩展侧边栏等你确认，密码与支付卡字段保持掩码。15 个 browser_* 工具覆盖 snapshot、文本读取、标签页列举/打开/跟随、点击、输入、按键、滚动、等待、导航、后退、关闭、前进与刷新。本项目是 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser 桥接插件的再打包版，发布到 npm，可直接 `dsh plugin add` 安装：放宽了宿主安装时校验的 peer 范围，避免被判为版本不兼容；随包的扩展额外探测 DSH 桌面端宿主端口 19387，因此无需手填桥接地址；并附带脚本把扩展复制到固定目录，避免切换 profile 或重装后扩展失效。预构建 Release tarball 内含插件本体与已构建的 MV3 扩展。上游：https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser。

description.en: Focus-aware notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approvals, questions, plan reviews and finished replies appear as one alert only when the conversation window loses focus; background conversations alert at any time and subagent sessions never do.
description.zh: 焦点感知的 DeepSeek Harness 通知插件：审批、提问、方案确认与回复完成统一为一种提醒，当前对话在窗口失焦后才弹出，后台对话随时提醒，子代理会话不提醒。

description.en: Floating FC/NES game hall for DSH Web with fceumm, local ROM upload, and GitHub online library.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右下角挂悬浮球打开 FC/NES 游戏厅（fceumm），支持本地上传与自填 GitHub 在线库。

description.en: Expose every model already configured in your local DeepSeek Harness to the LAN over OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, with API keys, per-key rate limits, a circuit breaker, model filters and usage reports.
description.zh: 把本机 DeepSeek Harness 已配置的全部模型，以 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容接口开放给同一局域网；自带 API Key、按 Key 限流、熔断、模型过滤与用量报告。

description.en: OpenCode Go in the DeepSeek Harness model list, providing subscription quota display, model discovery, session affinity, and more.
description.zh: 把OpenCode Go接入DSH的模型列表，提供订阅额度显示、模型发现、会话亲和等功能。

description.en: Cross-session and cross-project long-term memory: a non-blocking silent sedimentation dispatch on turn/end writes into a local SQLite store (FTS5 trigram full-text index with insert/update/delete sync triggers) that later turns recall from; entries are scoped per project alongside a global tree, and the plugin ships its own embedded web dashboard (it starts the HTTP server itself, no separate process) for browsing, graphing and controlled deletion.
description.zh: 跨会话、跨工程的长期记忆：turn/end 时非阻塞派发无感静默沉淀，写入本机 SQLite（FTS5 trigram 全文索引，含增删改同步触发器）供后续回合召回；记忆按项目作用域与全局树分层存储，并自带内嵌 Web 看板（插件自身起 HTTP 服务，非独立进程）用于浏览、图谱与受控删除。

description.en: Correct-encoding command runner and mojibake recovery: encoding_run spawns a child process and decodes its raw output bytes (UTF-8/UTF-16LE/GBK auto-detected or forced), and encoding_decode recovers garbled text back to correct Unicode.
description.zh: 编码正确的命令执行与乱码还原：encoding_run 自动识别 UTF-8/UTF-16LE/GBK 并正确解码子进程输出，encoding_decode 把乱码文本还原为正确 Unicode。

description.en: One-button prompt optimizer: rewrites the composer draft via a configurable strategy, with an editable template, few-shot examples, pinned models and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 一键提示词优化：按可配置策略改写输入框草稿，提供可编辑模板、Few-shot 示例、指定模型与推理强度。

description.en: A row of model preset buttons above the composer: left-click switches the session to that preset's provider, model and reasoning effort, right-click opens an editor for it, and each preset can carry a custom name instead of the model id. The editor reads the session's live model catalog, and presets are stored locally.
description.zh: 输入框上方的一排模型预设按钮：左键点击把当前会话切换到该预设的提供方、模型与思考强度，右键点击打开该预设的编辑弹窗，每个预设还可以自定义备注名称而不必使用模型名。编辑弹窗读取当前会话真实的模型目录，预设保存在本地。

description.en: Adds a manim_card tool that renders Manim Python into a playable animation card in the chat stream; code runs in the browser via a bundled runtime, so no local Python is needed.
description.zh: 新增 manim_card 工具，把 Manim Python 渲染为聊天流中可播放的动画卡片；代码经随包分发的运行时在浏览器内执行，本机无需安装 Python。

description.en: Restarts the DSH desktop app on Windows and wakes the sessions listed for it afterwards. The agent-facing restart tool is off by default and refuses while the host is busy.
description.zh: 重启 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面端，并在重启后唤醒清单里指定的会话。面向 agent 的重启工具默认关闭，宿主繁忙时拒绝重启。

description.en: Keeps running, finished-but-unopened and currently open sessions pinned above the workspace groups in the DSH Web sidebar, and lets any session or workspace be pinned there from its own "..." menu.
description.zh: 把运行中、跑完未点开和当前打开的会话固定在 DSH Web 侧栏工作区分组上方，并可从任意会话/工作区的「...」菜单里全局置顶。

description.en: Bridges the CursorTouch/Windows-MCP desktop automation server into DSH through the official MCP client bridge, registering its screenshot, UI tree snapshot, mouse and keyboard input, clipboard, process and registry tools as mcp__windows__* tools for the model, and adds a windows_mcp_doctor diagnostic tool. Computer Use is off by default and is switched on from the plugin panel.
description.zh: 通过官方 MCP 客户端桥接层把 CursorTouch/Windows-MCP 桌面自动化服务器接入 DSH，把截屏、UI 树快照、鼠标键盘输入、剪贴板、进程与注册表等工具注册成 mcp__windows__* 供模型调用，并附带 windows_mcp_doctor 诊断工具；Computer Use 默认关闭，需在插件面板里打开。

description.en: Checks each step of a plan before you approve it, using command rules plus Jev or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with logprobs, and marks steps that can't be undone, affect things outside the workspace, weren't asked for or are too vague on the plan review card.
description.zh: 在你同意执行计划前逐步检查每一步，用命令规则加上 Jev 或支持 logprobs 的 OpenAI 兼容端点，在计划审阅卡片上标出无法恢复、影响工作区以外、需求没提到或描述太模糊的步骤。

description.en: Predicts your next message after each completed turn and shows it as ghost text in the composer: press → to accept, or keep typing and finish it word by word with Ctrl+→, Esc to dismiss. The prediction model follows the session by default or can be picked in the settings card, which also has an on/off switch and a speed test.
description.zh: 每轮对话结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色幽灵文字显示在输入框里：按 → 接受，也可以直接开始打字、用 Ctrl+→ 逐词补齐，Esc 关闭。预测模型默认跟随当前会话，也能在设置卡片里指定；卡片里还有总开关和测速。

description.en: Keeps the images you pasted or attached in the composer, per session: they are mirrored locally in the browser and handed back through the official draft channel when you return to the conversation or the composer remounts, and dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.
description.zh: 按会话保住输入框里的图片草稿：在浏览器本地留一份镜像，切回该对话或输入框重新挂载时经官方草稿通道放回去；消息一旦发出或你手动移除，就不再见它回来。

description.en: Renders LaTeX in the chat — formulas inside your own message bubble, plus a live preview of the composer draft while you type.
description.zh: 在聊天里渲染 LaTeX：你自己的消息气泡内联渲染公式，输入时还会实时预览草稿里的公式。

description.en: Bridges the agent to a persistent OKF memory vault over MCP stdio: a Python server (SQLite FTS5 + Markdown) with 10 tools for searching and storing decisions, facts, learnings, conventions, profiles and sources.
description.zh: 经 MCP stdio 把 Agent 接入持久化 OKF 记忆库：Python 服务端（SQLite FTS5 + Markdown），10 个工具用于检索与写入决策、事实和偏好。

description.en: Skill usage scoreboard for DSH: counts both per-session deduplicated and per-load usage, scores `skill` tool calls and direct `read` of skill files, and shows the tally in a three-tab settings page (skill ranking, session board, management) with paging and JSON import/export.
description.zh: DSH 的 Skill 使用记分板：同时记录按会话去重与每次加载两种次数，统计 skill 工具调用与直接 read skill 文件两种记分来源，设置页三选项卡（Skill 排行 / 会话榜 / 管理）展示，支持分页与记分 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Kids' coding classroom: run Python and LOGO-turtle code, explain, practice, review and step through programs.
description.zh: 小朋友的编程小教室：跑 Python 与海龟画图代码、讲解、练习、点评、分步。

description.en: Runs one-time and recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with natural-language schedules, visual schedule editing and session-linked history. Supports custom models, skills, pause on failure, and permission settings.
description.zh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或周期 Agent 任务，支持自然语言计划、可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。支持自定义模型、技能、失败时暂停以及权限设置。

description.en: Registers the Xunfei Loomy cloud channel as an OpenAI-compatible supplier in dsh-router, adding model listing and streaming chat completions.
description.zh: 把讯飞 Loomy 云端通道作为 OpenAI 兼容供应商接入 dsh-router，提供模型列表与流式对话补全。

description.en: Browse the awesome-dsh-plugin catalog from a page in DSH Settings: filter by category or by installed state, search by name or description, sort by stars, downloads, name or date added, and install a plugin into the current profile. Two further tabs list what is already installed and which of those have a newer version in the catalog, with an update button on each row. The update view reports installed plugins whose update status cannot be determined, and overlapping install requests are refused. The catalog is cached locally for an hour with a mirror, a CDN and the npm registry as fallbacks when the official source is unreachable.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin 目录：按分类或已安装状态筛选，按名称或简介搜索，按 Star、下载量、名称或收录时间排序，一键把插件装进当前 profile。另外两个标签页分别列出已安装的插件、以及其中有更新版本的，并可一键更新。更新页会提示无法判断更新状态的已安装插件，并拒绝同时发起的安装请求。目录在本地缓存一小时，官方源不可达时依次回退到镜像、CDN 与 npm registry。

description.en: Composer prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: a button beside the model selector rewrites the draft through one auxiliary LLM call and writes the result back in place, with composer undo left intact; a /prompt-enhance slash command returns the rewritten prompt as a command result line without touching the draft; the enhancement call can be pinned to its own fast provider and model in the profile patch; the rewrite policy is faithful - original intent, language and information are kept, code, commands and paths are preserved verbatim, and nothing is invented or padded with placeholder text.
description.zh: 输入框提示词一键增强：模型选择器旁的按钮把草稿经一次辅助模型调用改写后直接写回输入框，输入框撤销不受影响；/prompt-enhance 命令把改写结果以命令结果行显示、不改动草稿；可在 profile 补丁里为增强调用单独固定 provider 和模型；改写忠实原文，保留意图、语言与信息量，代码、命令与路径原样保留，不编造事实、不输出占位文字。

description.en: Adds a Download button to DSH Web GUI delivery cards, so files delivered with present save straight from the browser.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 交付卡片上增加下载按钮，present 交付的文件可直接从浏览器下载。

description.en: Adds a UI effects page to Settings that switches off DSH Web animations and transitions, loading and progress animations, backdrop blur, smooth scrolling, hover title scroll, shadows, gradients and JS motion one category at a time, to cut browser rendering cost.
description.zh: 在设置里新增 "前端特效" 页, 按分类关掉 DSH Web 的动画与过渡, 加载与进度动画, 毛玻璃, 平滑滚动, 标题 hover 滚动, 阴影, 渐变与 JS 动效, 降低浏览器渲染负担.

description.en: Adds a muted looping video behind the Harness workspace and makes the composer translucent after the boot splash finishes.
description.zh: 在 Harness 工作区后播放静音循环视频，并在开屏动画结束后将输入区域显示为半透明。

description.en: Turns file and directory paths in DSH chat into clickable buttons: click one to preview the file in the right sidebar, or open it with the system default application.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话中的文件与目录路径变成可点击按钮：点击即在右侧侧边栏预览，或用系统默认程序打开。

description.en: DSH onboarding plugin: recommends plugins across eight domains ranked by weighted GitHub stars and npm monthly downloads, installs the recommended set in one click behind a reviewable plan, and exports or imports an environment code recording a profile's plugin list, exact versions and enabled flags.
description.zh: DSH 新人引导插件：按八个领域推荐插件（GitHub Star 与 npm 近月下载加权排序），先出计划再一键安装，并可导出／导入记录 profile 插件清单、精确版本与启用状态的环境码。

description.en: Alibaba Open Code Review for DSH: host-model delegation with native preview/rule tools and a review skill, plus optional OCR-managed reviews.
description.zh: 将阿里 Open Code Review 接入 DSH：通过原生文件筛选、规则工具和审查技能复用当前会话模型，并提供可选的 OCR 独立审查模式。

description.en: Gives the agent four session tools: start a new session, send a message into another one, list sessions with their state, and wait for another session's turn to finish so its answer can be read back.
description.zh: 给 AI 四个会话工具：新建会话、给别的会话发消息、列出会话及其状态，以及等另一个会话这一轮跑完并把它的回答取回来。

description.en: Adds a handoff button to every assistant message that writes an LLM-summarized handoff document of the current conversation into the workspace handoff/ directory.
description.zh: 为每条 AI 回复添加 Handoff 按钮，点击后由 LLM 将当前会话总结为交接文档，写入该会话工作区的 handoff/ 目录。

description.en: Token usage dashboard for the whole harness: billed tokens from every session are rolled up per session and turn (uncached input, cache read, cache write and output) with a peak/off-peak CNY cost estimate, and a "Token 用量" entry above Settings in the sidebar opens the dashboard at /token-stats, in a new tab on the web and in an in-app popup on the Desktop. The page recollects and repaints every 60 seconds while the tab is visible. Usage is read from the same session event stream dsh-token-meter consumes, accepting 0.1.x assistant/chunk and 0.2.x assistant/message and assistant/attempt, and counting an attempt repeated after an llm retry as its own billed call; cold history is seeded once from a persisted rollup file and afterwards only logs whose mtime or size changed are re-parsed. Host half and client half ship in the one package.
description.zh: 整个 Harness 的 Token 用量看板：把全部会话的计费 token（未缓存输入、缓存读取、缓存写入、输出）按会话与轮次汇总，并给出高峰/低谷的人民币预估费用；侧边栏「Token 用量」入口（在设置上方）打开 /token-stats 看板，Web 端新标签页、桌面端应用内弹窗。标签页可见时每 60 秒自动重新采集并重绘。用量读取的是 dsh-token-meter 消费的同一条会话事件流，兼容 0.1.x 的 assistant/chunk 与 0.2.x 的 assistant/message、assistant/attempt；llm 重试后的再次采样按一次新的计费计入；冷历史只从持久化 rollup 文件播种一次，之后仅对 mtime/size 变化的日志做增量重解析。宿主半与客户端半在同一个包里。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory: captures durable facts from each turn, auto-associates them by shared entity and tag, and recalls with BM25 plus spreading activation over the link graph.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆：从每轮对话抽取持久事实、按共享标签与实体自动建立联想关联，并以 BM25 加关联图激活传播进行召回；提供六个模型可调用工具与一张设置卡片。

description.en: Adds a Matrix-inspired digital-rain startup animation for DeepSeek Harness, a rectangular light portal that opens to both sides, optional replay when the desktop window reopens, and a green UI theme with adjustable hue.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加黑客帝国风格的数字雨开屏动画、向两侧展开的矩形光门、可选的窗口恢复重播，以及可调色相的绿色界面主题。

description.en: Checks an electrical work permit for the elements it must carry and for the issue and permission sequence the current electrical safety regulations require. Reports the differences it finds; it does not judge whether the work was safe or whether the permit was validly authorised.
description.zh: 依据现行电力安全工作规程，核对电力工作票应载明的要素，以及签发与许可的先后顺序。只报告发现的差异，不判定作业是否安全、许可是否有效。

description.en: A Cyrene-themed agent for DSH, with a customizable look (palette, wallpaper, particle effects, background music, typing sound) and a code security scan. It carries a worldbook, long-term memory and a speech-style correction layer (every reader gets their own Cyrene), plus retrieval over the script to back up its answers.
description.zh: 给 DSH 用的昔涟主题 agent，包括可自定义美化主题（配色、壁纸、粒子效果、背景音乐、打字音效）与代码安全扫描。拥有世界书、长期记忆与说话方式修正（一千个人心中有一千个昔涟），剧情检索增强回答。

description.en: Adds a refresh button and a power menu (restart / close DeepSeek Harness) to the conversation header. Client-only, zero tokens, no dependencies. The power menu is Windows-only.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部加一个刷新按钮和一个电源菜单（重启 / 关闭 DeepSeek Harness）。纯客户端、零 token、零依赖。电源菜单目前仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Trip-planning agent preset for mainland China that answers in Chinese: queries 12306 train availability, Fliggy and Tuniu flight and hotel prices, and real Amap transit routes, checks closures and weather, and delivers a single offline HTML roadbook with draggable maps, three hotel price tiers and an itemized budget. Ships 9 skills, an environment doctor that walks users through missing API keys, and a patch for the 12306 MCP server; it plans and queries but never books or pays.
description.zh: 中文旅行规划 agent 预设「旅行规划助手」（面向国内行程）：实时查 12306 余票、飞猪 / 途牛机票与酒店价格、高德真实路线，核实闭馆与天气，交付一份可离线打开的单文件 HTML 路书（可拖动地图、三档酒店、分项预算）；附 9 个技能、引导用户补齐 Key 的环境自检，以及 12306 MCP 的预售期补丁；只规划查询，不代订代付。

description.en: Windows computer-use capability for DSH: screenshot → vision model → simulated mouse/keyboard with self-evolving knowledge base. Dual-mode plugin tools + skill-only pwsh fallback.
description.zh: Windows 桌面识图+模拟操作能力：截图→vision模型→模拟鼠标键盘，内置自进化应用技巧库。支持插件工具模式和纯skill模式双形态。

description.en: Renders workspace Markdown files in a standalone full-screen reader with GFM, KaTeX, Mermaid, outline navigation, live file reload, and browser printing/PDF export.
description.zh: 在独立全屏阅读器中渲染工作区 Markdown 文件，支持 GFM、KaTeX、Mermaid、目录导航、文件更新同步以及浏览器打印和 PDF 导出。

description.en: Resume screening plugin for HR in DeepSeek Harness: ingest up to 100k Word/PDF/Excel resumes into one searchable library with skills / coarse categories / ingest time, auto-ingest & de-dupe new resumes, then screen by plain-language criteria — rule pre-filter in the database plus LLM fine-judge on the shortlisted few, CSV export. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 面向 HR 的简历筛选插件:把 Word/PDF/Excel 简历统一收进简历库建档(技能/粗分类/入库时间),新简历自动入库、重复自动去重;用大白话下指令即可筛选,硬性条件靠库内规则精准过滤,入围的少数人再由 LLM 精判适配度,结果可导出、可追溯。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

description.en: Pasted screenshots become numbered references: each Ctrl+V image is stored in the attachment library under a stable number, listed in a composer-dock thumbnail panel with an image source in the @ menu, and inserted as a reference chip at the caret — automatically after paste when the auto-insert switch is on.
description.zh: 粘贴即编号引用：Ctrl+V 的截图入库后拿到固定编号「图片N」，在输入框旁面板里以缩略图列出，可经 @图片 菜单插入引用；开着「自动插入」时粘贴后直接落到光标处。

description.en: Standalone arrow-key input history for the DSH web composer: ↑/↓ recalls sent prompts from one global ring shared across all sessions and workspaces, persisted to localStorage with an overridable cap.
description.zh: DSH 网页版输入框独立输入历史插件：↑/↓ 上下键即时召回已发送的提示词，所有会话与工作区共享一个全局历史环，localStorage 持久化、容量可配。

description.en: Reports which PowerShell the DSH pwsh executor rows actually run — enabled rows only, with version-numbered Store paths refused as pins — and installs the self-updating Microsoft Store package as a background job after reading the connection cost, because Windows defers Store downloads on a connection marked as metered. Two tools and a prompt section on the host side, plus a configuration card, a diagnostics section and a re-detect action in the Web UI; Windows only, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 报告 DSH pwsh 执行器各行实际运行的 PowerShell——只认启用中的行，拒绝把带版本号的商店路径当作 pin——并以后台任务安装会自动更新的微软商店版 PowerShell 7；动手前先读连接计费方式，因为 Windows 会推迟按流量计费连接上的商店下载。宿主侧两个工具加一个提示词区段，Web 界面里是配置卡片、诊断区段与重新检测按钮；仅 Windows，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Select text in any Windows app and read the translation in an always-on-top card next to the cursor: streaming text follows the newest line, up to 15000 characters per request. Windows only.
description.zh: 在任意 Windows 应用里划词，鼠标旁弹出只含译文的置顶卡片；译文流式出现并跟随最新一行，单次上限 15000 字。仅 Windows。

description.en: Two-step session deletion: the session menu moves a chat into a recycle bin without deleting anything, the bin panel restores an entry, deletes one for good right away, or empties the whole bin, and the next start wipes its log, projection cache, spill files and workspace membership.
description.zh: 两步删除会话：会话菜单先把会话移入回收站（不删任何内容、可随时恢复），面板可恢复、可逐条立刻删除、也可整体清空，下次启动 DSH 时才真正清掉日志、投影缓存、spill 文件与工作区登记。

description.en: Read-only lazy session viewer: lists sessions with stat only, then decompresses just the tail Zstandard frames to inspect recent events; includes search, stats, and export in a standalone /lazyview panel. Requires Node.js 24+.
description.zh: 只读会话惰性查看器：仅 stat 列出会话，再只解压尾部 Zstandard 帧查看最近事件；独立 /lazyview 面板支持搜索、统计和导出。需 Node.js 24+。

description.en: Shows the linked COROS watch model and cumulative activity days in the Web UI, expanding to a one-line review and suggestion when clicked.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中常驻显示已绑定的高驰手表型号与累计运动天数，点击展开一句话点评与建议。

description.en: A 3×3 pad of saved phrases sitting to the left of the composer and tracking the input box's height: clicking a cell inserts its text at the caret as one undoable edit. Presets are editable in place, 9 cells per page up to 12 pages, and the UI follows the DSH language setting. Falls back to a panel above the composer when the window leaves no room.
description.zh: 输入框左侧的九宫格快捷短语面板，高度跟随输入框：点一格就把该条短语以一次可撤销的编辑插入光标处；面板内可就地编辑，每页 9 格、最多 12 页，界面跟随 DSH 语言设置。窗口放不下时退回输入框上方浮层。

description.en: Permanently deletes a session from the sidebar, waiting for a running turn to stop and cascading to its subagent sessions.
description.zh: 从侧边栏永久删除会话：等待正在运行的回合停下，并级联删除其子代理会话。

description.en: Composer key remap for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: bind Enter, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, Shift+Enter or any custom chord to the Send, Newline or Interrupt actions, with cross-action migration, durable persistence and native behavior preserved by default.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框键位自定义：把 Enter、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter、Shift+Enter 或任意组合键分配给发送、换行、打断三个动作，支持跨动作互斥迁移与持久化保存，默认保持 DSH 原生行为。

description.en: Local file recall: indexes the folders you choose into one local SQLite database, so 'where did I put that file?' is one query instead of a disk walk. Caches, VCS and program folders are pruned per directory; each folder keeps its own incremental anchor, so a folder added later is backfilled in full. Read-only: it never modifies, moves or deletes your files. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 本地文件记忆索引：把指定的文件夹记进本机一个 SQLite 库，忘了东西放哪问一句就能找回，不必翻硬盘；缓存、版本库与程序目录整棵跳过。每个目录各有独立增量锚点，后加入的目录首扫回填全部历史。只读，绝不修改、移动或删除你的文件。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

description.en: Live session status on the browser tab favicon with sound notifications for pending input and completed tasks.
description.zh: 浏览器标签页 Favicon 实时回显会话状态，并支持需介入/已完成时的音效提示。

description.en: Shows Provider/Model in the DSH Web composer model selector trigger; the dropdown list and its search are unchanged.
description.zh: DSH Web 对话框模型选择器的触发器显示「供应商/模型」；下拉列表与其搜索均不变。

description.en: Registers the Akasha Book memory server over stdio and exposes its 22 akasha_* tools to DeepSeek Harness, covering lookup, briefs, revision chains, audits and session recall. Companions: Hindsight (repo memory), OpenViking (user memory), and the built-in session search (see repo README). Setup: clone the repo, copy core/ aside, then replace <AKASHA_DIR> in cordis.patch.yml with its absolute path (or set the AKASHA_DIR env var); plugins fail loudly while the placeholder remains.
description.zh: 把阿卡夏之书外置记忆层以 stdio 注册进 DSH，暴露 22 个 akasha_* 工具：检索、主题简报、修订链、审计与会话回看。（配套：Hindsight 仓库记忆 / OpenViking 用户记忆 / 宿主会话检索；见仓库 README） 安装：clone 仓库并复制 core/，把 cordis.patch.yml 里的 <AKASHA_DIR> 换成实际路径（或设 AKASHA_DIR 环境变量）；占位符未替换时插件会明确报错。

description.en: Checks an FMEA worksheet for element completeness and for the arithmetic that follows from it - severity, occurrence and detection against the resulting risk priority number - following published FMEA method standards. Reports inconsistencies; it does not judge whether the ratings themselves are appropriate.
description.zh: 参照公开的 FMEA 方法标准，核对 FMEA 分析表的要素齐备性，以及严重度、发生度、探测度与风险顺序数之间的算术一致性。只报告不一致之处，不评价各项评分数值是否恰当。

description.en: Maintained fork of feibi-mochi/deepseek-harness-control-center, which has not been updated since 2026-09-09. Pricing follows the official model pool instead of a hardcoded model prefix, so DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (`deepseek-flash`) is billed and shows its peak/off-peak clock, and the official price page is parsed structurally so a renamed or retired model no longer stops price sync. Adds an English interface beside the original Chinese. Otherwise the same plugin: balance, per-session cost and token breakdown, a 24-hour peak/off-peak clock, Z.ai plan quota, and a local usage ledger, following the host light/dark theme.
description.zh: feibi-mochi/deepseek-harness-control-center 的维护分支，上游自 2026-09-09 起未再更新。计价改为跟随官方模型池、而非硬编码模型前缀，因此 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（`deepseek-flash`）能正常计价并显示峰谷时钟；官方价格页改为结构化解析，模型改名或下架不再中断价格同步。界面在原有中文之外增加英文。其余与原插件一致：余额、本会话花费与 token 拆分、24 小时峰谷时钟、Z.ai 套餐额度与本机用量账本，并跟随宿主明暗主题。

description.en: Drop-in enhanced fork of the official workflow tool: a verbatim fork of the stock tool plus a persisted saved-workflow library (workflow_save / workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_delete / workflow_run_saved) backed by ctx.storageDomain, so scripts can be stored, retrieved and re-run with new arguments.
description.zh: 官方 workflow 工具的 drop-in 增强版：在逐字 fork 的官方工具之上，用 ctx.storageDomain 提供持久化的 saved workflow 库（workflow_save / workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_delete / workflow_run_saved），可把编排脚本存库、检索并带新参数重跑。

description.en: English-only fork of dsh-model-router. Routes each agent step across a configurable model pool and adjusts reasoning effort based on task complexity, tool failures, and cost.
description.zh: dsh-model-router 的纯英文分支。把每个 agent 步骤路由到可配置的模型池，并按任务复杂度、工具失败与成本调整推理强度。

description.en: Fork of @michengai/dsh-pua that removes the upstream global kill-switch so the composer entry is always visible while the feature stays off by default and can be toggled per session; the entry is a dropdown (Turn on / Turn off / Options) with a more compact options panel.
description.zh: 基于 @michengai/dsh-pua 的修订版：解除上游「全局总闸」，让入口恒常显示、功能默认关闭并可按会话开关；入口改为下拉菜单（打开 / 关闭 / 选项），选项面板更紧凑。

description.en: Lists the Docker Compose projects of your DSH workspaces in the right sidebar, one group per project directory, with container status, project- and service-level up/stop/restart, and streamed per-service logs.
description.zh: 在右侧栏列出各 DSH 工作区中的 Docker Compose 项目，按项目目录分组，显示容器状态，支持项目级与服务级 up/stop/restart 以及单服务日志流。

description.en: Input-box floating translation widget for DSH: translate drafts via session model, Zhipu GLM, or custom endpoints, with preview/replace/append, connectivity testing, and recent history.
description.zh: DSH 输入框悬浮快捷翻译挂件：支持当前会话模型、智谱 GLM 与自定义端点，提供预览/替换/追加、连通性测试及最近历史找回。

description.en: Injects a small continuity pointer at the start of a new session, naming the previous session and any handoff file, and reuses DSH's own compaction summary when there is no handoff file.
description.zh: 新会话开始时注入一条很小的接续指针，说明上一个会话是谁、工作区有没有交接文档；没有交接文档时复用 DSH 已有的压缩摘要。

description.en: Scoped persistent memory for DSH: memory_save/search/replace/remove/list across global, user, project and failure scopes, DSH storage-domain persistence with secret and prompt-injection scanning, session-scope search, retention cleanup, and optional session-start injection; standing context via memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin.
description.zh: DSH 有界持久记忆：memory_save/search/replace/remove/list 覆盖全局、用户、项目、失败四类范围，基于 DSH storage-domain 持久化，写入前做密钥与提示注入扫描，支持会话范围检索、保留期清理与可选的会话开始注入；常驻上下文用 memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin 管理。

description.en: Open the extension side panel and it takes over the page you are browsing right now. On top of upstream it adds: hover, coordinate clicks, drag, batched action chains, whole-page screenshots, local file upload, image listing, and switching between several connected browsers. Pages reach the model as structured text with a numbered element list; actions wait for your approval and sensitive fields stay masked. Ships as the bridge plugin, with the extension in the same release. This project is a fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser
description.zh: 打开浏览器扩展侧边栏，就能原地接管你当前正在浏览的网页。在上游基础上补齐了：悬停、坐标点击、拖拽、批量动作链、整页截图、本地文件上传、图片地址列举，并可在多个已连接的浏览器之间切换。页面以带编号的结构化文本交给模型；动作默认需要你批准，敏感字段以掩码呈现。发布的是桥接插件，配套扩展在同一 Release 里。本项目是 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser 的 fork，原仓库：https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser

description.en: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: five tools to ingest Markdown, plain text and PDF files, search them with BM25 or hybrid BM25 plus optional local embeddings, and answer with cited source passages. Runs offline with no database server. Requires Node.js 18+ and Python 3.9+; PDF ingest needs pymupdf.
description.zh: 本地知识库：五个工具，导入 Markdown、文本与 PDF，用 BM25 或 BM25 + 本地向量的混合检索查找，回答时带原文引用。离线运行，不需要数据库服务。需 Node.js 18+ 与 Python 3.9+；导入 PDF 需 pymupdf。

description.en: Resident-index grep for DeepSeek Harness that shadows the built-in grep/glob tools under the same names: repeated content searches hit an in-memory index ranked by access/modification frecency, and glob serves the built-in ripgrep semantics when available, falling back to the index otherwise.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻索引 grep，以同名遮蔽内置 grep/glob 工具：重复内容检索命中按访问/修改 frecency 排序的内存索引，glob 在可用时对齐内置 ripgrep 语义、不可用时回退索引。

description.en: Read-only Raindrop.io dashboard in the sidebar with collection and tag distribution, top source domains, content types, a 12-month trend and a cleanup backlog, plus two read-only agent tools for analyzing saved bookmarks. Requires a Raindrop.io API token (create an app and paste the token).
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 Raindrop.io 只读仪表盘：分类与标签分布、域名来源 Top、内容类型、近 12 个月趋势与待清理项，并提供两个只读 Agent 工具分析收藏。需 Raindrop.io API token（创建应用后粘贴）。

description.en: Edit global AGENTS.md and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md custom instructions in DeepSeek Harness settings, with project-chain discovery, byte-budget display, and save-conflict handling.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页编辑全局 AGENTS.md 和项目 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 个性化指令，提供项目指令链浏览、字节预算显示与保存冲突处理。

description.en: Tavily search and page fetch: tavily_search queries with a rotating pool of up to eight API keys that backs off per key on 401/403/429 so one exhausted account does not take the tool down, and web_fetch retrieves a single page through curl, returning its HTTP status with de-tagged text.
description.zh: Tavily 检索与网页抓取：tavily_search 带最多八把 API key 的轮询池，按 key 对 401/403/429 退避，单个账号额度耗尽不再等于工具失效；web_fetch 经 curl 抓取单页，返回 HTTP 状态与去标签正文。

description.en: Cron scheduler for agent tasks: create jobs by natural language or a sidebar UI, inject a user message into a new or fixed session on schedule to trigger a full agent turn, with run history, manual trigger, and live SSE sync. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:cron.
description.zh: Agent 任务定时调度器：自然语言或侧栏 UI 创建任务，到点向新建/固定会话注入 user 消息触发完整 agent turn，带执行历史、手动触发与 SSE 实时同步。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:cron。

description.en: Downloads a Bilibili video with yt-dlp, samples key frames, and transcribes it — from the site subtitles, or from a local faster-whisper install when there are none. Registers the skill the agent uses to write the summary; activates when a user message contains only a video link. Requires yt-dlp and ffmpeg on PATH; transcription needs faster-whisper.
description.zh: 用 yt-dlp 下载 B 站视频、抽帧并转写：优先用站方字幕，没有字幕时调用本机 faster-whisper。注册写总结所需的技能，当用户消息只有一条视频链接时自动启用。需 PATH 上有 yt-dlp 与 ffmpeg，转写另需 faster-whisper。
