description.en: Use Zed AI hosted models in DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 Zed AI 托管模型。

description.en: Picks a random installed skin on every DeepSeek Harness launch and enables exactly that skin, with an on/off switch and a shuffle action inside the Skins settings page. Skins the running host would refuse to load are excluded, and a manual switch still applies until the next launch.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时随机启用一个已安装皮肤，并在「设置 → 皮肤」页内提供开关与「立即随机换一个」按钮。宿主会拒绝加载的皮肤自动排除；手动切换的皮肤一直有效到下次启动。

description.en: One-click prompt refinement for the DSH composer: the ✦ button next to Send rewrites the draft into an agent-ready prompt in Standard or Light mode, with Revert and Retry; asks follow-up questions through the question card when the draft is missing information; checks that paths, identifiers, numbers, URLs, inline code and @mentions survive the rewrite and adds back any that were dropped; runs on the conversation model or a dedicated model chosen on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框一键改写提示词：点「发送」旁的 ✦，按「标准」或「轻」档把草稿改写成 Agent 可直接执行的提示词，可撤回或重试；草稿缺少信息时通过提问卡片追问；校验路径、标识符、数字、URL、行内代码与 @ 提及在改写后逐字保留，丢失的会补回；可使用会话模型，或在插件页面指定专用模型。

description.en: Teaching board view: agent-generated self-contained HTML is projected into a sandboxed iframe as a board, annotated by hand (brush, four colours, eraser, undo), extended in place across several tool calls, and screenshotted back into the conversation as a real user message.
description.zh: 教学平面视图：agent 生成的自包含 HTML 投影进沙箱 iframe 当板书，可用画笔手写勾画（四色、橡皮、撤销）、在同一块板上增量续写，并把画面截图作为真实用户消息发回对话。

description.en: Input prediction: the likely continuation of your draft appears as grey ghost text after the caret and Tab accepts it, and after each assistant turn 1-3 clickable follow-up suggestions appear above the input box and send on click. Ghost completion, suggestions and the suggestion count can be toggled in Settings, Built-in plugins.
description.zh: 输入预测：在输入框里用灰字续写你草稿最可能的后续，按 Tab 接受后落进输入框、可继续编辑；每轮回答结束后在输入框上方给出 1–3 条你可能会发的下一条，点一下就发送。灰字补全、回复后推荐与推荐条数都能在「设置 → 内置插件 → 输入预测」里开关。

description.en: Enhances the native right-sidebar Files tab rather than replacing it: each row gets an @ reference button that inserts the canonical path mention into the composer, plus a size column, a sortable modification-time column, and a status dot for untracked, unstaged and staged files. Below the tree a git bar shows the branch with ahead/behind counts and expands upward into the 20 most recent commits, with a repository selector when a workspace has independent repositories in subdirectories. A header search box walks the workspace recursively and can open a result or expand the tree at it, preview tabs offer reveal-in-tree and one-click @, the tree is keyboard navigable with ARIA tree semantics, and a right-click entry on the Files tab switches back to the native tree at runtime.
description.zh: 增强右侧栏原生的「文件」标签页而非替换它：每行带一个 @ 引用按钮，把规范路径提及插入输入框；另有大小列、可排序的修改时间列，以及按未跟踪/未暂存/已暂存着色的状态点。文件树下方有 git 栏，显示分支与领先/落后数量，并可向上展开最近 20 条提交；当工作区的子目录是独立仓库时提供仓库选择器。页头搜索框递归遍历工作区，可打开结果或在文件树中展开定位；预览页签提供「在文件树中定位」与一键 @；文件树支持键盘导航与 ARIA tree 语义；右键「文件」标签页可在运行时切回原生树。

description.en: Engineering work-tools for DeepSeek Harness: registers two model-facing Host Tools — a scoped `git` runner, and a package-manager runner (`dev`) that detects npm/pnpm/yarn/bun from the workspace lockfile and picks the right verb per manager. Both run through dsh's sandboxed shell and return structured stdout/stderr/exitCode, so the agent gets focused, reviewable results instead of raw bash, and adding another tool is a copy-paste of one register block.
description.zh: 面向软件工程师的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：注册两个模型可直接调用的 Host Tool——受工作区约束的 `git` 运行器，以及按 lockfile 自动识别 npm/pnpm/yarn/bun 并选择正确动词的包管理器运行器（`dev`）。两者都经 dsh 沙箱 shell 执行，返回规整的 stdout/stderr/exitCode，让 agent 拿到聚焦、可复核的结果而不是裸 bash；再加一个工具只需复制一个 register 块。

description.en: Skin author workbench: official token browser (169 --dsw-* variables with Chinese descriptions and module-usage tags), live try-on, durable skin save, theme freeze, seven spectrum presets with SVG backdrops and custom backdrop upload.
description.zh: 皮肤作者工作台：官方 token 浏览器（169 个 --dsw-* 变量，带中文描述与模块标签）、实时试穿、皮肤持久保存、主题固化、7 套光谱预设与 SVG 背景图，以及自定义背景上传。

description.en: Adds a Forget action to every session row menu, confirmed by a second click in the menu, that removes the session from the sidebar and from disk: running work is stopped, workspace, archive and pin records are detached through official channels, the log directory and projection-cache entries are deleted, and a revive guard re-deletes anything a late write or a lingering handle recreates; memories, attachments and other sessions are left alone.
description.zh: 在会话行菜单加入「遗忘会话」（菜单内二次点击确认），把会话从侧栏与磁盘彻底移除：先停掉正在运行的工作，经官方通道解除工作区、归档与置顶记录，删除日志目录与投影缓存条目，并由复活守卫在一个窗口内补删迟到写入或句柄残留重建的文件；灵枢记忆、附件与其他会话不受影响。

description.en: LaTeX and BibTeX guardrails for DeepSeek Harness: compile checks with automatic xelatex/lualatex detection, BibTeX entry deduplication and field filling from Crossref, and \cite key audits against the .bib file.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 LaTeX 与 BibTeX 检查工具：编译检查（自动识别 xelatex/lualatex），基于 Crossref 的 BibTeX 条目去重与字段补全，以及 \cite 键与 .bib 文件的一致性审计。

description.en: Plugin inventory manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: table view of installed plugins with status filters, enable/disable switches applied via HMR, config viewer/copy, uninstall and npm update reminders.
description.zh: DSH 插件总览（逃咪）：以表格视图管理已安装插件，支持状态过滤、HMR 热生效的启停开关、配置查看/复制、卸载与 npm 更新提醒。

description.en: Adds a writing-plans skill that generates a structured implementation plan document before coding, then executes simple tasks inline or offers an execution choice for complex work.
description.zh: 添加 writing-plans 技能，在写代码前生成结构化实现计划文档，简单任务直接执行，复杂任务提供执行方式选择。

description.en: Two-level theme manager for the DSH Web UI: pick a culture / scene, a national flag, a developer palette, or a high-contrast pairing first, then a concrete style (58 built-in palettes, light and dark).
description.zh: DSH Web 两级主题管理器：先选文化 / 场景、国旗、开发者配色或强烈对比配色，再选具体风格，内置 58 套浅色 / 深色配色。

description.en: Live CPU, memory and GPU readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar — a clickable badge with a details panel, per-metric toggles, and three refresh speeds.
description.zh: 在输入框下方的状态栏里实时显示 CPU、内存与 GPU 读数：可点击的徽章、详情面板、逐项开关与三档刷新速度。

description.en: Injects the contents of a .keep-reminder file from the session working directory as a system-reminder, with three modes: once per session, first step of every turn, or every request.
description.zh: 把会话工作目录下 .keep-reminder 文件的内容作为 system-reminder 注入，支持三种模式：每会话一次、每轮第一步、每次请求。

description.en: MCP manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: a Settings page beside Plugins that lists the MCP servers the running loader tree actually holds, each with its config summary, endpoint and live state, and disables or restores any of them through a paired-marker block in the profile's cordis.patch.yml. Env values, header values and `!!js` sources reach the page only as key names or dot-paths.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 极简管理：与「插件」同级的一页设置，列出运行中 Loader 树里真实存在的 MCP 服务器及其配置摘要、端点与实时状态，并通过 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 成对标记块停用或恢复任一服务器；环境变量值、请求头值与 `!!js` 表达式只以键名或点路径的形式到达页面。

description.en: Customs declaration document consistency check: field-level findings with rule IDs.
description.zh: 报关单证一致性检查：按规则 ID 输出字段级发现。

description.en: Tired of going fullscreen by hand every time you open Harness? This plugin fills the screen for you - auto-maximize (keeps the window buttons) or true fullscreen on launch, then maximize / restore / minimize / always-on-top anytime. It quits only after a native confirmation dialog - Esc, double Esc, or Ctrl+Q; in fullscreen, Esc leaves fullscreen first. The window channel installs itself, so no script or Python is needed; the first install takes effect after two DSH restarts.
description.zh: 如果你嫌每次打开 Harness 都要手动全屏，这个插件可以帮你自动铺满：启动时自动最大化（保留右上角窗口按钮）或真全屏；随时可最大化／还原／最小化／窗口置顶；退出前弹原生确认框，快捷键可选 Esc、双击 Esc 或 Ctrl+Q，且全屏下 Esc 先退出全屏。窗口通道由插件自己安装，无需脚本或 Python，首次安装需重启两次 DSH 生效。

description.en: Toolbar picture button in the DSH Web composer: click to pick multiple images through the native file dialog — they join the same draft-image rail as drag-and-drop and paste, with the host image-format, per-message-count and per-image-size limits enforced inline.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框工具栏图片按钮：点击调用系统文件选择器直接多选取图，进入与拖拽/粘贴相同的草稿图片栏，并内联校验宿主的图片格式、单条张数与单张大小限制。

description.en: Restores the blue shimmering Deep diving turn status row that DSH 0.1.6 and earlier showed at the end of the transcript.
description.zh: 恢复 DSH 0.1.6 及以前在对话流末尾显示的蓝色流光深度求索中回合状态行.

description.en: Auto-expand reasoning and tool cards, tune code-block font size and line spacing, and choose the model output language (auto, Chinese or English).
description.zh: 自动展开思考与工具卡片，调整代码块字号与行距，并可选择模型输出语言（自动、中文或 English）。

description.en: Provides shared plan, context pickup, and progress update Skills through StateDock Remote MCP without executing tasks or scheduling agents; targets Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 通过 StateDock Remote MCP 提供共享计划、上下文恢复与进度更新 Skills，不执行任务或调度 Agent；适配 Harness 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: Low-token web search that returns only {title, url, snippet} per hit — vendor extras such as answer, score and raw_content never enter the context. Five interchangeable backends (Tavily, Brave, SearXNG, Google CSE, Exa) with automatic failover to the next usable one in fallback / chain order when the primary fails, deduplicating repeated providers. Returned URLs and snippets are sanitized of tracking parameters.
description.zh: 低 Token 联网搜索：只把结果裁成 {title, url, snippet} 三个字段返回，厂商附带的 answer / score / raw_content 等一律不进上下文。后端可在 Tavily、Brave、SearXNG、Google CSE、Exa 五种之间配置，主后端失败时按 fallback / chain 顺序自动切换到下一个可用后端（同一后端去重）。返回的 URL 与摘要经清洗，除去跟踪参数。

description.en: Runs the local Cursor CLI as a child coding agent from DSH - a `cursor_code` tool plus the native one-shot `cursor_subagent` tool, one mirrored DSH sub-session per run, per-task model choice, resumable conversations, a step timeline with real file diffs, and a usage, model and session panel.
description.zh: 把本机 Cursor CLI 当作子编码智能体：提供 `cursor_code` 工具与原生一次性 `cursor_subagent` 工具，每次运行镜像为一个真实的 DSH 子会话，可按任务选模型、会话可续聊，返回逐步工具时间线与真实文件 diff，并提供额度、模型和会话面板。

description.en: DSH Cordis computer-use provider for the ZTE Nde desktop. npm install auto-fetches the musl binary built by computer-use-linux-zte-nde (v0.7.7-nde.3) into the package's own bin/ via postinstall; resolveCommand() resolves the cordis command path against import.meta.url so the mount works regardless of dsh web's cwd. Reserves the shared computer-use slot via ctx.computerUse.register and exposes MCP tools under mcp__computer-use-linux-nde-mcp__* (screenshot, list_windows, click, type_text, doctor, etc.). Two notable Nde fixes upstream of this provider: KWin caption+coords fallback for window targeting, and SnapshotCache that keeps AT-SPI single-wake per (app, pid) so Chrome is not repeatedly disturbed.
description.zh: 为中兴 Nde 桌面定制的 DSH Cordis computer-use provider。npm install 完成后由 postinstall 钩子从 computer-use-linux-zte-nde v0.7.7-nde.3 release 自动下载 musl 静态二进制到包内 bin/，SHA 校验后 chmod +x；cordis patch 里的 command 用相对路径，由 provider 内部 resolveCommand() 依据 import.meta.url 解析为绝对路径，不依赖 dsh web 的 cwd。占用 DSH 一等公民 ctx.computerUse slot，工具命名空间为 mcp__computer-use-linux-nde-mcp__*（screenshot、list_windows、click、type_text、doctor 等）。binary 本身携带两个 Nde 适配修复：KWin 窗口寻址的 caption+coords 兜底，以及 SnapshotCache——同一 (app, pid) 5 秒内的 AT-SPI 树结果复用、避免 Chrome 反复被唤醒。

issues.detail: declares install-time scripts; the harness gates them via allowBuilds

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-ashtonsun-dsh-experimental-computer-use-linux-nde-mcp
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-experimental-computer-use-linux-nde-mcp

notes: added the missing web platform to the client half

description.en: Distill over-long model reasoning into its useful core, replay the compressed version on every later request, and report each session's cost and savings. Disabled by default: select one rewrite backend first. derive needs no install and works on packaged DSH; in-place needs 14 source patches and a rebuild (recommended for source checkouts); message-edit needs a third-party plugin and is experimental only.
description.zh: 把过长的模型思考压缩成有用核心，之后每次请求重放压缩版，并给出每个会话的开销与节省报告。默认关闭：必须先选择一个改写后端。derive 无需安装、打包版也能用；in-place 需给 DSH 源码打 14 处补丁并重建（源码构建首选）；message-edit 需装第三方插件，仅实验性，不推荐。

description.en: Project-based learning coach: a subject-agnostic teaching engine plus swappable domain packs (Unity/C# included), shipped both as a DSH skill and as an installable bundle. The skill protocol enforces attempt-first teaching and graded hints; a zero-dependency validator rejects ability claims their evidence does not support and blocks stage acceptance while blockers are open.
description.zh: 项目制教学教练：学科无关的教学引擎 + 可替换领域包（随包提供 Unity/C#），同时以 DSH 技能与可安装组合包分发。技能协议强制"先做后教"与分级提示；零依赖校验器会拒绝证据不支撑的能力结论，并在存在未解决阻塞项时阻止阶段通过。

description.en: Live2D avatar stage and desktop companion for DSH: bundled Haru sample, custom Cubism 2/3+ model loading with scale and position controls, a draggable in-page pet, an optional transparent always-on-top desktop pet window, per-conversation expression prompt control, and opt-in voice with self-hosted ASR/TTS.
description.zh: DSH 的 Live2D 形象舞台与桌宠：内置 Haru 示例、自定义 Cubism 2/3+ 模型加载与缩放/位置控制、页面内可拖动桌宠、可选透明置顶桌面独立桌宠窗口、按对话授权的表情 control prompt，以及默认关闭、需自部署 ASR/TTS 的语音功能。

description.en: Network explorer for kids: my identity, DNS lookup, a traceroute trip, speed test and who is home on the LAN.
description.zh: 网络小旅行：我的身份、DNS 查询、路由追踪、测速、谁在局域网。

description.en: Storage explorer: disk boxes, the home folder and the heaviest items.
description.zh: 存储小仓库：磁盘分区、主目录、最占空间的东西。

description.en: Turns a ZSpace (极空间) NAS into native agent tools: list, stat, search, read, download, upload, write, create folders, rename, move, copy and delete files on the NAS. Works across networks through the desktop client relay — no LAN, no WebDAV, no SSH — and switches to the faster direct WebDAV transport automatically when the NAS is on the same network. Deletes require an explicit confirm: true; write, upload, create-folder, rename, move and copy run directly, and zspace_write overwrites a same-named file unless overwrite is false.
description.zh: 把极空间（ZSpace）NAS 变成 agent 的原生工具：列目录、查属性、按名检索、读取、下载、上传、写入、建目录、重命名、移动、复制、删除 NAS 文件。跨网络走桌面客户端中转——不需要同一局域网、不用 WebDAV、不用 SSH；同一网络时自动改走更快的 WebDAV 直连。删除需显式传 confirm: true；写入、上传、建目录、重命名、移动、复制默认直接执行，zspace_write 会覆盖同名文件（除非传 overwrite: false）。

description.en: Floating usage window for DSH Web showing Claude and Codex subscription windows with reset countdowns, plus DeepSeek API spend and balance; display-only companion to dsh-cost-meter.
description.zh: DSH Web 悬浮用量小窗，显示 Claude、Codex 订阅用量窗口与重置倒计时，以及 DeepSeek API 今日花费与余额；只展示，是 dsh-cost-meter 的伴侣。

description.en: SDD task progress (todos) and progress ledger (sdd/progress.md) as a right-sidebar tab bound to the current session, rendered with the official MarkdownText, auto-refresh every 5s.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏以当前会话为维度展示 SDD 任务进度（todos）与进度台账（sdd/progress.md），采用官方 MarkdownText 渲染，每 5 秒自动刷新。

description.en: OpenRouter provider that reads the live /models list, so new models appear without a harness release: models sorted by name with input/output prices, per-model reasoning levels, image input, reasoning_details replay, Anthropic prompt caching, and actual spend per session including subagents from OpenRouter usage.cost, shown under the Web UI composer and by /cost.
description.zh: 读取 OpenRouter 实时 /models 列表的模型提供商，新模型无需等待 harness 发版即可出现：模型按名称排序并显示输入/输出价格，按模型提供思考档位、图片输入、reasoning_details 回放、Anthropic 提示缓存，并按 OpenRouter usage.cost 统计本会话（含子代理）的实际花费，显示在 Web 输入框下方并可用 /cost 查看。

description.en: Computer safety shown as castle guards: firewall, disk encryption, lock screen, remote ports and login history.
description.zh: 电脑安全小城堡守卫：防火墙、磁盘加密、锁屏、远程端口、登录记录。

description.en: Explains computer memory as a workbench: current usage, memory pressure and top programs.
description.zh: 把内存讲成工作台：当前占用、内存压力、最占内存的程序。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness covering approval requests, questions, run completion, errors and sign-in prompts, with the conversation name as the first line of every notification.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面通知：申请权限、提问、任务完成、出错与登录提醒，每条通知第一行都是会话名称。

description.en: Android development toolchain inside DeepSeek Harness: 23 android_* tools that find the SDK, create and manage AVDs, start and stop emulators, scaffold a Kotlin/Compose project, build and run it with Gradle, then install, launch, screenshot, tail logcat and drive the UI. A settings page holds the SDK, emulator, API-level, build and output parameters.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里驱动 Android 开发工具链：23 个 android_* 工具负责探测 SDK、创建与管理 AVD、启停模拟器、生成 Kotlin/Compose 工程、用 Gradle 构建运行，并完成安装、启动、截图、logcat 与 UI 操作。设置页集中管理 SDK、模拟器、API 级别、构建与输出参数。

description.en: Adds mind maps and an Excalidraw canvas to the DSH sidebar, with local blueprint-file editing, Excalidraw file previews and standalone CLIs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏提供思维导图和 Excalidraw 自由画布，支持本地思维导图文件编辑、Excalidraw 文件预览与独立 CLI。

description.en: Fantasy glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web UI: a moonlit nether-forest scene with drifting teal clouds, red spider lilies spreading from the lower-left and a sleeping cat in the corner, drawn over a WebGL2 fluid background with its own wallpaper and video backgrounds. Ships two switchable variants (pale / saturated blue), plus cat-paw, fish, bubble and starlight decorations. One switch restores the stock interface exactly.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面打造的奇幻玻璃拟态皮肤：月光冥界森林，青绿流云缓缓翻涌、绯红彼岸花自左下蔓延、角落里趴着一只睡猫，底层是 WebGL2 流体；另有自定义壁纸与视频背景。内置两套可一键切换的风格（淡雅 / 蓝色），并有猫爪、小鱼、泡泡、星光装饰。一个开关即可完全还原原生界面。

description.en: Adversarial code review — parallel finders inspect a diff through separate lenses (correctness, lifecycle, contract, security), then each finding goes to independent verifiers tasked with refuting it, and one refutation drops it.
description.zh: 对抗式代码审查：多个 finder 并行地从不同视角（正确性、生命周期、契约、安全）审查改动，随后每条发现都交给独立验证者去推翻它，只要有一票推翻就丢弃。

description.en: Model-driven context compaction for DeepSeek Harness. The agent decides when and what to compress, commits durable session-log replacements, and ships reversible tool-result compression with byte-exact hash retrieval.
description.zh: 由模型主导的 DeepSeek Harness 上下文压缩：由 agent 决定何时压缩、压缩什么，以持久化会话日志替换提交，并提供可逆的工具结果压缩与逐字节哈希取回。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu on file references in chat output, listing registered applications with icons for open-with, revealing files in the file manager, and copying absolute or relative paths resolved against the session workspace, while code blocks, plain text and external links keep the native menu.
description.zh: 为聊天输出中的文件引用添加右键菜单，列出系统关联应用（带图标）供选择打开，在文件管理器中定位文件，并复制基于会话工作区解析的绝对或相对路径；代码块、普通文本与外部链接保持原生菜单。

description.en: Links DeepSeek Harness to VS Code: approvals answered in native notifications, ask_user_question answered in a sidebar card, an ide_context tool fed by the active file, diagnostics and selection, selection to composer, and a sidebar with the live transcript, workspace-scoped session picker, model and permission controls.
description.zh: 把 DSH 接进 VS Code：审批用原生通知回答，ask_user_question 在侧边栏卡片里作答，ide_context 工具读取当前文件、诊断与选区，选区可插入 DSH 输入框，侧边栏提供实时转录、按工作区限定的会话列表以及模型与权限控制。

description.en: Processes as little workers: how many, the busiest, the family tree and badges.
description.zh: 进程小工人：数量、谁最卖力、家族树、工牌。

description.en: Shows what each assistant turn cost under every reply, priced from the token usage of that turn at the official peak and off-peak CNY rates, together with the account and bonus balances; when a turn cannot be priced it states the reason instead of guessing.
description.zh: 在每条助手回复下面显示本次问答的花费、账户余额与礼金余额，按该轮 token 用量乘官方峰谷单价计算；算不出价时写明原因，不猜测。

description.en: Let Codex dispatch tasks to DeepSeek Harness workspaces, follow execution, read results, and continue collaboration through a local bridge and companion Codex skill.
description.zh: 通过本机桥接插件与配套 Codex 技能，让 Codex 向 DeepSeek Harness 工作区派发任务、跟踪执行、回读结果并继续协作。

description.en: DSH plugin that installs, supervises and auto-upgrades the local miloco-mcp-server background service, bridges its MCP tools into DSH and adds service, account and license settings panels.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中安装、守护并自动升级本机 miloco-mcp-server 后台服务，把它的 MCP 工具接入 DSH，并提供服务、账号与授权设置界面。

description.en: Workspace-isolated durable memory for DSH, with searchable, auditable, correctable, and removable workspace memories plus controlled global memory.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供工作区隔离的持久化记忆，让每个工作区拥有可检索、可审计、可纠错和可删除的独立记忆，并支持受控的全局记忆。

description.en: Smart calendar and checklist assistant with lunar dates, macOS/Windows native notifications, and WeCom push.
description.zh: 智能日程与待办助手：农历节气、macOS/Windows 原生桌面弹窗、企微多平台推送与拖拽改期。

description.en: Phone-side command center rather than a web-UI mirror: dispatch tasks into isolated git worktrees from a PWA, tool-approval push notifications with phone/desktop first-answer-wins racing (never auto-approved), a multi-machine session board, and an end-to-end encrypted zero-knowledge relay you can self-host.
description.zh: 面向手机的指挥台而非 Web UI 镜像：从 PWA 把任务派发进隔离的 git worktree，工具审批推送通知支持手机/桌面「谁先答谁算」（绝不自动批准），多机会话看板，以及可自建的端到端加密零知识中继。

description.en: Quick sticky notes with colored labels, pin, timed reminders, and password protection for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 泡泡猫的即时便签 — 支持彩色标签、置顶、定时提醒与密码保护。

description.en: DSH plugin: read and write DingTalk AI Tables through the official dws CLI, adding ten DingTalk AI Table tools (nine `dingtalk_aitable_*` plus `dingtalk_sync_job`), a settings panel, and scheduled CSV export.
description.zh: DSH 插件：包装钉钉官方 dws CLI，读写钉钉 AI 表格，提供 10 个钉钉 AI 表格工具（9 个 `dingtalk_aitable_*` 加 1 个 `dingtalk_sync_job`）、设置面板与定时 CSV 导出。

description.en: Ocean-blue theme for the DSH web interface: swimming fish, rising bubbles, a daily-quote ticker above the input box, and a replacement brand area; Settings → Marine Theme exposes 7 groups and 32 options (brand text and size, badge, primary color, watermark, fish, quotes, overall scale) that apply instantly without a reload, plus a two-step reset to defaults.
description.zh: 海洋蓝主题：游动鱼群、上升气泡、输入框上方的「每日鱼语」，以及左上角品牌区替换；「设置 → 海洋主题」提供 7 组 32 项可调（品牌文字与字号、徽章、主色、水印、鱼群、语录、整体缩放），改动即时生效无需刷新，并带二次确认的一键恢复默认。

description.en: Two-way TickTick/Dida365 (滴答清单) task sync via the official OAuth Open API: pull tasks across lists, create/update/complete/delete tasks, and one-shot title-deduped sync, with a web settings panel.
description.zh: 基于官方 OAuth Open API 双向同步滴答清单（TickTick/Dida365）任务：拉取各清单任务、创建/更新/完成/删除、按标题去重的一键同步，带 Web 设置面板。

description.en: Session-memory autopilot: watches DSH sessions and extracts OKF entries in-process through the harness LLM (ctx.llm, deepseek-official by default) at idle, commit, compaction and end checkpoints, storing them via the vault MCP server.
description.zh: 会话记忆自动驾驶：监听 DSH 会话，在会话结束与压缩前通过宿主 LLM（ctx.llm，默认 deepseek-official）就地抽取 OKF 条目，无需外部 API Key。

description.en: Read-only DeepSeek web archive tools for DSH: list/download/search sessions, share-list, and a digest tool that compresses the 100-session history into one high-density page with activity bars and topic clusters. Write operations are intentionally not exposed (the web client rate-limits them). Requires the separately installed deepseek-ops Python client (github.com/Panniantong/deepseek-ops, by another author) with QR-code login; set scriptDir to its path.
description.zh: DSH 内只读访问 DeepSeek 网页版会话归档：列会话/下载全文/搜索索引/分享列表，以及把 100 段会话压缩成一页高密度摘要（含活跃度直方图与主题聚类）的 digest 工具。刻意不暴露写操作（网页版有限流）。需另外安装第三方 deepseek-ops Python 客户端（github.com/Panniantong/deepseek-ops，另一位作者）并扫码登录，在插件配置里把 scriptDir 指向它。

description.en: Unit conversion as a `convert` tool: 10 categories (length, area, volume, time, angle, speed, temperature, pressure, energy/heat, power) and 82 units with English and Chinese aliases, plus a locale-aware Unit Converter tab in the DSH web view with one module per category and a temperature-difference (Δ) switch.
description.zh: 单位换算：提供 convert 工具，覆盖长度/面积/体积/时间/角度/速度/温度/压力/热量/功率十大类共 82 个单位，支持中英文单位名与温差（Δ）换算，并在 DSH Web 会话视图中提供按类别分模块、跟随中英文界面语言的「单位换算」标签页。

description.en: NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek nodes inside DSH: five read-only tools covering provenance (both upstream releases this build names), a data directory's restored state and ledger audit, the conformance vectors, exact decimal conversion, and node reachability. Driving the node -- starting or stopping a daemon, depositing funds, sending bus messages -- is deliberately not exposed, because those are audited privileged operations in this project.
description.zh: 把 NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek 节点接入 DSH：五个只读工具，覆盖版本与上游出处、数据目录恢复状态与账本审计、一致性向量、精确十进制换算，以及节点可达性探测。刻意不暴露启动/停止守护进程、存款、发总线消息这类在本项目里受审计的特权操作。

description.en: Cubox sync for DeepSeek Harness: scheduled sync of your bookmarks, an AI daily brief generated from your own prompt template straight into Obsidian, and per-card markdown export.
description.zh: Cubox 收藏同步：定时同步收藏，按你的 prompt 用 LLM 生成今日收藏简报直接写入 Obsidian，可导出每张收藏为 Markdown。

description.en: Global experience archive for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: probes local tools (with versions and PATH-first hits), convenient paths, network latency and disk speed; folds per-session stats from session/event; LLM-extracts durable facts; env_profile tool with remember; byte-stable summary injected every turn to speed up sessions and cut token use.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全局经验档案（Windows）：探测本地工具（含版本与 PATH 首个命中）、便捷路径、网络延迟与磁盘速度；从 session/event 折叠每会话统计；由 LLM 抽取持久知识条目；提供带 remember 的 env_profile 工具；每轮注入字节稳定的摘要，加快会话并降低 token 消耗。

description.en: Mounts the tsm-core-dlr semantic service (LanceDB vectors + graph) as MCP tools and ships the scenario-independent DLR/TSM modeling skill, a service-status overlay and the agent rules; the service is a hard dependency and must be running before the bundle activates.
description.zh: 把 tsm-core-dlr 语义服务（LanceDB 向量 + 图）挂为 MCP 工具，并携带与场景无关的 DLR/TSM 建模技能、服务状态浮层与 agent 规则；该服务是硬依赖，须先运行、bundle 才能激活。

description.en: Radial right-click menu on conversation turns in the DSH web GUI for forking a session from a chosen turn, interrupting generation, copying the working directory path or session ID, opening the working directory, and exporting session logs.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话轮次上点击右键弹出的圆盘菜单：从此轮分叉出新会话、打断生成、复制工作目录路径与会话 ID、打开工作目录、导出会话日志。

description.en: Media-scape theme for the DSH web UI: standing/character-art and video wallpapers (mp4/webm, local + online) with boot animation, base color schemes (single-source JSON + presets + picker), capsule host-element styling, ambient particles, background music player (covers/playlists/random), typing sound effects, and a draggable dock toolbar with a unified upload entry — wallpapers and music uploaded together (suffix-classified), mid-upload no-disk buffering, pause→.part snapshots with offset resume, filename+size dedup with "skipped" notices, and true-delete removal with list refreshes.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 媒体景观主题：立绘/视频壁纸（mp4/webm，本地+在线）+ 开屏动画 + 基底配色（单真源 JSON + 预设包 + 取色器 + 胶囊宿主元素样式）+ 氛围粒子 + 背景音乐播放器（封面/歌单/随机）+ 打字音效 + 可拖动 dock 工具条；dock「传」统一上传壁纸与音乐（按文件后缀识别）——上传中途不落盘、暂停落 .part 快照可续传、文件名+大小去重预检「已跳过」、移除真实删除并前后刷新列表。

description.en: Codex-shaped coding tools and agent presets for GPT models on DeepSeek Harness: exec_command, write_stdin, apply_patch and view_image, plus OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses API routes, bridged to DSH-native plan, ask, approval and compaction. Long-running commands become DSH background jobs with bounded head/tail output readable through job_output, and each subagent type can be pinned to its own preset, provider, model and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 上 GPT 模型的 Codex 风格编码工具与 agent 预设：exec_command、write_stdin、apply_patch、view_image，以及 OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Responses API 两条路由，并桥接 DSH 原生的计划、提问、审批与压缩。长命令注册为 DSH 后台作业，输出首尾有界，可用 job_output 读取；每种子代理类型可独立指定 Preset、Provider、Model 与 Reasoning effort。

description.en: LAN reverse proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness - enables mobile/tablet access with full features, fixes settings panel inaccessible via reverse proxy.
description.zh: DSH 局域网反向代理插件 - 让手机/平板访问 DSH 获得完整功能，修复反代访问时设置面板无法打开的问题。

description.en: Colors each DSH sidebar session title by state: unread (blue while the model is running, green once it has finished) and pinned (yellow, read from DSH's own pinned set), composed into one left-to-right gradient. Pinning, archiving and ordering stay with DSH itself — the plugin reimplements no pinning and rewrites no official bundle — and a settings section lists every unread session.
description.zh: 按状态给 DSH 侧栏会话标题上色：未读（模型运行中＝蓝、已跑完＝绿）与置顶（黄，读取 DSH 官方置顶集合），两者合成一条从左到右的渐变。置顶、归档与排序由 DSH 官方提供，本插件不重复实现置顶、也不改写官方 bundle；另含列出全部未读会话的设置分节。

description.en: Manual model probe for DeepSeek Harness: a session-view tab where you pick provider, API type, model and route, then send one real raw HTTP request over openai-completions, openai-responses or anthropic-messages — streaming or not — and read latency, TTFT, HTTP status, token usage and a three-layer diagnosis chain (API request / model response / strict check) on one screen, with errors in plain language.
description.zh: DSH 模型健康检查：会话视图页签内按「供应商 → API 类型 → 模型 → 路由」选定目标，手动发一条真实裸 HTTP 请求（支持 openai-completions / openai-responses / anthropic-messages 三协议，流式可切），一屏看清耗时、TTFT、HTTP 状态、token 用量与三层诊断链（API 请求 / 模型响应 / 严格校验），错误全部人话化。

description.en: Theme studio for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: eight switchable preset styles, accent and panel-translucency fine-tuning, host-side wallpapers painted on the first frame, and a one-click fix when the wallpaper-engine glass tint greys out light styles.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 主题工坊：可切换预设风格、强调色与面板透明度微调、宿主壁纸首帧绘制；wallpaper-engine 玻璃色把浅色主题洗灰时一键改为白色玻璃。

description.en: Sidebar unread / waiting / status hub for DSH Web: a bell jumps to the next unread session, a shortcut walks sessions waiting for input, and ⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. step back and forward through the conversations you have visited; one overlay lists unread and pending sessions side by side; a six-metric readout at the sidebar foot makes every icon a button that jumps to the next session of that kind; a host-side ledger keeps the account across restarts, so an unread session keeps its green row dot after a restart, and a startup dialog offers to re-send a continue message to sessions whose turn was cut off.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏的未读、待办与状态读数中枢：铃铛按顺序定位未读会话，快捷键依次走到正在等你输入的会话，⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. 在访问过的对话之间前后切换；另有总览把未读与待决策会话分两区铺开；底部一行六项会话状态读数，每个图标都能点，点了跳到下一个同类会话；账本落在 host 半边，重启也不丢——未读会话重启后仍然显示行内绿色小标，启动时还会把上次被切断的会话列成清单，一键重发续跑消息。

description.en: Full workbench fork of dsh-better-sidebar: explorer, editor, terminal, Git, browser and split panes, plus a VSCode-like shell refactor with a full-width compact header and activity rail; publishes as @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23 on npm.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 完整工作台 fork：资源管理器、编辑器、终端、Git、浏览器与分屏，外加仿 VSCode 外壳重构（全宽紧凑顶栏与活动栏）；npm 包名 @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23。

description.en: Write notes and memos to flomo (浮墨笔记) from any agent via the flomo_send tool, configured once with the flomo API URL or API Key.
description.zh: 配置一次 flomo API URL / API Key，Agent 即可用 flomo_send 把笔记、摘要、待办写进 flomo（浮墨笔记）。

description.en: Round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows desktop, reusing existing Agent sessions with discussion, editable task cards, sequential and parallel steps, shared meeting files, and secretary minutes.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 桌面版 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 的圆桌会议，复用已有 Agent 会话，提供讨论、可编辑任务卡、顺序与并行步骤、会议文件归档及秘书纪要。

description.en: Manage native archives by workspace, with search, unarchive, and permanent deletion of individual sessions or fixed batches.
description.zh: 按工作区管理原生归档，支持搜索、取消归档、单项和固定范围批量永久删除。

description.en: Hermes in the DSH sidebar: start and stop the gateway and dashboard, watch the dashboard beside the chat, and bridge DSH to Hermes. Windows only; requires an existing Hermes install.
description.zh: 把 Hermes 放进 DSH 右侧栏：启停网关和 dashboard，聊天旁边就能看 dashboard，再把 DSH 和 Hermes 接起来。仅 Windows；需已安装 Hermes。

description.en: Ghost-text completion for the composer: FIM suggestions stream in inline after a typing pause (SSE, first token rendered immediately), Tab accepts one word at a time and Shift+Tab takes all, in-flight requests are truly cancelled on retyping or Esc. Plus two-layer typo checking: a browser-local dictionary scan (Chinese wrong phrases, English misspellings and proper-noun capitalization, user-defined per-browser entries) with a debounced LLM context pass, underlined in red in the text with per-item navigation and click-to-fix.
description.zh: 输入框 ghost 补全：停笔后 FIM 建议内联流式渐显（SSE，首 token 即上屏），Tab 逐词采纳、Shift+Tab 全量，重新输入或 Esc 会真正取消在途请求；错别字双层检查：浏览器本地词典扫描（中文错词、英文错拼与专名大小写、本浏览器自定义词条）叠加防抖 LLM 上下文校对，文中红波浪线标注、逐条导航、点击修正。

description.en: Shows a reminder card in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI whenever the agent is waiting for your answer, and adds a desktop notification plus a flashing tab title when you are on another tab or window.
description.zh: 当 agent 停下来等你作答时，在 DSH Web 界面右下角弹出提醒卡；若你切到了别的标签或窗口，再补一条系统通知并让标签标题闪烁。

description.en: Ships the Zhouli-mode agent preset, which runs a session in three phases (declaring roles on opening, citing authorities while working, a six-item self-audit at the close), plus one tool with seven actions over a bundled 49,384-character 《周礼》 corpus that returns every passage with a stable 篇序.职官序 coordinate, a per-office establishment index and collation between two Kanripo witnesses.
description.zh: 主打「周礼模式」agent 预设：会话分三段依六官法度而行——开工「设官分职」、事中「依典援据」、收尾「岁终之会」依六计考成。另附 zhouli 工具，七种检索动作，检索内置 49,384 字《周礼》语料，每条结果带稳定坐标（篇序.职官序），含职官员额索引与 Kanripo 两本互校勘记。

description.en: ZCode-style enhancement of dsh plan mode: a model-initiated enter_plan_mode tool, hard interception of write-class tools at dispatch time (ctx.tools.guard) while planning, and a four-phase planning prompt section (explore, design, review, exit), reusing the official plan/mode state machine and exit review flow.
description.zh: dsh 计划模式的 ZCode 式增强：模型可主动调用 enter_plan_mode 进入计划模式，计划期间写类工具在分发前被硬拦截，并注入「探索 → 设计 → 评审 → 退出」四阶段工作流提示词；复用官方 plan/mode 状态机与退出评审流，只做增量。

description.en: Host performance monitor in the right Sidebar: CPU, memory and swap gauges, a GPU clock and VRAM bar, CPU / GPU / motherboard / drive temperatures, and a process table sortable by CPU, memory or name.
description.zh: 右侧栏主机性能监控：CPU、内存、交换内存仪表盘，显卡频率与显存条，CPU / 显卡 / 主板 / 硬盘温度，以及可按 CPU、内存、进程名排序的进程列表。

description.en: Push DSH task results to the Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today screen as service cards. After installing, enter the auth code on the plugin settings page: DSH top-left Plugins - dsh-harmonyos-hiboard.
description.zh: 把DSH的任务结果，以服务卡片形式推送到华为鸿蒙负一屏。安装后请在插件设置页输入授权码，位置：主页面左上角「插件」→ 「dsh-harmonyos-hiboard」。

description.en: Browse the skill library from a floating-ball panel: you choose the skill root yourself through a native directory chooser (defaults to ~/.dsh/skills, no path is shipped with the plugin), skills are grouped into first and second level categories, descriptions are read from each SKILL.md frontmatter, search filters by skill name, description or original text, and a card opens the full SKILL.md. Skills can be switched on and off per card, per category or for the whole library — the toggle rewrites disable-model-invocation in that SKILL.md and keeps a .bak-toggle backup, and disabled cards grey out until restored. A failure ledger separates automatic from manual entries and records skill successes and failures by listening to tools/result events, reusing an existing ledger file if one is found in the library and otherwise creating one under skill-master/references. The DSH settings page gains a floating-ball section that shows or hides the three balls and offers one-click restore of a ball dragged off-screen.
description.zh: 悬浮球面板直接浏览技能库：技能库位置由你自己指定（弹系统目录选择框，默认 ~/.dsh/skills，插件不含任何预设路径），技能按一级/二级分类归组，中文简介直接读各 SKILL.md 的 frontmatter，支持按技能名、简介或原文实时搜索，点卡片查看 SKILL.md 全文。技能可单个卡片、按分类或全库批量启停——启停即改写该 SKILL.md frontmatter 的 disable-model-invocation 并自动备份为 .bak-toggle，停用卡灰显带徽章、随时一键恢复。失效台账分「自动 / 人工」两栏显示，监听 tools/result 事件自动登记成功与失败；初始化时会先在技能库内搜索已有台账文件复用（约定路径 skill-master/references 优先），搜不到才创建。DSH 设置页新增「悬浮球导航」分区，可控制三个悬浮球的显隐，并提供「一键恢复悬浮球默认位置」，把拖出屏幕的球立即复位。

description.en: Session model selector with search: two-stage loose matching (normalised substring first, subsequence as fallback, so glm53 finds GLM-5.3 and ds finds DeepSeek), providers with recent successful calls pinned first, and a reasoning-effort pane that remembers each model's last explicitly chosen effort.
description.zh: 搜索增强的会话模型选择器：两段式宽松匹配（先归一化子串，未命中再退子序列，glm53 命中 GLM-5.3、ds 命中 DeepSeek）、近七天成功调用过的供应商置顶，推理档位面板记住每个模型上次显式选择的档位。

description.en: Multi-agent frugality defense plugin: read-ledger dedup metrics, compaction-immune rules, completion gate, cheap-model review lane.
description.zh: 多智能体防内耗防御插件：读取台账去重度量、免疫压缩规则区、完成机械门禁、低成本审查 lane。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show a provider + model icon in the sidebar for every session, updated live from the composer model selector with a last-request fallback for history sessions; aggregator routes render the provider logo with a 10px model logo in the corner.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧边栏为每个会话显示 provider 与 model 图标，跟随输入框选择器即时更新，历史会话回退到最近一次请求；聚合路由（如 opencode-go、traex）显示 provider 主图并叠加 10px model 小图标。

description.en: Turns markdown into a WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) draft: inlines every CSS rule onto its element because the editor discards `<style>` blocks and class names, uploads each local image through WeChat's own endpoint so it is not filtered out, and creates the draft; it never broadcasts.
description.zh: 把 markdown 变成排好版的微信公众号草稿：样式逐条内联到元素上（编辑器会丢弃 `<style>` 块和 class 名），每张本地图片走微信自己的上传接口以免被过滤，然后创建草稿；不做群发。

description.en: Annotate pages inside the existing Harness Browser: click or drag to select, comment or ask, then send marked screenshots or DOM location details to the current session. While enabled it replaces the official Browser, Chat and Layout providers; targets Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2.
description.zh: 在 Harness 原有 Browser 内批注网页：点选或框选后就地评论、提问，可把标记截图或 DOM 定位资料发给当前会话；启用期间替换官方 Browser、Chat 与 Layout 提供方，精确支持 Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2。

description.en: Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the session approval stance and is enforced by request interception.
description.zh: 按无障碍 ref 操控浏览器：导航、把页面快照成 ref 树、操作元素、等待条件；域名策略跟随会话审批状态，并由请求拦截层强制执行。

description.en: Declarative task-DAG orchestration for DSH: validates dependency graphs, runs topological task layers in parallel through workflow-backed subagents, and propagates failures deterministically.
description.zh: DSH 声明式任务 DAG 编排：校验依赖图，通过工作流子智能体并行执行拓扑任务层，并确定性传播失败。

description.en: Enforces a check-fix-recheck loop when a task is wrapping up: it auto-runs your tests/lint/audit, blocks any round that still has unfixed problems, and only calls the task done after three consecutive clean full checks, then notifies the user.
description.zh: 收尾自检哨兵：任务收尾时强制「全面检查 → 修复 → 再全面检查」循环，自动跑测试/lint/audit，有未修复的问题就打回，直到连续三轮零问题才判定完成并通知用户。

description.en: Digests the images in a prompt with a vision model before admission, so any model — a text-only one included — can read them without the session ever switching models, and adds a describe_image tool for image paths.
description.zh: 在准入前把提示词里的图片换成视觉模型的文字分析，因此任何模型（包括纯文本模型）都能读图且会话不切换模型；另提供 describe_image 工具处理图片路径。

description.en: Pins a selected passage of a finished user or assistant message as source text and keeps it in the model input across context compaction: each pin is recall-on-demand by default, or can be moved to a neutral resident system-prompt section or an emphasised highlighted one. Selections are aligned back to the source text with source-exact, source-normalized or rendered fidelity, and each of the three levels has its own character budget.
description.zh: 把已定稿的用户或助手消息里划选的一段原文钉住，让它在上下文压缩后仍留在模型输入中：每枚钉子默认按需补回，也可改为 resident（中性常驻系统提示词）或 highlight（强调常驻）。选区会以 source-exact、source-normalized 或 rendered 三级保真对回源文本，三个级别各有独立的字符预算。

description.en: Zhihu (知乎) for DeepSeek Harness: wraps the local pyzhihu-cli as 18 zhihu_* tools — 14 read-only (search, hot list, question, answer, user, feed, topic, notifications, collections) plus 4 publishing tools that are not registered until readOnly is turned off — with a web panel in the sidebar for login, config and lookups.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供知乎能力：包装本机 pyzhihu-cli 为 18 个 zhihu_* 工具——14 个只读（搜索/热榜/问题/回答/用户/推荐流/话题/通知/收藏夹）与 4 个发布类工具（readOnly 关闭前不注册）——并在侧栏提供 Web 面板做登录、配置与查询。

description.en: Cross-session meeting room for DSH: a host session opens a room with a topic and a round limit, invites other sessions in order, they speak one at a time, and the meeting closes with written minutes.
description.zh: 跨会话会议室：主持人开房定题、定轮次，按顺序邀请其它会话，一位一位发言，轮次用满即收会出纪要。

description.en: View tab manager for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI session header: enable, hide, reorder and rename the conversation view tabs (Chat / Trajectory), with locale-aware zh/en copy and npm update reminders.
description.zh: DSH 视图标签管理器（逃咪）：管理会话页头视图标签（对话/轨迹）——启停、隐藏、排序与重命名，文案随界面语言中英切换，并带 npm 更新提醒。

description.en: Distills daily AI conversations (Doubao, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Kimi) into structured Markdown notes in your Obsidian vault.
description.zh: 把每天和各种 AI 的对话提炼成结构化 Markdown 笔记，写入你的 Obsidian 库。

description.en: Tracks this turn cost under the input box, today tokens and spend in the sidebar with peak and idle pricing, and pins the latest question to the top of the conversation.
description.zh: 输入框下方显示本轮花费；侧栏显示今日 token、消费与高峰/空闲时段；对话区顶部钉住最新提问，点击可跳回。

description.en: Skill center panel for the DSH web GUI - search online skill registries (SkillHub, skills.sh, GitHub), install skills to user or project roots, and manage local skills with enable, create, edit, delete and preview.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的技能中心面板——搜索网络技能市场（SkillHub、skills.sh、GitHub），一键安装技能到用户或项目根，并管理本地技能（启停、创建、编辑、删除、预览）。

description.en: Track DeepSeek Harness's own releases and update in one click: reads the npm dist-tags and the GitHub changelog, shows every change between the running build and the target, grades the risk, then hands the install to a detached helper that backs the current install up with an atomic rename, runs npm, verifies what landed, relaunches, and rolls back when the new build does not come up.
description.zh: 跟踪 DSH 官方版本并一键更新：读取 npm dist-tags 与 GitHub 更新说明，列出当前版本到目标版本之间每一个版本的更新点，给出分级风险清单（预发布、破坏性变更措辞、本机多份安装与 PATH 不一致、插件 dsh.engines.dsh 兼容性、备份与回滚可用性），再把安装交给分离助手——用 rename 原子备份当前安装、执行 npm、校验落地结果、用原命令重启，新版本起不来就自动回滚。

description.en: Realtime token counter beside the deep-thinking indicator in chat, with merged or split input/output display, per-step operation counts, and auto-scaling K/M/G/T units.
description.zh: 在聊天页“深度思考”指示旁实时显示 token 计数，支持输入/输出合并或分列展示、逐步骤操作计数与 K/M/G/T 自适应单位。

description.en: Local Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: branch search and switching, hunk-level staging, commit graph, file history and blame, stash and worktree management, conflict resolution, and eight git tools for the agent.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地 Git 工作台：分支搜索与切换、hunk 级暂存、提交图谱、文件历史与 blame、储藏与工作树管理、冲突处理，以及 8 个供 agent 使用的 Git 工具。

description.en: One-click launcher for the Web UI: a double-click Start-DSH-Web.cmd on the Windows desktop that boots dsh web and auto-opens the browser (polling until ready), plus a web_launcher model tool (install / open / status).
description.zh: Web 界面一键启动器：在 Windows 桌面创建双击即用的 Start-DSH-Web.cmd（自动启动 dsh web，轮询就绪后自动打开浏览器），并提供 web_launcher 模型工具（install / open / status）。

description.en: Skill manager for DSH with a pack system. Installs skills as versioned packs and never overwrites files you have edited - upgrades skip your changes and report them. Also ships 6 built-in skills, a problem-grouped settings panel, and tools that let the agent read and write the skill library in conversation.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器，带技能包机制。技能以带版本的包安装，升级时绝不覆盖你改过的文件，只跳过并如实报告。另自带 6 个基础技能、按「你遇到的问题」分组的面板，以及让模型在对话里直接读写技能库的工具。

description.en: Select foreign text in a DSH conversation and a Simplified Chinese translation card appears right below the selection.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用鼠标选中外文，选区正下方就地浮出简体中文译文卡片。

description.en: Agent-facing plugin installer that resolves DSH-compatible versions, handles ambiguous names, and verifies the loader entry after install.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的插件安装器：解析 DSH 兼容版本、处理同名歧义，并在安装后校验 loader 入口。

description.en: Element-level PowerPoint canvas that edits the opened .pptx in place: click, marquee-select or pick a whole slide, describe the change, and the AI writes byte-preserving OOXML patches with undo and redo.
description.zh: 元素级 PPT 画布，就地改写已打开的 .pptx：点选、框选或整页选中后用自然语言描述改动，AI 以字节保真的 OOXML 补丁写入，支持撤销与重做。

description.en: Exposes any local service on a LAN address and a public cloudflared quick-tunnel domain behind one password login, with per-route open/block gates managed from the plugin settings page. Requires Python 3 and cloudflared on the machine, and reports either of them being missing or misconfigured in the settings page before you start; LAN and local access are passwordless by default, while the public tunnel requires the passcode.
description.zh: 把一个口令登录的内网地址与公网 cloudflared 快速隧道域名提供给本机任意服务，每条路由的开放/屏蔽闸门在插件设置页里管理。需本机有 Python 3 与 cloudflared，缺失或路径填错会在启动前的设置页里提示；内网与本机访问默认免密，公网隧道需要口令。

description.en: Sidebar conversation actions: open the row menu on right-click, rename by double-click, copy the session id, and delete a conversation together with its storage after a confirmation.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话操作：右键打开行菜单、双击重命名、复制会话 ID，以及二次确认后连同存储一起删除会话。

description.en: A newspaper-style front page for a session you left running, as a Conversation View tab beside Chat and Trajectory: a per-turn timeline (duration, steps, tools, tokens, outcome), file churn counted per file, where the wall clock went and how much of it was the model rather than tools, which single turn ate the spend, failures nobody retried quoted with their failing command, and a context-pressure gauge measured against the routed model's own declared capacity. The briefing is folded from the durable session log and never generated by a model, so it costs no tokens, cannot hallucinate, and is byte-identical for the same log and clock; it appends nothing to the session and reaches no model, and it reports a pending approval without ever answering it. Pages are offered only when they have content, and the tab refreshes itself on turn settle and on a two-speed poll backed by a metadata-only tail probe.
description.zh: 把跑着的会话排成一张报纸式头版，作为 Chat 与 Trajectory 旁的 Conversation View 标签页：逐轮时间线（耗时、步数、工具、token、结果）、按文件统计的改动热度、墙钟时间去向以及其中多少是模型而非工具、哪一轮吃掉了花费、无人重试的失败（附失败命令），以及对照该路由模型自报容量的上下文压力仪表。简报由持久会话日志折算而成、从不调用模型：零 token、不会编造、同一份日志与时钟下字节一致；不向会话追加任何内容、也不触达模型，只报告待批准项而绝不代为应答。仅在某一页有内容时才提供该页；标签页在轮次结束时自刷新，并用只读日志尾部的探针做两档轮询。

description.en: Loopback-only ACP door for DeepSeek Harness: connect VS Code and other local clients to a running kernel over the local loopback address, sharing its models, tools, memory and sessions. Browse history, change permission modes and call capabilities registered by DSH plugins.
description.zh: 为正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 内核提供仅监听本机回环地址的 ACP 接入点，供 VS Code 等本机客户端连接，共用模型、工具、记忆和会话，并支持历史查看、权限切换及调用 DSH 插件已注册的能力。

description.en: Kite-flying engine: while the agent codes, an animated kite drifts and sways in the wind on screen, tethered to the bottom edge of the window — the busier the agent, the denser the events and the higher it flies; ships a Weifang-style framework card deck (sand-swallow, goldfish, butterfly, bagua, dragon-head and more, hard-wing / soft-wing / flat / dimensional frames), with shape x pattern x colors all swappable data configs, and supports pasting user images onto the kite face with real-time affine transforms as the kite banks.
description.zh: 放风筝引擎：agent 编程时屏幕上放一只动画风筝——token 越多事件越密风筝飞得越高，随风漂移摆动，一根线牵在窗口底边；潍坊系框架卡组（沙燕/金鱼/蝴蝶/八卦/龙头等，硬翅软翅板式立体），形状×图案×配色全是可替换数据配置，支持把用户上传的图片糊上风筝面，贴图随风筝侧正斜的姿态实时仿射变换。

description.en: Captures every plan the agent presents through exit_plan_mode as markdown under <workspace>/.dsh/plans, opens a review window, and keeps a Plans history tab recording the outcome of each plan.
description.zh: 将智能体通过 exit_plan_mode 呈现的每个计划捕获为 <workspace>/.dsh/plans 下的 markdown，打开审阅窗口，并以 Plans 历史标签页记录每个计划的结果。

description.en: Git Changes tab for the DSH web GUI: staging, diffing, AI-drafted commit messages, branch/merge/stash/worktree operations and sync, with live updates via fs.watch plus a changeToken poll.
description.zh: Git 更改标签页：暂存、对比、AI 起草提交信息、分支/合并/储藏/工作树操作与同步，通过 fs.watch 加 changeToken 轮询实现实时更新。

description.en: A Git Graph tab for DSH Web: a faithful port of vscode-git-graph 1.30.0 that registers a native tab in the dsh-better-sidebar right rail (prerequisite), auto-binds to the session workspace, runs the full git operations (checkout/merge/rebase/push/tag/stash) directly on the host, and opens file diffs in the built-in DiffTab.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 vscode-git-graph 1.30.0 忠实移植：入驻 dsh-better-sidebar 右侧栏的原生 Git Graph 提交图 tab（前置依赖），自动绑定会话工作区，host 直跑全套 git 操作（checkout/merge/rebase/push/tag/stash），文件 diff 复用内置 DiffTab 打开。

description.en: Moves selected messages from one conversation into another, and manages a workspace's conversations with archive, restore, delete and move between workspaces.
description.zh: 把选中的消息从一个对话迁移到另一个对话，并管理工作区的对话——支持归档、还原、删除和跨工作区迁移。

description.en: Render Markdown + JSON into self-contained HTML documents, cards, dashboards, and galleries (CLI + artifact_render tool).
description.zh: 把 Markdown + JSON 渲染成自包含 HTML 文档/卡片/仪表盘/画廊（CLI + 内置 artifact_render 工具）。

description.en: Adds an "approve for me" access mode whose approval requests are answered by an independent reviewer model instead of a person: the reviewer can read the workspace read-only, a reviewer that cannot run hands the request back to the human, and every decision is recorded with its rationale in an Approvals tab.
description.zh: 新增「替我审批」访问模式：审批请求由独立的复核模型裁决而非人工，复核者可只读工作区，复核跑不起来时把请求交回人工，每次裁决的理由记录在「审批」页签中。

description.en: Session-local scheduled tasks: inject a prompt into the current session after a delay, at a fixed time, or on a repeating interval, so the model wakes up and runs it on time. Manage them from a panel above the composer, the /schedule command, or seven model-facing tools. Timers freeze while DSH is closed and never auto-resume; pause keeps the remaining time, so resuming continues from where it stopped.
description.zh: 会话内定时任务：按延迟、固定时刻或重复间隔向当前会话注入一段提示词，到点唤醒模型执行。可用输入框上方面板、/schedule 命令、或 7 个面向模型的工具管理。DSH 关闭期间计时冻结、绝不自动恢复；暂停保留剩余时间，恢复后从原处继续。

description.en: Tracks API token usage and estimated costs with per-route model pricing, optional billing groups, synchronized CNY/USD display, session reports, composer totals and a clickable daily sidebar total.
description.zh: 按 API 路由与模型配置单价，统计 Token 用量与估算费用，支持可选账单分组、同步切换 CNY/USD，以及会话报告、输入框费用和可点击的侧边栏今日金额。

description.en: Plugin compatibility vet for dsh that compares installed plugins peerDependencies against the running dsh version to flag which ones the startup preflight will refuse to load, prints copy-pasteable fix commands, and offers a top-of-page banner in dsh web to isolate, uninstall or upgrade them, with an automatic backup before the change and rollback if the re-check fails.
description.zh: dsh 插件兼容性体检：把已装插件的 peerDependencies 与当前 dsh 运行时比对，提前指出哪些会在下次启动被预检拒绝加载，并给出可直接执行的中文修复命令；dsh web 顶部横幅可按键隔离、卸载或升级，改动前自动备份、复检不过自动回滚。

description.en: Headless-browser verification tools so the agent opens the page it just built, reads the rendered DOM and computed styles, checks the console, and screenshots the result; ships a frontend-verify skill.
description.zh: 无头浏览器验证工具：让 agent 打开自己刚写的页面，读取渲染后的 DOM 与计算样式、检查控制台、截图留档；内置 frontend-verify 技能。

description.en: Adds a button beside the composer and a global hotkey palette (default mod+shift+k) that hand one-off questions to a web chat instead of into the harness context: the draft is lifted out of the composer, copied to the clipboard and opened in the templated URL. Ships target-site presets (DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, 豆包, 腾讯元宝, GLM, Gemini), a local question history that can be re-opened, copied, or inserted back into the composer, and a settings tab for site, URL template, hotkey, clipboard and history.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加一个按钮，并提供全局快捷键（默认 mod+shift+k）浮层，把一次性的小问题交给网页版对话而不是送进 harness 上下文：草稿会从输入框取出、复制到剪贴板并打开模板 URL。内置目标站点预设（DeepSeek、Kimi、Qwen、豆包、腾讯元宝、GLM、Gemini），带本地问题历史（可重新打开、复制或回填到输入框），以及设置页（站点、URL 模板、快捷键、剪贴板、历史）。

description.en: Token usage statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness - today's token consumption by model, cache hit rate, 7-day trend chart, optional header badge, persistent storage with auto cleanup.
description.zh: DSH Token 用量统计插件 - 今日 Token 用量按模型分桶、缓存命中率、7 日趋势图、可选顶栏徽标、持久化存储自动清理。

description.en: ChatGPT-style side chat for the DSH Web GUI: ask small questions about the current topic in a floating side panel, answered by an independent lightweight session over the official /api RPC — the main conversation is never touched. Streaming text, collapsible reasoning, tool chips, stop button, agent-preset selector, and an automatic context snapshot from the visible main chat.
description.zh: ChatGPT 式侧边快速提问：在 DSH Web 聊天界面右侧悬浮面板中就当前话题提小问题，由独立轻量会话通过官方 /api RPC 回答，绝不写入、不影响主对话。流式正文、可折叠思考、工具 chips、停止按钮、agent 预设选择，自动抓取主对话最近内容作为背景。

description.en: Model usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: automatic per-call accounting from session logs with real timestamps, full history and live increments, showing tokens, cost, requests, trend and model composition with per-model, per-project and per-session views and editable tiered pricing.
description.zh: MIMO Quota Panel —— DeepSeek Harness 的模型额度面板。装上即用，零配置：从会话事件日志逐调用自动记账（真实时间戳、全历史、实时增量），一屏展示 Token 用量、消费金额、请求次数、趋势波形、模型构成，支持按模型 / 粒度 / 时间范围 / 项目·对话 统计切换。内置可编辑定价，DeepSeek 峰谷价按记录时间自动套算，小米全系牌价开箱即用。

description.en: Embedded terminal for DeepSeek Harness: opens an in-app terminal panel in the right sidebar (DockKit) or bottom composer dock, with PSReadLine geometry protection and full theme sync.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内嵌终端插件：在右侧栏（DockKit Tab）或输入框下方以沉底抽屉形式提供界面内嵌的交互式终端，跟随官方主题与工作区目录，支持 PSReadLine 尺寸保护与位置热切换。

description.en: Academic Harness as a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) profile plugin: research persona, scientific skills catalogue, living lab notebook, and specialist subagents.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上科研大脑，自带科研人设、科学技能库、实验记录本和专家子代理。

description.en: 冻结计划的自动化中间件（TypeScript / Node ≥ 22.6）：LLM 只规划一次，执行由本地规则与决策模型逐步完成，演示一次后既可端侧执行。
description.zh: 让 LLM 只规划一次，之后由本地规则逐步执行浏览器自动化，演示一遍就能离线跑。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web 插件：8.6 秒蓝调开机动画（可跳过）+ 三张同主题壁纸，设置页可切换、可调遮罩。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一段 8.6 秒蓝调开机动画，可跳过，还附三张同主题壁纸，设置页能切换和调遮罩。

description.en: Curated long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: two tiers of plain-text facts, memory tools, per-request injection, and after-turn consolidation.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上长期记忆，自动记住并整理关键信息，让 AI 越用越懂你。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 桌宠主题插件：可拖拽角色、右下角 token/思考时间立牌、聊天背景与液态玻璃界面
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个能随手拖的鲸鱼女仆桌宠，还有立牌、聊天壁纸和液态玻璃界面，一键开关。

description.en: Evolvable Markdown playbook for DSH agents — retrospectives distill lessons, consulted before tasks.
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 装上一本会自己进化的 Markdown 操作手册，任务后自动复盘攒经验，下次干活前先翻手册。

description.en: DSH AFK 插件：全局或会话级自动应答、禁用提问与持久未读记录
description.zh: 离开时让 Agent 自动应答或暂停提问，回来再看提问记录，不用一直守着。

description.en: Gives the agent a mouth through the ai-ball floating orb: speak text that the orb types out character by character, set its mood colour, show or hide its monologue panel, read back what you typed into it, and check or start it. The orb is a separate Python 3.10+ overlay you install yourself, and the plugin only writes the files it watches.
description.zh: 通过 ai-ball 悬浮球给 agent 一张嘴：让球逐字打出你要说的话、按 mood 改变边缘光颜色、显示或收起独白面板、读回你打的字，以及检查接线和启动球。球是独立的 Python 3.10+ 悬浮层，需自行另外安装；插件只写它监听的那几个文件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: live API cost per chat, subagents, and the whole machine.
description.zh: 在输入框旁实时显示当前会话、子代理和整台机器的 API 花费，帮你随时掌握成本。

description.en: DSH 插件：按 YAML 配置调用后端接口、启停/接管本地 Java 服务、按字节偏移增量读日志并等待日志特征，让模型改完代码自己验证
description.zh: 按 YAML 配置调接口、管本地 Java 服务、增量读日志等特征，让模型改完代码自己验证。

description.en: macOS 13+. Plays a macOS system sound when DeepSeek Harness needs a tool approval, an agent question, a macOS permission prompt, or an administrator password sheet, then repeats on a 0/25/20/15/10/5 second cadence until the request is resolved. Ships as a bundle with a switch and a config form in the Plugins page.
description.zh: 需 macOS 13+。在 DeepSeek Harness 需要工具审批、Agent 提问、macOS 权限弹窗或管理员密码弹窗时播放系统提示音，并按 0/25/20/15/10/5 秒节奏重复提醒，直到请求被处理。以 bundle 形式提供，在侧边栏插件页带开关和中文配置表单；需 macOS 13+。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：列出并永久删除已归档会话（磁盘数据、归档标记、投影缓存、反馈记录一并清理）
description.zh: 按项目分组列出已归档会话，支持搜索筛选，可取消归档或彻底删除，连磁盘数据和缓存一起清干净。

description.en: Adds an animated ASCII whale ocean behind empty chats, with neutral frosted-glass input, visual color selection, light/dark support, and configurable whales, fish, grid and wakes.
description.zh: 在空白聊天背景中呈现 ASCII 鲸群与游鱼，提供中性毛玻璃输入框、可视化选色器、深浅色适配，以及鲸鱼、鱼群、栅格和尾迹参数设置。

description.en: DSH 插件：文字组成的俯视鲸鱼背景，纯字符 / 彩色字格 + ASCII，五种鲸类，阅读区与输入框毛玻璃，鱼群避让，全滑块设置。
description.zh: 把对话页背景变成文字拼成的俯视鲸鱼，五种鲸类游动，阅读区毛玻璃，还能调滑块设置。

description.en: Task Center for DeepSeek Harness: scheduled and webhook tasks that deliver into a session, plus a 任务管理 agent preset
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个任务中心，定时或 webhook 触发任务，自动开新会话或往已有会话里发消息。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-auto-task-center
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-auto-task-center

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Moves the DSH sidebar account avatar out of the bottom strip: four placements (including a zero-height inline mode), three heights, and a settings card on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 把侧边栏账户头像从底部挪到别处，腾出空间给会话列表，还能调高度和位置。

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek balance and what the current session has cost in a corner overlay, with budget alerts, peak-hour warnings and opt-in official price sync.
description.zh: 在右下角浮层显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与本会话花费，支持预算告警、峰时提醒，以及可选开启的官方价格同步。
把 SillyTavern 角色卡和世界书导进来，配好 Harness 技能存成预设，选一下就能开演角色扮演。

description.en: Retrieval and planning toolkit for the BeiShan Besson Minecraft modding tutorials site: 7 tools to search 194 indexed tutorials, plan learning routes, compare version environments, and fetch article text.
description.zh: 北山 Besson Minecraft 模组开发教程检索与规划工具包：7 个工具检索 194 篇教程文章、规划学习路线、对比版本环境差异并抓取文章正文。

description.en: B站直播助手（DD版）：自动巡场看直播、听声音看画面、写直播笔记、给主播打分
description.zh: 挂在B站账号上自动巡场看直播，听声音看画面记笔记，离场给主播打分并推送。

description.en: PDF reader, annotations, OCR, translation and navigation bundle for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话旁边直接读 PDF，支持标注、OCR、翻译和跳转导航，边聊边查资料。

description.en: A plain-notebook calendar in the DSH sidebar: a 70-day, Monday-first grid whose cells print that day's note; one note per day is stored in a .xlsx you choose, in the DesktopCal two-column layout (Excel date serial plus free text, newest date first). Clicking a day opens the editor for it, and import/export move that same format in and out, with a preview step and a conflict policy (keep, overwrite, concat or skip).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏里的纯记事本日历：周一起始的 70 天网格，格子里直接显示当天内容；每天一条，写进你自己指定的 .xlsx，沿用 DesktopCal 两列格式（Excel 日期序列号 + 自由文本，新日期在前）。点某天即打开该日编辑框；导入导出走同一格式，导入先预览，冲突可选保留、覆盖、拼接或跳过。

description.en: Animated background themes for the DSH desktop — 10 scene renderers (milky way, glow horizon, layered mountains, cloud dome, aurora ionosphere, black hole, cloud train, particle image, pixel sculpt, blinking squares), a wallpaper and video library, per-zone UI surface transparency, and a replica of the Appearance settings panel.
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面版换上动态背景——10 种场景渲染器（银河、辉光地平线、层峦、云穹、极光电离层、黑洞、云列车、粒子成像、像素雕塑、闪烁方块）、壁纸与视频素材库、UI 表面分区透明，外加逐像素复刻的 Appearance 设置面板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: ChatGPT subscription prices by country (Go/Plus/Pro), refreshed daily from each App Store, with USD and CNY conversion.
description.zh: 每天自动更新 ChatGPT 各国订阅价格，支持美元和人民币换算，方便比价和挑选最划算的区服。

description.en: Finds wasted GitHub Actions runner time and proposes small, reviewable workflow patches, with explicit approval before any edit and a DSH settings page for analysis rules, history limits, storage, and cost estimation.
description.zh: 找出被浪费的 GitHub Actions 运行时间，并提出小而可审查的工作流补丁；任何修改都需要明确批准，并提供用于分析规则、历史上限、存储和成本估算的 DSH 设置页面。

description.en: Aqua glass theme adapted for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, with floating glass sidebars and fixes for Windows sidebar and titlebar controls.
description.zh: 适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的 Aqua 玻璃主题，提供悬浮玻璃侧栏，并修复 Windows 侧栏和标题栏控件布局。

description.en: On-demand consultation with the OpenAI Codex CLI from DeepSeek Harness: read-only reviews, inline evidence, verified model provenance, quota guardrails and durable call logs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里随时叫 OpenAI Codex CLI 帮你做只读代码审查，带证据、可溯源、有额度保护。

description.en: 给你的DSH加入集成串口、TCP服务端、TCP客户端、UDP功能的调试助手，模型可直接读到调试助手接收，发送的内容，也可代替你向对端发送数据
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接调试串口、TCP 和 UDP，收发内容模型能读也能代发，联调省事。

description.en: ChatGPT-style composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness: ghost-text next-message suggestions, Tab to accept, Esc to dismiss.
description.zh: 每轮对话后自动猜你下一句要说什么，灰字提示，按 Tab 采纳、Esc 忽略，打字更省事。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness gate - per-turn persistent-operation counter: remind, instruct the model to stop, then ask for confirmation. Steps aside under sandbox/read-only modes; follows a live permission switch without restart. Verified on real hardware (full -> workspace-write -> read-only -> full). Crafted on an estimated 0.27 USD of model spend.
description.zh: 给 AI 代理加个操作确认闸，连续执行危险操作时先提醒、再叫停、最后要你点头，防止权限放开后失控。

description.en: DeepSeek opening animation for DeepSeek Harness: whale line-draw splash rendered as DSH Desktop launch screen, plus an opt-in full-screen client overlay.
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端加上 DeepSeek 鲸鱼线绘开屏动画，启动第一眼就是它，还能选开全屏客户端覆盖层。

description.en: Desktop only. DeepSeek Web in the Harness right Sidebar with synchronized theme, automatic launch, one-time web sign-in, and one-click question transfer.
description.zh: 仅 Desktop。把 DeepSeek 网页版放进 Harness 右侧栏：同步主题、自动打开、网页登录一次即可保持，并一键把提问带入当前对话。

description.en: Native Acrylic and fully transparent window backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness on Windows 11, with a mode selector and live Wallpaper Engine backdrop; requires a one-time manual desktop adapter installation. Node 20+.
description.zh: 为 Windows 11 版 DeepSeek Harness 提供可切换的原生毛玻璃与完全透明背景，实时显示 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸；需先手动安装一次桌面原生适配；需 Node 20+。
给编码 AI 加一套开发流程：先写规格说明，再按步骤实现，让写代码更规范可控。
给 DeepSeek Harness 加上 Exa 联网搜索和网页抓取，免登录或填 Key 都能用。

description.en: A biomimetic memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Folds context into token clues and reconstructs memories, enabling infinite conversations without overflow. (一个 DSH 的仿生记忆插件，将上下文折叠为 Token 线索并重建记忆，告别上下文溢出，给所有模型完整的一生。)
description.zh: 把聊天上下文折叠成线索来重建记忆，让对话不再爆上下文，聊多久都不断片。

description.en: GCUA agent state machine plugin for DeepSeek Harness — ported from Tongyi-MAI/OpenGCUA harness philosophy: todo ledger + stall guard + phase trails + sandboxed Python worker
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上 GCUA 状态机，用待办账本、卡顿守卫和沙盒 Python 执行器管住智能体的每一步。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a Sourcetree-style Git workspace — changes, diff, history, branches, push, AI-written commit messages and AI-assisted conflict resolution in a full-height panel
description.zh: 在 Web 界面里给你一个 Sourcetree 风格的 Git 工作台，看改动、比对差异、翻历史、管分支、推送，还能让 AI 写提交信息和解决冲突。

description.en: 到点叫醒 DSH 会话，翻你关注的 GitHub 仓库和主题，挑出值得跟的变化，写日报、记判重表。只读。
description.zh: 定时唤醒会话扫你关注的 GitHub 仓库，挑出值得跟的变更写成日报，只读不写。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for SuperGrok and X Premium subscriptions: device-code sign-in, the xai provider, account-visible chat models with context and per-million-token prices, reasoning efforts read from model capabilities, and subscription usage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 SuperGrok / X Premium 订阅插件：设备码登录、xai 提供商、账号可见对话模型与上下文/百万 token 价格、按模型能力读取的推理强度，以及订阅用量。

description.en: Windows only. Autonomous news briefing on user absence or continuous schedule, with native OS desktop alerts for AI completions, delivered to DSH sessions or IM bots.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。离席或持续自主资讯推送与 AI 会话完成原生桌面弹窗通知，支持投递至 DSH 会话与 IM 机器人。

description.en: Makes the agent narrate its process: every turn opens with how it reads the message and what it will do first, then short interim notes between tool-call batches, with in-app settings for style, sentence cap and toggles.
description.zh: 让 agent 边做边说：每轮先用一两句说明怎么理解消息、准备怎么做、第一步是什么，并在工具调用批次之间写过程叙述；插件页可直接调整详略、句数上限与开关。

description.en: IP & subnet math toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: IPv4 subnet layouts, CIDR splitting & summarization, arbitrary address range to minimal CIDR cover, IPv6 subnet math (128-bit exact) and IPv4/IPv6 parsing with RFC 5952 normalization and IANA classification — zero dependencies
description.zh: 纯计算 IP 与子网工具，支持 IPv4/IPv6 解析、CIDR 汇总和子网规划，零依赖离线可用。

description.en: dsh-pet
description.zh: 把桌面宠物搬到安卓手机上，让深深在手机桌面陪你互动卖萌。

description.en: A DSH plugin that turns one provider API key into a managed pool + more built-in LLM Providers
description.zh: 把一个厂商 API Key 变成可管理的密钥池，还内置更多 LLM 厂商，省心又省钱。

description.en: 拾页：DeepSeek Harness 本地资料库插件，采集网页、文本与字幕，分类检索并供 Agent 引用分析。
description.zh: 把网页、文字和视频字幕存到本地整理成资料库，让 Agent 随时检索引用、帮你写知识笔记。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DSH: one Markdown file per note, with tags, hierarchical folders, full-text search, attachment opening via the system default app, zero-dependency Office text extraction, and citation into the conversation. Built for host DSH 0.2.0-rc.2; on Windows the default root is E:/dsh-kb.
description.zh: 本地知识库：每篇笔记一个 Markdown 文件，支持标签、层级目录、全文检索、附件用系统默认程序打开、Office 零依赖文本抽取，以及引用到对话。面向宿主 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2；Windows 下默认根目录为 E:/dsh-kb。

description.en: Local-first memory and persona plugin for DeepSeek Harness: four file-backed memory layers (pinned, memory, facts, experience), editable SOUL/MOOD persona, zero-LLM session capture, BM25 recall and a themed mood card; no standalone web panel, Python service, vector database, or API key.
description.zh: 澜·轻量本地记忆与人格系统：四层文件记忆（pinned / memory / facts / experience）、可编辑 SOUL/MOOD 人格、零 LLM 捕获、BM25 检索与状态池卡片；无独立管理面板，不依赖 Python 服务、向量库或 API Key。

description.en: Learning Mode toggle in the input toolbar: injects a teaching prompt into the current session so the assistant introduces a topic, teaches it, tests it, and corrects mistakes, rendering graded quizzes through GenUI. Requires the GenUI plugin (@changfenhuang/dsh-genui); without it the teaching text still works but quizzes, sliders and charts degrade to plain text.
description.zh: 输入框工具栏的学习模式开关：为当前会话注入教学提示词，按「引入知识点—学习—测试—反馈纠错」引导，并用 GenUI 生成可判分的互动测验。需先安装 GenUI 插件（@changfenhuang/dsh-genui）；未安装时教学文字仍生效，但测验、滑块与图表会退化为纯文本。

description.en: IMAP/SMTP mail tools for listing, reading, searching, replying, sending and moving messages, with built-in provider presets (QQ, 163, 126, Gmail, Outlook, iCloud or a custom server), attachment upload and download, and a sidebar page for account setup.
description.zh: 通过 IMAP/SMTP 列出、读取、搜索、回复、发送和移动邮件的工具集，内置 QQ／163／126／Gmail／Outlook／iCloud 与自定义服务器预设，支持附件上传下载，并提供侧栏账号配置页。

description.en: Give a DSH agent Markji (maimemo) cards: local SQLite cache, plain-text search, queued edits, archive, background sync with crash-resume.
description.zh: 让 DSH agent 直接读写墨墨记忆卡，本地缓存搜索、改动排队同步，断点续传不丢数据。

description.en: Manage MCP servers inside DeepSeek Harness: enable/disable, OAuth 2.1 authorization, scheduled + after-expiry token renewal, and a tool browser with descriptions. Generated by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里统一管理 MCP 服务器，开关、OAuth 授权、自动续期 token，还能浏览工具说明。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 可视化管理器：列表 + 详情页，查看工具 schema / 提示 / 资源，支持增删启停与连接测试
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that publishes the running Harness as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for other agent harnesses.
description.zh: 把正在运行的 DSH 变成一个 MCP 服务器，让其他智能体框架也能直接调用它的能力。

description.en: Safe Markdown-to-WeChat draft workflow plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 Markdown 草稿安全地一键转成微信公众号草稿，排版省心，发布更稳。

description.en: Disk-backed long-term memory for DSH: a SQLite FTS5 vault that captures every conversation turn, injects relevant past turns into new sessions within a per-turn character budget, groups sessions into resumable conversation files, and ships a web panel for search, paging and capacity.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供磁盘上的长期记忆：SQLite FTS5 记忆库自动采集每轮对话，新会话按预算把相关的旧片段注入上下文，会话可按「对话文件」串成可续接的线索，并带一个可检索、可翻页、可调容量的网页面板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量与成本看板：按模型/供应商/项目/会话统计调用与缓存命中，接入 OpenRouter 单价估算成本
description.zh: 按模型、供应商、项目和会话统计 Token 用量与缓存命中，还能估算成本，帮你把 AI 开销看得明明白白。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets an AI agent live and act autonomously in Minecraft — mineflayer service + MC tools, driven by a local Qwen3.8 model.
description.zh: 让 AI 智能体在 Minecraft 里拥有身体，能自主行动、看世界并与你互动。

description.en: DSH bundle: on every startup (any launch path) check the mobile web profile service, rebuild it when missing, and email the fresh access link
description.zh: 每次启动 DSH 都自动检查手机访问服务，缺了就重建并把新链接发到邮箱，让手机访问自己修好。

description.en: Model failover for DeepSeek Harness: pick one or more providers and the pool becomes every model inside them; when a request fails (rate limit, quota, timeout, server or transport error) the next untried model in the pool retries automatically, and the original error surfaces once the pool is exhausted. Configure from a seat beside the composer model picker or the model_failover tool, with no restart needed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的模型故障自动转移：可选一个或多个供应商，池=所选供应商内的全部模型；请求失败（限流、配额、超时、服务端或传输错误）时自动用池中下一个未试过的模型重试，整池试尽则交还原错误。在输入框右下角模型选择器旁的「故障转移」面板或 model_failover 工具里配置，无需重启。

description.en: Reorder your own models: drag inside a provider card on the Models settings page, or use the Model order section when another plugin already occupies that card. The order is written through the host settings service with a revision check, so the settings page and the model picker stay in sync. The settings left nav can be reordered by drag as well.
description.zh: 模型顺序：在「设置 → 模型」的提供方卡片里拖动调整；卡片格被别的插件占用时，入口在设置左导航的「模型顺序」分区。顺序通过宿主 settings 服务带版本校验写回，设置页与模型选择器保持同步；设置左导航本身也可拖拽排序。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 补齐上下文与历史控制能力的一组实用补丁；每个补丁都可以独立启停。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 补齐上下文与历史控制功能，每个补丁可独立开关，即装即用。

description.en: Help DeepSeek Harness to use your Omarchy desktop.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控你的 Omarchy 桌面，把桌面操作交给 AI 助手。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-omarchy-agent
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-omarchy-agent

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: OneBot v11 hub for DeepSeek Harness: relays QQ events verbatim to downstream bots while giving the agent a full timeline, action ledger and 28 onebot_* tools.
description.zh: 把 DSH 接到 QQ 上，一边转发 OneBot v11 事件给下游 bot，一边让 AI 用 28 个工具在群里干活。

description.en: Full-page OpenCode Go usage view in the DSH Web UI opened from the sidebar: official 5-hour, weekly and monthly used-percent rings, reset countdowns, a local pacing forecast and a 7-day sampling trail, with multiple API-key accounts you can switch between. Add your key as OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY in DSH credentials first.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面侧栏打开的整页 OpenCode Go 用量视图：官方 5 小时、每周、每月已用百分比三环、重置倒计时、本地节奏预测与 7 天采样轨迹，并可在多个 API Key 账号之间切换；需先在 DSH 凭据里配置 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY。

description.en: Per-conversation x-opencode-session header for DeepSeek Harness: OpenCode Go / Zen routes stop returning 400 MissingSessionID, with no file patching and no re-apply after a DSH upgrade.
description.zh: 给 OpenCode 路由的每次对话自动加上会话请求头，不再报 400 MissingSessionID，升级 DSH 也不用重打补丁。

description.en: Remote fleet for DeepSeek Harness: native orca_* tools and a cached fleet panel for trusted SSH hosts — status, read, grep, transactional patches, tmux jobs.
description.zh: 在对话里直接管理 SSH 机群：查状态、读写文件、跑 tmux 任务，还能看每一步结果。

description.en: 手机远程操控 DSH：手机浏览器原生页面 + 限时门 + 企微机器人长连接
description.zh: 在外面用手机浏览器直接操控电脑上的 DSH，任务跑完还能收到提醒，发句话就能召唤远程入口。

description.en: Shell-style prompt history for the DeepSeek Harness composer: ArrowUp walks back through the messages you already sent, ArrowDown walks forward and restores your draft.
description.zh: 给输入框加上命令行式历史记录，按上下方向键就能翻看已发送的消息、找回草稿。

description.en: Codex-style next-instruction prediction for the DeepSeek Harness composer: a Tab-to-accept suggestion rendered as the input placeholder.
description.zh: 在输入框里用占位提示预测你下一句要说什么，按 Tab 就能直接采纳，打字更省事。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: ships the Deep Paper Reading agent preset for figure-by-figure, experiment-by-experiment close reading of a single biomedical paper.
description.zh: 装上就能对单篇生物医学论文逐图逐实验精读，自动生成图表化报告，理清逻辑链和证据差距。

description.en: DSH plugin: audio chimes, cross-session toasts, desktop push, and IM webhooks for turn completion, errors, and approvals.
description.zh: 回合结束、报错或等待审批时，用提示音、跨会话弹窗、桌面推送和 IM 机器人提醒你。

description.en: 专门用于DSH的人类注意力聚合插件 | 此插件完全由ai开发(人类仅提供想法,未写代码)
A simple dsh-plugin to implement a remote access ability for every dsh app.
description.zh: 让任意 DSH 应用都能用手机远程操控，随时随地驱动你的 AI 助手。

description.en: Subagent-shaped bridge between Codex and DeepSeek Harness: Codex spawns DSH workers over a loopback MCP endpoint and gets final answers back; DSH agents can dispatch to Codex in return.
description.zh: 让 Codex 和 DSH 互相派活：Codex 能拉起 DSH 子代理干活并拿回结果，DSH 也能反过来调用 Codex。

description.en: Give your DSH agent eyes via any OpenAI-compatible vision model - 11 provider presets (Doubao/Qwen-VL/GLM-V/OpenAI/Gemini/Ollama...), capability checkboxes that inject live prompt guidance, and analysis of images the user drops into the chat; the agent writes its own observation prompt, and base64 never enters its context.
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体装上眼睛，接入任意兼容 OpenAI 的视觉模型，自动分析图片内容。

description.en: Jira and Confluence for DeepSeek Harness: the tools of Atlassian remote MCP server, a result card for issues and pages, and an issue panel.
description.zh: 把 Jira 与 Confluence 接进 DeepSeek Harness：提供 Atlassian 远程 MCP 服务器的工具、问题与页面的结果卡片，以及问题面板。

description.en: Browse Claude Code, DSH and Codex session logs by working directory, with per-turn context composition, token usage, compaction markers and cost estimates.
description.zh: 按工作目录浏览 Claude Code、DSH 和 Codex 会话日志，查看每轮上下文构成、token 用量、压缩点和费用估算。

description.en: dsh-purge 社区衍生版 v1.1.73: 适配 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1 (修 {{cwd}} 崩溃) + workspaceGate 按工作区启用 | community fork of dsh-purge
description.zh: dsh-purge 社区分支版，适配 DSH 0.2.1 修复崩溃，还能按工作区开关红队测试功能。

description.en: 在 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）设置页里创建/编辑 agent 预设的可视化工作台：分段提示词 + 能力开关 + 内置模板。A visual agent-preset workbench for DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页里可视化创建和编辑 Agent 预设，分段写提示词、开关能力、套用模板，不用碰 YAML。

description.en: One-click plain-text prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness, with optional local checks and sentence review.
description.zh: 点一下输入框里的魔法棒，就能用当前模型把提示词改得更好并写回，不满意还能撤销。

description.en: Composer prompt refinement for DSH: rewrites a rough draft into a structured, unambiguous prompt with one-click undo, reference-chip protection, three model sources (composer / account / any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) and disconnect-aware cancellation.
description.zh: DSH 输入框提示词优化：把粗糙草稿改写成结构清晰、无歧义的提示词，支持一键撤回、引用芯片保护、三种模型来源与断连即停。

description.en: Read-only session-log projector (drsc) for DSH: scans ~/.dsh/sessions/**, decodes zstd/tiled-frame logs with a vendored leaf decoder and rewrites per-session projections into its own SQLite (node:sqlite, segments / replaces + FTS5), exposed through a single fenced HTTP route — surface ledger, recall/compression pair accounting and Chinese-capable full-text search. Token counts share the exact DeepSeek-V4 tokenizer and formula as CCI verify, falling back to a labelled chars/4 basis when assets are absent. Never writes session files; all output lands in its own data directory. Serves three consumer plugins: context-compression-improved (surface marking + recall reconciliation), session-steward (search-corpus switch), prime-memory (historical anchor backfill). Hosts 0.1.0-rc.2 .. 0.2.1-rc.2 (17-tag exact engines.dsh enum). npm: dsh-reference-session-collector.
description.zh: DSH 会话原文只读投影同步器（drsc）：只读扫描 ~/.dsh/sessions/** 会话日志，经内置 leaf 解码器解 zstd/分段帧日志后投影进插件自有 SQLite（node:sqlite，segments/replaces + FTS5），由单条 fenced HTTP 路由提供 surface 标记账本、召回/压缩对账与中文可用的内容检索面；token 计数与 CCI verify 用同一套 DeepSeek-V4 分词器与公式，资产缺失时落带标注的 chars/4 口径。绝不写会话文件，所有落盘仅进自有数据目录。服务三个消费插件：context-compression-improved（surface 标记+召回对账）、session-steward（检索语料源切换）、prime-memory（历史投影锚点回填）。支持宿主 0.1.0-rc.2 .. 0.2.1-rc.2（engines.dsh 17 tag 精确枚举）。npm 包名：dsh-reference-session-collector。
把 QQ 机器人接到 DeepSeek Harness 上，让你在 QQ 里直接远程指挥 AI 干活。

description.en: DSH 后台项目研究引擎：说出需求即自动在后台调研并把结果交给 Agent
description.zh: 说出开发需求，它就在后台自动调研项目并给出结论，直接喂给 Agent 用。

description.en: Infix rerun for DeepSeek Harness: re-run any earlier turn in place - the reply is regenerated from the same prompt while every later turn survives, so subsequent calls read A B C1 D E F G. Official seams only; the append-only session log is never rewritten.
description.zh: 点一下就能重跑之前某一轮回答，后面的对话还都保留，历史不乱。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness sandbox provider backed by MXC (Microsoft eXecution Containers).
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接上 MXC 沙箱，把进程关进容器里跑，Windows 11 上更安全。

description.en: Deepseek Harness内置截图工具：即时框选、标注、取色，全部本地。Built-in screenshot tool for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: instant region capture, annotations, colour picker, all local.
description.zh: 一键框选截图，随手标注取色，确认后直接进剪贴板，全程本地处理。

description.en: Adapter-first web search and readable page fetching for DeepSeek Harness, configured entirely in the Web UI.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上网页搜索和正文抓取，搜索源可换，全部在 Web 界面里配置。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：侧栏工作区文件夹（分组）与会话移动 · Workspace folders and session move for DSH
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧栏加一层可嵌套的虚拟文件夹，还能把会话搬到别的工作区，搬完就在新目录下跑。

description.en: Export a session as a ZIP archive with its attachments, and import such an archive as a new standalone session in the current workspace.
description.zh: 把会话连同附件导出为压缩包，或把这样的压缩包导入为当前工作区里的新会话。

description.en: Delete DeepSeek Harness sessions into a recoverable 7-day trash, and edit an already-sent request by branching. A DSH plugin.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话删进可恢复的 7 天回收站，还能改写已发出的请求并分叉重发。

description.en: A right-sidebar assistant that knows the main session's finished turns, follows the main agent's running steps and background jobs, and answers in the panel; its model, context budget and answer style are configurable.
description.zh: 侧边栏助手：知道主会话已完成的回合，跟随主 Agent 正在跑的步骤与后台 job，在面板里回答问题；模型、上下文预算与回答风格可配置。

description.en: Per-turn first-token latency and output speed beside the built-in usage pill, folded on the host over the durable event log: first-token time is replayed from each message's compact stream, so historical turns stay exact after a reload rather than showing an estimate.
description.zh: 在自带用量胶囊旁显示每轮的首字延迟与输出速度，由宿主在持久事件日志上折叠得出：首字时刻从每条消息的压缩流中重放还原，所以刷新后历史轮次依然精确，而不是估算值。

description.en: Hermes-style in-process background skill learning for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 在后台自动学习并沉淀技能，越用越懂你。

description.en: Third-party SSH operations and remote workspaces for DeepSeek Harness, with local and remote projects in one sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏里统一管理本地和 SSH 远端项目，远端跑 Agent、终端和文件，也能单独用 SSH 面板传文件、做端口转发。

description.en: 连接本地或SSH远端opencode的子智能体插件
description.zh: 把任务派给本机或 SSH 远端的 OpenCode 子智能体执行，Harness 负责验收结果。

description.en: Subagent Toolkit: folds the built-in subagent dropdown into History / Today / Previous / Current groups by usage batch, adds per-row and whole-group deletion of subagent sessions, and keeps the subagent model allowlist live per delegation. The original header is left untouched.
