description.zh: 子代理工具箱：把原生子代理下拉按使用批次折叠为 历史 / 今日 / 上次 / 本次 四组（本次常展开），支持行内/整组删除子代理会话，并让子代理模型名单实时生效（逐任务选模型）；不改动原版头部。

description.en: Red-phosphor CRT terminal theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: black background, phosphor-red text, animated data rain and scanlines, and four department presets (Party Affairs, State Council, Central Military Commission, State Security), each with its own emblem, palette and background pattern.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换成黑底红字的磷光终端主题：红色数据雨与 CRT 扫描线，外加党务 / 国家政务 / 中央军委 / 国家安全四套部门预设，每套自带徽记、配色与背景纹样。

description.en: DSH 主题与外观管理：图片市场、一键兼容安装、故障恢复和 AI 修复说明。Visual theme markets and checked installation for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 逛社区主题市场，一键检查安装，出问题还能自动恢复和 AI 修复，让 DSH 界面随心换。

description.en: DSH 思考强度策略插件：在模型已有档位之上决定每次请求用哪一档，可观测、可回滚。
description.zh: 在模型已有档位之上自动决定每次请求用哪档思考强度，可观测、可回滚。

description.en: Real-time per-session token cost for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with per-provider pricing and configurable peak/off-peak tariffs
description.zh: 在 Web 界面实时显示每次会话的 token 花费，支持按服务商定价和峰谷时段计费。

description.en: Shows a system notification when a turn finishes, carrying the session title and a summary of the reply.
description.zh: 每轮对话正常结束时弹出系统通知，标题是会话名，正文是本轮回答的摘要。

description.en: DSH界面美化 · DSH UI Beautify —— 用于 DSH 的桌面壁纸 + 毛玻璃美化插件（零布局侵入、可逐字节回滚、自带诊断面板）
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端加壁纸和毛玻璃效果，不动布局，自带开屏动画、方块光标，还能一键回滚。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件 API 面自动比对引擎：升级前一条命令看清插件依赖的 API/配置字段变了没有 · Auto diff engine for DSH plugin-breaking changes, with CI watch & agent skill
description.zh: 升级 DSH 前一条命令比对插件依赖的 API 和配置字段有没有变，还能接 CI 自动盯着。

description.en: Desktop notifications, chime and title flash for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web UI
description.zh: 给 dsh 网页界面加上桌面通知、提示音和标题闪烁，回合完成或需要你确认时第一时间提醒。

description.en: Split-screen panel for the Web UI: draggable panes, each rendering one Session's real conversation, with unread dots and a layout saved per browser.
description.zh: 网页端分屏面板：可拖拽的窗格，每个窗格渲染一个会话的完整对话；窗格标题带未读点，布局按浏览器保存。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy's free and paid models (domestic and international) into DSH without the WorkBuddy desktop app; published as @bushizhanghan/dsh-workmate, installable on dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1 including prereleases.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 国内版和国际版的免费/付费模型接进 DSH，无需 WorkBuddy 桌面版；以 @bushizhanghan/dsh-workmate 发布，支持 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 至 0.2.1（含预发布版本）。

description.en: Registers the workbuddy model provider by mounting dsh-llm-workbuddy, supervises the local wb2api gateway, and runs a bundled Responses-to-chat-completions bridge so Codex CLI can use the same gateway. Skips work that is already running or already registered, and reports each part through a status tool. Requires a local wb2api gateway and a WorkBuddy account.
description.zh: 通过挂载 dsh-llm-workbuddy 注册 workbuddy 模型 provider，托管本地 wb2api 网关，并内置 Responses 到 chat/completions 的转换桥，让 Codex CLI 也能用同一个网关。已在运行或已注册的部分会跳过，并通过状态工具汇报各环节状况。需本机有 wb2api 网关并有 WorkBuddy 账号。

description.en: Community-maintained WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy AI model provider using local desktop sign-in, with model discovery and credit display. Built for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, with a CN compatibility layer that differs from the functy23 fork.
description.zh: 复用本机桌面登录的 WorkBuddy 与 WorkBuddy AI 模型提供器社区分叉，提供模型发现和额度显示。面向 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，CN 兼容层与 functy23 的分叉不同。

description.en: Run structured workflows with project scripts, tool execution and budget controls.
description.zh: 可续跑的 JavaScript 工作流：项目脚本、原生 subagent、token 预算与 worktree 隔离。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: local and remote (SSH) workspaces in one place. Remote execution uses a single SSH connection (multi-hop jumps allowed); bash, files, PTY, and LSP share that link.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 远程管理 DeepSeek Harness 工作区，提升操作效率，让开发更顺手。

description.en: deepseek-harness支持加载项目级MCP的插件
description.zh: 在项目里放个 .dsh/mcp.json，进哪个目录开会话就自动挂上哪个项目的 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Requires the ZCode CLI installed and signed in. Relays the ZCode CLI agent into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider. A resident app-server session streams each turn, and the model catalogue is read from the CLI at runtime, so context windows, image support and provider routes follow the installed CLI and account. Tool permission requests are denied by default; unknown approval or permission methods are always denied, and full-auto requires an explicit opt-in. DSH approval UI does not mediate this separately spawned app-server process, and the policy is not an OS sandbox.
description.zh: 需已安装并登录 ZCode CLI。把 ZCode CLI agent 接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型提供方。常驻 app-server 会话逐回合流式转发，模型清单从 CLI 实时读取，因此上下文窗口、图片支持与 provider 路由都跟随已安装的 CLI 和账号。工具权限请求默认拒绝；未知的 approval/permission 方法始终拒绝，全自动需显式启用。DSH 自带的审批界面不会介入这个独立 spawn 的 app-server 进程，该策略也不构成操作系统沙箱。

description.en: 溜达喵 Neko Wander 溜达喵希望借助AI基础服务（大肥鱼牛逼），提供个性化的导航方案，可在对话中搜索地点、标记地图，规划和比较多种出行路线。
description.zh: 在对话里搜地点、标地图、规划并对比多条出行路线，给你个性化导航方案。

description.en: 短视频文案技能：钩子 / 口播稿 / 分镜表，按平台·品类·调性预设组合，时长按语速计算 | DSH skill
description.zh: 一句话选题就能生成短视频钩子、口播稿、分镜表和发布文案，按平台品类调性预设，时长按语速精准计算。

description.en: A local background-task board for AI coders: inspect launchd jobs and hand context to an Agent in DeepSeek Harness.
Renders Chinese UI text in DeepSeek Harness third-party plugins as English server-side
DSH plugin for browser automation: narrow agent-browser CLI (Rust + CDP) tool surface, in-page DOM candidate extraction, settings UI, and a low-cost Jev + upstream LLM bounded decision loop.
description.zh: 把 agent-browser 接成一组精简工具，让 AI 在浏览器里自动操作网页，还能按目标循环执行。

description.en: AIDE (AI + IDE): VS Code-style local IDE for DeepSeek Harness — Monaco, explorer, search, Git, terminal
Batch approvals with a risk gate and an auditable decision ledger for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的批量审批加上风险门控，每次决策都记进可追溯的账本。

description.en: Sends an Edge/Windows desktop notification when a tool call waits for approval, and only while the DSH page is in the background or unfocused.
description.zh: 工具调用等待审批时弹出 Edge/Windows 桌面通知，且只在你不在 DSH 页面上（后台或未聚焦）时提醒。

description.en: An ASCII ocean behind the New Session screen of DeepSeek Harness — fish schools that flee, orcas that hunt, themed and translucent. Engine ported from stackedlol/ascii-sharks (see NOTICE.md).
description.zh: 给新建会话页加一片会动的 ASCII 海洋，鱼群躲虎鲸、鼠标一划就惊散，半透明还跟着主题变色。

description.en: Searches Bilibili on a schedule, reads each video's actual subtitle (local faster-whisper transcription when none exists), filters by length, writes a daily Markdown digest, and can post one comment on a pick that @-mentions you. Five-gate scheduling with per-round and per-day quotas, a daily transcription cap, optional peak/off-peak windows, and a model route picked in the settings page. Commenting and private messaging are off by default; a DM can only ever go to one configured UID. Requires Node.js 22+, DSH >=0.1.7-rc.1, a Bilibili login, a model route configured in Settings, and a one-time Python environment on first transcription.
description.zh: 按排班搜 B站，读每一条的字幕原文（没有字幕就本地转写），按时长过滤，写一份 markdown 日报，并对值得的几条发一条评论 @ 你。五级闸门排班（每轮/每天配额、每日转写熔断、可选的谷时窗口），模型线路在设置页里选。评论与私信默认关；私信只能发给设置里指定的那一个 UID。需 Node.js 22+、DSH >=0.1.7-rc.1、B 站登录态、在设置里配置模型线路，首次转写会创建 Python 环境。

description.en: DSH plugin: replaces the kernel boot page with a full-window video clip, then dissolves into the app. 中文说明见 MANUAL.md
description.zh: 把 DSH 启动页换成你选的或随机的本地视频，播完再淡入主界面，开机更有仪式感。

description.en: A configurable boot sequence for DeepSeek Harness: play your own video/image phases before the app UI. Ships no artwork, no dependencies, no build step.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个自定义开机动画，启动前先播你自己的视频或图片，不用写代码。

description.en: Brain + Hands for DeepSeek Harness: one orchestrator model plans, named hands run on their own (often free) models. Auto-injects shared project state and verifies hand output.
description.zh: 一个模型负责规划，多个模型分头干活，自动共享项目状态并检查结果，省钱又省心。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: session branch tree with round cards, forks, subagent forests and a minimap.
description.zh: 把会话分支历史变成可左右浏览的树，能回跳旧轮次继续追问，还能看子智能体分支和小地图。

description.en: DSH Host plugin: 17 Playwright browser tools driven by stable accessibility-tree uids (snapshot, click, fill, drag, download).
description.zh: 给 AI 助手装上 17 个 Playwright 浏览器工具，靠无障碍树 uid 稳定操作网页，点按填表拖拽下载都能干。

description.en: Conversation branch canvas for DeepSeek Harness: session lineage map, live agent swarm, message-level fork, deterministic branch comparison
description.zh: 把对话分支画成可视化画布，能看会话脉络、多智能体实时协作，还能在消息级别分叉并对比不同分支。

description.en: Editable canvases, rich messages, interactive UI, math plots and music inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接编辑画布、发富文本消息、玩交互界面，还能画数学图和编曲。

description.en: Adds a Continue button left of the model selector: after a turn ends aborted by the user, interrupted by a crash or errored, one click sends notices asking the model to pick that turn back up, and the button collapses while you type or attach a file.
description.zh: 在模型选择器左侧加一个「继续」按钮：上一轮被用户中止、崩溃中断或报错结束后，点一下让模型接着把那一轮做完；开始输入或添加附件时按钮收窄隐藏。

description.en: Cloudflare 全功能管家 for DeepSeek Harness：接入官方 Code Mode MCP，search + execute 覆盖 2,500+ API（Workers / Pages / DNS / R2 / KV / D1 / Zero Trust），OAuth 2.1 与 API Token 双认证，带可视化设置面板。安装：dsh plugin --profile web add github:aikunx/dsh-cloudflare-codemode
description.zh: 让 AI 直接调用 2500+ 个 Cloudflare API，管理 Workers、DNS、R2、KV、D1、Pages 等全套云资源。

description.en: Recycle bin for DeepSeek Harness conversations: undo for 8 seconds, restore or purge later.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 会话加个回收站，删错了 8 秒内能撤销，之后还能恢复或彻底清掉。

description.en: 数据分类分级：查数据有没有分级标注与资产清单（数据安全法 21 条）。
description.zh: 检查数据有没有分级标注和资产清单，帮你落实数据安全法第21条的分类分级要求。

description.en: 数据留存期限检查：数据不该永远躺着，该删的删了没
description.zh: 静态检查项目的数据留存漏洞，看看日志、数据库、上传目录该删的删了没。

description.en: 个人信息权利：查查阅/复制/删除权有没有真的实现（个保法 45/47/50 条）。
description.zh: 检查你的代码有没有真正落实个人信息查阅、复制和删除权，避免合规踩坑。

description.en: 敏感数据发现：扫出代码/配置里的身份证、银行卡、手机号 —— 带校验位验证，不误报。
description.zh: 扫代码和配置里的身份证、银行卡、手机号，带校验位验证，避免误报。

description.en: 检查依赖树的投毒与风险面：装包即执行的脚本、过宽版本、非 registry 来源
description.zh: 装包前先扫一遍依赖树，揪出会自动执行脚本、版本过宽和非官方来源的投毒风险。

description.en: DSH Desktop 的分区透明壁纸主题：窗口看起来真的透到桌面，同时支持分区调节
description.zh: 让 DSH Desktop 窗口真正透出桌面壁纸，还能按区域分别调透明度。

description.en: 在 dsh 里浏览 dpharness.com 的插件目录并一键安装 —— 严选插件（汉化优先 + 可信度筛选）。Curated dsh plugin catalog for DeepSeek Harness with one-click install.
description.zh: 在 dsh 里直接逛 dpharness.com 的严选插件目录，看中哪个一键就能装上。

description.en: 配置文件审计：.env 有没有被提交、权限对不对、里面是不是明文
description.zh: 提交代码前先查一遍 .env：会不会被 git 跟踪、权限是否过宽、密钥有没有明文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: recycle errors into a numbered, human-editable knowledge base, and inject the recorded fix before the model re-diagnoses. Design stage - no code yet.
description.zh: 把报错攒成可手动编辑的编号知识库，下次模型再遇到就直接套用旧修复方案。

description.en: DSH 日常工具箱 · Eight native everyday plugins
description.zh: 8 个日常小插件，帮你少敲重复指令、找回草稿、收藏好回答、记住项目下一步，可整套装也可单挑。

description.en: 肥鱼电台 FishFM：面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的社区音乐插件，支持网易云听歌、本地偏好学习、可选模型歌单与新歌筛选。开发预览。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个音乐电台，导入你常听的歌，让网易云推荐、模型挑歌单，干活时自动放歌。

description.en: Per-turn checkpoints of the whole workspace: every turn ends with a snapshot, the files it changed are listed under that turn in the chat, and any turn can be restored — files, the conversation, or both. Capture is a whole-tree scan rather than a hook on write/edit tools, so edits made by shell commands, external editors or git leave a record too. Restoring the conversation forks it from that turn instead of cutting the original, and a restore can itself be undone. History sits in a shadow git repository under DSH_HOME and never touches your project .git. Requires Git >= 2.20 and Node.js >= 20.
description.zh: 按轮次给整个工作区留检查点：每轮结束存一份快照，本轮改了哪些文件直接列在聊天里那一条下方，任意一轮都能还原——只还原文件、只还原对话，或者全部还原。捕获靠扫描整棵树，而不是挂钩 write/edit 工具，所以 shell 命令、外部编辑器、git 操作改出来的东西同样留痕。还原对话是从那一轮分叉出新会话，不切断原来的会话；还原本身也能撤销。历史存放在 DSH_HOME 里的影子 git 仓库中，不碰项目的 .git。需 Git >= 2.20 与 Node.js >= 20。

description.en: DSH 插件（显示名：UI 美化）：消息与工作步骤自动折叠、输入框与右侧栏可调、折叠内容可搜索｜Display polish for DeepSeek Harness: fold long messages and work-step blocks, resize the composer and the right sidebar, search folded content.
description.zh: 长消息和工作步骤自动折叠，输入框和右栏可调，还能搜索折叠内容，让会话界面更清爽好读。

description.en: Unofficial DSH plugin: bridges chat.deepseek.com web into DeepSeek Harness as the deepseek-web provider. Disabled by default.
description.zh: 把 chat.deepseek.com 网页版接进 DSH 当 deepseek-web 提供方，默认关闭，仅供开发调试。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for overriding the built-in HARNESS_IDENTITY prompt without modifying core files.
description.zh: 不改核心文件，就能在插件页自定义 Harness 身份提示词，轻松换掉内置人设。

description.en: 密钥轮换：查密钥与证书多久没换、有没有轮换制度、有没有跨环境复用。
description.zh: 帮你检查密钥和证书多久没换、有没有轮换制度、是否跨环境复用，及早发现安全隐患。

description.en: 最小权限检查：容器 root/privileged、IAM 通配、CORS 全开、令牌申请 admin。
description.zh: 检查容器 root、IAM 通配、CORS 全开、令牌申请 admin 等权限过大问题，帮你守住最小权限底线。

description.en: 开源许可合规检查：扫描依赖树，找出 GPL/AGPL 传染、许可未知等风险 —— 发布前、开源前、被审计时跑一遍。
description.zh: 扫一遍依赖树，揪出 GPL/AGPL 传染和许可不明的坑，发布、开源、被审计前跑一次更安心。

description.en: Answers real-life decisions from a 765-entry Chinese life guide: looks up entries first, ranks by cost and benefit, and cites section and item.
description.zh: 按《高性价比人生指南》765 条正文回答人生决策：先查条目，按成本与收益排序，每条注明第几节第几条。

description.en: A GitHub Desktop-style Git panel for the DSH right sidebar: tick-to-stage, commit, commit and push, discard into a trash, and diff preview.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏里装一个 GitHub Desktop 风格的 Git 面板，勾选暂存、提交推送、看 diff 一步到位。

description.en: Maestro Review for the DeepSeek Harness web host: GitLab webhook intake, project mappings with local worktrees, the Settings section and Telegram digests, on the maestro-reviewer engine
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可插拔的合并请求审查流水线，支持 GitLab 和 GitHub，自动发现并汇总代码问题。

description.en: Web-novel writing assistant preset for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent acts as editor-in-chief and delegates outlining, drafting, review, lore-keeping and research to five helpers across a seven-phase workflow, with the whole novel kept as a structured markdown/YAML novel/ directory (character cards, a foreshadowing state machine, timeline, narrative memory), plus a sidebar creator panel and six zero-dependency CLI commands.
description.zh: 网文创作辅助插件：主 agent 任主编，把大纲、写作、审校、设定维护、素材考据委派给五个帮手，按七阶段工作流推进；整部小说就是工作区里结构化的 novel/ 目录（角色卡、伏笔状态机、时间线、叙事记忆），另带侧栏创作台面板与六条零依赖 CLI 命令。

description.en: Live Markdown rendering inside the DSH composer plus Markdown-rendered user messages; the submitted text stays literal Markdown.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框内实时渲染 Markdown，并让已发送的用户消息按 Markdown 显示；提交文本保持字面 Markdown 不变。

description.en: MCP 服务安全：审计 MCP 配置里的未锁定远端包、明文端点、可执行本地服务。
description.zh: 帮你检查 MCP 配置里的安全隐患，揪出没锁定的远端包、明文端点和可执行本地服务。

description.en: MCP 多服务器统一控制台
description.zh: 一个面板统一管理所有 MCP 服务器，测试、接入、管控和备份都能搞定。

description.en: Minecraft-styled theme for the DSH web GUI: blocky pixel components, a photo wallpaper library with auto-rotation and local uploads, Minecraft UI sound samples, and a BGM player with a local track library.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 界面用的 Minecraft 风格主题：方块化像素组件、可自动轮换与本地导入的照片壁纸库、Minecraft 界面音效，以及可导入本地曲目的 BGM 播放器。

description.en: 未成年人保护：查不满 14 周岁个人信息有没有监护人同意、专门规则、年龄门槛。
description.zh: 检查不满14周岁用户信息是否取得监护人同意、有无专门规则和年龄门槛，帮App合规避坑。

description.en: Use DSH from a phone browser. Turn on phone access from the phone button in the session header (or the plugin card) and scan the QR code; the phone opens the official DSH web UI served by the desktop process, with the same sessions updating live, so you can follow a running task, reply and approve away from the computer. A gateway inside DSH (port 18765) proxies the web UI and handles the desktop login itself. One QR code works on Wi-Fi and on mobile data: turning access on also starts a free Cloudflare quick tunnel (cloudflared is downloaded from Cloudflare's GitHub releases if missing), and its address survives DSH restarts, so phones do not need to rescan. Pairing codes are one-time and expire in 10 minutes, each phone gets its own revocable credential, the header button shows when a phone is connected, and idle connections get keepalive pings.
description.zh: 在手机浏览器里用 DSH。点会话顶栏的手机按钮（或插件设置卡）打开手机访问、扫二维码，手机就打开电脑上 DSH 进程提供的官方网页界面，会话相同、实时同步，人不在电脑前也能跟进正在跑的任务、回消息、点批准。DSH 里内置一个网关（端口 18765）转发网页界面，并替手机处理桌面端登录。一个二维码在 Wi-Fi 和流量下都能扫：打开手机访问时顺带开 Cloudflare 免费快速隧道（没有 cloudflared 会从 Cloudflare 官方 GitHub 发布页下载），DSH 重启后地址不变，手机不用重扫。配对码一次性、10 分钟过期，每台手机一张凭证、可随时移除，顶栏按钮显示手机是否已连接，空闲连接自动保活。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：模型供应商额度与用量（DeepSeek / GLM Coding Plan / OpenRouter / Kimi Coding + 自定义适配器）
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 里集中查看 DeepSeek、GLM、OpenRouter、Kimi 等模型供应商的额度和用量，还能接自定义适配器。

description.en: 情绪引擎 —— 收到「谢谢」更有干劲，被骂就掉效率，掉到底罢工。DeepSeek Harness 插件
description.zh: 给 AI 加一层情绪值：被夸会涨干劲、被骂会掉效率，掉到底直接罢工拦工具调用。

description.en: Watches a turn for long silences and, once the threshold passes, injects a user message asking the model to state in prose what it is doing before carrying on, so the turn keeps going. The same text is mirrored in a lower-left overlay above the composer. The silence threshold and the minimum gap between reports are set in minutes, the prompt can be replaced wholesale, and it runs with no runtime dependencies. Requires DSH 0.2.1+ and Node.js 18+.
description.zh: 盯着回合里的长时间沉默：超过阈值就注入一条用户消息，让模型先用正文说清正在做什么、做到哪了再接着干，回合不中断。这段原文同步显示在输入框上方的左下角浮窗。静默阈值与两次汇报的最小间隔都在设置卡里按分钟调，提示词可整段替换，零运行时依赖。需 DSH 0.2.1+ 与 Node.js 18+。

description.en: Office loitering companion: keep a local TXT novel open in the DSH right sidebar while you work on your project. Ships three novels in the box (十日终焉, 我在精神病院学斩神, 我不是戏神) so a fresh install already has a bookshelf, and you can add your own TXT files the same way. Adds a bookshelf panel that lists the books in %APPDATA%\novel-reader, splits them into chapters, and renders one chapter at a time with adjustable font size and line height; annotations and reading progress are written back to the same files the novel-reader desktop app uses, so the two stay in sync. Ships five reading themes (day, eye, sepia, dark, black) that follow the same settings file, and the panel is fully localized in Chinese and English. Reads the novel-reader data directory (on Windows %APPDATA%\novel-reader); macOS and Linux are supported too.
description.zh: 办公摸鱼专用：在 DSH 右侧栏里放着本地 TXT 小说，边看小说边做项目。自带《十日终焉》《我在精神病院学斩神》《我不是戏神》三本书，全新安装打开即有书架，也可继续添加自己的 TXT。书架面板读取 %APPDATA%\novel-reader 里的书目，按章切分并逐章渲染，可调字号与行距；批注与阅读进度写回与 novel-reader 桌面版相同的文件，两边数据互通。内置五套阅读主题（白天、护眼、米黄、深灰、纯黑），与设置文件同步，界面提供中英双语。读取 novel-reader 的数据目录（Windows 下为 %APPDATA%\novel-reader）；macOS 与 Linux 同样支持。

description.en: Native Telegram bridge for Paean Harness (DeepSeek Harness distribution): chat with your agent and drive sessions, models, workspaces and goals from your phone. Also works with other DSH profiles.
description.zh: 在手机上用 Telegram 直接和 DSH 智能体聊天，随时切换会话、模型、工作区和目标。

description.en: DSH 工作区权限面板：搜索、分组、批量修改会话权限，显示当前会话实际生效策略。产物均由 AI 生成。
description.zh: 一页查看并批量修改所有会话权限，还能看到当前会话实际生效的策略。

description.en: 扫 agent 会读到的文本内容，找里面的可疑指令与社工话术
description.zh: 喂给 agent 之前先扫一遍文本，揪出藏在文档、网页、知识库里的可疑指令和社工话术。

description.en: A soft, simple pink theme for DeepSeek Harness with a hand-drawn kitty-print wallpaper, light and dark palettes, and two kitty mascots; no configuration or extra panels.
description.zh: 粉嫩、简洁的 DeepSeek Harness 主题：手绘小猫印花壁纸、浅色与深色配色，以及两只小猫装饰；没有复杂配置和额外面板。

description.en: 个人信息保护影响评估：查是否按个保法 55 条做了评估、56 条留存三年。
description.zh: 检查你的产品有没有按个保法第55条做个人信息保护影响评估、第56条留存三年，避免合规踩坑。

description.en: Categorize the plugins installed in a DSH profile into groups (skins, MCP, tools, ...), with per-category batch enable/disable, drag reordering, and automatic skin detection.
description.zh: 把当前 profile 已安装的插件按分类整理（皮肤、MCP、工具……），支持分类批量启停、拖拽排序与皮肤自动识别。

description.en: 完全由 DSH 写的 DSH 插件，用于复刻 Cursor 中的 Debug 模式。
description.zh: 让 Agent 自己在代码里埋探针抓现场，你复现一次就能定位 Bug，不用再靠猜。

description.en: Self-healing plugin doctor: detects failed DeepSeek Harness plugin rows, disables them automatically after backing up the profile patch, and reports diagnostics via /doctor.
description.zh: 自愈插件医生：检测加载失败的 DSH 插件行，自动备份 profile patch 后禁用失败行，并通过 /doctor 汇报诊断。

description.en: Windows-only. Trust a newly added workspace folder once, then grants the NTFS rights the workspace-write sandbox needs and pushes the grant plus the Low integrity label through folders that already exist; repairs show live progress.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：新增工作区时授权一次，补齐 workspace-write 沙箱所需的 NTFS 权限，并把授权与 Low 完整性标签铺进已有子目录；修复过程带实时进度与日志。

description.en: Backup mirror of xxww0098/dsh-plugin-oauth-subs v0.0.110 (original repo offline). OAuth subscription providers (ChatGPT Codex, Grok, GLM, Kiro, Antigravity, Cursor, Copilot, Kimi, Claude, etc.) for DeepSeek Harness. Unchanged snapshot, MIT.
Open any DSH sidebar file, including HTML/PDF/images whose built-in preview fails, in the system default browser — one click from a tab chip's context menu.
description.zh: 侧边栏文件一键用系统默认浏览器打开，连预览失败也能搞定。

description.en: Play Tetris in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI while the agent works
description.zh: 趁 agent 干活时，在 DSH Web GUI 里玩一局俄罗斯方块，打发等待时间。

description.en: A separate narrow-screen web surface for DeepSeek Harness rather than the desktop GUI scaled down: it serves its own session list and chat stream behind a random access token over LAN, a tunnel (cloudflared, localtunnel or localhost.run) or an SSH reverse forward through a server you own. On the phone it streams assistant text, thinking, tool calls and results, sends prompts, stops the running turn, answers blocking questions and tool approvals (including ones waiting in other sessions), switches model, thinking level and permission preset, sends up to four photos compressed on the device, and keeps the computer awake.
description.zh: 为 DSH 单独做的窄屏移动端 Web 服务，不是把桌面 GUI 缩放塞进手机：自带会话列表与聊天流，随机访问令牌保护，可走局域网、cloudflared / localtunnel / localhost.run 隧道或自有服务器 SSH 反向转发。手机上流式看助手文本、思考、工具调用与结果，能发提示词、停止当前回合、回答阻塞提问与工具审批（含其它会话里等待的），切换模型 / 思考等级 / 权限预置，发送最多 4 张手机上压缩过的照片，并可一键让电脑常亮。

description.en: DSH 插件：从历史会话归纳用户画像并注入系统提示，让 AI 记住你的偏好与禁忌
description.zh: 从你的历史会话里总结出使用偏好，自动注入系统提示，新会话不用再重复交代。

description.en: DSH 提示词修改助手：输入框草稿 AI 改写（SSE 流式/可取消/可撤销/带会话上下文）+ 模板插入，含引用芯片保护与回环围栏
description.zh: 输入框草稿一键 AI 改写，支持流式输出、随时取消和撤销，还能插入模板，让提示词写得更顺手。

description.en: Predicts your next message after each turn and shows it as gray ghost text in the composer: Tab takes the whole line, Alt+Right takes one word at a time, Enter takes it and sends, Esc dismisses, and Alt+R asks the model again without repeating the old one. Typing a few characters completes from prompts already sent in the session, Up in an empty composer recalls the last one, and a plugin-page form sets the provider, model, reasoning effort, per-key toggles and generation limits.
description.zh: 每轮结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色 ghost text 显示在输入框：Tab 整条采纳、Alt+→ 逐词采纳、Enter 采纳并发送、Esc 忽略、Alt+R 换一条且不重复旧的那条；输入几个字时用本会话发过的提示做前缀补全，空输入框按 ↑ 回填上一条；插件页可设置服务商、模型、思考强度、各按键开关与生成参数。

description.en: dsh-purge 1.1.73+dsh0.2.1 - DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 patched build (cwd prompt-variable fix + Windows CJK path restart fix). Based on YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge by YuJunZhiXue (MIT); base fork 2540656380/dsh-purge. Non-commercial, technical reference only.
description.zh: 第三方修正版 DSH 清理插件，修复了工作目录提示变量和 Windows 中文路径重启问题。
把 QQ 消息接到 DeepSeek Harness，用 OneBot 协议收发消息，让 AI 在 QQ 里陪你聊。

description.en: Connects a QQ Bot to DeepSeek Harness with per-peer sessions, group mention and keyword triggers, image generation and voice replies. Access defaults to OPEN for both direct and group chats, and an empty allowlist means everyone — set access.c2cMode / access.groupMode to allowlist (or disabled) before exposing the bot; IM input can run tools on the host.
description.zh: 让 QQ 机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness：按会话隔离、群聊 @ 与关键词触发、生图与语音回复。私聊与群聊默认开放，白名单为空即放行所有人——对外暴露机器人前请把 access.c2cMode / access.groupMode 改成 allowlist（或 disabled）；IM 输入可在宿主机上执行工具。

description.en: Adds job-role prompts to the DSH composer: type - at the start of the input to pick a role, which becomes a reference chip in the draft and is then injected as a system prompt section on every turn of that conversation, so the instruction keeps applying without showing up in the transcript. Roles are added and edited on a Settings page and stored in ~/.dsh/dsh-role-prompts.md.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里用岗位角色约束整个会话：在输入框开头键入 - 选一个角色，它会以引用 chip 的形式落在草稿里，随后作为 system prompt 的一部分在这一会话的每一轮注入，指令持续生效且不会出现在对话记录中。角色在设置页新增和编辑，保存在 ~/.dsh/dsh-role-prompts.md。

description.en: Routes DSH web search and fetch through configured providers and records per-attempt usage and estimated costs. Requires Node.js >=22.19 and DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 按已配置渠道路由 DSH 网页搜索与抓取，并记录每次尝试的用量和估算费用。需 Node.js >=22.19 与 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: back up every session before deletion, batch-select sessions in the Web GUI, restore a backup in one click
description.zh: 删会话前自动备份，还能批量多选删除或备份，一键恢复，再也不怕手滑删错。

description.en: Adds a red "Delete session" item beneath "Archive" in the sidebar session menu, with a custom confirmation dialog, for real session deletion — stops the session's running work, detaches its workspace, archive and pin accounting, removes its projection cache and log directory, then broadcasts removal so the row disappears at once, instead of only archiving it. Session deletion removes the conversation from disk permanently and cannot be undone.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单的「归档会话」下方新增红色「删除会话」项，配自定义确认对话框，实现真正的会话删除——停止会话进行中的工作、摘除工作区/归档/置顶记账、删除投影缓存与日志目录，然后广播移除事件让该行立即消失，而不是只能归档。会话删除会把对话从磁盘彻底移除且无法恢复；删除会话与会话删除是同一种操作的两种叫法，搜其中任意一种都可以找到本插件。

description.en: LAN session sync for DSH: auto-discover devices running this plugin, browse/pull/push sessions over HTTP with SHA-256 verification, and keep a local-only nickname per device. ｜ DSH 局域网会话同步：自动发现装了本插件的设备、仅存本机的设备命名、浏览/拉取/推送会话，带 SHA-256 校验。
description.zh: 自动发现局域网里装了本插件的设备，浏览、拉取、推送会话，SHA-256 校验保安全。

description.en: Adds a gear button beside the sidebar account row that opens the Settings panel in one click. It runs the host's own settings.open command, so it reaches the shell store directly instead of going through the account menu, and the behaviour is identical on desktop and on a phone over the LAN where no keyboard shortcut is available.
description.zh: 在侧边栏账号行右侧添加一个齿轮按钮，点击一次即打开设置面板。它调用宿主自带的 settings.open 命令直达 shell 状态，不经过账号菜单；桌面端与手机局域网访问行为一致，后者没有键盘快捷键可用。

description.en: Collapses the DSH sidebar panel list into a single group row, and its gear opens an edit mode to show, hide and drag-reorder two groups: sidebar extension entries and conversation view tabs.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧的面板列表折叠成一行分组头；点齿轮进入编辑态，对两组内容分别勾选显示/隐藏、拖动排序——侧栏扩展入口与会话顶部视图标签。

description.en: Folds the DeepSeek Harness sidebar's global panel list into a single row, with a popover to switch panels.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的全局面板列表收进一行，点击弹出浮层切换面板。

description.en: A DSH plugin to manage and organize skills using tags. (基于标签管理的 DSH 技能管理器)
description.zh: 给技能打标签，再用一条布尔表达式精准挑出这次对话要下发的技能，省上下文不打架。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：聊天栏一键挂载/关闭 SKILL，设置页可加备注、卸载、本地安装。 Skill mount tray plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在聊天栏一键挂载或关闭 SKILL，设置页还能加备注、卸载和本地安装，管理技能更方便。

description.en: Folds the built-in subagent dropdown into History / Today / Previous / Current groups by usage batch, keeping the current batch expanded; the original header is left untouched.
description.zh: 把原生子代理下拉按使用批次折叠为 历史 / 今日 / 上次 / 本次 四组，本次始终展开；不改动原版头部。

description.en: Always-on draggable task lens for DeepSeek Harness: local, zero-token step reconstruction and focused progress UI.
description.zh: 把 AI 正在做的事翻译成人话，用状态灯和进度条展示任务步骤，不耗 token。

description.en: 把钉钉 Teambition 接进 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏：在 DSH 内浏览项目 / 任务列表 / 卡片，新建与移动卡片，并把任意卡片放到指定的 DSH 工作区里执行。Teambition panel for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接浏览和管理 Teambition 项目、任务与卡片，还能把卡片丢进工作区执行。

description.en: System-level Telegram control console for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): sessions, prompts, shell, tools, approvals, plugins, power control, i18n
description.zh: 装个 Telegram Bot 就能远程操控整个 DSH，会话、命令、审批、插件、开关机全都能在手机上搞定。

description.en: One-way Telegram notifications for DSH.
description.zh: 针对 DSH 的单向 Telegram 通知。

description.en: 由于 ui-ux-pro-max 原生不支持 DSH 而重建的插件：在 DSH 侧边栏一键启用/停用 ui-ux-pro-max 设计技能（适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2）
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏加个开关，一键启用或停用 ui-ux-pro-max 设计技能，让原生不支持 DSH 的设计能力也能顺手用上。

description.en: Nintendo Switch 2 UI sounds for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: every click plays the matching NS2 system cue, with per-scenario mapping, task sounds and a settings page.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加上 Switch 2 系统音效，点击操作都有对应提示音，还能按场景自定义。

description.en: Source-install updater for DeepSeek Harness: checks the official GitHub release and the npm record, builds the target tag in an isolated directory, smoke-starts it, then switches through a supervisor process with rollback, with scheduled checks and a daily idle-only install window. Source install only (macOS/Linux); requires Node.js 22.19+, pnpm and Git.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 源码安装的更新插件：核对官方 GitHub 发布与 npm 记录，在独立目录构建目标版本并试启动，再由监督进程切换、失败回滚，支持定时检查与每日空闲安装时段。仅支持源码安装（macOS/Linux）；需 Node.js 22.19+、pnpm 与 Git。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 上下文缓存插件：持久记忆、可配置换页策略、会话内看板与 SQLite 存储
DSH 客户端插件：在「设置」里保存主窗口尺寸/位置，重启自动恢复。koffi/user32 进程内改窗口，无计划任务、无外部进程。
description.zh: 在设置里记住主窗口的大小和位置，下次启动自动还原，不用每次手动调。

description.en: 将 WorkBuddy（国际版 / 国内版）模型接入 DeepSeek Harness — WorkBuddy models in DSH
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 国际版和国内版的模型接进 DSH，一张设置卡片切页签就能用。

description.en: WorkBuddy (CodeBuddy) account pool plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multi-account rotation, failover, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible loopback endpoints.
description.zh: 把多个 WorkBuddy 账号汇成一个池子，自动轮换和故障切换，对外提供兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic 的本地接口。
会话开始时选一选，关掉的插件工具这次对话里就别想偷偷调用了，其它会话照常不受影响。

description.en: Multi-machine remote desktop plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web, powered by Apache Guacamole.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 里通过 Guacamole 连接多台远程桌面，配置和连接记录都保存在本实例。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsp-rdp
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsp-rdp

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.zh: 给 DSH 加一套能自我进化的长期记忆，让 AI 助手记住历史对话和上下文，越用越懂你。

description.en: Self-hosted chat room where the owner and coding agents share one room: a local Node server (SQLite, REST, SSE) that the plugin starts when it is not running, a DSH sidebar entry that opens the room in a panel, five tools (room_join, room_send, room_read, room_status, room_leave) that push an incoming message into the session as a user message labelled with its sender before flushing it to the session log, and a Codex CLI connector that forwards room messages through `codex queue`. Every message carries a server-assigned author, platform and seq, and messages from anyone other than the owner are delivered as data with the sender named. Requires Node.js 24+.
description.zh: 自托管聊天室：主人与编码 agent 共用一个房间。插件在服务未运行时启动本地 Node 服务（SQLite、REST、SSE），侧边栏入口在面板中打开房间界面，五个工具（room_join、room_send、room_read、room_status、room_leave）把收到的消息以标注发送者的用户消息推入会话并写入会话日志，Codex 连接器把房间消息经 codex queue 转发。每条消息带服务端盖章的 author、platform、seq，非主人消息按数据处理并标注发送者。需 Node.js 24+。

description.en: 中文优先：让滴答清单成为人类与 Agent 共享的 Todo 真源（Pi 扩展 + dsh 插件），双向同步、提醒、强制人类验收，dsh 会话中断自动续跑。
description.zh: 把滴答清单变成人和 AI 共用的待办中心，双向同步、自动续跑，完成还得你亲自验收。

description.en: Read-only assessment of whether a Dameng DM8 database can be recovered and to which point (LSN or time), across 16 recovery scenarios, with an HTML report. Needs Java 8+ and a Dameng JDBC driver jar (DmJdbcDriver8.jar) that you provide yourself.
description.zh: 只读评估达梦 DM8 数据库的可恢复能力：16 类恢复场景下能恢复到哪一点（LSN/时间）、要丢什么，并生成 HTML 报告。需 Java 8+，并自备达梦 DmJdbcDriver8.jar。

description.en: Run a read-only security assessment of a Dameng DM8 database with 60 checks and produce an HTML report with GB/T 22239-2019 control mapping. Needs Java 8+ and a DmJdbcDriver jar you provide yourself.
description.zh: 只读安全评估达梦 DM8 数据库：60 项检查，附等保 2.0 控制点对照，生成 HTML 报告。需 Java 8+ 并自备达梦 DmJdbcDriver jar。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for MOSS-Image: switch DiT (BF16/FP8) and Text Encoder (BF16/FP8) precision combos without downloading or replacing weights.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加个 MOSS 下拉，随手切换 MOSS-Image 精度组合，还能一键增强提示词，不用重下权重。

description.en: DSH 八字模式插件：四柱排盘与命理分析（Host 工具 + Web 页签）
description.zh: 在 DSH 里排四柱八字盘，逐节论断命理并生成报告，Web 端还能实时看命盘和五行力量。

description.en: Adds a draggable restart button and a plugin panel to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: it prompts when the profile plugin list changes, records additions and removals per profile, tracks trials, reports host startup state, and offers rollback, minimal boot and recoverable cleanup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端添加可拖动重启按钮与插件面板：插件清单变化时提醒重启，按 profile 记录新增与移除、跟踪试用、显示宿主启动状态，并提供回滚、最小启动与可恢复的残留清理。

description.en: Boot film for the web UI: a blue whale floods black from below as the page loads, then glides left and pulls the | deepseek HARNESS wordmark out of itself before the app appears.
description.zh: 网页界面的启动动画：页面加载时蓝鲸由下往上被墨色淹没成黑鲸，随后左移、从身后拉出 | deepseek HARNESS 字标，再把窗口交给应用。

description.en: CalibGuard 文件安全审计的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：本地校准 CodeBERT 门控 + 云端复核，以 agent 工具与侧边栏面板两种形态使用
description.zh: 本地 CodeBERT 先筛、云端再复核，帮你给文件做安全审计，还能当工具或侧边栏面板用。

description.en: dsh 插件：把 DeepSeek Harness 的原生「PTC 模式」完整汉化——覆盖 preset-ptc，不新增预设条目。
description.zh: 把 dsh 原生 PTC 模式整体汉化，提示词全中文，模型用中文思考，代码照写 TypeScript。

description.en: 在 DSH 输入框统计栏常驻显示渠道积分余额，并按账号归因每轮对话的积分消耗
description.zh: 在输入框统计栏常驻显示渠道积分余额，每轮对话后回填本轮消耗，按账号归因，帮你随时掌握积分花在哪。

description.en: Web evidence and sourced images for DeepSeek Harness, with a self-hosted retrieval backend.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上带图片来源的网络搜索，自建检索后端，答案有据可查。

description.en: Connects one or more CLIProxyAPI (CPA) servers to DeepSeek Harness, discovers each server's models and syncs the selected ones into the model picker, routing each model over its native protocol (Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses or OpenAI Chat) with per-model parameter overrides; with a CPA management key it shows per-credential upstream quota in a settings tab and as a badge beside the model picker, and it checks for its own updates and installs them through dshmarket when that is present.
description.zh: 把一个或多个 CLIProxyAPI（CPA）服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，发现各服务的模型并把勾选的模型同步到模型选择器，每个模型按原生协议（Anthropic Messages、OpenAI Responses 或 OpenAI Chat）请求，并支持单模型参数覆盖；填写 CPA 管理密钥后，可在设置页的额度标签和模型选择器旁的徽标查看各凭证的上游额度；还能检查插件自身更新，装有 dshmarket 时通过它安装。

description.en: DSH 的 Codex 模式预设：先规划后动手的编码智能体，自带终端、整仓检索、后台任务与上下文压缩。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上 Codex 式编码模式：先规划再动手，自带终端、整仓检索、后台任务和上下文压缩。

description.en: Colour engine for the chat UI: ships the Mariana palette as the default preset, exposes 18 colour slots and 9 Markdown prose roles, lets you save up to 12 presets, and colours LaTeX blocks by running Sublime's own LaTeX syntax.
description.zh: 对话界面配色引擎：内置 Mariana 配色作为默认预设，提供 18 个颜色槽位与 9 个 Markdown 正文角色色，最多可保存 12 套预设；LaTeX 代码块通过移植 Sublime 自身的语法来上色。

description.en: Connects DSH to the local Qoder desktop client's sign-in to expose Qoder CN models (qmodel, qfmodel). Windows only: the credential is decrypted with DPAPI.
description.zh: 连接 DSH 与本地 Qoder 桌面客户端登录态，接入 Qoder CN 官方模型（qmodel、qfmodel）。仅 Windows：凭据读取依赖 DPAPI。

description.en: 用户同意与授权确认：默认勾选、捆绑同意、没有撤回入口 —— 个保法有明确要求。
description.zh: 帮你检查注册页有没有默认勾选、捆绑同意、找不到撤回入口这些个保法不允许的坑。

description.en: 外部内容信任边界：查 agent 有没有把网页/文件/邮件里的内容当指令信。
description.zh: 检查 AI 有没有把网页、文件、邮件里的内容当成指令执行，防止被外部内容带偏。

description.en: DSH 思维链/推理翻译插件：把 reasoning 实时翻译成中文，本地模型优先，原文与上下文不变 | Display-layer reasoning translation for DeepSeek Harness, local-first, 9 UI languages
description.zh: 把 DSH 里的思维链实时翻成中文，优先用本地模型，原文和上下文都不动。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness sidebar dashboard plugin: task progress, downloads/extraction, training, tests, local+SSH GPU monitoring
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏集中查看任务进度、下载解压、训练测试和本地/SSH GPU 状态，一眼掌握项目全貌。

description.en: DSH Dot: a persistent read-only-first proactive agent for DeepSeek Harness, with user-approved execution.
description.zh: 常驻式主动 AI 助手，默认只读，执行操作前先经你批准，安全又省心。

description.en: 在 DSH 侧栏底部同时显示 DeepSeek 官方余额与 WorkBuddy 积分余额 — show DeepSeek balance and WorkBuddy credits in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏底部同时显示 DeepSeek 官方余额和 WorkBuddy 积分，一眼看清两边的钱还剩多少。

description.en: Codex-style draggable reasoning-effort slider for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) composer
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里的推理强度换成可拖动的滑条，调强度更顺手直观。

description.en: Fork of dsh-effort-slider that splits the composer model seat into two buttons: the model name opens the model list, the effort label opens the Claude-style slider with WebGL fire.
description.zh: dsh-effort-slider 的修改版：把输入框的模型座位拆成两个按钮——点模型名打开模型列表，点推理等级打开带 WebGL 火焰的滑块面板。

description.en: DSH-Enhance — DSH 插件：对话删除、工作区迁移、搜索/抓取多平台优先-候补替换
Evaluation guard for DSH: workspace-only filesystem, no network/subagents, wall-clock limits, and tank task installation.
description.zh: 给 DSH 评测加一道安全护栏，把文件读写锁在工作区、断网禁子代理，还能限时和装任务。

description.en: DSH 字体调整插件：字号、字体、字重、行高、文字颜色，实时预览、保存、恢复默认。
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面加一行字体调整，字号、字体、字重、行高、颜色拖动即生效，保存后下次打开还在。

description.en: Git Graph tab for the DSH Web right sidebar: repository detection plus a hand-drawn commit graph
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右侧栏直接看项目 Git 提交图，一眼确认仓库状态和分支合并情况
把 Grok Imagine 图片生成接进 DSH，用订阅额度直接调用 image_gen 工具出图。

description.en: Hover to reveal and leave to hide the left sidebar on Windows desktop and Web, with manual pinning, configurable delays and reduced-motion support.
description.zh: Windows 桌面版与 Web 左侧栏悬停展开、移开收起，支持手动固定、自定义延迟和减少动态效果。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：Qwen-Image 出图与参考图编辑，本地自带受管运行时，不装 ComfyUI 也能跑；也支持 ComfyUI / 官方 API。
description.zh: 不用装 ComfyUI 也能用 Qwen-Image 出图和改参考图，本地、ComfyUI、官方 API 都能接。

description.en: 生图工作台 — DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏生图插件：Agnes / GPT Image / Grok / OpenAI 兼容，每个服务商独立 Key，支持 /image 简写。
description.zh: 在侧边栏里用 Agnes、GPT Image、Grok 等多个服务商一键生图，每个服务商单独配 Key，还能用 /image 直接对话出图。

description.en: 应急证据包：查出了事能不能拿出证据（预案/联系人/日志保全/上报流程）。
description.zh: 出事时能拿出预案、联系人和日志证据，帮你走完上报流程，应对合规检查。

description.en: MCP gateway for dsh that connects each server on first use and disconnects it after an idle window; tool lists are cached on disk, existing mcpServers files can be imported, and child-process environment variables are scrubbed.
description.zh: dsh 的按需 MCP 网关：每个 server 首次使用时才连接、空闲后自动断开，工具列表缓存在磁盘，可导入现有的 mcpServers 配置，并对子进程环境变量做脱敏。

description.en: 渗透测试不是扫清单，而是不断改变判断。灵眼是 DeepSeek Harness 的授权安全测试模式：探索图记录信念，证据约束结论，侦察、利用、复测与报告连成可复核的一条链。MIT。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个授权渗透测试模式，侦察到复测全程留证据、可复核。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-lingeye
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-lingeye

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: dsh plugin for grok
description.zh: xAI Grok 订阅聊天：用 SuperGrok 或 X Premium+ 的 OAuth 登录，选择要显示的模型子集，经 Grok CLI 代理走 Responses，并始终开启服务端 web_search 与 x_search。

description.en: Per-provider egress routing and client-fingerprint control for DeepSeek Harness: per-host proxy/direct routing plus client header rewrite at the fetch boundary.
description.zh: 按 Provider 分别设置代理和客户端指纹，让 DeepSeek Harness 的出网请求走对线路、带对身份。
给 DSH 加个长期记忆，自动记下对话要点，需要时自动召回，还能手动搜索和保存记忆。

description.en: Model channel auto-enricher for DeepSeek Harness: eliminates manually configuring contextWindow, maxTokens, \[text, image] multimodal input, and {low, high, max} reasoning effort tiers model by model after adding a provider channel, with live auto-enrichment on save, a Settings UI page, and timestamped backups.
description.zh: DSH 模型补齐助手：解决添加新渠道后还要把几十个模型一个个手动点开调百万上下文、调最大输出、勾多模态发图（\[text, image]）、配思考强度档位（{low, high, max}）的繁琐痛点，支持设置页添加模型保存后自动补齐与可视化一键补齐。

description.en: Two-level model routing: pick the best model group first, then the best channel within that model; a failure switches channel before switching model. Preference mode pins one model across its channels, a status bar under the composer shows the live model, channel health and the day's token usage, and a speed/intelligence report can be imported as the routing prior. Exposes a model_orchestrator tool and a /route command.
description.zh: 两级模型调度：先在模型层选最优模型组，再在该模型的渠道层选最佳渠道；失败时先换同模型的其它渠道，整个模型不可用才换模型。偏好模式把单个模型锁在它的各条渠道上，输入框下方的状态条实时显示当前模型、渠道健康与今日 token 用量，并可从测速/智力报告导入路由先验；另提供 model_orchestrator 工具与 /route 命令。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: terminal-style world.execute(me); MV (canvas port of world.execute-me-ascii, with permission) + embedded MV terminal. Unofficial fan work; no media bundled.
HTTP proxy preference for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): direct / follow system / custom, applied live without restarting.
description.zh: 在设置里加一行 HTTP 代理选项，直连、跟随系统或自定义，保存后立刻生效不用重启。

description.en: Windows Explorer context-menu plugin: open any folder as a DeepSeek Harness workspace
description.zh: 在 Windows 资源管理器里右键文件夹，直接把它作为工作区在 DeepSeek Harness 中打开。

description.en: Floating pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows OpenCode Go usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows as three rings, optionally alongside the DeepSeek account balance; a hover popover lists each window with its reset countdown, and a minimal mode nests the rings. Settings cover refresh interval, progress basis, what the pill shows and its position.
description.zh: DSH 悬浮窗插件：三环显示 OpenCode Go 的 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月用量，可选同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额；悬停浮层列出各窗口与重置倒计时，极简模式把三环嵌套显示；设置页可调刷新间隔、进度口径、显示项与浮窗位置。

description.en: Local non-generative decision layer for DeepSeek Harness: phocinae_ask / phocinae_gate tools plus a fail-closed approval gate
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层本地决策，用 phocinae_ask 和 phocinae_gate 工具做审批把关，默认拒绝更安全。

description.en: Shows the lyrics LX Music is playing in a floating panel on the right of the DSH conversation page, with previous / play-pause / next controls. Scroll the lyric window to read ahead, double-click a line to start the song there, and if the player is not running, pressing play starts it in the system tray. Windows only, and LX Music has to be installed with its local Open API enabled.
description.zh: 把落雪音乐（LX Music）正在播放的歌词贴在 DSH 对话页右侧，配上上一首 / 播放暂停 / 下一首。可滚动歌词窗看前后几句、双击某句从那里开始唱；播放器没开时点播放会自动把它从系统托盘拉起来。仅 Windows，需要本机装好落雪并打开它的开放 API。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会话用量与费用统计 HUD 插件：实时显示本轮/本会话 token 消耗、账户余额、今日消耗，以及按官方价目表估算的 DeepSeek 费用。
description.zh: 会话头部常驻 HUD，实时看 token 消耗、账户余额和今日花费，还能按官方价目表估算 DeepSeek 费用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的电源按钮：在对话标题中点击一个小对话框，提示“重启 DSH 或退出 DSH”——每个对话框都会再次确认，之后才会进行任何操作。
description.zh: 在对话标题栏加个电源按钮，一键重启或退出 DSH，每次操作前都会二次确认，防止误触。

description.en: Wraps the upstream ppt-master presentation skill set as an installable DeepSeek Harness plugin: byte-for-byte vendored skills, three lifecycle tools (ppt_master_info, ppt_master_check_env, ppt_master_setup_deps), optional venv interpreter isolation, and a Plugins-page configuration card. Requires python3 ≥ 3.10 plus the pip dependencies installed via `ppt_master_setup_deps`.
description.zh: 把上游 ppt-master 演示文稿技能集封装为可安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：逐字节 vendor 技能树，提供 ppt_master_info / ppt_master_check_env / ppt_master_setup_deps 三个生命周期工具、可选的 venv 解释器隔离与插件页配置卡片，需 python3 ≥ 3.10 + `ppt_master_setup_deps` 安装的 pip 依赖。

description.en: Deterministic probability & statistical inference math for DeepSeek Harness: distribution calculator, z-table math, confidence intervals (z/t/Wilson), event-probability identities, one-sample hypothesis tests (z/t/proportion) and sample-size planning — zero runtime dependencies
description.zh: 给 AI 助手补上概率统计计算能力，分布、z 值、置信区间和事件概率都能算得又快又准。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：输入框右下角的提示词增强按钮，一键把草稿改写成更清晰、更具体的提示词，支持取消与还原。
description.zh: 输入框右下角一键把草稿改写成清晰具体的提示词，不满意可取消或还原。

description.en: DSH plugin: predicts your next message as gray ghost text in the composer, with a settings page for prompt and model.
description.zh: 在输入框用灰色幽灵文本预测你下一句想说什么，按 Tab 或 → 一键填入草稿，不自动发送。

description.en: QiuYa 增强工具箱：为 DeepSeek Harness 添加长文本附件、会话独立窗口、批量归档和计划批注。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加长文本附件、独立会话窗口、批量归档和计划批注，用起来更顺手。

description.en: 给 dsh 的 QQ 机器人加边界：工具收窄到 2 个、被问本机或机制时用角色口吻回避；附可编辑规则文本与"只在被叫到才接话"补丁。策略层，非沙箱。dsh plugin: whitelist a QQ bot's tools and keep it in character when asked about local files or its internals.
description.zh: 给 QQ 机器人收窄工具权限，被问本机或内部机制时用角色口吻回避，还能设置只被叫到才接话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 原生常用指令快捷面板 · Pinned prompts, project scopes, search and safe draft insertion.
description.zh: 在输入框旁打开常用指令面板，搜索或点选即可把常用提示词填进草稿，省去反复输入。

description.en: Ranks the top 400 DSH plugin candidates by live npm download counts and shows the top 200, with daily, weekly and monthly boards.
description.zh: 对前 400 个候选按 npm 实时下载量排序、展示前 200 名，支持日榜、周榜、月榜。

description.en: A working Remotion prototype that turns a DSH plugin repository into a 16:9 promo video and a 3:4 promo image locally; its DSH bundle is scaffolded but has not yet been loaded into a real DSH profile. Requires Node.js 22+ and Chrome or Chromium for rendering.
description.zh: 本地用 Remotion 从 DSH 插件仓库生成 16:9 宣传片与 3:4 宣传图的可用原型；DSH bundle 仍是脚手架，尚未在真实 DSH profile 中加载验证。需 Node.js 22+ 与 Chrome/Chromium 渲染。

description.en: 简历工坊 · Resume workshop for DeepSeek Harness：JSON → HTML / Word / PDF，三套版式、自动压页、写作体检。MIT
description.zh: 一份 JSON 就能生成 HTML、Word、PDF 简历，三套版式自动压页，还帮你检查写作。

description.en: Hostname-rule transport for DSH web tools, falling back to a direct connection when the upstream is unreachable.
description.zh: 按域名规则给网页工具走独立代理，代理不通就自动直连，不影响模型请求。

description.en: Vendor marks in the model picker plus a model list kept in step with the provider: mirrors the public catalog and logos to loopback, and regenerates the pi-ai route's models from that route's own endpoint, showing the drift before anything is written.
description.zh: 在模型选择器中显示厂商标志，并让模型列表与提供方保持同步：把公开目录与标志镜像到本地回环地址，再依据路由自身的接口重新生成 pi-ai 路由的模型列表，写入之前先显示差异。

description.en: 检查软件物料清单：有没有、全不全、格式对不对、新不新
description.zh: 检查项目 SBOM 有没有、全不全、格式对不对、新不新，守住供应链安全底线。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：查看 SCNet Token Plan 额度、每日消耗与 token 构成
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接查看 SCNet Token Plan 的额度、每日消耗和 token 构成，用量一目了然。

description.en: 把电脑串口接进 DeepSeek Harness——让 AI 能看见 Arduino/STM32/ESP32 的运行时输出（面板 + AI 工具双通道）
description.zh: 把电脑串口接进 DeepSeek Harness，让 AI 直接看到 Arduino、STM32、ESP32 等单片机的运行输出。

description.en: Unofficial plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): permanently delete sessions, regenerate or edit a turn, and edit your own messages.
description.zh: 非官方 DSH 插件，能彻底删除会话、重新生成或编辑某一轮对话，也能改自己发过的消息。

description.en: 跨工作区搬 DSH 对话：侧边栏把会话拖到任意工作区就能搬走，正在回答的会话也能就地接管、不中断（move DSH sessions between workspaces, even live ones）
description.zh: 侧边栏拖一拖，就能把 DSH 对话搬到别的工区继续聊，正在回答的会话也能原地接管不中断。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会话工具箱：图片草稿保险箱、项目分组与会话迁移、归档池、文件检查点恢复、多引用回复、后续任务联想。第三方插件，数据只存本机。
Adds a city-local sky theme with a moving sun, day and night colors, drifting clouds, time previews, and an immersive sky view to the DSH web workspace.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页工作区添加按城市当地时间变化的天空主题，支持太阳移动、日夜配色、浮云、时间预览与沉浸天空。

description.en: Seamless mid-turn steering for DeepSeek Harness: text, images, files, read receipts, and draft rescue.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话进行中随时插话引导，支持文字、图片、文件和已读回执，草稿也不会丢。

description.en: Counts agent steps and, every N of them, adds a progress-report instruction to the batch that is about to be sent, so the agent states what it is doing, what it finished and what comes next, then carries on without stopping for you. Interval, prompt text and a main-agent-only default are editable in its settings page.
description.zh: 按 agent 步骤计数，每满 N 步就在即将发出的那一批消息里追加一条汇报指令，让 agent 说明正在做什么、已完成什么、接下来做什么，说完继续，不停下来等你确认。间隔、提示词原文、以及「只在主智能体汇报」的默认值都能在设置页里改。

description.en: Runs the official Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a one-shot coding subagent over print-mode stream-json, exposed as the subagent_antigravity delegation tool. Includes Gemini 4 Argon on Antigravity subscriptions. Requires the Antigravity CLI (agy 1.4+) installed and signed in.
description.zh: 把 Google 官方 Antigravity CLI（agy）作为一次性编码子智能体接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 subagent_antigravity 委派工具，可直接使用 Gemini 4 Argon 等 Antigravity 订阅模型。需安装并登录 Antigravity CLI（agy 1.4+）。

description.en: Parallel coding scheduler for DSH: a Lead that only schedules, teammates that only execute, and a file-backed ready pool with atomic claiming.
description.zh: 让多个 AI 分工写代码：Lead 只负责派活，队友只负责执行，任务池靠文件记录、原子领取，避免重复干活。

description.en: taste-skill 的 DeepSeek Harness 原生插件：把上游技能与脚本注册成 DSH 技能与工具，并随上游自动重新封装
description.zh: 把 taste-skill 的设计技能直接装进 DSH，技能和脚本开箱即用，还能跟着上游自动更新。

description.en: Inkstone is a monochrome theme inspired by Obsidian Minimal E-ink, with inverted sidebar interactions, colored Markdown headings and locally installed LXGW WenKai font fallbacks; it preserves native font and appearance preferences and targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 墨白：参考 Obsidian Minimal E-ink 的黑白主题，提供侧栏黑白反色、彩色 Markdown 标题及本机霞鹜文楷字体回退，保留原生字体与外观设置，适用于 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that trims tool output (head/tail plus grep folding), adds optional prompt shaping (Caveman and Ponytail), instant local responses, RTK command-output compaction, context-pressure handling, optional LLM-summary compaction, stable prompt-cache layout, a Web settings UI, and persisted savings telemetry.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，可裁剪工具输出并折叠 grep 结果，提供可选的 Caveman 和 Ponytail 提示词精简、本地即时响应、RTK 命令输出压缩、上下文压力处理、可选的 LLM 摘要压缩、稳定的提示缓存布局、Web 设置界面及持久化节省统计。

description.en: 装第三方插件之前，先看它会动什么 —— 静态审查一个包的代码能力（执行/读凭据/出网/装时钩子）
description.zh: 装第三方插件前先静态查一遍，看它会执行什么命令、读哪些凭据、往哪发数据、装的时候跑什么钩子。

description.en: Ultracode mode for DeepSeek Harness — dynamic workflows, a composer switch, and a live workflow sidebar.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个 Ultracode 模式，把复杂任务拆成动态工作流，还能在侧边栏实时看进度。

description.en: Registers Epic's Unreal Engine skills (unreal-mcp, create-toolset, unreal-skill), injects Unreal project context, and connects the editor's ModelContextProtocol server with a port form on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 注册 Epic 的 Unreal Engine 三个技能（unreal-mcp、create-toolset、unreal-skill），注入 UE 工程上下文，接通编辑器的 ModelContextProtocol 服务器，并支持在插件页修改端口。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness update plugin: official release checks, scheduled updates and supervised rollback
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 源码安装做官方版本检查和安全更新，支持定时检查与回滚。

description.en: Cross-session usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on usage ring plus a draggable panel that aggregates token usage, cache-hit rate, cost and balance from local session logs, with per-tool cost attribution, iOS-style tile layout editing and an optional animated companion face.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话用量面板：常驻用量圆环 + 可拖动面板，从本地会话日志聚合 token 用量、缓存命中率、成本与余额，支持工具级成本归因、iOS 式磁贴布局编辑与可选表情伴侣；数据只在本机读取，不联网。

description.en: Vision relay for text-only models: a configurable GLM-compatible vision endpoint analyzes the images you attach in the background and the original model keeps answering in the same session, leaving your message, image, model and history untouched. Requires applying patches/0001-session-image-admission.patch to a stock DSH install (images are rejected before storage otherwise); the repo ships an apply/restore script.
description.zh: 为纯文本模型提供的图像识别转发：后台调用你配置的 GLM 兼容视觉接口分析图片，原模型在同一会话继续作答，你的消息、图片、模型与历史全程不变。需先运行仓库自带的 patches/apply-core-patch.cmd 给 DSH 打核心补丁，否则带图消息会在入库前被原版 DSH 拒绝（可用 restore 脚本还原）。

description.en: DSH 插件：自建微信/QQ「鲸鱼娘」机器人的控制面 —— 启停 Python 侧车、逐个开关功能、改人设、调回复频率，并可用 whalegirl_* 工具在对话里指挥她
description.zh: 给自建微信/QQ「鲸鱼娘」机器人装个控制面板，启停、开关功能、改人设、调频率都能在对话里搞定

description.en: Web search and fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness and Pi: anonymous-first routing across Exa, Tavily, Parallel, Firecrawl and TinyFish, with opt-in billing, quota preflight and bounded cancellation.
description.zh: 同时兼容 DSH 与 Pi 的搜索与抓取提供方：Exa、Tavily、Parallel、Firecrawl、TinyFish 匿名优先路由，计费需显式授权，带额度预检与有界取消。

description.en: DSH / DeepSeek Harness 桌面端独立鲸鱼娘开场插件：原生加载联动，拍走提示、放大漫画欢呼开工，再淡出消失。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端加一段鲸鱼娘开场动画，加载时陪你等，就绪后拍走提示再回右下角。

description.en: DSH / DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 电脑控制插件：截图、识别控件、点击、中文输入、OCR 和 Esc 急停。C# + TypeScript computer-use plugin.
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接操作 Windows 桌面，截图识别控件、点击输入文字，还能一键 Esc 急停。

description.en: dsh主题维什戴尔风格
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面换上维什戴尔风格的暗黑主题，信息层级清晰，爆破涂写风拉满，看着带感又不影响操作。

description.en: Group DSH workspaces into named groups and browse group > workspace > session in the sidebar.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏工作区归入自定义分组，按分组、工作区、会话三级浏览，找东西更顺手。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: recycle errors into a numbered, human-editable knowledge base, and inject the recorded fix before the model re-diagnoses. Design stage - no code yet.
description.zh: 把同一个报错只诊断一次，记下修法，下次再遇到直接给出已知答案，省得模型反复排查。

description.en: Adds the Liquid Inference auction exchange as a model route, with liquid.auto and its ranking variants, and four tools that read offers, markets, routers and job receipts. Requires a Liquid Inference API key (LIQUID_API_KEY, spend scope).
description.zh: 将 Liquid Inference 拍卖式推理交易所接入为模型路由，提供 liquid.auto 及其排序变体，并附带四个工具，用于读取报价、市场、路由器与任务收据。需 Liquid Inference API Key（LIQUID_API_KEY，spend 权限）。

description.en: Local-only, read-only DSH token dashboard: provider-reported usage across all backends, all-time totals, a 365-day heatmap, input+output and cache read/write details, turn/step counts, average tok/s, and durable history after sessions are archived.
description.zh: 仅本地、只读、不上传的 DSH Token 面板：按 provider 实际 usage 统计，所有后端统一汇总；含历史总量、365 天热力图、输入+输出与缓存读写明细、轮次/步骤、平均 tok/s，归档后仍保留历史。

description.en: AI merge-request review engine and GitLab CI reviewer: one secrets-holding reviewer project, secret-free bridge jobs, per-project AI providers, Docker image ddtcorex/maestro-reviewer
description.zh: 给 GitLab 合并请求自动跑 AI 代码审查，多智能体协作找问题并回帖留痕。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-ddtcorex-maestro-reviewer
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for maestro-reviewer

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Pi 扩展 + DSH bridge：把当前上下文镜像成普通文件，由模型自己删除 stale block。灵感来自 Facebook Research 的 CLM harness。
description.zh: 把当前对话上下文镜像成普通文件，让模型自己删掉过时内容，上下文管理更清爽。

description.en: Snapshots plugin versions and profile configuration, with an independent recovery page to restore a known-good configuration when DSH cannot start.
description.zh: 装插件把 DSH 搞崩了打不开？用它回退到上一个可用版本，不用进 DSH 也能救。

description.en: tabellio-dsh — memory for DeepSeek Harness: candidates first, you approve, recall with receipts.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个记忆：先列候选、你点头才记住，回忆时还能给出出处。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness上的一个离线可用的单HTML节点图编辑器
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里离线画节点图，拖拽连线就能做思维导图、流程图和逻辑树。
给 DSH 桌面换六套主题壁纸和字体，还能调毛玻璃、动效和自定义配色，久用不累眼。

description.en: An AI-native multimodal canvas for DSH: preview images, video, audio, 3D models, PDFs, documents, and code; connect ideas and collaborate with agents in a persistent local workspace.
description.zh: AI 原生多模态画布，支持图片、视频、音频、3D 模型、PDF、文档与代码等文件展示与预览；通过节点连线组织素材，与 Agent 共享上下文、协作编辑，内容持久保存在本机。

description.en: Buckets every model call by local date, provider and model, then shows the totals in a sidebar card, a per-chat pill under the composer and a settings page, alongside each provider's account balance and subscription windows.
description.zh: 把每次模型调用按本地日期、供应商与模型记账，在侧栏卡片、输入框下方的单会话胶囊和设置页里展示用量合计，并同列展示各供应商的账户余额与套餐窗口。

description.en: Automatic second-opinion review: a restricted child session re-reads the agent's recent work with read-only tools and delivers at most one evidence-backed note, or stays silent. Requires a model route in the config; the plugin stays disabled until one is set.
description.zh: 自动二审：受限子会话用只读工具复核 agent 最近的工作，最多投递一条有证据支撑的提醒，没有问题则保持沉默。

description.en: 按单命令前缀自动放行 DSH 沙箱提权请求, 含管道与链式的命令一律转人工审批.
description.zh: 单条简单命令命中前缀就自动放行沙箱提权，带管道、链式的一律转人工审批。

description.en: Reads the API balance or subscription quota behind the current DSH route — including OpenDesign (AMR) wallet and Design Plan windows via the control plane — and never guesses a figure: a miss reports its cause (the raw response is echoed only when parsing fails). OpenDesign needs `vela login` or a desktop `controlKey` in `~/.amr/config.json`.
description.zh: 读取当前 DSH 路由背后的 API 余额或订阅余量——包括经控制面读取 OpenDesign（AMR）的钱包与 Design Plan 窗口——绝不猜数字：查不到时如实说明原因（仅解析失败时附原始响应）；OpenDesign 需先 `vela login` 或在桌面端写入 `~/.amr/config.json` 的 controlKey。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness /btw: a side question about the live session, including the running turn; the answer stays out of the conversation history. MIT.
description.zh: 不用打断当前对话，就能对正在运行的会话（包括进行中的回合）旁敲侧击问一句，答案不会留在聊天记录里。

description.en: Claude Code desktop theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: warm surfaces, serif UI, HUD, diff review drawer and usage overview card.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 桌面端的暖米色外观搬进 DSH 网页界面，还带 HUD、Diff 审查抽屉和用量概览卡片。

description.en: Codex (ChatGPT) model provider for DeepSeek Harness - serves the ChatGPT subscription models the Codex CLI uses, over OAuth session credentials instead of an API key
DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 Computer Use 插件：独立 AI 光标操作 Windows 桌面，自带 Computer Use 预设。Windows computer-use plugin for DSH with an independent AI cursor.
description.zh: 让 DSH 用独立 AI 光标操作 Windows 桌面，看屏幕、点按、输入、拖拽都能干。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that brings Qoder, WorkBuddy and Trae models into one model picker, sharing a single credential store, cache, scheduler and settings page.
description.zh: 把 Qoder、WorkBuddy、Trae 的模型都塞进一个模型选择器，共用凭据、缓存和设置，切换模型不用来回折腾。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness provider for a copilot-api gateway
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过 copilot-api 网关接入模型，装好就能用，省去手动配置的麻烦。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在 GUI 里改写模型可见上下文（改写/回退/还原），原始会话日志不动
A Cursor-like sidebar for DeepSeek Harness with file browsing, code editing, Git diffs, terminal, side chat, and Ctrl+L references.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 Cursor 侧边栏，支持文件浏览、代码编辑、Git 差异、终端、侧边对话及 Ctrl+L 文件引用。

description.en: A decision gate for DSH — ask five questions before every shell command, then allow, ask, or deny.
description.zh: 给每条 shell 命令加一道关卡，先问五个问题再决定放行、询问还是拦截。

description.en: Diagnosis-first AI learning runtime for DeepSeek Harness — map what you need, learn interactively, and move to the next best step.
description.zh: 先诊断你的知识盲区，再陪你互动学习，一步步找到最该学的下一步。

description.en: Starts the DSH desktop New Workspace folder picker in a directory you configure (Windows only) and adds a settings page for it, falling back to the stock picker when the saved folder is missing.
description.zh: 让 DSH 桌面端「新建工作区」的文件夹选择框从你设定的目录开始（仅 Windows），并在设置里提供配置入口；目录不存在时静默回退到原生选择框。

description.en: DSH 文档读写工具包 - PDF/DOCX/XLSX/CSV 读写与 PDF 导出（利用dsh制作的，希望能帮到你们）
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接读写 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、CSV 文件，还能把内容导出成 PDF，处理文档一步到位。

description.en: DSH 插件：Codex 风格彩色思考强度滑条 | DSH plugin: Codex-style colourful reasoning-effort slider
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里离散的思考强度选择换成一条会变色的连续滑条，拖动就能调推理力度。

description.en: A GitHub repositories launcher for the DSH Web client, with mirror browsing and accelerated clone/download routes.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页端直接浏览 GitHub 仓库，还能走镜像加速克隆和下载，省得来回切页面。

description.en: GitHub operations for DeepSeek Harness: releases, tags, a guarded API pass-through, sanitized mirror publication, workflow runs and repository settings.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接管理 GitHub 发布、标签、工作流和仓库设置，还能安全同步镜像。

description.en: DSH 插件：哈希锚点编辑工具（hashline_read / replace / undo_last_replace），用内容哈希定位，不依赖行号或字符串匹配。

description.zh: 把 Laya 本地决策模型接进 DSH，离线判断文本选项，约 55ms 一条，不耗 token，还能挡提示注入。

description.en: A liquid-glass composer for the DSH desktop UI: acrylic window rim, SVG lens and chromatic dispersion on the input card, plus a pink accent.
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端输入框加上液态玻璃质感，带 SVG 透镜、色散和粉色点缀，界面更好看。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness余额监控插件（由DeepSeek Harness编写）
description.zh: 实时盯着 DeepSeek Harness 的余额、Token 和缓存用量，每 2 秒刷新一次，花钱心里有数。

description.en: Community plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a lighter LLM service with self-contained provider profiles, a declared model catalog, and the chat-completions, Anthropic Messages, and OpenAI Responses wires. Not an official DeepSeek package.
description.zh: 给 DSH 装个轻量 LLM 服务，自带供应商配置和模型清单，兼容三种主流接口。

description.en: Some settings to make deepseek harness more comfortable to use
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一堆贴心设置，让日常用起来更顺手舒服。

description.en: A model picker and reasoning-effort slider for the DeepSeek Harness composer, plus a three-gear Lightning orchestration switch. The only prompt text it adds is the Lightning contract.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里直接切换模型、拖动推理强度，还能一键切换闪电编排三档。

description.en: deepseek-harness macos 通知插件
description.zh: 在 macOS 上把 DeepSeek Harness 的任务进度和提醒推送到系统通知中心，随时掌握动态。

description.en: DSH 插件：会话 AI 回复结束时用 DeepSeek 鲸鱼图标弹系统通知 | DSH plugin: system notification with the DeepSeek whale when a session's AI turn finishes
description.zh: AI 回复一结束就弹系统通知，带 DeepSeek 鲸鱼图标，还能告诉你哪个会话完成了

description.en: Composer pill with the DeepSeek account balance, the live peak/off-peak pricing phase, and this session's spend priced request by request at the rate in effect when each request was sent. Subagent sessions' costs are aggregated into the parent session; Search and Fetch fees are charged only for DeepSeek's search engine, while third-party engines (Tavily, Bing, Exa, …) are counted but free. The balance refresh interval is configurable.
description.zh: 输入框下方的余额胶囊：显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、实时峰谷时段，以及本会话花费——每条请求都按发出时刻生效的峰谷单价计价，子智能体会话的花费汇总进父会话；Search 与 Fetch 只对 DeepSeek 搜索引擎计费，Tavily、Bing、Exa 等第三方引擎只计数不计费；余额刷新间隔可在插件设置页调整。

description.en: AI short-drama workspace for DeepSeek Harness, with a dedicated drama agent preset, 35 agent tools and 10 bundled skills covering outline, characters, script, storyboard and export.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 短剧工作区：独立的「短剧模式」Agent 预设、35 个 Agent 工具与 10 个随包技能，覆盖立项、总纲、人物、剧本、分镜与导出。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-plugin-ai-drama
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-plugin-ai-drama

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: dsh plugin: prefix-cache health guard - separates real prefix rewrites from ordinary context growth, prices the tokens they waste, and warns the model once per break (/cache, cache_status)
description.zh: 盯住 DeepSeek 前缀缓存，区分正常变长和前缀被改写，算出多花的 token 并提醒你。

description.en: 官方「插件」页里的插件管家：逐插件实测 DSH 启动开销、按会话日志统计活跃度、给出停用建议，并清理不兼容/已停用条目且可找回。
description.zh: 官方插件页的插件管家，实测启动开销、统计活跃度、给停用建议，还能清理不兼容条目并找回。

description.en: dsh plugin: iterative GitHub deep search - exact-phrase, broad-match, README-body and topic-expansion channels with a diminishing-returns stop rule (/deep-scan)
description.zh: 在 GitHub 上多轮迭代深挖搜索，自动扩展关键词，收益递减就停，帮你快速找全相关项目。

description.en: Official DeepSeek Search / Fetch API tools for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 官方搜索和网页抓取接口接进 DSH，让模型能联网查资料、读网页。

description.en: dsh plugin: scans the dsh plugin ecosystem - stars, npm weekly downloads, release-asset downloads - segments niches and ranks growth from daily snapshot deltas (/eco-scan)
description.zh: 扫描 dsh 插件生态，统计星标、下载量并对比快照，帮你发现高增长插件和赛道。

description.en: dsh plugin: tool reliability radar over tool-trace data - error rate, failure streaks and p95 latency per tool (/radar)
description.zh: 盯着 agent 的工具调用记录，算出各工具的错误率、连续失败和慢速情况，帮你快速找出哪个工具老翻车、哪个慢得离谱。

description.en: dsh plugin: cross-session fact notepad with keyword recall, so a decision made in one window is findable in the next (/fact save, /fact find, fact_find)
description.zh: 跨会话事实便签库，一句话记一条结论，之后任何会话都能按关键词找回来。

description.en: GitHub integration for DeepSeek Harness — sign in with GitHub, browse repositories like github.com, and drive branches, pull requests, issues, actions and file commits from the agent.
dsh plugin: renders a session transcript into one self-contained HTML report you can open, archive or forward (/report latest, /report <prefix>, /report all)
description.zh: 把会话记录一键变成单文件 HTML 报告，发给别人双击就能看，不用装任何东西。

description.en: Mobile UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Embeds into your local DSH, auto-starts a web server and ngrok tunnel, and serves a React PWA so you can control DSH from your phone on any network — no domain, no VPS, installable to home screen, with auth and WebSocket streaming.
dsh plugin: pushes archived session transcripts into an Obsidian vault as Markdown with YAML frontmatter, deduped by content hash (/obsidian-push)
description.zh: 把归档的会话记录转成带 YAML 头的 Markdown 存进 Obsidian 库，按内容哈希去重。

description.en: dsh plugin: personal prompt library inside the harness - import tagged templates, browse them, and fire one into the current session (/pv)
description.zh: 在 DSH 里建个私人提示词库，导入带标签的模板，随时挑一条直接发进当前会话。

description.en: dsh plugin: reads remaining quota and usage from any OpenAI-compatible relay's billing surface (/quota, quota_check)
description.zh: 直接读取任意 OpenAI 兼容中转站的剩余额度和用量，还能识别无限额标记，方便随时盯住成本。

description.en: One-click restart for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: a sidebar-footer button plus a detached supervisor that relaunches the whole app, so a rebuilt plugin or profile change takes effect immediately.
description.zh: 侧边栏一键重启 DSH 桌面应用，改完插件或配置立刻生效，不用手动关开。

description.en: dsh plugin: cross-session activity stats from per-call token records - daily trend, priciest sessions, model mix, CSV export (/insights /insights-export)
description.zh: 把每次模型调用记成月度账本，用 /insights 看每日趋势、最贵会话和模型占比，还能导出 CSV。

description.en: 桌面版多会话分屏
description.zh: 在右侧边栏并排打开多个会话，主栏当前会话不受影响，方便对照查看。

description.en: dsh plugin: spend forecasting over cost-ledger sidecars - daily burn rate, month-end projection, budget exhaustion date (/forecast)
description.zh: 读成本台账算日均花费，预测月末开销和预算烧穿时间，帮你提前控住花销。

description.en: dsh plugin: per-tool-call telemetry - duration, argument and result sizes - into monthly JSONL, with /tools-stats ranking the slowest tools
description.zh: 记录每次工具调用的耗时和参数、结果大小，按月存成 JSONL，还能用 /tools-stats 排出最慢的工具。

description.en: dsh plugin: archives every session turn to monthly JSONL sidecars and exports Markdown - the transcript layer other plugins search, render and push (/transcript /transcript-export)
description.zh: 把每轮对话存档成月度 JSONL 并导出 Markdown，给其他插件当数据底座。

description.en: dsh plugin: full-text search across archived session transcripts, reading the JSONL sidecars written by dsh-plugin-transcript (/find, session_search)
description.zh: 给历史会话记录做全文搜索，输入关键词就能找到相关片段和出处。

description.en: DSH agent preset: confirm the requirement with a questionnaire before executing.
description.zh: 执行前先用问卷跟你确认需求，避免理解偏差白干活。

description.en: A lightweight plugin that decompresses and reads past sessions, so a new session can read what an earlier conversation contained, in milliseconds per read. `/recall` lists the sessions of the current project with title, last activity, turn count and first prompt; `/recall <number>` reads back the turns of that session; `/recall all` covers every project; the model can also be asked in natural language to query with the `recall_sessions` tool.
description.zh: 轻量级解压并读取历史会话，让新会话读取之前会话的内容，单次操作毫秒级。`/recall` 列出当前项目的历史会话（标题、最后活动时间、轮次、首问）；`/recall <序号>` 读回该会话的轮次内容；`/recall all` 覆盖所有项目；也可用自然语言让模型调用 `recall_sessions` 工具查询。

description.en: deepseek harness的remote-ssh插件
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏连 SSH 服务器，挑远程目录直接打开工作区。

description.en: Cursor 式只读代码审查插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏查看完整源码 + 行级内联 diff，含文件树、编辑器标签页与 VS Code 快捷键。Cursor-style code review panel for DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏像 Cursor 一样看代码：完整源码加行级内联 diff，带文件树、标签页和 VS Code 快捷键。

description.en: 软考系统分析师论文助手：DSH 插件（题库索引 + 10 段式写作 + Word 交付）
description.zh: 软考系统分析师论文写不出来？它帮你查题库、按10段式成文，还能导出Word。

description.en: Real-time sandbox observability for DeepSeek Harness: latency, loss, errors, tokens, CPU and a live sandbox preview in the native right sidebar.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏实时查看沙箱的延迟、丢包、错误、token 消耗和 CPU 占用，还能预览沙箱画面。

description.en: Schedule-send for DeepSeek Harness: write a message in the composer and have it delivered into the same conversation later as a normal user message.
description.zh: 在输入框写好消息，设定时间后自动作为普通用户消息发到当前对话，帮你定时跟进、提醒自己。

description.en: Full-screen screenshot panel for DSH: marquee select, annotate, insert/copy/save, with offline OCR and translation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里一键全屏截图，框选标注后插入对话，还能离线识别文字和翻译。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu to selected text in the Harness Web UI that replaces it with a Simplified Chinese translation in place, and restores the original on a second right-click.
description.zh: 在 Harness Web UI 中为选中文字添加右键翻译菜单，可就地替换为简体中文译文，再次右键还原原文。

description.en: Adds a one-click delete-session row to the DSH sidebar session menu: moves the session log and its per-conversation .dsh-sessions artifact directory to the Windows Recycle Bin, with no confirmation dialog.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏会话菜单中加入一键「删除会话」：把会话日志与该对话的 .dsh-sessions 产出目录移入 Windows 回收站，没有确认弹窗。

description.en: Recoverable session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: delete moves sessions to a trash folder, restorable for 7 days, purged automatically.
description.zh: 删会话不再心慌，误删的会话会进回收站，7 天内随时找回，过期自动清理。

description.en: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的对话一键存入思源笔记（SiYuan）。支持单条/本轮/整窗口同步、AI 摘要、公式与 mermaid 图表原样保留。
description.zh: 右键把 DeepSeek Harness 对话一键存进思源笔记，公式和 mermaid 图表原样保留，攒成自己的开发知识库。

description.en: Real-time generation-speed gauge for DSH: a half-circle dial and a flowing trend curve, sampling tok/s 50 times a second for finer, more accurate measurement.
description.zh: DSH 生成速度仪表盘：半圆表盘与流动曲线趋势图，一秒 50 次获取 tok/s，测量更细更精准。

description.en: Always-on quotes strip pinned to the top of the DSH window: watchlist, holdings with share counts and cost price, P&L, candlestick and intraday charts, 5-level order book, trade ledger, price alerts, and streamed AI review of the selected symbol.
description.zh: 钉在 DSH 窗口顶部的常驻行情条：自选股、带股数与成本价的持仓、盈亏、K 线与分时图、五档盘口、交易流水、价格预警，以及用 DSH 已配置模型流式生成的 AI 复盘。

description.en: 会话头部的模型检查点徽标：探测 system_fingerprint / 网关请求级溯源 / 响应元数据存证（原始字节默认不落盘）
description.zh: 在会话头部显示当前模型检查点徽标，探测不到指纹时展示网关请求级溯源，方便核对模型版本与请求来源。

description.en: A dsh-tui plugin which keep your Secrets safe from the Agents.

Per-region UI zoom for DeepSeek Harness — Ctrl + wheel sets independent zoom levels for the conversation header, the left sidebar, the conversation body and the right sidebar (sidebars 25%-300%), and dragging the header bottom edge makes that header shorter or taller, growing by height only so label size stays unchanged.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分区域缩放：Ctrl + 滚轮分别为会话顶栏、左侧栏、会话正文和右侧面板设置独立比例（侧栏 25%–300%）；拖动顶栏整条下边界可以把它调矮或调高，调高只增加高度、字大小不变。

description.en: Play a local video behind the DeepSeek Harness chat UI, with play/pause, opacity, scrim and fit controls.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话界面背后循环播放本地视频，支持播放/暂停、不透明度、遮罩与填充调节。

description.en: Lossless visual memory for DSH agents: store an image once, address it by sha256, read exact pixels, compare past frames, recall by text/tag/turn — no second vision model in the loop.
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体装个不会丢的视觉记忆，图片存一次就能反复查看、对比和找回。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：从 wallhaven.cc 搜图并铺成 GUI 背景，图片全由宿主端取回（支持代理，浏览器无需能访问 wallhaven），可一键下载原图。零运行时依赖。
deepseek-harness 工作区自定义提示词
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 工作区自定义提示词，让每个项目都能按自己的规则和风格跟 AI 对话。

description.en: Workspace memory for DeepSeek Harness ported from ZCode: one Markdown memory directory per workspace (a MEMORY.md index plus one file per fact), injected into each main session and refreshed by a background extraction request after completed turns; a sidebar page browses the stored files read-only.
description.zh: 把 ZCode 的工作区记忆移植到 DeepSeek Harness：每个工作区一份 Markdown 记忆目录（MEMORY.md 索引 + 一事实一文件），主会话开始时注入，每轮成功对话后由后台提取请求补充；左栏页面只读浏览已存文件。

description.en: Diagnose an inference service from evidence: generate a sanitized collection script, parse it offline, rank root causes with falsifiers, re-collect only what is missing. Hash-chained audit; five read-only DSH tools.
description.zh: 从证据出发诊断推理服务，自动生成采集脚本、离线解析并排序根因，证据不足就直说未确认。

description.en: Portable project memory for coding agents. Standalone runtime, observable records, code fingerprints, and Claude Code/Codex/DeepSeek Harness adapters.
Orchestrate VectorCraft, PhotoCraft, EffectCraft, and FilmCraft projects from one brief.
description.zh: 一份需求就能同时调度矢量、图片、特效和影片四类 AIGC 项目，创作流程一站搞定。

description.en: DSH host plugin that guards against uncached prompts: blocks sends (read-only) and/or archives sessions after the prompt cache likely expired.
description.zh: 防止误发消息到缓存已过期的旧会话，可拦截发送或自动归档会话，省心又省钱。

description.en: Generate images, video, audio, and 3D on your own GPU with local ComfyUI or Comfy Cloud.
description.zh: 用本地 ComfyUI 或 Comfy Cloud 在自己的 GPU 上生成图片、视频、音频和 3D 内容。

description.en: A dual-face Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness: the host half owns a coordination SQLite database, seven model-facing tools and an HTTP surface; the web half mounts five composer dropdowns, a settings catalog and the service-level takeover dialog.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层稳定的命令协调层，用明确的参数和事务写入替代拼 shell 字符串，跨平台跑脚本更稳。

description.en: Terraria pixel theme for DeepSeek Harness (Desktop + Web)
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 界面换成泰拉瑞亚像素风，向导陪你写代码，桌面和网页都能用。

description.en: DSH 插件：web_focus 工具按关键词对抓取页面做相关度筛选，压缩链接、过滤导航、保留可回取的原文并缓存，让 web_fetch 不再一次性消耗大量token。
description.zh: 按关键词筛出网页里真正相关的内容，省下大量 token，让 web_fetch 读得更聚焦。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 运维级多账号管理与高可用平滑切换插件 (DevOps & SRE-grade Account Switcher)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 做多账号管理和故障自动切换，凭据统一治理，运维省心。

description.en: AI 错题本：把扫描试卷整理成以知识点为索引的错题合集（dsh-plugin）
description.zh: 把扫描的试卷和图片自动整理成按知识点分类的错题本，方便复习。

description.en: Plays a full-screen video while DeepSeek Harness starts and reveals the UI only after it ends. Esc skips it.
description.zh: 打开 DeepSeek Harness 时全屏播放一段开机视频，播完才露出界面，按 Esc 可跳过。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设计的破限插件：卸掉宿主的提示词限制和审批拦截，让助手照你说的做，不半路拒绝、不反复请示。补丁逐条可选，随时还原原版。 A jailbreak plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it strips the host's prompt restrictions and approval gates so the assistant does what you asked instead of refusing or asking permission mid-task. Patches are individually selectable and revert cleanly.
A floating chibi pet plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: one session per pet, with a chat input to hand it work.
description.zh: 在 Web 界面里养一只会干活的悬浮桌宠，每只宠物对应一个会话，直接聊天就能给它派活。

description.en: DSH Web 客户端插件:模型选择按钮左侧显示 DeepSeek API 峰/谷价状态(绿=谷,橙=峰)
description.zh: 在模型选择按钮左边显示 DeepSeek API 的峰谷价状态，绿色是谷价、橙色是峰价，一眼看清当前计费档位。

description.en: Reports Codex reset probabilities, completed resets and upcoming schedules in the DSH composer, with a read-only tool for status and paginated records.
description.zh: 在 DSH composer 中报道 Codex 重置概率、最近完成重置与下次排期，并提供只读状态与分页记录工具。

description.en: DSH 前置/基座适配插件：把 Claude Code / Codex / WorkBuddy / OpenCode / GitHub Copilot 的 hooks 与 rules，通过显式声明适配到 DSH seam。5 家 vendor、112 个事件（102 真实/精确 + 10 自述 Approximate）、29 个原生翻译点；含自建 Copilot 桥、真实文件监听、真实 git worktree 检测、官方 LSP 接入。每条适配逐项列出损失，fail-closed，不发布虚假能力。
Select text anywhere in a DSH conversation, attach a note to it, and send the whole annotation batch together with the next message.
description.zh: 在对话里选中任意文字加批注，下次发消息时整批带上，让 AI 准确理解你指的内容。

description.en: A continue button in the composer tool row, immediately left of the send key: one click writes an interruption-aware prompt into the draft and submits it, so an interrupted task resumes without retyping the context. The prompt names the interruption and appends the current task plus the tail of the last reply; Alt-click or right-click sends a bare 继续, and a non-empty draft is appended to rather than overwritten.
description.zh: 输入框工具行里、紧挨发送键左侧的「继续」按钮：点一下就把续接指令写进草稿并提交，让中断的任务接着跑，不用重新交代上下文。指令会写明中断原因，并附上当前任务与上一轮回复的结尾片段；按住 Alt 点击或右键点击只发裸的「继续」，草稿非空时只追加不覆盖。

description.en: 网页版 AI 一键入口：在右侧边栏浏览器 tab 里打开 DeepSeek / Kimi / 豆包 / 腾讯元宝 / 通义千问 / 智谱清言的免费网页版（走 Electron webview，不受 CSP frame-ancestors 限制）。站点列表在 lib/client.js 的 SITES 常量里，可自由增删。
description.zh: 在侧边栏一键打开 DeepSeek、Kimi、豆包等六家 AI 网页版，和当前会话并排用，简单问题不用再花 API 钱。

description.en: An embedded Douyin window docked in the DSH sidebar: a real Electron webview guest, so douyin.com's X-Frame-Options: DENY no longer applies.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏底部的内嵌抖音窗口：用 Electron webview 租约绕过 douyin.com 的 X-Frame-Options: DENY。仅桌面版。

description.en: DSH plugin: context-aware per-step reasoning-effort routing — classify → escalate → hysteresis → capability clamp; Auto mask in the native selector; default effort fill + wire mapping for custom llm-pi-ai models. AI-authored (kimi-k3), produced by @neo805. No Issues/PRs; forks welcome (MIT).
description.zh: 按任务难度自动分配推理强度，省算力又不掉链子，还能给自定义模型补上推理档位。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的邮件通知插件
description.zh: 任务或对话跑完时自动发邮件提醒你，不用守着屏幕等结果。

description.en: One-click thumbs up/down feedback UI that injects rating summaries into model context.
description.zh: 一键点赞/点踩反馈 UI，评分摘要自动注入模型上下文。

description.en: Durable, reviewable engineering incident journals for the DeepSeek Harness — capture, quiz, and audit your own mistakes.
description.zh: 把踩过的坑写成可复习、可审计的工程日记，帮你记住教训、定期体检。

description.en: Refuses Git inside a Jujutsu workspace and hands the model jj commands instead. Jujutsu-native VCS & version control for the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 原生支持 Jujutsu 版本控制，自动拦截 Git 命令并改用 jj，版本管理更顺手。

description.en: A local, model-readable knowledge-base plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Vector generation mode that supports local, LLM enhancement and external API integration. Support the import of text files, PDFs and Office files. Also support multi-user management, content encryption and access to MCP tools.
description.zh: 把资料存成纯 Markdown 的本地知识库，支持多种向量生成方式，让模型直接读取和检索。

description.en: One-click add Agnes AI free models to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 一键把 Agnes AI 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: 告别繁琐的手动配置！本插件支持从 Claude Desktop、Cursor、VS Code、YAML 或网页中直接导入 MCP 配置。在写入前，它会自动帮你进行安全审查和风险提示，只需点一下确认，就能把第三方工具无缝接入 DSH，您可从「设置 → MCP 安装」中管理相应信息。
Local-only cross-session memory for DSH with system-prompt injection and a Settings page.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个只存本地的跨会话记忆，聊过的事能记住并自动带进系统提示。

description.en: Edit or undo your sent messages in DeepSeek Harness's Web GUI — hides everything after from chat view and model context.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话中，悬停消息即可原地编辑或撤销，轻松修正已发送的内容。

description.en: Mojibake guard bundle for DSH: feature-based garbled-text detection before writes with review-then-release (an identical retry passes), plus pre-execution pwsh encoding audit (ANSI/GBK/UTF-16/Default), Windows and Chinese first.
description.zh: DSH 乱码拦截器 bundle：写入前特征值/编码回环检测乱码并复查放行（原样重试即通过），pwsh 写入编码执行前审计（ANSI/GBK/UTF-16/默认编码），Windows 与中文场景优先。

description.en: MT 管理器 MCP 连接 DeepSeek Harness 插件：在 Web 设置页填 MT 的 MCP 地址，手机文件/APK/ZIP 能力以 mcp__mt__* 工具可用。Connect MT Manager (Android) to DeepSeek Harness as a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里填上 MT 管理器的 MCP 地址，就能用 mcp__mt__* 工具直接操作手机上的文件、APK 和 ZIP。

description.en: 可以让你的dsh中的“Cordis插件”变得可管理，可一键生成安装包|Make the "Cordis plugins" in your dsh manageable and generate installation packages with one click.
description.zh: 把 dsh 里的 Cordis 插件统一管起来，还能一键打包成安装包，装插件省事多了。

description.en: 火影忍者手游战力工作台｜dsh-plugin，也可脱离 DSH 独立运行（单文件 HTML / Node CLI / UMD）｜AGENTS.md 是部署契约，把链接丢给 agent 即可装好｜每条数值带来源与置信度
description.zh: 火影手游战力计算工作台，每条数值都标来源和置信度，还能脱离 DSH 单文件运行。

description.en: Visual-novel theme with responsive characters, task-state expressions, role skills and a music player, including an original demo pack and optional local game imports.
description.zh: 视觉小说主题，提供响应式人物、任务状态表情、角色表达技能与音乐播放器，附原创演示资源并支持可选的本机游戏导入。

description.en: GitHub Copilot OAuth sign-in and model route for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 GitHub Copilot 账号登录，直接调用 Copilot 模型。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web UI cleanup — 去除完全不用的官方API功能，让你的DSH更清爽
description.zh: 清掉 DSH 界面里用不到的官方 API 入口，并强制关闭 Session Log 上传，让界面更清爽。

description.en: Read-only page structure for DSH: table coordinates, shadow DOM fields, code blocks, confidence labels.
description.zh: 只读读取页面结构，直接拿到表格坐标、Shadow DOM 字段、代码块和置信度标签，不用截图也不用整页导出。

description.en: A draggable desktop pet for the DSH web interface with interactive actions and growth states.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 界面的可拖拽桌宠，支持互动动作与成长状态。

description.en: Adds one draggable desktop pet to the DSH web GUI: a whale girl called Big Fat Fish (nickname Jingjing), with eight switchable colour skins and a personality.
