She eats rice, is clever but lazy, and is a tsundere: too many rapid clicks and she lies down and refuses to react for a while, calling her fat annoys her and she insists she is not, and the nickname Jingjing pleases her. She also remembers you between sessions: three fat-calls today and she greets you cold, three nickname-calls and she greets you warm, coming back after half an hour earns "I was not waiting for you", and the first few meetings she is shy - so the counters reset each local midnight and are stored in a state file the plugin owns. After ten quiet minutes she drifts to a corner, which is visual only and never moves the position you chose. The eight PNGs are bundled with the plugin and served by the plugin itself, so there are no third-party requests. NOTE - the artwork carries an OleapCrow mark and was supplied by the repository owner, the eight skins are recolourings of that one drawing, and the plugin has not been installed against a live DSH host.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面加一只可以拖动的桌宠：一只叫「大肥鱼」（昵称「鲸鲸」）的鲸鱼娘，八种配色皮肤可切换，并且有性格——只吃米饭、聪明但懒、嘴硬心软；连点几次会躺平不干了，被叫「大肥鱼」会生气并坚持自己不胖，叫「鲸鲸」才高兴。她还会记事：今天被叫胖三次就来时冷淡，被叫昵称三次就亲近，离开半小时再回来说「才不是等你」，头几次见面怕生；这些计数每天零点清零，存在插件自己的状态文件里。十分钟没人理会游到角落，那只改视觉、不会动你放她的位置。八张皮肤图随插件分发、由插件自己提供，因此没有任何第三方请求。注意：画面带有 OleapCrow 标记、由仓库所有者提供，八种皮肤是同一张画的重新配色；本插件尚未在真实的 DSH 宿主上安装验证过。

description.en: dsh会话置顶插件 ｜ dsh session pinning plugin, pin important DeepSeek Harness sessions in the workspace sidebar
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏置顶重要会话，快速访问常用对话，提升工作流效率。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance and today's token usage in the sidebar footer, and reconciles locally estimated spend against the balance the account actually lost over the days it has sampled.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与今日 token 用量，并把本地估算的花费与账户余额实际减少量按采样覆盖的时长对账。

description.en: SiYuan integration for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把思源笔记接进 DSH，能检索、创建和修改笔记内容，还支持多核心连接与逐端点授权。

description.en: Constrained subagent roster for DeepSeek Harness: one tool per role, each pinning a child system prompt, a capability allow-list, and a model tier. Bulk work vs team work by tool shape. 子代理名册：按角色约束系统提示词/能力范围/模型档位。
description.zh: 给每个子代理角色固定系统提示、能力范围和模型档位，让批量任务和团队协作各走各的路。

description.en: 项目群 / Project Room — 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的持久项目群聊。A persistent project group chat for DeepSeek Harness.
Adds a button to the composer that rewrites the current draft into a clearer, more specific prompt through a one-shot LLM call, with one-click revert and cancel.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，一键调用 LLM 把当前草稿改写成更清晰具体的提示词，支持一键恢复原文与取消。

description.en: 把一支 PV 当作 DeepSeek Harness 的默认主页与屏保：启动即接管、Esc 返回、标题栏跟随影片配色、可选的锁屏按钮
description.zh: 把一支 PV 变成 DSH 的默认主页和屏保，打开就循环播放，按 Esc 回到空白会话。

description.en: Fork of dsh-reasoning-effort with a two-level model picker in the composer: a provider list, a model pane that slides out beside it, search, and compact rows, alongside the reasoning-effort slider and its max-level effects.
description.zh: dsh-reasoning-effort 的分支：输入框里的两级模型选择器（Provider 列表 + 右侧滑出的模型栏）、搜索与紧凑行，并保留推理强度滑块与最高档特效。

description.en: Adds a corner card that estimates how much a session spent repeating a failed or empty tool call with the same arguments.
description.zh: 在左下角显示这一场里，失败或空结果之后又用同一组参数重试花了多少钱。

description.en: 蕾米埃尔桌宠 · DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：跟随会话状态自动切换 GIF，支持 Web UI 与桌面版。
description.zh: 蕾米埃尔桌宠会跟着会话状态自动换 GIF，Web UI 和桌面版都能用，让干活多点陪伴感。

description.en: Runs a diff past several reviewers at once — a CLI coding agent such as codex or claude, or a DSH subagent — and merges their separate sections into one report; reviewers and named review modes are configured in the settings UI.
description.zh: 把同一个 diff 同时交给多个评审者——已安装的 CLI 编程智能体（codex、claude 等）或 DSH 子智能体——各自成节，合并为一份报告；评审者与命名评审模式在设置界面里配置。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness safe-mode recovery console: minimal TUI, history, repair, model/provider management
description.zh: 主界面打不开时，用这个安全终端来修复插件、管理模型，不加载任何用户配置，轻量又可靠。

description.en: DSH 会话总线插件：会话之间互相推送消息并自动唤醒对方，跨工作区直接派活，按对话内容路由问题
description.zh: 让不同会话之间互发消息、自动唤醒对方，跨工作区直接派活，还能按对话内容把问题转给合适的会话。

description.en: Real-time session cost meter for the DeepSeek Harness (CNY): token usage from the session log and live stream, priced by an editable per-model table.

Continues work across coding agents inside DeepSeek Harness: six sessionflow_* tools query a local session index built by sessionFlow to find past work, show where the current project left off, and hand the goal, files and open items to the next agent. Requires the separate sessionFlow core, installed from its GitHub repo. Everything stays local — no cloud, no telemetry.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里跨编码 Agent 继续工作：六个 sessionflow_* 工具查询 sessionFlow 构建的本地会话索引，找回过去的工作、看清当前项目做到哪了，并把目标、涉及文件与未完成事项交给下一个 Agent。需要另行安装独立的 sessionFlow 核心（见其 GitHub 仓库）。全程本地运行——无云端、无遥测。

description.en: DSH 官方侧边栏浏览器：结构化观察、原生输入、提取与操作后复核。
description.zh: 让 Agent 直接读取并操作 DSH 桌面侧边栏里的网页，边看边点还能复核结果。

description.en: Sidecar markdown memory for DSH: per-session index injection, one-click memory-flow button, enforced 分类-主题.md format, cross-project search.
description.zh: 用 Markdown 文件帮你轻松管理 AI 记忆，支持一键注入上下文、按会话自动整理和跨项目快速查找。

description.en: In-conversation source deck for DSH Desktop: the current chat model runs LLM search rounds, candidates render as GitHub-aware cards, and keep/exclude feedback, favorites, and the selected sources stay in the same conversation.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的会话内资料台：由当前对话模型执行搜索轮次，候选以 GitHub 卡片展示，保留/排除反馈、收藏夹与筛选结果都留在同一会话。

description.en: Runs a second agent: hands independent subtasks to a local Codex CLI in parallel (up to three at a time), and asks it to review a design or a plan before the user sees it, returning conclusion, evidence, counterexamples and a verification step. A dispatch missing its timeout or its acceptance check is rejected by the plugin, not by the model remembering to check.
description.zh: 双 agent 协作：把互不依赖的子任务并行交给本机 Codex（同时最多三路），并在方案交给你看之前先让它盲审一轮，必须回「结论 / 证据 / 反例 / 验证方式」四段；缺超时或缺验收判据的派活会被插件当场拒绝，不靠模型自己记得。

description.en: DSH Tavern 长局后续提醒插件：记录约定、托办与来信，到时间提醒正文
description.zh: 在 DSH Tavern 长局里帮你记住约定、托办和来信，到点自动提醒正文，不怕忘事。

description.en: Adjustable thinking intensity (reasoning effort) for third-party API-key providers in DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Declares 推理等级 for custom OpenAI-compatible routes so the composer picker works again.
description.zh: 给第三方 API Key 接入补上推理等级选择器，让思考强度随时可调。

description.en: TinyFish-backed search and fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web) — $0 SERP and page extraction, direct or via Monid.
description.zh: 给 AI 助手接上实时联网能力，免费搜索和抓取网页，每次调用零成本。

description.en: 公式与数学插图工具：LaTeX 公式离线转 PNG、参数化几何/曲面模板、数值自校验。DeepSeek Harness 插件（适配 0.1.0-rc.6 与 0.2.0-rc.2）。
description.zh: 把 LaTeX 公式和几何图形离线转成 PNG，还能自动校验数值，写文档做图省心。

description.en: Hides tool schemas from the model's prefill and reveals one tool at a time through a decision model API. Requires a running decision-model API endpoint and pnpm on PATH.
description.zh: 通过决策模型 API 把工具 schema 从模型 prefill 中隐藏，每次按需揭示一个工具。需运行决策模型 API 端点，且 PATH 中有 pnpm。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: explain terms first, then render visual cards (PNG) or an offline clickable mermaid page.
description.zh: 先讲清术语，再把概念画成 PNG 卡片或离线可点的 mermaid 图，学习讲解更直观。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 鲸鱼跳跃小游戏 / whale jump plugin
WorkBuddy 账号管理与切换 Switch between archived WorkBuddy accounts from the DSH Plugins page, without reopening the WorkBuddy app
DeepSeek Harness 工作区管理面板插件：任意层级分组导航、原生侧边栏按管理面板、LLM 整理与 AGENTS.md 支持
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区按任意层级分组整理，还能让 LLM 帮你自动归类，找项目不再翻半天。

description.en: DSH plugin orchestration and workspace-isolation manager: plugin scanning, per-workspace isolated instances, and a standalone rescue entry.
description.zh: 按工作区隔离 DSH 插件、扫描冲突，还能在 DSH 崩溃时独立自救。

description.en: 增强deepseek harness的工作区的多级目录功能
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 工作区加上多级目录，文件再多也能分门别类整理清楚。

description.en: Codex, Grok Build, Cursor, Pi, and ZCode presets on DSH models, with native sessions and optional OMD enhancements.
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型与原生会话上提供 Codex、Grok Build、Cursor、Pi、ZCode 预设及可选 OMD 增强。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-oh-my-agents-above-all
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for oh-my-agents-above-all

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Build editable layered posters and composites, then export PSD or flat images.
description.zh: 在分层画布上拼海报、做合成图，随时改图层，还能导出 PSD 或普通图片。

description.en: 划词助手：任意 Windows 应用里选中文字，弹出解释 / 总结 / 翻译 / 朗读。DeepSeek Harness 插件。
Run Bazi, Qimen, Ziwei, Fengshui, and Tarot readings with script-verified charts.
description.zh: 一键排八字、起奇门、看紫微、测风水、抽塔罗，盘面都由脚本核对过，娱乐参考更放心。

description.en: A configurable Liquid Glass theme for DeepSeek Harness with translucent surfaces, wallpaper, desktop transparency, window blur, custom cursors, click ripples, and per-side conversation contrast controls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的液态玻璃主题，包含半透明界面、壁纸、桌面透出、窗口模糊、自定义光标、点击涟漪和消息辨识选项。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness native SSH terminal and SFTP workspace with direct agent tools and security sandboxing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生 SSH 终端与 SFTP 远程工作区，支持 Agent 直连运维与三级安全沙盒。

description.en: ADHD-friendly output shaping where the mode belongs to one session, not a global setting: switch it with /i-have-adhd on|off in the conversations you want shaped, and the state stays with that session. Ported from ayghri/i-have-adhd.
description.zh: ADHD 友好输出塑形插件：模式属于单个会话，而不是一项全局设置——用 /i-have-adhd on|off 在你想要塑形的对话里开启/关闭功能，状态随该会话保留。移植自 ayghri/i-have-adhd。

description.en: Executor/advisor workflow ported from pi-advisor-flow: the executor calls ask_advisor for a second opinion at key decisions, after repeated failures and before completion; equivalent repeated tool calls are intercepted before execution for an advisor review with a proceed/revise/blocked verdict, and hard mode force-reviews every turn before it closes. Per-call token and cost ledger with /advisor status readout, privacy tiers for repo context and file contents, six-shape secret redaction, and a web settings card; advisor failures never stall the main loop.
description.zh: 移植自 pi-advisor-flow 的执行者/顾问工作流：执行者经 ask_advisor 工具按需请求第二意见（可附问题、草稿、仓库上下文档位与点名文件）；等价工具调用重复达到阈值时在执行前拦截，由顾问以 proceed/revise/blocked 三值裁决，硬模式下回合收口前强制评审；提供逐次 token 与成本台账、/advisor status 状态读数、仓库上下文与文件内容分级授权、六类密钥形状脱敏与 web 设置卡；advisor 失败不停摆主循环。

description.en: 给 DSH 里的 AI 一层自己的判断记忆。判断节点 + 确定性取代（supersede）+ 双时态账本 + 双链，规则与人格分开治理，图谱作可解释性界面。 - Persistent judgment memory & self-evolving personality for AI agents (bi-temporal ledger, deterministic supersession, knowledge graph).
DSH 回答标注插件：选中回答里的文字写备注，攒够了一次性发给 agent / Annotate a DSH answer and send the whole set as one message
Google Antigravity and Cloud Code Assist model provider with Gemini 3.8 Flash, sandbox failover, and multi-account quota management.
description.zh: Google Antigravity 与 Cloud Code Assist 模型提供方插件，支持 Gemini 3.8 Flash、沙箱端点容灾与多账号配额管理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：Google Antigravity 直连代理核心与模型服务，支持双模型池额度监控、热切换网络代理与长文本防御
description.zh: 让 DSH 直连 Google Antigravity 的代理核心和模型服务，能盯双模型池额度、随时切网络代理，还能防长文本翻车。

description.en: Registers an apiCost session projection that estimates DeepSeek spend from reported token usage at published peak / off-peak rates, in CNY and USD, over self, delegation-tree or verified-team scopes: a composer-dock pill and its detail panel, the /cost command, a session_cost tool, and GET routes for the view and the current rate card. A panel switch parks model requests at the llm/stream waterfall while peak rates apply and dispatches them unchanged once the off-peak window opens, so the call is billed at the off-peak rate with no failure reported to the session.
description.zh: 注册 apiCost 会话投影，按官方公布的峰谷价目表把上报的 token 用量折算成 ¥/$ 花费，覆盖本会话、委派树与经校验的团队三种范围：输入框下方的胶囊与其详情面板、/cost 命令、session_cost 工具，以及读取视图与当前价目表的 GET 路由。面板上的开关可在高峰时段把模型请求停在 llm/stream 上，待谷时窗口开启后原样派发，于是按谷时价计费，且会话中不会出现任何失败。

description.en: DSH 审批/提问提醒:DSH 有焦点时只响提示音,焦点不在 DSH 时额外在屏幕右下角弹出系统通知
description.zh: DSH 需要你审批或回答时自动响铃提醒，窗口在后台还会弹系统通知，不用一直盯着等。

description.en: Two-tab archive panel (archived / active) where every row offers archive or unarchive next to permanent delete; each row shows its bound workspace folder as a clickable path, and queued archive-entry cleanup keeps a deleted session from resurfacing in the active list.
description.zh: 双 Tab 归档面板（已归档 / 活跃），每行的归档或取消归档与彻底删除并排；显示绑定的工作目录且可直接点击打开，删除后的归档记录进入待清理队列，避免已删会话重新出现在活跃列表。

description.en: DSH pet plugin that adds an Arknights operator library and custom image pets: pick one of 486 operators and the plugin downloads that operator Codex v2 atlas from the pinned upstream revision, verifies every Git blob hash and installs it locally, or import your own Codex atlas (1536x1872 or 1536x2288) or a plain PNG/WebP/GIF; the pet then follows session activity, shows a bubble while a decision is pending, and can be dragged and resized.
description.zh: DSH 桌宠插件：内置 486 位明日方舟干员素材目录，选定干员后从固定上游版本下载 Codex v2 图集并逐个校验 Git 哈希再本地安装；也可导入自己的 Codex 图集（1536×1872 或 1536×2288）或普通 PNG/WebP/GIF 图片；桌宠随会话状态切换动作，等待确认时显示气泡，可拖动并调整尺寸。

description.en: Adds a configurable bubble behind assistant replies, with an optional liquid-glass material and matching chrome for process, tool-call and reasoning rows.
description.zh: 给助手回复加一层可调节的气泡底，可选液态玻璃材质，并让过程、工具调用与思考等周边行同步。

description.en: Read-only attachment library: lists every image and file attachment stored on this machine, its size, and which conversations (including those in the session trash) still use it, with Show in Finder and Open in Preview.
description.zh: 只读附件库：列出本机保存的所有图片和文件附件及其占用空间，以及哪些对话（包括会话回收站中的）仍在使用它们，并可在访达中显示或用预览打开。

description.en: Records the version of the edit target as an observation when the agent inspected the file with bash instead of the read tool, so the filesystem observation policy stops rejecting edits with FS_NOT_OBSERVED. Applies to edits only; blind whole-file overwrites stay guarded.
description.zh: 当 agent 用 bash（sed/awk/cat）看过文件而非 read 工具时，为编辑目标补登记一次真实版本的观察记录，使文件系统观察策略不再以 FS_NOT_OBSERVED 拒绝编辑；只作用于编辑，整文件盲覆盖仍受保护。

description.en: Starts the WorkBuddy Panel backend (wb2api.exe from workbuddy2api-panel, Windows) with DSH and on exit stops only the process it launched; optionally syncs the backend's /v1/models into the workbuddy provider, and its settings card picks models, shows credit multipliers and installs, updates or rolls back the backend from checksum-verified GitHub releases.
description.zh: 随 DSH 启动 WorkBuddy Panel 后端（workbuddy2api-panel 的 wb2api.exe，Windows），退出时只停自己拉起的进程；可把后端 /v1/models 同步到 workbuddy 模型提供方，设置卡片可勾选模型、查看积分倍率，并从经校验和验证的 GitHub Release 安装、更新或回滚后端。

description.en: Scheduled update checks for DeepSeek Harness itself and installed plugins, applied only in idle windows — four schedule modes (daily, every N hours/days/minutes), bidirectional plugin whitelist, disk-verified installs, and a web settings panel with hot-reload config.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 定时自动更新插件：本体与已装插件一并检查，仅在空闲窗口执行。四种调度模式（每日/每N小时/每N天/每N分钟）、双向白名单、磁盘回读验证、内嵌设置面板热生效。

description.en: DSH Bash Guard plugin with scope-based permissions and native inline controls
Replaces the session topbar title with a workspace and session breadcrumb, switching workspaces, sessions and subagents from dropdowns in the topbar.
description.zh: 把会话顶栏标题换成工作区与会话面包屑，可在顶栏下拉里切换工作区、会话与子智能体。

description.en: Time-based model routing: a settings panel defines weekday peak and off-peak windows and the provider/model each one uses, the choices are read from the harness registry (API keys and subscription logins alike), and a global switch decides whether that policy sets the model and reasoning effort of every request. The switch is independent per session, each session row carries a light showing its own state, and the settings panel names the model in force right now and why. A day no window matches — every weekend and holiday — uses the primary model of the first plan; the advanced thinking model is a separate axis, used only when a session itself asks for max reasoning.
description.zh: 按时间做模型路由：在设置页定义工作日峰谷时段与各时段使用的 Provider/模型（候选来自 harness 已注册的 API 与订阅账号），打开开关后由该策略决定每次请求的模型与思考档。开关按会话独立，会话列表每行带指示灯显示各自状态，设置页顶部写明此刻生效的模型与原因。无任何时段命中的日子（周末、假期）使用第一个方案的主力模型；高级思考模型是另一根轴，只在会话自身要求 max 思考时使用。

description.en: An easter-egg brake-pedal self-test. A draggable pill in the DSH web UI runs six full-force braking stomps; the bracket snaps at a pseudo-random stomp between the second and the sixth, or the run passes entirely, and then a fictional notice appears. The pedal force is derived and labelled as such, while the session figures it derives from are read from the real session log. It never intercepts, delays or takes over the real stop action.
description.zh: 一个制动踏板自检彩蛋。DSH 网页界面上有一颗可拖动的胶囊，做六脚全力制动测试：支架在第二到第六脚之间伪随机地断裂，也可能整轮通过，随后弹出一份虚构通报。踏板力由会话事实推导并在界面上标为推导值，而这些事实取自真实会话日志。它从不拦截、延迟或接管真实的停止动作。

description.en: 把 DSH Web 界面换成自家品牌（Logo / 名称 / 中央标题 / favicon），并给页面与项目文件夹打上「为什么加 · 在干什么」水印。Rebrand your DSH web UI and stamp "why added / what job" watermarks on pages and project folders.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成自家品牌，还能给页面和项目文件夹打上用途水印，方便团队看清来龙去脉。

description.en: A conversation-style layer that rephrases trade-off warnings: when a shortcut is cheap but has a catch, the reply may say the fast road is the rival shop and the slow one keeps its rules. Ships a rewrite engine that turns any text into a fixed-format dialogue with five independent knobs (act count, catchphrase density, ending turn, seed, preset), a slider for four on/off intensity levels, and a /bushaoxin command that reports a joke "heartburn index" from the session tool-call log. Every rewrite ends with a real technical conclusion that cannot be disabled. Zero dependencies, no build step, engine is pure functions.
description.zh: 一个对话文风层：谈到「便宜的路有坑」这类取舍时，把警告换成另一种说法——快而便宜的是隔壁黑心店，慢而可靠的老店在立规矩。附带改写引擎，可把任意文本拧成固定骨架的对白，有五个互相独立的旋钮（幕数、招牌台词密度、收尾走向、种子、预设档）；一个四档强度滑条；以及 /bushaoxin 命令，按会话的工具调用记录生成一份段子式的「烧心指数」病历。每篇改写末尾永远附一行真实技术结论，不可关闭。零依赖、无构建步骤，引擎是纯函数。

description.en: Extreme LLM-call compression for DeepSeek Harness: title short-circuit, in-flight dedup, 24h replay cache, and batch-merging N parallel requests into 1 upstream call via a `[[TASK n]]`/`[[ANSWER n]]` delimiter protocol - fewer API calls, less spend, same answers.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的极端 LLM 调用压缩：标题生成短路、飞行中请求去重、24 小时回放缓存，并用 `[[TASK n]]`/`[[ANSWER n]]` 分隔协议把 N 个并行请求批量合并为 1 次上游调用——更少 API 调用、更低开销、相同答案。

description.en: Open and copy local files and web links from a chat turn.
description.zh: 打开和复制本轮的本地文件与网页链接。

description.en: Local Token usage dashboard in DSH Settings with hourly activity, daily heatmaps, custom date ranges, model breakdowns, local/API filters, and native cache-hit accounting, without cost estimates or composer overrides. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中统计本地 Token 用量，支持小时活动图、日历热力图、自定义日期、模型用量分布、本地/API 筛选和原生缓存命中口径，不估算费用，不替换输入框状态栏。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更高兼容版本。

description.en: Adds separate Chat and Work modes to DeepSeek Harness, embeds DeepSeek's official chat page, and provides an animated desktop companion with quick chat and task-completion notifications.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加聊天与工作双模式，内嵌 DeepSeek 官方聊天网页，并提供支持快捷聊天和任务完成提醒的桌面伙伴。

description.en: Peer collaboration between a DeepSeek Harness agent and the local Codex CLI: split a goal into a shared work list, hand tasks over, review what comes back, and keep every prompt, event stream, and answer on disk.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness agent 与本机 Codex CLI 对等协作：把目标拆成共享工作清单、派活与交接、互相审查，并把每一步的提示词、事件流与回答留档在本地。

description.en: Codex-style glowing reasoning-effort slider for the DeepSeek Harness composer · DSH 推理强度滑块（Codex 风格）
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加个 Codex 风格的发光推理强度滑块，拖一拖就能调推理力度。

description.en: A launcher panel for DSH: manages the capability composer, the plugin inventory and the MCP bridge, and walks you through installing the browser tab-bridge extension.
description.zh: 启动器面板：统管能力组合、插件清单与 MCP 桥，并引导安装浏览器标签页扩展。

description.en: Assembled context for DeepSeek Harness: a context tree over the session surface with per-node assemble modes (full / key / off), agent-authored presets, and a panel that decides what the model actually sees.
description.zh: 把会话记录整理成一棵可勾选的上下文树，按节点决定哪些内容真正发给模型，省 token 又可控。

description.en: DSH 状态栏花费计量：本轮/会话实时花费（波峰/波谷分时计价）、当前时段与切换倒计时、账户余额三颗 pill
description.zh: 在 DSH 状态栏实时显示本轮和会话花了多少钱，波峰波谷分时计价，还能看余额和时段倒计时。

description.en: User-editable CSS themes and background images for the DSH Web GUI and Desktop app, with pickers in Settings
description.zh: 在设置面板里自由换 CSS 主题和背景图，让 DSH 网页版和桌面版界面更好看、更顺手。

description.en: Database management plugin for DeepSeek Harness: SQLite and PostgreSQL connections, schema browser, SQL runner with a read-only guard, and a db tool the model can call.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里连 SQLite 和 PostgreSQL，浏览表结构、跑 SQL 看执行计划，模型也能通过 db 工具只读查库。

description.en: Tokyo Night 暗色 / 亮色主题 for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 桌面端 —— 注册进主题运行时的真实皮肤，含亚克力磨砂面板、材质模糊与等宽字体选择器。Tokyo Night dark & light themes for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Desktop — real theme-runtime skins with acrylic panels, material blur, and a monospace font picker.
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端换上 Tokyo Night 暗色/亮色皮肤，带亚克力磨砂面板和等宽字体选择。

description.en: Discussion mode for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - a sidebar-toggled design conversation where the agent consults as a domain expert, acting tools are denied, and only the user can end the mode. 讨论模式
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个讨论模式，让 AI 先当行业专家陪你聊清想法，动手工具全禁用，退出只能你来定。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-discuss-mode
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-discuss-mode

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Document review workbench: select text in a Markdown file, leave comments saved as MRSF sidecar files next to it, and let the agent read them with doc_review_* tools and propose edits you accept or reject.
description.zh: 文档批注台：在 Markdown 文档上划词写批注，批注按 MRSF 侧车文件存在文档旁，Agent 用 doc_review_* 工具读取并登记改动提案，你在批注页逐条接受或拒绝。

description.en: DSH plugin: drive the user's own Chrome/Edge with real login state — minimal Local State + Cookies copy, domain allowlist trimming, realtime watch panel, ego_local_doctor/ego_local_sync, local-browser settings page.
description.zh: 让 Agent 直接接管你本机已登录的 Chrome/Edge，免登录就能自动化操作网页。

description.en: Offline Beijing-time peak/idle indicator below the conversation composer, with a 2026 calendar, uncertainty labels, and brief peak reminders; no API key or runtime network access required.
description.zh: 会话输入框下方的离线北京时间峰谷指示器，内置 2026 年日历、待确认状态和短暂高峰提醒，运行时无需密钥或联网。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: 15 FlyMemory MCP tools, automatic recall and capture hooks, and a supervised local engine.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上长期记忆，自动记住并回忆对话内容，越用越懂你。

description.en: A GitHub Desktop-style Git panel for the DSH right sidebar: tick-to-stage, commit, commit and push, discard into a trash, and diff preview.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏里装个 GitHub Desktop 风格的 Git 面板，勾选暂存、提交推送、看 diff 一步到位。

description.en: Git panel in the right sidebar plus fifteen agent tools: editor-style diffs, a commit graph across every branch, staging and committing, branch, stash and remote operations, and model-assisted commit messages, pre-commit review and commit splitting.
description.zh: 右侧栏的 Git 面板与十五个 Agent 工具：编辑器式的差异、覆盖全部分支的提交图、暂存与提交、分支与贮藏与远程操作，以及由模型协助的提交说明、提交前审阅和拆分提交方案。

description.en: Go (weiqi) for the DeepSeek Harness: a full rules engine, a three-level built-in AI, a dead-stone estimator, optional LLM review, SGF import/export, and an optional KataGo GTP bridge.
description.zh: 圍棋插件：完整規則引擎、三檔內建 AI、死子估算、可選 LLM 覆盤、SGF 匯入匯出，以及可選的 KataGo GTP 引擎橋接。

description.en: Self-learning habit engine for DeepSeek Harness: correction signals, threshold judgment, two-level human gate · 自学习习惯引擎：观察纠正信号、阈值判断、两级人工门控
description.zh: Self-learning habit engine for the DeepSeek Harness — detects user-correction signals, judges habits with a low-cost model on threshold, settles candidates behind a two-level human gate

description.en: EN: Windows-only HarmonyOS workbench with 41 DSH tools and native agent presets. 中文：面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 原生鸿蒙开发工作台，包含 41 个 DSH 工具与原生鸿蒙预设。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里给原生鸿蒙开发配上工作台和 41 个工具，能构建、部署、查日志、控设备，还能跑 UI 自动化。

description.en: Panel entry for the official client-plugin hot reload that tells you what actually changed first: it diffs each row rev against the last seen state and reloads only the plugin bundles that changed, keeps whole-graph reloads behind an explicit confirmation (a bare call is refused and reports the affected row count), and reports replay counters so a silent no-op cannot hide.
description.zh: 把官方客户端插件热重载做成面板入口，并且先告诉你「到底变了什么」：比对每行 rev 与上次所见后只重载 bundle 变化的那几个插件；整图重载必须显式二次确认（不带参数会被拒绝并回报受影响行数）；同时暴露重放计数，让「点了没反应」无法被静默掩盖。

description.en: Draws circles, arrows, boxes and text on the DSH image preview, keeps every mark selectable so it can be dragged, scaled or re-edited later, and attaches the flattened PNG to the composer at the original image resolution.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的图片预览上圈选、画箭头、方框与文字，每一笔都能再选中拖动、缩放或改字，并把原分辨率的标注图作为附件放进输入框。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web 输入历史插件:↑/↓ 终端式翻查本会话消息,/history 可搜索面板;纯客户端,按会话隔离。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页里用 ↑/↓ 快速翻查本会话历史消息，还能用 /history 打开搜索面板，纯本地按会话隔离。

description.en: 隔离舱：在 DSH 主会话之外运行受沙箱约束的隔离任务；主会话默认完全无感，结果返回与文件导出都要手动确认。
description.zh: 在主会话之外跑沙箱隔离任务，全程无感，结果和文件导出都得你手动确认。

description.en: LAN-only remote access for DSH: pair a phone or another PC by QR code or token to open the same web UI, with optional key-free access inside the LAN.
description.zh: 仅内网的远程访问：手机或另一台电脑通过扫码或令牌接入同一份 DSH Web 界面，并可选内网免密钥直连。

description.en: LaTeX compile gate + VTO typesetting loop for DeepSeek Harness: MiKTeX-native, 10 tools, 3 skills, persistent defect ledger, and a Plugins-page configuration form
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web 界面 LaTeX 公式复制插件：悬停公式浮现复制按钮，一键复制公式的 TeX 源码。
description.zh: 悬停公式或表格就能一键复制 TeX 源码和 GFM 表格文本，粘贴不再乱码。

description.en: Registers a local LLM provider that routes model calls to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint or the Ollama native API, with a connection-test card in the Models settings page and no account sign-in.
description.zh: 注册一个本地 LLM provider，把模型请求转发到 OpenAI 兼容端点或 Ollama 原生 API，并在「设置 → 模型」页提供连接测试卡片，无需登录账号。

description.en: Adds Chilean Spanish (es-CL) to the Web UI language list: 2,603 strings across 57 namespaces, with per-key fallback to English.
description.zh: 为 Web 界面新增智利西班牙语（es-CL）：57 个命名空间、2603 条文案，缺失项按 key 回退英文。

description.en: Adds the dshmarket plugin market to the DSH sidebar as a panel of its own, ordered above the built-in Plugins entry. Clicking the entry renders the market through the client service dshmarket publishes for hosts, so the catalog, category filters, comments and install and update flows are the ones dshmarket ships rather than a copy of them. Nothing to learn or configure: the panel is the market, with its own sidebar entry, label in Chinese or English to match the interface language, and icon. If dshmarket is not loaded the panel says so instead of failing client composition, and its locale keys, slots and style tag are released when the plugin unloads.
description.zh: 把 dshmarket 插件市场作为独立面板放进 DSH 侧边栏，排在「插件」之上。点击即通过 dshmarket 对外发布的 host 端 client service 渲染市场本身，因此目录、分类筛选、评论与安装/更新流程都是 dshmarket 自己的，而不是一份副本。无需学习或配置：这个面板就是市场，有自己的侧边栏条目、跟随界面语言的中英文名与图标。dshmarket 未加载时面板会明说，而不是让客户端组装失败；插件卸载时其语言键、插槽与 style 标签一并释放。

description.en: Long-term memory scoped to the DSH workspace. A session opens with a one-line-per-memory index - bodies are fetched on demand by the `memory` tool, so the same character budget holds about three times as many entries - and when a turn ends a purely local search over the last user message pulls the matching memories into the next briefing at no model cost. Optional auto-capture distils a stretch of conversation into structured memories; in draft mode they wait in an approval queue instead of landing directly. A portrait layer keeps a workspace and a global picture, rewritten from the journal and the records, with the same draft-or-direct choice. Settings → Memory holds the archive, list and timeline views, a health check (duplicate clusters, stale entries, broken links), the supersede version chain with rollback, and a read-only scan that imports existing WorkBuddy / Qoder memory files.
description.zh: DSH 的工作区长期记忆。会话开始只注入「一行一条」的记忆索引，正文由 memory 工具按需取——同样字数预算约装三倍条目；一轮结束时用当轮最后一条用户消息做纯本地检索，命中的记忆下一轮随简报召回，不花模型 token。可选自动提炼把一段对话归纳成结构化记忆，captureMode=draft 时先进审批队列、你批准了才生效。另有画像层：工作区与全局各一份全貌，由日志与条目重写生成，同样可走草稿。设置 → 记忆 里有档案 / 列表 / 时间线、体检（重复簇、过期未用、断链）、版本链 supersede 与一键回滚，以及「扫描本机」把已有的 WorkBuddy / Qoder 记忆文件导入（只读，不动来源）。

description.en: Add MiniMax image understanding, image generation, speech synthesis, and transcription tools to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 MiniMax 识图、文生图、语音合成和语音转写工具。

description.en: Per-model and per-provider enable/disable switches, plus third-party thinking-effort rules, for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) desktop app. Unofficial; app.asar untouched.
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面版加上按模型、按服务商单独开关，还能自定义第三方思考强度规则，不用改 app.asar。

description.en: Model failover router that queues all connected DSH models, retries with continue text on failure, switches to next model, and quarantines failing models for the day.
description.zh: 模型接力路由器：将已接入 DSH 的全部模型排成优先级队列，失败时自动重试「继续」，不行则切换下一模型，并将故障模型隔离至次日。

description.en: Replace the model picker with global search, favorites, recent selections, model-family navigation, and reasoning effort selection.
description.zh: 替换模型选择器，提供全局搜索、收藏、最近使用、模型家族导航与思维强度选择。

description.en: 模型选择 · 子代理路由 · 推理层级 — DSH Web GUI 的三分区模型菜单插件
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里一键切换模型、推理强度和子代理模型，让不同任务各用各的配置。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 只读“挂载”面板——快速查看指南、技能、MCP服务器及代理预设 Read-only "mounts" panel for DeepSeek Harness — instructions, skills, MCP servers and Agent Presets at a glance.
description.zh: 一个只读面板，让你一眼看清 DeepSeek Harness 里挂了哪些指南、技能、MCP 服务器和代理预设。

description.en: Windows toast notifications when a DeepSeek Harness task finishes: the session title, the outcome, and a summary of the final reply, sent once when the agent really stops rather than once per round of a running goal.
description.zh: DSH 任务完成时，在 Windows 通知栏弹出原生通知，带上会话标题、结果状态与最后一条回复的摘要；在 agent 真正停下来时才发一条，而不是每跑一个回合就响一次。

description.en: Linux desktop notifications and a chime for DeepSeek Harness, sent by the host process so they still arrive with the browser page closed: turn completion, pending questions, tool approvals and turn errors, delivered through notify-send and paplay with a canberra-gtk-play fallback. A browser half adds an in-page toast, a Web Notification and a synthesized Web Audio chime as fallback; every switch lives in a Settings page or a JSON file.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Linux 桌面通知与提示音，由宿主进程发出，浏览器页面关闭后依然可达：回合结束、等待选择、工具批准与回合出错四类事件，走 notify-send 与 paplay（回退 canberra-gtk-play）。浏览器半身作为兜底提供页内浮层、Web Notification 与 Web Audio 合成提示音；所有开关都在设置页或 JSON 配置文件中。

description.en: DSH Desktop 插件：小说创作搭档 —— 边提问边完善世界观/人物/情节，每章先写大纲给作者改，定稿后再写正文。
description.zh: 写小说时边聊边搭世界观和人物，每章先出大纲让你改，定稿后再自动写正文。

description.en: Your real Obsidian vault in the DSH right Sidebar: the vault tree, full-vault search, notes rendered with read-view typography, wikilink navigation, in-place editing, and a clickable outline.
description.zh: 把你真实的 Obsidian 知识库放进 DSH 右侧栏：目录树、全库搜索、按阅读视图排版渲染笔记、双向链接跳转、就地编辑，以及可点击跳转的笔记大纲。

description.en: Bottom terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI, providing multi-tab interactive terminals powered by node-pty (Windows ConPTY / POSIX openpty) with split panes, a side terminal list, and a dropdown new/split menu. Also compatible with DSH-better-sidebar — auto-detected at runtime, it switches to a bottom workbench tab so PTY sessions do not bind the DSH session write handle.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 底部终端面板插件，基于 node-pty 提供多标签交互式终端（Windows ConPTY / POSIX openpty），支持拆分面板、右侧终端列表与下拉新建/拆分菜单。同时兼容 DSH-better-sidebar——运行时自动检测并切换为底部工作台 tab，PTY 会话不绑定 DSH session 的 write handle。

description.en: OpenCode Zen free models as a native DSH/RDSH provider plugin: authenticated loopback relay, isolated upstream client, MIT.
description.zh: 在 DSH/RDSH 里直接用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，装好就能聊，无需额外配置。

description.en: Pick the model your subagents run on — with a reasoning-effort ceiling and an output-token cap — enforced in code on every child DSH starts, whichever tool starts it.
description.zh: 自己选定子代理运行的模型——附带推理力度上限和输出 token 上限——在代码层面对 DSH 启动的每一个子代理强制执行，无论它由哪个工具启动。

description.en: A composer switch between running always and running only in off-peak hours, set per session: a task is judged by the session that owns it, so changing one session no longer changes the others, and a session without its own choice follows a default. In off-peak mode every task, including one already running, is held at its next agent step or tool dispatch when a Beijing peak window starts (Monday to Friday 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00, statutory holidays excluded), and one timer releases it at the boundary; weekends and holidays are idle all day. The holiday calendar lists every statutory day off in 2025 and 2026 from the State Council notices, and a year with no data is reported as unknown rather than assumed to be a workday.
description.zh: 在「全天运行」与「仅空闲时段运行」之间切换，且按会话独立：任务按所属会话判定，改一个会话不再影响其他会话，没有单独设置的会话跟随默认值。选择空闲模式后，任务（含正在运行的）在进入北京高峰时段（周一至周五 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00，法定节假日除外）时，会在下一个 agent 步进或工具分发边界被扣住，并由一个定时器在边界时刻精确放行；周末与法定节假日全天为空闲。内置 2025、2026 年国务院办公厅公布的逐日放假数据，无数据的年份如实标为未知，而不是默认按工作日处理。

description.en: Compiles an LLM persona in DSH from six dimensions (identity, tone, creative habits, feedback style, boundaries, run parameters), injects the compiled text into the system prompt at the end, ships six built-in templates plus a drop-in templates folder, and drafts a persona from your own past messages — either by counting patterns in them or by having the current model read them and report its rationale. Adds a panel next to the composer and a /persona command.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里把 LLM 的人格拆成六个维度（身份、语气、创作习惯、反馈方式、边界、运行参数）编译成一段提示词，注入系统提示词末尾；内置六套模板并支持直接丢文件的模板目录；还能读你过往消息归纳出人格草案——或统计成文，或让当前模型深读并给出判断依据。附带输入框旁的悬浮面板与 /persona 命令。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：右侧栏每日习惯看板 + 主区域统计页。
description.zh: 在右侧栏打卡记录每日习惯，主面板看统计和专注时长，还能给任务和书影写笔记。

description.en: A desk pet that floats over the DSH interface and opens into a daily check-in, focus timer and habit journal.
description.zh: 浮动在 DSH 界面上的桌宠，点开是打卡、专注计时与生活手帐。

description.en: Adds a toggle to the DSH UI that opens the current session to a phone browser through an embedded loopback reverse proxy and a Cloudflare quick tunnel, and pushes each new tunnel address to WeChat.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里加一个开关，经由内嵌的 loopback 反向代理与 Cloudflare 快速隧道把当前会话开放给手机浏览器，并把每次的新隧道地址推送到微信。

description.en: DSH plugin: talk to your DeepSeek Harness from your phone. Send text and photos, read replies as they stream — across any network via your own Tailscale tailnet. 用手机跟电脑上的 DSH 对话，不同 Wi-Fi 也能用。
description.zh: 用手机远程跟电脑上的 DSH 聊天，发文字传照片，回复实时流式显示，跨网络也能用。

description.en: dsh plugin: bills every model call into a monthly JSONL cost ledger - token buckets, cache reads, off-peak rules (/ledger /ledger-export)
description.zh: 把每次模型调用都记进月度成本账本，按 token 分类统计，还能导出查看花销。

description.en: Custom Chinese nicknames for dsh plugins, displayed directly in the native plugin list.
description.zh: 给 dsh 插件列表里的插件自定义中文备注名，直接显示在原生设置页。

description.en: Adds sessions without a workspace to DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DSH 能一键开个不占项目工作区的临时会话，输入区照常好用。

description.en: Shows whether the DeepSeek API is currently billing at the off-peak or peak rate in the sidebar brand row, with the Chinese statutory-holiday calendar built in and zh/en copy.
description.zh: 在侧边栏品牌位显示 DeepSeek API 当前按空闲还是高峰时段计费，内置中国法定节假日与调休日历，中英双语。

description.en: dsh plugin: cross-session pinboard - pinned notes ride into every session's system prompt under a token budget (/pin /unpin /pins, pin_add)
description.zh: 在任意会话里 /pin 一条便签，之后每个会话都会自动带上它，长期约定不用反复交代。

description.en: dsh plugin: makes the agent know what it costs - live relay credits, per-model price, pre-task estimates and a budget gate (price_status, quote_task)
description.zh: 让编码助手实时看到花了多少钱，按模型算价、预估任务成本，超预算自动拦下。

description.en: Search field on the DeepSeek Harness Plugins page that filters the installed and official plugin cards as you type, matching each card title, description and package name; space-separated keywords must all match.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness「插件」页加一条关键词搜索框：边输入边过滤已安装与官方插件卡片，命中范围是卡片标题、描述与包名，空格分隔的多个关键词之间是 AND。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: shows the current session's spend, priced by DeepSeek's peak and off-peak rate windows.
description.zh: 实时显示当前会话花了多少钱，按 DeepSeek 峰谷时段分别计价，帮你随时掌握开销。

description.en: Open your DeepSeek Harness desktop Web UI from your phone over your own Tailscale tailnet — one switch, no port forwarding, no public exposure.
description.zh: 用手机通过自己的 Tailscale 网络打开电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面，不用端口转发也不暴露公网。

description.en: Enforce strict checks as dsh harness policy: repeated-failure intervention, a glob-protected critical-path gate that blocks with diagnostics, and an automatic post-write check.
description.zh: 把严格检查变成硬性策略：重复失败自动干预，关键路径写入前先拦截并给出诊断。

description.en: File-defined command hooks across the session, prompt, tool, permission, Stop and PostCompact seams, with an approval-only GUI: no unapproved command runs, and approval binds the exact definition, canonical working directory and pinned watchFiles. Commands run as the DSH OS user without a hook sandbox, so the trust ledger is explicit.
description.zh: 文件声明的命令钩子，覆盖会话、提问、工具、审批、Stop 与压缩后等事件，配套只读审批界面：未经批准的命令不执行，批准绑定精确定义、实际执行目录与 watchFiles 固定内容。命令以 DSH 系统用户身份运行且无独立沙箱，因此信任记录是显式的。

description.en: MCP server console under Plugins: manage the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client at runtime — add/edit/delete servers, enable/disable/reconnect, per-tool switches, live status and tool lists over SSE, mcpServers JSON import, and auto-migration of profile-YAML MCP entries; an uninstall leaves a native fallback block that keeps the same servers loadable.
description.zh: 插件页 MCP 服务器控制台：运行时管理官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client——新增/编辑/删除服务器、启停/重连、工具级开关、SSE 实时状态与工具列表、mcpServers JSON 导入、自动迁移 profile YAML 里的 MCP 条目；卸载后留下原生 fallback 块，同一批服务器仍可加载。

description.en: Safe detached DSH restart: /restart and /dsh-restart slash commands with native candidate styling plus a dsh_restart agent tool; a detached worker restarts DSH after 3 seconds without freezing the session, and Windows/macOS use a native Node helper built on the official appExit service.
description.zh: 安全的分离式 DSH 重启：/restart 与 /dsh-restart 斜杠命令（原生候选样式）加 dsh_restart Agent 工具；分离的 worker 在 3 秒后重启 DSH 且会话不冻结，Windows/macOS 走基于官方 appExit 服务的原生 Node helper。

description.en: Refine prompts with guided questions and editable previews using Harness AI or native Codex across Web, desktop and TUI, applying drafts only after user confirmation.
description.zh: 在 Web、桌面端和 TUI 中使用 Harness AI 或原生 Codex 澄清并优化提示词，预览可编辑，确认后仅填入草稿。

description.en: A prompt optimizer in the composer input tool row: pick a category and a template, then ✨ rewrites the draft in place with one-click undo. Pick from the Basic, Context and Image categories; you can cancel a run, and it shows elapsed time and token usage. Ships 15 templates covering task-instruction rewriting, step planning, safety-research framing, system-prompt role cards, and text-to-image / image-to-image prompts; context templates read the recent turns of the session for coreference resolution. Calls go through the host model service, and a settings section exposes the model and the budgets. Output guards check that user-written constraints survive, warning rather than auto-retrying. Adapted for dsh 0.1.7 and 0.2.
description.zh: 给对话输入框工具行加一个提示词优化器：选类别（基础 / 上下文 / 图像）与模板，点 ✨ 即原地改写草稿，支持一键还原。可取消，并显示耗时与 token 用量。内置 15 个模板，覆盖任务指令改写、需求步骤化规划、逆向/安全研究语境与系统提示词角色卡，以及文生图与图生图提示词。上下文类模板会读取当前会话最近几轮用于消歧。调用走宿主模型服务，设置分区可调模型与各项预算；输出守卫会核对用户明写的约束是否保留，只告警不自动重试。适配 dsh 0.1.7 与 0.2 系列。

description.en: Keeps quotes out of the message body: quoting any passage from an assistant turn opens an editable quote tray above the composer, the quotes are injected into the next turn as system-prompt context (attributed with source and time), and an expandable quote row under that turn shows exactly which quotes were used. Quotes persist across page reloads and are claimed per turn; the host and client halves hand-shake on version and report a compatibility verdict.
description.zh: 把引用与消息正文彻底分开：引用任意助手回合里的段落会打开输入框上方的引用行，随下一回合作为 system-prompt 上下文注入模型（带来源与时间标注），并在回合尾部以可展开的「引用(N)」行显示这一轮到底用了哪几条；引用本地落盘、刷新不丢、按回合认领；宿主与客户端两半体做版本握手并上报兼容结论。

description.en: Quote text selected in a DSH Web conversation, then either attach it to the current composer or dispatch it to a subagent session: the quote sits on a bar above the composer, or opens that subagent in a new pane on the right. When the target has no subagent yet, the quote is held and the composer is seeded with a spawn request, then picked up automatically once the new session appears. Client-only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页版会话里划词后，把选中内容引用到当前输入框，或分派到子智能体会话：引用落在输入框正上方的引用条上，或在右侧新开一格打开该子智能体会话。目标还没有子智能体时先挂起这条引用，并在输入框写入派生请求，新子会话一出现就自动接续。纯客户端。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 朗读插件：多声线 TTS + RVC 变声 + 离线兜底，零 token 消耗
description.zh: 让 DSH 把聊天文字用多种声线读出来，支持自动朗读、RVC 本地变声和离线兜底，全程本地合成不耗 token。

description.en: Double-click one of your own messages to rewrite it and continue in a new branch from that point.
description.zh: 双击自己发送的消息即可修改，并从该处开一条新分支继续。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the DSH Web UI through a loopback-only endpoint that requests a relaunch using the current process executable, arguments and working directory.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面添加基于本机回环接口的重启按钮，按当前进程的可执行文件、参数和工作目录请求重新启动。

description.en: Right-to-left reading mode for the conversation answer area, with a button to switch back to left-to-right.
description.zh: 为对话回答区域提供从右到左的阅读模式，并提供按钮一键切回从左到右。

description.en: DSH 会话管理插件：删除（回收站恢复/彻底清除/一键清空）、强制删除异常会话、恢复归档会话、统计、继续/暂停、打开日志目录、未读标记、工作区分组与排序、上下文压缩阈值。DSH session manager: recoverable trash, empty trash, force delete, stats, continue/pause, log folder, workspace grouping, compaction threshold.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里管会话：删除可回收、恢复归档、看统计、暂停继续、分组排序，还能设压缩阈值。

description.en: Session trash: move conversations to a trash instead of deleting them, restore them, or delete them permanently after a second confirmation; a session opened in this run is hidden and moved at the next start.
description.zh: 会话回收站：把对话移到回收站而不是直接删除，可以恢复，或再次确认后永久删除；本次启动中打开过的会话先隐藏，下次启动时再移入。

description.en: DSH 会话保险库：归档恢复、可恢复回收站、批量管理与安全永久清除
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话的归档、回收站和批量管理集中到一个设置页，误删也能随时恢复。

description.en: Read-only CSV/XLSX comparison by business keys, with offline HTML review and exportable comments.
description.zh: 按业务主键对齐 CSV/XLSX 改动，生成本地 HTML 审阅报告并导出逐条评论。

description.en: iOS 26 liquid-glass skin: one white-grey-blue fog field behind the whole window, a single 40px frost on top of it, a floating glass sidebar and reply bubbles. Light and dark palettes, no photo wallpaper, no dependencies (33 KB).
description.zh: iOS 26 液态玻璃皮肤：整窗共用一层白→灰→淡蓝的静态雾场，雾上只磨一次（blur 40px），左侧栏是悬浮玻璃卡，回复是一条气泡；浅深两套配色，不用照片壁纸，零依赖（33 KB）。

description.en: Rewinds a session to before a chosen user turn, from a button beside Copy under your own message — the model-visible surface is replaced in place and the interface hides the rewound turns, without patching DSH source or deleting the original session log.
description.zh: 在你自己的消息下方、与「复制」并排的回退按钮，把会话退回该轮发起之前——模型可见历史就地遮蔽，界面同步隐藏被回退的轮次，不改 DSH 本体源码、不删原始日志。

description.en: SSH workspaces for Windows DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2: discover OpenSSH hosts, add or browse remote project directories, and route file, search and Bash operations by workspace while the DSH runtime stays local. A Desktop compatibility fork of Yan-Zero/dsh-remote-ssh that preserves local permission defaults.
description.zh: 为 Windows DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2 提供 SSH 工作区：发现 OpenSSH 主机、添加或浏览远端项目目录，按工作区路由文件、搜索与 Bash 操作，DSH 运行时仍在本地。基于 Yan-Zero/dsh-remote-ssh 的 Desktop 兼容分支，保留本地默认权限。

description.en: Adds a sticker pack to DeepSeek Harness replies. The plugin rolls the dice, the model attaches the chosen sticker at the end of its reply, and the pictures come from a remote pack.json you can host anywhere.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的回复加上表情包。贴不贴由插件掷骰决定，模型把选中的图放到回复末尾；图库来自一个可以自己托管的远端 pack.json。

description.en: EN: Lifecycle-safe subagent routing and role controls for DSH Web. 中文：面向 DSH Web 的生命周期安全子代理路由与角色控制。
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 的子代理做安全路由和角色管控，多代理协作更稳更可控。

description.en: Route DSH subagent delegations to configured models with per-role routing for explore, plan and patch subagents, round-robin or random distribution, cross-provider failover, and active-window slicing of fork seeds.
description.zh: 为 DSH 子代理派发按角色（探索 / 规划 / 修补）分流到指定模型，支持轮换或随机分配、跨供应商故障转移，并对 fork 种子做活跃窗口切片。

description.en: Adds an Assist button beside the composer send key. It scans the skills and MCP tools available in the session, ranks them against the text currently in the input box, and lets you inject the selected ones into the running conversation as a steering message.
description.zh: 在对话框发送键旁添加一个「辅助」按钮：扫描本会话可用的技能与 MCP 工具，按输入框里的当前草稿排序，并可把选中的技能作为 steering 消息注入正在运行的对话。

description.en: Floating token & cost monitor for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在窗口边缘挂个悬浮小窗，随时看余额、当前对话耗了多少 token、花了多少钱，还能拖动收起。

description.en: Strict checker for dsh: verify code and commands with real checkers - Lean 4 kernel checking, language compilers, and harness-shell hazard rules.
description.zh: 用真正的编译器、Lean 4 内核和危险命令规则来校验代码与命令，别再自己反复看 diff 了。

description.en: Adds a delete-session action that permanently removes session logs, workspace entries and archives.
description.zh: 增加删除会话的操作，永久移除会话日志、工作区条目与归档。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 翻译模式：Agent 预设（只返回译文）+ 动态插件控件（语言/风格设置）+ 18 语 i18n
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 翻译模式：Agent 预设（只返回译文）+ 动态插件控件（语言/风格设置）+ 18 语 i18n

description.en: Bridge to the UnrealAgentLink editor plugin: the Unreal Engine editor dials this WebSocket bridge on 127.0.0.1:17860 and the agent drives it through 12 tools covering all 170 cataloged commands (actors, levels, blueprints, materials, PCG, screenshots, logs, undo).
description.zh: UnrealAgentLink 编辑器插件的桥接端：Unreal 编辑器拨入 127.0.0.1:17860 的 WebSocket 桥，agent 由此用 12 个工具驱动全部 170 个已编目命令（Actor、关卡、蓝图、材质、PCG、截图、日志、撤销）。

description.en: White-box memory in two parts: four user-authored long-term tiers (must-follow rules, behavior settings, user profile, optional rules) injected as one system-prompt section, plus a separate temporary working set (cross-session handoffs, stage goals, waiting items) with its own 1200-character budget that stops being injected once an entry is done. The long-term tiers are plain Markdown files the user can read and edit; the agent can only propose them, and nothing is written until the user accepts in the Chinese panel. Temporary entries are written only when the user explicitly asks, and live in <DSH_HOME>/temp-memory.json (created on first write), not in the memory directory. No auto-capture, no background writes, no network.
description.zh: 白箱两段记忆：四层用户自写的长期记忆（必须遵守／行为设定／用户画像／可选遵守）注入为系统提示词的一节；另有「临时记忆」（跨对话交接／阶段目标／等待项）独立成节、独立预算（默认 1200 字），条目完结即停止注入。长期记忆是记忆目录里可读可改的 Markdown 文件，AI 只能提议，用户在中文面板点「采纳」才写入；临时记忆只在用户明确要求时写入，存放在 <DSH_HOME>/temp-memory.json（首次写入才创建），不在记忆目录里。不自动采集、不后台回写、不联网。

description.en: Plays local video and audio inside the conversation. Media files the model writes during a turn - screen recordings, transcodes, voiceovers - get a player under its final reply automatically when their paths appear in its commands, the command output or the reply; the play_video tool plays any other file. Video shows as compact cards with a hover preview, audio as a slim seek bar, streamed over HTTP Range so long files seek instead of loading into memory. Also registers a sidebar media preview renderer, since the built-in previewer treats mp4 as unviewable.
description.zh: 在对话流里直接播放本地视频和音频。模型这一轮写出的媒体文件（录屏、转码、配音），只要路径出现在它跑的命令、命令输出或回复里，回合收尾时播放器就自动出现在回复正下方，不用调工具；别的文件用 play_video 工具播放。视频是带悬停预览的小卡片，音频是可拖进度的细条，走 HTTP Range 流式传输，长视频能拖进度条、不会整个读进内存。同时注册了侧边栏媒体预览渲染器——内置预览器把 mp4 当作不可预览。

description.en: Adds two Volcengine Doubao cloud speech recognizers to the DeepSeek Harness voice-input picker, optionally rewriting the transcript with an LLM.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的语音输入加入两个豆包云端识别器，可选再用大模型把口语顺成通顺的书面句子。

description.en: Multi-provider web_search router for DeepSeek Harness with prioritized fallback, cooldowns and host-managed credentials.
description.zh: 按优先级调度多个搜索服务，自动切换备用，让联网搜索更稳定高效。

description.en: divination plugin for DeepSeek Harness desktop

Codex-style Create Workspace dialog: name it and the folder is created for you, or pick one with a native chooser that remembers where you were (the native chooser is Windows-only; elsewhere use the name field).
description.zh: Codex 式的创建工作区对话框：填名称就自动建出目录，或者选文件夹——原生选择窗口会记得你上次在哪（原生选择窗口仅 Windows 可用，其它平台请直接填名称）。

description.en: Custom sidebar workspace groups for DeepSeek Harness - group directories, drag to regroup and reorder, per-group session browsing and content search, with a one-click fallback to the official workspace list.
description.zh: 在侧边栏以自定义分组组织工作目录 - 拖拽变更分组与顺序、组内会话浏览与内容搜索，可一键切回官方工作区列表。

description.en: Hierarchical workspace tree and multi-view manager for DSH: workspace and session naming creates virtual folders (/), multi-view support (workspace tree, flat workspaces, single list, time timeline), session pinning, and independent sections for workspaces and sessions.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏工作区层级树与视图增强：名称中的 / 自动解析为虚拟分组，提供按工作区树、按工作区、单列表与时间线四种视图，支持会话置顶与工作区/会话独立分区管理。

description.en: Deep-space theme for the Harness Web GUI: two fully designed light and dark palettes over a seamless cross-dissolve nebula wallpaper, plus a model probe that reports which configured models actually answer and their real context window.
description.zh: 深空观测站主题：浅色与深色两套完整设计，衬在无痕交叉溶解的星云动态壁纸之上；附带模型检验面板，告诉你哪些模型真的可用、真实上下文窗口有多大。

description.en: Endless memory for the DeepSeek harness: your agent never forgets. After Victor Taelin's OptChat spec.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek 智能体装上永久记忆，聊过的事它都记得，再也不用反复交代。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-elephant-memory
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for elephant-memory

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: DSH plugin: offline official Godot documentation as agent tools - ranked search, class/member/enum lookup, and API checks against the engine version the project really uses. / 把本地 Godot 官方文档变成 DSH 的离线文档工具链。
description.zh: 把本地 Godot 官方文档变成离线查询工具，按项目实际引擎版本搜类、查成员、验 API。

description.en: Local art pipeline for DSH: drives the locally installed SD WebUI and ComfyUI backends through ten image_* tools and an Art Studio sidebar panel with an embedded ComfyUI canvas, post-processes with the Python shipped with those installs (rembg cutout, Real-ESRGAN upscale, seamless tiling), and writes Godot-ready assets with res:// paths once a project root is set.
description.zh: 本机美术流水线：把本机已装的 SD WebUI 与 ComfyUI 接进 DSH——10 个 image_* 工具 + 「美术工坊」侧边栏面板（内嵌 ComfyUI 画布），用整合包自带的 Python 做抠图 / 放大 / 无缝平铺后处理；填写 Godot 项目根目录后，产物直接落成带 res:// 路径的游戏资产。

description.en: Registers one `ocr` tool for text-only models: it runs the offline script bundled in the repo over a single image or PDF and returns the recognized text — Windows native OCR first, then RapidOCR, then Tesseract. Recognition runs locally with no network request and no API key. Needs Python 3.11 on PATH plus `pip install winocr pillow` (winocr is the preferred engine; RapidOCR and Tesseract are fallbacks). Per-line results for images, per-page results for PDFs.
description.zh: 为纯文本模型注册一个 `ocr` 工具：调用仓库自带的离线脚本识别单张图片或 PDF 并返回文字——Windows 原生 OCR 优先，其次 RapidOCR，最后 Tesseract；识别过程在本机完成，不发网络请求、不需要 API key。需自备 PATH 上的 Python 3.11 并 `pip install winocr pillow`（winocr 为首选引擎，RapidOCR 与 Tesseract 为兜底）。图片返回逐行结果，PDF 返回逐页结果。

description.en: Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: a persistent PowerShell UIA backend behind 16 merged MCP entries (read/click/type/observe/verify), a hardened policy layer (red lines, approvals, observation binding, point-ownership and focus guards) and a performance pass (prewarm, caching, pixel-hash stability probe). Fork of dsh-computer-use-win.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的 Windows 计算机操作插件：常驻 PowerShell UIA 后端，对外只有 16 个合并入口（读取/点击/输入/观测/验证）；带加固的策略层（红线拒绝、显式审批、观测绑定、落点归属与前台焦点守卫）与一轮性能优化（后端预热、缓存、像素哈希稳定探测）。fork 自 dsh-computer-use-win。

description.en: Chinese multi-agent workflow with per-role model fallback, versioned Mermaid task plans, independent Agent and Jev reviews, persistent expert collaboration, and pure-function calculation tools.
description.zh: 中文多智能体工作流，支持按角色配置模型回退、版本化 Mermaid 任务规划、独立 Agent 与 Jev 审核、专家持久化协作和纯函数计算工具。

issues.detail: declares install-time scripts; the harness gates them via allowBuilds

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-agent-swarm
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-agent-swarm

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: DSH 酒馆插件，支持角色扮演单聊、群聊，把聊天写成小说；支持配置 ComfyUI 画图，台词语音合成。/ Aha Tavern: DSH Tavern Plugin, supporting roleplay single chat and group chat, turning chats into novels; supports ComfyUI configuration for drawing and dialog speech synthesis.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里开一间酒馆，和角色单聊群聊、把对话写成小说，还能配 ComfyUI 画图和语音合成。

description.en: DSH Markdown manuscript review plugin source: annotations, proposals, version comparison, figures and BibTeX
description.zh: 审阅 Markdown 论文稿，支持批注、修改建议、版本对比，还能处理图表和 BibTeX。

description.en: Dual avatars (user + assistant) for the DeepSeek Harness chat transcript, with an Avatars settings page.
description.zh: 给聊天记录加上用户和助手双头像，一眼分清谁在说话，还能在设置页里换头像。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek account balance and the current peak / off-peak phase in the sidebar, and estimates per-session and per-turn cost using the official peak and off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示 DeepSeek 余额和峰谷时段，还能按官方价估算每轮和每个会话的花费。

description.en: Role-play plugin for DeepSeek Harness: imports SillyTavern character cards (JSON/PNG) and world books (lorebooks), binds DSH skills to a character, and registers the combination as a native agent preset.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 角色扮演插件：导入 SillyTavern 角色卡（JSON/PNG）与世界书（lorebook），为角色绑定 DSH 技能，并注册为原生 agent preset。

description.en: Theme that pairs Windows XP-era scenery wallpapers with a modern frosted-glass interface: a fixed background layer behind the DeepSeek Harness web UI, panel styling applied through theme tokens, a wallpaper picker with custom image import, and a light/dark toggle. Works on desktop and mobile web surfaces.
description.zh: 让 XP 时代的风景壁纸与现代磨砂玻璃界面同框的主题：DeepSeek Harness Web 界面 之下的固定壁纸底板、经主题 token 应用的面板玻璃样式、支持导入自定义图片的 壁纸选择器与明暗切换按钮——桌面与移动端均可使用。

description.en: DSH 中文合规与工程技能集（7 个技能）：对外文案合规红线、AI 生成内容标识、个人信息保护对照、应用市场上架预检、中文公文排版（GB/T 9704-2012）、发布前自检、密钥扫描。全部离线静态检查，不联网、不上传。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加 7 个中文合规与工程技能，文案红线、AI 标识、公文排版、发布自检全离线搞定。

description.en: Adds a Chinese-mode toggle beside the composer that opens a panel for switching reply, reasoning, and tool-narration language, persisted in the profile.
description.zh: 在输入框左侧加一个中文模式开关，点开可分别切换回复、思考与工具说明的语言，配置随 profile 持久化。

description.en: Windowed compaction, session-private notes and paged history recall for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话做窗口化压缩、私有笔记和分页历史回溯，长对话不再爆上下文。

description.en: 列出并删除 DSH 已归档会话：默认移入回收站可恢复，带二次确认与日志归属校验。
description.zh: 把 DSH 里已归档的会话列出来并删掉，默认进回收站可恢复，删前还得二次确认。

description.en: Customizes the DSH home sidebar plugin entries without harness source changes: one- or two-column panel list, icon-only mode with 500ms hover tooltips, and per-entry ordering, hiding, and a settings page for the upper panel area and the footer plugin row.
description.zh: 无需改动 Harness 源码即可自定义主页侧边栏的插件入口：上方面板列表支持单栏/双栏与仅图标（悬浮 500ms 显示名称），底部插件行支持默认横向/单列/双列，两个区域均可逐条目排序、显示或隐藏，并提供设置页。

description.en: Geodesic math toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): great-circle distance, bearings, destination points, DMS parsing, rhumb lines, path intersections, spherical polygon areas — zero runtime dependencies
description.zh: 地理计算工具箱，提供球面距离、方位角、目标点、DMS解析等 geodesy 数学函数，零依赖即插即用。

description.en: Git repository connector for DeepSeek Harness: saved repo profiles addressed by name, work-copy operations (clone/fetch/pull/push/commit), Gitea/Forgejo/GitHub API tools, keys in the DSH credential center, and per-repo safety flags (TLS bypass, overwrite, force push).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 仓库连接：按档案名操作仓库（clone/fetch/pull/push/commit）、Gitea/Forgejo/GitHub API、密钥存 DSH 凭据中心，并按仓库单独授权忽略证书/允许覆盖/force push 等危险开关。

description.en: Deterministic goal-completion gate for DSH: a contract-first AC grammar with named failable check commands, a gate that re-runs every check itself (zero model trust), verdicts bound to a tree digest so file changes void passing verdicts, and a hard deny on false completion at update_goal via tools/pre-execute with a false-complete counter that blocks after two catches; scope-aware task-level claim handling (strict or goal-only) keeps multi-task Agent Teams loops from deadlocking.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性目标门控插件：契约先行的 AC 文法（每条检查都是可失败的具名命令），门控自己重跑每条检查、零模型参与；verdict 绑定文件树摘要，文件改动即作废已过审结论；通过 tools/pre-execute 硬拦 update_goal 的完成声明，配合假完成计数，两次被抓住即 BLOCKED；任务级完成声明按作用域分级（strict/goal-only），多任务 Agent Teams 循环不会死锁。

description.en: Hand a command-line-verified operation over to the GUI: drive it once, verify with ground truth, and hand back a self-contained illustrated tutorial.
description.zh: 把命令行验证过的操作交接给图形界面：自己驱动一遍、用地面真值验证，并产出人能照着做的自包含带图教程。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with automatic model distillation, source-linked encrypted session logs, and guarded compaction.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分层长期记忆，支持自动模型提炼、可追溯的加密会话日志和带校验的记忆压缩。

description.en: Read and write Apple iCloud Calendar over CalDAV through five tools: list calendars, read a window with recurring events expanded, create an event, and delete behind a dry run that must confirm the exact object count. Credentials come from DPAPI, Keychain or libsecret, or from an environment variable.
description.zh: 通过 CalDAV 读写苹果 iCloud 日历，提供五个工具：列出日历、按时间窗读取并展开重复日程、创建事件，以及先干跑、按对象数确认后再删除。凭据保存在 DPAPI／钥匙串／libsecret 或环境变量中。

description.en: Governs the persistent information and project constraints an agent works with - project orientation and scope, information and document lifecycle, and persistent workspace mutation - through one additive system-prompt section plus deterministic runtime checks.
description.zh: 治理代理在项目中持续接触的持久信息与项目约束：项目定位与范围、信息与文档生命周期、持久工作区变更；通过一个附加的系统提示章节与确定性的运行时检查落地。

description.en: Optional JEV decision mode with deterministic project reads, bounded semantic selection, native authorization checks and desktop credential settings.
description.zh: 可选 JEV 决策模式，提供代码优先项目读取、有限语义选择、原生授权检查与桌面密钥设置。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏「使用情况」：按通道查看用量明细、年度热力图、项目/会话用量与余额配额快照，纯本地只读、零外网
description.zh: 在侧边栏按通道查看 Token 用量、缓存命中率和成本，还有年度热力图与余额配额快照，纯本地只读。

description.en: Monet (Material Design 3) dynamic-color wallpaper theming for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 用壁纸自动生成 Material Design 3 配色，让 DeepSeek Harness 界面跟着壁纸一起变好看。

description.en: Switch providers and models, adjust reasoning effort; each model remembers its own level.
description.zh: 切换供应商、模型与思考强度，每个模型各自记住档位。

description.en: Backs up DeepSeek Harness sessions, plugin config and workspace memory to Nutstore (Jianguoyun) over WebDAV, with incremental upload, connection test and one-click restore on a new machine.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话记录、插件配置与工作区记忆通过 WebDAV 增量备份到坚果云，支持连接测试与在新机器上一键恢复。

description.en: Sidebar auxiliary chat for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): right-column panel hosting temporary auxiliary sessions that one-way mirror the main session's context and are deleted when closed · DSH 侧边栏辅助会话插件
description.zh: 在会话窗口右侧开一列临时草稿会话，单向同步主会话上下文，随手问随手删，主对话不受影响。

description.en: 以 per-agent 阴影顶替内置 glob：自动排除无底洞目录（node_modules 等），传 include 白名单才能搜入 | Shadows the built-in glob per agent: auto-excludes bottomless directories (node_modules etc.), pass an include whitelist to search inside them
description.zh: 给 glob 搜索加个白名单，自动跳过 node_modules 这类无底洞目录，找文件更快更准。

description.en: Copilot 引导层插件：WebUI 设置卡片一键 GitHub 授权 + 自动激活模型路由并收窄模型列表（复用 dsh-llm-pi-ai 内置 device-flow） | Copilot onboarding plugin: one-click GitHub auth from the WebUI settings card, auto-activating the model route and narrowing the model list (reuses dsh-llm-pi-ai's builtin device flow)
description.zh: 在 WebUI 设置卡片里一键完成 GitHub 授权，自动激活 Copilot 模型路由并精简模型列表。

description.en: Sends a macOS Notification Center alert when a session finishes or the agent is blocked on an answer, an approval, or an error. The banner carries the last reply and plays your system alert sound, and clicking it returns you to the DSH page.
description.zh: 会话结束、或 Agent 卡在等你回答／批准／排错时，发一条 macOS 系统通知；横幅带上最后一条回复并播放你的系统提示音，点击即可回到 DSH 页面。

description.en: Live usage gauge injected into the system prompt every turn: session tokens and estimated spend, a next-turn estimate, and two predictions the model can act on — which step fills the context window and which step burns the budget. /qm panels, zero-config by default, optional price table, and it publishes a summary.json budget contract sibling plugins read.
description.zh: 实时用量仪表：每回合向系统提示注入一行 token/花费仪表，含下一步预估，以及模型可以自刹的两条预测——第几步撑满上下文、第几步烧穿预算。/qm 面板自查，零配置即用，价格表可选，并向家族发布 summary.json 预算契约供兄弟插件读取。

description.en: Delete DSH conversations for real: a 删除对话 item in the sidebar session menu plus out-of-band deletion of the session log and projection cache.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话菜单里加个「删除对话」，能把会话记录和缓存真正删干净。

description.en: Session trash for DSH: move sessions to a recoverable trash, restore or purge them in settings.
description.zh: 会话回收站：移入回收站、恢复或永久删除会话。

description.en: Compiles a rough need into a versioned task book (goal / context / constraints / acceptance / decisions / open gaps, all numbered) and hands it to any AI window losslessly: the receiver must pass a read-back handshake — restate, list gaps, declare READY — before work starts; /answer closes gaps with an automatic version bump, /forge-list tracks which window holds which version.
description.zh: 把大白话编译成开源标准任务书（目标/约束/验收/决策/缺口全编号），再无损交接给任意窗口的 AI：接收方必须通过回读握手——复述理解、列出缺口、声明 READY——才被允许开工；缺口答案回填自动升版本，台账记录哪个窗口持有哪个版本。

description.en: DSH plugin: wakes the agent when a long background task (download, install, wait) finishes after the turn has ended, so it reports back on its own.
description.zh: 后台任务跑完了，智能体会自己回来告诉你结果，不用再追问「好了没」。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle that registers the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server as mcp__rea__* tools — third-party adapter
description.zh: 把 REA 逆向工程 MCP 服务器接进 DSH，让你直接调用工具拆解分析任意目标。

description.en: Aborts a DSH reasoning stream that starts repeating itself instead of letting the turn stall: five rules over the streamed reasoning text (periodic unit, repeated block, repeated line above a share floor, 64-gram density, and a long trailing run of punctuation or whitespace), plus a JSONL fire journal, a Web GUI log panel, and opt-in recovery that retries with a corrective message.
description.zh: 在推理流开始自我重复时提前中断本轮，避免长时间卡死：对推理文本做五条判据（周期单元、重复块、带占比下限的重复行、64-gram 密度、末尾超长标点或空白段），并附带 JSONL 触发日志、Web GUI 日志面板，以及可选的重试恢复（带纠正消息）。

description.en: DSH plugin: finish a DeepSeek account sign-in from a remote browser (loopback redirect claim + in-page paste panel)
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 账号登录在你眼前的浏览器里直接完成，不用再折腾远程回调。

description.en: Cross-session memory as plain Markdown per workspace: weighted injection, bi-temporal invalidation, TTL review with stale markers, credential redaction, error and session retrospectives, SOP skills, and approval-gated self-improvement proposals.
description.zh: 按工作区存放的纯 Markdown 跨会话记忆：重要性加权注入、双时态失效、按 TTL 复查并标注可能失效、凭据脱敏、出错与会话复盘、SOP 技能沉淀，以及需人工确认的自我改进提案。

description.en: Windows serial-port monitor for DeepSeek Harness — port parameters, live text/hex receive and data sending.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 串口调试面板：串口参数设置、文本/十六进制实时接收显示与数据发送。

description.en: DSH 会话时钟：按会话授时 + 跨轮/跨会话空闲间隔，作为内置 dsh-time-context 的补充插件。Per-session clock injection for DeepSeek Harness with durable idle-gap tracking. A companion to the built-in dsh-time-context.
description.zh: 给每个会话单独授时，还能算出跨轮、跨会话的空闲间隔，补上内置时间上下文的短板。

description.en: Right-sidebar page for DSH that draws the current session's repository as a VS Code-style commit graph - colored branch/merge lanes, ref chips and per-commit details - with a working-tree Changes area above it (staged/unstaged sections with inline diffs) for every working tree of the repository; read-only, works with or without dsh-better-sidebar, and follows the session's worktree label when dsh-session-worktree is installed.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏页：把当前会话的仓库画成 VS Code 风格的分支/合并提交图谱（彩色泳道、ref 徽章、提交详情），上方带工作区 Changes 区（staged/unstaged 分节、行内 diff），覆盖仓库的每个工作树；只读，装不装 dsh-better-sidebar 都能用，装了 dsh-session-worktree 时跟随会话的 worktree 标签。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: unified Skills + MCP manager with hot-reload enable/disable and Git-based skill install/update.
description.zh: 把 Skills 和 MCP 服务统一管起来，支持热重载开关和 Git 安装更新，设置面板和侧边栏都能进。

description.en: Displays account quotas, Git state, context usage, public API reference costs, Subagent activity, and streaming speed in DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 显示账户额度、Git 状态、上下文、公开 API 参考费用、Subagents 活动和生成速度。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接的共生体（dsh-sym）：实时会话花费（人民币，按厂商/模型与峰谷时段折算）、每轮费用、账户余额、峰谷时段标记，以及把任一回复作为上下文引用的 @ 按钮。名字取自 symbiote —— 附着在宿主上、持续长出能力，功能不限于计费。
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面上直接显示实时花费、余额和峰谷时段，还能一键 @ 引用回复。

description.en: Turns an image folder into a frosted-glass global wallpaper for the DSH web UI, keeping the official palette.
description.zh: 把文件夹里的图片设为 DSH 网页端全局磨砂壁纸，配色沿用官方原版。

description.en: DiagramKit — 结构化示意图的排版量尺与自检器：量真实字宽、查溢出/重叠/穿框，每次调用返回「图 + 可执行的修法」。DeepSeek Harness 插件。
description.zh: 画结构化示意图时帮你量准字宽、查出溢出重叠穿框，还顺手给出改法。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents from drifting off-task: it locks in the good first-round behavior, watches every step, and pulls the agent back when it degrades.
description.zh: 给 AI 智能体上锚，锁住首轮好表现，跑偏就自动拉回来，防止越干越离谱。

description.en: Page beautification for DeepSeek Harness: ship open-source CJK webfonts and let the Web GUI pick its body font
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的网页界面换上开源中文字体，还能自己挑正文字体，看着更舒服。

description.en: UI polish layer for the DSH web client: frosted-glass menu surfaces, a draggable reasoning-effort slider that replaces the level radio list, and model-menu navigation that reaches the model list in one click and closes on a single Esc.
description.zh: DSH 网页端界面打磨层：补上浮层毛玻璃材质，用可拖动滑杆替换推理等级单选列表，模型菜单一次点击直达列表、Esc 一次关闭。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧边栏左下角显示账号余额、今日 token 消耗与花费
Video editing toolset for DSH: probe, trim, concat, audio handling, subtitle burn-in, transform, transcode and frame grabbing, powered by ffmpeg downloaded on first use.
description.zh: DSH 视频剪辑工具集：探测、裁剪、拼接、音轨处理、字幕烧录、变速、转码与抽帧，引擎为首次使用时自动下载的 ffmpeg。

description.en: A plugin for dsh: quantify every dsh Agent interaction as a visualized performance metric and automatically sync it to WakaTime, using data to showcase your productivity with Agent.
description.zh: 一个 dsh 插件：将 DSH 的每一次 Agent 交互量化为可视化表现指标,自动同步至 WakaTime,用数据展示你与 Agent 协作的生产力。

description.en: Credential-free concurrent web search fan-out for DeepSeek Harness (Startpage, DuckDuckGo, Ecosia, Google, Mojeek + consensus merging) — the web_search tool.
description.zh: 免密钥并发调用多个搜索引擎，自动汇总去重，给 AI 助手提供更全的联网搜索结果。

description.en: Deep-sea whale-blue reskin for the DSH Web GUI: 14 theme tokens in light and dark, five whale-tail-maid placements, a clock and weather card, and a collapsible hardware readout (CPU, memory, GPU, per-drive temperatures via HWiNFO). No backdrop image is bundled; drop your own in. MIT code, MIT character art.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 的深海鲸蓝换肤：亮/暗两套共 14 个主题 token、5 处鲸尾女仆角色元素、时钟与天气卡片，以及可上下伸缩的硬件状态悬浮窗（CPU / 内存 / GPU / 硬盘温度，温度需 HWiNFO 提供）。包内不含背景图，放一张你自己的即可。源码与角色素材均为 MIT。

description.en: Personal agent for DeepSeek Harness: persistent chat, goals, actionable ideas, multi-session task coordination, and self-evolution through plugin discovery and recommendations.

Compact 56px app navigation rail with a separate conversation list and sidebar collapse control for the DSH web UI; also hides embedding, rerank and image/video generation models from the chat model menu and /model.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 56px 紧凑应用导航栏、独立对话列表与侧栏展开/收起控制；并在对话模型菜单和 /model 中筛除向量、重排及生图/视频型号。

description.en: Light/dark colour theme for the DSH web UI with an APTX capsule logo, browser tab title and icon branding, and optional Ai Haibara (Detective Conan) artwork panels, configured under Settings → General → Appearance with a no-decoration mode.
description.zh: DSH Web 明暗配色主题：APTX 胶囊标志、浏览器标签标题与图标、可选的灰原哀（名侦探柯南）展示素材，在「设置 → 通用 → 外观」中配置，可选无装饰模式。

description.en: 在 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）里使用 OpenCode Zen 的匿名免费模型：原生 LlmAdapter，无需 API Key，零依赖。
description.zh: 不用 API Key 就能在 DSH 里白嫖 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型，装上即用，零依赖。

description.en: 中国法定退休年龄与养老金测算：2025 渐进式延迟退休、退休倒计时、预计月养老金 —— 单文件网页计算器 + DeepSeek Harness 插件 + 跨工具 Agent Skill
description.zh: 算算你还有多少天退休、每月能领多少养老金，2025 延迟退休新规一键测算。

description.en: Drops a bowl of white rice from the top of the DSH window for every N tokens you spend; the bowls fall and bounce under gravity, can be dragged and thrown, and a vortex button (with a sound effect) inhales them all — or just the one you drop on it. Threshold, bowl size, on-screen cap, auto-righting and artwork are adjustable in an in-app panel.
description.zh: 每花掉 N token,就从 DSH 窗口顶端掉下一碗白米饭:米饭自由落体、落地弹跳,可以拖着扔出去;一个漩涡按钮(带音效)能把它们全部吸走,把某一碗拖上去松手则只吸那一碗。每碗额度、米饭大小、最多摆几碗、落地是否自动回正、米饭图都能在面板里调。

description.en: Read-only clinic for DSH session logs: 22 named diagnostics (token waste, retry and failure loops, context bloat, cross-session amnesia, idle MCP servers and skills), each reported with a replayable evidence locator such as session.v4.jsonl.zstd#L101-L110, and each finding turned into an executable prescription — a profile-patch YAML snippet or a command with current to suggested values, risk, verification and source — plus a feedback command that retires a prescription you reject, after which the report states it was removed by your feedback. Zero dependencies, default zero egress, session files are never written.
description.zh: DSH 会话日志的只读体检诊所：22 项具名诊断（token 浪费、重试与失败循环、上下文膨胀、跨会话失忆、闲置的 MCP 服务器与 skill 等），每条都附可复核的证据定位符（如 session.v4.jsonl.zstd#L101-L110）；每个问题给一条可执行处方（profile patch 片段或命令，含当前值到建议值、风险与验证方式），并支持标记「已拒绝」让该处方不再出现（报告会写明是你撤掉的）。零依赖、默认零外发、会话文件只读。

description.en: LeetCode Hot 100 learning plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): lessons, sandboxed judge, AI tutor, spaced review, and an AI agent that adds LeetCode problems from a plain description. 力扣热题 100 学习插件。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里边刷力扣热题 100，边学算法：AI 讲题、沙箱判题、间隔复习，还能一句话加题。

description.en: Trusted office suite for government/enterprise work by Beijing Caizhi Technology (深知可信智能): three skills — trusted consulting (policy/regulation Q&A with citation markers + provenance HTML), trusted search (authoritative policy/standard retrieval with traceable HTML + clean Markdown), and official-document writing (draft/rewrite/Word/red-head delivery); all interfaces go through the dknowc trusted workbench MCP (Bearer auth), products land in the session workspace, one-time key setup persists for later sessions; ships on npm as dknowc-dsh.
description.zh: 彩智科技深知可信智能出品的可信办公全家桶 dsh 插件：包含深知可信咨询（政策/法规/办事问答，带真实来源角标 + 可点击溯源 HTML）、深知可信搜索（权威政策/标准检索与深度研究，溯源 HTML + 干净 Markdown）、深知公文写作（正式公文起草/改写/Word/红头交付）三个 Skill；接口统一经深知可信工作台 MCP 转接（Bearer 认证），产物写入会话工作区，API Key 一次配置长期免注册；已发布 npm 包 dknowc-dsh。

description.en: DSH小助手：原生 Swift 悬浮窗 + DSH 会话状态驱动，含素材管线与日报
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作状态变成桌面上的 Swift 悬浮小助手，随时看进度、收日报。

description.en: Live DOM floating panels and screenshot overview for DeepSeek Harness Desktop
description.zh: 把 DSH 桌面端常用界面变成可拖动缩放的浮动面板，还能截图总览，操作更顺手。

description.en: Check-digit mathematics toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): generate, validate, repair and detect check digits for 15 schemes (Luhn, Verhoeff, Damm, ISBN, EAN, UPC, GTIN-14, ISSN, ISIN, CUSIP, IBAN, CAS, ABA) plus ISBN-10/13 conversion and a single-edit repair search — zero runtime dependencies
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供校验码数学工具箱，支持生成、验证和检测 11 种校验码（如 Luhn、ISBN、IBAN 等），零依赖即插即用。

description.en: Cloudflare Zero Trust access for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Access 认证、Tunnel 与 DNS 配置，无需公网 IP。
description.zh: 不用公网 IP，就能给 DSH 加上 Cloudflare 零信任认证、Tunnel 和 DNS 配置，安全远程访问。

description.en: Real-time command monitor for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Watch foreground/background command output in the Web UI without pausing the conversation. 命令窗：实时显示 DSH 命令与执行输出。
description.zh: 在 Web UI 里实时查看 DSH 命令的前后台执行输出，不用打断对话就能盯进度。

description.en: Observe and steer a local Codex (OpenAI) session from DeepSeek Harness, over the codex app-server protocol.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里实时观察并操控本地 Codex 会话，随时接管和引导 AI 干活。

description.en: Let a DSH model inspect and operate Windows applications through an installed Codex Computer Use runtime, with per-session app approval.
description.zh: 让 DSH 当前模型通过已安装的 Codex Computer Use 运行时读取和操作 Windows 应用，并保留每个会话的应用授权。

description.en: Configurable overrides for the DeepSeek Harness standard preset: Bash/PowerShell channel, disabled rows, persona and harness identity
description.zh: 给 DSH 预设加可配置覆盖：切换 Bash/PowerShell、关掉不需要的工具、自定义助手人设，装完默认不改动原有行为。

description.en: One clean git and GitHub surface for DSH: status, per-task worktrees, commit, push, sync, pull requests, and enforcement that stops raw git in bash from leaving dirty trees and unpushed commits behind.
description.zh: 让 DSH 统一管理 git 和 GitHub：状态、任务分支、提交推送、同步和 PR，还会自动拦截裸 git 命令，避免留下未提交的改动。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: live NVIDIA GPU monitor in the web rightbar. NVML-first on Linux (nvidia-smi fallback). NVIDIA only! Not AMD/Intel/macOS. Multi-GPU util/VRAM/power/temp, processes, sparklines. Installable dsh.bundle.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页右侧栏实时盯住 NVIDIA 显卡，利用率、显存、功耗、温度和多卡进程一眼看清。

description.en: DSH plugin: folds the oldest part of a session history into one message backed by a lossless local archive, so a long session sends fewer tokens. No model-written summary; everything recoverable.
description.zh: 把会话历史最旧的部分折叠成一条消息，内容存本地无损归档，随时能还原，不靠模型写摘要。

description.en: Give your AI a project memory: /init makes it read the codebase and write .dsh docs, then every later turn gets them injected back automatically.
description.zh: 让 AI 记住你的项目：/init 自动读代码写 .dsh 文档，之后每轮对话都自动带上这些背景知识。

description.en: Live2D companion for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): realtime TTS voice, continuous speech input, subtitle translation, multi-model catalog, standalone entry
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话加个会说话的 Live2D 角色，语音合成加连续语音输入，动嘴动表情还能看字幕。

description.en: deeepseek-harness kiro provider
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Kiro 模型服务，即插即用，轻松切换 LLM 提供商。

description.en: MCP servers settings page for the dsh web GUI: a JSON editor over a profile-config namespace that mounts live mcp-client instances from the saved servers
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页界面里用 JSON 编辑 MCP 服务器配置，保存后自动挂载可用的 mcp-client 实例。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 记忆框架插件。MEMFLOW 记忆流模式：会话会结束，记忆不会——感知先行、边做边记、无缝续接。分布式记忆架构：每个项目都有自己的记忆，子任务自定义记忆上下文，项目 skill 自迭代——一个插件让你的所有工作流实现类Hermes效果。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上记忆流，会话结束记忆还在，项目上下文自动续接。

description.en: DSH 会话 Mermaid 图表渲染插件：Codex 风格图表卡片，全屏 + 滚轮缩放 + PNG/SVG 导出，深浅主题自适应。DSH web plugin rendering mermaid code blocks as diagram cards with fullscreen, wheel zoom, PNG/SVG export.
智能体团队面板美化: 用「哦鲸鲸」形象替换 DSH 智能体团队面板里成员行的状态图标（静止 / 运行 / 失败），会话头部「对话／轨迹」右边那条空白带子变成一条跑道：哦鲸鲸会出现在这里跑步和吃白饭
description.zh: 把 DSH 智能体团队面板里成员的状态图标换成「哦鲸鲸」形象，静止、运行、失败一眼就懂，面板更好看。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (cordis) plugin to install and manage local inference providers like Strata, Ninfer, VLLM, llama.cpp, and more.
description.zh: 帮你一键安装和管理本地推理引擎，让自家硬件跑出比 Unsloth 更强的性能。

description.en: Tick which models appear in the DSH model selector, and fold provider groups in the settings panel.
description.zh: 在设置里逐个勾选要显示的模型，未勾选的从模型选择器菜单中隐藏；provider 分组可在设置面板中折叠。

description.en: CSPRNG-backed random tools for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) agents: range-bound numbers, custom-alphabet strings, secure bytes, UUID v4, unbiased shuffle.
description.zh: 给 AI 智能体提供安全随机能力，生成随机数、密码字符串、UUID 和洗牌结果。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: shows the current session's spend, priced by DeepSeek's peak and off-peak rate windows.
description.zh: 实时显示当前会话花了多少钱，按 DeepSeek 高峰和低谷时段分别计价。

description.en: DSH plugin for cross-session token usage statistics (/usage command + Web GUI Token 用量 panel)
description.zh: 统计所有会话的模型 token 用量，/usage 命令加网页面板随时查看消耗情况。

description.en: Control pnpm build-script approval across DSH profiles from Add Plugin, and repair same-Git-URL updates on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 在“添加插件”中统一控制各 DSH 配置的 pnpm 构建脚本审批，并修复 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 的同一 Git 地址更新问题。

description.en: Composer prompt tuner for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: rewrites the input draft through a model you choose, with a review card, SSE streaming, and a settings page for model / reasoning effort / style / optimization prompt.
description.zh: 把输入框里写得不清楚的草稿一键改写成条理清晰、可直接执行的提示词，还能自己选模型和风格。

description.en: 一个小白制作的DSH截图插件：Alt+A调出截图框，自由选取后点击确定即可自动复制到系统粘贴板，也可点击另存为单独保存为独立图片文件。
description.zh: 按 Alt+A 就能框选截图，自动复制到剪贴板，也能另存为图片文件。

description.en: Delete a DSH session together with the workspace artifacts that session produced - the file list is reconstructed from the session log and previewed with its total size. The artifacts can also be deleted on their own, keeping the conversation.
description.zh: 删掉 DSH 会话时，顺手把它产生的文件一并清理，还能先看清单和总大小再决定。

description.en: Single-client session tabs preserving native sidebars and background work
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上会话标签页，一个窗口切换多个会话，侧栏和工作台照常保留。

description.en: Fix for huge, slow-loading, OOM-ing DSH sessions: deletes the dead streaming fragments out of session logs on disk, so the next load is smaller. DeepSeek Harness plugin.
description.zh: 启动时自动清理会话日志里的无效流式碎片，避免长会话加载后膨胀到几个G，默认只做演练不实际改动。

description.en: DSH 右侧边栏的移动设备面板：把 mobilecli 封装成实时画面 + 直接操作，一套 API 同时覆盖 iOS 与 Android，并把 mobilecli 自带的 skill 一并注册给模型。A mobile device panel for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar — wraps mobilecli as a live screen with direct interaction, one API for iOS and Android, plus the bundled mobilecli skill registered for the model.
description.zh: 把手机实时画面搬进 DSH 右侧边栏，一套 API 同时操控 iOS 和 Android。

description.en: Cross-compaction memory for a long session: on compaction it stores what is being dropped, and at question time it injects a few relevant passages (or nothing) so the model can recall what you decided before.
description.zh: 跨压缩记忆：压缩时把被压掉的内容存到本机，提问时只注入相关的那几段（没有就一点不注入），让模型重新想起你早先定过的事。

description.en: Make DSH follow your system network settings: route through the OS proxy and trust its certificate store, so TLS-intercepting accelerators work without environment variables or a restart.
description.zh: 让 DSH 跟随系统网络设置：走系统代理并信任系统证书库，无需环境变量、无需重启。

description.en: DSH 用量监控插件：供应商周期限额显示（DeepSeek/OpenCode/Command Code）+ 自动探测 DSH 已添加供应商并自动填入 API Key
description.zh: 一眼看清 DeepSeek 等供应商的周期限额、余额和今日 Token 用量，还能自动识别已添加的供应商并填好 API Key。

description.en: Generate images from chat by calling a fleet of local or LAN ComfyUI workers, with workflow templates, worker health checks and queue control.
description.zh: 在对话里直接调用本机或局域网的 ComfyUI 机队出图，支持工作流模板、机队健康检查与队列控制。

description.en: 把 Unreal Engine 5.8 内置 MCP 接入 DeepSeek Harness —— 在设置里一键探测端点，让 AI 直接驱动 UE 编辑器
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里一键探测并接入 UE5.8 内置 MCP，让 AI 直接驱动虚幻编辑器。

description.en: Watches the foreground browser window, recognizes video courses, classifies them by subject, fetches Bilibili metadata/danmaku/comments, and generates Markdown + Mermaid knowledge maps and Word study manuals.
description.zh: 定时观察浏览器前台窗口，识别视频课程并按学科分类，抓取 B 站简介/字幕/弹幕/评论，生成 Markdown + Mermaid 知识地图与 Word 学习手册。
