description.zh: 通过浏览器把 DSH 工作区分享到局域网：手机、平板、其它电脑可浏览、下载、上传文件，无需 DSH 登录。带令牌门卫、路径边界、只读模式与速率限制，零依赖(node:http)。

description.en: DSH 第三方插件管理器（lite）：在设置页「插件 → 第三方插件」列出非官方插件，提供启用/停用（状态持久化、重启后保持）、卸载、检查更新、npm 一键安装/升级。A lite manager for third-party DeepSeek Harness plugins: list / enable / disable / uninstall / update.
deepseek harness mcp support
description.zh: 为 DSH 原生 MCP 桥接提供轻量封装，让你能灵活配置和管理 MCP 服务器，扩展 AI 工具能力。

description.en: Hover timestamps for DSH web. Hovering a chat node row — Think, Bash, Read/Edit/Write, Search, commands, compaction markers, sub-calls — pops a compact card with that node's start time → end time and how long it took.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页聊天界面中，鼠标悬停任意节点即可快速查看其开始与结束时间，方便排查耗时与性能问题。

description.en: Background notification plugin: desktop notification, with a tab-title fallback, when an approval prompt or an ask-user-question card appears while the page is in a background tab. The host queues approval and question events behind a same-origin endpoint that the client polls every 3 seconds; clicking the notification focuses the page, and the tab title is restored once the page becomes visible.
description.zh: 后台通知插件：页面处于后台时出现审批提示或提问卡片，即发送桌面通知（通知权限不可用时回退为标签页标题 ⚠ 前缀），点击通知聚焦页面；宿主将事件存入同源队列供前端每 3 秒轮询，页面恢复可见后标题自动还原。

description.en: The public-apis catalog wired into DeepSeek Harness: search 1716 free public APIs by keyword, category, auth, HTTPS or CORS and call any of them.
description.zh: 把 public-apis 目录接入 DeepSeek Harness：按关键词、分类、auth、https、cors 搜索 1716 个免费公共 API 并直接调用。

description.en: Share a selected chat segment as Markdown, HTML, TXT, or PNG; Session-header dialog with range or multi-select, redaction, tool calls, and subagent conversations, plus the /share command.
description.zh: 将选中的聊天片段分享为 Markdown、HTML、TXT 或 PNG；提供 Session Header 弹窗（范围或多选、脱敏、工具调用、子代理对话）与 /share 命令。

description.en: DSH 实时技能显示小插件 🌟 输入框下方的可爱小徽章，实时显示当前技能，悬停看历史。Real-time active skill chip for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在聊天输入框下方实时显示当前正在使用的技能名称，鼠标悬停还能查看历史记录，装上即用。

description.en: Taojian (陶笺): Claude-inspired DSH theme with warm paper, clay accent, Noto Serif SC, and Cascadia Mono.
description.zh: 陶笺：奶油纸浅色主题，陶橙强调色，界面思源宋，代码 Cascadia Mono。非官方，与 Anthropic、DeepSeek 无关。

description.en: Text-to-image and image-to-image generation via OpenRouter's unified Image API: configurable model aliases with parameters gated against the live model capability listing, reference-image inputs, a settings card, and inline chat display of results.
description.zh: 通过 OpenRouter 统一 Image API 的文生图与图生图：以别名配置模型，参数按实时模型能力列表校验，支持参考图输入、设置卡片与对话内联展示结果。

description.en: Voice (speech-to-text) input for the DSH Web composer via Web Speech API — tap, speak, transcript fills the input box. Zero server, zero API keys.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页编辑器里点一下麦克风就能说话转文字，语音直接填进输入框，改完再发送，不用服务器也不用 API 密钥。

description.en: Adds a sidebar entry that opens a card gallery of all Red Fox Community skills from the redfox-community-dsh plugin.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部加入「红狐 Skills」入口，点击后切换为卡片式技能画廊，集中展示 redfox-community-dsh 插件内的红狐社区技能。

description.en: Kling AI remote MCP plugin for DeepSeek Harness

Cipher memory platform as a DSH bundle: four memory types (attention, experience, preference, cognitive) sedimented per turn by four memory agents, cross-session deterministic recall injected via systemPrompt.context, insight review kept out of user-facing output, per-session UNNI/LOOP modes with memory-driven auto-continuation, memory search/ingest tools, plus a settings page (SOUL editor) and an AgentPool panel.
description.zh: 把 cipher 记忆平台原生带进 DSH：四类记忆每轮沉淀、跨会话确定性检索经 systemPrompt.context 注入、洞察复核只进沉淀、会话级 UNNI/LOOP 模式（记忆驱动自动续轮）、记忆检索/写入两个工具，以及设置页（SOUL 编辑器）与 AgentPool 面板。

description.en: Anthropic Claude plan usage indicator for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里直观显示 Anthropic Claude 套餐用量，方便你随时掌握剩余额度。

description.en: Command Code LLM provider for DSH Desktop: registers the commandcode route with a live model catalog, configurable request and stream-idle timeouts, multi-account rotation on 429/401, plan-aware model filtering, an OAuth login flow and a bilingual usage and billing panel.
description.zh: 把 Command Code 接入 DSH Desktop 的模型提供商插件：注册 commandcode 路由，带实时模型目录、可配置的请求与流式空闲超时、429/401 自动多账户轮换、按套餐过滤模型、OAuth 登录流程，以及中英双语的用量与计费面板。

description.en: 虾说教材写作 · dsh-course-writer — AI course-authoring workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). 三栏式工作台 · 九阶段门禁 · 课程/章节/资料库/知识图谱 · 导出 TXT/Word · 分享协作。Three-pane workspace, nine-phase gated workflow, lorebook, export & share.
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 开发者使用报告——类 Spotify Wrapped，统计与 AI 结对编程的行为，生成可分享报告卡片
Kun Like 桌宠 - DSH 桌面宠物插件
Local request and response inspector for session-associated DeepSeek Harness LLM calls
description.zh: 本地查看 DeepSeek Harness 每次 LLM 调用的请求与响应，方便调试和排查问题，数据不出本机。

description.en: Reliable vision + OCR for text-only models on DeepSeek Harness: describe_image (normal/critical) + extract_text tools, auto-preprocessing, retries, and a persistent answer cache.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型加眼睛，支持图片描述和文字提取，自动重试和缓存，让LLM看懂图片。

description.en: 用于dsh-web加强安全性的插件，可设置用户名密码进行登录
description.zh: 给 dsh-web 加一道登录门，输入用户名密码验证通过后才能访问界面，账号信息加密存储更安全。

description.en: Keeps every model request inside a per-provider allow-list, enforced at the agent/request waterfall: disallowed models are redirected to a fallback or refused; subagents stop inheriting stale creation-time routes; warns when consecutive requests would make a --models-max 1 llama.cpp router reload models. A one-entry list is a global single-model mode.
description.zh: 按供应商锁定可用模型，超出白名单的请求自动降级或拒绝，防止子智能体乱用模型。
已停用的 OAuth 插件，请勿安装；当前版本已内置 openai-codex 认证与模型路由功能。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for third-party OpenAI Responses and native Gemini APIs, with custom providers, model discovery, and hosted web search.
Windows desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Codex-compatible pets as a layered overlay, with a Plugins settings card.
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面上养一只透明置顶的 Codex 小宠物，会话运行、等待或完成时它会冒泡提醒你，不打扰网页操作。

description.en: Pin and unpin sessions to the top of the Web sidebar with a dedicated pinned panel, archive section, and native three-dot menu integration.
description.zh: 把会话置顶到 Web 侧边栏顶部：独立置顶面板、归档区、原生三点菜单集成。

description.en: Gemini-styled skin restyling the conversation ground, sidebar rows, hero greeting and composer through one stylesheet over the --dsw-* tokens, with light and dark both covered.
description.zh: Gemini 风格皮肤，用一张叠在 --dsw-* 令牌之上的样式表重塑对话区底色、侧栏胶囊行、首屏问候语与输入框，明暗主题都覆盖。

description.en: A terminal workbench for dsh with streaming chat, tool execution, session management, provider management, and image input.
description.zh: 面向 dsh 的终端工作台，提供流式对话、工具执行、会话管理、Provider 管理与图片输入。

description.en: A session & token mini dashboard for DSH web. It renders just above the sidebar's "Settings" row and summarizes, in one small draggable float window, what your sessions are doing right now and what they have cost you today.
一个dsh的辅助使用小插件，DSH client plugin: embedded tool rail + session questions console — jump to past questions, collapse the model's working process. 🐱
description.zh: 在对话侧边栏快速回顾历史提问，折叠模型工作过程，提升会话效率的小工具。

description.en: Global prompt-injection / context-virus defense for DeepSeek Harness: scans tool arguments, tool results, pre-model messages and the outbound stream; quarantine/block/monitor modes, canary trap, and an evolvable on-disk signature library with learn/import/export.
description.zh: 全局提示注入 / 上下文病毒防御：扫描工具参数、工具结果、进模型前消息与出站流；隔离/阻断/监控三模式、金丝雀陷阱、可演进磁盘签名库（学习/导入/导出）。

description.en: Plugin for integrating RingCentral with DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 将 RingCentral 团队消息机器人接入 dsh，让智能体直接在聊天窗口里对话和协作。

description.en: Attach tables and documents (xlsx, csv, pdf, zip…) to the DSH composer via paste or drag-and-drop: files are saved into the session workspace and an @reference is inserted.
description.zh: 把表格与文档（xlsx、csv、pdf、zip…）粘贴或拖拽进 DSH 输入框即可附加：文件会保存到会话工作区并插入 @引用。

description.en: Tavily web-search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — registers into ctx.web so the model-facing web_search tool uses Tavily
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Tavily 搜索，让模型能实时联网查资料，即插即用。

description.en: Detects WSL2 clock skew versus Windows that can break TLS and tokens.
description.zh: 检测相对 Windows 的 WSL2 时钟偏差，避免 TLS 与 token 异常。

description.en: Compares WSL versus Windows DNS resolution for common endpoints.
description.zh: 对比 WSL 与 Windows 对常用域名的 DNS 解析结果。

description.en: Reports Docker CLI, context, and daemon reachability in WSL, plus vLLM :8000 /v1/models health and GPU runtime hints.
description.zh: 报告 WSL 内 Docker CLI、context 与 daemon 是否可达，并探测 vLLM :8000 的 /v1/models 健康与 GPU runtime。

description.en: Lists or copies files from the Windows Downloads folder into the WSL workspace.
description.zh: 列出或复制 Windows「下载」文件夹中的文件到 WSL 工作区。

description.en: Opens a WSL Linux path in Windows Cursor, VS Code, or Notepad (optional line/column; win_editor_status).
description.zh: 用 Windows 的 Cursor、VS Code 或 Notepad 打开 WSL 路径（可选行列；含 win_editor_status）。

description.en: Reports PowerShell, cmd, and LANG encoding for UTF-8 versus code-page issues.
description.zh: 报告 PowerShell、cmd 与 LANG 编码，便于排查 UTF-8 与代码页问题。

description.en: Advises or applies allowlisted Windows portproxy for a WSL listen port, preferring the kit :3081 relay and launch token for local dsh UI.
description.zh: 为 WSL 监听端口提供白名单 Windows portproxy 建议或应用；本机 dsh UI 优先用 kit 的 :3081 中继与 launch token。

description.en: Probes Windows-host Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, and llama-server from WSL, compares ctx, and reports /v1/models apiReady versus TCP.
description.zh: 从 WSL 探测 Windows 上的 Ollama、LM Studio、vLLM 与 llama-server，比对 ctx，并报告 /v1/models 的 apiReady 与 TCP 是否打通。

description.en: Warns when the workspace path sits on slow /mnt/c.
description.zh: 当工作区路径落在缓慢的 /mnt/c 上时发出告警。

description.en: Browse WSL directories under / and /mnt for workspace picking (start/filter; im-workspace shortcuts).
description.zh: 浏览 WSL 的 / 与 /mnt 目录以便挑选工作区（start/filter；含 im-workspace 快捷入口）。

description.en: Saves a Windows clipboard image into a WSL file (clear ok:false + hint when clipboard has no image).
description.zh: 将 Windows 剪贴板图片存为 WSL 文件（无图时返回明确 ok:false 与 hint）。

description.en: Hints how to forward the Windows OpenSSH agent into WSL without dumping keys.
description.zh: 提示如何把 Windows OpenSSH agent 转发进 WSL，且不输出密钥。

description.en: Lists WSL distros and validates a Linux workspace path for DSH.
description.zh: 列出 WSL 发行版并校验可用于 DSH 的 Linux 工作区路径。

description.en: Gives read-only advice for Windows .wslconfig memory and mirrored networking.
description.zh: 只读查看 Windows .wslconfig，并给出内存与 mirrored 网络建议。

description.en: Kling AI remote MCP plugin for DeepSeek Harness

Screenshot-review skill for DeepSeek Harness: the agent opens a frontend page, screenshots it, views the screenshot itself, revises the code, then re-screenshots — iterating until the page visually matches the user's requirements. Ships as a dsh.bundle, so it installs with `dsh plugin add`.
description.zh: 截图审阅 skill：模型自己打开页面、截图、看图、改代码，反复迭代直到前端效果符合要求。以 dsh.bundle 打包，可用 `dsh plugin add` 一键安装。

description.en: 多智能体总指挥插件（DeepSeek Harness 原生版） ——让 DeepSeek 高效打开并指挥一个 claude / opencode / codex 智能体团队，实时看到每个智能体在做什么，通过共享记忆与任务看板编排多人协作。
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 指挥 claude、opencode、codex 组成智能体团队，实时看进度、共享记忆、用任务看板编排协作。

description.en: DSH 插件：可拖拽余额饼图 / 真实消耗 / 历史热力图 — balance pie with real spending & monthly heatmap for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在侧边栏实时查看余额消耗，用饼图和热力图直观掌握每月花费，拖拽交互超方便。

description.en: Slash commands ported from other coding agents (setup, connect, install, trust, browse, doctor, status, model, memory, compact, resume, review, mcp, init, suggest, improve, refactor), a zero-dependency static scanner for plugin source, and an in-repo catalog of audited plugin report cards that cite file-and-line evidence.
description.zh: 从其他编码 Agent 移植过来的斜杠命令（setup、connect、install、trust、browse、doctor、status、model、memory、compact、resume、review、mcp、init、suggest、improve、refactor），一个零依赖的插件源码静态扫描器，以及一份内置的插件评级报告卡目录，每条结论都给出文件与行号级别的证据。

description.en: 电商经营驾驶舱 · Ecommerce Business Cockpit — DeepSeek Harness plugin (demo/landing, source private)
A live conversation map for DeepSeek Harness web: real-time session tree with subagent lineage, running state, and one-click navigation.
description.zh: DSH 对话地图：当前工作区全部会话的实时树状图，子代理谱系、运行状态一目了然，双击即跳转。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 实时 AI 自审插件：任何报错/警告第一时间连同时间、错误码、会话、用户原话、AI 动作与工作区写入专用日志目录，并主动通知 AI、内置 read_error_logs 工具随时读取。Real-time AI self-audit for DeepSeek Harness — captures every error/warning with timestamp, error code, session, user prompt, AI action and workspace into a dedicated log folder; instantly notifies the agent and ships a read_error_logs tool.
description.zh: 实时捕获 AI 报错和警告，连同时间、会话、用户原话等完整信息写入日志，并主动通知 AI，方便随时排查问题。

description.en: Connect Feishu chats to DeepSeek Harness projects, conversations, replies, and scoped tool approvals over WebSocket.
description.zh: 通过 WebSocket 将飞书聊天连接到 DeepSeek Harness 的项目、对话、回复和限定范围的工具审批。

description.en: Ink-and-paper Apple-inspired theme for the DSH web client with a handwritten jimmy sidebar brand.
description.zh: 墨水纸质感的苹果风 DSH 网页主题，侧栏使用手写 jimmy 字标与小狗头像。

description.en: Makes ctx.logger output visible: a /logs chat command over a full-capture ring (level, name, grep, since filters) plus a default-on stderr exporter for warnings and errors, configurable per plugin; works headless. Also documents that dsh's default log buffer silently drops warn and debug records.
description.zh: 让 ctx.logger 的日志在聊天里可见，通过 /logs 命令查看过滤，还能把警告和错误输出到 stderr，方便调试。

description.en: MCP & Skills management panel for DeepSeek Harness — manage MCP servers and the skill library from the Settings page.
description.zh: 在设置页集中管理 MCP 服务器和技能库，每个服务器卡片状态一目了然，方便快速配置与维护。

description.en: Presets message-injection content combos and auto-injects them into every message.
description.zh: 预设消息注入内容组合，每条消息自动注入输入框首行。

description.en: Global Alt+M model command palette for DeepSeek Harness Web: fuzzy search over models and providers, favorites and recents, per-model reasoning effort, provider and model configuration, request retries, capacity presets, and optional OpenRouter image/video generation tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的全局 Alt+M 模型命令面板：模型与提供商的模糊搜索、收藏与最近使用、每模型思考档位、提供商与模型配置、请求重试、容量预设，以及可选的 OpenRouter 图片/视频生成工具。

description.en: dsh 支持多租户插件
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成多租户服务，支持多角色登录、用量计量和操作审计，适合团队共享使用。

description.en: A live reasoning-token badge for DSH web. It appends a compact Think(128) / Think(5.2K) marker to the title of every "Think" disclosure row in the conversation — ticking in real time while the model is still thinking, and staying put on history messages afterwards.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页对话中实时显示思考令牌数量的小徽章，让推理过程一目了然。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置中统一导入、启用、更新和管理本地及云端私有插件。
Agent-native Software Development Lifecycle Management for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 Jira 式项目管理搬进 DSH 工作区，让智能体帮你建任务、理依赖、盯进度，轻量又本地化。

description.en: Create a one-click Windows desktop shortcut from the Settings page: a .cmd launcher + desktop icon for DeepSeek Harness or any local server, auto-opens the browser, with taskbar pin hints.
description.zh: 在设置页一键创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式：为 DeepSeek Harness 或任意本地服务生成 .cmd 启动器与桌面图标，自动打开浏览器、可固定任务栏。

description.en: DSH tools for operating a self-hosted Talebook library: search, download, upload and manage books and audiobooks, manage Legado book sources, and admin operations, with approval-gated writes.
description.zh: 在自托管 Talebook 书库上搜索、下载、上传和管理书籍与有声书，管理 Legado 书源及管理员操作；写入操作需经批准。

description.en: Hard-stops further tool calls after a configurable per-session budget is reached.
description.zh: 在达到可配置的会话级工具调用次数上限后，硬拦截后续工具调用。

description.en: Replace tool-card leading icons with emoji while preserving the original cards.
description.zh: 把工具卡片前面的图标换成 emoji，同时保留原卡片全部内容。

description.en: DSH peak/off-peak tariff, DeepSeek API balance, reminder, and Web status badge plugin
description.zh: 一键查峰谷电价和API余额，带定时提醒和顶部状态徽标，随时掌握账号与用电状态。

description.en: 语音输入插件 for Deepseek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框加个麦克风按钮，点击就能用浏览器语音识别实时转文字，免部署零成本。

description.en: Opens http(s) URLs from WSL in the Windows default browser.
description.zh: 在 Windows 默认浏览器中打开来自 WSL 的 http(s) 链接。

description.en: Reads and writes the Windows clipboard from WSL.
description.zh: 从 WSL 读写 Windows 剪贴板。

description.en: Safe Git Credential Manager hints for WSL without exposing secrets.
description.zh: 提供 WSL 下 Git Credential Manager 的安全指引，不回传密钥。

description.en: Reports the current WSL distro and warns about multi-distro setups.
description.zh: 报告当前 WSL 发行版，并提醒多发行版混用风险。

description.en: Uses a GitHub App to report open PRs and the latest Actions run for the current repo without returning secrets.
description.zh: 通过 GitHub App 查询当前仓库未关闭 PR 与最近一次 Actions，不回传密钥。

description.en: Probes nvidia-smi and GPU visibility inside WSL.
description.zh: 探测 WSL 内的 nvidia-smi 与 GPU 可见性。

description.en: Launches allowlisted Windows apps such as VS Code, Explorer, and browsers from WSL.
description.zh: 从 WSL 白名单启动 Windows 应用（如 VS Code、资源管理器、浏览器）。

description.en: Shows a short Windows MessageBox or toast (BalloonTip) from WSL when a long task finishes.
description.zh: 长任务结束后从 WSL 弹出 Windows MessageBox 或 toast（气球提示）。

description.en: Converts Linux and Windows paths with /mnt/c caveats for WSL.
description.zh: 在 WSL 下转换 Linux 与 Windows 路径，并说明 /mnt/c 注意点。

description.en: Diagnoses WSL port listening and Windows localhost forwarding, with a 3080/3081 uiPlaybook for the dsh web relay and launch token.
description.zh: 诊断 WSL 端口监听与 Windows localhost 转发，并对 dsh web 中继的 3080/3081 给出含 launch token 的 uiPlaybook。

description.en: Native DSH HTTP request plugin with configurable credential whitelist and usage skill
description.zh: 原生 DSH 插件，直接发起 HTTP 请求，支持凭据白名单，安全又灵活。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for LLM agents — TagMemo V9.1 wave algorithm ported to DeepSeek Harness. Zero-dependency Cordis plugin with passive recall injection.
description.zh: 给 LLM 智能体装上跨会话长期记忆，自动回忆相关上下文，让对话更连贯。

description.en: Cadence SKILL (Virtuoso Lisp) assistant for EDA engineers: official-doc-anchored API lookup (3557 entries across 5 IC6.1.8 manuals, signature confidence levels, never invents APIs) plus zero-execution static analysis driven by a lexical depth coordinate system — iterator-safe deletion with position-sensitive copy() protection, printf placeholder/argument reconciliation, in-loop nth O(N^2) detection, deprecated APIs with page refs, dangerous-intent interception and CIW error-log triage. Host half has zero third-party dependencies.
description.zh: 面向 Cadence Virtuoso 版图工程师的 SKILL 脚本助手：官方文档锚定的 API 检索（5 本 IC6.1.8 手册 3557 条，签名带置信度，查不到绝不臆造）＋不执行代码的深度静态检查——词法深度坐标系可精确判定跨行循环体与同行闭合，覆盖迭代中删除（copy 位置敏感）、printf 占位符与实参对账、循环内 nth O(N^2)、废弃 API（带页码引用），另有危险需求拦截与 CIW 错误日志定位修复。宿主半区零第三方依赖。
让 DeepSeek Harness 聊天窗口悬浮在其他应用之上，随时提问、随时切换，不打断工作流。
把多个 Harness 会话并排放在一个屏幕上，像 iTerm 分屏一样同时操作，切换方便，效率翻倍。

description.en: Turn every idea into an image or video with Kling AI. In DeepSeek Harness, use natural language for text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-image creation, task tracking, and result previews.
description.zh: 一句话，让灵感从想法变成大片。在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接用自然语言调用可灵 AI，支持文生图、图生图、文生视频、图生视频、参考图创作、任务跟踪和结果预览。

description.en: User-defined agents with automatic routing, model failover, and squad orchestration: six model tools (agent_dispatch / agent_followup / agent_list / agent_squad / agent_import_skill / agent_upsert), no built-in agents, a native right-tab panel (Overview / Agents / Squads / History), and a floating action ball.
description.zh: 自定义 Agent + 自动路由 + 小队编排：六个模型工具（agent_dispatch / agent_followup / agent_list / agent_squad / agent_import_skill / agent_upsert），无内置 Agent，原生右 tab 主面板（总览 / Agent / 小队 / 历史）与悬浮活动球。

description.en: macOS sound alerts for DeepSeek Harness agent lifecycle events
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体生命周期事件播放 macOS 本地提示音，让你无需盯屏也能实时掌握任务状态。

description.en: AgentENV/E2B microVM execution-world bundle for DeepSeek Harness

description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 自动检查并更新插件，省去手动升级的麻烦，保持环境始终最新。

description.en: Clean Architecture reference library for DSH: 8 pinned reference repos (Go, Java, C#, Python) indexed into a local FTS5 database, with assertion rules, a review ledger, and a read-only observation panel.
description.zh: DSH 的 Clean Architecture 参考库:8 个钉版参考仓(Go / Java / C# / Python)索引进本地 FTS5,提供断言规则、审查台账与只读观察窗面板。

description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness outbound traffic through a local Clash proxy, with automatic fallback to direct when the proxy is off.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的出网流量走本地 Clash 代理，代理关闭时自动回落直连。

description.en: A simple desktop rather than a web.
description.zh: 把 dsh web 变成桌面应用，启动即弹窗，支持托盘和窗口记忆，退出干净利落。

description.en: Drag documents into the dsh web chat; the agent reads them directly from the local filesystem and the right sidebar lists the outputs and file paths.
description.zh: 拖拽文档进 dsh Web 对话框，Agent 直读本地文件处理，右侧侧栏展示产出与文件路径。

description.en: DSH 斗地主插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 里等回复时来一把（PVP → DSH Agent）

Force the agent's chain-of-thought, planning, tool-invocation reasoning, and internal deliberation to stay in Chinese — the language constraint is injected at the top of the system prompt before every reasoning step, so it cannot be diluted by tool-returned content. A settings panel lets you edit the constraint text on the fly.
description.zh: 让 Agent 的思考过程也自动使用中文。在每步推理前向 System Prompt 最顶部注入语言约束，强制思维链、规划、工具调用推理全部使用中文，防止工具返回英文内容后发生语言漂移。支持在设置面板中实时编辑约束文本。

description.en: Consent-bound one-turn voice preview for DSH Web with a credential-free local synthetic demo, optional Qwen Audio, exact Session isolation, and explicit transcript-to-draft handoff without automatic submission.
description.zh: DSH Web 的会话绑定单轮语音预览：提供无需凭证的本地合成演示和可选的 Qwen Audio，保持精确会话隔离，并仅在明确操作后将转写写入草稿，不会自动提交。

description.en: DSH host-side plugin: real macOS Calendar integration (create/list/query/delete events via AppleScript) for DeepSeek Harness agents
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体直接操作 macOS 日历，创建、查询、删除日程事件，实现日历管理自动化。

description.en: Provider-first three-level model selector for the DSH Web model seat: pick a provider, then a model from that provider, with inline search on both levels, failed-provider retry rows, and a Model · Provider trigger.
description.zh: Provider-first 三级模型选择器：先选供应商再选模型，两级均可行内搜索，失败供应商以可重试行展示，触发器显示 Model · Provider。

description.en: A tiny behavioral mood ring for AI coding agents — folds session behavior (consecutive failures, repeated calls, activity) into a four-state Mood (GOOD / CONFUSED / FRUSTRATED / OVERWHELMED) shown as a low-friction session-header status light.
description.zh: 给 AI 编程 Agent 的轻量心情指示器——把会话行为（连续失败、重复调用、活动强度）折叠成四态 Mood（顺利 / 困惑 / 受挫 / 过载），以低干扰的会话头部状态灯呈现。

description.en: DSH platform account and persistent browser-session manager
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 平台账号，并持久化浏览器会话，免去重复登录烦恼。

description.en: OAuth sign-in for 9 subscription LLM providers (Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity, OpenRouter, Agnes AI, Qwen, Spark, ERNIE) with zero-config login and usage dashboards.
description.zh: 支持 Claude、Codex、Grok、Antigravity、OpenRouter、Agnes AI、Qwen、星火、文心一言共 9 个订阅账号的 OAuth 登录，零配置直连，内置用量看板。

description.en: Gathers custom plugin settings pages and cards into draggable top tabs under a unified Plugin settings navigation row.
description.zh: 在设置弹窗中增加「插件设置」导航，将各插件的设置页与卡片统一收纳到可拖拽排序的顶部标签页中。

description.en: Adds a /dshpp slash command that reports session and token usage, cache-hit rate, and estimated cost from harness session logs; the repo also ships a CLI and local web console for lifecycle, provider, session, and plugin-security management.
description.zh: 新增 /dshpp 斜杠命令，从 Harness 会话日志汇总会话数与 token 用量、缓存命中率与估算成本；同仓库还附带用于生命周期、Provider、会话与插件安全管理的 CLI 与本地 Web 控制台。

description.en: DSH桌面启动器插件，双击桌面快捷方式启动dsh Web UI，不需要每次打开终端手动输入命令
description.zh: 双击桌面图标就能启动 dsh Web UI，还带一键关机按钮，省去每次敲命令的麻烦。

description.en: Auto-wakes the main agent after a DSH service restart: compares last-run timestamps, posts a recovery notice with humanized downtime, and delivers it so interrupted work picks itself back up. Runs on plain cordis ctx, packaged-DSH-Desktop ready.
description.zh: 检测 DSH 服务重启后自动唤醒主 agent：对比上次运行时间、人性化播报中断时长，并把提示消息投递回来让中断的工作自动恢复。仅依赖 cordis ctx 服务，兼容 DSH Desktop 打包环境。

description.en: Session management for DSH: archive or delete one session, archive/delete all sessions in a workspace, and restore archived sessions from the settings page — archiving backs up workspace metadata and restoring recreates deleted workspace registrations automatically.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理：可归档或删除单个会话，工作区行可归档全部、恢复已归档或删除全部会话，设置页可查看/恢复/删除已归档会话；归档时备份工作区信息，恢复时自动恢复原工作区，原工作区被删除时自动重建。

description.en: Compact DSH wallet panel for any Sub2API-compatible third-party balance site. Uses /v1/usage with a long-lived API Key, auto-discovers configured providers, and shows balance plus daily usage.
description.zh: 通用 Sub2API 第三方余额面板：使用 /v1/usage 和长期 API Key，自动发现 DSH provider，显示余额及今日用量。

description.en: A turn-based conversation timeline for DeepSeek Harness with bookmarks, history loading, keyboard controls, and mobile support.
description.zh: A discoverable, accessible conversation timeline for DeepSeek Harness with search, bookmarks, history loading, and mobile support.

description.en: WebMCP bridge: your agent discovers & calls site tools exposed over the W3C WebMCP protocol via a built-in headless Chromium.
description.zh: WebMCP 桥接器：让 agent 通过内置无头 Chromium，发现并调用网站按 W3C WebMCP 协议暴露的站点工具。

description.en: Virtual session folders, click-to-move menu, and active task banner for DSH sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏虚拟会话分类树、点击式移动菜单与任务状态胶囊。

description.en: Task-local, privacy-preserving file catalogs for reusable Codex input-file understanding.
一个Deepseek Harness远程插件（AI Coding注意）
Local semantic index over workspace documents (MD/PDF/DOCX/TXT): FTS5 BM25 + local embedding hybrid retrieval, hit citations with line numbers, and incremental updates.
description.zh: 工作区文档的本地语义索引（MD/PDF/DOCX/TXT）：FTS5 BM25 与本地嵌入混合检索、带行号命中引用、增量更新。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bundle: route the harness through OpenLLM (OpenAI-compatible) + register the OpenLLM MCP, with CLI/daemon onboarding.
description.zh: 给 Harness 接上本地 OpenLLM 网关，无需 API Key 就能直接调用模型。

description.en: DSH 带队模式插件：主 Agent 只规划派活监工，改动交给 subagent，每次派活弹窗选子模型
Type /tabs to pick a browser tab (via chrome-devtools-mcp) and auto-fill its URL into the composer.
description.zh: 输入 /tabs 弹出浏览器标签页选择器，点选后链接自动填入输入框。

description.en: High-fidelity, faithful, bilingual, recursive compaction backend for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 高保真上下文压缩后端，无损替换基础版，提升摘要质量且不改变原有策略。
当智能体向你提问或请求审批时，自动弹出EAC窗口并闪烁提醒，帮你及时处理会话请求。

description.en: Event relay: one SSE channel pushing host-side notifications to subscribed browser surfaces (server-side topic-prefix filtering, __relay/open reconnect signal)
description.zh: 把主机端事件实时推送到浏览器页面，支持按主题过滤和断线重连，让前端界面随时感知后端动态。

description.en: Whole-disk @ file references for DeepSeek Harness — Everything-backed instant search with fuzzy/regex and a cross-platform fallback index
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 @ 引用支持全盘搜索，基于 Everything 实现秒级模糊匹配，无 Everything 时自动切换备用索引。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: remote settings + Let's Encrypt IP certificates
description.zh: 远程浏览器直接改设置，用Let's Encrypt IP证书自动上HTTPS，免域名免备案，装完即用。

description.en: Expose DeepSeek Harness tools as a standard MCP server (streamable HTTP) — drive dsh from Claude Code, Codex, or any MCP client
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 工具暴露为标准 MCP 服务器，让 Claude Code、Codex 等任意 MCP 客户端直接驱动 dsh。

description.en: Enables or disables MCP servers from Settings → MCP Servers: stops or starts each @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client connection immediately and persists the change across restarts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置 → MCP 服务器中直接启用或停用 MCP：即时停止或启动每个 MCP 客户端连接，并持久化，重启后依旧生效。

description.en: DSH plugin: poll GitHub Actions, surface failed checks as cards, open a fix session with log context.
A standalone desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, powered by your local Hermes Agent — with real conversation, long-term memory, and persona.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面配一只本地桌宠，接上 Hermes Agent 大脑，能真聊天、记长期记忆，还带拟人人格。

description.en: Visual plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness: AI auto-translation, AI one-click summaries, AI plugin search, one-click share & install of multiple plugins, bulk updates
description.zh: 可视化插件管理器，支持AI自动翻译、一键摘要、智能搜索，还能批量安装更新和分享插件。

description.en: Enables or disables DSH plugins from Settings → Plugins: each toggle stops or starts the plugin immediately without a restart and the change persists across restarts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置 → 插件页直接启用或停用插件：切换开关即时停止或启动插件（无需重启），并持久化，重启后依旧生效。

description.en: Read-only DSH plugin auditor with static scanning, current-session model review, and confirmation gates.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 插件审查器：静态扫描、当前会话模型审查和启用前确认。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness novel writing and reading workspace plugin (modified fork of dsh-workspace-explorer, MIT): character-accurate pagination, auto-saved progress, pinned progress bookmark, return-to-progress chip, chapter TOC, ruled-line writing mode
Read-only live subagent process inspector for DeepSeek Harness Web
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话中实时查看子 agent 树、任务步骤、推理、工具调用和 token 消耗，方便调试和观察。

description.en: DSH 鎏金主题插件:金粉奢华皮肤,htm 恒等映射流水,原型驱动的逐节移植
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上金粉奢华皮肤，零构建即装即用，界面全面焕新。

description.en: dsh-vision-toggle 是一个为 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 提供「支持图片」开关的插件，让你在设置页按模型一键启用/禁用图片输入
description.zh: 在 dsh 设置页为每个模型一键开启或关闭图片输入，灵活控制多模态能力。

description.en: 调节输入框和内容展示区的宽度百分比
description.zh: 在设置里加两个滑杆，随手调输入框和内容区宽度，宽屏用起来更舒服。

description.en: Drag a conversation onto any workspace group in the sidebar to relocate it between DSH workspaces, updating its cwd, disk location and registry ownership.
description.zh: 把侧边栏中的对话拖到任意工作区分组，即可在 DSH 工作区之间迁移该对话，同步更新其 cwd、磁盘位置与工作区注册表归属。

description.en: HTTP network debugging toolset for DeepSeek Harness: a general-purpose HTTP client with SSRF/private-network protection, per-session request history with replay, response inspection and HAR export - three dsh tools plus a zero-dependency CLI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的网络调试工具集：带 SSRF/私网防护的通用 HTTP 客户端、会话内请求历史与重放、响应检查与 HAR 导出——三个 dsh 工具外加零依赖 CLI。

description.en: Turns code review into a hard gate: deterministic severity rules, LLM-assisted findings, a team approval quorum and a durable compliance audit trail that must pass before a merge proceeds.
description.zh: 将代码评审变成一道硬性闸门：确定性严重级别规则、LLM 辅助发现、团队批准法定人数与合规审计追踪，未通过前禁止合并。

description.en: A terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供终端界面，让你在命令行里直观地查看和管理 agent 运行状态。
人机协作认知插件，AI负责发散创意，人负责直觉收敛，提升决策质量与效率。

description.en: Arknights Rhine Lab (莱茵生命) skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
deepseek harness plugin browser runtime
DSH plugin: browse & live-sync local Claude Code / Codex CLI / Cursor Agent conversations inside the dsh web GUI
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页界面里直接浏览并实时同步 Claude Code、Codex CLI 和 Cursor Agent 的本地对话记录，方便统一查看和管理。

description.en: DSH Web GUI 对话区宽度调节插件：聊天内容区/用户气泡宽度滑块即时生效
DeepSeek 分时段计费小组件 · DSH client 插件（platform=web）：按北京时间自动判定高峰/空闲时段，10 款风格侧边栏小组件 + 设置页
description.zh: 按北京时间自动识别高峰/空闲时段，用10款侧边栏小组件直观展示DeepSeek分时计费价格，帮你省钱。

description.en: A generic web-app docking system for DeepSeek Harness: dock any local web service (marimo, Pluto.jl, gradio, streamlit...) via *.localhost routing + iframe.

OAuth2-capable IMAP email reader for accounts where password authentication is disabled. Microsoft disabled Basic Auth for personal Outlook IMAP in 2024, so this plugin authenticates via refresh-token OAuth2 (XOAUTH2) with automatic token refresh, plus app-password login for Gmail through an optional local HTTP/SOCKS proxy. Registers list/read/search as ol_email_* so it can coexist with the market dsh-email plugin without tool-name clashes.
description.zh: 面向密码认证被禁用邮箱的 OAuth2 IMAP 读取插件：微软 2024 年起停用个人 Outlook 的 IMAP 基本认证，本插件改用 refresh-token OAuth2（XOAUTH2）自动续期，Gmail 走应用密码并可选本地 HTTP/SOCKS 代理；工具注册为 ol_email_*，可与市场版 dsh-email 共存不撞名。

description.en: Experience validation layer for DSH: zero-token collection of tool-failure/retry/search signals, AI refinement into verified skill books (three-layer verification), looked up at task start. Ships 10 trial skills and benchmark data (complex-task success 100% vs 60% bare).
description.zh: DSH 经验验证固化层：零 token 采集工具失败/重试/搜索信号，加工轮提炼成经三层检验的技能书，任务开局翻书复用。内置 10 本试验经验 + benchmark 数据（复杂任务成功率 100% vs 裸环境 60%）。

description.en: Security-focused Feishu (Lark) channel for DeepSeek Harness: allowlisted remote-agent access with workspace-scoped paths, symlink checks, risk-based approvals, session isolation, redacted logs, and bounded message queues.
description.zh: 面向安全的 DeepSeek Harness 飞书通道：提供白名单远程 Agent 访问、工作区路径与符号链接边界校验、风险分级审批、会话隔离、日志脱敏和有界消息队列。

description.en: Floating minimal-mode DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: a transparent terminal TUI over dsh web in a borderless Electron window.

One-time Full access switch for DeepSeek Harness: new sessions (workspaces and conversations) start with danger-full-access and skip the per-session Full access confirmation; installable as a dsh bundle or via patch scripts.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加 Full access 一次性开关：新工作区与新对话默认 danger-full-access 并跳过逐个确认；可作为 dsh bundle 安装，也可用脚本打补丁。

description.en: Live remaining balance for the current API key from Sub2API, New API, or official DeepSeek, plus actual spend when the site publishes it, not a local token estimate.
description.zh: 读取当前 API key 在 Sub2API、New API 或 DeepSeek 官方账本上的剩余额度；站点公布实扣时才显示实扣，不是本地 token 估算。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Cursor-style Git commit-chain graph with SVG lanes, commit details, diff, filtering, and guarded branch switching.
Literal Hermes Agent → DeepSeek Harness bridge: shared memory, skills, live tools, MCP, and full-agent delegation.
description.zh: 将 Hermes 智能体无缝接入 DeepSeek Harness，共享记忆、技能与实时工具，支持 MCP 和全代理委派，让多智能体协作更高效。

description.en: Configurable VS Code style keyboard shortcuts for the DSH web GUI, with a settings-page keybinding editor, conflict detection and JSON import/export.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供可配置的 VS Code 风格键盘快捷键，内置设置页改键、冲突检测与 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Uses an isolated LLM review to approve or reject DSH sandbox permission requests.
description.zh: 使用隔离的 LLM 审查来批准或拒绝 DSH 沙箱权限请求。

description.en: Nous Portal LLM plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接接入 Nous Portal 模型库，无需改动核心代码，即插即用。

description.en: Matrix rain for expanded thinking in DeepSeek Harness Web
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 网页里的思考过程变成数字雨特效，让推理内容可视化，边看边想更带感。

description.en: DSH plugin: sync MCP configs from Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Cursor Agent
description.zh: 一键同步 Claude Code、Codex CLI 和 Cursor 的 MCP 配置，省去手动迁移的麻烦。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) skill: read/write Notion workspaces via the official REST API
/fuck — migrates your Claude Code & Codex habits into DeepSeek Harness. One command, parallel scan, boot-time recall.
description.zh: /fuck 命令：把 Claude Code 和 Codex 的使用习惯迁移进 DSH。

description.en: dsh插件：DeepSeek 官方余额状态栏（DSH web 插件）
DSH plugin: auto-upload conversation progress to Tencent IMA (daily note + Work knowledge base)
description.zh: 自动把对话记录同步到腾讯IMA，自动生成每日笔记和工作知识库，方便随时查阅和知识沉淀。

description.en: Web UI plugin that folds each staged response's think and tool calls into per-segment bounded, scrollable slide windows with a configurable height, keeping every intermediate response visible.
description.zh: Web UI 插件：以阶段性文字回复为界分段，把每段的 think 与工具调用收进限高可滚动、高度可配置的 slide 窗口，中间过程始终可见。

description.en: Send QQ private-message notifications via a local NapCat bot: qq_send / qq_status / qq_napcat / qq_deploy native tools plus one-click deployment scripts.
description.zh: 通过本机 NapCat 机器人向主号 QQ 发送私聊通知：qq_send/qq_status/qq_napcat/qq_deploy 原生工具与一键部署脚本。

description.en: 对DSH里的OpenCode的Go套餐，以及DeepSeek官方API的额度监控
description.zh: 在DSH界面左下角实时监控OpenCode Go套餐、DeepSeek API余额和MiniMax Token Plan额度，并显示当前任务的token消耗与预估费用。

description.en: Branching surveys in the web GUI: the ask_survey tool with per-option routing, hover insights, Mermaid diagrams, quick one-click answer templates, and resumable banked progress.
description.zh: 网页端分支问卷：ask_survey 工具，按选项路由后续问题，悬停洞察、Mermaid 流程图、一键快速模板，答案可暂存续答。

description.en: Adds a Branch Chat tab to dsh-better-sidebar that opens independent archived sessions with a head/middle/tail context digest and the same tools as the main agent.
description.zh: 在 dsh-better-sidebar 新增分支对话页签：开出独立封存 session，注入头／中／尾脉络摘要，并使用与主对话相同的工具。

description.en: Manage installed DeepSeek Harness skills from Settings: disable/enable without uninstalling, restorable trash. Desktop + web. (dsh-plugin)

SMS forwarding webhook for DeepSeek Harness. Phone apps (SMS Forwarder, Tasker, or any HTTP POST) push messages to a local HTTP endpoint; the plugin stores them as JSONL and exposes sms_recent / sms_search tools so the agent can read SMS verification codes during tasks. Auto-extracts the first 4-8 digit OTP from each message, supports keyword filtering, and works over LAN or Tailscale.
description.zh: DSH 短信转发 webhook：手机端转发 App（短信转发器/Tasker 等）把短信 POST 到本地 HTTP 端点，插件落盘 JSONL 并暴露 sms_recent / sms_search 工具，让 agent 在任务中直接读取短信验证码；自动提取 4–8 位 OTP，支持关键词过滤，可走局域网或 Tailscale。

description.en: Read and search bounded log output from allowlisted SSH servers and log roots without exposing arbitrary remote commands.
description.zh: 从白名单 SSH 服务器和日志根目录读取或搜索有界日志内容，不开放任意远程命令。

description.en: 灵感便签 (Sticky Notes) plugin for the dsh web GUI: jot ideas while the agent thinks — without interrupting it. Queue-channel sends/forwards, auto-persist (localStorage + host file), export TXT/JSON/MD, bilingual zh/en. DeepSeek Harness plugin · @lastplayer82/dsh-sticky-notes
description.zh: 在智能体思考时随手记灵感，不打断对话，还能一键把便签内容发进聊天里。

description.en: A paper-and-ink client-side theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: Balanced preserves semantic status colors, and Immersive maps supported surfaces to monochrome.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 纸墨风客户端主题，提供保留语义状态色的平衡模式和黑白沉浸模式。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: top-right widget counting let me / we / let's / I'll in reasoning chains
description.zh: 在右上角实时统计思维链中“let me”等短语的出现次数，帮你快速洞察推理过程。

description.en: Readable thinking display for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把模型思考过程分段整理成清晰摘要，让推理内容一目了然，方便阅读和复盘。

description.en: A phone shell for the web GUI - the sidebar becomes an overlay drawer that closes when a session is tapped, the settings sheet goes full-screen single column, and the transcript is retuned for phone reading.
description.zh: 网页版界面的手机外壳：侧栏改为覆盖式抽屉、点会话自动收起，设置面板改全屏单列，正文排版按手机阅读距离重调。
把 Trae 的积分变成本地 OpenAI/Anthropic 接口，让 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具直接调用 GLM、DeepSeek 等模型。

description.en: Check which DeepSeek Harness plugins actually loaded, and look up public evaluation boards on trapstreet.run
description.zh: 查看 DeepSeek Harness 插件是否真正加载，并浏览 trapstreet.run 上的公开评测榜单。

description.en: Per-session Web Search toggle that directs the agent to search the web before answering.
description.zh: 在聊天输入框加个「联网搜索」开关，打开后助手会先搜网页再回答。

description.en: Agent Trace — visualize an agent's reasoning, parallel tool calls, and results as an interactive DAG inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把智能体的推理过程、并行工具调用和结果，以交互式流程图的形式实时展示在聊天流中，让执行逻辑一目了然。

description.en: Ask a sidebar assistant about selected assistant text: an ephemeral right-side panel answers from a snapshot of the main conversation's LLM history with streaming Markdown, collapsible thinking and multi-turn follow-ups, without touching the main conversation.
description.zh: 选中助手回答中的文本，在临时右侧面板向侧边栏助手提问：基于主对话 LLM 历史快照回答，支持流式 Markdown、可折叠思考与多轮追问，不打扰主对话。

description.en: S3 storage backend for the DeepSeek Harness attachment seam: content-addressed, idempotent uploads with verified reads, installable with one dsh plugin command.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 S3 附件存储，支持内容寻址与幂等上传，读取可校验，一条命令即可安装。

description.en: Fast `@` file/session reference caching for the DSH Web GUI: preloaded indexes, browser-local keystroke filtering and native mention serialization.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框 `@` 文件/会话引用加速：预加载索引、浏览器本地按键过滤、保留原生 mention 序列化。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle providing Brave Search API access and a unified brave_search tool
description.zh: 一键接入 Brave 搜索，在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接搜网页、新闻、图片和视频，还能拿 LLM 上下文。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的社交评论研究插件

Verifier-gated multi-agent mathematical proof-search orchestration, native to DeepSeek Harness: content-addressed fact graph, role-gated tools, cold-start verifier, worker swarm, paper/report rendering. TypeScript, cross-platform. Based on Danus (frenzymath).
System tray support for DSH Desktop: tray icon plus settings to hide the main window on minimize or close, with self-healing boot-time injection.
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 加系统托盘，最小化或关闭时隐藏到托盘，更新后还能自动恢复。

description.en: DSH bundle: 当前 Git 分支徽标。在会话 header 与新会话欢迎页显示当前分支，支持切换、新建、更新、拉取、推送、删除（仅本地分支，IDEA 风格目录树）。
A github reviewer based on the Deepseek Harness
Session loop-health diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness: oscillation/stall/near-repeat/per-tool/token/compaction profiles + auditable 0-100 score. CLI + live watch bundle.
Local LLM integration plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接管理本地 GGUF 模型，通过 llama-server 提供服务，无需安装 Ollama。

description.en: MCP marketplace and management panel in the Web sidebar: one-click official templates (Apifox public/private, Apipost, MasterGo, Pixso), paste raw mcpServers JSON, and enable, edit or delete your services with hot reload.
description.zh: Web 侧边栏的 MCP 市场与管理面板：官方模板一键配置（Apifox 公有云/私有化、Apipost、MasterGo、Pixso）、粘贴完整 mcpServers JSON、我的服务增删改启停，热加载生效。

description.en: A unified memory management layer
description.zh: 为 AI Agent 提供统一记忆管理，支持短长程记忆、语义检索、智能摘要与可视化界面，让对话更连贯。

description.en: 为原版 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期记忆：用键值对保存身份、偏好、方法论和约束，并在后续对话中按提问召回。可手动增删改查；也可选「记忆迁移」，从 ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / DeepSeek 官方导出包提取少量核心记忆。独立插件，不修改 DSH 源码。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上长期记忆，用键值对保存你的身份、偏好和规则，后续对话自动按提问召回，还能从其他 AI 导出包迁移核心记忆。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness mobile: CSS-only UI plugin, password-protected Cloudflare tunnel and a tiny Android WebView app - use DSH on your phone.
description.zh: 用手机也能玩 DSH：纯 CSS 移动端界面，配密码保护的 Cloudflare 隧道和安卓 WebView 小应用。

description.en: DSH skill pack: legacy code modernization workflow (preflight -> assess -> map -> transform) with Cordis mount plugin, offline Python scripts and smoke tests
description.zh: 把老代码现代化改造的流程打包成技能，自动完成评估、映射和转换，附带离线脚本和冒烟测试。

description.en: DSH休闲阅读文本插件
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面里摸鱼看小说的插件，支持悬浮窗分页阅读和透明隐形模式。

description.en: Antigravity-style run_command for DSH: short commands return inline within a configurable wait window (default 10s) while longer ones auto-promote into ctx.jobs for later collection and completion notices — executed via ctx.shell under the session sandbox and approval pipeline.
description.zh: Antigravity 式 run_command：短命令在可配置窗口（默认 10 秒）内同步返回结果，长命令自动晋升为 ctx.jobs 后台任务并推送完成通知——命令经 ctx.shell 执行，受会话沙箱与审批管线约束。

description.en: DeepSeek API balance + per-call cost tracker: durable per-call cost ledger from real usage chunks with official Beijing peak/off-peak (x2) pricing, 60 s balance polling, and a sidebar footer action showing balance and today's spend.
description.zh: DeepSeek 余额与逐次调用成本追踪：基于真实 usage 的持久化成本账本，支持官方高峰/低谷定价（北京时间 ×2），60 秒余额轮询，侧栏底部显示余额与今日消耗。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness proxy config plugin: injects HTTP/SOCKS proxy into process.env so plugin installs (pnpm/git) use it
description.zh: 配置代理后自动生效，让 Harness 及子进程走 HTTP/SOCKS 代理，访问外网更顺畅，本机内网直连不绕路。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供 SSH 远程工作区能力：已核验的服务器身份、失败关闭的 Agent 执行路由、远端文件与命令操作；提供 Windows 离线一键安装包，无需 Node.js 或构建工具。
DSH plugin: expose rtk (Rust Token Killer) as wide-category Tools — save 60-90% tokens on shell output with softRewriteBash routing
description.zh: 把 Rust Token Killer 的 60+ 个 token 优化命令变成模型可调用的工具，处理 shell 输出能省 60-90% token。

description.en: 为deepseek harness创建自动化任务
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness启用内置持久化调度器，让根Agent拥有创建和管理自动化任务的能力。

description.en: Memory consolidation tuning for dsh-mneme (autoDream enabled, schema-max output budget, deepseek-chat route) plus the llm-deepseek reasoning-effort fix, an MCP bridge to the auditable seed-society agent runtime, and six yogacara seed skills.

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 提供会话管理：列表（含标题）/ 点击预览 / 真删除（二次确认）/ 归档分组与恢复。
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持列表预览、二次确认删除、归档分组与恢复，让会话整理更高效。

description.en: DSH SSH Forge：为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供 SSH 远程工作区能力：已核验的服务器身份、失败关闭的 Agent 执行路由、远端文件与命令操作；提供 Windows 离线一键安装包，无需 Node.js 或构建工具。
DSH plugin bundle for obra/superpowers skills and development workflows

A useful or useless plugin for Deepseek Harness that visualize your token usage as-you-go. It's just delightful watching colorful bubbles popping up while your agent is emptying your wallet, isn't it?
description.zh: 把 token 消耗变成实时冒出的彩色气泡，让你边烧钱边看得开心。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件工具包——一条命令安装两个常用插件：mcp管理 与 Skill管理。装完即用，设置页自动出现 mcp管理 与 Skill管理 两个分区。
Personal usage analytics & activity dashboard for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI: token totals, contribution heatmap, model share, insights. Local-only, metadata only.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供个人使用统计与活动仪表盘，展示 token 消耗、贡献热力图和模型占比，帮助了解使用情况。

description.en: Personal usage analytics & activity dashboard for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI: token totals, contribution heatmap, model share, insights. Local-only, metadata only.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页界面里查看个人用量统计和活动仪表盘，包括 Token 总数、贡献热力图、模型占比和洞察，数据仅存本地。
给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加上语音输入和朗读功能，动动嘴就能和 AI 对话，也能让 AI 把回答念给你听。

description.en: Un-clamps the composer stats footer: long turn and token stats lines span the full composer width instead of truncating with an ellipsis.
description.zh: 解除输入框统计行的宽度限制：较长的轮次与 token 统计行横跨输入框全宽居中显示，不再以省略号截断。

description.en: 指哪打哪：在任意网页标记元素并评论，截图+结构化文本直达 dsh 会话（dsh 插件 + 浏览器扩展）
description.zh: 在任意网页上直接标记元素并写评论，截图和结构化内容一键发送到 dsh 会话，告别繁琐描述。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：逐页判断搜索结果的语义相关度，智能过滤无关噪音，量化信息覆盖度，让每一次AI检索都透明可信。
description.zh: 逐页判断搜索结果的相关度，自动过滤无关噪音，量化信息覆盖度，让AI检索更透明可信。

description.en: DeepSeek API 余额显示插件 / DeepSeek API balance display for DeepSeek Harness

description.zh: 把 DSH 所有组件装进一个指挥室，统一管理插件、技能、预设和规范，一目了然。

description.en: Visual conversation canvas for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把对话变成可视化画布，让你像看地图一样浏览和管理整个会话。

description.en: Automatically sends a "continue" prompt when a reply is cut off at the output token limit, resuming long answers without manual input; aimed at self-hosted Ollama deployments with small output caps.
description.zh: 回答因达到单次输出 token 上限被截断时自动发送"继续"续写，无需手动操作；面向自部署 Ollama 等小输出上限场景。

description.en: DSH 余额与消耗面板（dsh-balance-stats）
description.zh: 实时查看 DeepSeek Harness 的余额和消耗情况，帮你随时掌握成本，避免超额。

description.en: dsh对话导航
DeepSeek Harness timeline with hover Q&A preview and panel pin
description.zh: 给聊天消息加一条时间轴侧栏，悬停就能预览问答摘要，还能钉住面板、按天分隔和加书签。

description.en: 64-entry external CLI catalog with bounded public discovery and guarded package-manager or manual official installation, exposed through DSH tools and a standalone command.
description.zh: 包含 64 个条目的外部 CLI 清单，支持受限公开来源发现，并通过 DSH 工具和独立命令行提供受保护的包管理器或官方手动安装。
在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里加一个独立的聊天窗口，直接问 DeepSeek，不用切换页面。

description.en: Drag documents into the dsh web chat; the agent reads them directly from the local filesystem and the right sidebar lists the outputs and file paths.
description.zh: 拖拽文档进 dsh Web 对话框，Agent 直读本地文件处理，右侧侧栏展示产出与文件路径。

description.en: Unofficial community plugin: per-session Engram memory for DeepSeek Harness — spawns an engram MCP child per agent session rooted at the session workspace, registers mem_* tools per agent scope, and injects the Memory Protocol as a system-prompt section.
description.zh: 为每个智能体会话创建独立的 Engram 记忆空间，让记忆按会话隔离，互不干扰。

description.en: dsh 中可以使用插件来调用gpt-image2生成图片
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中按需生成图片，一句话描述需求即可快速出图，提升创作效率。

description.en: Claude Code / Codex CLI update detection, prompting, and one-click channel updates for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 自动检测 Claude Code 和 Codex CLI 版本，一键更新 DeepSeek Harness 插件，省心省力。

description.en: Codex-style session archiving: hovering a sidebar conversation row reveals an Archive icon at the far right; one click archives the session via the official workspace archive API.
description.zh: Codex 风格会话归档：鼠标悬浮侧边栏会话行时，最右侧浮现 Archive 图标，一键归档会话。

description.en: DSH plugin: bookmark every question you asked — index, search, and jump back to any conversation point in one click.
description.zh: 给对话加个书签索引，一键回看所有问过的问题，长对话翻找不再头疼。

description.en: User message jump bar for the DSH web GUI: a minimap-style dash strip on the right edge of the conversation, with hover preview, click-to-jump, drag-to-scrub and a viewport marker.
description.zh: DSH Web 用户消息跳转条：对话区右缘 minimap 式横杠条带，悬停预览消息内容、点击跳转置顶、拖拽快速浏览，并带当前视口标记。

description.en: Codex-style left message navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话侧边栏添加 Codex 风格的左侧消息导航栏，快速跳转历史消息。

description.en: Planner/executor delegation with named roles: a strong planner steers, disposable executor sub-agents (per-role routes and prompts) implement. Default role plus per-delegation override, a global reasoning-effort knob in the composer chip, and a settings page for role management.
description.zh: 规划者/执行者委派调度：高阶模型（Planner）定方向，一次性低阶执行子代理（按角色的路由与提示词）干具体活；默认角色 + 单次委派覆盖，输入框芯片快速切换角色与全局思考等级，设置页管理执行角色。

description.en: Mnemosyne 永久记忆插件 - 为 DSH 提供长期记忆、向量搜索和 LLM 反思功能，对标 Hindsight Coding Agents
description.zh: 给 DSH 装上永久记忆，自动保存对话并支持语义搜索，让 AI 能记住长期上下文，越用越懂你。

description.en: DSH 模型中心插件：免费模型目录 / 真免费实测 / 价格余额 / 一键切换 / 用量统计 — Model center plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把免费模型、真实可用性、价格余额和用量统计聚合到一张卡片，一键切换模型，省心省钱。
把常用提示词、模板和代码片段集中存好，聊天时在输入框旁一键取用，省去反复敲打的麻烦。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin (not MCP): a falsification-driven correction loop — explicit claims, deterministic gates, mutually exclusive hypotheses — that turns agent retry loops into auditable evidence for better development quality.
description.zh: Popper: a falsification-driven correction loop for agent sessions — claim commitment, gate falsification, and mutually exclusive hypothesis revision, with an append-only evidence ledger

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 项目组插件
description.zh: deepseek项目组功能

description.en: Quick-prompts bar for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): per-category snippet chips above the composer, orange placeholder highlighting, two-column prompt/category management, and per-session category memory.
description.zh: 在输入框上方按分类展示常用提示词片段，一键插入并高亮占位符，支持双栏管理和会话记忆，提升写作效率。

description.en: DSH插件，手机远程控制
description.zh: 手机扫码就能远程控制电脑上的 DSH WebUI，局域网内随时访问，未授权设备自动拦截。

description.en: Turns each produced-file chip into a per-file menu: open the file, copy its path, reveal it in the native file browser, or open a terminal cd-ed into its directory.
description.zh: 把每个产物文件卡片变成按文件操作的下拉菜单：打开文件、拷贝路径、在系统文件浏览器中定位，或打开终端并进入其目录。

description.en: Session manager panel under Settings → Plugins: list all sessions with title, cwd, agent preset, updated time, turns and steps, expand a row to view message history, delete non-running sessions, and export a session as JSON or Markdown via a browser Blob URL.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件 下的会话管理面板：列出全部会话的标题、工作目录、agent 预设、更新时间、轮次与步数，展开可查看消息历史，删除非运行中的会话，并经浏览器 Blob URL 导出为 JSON 或 Markdown。

description.en: 回答过程中折叠思考过程，直接输出回答内容。
description.zh: 折叠思考过程，直接展示回答，并在输入框上方显示会话活动状态条，实时统计各操作次数。

description.en: Remote-control your dsh agent from Telegram: chat, skills, workspace browsing, and file transfer.
description.zh: 通过 Telegram 遥控 dsh Agent：对话、技能调用、工作目录浏览与文件传输。

description.en: ⚡ ThunderForge — 宇宙无敌雷霆霹雳炫光 DSH 插件锻造炉：一站式插件开发套件（单一 Bundle）

description.en: DSH web plugin: interaction timeline rail for long conversations (fork-independent successor of dsh-history)

description.en: lhenlihai-hub/dsh-voice-input 声明为 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加语音输入，直接说话转文字，解放双手，让交互更自然。

description.en: DSH-Wallpaper background wallpaper and system font picker plugin for DSH Desktop. Plugin source only, no DSH core.
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 换壁纸、调系统字体，让桌面更顺眼的小插件。

description.en: 面向 Claude、Codex、Cursor 和 DeepSeek Harness 的足球数据 MCP Server，支持 18 个欧洲联赛、8 个杯赛，以及比赛、积分榜、交锋、赔率和近期状态查询。

description.en: MCP stdio gateway for exposing local AGY, Codex, and OpenCode CLI agents to DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

description.zh: 发现 Codex 和 Claude 使用过的项目目录，并将其注册为共享的 DeepSeek Harness 工作区。

description.zh: 把终端操作录制成 asciinema 视频，支持离线回放和导出 HTML，方便分享和演示。

description.en: Type @ in the composer to reference another conversation: pick a historical session and inject its compacted context into the current prompt.
description.zh: 输入 @ 引用另一个对话：选择历史会话，将其压缩总结注入当前提示词。

description.en: Splits the DeepSeek Harness sidebar into independently scrollable Pinned and Recents panes, and hides pinned sessions from Recents.

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话产物列表增加主动展开与收起功能的 Web UI 插件。
description.zh: 让对话结束后的产物列表支持主动展开和收起，查看文件更顺手。

description.en: Scan project lockfiles (npm/pnpm/yarn/pip/go/cargo/maven/gradle) against the free OSV API and report confirmed dependency vulnerabilities with fix versions
description.zh: 扫描项目锁文件，对接OSV漏洞库，自动识别依赖漏洞并给出修复版本。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: unified file import - byte-level upload store, file-list context injection, read_attachment/place_attachment tools, historical file bubbles
Immersive Hiyuki dual-form skin for DeepSeek Harness Web, with frost/sakura transitions, themed controls, and native DSH layout.
a dsh plugin that helps you to automatically generate, evolve and manage your dsh plugins
description.zh: 自动帮你生成、迭代和管理 DSH 插件，把一次成功的任务变成下次能直接用的能力。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: run subagents on a local llama.cpp model via the OpenAI Responses (/v1/responses) protocol — LLM adapter + delegation skill
DSH plugin: expose a local MCP server to remote agents via outbound-only tunnel (mcp-proxy + cloudflared Quick Tunnel) and register the public URL into dsh-mcp-client
description.zh: 把本地MCP服务通过出站隧道暴露给远程智能体，并自动注册公网地址，实现安全远程调用。

description.en: OpenRouter image, video, and speech generation as deepseek-harness tools — an out-of-tree profile bundle, no fork required
description.zh: 把 OpenRouter 的图片、视频和语音生成能力接入 deepseek-harness，无需改代码即插即用。

description.en: DSH插件，消息功能增强
description.zh: 在聊天输入框上方加一条索引标尺，帮你快速定位用户消息和最终计划，一眼看清执行结果。

description.en: 📡 手机远程遥控 DeepSeek Harness：实时进度 / 审批 / 对话（PWA + PIN 配对 + Tailscale 外网支持）
description.zh: 手机远程遥控 DeepSeek Harness，随时查看进度、审批请求和对话，支持 Tailscale 外网访问。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于关键词和语义分类的动态模型路由插件，可按任务自动选择模型与推理强度。
description.zh: 按关键词和语义自动选模型，动态调整推理强度，省心又高效。
把会话过程、产出和token消耗一键生成可独立打开的办公室动画仪表盘，方便复盘汇报。

description.en: A live peak/off-peak pricing readout for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: one status pill under the composer, with the effective prices on hover. · DeepSeek Harness 错峰计价浮标
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面实时显示错峰计价状态，悬停即可查看当前价格，帮你省钱。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 制作的仿 OpenCode 的 TUI 界面插件
Safe loopback-only Web UI for managing DeepSeek Harness profile plugins
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页端管理插件，可启用、禁用或移除已安装的插件，操作安全便捷。

description.en: Plugin tools provider for DeepSeek Harness: expert2skill, skill-compliance, dependency-scan (dsh.bundle)
description.zh: 内置专家转技能、合规校验与依赖扫描工具，自动完成插件规范检查与评分报告，让开发维护更省心。

description.en: DSH native tool: analyze the current branch diff and generate a Conventional Commits PR title, description and self-review checklist
description.zh: 分析当前分支的代码差异，自动生成符合 Conventional Commits 规范的 PR 标题、描述和自检清单，提升提交流程效率。

description.en: DSH 会话额度监控增强版：真实 token 计费、实时进度条、额度耗尽拦截、峰谷定价、右上角余额校准胶囊（官方基线 + 同源防护 + inputWrite 计费档）

description.zh: 在 WebUI 里直接打电话式对话，随时打断、追问或纠正 Agent，用语音指挥它干活。

description.zh: 把本地 DSH 会话日志挖成个人使用报告，自动生成 Markdown 日报/周报/月报和自包含 HTML 账单，帮你复盘效率。

description.en: Exposes the DSH dynamic-Cordis toolset to Claude Code over MCP (streamable HTTP on the existing web port, no new listener): ten tools to list, inspect, define, run, stop and permanently remove dynamic plugins in a live DSH session, with the same approval flow the GUI uses for packages that ship a client half. Bearer auth is mandatory — the token is configured on a DSH settings page, the endpoint answers 503 rather than serve without one, accepts loopback only and never emits CORS headers.

description.en: DSH 数据模式插件：在原版 DeepSeek Harness 上增加只读问数。连接数据库或上传 CSV/Excel，用自然语言查数，并支持按数据源管理业务知识。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: live task completion time, token & per-model cost estimator in the session header, with LLM-powered PERT estimates. / DSH 插件：会话标题栏实时任务耗时、token 与花费估算。
description.zh: 在会话标题栏实时显示任务耗时、token 消耗和各模型花费，还能用 AI 预估完成时间。

description.en: One-click skin switching for DSH Web settings: auto-detects installed themes, keeps exactly one active at a time, and falls back to the official look when all are off. Changes apply instantly and survive restarts.
description.zh: DSH 主题切换：自动检测已安装的皮肤/主题，在设置页一键互斥切换，全部停用时回退官方默认外观，切换即时生效并跨重启保留。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: local daily/weekly token usage dashboard and heatmap
description.zh: DSH web GUI token-consumption heatmap: a daily/weekly total-token usage panel fed by session-log usage events

description.en: A `search` tool that learns to pick between fast and thorough search strategies using a contextual bandit (Thompson sampling), improving from real usage instead of a fixed heuristic.
description.zh: 使用上下文赌博机算法（Thompson 采样）学习何时使用快速搜索、何时使用深度搜索的 `search` 工具。

description.en: GitHub REST API tools + browser sidebar panel: repos, search, issues, PRs, comments, account binding (credential-store), and one-click clone-as-workspace.
description.zh: GitHub REST API 工具 + 浏览器侧边栏面板：仓库/搜索/Issue/PR/评论、账号绑定（凭据库）与一键克隆为工作区。

description.en: Give text-only DeepSeek models vision by describing images through an OpenAI-compatible vision model (DSH plugin)
One-click DSH background switcher backed by local Wallpaper Engine images/videos
WeCom (Enterprise WeChat) Smart Robot bridge: two-way chat over the aibot WebSocket gateway, no public endpoint needed.
description.zh: 企业微信智能机器人桥接：aibot WebSocket 双向对话（bot_id + secret），无需公网回调。

description.en: Windows-grade notifications for DeepSeek Harness: system toasts, custom sounds, and a taskbar tray badge — a native DSH profile plugin (zero patching).
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上 Windows 原生提醒：系统弹窗、自定义提示音和任务栏角标，待办决策不再错过。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：Workspace Only 开关 —— 任何模式下越界文件访问都请求用户确认 (approval prompt in every mode)

description.en: Reports bounded, repository-relative Git status as structured data without staging, committing, or changing branches.
description.zh: 以结构化数据返回有界、相对仓库根的 Git 状态，不暂存、不提交，也不切换分支。

description.en: 工作空间文件浏览器：树形目录浏览、搜索、在线编辑，可放入布局左/右区域，文件在对话/轨迹同级标签页打开

Zhihu (知乎) dashboard: hot list with trend arrows, follow feed (favorites/creations/followees), post tracking (question/keyword/person) with auto-briefs, and five agent tools (zhihu_search/hot/answer/global_search/followees).
description.zh: 知乎面板：热榜（带趋势标记）、关注动态（收藏/创作/关注的人）、帖子追踪（问题/关键词/关注的人，支持自动创意简报），并提供 5 个对话工具（zhihu_search / hot / answer / global_search / followees）。

description.en: 基于deepseek harness插件功能捏的狼人杀小游戏

description.en: DSH 插件管理器：设置→插件管理。插件安装/卸载/禁用/更新，插件包导入导出，Agent 预设清理。

description.en: A local table data management plugin developed for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接管理表格数据，无需数据库和服务器，数据全存在本地，简单好用。

description.en: Destructive-command interception gate for dsh: parses shell semantics, judges risk against 41 built-in rules, and holds irreversible rm -rf, git reset --hard, and git push --force style commands at a confirmation gate.
description.zh: dsh 破坏性命令拦截闸门：解析 shell 语义、依据 41 条内置规则判定风险，将 rm -rf、git reset --hard、git push --force 等不可逆命令挡在确认关卡之前。

description.en: Blocks agents from reading or writing sensitive files (.env, credentials, key material), masks leaked secret-shaped values in tool results, keeps an audit journal, and exposes safe sg_* inspection tools that never print raw values.
description.zh: 拦截 agent 对敏感文件（.env、凭据、密钥材料）的读写，对工具结果中泄露的机密形状内容做掩码兜底，记录审计日志，并提供永不输出原始值的 sg_* 安全检查工具。

description.en: Cross-app project memory for DeepSeek Harness with role-separated writeback, a visual knowledge workspace, confirmed corrections, session controls, local Writer and organizer settings, and an account-free Windows local installation preview.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的跨应用项目记忆，支持角色分离写回、可视化知识工作台、确认后纠错、会话控制、本地 Writer 与整理模型设置，以及免账号 Windows 本地安装预览。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 桌面宠物「宇昊」

Turns a stated need into a plugin choice: an agent skill that queries a catalog of the whole `dsh-plugin` topic (2600+ repos, recrawled every 6 hours, Chinese descriptions from Workers AI) through a ranked search API, then hands back the matching `dsh plugin add` command.
description.zh: 把「我想让 DSH 做什么」直接变成选好的插件：技能查询覆盖整个 `dsh-plugin` topic 的目录（2600+ 仓库，每 6 小时重抓，简介由 Workers AI 译成中文）的相关度检索接口，再给出对应的 `dsh plugin add` 命令。

description.en: 这是一个专为 DeepSeek-Harness 定制的桌宠皮肤包， DeepSeek 的标志性“大鲸鱼”等宠物养成。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 界面加一只会游泳、会互动的桌面小鲸鱼，陪你写代码、跑任务，让开发不再枯燥。

description.en: dsh 主题管理插件
description.zh: dsh 主题管理插件

description.en: Kimi-Code-style agent swarm for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): parallel worker agents + coordinator synthesis — agent_swarm tool and /swarm command

Floating API-balance badge for DeepSeek Harness: live balance for DeepSeek, Moonshot, OpenAI and custom endpoints; draggable, resizable, frosted-glass look, with text color adapting to the content beneath.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 悬浮 API 余额徽章：实时显示 DeepSeek / Moonshot / OpenAI / 自定义接口余额；可拖动缩放、亚克力质感、文字颜色随下方内容明暗自适应。

description.en: DSH Web UI 的认证门禁插件，提供 SVG 图形验证码与防暴力破解保护
description.zh: 给 DSH Web UI 加一道登录门，用 SVG 图形验证码拦住暴力破解，保护你的管理界面。

description.en: DSH Auto Mode — native security review plugin for DeepSeek Harness: pre-execution rule interception + delivery-time independent subagent review. Built for long-running agents.
Provides the bili_summary tool: Bilibili video metadata, subtitle timeline, and sharp-based frame capture with built-in error handling and graceful degradation.
description.zh: 提供 bili_summary 工具：B 站视频元数据、字幕时间轴与 sharp 切帧配图，内置错误处理与优雅降级。

description.en: Claude → DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 配置迁移插件：自动识别用户主目录与项目根的 .claude/skills、.claude/rules、.mcp.json、CLAUDE.md，skill 按工作区隔离唤醒，MCP 动态注册真实连接，内置可折叠配置中心看板
Code smell radar: statically scans TODO/FIXME debt, stub implementations, long lines, oversized files and duplicated blocks, with severity-sorted read-only fix suggestions.
description.zh: 代码气味雷达：静态扫描 TODO/FIXME 债务、未实现桩、超长行、大文件与重复代码块，按严重度输出修复建议，全程只读。

description.en: DSH bundle plugin: screenshots, screen recording, Markdown→Xiaohongshu image cards, dev.to publishing, and human-in-the-loop review for DeepSeek Harness
Conversation-local credential handoff for DSH that writes through the credential service without exposing the secret.
description.zh: 会话级凭证交接：通过 credential 服务安全传递。

description.en: 数据台账：DeepSeek Harness 本地数据统一看板——对话/账本/技能/记忆/日志的来源、位置与内容摘要，回收站删除、浏览器存储清理（dsh-plugin）
description.zh: 数据台账：DeepSeek Harness 本地数据统一看板——对话/账本/技能/记忆/日志的来源、位置与内容摘要，回收站删除、浏览器存储清理（dsh-plugin）

description.en: Transparent image preprocessing route for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 透明图片预处理路由：给纯文本模型加视觉通道。

description.en: Document-code consistency guard: audits version headers / changelog tables / directory trees / module & test counts / cross-doc references for drift, with severity-sorted, read-only fix suggestions.
description.zh: 文档与代码一致性守护：版本号/更新记录表/结构树/模块清单/测试计数/交叉引用漂移审计与修复建议，全程只读。

description.en: DSH 对话报告化分享插件：生成带封面、摘要统计与章节排版的精美报告，导出为 PNG 图片 / 单 HTML 文件 / PDF。
Installs two selectable Agent Presets: a shell-restricted general-purpose agent and a repository-focused coding agent.
description.zh: 安装两个可选 Agent Preset：默认不暴露 Shell 的通用 Agent，以及面向真实代码仓库的 Coding Pro。

description.en: VS Code-style file explorer for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar file tree + multi-tab preview (code/image/PDF/audio/video/zip), search, sort, split view. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:ZrSiO4-y/dsh-explorer

description.en: Keeps what the agent builds at runtime: turns a `cordis_define` dynamic package into a real installed plugin that survives restart, writing the bundle and registering the profile layer with no pnpm, no network, and no build authorization.
description.zh: 把 agent 现场造出来的插件留下来：将 `cordis_define` 的动态包固化成能跨重启存活的正式插件，写包并注册 profile 层的全过程不用 pnpm、不联网、不需要构建授权。

description.en: Runtime plugin loading for the Web UI: a watched hot directory installs/updates client-plugin bundles live on every open page, no restart. Includes a right-column subagent dashboard example.
description.zh: Web UI 运行时插件加载：监视热目录，运行中安装/更新客户端插件 bundle，所有页面即时生效，免重启。附子智能体看板示例。

DSH plugin: /init slash command that generates an AGENTS.md guide for the current project with a two-stage model call

Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a local KoboldCpp (llama.cpp) server through koboldcpp_run and koboldcpp_vision tools, with on-demand server lifecycle management.
description.zh: 给在线模型装上本地双手：koboldcpp_run 与 koboldcpp_vision 工具把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地 KoboldCpp（llama.cpp）服务器，并按需拉起与管理服务器生命周期。

description.en: 浮游主题（Krill）——深海世界 + 浅海世界 双模式主题插件（DSH Web）：深色=深海（亮度编码信息层级），亮色=浅海（清澈度编码）；浮游生物动画背景、深潜工作态增强、水母参数入口。dsh-plugin
Fix the DeepSeek Harness web UI on phones: injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill so it works over plain HTTP on your LAN - no certs, no proxy. dsh plugin + CLI, zero dependencies.

Line-range selection: browse workspace files, preview code with line numbers, visually select a line range, and write a `@path:start-end` reference into the composer; the agent receives the exact selected lines on send.
description.zh: 行选区：浏览工作区文件、带行号预览代码、可视化选中行范围，一键把 `@path:start-end` 引用写入输入框，agent 发送时自动收到所选行原文，精准修改指定行。

description.en: Local Markdown wiki as long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — RRF-fused retrieval (keyword + wikilink graph + temporal), token-budget injection, auto-capture. Ported from llmwiki.
description.zh: 把本地 Markdown 笔记变成 DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆，自动检索并注入上下文，让对话更连贯。

description.en: dsh mcp服务器配置管理
description.zh: dsh mcp服务器配置管理

description.zh: 让 DSH agent 直接调用 Xcode 的无头能力，建工程、构建测试、跑模拟器、渲染预览全搞定。

description.en: Per-file-type multimodal chains: preset processing models per wildcard convert image/video/audio files into prompt tokens before they reach the text-only session model, with per-preset fallback chains and a Multimodal settings page.
description.zh: 让只认文字的会话模型也能看懂图片、视频和音频，按文件类型配置处理模型链，先转成文本再进会话。

description.en: DSH Web GUI 新闻聚合插件：侧边栏入口 + 弹窗聚合国际/AI/科普/历史 RSS 新闻，站内阅读、中英互译、自定义源。A news aggregator plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: RSS feeds, in-app reading, bilingual translation, custom sources.
System-native notifications when a task finishes or needs your confirmation: Windows toast, macOS osascript, and Linux notify-send.
description.zh: 任务完成或需要确认/输入时发送操作系统原生通知：Windows toast、macOS osascript、Linux notify-send。

description.zh: DSH Web 右下角「余额」徽标：展开时读取当前所选提供方，显示 OpenCode Go 计划限额或 DeepSeek 预充值余额，并附本机 token 用量与按定价表估算的消费金额。

description.en: Native desktop pet for DSH that follows agent activity, supports Codex pet packages, and imports approved pets directly from Petdex without its CLI.
description.zh: 跟随 agent 状态的 DSH 原生桌宠，兼容 Codex 桌宠包，并可在插件内直接从 Petdex 导入已审核桌宠，无需 Petdex CLI。

description.en: DSH使用体验优化包-UI has been i18n (zh/en)。自动审核(auto-review)、提示音(systematic notification)，为你把关系统权限，持续推进；需要你审批、回答或后台任务跑完时，提示音 + 系统通知一个不落。一行命令装完，解放被持续召唤的碎片时间。
Colorscheme Plugin For DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: Colorscheme Plugin For DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Hot-reload DeepSeek Harness plugins without restarting dsh web — auto-watch, /reload command, dependency-change restart
description.zh: 改完插件不用重启 dsh web，自动监听变更并支持 /reload 命令热加载。

description.en: Scouts the deepseek-harness repo and every dsh-plugin-tagged repository to discover harnesses related to your goal, then judges each as worth trying, watching, or skipping.
description.zh: 侦察 deepseek-harness 官方仓库与所有 dsh-plugin topic 仓库，发现与目标相关的 harness，并判断每个值得试用、观望还是跳过。

description.en: Static pre-install security auditor for plugin bundles: lifecycle scripts, dynamic execution, credential-exfiltration combos, and patch-layer hazards, with zero dependencies and in-memory tar parsing.
description.zh: 插件安装前静态安全审计：生命周期脚本、动态执行、凭据外传组合特征与 patch 层风险；零依赖，tar 包全程内存解析不落盘。

description.en: Toggle, delete, undo-delete, and check/update plugins from the Web settings panel; runtime enable/disable is persisted to the profile.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置面板中启用、停用、删除/撤回插件，并支持版本检测与 npm 插件更新；运行时开关持久化到 profile。

description.en: Optimize Prompt button under the composer: one click rewrites your draft into a clearer, more executable prompt, with a before-and-after dialog and one-click replacement.
description.zh: 输入框下方「优化提示词」按钮：一键把草稿重写为更清晰、更可执行的提示词，弹出前后对比，支持一键替换回输入框。

description.en: DSH 插件：把「推理等级」(reasoning effort) 档位名翻译成中文，并为接入的自定义第三方模型注入推理等级显示与请求体写入（官方 DSH 默认不注入）。npm: dsh-reasoning-zh | DSH plugin: translate reasoning-effort level names into Chinese and inject reasoning-level display for third-party custom models. npm: dsh-reasoning-zh
Model sampling sliders (temperature / maxTokens) in the composer: override every model request for all providers via the agent/request hook, with hot/persist modes.
description.zh: 对话输入区的模型采样滑杆（temperature / maxTokens）：通过 agent/request 钩子对所有供应商的每次请求生效，支持热调/持久化两种模式。

description.en: Cron/one-shot scheduled tasks: run shell commands or fire webhooks on a schedule, with optional ServerChan/DingTalk/Feishu/webhook delivery of results.
description.zh: cron / 一次性定时任务：按调度执行 shell 命令或投递 webhook，结果可推送到 ServerChan / 钉钉 / 飞书 / 通用 Webhook。

description.en: Attach tags to sessions and search sessions by tag in the Web settings panel.
description.zh: 为会话添加标签，并在 Web 设置面板中按标签搜索会话。

description.en: Restore archived sessions to their original workspace from the Web GUI sidebar.
description.zh: 从 Web GUI 侧栏查看已归档会话，并一键恢复到原工作区。

description.en: A hands-off safety net: directories the agent deletes go to a trash folder first and symlinks are never followed, with zero approvals.
description.zh: 脱手模式安全网：agent 删除的目录先进回收站、链接绝不跟随，零审批。

description.en: Expanded color-coded diff tool cards for the edit/write tools — DeepSeek Harness client plugin with per-file line numbers

description.zh: 无需等待或打断正在工作的 Agent：即时冻结有界 Session 快照，由隔离且无工具的 LLM 异步总结，再将带来源信息的上下文胶囊投递到另一 Session 或已授权 Room；对 Session 默认 quiet，也可显式 wakeup。

description.en: Opt-in pixel-neon arcade skin with Fusion Pixel fonts, animated whale-girl icons, custom crosshair and draggable detail windows; preserves light/dark/system themes. v0.3.2 includes local display-name controls, mobile menu improvements and an optional source patch for the arcade home screen, transitions and telemetry HUD.
description.zh: 可选的像素霓虹街机皮肤：Fusion Pixel 字体、鲸鱼娘像素图标、十字准星与可拖动详情窗口，保留浅色/深色/跟随系统。v0.3.2 支持本地自定义称呼并完善手机菜单；完整街机首页、转场与数值 HUD 另附可选源码集成补丁。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 换肤插件：10 套预设皮肤 + 自然语言换肤 + 自定义背景图片 + 界面控件联动，设置→通用→「皮肤」行内切换，settings.yaml 跨设备同步。
dsh status plugin；可以方便的查看宿主机的运行状态，故障时方便排查
description.zh: dsh status plugin；可以方便的查看宿主机的运行状态，故障时方便排查

description.en: Tavily search with multiple API keys, key rotation and failover, a usage gauge, and a settings card.
description.zh: Tavily 多密钥搜索：支持密钥轮换/故障转移、用量仪表盘与设置卡片。

description.en: Shows a Spark Scope card at the bottom of the dsh sidebar: model server decode and prefill rates with sparklines, running and queued requests, KV cache, TTFT and TPOT p95, and GPU temperature, power, load and memory for each DGX Spark node. Read-only; needs a running Spark Scope server. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧边栏底部显示 Spark Scope 卡片：模型服务的 decode 与 prefill 速率及走势图、运行中与排队请求、KV 缓存、TTFT 与 TPOT p95，以及每个 DGX Spark 节点的 GPU 温度、功耗、负载和显存。只读，需要已运行的 Spark Scope 服务。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用。

description.en: Evidence-backed Skill self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness: redacted trajectory learning, quarantined proposals, arena validation, canary monitoring, automatic rollback.
description.zh: 带证据的 Skill 自进化：脱敏轨迹学习、隔离提案、竞技场验证、金丝雀监控与自动回滚。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness streaming MCP bridge: live session events as MCP progress, plus ACP adapter for cc-connect/Feishu.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 流式 MCP 桥接：将实时会话事件作为 MCP 进度输出，并提供 cc-connect/飞书 ACP 适配器。

description.en: Source Control panel in the DSH Web left rail: search, switch and create branches with ahead/behind counts, a topo-order commit graph, and a click-to-expand preview of any commit showing its files (A/M/D), insertions and deletions, message, author and timestamp. An always-on footer dock above Settings carries the branch dropdown and recent commits and follows the open session; fetch and fast-forward pull are one button, and a git_worktree agent tool creates, lists and removes worktrees.
description.zh: DSH Web 左侧栏的源代码管理面板：搜索、切换与创建分支并显示领先/落后提交数，拓扑序提交图，点击任意提交可展开查看其文件（A/M/D）、增删行数、提交信息、作者与时间。设置上方常驻一个底部停靠区，包含分支下拉与最近提交并跟随当前会话；fetch 与快进 pull 合并为一个按钮；另有 git_worktree 工具供智能体创建、列出与移除 worktree。

description.en: Yuque knowledge base as external memory for dsh — auto-injects matching document fragments into conversation, with catalogue search, cloud full-text search and online reading.
description.zh: 把语雀文档作为 dsh 的外部记忆：对话中自动检索并注入相关文档片段，支持目录快照检索、云端全文搜索与在线阅读。

description.en: Release gate for AI answer quality. Two channels: replay an existing VeriScope archive through the original Python quality gate, or run a threshold gate over a Ragas per-row export with Node only — no VeriScope, Python or pandas. Returns PASS, FAIL or REVIEW with source evidence and a re-checkable receipt; supports per-row thresholds and exact decimal comparison. It never re-evaluates and never calls a model, and REVIEW never becomes PASS.
description.zh: AI 回答质量的发布门禁。两条通道：用原 Python 门禁重放 VeriScope 归档，或仅用 Node 对 Ragas 逐条导出做阈值判定，后者不需要 VeriScope、Python 或 pandas。返回通过／失败／待复核，附出处与可复验回执；支持逐条阈值与精确十进制比较。不重新评测、不调用模型，待复核永不转为通过。

description.en: TOTP-only access control for personal DeepSeek Harness Web instances, with in-app QR enrollment, single-use recovery codes, live protection controls and lock-all revocation of page access.
description.zh: 面向个人 DeepSeek Harness Web 实例的纯 TOTP 访问验证，支持设置内扫码绑定、一次性恢复码、动态启停保护和撤销所有页面授权。

description.en: The session page has an extra "Git" page; on the left is a preview of the non-staged/staged changes, and on the right is a diff preview with a row-level action bar (staged/discarded).
description.zh: 会话页里多出一个 Git 页；左侧是未暂存 / 已暂存的改动，右侧是带行级操作条（暂存 / 丢弃）的 diff 预览。

description.en: Command Code balance and quota panel: a status row under the composer showing the available balance and the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows.
description.zh: Command Code 余额与额度面板：在输入框下方显示可用余额，以及 5 小时、每周、每月三个额度窗口。

description.en: Use the free AtomGit quota already signed in on this machine to have AtomCode run an independent code review: the model calls the atomcode_ask tool on its own, and you can also use the /atomcode-review command to review uncommitted changes, a branch or a PR in one click. The plugin reads no API key; a usage pill below the input box shows the CodingPlan quota.
description.zh: 用你本机已登录的 AtomGit 免费额度，请 AtomCode 给代码做一次独立代码审查：模型通过`atomcode_ask` 工具自主调用审查；你也可以使用`/atomcode-review`命令，一键评审未提交改动 / 分支 / PR。本插件不读取 API key；输入框下方有用量胶囊显示 CodingPlan 额度。

description.en: Persistent Bots and group rooms inside DSH — each Bot keeps its own model, permission preset, workspace and session across restarts, and every answer is a run written to a ledger the sidebar panel replays.
description.zh: DSH 里的常驻 Bot 与群聊房间——每个 Bot 都有自己的模型、权限预设、工作区与重启后仍在的会话，每次回答都是一条写进运行记录的 run，侧栏面板据此回放。

description.en: A Markdown-based draft-board plugin for dsh: live-preview editing and local persistence.
description.zh: 基于 Markdown 的 dsh 草稿板插件，支持实时预览编辑，本地持久化。

description.en: Persistent C/C++, Python, and TypeScript definition navigation with a standalone workspace UI for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化的 C/C++、Python 和 TypeScript 定义跳转及独立工作区界面。

description.en: Drag folders into the DeepSeek Harness web composer instead of hitting 'only the desktop app supports folders'. Adds a host folder dialog, /folder, and drag/paste into @path mentions. Plain browser, no desktop app.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页版直接拖文件夹进输入框，不再提示「只有桌面端支持添加文件夹」。新增主机文件夹选择框、/folder 命令，拖入/粘贴自动解析为 @路径 引用。纯浏览器可用，无需桌面端。

description.en: Peer communication between conversations in one DeepSeek Harness process: list the conversations the workspace shows, link one under a nickname, message it without waiting for its turn to end, read its progress without waking it, and declare rules for your own tool calls.
description.zh: 同一 DeepSeek Harness 进程内对话之间的对等通信：列出工作区里的对话、用昵称连接、发消息而不必等对方当前一轮结束、不唤醒对方地查看进度，并给自己声明工具调用规则。

description.en: Bring a DSH plugin repository's build and release pipeline into the app: a sidebar panel listing each repository's latest workflow run, its releases, and how far the local checkout has drifted from the last release, with buttons to trigger a build, cut a release, publish a draft, re-run, cancel, or read the failed-step log. Drives the workflows through the machine's authenticated gh CLI, so the plugin stores no credential of its own, and which repositories are tracked lives in a config file rather than the package.
description.zh: 把 DSH 插件仓库的持续构建与发布搬进应用：侧边栏面板逐仓库显示最近一次工作流运行、已发布与草稿 Release，以及本地检出相对上次发布的领先与未提交情况，并提供触发构建、发布、公开草稿、重跑、取消、查失败日志等按钮。通过本机已登录的 gh CLI 驱动工作流，插件自身不保存任何凭据，被监视的仓库列表放在配置文件里、不打进包。

description.en: Auto-renames DSH sessions with LLM-summarized titles: runs after the first prompt and on /handoff, or manually via a header button or /autotitle, with configurable title language and max title bytes.
description.zh: DSH 会话自动重命名（session rename）：基于全部会话消息的 LLM 总结标题，首条提示词与 /handoff 后自动命名，会话头按钮或 /autotitle 手动触发，标题语言与最大字节数可设置。

description.en: Zero-interruption audit and fuse blocking for DeepSeek Harness: silently records every tool call with deterministic risk scoring, cumulative-risk bonuses, risk-level breakdowns and retention-based cleanup; blocks irreversible catastrophes (protected-path deletion, disk wipe, force-push to protected branches/refs, credential exfiltration), and renders a redacted /risk-guard operation bill with --since filtering.
description.zh: 零打扰审计与保险丝拦截：静默记录每次工具调用并做纯规则风险评分（含累积加分、风险等级分布、归档保留期清理），只拦不可逆灾难（受保护路径删除、磁盘擦除、force push 到受保护分支/引用、凭据外发），/risk-guard 输出脱敏操作账单并支持 --since 时间过滤。

description.en: Sign in with a ChatGPT account and view Codex subscription usage directly in DSH Web's model settings, with browser or device-code OAuth.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的模型设置中使用浏览器或设备码登录 ChatGPT 账号，并直接查看 Codex 订阅用量。

description.en: Temporary workspace for DSH web — one click creates a throwaway workspace whose conversations are deleted at the next restart (immediately or after a delay, optionally behind a confirm dialog). Pin a temp workspace to keep it: its files move into the folder you pick, its title becomes that folder's name, its conversations migrate, and a real host-level restart re-indexes them.
description.zh: DSH web 临时工作区：一键创建一次性工作区，下次重启自动清空其全部对话（可立即/延迟删除，也可先弹确认框）。点击图钉可永久保留——文件移入所选文件夹、以文件夹名为标题、对话一并迁移，并触发真实的宿主级重启重新索引。

description.en: Provider balance and quota status bar for DSH Web, with model capability settings, external JSON health monitoring, visual field binding, and per-model status details.
description.zh: DSH Web 的供应商余额与额度状态栏，支持模型能力设置、外部 JSON 健康监测、可视化字段绑定和逐模型状态详情。

description.en: Education toolkit for DSH agents: lesson-plan skeletons by grade band, quiz scaffolding and answer-key validation, analytic rubrics, Anki/markdown flashcards, and readability levels.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供教育工具包：按学段的教案骨架、测验题与答案校验、分析式评分量规、Anki/markdown 闪卡与可读性分级。

description.en: Unify third-party plugin settings in DeepSeek Harness. Auto-discover, group, and reorder plugin settings under one collapsible nav entry with drag-and-drop support.
description.zh: 统一收纳 DeepSeek Harness 里的第三方插件设置：自动发现、分组，并在一个可折叠的导航入口下拖拽排序。
