description.en: Agent mode picker for DSH: pick an external Agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code, Gemini CLI, Aider, Goose, Hermes…) as the session's default executor from a control next to the input box, instead of editing configuration files. The agent roster is data-driven, and installed CLIs are discovered automatically from PATH, the managed CLI directory and a drop-in convention directory. Agents that are installed but still missing credentials or a required background service are shown as "needs setup" rather than silently hidden.
description.zh: DSH 的 Agent 模式选择器：在输入框旁边直接选定一个外部 Agent CLI（Claude Code、Codex、 Qwen Code、Gemini CLI、Aider、Goose、Hermes…）作为当前会话的默认执行体，不必去改配置文件。 Agent 名册是数据驱动的，已安装的 CLI 会从 PATH、托管 CLI 目录和约定目录自动发现；装了但还缺 凭据或需要常驻服务的，会显示为「待配置」而不是被悄悄藏起来。

description.en: Folds each 4-50 KB paste in the DSH composer into its own chip (expand or delete it individually), and turns a paste of 50 KB or more into a real file attachment. Declares DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0, so it stays visible on the 0.2 release line.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里每次 4–50 KB 的粘贴折叠成独立的一枚 chip（可单独展开或删除），50 KB 及以上的粘贴转成真附件。声明 DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0，因此在 0.2 版本线上保持可见。

description.en: White noise player: lays a layer of background sound (rain, streams, campfire, café) while AI codes, for flow and focus. Supports multiple playback modes (sequential / shuffle / single-loop / intermittent) and AI automatic background music download from Wikimedia Commons (CC0/PD/CC-BY).
description.zh: 白噪音播放器：AI 编程时铺一层背景音（雨声、溪流、篝火、咖啡馆……），帮助进入心流状态、集中精力、高效思考。支持顺序/随机/单曲循环/间歇等多种播放模式。支持 AI 自动从 Wikimedia Commons 下载 CC0/PD/CC BY 背景音乐到对应场景文件夹。

description.en: Jenkins CI integration with a live build-progress panel in the right sidebar, a multi-instance settings page, five model-facing tools (list jobs, build status, console log, workspace, trigger build), and a failure wake that hands a failed followed build to the conversation that followed it.
description.zh: Jenkins CI 集成：右侧栏实时构建进度面板、多实例设置页、五个面向模型的工具（列 job、构建状态、控制台日志、工作区、触发构建），以及构建失败时唤醒当初关注该 job 的那个会话。

description.en: Turns a streaming assistant reply into short blips, one per character at a configurable minimum spacing, for the reply text only, and keeps sounding when the window is minimized, covered, or in a background tab. Two built-in voices, or a custom one shaped by waveform, or loaded from an audio file.
description.zh: 把流式输出的助手回复变成短促音效：按可调的最小间隔逐字发声，只对回复正文发声，窗口最小化、被遮挡或切到后台标签页时照常发声。内置两种音色，也可自调波形，或载入音频文件当音色。

description.en: Xiao character theme for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop with light and dark palettes, selectable illustrations, a draggable companion, session-state feedback, and optional official DeepSeek balance display.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 与 Desktop 的魈角色主题，提供明暗配色、可切换立绘、可拖动伙伴、会话状态反馈及可选的官方 DeepSeek 余额展示。

description.en: Control Proxmox VE virtual machines from the conversation: 16 tools for the VM console over VNC (screenshots, mouse, keyboard, batched actions, Unicode text and clipboard) and for running commands and reading or writing files through the QEMU guest agent, all over one ssh connection to the node, so the host needs no X11 or Wayland.
description.zh: 在对话里控制 Proxmox VE 虚拟机：16 个工具，既能通过 VNC 操作 VM 控制台（截图、鼠标、键盘、批量动作、Unicode 文本与剪贴板），也能经 QEMU guest agent 执行命令、读写文件；全部走一条到节点的 ssh 连接，宿主无需 X11 或 Wayland。

description.en: Windows desktop control through UI Automation: nine tools that read a window control tree and drive elements by id through their own UI Automation patterns, with every write gated by an approval policy, an append-only action log and a settings panel.
description.zh: 通过 UI Automation 控制 Windows 桌面：九个工具读取窗口控件树、按 id 走控件自身的 UIA 模式操作，每次写入都受审批策略、动作日志与设置面板约束。

description.en: Agent persona management, agent memory, edit-and-regenerate for past messages: create and manage agents, each with its own identity, long-term memory, global memory and chat history.
description.zh: Agent人格管理，Agent记忆，历史消息编辑并重新生成：创建和管理 Agent，每个 Agent 有独立身份、长期记忆、全局记忆与聊天记录，历史消息可编辑后重新生成。

description.en: Collapses each settled turn's process rows into one expandable disclosure in the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation while keeping the final answer visible.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话中已结束回合的过程行折叠成一个可展开的总结，同时保留最终答案可见。

description.en: Connects the MiniMax Code models to DSH - reusing the desktop app's sign-in or signing in on its own - with Anthropic-compatible model access, a live model catalog, the daily check-in that grants the free credits, and a credit balance that follows the model you selected.
description.zh: 将 MiniMax Code 的模型接入 DSH：复用桌面 App 登录态或用设备码自行登录，提供 Anthropic 兼容接入、动态模型目录、每日签到领取免费额度，以及跟随所选模型显示的积分余额与到期提示。

description.en: SillyTavern-style prompt rules for DSH: layered system-prompt anchors, constant/keyword entries, reproducible probability gates and regex rewriting.
description.zh: 类世界书的 DSH 提示词规则：分层系统提示锚点、蓝绿灯条目、可复现概率门与正则替换。

description.en: Publishes an ordered system prompt section that names wsl as the command executor to reach for first, so the agent prefers WSL over PowerShell on Windows. Registers no tools, and only advertises executors the agent can actually call.
description.zh: 发布一段带顺序的系统提示词段，指定 wsl 为执行命令时优先选用的执行器，让模型在 Windows 上优先走 WSL 而不是 PowerShell。不注册任何工具，且只宣传模型真实可调用的执行器。

description.en: Gives the agent its own clock: per-session time readings whose precision the agent can change at runtime, elapsed-time counters, and one-shot countdowns that survive a host restart.
description.zh: 为 agent 提供它自己的时钟：按会话注入时间读数且精度可由 agent 运行时调整，并附带累计计时器与跨宿主重启可靠的一次性倒计时。

description.en: Checks installed DSH plugins for version-declaration and API risks against the current host, with source locations when available, certainty, impact basis and coverage limits. Adds a compatibility settings panel, plugin-detail findings/badges, a compat_check agent tool and a skill provider.
description.zh: 检查已装 DSH 插件相对当前宿主的版本声明与 API 风险，报告可用源码位置、确定度、影响依据和覆盖限制。提供兼容性设置面板、插件详情发现与角标、compat_check 对话工具及 skill provider。

description.en: Keeps the most recently used sessions resident in the browser so switching back reuses the already loaded history instead of re-reading it; the number of resident sessions is configurable and the plugin can be switched off.
description.zh: 让浏览器最近用过的会话保持常驻：切走再切回来直接复用已加载的历史、不再重新读取；常驻数量可配置，并可整体关闭。

description.en: Displays generated images in a conversation gallery with a lightbox viewer.
description.zh: 以对话内画廊和灯箱展示生成的图片。

description.en: Client-side performance HUD and always-on recorder for DeepSeek Harness: FPS and worst frame, long tasks with four-leg attribution (React fiber / subtree / DOM writes / scheduler), per-plugin callback rate and sync time, DOM growth and writers, JS heap, host event loop and link RTT, plus a night-watch recorder that keeps the worst stalls and exports incident packs for replay.
description.zh: 纯客户端性能 HUD 与默认常开的记录器：帧率与最差帧、Long Task 四条腿归因（React fiber / 子树 / DOM 写入 / 调度点）、每插件回调速率与同步耗时、DOM 增长与写入者、JS 堆、宿主 event-loop 与链路 RTT；守夜层自动留存最差几次卡顿，可逐帧回放并导出事故包。

description.en: A pinned-sessions group in the sidebar, above the workspace list: every pinned session across all workspaces in one collapsible, searchable list, with click-to-open and a hover-revealed unpin button.
description.zh: 侧栏「工作区」上方的一个置顶分组：跨工作区汇总所有置顶会话，可折叠、可就地搜索，点行打开、悬停出现取消置顶按钮。

description.en: Leafy green skin for the DSH Web GUI that overrides the --dsw-* palette in light and dark themes, plus a CSS layer for corners, shadows and motion that can be switched off.
description.zh: 叶绿色皮肤：把 DSH Web GUI 的 --dsw-* 调色板覆盖成浅色 / 深色两套叶绿配色，另有一层可关闭的样式层处理圆角、阴影与动效。

description.en: Draggable companion widget by Tokyo with Codex quota monitoring, manual executable discovery, and editable replies. Requires the Codex CLI (codex app-server) and a ChatGPT login; API-key logins expose no subscription quota.
description.zh: Tokyo 的可拖动陪伴挂件，支持 Codex 额度监控、手动程序定位和可编辑回复。需安装 Codex CLI（codex app-server）并使用 ChatGPT 登录；API-key 登录不显示订阅额度。

description.en: Persistent memory for dsh in the style of Hermes Agent: a memory tool that keeps a user profile and the model's own notes, delivered to every chat as a logged context message — at the start, after a change and after compaction — and a session_search tool that reads earlier chats only after the user approves, with a Memory panel to see and edit what is kept.
description.zh: Hermes Agent 风格的 dsh 持久记忆：一个 memory 工具维护用户档案与模型自己的笔记，并在每段对话的开头、记忆变更后、压缩之后各投递一条带记录的消息；session_search 工具只在用户同意后才会读取更早的会话；另有 Memory 面板可查看和编辑已保存的内容。

description.en: Creates local, content-addressed workspace checkpoints with diff previews and two-phase restore confirmation.
description.zh: 创建本地内容寻址工作区存档，提供差异预览和两阶段确认恢复。

description.en: Adds a Restart dsh button above Settings that restarts dsh in place: through systemd when dsh runs as a systemd unit, otherwise via process.execve with the same PID (a thin wrapper parent on Windows or Node < 22.15), so whatever started dsh needs no supervisor config (verified on Linux; Docker, macOS and Windows not yet run for real); the page reloads once the new boot id answers.
description.zh: 在「设置」上方添加「重启 dsh」按钮，原地重启：以 systemd 单元运行时由 systemd 重启，否则通过 process.execve 保持同一 PID（Windows 或 Node < 22.15 时保留一个轻量父进程），启动 dsh 的守护进程或终端无需额外配置（已在 Linux 实测，Docker、macOS、Windows 尚未实机测试）；新 boot id 响应后页面自动刷新。

description.en: Imports the MCP servers Codex and Claude Code already declare as dsh mcp-client tools, links the skills of 22 known agent skill directories into ~/.dsh/skills as symlinks instead of copying them, and adds a Settings page that lists what was mounted, toggles each skill, and changes the source on a name conflict.
description.zh: 把 Codex 与 Claude Code 已声明的 MCP 服务器接入 dsh 的 mcp-client，把 22 个已知 Agent 技能目录的技能以符号链接（不复制文件）导入 ~/.dsh/skills，并提供设置页：列出本次实际挂载的服务器与技能、逐项启停技能、重名时改选来源。

description.en: DeepSeek API billing-period chip in the composer dock: shows whether the current time is peak or off-peak with a countdown to the next rate switch, opens the peak/off-peak window rules on click, and during peak hours intercepts sending to ask for confirmation first.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek API 当前计费时段（高峰/空闲）与距下次切换的倒计时，点击可展开高峰/空闲时段规则；高峰时段发送消息前会先拦截并弹出确认。

description.en: Auto-hide a sidebar workspace the moment its last unarchived session is archived, and add a "隐藏工作区" entry to each workspace row's own "..." menu. The restore entry sits at the bottom of the sidebar. It only toggles display and never archives, deletes or rewrites a workspace.
description.zh: 某个工作区的未归档会话从 1+ 掉到 0 的那一刻自动隐藏它的侧栏行，并在工作区行自带的「…」菜单里追加「隐藏工作区」，另配侧栏底部恢复入口。只切 display，不归档、不删除、不改写任何工作区。

description.en: Windows x64 CUDA translation panel for text and original-format documents, using host model selection, voice input and document preview. Automatically installs its pinned CUDA/cuDNN component; falls back to CPU when no compatible GPU is available. The download is about 2.04 GB.
description.zh: 翻译 CUDA：Windows x64 文本与原格式文档翻译，复用宿主模型选择、语音输入及文档预览。自动安装绑定的 CUDA/cuDNN 组件，无兼容 GPU 时回退 CPU。下载约 2.04 GB。

description.en: Blocks AI coding agents from editing files without evidence and from running unapproved high-risk commands, and tells quoted dangerous strings apart from commands actually being executed.
description.zh: 拦截 AI 编码智能体未取证就改文件、未获授权执行高危命令，并区分「被引用的危险字符串」与「真要执行的命令」。

description.en: VSCode-style Source Control page in the DSH Web right sidebar: a paged commit lane graph with ref markers and per-commit diffs, grouped working-tree changes with stage/discard/unstage, a commit box with amend and AI-generated messages, a side-by-side and unified diff page, GitHub repository and pull request creation through the gh CLI, and bidirectional HTTPS/SSH remote switching.
description.zh: DSH Web 右侧 Sidebar 中的类 VSCode 源代码管理页：带引用标记与分页的泳道提交图与逐提交差异、分组的工作区变更与暂存/丢弃/取消暂存，支持修补上一次提交与 AI 生成信息的提交框、并排与统一差异视图、通过 gh CLI 新建仓库与创建 Pull Request，以及 HTTPS 与 SSH 远程地址双向切换。

description.en: Aggregated status badges on collapsed sidebar groups in DSH: a folded folder row shows in-progress / awaiting-approval / done / scheduled / review-pending counts, with numbers and hover detail. (sidebar badge / group status / aggregate)
description.zh: DSH 侧栏折叠分组聚合徽标：收起的文件夹行显示进行中/待审批/已完成/定时任务/等待评审的聚合状态，带数字与悬停明细。（侧栏徽标 / 分组状态 / 聚合）

description.en: Agent skill and tool for querying multi-platform model account balances: DeepSeek, Doubao / Volcengine, Qwen / Alibaba Cloud, Hunyuan / Tencent Cloud, and custom HTTP endpoints. Read-only, with 60s cache.
description.zh: 多平台余额 Agent 技能与工具：查询 DeepSeek、豆包 / 火山引擎、千问 / 阿里云百炼、混元 / 腾讯云以及自定义 HTTP 接口的账户余额；只读，内置 60 秒缓存。

description.en: Aggregates all local Trae accounts into one auto-failover model provider, with manual and automated daily check-in, credits and expiry monitoring, and a model selection settings card.
description.zh: 把本机多个 Trae 账号聚合成一个自动容错换号的模型供应商，附带手动与自动签到、积分与到期监控，以及模型配置设置卡片。

description.en: Answers a hard question with a one-page visual HTML explainer: the model writes a short Markdown draft and the bundled dependency-free `am` CLI builds the layout, CSS and diagram coordinates. Vendors the upstream answer-me-with-html skill verbatim as a skill-only DSH bundle with no Host code.
description.zh: 把复杂问题回答成一页可视化 HTML：模型只写简短的 Markdown 草稿，随包附带的零依赖 `am` 命令行负责排版、配色与图表坐标。以上游 answer-me-with-html 技能原样内置，是纯技能的 DSH bundle，不含 Host 代码。

description.en: Windows x64 CPU translation panel for text and original-format documents, using host model selection, voice input and document preview. CPU OCR without NVIDIA dependencies. The download is about 364 MB.
description.zh: 翻译 CPU：Windows x64 文本与原格式文档翻译，复用宿主模型选择、语音输入及文档预览。使用 CPU OCR，不安装 NVIDIA 运行库。下载约 364 MB。

description.en: Notes-backed context compression for DeepSeek Harness: replaces LLM-summarized compaction with a model-written persistent notebook plus recoverable raw history, so the rollover boundary itself costs zero model calls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供笔记式上下文压缩：用模型维护的持久笔记本取代 LLM 摘要式压缩，并保留可恢复的原始历史，窗口边界本身不产生模型调用。

description.en: Registers the project-cross-migration skill for DSH: five-layer agent project migration (conversations, memory, persona, tools, environment) with entry validation, JSONL integrity checks and readable restore. 1,418-message real migration verified across three platforms; pure Python stdlib, MIT.
description.zh: 为 DSH 注册 project-cross-migration 技能：对话/记忆/人格/工具/环境五层迁移，含入口校验、JSONL 完整性检查与可读还原。三平台 1418 条消息真实迁移实测；纯 Python 标准库，MIT。

description.en: Summarizes the current DeepSeek Harness session with /recap or after inactivity, with configurable models, Chinese and English output, and expandable summaries in the conversation.
description.zh: 通过 /recap 或闲置触发回顾当前 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持配置模型、中英文输出，并在对话内展示可展开的摘要。

description.en: Uses a dedicated model for context compaction rescue and adds manual compaction to the native context popup.
description.zh: 使用专用模型处理上下文压缩恢复，并在原生上下文弹窗提供手动压缩。

description.en: Runs git in the Host process so push, pull and fetch work inside the agent sandbox; exposes 8 agent tools (status, diff, log, stage, commit, push, fetch, pull) and 11 slash commands including /git-status, /git-commit, /git-tag and /git-name-set.
description.zh: 在宿主进程中执行 git，使 push、pull、fetch 在 agent 沙箱内可用；提供 8 个 agent 工具（status、diff、log、stage、commit、push、fetch、pull）与 11 个斜杠命令，包括 /git-status、/git-commit、/git-tag 与 /git-name-set。

description.en: Turns what a design, plan or document claims into a model and decides it: UML diagrams rendered, read and reviewed; state machines, protocols and data models checked as models; migrations tested for coverage and rollback symmetry; concurrency claims mined and routed to the checker that can decide them; dependency graphs audited; reports diffed.
description.zh: 把设计、计划或文档里的声称抽成模型再判定：UML 图渲染、读取与审查；状态机、协议与数据模型按模型判定；迁移检查覆盖与回滚对称；并发声称挖掘后分派给能判定它的工具；依赖图审查；报告对比。

description.en: Notes taken from DeepSeek Harness conversations: quotes whole replies or selected passages, keeps highlights rendered at their original position in the session, attaches editable Markdown notes, tags them, filters by workspace or session, and exports Markdown or a full JSON backup stored as local JSON files.
description.zh: 从 DSH 会话里记笔记：可收藏整条回复或选中片段，划线会持久重绘回原文位置，可为其补写可编辑的 Markdown 笔记、打标签，按工作区或会话筛选，并导出 Markdown 或完整 JSON 备份；数据以本机 JSON 文件存储。

description.en: Claude-style Git branch and PR composer bar for DeepSeek Harness: quick branch switcher, native diff drawer integration, and adaptive PR creation with Actions CI status.
description.zh: DSH 对话输入框 Git 状态胶囊条：极速切换分支、联动原生 Diff 抽屉、自适应 Commit/PR 及 Actions CI 状态追踪。

description.en: Read-only XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV and TSV viewer for dock-files with worksheet tabs, sorting, filters, search and cell links.
description.zh: dock-files 的只读表格查看器，支持 XLSX、XLS、ODS、CSV、TSV 格式以及工作表切换、排序、筛选、搜索和单元格链接。

description.en: Turns a learning request and local materials into a structured, locally stored AI course with outline, lessons, diagrams and learning progress.
description.zh: 把学习诉求和手头资料变成结构化、纯本地的 AI 课程，含大纲、知识点内容、图表与学习进度。

description.en: Deterministic prompt-injection interception: tool results from file reads, repo searches and web fetches are scanned before they enter model context; high-severity findings quarantine-wrap or block, and credential-material files quarantine on the path alone.
description.zh: 确定性注入拦截：文件读取、仓库搜索与网络抓取的工具结果在进入模型上下文前被扫描；高危发现隔离包裹或阻断，凭证类文件按路径即隔离。

description.en: Reference search for DeepSeek Harness: refkit_search looks up image, video, audio and text references across 24 open sources and tags each result with its normalized license and a use verdict for the intended use; refkit_rights re-checks one license against another use. Source keys and search tuning live on a settings page. 11 of the 24 sources need API keys; the use verdict is returned only when an intended use is passed. Runs on DSH ^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.2 (tested on 0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的参考素材检索插件：refkit_search 在 24 个开放来源中检索图片、视频、音频和文本参考素材，为每条结果标注规范化的许可证和针对用途的可用性判定；refkit_rights 针对另一种用途复核单条许可证。来源 key 与检索参数在设置页配置。24 个来源中 11 个需要 API key；仅在传入用途时返回可用性判定。支持 DSH ^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.2（实测 0.1.7-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.2）。

description.en: Prompt optimizer in the composer: rewrites the draft into an eleven-section analytical prompt using the conversation, workspace files and the session's selected model, with one-click undo.
description.zh: 输入框内的提示词优化器：结合对话历史、工作区文件与会话选定模型，把草稿改写为十一节分析式提示词，支持一键撤销。

description.en: Adds an Inherit row to the session menu: mechanically extracts concrete anchors (task, recent instructions, files edited, recent failures, commands, todos) from a long session into a handoff and continues in a clean session, with the same preset, no history copied and no model call.
description.zh: 会话菜单新增「继承」：把长会话里的具体锚点（任务原文、最近的用户指令、改过的文件、最近的失败、命令、待办）机械提取成交接单，在干净的新会话里接着干——预设默认一并继承，不复制历史，也不调用模型。

description.en: /compact and auto-compaction summarize with the model selected in the session, not the model that finished the last turn.
description.zh: /compact 与自动压缩使用会话中当前选中的模型来生成摘要，而不是用跑完上一轮的那个模型。

description.en: The Quick Control panel core for DSH Web: a standalone floating shortcut panel whose switches other plugins register through the quickControl service, with the skin system and zh/en i18n. The dock-base Workbench integration ships separately as the dock-flash adapter.
description.zh: DSH Web 快捷控制面板核心：可独立浮动的快捷面板，开关项由其它插件通过 quickControl 服务注册，内置皮肤系统与中英文 i18n；dock-base 工作台集成由 dock-flash 适配器单独提供。

description.en: Registers a configurable prompt variable so an agent preset whose persona uses complete: true can still receive an injected text block; the plugin ships no content of its own and reads the text from its config.
description.zh: 注册一个可配置的 prompt 变量，让使用 complete: true 人格的 agent 预设也能收到一段注入文本；插件本身不含内容，文本由配置提供。

description.en: Cross-workspace worker fleets: one orchestrating session spawns named worker sessions in other project workspaces, queues or steers tasks into them, watches them in the background via a real host job, and collects their reports. Worker completions deliver themselves to the orchestrator's session rather than needing to be polled, so an idle orchestrator still reacts. Escalations and failed workers deliver by steer when the orchestrator is mid-turn and by queue when it is idle; a turn that ends without a report counts as a failure and the worker is replaced after a configurable limit. The roster persists to disk and each worker session carries a durable title, so a restart neither loses the fleet nor spawns duplicate sessions. Ships five agent presets at full plugin parity with the standard preset.
description.zh: 跨工作区的多智能体工舰队：一个编排会话在其他项目工作区中创建具名的 worker 会话，向其排队或插队下发任务，以后台任务的方式监视其进度，并收集其报告。worker 完成后主动把消息投递到编排会话，无需轮询，空闲的编排器同样能及时反应。当编排器正在执行任务时，升级提问与失败通知以 steer 方式送达，空闲时以 queue 方式送达；一个回合结束时若未提交报告即判定为失败，达到阈值后自动替换该 worker。名册持久化到磁盘，且每个 worker 会话带有持久标题，重启既不会丢失工舰队，也不会产生重复会话。附带五个智能体预设，插件清单与 standard 预设完全一致。

description.en: DSH plugin: a four-entry learning flow in the session input bar — scaffold a preset, collect candidates, merge reviewed changes, and run a read-only workspace audit.
description.zh: DSH 插件：会话输入区的四入口学习流程——初始预设、收集提炼、关联升级、沉淀复用。

description.en: Push a Gotify notification when each conversation turn ends, with configurable templates, priority and per-cause titles.
description.zh: 每轮会话结束时向 Gotify 服务器推送通知，支持模板、优先级与按结束原因区分标题。

description.en: On-screen test-progress HUD for DSH — a click-through panel drawn over the app under test, showing each step's expectation vs actual and whether the waiting human may take back the mouse and keyboard. Ships a universal prebuilt binary (arm64 + x86_64), so no Xcode Command Line Tools are needed; the panel itself requires macOS 14+.
description.zh: 把自动测试的进展画在被测界面之上的浮层：每步的期待与实际，以及等待的人现在能不能动鼠标键盘。包内附带通用预编译二进制（arm64 + x86_64），无需 Xcode 命令行工具；浮层面板自身要求 macOS 14 及以上。

description.en: Shows oversized images to the model at readable resolution instead of one downscaled copy: before admission, a large upload is split into as many tiles as the attachment store allows (an 8000x8000 screenshot becomes 20 tiles of 2000x1600), so small text survives. Replaces the local attachment store; adds no settings of its own.
description.zh: 让超大图片以可读分辨率进入模型视野，而不是被压成一张缩图：准入前按附件存储允许的上限把大图切成多张切片（8000x8000 的截图会变成 20 张 2000x1600），小字得以保留。以替换本地附件存储的方式实现，不新增任何配置项。

description.en: DSH full liquid-glass skin: 13 adjustable refractive glass surfaces, time-of-day wallpapers, four theme colours, and a water-drop highlight on the selected item.
description.zh: DSH 全液态玻璃皮肤：13 个可调折射液态玻璃面、随时段轮换的壁纸、四档主题色、选中项带水滴状高亮飞镜。

description.en: Global Quick Actions beside every session-backed composer in DSH. One press sends a preset or your own saved text, with per-action send confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 每个由会话支持的消息编辑器旁提供全局快捷动作。一键发送预置或你自己保存的文本，每个动作可单独设置发送确认。

description.en: Signed chain-of-custody for sessions: every watched tool result appends a hash-chained, ed25519-signed record, with commits bound into the chain — tampering with any line or truncating the tail fails deterministic replay verification.
description.zh: 会话签名监护链：被监视的工具结果逐条追加哈希链 ed25519 签名记录，commit 绑定进链——篡改任意行或截断尾部都会在确定性重放校验中失败。

description.en: Week-keyed personal memo service: stores entries in ISO-week tables, resolves week/month/quarter/year navigation from one period calendar, archives quarters, runs AI analysis and Markdown report export, requires an explicit force flag to edit a past week, and turns one suite-wide telemetry failure analysis into a GitHub issue report.
description.zh: 按 ISO 周组织的个人备忘服务：条目按周存储，周/月/季/年四种视图由同一份周期日历解析，支持按季度归档，提供 AI 分析与 Markdown 报告导出，修改非当前周需要显式确认，并能把整条插件套件的遥测失败分析整理成一份 GitHub issue 报告。

description.en: Registers system-prompt sections that make the model reason in Simplified or Traditional Chinese, with strict/prefer modes and an optional reply-language policy. Adds a /thinking-zh command for per-session switching. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 注册系统提示词段落，让模型的内部思考使用简体或繁体中文，支持严格/宽松两种强度，并可单独约束最终回复语言。提供 /thinking-zh 命令做会话级切换。零运行时依赖。

description.en: macOS only: holds a PreventUserIdleSystemSleep assertion (caffeinate -i -w <host pid>) while any DSH session runs, and releases it when the last one stops, so a long turn is not cut off by idle sleep. The display may still turn off. It keeps holding through the maintenance phase, where Agent.status reports idle and a long manual /compact runs, via the compaction/start and compaction/end events. It reconciles against ctx.agents.list() every 60s, so a session already running when the plugin is hot-reloaded is picked up at once instead of at the next turn boundary. A failed hold retries with exponential backoff capped at 60s and never gives up; release escalates from SIGTERM to SIGKILL after 2s, and -w lets caffeinate exit by itself if the host dies. No browser half — configured through the profile patch. 51 tests, including two that read pmset -g assertions on real hardware.
description.zh: 仅 macOS：任意 DSH 会话运行期间持有 PreventUserIdleSystemSleep 断言（caffeinate -i -w <宿主 pid>），最后一个会话结束后释放，长时间回合不会因空闲休眠被切断；屏幕仍可正常息屏。它会一直持有跨过 maintenance 阶段——该阶段 Agent.status 报 idle 而手动 /compact 正在跑，靠 compaction/start 与 compaction/end 事件兜住。每 60 秒与 ctx.agents.list() 对账，插件热重载时已在运行的会话立即被接管，不必等到下一个回合边界。持有失败按指数退避重试、上限 60 秒且永不放弃；释放时先 SIGTERM，2 秒未退出升级 SIGKILL；带 -w，宿主崩溃时 caffeinate 自行退出。无前端半身，通过 profile patch 配置。共 51 个测试，其中 2 个在真机上直接读 pmset -g assertions。

description.en: Task-list staleness guard for DeepSeek Harness: watches the session event stream and counts tool calls since the last todo_write; past a configurable threshold it appends one short notice before the next step, quoting the current list, so the model writes it back to the real progress instead of leaving a stale snapshot on screen. Pure prompt injection, no blocking and no data mutation.
description.zh: 任务清单陈旧度守卫：监听会话事件流，统计上一次 todo_write 之后又发生了多少次工具调用；超过可配置阈值时在下一步之前追加一条简短提醒，并附上当前清单内容，让模型把清单写回真实进度，而不是在界面上留一份过期的快照。纯提示注入，不阻断流程，也不改动任何数据。

description.en: Highlights answered ask blocks (question n/n answered) in the conversation with a soft card style; pending asks and other tool blocks keep their native look.
description.zh: 提问块高亮：把对话里已答复的「提问 n/n 已回答」工具块用柔和卡片样式凸显；等待中的提问块与其它工具块保持原样。

description.en: Shows GLM Coding Plan quota windows (5-hour, weekly, monthly tools) as an always-visible pill in the composer stats row with a 5h reset countdown, opening a card-grid detail panel with limits, reset times, 24h per-model token usage and one-click plugin self-update.
description.zh: 在输入框统计行常驻 GLM Coding Plan 额度 pill(含 5 小时窗口重置倒计时),点击展开双列卡片式详情面板:各窗口限额、重置时间、近 24 小时按模型 Token 用量与小时级 sparkline,支持插件一键自更新。

description.en: System-prompt surface drift gate: every section any plugin or preset contributes to the assembled system prompt is hashed and baselined; a silent rewrite of what the model is told fails loud.
description.zh: 系统提示词面漂移门：任何插件或预设注入组装提示词的段落均哈希基线化，对模型被告知内容的静默改写将响亮报错。

description.en: Watchdog for quota exhaustion: on a 429 or quota error it creates a recurring schedule that re-sends a continue-the-task prompt until a turn closes normally, so a long task resumes without manual restarts; /keep-running list and /keep-running cancel <id> manage those schedules. Requires @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule to be mounted first (it registers the schedules).
description.zh: 配额看门狗：遇到 429 或配额错误时建立循环调度，持续重发「继续任务」提示直到某一轮正常结束，长任务不必手动重开；/keep-running list 与 /keep-running cancel <id> 用于查看和取消。需先挂载 @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule（调度由它注册）。

description.en: Skill manager page in the DSH Web Settings panel, at the same level as Plugins: lists every skill the installation serves with its own summary, source and disk footprint, and removes any of them into a recoverable trash.
description.zh: DSH Web 设置里的 skill 管理器页面，与「插件」同级：列出当前安装提供的全部 skill 及其自己的简介、来源与占用，并可逐个移除（移除是移入可恢复的回收站）。

description.en: Hermetic composition lock: fingerprints the profile's dependencies, bundle order, lockfile and patch layer; booting a drifted composition warns, or fails under strict mode (the --frozen posture for CI).
description.zh: 密闭组合锁：对 profile 的依赖、组合顺序、锁文件与补丁层取指纹；组合漂移时启动告警，strict 模式直接失败（CI 的 --frozen 姿态）。

description.en: Archives the sessions of a workspace when its folder is deleted or moved away, or when its registration is removed, and restores them when it returns: unarchives only the sessions it archived itself, re-attaches every member its ledger recorded (including sessions you archived manually, whose archived state is left unchanged), and adopts ungrouped sessions whose working directory is that workspace path.
description.zh: 工作区文件夹被删除或移走、或工作区登记被移除时，自动归档其会话；目录或登记回归时恢复：只取消归档本插件归档过的会话，把台账记过的全部成员挂回分组（含你手动归档的会话，且不改其归档状态），并把「无项目」里工作目录正是该工作区路径的会话归位。

description.en: Injects your existing markdown documents (notes, rules, knowledge-base files) into every dsh session's system prompt as read-only memory — list file or directory paths in `files`; no database, no service, no write path; UTF-8 byte-budgeted truncation with line-boundary fallback, total budget, YAML front-matter stripping, and freshness timestamps.
description.zh: 把本地已有的 markdown 文档（笔记、规则、知识库）按路径清单注入 dsh 每个会话的系统提示词，当只读记忆——无数据库、无服务、无写入通道；支持目录收集、UTF-8 字节预算截断、front-matter 剥离与新鲜度时间戳。

description.en: Codex-style sidebar: a pinned band for projects and conversations, collapsible 置顶/项目/组件 sections, a bell activity view of recently used conversations, and per-project emoji icons.
description.zh: Codex 风格侧边栏：项目和对话共用的置顶区、置顶/项目/组件 三段可折叠分区、小铃铛活动视图（含最后一条回答的预览）、可为每个项目换 Emoji 图标。

description.en: A draggable balance and usage card for the web UI. Clicking the character button slides the card out from the left side of the image and clicking it again retracts the card; it shows the official DeepSeek account balance split into granted credit and top-up, and token usage folded from local session logs for today, the last 7 days and the month, priced per call with the official peak/off-peak rates (cache hits, cache misses and output are priced separately).
description.zh: 可拖动的余额与用量浮层卡片：点一下角色图片，卡片从图片左侧滑出，再点一下缩回；显示官方 DeepSeek 余额（赠金 / 充值拆分），并按缓存命中、未命中、输出三段计价，汇总本地会话日志的今日 / 近 7 天 / 本月 token 用量与人民币估算花费（按官方峰谷时段逐次计价）。

description.en: An always-last, collapsible Recent tasks workspace group in the DSH sidebar: a sidebar entry and the Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N shortcut start a chat in a dedicated folder, so it lands in that group instead of 未分组. The group is a genuine workspace record rather than a plugin-drawn look-alike, so collapse, rename, search and drag order behave normally, and its folder, group name, pin-last and auto-repair are live settings.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏里常驻末位、可折叠的「最近任务」工作区分组：侧边栏入口与 Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N 快捷键在专用目录里开新对话，对话因此归入这个分组，而不是「未分组」。该分组是真正的工作区记录，而非插件画出来的仿制品，折叠、改名、搜索与拖拽排序都正常可用；目录、分组名、常驻末尾与自动重建都是实时设置。

description.en: Adds a checkbox-style switch at the right end of the Installed group header on the DSH Plugins page: it opens a checklist of the unofficial plugins, all checked by default, and toggles only the ones you keep checked. Once everything is off the button flips to enabling them again. Disable/enable only — it never uninstalls a plugin or deletes plugin files and configuration, and its UI copy follows the app language.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页的「已安装」分组标题右端加一个勾选式开关：点开是当前方向下非官方插件的清单，默认全选，只切换你保留勾选的那些；全部停用后按钮翻转成启用侧。只做启用/停用，从不卸载插件、也不删除插件文件与配置，界面文案跟随应用语言。

description.en: Discord bridge loaded into the same Host as the desktop app or dsh web, with no separate process or profile — chat with sessions in any workspace from DMs or threads, attach to sessions open on the desktop, and answer tool approvals and model questions from whichever side responds first.
description.zh: 与桌面端或 dsh web 运行在同一个 Host 里的 Discord 桥接，无需单独进程或 profile：在私信或线程里与任意工作区的会话对话，接入桌面端正在用的会话，工具审批和模型提问在 Discord 与桌面端谁先答谁生效。

description.en: Names a session from its first prompt, and streams AI title suggestions into the rename dialog.
description.zh: 用首条消息为会话命名，并在重命名弹窗里流式给出 AI 标题建议。

description.en: One-click TokenDance gateway access for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth sign-in stores the API key, a live model catalog with per-model visibility, and agent tools for chat, image generation, video generation and typed decisions.
description.zh: 一键接入 TokenDance 模型网关：OAuth 登录保存 API Key，实时模型目录可逐模型控制显隐，并提供对话、生图、生视频与类型化判断的 agent 工具。

description.en: Recalls messages you already sent in the DSH composer with ArrowUp; ArrowDown walks forward, restores the draft you were writing, and one more press discards it and clears the composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框用 ↑ 调回本会话已发送的消息；↓ 前翻并恢复你正在写的草稿，再按一次 ↓ 丢弃草稿、清空输入框。

description.en: Keenable web search and page fetch for the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools, working with any model and no API key.
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 与 web_fetch 工具提供 Keenable 网页搜索与网页读取，适用于任意模型，无需 API Key。

description.en: Adds Alt+Enter as a newline to the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web composer.
description.zh: 给 dsh 的网页输入框加上 Alt+Enter 换行。

description.en: Milestone progress soft-enforcement guard: injects persistent system-prompt rules and post-execute notices when tool calls omit visible progress text, with a Web settings form.
description.zh: 阶段性结论软强制守卫：常驻注入系统提示词规范，并在模型调用工具漏发可见结论时自动附加软强制纠偏提醒，支持 Web 设置表单。

description.en: Import the copied connection information from the new API site with a single click.
description.zh: 一键从new api站点导入复制的连接信息。

description.en: Shows the API balance of the provider behind the current model as a dsh Web sidebar card, with per-package progress bars, currency/credit-aware units, a settings tab, and subscription and credit quota monitoring.
description.zh: 在当前会话所用模型的厂商 API 余额，以 dsh Web 侧边栏卡片常驻展示，含每套餐进度条、货币/积分单位区分、设置页，以及订阅与积分额度监测。

description.en: Solo murder-mystery (jubensha) in a session tab: the AI hosts the game and plays every other seat, each knowing only its own role book, while the player's seat stays yours — with a stage bar, a per-seat timeline, a clue page and a reveal that unseals the truth only at the end.
description.zh: 一个人的剧本杀：AI 当主持人，AI 填满其余的椅子（各自只知道自己的角色本），留一个位子给你 —— 带阶段条、按座位归集的时间线与搜证页，而真相到复盘才解封。

description.en: Exposes a stdio MCP server as native DeepSeek Harness tools. Ships with the official Microsoft Playwright MCP preset, so the agent browses through the Edge or Chrome you already have open, with your logins intact; any other stdio MCP command can be configured instead. Host-only, no client bundle, no npm dependencies. To drive your own browser, start Edge/Chrome with remote debugging and allow npx to fetch @playwright/mcp.
description.zh: 把 stdio MCP 服务器变成 DeepSeek Harness 原生工具。默认接微软官方 Playwright MCP，agent 直接操作你已打开、已登录的 Edge 或 Chrome；也可换成任意 stdio MCP 命令。宿主侧插件，不带客户端包，无 npm 依赖。要接管你自己的浏览器，需以远程调试模式启动 Edge/Chrome，并允许 npx 拉取 @playwright/mcp。

description.en: Invites people into one conversation through single-use links with no account: up to 20 guests discuss together and ask the AI, the shared fork runs read-only, and the owner can remove guests or end the share at any time.
description.zh: 用一次性链接邀请别人加入同一段对话，不需要账号：最多 20 位访客一起讨论、一起问 AI，分享用的 fork 以只读权限运行，所有者可以随时移除访客或结束分享。

description.en: Delegates self-contained coding subtasks to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Agent SDK and returns the result to the host session. Nineteen per-call parameters control model, thinking effort, permission mode, allowed tools, turn count and budget cap; background jobs return a jobId immediately and stream incremental output; the result carries a session handle that can be passed back as resume to continue the same conversation; commands expected to run past ~20 seconds go through the built-in mcp__dsh__shell channel, which streams output line by line without consuming model context; a Claude Code monitor panel in the session lists jobs, renders the structured process, shows live output blocks and cancels a run; the delegation procedure ships as a runtime-registered skill, so installing the plugin installs the skill.
description.zh: 把自包含的编码子任务委派给本机 Claude Code（官方 Agent SDK 驱动），结果回传主会话：19 个参数可按次控制模型、思考强度、权限模式、允许工具、轮次与预算上限；后台作业立即返回 jobId 并支持增量读取；结果附会话句柄，传回 resume 即可在同一会话续跑；预计超过 20 秒的命令经内置 mcp__dsh__shell 通道逐行实时输出，不占用模型上下文；会话内附 Claude Code 监控面板（任务列表、结构化过程视图、实时输出块、一键取消）；委派规程以运行时技能注册，安装插件即安装技能。

description.en: Switch DSH's built-in web_search between the DeepSeek Search API (/v1/tools/search) and the default account search, with automatic fallback, a settings page and a sidebar switch.
description.zh: 给 DSH 内置 web_search 加一个开关：在 DeepSeek Search API（/v1/tools/search）与默认账号搜索之间切换，失败自动回退，并带设置页与侧栏开关。

description.en: Deterministic write gate: scope policy denies out-of-scope write/edit calls before they touch the disk, residue rules scan the written text, and every decision lands in a content-hashed JSONL ledger; can reuse the repo's agent-pr-gate.yaml so CI and session enforce one policy.
description.zh: 确定性写入门禁：范围策略在落盘前拒绝越权写入，残留规则扫描所写文本，每个决定落入带内容哈希的 JSONL 台账；可复用仓库的 agent-pr-gate.yaml 让 CI 与会话共用同一策略。

description.en: Compaction integrity: directive lines (never/must/必须 style markers) extracted from the compacted range are verified against the summary — verbatim or by content-word coverage — and every constraint the session silently forgot is reported and written to a JSONL ledger; pinned constraints from config are checked on every compaction.
description.zh: 压缩监护：从被压缩范围提取指令行（never/must/必须 类标记），对照摘要做逐字或内容词覆盖存续校验；会话悄悄遗忘的约束会被响亮上报并写入 JSONL 台账；配置中的 pinned 约束每次压缩必验。

description.en: Tool-surface snapshot and drift gate: baselines the full visible tool registry (name/description/parameters, MCP tools included) into a committable JSON file and warns loudly when an upgrade adds, removes or reshapes a tool.
description.zh: 工具面快照与漂移门：全量可见工具注册表（含 MCP 工具）基线化为可提交的 JSON，升级新增、移除或改动工具时响亮告警。

description.en: Account balance and cost statistics pill for DeepSeek Harness. It adds a pill at the right-hand end of the official stats row below the session composer, combining the billing period (peak/off-peak, colour-coded), the account balance and the current session cost; clicking it expands a per-session breakdown with cache-hit input, cache-miss input and output amounts, plus cost per model. The rate table is refreshed with plugin releases to follow official pricing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的账户余额及费用统计胶囊。它在会话输入框下方的官方统计行右侧新增一枚胶囊，集成计费时段（高峰/低谷，用颜色区分）、账户余额与会话费用；点击展开可查看本次会话的详细费用统计，包括缓存命中输入、缓存未命中输入、输出三项金额，以及按模型拆分的花费。费率表随插件版本更新，以跟随官方调价。

description.en: Windows XP (Luna) skin for the DSH web GUI: beige Luna panels, gradient buttons, #7F9DB9 input fields, rounded blue scrollbars and a CSS-drawn Bliss-style desktop, plus a chime when a turn finishes and a different cue when the agent stops for approval.
description.zh: 把 DSH 换成 Windows XP：Luna 蓝皮肤（米色面板、渐变按钮、#7F9DB9 输入框、圆角蓝色滚动条、纯 CSS 绘制的 Bliss 风格桌面），外加一轮跑完时的提示音，以及智能体停下来等你批准时的另一种提示音。

description.en: Backup, restore and machine-migration for DSH: packs skills (which live outside ~/.dsh, in ~/.agents/skills), plugin manifests, core config, memories, todos and optionally sessions into a tar.gz with a sha256 sidecar, then imports it on another machine as a three-way merge against a baseline, listing per-file differences instead of overwriting changes made there. Credentials never enter an archive (filename deny-list of 27 names plus 7 private-key suffixes plus a content gate, enforced again on the import side), every import writes a pre-restore snapshot first, and an archive can be uploaded to any WebDAV server and pulled back on the new machine. Also includes scheduled backups, a read-only viewer for individual files, and an in-panel cloud card; no npm runtime dependencies (packing uses the system tar).
description.zh: DSH 的备份 / 恢复 / 换机迁移：把技能（技能目录在 ~/.dsh 之外的 ~/.agents/skills）、插件清单、核心配置、记忆、待办、以及可选的会话打成一个带 sha256 边车的 tar.gz，再在另一台机器上以「带基线的三方合并」导入 —— 逐文件列出差异，而不是直接覆盖对方改过的东西。凭据永不进包（27 个文件名 + 7 个私钥后缀的黑名单，外加内容特征闸，导入侧再过一遍），每次导入前先写一份可原样还原的快照；归档可以推到任意 WebDAV 服务（绿联 NAS / 群晖 / 坚果云 / Nextcloud）并在新机器上下载回来。另含定时备份、单文件只读查看、面板内的云端卡片；零 npm 运行时依赖（打包用系统 tar）。

description.en: Turn-finished music reminder: when an agent turn ends, play a ringtone or any local audio file (bundled synthesised telephone ring, custom absolute path, or an in-page upload), with a floating chip to pause, resume or dismiss it and loop-until-paused playback; configured in Settings, defaults overridable per deployment.
description.zh: 回合提醒音乐：对话（回合）结束时播放铃声或任意本地音频提醒你回来——内置合成的电话「叮铃铃」，也可填宿主机绝对路径或直接在设置页上传；右下角浮标可暂停/继续/关闭，默认循环响到你手动停；设置项在「设置 → 内置插件」里，部署级默认值可写进 cordis.patch.yml。

description.en: Agnes AI image and video generation tools for DeepSeek Harness, where long video jobs can be resumed in a later call. Requires an Agnes API key (AGNES_API_KEY).
description.zh: 把 Agnes AI 的生图 / 生视频接成 DSH 原生工具，长视频任务可稍后续查。需设置 Agnes API Key（AGNES_API_KEY）。

description.en: Reimplements the shut-down BSide: Olivia Lin letter API on loopback so the game client keeps sending and receiving letters: every incoming letter is delivered to one persistent DSH agent session, and the reply is written back to the local letter store.
description.zh: 在回环地址上复现已关停的《BSide: Olivia Lin》信件 API，让游戏客户端照常收发信件：每封来信投进同一个持久 DSH agent 会话，回信写回本地信件库。

description.en: Browse, search, install, and apply VS Code color themes to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: bundles 14 curated themes with live color-swatch previews, searches the official VS Code Marketplace for more, and one-click installs map any theme's palette onto the DSW design tokens with live switching and persisted selection.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中浏览、搜索、安装并应用 VS Code 配色主题：内置 14 款精选主题并带实时色卡预览，可搜索官方 VS Code 插件市场安装更多主题，一键安装会把任意主题的调色板映射到 DSW 设计令牌，支持实时切换与选择持久化。

description.en: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: the standard tool stack plus four working rules written into the persona prompt — a project keeps at most four documents (intro, decisions, change log, current state and next steps), those documents describe only the current state with no AI edit history or superseded decisions, no git commit or push or pull request until the user explicitly asks, and a careful-coding workflow (restate the goal and done-criteria first, surgical diffs, evidence before claiming success) with plain-language reports.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Agent 预设：标准模式的工具栈，外加写进人格提示的四条工作纪律——每个项目最多四个文档（项目介绍、方案设定、改动记录、现状与下一步）；文档只写当前状态，不记 AI 修改历史、不留被推翻的旧方案；用户没有明确指令就不提交、不推送、不开 PR；动手前先复述目标与验收标准、只做手术式最小改动、没验证不说已修复，汇报用大白话。

description.en: Offline Wikipedia and ZIM lookups through your own kiwix-serve: the wiki_search, wiki_read and wiki_books tools run full-text search with snippets, read an article by exact title, and list the local ZIM library.
description.zh: 通过你自己运行的 kiwix-serve 离线查询维基百科等 ZIM 数据包：wiki_search / wiki_read / wiki_books 三个工具分别做带摘要片段的全文搜索、按精确标题读取全文、列出本地 ZIM 书库。

description.en: Read-only orchd panel for the DSH right sidebar: task board, ideas board, dependency graph, review timeline and an install entry for the project of the current session.
description.zh: 把 orchd 项目状态带进 DSH 右侧栏的只读面板：任务看板、想法看板、依赖图、审查时间线与接入入口，只跟当前会话的项目。

description.en: Enable permessage-deflate on DSH's WebSocket transport without modifying the DSH install tree.
description.zh: 在不修改 DSH 安装目录的前提下，为 DSH 的 WebSocket 传输启用 permessage-deflate。

description.en: Two games inside DeepSeek Harness where the model supplies intent and a local engine owns the rules: a twin-brain snake that periodically draws a strategy card, and Chinese chess where the model only comments on a move picked from locally generated legal candidates. Both keep running when the model is slow, offline or out of quota.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里玩游戏，分工是模型负责「想」、本地引擎负责「动」：双脑贪吃蛇会周期性抽一张策略卡；中国象棋里模型只从本地生成的合法候选着法里挑一个并解说。模型变慢、断网或额度用尽时，两个游戏都照常运行。

description.en: Git plugin — adds Git management to the session tab bar, covering the basics: commit | pull | push | branch | diff.
description.zh: Git 插件 —— 会话 Tab 栏添加 Git 管理功能，支持 commit | pull | push | branch | diff 等基础功能。

description.en: Registers a janitor_scan tool that returns a deterministic, reviewable cleanup plan for session debris (plan docs, scratch scripts) with per-file verdicts and evidence; scan-only, never deletes.
description.zh: 注册 janitor_scan 工具：对会话遗留物（计划文档、临时脚本）给出确定性、可审阅的清理计划，逐文件裁决附证据；只扫描，永不删除。

description.en: Desktop tweaks: F11 fullscreen toggle; enables Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy and paste in the terminal, both switchable in the General settings.
description.zh: 桌面修改：F11 全屏切换；使终端使用 Ctrl+C/V 复制粘贴，从通用设置内开启/关闭。

description.en: Deterministic network egress gate: web fetches and searches are checked against a destination allowlist in tools/pre-execute and denied before they run; shell fetch-verbs are observed (enforcement opt-in).
description.zh: 确定性网络出口门：网页抓取与搜索在 tools/pre-execute 按目的地白名单校验，越权即拒；shell 抓取动词默认观察，可选拦截。

description.en: Extends the composer model selector menu with a third Context window row, preset capacities (64K–2M), custom input, provider-wide sync, and adaptive compaction guard.
description.zh: 在底部聊天输入框的模型选择弹窗中扩展第三行【上下文窗口】，支持 64K~2M 档位切换、自定义容量输入、提供商批量同步与自适应压缩防失败守卫。

description.en: In-chat image viewer for the web UI: takes over content image clicks (Markdown images, message attachments rendered as blob: URLs, and read_image results) and opens a dialog with pointer-centered wheel zoom and an editable percentage, drag pan, 90° rotation, download with progress, copy as PNG, open with the default app, and ←/→ gallery browsing across the conversation.
description.zh: Web UI 的聊天图片查看器：接管内容图片点击（Markdown 图、以 blob: URL 渲染的消息附件图、read_image 结果），打开弹层后支持以指针为中心的滚轮缩放与可编辑百分比、拖动平移、90° 旋转、带进度下载、复制为 PNG、用默认应用打开，以及会话内 ←/→ 图集浏览。

description.en: Thesis and empirical-analysis workbench that drives IBM SPSS from the conversation: spss_check (environment self-check), spss_variables (list .sav variables with labels, types, measurement levels, case counts), spss_data (sample case rows to inspect missing and outlying values), spss_run / spss_run_file (execute SPSS syntax or an .sps file, relative CD and GET FILE paths auto-rebased), and spss_analyze (one-shot frequencies, descriptives, crosstabs with chi-square, t-tests, one-way ANOVA, correlation, linear regression). Results come back as structured tables extracted through OMS. SPSS 25-31 is auto-detected; the bundled MCP server is zero-dependency stdio.
description.zh: 论文/实证分析工作台：在对话里直接驱动 IBM SPSS。spss_check（环境自检）、spss_variables（列出 .sav 变量：名称/标签/类型/测度水平/案例数）、spss_data（抽查案例数据，检查缺失与异常值）、spss_run 与 spss_run_file（执行 SPSS 语法或 .sps 文件，自动修正 CD / GET FILE 相对路径）、spss_analyze（一键跑频数、描述统计、交叉表卡方、t 检验、单因素方差、相关、线性回归）。结果经 OMS 导出为结构化表格。自动探测 SPSS 25-31；内置 MCP server 为零依赖 stdio 服务。

description.en: Wallpaper-aware readability repair for the DSH Web GUI: it lifts the three low-contrast secondary text tokens with color-mix plus an adjustable text halo, adds content rules (bold, permanently underlined or recoloured links, tinted headings and body text) scoped to conversation Markdown only, offers adjustable rainbow-edge and gradient-fill heading effects, loads custom fonts from the plugin folder or the DSH home, and ships a draggable WYSIWYG preview with a WCAG contrast badge.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的「壁纸感知」可读性修复：用 color-mix 把三个低对比次级文字 token 向主文字靠拢，并叠加可调强度的文字光晕；提供仅作用于会话 Markdown 的内容规则（链接加粗 / 常驻下划线 / 变色、标题与正文变色）、可调的彩虹描边与渐变填充标题特效、从插件目录或 DSH_HOME 加载的自定义字体，以及带 WCAG 对比度徽标的可拖动 WYSIWYG 预览窗。

description.en: Agent tool that returns the running DSH Web GUI URL including its per-process launch token, so browser automation can open the GUI instead of getting a 401.
description.zh: 把当前 DSH Web GUI 的合法带 token 地址作为 agent 工具返回，浏览器自动化可直接打开 GUI，不再遇到 401。

description.en: Control a DeepSeek Harness agent from Feishu/Lark: send a task by DM, an agent runs it with your configured model and replies in the chat, and a feishu_send tool lets the agent push results. Uses lark-cli's WebSocket connection, so no public webhook is needed, and ships a resident launcher. Note: the plugin does not check who sent a message, so anyone who can DM the bot — by default, members of the Feishu tenant the app belongs to — can drive an agent running with the host's own model credentials and file permissions. Setup is not one `dsh plugin add`: `lark-cli` must be installed and authenticated once, and a Feishu self-built app with the permissions the README lists is required.
description.zh: 从飞书/Lark 操作 DeepSeek Harness：私聊发送任务，agent 用你配置的模型执行并把结果回到会话；feishu_send 工具可让 agent 主动推送结果。基于 lark-cli 的 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 webhook，并附常驻启动器。注意：插件不校验发送者身份，因此任何能私聊到该机器人的人（默认即该飞书应用所属企业内的成员）都能驱动一个使用宿主机自身模型凭据与文件权限运行的 agent。安装不是一条 `dsh plugin add` 就完事：需要先全局安装并登录一次 `lark-cli`，并在飞书开放平台建一个带 README 所列权限的自建应用。

description.en: macOS computer-use tools backed by a plugin-owned Cua Driver runtime.
description.zh: 通过插件独立管理的 Cua Driver 运行时提供 macOS 电脑操作工具。

description.en: Connects an existing local CodeGraph CLI to each session's indexed project, shares one MCP process per project, and updates session-scoped tools when the working directory or index changes.
description.zh: 将本机已安装的 CodeGraph CLI 接入各会话的已索引项目，同项目共享一个 MCP 进程，并在工作目录或索引变化时更新会话级工具。

description.en: Declares a spec-driven development agent preset with a Chinese persona and four static Claude Code/Codex delegation tools for planning, implementation, review and knowledge distillation; roles are prompt-guided, not an automatic state machine.
description.zh: 声明规范驱动研发预设，包含中文人格与四个 Claude Code/Codex 静态委派工具，用于规划、实现、审查与知识提炼；角色由提示词引导，并非自动状态机。

description.en: Grok model provider for DeepSeek Harness with model discovery, image and video generation, text-to-speech tools, and durable local media tasks over an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入 Grok：模型发现、图片与视频生成、文字转语音工具，以及可重启恢复的本地媒体任务。

description.en: GitHub issue service for DSH: turns a telemetry failure analysis into a uniform issue report, builds a pre-filled new-issue URL that is shortened when it would exceed a configured length budget, and rewrites a plain description into a structured issue with the deployment's model.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 GitHub issue 服务：把遥测失败分析整理成统一格式的 issue 报告，构造预填的新建 issue 链接并在超出配置长度时裁剪正文，再用部署配置的模型把一段自然语言描述改写为结构化 issue。

description.en: Reverse-engineering workbench: bridges a local IDA Pro into DeepSeek Harness through @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, exposing the ida-pro-mcp toolset (decompile, xref, rename, comment) as mcp__ida__* tools. Auto-selects idalib headless mode (analyses a binary in-process, no IDA GUI) or GUI mode (connects to the IDA plugin RPC on port 13337). Adds re_check, re_open and re_status; the bundled MCP server is a zero-dependency stdio proxy usable from any MCP client.
description.zh: 逆向分析工作台：通过 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 把本机 IDA Pro 桥接进 DSH，将 ida-pro-mcp 工具集（反编译、xref、重命名、注释）以 mcp__ida__* 注册给模型。自动选择 idalib 无头模式（进程内分析二进制，无需打开 IDA GUI）或 GUI 模式（连接 IDA 插件 RPC，默认 13337 端口）。附带 re_check、re_open、re_status 三个工具；内置 MCP server 为零依赖 stdio 代理，任意 MCP 客户端可直接挂载。

description.en: Codex-style reasoning-effort card for the composer: takes over the model selector and shows the current level, the model row and a segmented slider over the model's own adapter-provided levels, with a model list, a reset, and a purple aurora with twinkling particles at the maximum level.
description.zh: 输入框里的 Codex 风格推理强度卡片：接管模型选择器，显示当前档位、模型行，以及覆盖模型适配器所报全部档位的分段滑块；另带模型列表、重置，以及最高档时的紫色极光与闪烁粒子。

description.en: PCL-style modpack for DSH plugins: export a small .dshpack.zip manifest of the selected third-party plugins and their versions, then import it with a preview before reinstalling.
description.zh: PCL 式 DSH 整合包：勾选已安装插件导出小体积 .dshpack.zip 与安装命令串，导入时先预览、确认后再按版本重新安装。

description.en: Session-context surfaces ported from T3 Code: a session-row hover card showing machine, git branch, model, agent preset, approval policy and token usage, a status pill covering pending approval, awaiting input, working, error and subagent work, a provider and model chip, a per-session header strip, a lineage breadcrumb, row-menu actions that copy the context or run DSH compaction, and a preference row in DSH Settings for choosing which facts appear. Nothing is added to the composer.
description.zh: 移植 T3 Code 的会话上下文界面：会话行悬浮卡显示机器、Git 分支、模型、代理预设、审批策略与 token 用量，状态标签覆盖待审批、等待输入、运行中、错误与子代理工作，另有提供方与模型标记、会话头部信息条、血缘面包屑、可复制上下文或执行 DSH 压缩的行菜单操作，以及位于 DSH 设置中用于选择显示哪些事实的偏好行。输入框区域不新增任何元素。

description.en: Read, edit, export and verify Excel VBA projects through a real Excel COM instance: modules, UserForm code, procedure lists and .frm/.frx exports. Windows only, with desktop Excel installed, Python 3.10+ with pywin32, and AccessVBOM=1.
description.zh: 通过真实 Excel COM 读写、导出并校验 Excel VBA 工程：模块、窗体代码、过程清单与 .frm/.frx 导出。仅 Windows：需安装桌面版 Excel、Python 3.10+（含 pywin32），并设置 AccessVBOM=1。

description.en: Previews a workspace OpenWiki in the DSH Web right Sidebar: detects the wiki directory, serves it with the official `openwiki visualize` reader on a loopback port, and embeds it in its own tab, reporting the installed openwiki and DSH versions against configurable floors and checking the registry for its own updates.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右侧边栏预览工作区的 OpenWiki：识别 wiki 目录，用官方 `openwiki visualize` 阅读器在本地回环端口提供服务并嵌入自有标签页，同时对照可配置的版本下限报告 openwiki 与 DSH 版本，并向 registry 检查自身更新。

description.en: Skill-creation console for the Web UI: fetches the official creator skills, hands the requirements to the Huawei Cloud, generic, or REST API creator, then scores the generated skill against a 10-point rubric and returns the itemised deductions to the creator until it reaches 8.5/10.
description.zh: Web 界面上的技能创建面板：拉取官方 creator 技能，把需求交给华为云 / 通用 / REST API 三个 creator 之一执行创建，随后按 10 分制评测产物，未达 8.5 分就把逐项扣分交回 creator 修改直到通过。

description.en: Ctrl+F find-in-session for the conversation, powered by the session store rather than the DOM - labels every hit by source (you / assistant / reasoning / tool call / tool result / system), groups results by turn, merges identical snippets, offers prose-vs-everything scope, regex / case / whole-word options, highlights all matches, and copies or exports the result set as Markdown.
description.zh: 会话内 Ctrl+F 全文查找（读会话 store 而非 DOM）：命中按来源分类（你/助手/思考/工具调用/工具输出/系统）、按轮次分组、同文合并，可切「只搜正文 / 搜全部内容」，支持正则/大小写/全词，全量高亮，并能把结果复制或导出为 Markdown。

description.en: Per-workspace gate that hides the tool schemas and system prompt sections of selected plugins from the model in directories that do not need them.
description.zh: 按工作区门控插件：把选定插件的工具 schema 与系统提示词段，从不需要它们的目录的模型上下文中摘掉。

description.en: Drive a browser from one natural-language goal: a decision service picks the next operation and target from an indexed element table, so a DSH session spends one tool call instead of one turn per click.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 一句话目标：决策服务从带编号的元素表里挑出下一步操作与目标元素，驱动真实浏览器把事办完，一趟多步任务只花一次工具调用。

description.en: Adds a line-based copy tool for replacing or inserting file sections, with indentation control and diff previews.
description.zh: 提供按行复制工具，可替换或插入文件片段，并支持缩进控制和 diff 预览。

description.en: Adds a My Groups tab to the DSH Installed plugins page: custom groups with drag reordering, colored text tags, Chinese notes, group locking, real enable switches, and two preset snapshot slots.
description.zh: 在 DSH「已安装插件」页新增「我的分组」标签页：自定义分组与拖拽排序、彩色文字标签、中文备注、分组锁定、真实启停开关，以及两个预设快照槽位。

description.en: Turns course, lecture, tutorial, meeting, and talk videos into structured study notes: it extracts the audio track with ffmpeg, transcribes it with Whisper, then writes notes with a chapter outline, emphasis markers, and a quick-reference card.
description.zh: 把课程、讲座、教程、会议、演讲等视频整理成结构化学习笔记：用 ffmpeg 提取音轨、Whisper 语音转文字，再生成带分段大纲、重点标记和速查卡的笔记。

description.en: Opens academic sites through institutional proxy rules and optionally renames eligible new PDFs using matched article metadata, with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and US English settings.
description.zh: 按机构代理规则打开学术网站，可依据匹配的论文元数据重命名符合条件的新 PDF，并提供简体中文、繁体中文及美式英语设置界面。

description.en: Runs /single-turn and /multi-turn answers in isolated sub-agents so results stay in the current chat and never enter the main model context.
description.zh: 用 /single-turn 与 /multi-turn 在独立子代理中作答，结果只留在当前对话，不进入主模型上下文。

description.en: DSH plugin: hands a long session over to a fresh session in the same workspace on /handoff or at a token threshold, carrying the preset, model, permissions and plan mode across; the brief is written by the session's own model and the switch waits for a step boundary instead of interrupting running work.
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过 /handoff 或会话累计 Token 阈值把长会话交接给同工作区的新会话，并继承 preset、模型、权限与 Plan 模式；交接简报由会话自身的模型撰写，切换在 Step 边界发生，不中断正在执行的步骤。

description.en: DSH plugin: a settings panel to list, add, rewrite and toggle @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client MCP rows — no more hand-writing them into cordis.patch.yml. Zero build, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 插件：一块设置面板管理 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 的 MCP 行——列出、新增、改写、启停，不必再手写 cordis.patch.yml；零构建、零运行依赖。

description.en: API regression and acceptance workbench: snapshot the responses of the endpoints you register before the agent edits the backend, rerun them all after the edit, and review a structured field-level diff (status codes, added and removed fields, numeric old → new values with the delta) beside the captured source diff, accepting each endpoint one by one before exporting a Markdown or single-file HTML report.
description.zh: 接口回归验收台：登记端点后先快照响应基线，模型改完后端一键重跑，把结构化字段级差异（状态码、字段增删、数值新旧值与差值）与源码 diff 并排展示，逐项验收后再导出 Markdown / 单文件 HTML 报告。

description.en: Reads and writes WPS 365 cloud documents (smart documents and .docx/.xlsx/.pptx) through the locally installed wps365-cli, with conflict checks before writing; requires a WPS 365 enterprise account.
description.zh: 通过本机安装的 wps365-cli 读写 WPS 365 云文档（智能文档与 .docx/.xlsx/.pptx），写入前先做并发冲突比对；需要 WPS 365 企业版账号。

description.en: After each reply, shows a gray next-prompt suggestion in the empty composer that Tab or → accepts, and ↑ in an empty composer recalls your last sent message; nothing is sent automatically.
description.zh: 回答结束后在空输入框里显示一条灰色的下一句建议，按 Tab 或 → 采纳；空输入框按 ↑ 填入上一次发送的内容；不会自动发送。

description.en: A DSH conversation workspace: turn actions, provenance quotes, local notes and summaries, in-conversation find, focus lock, and per-workspace command buttons.
description.zh: DSH 会话工作台：轮次操作、引用出处、本地笔记与摘要、会话内查找、专注锁和多工作区命令按钮。

description.en: Hot-swap the outbound proxy in dsh between direct, system, and saved proxies without restarting.
description.zh: 在 dsh 运行过程中热切换出站代理（直连/系统/自定义），无需重启即可生效

description.en: A T3 Code-style New Session screen for the composer: a "What should we build in <project>?" headline whose project name opens a workspace menu, a reasoning-effort picker in the composer tool row, and a git branch strip under the card that searches local and remote refs and switches with git checkout.
description.zh: 把 T3 Code 的新会话界面移植到 DSH 输入框：标题「What should we build in <project>?」里的项目名可点开工作区菜单，工具栏里新增推理强度选择器，卡片下方新增 git 分支条，可搜索本地与远程引用并用 git checkout 切换。

description.en: Web search, page fetch and one-call research through DeepSeek's official Search and Fetch API; needs a DeepSeek API key.
description.zh: 通过 DeepSeek 官方 Search/Fetch 接口做网页搜索、单页抓取与一键调研；需要一个 DeepSeek API key。

description.en: Observes consecutive identical tool failures and optionally pauses before the next model step, preserving original results and successful repeats, with an in-chat report in DSH Web.
description.zh: 监视连续相同的工具失败，可在下一个模型步之前选择暂停；保留原始结果与成功的重复调用，并在 DSH Web 里出一份会话内报告。

description.en: Custom brand icon and name for the DSH Web sidebar and conversation hero, editable live from a settings card on the plugin detail page.
description.zh: 自定义 DSH Web 侧边栏与会话页的品牌图标和名称，插件详情页内置设置卡片，保存即生效。

description.en: Adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session-row menu; the confirmation mode is configurable (click again, confirm in a dialog, or delete immediately) and a session that is running a task is refused.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话行菜单中加入「删除会话」项，确认方式可配置（再次点击、对话框确认或直接删除），正在执行任务的会话会被拒绝删除。

description.en: Puts your own animated vector logo over the DSH brand mark in the sidebar and beside the start-page headline, taking over the three single slots sidebar.brand.mark, sidebar.brand.name and conversation.hero.brand.mark. The bundled patch only inserts the plugin into the loader — the official brand plugin (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official) holds those slots too, so you must disable it in the profile's cordis.patch.yml and restart. Ships a swimming whale that follows light and dark themes through currentColor and is tuned to stay legible at the sidebar's 24 px.
description.zh: 把自己做的矢量 Logo 换到 DSH 侧栏与首屏标题旁，接管 sidebar.brand.mark / sidebar.brand.name / conversation.hero.brand.mark 这三个 single 槽位。包里自带的补丁只把自己插进 loader——这三个槽位同时被官方品牌插件 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official 占着，所以要先在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里把它 disabled，再重启 DSH。默认那只鲸鱼会游动，用 currentColor 跟随明暗主题，动效按侧栏 24px 的可读性调过。

description.en: Test work framework for DSH that scaffolds a product, module and version directory tree, registers seven test_framework_* tools and four runtime skills, and adds a prompt-level gate that reports which requirement-document splits, versions, related documents and environment credentials are still unrecorded before testing starts. Requires the playwright MCP server (no fallback).
description.zh: DSH 测试工作框架：把空文件夹初始化为产品、模块、版本、报告与归档目录树，注册 7 个 test_framework_* 工具与 4 个运行时技能，并提供提示词级闸门——开测前报告需求文档拆分、版本、跨文档关联与环境账密中尚未登记的部分。需先配置 playwright MCP（无替代路径）。

description.en: Adds a live status badge to the session header and delivers guidance added mid-task without interrupting the turn.
description.zh: 在会话头显示实时状态徽标，并在不打断当前回合的前提下投递运行中新增的指导。

description.en: Composer model selector grouped by provider: pick a provider card, then drill into that provider to choose a model, with cross-provider search and Reasoning Effort kept.
description.zh: 按来源分块的输入框模型选择器：先选来源渠道卡片，再下钻进该渠道选择模型，保留跨来源搜索与推理强度调节。

description.en: Local-only telemetry service for DSH plugins: records operation trails and error events into a storage-domain KV table, applies a configurable redaction rule set before the write and again when the analysis reads back a record stored before a rule existed, and groups one plugin's failures by feature-code anchor, reporting the window it read, the route each group ran on, and the attempts recorded after its last failure in write order.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件的本地遥测服务：把操作轨迹与错误事件写入 storage-domain KV 表，在写入前按可配置的规则集脱敏，并在分析读回早于规则存在的旧记录时再次按同一规则集脱敏，然后按功能码锚点聚合单个插件的失败事件，同时报告读取的时间窗口、每个失败组的模型路由，以及按写入顺序统计的最近一次失败之后的尝试次数。

description.en: Records every session as one readable Markdown timeline inside the session workspace - the full request sent to the model (system prompt and plugin injections included), user input, replies, reasoning, tool calls and results, file reads and writes, web searches, skill loads, command runs and token usage - with a review page, a per-session tab and configurable capture scope.
description.zh: 把每次会话记录成会话工作区内一份可读的 Markdown 时间线——发往模型的完整请求（含系统提示词与插件注入）、用户输入、模型回复、推理过程、工具调用与结果、文件读写、联网搜索、技能加载、命令执行与 token 用量，并带审阅页、会话内标签页与可配置的采集范围。

description.en: Keeps the DSH host awake during active tasks using native power assertions and releases them when tasks finish.
description.zh: 在任务运行期间通过原生电源断言保持 DSH 主机亮屏与唤醒，并在任务结束后释放。

description.en: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless moli browser over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed; single-engine moli serve with auto LD_LIBRARY_PATH/FONTCONFIG_FILE injection and a persistent profile dir for logins), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.
description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 moli 无头浏览器（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 / Electron；单发动机 moli serve 直连，自动注入 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 与 FONTCONFIG_FILE，profile 目录持久化登录态）；另带一个网页面板——可直接点、滚、打字的实时页面，操作/控制台/网络日志与一键清理，窗口外观（边框色、透明度、玻璃效果）与几何（贴合画面比例去黑边、顶部留白、默认居中）可自定义，页面分辨率可调（默认 1920×1080）——收起后的胶囊可拖到任意位置（自由位置），切回「网页」自动续帧不用再点「开始」，实时画面「最大边」默认 1920——外加两份随包技能（browser、browser-runtime），由插件经 DSH 内置技能提供者提供，技能中心显示「系统内置」，默认不往 $DSH_HOME/skills 落盘。

description.en: Send local files to WeChat from any DSH session by reusing an installed IM plugin, plus cron-scheduled tasks that run in fresh sessions, a workspace activity glow, a header activity indicator, a completion chime, a macOS sidebar vibrancy toggle and a one-click host restart.
description.zh: 在任意 DSH 会话把本机文件主动投递到微信（复用已装的 IM 插件），另有按 cron 在全新会话里跑的定时任务、工作区活动呼吸灯、标题栏活跃指示、对话完成提示音、关闭 macOS 侧栏毛玻璃与一键重启宿主。

description.en: Workspace-free chats that promote real files into their own project workspace - a maintained fork of dsh-scratchpad, kept working on current DSH.
description.zh: 免工作区自由对话，产物自动提升为独立项目工作区；dsh-scratchpad 的持续维护 fork，跟当前 DSH 保持可用。

description.en: Colors DSH sidebar Session rows by their official status, in an Evangelion-flavored palette: a blue left rail for a row awaiting interaction, red for the session open in the main view, purple for finished-but-unviewed, and a static rainbow title for pinned rows. Every colour is mode-scoped — dark keeps the vivid stop, light takes a darker variant solved to clear 4.5:1 against the light wall — and the split reads DSH's own dark marker. Reads official Client services only: it owns no state, never polls, and ships no host-side half.
description.zh: 按官方状态给 DSH 侧栏会话行染色，配色取自福音战士：等你处理的会话为蓝色左轨，主视图打开的那条为红色左轨，已结束但未查看为紫色左轨，置顶行的标题为静态彩虹。左侧轨道按模式分档——暗档保留原色，亮档换成对浅底 ≥4.5:1 的压暗变体——分档读的是 DSH 自己的暗色标记；未读的紫色轨道两种模式共用。只读取官方 Client 服务，自身不持有状态、不轮询，也没有宿主侧代码。

description.en: SSH and JumpServer terminal plugin: real-machine read tools, human-initiated read-write operations, and session management from inside DSH.
description.zh: SSH 与 JumpServer 终端插件：真实机器读工具、人工发起的读写操作，以及 DSH 内的会话管理。

description.en: Classic 25/5/15 pomodoro timer for DSH that ties each run to the current session task or a manual project name, with a stats panel, a 365-day heatmap, a draggable floating timer and a corner pill, local JSON storage, and CSV export.
description.zh: DSH 番茄钟：经典 25/5/15 计时，可将每次专注关联当前会话任务或手动输入项目名，内置统计面板与全年热力图，配可拖动悬浮计时卡与角落迷你药丸，数据本地持久化并支持导出 CSV。

description.en: Plugin diagnostics for the dsh web GUI: finds plugins that failed to load, bundle rows that never started and broken file links, then reports the findings. Read-only: it does not repair, journal or undo anything.
description.zh: dsh Web 界面的插件诊断：找出加载失败的插件、未启动的 bundle 行与失效的 file 链接，并报告扫描结果。只读：不修复、不写日志、不提供撤销。

description.en: Rewrites the draft in the DSH composer into a clearer, more executable prompt through the harness's own LLM routes, showing an original/optimized comparison before you adopt it.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里的草稿通过 harness 自身的 LLM 路由改写成更清晰、更可执行的提示词，采纳前先显示原文与优化后的对比。

description.en: Codex-style keyboard answers for the pending command-approval panel — 1 allows once, 2 rejects, Enter confirms the highlighted choice, arrow keys move it, and Esc rejects, with the buttons still usable by mouse.
description.zh: 审批面板的 Codex 风格键盘应答：按 1 允许一次、2 拒绝、回车确认高亮项、方向键切换高亮、Esc 拒绝，鼠标点按依旧可用。

description.en: Client theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: a fluid background, frosted glass panels and quantised shader effects, with 100 adjustable parameters persisted to a JSON file.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 客户端主题插件：流体背景、毛玻璃面板与量子化着色器效果，100 项参数可调并持久化到 JSON 文件。

description.en: Layered cross-session memory for DSH that pushes only what changed - the first round injects every active entry, later rounds push only added / updated / removed ones, and nothing at all is injected when nothing changed, with keys that merely repeat an entry id left out of the text so the baseline is about 26% smaller. Facts and decisions carry semantic keys (one active truth per key), the model may only write to an inbox that a human promotes, an entry can carry a review date that raises a one-time reminder when due, and search is relevance-ranked with journal lines down-weighted and Chinese matched by bigram. A sidebar tab tells the lifecycle story instead of listing files - entries are grouped by stage (awaiting confirmation / in use / archived) along four axes (topic - one level, human-assigned, type, tag, date), each group can be ticked for batch promote / withdraw / archive / restore / delete / assign topic, and topics can be renamed store-wide or searched on their own. The archived stage reads in three levels - the category says why an entry left (distilled into the docs / useless for good / not needed right now, the first two being defaults you can add to), below it the entry topic stays collapsed until you click it, and entries with no topic sit right under the category. The tab also shows the global and workspace instruction files plus the current injection size. A zero-dependency CLI ships with it, so the store is usable without DSH.
description.zh: 分层跨会话记忆，只推变化的部分：首轮注入全部有效条目，之后只推新增 / 已更新 / 已失效，没有任何变化时一个字都不注入；与条目 id 重复的 key 不再写进正文，基线体积因此小约 26%。事实与决策带语义键（一个 key 只有一个有效结论），模型只能写收件箱、由人确认后才成为常驻事实；条目可以带复核时间，到期后提醒一次；检索按相关度排序、流水行被降权，中文按 bigram 匹配。侧边栏页签不再只是列文件，而是讲清流程：条目按「待你确认 / 已在用 / 已归档」分组，每个阶段都能按四个维度（主题——一级、由人归类，类型，标签，日期）查看；可逐条勾选做批量提升 / 撤回 / 归档 / 取回 / 删除 / 归类，主题可全库改名、也可只在该主题内搜索。「已归档」分三层：分类说明它为什么退场（已蒸馏 / 已废弃 / 暂时不用，前两个是默认分类，也能自己新建一个），分类下面是主题行、点开才列出条目，没写主题的条目直接列在分类下。页签同时显示全局与工作区规范文件以及当前注入体积。附带零依赖 CLI，不装 DSH 也能用这套记忆库。

description.en: Click a delivered-file card to open the file with the system default application instead of DSH's built-in sidebar preview; hold Shift to keep the original preview.
description.zh: 点击交付文件卡片时用系统默认程序打开文件，而不是在 DSH 侧边栏里预览；按住 Shift 保留原来的预览行为。

description.en: Removes sandbox_permissions / justification arguments that cannot widen the call's current sandbox mode, so calls no longer fail with 'sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode'. GPT models tend to fill these optional fields on every call and pick workspace-write, which is narrower than danger-full-access. Runs in tools/pre-execute: compares the requested mode with the mode the session's sandbox policy resolves, and drops the fields when the request is the same or narrower (also drops a lone justification). Also understands the values GPT carries over from Codex's own shell tool: null, empty and use_default are treated as no request, and in a danger-full-access session any value (including require_escalated) is dropped because nothing is wider. Real widening requests, unknown modes and tools that do not advertise DSH's escalation schema are left to DSH core. Never widens permissions. Configurable tool list (default bash, pwsh, write, edit, run_code). Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 去掉那些不会让当前沙箱模式变宽的 sandbox_permissions / justification 参数，避免调用报错「sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode」。GPT 系列模型往往每次调用都会填这两个可选参数，并选 workspace-write，而它比 danger-full-access 更窄。插件在 tools/pre-execute 阶段把请求的模式和会话沙箱策略给出的当前模式做比较：相同或更窄时去掉这两个字段（只有 justification 时也会去掉）。同时兼容 GPT 从 Codex shell 工具带过来的取值：null、空值和 use_default 视为没有请求；会话已经是 danger-full-access 时，任何取值（包括 require_escalated）都会去掉，因为不存在更宽的模式。真正的升权请求、无法识别的模式值，以及没有声明 DSH 升权参数的工具，都原样交给 DSH 处理。不会放宽任何权限。监控的工具列表可配置（默认 bash、pwsh、write、edit、run_code）。零依赖。

description.en: Category tree for the DSH sidebar workspace browser: workspaces and their sessions nest under user-made categories (collapsed state remembered), rows drag between categories, a new workspace can be created straight into one through the directory picker, categories rename and delete in place, and a footer toggle switches the panel back to the built-in list.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏工作区浏览器的分类树：工作区与其会话挂到自建分类下（折叠状态记忆），行可在分类间拖拽，新建工作区可直接落进某个分类（走系统目录选择器），分类可原地重命名与删除，底栏开关可把面板切回原生列表。

description.en: Query and manage JumpServer through conversation: assets, users, accounts, permissions, sessions, command audit logs, command filters, and RBAC roles, authenticated with an AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret pair (HTTP Signature).
description.zh: 通过对话查询与管理 JumpServer：资产、用户、账号、授权、会话、命令审计、命令过滤与 RBAC 角色，使用 AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret（HTTP 签名）鉴权。

description.en: Drive Blender 3D modeling from the harness — create primitives, run boolean CSG, transform, assign material and modifier, query the scene, and export STL/OBJ/PLY/GLTF via a JSON bridge. Bundles a headless trimesh+manifold3d runtime and a Blender bpy add-on speaking the same protocol. Includes auto environment setup (detect/install/configure/verify via the blender_setup tool).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动 Blender 3D 建模——创建基本体、布尔运算、变换、赋予材质与修改器、查询场景，并通过 JSON 桥接导出 STL/OBJ/PLY/GLTF。内置无头 trimesh+manifold3d 运行时，以及同协议的 Blender bpy 插件。内置自动环境检测/安装/配置/验证（blender_setup 工具）。

description.en: Brings the providers you already configured in cc-switch into DeepSeek Harness: reads the cc-switch database, converts Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi entries into llm-pi-ai routes with their API keys, and adds a health check that measures time-to-first-byte and whether each stream completes.
description.zh: 把 cc-switch 里配好的模型供应商接进 DeepSeek Harness：读取 cc-switch 数据库，将 Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi 等条目转成 llm-pi-ai 路由并写入 API Key，还提供实测首字节耗时与流能否正常收尾的体检。

description.en: Maximizes the DeepSeek Harness desktop window automatically on startup, equivalent to clicking the maximize button once. Cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), best-effort, host-only.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版启动时自动最大化主窗口，等价于手动点一次最大化按钮。跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），尽力而为，host-only 插件。

description.en: C++ audit skill: detects the target project's actual C++ standard before making any recommendation, then reports findings across RAII and ownership, move semantics, exception safety, performance and memory, containers and algorithms, concurrency, templates and compile-time, standard boundary, and type safety, ABI and interface design, each with a checkpoint, a reason, a bad-to-good example and the minimum standard.
description.zh: C++ 审查技能：先探测目标工程真实的 C++ 标准再给建议，随后按 RAII 与所有权、移动语义、异常安全、性能与内存、容器与算法、并发、模板与编译期、标准边界、类型安全、ABI 与接口设计逐条给出结论，每条含检查点、原因、反例→正例与适用标准。

description.en: PWA icon: sets the icon (and manifest app name) used when the Web GUI is installed or added to the desktop; ships a default icon set and accepts a custom image.
description.zh: PWA 图标：把 Web GUI 安装/添加到桌面时使用的图标（以及 manifest 应用名）换成自定义内容，包内自带默认图标集，也可配置自己的图片。

description.en: Construction cost workbench for DeepSeek Harness projects.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 项目的工程造价工作台。

description.en: Overlay reader for agent output files: Markdown rendering, in-panel PDF, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX text preview and reply-end file chips, with search, outline and position memory.
description.zh: agent 产出文件的浮层阅读器：Markdown 渲染、PDF 面板预览、DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 文本提取与回复末尾文件 chips，支持搜索、大纲与位置记忆。

description.en: Shows a spinner on a sidebar workspace row while any of its sessions are running, and a short-lived finished mark after they stop.
description.zh: 侧边栏的工作区行会在其下会话运行时显示转圈，会话停止后短暂保留一个已完成标记。

description.en: Push-to-talk dictation for the Web composer: hold a hotkey to record and the transcript is written into the draft through DSH's own speech Remote (local SenseVoice), with an optional auto-send.
description.zh: 输入框按住说话：按住快捷键录音，经 DSH 自带语音 Remote（本地 SenseVoice）识别后写入草稿，可选自动发送。

description.en: Service farm for DSH: register, start, stop and restart long-running project services, with agent tools (farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register), farm.yaml declarations and an overview drawer UI with live log follow, search and export.
description.zh: DSH 服务农场：注册、启动、停止、重启长驻项目服务，提供 agent 工具（farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register）与 farm.yaml 声明式服务，总览抽屉支持按工作区分组、实时日志 follow、搜索与导出。

description.en: Turns a Minecraft Java save into a Blender cover or animation: scans the .mca region files for flat open ground, exports the terrain to OBJ, and drives Blender headless with MCprep materials, the BPS character rig and three-point lighting. After each render it reviews the frame with OpenCV for facing, ground contact, exposure, lighting and composition, then re-renders with adjusted parameters when a check fails. Requires Blender 4.2 LTS or newer and Python 3.10+ with opencv-python and numpy; the first run assembles the Minecraft assets with the bundled setup command.
description.zh: 把 Minecraft Java 存档变成 Blender 封面或动画：在 .mca 区域文件里找大片平地，导出地形为 OBJ，无头驱动 Blender（MCprep 材质、BPS 角色骨架、三点布光）。每次渲染后用 OpenCV 检查朝向、接地、曝光、布光和构图，不合格就调整参数重渲。需 Blender 4.2 LTS 以上、Python 3.10+（opencv-python、numpy），首次使用运行 setup 装配 Minecraft 素材。

description.en: DSH plugin: matches a model you declared on a custom gateway to the capability metadata it should have — context window, output cap, reasoning levels and image support — by looking the bare model name up at runtime; the plugin never writes your settings document.
description.zh: DSH 插件：按模型名在运行时查一次目录，把你在自定义网关上声明的模型该有的能力元数据补上——上下文长度、输出上限、推理等级、能否看图；插件自己不写你的设置文档。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the AdWhispr remote MCP server through mcp-remote with browser OAuth sign-in, adding tools for competitor ad research, ad creative cloning, and launching and managing Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns. Requires an AdWhispr account.
description.zh: 通过 mcp-remote 加浏览器 OAuth 登录，把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 AdWhispr 的远程 MCP 服务：竞品广告调研、广告创意克隆，以及 Meta／Google／TikTok 广告的投放与管理。需要 AdWhispr 账号。

description.en: Daily and weekly task manager: startup popup reminder, a marquee strip above the composer, one-click circle completion, editable task cards, and a Sunday AI weekly summary, plus a sidebar DeepSeek API usage widget with balance card, today/cumulative tokens and cost, per-model breakdown and a 7-day chart. Persists as JSON under $DSH_HOME.
description.zh: 每日/每周任务管理：启动弹窗提醒、输入框上方滚动条、圆圈一键完成、任务卡片编辑、周日 AI 周总结；另附侧边栏 DeepSeek API 用量小部件（余额卡片、今日与累计 tokens 及费用、按模型明细、近 7 日柱状图）。数据以 JSON 存于 $DSH_HOME。

description.en: Publishes HTML pages and Markdown documents written by the agent to GitHub Pages as shareable links, with tools to update them in place, list, read back, and delete them; adds an Artifacts sidebar panel and a bundled page-design skill.
description.zh: 把 Agent 生成的 HTML 页面和 Markdown 文档发布到 GitHub Pages 并返回可分享链接，提供原地更新、列出、读回和删除的工具；附带侧边栏 Artifacts 面板和内置的页面设计技能。

description.en: Show local images and short videos in the DSH conversation card with one-click download of the original file, or offer any other local file for download; works over local and remote connections and keeps the media itself out of the model's vision context.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话卡片内显示本地图片与短视频并提供原文件一键下载，也可为任意其他本地文件提供下载；本机与远程连接均可用，媒体本身不进入模型的视觉上下文。

description.en: YiHe pkg-dev knowledge packs for DeepSeek Harness: 52 domain packs and 90 RFB experience files for coding cognition.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 YiHe pkg-dev 知识包：52 个领域包与 90 个 RFB 经验文件，用于编程认知。

description.en: Sorts every loaded skill into one or more user-owned workspaces in a right-sidebar tab: each workspace is its own category list plus where every skill sits, categories are created, renamed, reordered and deleted in place, and skills are dragged or picked between them. A first run can let the profile model build the first classification, or place skills into categories the user built first; clicking a row copies its /skill-name and hovering unfolds the description the skill ships.
description.zh: 在右侧栏用一个或多个「工作区」给已加载的 skill 分类：每个工作区有自己的分类表和每个 skill 的归属，分类可就地新建、改名、排序、删除，skill 可拖动或用选择器改归位；首次使用可以让这个 profile 的模型从零分一版，也可以先自己建分类再让模型按分类分配。点击行复制 /skill-name，悬停展开 skill 自带的描述。

description.en: All-media (video/audio/image) sibling of liustack/modlens: turns local media into structured evidence (timeline / transcript / layout regions) injected into the conversation so text-only models can cite concrete frames, seconds and speakers — Evidence, not imagination.
