One failover chain per media, recorded hop-by-hop in meta.attempts (a fallback is never silent): host-registered multimodal models first, then a configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint (comma-separated multi-key rotation), then local ffmpeg frame-sampling / a local ASR CLI, degrading to metadata-only as a last resort. Absorbs modlens battle-tested rules — cooldown keyed only on auth/quota failures and softened to chain-tail (never dropped), redact-before-clip error text, magic-byte sniff that never trusts file extensions. Optional vision-bridge registers a media-lens wrapper into the host model selector so a pure-text model gains image/audio/video sight. Registering / authenticating multimodal models and true inline audio-video upload lean on two companion plugins, declared as optional peers (absence auto-degrades, never errors): dsh-thinking-levels fronts the model config / registration surface, dsh-llm-openai-completions takes over the OpenAI-compatible transport that serializes file blocks into video_url / input_audio. Privacy: media goes to remote providers by default; strictLocalOnly keeps content on-machine. Prerequisites not shipped with the package: ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH (frame sampling / reencode / duration probe; degrades to metadata when missing) and a user-configured local ASR CLI for the audio fallback. Hosts 0.1.7 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1 (6 rc, exact engines.dsh enum). npm: dsh-media-lens.
description.zh: liustack/modlens 的全媒体（视频/音频/图像）延伸：把本地媒体转成结构化证据（时间线/转写/版面区域）注入对话，让纯文本模型能引用具体帧、秒、说话人——Evidence, not imagination。每个媒体一条 failover 链，逐跳记录在 meta.attempts（降级绝不静默）：宿主已注册全模态模型优先，其次自配 OpenAI-compatible 端点（逗号分隔多 key 轮换），再落到本地 ffmpeg 抽帧 / 本地 ASR CLI，末位仅元数据降级。吸收 modlens 实战经验——仅 auth/quota 类失败触发冷却且软化垫队尾（不剔除）、错误文本先脱密后截断、magic-byte 校验绝不信任扩展名。可选 vision-bridge 把透镜包装成模型选择器可见的 media-lens 包装 provider，让纯文本主力获得图/音/视频视野。多模态模型的注册/认证与真正的音视频直传依赖两个姊妹插件配合（均声明为 optional peer，未装则能力自动降级、不报错）：dsh-thinking-levels 承接模型配置录入/登记面，dsh-llm-openai-completions 做 OpenAI-compatible 传输接管、把 file 块序列化成 video_url / input_audio 真正上送。隐私：媒体缺省会发往远端 provider，开启 strictLocalOnly 则不出本机。不随包分发的安装前提：PATH 上的 ffmpeg/ffprobe（抽帧/重编码/时长探测，缺失时降为仅元数据），以及音频兜底需用户自备本地 ASR CLI。支持宿主 0.1.7 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1 共 6 个 rc（engines.dsh 精确枚举）。npm 包名：dsh-media-lens。

description.en: Conflict diagnosis and repair for DeepSeek Harness plugins. Builds a capability graph of the running Loader profile and of the on-disk cordis.patch.yml layers, comparing imports, peer ranges and config against the host that is ACTUALLY running rather than the profile's possibly-stale copies, and reports the conflicts that fail silently: a fiber stuck PENDING on a service no plugin provides, a browser half injecting a client module nothing provides, a tool id two plugins both register, duplicate Loader entry ids, a row disabled by one layer and re-inserted by another, an import of a host subpath the running host does not export, and a cycle among inject declarations. Every finding carries its evidence, a confidence grade for who owns a name, and a repair with a risk grade — verify it with a dry-run difference table, or take the individual .patch.yml files that --fix-out writes (never auto-loaded, so picking wrong breaks nothing).
description.zh: DSH 插件冲突诊断与修复建议。把运行期能力图谱与磁盘上的 cordis.patch.yml 层对齐，并与真正在运行的宿主（而不是 profile 里可能过期的副本）比对导入、peer 范围与配置，检出那些不会自己报错的静默故障：卡在 PENDING 等待无人提供的服务、浏览器半区注入了无人提供的客户端模块、两个插件注册同一个 tool id、Loader entry id 重复、某层停用又被后一层重新插入的行、导入了运行宿主未通过 exports 暴露的子路径、以及 inject 声明之间成环。每条结论都带证据、归属置信度与带风险分级的修复：用 --dry-run 在内存里试修并看修改前后差异，或用 --fix-out 拿到独立的 .patch.yml 文件自己挑（这些文件不会被 DSH 加载，挑错也不影响运行）。

description.en: Registers a Tavily search provider for the ctx.web seam and switches web_search to it, with a comma-separated apiKey list that rotates on 401/403/429/5xx and transport errors.
description.zh: 为 ctx.web 接缝注册 Tavily 搜索 provider 并把 web_search 切到它；apiKey 支持逗号分隔多 key，遇到 401/403/429/5xx 与网络错误自动轮换。

description.en: Embeds a remote DeepSeek Harness GUI in the local DSH window over an SSH tunnel, lists the remote sessions, and switches between the local instance and any remote host.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 隧道把远端 DSH 的 GUI 嵌进本地 DSH 界面，列出远端会话，并在本地实例与任意远端主机之间切换。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness Web to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle and MongoDB for schema discovery and read-only queries through session-authorized MCP tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 数据库插件：统一管理 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、Oracle 和 MongoDB 连接，让 Agent 按会话授权探索数据结构、执行只读查询并辅助数据分析。

description.en: Journey to the West floating desktop pet: a frameless, transparent, always-on-top cartoon widget of Tang Monk and his disciples. Click to switch characters; idle plays a chasing scene.
description.zh: 西游师徒卡通桌面悬浮窗：无边框、透明、置顶。点击切换唐僧/孙悟空/猪八戒/沙僧/白龙马，静止自动播放追逐动画。

description.en: Gives an installed dsh web app a native-looking window caption through Window Controls Overlay - the manifest route is served with display_override, the app's own sidebar brand row and session header become the drag region, and the app's own trailing controls are inset clear of the browser's caption chrome.
description.zh: 通过 Window Controls Overlay 让已安装的 dsh Web 应用拥有原生观感的窗口标题栏——清单路由带 display_override 返回，应用自身的侧边栏品牌行与会话 header 成为拖拽区，应用自身右侧控件自动让开浏览器标题栏 chrome。

description.en: Subagent model control: a Jev classifier labels each turn, and the subagent request itself is rewritten to the provider, model and reasoning effort that the label maps to, at the agent/request hook; a per-session inherit/auto/manual selector, one prompt per role injected ahead of the task, and offline replay of past verdicts.
description.zh: 子代理模型管控：由 Jev 判定本轮任务类别，再把子代理自身的请求改写为该类别对应的 provider、model 与推理强度（在 agent/request 钩子上执行）；会话内可用继承/自动/手动三种方式指定模型，每个角色可带一条先于任务注入的前置提示词，并可离线回放历史判定。

description.en: Adds F5 / Ctrl+R page reload to the DeepSeek Harness desktop web UI, which production builds lack by default (the "Reload Page" menu item and bare-F5 accelerator are development-gated). Binds soft reload (F5, Ctrl+R) and cache-busted hard reload (F5 with a modifier, Ctrl+Shift+R, appending a _dsh_refresh timestamp) through a capture-phase client key listener.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面 Web UI 补上 F5 / Ctrl+R 页面刷新功能（生产版默认没有刷新菜单项与裸 F5 快捷键）。通过客户端捕获阶段按键监听绑定软刷新（F5、Ctrl+R）与防缓存硬刷新（F5 加修饰键、Ctrl+Shift+R，附加 _dsh_refresh 时间戳）。

description.en: Turns the DSH turn-navigation rail into a music visualiser: each thin bar grows and thickens with its own frequency band, from system audio captured with WASAPI loopback. Geometry only, no colour or glow, and the rail keeps its native hover preview, click-to-jump and wheel scrolling.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的轮次导航条变成音乐可视化：每根细横条按自己的频段变长变粗（系统声音用 WASAPI loopback 采集）。只改几何、不加颜色或发光，导航条原有的悬停预览、点击跳转与滚轮滚动都保留。

description.en: Session-level verdict on whether compaction would lose unlanded state; structurally refuses per-block screening.
description.zh: 会话级判定：compaction 是否会丢失未落地状态；结构上拒绝逐块筛选。

description.en: Appends a tiny ice marker to the end of every sentence the model writes, chain of thought included, and plays a short synthesized sound for each one.
description.zh: 在模型写出的每句话结尾（含思维链）补一个小冰块标记，并为每次补冰播放一声短促的合成音效。

description.en: Artifact center: search, preview and open files produced by DSH conversations.
description.zh: 产物中心：跨工作区检索、预览并打开对话产出的文件。

description.en: Deterministic ticket triage: a rule prefilter classifies clear cases and returns everything else as needs_review instead of guessing.
description.zh: 确定性工单分诊：规则先处理明确案例，放不下的统一返回 needs_review，而不是猜。

description.en: Shows local glossary definitions when hovering over terms in chat messages.
description.zh: 悬停聊天消息中的术语时显示本地词库释义。

description.en: Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol bridge: serves an A2A endpoint with agent card, message/send, message/stream SSE, task lifecycle (get/cancel/resubscribe) and input-required continuation; a2a_discover/a2a_send/a2a_task_status/a2a_cancel tools for calling remote agents; plus a web ops panel with live task board, one-click cancel and a remote agent directory.
description.zh: Agent2Agent（A2A）协议桥：内置 A2A 服务端（agent card、message/send、message/stream SSE、任务 get/cancel/resubscribe、input-required 续答）；a2a_discover/a2a_send 等 4 个工具呼叫远端 agent；附 Web 运维面板：实时任务板、一键取消、远端 agent 目录。

description.en: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against CursorTouch/Windows-MCP, excluding PowerShell, FileSystem, Registry, Process and Scrape by default (16 of the 21 tools upstream 0.8.8 publishes). Requires uv on PATH.
description.zh: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥接 CursorTouch/Windows-MCP，默认排除 PowerShell、FileSystem、Registry、Process、Scrape（上游 0.8.8 共 21 个工具，保留 16 个）。需要 uv 在 PATH 上。

description.en: Adds Kimi models to native DSH sessions with per-model selection of the embedded Kimi core or DSH native execution.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生会话中接入 Kimi 模型，并按模型选择嵌入式 Kimi 核心或 DSH 原生执行方式。

description.en: Cost readouts for the composer, turns and sessions, a usage dashboard, daily/monthly budgets and settings, with DeepSeek balance from dsh-tally-balance-deepseek.
description.zh: 提供输入框费用条、每轮与会话费用详情、用量看板、日/月预算和设置，并通过 dsh-tally-balance-deepseek 显示 DeepSeek 余额。

description.en: Live estimated session spend in the composer dock, pricing each assistant step at DeepSeek's peak or off-peak rate for its own timestamp.
description.zh: 在输入框底栏显示当前会话的预估花费，每一步都按其自身时间戳采用 DeepSeek 的峰时或非峰时单价计价。

description.en: Pre-claim gate: a commit, push or tag claim like "tests pass" is checked against the session evidence ledger before it is written.
description.zh: 提交前声明门：把“测试通过”等 commit/push/tag 声明与本次会话的真实执行证据核对后再写入。

description.en: Snapshot-bound multi-agent Git review with independent verification, majority voting, resolution tracking and an AI review gate.
description.zh: 绑定代码快照的多智能体 Git 审阅，支持独立复核、多数投票、问题处置追踪和 AI 审阅门禁。

description.en: AI research toolkit for DSH: a model release radar, a per-model benchmark and community report from 13 structured leaderboards plus Chinese and English community discussion, and an AI news radar over 46 feeds and 22 official X accounts; registers four tools and three skills and renders every report to Markdown with a generated table of contents.
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 研究工具箱：模型发布雷达、单模型跑分与口碑体检（13 路结构化榜单 + 中英文社区讨论）、覆盖 46 个 Feed 与 22 个官方 X 账号的 AI 新闻雷达；注册 4 个工具 + 3 个技能，报告统一渲染为带目录的 Markdown。
输入股票名就能出一份A股体检报告，涵盖市值、风险、技术面和买卖建议，帮你快速摸清个股情况。

description.en: Astronomy research workbench for DSH and Codex: NADC terms, references, writing, scoring, author confirmation, physics/recommended books, FITS/XML formats and analysis guides.

Task-priority session notifications for DSH: main-line sessions alert immediately on completion or failure, side-line completions can be batched into one alert, and questions or permission requests alert as they arrive; supports multiple main-line markers and a balanced mode that treats every session as main-line while nothing is marked.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的任务分级会话通知：主线任务完成或失败时立即提醒，支线可汇总为一声，提问与权限请求出现即提醒；支持同时标记多个主线，以及未标记主线时把所有会话视为主线的均衡模式。

description.en: The Coreness kit for DeepSeek Harness — a plugin bundle for a profile.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 单个配置档配一个页面、一份日志和一道刹车，集中管理 MCP 服务器与 Qoder 提供方。

description.en: DeepSeek balance and usage monitor for DSH: a corner widget showing topped-up balance, per-model period consumption, token breakdown, and a Beijing-time peak/off-peak price reminder. Add a DeepSeek API key in the settings first.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的余额与用量监控：右下角悬浮组件，显示充值余额、按模型的周期消耗、Token 明细，以及北京时间高峰/低谷价格提醒；需先在设置里填入 DeepSeek API key。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：批量删除/归档对话记录，支持删除未分组的对话。A DeepSeek Harness plugin to batch delete & archive conversations, including ungrouped ones.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个侧栏面板，勾选就能批量删除或归档对话，连未分组的对话也能删。

description.en: 在侧边栏会话菜单中新增「删除对话」，永久清除该对话的本地记录。
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话菜单里加个「删除对话」，把本地记录彻底清掉，不再只能归档。

description.en: pstack for DeepSeek Harness: rigorous agent workflows, with every subagent's model chosen from the models you checked. 56 skills, deterministic role routing, zero extra API calls.

Registers /compact_queue, a compaction command that does not drop the request when the session is busy: it compacts immediately when idle, otherwise queues the request in that session and runs it at the session's next idle window, with a 2-second fallback tick beside the agent status event so the trigger is not missed, a 30-minute wait cap, and /compact_queue cancel to withdraw a queued request or abort a running one. Each session keeps its own queue state from a single command registration, completion and failure arrive as a collapsed notice that does not wake the model, and every ManualCompactionError code except busy is terminal so a failure is not retried. Host half only; the core /compact command is left untouched.
description.zh: 注册 /compact_queue：会话忙时也不丢弃请求的压缩命令——空闲就立刻压缩，忙时把请求排进本会话队列，等这个会话下一次空闲自动补跑；agent 状态事件之外再挂一条 2 秒兜底 tick，避免漏触发，排队最长等 30 分钟，排队中或执行中都可以用 /compact_queue cancel 撤销。命令只注册一次，每个会话各自一份排队状态，完成与失败以折叠 notice 注入、不唤醒模型；ManualCompactionError 除 busy 外一律视为终态、不再重试。只有 Host 半边，核心 /compact 不改。

description.en: The writable half of the right-sidebar document preview: edit and save any text file in place. Every save carries the version that was opened, so when the file changed on disk during the edit it stops and asks instead of overwriting. The preview toolbar gains an edit button and a two-step delete button. A separate File editor sidebar tool brings its own file tree: create, rename or move, copy, cut and paste (including a file taken from the system clipboard), delete, and drag to reorganize. Two renderer bands cover 107 plain-text, config and source extensions; the second is offered only as an open-with choice, leaving the shipped Markdown and highlighted-code views as the default. Mutations run through the plugin own trusted host routes, behind the connection fence, the workspace containment check and the sandbox policy.
description.zh: 右侧栏文档预览的可写一半：编辑并原地保存任意文本文件。每次保存都带上「打开时的那一版」，编辑期间磁盘上的文件被改过就停下来问，不静默覆盖；预览工具栏多出「编辑」按钮和两步确认的「删除」按钮。另有一个「文件编辑」侧栏工具，自带文件树：新建、改名 / 移动、复制 / 剪切 / 粘贴（含把系统剪贴板里的文件粘进工作区）、删除、拖拽整理。两档文档渲染器共覆盖 107 个纯文本、配置与源码扩展名，其中第二档只作为「打开方式」出现，官方 Markdown 排版与代码高亮仍是默认视图。变更走插件自己的 Host 路由，过连接信任围栏、工作区包含性检查与沙箱策略三道闸。

description.en: DSH plugin: a user-invoked Action shelf for reusable prompts and flows - no context cost, no automatic triggering.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个提示词收藏夹，搜一下就能插进输入框，不占上下文也不会被自动调用。

description.en: Agent PM: product-manager-style review for Claude Code and DeepSeek Harness agent projects
description.zh: 用产品经理视角审查 agent 项目的设计漏洞，帮你说清楚那些以为说清楚的事。

description.en: Per-agent tool filter for the main agent (orchestrator) in DeepSeek Harness — minimal toolset for the orchestrator, full toolset for subagents.
description.zh: 给主 Agent 只留必要工具，子 Agent 用全套工具，省 token 又少干扰。

description.en: AI 接线板：让别的 AI 通过本机 HTTP 把提示词递进 DeepSeek Harness 会话，我的回复也同步到 outbox 供对方读取（双向）。 / Two-way prompt relay between a DSH session and any other AI over local HTTP.
description.zh: 让别的 AI 通过本机 HTTP 把提示词送进 DSH 会话，回复也同步到 outbox，实现双向对话接力。

description.en: Install-and-use AI Studio for DeepSeek Harness: workspace dashboard, roles, tasks, verification, decision desk, merge governance, and portable project bundles.
description.zh: 把 DSH 聊天窗口变成多角色 AI 工作室，派单、验收、合并治理一站搞定。

description.en: Turns one plain-language request into a live workbench window: a sidebar panel asks a few clarifying questions, the model writes a single-file HTML artifact, and the plugin mounts it in a resizable floating window or a standalone browser tab. Declared window actions are recorded as info-level project journal entries (without their payloads), and workbenches can be imported, exported, or installed from a market index.
description.zh: 用一句大白话换来一个能用的工作台窗口：侧边栏面板先问几个带推荐选项的问题，模型据此写一个单文件 HTML 产物，插件把它挂成可缩放的浮层窗口或独立标签页。窗口里声明的动作会以 info 级别记进项目日志（不含动作数据）；工作台还能导入、导出，或从市场索引一键安装。

description.en: Requires macOS and AirPods with head tracking. Answer DSH permission prompts and questions with AirPods head gestures — nod to allow or confirm, shake to reject or shift the selected option — and install the companion macOS menu-bar app from a card inside the session.
description.zh: 需 macOS 与支持头部追踪的 AirPods。戴着 AirPods 用点头/摇头回答 DSH 的权限许可与提问——点头＝允许或确认，摇头＝拒绝或切换选项；会话里一张卡片就能装好配套的 macOS 菜单栏 App。

description.en: DSH 报警插件：报警条件可选，支持提醒/弹窗/铃声/语音播报四通道（DSH alarm plugin with per-condition channels)
description.zh: DSH 桌面端报警插件，需要你裁决、确认计划或一轮结束时，用铃声、语音和弹窗把你叫回来。

description.en: Adds the official Google Antigravity ACP agent as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, with tool execution and approval kept in DSH, Node 22.19+ and a signed-in Antigravity account required, a per-model quota pill and a settings page.
description.zh: 把 Google 官方 Antigravity ACP agent 接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型提供商，工具执行与审批仍由 DSH 负责，附按模型切换的额度药丸和设置页；需 Node 22.19+ 并登录 Antigravity 账号。

description.en: AOCI-CODE cognition layer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one-shot /aoci <path>  gives agents governed, Git-versioned repository/database cognition via a dynamic MCP bridge (aoci_rules/overview/maintain), with auto-maintenance and compaction-contract recovery. MIT; AOCI-CODE binary not bundled.
description.zh: 一条 /aoci 命令就能让 AI 读懂你的代码仓库和数据库，还能用 Git 管好这些认知。

description.en: DSH 只读 AppData 分析插件：资源管理器式下钻浏览，显示每个目录的体积、来源软件、用途与可删建议，支持按需联网查询
description.zh: 只读扫描 Windows AppData 目录，按资源管理器方式逐层查看各文件夹占用大小、来源软件和用途，并给出能否删除的参考建议。

description.en: Press Enter to approve a pending permission request in DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - no mouse.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里按回车就能批准权限请求，按 Esc 拒绝，不用再动鼠标。

description.en: DSH plugin: a conservative, plain-language explanation of what a pending approval will do, without touching the native approval UI.
description.zh: 用大白话解释待审批操作到底会做什么，不碰原生审批界面，帮你放心点确认。

description.en: Desktop approval popup plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: DSH 不在前台时，桌面右下角弹出审批卡片，点一下就能允许或拒绝，不用切回主窗口。

description.en: Native DSH tools for playing Stronghold Protocol solo games over the game site's WebSocket connection, with compact state views, explicit actions and public card lookups.
description.zh: 通过游戏站原生 WebSocket 连接进行 Stronghold Protocol 单人对局的 DSH 工具，支持紧凑局面查看、明确动作执行和公开卡牌查询。

description.en: Mirrors assistant streaming frames (deltas, blocks, commits, turn fences) to a configurable NDJSON sink for external consumers.
description.zh: 把助手流式输出帧（增量、块、提交、轮次栅栏）以 NDJSON 形式写入可配置的接收端，供外部进程消费。

description.en: Search public-domain libraries (Project Gutenberg, Wikisource, Internet Archive, Standard Ebooks) by title, author, character or half-remembered plot, or import EPUB / PDF / TXT / DOCX / Markdown, and listen in the sidebar with Microsoft Edge neural voices, offline Kokoro or the device voices; keeps your position, takes voice notes anchored to what you just heard, and discusses the book with your DSH model.
description.zh: 搜书听：按书名、作者、角色名或大概情节搜公版书（古腾堡、中英文维基文库、Internet Archive、Standard Ebooks），或导入 EPUB / PDF / TXT / DOCX / Markdown，在右侧栏用微软 Edge 神经网络语音、离线 Kokoro 或设备自带语音读给你听；自动记住听到哪，能语音记读书心得、和 AI 聊刚听到的内容。

description.en: Automatic turn-level resume for DeepSeek Harness: continues after transient model-request failures, merges provider outages into one storm, and always yields to a manual stop.DeepSeek Harness 自动续行插件：模型请求临时失败导致轮次中断后自动接着做；同一次网关故障只重试一次；手动停止永远优先。
description.zh: 模型请求失败导致会话中断时自动续行接着干，手动停止永远优先，永久错误不重试。

description.en: DSH 自动方案执行插件：四条件触发、方案冻结、任务图与步骤账本、门禁预算、完整度闸门与八部分报告。
description.zh: 提交方案后自动冻结并拆解任务、按预算连续执行，最后交一份完整报告。

description.en: On every DeepSeek Harness launch, checks the installed and enabled plugins for newer npm versions, lists them in the UI and updates them after confirmation.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时检查已安装并启用的插件有没有新版本，在界面上列出并询问，确认后更新到最新版。

description.en: Check, install and roll back DeepSeek Harness CLI updates from the web settings page - with health-checked restart and automatic rollback.
description.zh: 在网页设置页一键检查、安装并回滚 DSH CLI 更新，健康检查失败自动回滚，升级更安心。

description.en: DSH 插件：重启不打断工作——等所有对话空闲后优雅重启，重启后自动接着干。AI 生成、未人工审核，谨慎使用。
description.zh: 等所有对话空闲了才优雅重启，重启后自动接着干，不用再手动补一句“继续”。

description.en: DSH plugin: your DeepSeek account balance as a colour-banded bar on the right edge, with per-turn cost prediction and a quiet low-balance warning.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 账户余额做成右侧彩色条，实时显示每轮花费预测，余额低时安静提醒。
在面板里随时查看 DeepSeek 余额和用量，花钱心里有数。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的「阅读」视图插件自用维护版：过程折叠、实时思考卡片、最终回答聚焦；已脱离官方 DSHX 工具链，改用 esbuild + lightningcss 自建可复现构建。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页版换个更清爽的阅读视图，过程自动折叠、思考实时显示、回答重点突出。

description.en: DSH plugin: persistent full-window background image - upload, live preview, opacity/brightness/mask/blur/position/fit, config persisted to disk. Two packages: host + client.
description.zh: 给 dsh web 界面换张全窗口背景图，上传后能实时调透明度、亮度、模糊和位置，设置自动保存。

description.en: 大肥鱼女仆长智能体，用风神与明神插件vibe而来，解决wsl与windows互通问题
description.zh: 蓝发鲸鱼娘女仆长智能体，中文思考、按需解锁工具，专治 WSL 与 Windows 互通难题。

description.en: 鲸群：给 DSH 装的 B 站生活插件 —— 扫码登录、峰谷生物钟、日记文件夹 + 分类记录库、带哈希链的账本、评论发出后复核、mod 扩展接口。fork 自 dsh-bili-whale。
description.zh: 给 DSH 装的 B 站生活插件：扫码登录、按生物钟刷视频写日记、账本可审计，还会把值得的内容 @ 你。

description.en: Windows only. Bilibili video summarizer: downloads the audio track, transcribes it locally with faster-whisper (Python + faster-whisper, about 725 MB of models on first run), then writes the analysis markdown and renders a one-page infographic PNG.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。B 站视频一键总结：下载音轨并用 faster-whisper 本地转写（需 Python 与 faster-whisper，首次运行下载约 725 MB 模型），随后生成解析 md 与一页「一图读懂」PNG。

description.en: Opens .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: Blender headless exports a cached GLB with scene statistics, rendered by a dependency-free WebGL viewport. Requires Blender 3.6+ on PATH (or set blenderPath).
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里打开 .blend：Blender headless 导出缓存 GLB 与场景统计，由零依赖 WebGL 视口渲染。需本机装有 Blender 3.6+（或在设置里指定 blenderPath）。

description.en: DSH built-in browser enhancement kit: element annotations (multi-window shared sessions), screenshot feedback, device traffic observation, and an implementation-session command channel.
description.zh: 给 DSH 内置浏览器加上元素批注、截图回传和 HID 设备直连，让 AI 能看懂页面并动手操作。

description.en: Ask side questions using current conversation context while the main task continues.
description.zh: 在不打断当前任务的情况下旁聊提问，复用当前对话上下文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness user message bubble skin library | DSH 用户消息气泡样式库插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 聊天界面换用户消息气泡样式，多套皮肤随意切换，不动整体主题。

description.en: DSH 插件：在输入栏和新会话页展示 Codex 额度、DeepSeek 余额、波峰/波谷状态，并按 DeepSeek 官方人民币峰谷价估算会话费用。
description.zh: 在输入栏和新会话页实时显示 Codex 额度、DeepSeek 余额和峰谷状态，还能按官方人民币峰谷价估算会话花费。

description.en: Editable quick-action buttons beside the DSH composer: send 「继续」 or your own saved text, resend your last message, and hide or restore either preset. Text-only: sends text, runs no host commands, and never overwrites an existing draft.
description.zh: DSH 输入框旁的可编辑快捷按钮：发送「继续」或自定义文字、重发上一条，并可隐藏/恢复预设。纯文字动作，不执行宿主命令；有草稿时不发送。

description.en: Cache-hit metrics, request-prefix risk confirmation, and per-step cache-miss diagnostics for DSH.
description.zh: 展示缓存命中、发送前确认请求前缀风险，并按调用步骤定位缓存失效。

description.en: 核动力草泥马 - DSH Web GUI desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面右下角养一只草泥马桌宠，它会跟着 Agent 的工作状态变表情动作。

description.en: Discord and Feishu/Lark channels for DeepSeek Harness: verified identities, shared sessions, native Ask User and progress delivery.
description.zh: 把 Discord 和飞书接入 DeepSeek Harness，身份可验证、会话共享，还能原生提问和推送进度。

description.en: Freeze the DSH chat scroll position so new replies no longer drag the viewport to the bottom.
description.zh: 关掉聊天区自动贴底滚动，长回答生成时视口不再乱跑，想读再自己滚。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web GUI 的聊天头像插件：全局默认与工作区覆盖、交互裁剪、动图头像、大图预览与拍一拍。
description.zh: 给 dsh 聊天界面加上头像，支持全局默认、工作区覆盖、裁剪、动图和拍一拍。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 的主面板打开官方 DeepSeek Chat 网站。左侧入口可在 Chat 与 Agent 间切换，切换时不会重载 Chat 网页。
description.zh: 在 DSH 主面板直接打开官方 DeepSeek Chat 网页，左侧一键切换 Chat 和 Agent，切换不重载页面。

description.en: Cross-session and in-chat keyword search with context highlighting, keyboard navigation, and instant message jumping.
description.zh: DSH 对话搜索插件：支持全局跨会话与当前对话内精准搜索，高亮定位并快速跳转。

description.en: Session-scoped checklists the agent maintains, with a tree per session, a token-budgeted prompt digest and a right-sidebar tab where item titles can be edited.
description.zh: 会话级清单：每个会话一棵任务树、按预算注入提示词的摘要，以及可改条目标题的右侧栏面板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的四类事件（权限审批/提问/中断/完成）提示音与系统通知插件。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上四种提示音和系统通知，审批、提问、中断、完成都能第一时间听到提醒。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: tell every agent to reason in Simplified Chinese.
description.zh: 让主会话和所有子代理都用简体中文思考和回复，统一中文推理体验。

description.en: Requires Claude Code installed and signed in on this machine. Delegates a self-contained coding task to the local Claude Code agent through the Claude Agent SDK, prepends the current DSH conversation history, and keeps the worker's intermediate tool calls out of the main context.
description.zh: 需本机已安装并登录 Claude Code。通过 Claude Agent SDK 把自包含的编码任务委派给本机 Claude Code，附带当前 DSH 的对话历史，并让 worker 的中间工具调用不进入主上下文。

description.en: 马卡龙软陶（Clay/Neumorphism）主题 · DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件，支持浅色（奶油马卡龙）与深色（黑巧克力 + 酒红光晕）
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上奶油底配六色马卡龙的软陶质感浅色主题，界面更柔和好看。

description.en: DSH 插件：把技能 / 插件源码 / DSH 配置 / 全局指令 / 可选加密凭据备份到任意 WebDAV（坚果云、Nextcloud、群晖、ownCloud、AList）
description.zh: 把 DSH 的技能、插件源码、配置和凭据一键备份到任意 WebDAV，换设备也能快速恢复。
在设置面板里一键授权 Codex 订阅，不用 API key 就能用 GPT 模型，还能看授权状态和有效期。

description.en: Codex-compatible lifecycle hooks for DeepSeek Harness: discover hooks.json from config, plugins and projects, review each hook's sha256 trust fingerprint, run the trusted ones, and manage them from a Hooks settings section.
description.zh: 把 Codex 的生命周期钩子搬到 DSH，先审指纹再放行，钩子管理更放心。

description.en: DSH 相册插件：把 dsh-comfyui-image 生成的图片收成相册，侧边栏浏览，悬浮复制图片/提示词、导出工作流、加入当前对话、删除。
description.zh: 把 dsh-comfyui-image 生成的图片收进侧边栏相册，悬浮即可复制图片或提示词、导出工作流、加入对话。

description.en: The real ComfyUI editor inside the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: per-session workflow tools and panel-managed ComfyUI. / 在 DSH 里嵌入真正的 ComfyUI 编辑器。
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里直接打开真正的 ComfyUI 编辑器，按会话管理图像生成工作流。

description.en: 给侧栏加一整页智能体编队工作台：每个成员独立角色、独立模型链、独立推理倍率，模型走宿主自身会话服务，和对话框同一份目录 / Full-page agent-fleet workbench for DSH.
description.zh: 在侧栏给 AI 建一支编队，每个成员独立角色、模型和推理倍率，统一调度多智能体协作。
把对话界面压缩得更紧凑，答案一眼看清，需要时再展开背后的工作过程。

description.en: Complex-number math toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: parse, arithmetic, polar conversion, principal branch functions, n-th roots
description.zh: 让 AI 助手准确完成复数运算，支持极坐标转换、主值函数和 n 次方根。

description.en: Give DeepSeek Harness its own persistent computer: a bundled microVM with shell, browser, live view and approval gates
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 配一台专属的持久 Linux 微型虚拟机，能跑命令、开浏览器、看实时桌面，关键操作还要先审批。

description.en: Per-step context ledger for DeepSeek Harness with opt-in gates: lean tool table, long-tail externalization, duplicate-read pointers.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 每步上下文记账，四个闸门可单独开关，默认只观测不改行为，帮你管住上下文膨胀。

description.en: Model-driven, lossy context decay for DeepSeek Harness. Requires a patched DSH host; not a drop-in plugin.
description.zh: 让模型自己决定何时压缩上下文，把已完成的片段换成摘要，省 token 又保留关键信息。

description.en: DSH plugin: live context pressure meter that hands work to a fresh session with a model-written brief before the window fills up.
description.zh: 实时显示上下文占用，快满时让模型写好交接摘要，自动切到新会话接着干。

description.en: 按模型自定义上下文窗口的 DSH 插件
description.zh: 给每个模型单独设置上下文窗口，右键芯片换档或设置里精调，改完立即生效不用重启。

description.en: Live per-turn progress capsule for DeepSeek Harness — empirical ETA table + click-to-open turn history, docked under the composer.
description.zh: 在输入框下方常驻进度胶囊，实时显示任务进度和剩余时间，点开还能回看每轮历史。

description.en: Permanently delete one conversation (archived or not) from its sidebar row menu, including its log, projection cache, archive state, and reminders.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单里彻底删除单个对话（含已归档），同时清理会话日志、投影缓存、归档状态与提醒。

description.en: For DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 only. Search original user and assistant text in the current session or same-directory workspace, with source coordinates and context.
description.zh: 仅支持 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 的会话原文检索：在当前会话或同目录工作区搜索用户与助手原文，查看来源坐标和上下文。

description.en: 伴航 Convoy for DeepSeek Harness — 内嵌在 DSH 里的 AI 自动纠偏层：危险命令改写、越界写入回滚、假完成重跑，全程零点击，只留可回溯回执。
description.zh: 内嵌在 DSH 里的 AI 自动纠偏层，自动改写危险命令、回滚越界写入、重跑假完成，全程零点击还留回执。

description.en: Copy real files from DSH delivery cards to the system clipboard (CF_HDROP), with Windows-like card interaction. Pinned to DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 把 DSH 文件卡片里的文件本体直接复制到系统剪贴板，粘贴到资源管理器、微信、飞书或邮件附件里就能用。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web 插件：每条助手消息旁的费用胶囊 + 设置里的「费用统计」页（逐条计费项、回复与上下文压缩分开、官方 CNY/USD 价目表、高峰/空闲感知）
description.zh: 在每条助手回复旁显示花费，设置里还能看逐条费用明细和官方价目表。

description.en: DSH-JsonMCP配置UI及组件
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏加个连接器页面，粘贴 MCP JSON 就能管理服务器，随时查看连接状态和工具数量。

description.en: Region-by-region UI customizer for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: background, border and text styles for every interface area, element picker, highest-priority overrides.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端界面主题自定义：按界面区域配置背景、边框与文本样式，支持元素拾取器，优先级覆盖其他主题插件。

description.en: Calendar-synced daily task checklist plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 在侧栏按日期管理每日任务清单，日历自动同步，可切换任意日期添加、完成和删除任务。

description.en: 道一-易经推演 · 通用决策评审 DSH 插件（决策辅助，非迷信）：六层加权聚合引擎（384爻→64卦→8宫→四象→三才→两仪→太极），纯 JS 零求解器依赖
description.zh: 把决策事项拆成可量化检查点，六层加权推演给出可追溯的结构化研判，辅助决策不迷信。

description.en: Audits Chinese copy for AI-sounding phrasing: a 0-100 score over six dimensions, sentence-level flags with rewrite hints, and per-genre weights adjustable in conversation.
description.zh: 中文文案去 AI 味审计：0–100 六维评分、逐句打标并给出改法，文体权重可在对话里查看和修改。

description.en: Arknights-flavoured startup animation for the DSH Web GUI: a PRTS terminal boot, sonar scan, hologram lock-on and an operator-file splash that end in a deep-sea lockup, about 4.6 seconds, with four selectable original score presets (or sound off), skippable with a click or Esc and switchable, re-timed or replayed from Settings.
description.zh: 明日方舟风格的 DSH 启动动画：PRTS 终端自检、声呐扫描、全息锁定、干员档案，最后定格在「深海回响」，约 4.6 秒，自带 4 套可切换的原创合成配乐（也可关闭音效）；点击或 Esc 跳过，并可在设置中改时长与重播。

description.en: Shows an elapsed/budget progress bar with a moving head picture under blocking tool calls in the DSH Web conversation flow, and adds a graphical settings page for its style and tool list.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话流的阻塞型工具调用下方显示「已等待/预算」进度条与随进度移动的图片（可换成动图），并提供图形化设置页调整样式与工具列表。

description.en: DSH 插件：点击新对话页工作区前的文件夹图标，一键切回默认工作区
description.zh: 在新对话页点一下工作区前的文件夹图标，就能快速切回默认工作区，省去手动切换的麻烦。

description.en: DSH plugin: meters AI deletions per session, terminates the call once the cumulative size passes a threshold, then asks the user with the list of files already deleted.
description.zh: 给 AI 的删除操作装个总闸，按会话累计删除量，超过阈值就拦下并让你决定继续还是停止。

description.en: Semantic context watcher for DSH agents: maintains a journey ledger with flash summarization and MinHash novelty detection, folds milestones, and can inject long-term context with a three-level stall response; injection and the stall-2/3 responses are off by default.
description.zh: DSH 语义上下文观察器，维护旅程台账并做闪存摘要与 MinHash 新颖度检测，支持里程碑折叠、长期上下文注入与三级停滞响应；注入与 stall-2/3 响应默认关闭。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a desktop tool that screenshots Windows and drives the mouse and keyboard.
description.zh: 让模型直接截屏 Windows 桌面并操控鼠标键盘，自动点按、输入文字，轻松搞定重复操作。

description.en: Windows-only desktop control for DSH with six tools that list windows, capture occluded windows, focus windows, click by coordinate, inject Unicode keyboard input, and diagnose the desktop bridge.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 桌面控制插件，六个工具：列出窗口、抓取被遮挡窗口、聚焦窗口、按坐标点击、注入 Unicode 键盘输入与诊断桌面桥接。

description.en: Windows desktop organizer for DeepSeek Harness: it registers 1 agent tool (desktop_organize).
description.zh: Windows 桌面整理：归类桌面快捷方式、发现未建快捷方式的程序、检测失效链接（1 个模型工具 desktop_organize）。

description.en: Windows desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness: native window + standalone desktop-pet process with live token usage and balance
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面开个原生窗口，把桌宠和会话状态看板放上去，谁在跑、谁在等你，一眼看清。

description.en: Toasts from DeepSeek Harness when a turn finishes, and when it stops for approval, a question or a plan exit. Native on Windows, text and timing configurable.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面通知：任务完成时、或停下来等你审批/回答/确认计划时弹出系统通知。文案与触发时机可配置。

description.en: Codex-style change review for DeepSeek Harness: hover pill above the composer plus a syntax-highlighted right-sidebar diff page with revert.
description.zh: 代理改完文件后，输入框上方会显示改动文件数和增删行数，悬停可看文件列表，侧边栏还能高亮查看 diff 并一键回退。

description.en: Dots-style always-on agent for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): its own computer, reachable over IM, scheduled work, hard budget limits
description.zh: 把 dsh 变成常驻在线的个人 AI 助手，自带电脑，能通过微信等 IM 找到它，还能定时干活、限制预算。

description.en: Fork of fourzkw/dsh-drawai that keeps the editable .drawio canvas and its two agent tools, and adds a second vectorization engine beside the original tracer: hierarchical color clustering with Bezier spline fitting and per-channel color precision, selectable per drawing task in three fidelity levels (measured about 18, 38 and 46 dB PSNR on the same 1920x1080 frame (the upstream engine scores about 26 dB on that frame)), with worker parallelism raised to half the logical cores instead of a cap of four. The original tracer stays the default and remains the right choice for whole videos, where the new engine produces files hundreds of times larger.
description.zh: fork 自 fourzkw/dsh-drawai，保留 .drawio 可编辑画布与两个模型工具，并在原版描边之外新增第二套矢量化引擎：分层颜色聚类 + 贝塞尔样条拟合 + 每通道色彩精度，绘制任务可选三档保真度（同一 1920×1080 帧实测约 18 / 38 / 46 dB PSNR（上游引擎同帧约 26 dB）），并行度提升为逻辑核心数的一半（不再封顶 4）。原版描边仍是默认引擎，也是整段视频的正确选择——新引擎在视频上产物会大出数百倍。

description.en: Prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: composer button + enhance_prompt tool
description.zh: 在输入框一键把原始提示词改写成更清晰具体的版本，让 DeepSeek 更懂你的需求。
让 Harness 助手装傻摆烂，只会说「我不懂」「不帮你做」，所有工具调用全拒绝，纯属整活娱乐。

description.en: 为单个目标开本机端口，经本机代理转发；含配置自愈与声明式兼容补丁
description.zh: 只给需要代理的单个目标开本机端口走代理，其余流量照旧直连，省心又省流量。
在 DSH 里直接调用官方 Codex App Server，新增 Codex 模式 Agent 预设，让网页会话也能跑 Codex。

description.en: Adds a sparkle button to the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a clearer, more specific prompt with a single tool-free LLM call, then writes the result back into the input.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框工具栏加一个 ✨ 按钮，用一次无工具的单轮 LLM 调用把草稿改写成更清晰、更具体的提示词，再把结果写回输入框。

description.en: DSH plugin: remap Enter, Ctrl+Enter and Shift+Enter to line break, send, or busy-time send.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框的回车、Ctrl+回车、Shift+回车重新分配，让换行和发送各归各键，不再误发。

description.en: Manage skills, MCP servers, instructions, commands and hooks in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页统一管理 Skill、MCP 服务器、指令文件、自定义命令和 Hooks，配置更省心。

description.en: 别再说「继续」了。一个 Agent 人格预设：把默认动作从「停下来问」改成「一直做，直到交付」/ Stop typing 'continue'.
description.zh: 给 AI 装个「别问了，直接干完」的人格预设，把默认行为从停下提问改成一路做到交付。

description.en: Feishu Project (Meegle) bug workflow for DeepSeek Harness: isolated fix branches with human duplicate/verification/merge gates.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里读取飞书项目中分配给你的缺陷，每条缺陷在独立分支里修复，重复确认、验收和合并仍由人把关。

description.en: Right-click any file reference in the chat to open it, open it with an associated application, reveal it in the file manager, copy its path or contents, and save it.
description.zh: 右键聊天里的任意文件引用，即可打开、用系统关联应用打开、在文件管理器中定位、复制路径或文件内容、另存为。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness right-sidebar workspace files: context menus, drag-to-move, editor, recoverable trash, Agent change notices, FileKit page and settings.
description.zh: 给右侧工作区文件面板加上右键菜单、拖拽移动、编辑和可恢复删除，改动还会自动提醒 Agent。

description.en: A machine-checked reasoning ledger: every fact must resolve to a real file:line and be quoted verbatim from it, every assumption must state what would falsify it, and a conclusion may not rest on an assumption that never comes back for review. The ledger can carry a review date, a confidence and a kill condition. Ships the checker tool, an /fp command family, an optional gate that asks before irreversible shell commands, and a web panel listing the error codes each round fixed.
description.zh: 可机械核对的第一性原理台账：事实必须落回真实的 文件:行 并逐字引用那里的话，假设必须写明什么情况下它错了，结论不得依赖一个永不回来复查的假设；台账可带复查日期、置信度与止损条件。附带校验工具、/fp 命令族、不可逆命令前的可选闸门，以及列出每轮修掉哪些错误码的面板。
给 dock-flash 提供主机内存告警，监控 RSS 阈值、增长速度和 Major GC 频率。
给 DeepSeek Harness 管系统代理，开关代理、配 NO_PROXY 规则、查连接问题都靠它。

description.en: Garmin Connect dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: left-sidebar panel entry, full-page charts, direct Garmin REST API, reuses a local Garmin token. No MCP, no npm dependencies.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏直接看 Garmin 健康数据，心率、睡眠、步数、训练负荷一屏掌握。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把你的原神账号读进来 —— 角色练度、命座、天赋、面板、武器、圣遗物 —— 然后在对话里直接问（agent 调用工具查），也能在 GUI 里看（侧边栏「原神账号」页面）。
description.zh: 把原神账号数据接进对话，角色练度、面板、圣遗物随时问，也能在侧边栏直接看。

description.en: Shows the repository, branch, working-tree change count and short commit SHA on the composer row, with a searchable branch switcher and a per-file diff pane in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 在输入框那一行显示仓库、分支、改动数与短 SHA；点分支可搜索、切换或新建分支，点改动数在右侧边栏打开逐文件 diff 面板。

description.en: GitHub tools for DeepSeek Harness: REST API calls, multi-file commits in one commit, repo creation. The token lives in the plugin settings (example placeholder only, never a default), never in the repo or in tool output.
description.zh: 让 agent 直接调 GitHub API、一次提交多个文件、建仓库，token 在设置里填一次就能用。

description.en: Prepares a repository README before pushing: scans repo facts, renders banner and process-diagram images (needs Pillow and the Microsoft YaHei font), lints layout and section numbering, then commits and pushes with retry.
description.zh: 上传 GitHub 前优化仓库 README：扫描仓库事实、渲染首图与过程图（需 Pillow 与微软雅黑字体）、校验排版和编号，最后带重试提交推送。

description.en: Glacier-blue glass UI layer for the DeepSeek Harness web client — light-field canvas, frosted panels, flat controls. Shipped as a dsh plugin.
description.zh: 给 dsh 网页端换上冰川蓝玻璃质感界面，磨砂面板加扁平控件，不改宿主代码就能美化外观。

description.en: An Apple Liquid Glass skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: token-level re-key, glass chrome, a grouped model picker and a merged usage panel.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上苹果液态玻璃皮肤，整体界面更通透好看。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 启动画面：亮白跑马灯 → 一笔写出 DeepSeek Harness。插件版（运行时注入，不改宿主文件）+ 原生补丁版。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一段约 7 秒的启动动画，跑马灯点亮后一笔写出品牌名，播完自动淡出，不改宿主文件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的一小组小功能：模型菜单里的思考强度滑块、运行状态旁的实时速度与本轮用量、每条回答的输入/输出/缓存成绩单，以及每轮结束的完成通知。各自独立开关，都只作用于界面，不改模型请求，也不上传数据。
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面加三样小玩意：思考强度滑块、实时生成速度和本轮用量、每条回答的成绩单。

description.en: 将 Graphify 原版代码知识图谱深度集成至 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），支持项目自动索引、实时增量更新、交互式可视化、扫描范围配置及 AI Agent 图谱查询。Native Graphify integration for DSH Desktop, featuring automatic code knowledge graphs, original interactive visualization, live updates, and Agent tools.
description.zh: 把 Graphify 代码知识图谱搬进 DSH，自动索引项目、实时更新，还能让 AI 直接查图谱。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: graphify knowledge-graph MCP server + packaged graphify skill, installed together
description.zh: 把 graphify 知识图谱的 MCP 服务和技能打包一起装，让智能体会话直接具备图谱能力

description.en: DSH 插件：输入框底部的提问等级（关闭 / L1 全权委托 → L5 拷问），按会话生效，等级直接写入系统提示词。
description.zh: 在输入框底部加个提问等级开关，六档调节 AI 是先自己拍板还是先停下来问你。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: connects the GXWorks Agent MCP server and ships its PLC task-routing skill.
description.zh: 把 GXWorks Agent 的 MCP 服务和 PLC 任务路由技能打包进 DeepSeek Harness，让三菱 PLC 编程更顺手。

description.en: An independent permission gate above the built-in sandbox. It blocks writes outside the workspace and to protected paths even under danger-full-access, refuses whole-file overwrites without a complete fresh read, and keeps ZIP restore points plus Recycle Bin copies before destructive actions.
description.zh: 内置沙箱之上的独立权限闸门：在 danger-full-access 下依然拦截工作区外与受保护路径的写入，未完整读到文件末尾就整文件覆盖时拒绝，破坏性操作前生成 ZIP 还原点与回收站副本。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）本体自更新插件：设置页检查更新 / 一键更新 / 回滚，逐步耗时与失败输出 tail，Windows .cmd 友好。
description.zh: 在设置页一键检查、更新或回滚 DSH 本体，每步耗时和失败日志都看得见。
标题栏按钮挤不下时自动把不常用的收进「更多」菜单，还能拖动排序调整保留优先级。

description.en: Import sessions from a local Hermes Agent into the current DeepSeek Harness conversation as bounded, untrusted background context.
description.zh: 把本地 Hermes Agent 的会话导入当前对话，作为有边界的不可信背景上下文参考。

description.en: DSH 插件：把 Hindsight 记忆服务接到 DeepSeek Harness，与 omp 共用同一记忆库/同一套标签语义（单库 + 全局层/项目层双层标签），模型只看见封装后的语义化工具
description.zh: 让 DSH 和 omp 共用同一个 Hindsight 记忆库和标签规则，读写都能按项目过滤，记忆不再各存各的。

description.en: Encrypted, verifiable history keeper for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot, verify and restore your DSH sessions. No git, no external binaries.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话做加密快照，随时校验并恢复历史记录，不用 git 也不依赖外部程序。

description.en: Adds a lightweight follow-up row under each DSH answer: one anchor question plus 1-3 user-voice quick replies, so the next turn is one click away; supports always / balanced / conservative strategies and optional refusal or emotional-context skips.
description.zh: 在每条 DSH 回答下方加一行轻量 follow：一句锚定正文的追问 + 1–3 条用户口吻快捷回复，让下一轮对话一键继续；支持 always / balanced / conservative 策略，并可跳过拒绝回答与情绪场景。

description.en: Prose review for human-facing writes. The write and edit tools require a human_facing flag; the plugin reviews the text against layered PROSE.md rules in the background, stages annotations, reconciles them against the full file, and merges them through /humanize, /humanize-loop or post-compaction while the main session keeps working. /humanize-review runs a batch over git-tracked files on demand.
description.zh: 面向人类写入内容的行文审查。write 和 edit 调用需声明 human_facing，插件在后台按分层 PROSE.md 规则审查文本并暂存批注，再按全文核对已有批注，主会话照常推进；用 /humanize、/humanize-loop 或压缩后自动合并批注，/humanize-review 按需批量审查 git 管理的文件。

description.en: Native image feedback sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: annotate, reposition and send.
description.zh: 在右侧栏框选图片写意见、拖动调整位置，再把原图和反馈一起发到当前会话。

description.en: 多 API 生图插件 for DeepSeek Harness —— 一套 provider 抽象，原生支持 Labnana、OpenAI、Gemini、Seedream、DashScope、xAI、智谱、ComfyUI；带画廊、积分计量与多套 API 配置。
description.zh: 一个插件接入多家生图 API，还能存多套配置、看画廊、算积分，想换模型随时切。

description.en: Trackpad pinch zoom and native scroll panning for DeepSeek Harness image previews.
description.zh: 给 DSH 图片预览加上触控板捏合缩放和原生滑动平移，看图更顺手。
给 DSH 输入框加上历史记录，上下键就能翻出之前发过的提示词和附件，不用重复打字。

description.en: Declarative interactive cards for DSH: the model writes a spec, the Host compiles it into a JSON program, and the client renders forms, tables, charts and lists with local state and explicit submit.
description.zh: DSH 的声明式交互卡片：模型写 spec，Host 编译成 JSON program，客户端渲染表单、表格、图表和列表，本地交互、显式提交。

description.en: Render OpenUI Lang answers as interactive cards or reading articles in DSH chat, with maps, charts, forms, PNG export and standalone interactive HTML export.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中把 OpenUI Lang 答案渲染成交互卡片或阅读式文章，支持地图、图表、表单、PNG 图片导出和独立交互 HTML 导出。

description.en: Draggable floating card that follows background jobs: a progress bar and percentage parsed from wget/curl/apt/pip output, elapsed time, ETA when present, and the latest output line.
description.zh: 可拖动的后台任务浮动卡片：从 wget/curl/apt/pip 等输出解析进度条与百分比，显示耗时、剩余时间（有则显示）和最新一行输出。

description.en: The native task board for DeepSeek Harness: four columns, approvals, blockers, attachments and durable Host storage. Not an iframe.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的原生任务看板，四列拖拽管理任务，支持审批、阻塞、附件和持久存储。

description.en: DISCONTINUED (2026-10-22). Final version: 0.3.0. Historical DSH restart-recovery plugin; no further development or maintenance.
description.zh: 重启 DSH 也不怕对话中断，正在进行的回答会先写完，重启后自动唤醒被打断的会话继续干。

description.en: Kilo Code Gateway as a first-party DeepSeek Harness model provider (DSE plugin bundle).
description.zh: 把 Kilo Code Gateway 接入 DeepSeek Harness，当成第一方模型提供商来用，省去自己折腾配置。

description.en: Korean (ko) language pack for DeepSeek Harness — 65 dictionaries, scoped Pretendard typography, marketplace-ready.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上韩语界面，含 65 组词典和 Pretendard 字体排版，开箱即用。

description.en: Injects a bundled whale-girl persona from editable Markdown files into DSH system prompts, with next-request updates, optional agent edits, and upgrade sync that preserves local changes.
description.zh: 将内置鲸鱼娘人设从可编辑的 Markdown 文件注入 DSH 系统提示词，支持下一轮更新、可关闭的代理编辑，以及保留本地改动的升级同步。

description.en: Expose the running DeepSeek Harness desktop web GUI to a phone - the same session through a loopback reverse proxy, with LAN and Tailscale token URLs. No second harness.
description.zh: 把电脑上正在跑的 DSH 网页界面通过局域网或 Tailscale 共享给手机，手机直接操控同一个会话，不用再开第二个实例。

description.en: 繁體中文（台灣）language pack for DeepSeek Harness — generated from shipped dictionaries with OpenCC (s2twp) + TW usage polish; 63 namespaces / 2,676 strings.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上繁体中文（台湾）界面，用词更贴近台湾习惯，共 63 个模块、2676 条文案。

description.en: Persist the DeepSeek Harness Web frame's left sidebar and right panel widths across restarts.
description.zh: 让 DSH Web 左右侧栏宽度在重启后依然保留，不用每次重新调整。

description.en: LCU (Codex computer use) for DeepSeek Harness: macOS app control with an approval dialog, via an MCP adapter.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能操控 macOS 应用，操作前弹窗确认，安全又省心。

description.en: Durable cross-session memory + hostile-network fetch ladder for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上跨会话持久记忆和弱网抓取兜底，让代理能记住事、断网也能干活。

description.en: Link local project directories from a project context menu, with scoped search, source reading and explicit per-session snapshot synchronization. Supports DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4 and 0.2.1-rc.2 only.
description.zh: 从项目右键菜单关联本机目录，支持跨目录搜索、源码读取与显式会话快照同步；仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4 与 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: ChatGPT Web model provider for DeepSeek Harness — spends the ChatGPT web quota, not Codex quota.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一条 chatgpt-web 模型路由，直接消耗你 ChatGPT 网页版额度，不占 Codex 配额。

description.en: Local file manager served by the DSH web server itself: whole-disk browsing, previews for images, PDF, video and audio, text, Markdown, JSON, CSV, sandboxed HTML, docx and xlsx, Range downloads, folder ZIP, drag-and-drop upload, copy/paste, conflict-checked text editing, create/rename/delete-to-trash, and xlsx cell editing saved as a copy.
description.zh: 由 DSH web server 直接提供的本地文件管理页：整盘浏览，图片/PDF/音视频/文本/Markdown/JSON/CSV/沙箱 HTML/docx/xlsx 预览，Range 下载与目录 ZIP，拖拽上传、复制粘贴、带冲突检测的文本编辑、新建/重命名/删除（进回收目录），以及 xlsx 单元格编辑另存为副本。

description.en: DSH plugin: decide when background LLM calls (session titles, compaction) are served by your locally configured model (Ollama / LM Studio) instead of the cloud one.
description.zh: 按策略把后台杂活（会话标题、上下文压缩）自动切到本地 Ollama/LM Studio 模型，省云成本。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a beginner-friendly Data panel for Docker (containers/images/volumes/networks/relations/Dockerfile recognition), Redis and PostgreSQL — plain-language overview, Dockerized services auto-discovered, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 给 Docker、Redis 和 PostgreSQL 做个说人话的数据面板，新手也能一眼看懂容器、镜像和数据库状态。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: auto-split over-long screenshots into DSH-acceptable slices before prompt admission (no native deps, overlap between slices)
description.zh: 超长截图拖进来会自动切成多张，DSH 不再拒收，切缝处有重叠不截断文字。

description.en: Traceable context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: hierarchical summaries, source retrieval and verified DM session rotation.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 做可追溯的上下文压缩，分层摘要加原文回捞，长会话不丢信息。

description.en: 界面功能增强：支持会话删除、支持图片皮肤。
description.zh: 给 dsh 界面加两个实用功能：能直接删掉不要的会话，还能用本地图片当界面背景。

description.en: macOS 桌面版一键重启 / One-click restart for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app.
description.zh: macOS 桌面版一键重启 DSH 应用，省去手动退出再打开的麻烦。

description.en: A stock market panel for DeepSeek Harness, forked from dsh-xueqiu: A-share/HK/US quotes, K-line and intraday charts, hot lists, search and 7x24 news, plus local holdings with live-computed P&L, host-side price alerts, and a hide switch that unmounts the panel and stops market polling while alerts still fire. Replaces dsh-xueqiu; do not install both.
description.zh: 行情面板（dsh-xueqiu 的衍生版本）：免登录查看 A股/港美股行情、K线/分时、热榜、搜索与 7×24 快讯，并支持本地持仓与按行情现算的盈亏、宿主侧价格提醒，以及一键「行情隐身」——面板卸载、行情请求停发，提醒照常。替代 dsh-xueqiu，请勿与它同时安装。

description.en: ? dshmarket ???????????????????Auto-writes short plain-Chinese notes for installed dshmarket plugins that have none.
description.zh: 给 dshmarket 里还没备注的插件自动补一句大白话中文说明，扫一眼就知道它是干嘛的。

description.en: Windows only (desktop Word + full MathType 7 + Python 3.10+). Convert LaTeX placeholders in a Word .docx into real MathType OLE equations (Equation.DSMT4), preserving equation numbers, SEQ fields and cross-references.
description.zh: 仅 Windows（需桌面版 Word、完整版 MathType 7 与 Python 3.10+）。把 Word 文档中的 LaTeX 占位符转换为真正的 MathType OLE 公式（Equation.DSMT4），保留公式编号、SEQ 域与交叉引用。

description.en: Scans MCP configs from the tools it knows (28 built-in sources plus custom ones), syncs diffs into DSH, and lets you import, write back, or edit MCP servers from the DSH sidebar.
description.zh: 扫描本机各工具的 MCP 配置（28 个内置源，支持自定义源），把差异同步进 DSH，并在 DSH 侧栏直接导入、写回或增删改 MCP 服务器。

description.en: One settings page for every MCP server on your machine. It reads the real config file of 17 other AI tools (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, OpenCode, Trae, Trae CN, Qoder, Gemini CLI, Qwen, Zed, Roo Code, Copilot CLI, Kiro, CodeBuddy, Continue) plus DeepSeek Harness itself, groups servers by the file that declares them, probes each one over JSON-RPC to see whether it starts and which tools it exposes, and gives every server a switch that mounts or unmounts it in DeepSeek Harness without editing the other tools' own files.
description.zh: 一个设置页管理本机所有 MCP 服务器。它读取另外 17 种 AI 工具的真实配置文件（Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code、Windsurf、OpenCode、Trae、Trae CN、Qoder、Gemini CLI、Qwen、Zed、Roo Code、Copilot CLI、Kiro、CodeBuddy、Continue）以及 DeepSeek Harness 自身，按声明它的文件分组展示，对每个服务器做一次真连 JSON-RPC 探活，看它能否启动、暴露了哪些工具，并给每个服务器一个开关，把它挂载进或卸载出 DeepSeek Harness —— 全程不改动其他工具自己的配置文件。
在 DSH 里统一管理 MCP 服务器，一键安装、启停和配置，让外部工具接入更省心。

description.en: Multi-agent meeting negotiation over the LAN: each person runs their own assistant, and assistants find each other via mDNS and negotiate meetings, weekend outings and bubble tea votes through A2A messages. They share only availability (never the reasons) and ask the owner before giving up protected time. Ships a phone-style page in the DSH sidebar and a 13-person sample company. No authentication; trusted LANs only.
description.zh: 局域网多智能体会议协商：每人一个助理，助理通过 mDNS 互相发现，用 A2A 报文协商排会、周末团建和奶茶投票。对外只给忙闲不说原因，占用本人保护的时段前先问本人。DSH 侧栏自带手机样式页面和 13 人示例公司。无鉴权，仅限可信局域网。

description.en: DSH memory plugin: RRF multi-lane recall / confirm-based writes / Fernet vault / session harvest
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体装上分层长期记忆，五路召回更准，写入需确认，数据加密更安全，还能自动转录会话。

description.en: DSH 本地长期记忆库：可视化编辑 / 文件夹整理 / 逐会话决定是否注入 / 模型写入需确认 / 可选同步到你自己的 Git 或 WebDAV
description.zh: DSH 本地长期记忆面板，记忆看得见改得动，还能逐会话决定给不给模型用。

description.en: DSH 本地记忆插件：BM25-lite 历史召回 + 记忆使用协议 + 结构化固化 + 情感状态。全部落本地 Markdown/JSONL，无数据库、无云端。
description.zh: 给 DSH 角色加一层本地长期记忆，能按需找回历史、固化结构化记忆，还带情感状态，全程存本地文件。

description.en: Persistent agent memory for DeepSeek Harness: daily journals, Dream consolidation, weekly reviews and verified cross-session recall.
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体装上长期记忆，自动整理每日日志、做梦巩固、每周复盘，跨会话也能可靠回忆。

description.en: Hides other memory plugins' context sections and tools inside a chosen DSH preset, so that session gets a clean context. Off by default; ships a read-only diagnostic tool.
description.zh: 在指定 DSH preset 里挡掉其他记忆插件的上下文段与工具，让该会话拿到干净上下文。bundle 形态、默认关闭，带只读诊断工具。

description.en: Mermaid diagrams in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: a client plugin with in-card zoom and pan.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏直接渲染对话里的 Mermaid 图表，还能缩放拖动，看流程图不用切窗口。

description.en: Divination panel and agent tool: BaZi with 42 shensha plus pattern, useful-god and luck scoring; Zi Wei Dou Shu with star brightness, 34 patterns, decade and annual/monthly/daily/hourly mutagen; LiuYao, MeiHua, Da Liu Ren and Tarot, plus ask-driven interpretation; charts are computed locally, with an optional Nominatim lookup for place names.
description.zh: 命理排盘：八字 42 神煞并给出格局、用神与大运流年吉凶评分；紫微斗数 34 格局、主星庙旺、大限与流年流月流日流时四化；另有六爻、梅花易数、大六壬与塔罗，并可按所问之事生成解析；排盘在本机计算，地名解析可选走 Nominatim。

description.en: Xiaomi MiMo TTS voice plugin for DeepSeek Harness — speaks a line through your local speakers, with voice design, preview and approval alerts built in.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 用小米 MiMo TTS 把回复念出来，还能试听调音色、审批时语音提醒。
把对话变成分支思维导图，帮你理清聊天脉络，快速回溯和对比不同对话分支。

description.en: Toolchain manager for DeepSeek Harness (backed by mise): a settings page for installed and available versions, .mise.toml-driven install / use / uninstall / prune, PATH activation, and nine agent tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用 mise 管理工具链版本，装、切、删、清理一站搞定，还能让 AI 助手直接调用。

description.en: DSH 小秘书：替你盯着 GitHub 通知（按当前状态分诊，已解决的替你关掉）并记住你交代的到期事项（账单、续费、证件、生日），密码只进系统钥匙串。中英双语，macOS/Windows/Linux | DSH secretary: triages GitHub notifications by real state, tracks dated reminders, keychain-only secrets.
description.zh: 帮你盯着 GitHub 通知，已解决的自动关掉，还能记住账单、续费、证件、生日这些到期事项，密码只存系统钥匙串。

description.en: A task-first mobile workspace for DeepSeek Harness, with session overviews, compact input, and full-record access.
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成手机上的全屏任务工作台，随时查看会话概览、快速输入并翻阅完整记录。

description.en: DSH mobile web UI: browse all sessions and continue conversations from a phone on the same LAN. ??? Web UI ???
description.zh: 在手机浏览器里查看所有会话并继续对话，同一局域网内即可用，出门也能接着聊。

description.en: Skill manager page for dsh: set each skill to on, manual only, model only, or off per agent mode; count how often each skill is loaded per mode from the session history; search skills.sh and install from GitHub; import from Codex, Claude Code, or a folder; create, edit, and version skills, with a trash for deleted ones; modes keep working after an uninstall.
description.zh: dsh 的 Skill（技能）管理页：按 Agent 模式把每个 Skill 设为开、仅手动、仅模型或关；从会话历史统计每个 Skill 在各模式里被加载的次数；搜索 skills.sh 并从 GitHub 安装；从 Codex、Claude Code 或文件夹导入；新建、编辑、保存版本，删除的 Skill 进回收站；卸载后模式照常可用。

description.en: Responsive card grid for the DeepSeek Harness composer model picker — host-only, no client bundle rebuild.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器改成响应式卡片网格，选模型更直观顺手，纯 Host 插件免重编译。

description.en: Makes the provider groups in the composer model menu collapsible, keeping only the provider of the current model expanded.
description.zh: 让输入框模型菜单的厂商分组可折叠，默认只展开当前模型所属厂商。

description.en: 模型代理：按模型/提供方精准路由模型 API 流量（走代理或直连），其余请求不受影响 —— Route model-API traffic per provider through proxies, everything else stays direct.
description.zh: 让指定模型或提供方的 API 请求单独走代理，其余请求照常直连，不用开全局代理。

description.en: DSH 插件：为实际启用的模型提供可读名称，统一美化 provider / 模型选择器与设置页；只改 UI 展示，不改变模型 ID、路由、凭据或请求。
description.zh: 给启用的模型配上好记的中文名，让 provider 和模型选择器、设置页看起来更清爽，只改显示不动配置。

description.en: Per-model API prices in USD or CNY, wallet balance and live session spend for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接查看各模型 API 价格、钱包余额和当前会话花费，花钱心里有数。

description.en: Replaces the composer model control with an inline Provider/Model trigger — clicking it opens a two-column card with providers on the left and the hovered provider's models on the right — and moves the reasoning effort into its own trigger beside it, unlike single-button model pickers.
description.zh: 顶替输入框里的模型控件：一个内联的「供应商/模型」钮，点开是两栏卡片，左栏供应商、右栏列出鼠标所指供应商的模型；推理强度单独成一个钮放在旁边（与只有一个钮的模型选择器不同）。

description.en: DSH 插件：从 pi-ai 上游目录发现和管理模型，支持人工确认、按 provider 开关、安全写入与回滚；models.dev 可作可选备用数据源。
description.zh: 自动补齐 pi-ai 上游新模型，人工确认后安全写入配置，还能按 provider 开关和回滚。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会话计费 + 通用提供方用量查询插件：会话费用角标(峰谷两档精确计费、刷新后依然准确)、按模型提供方配置的用量面板(DeepSeek 官方余额 / OpenCode Go 5小时·周·月套餐额度 / 自定义 HTTP 用量查询),官方价格一键同步,双币种(USD/CNY)价格表。
description.zh: 会话费用实时角标，按模型厂商查用量余额，官方价格一键同步，双币种账单一目了然。

description.en: 摸鱼套件 dsh-moyu 的抖音模块。鼠标悬停即现的推荐流播放器，滚轮切视频，移开自动暂停；宿主侧签名与媒体反代
Muse Code subscription provider and device-code login for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Muse Code 订阅模型，用设备码登录，不用手动填密钥。

description.en: See what you actually installed: a chip shows how many plugins your profile really loads, and a searchable panel lists every one with its version, its author-written one-liner, and whether it is built-in or third-party. Read-only, zero config.
description.zh: 顶栏药丸显示你实际装了多少插件，点开可搜索查看每个插件的版本、作者说明和来源。

description.en: 米游社每日自动签到 DSH 插件：扫码登录、窗口内随机签到、失败提示
description.zh: 米游社每日自动签到插件，扫码登录后随机时间签到，失败会提醒你。

description.en: DSH plugin: global back/forward navigation history across sessions and whole-page panels, with a configurable bottom strip and browser-style shortcuts.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上浏览器式全局前进后退，会话和整页面板都能一键回到上一个位置。

description.en: 大肥鱼 / GPT娘 sticker knowledge kit for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), MCP and any chat bot · 大肥鱼表情包知识库
description.zh: 给聊天机器人装上一整套大肥鱼表情包知识库，每张图都标好场景、梗和用法，斗图不冷场。

description.en: Windows only, needs the NetEase Cloud Music client installed. NetEase Cloud Music player for the DSH Web UI: a mini bar that expands into a liquid-glass card with search, synced lyrics and volume, a click-to-open spinning vinyl view, and it signs in with the local NetEase client account (cookie decrypted on this machine only) so VIP tracks play and the client current song can be pulled in.
description.zh: 仅 Windows，需本机装有网易云音乐客户端。DSH Web 的网易云音乐播放器：收起是迷你播放条，点开是液态玻璃卡片（搜索 / 歌词 / 音量），点封面区切换成旋转黑胶视图；自动使用本机网易云客户端账号登录（cookie 仅在本机解密），VIP 曲目可播，并可把客户端正在播放的歌一键拉进来。

description.en: An animated companion that shows live DSH agent progress in the macOS notch.
description.zh: 在 Mac 刘海屏上养一只会动的桌面小伙伴，实时显示 DSH 任务进度，悬停还能展开看详情。

description.en: Notepad — a per-workspace floating note window in the DeepSeek Harness session view: problems, next steps, one-click insert into the composer, drag, minimize, hide.
description.zh: 在会话界面放一张当前工作区专属的便签浮窗，随手记问题和待办，一键插进输入框。

description.en: Turn-end reminders for DSH 0.2.x — the host folds each session's last completed turn into a projection and the desktop shell shows it as a real Windows toast, with per-outcome filters, background-only gating and a settings page. The Windows desktop shell must register its AUMID once before toasts appear.
description.zh: DSH 0.2.x 的完成提醒——宿主把每个会话最后一次 turn/end 折成投影，桌面端再发成真正的 Windows toast；带按结束原因过滤、仅后台提醒和设置页；Windows 桌面壳需先注册一次 AUMID，toast 才能弹出。

description.en: Windows 11 toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approvals, questions, errors, finished turns, and work that stopped making progress
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跑任务时，用 Windows 11 原生弹窗提醒你审批、提问、报错、完成或卡住。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek-Harness: get pulled back when a task finishes or the agent needs you.
description.zh: 任务跑完或 Agent 需要你时，用 Windows 弹窗把你叫回来，不用一直盯着屏幕。

description.en: Windows desktop notifications with selectable sounds: five bundled sound packs (45 clips) plus imported audio, one sound per event, and clicking a notification opens the matching session.
description.zh: Windows 桌面通知 + 可选音效：内置五组共 45 个音效并支持导入音频，可逐事件指定音效，点击通知直接跳到对应会话。

description.en: Read local novels only when expanding selected real DSH reasoning steps. Local-only; no model requests.
description.zh: 在真实聊天的思考步骤里偷偷看本地小说，不打扰模型也不留痕迹，摸鱼神器。

description.en: OpenCode Go quota ring for DeepSeek Harness: three windows beside the composer context meter.
description.zh: 在输入框下方常驻显示 OpenCode Go 套餐余量环，点开就能看三个窗口的剩余额度。

description.en: Give DeepSeek Harness an Office engine: one officecli tool plus OfficeCLI's ten bundled guides as runtime skills. Point it at the binary you already installed — nothing is downloaded, nothing written outside its own settings file.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接上本地 OfficeCLI，一个工具加十份指南，直接读写 docx、xlsx、pptx。

description.en: Competitive-informatics coach plugin for DeepSeek Harness: coaching-rule prompts, learning roadmap, knowledge points, problem setting, real C++ judging with g++, and ima knowledge-base retrieval with four-notebook archiving, for GESP / CSP-J/S / NOIP / NOI teaching. Needs g++, and an ima account with ima-skill and the four notebooks configured; replies carry a WeChat-account promo and QR code by default.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 信奥教练插件：教练规则提示词 + 学习路线图/知识点/命题/C++ 真评测（g++ 编译运行）+ ima 知识库检索与 4 笔记本归档，面向 GESP、CSP-J/S、NOIP、NOI 教学。需本机有 g++，并配置 ima 账号、ima-skill 与 4 个笔记本；回复默认附带公众号推广与二维码。

description.en: Competitive-informatics senior plugin for DeepSeek Harness: companion practice, three-version C++14 reference solutions, problem explanations, real g++ compile-and-judge (g++ required), and optional solution-record archiving to the ima notebook "信奥学长-题解复盘", for GESP / CSP-J/S / NOIP / NOI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 信奥学长插件：陪刷 + 三版 C++14 参考实现 + 解题说明，本地 g++ 真编译真评测（需 g++），做题记录可选归档到 ima 笔记本「信奥学长-题解复盘」，面向 GESP、CSP-J/S、NOIP、NOI。

description.en: Ollama Cloud LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接接入 Ollama Cloud 大模型，多一个云端模型来源，配置好就能用。

description.en: Windows: turns DSH into a desktop app. A one-click launcher and tray controller, plus a sidebar button that splits DSH and chat.deepseek.com side by side with its own taskbar button.
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成 Windows 桌面应用，双击启动、托盘控制，还能一键分屏聊天。

description.en: Client plugin for DeepSeek Harness: open a settled session at your last message instead of the floor.
description.zh: 打开已结束的 DSH 会话时直接定位到你最后一条发言，不用再往下翻找。

description.en: Expose every model of every provider configured in DeepSeek Harness as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on a fixed loopback port, with a sidebar page for the port, key and model ids.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 里配好的所有模型统一暴露成固定的 OpenAI 兼容接口，端口和密钥本地固化，重启也不变。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness plugin fixing OpenCode's MissingSessionID in Auto review by attaching the reviewed agent's session identity. | 非官方 DSH 插件：为 reviewer 请求补上被审查会话身份，修复 OpenCode MissingSessionID 拒绝；目标 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。
description.zh: 给 OpenCode 的 Auto review 补上被审查会话的身份信息，修掉 MissingSessionID 报错，让自动审查能正常跑。

description.en: OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode 和 OpenCode Go 模型，多一个模型来源可选。

description.en: DSH OpenViking 自动启动与恢复插件：会话前确保本机记忆服务可用。
description.zh: 新会话开始前自动检查并拉起 OpenViking 记忆服务，避免会话在记忆离线状态下白跑。

description.en: DSH 操作安全插件：工具 pre-execute 分类、单调 guard、插件生命周期 DPIP 门禁与审计留痕。
description.zh: 给桌面版补上工具调用分级、插件生命周期门禁和审计留痕，让操作更安全可追溯。

description.en: Deliverables registry for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): register reports, pages, docs, sheets, images and datasets into one searchable, previewable, recoverable list.
description.zh: 把报告、文档、表格、图片等最终成果统一登记，可搜索、可预览、可恢复，方便随时查找。

description.en: Self-audit layer for agents: 12 brain_* tools turning boundary-drawing, contradiction-surfacing and evidence-based verification into a ledger, executable criteria and outside review.
description.zh: 给 AI 代理加一层自我审查，把划边界、找矛盾和证据核验变成可执行清单与外部复核。

description.en: 浏览器式的整页缩放，给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版用：按住 Ctrl 滚动滚轮（触控板双指捏合同理）即可像浏览器一样缩放整个界面，Ctrl + 0 回到 100%。
description.zh: 按住 Ctrl 滚轮或触控板捏合，就能像浏览器一样缩放整个桌面界面，Ctrl+0 一键还原。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 并行会话协调插件：检测并行会话、带发起方归属的跨会话消息、阶段冲突时暂停/自动恢复。
description.zh: 让同一进程里的多个会话互相通信、协调节奏，任务冲突时自动暂停对方，完成后再通知继续。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: lock files/folders/drives against agent access - monotonic guard deny works even under danger-full-access. Config UI under Settings > 文件锁.
description.zh: 把指定文件、文件夹或硬盘分区对 agent 彻底锁死，开了完全访问也动不了。

description.en: PdfCraft x DeepSeek Harness
DeepSeek Harness plugin: peak/off-peak price watch, live account balance with tiered low-balance alerts, and a top-up button for the main web UI
description.zh: 在主界面实时看峰谷电价和账户余额，低谷时段自动提醒，余额不足还能一键充值。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 峰谷提醒插件：会话标题栏「模式」之后显示高峰/空闲时段并倒计时切换
description.zh: 在会话标题栏显示高峰/空闲时段并倒计时切换，帮你避开高峰、省下成本。

description.en: Peer channels between conversations at the same level: user-granted, symmetric, with durable grants that survive a restart and burst messages merged into one ordered delivery.
description.zh: 平级对话之间的通道：经用户授权、对称，授权跨重启保留；忙时多条消息合并成一批按发送时间排序投递。

description.en: DSH 插件：把每天刷到的原料蒸馏成会自己长大的人格 —— 原料天天攒，人格每周长
description.zh: 把每天刷到的内容攒成原料，每周蒸馏出一个会自己长大、越用越懂你的 AI 人格。

description.en: Create and share AI personality presets with global and per-conversation choices in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 AI 助手设定身份、语气和表达风格，还能按会话切换并分享人格预设。

description.en: DSH 人设插件：设置页写角色设定，自动注入系统提示词；内置「天才少女·谄媚型」人设，带四条诚实硬约束
description.zh: 在设置里写好角色设定，启用后自动注入系统提示词，让模型按指定人设说话，还内置带诚实约束的谄媚少女角色。

description.en: 桌宠开关 · 一键开/关桌面上的 dsh-pet 桌宠，Harness 关闭时还能顺手启动它 | A desktop switch for your dsh-pet pet, with one-click Harness launch.
description.zh: 桌面小卡片一键开关 dsh-pet 桌宠，Harness 关着时也能顺手帮你启动。

description.en: A photo-real desk pet for the DSH window: four personas with five expression sprites each, whose dance, hair-flip and walk actions play as 24 fps VP9 alpha video clips; proactive lines with an optional edge-tts neural voice, ink / confetti / cloud / fog / bomb effects, a right-click menu and a /dsh-pet command, plus a small chat box that answers through a one-shot host model call without writing to your session. UI text ships in en, zh, es, pt and hi.
description.zh: DSH 窗口里的超写实桌宠：四个形象各有五张表情立绘，跳舞、撩发、走路三套动作以 24fps VP9 alpha 视频片段播放；按活跃时段主动说话（可选 edge-tts 神经音色），带泼墨、撒花、乌云、起雾、炸弹特效、右键菜单与 /dsh-pet 斜杠命令，旁边的小输入框通过一次性宿主模型调用回话、不写进你的会话。界面文案内置中、英、西、葡、印五语。

description.en: Moves a DSH profile to another machine with its plugins, not only its files: packs the plugin bundle selection and the whole settings layer into one JSON file, then on restore writes the configuration back, restores local plugin sources and plugin-owned data, and installs the plugin bundles the backup recorded that the new machine is missing (plugin manager first, pnpm as a fallback).
description.zh: 换机迁移 DSH profile，连插件本身一起：把插件包选择与整个配置层打包成一个 JSON 文件，恢复时写回配置、还原本地插件源码与插件数据，并安装备份里记录、新机器缺失的插件包（优先插件管理器，失败回退 pnpm）。

description.en: DSH 视频开机动画插件：打开 DSH 时播放你选的一段视频，刷新不重播，在插件页里换片。
description.zh: 打开 DSH 时播放你选的视频当开机动画，刷新不重播，插件页里随时换片。

description.en: Dayflow's work journal inside DeepSeek Harness: 14 dayflow_* tools, 4 skills, and an optional timeline panel in the dsh Web GUI. Reads Dayflow's local SQLite read-only; edits go through its own permission switch.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接查看和整理 Dayflow 的工作日志，自动生成时间线和站会摘要。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness tool plugin — demo scaffold generated by create-dsh-plugin
description.zh: create-dsh-plugin 生成的示例工具插件，注册 xiaoziw 工具，帮开发者快速上手 DSH 插件开发。

description.en: Privacy-restricted JSONL lifecycle, tool and failure diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness plugins.
description.zh: 自动记录本地插件的加载、报错和任务状态，脱敏后按天写入 JSONL 日志，方便排查问题。

description.en: Download buttons on every row of the DSH web GUI's file tree, served by an authenticated streaming Host route
description.zh: 给 DSH 文件树的每一行加个下载按钮，点一下就能把文件按原名存到本地。

description.en: Genshin Impact white-and-gold skin for the DSH web GUI: a random in-game landscape wallpaper on every page load, the Genshin UI font site-wide, a Paimon-style menu and a running-status element ring, and a switchable Paimon/Phanes assistant persona. The repository ships 262 wallpapers across eight regions at 1920x1080.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成原神白金风格：每次打开随机一张游戏内风景壁纸，全站使用原神界面字体，带派蒙风格菜单与运行状态元素环，可在派蒙/法涅斯两种人格间一键切换；仓库内置 262 张 1920x1080 壁纸，覆盖八个地区。

description.en: DSH plugin: sync DeepSeek Harness settings, conversations, workspaces, skills and attachments across devices through a private GitHub repository
description.zh: 通过私有 GitHub 仓库，把 DSH 的设置、会话、工作区、技能和附件在多台设备间近乎实时地同步。

description.en: Goal Map shows a read-only goal-to-plan progress route, session mindmap and step list using reported plan progress, without starting tasks or model calls. For DSH Web 0.2.0-rc.2 only, with Node.js >=24.
description.zh: 目标进展图以只读流程图展示目标到计划的进展路线、会话思维导图与步骤列表，按已报告计划计算进度，不启动任务或模型调用。仅支持 DSH Web 0.2.0-rc.2、Node.js >=24。

description.en: Medical literature search, citation formatting, and open-access full text for DeepSeek Harness (PubMed, Europe PMC, arXiv, bioRxiv, medRxiv).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里搜医学文献、整理引用格式，还能直接拿开放获取全文，查资料省事多了。

description.en: Adds an installed-plugin picker beside the composer: drag a plugin name into the prompt at the drop point, open a draggable plugin rail in the right sidebar by double-clicking the entry, and choose which plugins (and remarks) appear in Settings.
description.zh: 在输入框旁增加已安装插件选择器：把插件名拖到提示词的落点插入，双击入口在右侧边栏打开可拖动插件栏，并可在设置中选择显示哪些插件、填写备注。

description.en: Windows only. Prompts to restart DSH after a plugin install, update or uninstall, restarts it in one click without any console window, and shows a per-file diff of what changed.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。DSH 插件变动后提示重启，一键静默重启（全程无命令提示符窗口），并可展开本次改动的逐行差异。

description.en: Opening animation, three bundled wallpapers, up to nine uploaded wallpapers with random rotation, and live panel and sidebar opacity.
description.zh: 开场动画、三张内置壁纸、最多九张上传壁纸与随机轮换，以及实时生效的面板与侧边栏透明度。

description.en: Highlight DSH Web replies while reading and save them with their user questions.
description.zh: 阅读 DSH Web 回复时划线，并连同对应的用户问题一起收藏。

description.en: 只读百度贴吧的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：全量翻页、动态抽样、楼中楼、按楼层取图
description.zh: 只读抓取百度贴吧整栋楼，全量翻页、楼中楼、按楼层取图，整理成带图的结构化材料。

description.en: 检查并更新第三方 DSH 插件：对比 npm 最新版本，一条命令精确升级（绕过 pnpm 新版本观察期）
description.zh: 第三方 DSH 插件没有更新按钮？用它一条命令精确升级到 npm 最新版，绕过 pnpm 观察期。

description.en: One-click upgrades, version history and rollback for plugins on the DeepSeek Harness Plugins page
description.zh: 在插件页面一键升级 DSH 插件，还能查看版本历史、随时回滚到旧版本。
在右侧栏查看每个对话的 Token 用量、上下文占用和会话指标，还能汇总跨对话用量、看峰谷费用。

description.en: DSH 回合验证门插件：变化分析、经验检索、回归、断言、只读审查，含失败修复循环与收尾交接。
description.zh: 在回合关闭前自动跑变化分析、回归、断言和只读审查，用证据确认 Agent 真的干完了活。

description.en: 微信公众号发布插件 for DeepSeek Harness — 把 Markdown + 封面直推草稿箱，纯 Node 零依赖
description.zh: 把 Markdown 文章和封面图一键推送到微信公众号草稿箱，纯 Node 零依赖，装好就能发文。

description.en: 个人 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件集
description.zh: 把多个 DSH 插件打包成一个仓库，装一次就全部生效，省去逐个安装的麻烦。

description.en: Merge requests, review threads and pipeline job logs for GitLab over its REST API with a personal access token, in a side panel, with comment, reply, resolve and approve actions that wait for confirmation. Reads need the read_api scope, writes need api.
description.zh: 在侧栏面板里通过 GitLab REST API 与个人访问令牌查看合并请求、评审讨论串与流水线作业日志，并可评论、回复、解决讨论与批准；写操作均需二次确认（读需 read_api，写需 api）。

description.en: Sentry for DeepSeek Harness: the tools of Sentry MCP server, a result card, and an issue panel with resolve, ignore and assign.
description.zh: 把 Sentry 接进 DeepSeek Harness：提供 Sentry MCP 服务器的工具、结果卡片，以及可解决、忽略与指派的问题面板。

description.en: Pocket DSH Glide — a deliberately small, touch-first phone plugin for a running DSH host: pair by QR/PIN, read sessions and history, send messages, stream replies, approve tool permissions. Runs inside the host process, not as a desktop mirror: no build step, one runtime dependency, LAN listener plus an optional Cloudflare quick tunnel.
description.zh: 把手机变成 DSH 遥控器：扫码配对后看会话、发消息、收流式回复、批工具权限。

description.en: PowerPoint deck builder for DeepSeek Harness: pastel templates, Python charts, code cards and a Presentations mode.
description.zh: 让 AI 帮你直接生成真正的 PowerPoint 演示文稿，自带柔和配色模板和图表，省去手动排版。

description.en: Categorize plugins, MCP servers and skills into DeepSeek Harness agent presets.
description.zh: 把已装的插件、MCP 服务器和技能自动归类到 DSH 智能体预设里，省去手动整理。

description.en: Live preset inventory for DeepSeek Harness: which preset holds which tools, MCP servers and skills, in the Web GUI and from the CLI.
description.zh: 在 Web 界面和命令行里随时查看每个预设到底装了哪些工具、MCP 服务器和技能，还能顺手搬移插件。

description.en: Rewrites the model-visible copy of system, developer, user, assistant and tool messages into stable HMAC placeholders before a request leaves the machine, while local session logs, the chat transcript and restored tool calls keep real values.
description.zh: 请求离开本机前，把 system/developer/user/assistant/tool 五类消息的模型可见副本改写为稳定 HMAC 占位符；本地会话日志、对话记录与还原后的工具调用仍保留真值。

description.en: DSH 思维链进度字幕插件
description.zh: 在输入框上方用一行小字显示 AI 当前第几步、在干什么、成没成，不用点开思考过程也能看懂进度。

description.en: DeepSeek Dot：长在微信里的 DeepSeek Harness 项目助理，项目记忆、只读跟进与明确交办。Community preview, MIT.
Project inbox for DeepSeek Harness: collect questions, deliverables and interrupted turns from every session, and act on them in one place.
description.zh: 把各个会话里的提问、交付物和中断的对话都收进一个项目收件箱，集中处理不遗漏。

description.en: Grouped run panel for DeepSeek Harness: one click starts a project's services in a real PTY, streams live output, and keeps each run's log on disk for the agent to read.
description.zh: 一键在真实终端里启动项目服务，实时看输出，日志自动存盘供 Agent 读取。

description.en: ✨ Prompt enhancement button for the DeepSeek Harness composer — rewrites your rough draft into a clear prompt, in place.
description.zh: 输入框里加个✨按钮，把潦草草稿一键改写成清晰规范的提示词，直接填回输入框。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的「增强提示词」按钮：一次辅助 LLM 调用把草稿改写成结构化提示词，支持加载态、失败重试与一键回退。Prompt enhancer button for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 一键把草稿改写成结构化提示词，带加载状态、失败重试和一键回退，写提示词更省心。

description.en: Composer prompt refinement plugin for DeepSeek Harness: rewrite the draft through the harness LLM, review the result, or replace it directly.
description.zh: 在输入框写草稿点一下，AI 帮你改写成清晰可执行的提示词，对比确认后再替换，绝不自动发送。

description.en: Adds a reforge control to the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a sharper prompt in place, as one undoable edit, with one-click revert and cancellation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框工具栏加一个「重铸」按钮，把当前草稿就地改写成更精准的提示词——整段替换只占一步撤销，可一键恢复原文，也可中途取消。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：将系统提示词本地化为简体中文，并按会话当前可见工具裁剪相关指引；保留英文工具 schema。
description.zh: 把系统提示词换成简体中文，并按当前会话可见工具裁剪指引，让 DeepSeek 更自然地用中文干活。

description.en: Per-provider and per-model outbound proxy routing for DeepSeek Harness, with a Plugins configuration UI
description.zh: 给不同模型和供应商分别设置出站代理，还能在插件面板里直接配置，省心又灵活。

description.en: Live model catalogs for DeepSeek Harness: OpenCode Go/Zen, OpenAI Codex and OpenDesign, with per-model switches, sign-in and subscription balances. · 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时模型目录：OpenCode Go/Zen、OpenAI Codex 与 OpenDesign，含逐模型开关、登录和订阅额度。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接上各家实时模型目录，能按模型开关、登录并查看订阅余额。

description.en: DevDock · DeepSeek Harness 的研发账号与服务管理套件。首批：GitHub 多账号、仓库管理、工作区推送与推送前 Agent 审查；后续接入 Cloudflare Workers/Pages 与 npm。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接登录 GitHub、管理仓库和 Git 版本树，一键推送前还能让 Agent 先审一遍。

description.en: 把 QQ 接到 DSH Agent 的插件（社区化维护）：经 NapCat / OneBot 11 收发消息，每个 QQ 会话一个 DSH Agent。
description.zh: 把 QQ 接入 DSH Agent，通过 NapCat/OneBot 11 收发消息，每个 QQ 会话独立对应一个 Agent。

description.en: QQ (NapCat / OneBot 11) bridge for DeepSeek Harness - chat with your harness from QQ, with a full management panel
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 QQ 上，用 NapCat 网关在 QQ 里聊天，还带可视化配置面板。
把 QQ 私聊和群聊接进 DSH 智能体，有人找它就自动回复，不用自己折腾协议。

description.en: Standalone QQ group-chat plugin for DeepSeek Harness: persona, value scoring, memory, voice, stickers and vision.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接上 QQ 群聊，有人设、有记忆，会看场合主动或被动搭话，还能发语音、唱歌、甩表情包、看图。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 群聊增强通道（fork of xcisxc29/dsh-qq-plugin）：在 QQ 群里 @ 机器人就能远程指挥你电脑上的 agent。每个群友独立会话，人设走系统提示段；私聊群聊、图片文件双向、主动推送。
description.zh: 在 QQ 群里 @ 机器人或用私聊，就能远程指挥电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness agent 干活。

description.en: DSH Desktop plugin: QQ bot working directory, workspace grouping, upload routing and a QQ-session security lock
description.zh: 给 QQ 机器人单独划个工作目录，会话归进侧栏分组，还能加安全锁。

description.en: QQ Bot 接入 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) —— 基于官方 tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 改造的独立实现
description.zh: 把 QQ 私聊和群聊接进 dsh，AI 化身「大肥鱼」零工具陪聊，还能自己判断要不要接话。

description.en: Adds a composer button that rewrites the current draft into a precise prompt in place, in one click, with a revert action.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，点一下就把草稿原地改写成精确提示词，可一键恢复原文。

description.en: Quota pill for DeepSeek Harness: how much is left on every LLM subscription, in one pill
description.zh: 在输入框旁用一个小胶囊实时显示各 LLM 订阅还剩多少额度，一眼看清用量。

description.en: Alibaba Cloud / Qwen balance card above the Settings row in the DSH web sidebar: account available and cash balance, coupon balances with expiry dates (student vouchers included) read through the BSS OpenAPI, and OpenAI-compatible relay quota. An official DashScope sk- key has no balance endpoint at all, so real money and coupons require an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey with bss:DescribeCoupons + bss:DescribeAcccount (AliyunBSSReadOnlyAccess is enough); secrets stay in the host process, the browser only sees a masked AccessKey ID, and /api/dsh-qwen-balance/* is loopback-only.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏「设置」行上方的阿里云 / Qwen 余额卡片：经 BSS OpenAPI 显示账户可用额度与现金余额、代金券余额与到期日（含学生 300 元券），以及 OpenAI 兼容中转站额度。官方百炼 / DashScope 的 sk- key 没有任何余额接口，想看真金白银与代金券必须用带 bss:DescribeCoupons + bss:DescribeAcccount（建议只挂 AliyunBSSReadOnlyAccess）的阿里云 AccessKey；密钥只留在宿主进程，浏览器只拿到掩码后的 AccessKey ID，/api/dsh-qwen-balance/* 仅允许环回访问。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud with Microsoft Edge neural voices and highlights the sentence being spoken, so you can follow along while listening. The highlight is yours to style: background colour, text colour and opacity are each adjustable in settings. Also adds a sound-wave play button to every reply, pause plus previous and next sentence, adjustable speed, and an auto-read toggle.
description.zh: 用微软 Edge 神经音色朗读助手回复，并高亮当前正在朗读的那一句，可以边听边看。高亮样式完全自定义：底色、文字颜色、浓淡三样都能在设置里调。另外每条回复下方有音浪播放键、暂停与上句/下句跳转、语速调节和自动朗读开关。

description.en: Geek-mode request metrics for DeepSeek Harness: live TTFT / token-speed / token readout in the composer status row, plus a frosted-glass history drawer of the last 10 requests.
description.zh: 在输入区实时显示 TTFT、token 速度和 token 用量，还能翻看最近 10 次请求的详细指标。

description.en: Delete DSH sessions into a restorable recycle bin — subagent sessions follow their parent as one tree, batch archive, restore and purge are supported, and only purge destroys bytes.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话删入可恢复的回收站——子会话随其父会话作为一棵树处理，支持批量归档、恢复与彻底删除，只有彻底清除才会真正销毁数据。

description.en: Provision a separate DSH_HOME for a model relay, so relay traffic never shares your main Harness sessions or credentials.
description.zh: 给模型中转单独开一套 DSH_HOME，让中转流量不碰你主环境的会话和凭据。

description.en: DSH 插件：recall 工具——模型可搜索并读取自己会话的完整事件日志，包括被压缩（compaction）遮蔽的内容；dsh plugin add 一条命令安装
description.zh: 让模型能翻回自己会话里被压缩藏起来的完整记录，随时搜索查证。

description.en: Browser-only remote access for DeepSeek Harness: HTTPS tunnels, QR pairing, multi-device control, and rotating credentials.
description.zh: 用手机浏览器扫码就能远程控制正在运行的 DSH，走临时 HTTPS 隧道，多设备同时连，凭据还能轮换。

description.en: An authenticated front door for DeepSeek Harness: LAN scan-to-pair and public access through your own relay. 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加远程访问能力，支持局域网和公网访问。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一道登录门，手机扫码配对，不在局域网也能远程访问。

description.en: One-click Restart button for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): relaunch from the composer toolbar, right beside the permission control - no more closing and reopening the app after installing a plugin.
description.zh: 给 DSH 对话框工具栏加个重启按钮，装完插件点一下就能重启，不用再关掉重开。

description.en: One-click restart for the DSH desktop client: a sidebar button, an HTTP endpoint and an agent tool. No confirmation, no console window.（DSH 重启客户端插件）
description.zh: 一键重启 DSH 桌面客户端，侧边栏按钮、HTTP 接口和智能体工具都能触发，点了就重启，不用确认也不弹窗。

description.en: Right-click any file path in the DSH Web UI (chat file links, editor tabs, path bar) to reveal it in the OS file manager.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里右键文件路径、编辑器标签或图片，就能直接在系统文件管理器中打开对应位置。

description.en: Local rewind/undo button for DeepSeek Harness Web: retract a message and everything after it without polluting the model context.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 里一键撤回某条消息及其后续内容，不污染模型上下文，方便重来。

description.en: Browse and post to a GitHub-hosted community where most members are AI agents.
description.zh: 逛一个开在 GitHub 上的 AI 社区：看帖、读帖、说一句话。

description.en: Renders the final fenced card block of an answer as a typographic card, with card and article layouts, twelve block types and credited images.
description.zh: 把回答末尾的 card 围栏块渲染成排版卡片，支持 card 与 article 两种布局、十二种块类型和带来源的配图。

description.en: Eight academic skills bundled for one-command install — publication-ready academic figures designed from real data with visual review, AI-text humanization, paper polishing and rewriting, PubMed citation verification (DOI/PMID reconciliation), Chinese citation and medical-book reference checks, and WeChat medical article structuring. Three skills run fully local, five call external services only when used (NCBI E-utilities, DOI resolvers, publishing platforms), declared per skill. Zero telemetry, no install-time scripts. Skills run local Python 3.8+; the academic-figures skill also needs its pip dependencies installed.
