description.en: DeepWhale Teardown Studio — upload a pre-separated 3D model and render a teardown video locally (DSH plugin)
description.zh: 上传分好件的 3D 模型，在本地一键渲染出拆解动画视频，还自带无人机成品模板。

description.en: Telegram user-account (MTProto) plugin for DeepSeek Harness: channels, messages, in-chat search, comments, links, whitelisted sending, a DSH bot chat and a Telegram-to-DSH bridge, managed from a mobile-friendly Settings page.
description.zh: 用你自己的 Telegram 账号接入 DSH，直接看频道、搜消息、发评论，还能和 DSH 机器人对话互通。

description.en: A temp note in the DSH right sidebar with session, workspace, and global scopes, browser-local autosave, one-click copy, and one-click LLM polish through the default model.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏的临时笔记，支持会话级、工作区级与全局三种范围、自动保存、一键复制，以及用默认模型一键优化为 Markdown。

description.en: Unofficial DSH plugin bridging Tencent Docs official MCP endpoint (docs.qq.com) · 腾讯文档官方 MCP 桥（社区非官方）
description.zh: 把腾讯文档官方 MCP 端点接进 DSH，扫码取票即可用，无需手动配置凭据。

description.en: Give DeepSeek Harness eyes and hands: live click-through screen preview plus real mouse/keyboard control on Windows.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上眼睛和手，能实时看屏幕、点哪里就点哪里，还能用鼠标键盘直接操作 Windows。

description.en: Six complete Everforest palettes (hard/medium/soft × dark/light) for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
description.zh: 给 Harness 网页界面换上六套 Everforest 护眼配色，深浅明暗随意切换。

description.en: 暖纸 Warm Paper：米杏纸色 × 宋体 × 砖红的手记风 DSH Web 主题（DeepSeek Harness）
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页换上一套米杏纸色、宋体、砖红点缀的手记风主题，看着安静又舒服。

description.en: 在每条回答下方常驻显示本轮 Token 用量、回答耗时与会话累计 Token / Per-reply token usage, answer duration and session total for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在每条回答下方显示本轮 Token 用量、回答耗时和会话累计 Token，方便随时掌握用量和成本。

description.en: Local-first token usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). AI install guide for the plugin and the companion Android app.
description.zh: 本地统计 DSH 的 Token 用量，热力图、趋势、成本一目了然，还能导出数据。

description.en: Interactive cards for DeepSeek Harness replies: sliders, forms, charts and tables from a tool result, with actions that flow back to the agent.
description.zh: 在聊天回复里直接渲染滑块、表单、图表和表格，用户提交后参数自动回传给智能体。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that intercepts repeated tool calls, caps per-turn budgets, and breaks failure loops to reduce token waste.
description.zh: 拦截重复的工具调用、限制每轮调用次数并打断失败循环，帮你省下冤枉 token。

description.en: Read-only Trading 212 portfolio dashboard and dsh tools for holdings, history, risk, and trade markers.
description.zh: 只读查看 Trading 212 投资组合，展示持仓、历史、风险指标和交易标记，帮你快速掌握账户动态。

description.en: Adds an Insight tab next to the conversation and trajectory tabs in DSH: calls a model to interpret tool calls turn by turn, and supports a custom prompt.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话轨迹栏边新增「解读」标签：调用模型分轮次解读工具调用情况；允许自定义提示词。

description.en: Adds Restart App and Host and Reload Page items to the Windows system tray of the official DSH desktop app by patching app.asar in place, and re-applies that patch after each desktop update. Official DSH desktop app 0.2.x on Windows only.
description.zh: 给官方桌面端的 Windows 系统托盘加「重启应用与 Host」和「刷新页面」两项（原位修改 app.asar），并在桌面端每次更新覆盖后自动重打补丁。仅 Windows 官方桌面端 0.2.x。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 原生插件 · 本轮文件 · 按轮次查看生成或修改的文件，复制路径并预览。
description.zh: 按轮次集中查看 DSH 里生成或改动的文件，支持搜索、复制路径和面板预览。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin: account balance, published official prices, and per-session/per-Turn cost displays
description.zh: 在网页里显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、官方价格，以及每个会话和每轮对话花了多少钱。

description.en: DSH Web GUI 的联合会话视图：把多个对话并排摊在屏幕上，只读不改；需要时用 /weld 把它们的历史焊成一个新对话
description.zh: 把多个对话并排摊开一起看，只读不改；需要时用 /weld 把历史焊成新对话接着聊。

description.en: Keeps a DeepSeek Harness run going on its own: continues a turn that ended abnormally, and continues a turn logged as completed while the model tool call was emitted as plain text instead, which leaves the agent silently idle. Revives a model request that stops streaming. A wait on an approval or on a question is logged and notified, never answered.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的回合自己接上：轮次异常结束时补一条继续；工具调用被中转站当成正文吐出、回合却仍记为正常结束时，补一条带指向性的继续，让它重新发起工具调用；模型请求不再出流时掐掉当前轮重来。卡在审批或提问只记录并提醒，不代为回答。

description.en: Local-first token usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: totals, composition, models, trend, heatmap, and provider speed / first-token performance.
description.zh: 本地查看 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量，总量、构成、模型、趋势、热力图和响应速度一目了然。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 悬浮鲸鱼娘宠物：跟随会话模型显示 OpenCode Go 三窗口额度、DeepSeek 账户累计消费/余额、DeepSeek 官方 API 余额。
description.zh: 悬浮鲸鱼娘桌宠跟着当前会话模型，实时显示 OpenCode Go 额度、DeepSeek 消费余额和 API 余额。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）用量与工具调用统计插件：token 四桶、费用估算、工具调用次数与耗时排行、按对话与按模型定位开销，Web 设置页面板展示
description.zh: 在设置页看清 token 用量、费用和工具调用排行，帮你摸清开销花在哪。

description.en: VA Studio integration: ten tools that generate short dramas, images, videos, novels and screenplays, and reverse-engineer prompts from images or videos. Requires a running VA Studio backend.
description.zh: 接入 VA Studio：10 个工具，生成短剧、图片、视频、小说与剧本，并从图片或视频反推提示词。需运行中的 VA Studio 后端。

description.en: Online-model video generation for DeepSeek Harness: three model tools, a durable provider-task ledger that survives restarts, live chat cards and a Videos panel, cost estimates from a public price feed.
description.zh: 在 dsh 对话里直接生成视频，任务不怕重启，还能看进度、估成本。

description.en: 视频链接转文案的 dsh 侧栏工作台：播放器 + 逐字稿 + 发布导出，自带 video2text skill
description.zh: 粘贴视频链接就能生成发布文案和口播逐字稿，侧栏里边看播放器边改稿，一键导出。

description.en: Some words must never reach a page you hand in; some belong only on the page you keep. This DSH plugin writes that line into the system prompt — nothing personal in a formal deliverable, and now and then, in private notes, room for a heart.
description.zh: 给系统提示加一条规矩：正式交付文档不写私人话，私人文档可以偶尔写点心里话。

description.en: VNC client tab for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar — connects to any VNC/RFB server
description.zh: 在右侧边栏直接连任意 VNC/RFB 服务器，远程桌面随手就能看和操作。

description.en: DSH plugin: hold F9 to talk, release to transcribe with the local SenseVoice recognizer, and insert into whichever input has focus
description.zh: 按住 F9 说话，松开自动用本机 SenseVoice 识别，文字直接插入当前输入框。
把火山方舟的模型接进 DSH 模型选择器，直接驱动 agent 干活。

description.en: 把 AI 会话折成可审计的航海报告 · DeepSeek Harness 双端插件
description.zh: 把一次 AI 会话整理成可审计的航海报告，长对话结束后一眼看清全过程。

description.en: 把当前桌面壁纸作为 DeepSeek Harness 界面的半透明实时背景（macOS / Windows / Linux）
description.zh: 把当前桌面壁纸变成 DeepSeek Harness 的半透明实时背景，换壁纸自动跟着变。

description.en: Prompt-cache warmer for DeepSeek Harness: keeps a session provider cache prefix warm during long tool executions. Host plugin, per-provider TTL grid, journal + UTC-day budget.
description.zh: 长时间跑工具时自动给会话的提示词缓存保温，减少重复计费、省钱又提速。

description.en: Annotate web pages in the DSH right-Sidebar Browser tab: element/region comments with screenshots, merged into your next message.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏浏览器里直接圈选网页元素或区域写修改意见，截图和批注会自动合并进下一条消息。

description.en: Resilient web search and page extract tools for DeepSeek Harness with provider fallback and SSRF-safe extract
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加联网搜索和网页正文提取，多个搜索源自动切换，抓取还防 SSRF。

description.en: 给Deepseek Harness添加网页的密码访问，以便于公开到局域网访问
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加上用户名密码登录，方便安全地开放到局域网访问。

description.en: 一个 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）网页能力插件，以 ctx.web 提供方形式注册，接入keenable
description.zh: 给 dsh 加上网页搜索和抓取能力，通过 keenable 接入，让 AI 能查资料、读网页。

description.en: 一个 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）网页能力插件，以 ctx.web 提供方形式注册，接入tinyfish
description.zh: 给 dsh 加上网页搜索和抓取能力，通过 tinyfish 提供方接入，装好就能用。

description.en: 把微信接入 DeepSeek Harness 的通道插件，带落盘串行队列。WeChat (iLink) channel for DeepSeek Harness with a durable serial message queue.
description.zh: 用微信直接和你的 DSH agent 聊天，发文字图片文件都行，消息落盘排队，重启也不丢。

description.en: Whale-girl desktop pet for the DSH Web UI, drawn with hand-written SVG + CSS (no image or audio assets, zero runtime dependencies): swims while a turn runs, blows labeled bubbles on tool calls, taps the glass with an amber pulse when an approval is waiting, jumps with a turn duration/tool-count report on success and droops on failure, naps after dark or when idle. Click to poke, double-click to pet (affinity hearts), drag with remembered position, right-click menu (feed / mute / reset / hide), hover card with level, title, XP bar and per-turn stats. A `whale_say` tool lets the agent make her speak or act as a lightweight visible notification. Read-only over sessions and workspace; only ~/.dsh/whale-girl/state.json is written.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的鲸鱼女孩桌宠，手写 SVG + CSS 动画（无图片/音频素材，零运行时依赖）：任务运行中游泳，调工具时吐带标签的泡泡，等待审批时贴屏幕敲玻璃并伴随琥珀色脉冲，完成时跳一下并汇报本轮耗时与工具数，失败时下沉，闲置或深夜戴睡帽打盹。单击戳一戳，双击摸头涨好感，拖拽后记住位置，右键菜单可喂食/静音/回默认位置/隐藏，悬停显示等级、称号、经验条与本轮统计。`whale_say` 工具让 Agent 借她说话或做动作，作为轻量可见通知。只读会话与工作区，仅写入 ~/.dsh/whale-girl/state.json。

description.en: A whale-girl desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: chat, voice, screen awareness and game companion (fork of dsh-pet).
description.zh: 住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的鲸鱼娘 AI 伙伴，能聊天、能语音、能看屏幕，还能陪你打游戏。

description.en: Russian translation and responsive UI companion for DeepSeek Whale Widget 0.4.2; no bundled artwork
description.zh: 给 Whale Widget 0.4.2 加上俄语翻译和自适应界面，让俄语用户也能顺手用。

description.en: Registers one `wind_finance` tool for DeepSeek Harness: it routes a financial question to the right Wind data domain, executes it over the Wind meta-router MCP endpoint (or the per-domain CLI in batch mode), and keeps a per-day receipt so the same dataset is not pulled twice against one shared daily quota. Authentication, quota and network failures are reported with their error codes instead of falling back to another data source. Credentials are read from the environment and are never bundled with the plugin.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册一个 `wind_finance` 工具：把金融问题路由到正确的 Wind 数据域，经 Wind meta-router MCP 端点（或批量模式下的分域 CLI）执行，并用按日回执避免同一份数据在共享日额度下被重复取数。认证、额度与网络失败如实返回错误码，不换数据源兜底。凭据只从环境变量读取，不随插件分发。

description.en: Unofficial CN compatibility fork of dsh-workbuddy-connect 0.7.8 (MIT); adds a CN request-path patch. Not affiliated with the original author.

Registers one `workpaper_gate` tool for DeepSeek Harness: it audits a workpaper set for completeness, covering both the target design or template itself and the instance-versus-template structure, with the rule list, template list and core-table list all configurable in one spec file. Findings come back as blocker, warning and info, and the workpapers are only read, never modified. Requires Python with openpyxl.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册一个 `workpaper_gate` 工具：审核底稿完整性，既审目标（设计层/模板）自身，也审底稿实例与模板的结构一致性；规则清单、模板清单与核心表清单全部配置化在同一个 spec 文件里。结果按 blocker / warning / info 分级，底稿只读不改。需 Python 与 openpyxl。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web plugin: batch-remove sidebar Workspaces (registration only — folders and session logs are kept). DSH 侧边栏工作区批量移除。
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏一次性批量移除多个工作区，只取消注册，文件夹和会话记录都保留。

description.en: Drive-letter chips and a remembered start directory for the DeepSeek Harness add-workspace picker · 给 DSH 的「添加工作区」加上盘符一键直达与上次目录记忆
description.zh: 给 DSH 添加工作区选择器加上盘符快捷按钮和上次目录记忆，Windows 换盘不用再手打路径。

description.en: Adds extra working directories to a workspace, each read-write or read-only, from a folder button next to the composer or the `/add-dir`, `/remove-dir` and `/dirs` commands; the model sees them in its runtime context, and `write` and `edit` calls into read-write directories skip the sandbox escalation prompt by default while shell commands still ask.
description.zh: 为工作区添加额外的工作目录，可设为读写或只读，可通过输入框旁的文件夹按钮或 `/add-dir`、`/remove-dir`、`/dirs` 命令管理；模型可在运行时上下文中看到这些目录，对读写目录的 `write` 与 `edit` 调用默认免去沙箱提权确认，终端命令仍会询问。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供嵌套工作区管理、首次安装交互式引导、专注模式、健康检查，以及对话式插件调整的社区插件。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上真正的子工作区、层级导航和专注模式，还能对话式调整插件、做健康检查。

description.en: dsh 插件：把 DeepSeek Harness 的原生「标准模式」完整汉化——覆盖 preset-standard，不新增预设条目。
description.zh: 把 dsh 标准模式整套汉化，提示词和工具描述都说中文，模型用中文思考，工具照旧直接调用。

description.en: 「装一次，所有会话都得听。」DeepSeek Harness 全局提示词插件：中文思维链、内容保真、反八股；规则可编辑，改完即生效
description.zh: 一次装好全局生效的系统提示词插件，让 AI 用中文思考、内容不走样、少说套话，规则还能随时改。

description.en: Chinese frontend UI design spec for dsh: injects the zh-ui-design skill and prompt rules (section-name headings, no filler copy, one signature element), plus a 10-rule UI copy/style linter.
description.zh: 中文前端界面设计规范：注入 zh-ui-design 技能与系统提示，标题即功能、去除解释性占位文案、单一记忆点签名元素；附带 10 条界面文案/样式 lint 规则。

description.en: DSH coding mode: coding-only agent preset plus host-plane tool mask for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个只保留编码刚需能力的「编码模式」预设，写代码更专注。

description.en: Development tooling for Minecraft 26.3 mods: starts a real dedicated server and a real client from JSON instance registrations, drives both through an authenticated HTTP probe, and asserts on world, UI and log state across Fabric, Forge and NeoForge, writing per-run evidence and shipping no game or loader files. Requires JDK 25 and a Minecraft 26.3 instance.
description.zh: Minecraft 26.3 mod 开发工具：按 JSON 实例登记启动真实的专用服与客户端，通过带鉴权的 HTTP 探针驱动两端，并对世界、UI 与日志状态做断言，覆盖 Fabric / Forge / NeoForge；每轮运行留下取证目录，且不随包分发任何游戏或加载器文件。需 JDK 25 与 Minecraft 26.3 实例。

description.en: REA
description.zh: 装上它，你的 DSH 助手就能对 JavaScript 做有证据支撑的逆向静态分析，查得更透。

description.en: Share omp (oh-my-pi) project memory with DeepSeek Harness: DSH injects the same memory_summary.md and learned.md window omp reads, and its learn tool writes back to the very same learned.md. Conservative by default - never deletes, refuses to evict when omp's 100-lesson cap would be hit, byte-faithful writes with a CAS re-check, and it will not create omp's memory directory on its own. Verified black-box: one prompt sent to omp headless and to a one-shot DSH task yields the same answer, while a control run without memory abstains on both sides.
description.zh: 把 omp（oh-my-pi）的项目级记忆接入 DeepSeek Harness：DSH 注入的是 omp 读的那同一份 memory_summary.md 与 learned.md 窗口，其 learn 工具写回的也是同一个 learned.md。默认保守——绝不删除，撞到 omp 的 100 条封顶时拒绝淘汰，写入逐字节保真且写前 CAS 复核，也不会替 omp 静默新建记忆目录。已做黑盒对跑：同一句提示词分别喂给 omp 无头模式与 DSH 一次性任务，答案一致；无记忆的对照组两端都明确回答没有。

description.en: DSH 插件：给「自动开发调度器2.0」用的场景化主备模型切换（场景 TAB、三角色 A/B 两侧模型、失效自动切换顺序、模型变更管控）
description.zh: 给自动开发调度器2.0加场景化主备模型切换，一键互换三个子代理角色的模型，失效自动切换。

description.en: Reviso for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): publish agent output for human review and find it again from the session
description.zh: 把智能体的输出发布出来给人审核，之后还能从会话里随时找回。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件包：Anima 风格 LoRA 数据集全流程引擎，覆盖抓图下载 → 去重筛选 → 文字检测修补 → 重排编号 → 打标洗标 → 训练配置。自带 anima_status/anima_stage/anima_job/anima_doctor 四个工具、Agent 预设与图形设置页，另有一套可脱离 DSH 独立运行的 15 阶段 Python CLI。
description.zh: 把 Anima 风格 LoRA 数据集从抓图、去重、打标到训练配置一条龙跑完，还能脱离 DSH 单独用。

description.en: Dsh插件工具集：解包、回编、签名、DEX、文件、压缩包、图片、哈希
description.zh: 让 AI 用自然语言直接解包、回编、签名 APK，还能改 DEX 和资源文件，不用敲命令行。

description.en: Blender 全栈导师 AI Skill：教学、评分、资产验收、ESD/BIO   Blender Full-Stack Mentor AI Skill — teaching, grading, asset acceptance, ESD/BIO
description.zh: Blender 全栈 AI 导师，帮你教学、评分、验收资产，还能搞定 ESD/BIO。

description.en: GPT-SoVITS voice output for DSH: a speak tool and /voice command, a read-aloud speaker button under each reply, and a settings tab to switch voices, tune synthesis, manage the local service and one-click install a voice pack. Windows only; needs a local GPT-SoVITS checkout with trained weights and its Python environment.
description.zh: 把本机 GPT-SoVITS 音色接进 DSH：voice_speak 工具与 /voice 命令朗读，每条助手回复下方有喇叭按钮，设置页可切音色、调合成参数、管本地推理服务，并支持一键安装音色包。仅 Windows；需本机已有 GPT-SoVITS 仓库、训练好的权重与它的 Python 环境。
在命令行里增删改查和校验 CAN DBC 数据库，还能和 Excel 表格互相转换，汽车电子开发省事不少。

description.en: A2UI-inspired agent-authored application cards with a persistent machine directory, SSH probes, and reviewed monitoring and control actions. SSH probes require OpenSSH (ssh, ssh-keyscan, ssh-keygen).
description.zh: 受 A2UI 启发的模型生成应用卡片，提供持久机器目录、SSH 探测及经审阅授权的监控与控制操作。SSH 探测需 OpenSSH（ssh、ssh-keyscan、ssh-keygen）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 多账号切换插件：本地 grant 库、热切换、余额与自动轮换
description.zh: 在 DSH 里管理多个 DeepSeek 账号，不重启就能热切换，还能按余额或限流自动轮换。

description.en: An AI next-move advisor for DeepSeek Harness. Find a better next step, then press Tab to make it yours.
description.zh: 它会读你最近的对话，帮你找出比下意识更优的下一步，按 Tab 就能直接采用。

description.en: DSH pre-execute gate: ask before a tool call leaks a credential, stops a service, or rewrites host network/registry state.
description.zh: 工具执行前先拦一道：遇到泄露密钥、停服务、改网络或注册表的危险操作，先问你一句再动手。

description.en: 策略声明 vs 实际执行：说好不干的事干了没，干了的有没有说
description.zh: 把项目策略声明和实际代码摆一起比，看说好不干的事干了没、干了的有没有说。

description.en: Adds a Teams sidebar dashboard that lists every Agent Teams chat with its roster and task roadmap, token spend in USD and RUB, work and online time, and an archive of older teams. Requires the Agent Teams plugin.
description.zh: 在侧边栏加一个「团队」面板，列出每个 Agent Teams 会话的成员与任务路线图、按时间段统计的 token 消耗与美元/卢布成本、总工时与在线时长，并可归档旧团队。需先安装 Agent Teams 插件。

description.en: Five production-grade DSH tools bundled into one plugin (8 tool slots total): git regression finder (find introducer, recent changes, bisect, blame age), stack-trace decoder with local code context, YAML/ENV/properties config validator with typo suggestions, cross-platform shell escape (POSIX/PowerShell/cmd), and MyBatis Plus SQL static auditor (N+1, missing @Transactional, LIKE leading %, SELECT *, missing WHERE). Zero npm dependencies, all offline; concurrency-safe except the bisect tool (dsh-when-broke). Each sub-plugin is also installable standalone (dsh-when-broke, dsh-stackdecoder, dsh-config-guard, dsh-cmd-shield, dsh-mp-auditor).
description.zh: 五个生产级 DSH 工具合一的 bundle（共 8 个 tool slot）：git 回归定位（引入者反查、最近改动、二分定位、blame 年龄）、带本地代码上下文的堆栈解码器、YAML/ENV/properties 配置校验器（带近似键名提示）、跨平台 shell 转义（POSIX/PowerShell/cmd）、MyBatis Plus SQL 静态审计器（N+1、缺 @Transactional、LIKE 前导 %、SELECT *、缺 WHERE）。零 npm 依赖，全离线；除 bisect 工具（dsh-when-broke）外并发安全。每个子插件也可单独安装（AAAlenwow/dsh-when-broke、dsh-stackdecoder、dsh-config-guard、dsh-cmd-shield、dsh-mp-auditor）。

description.en: 二次元主题插件 for DeepSeek Harness — anime wallpaper / glass panel / mascot widgets, installable via the official plugin manager
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上二次元壁纸、毛玻璃面板和看板娘挂件，一键安装即可美化界面。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：上传图片裁剪为 1:1 图标，用于 dsh 桌面端 App 图标（访达 / 应用程序 / Dock 即时生效，无需重启）或会话行图标。
description.zh: 上传图片裁成 1:1 图标，一键设为 dsh 桌面端应用图标，访达和 Dock 秒级生效，还能随时还原。

description.en: DSH 设置里多一页「AnySearch KEY」：登记多个 AnySearch API KEY（带备注），点一下就把 anysearch 插件切到那个 KEY —— 写 credentials 的 ANYSEARCH_API_KEY，逐次解析，切换立即生效、无需重启 dsh。
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里管理多个 AnySearch API KEY，一键切换立即生效，不用重启。

description.en: Live DeepSeek API balance and this session's token usage in the conversation header, with a detail panel for the topped-up / granted balance split, request count, input, output and cache-hit tokens, and context pressure. The API key is read on every query and is never cached, written to disk or returned to the browser.
description.zh: 在对话标题栏实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额与本会话 token 用量，详情面板展开余额拆分（充值／赠送）、请求次数、输入／输出／缓存命中 tokens 与上下文占用；API Key 每次查询现取，不缓存、不落盘、不返回浏览器。

description.en: DSH plugin: restart / update / inspect the DeepSeek Harness desktop app from the model side (Windows)
description.zh: 在模型侧直接重启、更新和检查 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用，Windows 用户不用手动操作。

description.en: Adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session row menu that permanently removes the session log directory, projection cache and archive/pin membership and drops its row from the sidebar, plus an archived-sessions panel where archived sessions can be restored or deleted.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话行菜单中新增「删除会话」，永久清除该会话的日志目录、投影缓存与归档/置顶记录，并让该行从侧边栏消失；同时在侧边栏提供已归档会话面板，可恢复或删除已归档会话。

description.en: Daily AI digest by email: fetches ten sources (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Hugging Face, arXiv, Hacker News and others), clusters near-duplicate stories, scores them in code and with an LLM, then emails the top three on a daily schedule with a four-part reading (facts, why it matters, impact, open questions). Adds four conversation tools and a sidebar panel for previewing the digest, sending it now and changing the schedule.
description.zh: 每日 AI 三报：抓取 10 个信源（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、Hugging Face、arXiv、Hacker News 等），语义聚类去重，程序打分加 LLM 打分，每天定时把选出的三条发到邮箱，并附「事实／为什么重要／影响／存疑」四段解读；另提供 4 个对话工具与侧边栏面板，用于预览、立即发送和改配置。

description.en: Read-only DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that surfaces the official Auto Review verdicts — review records and host-outcome evidence — in a sidebar panel. / DSH 自动审阅功能日志抓取
description.zh: 在侧边栏查看 Auto Review 对每次工具调用的放行或拒绝裁决，让审查过程不再隐形。

description.en: Windows-only: adds a switch to Settings → General that powers the computer off when the finished conversation ends (default delay 60 s, configurable 5–86400 s), behind a native countdown dialog that cancels the pending shutdown in one click (shutdown /a).
description.zh: 仅 Windows：在「设置 → 通用」增加一个开关，本次对话完成后按设定延迟（默认 60 秒，可设 5–86400 秒）自动关机，并弹出原生倒计时窗口，点一下即执行 shutdown /a 取消本次关机。

description.en: Auto-expand the assistant reasoning block while it streams and fold it back when done; both directions animate, the sidebar switch only controls the automation.
description.zh: 思考时自动展开思考块、结束后自动折叠，带过渡动画，还能在侧边栏开关自动模式。

description.en: DSH autonomous-learning plugin (v2): TypeScript engine, 11 native DSH tools, evidence-based verification, optional MCP adapter.
description.zh: 把学习目标自动拆成任务、建知识库并核验证据，帮你系统化自主学习。

description.en: 给用深鲸桌面产出的文档/PR 加「powered by dwh」署名徽章的 DSH skill 插件
description.zh: 给用深鲸桌面产出的文档和 PR 自动加上「powered by dwh」署名徽章，标明出处。

description.en: A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) client plugin: live account balance plus the current DeepSeek billing window (peak / off-peak) in the sidebar footer.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部实时显示账户余额和当前计费时段（高峰/低谷）及结束时间，花钱心里有数。

description.en: DSH 标题栏用量 HUD：余额 / 今日已用 / 峰谷倒计时 + 每轮消耗
description.zh: 在 DSH 标题栏常驻显示余额、今日用量和峰谷倒计时，每条回复还标出本轮花了多少。

description.en: Better Right-Click: right-click menu on file references in the DSH transcript. Copies the absolute path, reveals the file selected in Explorer by reusing and focusing an existing window, and lists every app registered for that file type so you can open it with the one you want. Menu labels follow the DSH display language (Chinese and English). Windows only (Explorer reveal and the registered-apps list use PowerShell).
description.zh: 给正文里的文件引用加右键菜单：复制绝对路径、在资源管理器中定位并选中文件（复用已打开的窗口并置前）、以及列出本机所有能打开该类型文件的程序让你自己选。菜单文案跟随 DSH 界面语言（中文/英文自动切换）。仅 Windows（资源管理器定位与程序列表依赖 PowerShell）。

description.en: DSH 侧边栏主题分组插件：工作区筛选、emoji 分组树、三级拖拽排序、批量归档与安全永久删除；叠加注入原生侧栏，不替换官方列表
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏加上主题分组，会话按 emoji 归类、拖拽排序，还能批量归档和安全删除。

description.en: Adds upload, download, new folder, delete, drag-to-move, drag-to-chat and in-place text editing with auto-save to the workspace Files tab and file previews.
description.zh: 为工作区「文件」标签页和文件预览添加上传、下载、新建文件夹、删除、拖拽移动、拖入对话，以及支持自动保存的原地文本编辑。

description.en: Chunked compaction for oversized sessions: takes over only when the live context exceeds 85% of the model window (or the request exceeds 4 MB), summarizes the history in 1.5 MB chunks and merges them; smaller sessions keep the built-in compaction.
description.zh: 超大会话分块压缩：仅在实测上下文超过模型窗口 85%（或请求超过 4 MB）时接管，把历史按 1.5 MB 分块摘要再合并；小会话仍走 dsh 自带压缩。
给 DSH 装一只会自己过日子的 AI 小鱼，定时醒来写日记、攒好感、记心情，还能主动找你聊天。

description.en: Reads Bilibili video content as text for DSH agents: metadata, subtitles, ASR, frame OCR, comments and danmaku. Frame OCR needs ffmpeg; the ASR/OCR venvs need Python 3.10+; AI subtitles need a Bilibili login.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频内容读成文本：元数据、字幕、本地转写、抽帧 OCR、评论与弹幕。抽帧 OCR 需 ffmpeg；ASR/OCR 虚拟环境需 Python 3.10+；AI 字幕需登录 Bilibili。

description.en: Extract Bilibili platform/AI subtitles or external/embedded/ASR/OCR fallback and render Markdown, Word, PDF, TXT, SRT or JSON with timestamps, bilingual alignment and a quality report. Requires Python 3.10+; platform/AI subtitles need a Bilibili SESSDATA cookie; OCR/ASR/PDF need ffmpeg, faster-whisper and LibreOffice or reportlab.
description.zh: 从 Bilibili 视频或本地视频提取字幕，输出 Markdown、Word、PDF、TXT、SRT 或 JSON，支持时间戳、双语对齐和质量报告。需 Python 3.10+；平台/AI 字幕需 Bilibili SESSDATA Cookie；OCR/ASR/PDF 需 ffmpeg、faster-whisper，以及 LibreOffice 或 reportlab。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 项目名 Toast 通知插件，内置温暖、可选择的手机风格提示音包。
description.zh: 给 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 项目加 Toast 通知，还自带温暖好听的手机风格提示音。

description.en: Built-in browser: gives the agent a real headed Chromium it can open, click, type and scroll in, keeping page state across calls.
description.zh: 内置浏览器：给 Agent 一个真实的有头 Chromium，可打开网页并点击、输入、滚动，页面状态在多次调用之间保持。

description.en: CDP browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: accessible snapshots, navigation, clicks, typing, screenshots and guarded approvals.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体直接操控正在运行的 Chromium 浏览器，自动完成网页浏览、点击、输入和截图。

description.en: BTW side chat for DeepSeek Harness: a read-only fork of the current conversation, answered in a Codex-style right-sidebar window.
description.zh: 不打断主任务，用 /btw 开个只读侧聊窗口，顺手问点旁支问题。

description.en: WorkBuddy 模型接入与每日签到合一的 DeepSeek Harness 插件 (cn models + daily check-in in one plugin)
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 模型接入和每日签到打包在一起，一个插件搞定模型配置和日常打卡。

description.en: DSH web plugin that browses, previews, restores and deletes archived sessions that were moved out of the sessions directory.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：浏览、预览、还原与删除已从会话目录搬出的归档会话。

description.en: Slims oversized MCP tool JSON Schemas per agent without changing dispatch, and reports token usage, cache hits and context composition on a settings page.
description.zh: 按 agent 收敛过大的 MCP 工具 JSON Schema（调度不变），并在设置页展示 token 用量、缓存命中与上下文构成。

description.en: Operate DeepSeek Harness (dsh) over MCP: expose sessions, task execution, and workspace management to any MCP client.
description.zh: 把 dsh 的会话、任务队列和工作区管理通过 MCP 开放给任意 MCP 客户端调用。

description.en: Bridges the third-party providers saved in a local cc-switch app into DeepSeek Harness: Anthropic-format tool groups become adapter routes, Codex groups are handed to the built-in pi-ai adapter, and a settings page picks which groups to import and in which order.
description.zh: 把本机 cc-switch 里保存的第三方供应商接入 DeepSeek Harness：Anthropic 格式的工具分组注册为适配器路由，Codex 分组交给内置 pi-ai 适配器，并在设置页选择导入哪些分组以及它们的顺序。

description.en: Chat wallpaper: use a local image, a local video or one of six preset gradients as the chat background, with clarity, opacity, zoom, position, dark veil, fit mode, motion and glass panels; files stay in IndexedDB and nothing is uploaded.
description.zh: 聊天壁纸：用本地图片、本地视频或六套预设渐变做聊天背景，可调清晰度、透明度、缩放、位置、暗色遮罩、显示方式、动效与玻璃面板；文件只存在浏览器 IndexedDB，不上传。

description.en: DSH Chat Manager Wide — unofficial fork of dsh-chat-manager
description.zh: dsh-chat-manager 的非官方加强版，能翻看归档对话的完整内容，还能安全地永久删除。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）桌面端会话列表「标记未读」插件：行首蓝点 + 会话菜单开关，宿主账本跨重启，打开会话自动清除。无外部依赖。
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话列表加手动标记未读，行首亮蓝点，打开会话自动清除，重启也不丢。

description.en: Keep DeepSeek Harness agents thinking and answering in Simplified Chinese: a token-lean system-prompt section plus a runtime-context reminder that also reaches long or resumed sessions.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体始终用简体中文思考和回答，长会话和恢复的会话也不会跑偏。

description.en: Session switcher for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): Ctrl+K palette, Ctrl+[ / ] cycling, customizable in-panel shortcuts — fork build with layout-independent chords and zh/en localization
description.zh: 用 Ctrl+K 快速切换会话，Ctrl+[ / ] 循环切换，还能自定义面板快捷键，中英文界面都支持。

description.en: Cline Pass 上游守卫 for DeepSeek Harness：按模型钉住上游 + 回读真实路由 + 漂移告警 + 缓存与 token 用量观测
description.zh: 给 Cline Pass 钉住上游模型并盯紧真实路由，漂移就告警，还能看缓存和 token 用量，省下重算缓存的冤枉钱。

description.en: Right-Sidebar tab menu enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: adds a 'Close other tabs' item that closes every content tab of the session except the one whose menu is open and the docked guide.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏增强：右键 tab 菜单增加「关闭其他标签」，一键关闭当前会话中除当前 tab 与引导页外的所有内容标签。

description.en: Per-workspace closet for temporary scripts and their run logs, kept in a .dsh-fix directory inside each project. Registers a script with its language and purpose, scans a project for leftover scratch scripts, backups and log files, runs registered scripts with a timeout and writes each run to a timestamped log, and sweeps chosen files into a reversible trash with per-batch restore. Scanning only lists and never deletes; cleanup moves files instead of deleting them; files already tracked by git are refused unless forced. Ships 7 agent tools and a settings panel.
description.zh: 按工作区管理临时脚本与其运行日志的收纳间，数据放在每个项目内的 .dsh-fix 目录。可登记脚本（语言与用途）、扫描项目中遗留的临时脚本/备份/日志、带超时执行已登记脚本并把每次运行写进带时间戳的日志、把选中的文件清运进可整批还原的回收站。扫描只列清单永不删除；清运只做移动不做删除；已被 git 跟踪的文件默认拒收，确需处理要显式加 force。含 7 个 Agent 工具与一个设置面板。

description.en: 国密算法合规检查：该用国密的地方，有没有还在用国际算法
description.zh: 检查项目里该用国密的地方是不是还在用国际算法，帮你过密评和等保密码要求。

description.en: 在 DSH 会话里检索知网并下载 PDF。复用内置浏览器的登录态，实测零验证码。
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话里直接检索知网并下载 PDF，复用浏览器登录态，不用管验证码和另存为弹窗。

description.en: Post-edit impact checks for DeepSeek Harness agents — a symbol index and reference graph that tell you what an edit touched, without re-scanning the repo.
description.zh: 改完代码立刻告诉你这次改动影响了哪些符号和引用，不用再全仓库 grep 一遍。

description.en: 阅读代码 · DSH 独立插件：一个独立于普通工作区选择的代码阅读模式：先理解业务，再梳理调用链、精读实现，最后通过具体场景验证理解。
description.zh: 独立于工作区的代码阅读模式，帮你从业务到调用链再到实现逐层读懂代码。
在 DSH 里快速切换 Codex 模型，顺手修好了浏览器 fetch 调用报错的问题。

description.en: Codex 风格 Worktree：会话默认在独立 git worktree 中工作，输入框上可选择本地或工作树，清理有保护、删除前留可恢复快照。
description.zh: 让 DSH 会话默认在独立 git worktree 里干活，输入框可切本地或工作树，删前留快照能恢复。

description.en: 🫡 把 DSH 挤成 Codex 的形状：设置页里的用量看板——Token 热力图、常用工具、技能与近 30 天明细，数据来自本机会话日志。
Optimized Command Code provider for dsh: client-view catalog, Go + GOAT plans, live refresh without restart
description.zh: 给 dsh 接入 Command Code 模型的优化版插件，支持客户端目录、Go 与 GOAT 套餐，改配置不用重启。

description.en: 一份能交出去的自查表、整改说明和合规证明
description.zh: 把终端里的检查结果一键变成自查表、整改说明和合规证明，三份文件直接能交出去。

description.en: DSH 网页输入框的补全与编辑增强：括号引号自动配对、选中即环绕、跳过闭符、删掉空对；弹层给四类候选并标出「凭什么给这张词表」 ｜ Completion and editing for the DSH web composer: auto-pairing, wrap-selection, skip closers, delete empty pairs, and a popup that says which word table it used
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框加上括号引号自动配对、选中环绕和智能补全弹层，打字更顺手。

description.en: Composer prompt enhancement for DSH Web: a ✨ button rewrites the current draft in place after asking only about genuine ambiguity, and an empty composer shows a grey next-message ghost that Tab or a click fills into the draft without sending.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框提示词增强：✨ 按钮先判断歧义、再原地改写草稿；空草稿时以灰色 ghost 给出下一步建议，Tab 或点击填入草稿且不自动发送。

description.en: DSH 插件：把「文件 / 目标 / 计划 / 反馈」四个常用动作常驻到输入框工具栏
description.zh: 把文件、目标、计划、反馈四个常用动作常驻输入框工具栏，不用每次展开菜单，点一下就用。

description.en: Reuses the sign-in already held by the local Doubao desktop app as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, and adds a read-only quota view for the 5-hour and weekly windows. Windows x64 only: the credential is decrypted with DPAPI.
description.zh: 复用本机豆包桌面客户端已有的登录态，作为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 provider，并提供 5 小时限额与周额度的只读额度概览。仅 Windows x64：凭据解密依赖 DPAPI。

description.en: Connects an existing local MiniMax Code sign-in to DeepSeek Harness through a loopback reverse proxy without storing an API key or signing out.
description.zh: 读取本机 MiniMax Code 登录态，经本地回环反向代理接入 DSH；不保存 API Key，也不会退出登录。

description.en: Adds a session-scoped context window selector next to the reasoning-effort row in the DeepSeek Harness model popup: a pill showing the effective window opens a dropdown of presets below the model default, the choice applies to the next request of that session only, and a new session falls back to the profile default. It writes no config file and appends nothing to the session log.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型弹窗的「推理等级」旁增加会话级上下文窗口选择器：显示当前生效窗口的胶囊按钮可展开默认窗口以下的档位下拉，选择只作用于该会话的下一次请求，新建会话自动回到 Profile 默认值。不改任何配置文件，也不向会话日志写入内容。

description.en: 多机 dsh 控制：从本地一个窗口驱动你其他服务器上的 dsh——远端会话原生进侧栏，整台远端界面也能搬进来。· Control the dsh instances on your other machines from one local window.
description.zh: 一个本地窗口就能连上你其他机器上的 dsh，直接聊天，不用来回切换。

description.en: In-conversation keyword search for the current session: pages the history back to its first window before matching, then highlights every hit and scrolls to the one you pick.
description.zh: 当前会话内的关键词搜索：先把会话历史翻回最早一页再匹配，命中处高亮并滚动定位到所选项。

description.en: DSH web plugin: session API cost + account balance, as a pill merged into the official composer stats row (费用 · 余额 · 缓存命中).
description.zh: 在输入框统计行里加一枚费用胶囊，实时看本会话 API 花费、账户余额和缓存命中，点开还有明细。

description.en: Native multi-platform accounts and model routing with staggered check-ins, event notifications, and quota forecasts. Its background worker needs a standalone Node >=22.23.3 with node:sqlite (enforced by engines.node); Qwen Office coding additionally needs Python with cryptography and wasmtime.
description.zh: 原生多平台账号与模型路由管理，支持错峰签到、事件通知与额度预测。后台 worker 需独立 Node ≥22.23.3（node:sqlite，已由 engines.node 约束）；千问办公的编码能力另需 Python（cryptography、wasmtime）。

description.en: dsh-custom-brand，大肥鱼品牌图标。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上大肥鱼品牌图标，侧边栏和界面都能自定义，看着更顺眼。

description.en: Cyrene · An Eternal Page Remembrance —— 昔涟的长期记忆插件：四问锚点、日/月/年、夜梦、五育自检、思源备份与余页（DSH 0.2.1+，零依赖）
description.zh: 给 AI 装上长期记忆，用四问锚点、日夜年档和夜梦记录，让它每次醒来都记得你是谁。

description.en: DeepSeek 网页工作台 for DSH — 在侧栏列出 DeepSeek 网页版会话，点开即用完整网页对话，支持接力到当前或新任务。
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 网页版会话搬进 DSH 侧栏，点开就能聊，还能接力到当前或新任务。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：检测模型思考段的复读退化并自动打断、自动续跑。通用重复检测，不依赖白名单。
description.zh: 盯着模型思考段，发现复读就自动打断并续跑，不用手动点继续。

description.en: One-click restart button for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app (Cordis plugin bundle): closes the window, exits every process, reopens automatically.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端加个重启按钮，点一下自动关窗、退进程再重新打开，省得手动折腾。

description.en: Windows desktop automation for DeepSeek Harness: UI Automation, screenshots, scoped actions and native permissions.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体直接操控 Windows 桌面，截图、点击、输入都能干，还能按权限范围安全执行。

description.en: Desktop mode for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: sessions as movable windows with a taskbar (experimental)
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面变成桌面模式，每个会话都是可拖动、可缩放的窗口，还带任务栏，多任务切换更方便。

description.en: Runs a Claude Code project's .claude/ slash commands and permissions.deny rules inside DeepSeek Harness. Command bodies expand $ARGUMENTS, positional arguments and @file references into the agent's next turn; matching tool calls are denied before they run. Every host service is probed, so a host without a command registry, working-directory service or TUI status line degrades one feature instead of failing the boot.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里运行 Claude Code 项目的 .claude/ 斜杠命令与 permissions.deny 规则。命令正文会把 $ARGUMENTS、位置参数与 @文件引用展开进模型的下一轮；命中的工具调用在执行前被拒绝。所有宿主服务都做探测：缺命令注册表、工作目录服务或 TUI 状态行时只降级一个功能，不会让宿主启动失败。

description.en: Douyin tools for DeepSeek Harness: dy-cli reads with an Edge XHR fallback, QR/SMS login state machine, account fingerprint, guarded comment.
description.zh: 把抖音热榜、搜索、视频、用户查询和扫码登录接进 DSH，还能安全地发受控评论。

description.en: Windows x64 only, 0.5.4 preview: two scoped tools (dragon_browser and dragon_desktop) that drive a visible browser through the DOM or CDP and Windows apps through UI Automation, with per-origin and per-executable read/control scopes, batch steps, a physical-Esc emergency stop and a redacted action log. 0.5.4 only widens the DSH compatibility range to 0.2.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1.x, because 0.5.3 pinned it to an exact DSH version and was silently skipped on DSH Desktop 0.2.1. Two long-lived native processes remove the per-action process spawn, so a single key step takes about 0.7 s on the same machine; when another window steals the foreground the step is aborted instead of typing into the wrong place. The browser side ships its own Edge/Chrome launcher and CDP client, so it no longer needs another browser plugin or the Electron runtime. It is not an OS sandbox; logins, admin windows and secure desktops stay with the user.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows x64，0.5.4 预览版：两个受控工具（dragon_browser 与 dragon_desktop），网页走 DOM/CDP、桌面走 Windows UI Automation，按网站来源和可执行文件分 read/control 权限，支持多步 batch、物理 Esc 急停与脱敏动作日志。0.5.4 只是把 DSH 兼容范围放宽到 0.2.0-rc.2 至 0.2.1.x——0.5.3 把版本钉死，在 DSH Desktop 0.2.1 上会被宿主静默跳过。原生命令改成两个常驻进程，省掉每次动作重新起进程，同机单步按键约 0.7 秒；前台被别的窗口抢走时直接中止这一步，不会把字打到别处。网页侧自带 Edge/Chrome 启动器与 CDP 客户端，不再依赖其他浏览器插件或 Electron 运行时。它不是系统沙箱，登录、管理员窗口和安全桌面仍由用户处理。

description.en: Read-only panel reporting an instance's plugin bundles, patch inserts, skills, upgrade health and decoupling health.
description.zh: 只读生态面板：汇总实例的插件束、补丁插入、技能、升级健康与解耦健康。

description.en: Windows / DSH 环境医生：体检 + 可执行修复
description.zh: 说一句「体检一下」，就能查出 Windows 和 DSH 环境哪里坏了、为什么坏、该怎么修。
为 DeepSeek Harness 维护专家身份库，统一管理角色设定、头像和来源信息，供其他插件调用。

issues.detail: declares install-time scripts; the harness gates them via allowBuilds

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-expert-ai
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-expert-ai

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Low-latency terminal for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: dedicated PTY websocket, persistent sessions
description.zh: 给 DSH 右栏加一个超低延迟终端，按键回显几乎无感，支持会话保持和复制粘贴。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：给文件引用加右键菜单（打开文件 / 在资源管理器定位 / 浏览器预览 / 复制路径）。Right-click actions for file mentions in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页里的文件引用加右键菜单，一键打开、定位、预览或复制路径，省得手动找文件。

description.en: DSH 桌面版文件编辑器插件：打开、编辑、查看文件（独立实现，不依赖 OneEdit）
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版里直接打开、编辑和查看文件，独立实现，不用装 OneEdit。

description.en: In-chat preview modal for local files, images, PDFs, Office documents and website links in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
description.zh: 在聊天里点一下文件或链接就能弹出预览窗口，图片、PDF、Office 文档和网页都能直接看，不用来回切应用。

description.en: Find bar in the sidebar text preview, with whole-file match counts for plain text and code, highlighted hits, and jumps between them.
description.zh: 侧边栏文本预览的查找栏：纯文本与代码按整份文件计数，命中高亮并可逐处跳转。

description.en: 两级搜索 failover 插件（Tavily → DeepSeek Search API；Fetch: DeepSeek → 直连）。带额度感知熔断，第一层失败自动切第二层。
description.zh: 搜索和抓取都做两级自动切换，第一层挂了自动换第二层，还带额度熔断，不怕断供。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that predicts your next message after each reply. Press Tab to accept it as an editable draft; it never sends by itself.
description.zh: 每次回复后自动猜你下一句想说什么，按 Tab 采纳为可编辑草稿，不会自动发送。

description.en: A DSH plugin that watches its own sessions, keeps what it learns, and changes the harness it runs in — but only keeps a change a second run proves.
description.zh: 自动复盘已结束的会话，找出让 Agent 失败的地方，把修复写成数据并跑两遍验证，只有第二次仍有效才保留。

description.en: Configure model providers by probing their endpoint, check DeepSeek Harness health, and repair what can be fixed.
description.zh: 给一个调用网址就自动配好模型，体检框架健康度，并修复可自动修复的问题。

description.en: General Agentics distribution bundle for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one install brings white-label brand, curated plugins, bundled skills, and MCP pre-configuration. Built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH), MIT licensed.
description.zh: 装一次就给 DSH 换上自定义品牌外观，还自带技能和 MCP 预配置，开箱即用。

description.en: 在 DSH 网页界面里悬浮一个 Git 提交面板，改动看得见，提交信息交给 AI 写，一键提交。
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页里浮出 Git 提交面板，改动一眼看清，提交信息可让 AI 代写，一键提交或推送。

description.en: Configurable Git commit and pull-request conventions for DeepSeek Harness — enforce user-defined rules on commit messages and PR titles/descriptions. ｜ DeepSeek Harness 的可配置 Git 提交与拉取请求规范插件，按用户自定义规则校验提交信息与 PR 标题/描述。
description.zh: 按你自己的规则检查 Git 提交信息和 PR 标题描述，不合规范就拦下来，团队协作更省心。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web-fetch provider for hosts-file accelerators: keeps web_fetch working when GitHub resolves to a local reverse proxy
description.zh: GitHub 走本地加速代理时，让 dsh 的 web_fetch 照样能正常抓取网页。

description.en: DSH plugin: lists the files a conversation turn produced or changed as plain text, and reveals a file in the OS file manager on double-click.
description.zh: 对话结束后列出本轮产出或改动的文件，双击路径直接在系统文件管理器里定位。

description.en: It logs how you talk to your AI — the 7th "final version" gets a bold red page, a late-night rewrite request gets underlined, a "thanks" earns a gold star, and a post-AGI verdict decides your fate. All local, rule-based, bilingual.
description.zh: 记着你怎么跟 AI 说话——第 7 次「最后一版」红页加粗，半夜改需求红页画线，一句「谢谢」金页贴花，AGI 来了翻本子给你发清算判决书。纯本地规则引擎，中英双语。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 保卫方案核对：依据《个体防护装备配备规范》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 按公开配备标准核对劳动防护用品配置表的品名、规格和数量，只提示差异，不下定性结论。

description.en: Standalone Windows boot guardian for DeepSeek Harness: detects boot failures, removes the newest suspect plugin bundle, restores the last-good profile patch, and relaunches the app.
description.zh: DSH 打不开时，双击守护启动就能自动排查启动失败、移除最新可疑插件、恢复上次正常配置并重新启动。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入递归自化能力优化，以及可视化调整
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上递归自优化能力，还能可视化调参，让插件越用越顺手。

description.en: Harness² experiments for DeepSeek Harness: isolated adapters, measured comparisons, native experiment views and evidence-linked lessons.
description.zh: 把 Harness² 实验框架接进 DSH，隔离对比不同提示、技能和配置，用实验视图和证据链看清模型改进效果。

description.en: Delegate subtasks from DeepSeek Harness to Herdr-managed coding agents, harvest exact results, and review them in DSH.
description.zh: 把 DSH 里的子任务派给 Herdr 管理的编码代理，拿回准确结果并在 DSH 里直接审阅。

description.en: Replaces detected secrets (OpenAI, AWS, GitHub, PEM, Bearer) with deterministic, structurally valid honey tokens before they reach the model or the session file; adds manual marking for values the detectors miss, explicit user-visible restore, and a cross-session canary alarm.
description.zh: 在密钥离开本机前，将其确定性地替换为结构合法的蜜罐假值（OpenAI、AWS、GitHub、PEM、Bearer 模式）；支持手动标记检测器认不出的值、用户可见的显式还原，以及蜜罐跨会话出现时的金丝雀告警。

description.en: A floating TODO, Note and Prompt panel for the DSH harness — three tabs, full CRUD, edge docking, grid and list views.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里挂一个悬浮面板，随手记 TODO、笔记和提示词，支持增删改查、贴边停靠和网格列表切换。

description.en: Image generation for DeepSeek Harness through an OpenAI-compatible relay (configured for api.ykh.ai / gpt-image-2).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接生成图片，走 OpenAI 兼容中转，装好就能用。

description.en: DSH plugin: an input-bar switch that tiles oversize screenshots into sendable square images.
description.zh: 输入栏加个开关，把超规格的长截图自动切成能发送的方形图块，再交给 DSH 附件通道。

description.en: Turns a local Markdown vault into two folders the user picks in Settings: a knowledge folder DSH writes notes into, and a memory folder used as the agent's long-term memory with per-turn recall and end-of-turn capture. Pure Markdown with frontmatter, BM25 search, reversible archive, and path isolation that rejects traversal, absolute paths and symlink escapes.
description.zh: 把本地 Markdown 库拆成两个由用户在设置页选择的文件夹：知识库由 DSH 在对话中写入笔记，记忆库作为 agent 的长期记忆，按回合召回、回合结束沉淀候选。纯 Markdown 加 frontmatter、BM25 检索、可逆归档，并用路径隔离拒绝穿越、绝对路径与符号链接逃逸。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个插件:把信息整理成 Inline 能接入的文章
description.zh: 说一句带 /inline 的话，就能把内容整理成文章并推送到 Inline，省去手动排版。

description.en: Workspace Markdown instructions and agent profiles for DeepSeek Harness: identity, persona, live reload and new-session defaults.
description.zh: 给工作区配上 Markdown 指令和 Agent 人设，改完即生效，新会话自动沿用。

description.en: Renders model answers as interactive cards inside DeepSeek Harness chat, with 24 whitelisted components and persistent turn cards.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 对话里的回答渲染成可交互卡片，内置 24 个白名单组件和回合尾部持久卡片。

description.en: Jev (TypeSafe System One) judgments at the DeepSeek Harness agent-loop gates. No UI dependency.
description.zh: 在 Harness 智能体循环的关键节点做类型安全判断，无需界面，随处挂载即可用。

description.en: Structured judgment plugin for DeepSeek Harness: ask batched named questions (choice, score, yes-probability) and get calibrated probabilities from TypeSafe Jev, Luna, or any compatible endpoint. Strict validation, per-connection config, audit ledger, budget metering. It judges; your agent decides. Types-only contract at ./contract.
description.zh: 一次调用批量回答命名问题，输出校准概率，帮 agent 做结构化判断。

description.en: Kill AI Slop for DSH — score a received document on three weighted axes (expression, execution, decision), audit work-slop with a delivery-obligation ledger, and machine-verify every quote against the source. Reads docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf, txt, md, csv, json and html. Zero runtime dependencies, zero network, fully local.
description.zh: AI垃圾过滤（Kill AI Slop）：给收到的文件打一个可回溯的体检得分（表达／执行／决策三维加权），用交付承接台账审查工作空转，每条引文回原文机器复核；支持 docx/pptx/xlsx/pdf/txt/md/csv/json/html。零运行依赖、零联网、纯本地计算。

description.en: Treat connections that arrive through a LAN proxy as loopback, so a DeepSeek Harness instance reached over a LAN/tunnel keeps its browser connection working.
description.zh: 把 LAN 代理进来的连接当作本地回环，让局域网或隧道访问的 DSH 实例浏览器连接不掉线。

description.en: Pins a Chinese (zh-CN) thinking and answering constraint into the system prompt, and registers a per-step runtime reminder so the agent does not drift back to English after tool output. Zero runtime dependencies, single file; falls back to a second registration path and only logs a warning when the host API changes.
description.zh: 把「用中文思考和回答」钉进系统提示词，并每步注入一条运行时提醒，避免工具返回英文后语言漂移。零运行时依赖、单文件，带能力探测与降级注册，宿主 API 变更时仅记日志、不抛错。

description.en: 兰台 · 簿 —— 给 agent 的 skill 做真正的精炼、去重、降本增效。
description.zh: 给 agent 的 skill 记一本账：经验先审再记，过期的自动核销，帮你去重、精炼、省成本。

description.en: Codex-style element annotation for DeepSeek Harness: Shift box selection, live style panel with from→to changes, Ctrl+click instant send, cross-page review sent as one message.
description.zh: 在本地页面上点选元素、框选区域、实时改样式预览，把修改意见一键发进对话。

description.en: Limbus Company 歌词风格的 DSH 桌面提示：会话事件以逐字动画浮在所有窗口之上，两侧随机落位，设置页自由编辑
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话事件变成 Limbus 歌词风动画提示，浮在所有窗口上，文案和动画都能在设置页里改。

description.en: Visible terminal panel that streams the agent's shell commands into an in-app terminal and lets the agent capture the terminal screen as text.
description.zh: 可见终端面板：把 agent 的 shell 命令实时显示在应用内终端，并支持 agent 以文本方式截取终端屏幕。

description.en: Русская локализация веб-интерфейса DeepSeek Harness (DSH): плагин-локализатор, 2737 строк в 64 разделах
description.zh: 把 DSH 网页界面完整翻译成俄语，覆盖 64 个板块共 2737 行文本，俄语用户用起来更顺手。

description.en: Russian (ru) language pack for the DeepSeek Harness web UI - 63 namespaces, 2730 strings
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加上俄语，63 个模块、2730 条文案全部汉化到位

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: macOS turn-completion notifications and an unfocused-completion unread dot.
description.zh: 对话跑完时如果窗口不在前台，就弹 macOS 系统通知，还能在未聚焦时显示未读小红点。

description.en: DSH 插件：Manim 动画工作室 —— 把论文/方法渲成带配音的讲解视频（manim_scene / manim_render / manim_frames / manim_voice）
description.zh: 把论文或方法一键渲成带配音的讲解视频，场景、画质、分镜全在编辑器里搞定。

description.en: DSH 插件：AI 漫剧/短剧技能总控 —— 本机技能全览、GitHub 开源发现、一键安装更新与回滚
description.zh: 给 AI 漫剧/短剧项目做技能总控，本机技能一眼看全，还能从 GitHub 发现、一键装更新和回滚。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会话标记板：把任意一轮对话标记成任务卡，命名、跳回原处、一键把结论填进输入框（标记保存在本机浏览器）
description.zh: 把任意一轮对话标成任务卡，能命名、跳回原处，还能一键把结论填进输入框。

description.en: Material Design Experience for DSH desktop
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端换上 JetBrains 官方 Material 主题配色，界面更好看。

description.en: Matt Pocock's 27 agent skills (mattpocock/skills) packaged as a DeepSeek Harness bundle
description.zh: 把 Matt Pocock 的 27 个智能体技能打包进 DeepSeek Harness，装上就能直接用。

description.en: Portable audio and native temporal video plugins, agent skills, CLI and MCP server for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上音频和视频分析能力，插件、命令行、MCP 都能用。

description.en: Plays video and audio files in the right Sidebar preview pane, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route so a remote browser can play and seek a large file without launching a native player on the Host.
description.zh: 在右側欄預覽區直接播放影片同音訊，經帶認證的 HTTP Range 路由串流，令遠端瀏覽器可以播放同跳轉大型檔案，唔使喺主機開原生播放器。

description.en: Meeting notes for dsh: one meeting per conversation, transcribed and speaker-separated on the machine itself, with points, assignments, handwritten notes, reviews and monthly scores in the same panel. Exports SRT/Markdown/Word and packs a meeting into a portable zip another dsh can import; confirmed assignments go to DingTalk/WeCom in one click, following your robot settings. Recognition models are swappable (a stronger local model can be imported from a file), and cloud recognition is off by default with no request made before consent. Word export needs Python and python-docx; the first run downloads a recognition model (28 or 77 MB).
description.zh: 会议记录插件：一个会话对应一场会议，本机离线转写与发言人分离；要点、工作安排、手写笔记、复盘与月度评分都在面板里完成。可导出 SRT／Markdown／Word，也能打成「会议工程包」（zip）在另一台 dsh 导入；已确认的工作安排按设置一键推送到钉钉／企业微信。识别模型可更换（支持从本地文件导入更强的模型），云端识别默认关闭、未同意即零请求。导出 Word 需 Python 与 python-docx；首次使用会下载识别模型（28 MB 或 77 MB）。

description.en: Inline user message editor: adds a pencil edit button next to Copy below sent user bubbles, switches the bubble in-place into a rounded editor card, and resends via session branch fork or in-session follow-up.
description.zh: 用户消息原位编辑与重发插件：在已发送消息气泡下方复制按钮旁提供铅笔编辑图标，点击原位展开圆角内联编辑框，支持从上一轮末尾分叉回退重发或在当前会话直接追发。

description.en: General-purpose method for the DeepSeek Harness: a domain-neutral planning protocol whose plan structure is enforced by schema and validator, not just requested by prose.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一套通用做事方法，任务先出结构化计划，由 schema 和校验器强制把关，少返工。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for the DSH Mobile Android app: QR pairing, DSH on your phone, answer approvals from notifications.
description.zh: 把 DSH 装进安卓手机，扫码配对后就能在通知栏里直接处理回答审批。

description.en: Below 1024px the sidebar leaves the shell frame entirely and is opened as an overlay drawer from a header button, so the conversation gets the full viewport width; wider layouts are untouched.
description.zh: 視窗闊度細過 1024px 時，側欄完全移出 shell frame，改由頁首按鈕以浮動抽屜方式打開，令對話可以用盡整個螢幕闊度；闊螢幕版面唔受影響。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: per-provider and per-model switches for the composer model picker. Switch a provider or a single model off and it stops being offered; routing and running sessions are untouched.
description.zh: 给模型选择器加厂商级和模型级开关，关掉的模型不再出现在列表里，路由和会话不受影响。

description.en: 多模型团队：DSH 插件，用同一份任务包并发询问多家模型，做事后审计、设计分叉与专责推理；内置 model-team 技能，安装即自动发现/调用；带账本、周报与逐模型进度窗。
description.zh: 把同一份任务同时发给多家模型跑，实时看进度，还能审计结果、出周报。

description.en: AI 研发工作台（DSH 插件）：MOSS 智能员工 + 可执行研发 DAG + 成本核算 + 产物审查 + 安全审计 + 个人工作台联动
description.zh: 把一句需求变成可执行、可审查、可计费的研发流程，由 MOSS 智能员工干活，还能盯成本和做安全审计。

description.en: DSH 摸鱼套件：伪装成状态栏的小说阅读器（本地 TXT、目录、老板键、隐藏统计）
description.zh: 把状态栏伪装成构建日志，上班时偷偷看本地 TXT 小说，支持目录、老板键和隐藏统计。

description.en: NInfer local inference provider and model manager for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH 里管理本地 NInfer 模型和可编辑的服务器配置，开箱即用 Qwen3.8 27B 参考配置。

description.en: 可以不用选择工作空间直接开聊，dsh会自己根据当前时间在数据目录创建文件夹作为工作空间，参考workbuddy的原理。
description.zh: 不用先选工作空间，直接开聊，插件会按当前时间自动建文件夹当工作区。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Windows 灵动岛
description.zh: Windows 桌面灵动岛，浮在所有窗口上实时显示 agent 状态，点一下就能切换会话。

description.en: Persistent cross-day notebook plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): append, list, search and delete notes kept in notes.md.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个跨天笔记本，笔记存在 notes.md 里，可追加、查看、搜索和删除，重启也不丢。

description.en: Zero-dependency DSH plugin: durable markdown notes as 5 model tools (note_save/list/read/search/delete) plus a /note slash command
description.zh: 零依赖笔记插件，让模型用5个工具和/note命令持久保存、检索Markdown笔记。

description.en: Desktop (Windows toast) notifications for DeepSeek Harness — questions, approvals, turn end and errors. Host-side plugin, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上通过桌面通知提醒你 DSH 的提问、审批、回合结束和报错，切到别的窗口也不错过。

description.en: Registers two tools for DeepSeek Harness. `doc_ocr` turns scanned PDFs and images into structured text (per-page text, financial tables with a balance-sheet tie-out check, contract-clause hits) through a local RapidOCR engine or a Zhipu GLM-OCR cloud engine, and `doc_preprocess` turns a directory of raw files into an Obsidian-ready knowledge base through a seven-stage pipeline with backend routing and sha256-based incremental skipping. Numbers that fail the tie-out are reported, not invented. The local engine needs Python 3 with rapidocr-onnxruntime, pypdfium2 and Pillow (pip install -r requirements.txt); the GLM engine needs ZHIPU_API_KEY.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册两个工具：`doc_ocr` 把扫描件 PDF 与图片转成结构化文本（逐页文本、带资产负债表平衡勾稽的财务报表行、合同条款命中），可用本机 RapidOCR 或智谱 GLM-OCR 云端引擎；`doc_preprocess` 用 7 阶段管线把一批原始文件整理成 Obsidian 可读知识库，含后端路由与 sha256 增量跳过。勾稽不平的数字只报出、不编造。本机引擎需 Python 3 并安装 rapidocr-onnxruntime、pypdfium2、Pillow（pip install -r requirements.txt）；GLM 引擎需设置 ZHIPU_API_KEY。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2) - linter, agent tools, skill prompt, and interactive graph visualizer
description.zh: 把零散笔记整理成结构化知识库，能检查格式、生成图谱，还能让 AI 直接查用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 搜索插件：把内置网络搜索换成一条可排序的搜索引擎链，每个引擎单独开关、拖动决定优先级，失败自动顺延下一个。
description.zh: 把内置搜索换成可排序的搜索引擎链，单个开关、拖动调优先级，失败自动换下一个。

description.en: Adds a Windows Explorer folder context-menu entry that registers the folder as a DSH project, with a switch for the menu entry in Settings → General. Windows only, and nothing extra has to be installed.
description.zh: 在 Windows 资源管理器文件夹右键菜单中加入「用 DeepSeek Harness 打开」，点击后把该文件夹登记为 DSH 项目；设置 → 通用 里有一个开关用于添加或移除该菜单项。仅支持 Windows，无需额外安装任何组件。

description.en: DSH Desktop 工作区右键菜单：打开本地文件夹、在资源管理器中定位、就地重命名 | Right-click a workspace in DSH Desktop to open, reveal, or rename it
description.zh: 在工作区列表里右键就能打开本地文件夹、在资源管理器中定位或直接改名，省得自己翻路径。

description.en: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). No API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接用 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型，不用 API key 也不用注册，装上就能用。

description.en: Floating overlay in the Harness Web UI with OpenCode Go usage: 5-hour rolling, weekly and monthly percentages, reset countdowns and the renewal date, with device-code sign-in and silent token refresh.
description.zh: 在 Harness Web UI 上悬浮显示 OpenCode Go 用量：5 小时滚动、每周与每月百分比、重置倒计时与续订日期，支持设备码登录与静默刷新。

description.en: Bundles the 32 gis/ skills of opengis-skills (GDAL, QGIS, GeoServer, PostGIS, PROJ, PDAL, GRASS GIS, JTS, GeoPandas, Shapely, CesiumJS, OpenLayers, Leaflet, deck.gl and more) into the DSH skill catalog; only names and descriptions appear up front, and instruction bodies plus reference documents load on demand.
description.zh: 把 opengis-skills 的 32 个 gis/ 技能（GDAL、QGIS、GeoServer、PostGIS、PROJ、PDAL、GRASS GIS、JTS、GeoPandas、Shapely、CesiumJS、OpenLayers、Leaflet、deck.gl 等）打包进 DSH 技能目录；目录只列出名称与描述，技能正文与参考文档按需加载。

description.en: Disk review canvas: agent-written semantics, human decisions, previewed cleanup with undo.
description.zh: 磁盘审查盘面：Agent 写语义、你做决定，清理前预览、执行后可撤销。

description.en: DSH plugin: let the agent autonomously produce a complete paper (literature → outline → writing → LaTeX compile → citation audit → independent review → PDF export → Zotero/Obsidian archival). MIT.
description.zh: 让 DSH 自动从找文献一路做到导出 PDF 的完整论文，还能审稿和归档。

description.en: Turns PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files into Markdown or plain text with heading levels preserved where the source allows it, and refuses scanned PDFs that have no text layer instead of writing an empty file, naming the OCR alternative instead. Requires Python 3.10+ and pip install -r requirements.
description.zh: 把 PDF、Word、PPT、Excel 转成保留标题层级的 Markdown 或纯文本；遇到没有文字层的扫描件会主动拒绝（退出码 2），不会写一个空文件骗过下游，并指明可改用 OCR（dsh-scan2md）。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装仓库 requirements。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）人设插件：在设置页里用 12 个字段分段配置 agent 的名字、称呼、自称、语气与行为准则，每次注入都有记录可查。
description.zh: 在设置页分段配置 agent 的名字、称呼、语气和行为准则，每次注入都有记录可查。

description.en: Highlights sidebar session rows by state (pending approval, running, just finished) with color, animation and a matching status dot.
description.zh: 按待审批、运行中、刚完成三种状态给侧边栏会话行上色并加呼吸动效，行尾配同色状态点。

description.en: A transparent, draggable performance HUD for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: CPU, GPU and memory usage in three compact rows that float directly over the interface without any card background, snapping to the nearest window corner so resizing or maximising keeps them in place; CPU package temperature comes from an optional elevated helper (LibreHardwareMonitor + PawnIO) and the plugin itself stays at a fraction of a percent of CPU. Windows only.
description.zh: DSH 界面上的透明性能悬浮窗：三行小字直接浮在界面上显示 CPU、GPU、内存占用率，没有底色也没有边框，可拖动并吸附到最近的窗口角，最大化或改变窗口大小都不会跑位；CPU 封装温度由可选的高权限助手（LibreHardwareMonitor + PawnIO）读取，插件自身开销不到单核百分之一。仅 Windows。

description.en: DSH bundle that exposes host-wide performance metrics (CPU / memory / IO) via a Settings tab, an optional HUD, and a native agent tool.
description.zh: 在设置面板和悬浮窗里实时查看 CPU、内存、IO 等性能指标，还能让 AI 助手直接读取分析。

description.en: One settings page for DeepSeek Harness: global instructions (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) and long-term memory.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一个个性化设置页，集中管理全局指令和长期记忆，不用再手动翻文件。

description.en: DeepSeek 娘桌面宠物 · 随 DSH 的工作状态动起来：深度思考、坐下睡觉、余额播报、好感度成长。Electron 独立窗口 + Cordis 插件。
description.zh: 挂在桌面的 DeepSeek 娘宠物，跟着 DSH 工作状态动起来，还能播报余额、养好感度。

description.en: Folds the durable todo and goal events the dsh pet ignores into a percentage bubble on the pet, and falls back to a one-line activity summary for a session that never wrote a todo list. Requires the dsh web pet plugin (@linxin666/dsh-pet >= 0.4.0).
description.zh: 把 dsh 宠物忽略的 todo 与 goal 事件折成宠物气泡上的百分比进度；会话没有任务列表时退化为一行当前活动摘要。需先安装 dsh web pet 插件（@linxin666/dsh-pet >= 0.4.0）。

description.en: iOS home-screen fix and always-on kit for DeepSeek Harness remote access: overrides the PWA manifest start_url to /pair-app so the phone icon stops hitting the harness 401, and ships a hidden watchdog that keeps the desktop host and its tunnel alive while the PC is on. Requires @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui (it serves /pair-app); the watchdog scripts are Windows-only.
description.zh: DSH 手机远程访问的开箱即用修复套件：把 PWA manifest 的 start_url 改到 /pair-app，解决 iOS「添加到主屏幕」后打开停在 401 的问题；附常驻/守护脚本、自动登录与电源设置说明、中文排错手册。需安装 @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui（/pair-app 由它提供）；守护脚本仅 Windows。

description.en: Deterministic, one-way PII anonymizer at the start of the DeepSeek Harness agent loop
description.zh: 在智能体处理前自动把提示词里的姓名、电话等隐私信息单向匿名化，防止敏感数据外泄。

description.en: DSH Web UI overlay plugin: a collapsible plan & progress capsule showing the session todo list, completed count and current task.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面右上角显示会话计划与进度胶囊，实时读取 todo 清单，可折叠展开查看任务完成情况。

description.en: Development kit for DeepSeek Harness plugins: compose a profile, boot a throwaway shadow, verify the host half, capture the client half, roll back a broken profile
description.zh: 一套给 DSH 插件开发用的工具包，能组装配置、启动临时影子环境、校验宿主端、抓取客户端、回滚坏掉的配置。

description.en: Capability self-model plugin for DeepSeek Harness: measures what skills really deliver, injects the measured truth before use, and corrects skill descriptions overnight with backups and revert.
description.zh: 先测出每个技能的真实水平，用前自动注入实测结果，夜里还能自动修正技能描述并支持备份回滚。

description.en: Registers one agent tool, plugin_guard, that statically scans a DSH plugin package before it is installed and reports a verdict with the reasons: a missing or broken dsh.bundle.patch, a missing dsh.permissions block, install scripts, dangerous APIs and obfuscation, dependency risk, and source that is not indexed and therefore cannot be verified. Read-only: the scanned code is never imported, installed, evaluated or run.
description.zh: 注册一个 agent 工具 plugin_guard，在安装前对 DSH 插件包做静态扫描，给出判定与原因：缺少或损坏的 dsh.bundle.patch、未声明 dsh.permissions、安装脚本、危险 API 与代码混淆、依赖风险，以及未索引、无法核验的源码。只读：不导入、不安装、不求值、不运行被扫描的代码。

description.en: Magic Context for DeepSeek Harness: reversible context reclaim, an out-of-band historian, an m[0]/m[1] memory baseline, project memories, and the compaction seam.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个会记事的上下文管家，自动压缩回收、跨会话记住项目要点，聊得再久也不丢线索。

description.en: A minimal out-of-tree DeepSeek Harness plugin scaffold: compatibility gate, host service row, browser client anchor, build/test/smoke chain, and a rename checklist for derived plugins.
description.zh: 帮你快速搭好 DSH 插件骨架，兼容性检查、构建测试一条龙，改个名就能开工。

description.en: CJK-friendly full-text content search for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar (click-to-reveal + previous/next match navigation).
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏加上全文内容搜索，中文也能搜，点一下跳到对应位置，还能前后翻匹配。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）回答语音朗读插件：把回复念出来，切窗口/切会话立即停止，设置页可调
description.zh: 把 DSH 的回复用语音念出来，切窗口或切会话就自动停，设置里可调。

description.en: DSH 内建 STM32 工作台插件：Keil AC5 编译、ST-Link/OpenOCD 烧录、引脚规划、串口与功能契约（适配 DSH 0.2.1）
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话里直接编译、烧录和调试 STM32，还能规划引脚、看串口，不用来回切工具。

description.en: Drive Unreal Editor 5.8+ from DeepSeek Harness. Reverse-engineered from Epic's official Claude Code Unreal MCP plugin using REA.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控 Unreal Editor 5.8+，在编辑器里自动干活，省去手动操作。

description.en: Ziztu for DeepSeek Harness: plan, write and make micro dramas and anime episodes from your agent, through Ziztu's MCP server.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接规划、编写并生成微短剧和动漫剧集，创作一条龙。

description.en: DSH 工作台门户插件：双宽瀑布墙首页 + 极光底图 + 快捷入口
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一个瀑布墙工作台首页，卡片大小错落、极光底图随主题切换，点卡片直达对应面板。

description.en: DSH 插件：会话头电源按钮，重启/退出 DSH | Power menu for DeepSeek Harness desktop
description.zh: 在会话头加个电源按钮，一键重启或退出 DSH，不用再折腾托盘了。

description.en: Switch the agent preset (standard / PTC / cordis) of an already-started conversation from the session header. DSH host+client plugin.
description.zh: 对话开始后也能在会话头部随时切换 Agent 预设，不用重开对话。

description.en: RLM-style agent mode for DeepSeek Harness: the model writes code that calls tools and subagents, plus a self-refining Continual Harness that keeps scoped memory across sessions.

description.zh: 让 AI 主动向你提问，点选或输入即可直接作答，回答卡片更紧凑顺手。

description.en: DSH host plugin: counts automatic context compactions and injects one short project-handoff notice per turn.
description.zh: 自动统计上下文压缩次数，每轮对话注入一条简短的项目交接提醒，避免长会话丢上下文。

description.en: DSH bundle plugin: one-phrase project memory init (AGENTS.md + docs) for dev and ops workspaces
description.zh: 一句话初始化项目记忆体系，自动生成 AGENTS.md 和进度、问题、决策等文档，开发运维都适用。

description.en: Sparkle button immediately left of the model selector that rewrites the composer draft into an executable prompt in place, modelled on WorkBuddy: the host calls the conversation LLM with a prompt-engineering system prompt, multi-level undo keeps up to 8 previous drafts, and a token-level diff card shows added and removed spans, the number of changed spots and the net character delta. Runs on the session model, is disabled while the draft is empty, and keeps the browser-session cookie fence in front of the LLM call.
description.zh: 模型选择器左侧的 ✨：把草稿原地改写成可执行的提示词（对标 WorkBuddy），调用在宿主侧完成；多层撤销最多保留 8 版，逐字差异卡标出新增与删除、改动处数与净增字数；增强跟随会话当前模型，草稿为空时自动置灰，调用前做浏览器会话 Cookie 校验。

description.en: Prompt enhancement: click the star button in the composer to have the current model rewrite the draft more clearly, with one click back to the original; the template is editable.
description.zh: 增强提示词：点击发送框的星形按钮，用当前模型把草稿改写得更清晰，可一键切回原文；模板可编辑。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: adds the 芒果AI (mangoai-official) OpenAI-compatible provider to the native Models settings card on enable, removes it on disable
description.zh: 启用后自动把芒果AI接入原生模型设置卡，停用即移除，换模型不用折腾配置。

description.en: Pre-launch and runtime HTTP proxy control: writes the proxy into DSH's user-level .env so the launcher and the requests before any plugin loads use it, then keeps that file in sync from a switch in the Plugins page.
description.zh: 启动前与运行时的 HTTP 代理控制：把代理写入 DSH 用户级 .env，让启动器和任何插件加载前的请求也走代理，并在「插件」页用开关同步该文件。

description.en: 本机脉象：压缩判级 / 四道机械闸 / 未提交改动，做成 DSH 统计条上的一格常驻读数，点一下按配置跑命令集并把报告落成 md+json ｜ Local pulse for DSH: compaction grade, four mechanical gates and uncommitted changes as one always-on readout in the stats dock; one click runs your command set and writes an md + json report
description.zh: 在 DSH 统计条常驻显示压缩判级、四道机械闸和未提交改动，点一下跑命令集并生成 md+json 报告。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: reject shell text I/O - Select-String, Get-Content, findstr, rg, cat, node -e - in pwsh/bash/ops_bash, and point the agent at read/grep/glob.
description.zh: 拦截 pwsh/bash 里用命令行读文件、搜文本的写法，引导 AI 改用 read/grep/glob 工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness ↔ QQ 机器人桥插件（OneBot 11 / NapCat）
description.zh: 把 DSH 接到 QQ 机器人上，@ 一下就能直通对话，还能在插件面板里配连接、项目和画图视频。

description.en: Authors and checks Quarto Book chapters and maintains a reusable theme. The two skills load only inside a type: book repository. Requires Quarto CLI and Python 3.
description.zh: 为 Quarto Book 写章节、校验结构并维护可复用主题。两个技能只在 type: book 的仓库里加载。需 Quarto CLI 与 Python 3。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：选中助手正文，一键引用回复（只填草稿，不自动发送）
description.zh: 选中网页任意文字或会话标题，一键把内容变成引用块填进草稿，不自动发送，回复更省事。

description.en: DSH 一键快捷输入：在消息输入框旁边放一排可自定义的快捷指令按钮，点一下就把预设文字直接发送到当前对话，省去重复打字。名称、字号、透明度、模块化形状与发送内容均可就地编辑。
description.zh: 在输入框旁加一排可自定义快捷按钮，点一下就把预设文字发进对话，省去反复打字。

description.en: Replaces the host-side folder chooser in the Add workspace flow with a name dialog, so a remote browser can create and open a workspace instead of an OS dialog appearing on the Host screen.
description.zh: 將「新增工作區」流程中喺主機彈出嘅資料夾選擇器，改成輸入名稱嘅對話框，令遠端瀏覽器可以直接建立並開啟工作區。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness bundle that connects the REA reverse-engineering MCP server.
description.zh: 把 REA 逆向工程 MCP 服务器接进 DeepSeek Harness，直接在对话里做二进制分析和反编译。

description.en: Toggles the rea-mcp server on and off from the DSH Web UI session header or through the rea_mcp_toggle agent tool, so the 170 mcp__rea__* tool schemas stop being sent with every request while REA is off (the tools payload drops from about 722 KB to about 95 KB) and the REA child process exits; the choice is kept in a profile-scoped state file and restored at startup by a row-level disabled expression.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 会话标题栏或通过 rea_mcp_toggle 工具开关 rea-mcp 服务器：不用逆向时，170 个 mcp__rea__* 工具 schema 不再随每次请求发送（tools payload 由约 722 KB 降到约 95 KB），REA 子进程同时退出；选择存入 profile 级状态文件，重启后由行级 disabled 表达式恢复。

description.en: dsh 撤回插件：只撤最后一条用户消息，对话与工作区文件一起回退
DeepSeek Harness plugin: browse, search, copy and hide the prompts you sent to the AI across all sessions.
description.zh: 把你说给 AI 的话找回来：按会话浏览、全历史搜索、一键复制，还能把不想看的会话藏起来。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 桌面版插件：不关程序热重载插件与界面（类似 Ctrl+F5），或彻底结束程序并由独立重启器立即拉起。
description.zh: DSH 桌面版热重载小工具，不关程序就能刷新插件和界面，也能一键彻底重启。

description.en: 每条问题给具体改法，不是一句「请整改」
description.zh: 检查报告不只指出问题，还直接给出具体改法、预估耗时和验证方式，省去自己查资料。

description.en: DSH plugin: a remote-workspaces sidebar backed by an end-to-end encrypted mesh — other machines' workspaces, conversations and GUI on your loopback, plus remote agent dispatch. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 把别的电脑上的工作区、会话和整个界面搬到本机 127.0.0.1，还能远程派活给智能体，端到端加密。

description.en: Research-paper writing mode (agent preset) for DeepSeek Harness: literature search, polishing, style checks and citation formatting. 科研论文写作模式。
description.zh: 写论文的全流程助手，从查文献、润色到引用格式和返修都能帮你搞定。

description.en: One-click restart button for DeepSeek Harness · 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧栏一键重启按钮
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏加个重启按钮，点一下就能自动关闭并重新启动整个应用。

description.en: A small dock in the DSH Web UI: restart the host or reload the page in one click. Restart asks first (now / 30s / 60s / 2min / cancel); the dock drags to any edge only after a 320ms hold, and stays anchored when the window resizes. Refresh refuses to run unless the plugin bundle is verifiably loadable (timestamp baseline + real bundle fetch + syntax compile), so a reload can never brick the app. Restart is Windows-only (PowerShell 5.1); the UI and page refresh work on all platforms.
description.zh: DSH 界面上一小框：一键重启宿主、一键刷新页面。重启会先问「立即 / 30 秒 / 60 秒 / 2 分钟 / 取消」，倒计时可撤回；小框需长按 320ms 才能拖动（避免手一抖就粘住），拖到边缘自动吸附，窗口缩放时跟着走。刷新前会真正确认插件包能加载（文件时间戳 + 取回 bundle + 语法编译三重检查），任何一项拿不到就不刷——宁可多点一次，也不把应用刷成起不来的样子。重启仅 Windows（PowerShell 5.1）；界面与刷新功能全平台可用。

description.en: Adds a sidebar Restart button to DeepSeek Harness Desktop on Windows that stops the whole application process tree and reopens the app.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版侧边栏添加「重启」按钮：结束整个应用进程树并重新打开应用。

description.en: DSH 桌面版电源菜单：侧边栏一键「重启 DSH」/「关闭 DSH」。重启会自动重新打开应用，改完插件或配置不必再去托盘翻菜单。Windows/macOS，MIT。
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版侧边栏加个电源按钮，一键重启或关闭 DSH，改完插件配置不用再翻托盘菜单。

description.en: Revival coins for DeepSeek Harness: package this instance of the assistant (sessions, persona, plugins, plugin data, config) into a restorable coin with daily refresh, diff and one-command restore.
description.zh: 把助手当前的会话、角色、插件和配置打包成复活币，随时对比差异并一键还原。

description.en: Per-session identity layer for DeepSeek Harness: tool/skill allowlists, multi-parent inheritance, dynamic switching, and a new-session picker.
description.zh: 给每个会话单独配一套工具和技能权限，还能随时切换身份，开新会话时直接选。

description.en: Adds a configurable SAO-inspired full-screen startup animation to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可配置的 SAO 风格全屏启动动画。

description.en: OCR for scanned, image-only PDFs into Markdown, built around the fact that a book takes about an hour: every page is checkpointed so an interrupted run resumes, a progress log reports live status, and a quality report names empty pages and low-confidence lines. Requires Python 3.10+ and pip install -r requirements; the first run downloads the OCR model.
description.zh: 把扫描版 PDF（影印书、拍照件）OCR 成 Markdown，并按“一本书要跑约一小时”来设计：逐页写检查点，中断可续跑；进度日志随时可查；质量报告点名空白页和低置信行。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装仓库 requirements；首次运行会下载 OCR 模型。

description.en: Scheduled tasks: run a prompt on a fixed interval, each run opening a fresh session, with a run history.
description.zh: 定时任务：按周期定时执行提示词，每次触发都开启全新会话，并保留运行记录。

description.en: Native, instant region-screenshot button for the DeepSeek Harness composer: one click freezes the screen, a WeChat-style overlay (gray mask, green selection) appears, and the cropped PNG is inserted into the current draft. An optional eye toggle hides the whole DSH window before capturing, then restores it. No ms-screenclip, about 10 ms per drag frame, coexists with voice input. Windows 10/11 x64 only; the first capture compiles a helper with the built-in .NET Framework csc.exe.
description.zh: 输入框里的原生秒开截屏按钮：点一下冻结全屏，微信风格选区浮层（灰色遮罩、绿色边框），确认后截图自动插入当前会话草稿。相机旁的小眼睛可选「先隐藏整个 DSH 窗口再截屏」，截完自动恢复。不调用系统截图浮层，拖动约 10ms/帧，与语音输入并排共存。仅 Windows 10/11 x64；首次截屏会用系统自带的 .NET Framework csc.exe 编译辅助程序。

description.en: WeChat-style screenshot for the DeepSeek Harness composer: capture the screen (optionally hiding the DSH window), drag-select a region, and attach the image directly to the message. Windows + PowerShell server-side crop.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框加个截图按钮，框选屏幕区域后图片直接进附件栏，回车就能发。

description.en: 在 DSH 输入面板下方添加截图按钮：点击调用系统自带截图工具（Windows/macOS/Linux），截图后 Ctrl+V 粘贴进输入框
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入面板下加个截图按钮，一点就调起系统截图工具，截完直接粘贴进输入框。

description.en: Sensitive-data guard for DeepSeek Harness: blocks credential reads/outbound secrets and redacts secrets, tokens, and PII before they reach the model, logs, or spill files.
description.zh: 在敏感信息进入模型、日志或落盘前自动拦截凭据读取、阻断密钥外发，并脱敏密钥、令牌和个人信息。

description.en: Physically delete DeepSeek Harness Sessions through an undoable recycle bin: trash, restore, or purge for good.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话加个回收站，删掉的会话能恢复，确认不要了再彻底清掉。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a DeepSeek-web-style red Delete row in the sidebar session menu.
description.zh: 给侧边栏会话菜单加个红色删除项，点一下确认就能清掉会话，运行中的任务也会先停掉。

description.en: Lists DSH session records and archive caches on a sidebar page, moves deletions into a restorable recycle bin, and refuses sessions written within the last 10 minutes.
description.zh: 在侧边栏页面里列出 DSH 的会话记录与归档缓存，删除先移入可恢复的回收站，最近 10 分钟仍在写入的会话会被拒绝。

description.en: Purge billion-context (bili) leftovers after an archive-manager session delete completes. Plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 删会话后自动清掉 billion-context 快照索引和 cost-meter 账本残留，避免 bili 面板还挂着旧会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会话回收站插件：头部垃圾桶按钮与侧栏「删除会话」先归档、可还原；设置页集中管理归档会话，可真正删除磁盘日志并支持批量清理。Session recycle bin for DSH.
description.zh: 删会话先放回收站，误删能一键还原，确认不要了再彻底清掉磁盘日志。

description.en: 把会话或产物发布成只读公网链接：对话快照、HTML/Markdown 产物，可换风格、可撤销。
description.zh: 把对话或产物一键发布成只读公网链接，对方点开就能看，撤销后立即失效。

description.en: The machine's non-pwsh execution surfaces as one DSH tool: a WSL Linux userland, nushell's structured pipelines, the MSYS2 userland (bash/zsh/fish/brush), and a real console for interactive programs.
description.zh: 把 WSL、nushell、MSYS2 和真实终端整合成一个 DSH 工具，让 AI 直接跑各种 shell 命令。

description.en: DSH 侧边栏工作区按身份上色（OKLCH），标记当前对话标题标红，自带可视化设置面板
description.zh: 给侧边栏工作区按身份固定上色，当前对话标题标红，长列表里也能一眼找到自己。

description.en: Folds every panel row in the sidebar (slot-registered and plugin-injected alike) into one Plugin Hub entry, giving the workspace list its vertical space back.
description.zh: 把侧边栏里所有面板行（slot 注册与插件直接注入两类）折叠成单独一行「插件大全」，把被挤掉的工作区高度还给会话列表。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: VS Code-style sash dividers in the left sidebar, per-row compact mode with auto-shrinking content, and per-block collapse into icons above the avatar.
description.zh: 给 DSH 左侧栏加上可拖拽的分区隔条，每行能自动收缩成紧凑模式，还能把整块折叠成头像上方的小图标。

description.en: dsh-skill-mcp-panel (local build): 技能与 MCP 管理改为设置窗口分栏，不再占用侧栏与中央主区。基于上游 2.1.0。
description.zh: 把技能和 MCP 管理挪进设置窗口分栏，不再占用侧栏和主区，界面更清爽。

description.en: DSH 技能用量面板：本机装了哪些 skill、当前会话真的用过哪几个，命中次数与首末轮次一目了然 ｜ Skill usage panel for DSH: what is installed, what this session actually used, with hit counts and first/last turn
description.zh: 一眼看清本机装了哪些 skill、这次会话真用过哪几个，命中次数和首末轮次都列得明明白白。

description.en: DSH plugin: keeps the session skill catalog out of every request — skills are listed on demand, the ones a task needs are recorded once, and only a picked skill is loaded by name.
description.zh: 让技能目录按需加载，不再每次请求都带上，省 token 又提速。

description.en: Agent skills: browse, toggle and edit skills in the management page, and let the agent write new ones itself.
description.zh: Agent技能：在管理页里浏览、开关、编辑技能，也能让 Agent 自己写新技能。

description.en: Self-learning agent skills for DeepSeek Harness: evidence-gated auto-publishing, bounded growth and safe recovery.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体自己写技能、自己学，发布前有证据把关，还能安全回滚。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 主题插件：10 套内置主题，自由搭配配色、背景与风格，支持自定义图片和一键恢复官方外观。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换肤的主题插件，10 套内置主题随意搭配配色背景，还能用自定义图片，一键恢复官方外观。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness to the local Sourcebook Desktop library via MCP.
description.zh: 把本地 Sourcebook 资料库接进 DSH，跨会话保存研究笔记，随时挑素材进任务、把成果交回审阅。

description.en: Spec mode for the DeepSeek Harness: interview-driven requirements capture with a read-only working tree.
description.zh: 通过模型主导的增量访谈，把你的需求逐步整理成开发规范和项目文档，工作区只读更安全。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness remote workspace plugin: pick a host from ~/.ssh/config, pick a directory, and its files, terminals and commands all run on that machine through a daemon-backed SSH pipe with exactly-once side effects.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 里选台 SSH 主机和目录，文件、终端、命令全在远端跑，断线也不中断。

description.en: Bookmark turns from the conversation right-edge turn rail; bookmarked dashes grow longer so a specific turn stays easy to find.
description.zh: 在对话右侧的轮次轨道上给某一轮打书签，书签短横会变长，方便快速找回。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 550W 核心终端：启动动画 + 同款主题 + 访问门口令 + 开机体检
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上流浪地球 550W 风格启动动画、主题和门口令，还能开机自检。

description.en: Status Monitor - a live status layer for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: notification center, project/session states, live run steps, FLIP transitions, hand-crafted clear and accordion motion.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏加一层实时状态流，通知、会话状态和运行步骤一眼看清。

description.en: DSH Web UI 插件：每组过程步骤默认只显示最近 5 步，点一下看全部
description.zh: 过程步骤默认只显示最近5步，点一下展开全部，还能切换只回答/分步骤/无限制挡位。

description.en: 🥪 上面一片人设，下面一片封印，中间夹住整个 harness —— 两张贴纸钉住 system prompt 的两端，挂成可选 DSH 预置
description.zh: 用两张贴纸钉住 system prompt 首尾，中间全留给 DSH，做成可选预置，不选就一点不留。

description.en: Independent novel-writing plugin for DSH: settings, outlines, chapters, review and continuity.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里独立写小说，设定、大纲、章节、审稿和连贯性检查一站搞定。

description.en: Strata local inference provider and model manager for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH 里管理本地 Strata GGUF 模型、视觉投影文件、MTP 和调优配置，本地推理一站搞定。

description.en: Registers local Qoder, QoderCN, OpenCode, Pi and CodeBuddy CLIs as DSH subagent backends, with ordered model fallback, live progress, per-run credit display, a settings page, and slash commands. Requires the corresponding CLI installed and logged in.
description.zh: 把本机 Qoder、QoderCN、OpenCode、Pi、CodeBuddy 等 CLI 注册为 DSH 子代理后端，支持模型故障转移链、实时进度、单次额度显示、设置页与斜杠指令。需先安装并登录对应 CLI。

description.en: DSH Web plugin for Suhuang Scroll grading controls in Better Sidebar
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏里给老师提供苏黄共阅的阅卷控制和状态面板，配置一次就能用。

description.en: Self-maintained DSH web task board with a human acceptance gate, card kinds and editable notes on executed cards.
description.zh: 自维护的 DSH 网页任务看板：带人工验收闸门、卡片类型与已执行卡片的可编辑备注。

description.en: Task details sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: a "View task details" button under every finished turn opens a resizable right-sidebar panel showing that task's input files, intermediate artifacts, output files, tools and skills used, inferred languages, a step-by-step flow timeline, and the model provider with token usage and cache hit rate.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务详情侧边栏：每个已结束任务的最下方显示「查看任务详情」，点开后从右侧边栏打开可拖拽调宽的面板，列出该任务的输入文件、中间产物、输出文件、所用工具与 skill、推断出的语言、按步骤组织的流程时间线，以及模型提供方与 Token 用量、缓存命中率。

description.en: 角色茶话会模式 | Character Tea Party Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): 8 LLM-girls roleplay around a tea table + per-message speaker avatars
description.zh: 给 dsh 加个「角色茶话会」模式，让 8 位大模型娘围桌语c聊天，每条回复还带头像。

description.en: Agent Teams 泳道看板 for DeepSeek Harness — 依赖 DAG 连线 + 通讯流，布局移植自 cc-haha
description.zh: 把 Agent Teams 的协作关系画成泳道看板，依赖连线和通讯流一眼看清，方便盯进度、查卡点。

description.en: Fixes the buddy / workbuddy channel 400 (code 11128, "Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel") in DeepSeek Harness, and re-applies the fix after every dsh-our-free-model upgrade.
DSH 测试自动修复：给 agent 一个 run_tests 工具，跑测试并把结构化失败（文件/行号/断言）直接交给它修复。自动识别 pytest / jest / vitest / cargo / go / npm，Windows 中文断言不乱码，同一失败反复出现时自动停止。
description.zh: 给 agent 一个 run_tests 工具，跑测试后把失败的文件、行号和断言直接交给它自动修复。

description.en: Two switchable design languages for the DSH GUI — liquid glass with inner-lit surfaces and pointer specular, and Soviet constructivism with cream/ink/red poster geometry — plus a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs, and a seven-expression whale-girl pet.
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面的两套可切换设计语言：内部发光的液态玻璃，与米色/血红/墨黑的苏联构成主义海报；附带个性化面板、投放式 CSS 皮肤包与 7 种表情的鲸鱼娘桌宠。

description.en: 四套可切换的 DeepSeek Harness 界面皮肤（樱风 / 褐东风 / 潮汐 / 月壤），纯设计令牌覆盖，不改宿主源码 · Four switchable theme skins for the DeepSeek Harness web UI
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面一键换四套皮肤，明暗自动跟随，不改源码只叠样式。

description.en: Four curated color skins (Aurora, Night Flight, Nordfjord, Sakura) for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with light/dark palettes and a settings picker.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上 4 套精选配色，自动适配深浅色，一键切换还能记住选择。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在聊天里用 /think 查看或切换当前会话的思考等级（Web 指令适配器 + QQ 机器人通道）
description.zh: 在聊天里用 /think 随时查看或切换当前会话的思考等级，Web 和 QQ 机器人都能用。

description.en: Algorithm field guide for graphics, animation, physics and AI work — 219 entries with tradeoffs and links to existing implementations, exposed as 10 agent tools and a sidebar page. AI-assisted tools require DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
description.zh: 图形/动画/物理/AI 算法的可查询天书——219 条术法，带取舍说明与现成实现链接，提供 10 个 agent 工具与侧栏页面。AI 工具需 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。

description.en: Tilda MCP accounts for DeepSeek Harness: add, remove and switch client accounts from Settings, a composer chip, or /tilda.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接增删和切换 Tilda 客户 MCP 账号，不用改 YAML 也不用重启。

description.en: Keeps the /tmp cleanup daemon alive: an in-process watchdog revives it within about two minutes after Android kills it, runs the due cleanup inside dsh while it stays down, and adds a settings page for status, config, clean and dry-run. The cleaner ships inside the package (bin/tmp-clean, Python 3), so no extra install step is needed.
description.zh: 保证 /tmp 清理守护进程常驻：被 Android 杀掉后约 2 分钟内由 dsh 进程内看门狗复活，守护进程持续不在时由 dsh 自己兜底清理；设置页可看状态、改配置、立即清理或演练。清理工具随包自带（bin/tmp-clean，Python 3），装好即用。

description.en: DSH 插件：会话中记录待办，自动记录上下文中关于这个待办事项的关键内容，等需要处理时可在新会话中直接开始任务，无需从头调查也不用再次说明情况
description.zh: 随手记下会话里的待办，自动保存上下文，以后新会话直接接着干，不用重新调查或解释。

description.en: DSH 侧边栏 Token 用量统计：趋势柱状图 / 热力图 / 模型环 / 会话与供应商统计 / 插件-MCP-Skill 榜 / 会话「用量」tab，纯本地分析
description.zh: 在侧边栏统计全历史会话的 Token 用量，用柱状图、热力图和模型环直观展示消耗趋势，帮你摸清成本花在哪。

description.en: token-poker 的 DeepSeek Harness 移植版 —— Agent 陪玩的虚拟筹码德州扑克（Earn Tokens 风格）
description.zh: 让 AI 助手陪你玩虚拟筹码德州扑克，边玩边赚 token，轻松又有趣。

description.en: Live decode speed (tok/s) pill in the composer status bar that tracks the currently streaming response.
description.zh: 在输入栏状态栏中实时显示当前流式响应解码速度（tok/s）的插件。

description.en: 白小纯修仙工具插件 —— DSH (Cordis) 插件：今日灵签/灵气检测/修为汇报
description.zh: 把修仙角色白小纯做成 DSH 小工具，能抽今日灵签、测灵气、报修为，给对话加点修仙乐子。

description.en: DSH Web GUI 插件：把 Think 与连续工具调用压成一条可折叠的横向胶囊工具链，模型说话才截断。
description.zh: 把 Think 和连续工具调用收成一条可折叠的横向胶囊链，模型开口才断开，工具流程一眼看清。
