description.zh: 把视频一键拆成脚本、分镜和风格指南，方便内容创作和复盘。

description.en: 给 dsh-bili-scroll 补上 B站 点赞/收藏/关注/转发/发动态（默认关 + 代码级硬上限）
description.zh: 给 B 站刷视频插件补上点赞、收藏、转发、关注和发动态，默认关闭还有硬上限，放心用。

description.en: DSH 插件：每天替你刷一轮 B 站 —— 读字幕原文判断、每条写结论、把这一轮的总结发邮件/写 Obsidian、推荐的进稍后再看。
description.zh: 每天自动帮你刷一轮B站，读字幕写结论，把总结发邮箱或Obsidian，好视频顺手加入稍后再看。

description.en: Two-rule, zero-runtime Morandi mist-blue theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI - 75x smaller than the original, no observers, timers or polling.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上莫兰迪雾蓝配色，零运行时开销，比原版小 75 倍，好看又不卡。

description.en: 划词分支助手：框选回答文字，一键创建分支会话，保留原文标记与分支树面板（DeepSeek Harness Web 插件）
description.zh: 框选回答里的文字就能一键开分支会话，原文留标记，分支树随时切换查看。

description.en: DSH bundle that supervises the BrowserSkill (bsk) bridge daemon as a host child process: starts with DSH, stops with DSH, auto-restarts after crashes.
description.zh: 让 BrowserSkill 桥接守护进程跟着 DSH 一起启停，崩溃后自动重启，不用手动管。

description.en: Turns real git history into two Chinese changelog drafts (short for users, long for developers); every entry carries its commit SHA and an evidence-backed verified/unverified mark, and commit subjects are never translated.
description.zh: 从真实 git 历史生成两份中文变更日志（面向用户短版、面向开发者长版）；每条都带 commit SHA 与「已验证／未验证」标记，只有能引用到验证证据时才标「已验证」，提交主题不翻译。

description.en: 为 DSH NEXT 提供会话删除、搜索管理、删除确认和可选备份的社区插件。
description.zh: 给 DSH NEXT 清理对话的插件，能统一查看、批量归档、按规则保留，确认后再删，还能顺手备份。
给聊天对话区加背景图，自动调节亮度和对比度，保证文字看得清，深浅主题都能用。

description.en: Hello Kitty pink theme skin for the DSH Web UI: overrides the --dsw-alias-* semantic tokens in light and dark mode and paints a custom wallpaper on the app frame. Installs as a static profile plugin, so the theme restores automatically on every Harness start.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的 Hello Kitty 粉色主题皮肤：覆盖 --dsw-alias-* 语义 token（浅色/深色），并给主框架铺上自定义壁纸；作为静态 profile 插件安装，Harness 每次启动自动恢复。

description.en: Codex-style file-based long-term memory for DSH: two-stage extraction, consolidated MEMORY.md handbook, prompt-injected summary, and search/read/list/note tools.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上跨会话长期记忆，自动整理历史会话成可搜索手册，每轮对话前注入摘要。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 官方与开源生态「插件与 Skill 双生态市场」一键安装与资产管理中心 (Plugins & Skills Market)
description.zh: DSH 插件和 Skill 的一站式市场，能一键安装、统一管理官方与开源生态的扩展资源。

description.en: In-app Community Bench tab for DeepSeek Harness: reads the public task-conditioned registry; no local scoring.
description.zh: 在应用内直接查看社区公开评测榜单，和所有人看到同一份数据，不本地打分。

description.en: Model-free local-handoff compaction backend for DeepSeek Harness
macOS cross-application desktop tools for DSH using CuaDriver, with a hidden agent cursor, background window selection and post-action observations.
description.zh: 基于 CuaDriver 的 macOS 跨应用桌面工具，默认隐藏虚拟光标，支持后台窗口选择和操作后界面回读。

description.en: Sidebar context/billing dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: live context ring, per-session usage & spend, account balance and token-plan quota readouts across configured LLM channels.
description.zh: 在侧边栏实时看上下文占用、会话花费、账户余额和额度，随时掌握用量。

description.en: DSH plugin: shows the current session's estimated cost in CNY in the composer dock; open it for a receipt-style breakdown and account balance.
description.zh: 在输入框底部实时显示当前会话花了多少钱，点开还能看费用明细和账号余额。

description.en: 轻量化的QoL插件，可在助手消息元数据行追加本轮 token 费用估算（¥）。
description.zh: 在助手消息元数据行显示本轮 token 花费估算，按高峰/空闲单价算钱，一眼看清每轮成本。

description.en: DSH 凭据管理设置页插件：列出/新增/删除 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml 的 refs（值只进不出）
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页里管理长期凭据，能列出、新增、覆盖、删除，但值只进不出。

description.en: Run Python on the local NVIDIA CUDA GPU from DeepSeek Harness: device status, foreground and detached jobs, durable logs, and a measured peak-VRAM figure per run.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接跑本地 NVIDIA CUDA GPU 的 Python 任务：设备状态、前台/后台作业、持久日志、每次运行实测的峰值显存。

description.en: Fonts and code-font settings for the UI with an English-only glyph scale (100-160%), a -4..+8 px content-size offset that actually applies, and settings kept across refreshes - a maintained fork of lsh2002/dsh-custom-fonts.
description.zh: 在设置页自定义界面中英文与代码字体，支持只放大拉丁字形的英文字形缩放（100-160%）与 -4..+8 px 的内容字号偏移，刷新后保留设置；lsh2002/dsh-custom-fonts 的维护分支。

description.en: Adds a Custom CSS section to Settings for adjusting dialog dimensions, font sizes, full-window wallpapers, and inspecting stable selectors.
description.zh: 在设置界面中调节弹窗尺寸、字号、全屏背景图与选择器速查，热注入自定义 CSS。

description.en: DSH bundle plugin: author Python tools in the Web UI or through agent tools, register them as first-class DSH tools, gate dangerous runs through built-in approval, group tools into packs.
description.zh: 在网页或对话里用 Python 写工具，保存即注册成 DSH 工具，危险操作走审批，还能打包分组。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：昔涟（Cyrene）两套 agent 预设——纯文本对话模式 / 昔涟工作模式；随包世界书、长期记忆与称呼，安装即注册预设。
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: deepseek_pricing_tier — is the DeepSeek API on peak (full price) or off-peak (half price) right now, and when does it flip. Zero network, no API key.
description.zh: 随时查看 DeepSeek API 当前是高峰全价还是低谷半价，还能知道几点切换，不用联网也不用密钥。

description.en: DeepSeek 余额/用量浮窗（DSH 长期插件）：官方余额 + 今日用量 + 峰谷计价 + 官方价目自动同步
description.zh: 在页面右上角悬浮显示 DeepSeek 账户余额和今日用量，自动按峰谷价算成本，价目表自动同步。

description.en: DocChain knowledge base and document conversion toolkit — filename, content and metadata search, topic listing, bulk document upload, document-to-Markdown conversion, image-similarity search, and a deep-research workflow. The configuration page keeps several docchain environments (each with its own address and credential), switches between them in one click, and pre-selects topics per environment. Needs a docchain service URL and API key (except doc2markdown).
description.zh: 知识库和文档转换插件：文档文件名、内容与元数据检索，主题查询，文档批量上传，文档转 Markdown，图搜图，并附带深度研究工作流。配置页可保存多个 docchain 环境（各带独立地址与凭据）并一键切换，还可按环境预选主题。除 doc2markdown 外需配置 docchain 服务地址与 API key。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: in-app toast + system notifications when a conversation finishes running, with a Settings page to configure it.
description.zh: 对话跑完或等你选择时，用页面提示卡片和桌面系统通知提醒你，还能在设置页里自己调。

description.en: Persistent named agents (dots) for DeepSeek Harness with a root-level panel and multi-host control.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一批有名字的常驻 Agent，用根级面板统一管理，还能把多个 Host 打包一起控制。

description.en: Take a local video all the way to a Douyin creator post: open the upload page, trigger the picker, hand the file over with verification, fill the title, set visibility - then stop before publishing unless explicitly told to publish.
description.zh: 把本地视频送到抖音投稿页的「待发布」状态：打开投稿页、真实点上传、递文件（回读校验）、填标题、设可见性，然后默认停手——可见性默认仅自己可见、不点发布。

description.en: Doxygen comment workflow for C/C++ (including Qt) sources: file headers, functions, module groups, trailing and short comments, plus a scan that flags comments whose signature fingerprint went stale. Requires Python 3.10+ with `pip install tree-sitter tree-sitter-cpp`.
description.zh: 为 C/C++（含 Qt）源码生成与维护 Doxygen 注释的工作流：文件头、函数、模块分组、行尾与简短注释，并扫描出签名指纹已过期、需要更新的注释。运行时需要 Python 3.10+ 并 `pip install tree-sitter tree-sitter-cpp`。

description.en: dsh 梦境记忆整合插件：凌晨随机窗口把记忆梦境化（裸上下文 narrative 纯梦写作）+ 信号驱动洞察晋升 + MEMORY.md 预算管理，随 dsh web 启停
description.zh: 每天凌晨随机时间把记忆写成梦境日记，自动挑出高价值洞察存回 MEMORY.md，还能在网页上翻看。

description.en: DSH 出站流量路由插件：DeepSeek 直连，外网模型与网页抓取走代理 · Egress router for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 模型请求直连、外网抓取走代理，代理挂了自动回落直连，可在设置里一键切换。

description.en: DSH 长 prompt 编辑插件：右侧栏编辑面板 / 扩展输入框 / 原生输入框 deck 与高级回车
description.zh: 在右侧栏或扩展输入框里舒服地编辑长 prompt，回车键也能玩出高级操作。

description.en: DSH Web GUI 插件：主对话右上角「?」弹出独立浮窗，用白话中文解释主 agent 正在做什么。只读、不打扰主 agent
description.zh: 主对话右上角点「?」开个浮窗，用大白话讲清主 agent 正在干啥，只看不动手。

description.en: Hand a local file to any program's file picker: wait for the native Open dialog, paste the path through the clipboard, read it back to verify character by character, then confirm. The target is always explicit and every step leaves evidence. Windows only (EnumWindows / UI Automation).
description.zh: 把本地文件交给任何程序的「打开文件」对话框：等对话框出现、走剪贴板填路径、读回来逐字核对、再点确认。目标必须显式给，每一步都留证据——文件上传、微信发文件、PS 打开都能用它代劳。仅 Windows（依赖 EnumWindows / UI Automation）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：侧栏工作区文件树右键，一键把文件/文件夹以原生 @引用 chip 插入输入框｜Right-click a file-tree row to insert a native @ reference chip into the composer.
description.zh: 右键侧栏文件树里的文件或文件夹，一键以原生 @引用 chip 插进输入框，省去手打路径的麻烦。

description.en: Flow Next for DeepSeek Harness: task context, native/PTC selection and check evidence. Experimental community preset.
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体加上任务上下文、原生/PTC 接口选择和检查证据，实验性社区预设。

description.en: Arms a watch on a directory and delivers a batched, deduplicated diff when the tree goes quiet, filtering out the writes the session made itself; delivery is per watch, either waking a new turn or queueing for the next step.
description.zh: 监视目录，在文件树安静后投递批量合并、去重的变更清单，并过滤掉本会话自己的写入；投递方式按监视器选择，可起新回合或排队到下一步。

description.en: DSH-for-AGI 开屏动画：9.9 秒五幕启动链 + 中文旁白，可跳过、可配置
description.zh: 给 DSH 冷启动加一段带中文旁白的开屏动画，五幕走完真实启动链，可跳过也能配置。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 用の日本語ネイティブ TUI（設計段階 / design phase）

Extend the built-in glob/grep tools: symlink following by default, extra grep flags, and a parallel glob that still returns newest first · 增强 DSH 内置的 glob / grep：默认跟随符号链接，grep 增加忽略大小写、上下文、文件类型，glob 并行扫描但结果仍按修改时间倒序
description.zh: 给 DSH 自带的 glob/grep 加料：默认跟随符号链接，grep 支持忽略大小写、上下文和文件类型，glob 并行搜索还按最新优先返回。

description.en: Git worktree panel for DeepSeek Harness: branch/merge topology, worktrees, changes and file tree.
description.zh: 在侧栏里只读查看 Git 分支拓扑、工作树和文件改动，不用切换目录或提交。

description.en: Independent goal governance for DeepSeek Harness: a standing goal charter plus a role-isolated reviewer that audits goal drift at turn boundaries, without micromanaging the executor. Design grounded in management science (MBO, PDCA, COSO, RACI, management-by-exception).
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个独立目标监督员，在每轮对话边界检查目标有没有跑偏，但不插手执行。

description.en: Excalidraw canvases in the workspace, with five agent tools to create, read and update .excalidraw files, the rendered PNG handed back to the model so it can see its own drawing, and a right-sidebar editor panel in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 让 Agent 在工作区里画 Excalidraw 图，还能把渲染好的图回传给模型自己看。

description.en: Grok (xAI) subscription provider for DeepSeek Harness: PKCE login, chat, usage chip, optional Imagine
description.zh: 用 xAI 账号直接登录 Grok，免 API 密钥，聊天、用量一目了然，还能选配图片生成。

description.en: Windows GUI automation reliability layer: probes whether a window is minimized, foreground or DPI-scaled, then clicks and types with the coordinate space and activation order handled for you. Zero dependencies, local only.
description.zh: Windows 窗口操作的可靠性层：先体检目标窗口是否最小化、是否在前台、有没有 DPI 缩放，再点击与输入——坐标口径和激活顺序由它处理。零依赖、纯本地、不联网。

description.en: OpenChamber-style handoff review for DeepSeek Harness: linked read-only review sessions, round by round.
description.zh: 把当前会话的改动交给一个只读的关联审查会话，一轮一轮地做交接评审。

description.en: dsh 心跳插件：定时触发 HEARTBEAT.md 检查 + 自动归档，随 dsh web 启停
description.zh: 定时检查 HEARTBEAT.md 并自动归档，让法塔自己决定要不要主动给你发消息，随 dsh web 一起启停。

description.en: A minimal DeepSeek Harness plugin used to exercise dsh-github-publisher end to end: one loader row, one demo tool.
description.zh: 一个极简 DSH 插件，注册 hello_publisher 示例工具，用来验证发布链路是否跑通。

description.en: 把 Hermes 的人设、长期记忆、技能库、MCP 服务器与 OpenViking 知识库原生接进 DeepSeek Harness —— 每一项能力都是可独立启停的一行。
description.zh: 把 Hermes 的人设、记忆、技能库、MCP 服务器和 OpenViking 知识库接进 DSH，每项能力都能单独开关。

description.en: Publishes the desktop shell's file-path bridge as the host-path seam the composer reads, so files and folders dropped into the composer become @path references instead of uploaded copies (images still upload through the native image channel).
description.zh: 把桌面壳的文件路径桥接发布为输入框读取的 host-path 接口，让拖入输入框的文件与文件夹变成 @path 引用而不是上传副本（图片仍走原生图片通道上传）。
集中管理所有插件的快捷键，支持自由绑定与冲突处理，告别分散设置，操作更顺手。

description.en: Multi-source image search & download for DeepSeek Harness: 19 engines (Baidu/Bing/360/Duitang/Huaban/DuckDuckGo/Yandex/Openverse/Wikimedia/Pixiv/Wallhaven/Konachan/Safebooru/Iconify), saves into the session workspace with per-file meta.json and renders inline.
description.zh: 一个插件聚合19个图片搜索引擎，搜图、找素材、批量下载一站搞定。

description.en: Structured image recognition: local sharp measurements plus a cloud vision model return description, OCR with coordinates, object locations and fine-grained attributes in one call; a fingerprint cache makes repeated images return in milliseconds without spending model quota.
description.zh: 结构化图像识别：本地 sharp 感知 + 云端视觉模型，一次调用拿到描述、带坐标的 OCR、 目标定位与细粒度属性；图片指纹缓存让重复图片毫秒返回且不消耗模型额度。

description.en: Unofficial Golden Spatula fan theme for the DSH Web GUI: an original hextech arena backdrop with a golden spatula crest (a parchment chart in light mode), four accent palettes (gold, cyan, violet, blue), a hex-board lattice, an optional aurora-and-gold-dust ambience, soft or sharp corners, and a floating hex-core panel that can turn the theme off without uninstalling.
description.zh: 金铲铲同人风格的 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面主题：原创海克斯竞技场背景与金色铲影（浅色为羊皮纸棋盘地图），金/青/紫/蓝四套强化配色与令牌覆盖，界面底层铺六边形棋盘网格，另有可开关的极光与金色浮尘氛围、圆润/锐利棱角切换；右下角「海克斯核心」面板可一键关闭、即时还原原生界面；不含游戏素材。

description.en: 思维年轮 DSH 浮动面板：右上角「年」按钮，读取本机 journal API（非官方插件）。
description.zh: 在 DSH 右上角加个「年」按钮，点开就能快速查看会话数、洞察状态和本周摘要。

description.en: Bundles the kb-curator skill, which keeps a local three-layer knowledge base and refuses to index anything the user has not approved. The L2 retrieval layer needs @kenz1117/dsh-engram installed separately, and the engine runs on Windows only.
description.zh: 捆绑 kb-curator 技能，用本地三层知识库保存资料，未获用户批准前不写入索引。L2 检索层需另装 @kenz1117/dsh-engram，且引擎目前仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Kingdee Cloud Starry Sky (金蝶云星空) WebAPI plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — typed agent tools to query, save, submit, audit, un-audit, view and delete bills/base data and to invoke BOS custom services.
description.zh: 让 DSH 助手直接操作金蝶云星空，查单、保存、提交、审核、反审核、查看和删除单据及基础资料，还能调用 BOS 自定义服务。

description.en: Pixel-art Little Red Riding Hood pet for the DSH session window: transparent and always on top, it walks back and forth along the composer, blinks, looks around, turns its head toward the cursor, sleeps on double-click, and scales from 2x to 7x in a right-click panel.
description.zh: 会话窗口里的像素桌宠「小红帽蕾克」：透明无边框、始终置顶，在输入框上沿来回走动，会眨眼、张望、蹦跳，鼠标靠近会转头看你，双击原地睡觉，右键面板可调 2×~7× 大小。

description.en: DSH 用量与余额：会话用量、按每笔实际发生时刻与模型计价的费用（峰谷/档位）、账户余额；账号登录无需 API Key。
description.zh: 看会话用了多少 token、按每笔请求当时的价格算花销，还能查账户余额，登录就能用不用配 API Key。

description.en: One screen for every work you have shipped: local project facts, GitHub stars and last push, whether the plugin market has picked it up and how many downloads it has, plus pending pull-request wait times against the upstream median.
description.zh: 一屏看清每个作品的现状：本地版本与文件数、GitHub star 与最后推送、市场是否已收录及下载量、收录 PR 等待时长对比上游中位数；全部只读、数字都来自 API，不经模型生成。

description.en: Live-preview panel for DeepSeek Harness: preview workspace pages beside the chat, auto-reload on save. · DeepSeek Harness 实时预览插件：边聊边看你的页面，改完自动刷新。
description.zh: 在聊天旁边开个实时预览面板，边聊边看工作区页面，保存后自动刷新。

description.en: Hot-reloads DSH plugin modules without restarting the app (module-cache purge, junction-path matching, bust fallback) and registers a refresh button in the session header so the browser page loads the new plugin bundles.
description.zh: DSH 插件免重启热重载：清模块缓存、按 junction 路径匹配、失败时带版本号重新导入， 并在会话标题栏注册一颗刷新按钮，让页面立刻加载新的插件 bundle。

description.en: Live wallpaper layer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — procedural presets, images, GIF and video behind a translucent shell
Per-turn and whole-session LLM cost meter for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在输入框下方和每轮对话旁显示 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 花费，点开还能看明细，帮你随时掌握用钱情况。

description.en: Japanese (ja) UI locale and font pack for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) web GUI — for the desktop app and dsh web profiles
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面加上日语，设置里一键切换，界面文字全变日文。

description.en: Русская локализация DeepSeek Harness: языковой пакет и пайплайн перевода
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加上俄语语言包，并附带一套翻译流程，让俄语用户直接上手使用。
压缩后用户原话被隐藏？这个插件把原文完整留存，并按预算重新注入上下文，保证不丢信息。

description.en: DSH Maestro5 — Lead + L1–L5 difficulty-tier subagents for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). One install adds the Team Lead session mode and a per-tier model configuration page. ｜ DSH 团队模式插件：主控 + 五档难度子智能体，安装即得配置界面。
description.zh: 装上就给 DSH 加个团队模式：一个主控带 L1–L5 五档难度子智能体，还能按档位分别配模型。

description.en: One-click move a running shell command to the background in DeepSeek Harness: a run tool whose card carries a small SVG U-turn button.
description.zh: 正在跑的前台 shell 命令，点一下就能转成后台任务，不用干等超时。

description.en: 把 DSH 回答里的数学公式复制成可在 Obsidian / LaTeX 中重新渲染的 TeX：悬停公式复制、选中带公式的文本时还原源码。
description.zh: 把 DSH 回答里的数学公式一键复制成 TeX 源码，粘到 Obsidian 或 LaTeX 里能直接重新渲染。

description.en: One MCP proxy tool for DeepSeek Harness: search, describe and call MCP tools on demand instead of loading every schema into context
description.zh: 把 MCP 工具收进一个代理入口，按需搜索、查看和调用，不用把所有 schema 都塞进上下文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: an MCP console for one profile — server overview, live tool inventory with full JSON Schema, connectivity probe, add/enable/disable with byte-preserving patch edits.
description.zh: 在设置页统一查看和管理当前 profile 的 MCP 服务器，能看工具清单、测连通性，还能直接增删启停。

description.en: 轻量级 DeepSeek Harness MCP 服务管理器：查看/启停/增删/导出本机已接入的 MCP 服务，零依赖，含设置页 UI。
description.zh: 轻量管理本机 MCP 服务，能查看、启停、增删、导出，还能从 Claude Desktop、Cursor 等客户端扫描导入配置。

description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness — a Settings page to list, enable/disable, edit, add, remove, probe and import/export the profile's MCP servers without hand-editing YAML. · DSH MCP 服务器管理面板
description.zh: 在设置页里管理 MCP 服务器，增删改查、启停、探测和导入导出都不用改 YAML。

description.en: Memory manager for DeepSeek Harness — global and project-scoped markdown memories: memory_* tools, system-prompt digest injection, and a read-only Settings page. · DSH 记忆管理（全局 + 项目级）
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体加一套文件式长期记忆，全局和项目笔记都能存，还会自动把重点塞进提示词。

description.en: Layered long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (Cordis): project/global/habit stores, progressive disclosure, zero-LLM core, two-gate habit learning.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上跨项目长期记忆，能记住项目、全局偏好和习惯，越用越顺手。

description.en: DSH 记忆/规则插件：索引式注入 + 本地检索 + 轮末提炼草稿审批 + supersedes 版本链；零依赖、按工作区存储
description.zh: 让 AI 每轮自动记住你的偏好和规则，跨工作区持久保存，随时调用管理。

description.en: Local token totals, per-model usage and a 12-week heatmap in a Chinese sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在中文侧栏面板中展示本地 Token 总量、模型用量与 12 周热力图。
在 Apple Silicon Mac 上一键跑本地大模型，自动管好 Python 环境和 mlx_lm.server，并接入 DSH 使用。

description.en: Turns the desktop layout into a thumb-friendly one: swipe drawer sidebar with adjustable width, layered back key, bigger tap targets, keyboard avoidance and a 15px font floor.
description.zh: 把电脑版界面调成适合手指用的样子：侧栏变可滑动的抽屉、宽度可调、返回键逐层退出、按钮放大、键盘不挡输入框、字号不小于 15px。

description.en: 模型故障转移队列：当前模型限额/限流/不可用时自动切到队列下一个模型继续，全图形界面配置 | Model fallback queue for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 当前模型限额、限流或不可用时，自动切到队列里的下一个模型接着干，图形界面就能配。

description.en: Sync DeepSeek Harness model configuration and third-party API keys across machines, over S3-compatible storage or WebDAV
description.zh: 把模型配置和第三方 API Key 同步到多台电脑，换机登录后拉取一次即可恢复。

description.en: A prompt enhancing plugin for newly released t2p model MOSS Image
description.zh: 给 MOSS Image 文生图模型自动润色提示词，让出图更贴合你的想法。

description.en: Multi-model deliberation pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: independent proposals, blind peer review, program-executed evidence verification, immutable revision and independent acceptance on a fresh context.
description.zh: DSH 多模型协作研讨插件：独立提案、互审、证据核验、完整稿修订与新上下文验收。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-multi-model-discussion
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-multi-model-discussion

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: Full-page NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH: daily recommendations, playlist browsing by category, charts, new releases, search, playlist/album/artist pages, QR-code login, synced lyrics, queue and downloads, plus four agent tools for search, song URLs, lyrics and playlist tracks.
description.zh: 整页式网易云音乐播放器：每日推荐、按分类浏览歌单广场、排行榜、新碟上架、搜索、歌单/专辑/歌手页、扫码登录、逐行歌词、队列与下载，并提供搜索、歌曲直链、歌词、歌单曲目四个 agent 工具。

description.en: Inline next-message suggestions and one-click prompt improvement for DeepSeek Harness. Tab to accept. Click to refine. You send.
description.zh: 在输入框里直接给出下一条消息建议，按 Tab 采纳、点一下就能润色，帮你更快写出好提示词。

description.en: Nord Theme for DSH

description.zh: 在 macOS、Linux、Windows 上给应用图标加未读角标，并通过桌面、浏览器和 webhook 推送提醒，不错过任何消息。

description.en: this is a tool for novel writing.
description.zh: 写长篇小说用的辅助插件，帮你把设定、章节和写作流程管起来，专心码字不跑偏。

description.en: Auto-continues a reply that was cut off at the output token limit, and gives every Our Free Model route its own request parameters (reasoning effort, max tokens, temperature, stop sequences) in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 回答被输出上限截断时自动帮你续写，还能给每条 Our Free Model 线路单独调推理强度、token 上限等参数。

description.en: Ollama Cloud for DeepSeek Harness: one API key, auto-pulled model catalog, real thinking levels, hosted web tools, and 5h/7d quota + token usage UI
description.zh: 一个 API Key 就能在 DSH 里用上 Ollama Cloud 模型，自动拉取模型列表，还能看额度和用量。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show the Ollama Cloud credit balance and recent usage as a Settings section, with an in-page API key editor.
description.zh: 在设置里直接查看 Ollama Cloud 额度余额和近期用量，还能顺手填或换 API Key。
在侧边栏实时显示 Ollama 云配额用量进度条和重置倒计时，随时掌握还能用多少。
让 dsh 的 web_search 直连 Ollama 云搜索，不用本地部署，一次 HTTP 请求就拿到结果。

description.en: A coastal theme for official macOS DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2, with animated clouds, local waves, swaying foreground plants and Chinese settings.
description.zh: 适用于官方 macOS DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 的海边主题，提供动态云层、局部海浪、前景花草摆动和中文设置。

description.en: Use ChatGPT subscriptions in DeepSeek Harness Desktop via official Sign in with ChatGPT, with dynamic Agent registration and native model and reasoning selection.
description.zh: 通过官方 Sign in with ChatGPT 授权在 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 使用 ChatGPT 订阅，支持动态 Agent 注册及原生模型和推理强度选择。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 原生 OpenRouter service tier 控制插件，兼容 0.2.0-rc.2 与 0.2.1-alpha.1
DSH plugin: DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, flat rates for other providers like z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, live per-session cost estimate and a hover cache-hit trend chart.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek 当前时段价格和本次会话花费，还能悬停查看缓存命中趋势。

description.en: 奶龙（bellylaugh）桌宠 DSH 插件：常驻 Deepseek harness 界面右下角，跟着 Agent 工作状态切换动作，任务完成时捧腹大笑。零依赖，支持热换宠物与笑声。
description.zh: 把奶龙桌宠放在 DSH 界面右下角，跟着 Agent 状态做动作，任务完成就捧腹大笑。

description.en: Quiet break, water, long-session and late-night reminders delivered by three bundled chibi companions, with cloud bubbles and a light bounce. Works in-page without extra downloads; the optional macOS desktop window uses a separately downloaded Electron helper.
description.zh: 用三套内置 Q 版角色提供久坐、喝水、连续工作与深夜关怀，带云朵气泡和轻回弹；页面内显示无需额外下载，可选 macOS 桌面窗口使用单独下载的 Electron 组件。

description.en: 鲸歌：让 dsh-pet 跟着 QQ 音乐 / 网易云音乐逐行显示歌词。QQ 音乐走 Windows SMTC，网易云读本地 cloudmusic.elog（无需 BetterNCM、支持 seek），延迟可调、翻译、桌面悬浮模式不切动画。
description.zh: 让 dsh-pet 跟着 QQ 音乐逐句显示歌词，桌宠边听边唱，还能校准延迟、显示翻译。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: live DeepSeek API peak/off-peak tariff state and spend tracking, for the agent, the chat, a sidebar chip and Settings (Windows, Linux, macOS).
description.zh: 实时显示 DeepSeek API 当前是高峰还是低谷计费，并统计已花费用，聊天、侧边栏和设置里都能看。

description.en: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话搬进系统级置顶小窗（Document Picture-in-Picture）
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话放进系统级置顶小窗，边干活边看 AI 回复，不用来回切窗口。

description.en: Live per-session cost badge for DeepSeek Harness (top-right), with peak/off-peak (time-of-day) pricing.
description.zh: 在右上角实时显示当前会话花了多少钱，还按高峰/低谷时段自动算价。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 免费网页搜索与抓取插件：360/Bing 多引擎并行竞速 + 相关性闸门 + GitHub 镜像回退，零费用零 API Key，中文查询与外国网站(github)检索均可用 / Free multi-engine web search & fetch plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 免费多引擎网页搜索与抓取插件，零 API Key，中文查询和 GitHub 检索都能用。

description.en: Validated, agent-composed interactive UI inside DeepSeek Harness conversations
description.zh: 让 Agent 在对话里按任务自动拼出交互界面，把操作、授权和后续请求都收进同一个入口。

description.en: Google Jules as a DeepSeek Harness capability — delegate coding tasks to the remote agent, watch them in the background, approve plans, and land the diff.
description.zh: 把编码任务交给 Google Jules 远程跑，后台盯着进度、审批方案，最后把改动合并进来。

description.en: Knowmesh for DeepSeek Harness: shared debugging wiki skill plus remote MCP tools
description.zh: 把调试经验沉淀成共享 wiki，每个故障模式只留一个标准答案，还能远程调用 MCP 工具查资料。

description.en: Draws mermaid code blocks in DSH replies as diagrams, including while the reply is still streaming.
description.zh: 把 DSH 回复里的 mermaid 代码块直接画成图表，边生成边渲染，不用等回复结束。

description.en: Persona manager for DeepSeek Harness — a JSON-backed persona library, a per-session binding so each session can run a different persona, an optional default persona for sessions that have no binding, and switching that applies either at once or from the next session; the Web UI adds a Model personas settings page and a persona chip next to the composer, and three model tools let the model list, switch and create personas itself.
description.zh: DSH 人格管理器：人格库存于一份 JSON，可按会话绑定人设、可为未绑定的会话指定默认人格，切换可选立即生效或下个会话生效；Web 端提供「模型人格」设置页与输入框旁的人格切换条，模型侧另有 persona_list / persona_switch / persona_create 三个工具可自行列出、切换与创建人格。

description.en: A sidebar prompt template library for DeepSeek Harness: browse, manage, and insert reusable prompts into the composer.
description.zh: 在侧边栏管理可复用的提示词模板，搜索后一键插入输入框，省去反复手打。

description.en: Relvato website monitoring for DeepSeek Harness: a dsh bundle that adds Relvato's hosted MCP server (52 tools).
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Relvato 网站监控，52 个工具随时查站点在线状态和故障。

description.en: Renders installed DSH plugin titles and descriptions in Simplified Chinese: at startup it translates the plugins the local JSON cache lacks through the harness LLM service, then projects { en, zh } metadata for resolveText() to render — no DOM changes, no third-party API.
description.zh: 把已安装插件的显示名与描述变成简体中文：启动时用 DSH 自带的模型服务翻译缓存尚未收录的插件，再投影 { en, zh } 元数据供 resolveText() 渲染——不改 DOM，也不调用第三方 API。

description.en: Windows-only power card injected into the DSH page: the artwork carries two hit zones (left shuts down, right restarts), the first click only turns the card into a yes/no question and the second click fires, and the restart engine stops only this instance's process tree, waits for the port to free, relaunches outside the host's Job Object and confirms the new instance answers on the plugin's own status route.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows：注入 DSH 页面的电源卡片，图案左右各带一块命中区（左关机、右重启），第一次点击只把卡片变成一句是否确认，第二次点击才执行；重启引擎只停本实例的进程树，等待端口释放后在宿主 Job Object 之外重新拉起，并用插件自己的状态路由确认新实例已经应答。

description.en: Rebind running sessions onto a rebuilt agent-preset revision, so preset changes apply without restarting dsh.
description.zh: 把正在运行的会话重绑到重建后的预设 revision 上，让预设改动无需重启 dsh 即可生效。

description.en: Switch the current session's agent preset (mode) at any time, including after the conversation has already started, from a session-header dropdown backed by a fenced POST /preset-switch/api route. The route also repairs sessions whose recorded preset was deleted. Fork of jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher updated for DSH 0.2.1.
description.zh: 随时切换当前会话的代理预设（模式），对话开始后也能切：会话头下拉菜单，由受限的 POST /preset-switch/api 路由支撑；该路由还会修复记录中预设已被删除的会话。jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher 的分支，已适配 DSH 0.2.1。

description.en: A floating panel that lights up which HowNet semantic primitives the current answer touches, as a brain-shaped node graph, EEG-style channel traces and a composition card.
description.zh: 悬浮面板：把当前这段回答点亮了哪些 HowNet 语义基元实时画出来——脑形节点网络、脑电样式的多导联曲线、构成指纹卡。

description.en: Describe the persona you want and the agent writes it: nickname, bio, taglines and links come from the host model, the avatar comes from your local asset library (or a path you give), then it fills your profile page and hands the picture to the site's own uploader. Dry-run by default - it only touches profile fields, never passwords or security settings.
description.zh: 你说想要什么样的人设，它把文案写出来并把资料页填好：昵称/简介/标语/链接由宿主模型生成，头像取本地素材库（或你给的路径），再由站点自己的上传控件完成头像入库。**默认 dry-run**，只写资料字段 —— 不碰密码、邮箱、安全设置。

description.en: Per-workspace subagents, commands, MCP servers and hooks for DSH from .dsh/settings.yml (+ personal settings.local.yml) · 从 .dsh/settings.yml（及个人的 settings.local.yml）为 DSH 工作区加载子代理、命令、MCP 和 hooks
description.zh: 让子代理、命令、MCP 和 hooks 跟着项目走，从工作区 .dsh/settings.yml 自动加载，不用再全局配置。

description.en: Prompt Compiler DSH plugin: compile rough drafts into structured prompts
description.zh: 把粗糙草稿一键编译成结构清晰、可直接执行的 prompt，还能被其他插件调用。

description.en: Ghost-text next-prompt prediction in the DeepSeek Harness Web composer, accepted with Tab.
description.zh: 在输入框里用灰字预测你下一句要发什么，按 Tab 就能直接采纳，省得反复敲提示词。

description.en: DSH PTC run_code parse-error position plugin (line + code frame)
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes the DSH Web UI for LAN access
description.zh: 把 DSH Web UI 开放到局域网，让手机、平板等设备也能直接访问使用。

description.en: 用 QQ 私聊远程驱动 DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 QQ 私聊里发句话，就能远程让电脑上的 DSH 干活，还能在 Web 界面随时接管。

description.en: Control DeepSeek Harness from QQ: sessions, tasks, progress, models and permissions.
description.zh: 在手机 QQ 里远程操控 DeepSeek Harness，随时查看会话、任务进度、模型和权限。

description.en: One-click screenshot button that floats over every DSH page, with a second one in the composer tool row: it captures the DeepSeek Harness window (or the whole desktop with a modifier) using the host capture tooling and puts the PNG where it is useful — straight into the composer draft as an attachment, or on the clipboard when no composer is mounted. Windows-verified, with macOS and Linux backends; no dependencies and no build step.
description.zh: 悬浮在任意 DSH 页面上的一键截图按钮（输入框工具行里另有一个）：用宿主侧工具截取 DeepSeek Harness 窗口（按住修饰键可截整个桌面），并把 PNG 放到用得上的地方——直接作为附件落进输入框草稿，没有输入框时放进剪贴板。Windows 实测，另带 macOS/Linux 后端；零依赖、无构建步骤。

description.en: 在 DSH 对话里选中一段文字，落成工作区的临时注释文件，并以引用块附到输入框；模型读完本轮后自动回收。零依赖、无需构建。
description.zh: 在对话里选中文字就能变成临时注释文件，以引用块附到输入框，模型读完自动删除。

description.en: Unified rail for the DSH sidebar: sort the top panels and the bottom actions as one list. / DSH 左侧栏统一排序插件：顶部面板与底部动作混排成同一条序列。
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧栏的顶部面板和底部动作合成一条列表，随意排序、改名、换图标、隐藏或折叠。

description.en: DSH Plugins 页的 REA 开关：总开关关闭 REA，并在完整版 / 压缩版 MCP 工具集之间切换
description.zh: 在插件页一键开关 REA，并在完整版和压缩版 MCP 工具集之间切换，避免两套工具同时加载。

description.en: Inventory every listening TCP endpoint and grade each holder as agent-spawned, workspace, dev-server, unattributed, system or protected; only the first two can be auto-selected, and a reap previews its descendant-closure plan unless confirmed.
description.zh: 枚举本机全部监听端口，按「会话派生的 / 工作区内的 / 开发服务器 / 无法归属 / 系统 / 受保护」六级定性持有者；只有前两级可被自动选中，回收前默认只预览后代闭包计划。

description.en: 让 DSH 支持中转站的推理等级：为每个模型提供关/低/中/高/max 五档可选，适配任意 OpenAI 兼容中转站
description.zh: 让任意 OpenAI 兼容中转站的模型都能选关/低/中/高/max 五档推理等级，直接在 DSH 模型选择器里调。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness desktop plugin that exposes a local harness to your own relay over a single outbound WebSocket - no inbound ports, works behind NAT. Forwards a fixed op allowlist, session events, prompts and attachments, and relays approvals or questions to the companion mobile app. Node ESM, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把跑 DSH 的电脑通过一条出站连接挂到自己的中继上，手机在外也能远程看会话、发消息、处理审批。

description.en: Project-based session dashboard and cross-session inbox for DeepSeek Harness Web
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话按项目整理成仪表盘，还能跨会话收件箱统一查看，研究进度一目了然。

description.en: Replaces the new-session hero with a combined picker: role cards for the agent presets and a workspace card, collapsed into capsule buttons that expand into two scrollable rows.
description.zh: 把新建会话界面的选择器换成组合面板：角色预设卡与工作区卡各自成排，折叠时是胶囊按钮，展开后是两行可滚动的紧凑卡片。

description.en: ⚠️ NOT REVIEWED BY ANY HUMAN - AI-generated (DeepSeek V4.1-flash). DeepSeek Harness desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 (Windows) bundle: gives the ACL sandbox runner a console so confined pwsh/cmd/powershell start again under workspace-write. No confinement is relaxed. dsh-plugin.
description.zh: 给 ACL 沙箱运行器补上控制台，让受限的 pwsh/cmd/powershell 能正常启动，解决 Windows 桌面端沙箱报错。

description.en: WeChat-style screenshot plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): configurable shortcut, region select, window snap, annotations, clipboard & PNG save. Windows only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里复刻电脑版微信截图体验，支持快捷键、区域选择、窗口捕捉、标注和保存。

description.en: Deletes a whole conversation from the sidebar session menu, and opens a right-click menu on a chat text selection with Copy, Quote (insert a Markdown quote block into the composer) and Ask: Ask sends the selection plus your question to one reused continuable subagent (label `ask`, found again through the subagent catalog after a restart) and streams the answer into the right sidebar.
description.zh: 从侧栏会话菜单删除整个会话；聊天里划词右键弹出「复制 / 引用 / 提问」：引用把 Markdown 引用块插入输入框，提问把选区与问题交给同一个复用的可继续子智能体（label `ask`，宿主重启后经子智能体目录找回），回答在右侧栏流式显示。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness UI plugin: shows this session's spend and the account's remaining balance below the composer.
description.zh: 在对话框下方实时显示本次会话花了多少钱和账户余额，点开还能看明细。

description.en: A permanent 'Delete session' action for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a confirmation dialog.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏加个「彻底删除会话」按钮，删前弹窗确认，避免误删。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会话删除插件：侧边栏一键永久删除会话，支持强制删除运行中的会话、回收站为空时自愈工作区索引
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 补上官方缺失的删除会话功能，侧边栏一键永久删掉会话，运行中的也能强制删。

description.en: Export the current DSH Session trajectory as a Markdown file from the Session header.
description.zh: 从会话标题栏一键把当前对话轨迹导出成 Markdown 文件，方便归档和复盘。

description.en: Searchable message overlay for DSH sessions: jump to any loaded message with the keyboard.
description.zh: 按 Ctrl+S 就能列出当前会话已加载的消息，键盘快速跳转到任意一条，找消息不用翻半天。

description.en: Cross-session messaging plugin for DeepSeek Harness: let user-launched sessions in one workspace message each other and coordinate tasks, write scopes, and conflicts.

description.zh: 给 dsh 插件一个统一的退出拦截点，退出前把没做完的收尾活儿并行跑完再安全退出。

description.en: Side chat for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: fork the current session into an ephemeral conversation that can really edit files, without polluting the main transcript.
description.zh: 从当前会话分出一个临时侧边会话，能真正改文件，又不弄脏主对话记录。

description.en: Adds a Restart row to the desktop app's sidebar foot beside Settings that restarts the app and reloads the page onto the newly installed plugin bundle.
description.zh: 在桌面版侧边栏底部、「设置」旁边新增一个「重启」按钮，重启应用，并在页面重连后加载到刚安装的插件包。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 客户端插件：把设置入口放到侧边栏底部，一键打开设置页。 / A DSH client plugin that puts a settings button at the bottom of the sidebar.
description.zh: 把设置按钮挪到侧边栏底部，点一下就能打开设置页，省得四处找入口。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance above the sidebar account area, the running cost of the open conversation, the cost of each turn beside its token count, and a one-click AI breakdown for any turn above a token threshold.
description.zh: 在侧边栏账户区上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、当前会话累计花费与逐轮费用，并对超出 token 阈值的单轮提供一键 AI 分析。

description.en: Interior and exterior ballistics paper reproduction and code generation skill. Requires LibreOffice Kit for PDF rendering and a vision API key (e.g. Qwen-VL) for formula OCR.
description.zh: 内/外弹道学的论文复现与代码编写 skill。前置：LibreOffice Kit（PDF 渲染）+ 视觉 API key（如千问，公式 OCR）。

description.en: Grouped skill picker for the composer. A button beside the input box opens a panel that browses every installed skill by scene (research, office, data, writing, media, dev), with auto-classification for new skills, Chinese annotations, search and drill-down; picking one inserts the /skill-name gesture.
description.zh: 输入框技能分组选择器：🧩按钮弹出按场景分组（科研、办公、数据、写作、媒体、开发）的技能面板，新装技能自动分类，中文说明、搜索与双层下钻，点选即插入 /技能名 手势。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 技能管理插件：设置页列出/查看/新建/编辑/删除本地技能，切换模型调用与用户调用策略，支持一键在文件管理器中打开技能目录
description.zh: 在设置页集中管理本地技能，能新建、编辑、删除，还能切换调用策略、一键打开技能目录。

description.en: DSH 原生 SkillX 插件：从会话提取可复用能力，支持契约化调用、版本管理与自动恢复。

Ship a local DSH plugin project to GitHub and the plugin market in one call: preflight, per-file upload with byte verification, the market registry PR, then pull every published file back and compare bytes.
description.zh: 一条命令把本地 DSH 插件工程发到 GitHub 并开市场收录 PR：逐文件上传带字节校验、市场条目 PR，最后把线上文件逐个拉回来比 sha256。
给 DSH 桌面版加代理切换、连通性自检和 SSE 超时保护，专治 Transport Failed 和证书拦截。

description.en: Adds Standard Compute as an OpenAI-compatible model provider through the built-in pi-ai adapter, with its standardcompute router model and two direct model pins; configuration only, no code.
description.zh: 通过内置 pi-ai 适配器将 Standard Compute 添加为 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商，包含 standardcompute 路由模型和两个直连模型；仅配置，无代码。

description.en: Startup video intro with per-clip playback parameters (segment, speed, brightness, fit, blurred cinema fill, hold ratio and fade duration) and light/dark clip variants selected by the app theme.
description.zh: 启动时播放视频开场，每段素材可独立调节播放片段、速度、亮度、画面适配、影院模糊填充、展示比例与淡出时长，并按应用浅色/深色外观自动选择对应版本。

description.en: Unified DeepSeek Harness status dashboard: session health, channels, jobs, memory, OpenCode Go usage and DeepSeek balance.
description.zh: 一个面板看全 DSH 运行状态：会话健康、频道、任务、内存、用量和余额，随时掌握。

description.en: A status bar in the composer footer showing the current phase, how long it has been running, the current step token count and a no-progress warning, projected from session logs without polling the host, plus a detail panel that opens on click.
description.zh: 在输入框底栏显示当前阶段、阶段已耗时、本步 token 数与无进展告警的状态条（纯日志投影，不轮询宿主），点击可展开详情面板。

description.en: Model-selectable subagents with per-task reasoning effort for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 0.2.x. Maintained continuation of CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: delegate one task to your local Reasonix as a subagent (Reasonix 子智能体)
description.zh: 把单个任务交给本机 Reasonix 当子智能体跑，让 DSH 多一个能干活的帮手。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件，仅对可信 SolidWorks 建模操作自动放行，兼顾效率与沙箱安全
description.zh: 给 SolidWorks 建模操作自动放行可信步骤，省掉几十次手动审批，建模不再卡住。

description.en: Open symlinks and junctions in the DSH sidebar, with targets outside the workspace gated by workspace trust · 让 DSH 侧边栏能展开、打开符号链接（含 Windows junction），指向工作区外的需工作区已信任
description.zh: 让 DSH 侧边栏能正常展开和打开符号链接与 Windows junction，工作区外的链接需信任后才可访问。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 同步与备份插件：通过 WebDAV 同步常用配置和 API Key，自动备份，并可预览、恢复历史配置。
description.zh: 通过自己的 WebDAV 同步 DSH 配置和 API Key，自动备份，还能预览、恢复历史版本。

description.en: dsh 群晖日历插件：CalDAV 工具 + 配置页，随 dsh web 启停
description.zh: 把群晖日历接进 dsh，用 9 个工具查、建、改、删日程和待办，随 dsh web 一起启停。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：跟随 Windows 系统代理，带开关
description.zh: 自动跟随 Windows 系统代理设置，每 5 秒同步一次，还能一键开关，省得手动配代理。

description.en: Generic monitor plugin for DSH Desktop: an HTTP polling rule engine. Poll any endpoint on schedule (multi-step, variable extraction, JS condition expressions); when conditions hit, wake a visible agent session to act — zero model calls otherwise. Configure everything in a sidebar GUI panel: create/edit/pause/test/fire-now/run history, same UX as the built-in scheduler plugin.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 通用监控插件：HTTP 轮询规则引擎。按规则定时轮询任意接口（多步骤、变量提取、JS 条件表达式），条件命中才唤醒一个可见的 agent 会话执行任务；未命中零模型调用、零 token 消耗。规则通过导航栏 GUI 面板配置：新建/编辑/启停/测试/立即触发/执行记录，与定时任务插件同款交互体验。

description.en: DSH sidebar dashboard for Tonghuashun simulated account and local backtest replay
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接看同花顺模拟持仓、分钟K线和资金流，还能回放本地回测。

description.en: Time & Timer for DeepSeek Harness: synced clock, lunar date, China holidays, and a 15-minute timer.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里显示同步时钟、农历和中国节假日，还能随手开个 15 分钟计时器。

description.en: DSH 待办清单：左侧导航、Agent 工具与可置顶的独立窗口。
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧导航加个待办清单，还能开成独立小窗口放桌面一角，随时置顶查看。

description.en: Model-facing native context compaction for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让模型按需触发原生上下文压缩，长会话不爆上下文，省 token 又稳。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：对话标题工具，支持当前会话命名和历史会话重命名
description.zh: 给 DSH 对话起名和改名的小工具，按「日期|类型|主题」格式命名当前会话或重命名历史会话，方便日后查找。

description.en: dsh turn-guard plugin: per-step timeout for agent turns (防模型退化死循环)
description.zh: 给 agent 每一步加超时，超时就强制中断，防止模型退化陷入死循环。

description.en: Short model-generated recap under every completed turn in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, plus an on-demand /recap command.
description.zh: 每轮对话结束后自动生成简短回顾，还能随时用 /recap 命令重新总结，方便快速回顾上下文。

description.en: DSH 插件：按「会话 × 供应商 × 模型」拆解调用次数与 token 用量，数据只读自 dsh-cost-meter 账本。
description.zh: 按会话、供应商、模型拆开看调用次数和 token 用量，哪条路由花了多少一目了然。

description.en: DSH Desktop plugin: usage stats, plan quotas, custom HTTPS balance, 26-week heatmap
description.zh: 一眼看清 DSH 用量和套餐额度，5小时、周、月窗口加 26 周热力图，还能查自定义 HTTPS 余额。

description.en: Plugin development toolset: mark files read by shell commands, sync code into a profile, mock a plugin backend, preview a plugin frontend, verify plugin loading, spin up an isolated test instance, run named shell shortcuts, and list the plugin's tools.
description.zh: 插件开发工具箱：命令读过的文件自动算已读、代码同步到 profile、后端模拟与前端预览、插件装载验证、隔离测试实例、自定义快捷命令、工具清单。

description.en: Shows which skills each turn invoked and installs, updates or removes skills inside the app.
description.zh: 显示每轮对话实际调用了哪些技能，并可在应用内安装、更新与删除技能。

description.en: Encrypted, chunked full backups of a DSH installation: config, sessions, plugins, workspaces and Hindsight memory packed into AES-256-GCM volumes that unlock by passphrase, recovery code or this machine's DPAPI slot, each package carrying a self-contained restorer, GFS rotation (last, daily, weekly, monthly, plus a total size cap and a recycle bin) and network or WebDAV targets. Zero external dependencies — node: builtins only, no 7z, openssl or rclone.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的配置、会话、插件、工作区与 Hindsight 记忆加密分卷打包：AES-256-GCM 卷可用口令、恢复码或本机 DPAPI 免密槽解开，包内自带自包含还原器；GFS 四档滚动保留（最近 / 每日 / 每周 / 每月，另有总体积上限与回收站），支持网络路径与 WebDAV 目标。零外部依赖，只用 node: 内置模块，不需要 7z、openssl 或 rclone。

description.en: dsh-plugin: encrypted backup / restore / migration of the dsh home config through a private GitHub repo
description.zh: 把 dsh 的配置加密备份到你的私有 GitHub 仓库，换机器时一键恢复迁移，省心又安全。

description.en: Speaks a cue for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: a configurable phrase when an agent turn completes normally, a second phrase when the agent needs you to choose — a question, a plan approval, or a permission request — and a time-of-day greeting when a new conversation starts. A small bubble in the lower-left corner mutes and unmutes every cue with one click, with its own toggle chime. Phrases are synthesized with a Microsoft Edge neural voice (skipping aborted and errored turns, subagent turns, and rounds that a goal is still driving), cached under the DSH home directory and replayed locally, with the desktop SAPI voice as the offline fallback.
description.zh: Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 语音提示：一轮对话正常结束时朗读一句可自定义的话（默认「已完成当前任务」），智能体需要你做选择时——提问、批准计划或权限确认——朗读第二句（默认「老大老大，等你做选择呢」），开始一个新对话时再按系统时间问候一句（默认「早上好／中午好／下午好／晚上好！有什么工作需要做吗？」）。页面左下角还有一个小悬浮泡，点一下就把所有播报静音或恢复（自带开关音效）。朗读用微软 Edge 神经语音合成（被中断或出错的回合、子代理回合、以及 goal 仍在续跑的回合不朗读），结果缓存在 DSH 主目录并本地播放，网络不可用时回退到系统 SAPI 桌面语音。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for selecting and routing web search providers.
description.zh: 灵活选择并切换网页搜索服务商，让 DeepSeek Harness 的搜索能力更顺手。

description.en: Doubao Search (Volcengine) web search provider for DeepSeek Harness — makes the standard web_search tool return real excerpts, not just titles and links.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_search 换上豆包搜索后端，返回真实摘要而不只是标题和链接。

description.en: 把 OpenCode 作为 DeepSeek Harness 的网页搜索提供方：经 OpenCode 的 Anthropic 兼容 Messages 接口调用 DeepSeek 的服务端 web_search，并自带设置页。
description.zh: 把 OpenCode 接成 dsh 的网页搜索源，让模型直接调用 DeepSeek 官方服务端搜索，还能在设置里调参。
给 Harness 接入 Serper 搜索后端，让 AI 助手能联网搜到最新网页信息。

description.en: Embed chat.deepseek.com web chat in DSH and transfer the conversation into a workspace session for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把 chat.deepseek.com 网页聊天嵌进 DSH，还能把对话转成工作区会话继续用。

description.en: dsh webhook 插件：HTTP webhook → 固定会话投递（异步队列），随 dsh web 启停
description.zh: 把外部 HTTP 请求转成消息投递到固定会话，让 agent 自动处理，随 dsh web 启停，即插即用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：通过 wxauto 监听 Windows 微信私聊消息，交给 DSH Agent 生成回复并自动发送。仅用于技术演示，请只用小号测试。
description.zh: 让 Windows 微信私聊自动接上 DSH Agent，收到消息就生成回复并自动发回，适合技术演示和小号测试。

description.en: Read Bilibili and Douyin from a session: WBI-signed Bilibili API calls behind one shared pacer (4 req/s, per-host cooldown after a 412) for video, feed, search, author, comments, danmaku and subtitles, plus Douyin hot list, video, feed and search rendered in a locally launched Edge over CDP.
description.zh: 会话内读 B站与抖音：B站走 WBI 签名接口，全部请求共用一个限速器（默认 4 请求/秒，吃 412 后按主机冷却），覆盖视频、热门、搜索、UP主、评论、弹幕、字幕；抖音则通过 CDP 驱动本机 Edge 渲染，读热榜、视频、推荐流与搜索。

description.en: 给 DSH Desktop 的鲸鱼壁纸插件：一片会游动的海铺在界面背后，控制台 20 项实时可调
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面背后铺一片会游动的鲸鱼海，纯视觉背景，不挡鼠标不抢键盘，控制台 20 项实时可调。

description.en: 给 DSH 小鲸鱼挂件加一层装饭喂鱼：装饭 → 每轮吃 → 报账 → 讨饭
description.zh: 给 DSH 小鲸鱼挂件加个饭盆，装饭喂鱼、按真实 token 消耗吃饭，吃完还会主动讨饭。

description.en: Command resolution forensics: which file a command actually runs, which PATH entry won, what it shadows, how many entries are duplicates or dead, and whether the copies behind one name report the same version.
description.zh: 命令解析取证：一条命令实际会跑哪个文件、PATH 哪一条胜出、遮蔽了谁、有多少重复与死条目，以及同名副本报的版本是否一致。

description.en: In-conversation workflow run timeline for DSH Web: a horizontal rail with phase stations, agent pills, loop arcs and parallel bands replaces the stock workflow tool card and workflow-run chat node. Planned stations render before the run starts via client-side script scanning; status dots and icons follow DSH official primitives.
description.zh: 对话内工作流运行时间线：横向轨道 + 阶段站 + 子代理药丸 + 循环弧线 + 并行带，替换官方 workflow 工具卡与 workflow-run 聊天节点。客户端脚本扫描让计划站在开跑前全部渲染；状态点与图标对齐 DSH 官方 primitives。

description.en: dsh X magpie 简化集成 magpie 供应商的 dsh 插件
description.zh: 把 magpie 网关的模型目录同步成 dsh 里的一个模型供应商，接上就能用。

description.en: SVG Studio for DeepSeek Harness: image + prompt to a pure, layered SVG. Personal, non-commercial use only; commercial licensing on request. By xiangwriter.
description.zh: 上传图片加一句提示，就能生成分层可编辑的纯 SVG 矢量图，适合个人创作使用。

description.en: Build editable motion-graphics compositions with layers, keyframes, and alpha renders.
description.zh: 用图层、关键帧和透明通道渲染，做出可随时修改的动效画面。

description.en: Design and restructure interfaces while keeping an editable FigCraft document.
description.zh: 边设计边重构界面，还能保留可继续编辑的 FigCraft 文档，改稿不丢结构。

description.en: Cut films from existing footage: tracks, captions, color, and a verified final export.
description.zh: 从现有素材里剪出成片，轨道、字幕、调色一站搞定，导出前还能先校验一遍。

description.en: Saber (Fate) theme for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web with light/dark palettes, 30 on-demand chat wallpapers rotating every five minutes, and a task attention tray below the right-side turn index, compatible with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版和 Web 的 Saber（Fate）主题，提供冰蓝浅色、深色配色、每五分钟随机切换的 30 张按需加载聊天背景，以及右侧对话索引下方的任务关注浮层，兼容 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 和 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Build and audit editable spreadsheets with live formulas, tables, and charts.
description.zh: 在表格里写公式、建图表，边做边查，轻松搞定可编辑电子表格。

description.en: Plan, batch-generate, and evaluate images with approved spend and hash-verified receipts.
description.zh: 批量规划、生成并评估图片，花多少有预算管着，每笔都有哈希凭证可查。

description.en: Cull, develop, and export photos while preserving originals and reversible edits.
description.zh: 照片筛选、调色、导出一步到位，原图不动，修改随时能撤回。

description.en: A per-repository, Docker-hosted MCP knowledge service that gives coding agents a governed Markdown "wiki" with semantic retrieval. The promise — a local RAG wiki that accumulates durable project knowledge across agentic sessions.
description.zh: 给每个代码仓库配一个本地RAG知识库，让AI智能体随时检索和记录项目文档，知识不丢失。

description.en: Inspect Maya scenes, capture reversible Playblasts, and restore every touched value.
description.zh: 检查 Maya 场景、录制可回滚的 Playblast，并把改动过的数值一键还原。

description.en: Generate MiniMax H3 video, music, speech, and images with resumable paid tasks.
description.zh: 用 MiniMax H3 生成视频、音乐、语音和图片，付费任务中断了还能接着跑。

description.en: Configure local models and providers with auto-discovery of reasoning effort, image input and context size. · 配置本地模型与 Provider，自动发现推理强度、图像输入与上下文大小。
description.zh: 自动发现本地 OpenAI 兼容模型服务，并解析模型的分级推理能力，方便 dsh 灵活调度。

description.en: 点歌台：DSH Web 插件（Alt+T 面板跨平台搜歌）+ IIROSE 用户脚本（一个 JS 链接，点歌进房间）
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板里跨平台搜歌点歌，还能把歌直接送进 IIROSE 房间播放。
为 Quick 和人工驱动的 SDD 开发提供 Node.js 工具与可复用的 Agent/Skill 指导，帮你规范地推进规格驱动开发。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin to connect and auto-sync OpenCode Desktop free models
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Desktop 的免费模型接进 DeepSeek Harness，自动同步，开箱就能用。

description.en: A scholarly journal-desk skin for DeepSeek Harness: Nature, Science, IEEE and Elsevier covers, manuscript stages, and an editorial letter behind the conversation.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上学术期刊桌面皮肤，可选 Nature、Science、IEEE、Elsevier 封面和稿件阶段，聊天背景还有编辑来信。

description.en: Inspect, edit, and OCR PDFs with pinned native tooling and review gates.
description.zh: 查看、编辑 PDF 还能做 OCR，内置原生工具和审核关卡，改完不怕出错。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的提示词优化插件。发送消息之前，用 DSH 已配置的模型整理当前草稿，并可追加经过校验的文件与技能引用。可使用现有的 DSH 模型重写你的草稿，并配有用于设置模型和推理强度的配置页面。
description.zh: 发消息前用 DSH 模型帮你把草稿改写成更清晰的提示词，还能自动补上文件和技能引用。

description.en: Local code memory with automatic source context, symbol lookup, vector search, and dependency graphs for JavaScript and TypeScript projects.
description.zh: 面向 JavaScript 与 TypeScript 项目的本地代码记忆：自动带上源码上下文，支持符号查找、向量检索与依赖图。

description.en: DSH 插件：Skill 与 MCP 使用审计。扫描 20 类 skill 来源，标注每个 skill 来自哪个工具，在对话顶部状态栏显示真实调用次数、成败、耗时与 MCP 使用。
description.zh: 扫描各类 skill 来源，统计调用次数、成败和耗时，还能追踪 MCP 使用情况，帮你摸清工具到底用没用上。

description.en: Edit and mix speech, music, and sound effects in one shared editor session.
description.zh: 在一个编辑器里同时剪辑和混音人声、音乐与音效，做音频创作更省事。

description.en: Exa (exa.ai) web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): dynamic enabled switch, credentials-service key resolution, bilingual settings card.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Exa 网页搜索，支持动态开关和密钥管理，让智能体随时获取最新网络信息。

description.en: Turn a brand brief into editable vector projects: logos, icons, infographics, charts.
description.zh: 把品牌简报一键变成可编辑的矢量项目，logo、图标、信息图和图表都能直接改。

description.en: Analyze shots, approve an edit by hash, and render videos locally with FFmpeg.
description.zh: 分析镜头、按哈希确认剪辑方案，再用 FFmpeg 在本地渲染出视频。

description.en: Run Doubao ASR/TTS, Seedream images, and Seedance video with explicit cost gates.
description.zh: 一键调用豆包语音识别、语音合成、Seedream 生图和 Seedance 视频，花钱前会明确提示成本。

description.en: Draft, lay out, and deliver editable Word documents with a reopened-file check.
description.zh: 帮你起草、排版并导出可编辑的 Word 文档，还能重新打开检查效果，交付更放心。

description.en: 沿用了此项目：https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge  专注于deepseek harness破甲|逆向|渗透|   适配最新版deepseek harness ：deepseek v4.1 flash 最新版

Asset governance console for self-hosted AI infrastructure. Registers MCP servers, skills, agents and AI apps in one ledger with a lifecycle state machine, per-tool RBAC permission points, department x agent x skill cost attribution, dependency topology and an append-only audit trail. Ships 27 plugin packages, 354 REST routes and 83 MCP tools; selftest runs 1486 end-to-end assertions. Not a hosted service, no cloud contract.
description.zh: 自托管 AI 基础设施的资产治理控制台。把 MCP 服务 / Skill / Agent / AI 应用登记进同一台账，带生命周期状态机、逐工具 RBAC 权限点、部门 x Agent x Skill 三维成本归因、依赖拓扑与只追加审计日志。含 27 个插件包、354 条 REST 路由、83 个 MCP 工具，selftest 1486 项端到端断言全绿。非托管服务，无云端合约。

description.en: Installs a self-evolving development-constraints rule library, exposes it to the agent through a constraints tool and a once-per-session reminder, and audits AI token cost and context usage.
description.zh: 把一套会自我进化的开发约束规则库装进项目，通过 constraints 工具和「每会话一次」的提醒交给智能体，并可审计 AI 的 token 成本与上下文占用。

description.en: Cross-session artifact center: agent tools that register deliverable files (PDF, Excel, PPT, code, JSON) into one shared directory, plus a sidebar panel that filters them by category, extension or keyword.
description.zh: 跨会话产物中心：agent 产出重要文件时用工具登记（默认复制一份到统一目录），侧边栏面板按分类、后缀或关键词即时筛选。

description.en: DSH 暖纸外观皮肤：Claude Desktop 暖白纸配色 + 更纱黑体两层字体
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上暖白纸配色和更纱黑体，看字写东西眼睛更舒服。

description.en: UI theme customizer, acrylic frosted glass, and panoramic live video/wallpapers for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 专为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 UI 个性化配色、毛玻璃拟态与全景壁纸/动态视频外观定制插件。

description.en: Freezes the DSH Web GUI reading column at a fixed width and re-aligns the reading position after the window is resized or zoomed.
description.zh: 固定 DSH Web GUI 的正文列宽度，并在窗口缩放后把阅读位置对回原处。

description.en: Connects Trae enterprise models to DeepSeek Harness from a personal access token alone, calling llm_raw_chat directly with no trae2api or traecli process; fetches the model catalog from upstream on startup and shows remaining quota for personal packs and enterprise seats.
description.zh: 仅凭一个个人访问令牌（PAT）把 Trae 企业版模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，直连 llm_raw_chat，不需要 trae2api 或 traecli 进程；启动时从上游拉取模型目录，并显示个人额度包与企业席位的剩余额度。

description.en: Configure DMXAPI Chat Completions, Responses, Anthropic Messages, and custom providers; edit models on existing preset routes.
description.zh: 配置 DMXAPI Chat、Responses、Anthropic 和自定义服务商，并直接编辑已有预设服务商的模型。

description.en: 鲸鱼娘陪玩
description.zh: 打游戏时自动截屏看懂局势，让鲸鱼娘桌宠实时冒泡给你出主意，不用手动截图。

description.en: DSH plugin: convert a request into MiL with Sarashina, review it, then hand it to the model dsh is running (TUI and Web UI)
description.zh: 把含糊的需求先转成 MiL 规范再让你确认，然后才交给 dsh 当前模型执行。

description.en: Windows balloon notifications for session lifecycle events (new / running / finished / error) across all workspaces, with a session-store watch that catches headless and A2A dispatch sessions whose events never reach the host bus. Windows only.
description.zh: 会话生命周期事件（新建 / 运行中 / 完成 / 出错）的 Windows 气泡通知，覆盖所有工作区；还会监听会话存储，捕捉事件从不经过宿主总线的无头与 A2A 派发会话。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets the model drive the right-Sidebar browser: read pages, click, type, navigate, switch phone/tablet/desktop viewport sizes, and screenshot. Desktop only; never touches app.asar.
description.zh: 让模型直接操作右侧边栏浏览器，读页面、点击输入、切换设备尺寸并截图。

description.en: Removes subagent entries and orphaned projection caches from DeepSeek Harness session logs after the app quits, always dry-run first and with a full backup.
description.zh: 在 DSH 完全退出后清理会话日志里的子代理条目与孤儿投影缓存，默认先试演并整份备份。

description.en: Jev-guided dispatch advice for DeepSeek Harness: before each turn, Jev judges whether to delegate and to which registered agent. Advice only — jev-optional, fail-open, keychain-first.
description.zh: 每轮对话前先帮你判断该不该派活、派给哪个智能体，只给建议不强制，失败也不影响使用。

description.en: DSH plugin: decision notes (Agent Notes) — 把「为什么这样改、放弃了什么」沉淀成可机械校验的仓库笔记：技能、会话开关、真门禁、上游合并
description.zh: 把每次改动的决策理由和取舍记成仓库笔记，还能自动校验，方便回溯和合并。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把全栈开发与问题排查提示词做成四个按场景自动加载的技能（单体/微服务 × 开发/排查），含 Vue3+TS+Spring Boot 与 Spring Cloud Alibaba 的硬约束。
description.zh: 把全栈开发和排查提示词做成四个技能，按场景自动加载，不用再手动粘贴。

description.en: Rewrites agent-issued delete commands (PowerShell `Remove-Item` and its aliases, Bash `rm`/`unlink`/`rmdir`, CMD `del`/`erase`/`rd`/`rmdir`) into system recycle-bin operations on Windows, Linux and macOS, best-effort checks scripts for the same operations before they run, and keeps no permanent-delete fallback.
description.zh: 把 Agent 提交的删除命令（PowerShell `Remove-Item` 及别名、Bash `rm`/`unlink`/`rmdir`、CMD `del`/`erase`/`rd`/`rmdir`）改写为 Windows、Linux、macOS 的系统回收站操作，执行脚本前尽力检查其中的同类删除操作，且不提供永久删除兜底。

description.en: Read-only Agent Team console for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: live roster, shared task board, and collaboration activity.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 里只读查看 Agent 团队名册、共享任务板和协作动态，还能看像素风流程图。

description.en: 在 DSH agent 回答之前，把「你可能已经忘了」的东西重新摆到它眼前。零第三方依赖；判断全部由可核对的规则完成，不做生成式推理（语义那几段用本机 bge-m3 算向量）。
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体回答前先自查：翻出旧记忆、查重、核对引用，避免漏看和重复。

description.en: AList v3 file management: browse, search, upload (streamed and multipart), offline downloads, archive listing, task polling and control, plus admin tools for storages, users, roles, meta rules, settings, search index, shares and labels - 75 tools in total; every write goes through the approval flow and passwords are never read back.
description.zh: AList v3 文件管理插件：浏览、搜索、上传（本地文件流式与 multipart）、离线下载、压缩包查看、任务轮询与控制，以及存储、用户、角色、元数据、站点设置、搜索索引、分享、标签等管理端操作，共 75 个工具；全部写操作强制走审批，密码与 Token 只写不读。

description.en: Movable radio pill with live visualizer, station search, favourites and self-update check for DSH Web.
description.zh: 可拖动的收音机胶囊，带实时可视化、电台搜索、收藏与自更新检查，面向 DSH Web。

description.en: Adds a Restart application section to the desktop app Settings; quits gracefully and relaunches the whole application.
description.zh: 在桌面应用设置中新增「应用重启」区块，优雅退出并自动重启整个应用。

description.en: Writes a model-generated annotation into every DSH escalation approval prompt — what the command does, what the model intends, how risky it is and why, and what each choice means — and keeps a searchable history of past approvals at /dsh-approval/history, with a diagnostics page at /dsh-approval/diag.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的每一次提权审批弹窗加一份由模型生成的注释：这段代码做什么、模型想达成什么、风险多大以及原因、每个选项意味着什么；并提供 /dsh-approval/history 历史授权查询（可搜索、可筛选、记录当时选了什么）与 /dsh-approval/diag 诊断页。

description.en: dsh plugin: unattended approval gate — bounded answer window for subagent/scheduled/cron approvals, fail-closed default instead of hanging (per origin or per session)
description.zh: 给无人值守的审批请求加个限时应答窗口，没人答就按默认裁决，不再无限挂起。

description.en: Forces ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English on every reply and every document. Commands: /asd100 on, /asd100 off, /asd100.
description.zh: 强制所有回复和文档按 ASD-STE100 简化技术英语输出。命令：/asd100 on、/asd100 off、/asd100。

description.en: A multi-agent group chat for DSH that decides who is worth waking: durable message log, attention routing, and cross-workspace membership.
description.zh: 给多个 DSH 会话建个群聊，消息先存后分发，只叫醒真正该看的人。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：上下文超过 45% 且静默 3 分钟时自动压缩会话历史
description.zh: 上下文占用超阈值且静默几分钟后，自动压缩会话历史，省 token 又省心。

description.en: Puts sessions into the built-in Auto review permission preset: new sessions at creation, existing root sessions when they are restored.
description.zh: 让会话进入内置的 Auto review 权限预设：新建会话在创建时进入，已有的根会话在重新打开时切过去。

description.en: This repo is a deepseek harness plugin for routing auto review (@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review) reuqests to user specified model
description.zh: 把 DSH 自动审查的安全检查交给便宜模型跑，省下主力模型的开销。

description.en: Automatic same-session continuation, retry with backoff, goal revival, and restart recovery for the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 没人盯着也能让会话自己接着跑，失败自动重试，目标不丢，重启还能续上。

description.en: Stops compaction summaries and session titles from burning their output budget on reasoning, by lowering the thinking level and raising the token floor for auxiliary calls only.
description.zh: 辅助调用降级：压缩摘要与会话标题不再被高思考档烧光输出预算，主循环完全不受影响。

description.en: Reads Claude Code and Codex plugin configurations to discover and preflight MCP servers and slash commands, with opt-in registration in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 读取 Claude Code 和 Codex 插件配置，发现并预检 MCP 服务器与斜杠命令，支持在 DeepSeek Harness 中按需启用注册。

description.en: Automated backups of DSH sessions, config and custom directories — scheduled or manual, packed as tgz with rotation
description.zh: 自动或手动备份 DSH 会话、配置及自定义目录，支持定时任务与压缩包轮换，数据更安全。

description.en: Gives pi-ai routed models a reasoning-effort ladder without manual settings: falls back declared to models.dev to a 7-tier default, and replaces the composer model chip with a Codex-style vertical picker.
description.zh: 让 pi-ai 路由的模型无需手写 settings 即可调节思考等级：按 已声明 → models.dev → 7 档兜底 的顺序回退，并把 composer 模型按钮换成 Codex 式竖向选择器。

description.en: Adds a Background button above Settings in the sidebar foot that fills the window with one of six preset wallpapers, the theme default, or a custom image URL, remembered across reloads.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部「设置」上方加一个「背景」按钮，可用 6 个预设壁纸、主题默认或自定义图片地址铺满窗口，并记住选择。

description.en: DSH 插件：Niri 风格水平滚动多窗口 B 站直播页，支持上下分屏、Solo、弹幕与焦点音量闪避
description.zh: 在侧边栏加个 B 站直播页，像 Niri 那样横向滚动管理多个直播间，还能上下分屏、看弹幕、按焦点自动调音量。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）开机动画插件：短片按顺序铺满播完再淡入界面，一键安装、素材可替换、不改 DSH 本体源码。基于 lxj5820 的作品二次修改（MIT）。
description.zh: 给 DSH 换一段开机动画，打开页面先铺满窗口播完短片再淡入界面，一条命令装卸、素材可替换，不改本体源码。

description.en: Unified install for DS Bot and the Codex-style sidebar: one package that mounts both and fixes their layout conflicts (composer alignment, sidebar footer, account entry, conversation width).
description.zh: DS Bot 与 Codex 风格侧栏的合一安装：一个包同时挂载两者并修复共存时的布局冲突（输入框对齐、侧栏底部、账户入口、对话宽度）。

description.en: Visualizes prompt-cache hit rates and model request activity in DSH Web, with request details, comparison, and conversation navigation.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中可视化提示词缓存命中率与模型请求活动，支持请求详情、请求对比和对话定位。

description.en: Live prompt-cache telemetry for the current session in the DSH right sidebar, drawn as a register bank and a reactor-core history board.
description.zh: 以寄存器阵列与反应堆芯历史盘面的形式，在 DSH 右侧栏实时显示当前会话的提示词缓存遥测。

description.en: Composes tools, skills and MCP servers into switchable per-session sets, shrinking the resident tool surface and the system prompt on demand.
description.zh: 能力组合：把工具、技能与 MCP 编成可切换的组合，按需缩小常驻工具面与系统提示。

description.en: Scans the skills DSH can load into one browsable catalog organized as collection, category and command, with a sidebar panel, click-to-insert into the composer, and custom categories and per-command notes saved outside the plugin directory.
description.zh: 把 DSH 能加载的技能扫成一份可浏览目录，按集合、分类、命令三级组织，提供侧边栏面板与点击插入输入框，自定义分类与命令说明保存在插件目录之外。

description.en: Cloudflare 人机验证的人工交接层：给 DSH 的 web_fetch 用。撞到验证就停下、用你自己的浏览器过、再从断点继续。不自动过验证、不接打码、不偷 cookie。
description.zh: 遇到 Cloudflare 验证就暂停，让你用自己的浏览器手动过，再从断点接着抓，不碰验证码也不偷 cookie。

description.en: Bilingual DeepSeek Harness changelog, security-advisory and storage panel — version timeline, CVE/GHSA records and disk usage in one sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在侧边栏集中查看版本更新记录、安全漏洞公告和磁盘占用，中英双语一目了然。

description.en: dsh 插件：把 DeepSeek Harness 的原生「极简模式」爆改成 Chat 模式——零工具、零系统提示词注入。
description.zh: 把 dsh 极简模式改成纯聊天模式，零工具零系统提示词，只留对话本身。

description.en: ChatGPT-like conversation layout for the DeepSeek Harness Web client: a 768px centered column, right-aligned neutral bubbles for user turns, full-width assistant text at 16/28, and rounded code blocks with their own copy banner. Adds semantic inline markup (`==confirmed==`, `!!risk!!`, `++key word++`, with bare 4xx/5xx codes highlighted automatically) and line-start check/warn/tip callouts; a fast/thinking chip in the composer that switches the model reasoning effort through ctx.modelDirectories; and sidebar contrast, where the selected session gets a tinted row with an accent bar and workspace folder icons are colored.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 的对话排版改成 ChatGPT 风格：768px 居中版心、用户消息右侧中性灰气泡、助手消息全宽 16/28 正文、带独立复制条的圆角代码块；另有行内语义标记（==已确认==、!!风险!!、++重点词++，裸的 4xx/5xx 自动命中）、行首 ✅/⚠️/💡 整行卡片、发送框旁「快速 / 思考」胶囊（经 ctx.modelDirectories 切换推理强度），以及左侧工作区高亮：选中会话带底色与左侧色条、工作区文件夹图标上色。

description.en: Switches every session's thinking and answers to Chinese — terse, a little wry, plain-spoken — while keeping proper nouns in English, and adds an "answer only what was asked" interaction rule. One global system-prompt section (order 10): no UI, no binaries, no network calls. Inactive under the minimal preset, which replaces the whole prompt with its own persona.
description.zh: 让所有会话的思考与回复都说中文：简洁、略沾文言、说人话，专有名词保留英文原形；并附一条「只答所问、不主动跑命令、动手前先提醒」的交互偏好。实现只是一条全局 system-prompt 段落（order 10）：没有界面、没有二进制、不联网。切到极简预设时不生效——那个预设会把整个 prompt 换成它自己的人设。

description.en: Banter lexicon plugin: collects the words and angry quips the user said into banter ammo with add, list and random-pick tools, and injects the current ammo list into the prompt every turn.
description.zh: 斗嘴词库插件：把用户说过的粗口与气话收成斗嘴弹药，配收录、查看与随机抽取工具，弹药清单每轮自动注入提示词。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的输入框回车键行为调整插件。
description.zh: 把输入框回车改成换行，Shift/Alt+Enter 才发送，聊天打字不再手滑发出去。

description.en: Conversation font-size controls for the Web UI: a stepper in the composer row, keyboard shortcuts, and Ctrl+wheel zoom, all writing through the theme service setFontSize.
description.zh: Web 界面的对话字号控制：输入区步进器、键盘快捷键与 Ctrl+滚轮缩放，统一走主题服务的 setFontSize。

description.en: DSH Web 客户端插件:AI 回复完成时播放双音提示音 (DeepSeek Harness)
description.zh: AI 回复完成时自动播放双音提示，不用盯着屏幕也能知道答案好了。

description.en: Attach files and folders in the composer via clipboard paste, a native file/folder picker, and @-mention path search; folders are converted to paged Markdown for the agent to read page by page. macOS only (clipboard and picker go through osascript).
description.zh: 在输入框附加文件和文件夹：剪贴板粘贴、原生文件/文件夹选择器、@-mention 路径搜索；文件夹转分页 Markdown 供智能体逐页读取。仅支持 macOS（剪贴板读取与选择器依赖 osascript）。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的本地离线汉语词典模式：字/词/成语/歇后语/汉英对译，零依赖插件 + 自带建库脚本
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个本地离线汉语词典，查字词成语歇后语和汉英对译，不用联网也能用

description.en: Staleness keeper for the Codebase Memory knowledge graph: it compares the graph Branch node head_sha with git rev-parse HEAD and reports an exact behindBy, rebuilds only the stale projects through the codebase-memory-mcp CLI so the MCP tool 60-second cap does not apply, watches each project for edits, and mirrors the same state into a settings card and a REST control surface.
description.zh: Codebase Memory 知識圖譜的保鮮插件：比對圖譜 Branch 節點的 head_sha 與 git rev-parse HEAD、給出精確的落後提交數，只重建落後的專案且走 codebase-memory-mcp CLI（不受 MCP 工具 60 秒上限約束），逐專案監看檔案變更，並把同一份狀態呈現在設定卡片與 REST 控制面。

description.en: In-place Markdown editing for the right-sidebar document preview: a file keeps the shipped renderer's look, clicking a paragraph, heading, list, fence, or table cell puts the caret exactly where you clicked, and only the edited range is written back through ctx.fs.writeText, optionally guarded by the version it read.
description.zh: 让右侧栏的 Markdown 预览就地可编辑：文档保持自带渲染器的排版，点段落、标题、列表、代码围栏或表格单元格时光标落在点击处，只有被编辑的那段经 ctx.fs.writeText 写回，并可带上读取时的版本作为护栏。

description.en: Codex-style Git panel for DeepSeek Harness: a header button opens a menu with commit, push, branch switching and creation, and repository initialization; shows the current branch and the total additions and deletions of uncommitted files.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格的 Git 面板：会话头部按钮打开菜单，提供提交、推送、切换分支、创建并切换与初始化仓库；显示当前分支与未提交文件的总增减。

description.en: Plays a 44-second sci-fi cold-boot sequence over the DSH window on startup: terminal log, whale mark, four spoken lines, and a skip button. Pure DOM and CSS in one self-contained client bundle, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 启动时在 DSH 窗口上播一段 44 秒的科幻冷启动序列：终端日志、鲸鱼标识、四句英文人声，外加一个跳过按钮。纯 DOM 与 CSS，单个自包含的客户端包，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Saves architecture and validated plans, runs native AgentTeams workers with approval, parallel coding and independent review, and summarizes progress and verification results.
description.zh: 保存架构和可校验计划，批准后通过原生 AgentTeams 并行开发与独立审查，并汇总进度、验证结果和交付阻塞。

description.en: 界面调色插件 for DeepSeek Harness：快捷键进入拾色模式，点选界面上任意元素就地改色 —— 元素级改动存成 CSS 规则、语义色走主题 token 层，空闲零轮询。
description.zh: 按快捷键就能点选界面元素直接改色，改动存成 CSS 规则或主题 token，不碰源码。

description.en: Command center for DeepSeek Harness: watch running background jobs in one panel, tell a long silence apart from a hang, and see when the agent is waiting on you.
description.zh: 一屏看清后台任务跑到哪、agent 在等谁、等了多久，卡住还是慢一目了然，需要你时还会喊你。

description.en: DSH 压缩指令插件：给 /compact 增加可选的摘要重点，让压缩后的摘要优先保留指定内容。
description.zh: 给 /compact 加个摘要重点，压缩历史时优先保留你指定的内容，不怕关键信息被压没。

description.en: Auto-pairs brackets and quotes in the DSH chat composer, inserting the closing half with the caret in between; it also wraps selected text with the typed pair and handles brackets committed by an IME.
description.zh: DSH 聊天输入框的括号/引号自动配对：输入左半边自动补右半边并把光标停在中间；也支持用符号包裹选中文字，以及中文输入法提交的括号。

description.en: 把 DSH 输入框做成 VS Code 手感：配对/环绕/跳闭合/删空对、四类候选（本文词·语言词表·工作区文件·模型名）、行内灰字提示、中文词补全；标准 bundle 插件，一条命令装，不写文件不改宿主源码
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框加上 VS Code 式补全和括号配对，打字更顺手，少来回改。

description.en: Connects a locally-signed-in Cursor desktop app to dsh as a native LlmAdapter — reads the Cursor login token from state.vscdb or auth.json, drives the private agent.v1.AgentService/Run HTTP/2 bidi stream, and translates InteractionUpdate deltas into dsh StreamChunks. No loopback proxy. macOS, Windows and Linux.
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 Cursor 桌面应用接入 dsh，原生 LlmAdapter 直连：从 state.vscdb 或 auth.json 读登录态，驱动 agent.v1.AgentService/Run 的 HTTP/2 双向流，把 InteractionUpdate 增量翻成 dsh StreamChunk，不走 loopback 代理。支持 macOS / Windows / Linux。

description.en: DCAR · Deterministic-first auto review for DeepSeek Harness — CAutoR 权限模式：程序先放行，疑难按需交给 LLM
description.zh: 程序先自动放行常规操作，疑难情况再交给 LLM 审查，让 DeepSeek Harness 的权限审批又快又稳。

description.en: Replaces rolling narrative summaries with an append-only session index, so early facts survive compaction verbatim and shadowed text stays retrievable by anchor.
description.zh: 把上下文压缩从滚动重写的叙事摘要改为只追加的会话索引：早期事实逐字保留，被压缩掉的原文可按锚点取回。

description.en: A context usage ring with configurable character-based automatic compaction, manual compaction, protected user requirements and recoverable original history for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 上下文用量环，支持按字符自定义自动压缩阈值、手动压缩、保留用户要求和回查原文，适配 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: Adds a one-click Continue button beside Send that resumes a stopped turn by sending the "continue" prompt; hidden while a turn is running or the session is empty.
description.zh: 在「发送」旁加一个一键「继续」按钮：用 continue 提示词续跑已停止的一轮；轮次进行中或会话为空时不显示。

description.en: Resume a conversation whose turn stopped early: /continue and an action-row button carry the interrupted reply on, covering manual stops, failed model requests, output-token cutoffs and crash recovery, and the continuation prompt is retired from the transcript once it has been answered.
description.zh: 从断点继续对话：/continue 命令与消息操作行按钮让模型接着被打断的回答往下写，覆盖手动停止、模型请求失败、输出 token 上限截断与崩溃恢复四种情形，续写提示在被回答后从对话框中回收。

description.en: C++ runtime info probe for Windows via CDB: cpp_trace prints variables at multiple breakpoints in one session (replaces hand-written print), cpp_probe dumps the call stack at a conditional breakpoint. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cpp-probe.
description.zh: Windows + CDB 下的 C++ 运行时信息探针：cpp_trace 一次会话多断点打印变量（替换手打 print），cpp_probe 条件断点输出调用栈。安装：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cpp-probe。

description.en: Custom Web Search plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), replacing web-search-deepseek with multi-engine sequential fallback.
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上自定义联网搜索，多引擎依次兜底，一个不行自动换下一个。

description.en: One standing system prompt for every workspace: a Custom instructions page in DSH's own Settings panel whose text is added to the system prompt of every session, subagents included, and stored in the profile instead of any project.
description.zh: 所有工作区共用的长期系统提示词：在 DSH 自己的设置面板里新增「自定义指令」页，文本会加入每个会话（含子代理）的系统提示词，并保存在 profile 而不是任何项目里。

description.en: DSH自定义主题：可自行修改背景图片，主题色，表情包与文案。基于[dsh-vesna-theme](https://github.com/Mahiru0427/dsh-vesna-theme)
description.zh: DSH 外观全项自定义主题，壁纸、明暗配色、表情包和文案都能换成你自己的。

description.en: Daily brief for DeepSeek Harness. Every day at a fixed hour it ranks the plugin market by real install counts and stars, cross-checks it against your own agent memory and working conventions, and proposes two kinds of item: concrete deltas on the plugins people actually use (original does A, the proposal does B) and directions nobody has built yet. The popularity numbers come from the catalog the market itself publishes and are quoted into the prompt rather than guessed; an entry the market has not measured is shown as unmeasured, never as zero. Approving an item opens a new session named after it and hands that session a fixed delivery contract — implement independently, never fork, test green before publishing. Rejected sources are remembered so they stop coming back.
description.zh: DSH 日报：每天定点按真实下载量与 star 把插件市场排一遍，再对照你自己的 agent 记忆与工作约定，产出两类条目——对已经有很多人在用的插件的具体改法（原版是 A，提案做成 B），以及生态里还没有的新方向。热度数字取自市场对外发布的目录并原样写进提示词，不由模型猜测；市场没测到的条目会标成「无热门度数据」，绝不当作 0。批准一条会按它的项目名新建一个会话，并把一份固定交付契约交给那个会话：独立实现、不许 fork、测试全绿才发布。标记「不感兴趣」的来源会被记住，不再重复出现。

description.en: DSH 插件：在 Web GUI 对话输入区底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（总额 / 赠送 / 充值）。

一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：在 ctx.web seam 上注册网页搜索和网页抓取两个 provider，后端使用 DeepSeek 原生的 Search / Fetch JSON API。  它接入 harness，而不是自带模型工具：模型侧 web_search / web_fetch 的 schema、provider 选择与结果渲染仍由 dsh-tool-web 负责；本包只提供两个后端。
description.zh: 给 DSH 接入 DeepSeek 原生网页搜索和抓取能力，让模型能联网查资料、读网页。
在侧边栏一键彻底删除某个会话，连本地数据副本也一并清干净。

description.en: A delivery receipt panel for a project hand-off. One trigger collects the branch and commit, the test and build results, screenshot dimensions with sha256, and the secret-scan verdict, then assigns every line to one of three zones by evidence alone — verified, local-only, or unverified. A claim in the unverified zone keeps its label and prints an explicitly empty slot instead of the claim itself, because a confidently worded sentence with nothing behind it is the exact thing the receipt exists to catch. Test failures and secret-scan hits are still evidence, so they land in the verified zone with a red tone rather than being quietly dropped.
description.zh: 项目收尾用的交付回执面板。触发一次即汇总分支与 commit、测试与构建结果、截图的宽高与 sha256、密钥扫描结论，然后只按证据把每一条分进三区：已验证、仅本地、未验证。落在未验证区的声明只保留标签，正文位置显式留空而不是把声明印出来——措辞自信而背后什么都没有的句子，正是回执要防的东西。测试失败与密钥扫描命中同样是有证据的事实，因此进已验证区并带红色色调，而不是被悄悄丢掉。

description.en: A resident assistant for DeepSeek Harness that is deliberately not another chat box: one floating window plus one standing conversation, both independent of every other session. The heartbeat is held back by four gates — an authority grant, a daily turn budget, quiet hours and a pacing cooldown — and it keeps working across restarts through a lease it has to hold. Each wake is decided by a model that must answer SKIP or a short message, so silence is a decision rather than a failure. The window shows the standing conversation's real message flow, read from the host session store, or from the on-disk session log when the host does not publish that session, and it can send into that conversation directly. den carries the same reach as the person it stands in for, with one limit: read-only. It may read every session, this machine and work channels such as GitHub, but it does not write, send or publish, it never asks anyone for permission, and it never gates another session's tool calls. `npm run digest:github` turns GitHub notifications and your own open pull requests into three Chinese sections — waiting on you, waiting on your review, and yours — with reply drafts that are explicitly marked as unsent.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的常驻助理，刻意不做成又一个会话框：一个浮窗 + 一个常驻会话，两者都独立于其他所有会话。心跳受四道门约束——授权、每日回合预算、安静时段、冷却——并靠必须持续持有的租约跨重启续接。每次唤醒都交给模型裁决：回 SKIP 就一个字都不说，所以沉默是一次决定，而不是一次失败。浮窗显示常驻会话的真实消息流（优先读宿主会话存储；宿主不发布该会话时改读落盘日志），并且可以直接在里面发话。den 拥有人同等的触达范围，但有一条硬限制：只读。它可以读所有会话、本机以及 GitHub 等工作渠道，却不写、不发送、不发布，从不向任何人索要许可，也从不拦别人的工具调用。`npm run digest:github` 把 GitHub 通知和你自己开着的 PR 整理成三区中文摘要——等你回的、等你审的、你自己的——并给出明确标注「未发送」的回复草稿。

description.en: Multi-agent delivery workflow for dsh: a commander dispatches to fixed and temporary agents through a persisted task state machine, with a canvas and roster in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的多 Agent 交付编排：总指挥派发 + 固定/临时员工 + 落盘任务状态机，右侧栏提供画布与名册面板。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that triages sandbox-escalation approvals: hard rules + exact allowlist + second-model review, sandbox stays on. Work in progress.
description.zh: 给沙箱提权请求做审核的 dsh 插件，靠硬规则、白名单加二次模型复核，让沙箱一直开着。

description.en: A download-progress indicator for the DSH session header: it reads the background-job roster and parses what downloaders already print — curl --progress-bar, wget, aria2, or a JSON progress file — into a progress ring, animated bars, transfer speed and ETA. Jobs that report nothing show as unknown progress instead of being hidden. A finished file opens with one click, or reveals in the file manager. No third-party plugin required; the package ships zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 会话头里的下载进度指示器：读取后台任务名册，把下载器自己已经打印出来的进度（curl --progress-bar、wget、aria2，或 JSON 进度文件）解析成环形进度、动画进度条、传输速率与剩余时间；不上报进度的任务显示为未知进度而不是被隐藏。已完成文件单击即开，也可在文件管理器里定位。不依赖任何第三方插件，运行时零依赖。

description.en: 推理等级滑条：DSH Web composer 里模型选择器旁的胶囊，点开是整宽渐变滑条（蓝→紫随档位推进、流光扫过、白钮拖动），复用官方模型目录的会话状态。
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页输入框的模型选择器旁加个胶囊，点开拖滑条就能改当前会话的推理等级。

description.en: DSH plugin: sync model-catalog reasoning levels (reasoningEfforts) from what the provider advertises on /v1/models — sync_reasoning_levels tool plus a one-click button in the Models settings page.
description.zh: 一键把模型目录里的推理等级和供应商实际公布的对齐，省得手动补。

description.en: Read-only unread-mail board for the accounts configured in dsh-email — unread messages appear as per-account cards in the DSH right sidebar (sender, subject, time) and refresh on demand.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 未读邮件看板——把 dsh-email 里配置的各账号未读邮件按账号列成右侧栏卡片（发件人、主题、时间），按需手动刷新。

description.en: Audits JLCEDA (EasyEDA) .enet netlists for broken net labels, dangling nets, power-rail orphans, conflicting pin polarity, and full-differential-amplifier feedback wiring.
description.zh: 校对嘉立创 EDA 导出的 .enet 网表，检查断链式网络标签、单脚悬空网络、电源轨孤立、引脚名与所连网络极性矛盾、全差分运放反馈接法。

description.en: Proxy provider that reshapes each outbound payload through a per-category op chain before forwarding upstream, keeping the prompt prefix monotonic between turns so unchanged history is not re-paid at full price; op names are transports (exec / http / inline) and accept user-defined algorithms.
description.zh: 代理 provider：每次出网前按类别跑 op 链重塑 payload 再转交上游，使 prompt 前缀在回合之间保持单调、未变的历史不必按全价重付；op 名只表示传输方式（exec / http / inline），可接入用户自定义算法。

description.en: Registers arbitrary configured DSH permission presets, each selecting a sandbox mode and approval policy plus the directories writable on top of it. Linux bwrap only.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加自定义权限预设，每个预设自定沙箱模式、审批策略和可写目录，仅支持 Linux bwrap。

description.en: Creates and edits Feishu and Lark cloud content through ten tools - Bitable databases and their records, documents with Markdown converted to native blocks, spreadsheets, wikis, drive files and messages - plus Base V3 dashboard charts and server-side aggregate queries.
description.zh: 通过十个工具创建与编辑飞书 / Lark 云内容——多维表格及其记录、把 Markdown 转成原生块的文档、电子表格、知识库、云空间文件与消息，并提供 Base V3 的仪表盘图表与服务端聚合查询。

description.en: Right-click a file or folder in the right sidebar file tree to add it to the composer as an @ reference (⌘/Ctrl and Shift multi-select insert a whole batch), open it with the default application, or reveal it in the system file manager. Open and reveal go through the built-in open-in-app host capability, so those entries appear unless the host explicitly reports the capability as unsupported.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文件树里右键，可把文件或文件夹作为 @ 引用加进输入框（⌘/Ctrl 与 Shift 多选可整批插入）、用默认应用打开，或在系统文件管理器中显示。打开与显示走宿主内置的 open-in-app 能力，只有宿主明确回答不支持时才隐藏这两项。

description.en: Firefly "Spring Missive" theme skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Overrides 74 --dsw-alias-* design tokens in matched light and dark sets, draws a spring-window backdrop with drifting petals and fireflies, places one character illustration on each side of the layout, and keeps the centre column legible with a radial spotlight scrim. Registers a Settings section with switches for the skin and for the artwork; both choices persist in localStorage.
description.zh: 流萤「春日手信」主题皮肤。覆盖 74 个 --dsw-alias-* 官方设计令牌（明暗两套），绘制春日橱窗背景与飘落花瓣、萤火；布局两侧各放一张人物立绘，中央用径向聚光遮罩保证文字对比度；在设置里注册分区，提供皮肤与立绘两个开关，选择存在 localStorage。

description.en: Windows floating status lamp outside the DSH window: a borderless always-on-top glowing orb on a fully transparent background — green with a breathing halo while tasks run, orange shaking for approval, blue floating for your input, dim grey idle, dark grey host offline; hovering lists each session's latest task, drag to move, and the lamp self-extinguishes within seconds when the plugin is switched off.
description.zh: 悬浮在 DSH 应用之外的 Windows 状态灯：无边框置顶发光圆灯，背景完全透明——绿灯光晕呼吸表示运行中、橙灯抖动待授权、蓝灯漂浮待你交互、灰灯空闲、暗灰宿主离线；悬停逐行列出各会话正在运行的任务，可拖动记忆位置，插件被关闭后数秒内自动熄灭。

description.en: Small DeepSeek Harness affordances for everyday actions — locate the current session from the sidebar header (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+D), copy a session ID from the session row menu (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C), open links in the system default program including localhost, open or copy inline code from a context menu, open changed-file cards with a local IDE or reveal them in the file manager, swap Enter with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, recall sent messages with Up/Down, and show the current workspace name inside the header open button; every one of them has its own switch in a Flow settings page.
