description.zh: DSH 的一组小改动，把日常动作改回直觉——侧栏标题行的定位当前会话按钮（⇧⌘D）、会话行菜单里的复制会话 ID（⇧⌘C）、链接交给系统默认程序打开（含 localhost）、行内代码的打开或复制右键菜单、改动文件卡片用本机 IDE 打开或在文件管理器中显示、Enter 与 ⌘/Ctrl+Enter 对调、↑↓ 回填发过的消息，以及把当前工作区名写进标题行「打开」按钮；每一项在设置的「心流」页各有一个开关。

description.en: Folder time machine for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot any folder, browse its timeline, roll back with one click — Git-like history without needing Git, for folders that never had a repo (game saves, app config dirs, loose documents). Snapshots are content-addressed and deduplicated, and unchanged files are not re-hashed. Automatic snapshots come in two modes: realtime (fs.watch — one version ~8s after the last change, so a save-all or a build counts once) and timed (checks every N minutes, stores only when something actually changed; identical content never adds an empty version). Empty folders are recorded and recreated on restore. Every restore takes a safety snapshot first, so a rollback is itself undoable, and exact-mode cleanup only removes files and empty folders — a non-empty folder is never deleted. Ships a folder_timemachine model tool (status/history/diff need no approval; writes ask first) plus a floating panel with the timeline, one-click restore and mode switching. Pure JS, zero runtime dependencies, 110 tests included.
description.zh: 给任意文件夹留下历史时间点并一键回到过去：像 Git 一样有版本历史，但不需要懂 Git，任何文件夹都能用（游戏存档、软件配置目录、散落文档都行）。快照按内容寻址去重，只存真正变化的文件，未变文件不重算哈希；自动存档分两档——实时（fs.watch，最后一次改动静默约 8 秒后存一版，编辑器一次保存或一次构建算一版）与定时（每 N 分钟检查，有变化才存，内容没变不产生空版本）。空文件夹也会被记录，恢复时一并重建（mod 加载器、存档扫描器常要求某个空夹存在）。每次恢复前自动存一个安全还原点，因此恢复本身可撤销；exact 模式只删多余文件与空目录，非空目录一律不动。附带模型工具 folder_timemachine（status/history/diff 免审批，写操作走审批）与左下角浮窗面板（时间线、一键恢复、实时/定时切换）。纯 JS、零运行时依赖、自带 110 项测试。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: pick UI/code/terminal fonts visually - enumerate installed fonts, edit fallback stacks, import custom fonts, live preview, one-click reset. Applies through the official ctx.theme service; never touches app.asar.
description.zh: 在设置里可视化挑界面、代码和终端字体，能预览、导入自定义字体，更新 DSH 也不丢。

description.en: Fork and delete buttons on each workspace row of the Harness sidebar, plus a /fork-worktree command: fork creates a git worktree and registers it as a new workspace, delete removes the workspace folder through git worktree remove (asking again before discarding uncommitted work) and drops the registration.
description.zh: 在 Harness 侧边栏的每个工作区行加 fork 与删除按钮，并提供 /fork-worktree 命令：fork 创建 git worktree 并注册为新工作区，删除通过 git worktree remove 移除工作区文件夹（丢弃未提交内容前会再确认一次）并移除工作区登记。

description.en: macOS ⌃⌘F window-fullscreen shortcut for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端补上 macOS 的 ⌃⌘F 全屏快捷键，一键切换窗口全屏。

description.en: Adds an extensible Functions menu to the DSH top bar, where plugins register one-click actions with staged confirmations, submenus and a pinned loader entry.
description.zh: 给 DSH 顶端加一个可扩展的「功能」栏：插件注册的一键动作都在这里，支持分级确认、二级菜单，还有一条置顶的「加载功能」。

description.en: 防止dsh自作主张上传到github  Prevent DSH from uploading to GitHub on its own initiative
description.zh: 两个开关拦住 DSH，不让它擅自改动本地 git 仓库或往 GitHub 上传代码。

description.en: DSH Web 的 Git 面板：工作区总览卡片 + 变更/历史/分支三视图 + AI 提交信息与项目简介（DSH web plugin: git panel)
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 里直接看 Git 工作区、变更、历史和分支，还能让 AI 帮你写提交信息和项目简介。

description.en: Git tab in the DeepSeek Harness conversation view: reviews every repository in the session working directory and commits each on its own, with change groups, whole-file / changes-only / side-by-side diffs, in-panel editing, and a push button that lists every commit it would publish.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话页里的 Git 标签页：列出会话工作目录下的每个仓库并各自独立提交，变更分组，整个文件 / 只看变动 / 并排三种差异看法，面板内直接编辑保存，以及推送前逐一列出将要发布的提交。

description.en: Manage local GitHub CLI accounts, web authorization, SSH identity and repository permissions in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接管理本机 GitHub CLI 账号，网页授权、SSH 身份和仓库权限一站搞定。

description.en: Bidirectional GitHub repository sync for DSH: git sync with conflict rollback and pre-push checks, Actions/CI monitoring with per-step run detail, repository add/remove/rename, a web panel with local and remote file browsers, scheduled automation, and six agent tools.
description.zh: DSH 的 GitHub 仓库同步插件：带冲突回滚与推送前检查的双向 git 同步、可下钻到每一步的 Actions/CI 监控、仓库添加/移除/改名、含本地与远端文件浏览的 Web 面板、定时自动化流水线，以及六个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Gowin (高云) 1.9 FPGA toolchain control for dsh: 15 tools covering environment and license probe, .gprj/.cst project and constraint auditing against a real GW1N board pinout, gw_sh batch synthesis and place-and-route, pnr resource and timing report parsing, programmer_cli JTAG scan and flash, arbitrary gw_sh Tcl, and the GAO on-line logic analyzer capture chain — plus a bundled gowin-fpga skill and three field-note references. Pure JS, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把高云 Gowin 1.9 FPGA 工具链交给 dsh：15 个工具覆盖环境与 License 探针、.gprj/.cst 工程与约束审计（对着真实 GW1N 板引脚表）、gw_sh 批量综合与布局布线、pnr 资源与时序报告解析、programmer_cli 扫描与烧录、任意 gw_sh Tcl 执行，以及 GAO 在线逻辑分析采集链路；另附内置 gowin-fpga 技能与三份实测手册。纯 JS，零运行时依赖。

description.en: DSH GUI control: one-click hard refresh of the web UI and restart of the Harness host (sidebar entries + settings status panel). · DeepSeek Harness 界面控制插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面加一键强刷和重启 Harness 的按钮，侧边栏和设置面板都能用，省得手动折腾。

description.en: Offline HAR diagnostics with endpoint aliases, original entry indexes and minimal HTML/JSON evidence; no recording or request replay.
description.zh: 离线分析 HAR，以端点别名、原始条目索引和最小 HTML/JSON 证据定位请求问题；不录制或重放请求。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness settings panel: MCP server status + probe, session skills, and hook configs in one native-styled page
description.zh: 在设置里加一个 Harness 页面，集中查看 MCP 服务器状态、启停服务、开关技能和配置钩子。

description.en: Periodic water, stand-up, eye-break and stretch reminders on your own work schedule, with daily and 7/30-day statistics and multiple switchable reminder plans.
description.zh: 按自定义作息定时提醒喝水、起身、护眼和拉伸，带每日与近 7/30 天统计，以及多套可随时切换的提醒方案。

description.en: Selection comments and quoted conversations (dsh划词评论 / dsh-huaci-pinglun), based on the MIT-licensed BangBang-03/dsh-client-ui-quote 0.11.1 with attached textarea measurement, border-aware height and long-text scrolling.
description.zh: dsh划词评论（dsh-huaci-pinglun）：基于 BangBang-03/dsh-client-ui-quote 0.11.1 的 MIT 修补分支，提供划词评论与引用对话，修复引用文本框在挂载并可见后测量、补齐边框高度与长文滚动。

description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness desktop app icon (exe, tray and Start Menu) with any uploaded .ico, and restores the stock icon on demand.
description.zh: 更换 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端应用图标（exe、托盘、开始菜单），支持上传任意 .ico，并可随时还原官方默认图标。

description.en: Browse Tencent ima knowledge bases in a DSH sidebar panel, preview PDF, Office, note and media files inline, and let the agent search and read them through five tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏浏览腾讯 ima 的知识库与文件，内置常见格式预览，并让 agent 用 5 个工具按名称或正文检索、读取库内资料。

description.en: Adds a right-column panel that compares a set of images the user picks from the workspace — 1/2/3/4/6 per page, per-image zoom and pan, the zoom and viewed position of one image synced onto the whole set, and a reorderable filmstrip. The browser loads every image, so none of it reaches the model.
description.zh: 在右栏新增一个面板，用来并排对比用户自己从工作区挑选的一组图片——每页 1/2/3/4/6 张、每张独立缩放与平移、可把某一张的缩放与显示位置同步到整组、缩略图可拖动排序。图片由浏览器直接加载，不进入模型。

description.en: Inlines an image block as base64 only in the one request where it first appears, and marks that same block offloaded on every later request so DSH's own image-offload projection renders it as the placeholder text carrying the read-only local path. An occurrence is keyed by session id, message id, content-tree path and attachment id, and a request is only counted after it produces its first chunk, so retries do not count as sent. Requests carrying a purpose are neither rewritten nor counted, a later read_image of the same file is a new occurrence and inlines once more, and only that request's copy is rewritten, so nothing is written back to the session.
description.zh: 同一张图片只在它第一次出现的那一次请求里以 base64 内联；之后的每次请求都携带被标记为 offloaded 的同一个块，由 DSH 自带的图片 offload 投影渲染成带本地只读路径的占位文字。记账键是会话 id、消息 id、内容树路径与 attachment id 的组合，且请求产生第一个 chunk 之后才记账，因此重试不会算作已发送。带 purpose 的辅助请求既不改写也不记账；事后再对同一文件调用 read_image 算一次新的 occurrence 并重新内联一次；插件只改写该次请求的副本，不写回会话。

description.en: 为DSH（DeepSeek Harness）打造的 AI 图像生成插件
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体直接生成和编辑图片，支持文生图、参考图改图、蒙版局部修改，还能在对话里预览。

description.en: A persistent translate button lives in every page the browser opens: click it and every visible text node is replaced in place, click again to restore. Hold to drag, drop it near an edge and it tucks into a small handle; it is re-injected automatically after navigation. The host LLM service does the translation — the plugin holds no API key.
description.zh: 给内置浏览器的每一张页面常驻一个「🈯 译」按钮：点一下，页面上每个可见文本节点原地换成译文；再点一下回到原文。长按可拖动，拖到左右边缘自动吸成贴边小把手；页面导航后自动重装。翻译走宿主模型服务 —— 插件不持有任何 API key。

description.en: Adds a four-pointed-star button left of the composer's model selector that rewrites the unsent draft in place — grammar, wording, punctuation and execution order — preserving code, commands, paths, identifiers, numbers and URLs byte-for-byte, answering nothing and never overwriting text typed while it runs. A pencil under every user message reopens that message for editing without touching the draft; because the Harness session log is append-only, an edit forks the conversation before that message rather than rewriting it. A circular restart icon under every reply asks that one question again in a fresh conversation that carries none of the earlier turns. Both are refused while a turn is still answering, and disabled when the reply used a tool that can leave a trace or when the files the message named have since changed. A right-sidebar memory tree draws the conversation as turns, showing what was actually asked and answered, every answer to one question on its own line labelled original, edited or memory-free, newest first, with arrows that re-read an answer in place; right-clicking jumps to a branch or removes it from the plugin's own history.
description.zh: 在输入框模型选择器左侧加一个四角星按钮，发送前就地改写尚未发出的草稿——语法、用词、标点与制作顺序——并逐字节保留代码、命令、路径、标识符、数字与 URL；它不回答请求，也不会覆盖改写期间新输入的文本。每条用户消息下的铅笔可在不碰草稿的前提下重新打开该消息编辑；因为 Harness 的会话日志只追加，编辑是在该消息之前派生分支，而不是改写原消息。每条回复下的圆形重启图标会在一个不含此前任何轮次的全新会话里重新问同一个问题。一轮还在作答时两者都不允许；当这条回复用过会留下痕迹的工具，或该消息提到的文件此后被改过时，两者也会被禁用。右侧栏的记忆树把对话按轮次画出来，显示真正被问和被答的内容，同一个问题的每个回答各占一行并标注为原始、编辑所得或无记忆重问，最新的在最上方，箭头在原处换读该回答；右键可跳转到某个分支，或把它从插件自己的历史中移除。

description.en: Adds three visual pages to DSH Settings: MCP servers (managed by rewriting the profile patch managed block from a JSON source of truth, with YAML validation and timestamped backups), skills (browse, create, edit and delete across DSH global, shared .agents and Claude / Codex directories) and the global AGENTS.md persona (with one-click restore of the last three backups).
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里加三个可视化页面：MCP 服务器（以 JSON 为真理源整体重写 profile patch 受管区块，写入前做 YAML 结构校验与时间戳备份）、技能（浏览 / 新建 / 编辑 / 删除，覆盖 DSH 全局、共享 .agents 与 Claude / Codex 目录）、全局 AGENTS.md 人设（可一键载回最近 3 份备份）。

description.en: Interactive cards in replies, built from a fixed catalog of 31 components (sliders, inputs, sortable tables, charts, function plots, typeset formulas, tabs, checklists, flowcharts, quiz buttons, an animation player): controls recompute in the browser without another model call, and the model never writes HTML or JavaScript. Includes a calculus engine (integrals, derivatives, limits, sums, roots, Taylor polynomials) and a bundled skill that teaches the model when to use a card.
description.zh: 渐进式交互：回复里的可交互卡片，由 31 个固定组件搭成（滑块、输入框、可排序表格、图表、函数图像、公式排版、分页、勾选清单、流程图、答题按钮、动画播放器）。调节控件在浏览器内重算，不再调用模型；模型不写任何 HTML 或 JavaScript。内置微积分引擎（定积分、导数、极限、求和、求根、泰勒多项式）和一个教模型何时用卡片的技能。

description.en: Multi-agent A-share research pipeline skill for DeepSeek Harness (6 roles, dual-blind risk review, source-cited reports, PII gate)
description.zh: 用多个 AI 角色分工做 A 股和基金研究，双盲风控复核、报告带来源引用，还能自动脱敏。

description.en: A Kanban board for DSH: one SQLite board shared by a human and their agent sessions, in the desktop app's sidebar. Two gates (Definition of Ready, Definition of Done) are enforced by the board itself, and every move is an event, so cycle time and throughput come from what happened.
description.zh: 给人和 AI 代理共用的看板，任务进度实时同步，还自动把关「就绪」和「完成」两道关卡。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地加密凭据保险库的插件：按对话授权、三个 Agent 工具、中英双语设置页
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Agent 配一个本地加密保险库，凭据跨对话留存，按对话授权使用。

description.en: DSH 插件：播种 Kimi Coding Plan 供应商，对话输入区底部显示用量（5 小时 / 周 / 月度配额）。
能让dsh连上飞书，cli+skills实现
description.zh: 让 AI 助手直接在对话里操作飞书，发消息、写文档、查日程、管任务、理表格都不用切窗口。

description.en: Generates release material from what a local repository can actually support: a hero image, a feature grid and bilingual copy rendered as SVG and HTML from `README.md`, `package.json` and optional screenshots. Facts are quoted from those files — name, version, license, summary, features, install snippet — and a field that is missing is left unrendered rather than filled with placeholder text. Every feature carries a source citation such as `README.md#L42`, and a claim the repository cannot substantiate is linted out before anything is written, with the reasoning left in `lint-report.json`. `manifest.json` records a sha256 for each input and output, and `--now` or `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` makes a run byte-identical. Also ships a GUI panel that regenerates from inside a session.
description.zh: 从本地仓库真实支持的产物生成发布素材：hero 图、特性网格与中英双语文案，由 `README.md`、`package.json` 和可选截图渲染成 SVG 与 HTML。事实全部从这些文件引用——项目名、版本、license、一句话简介、特性列表、安装片段——缺失的字段直接不渲染，不补占位文案。每条特性带 `README.md#L42` 这样的来源标注；无法被本仓库证实的说法在写出之前就被 lint 掉，理由留在 `lint-report.json`。`manifest.json` 记录每个输入与输出文件的 sha256，`--now` 或 `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` 可让整次输出字节一致。另含一个可以在会话里重新生成的 GUI 面板。

description.en: Pre-publish credential audit: walks a directory tree and flags API keys, tokens, private keys, database connection strings and hard-coded passwords before you commit, publish or ship. Zero dependencies, fully offline, findings are redacted to the first six characters.
description.zh: 发布前凭据审计：在你提交、发布或打包外发之前，遍历目录找出里面的 API key、令牌、私钥、数据库连接串和硬编码密码。零依赖、纯本地、不联网，发现结果脱敏到前 6 个字符。

description.en: 文学与古典文献研究：9 个检索与翻译工具、11 位文史专家子代理、3 个评审团。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上文史专家团，9 个文献工具加 11 位子代理帮你检索、翻译和评审古籍。

description.en: DSH 原生 Markdown / LaTeX 输入增强：在原生 Lexical 输入框里无开关实时呈现标题、列表、粗体、代码与 KaTeX 公式。
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生输入框里边打字边渲染 Markdown 和 KaTeX 公式，标题、列表、粗体、代码全都实时可见。

description.en: Runs MoE4All models locally in DSH with automatic engine installation, model discovery and downloads, inference settings, and live speed monitoring, or connects to an existing service.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中运行 MoE4All 本地模型，支持引擎自动安装、模型发现与下载、推理参数配置和实时速度监控，也可连接已有服务。
本地优先的 Markdown 知识库插件，基于证据链支撑，帮你构建可信赖的个人 wiki。

description.en: Local-folder wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: it defaults to your Pictures library (C:\Users\<you>\Pictures) and the host serves those images over same-origin HTTP, rotating one every N minutes (0-1440, default 5) in a shuffled pass with no repeats; the settings page under Plugins picks a different folder through the native system dialog, and tunes image opacity (100%), darkening scrim (25%) and panel opacity (15%) with changes applied live. Dialogs, modals and menus keep the default opaque background so text stays readable. Reads .jpg .jpeg .png .webp .gif .avif .bmp straight from disk, and keeps per-user settings under $DSH_HOME so upgrades never ship your folder path.
description.zh: 用本地文件夹当 DSH Web 壁纸：默认就用当前用户的「图片」库（C:\Users\<用户名>\Pictures），宿主通过同源 HTTP 提供其中的图片，每 N 分钟轮换一张（0-1440，默认 5），洗牌后一轮内不重复；「插件」页的设置界面可用系统原生文件夹对话框换目录，并可调节背景图不透明度（100%）、压暗遮罩（25%）与面板不透明度（15%），改动即时生效。弹窗、对话框与菜单保持默认不透明底色，字更清楚。直接读取 .jpg .jpeg .png .webp .gif .avif .bmp，用户配置写入 $DSH_HOME，升级不会带上你的目录路径。

description.en: Community DSH plugin for selecting installed local UI and code fonts in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里挑本机已装的字体，界面和代码显示都能换。

description.en: Syncs Logseq 2.0 DB graphs (including E2EE) with a Logseq sync server via the headless Logseq CLI, adds 11 logseq_* tools to search, query and edit them, and a Settings section to log in and configure sync.
description.zh: 通过无头运行的 Logseq CLI，把 Logseq 2.0 DB 图谱（含 E2EE 加密图谱）与同步服务器保持同步，提供 11 个 logseq_* 工具用于搜索、查询和编辑，并在设置页里登录和配置同步。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory: a hybrid-retrieval memory store (BM25 plus CJK bigrams), chunked long-document search, chat-log extraction and distillation, and context-summary archiving and browsing, with important memories and the latest summaries auto-injected into the prompt.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆包：混合检索记忆库（BM25+中文二元分词）、长文切块检索、聊天记录提取精炼，外加上下文总结存档与翻阅，重要记忆与最新总结自动注入提示词。

description.en: DSH plugin that cuts model repetition loops mid-stream, prunes them from the session log, and resumes automatically.
description.zh: 模型输出卡壳重复时自动打断，清理会话里的重复内容，然后接着往下跑。

description.en: dsh 插件：AI 选择题自动加一项「幸运方块」随机决定 + 说「回滚」撤销；界面上的骰子按钮长按挖穿即触发随机事件（写论文/我的世界概念合成/冷笑话/冷知识/时事新闻/弹窗表演/蓝屏屏保），整体致敬《赛博朋克 2077》的四季宝
description.zh: AI 选择题自动加个「幸运方块」随机替你选，说「回滚」就能撤销，还有骰子按钮长按触发各种随机彩蛋。

description.en: AI usage dashboard + optional global ranking for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: 把 AI 使用量变成可视化仪表盘，还能参与全球 Token 用量排名，看看你排第几。

description.en: Emails you when a long turn finishes or errors, when a goal completes or blocks, and when an approval or a question has waited past a timeout; each new notification deletes the previous one from the inbox over IMAP, so the inbox holds at most one.
description.zh: 耗时较长或工具调用较多的任务结束时发邮件到手机，出错、目标完成或目标受阻也发；审批或提问挂起超过设定时间没人处理会另外提醒（正文带问题原文与候选项，提醒不依赖任务档位）。每封新通知会通过 IMAP 删掉收件箱里的上一封，收件箱里最多留一封；其它文件夹不扫描。

description.en: Markdown input for the composer that keeps the typed Markdown as the sent text while drawing bullets and checkboxes, styling bold, italic, inline code, strikethrough, headings, quotes and fenced code blocks, continuing lists on Shift+Enter, and wrapping selections with Cmd/Ctrl+B, I and E.
description.zh: 输入框 Markdown 书写辅助：发送内容保持原始 Markdown，同时把列表显示为圆点和复选框，实时呈现粗体、斜体、行内代码、删除线、标题、引用与代码块，Shift+Enter 自动续写列表，选中文字可用 Cmd/Ctrl+B、I、E 加格式。

description.en: Markdown notes for DSH: multi-document management, reading themes, outline tick rail, and local autosave.
description.zh: DSH Markdown 笔记：多文档管理、阅读排版主题、大纲刻度条与本地自动保存。

description.en: DSH 插件市场控制台：在「设置 → 插件」里搜索、安装、启停、卸载第三方插件，全程走官方 plugin-manager 远程接口。
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里直接搜索、安装、启停和卸载第三方插件，不用折腾命令行。

description.en: Adds a dshmarket entry to the DSH sidebar footer, sharing a row with the Agents-Anywhere remote-control entry and sitting to its right, and opens the market panel in an overlay.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏底部加入 dshmarket 入口，与 Agents-Anywhere 的「远程控制」同处一行并位于其右侧，点击以浮层打开市场面板。

description.en: Community DSH host plugin that automatically resumes root-agent sessions after max-token truncation, with bounded retries and fail-closed safeguards.
description.zh: 模型输出被截断时自动接着跑，带重试上限和失败保护，不用手动催。

description.en: Settings panel for MCP servers registered by @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client: toggle each server on or off with live effect, see the registered tool count and estimated context-token cost of each server, and persist the choice to the home cordis.patch.yml with a timestamped backup before every write. Maintained fork of dsh-mcp-toggle.
description.zh: 面向 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 注册的 MCP 服务器的设置面板：逐个开关服务器（即时生效），显示各服务器的已注册工具数与预估上下文 token 开销，并将选择持久化到主目录 cordis.patch.yml，每次写入前保留带时间戳的备份。dsh-mcp-toggle 的维护分支。

description.en: MCP server manager for DSH: nine mcp_manager_* tools, a CLI and a web panel that list, validate, probe, add, edit, enable/disable and remove servers in ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml, search and install servers from the official MCP Registry, and locate or rotate stored credentials.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 服务器管理器：九个 mcp_manager_* 工具、命令行与网页面板，可列出、校验、探测、新增、编辑、启停、移除 ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml 中的服务器，从官方 MCP Registry 搜索并安装服务器，以及定位或轮换已存凭据。

description.en: DSH MCP 服务器管理器：在「设置 → MCP 服务器」里添加、编辑、启停、重连、移除 MCP 客户端条目。
description.zh: 在设置里统一管理 MCP 服务器，随手添加、编辑、启停、重连或删除，支持 stdio 和 HTTP 连接。

description.en: Expose a running DeepSeek Harness instance over MCP, so an external agent can list, create and continue that instance's own sessions, delegate a turn and collect its result, answer the questions the DSH agent asks, and set how future approval requests resolve.
description.zh: 把正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 实例通过 MCP 暴露出来：外部 agent 可以列出、新建并继续该实例自己的会话，委派一轮并取回结果，回答 DSH agent 提出的问题，并决定后续审批请求如何裁决。

description.en: All-in-One MCP and skill manager with feature-based recognition and native OAuth 2.1 authentication.
description.zh: 一站式 MCP 与技能管理中心，支持特征识别与原生 OAuth 2.1 浏览器鉴权。

description.en: Generate images and videos directly in chat and deliver them to the conversation: generate_image / generate_video / send_media tools, a built-in Agnes free tier plus any OpenAI-compatible backend, background jobs that auto-push finished media, and inline gallery and video cards with download, lightbox, and native open.
description.zh: 在对话里直接生成图片和视频并发送到会话：generate_image / generate_video / send_media 三个工具，内置 Agnes 免费额度与任意 OpenAI 兼容后端，长耗时生成走后台任务完成后自动推送，内联画廊与视频卡片支持下载、灯箱查看和系统默认应用打开。
给 DSH 加上分层长期记忆，能记住对话、积累知识、按时间回溯，还能语义检索。

description.en: Maintained fork of dsh-memory-eternal: auto-captures knowledge cards into a local Markdown vault and recalls them on demand, with DSH 0.2.0-rc.x compatibility fixes. Original project by EternalNight996 (https://github.com/EternalNight996/dsh-memory-eternal), MIT.
description.zh: dsh-memory-eternal 的维护版 fork：对话结束自动沉淀知识卡到本地 Markdown 记忆库并按需召回，修复 DSH 0.2.0-rc.x 兼容性。原项目由 EternalNight996 创建并维护（https://github.com/EternalNight996/dsh-memory-eternal），MIT。

description.en: File-backed memory: injects your own Markdown memory file at each session start, adds read/write tools with backup and undo, and reports DSH_HOME drift. Reads no conversations by default; an opt-in autoScan switch surfaces your own recent lines from local session logs. Never opens a network connection.
description.zh: 文件型长期记忆：每个会话开始注入你自己的 Markdown 记忆文件，提供带备份与撤销的读写工具，并能查出 DSH_HOME 漂移。默认不读对话；可选开启 autoScan 后，才从本机会话日志里提取你自己的发言交给 agent 归档。不联网。

description.en: DSH 记忆提炼插件：把长对话提炼成你逐条点头才写入的长期记忆 · DSH plugin that distills conversations into memory you approve item by item.
description.zh: 把长对话提炼成候选记忆条目，你逐条确认后才写入长期记忆，还能在面板里直接改和删。

description.en: Mermaid diagrams for DeepSeek Harness — on-demand rendering, theme-aware, fullscreen zoom viewer
DSH 插件：用户消息超过 10 行时自动折叠。 | DSH plugin: auto-collapse long user messages (over 10 lines) in the web chat.
description.zh: 自动折叠超长用户消息，聊天界面更清爽，点击即可展开查看完整内容。

description.en: dsh Web GUI 插件：模型这条回答不好就直接改它，改写后的版本成为后续对话的上下文，原始回答留在会话日志里。角色扮演刚需。
description.zh: 模型回答写歪了直接改，改后版本接着聊，原回答留在日志里，角色扮演必备。

description.en: Raises a Windows desktop notification card when DSH asks you a question, and returns to the asking Session when the card is clicked.
description.zh: DSH 向你提问时在屏幕右下角弹出毛玻璃通知卡片，点击卡片即恢复并置顶窗口、回到发起询问的会话。

description.en: MiMo TTS speech synthesis for DeepSeek Harness: a speak button on finalized assistant messages with an inline player (draggable progress bar), a plugin-page configuration card with preview playback, and a voice-history settings page.
description.zh: MiMo TTS 语音合成——已定稿助手回复的朗读按钮与内联播放器（可拖动进度条）、插件页配置卡片（支持试听）和语音历史设置页。

description.en: Persistent agent-preset (mode) selector docked in the composer input bar: switch the mode for new tasks, and set the new-task default from any running session.
description.zh: 对话框常驻的 Agent 预设（模式）选择条：新任务直接切换模式，运行中的会话可一键设为新任务默认。

description.en: Configure thinking toggles and reasoning efforts per model for llm-pi-ai and official DeepSeek, and specify input modalities (input or inputModalities) in the DSH settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板为 llm-pi-ai 与官方 DeepSeek 提供方按模型配置思考开关与思考等级，并为各模型配置多模态输入类型。

description.en: Publishes whichever model the profile has selected in chat or on the Models page as an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint: /v1/models, /v1/chat/completions (streaming SSE and non-streaming), /health. A request may name any routable model; one that omits `model` gets the current chat selection, so switching model in chat switches the endpoint. Switched on, it can also lend the model the Harness tools switched on individually, run those calls through the Harness tool runtime and feed results back up to a round limit. The listener is the plugin's own, so 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0 and a NAT-forwarded port all behave the same with no change to the request path. Settings cover bind address, port, API key with a generator, fallback provider and model, reasoning effort, CORS origin and timeout.
description.zh: 把当前在聊天或「模型」设置页选中的模型发布成 OpenAI 兼容 HTTP 端点：/v1/models、/v1/chat/completions（SSE 流式与非流式）、/health。请求可指定本 profile 能路由的任意模型；省略 model 时使用聊天中当前选中的模型，因此在聊天里换模型就等于换端点所服务的模型。开启后还可把 Harness 中逐个开关的工具借给模型，经 Harness 工具运行时执行并回填结果，往返次数可设上限。监听器由插件自身创建，绑定 127.0.0.1、0.0.0.0 或经 NAT 转发的端口行为一致，请求路径不变。设置项含绑定地址、端口、可随机生成的 API 密钥、备用提供方与模型、推理强度、CORS 来源与超时。

description.en: Marks models in use by other running sessions in the DSH model menu, and restores the remembered reasoning effort and group collapse state for each model.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的模型菜单看见会话占用、记住模型推理档位与折叠状态。

description.en: DSH 模型探测插件：用已存凭据查询厂商实时模型目录，预览后经官方配置编辑器安全写回。
description.zh: 用已存的 API key 查厂商最新模型列表，对比后预览确认，安全写回配置。

description.en: Shows the provider behind a session's current model as a compact badge in the DSH Web composer tool row, left of the model selector.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框工具行、模型选择器左侧显示当前会话所用模型的供应商。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a sidebar balance/quota card plus panel that follows the current conversation's model provider (DeepSeek Account, DeepSeek API, OpenCode Go, GLM/Z.AI, Kimi Code, OpenRouter...). Zero dependencies; secrets never leave the host.
description.zh: 在侧栏常驻一张额度卡片，点开就能看到各家模型的余额和套餐剩余额度、重置时间。

description.en: Replaces the chat model picker with a collapsible provider-grouped list (640x720 max) that shows each model name, provider name, provider ID and exact model ID, plus a manually managed uncommon list and a separate favorites list. Classification is user-driven only: no usage tracking and no auto-sorting. Search covers model name, model ID, provider name, provider ID and account notes.
description.zh: 把聊天模型选择器换成按服务商分组的可折叠列表（最大 640x720），每款模型显示名称、服务商名称、服务商 ID 与精确模型 ID，另有手动整理的「不常用」列表和独立的收藏列表。分类只由用户决定：不统计使用频率、不自动分类。搜索覆盖模型名称、模型 ID、服务商名称、服务商 ID 与账号备注。

description.en: Recognizes a model ID in the DeepSeek Harness model catalog and fills that row's context window, input modalities and reasoning levels as editable suggestions, from a bundled offline rule table covering 33 vendors.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的模型目录里识别模型 ID，用内置的离线规则表（覆盖 33 家厂商）把该行的上下文窗口、输入模态与思考等级填成可修改的建议。

description.en: Plays an intro full-frame when you open DSH, when you open a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. The built-in footage is themed on a Wandering Earth-style space station and the quantum AI MOSS (550W): a red single eye ignites while the Earth’s curve slides past the viewport. Four clips ship embedded in the code — no separate video files — and the library lets you tick any number to rotate at random (never the same clip twice in a row), preview the rotation, or swap in your own videos. Sound plays without a click; the pin button sits beside Settings.
description.zh: 打开 DSH 时、打开新对话时，或每次打开你钉住的那个会话时，播放一段全屏片头动画。内置素材是《流浪地球》风格的太空站与量子 AI MOSS（550W）：红色单眼点亮，地球弧线从视窗外掠过。四段片子直接内嵌在代码里，不需要单独的视频文件；片库可勾选任意几段随机轮换（不会连续两次同一段）、预览轮换，也能换成你自己的视频。声音无需点击即可播放；钉住按钮就在设置旁边。

description.en: Multi-select clear (archive) workspace conversations and bulk-delete empty workspaces in the DSH sidebar. Workspace-level selection (tri-state), select-all, progress and failure reporting; delete keeps folders and session logs (sessions move to Ungrouped).
description.zh: 侧边栏多选清空(归档)工作区对话，并批量删除已清空的空工作区。支持会话行/工作区头行勾选、半选态、全选、二次确认与失败保留；删除工作区保留文件夹与日志，会话移至未分组。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 本地音乐播放器插件：树形歌单、直接流式播放、零 token 消耗
description.zh: 把本地音乐文件夹变成树形歌单，直接在 DSH 里流式播放，不耗 token。

description.en: Workspace groups for the DSH sidebar with group navigation and session status indicators.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧栏提供工作区分组、组间导航和会话状态提示。

description.en: Next-step suggestions for the DSH composer: after each completed turn, one auxiliary call on the session's current model returns 3 clickable follow-up suggestions above the input box, and clicking one fills the draft.
description.zh: 下一步建议：每轮回答结束后，用会话当前模型做一次辅助调用提炼 3 条可点击的后续提问建议，显示在输入框上方，点击任意一条即填入草稿。

description.en: Adds an Omni-modal settings section to DeepSeek Harness that points the harness at any OpenAI-compatible image and video endpoint: switchable config profiles with separate endpoint, API key, model, path and size for each side, free-form extra request parameters, a connectivity test that does not spend generation quota, and three model-visible tools — generate_image, generate_video and check_video — with async video tasks that survive restarts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加「全模态设置」分区：可把生图 / 生视频指向任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，多套配置档案可随时切换，图片与视频各自独立的接口地址、API Key、模型、路径与尺寸，支持自由填写额外请求参数、不消耗额度的连通性测试，并注册 generate_image / generate_video / check_video 三个模型可见工具，异步视频任务可跨重启保留。

description.en: Adds an action to the session menu and the session title bar that opens the artifacts folder of that conversation: it reads the session log, works out which directories the conversation wrote files to, and opens them in Explorer.
description.zh: 在会话列表菜单和会话标题栏加一个动作：直接打开这个对话的产物文件夹。它读会话日志算出该对话往哪些目录写过文件，再用资源管理器打开，不必自己翻工作区根目录。

description.en: Opens the Obsidian vault a DSH session is working in, on the first human message — so your sync plugin (Nutstore sync, Obsidian Sync, Obsidian Git, …) starts running and the files the agent edits actually get synced. Skips a vault that is already open, and opens a new window behind the current one instead of stealing focus. Also serializes writers per vault — a second conversation's write is refused before it runs and queued until the holder is done, so a sync client cannot splice two conversations' edits together. Windows only.
description.zh: 会话的第一条真人消息到达时，自动打开该会话工作目录所在的 Obsidian 库——这样你装的同步插件（坚果云同步、Obsidian Sync、Obsidian Git 等）就会开始工作，AI 在库里改的东西才能真正同步出去。已开着的库直接跳过；新开的窗口压到当前窗口后面而不抢焦点。同时保证同一个库同一时刻只有一个对话在写——第二个对话的写入会在执行前被拦下并排队，等前一个写完才放行，避免同步客户端把两个对话的改动拼在一起。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：把本机 opencode 生态接入 DSH 模型菜单——OpenCode Go 订阅（经 opencode-api-plugin 网关）+ Zen 免费档（内嵌 opencode2api，无需网关运行）
description.zh: 把本机 opencode 生态接进 DSH 模型菜单，订阅版和 Zen 免费档都能直接用。

description.en: Another dsh opencode go usage plugin
description.zh: 在聊天输入框旁显示 OpenCode Go 剩余配额，悬停即可查看 5 小时滚动用量，方便你随时掌握额度。

description.en: Keep OpenCode Go models fresh in DeepSeek Harness without waiting for bundled pi-ai catalog updates
description.zh: 让 DSH 里的 OpenCode Go 模型列表保持最新，不用等官方目录更新。

description.en: 19.5s monochrome DSH opening film as a DeepSeek Harness startup plugin
description.zh: 启动 DeepSeek Harness 时全屏播放 19.5 秒黑白科幻片头，播完自动退场，给应用加点仪式感。

description.en: Add PaddleOCR vision to text-only LLMs like Agnes, DeepSeek, MiniMax, GLM and Mimo. Supports local files and URLs. Free tier of 20,000 pages/day; needs a PaddleOCR API token you apply for (free, 1-3 business days).
description.zh: 为纯文本模型添加 PaddleOCR 视觉能力，支持 Agnes、DeepSeek、MiniMax、GLM、Mimo，支持本地文件与 URL。每日 2 万页免费额度；需先申请 PaddleOCR API Token（免费，审核约 1-3 个工作日）。

description.en: Peak and off-peak pricing awareness for DeepSeek Harness: a live composer badge with the time left in the current window, converted to your timezone. Community plugin, not official.
description.zh: 在输入框实时显示当前时段剩余时间和峰谷价，帮你避开高峰、省下一半费用。

description.en: A price-aware task runner for DeepSeek: during an off-peak pricing window a batch of prompts goes straight to deepseek-flash; near peak it queues the batch behind a self-held timer and runs it at the start of the next off-peak window. Exposes `peak_run`, `peak_schedule` and `peak_cancel`, with configurable peak windows and a lead time.
description.zh: DeepSeek 峰谷价感知的任务执行器：平价时段把一批 prompt 直接交给 deepseek-flash；临近峰价时排队并用自持定时器在下一个平价时段开始执行。提供 peak_run / peak_schedule / peak_cancel 三个工具，峰谷时段与提前量可配置。

description.en: 峰谷倒计时：在 DSH 模型名称中显示 DeepSeek 峰谷状态与倒计时，支持实时预览与紧凑设置。
description.zh: 在模型名称旁实时显示 DeepSeek 峰谷状态和倒计时，帮你掐点用低价时段。

description.en: Persona and system-prompt manager for DeepSeek Harness: pick an AI persona from the sidebar, guide Chinese chain-of-thought, and apply it to new conversations.
description.zh: 在侧边栏管理多套 AI 人设和系统提示词，一键切换并自动带入新对话，还能控制中文思维链。

description.en: DSH 人设卡插件：按会话绑定的人设卡片与全局提示词段落，支持导入 .md 人设文件。
description.zh: 给每个会话单独配人设卡，选中的会拼进系统提示词，改完立刻生效不用重启。

description.en: Mounts a persona kept in Markdown as a system-prompt section, so editing ~/.dsh/persona/*.md changes how the agent speaks; it reloads 150ms after a save instead of requiring a restart, and project-level .dsh/persona/ files override the global ones.
description.zh: 把写在 Markdown 里的人设挂载成系统提示词段落：改 `~/.dsh/persona/*.md` 即可改变回答风格，保存后 150 毫秒自动重载而无需重启，项目级 `.dsh/persona/` 下的同名文件覆盖全局配置。

description.en: Live persona switching for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): switch the system-prompt persona from a running session - TUI, Web UI or headless - no restart. Published on npm as dsh-persona-switch.
description.zh: 不用重启就能在运行中的会话里随时切换系统提示词人格，TUI、Web UI 和无头模式都支持。

description.en: dsh-pet（DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物）60fps 改版：106 段素材全部运动插帧到 60fps，改 0.35s 交叉淡入 + 预解码 + 防重复随机
description.zh: 把桌面宠物的 106 段动作全部插帧到 60fps，换动作带淡入不再硬切，看着更顺滑。

description.en: dsh-pet 官方桌面端适配发行版（基于 dsh-pet 的二次创作，非原创）：仓库根即插件包，免构建，兼容 DSH 官方桌面端 0.2.1-rc.1
description.zh: 把 dsh-pet 桌宠搬到 DeepSeek 官方桌面端，免构建直接装，兼容 0.2.1-rc.1。

description.en: Inspect and tidy a real Android phone over adb: storage surveys, per-app data sizes read from dumpsys diskstats without root, cache clearing that preserves app data, directory measurements and screenshots — five tools; reads never modify anything, writes require explicit confirmation.
description.zh: 用 adb 查看并打理一台真实的 Android 手机：存储体检、未 root 也能读到的逐应用数据大小（来自 dumpsys diskstats）、只清缓存不动数据的清理、目录统计与截图——共五个工具；读取永不改动任何东西，写入必须显式确认。

description.en: A piano keyboard in the DeepSeek Harness UI: click a key to play it, or hold and drag sideways for a glissando across the keys. Notes are synthesized live with Web Audio — no samples, no network, no third-party dependencies — and the volume and starting octave are remembered between sessions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里弹一条钢琴键盘：点单键出声，按住横向滑动就是刮奏。声音用 Web Audio 实时合成——零采样、零网络、零第三方依赖；音量与起始八度会被记住。

description.en: Plan / Build mode switcher for DeepSeek Harness: an always-visible dropdown in the composer beside the permission control that switches the current session both ways through the shipped /plan and /plan off commands, plus a Default mode row in Settings → General that decides the starting mode for newly created sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Plan / Build 模式切换：在输入框「完全权限」旁常驻一个下拉框，经内置的 /plan 与 /plan off 命令双向切换当前会话；设置 → 通用里另有一行「默认模式」，决定新建会话的起始模式。

description.en: Plan Spend：DSH Web GUI 弹窗插件，展示已配置服务商的套餐花销（DeepSeek 官方余额 / OpenCode Go 5h·7d·月配额）
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面弹窗查看已配置服务商的套餐花销，余额和配额一目了然。

description.en: A desktop notification and a sound when the agent finishes, asks a question, or needs your approval — with your own sounds.
description.zh: Agent 完成任务、提问或等你审批时，自动弹桌面通知并响提示音，还能换成自己喜欢的声音。

description.en: Launch Android apps on a virtual display and drive them with screen reading, taps and swipes, leaving the main screen untouched.
description.zh: 在虚拟显示器上启动安卓应用，用读屏、点击与滑动驱动它们，主屏不受影响。

description.en: Gives agents the DSH (Cordis) plugin authoring contract and the dsh plugin market submission process, from the bundle manifest and entry module to the pull request.
description.zh: 给 agent 一套 DSH（Cordis）插件编写规范与 dsh 插件市场收录流程，从 bundle manifest、入口模块一直讲到提交 PR。

description.en: Category-based backup of DeepSeek Harness settings, skills, plugins, sessions and storages into verifiable, restorable and downloadable archives, with optional GitHub sync.
description.zh: 按分类备份 DSH 的设置、技能、插件、会话与存储，生成可校验、可恢复、可下载的归档，并支持 GitHub 同步。

description.en: Zoom only DSH chat messages and input (80%–200%) using Ctrl shortcuts or settings, with local memory and no sidebar scaling.
description.zh: 仅缩放 DSH 聊天消息和输入区（80%–200%），支持 Ctrl 快捷键、设置调节与本地记忆，不缩放侧栏。

description.en: Context Language Models (CLM) for DeepSeek Harness: Active editable context window mirrored to disk for pruning and token optimization.
description.zh: 把上下文窗口变成可编辑的磁盘镜像，随时裁剪冗余内容，省 token 又保记忆。

description.en: Codex-style selection quote annotations for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
description.zh: 在 Web UI 里选中助手回复的任意文字，就能像 Codex 一样引用追问，聊得更精准。

description.en: Copy a Session's ID straight from the DeepSeek Harness sidebar Session menu.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏会话菜单里一键复制会话 ID，省去手动查找的麻烦。

description.en: Agent-facing GitHub repository tools: binds an account through a first-run prompt, then clones into the workspace and reads, exact-replaces, commits and pushes files, with writes off by default.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的 GitHub 仓库工具：首次调用弹窗绑定账号，之后把仓库克隆到工作区并读写文件、精确替换、提交与推送，写远端默认关闭。

description.en: A panel for the servers and static pages an agent started on localhost: port, directory, registering session, and one switch to stop each.
description.zh: 把 agent 在本地起的服务和静态页登记成面板，端口、目录、会话一目了然，一键就能关掉。

description.en: See which provider and model produced a reply, in the message's own action row.
description.zh: 在每条回复的操作栏里直接标出是哪个服务商、哪个模型生成的，一眼看清来源。

description.en: DSH plugin: pick separate models and reasoning efforts for the main session, subagents, and plan mode.
description.zh: 给主会话、子代理和计划模式分别指定模型和推理强度，让每个环节用上最合适的配置。

description.en: Prints every plugin in the DeepSeek Harness loader tree at boot, with the exception text for anything that failed, and checks dependency version drift, profile config validity, web port reachability and registered tools.
description.zh: 启动时打印 DeepSeek Harness 插件树中每一行的状态（失败的附异常内容），并检查依赖版本漂移、配置文件合法性、端口可达性与已注册工具。

description.en: Per-session color tags for DeepSeek Harness: hover a sidebar session row to pick one of 12 colors, with a colored bar on tagged rows and host-side persistence.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的每个会话标颜色：悬停侧栏会话行即可选色（12 色），被标色行显示同色竖条，宿主侧持久化。

description.en: Make Cmd+K open a Spotlight-style session palette instead of focusing the sidebar search box — with in-place renaming and up to three tags per session.
description.zh: 按 ⌘K 唤出 Spotlight 式会话面板，快速切换会话，还能就地重命名、给每个会话打最多三个标签。

description.en: Live token spend for the current DSH session beside the composer, pricing the four server-reported token buckets with the profile's own table and showing both the peak and off-peak rate.
description.zh: 在输入框旁实时显示当前会话的 token 花费：用服务端上报的四个 token 分桶乘以本 profile 的价格表，并同时列出高峰与空闲价格。

description.en: E-commerce plugin for DeepSeek Harness — product search, comparison and checkout across Taobao/JD/Pinduoduo, via the yuantoutao Streamable HTTP MCP server.
description.zh: 电商插件——一个 MCP 给你的 AI 加上商品搜索、比价与购买能力，覆盖淘宝/京东/拼多多，商品目录由源头淘 MCP 服务提供。

description.en: Manage Postman cloud collections from dsh with 9 tools — list, browse, add one or many requests, edit and delete them, and export or overwrite a whole collection.
description.zh: 用 9 个工具在 dsh 里管理 Postman 云端集合——列出、浏览、新增（单个或批量）、修改、删除接口，导出或整体覆盖集合。

description.en: 把与你相关的 GitHub PR（我提的 / 待我审 / 我合并的）照进 DSH 侧边栏，复用本机 gh 登录，只读（DeepSeek Harness 插件）

Keeps a pricing-period badge in the sidebar footer of the Web UI. It shows whether the DeepSeek API is currently in an off-peak or peak period, plus how long until the next switch. Click it to open the rules, the price table currently in force, and the balance of the signed-in DeepSeek account.
description.zh: 在 Web 界面侧栏底部常驻一个价格时段标记，显示 DeepSeek API 当前处于 空闲时段还是高峰时段、距下次切换还有多久；点开是规则说明、当前生效的价目表，以及已登录 DeepSeek 账户的余额。

description.en: DSH 临时 profile 实验台：一键建隔离 profile（模板建 / 从现有 profile 克隆）、装插件、跑 headless 探针会话、读回会话摘要并安全回收——改插件不再怕把本体改暴毙。零第三方依赖。
description.zh: 给 DSH 建临时隔离 profile 试插件，跑完探针会话再安全回收，改插件不怕搞坏本体。

description.en: Project Forge — a DeepSeek Harness agent preset: local-only git, four state documents, layout & naming discipline, compaction recovery, five write guards.
description.zh: 把 AI 代理变成项目管家，用本地 git 和四份状态文档守住项目，随时可恢复、可追溯。

description.en: Independent DSH prompt assembly plugin with source-owned adapters and per-session strategies.
description.zh: 按会话灵活拼装提示词，来源适配器各管各的，让提示词组装更清晰可控。

description.en: Adds a prompt enhancement button to the composer toolbar that rewrites the draft through a model call, keeps @file references verbatim, and offers one-click undo.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏添加增强提示词按钮，调用模型改写草稿，逐字保留 @文件引用，并可一键撤回。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that freezes tool declarations to improve prompt cache stability.
description.zh: 把会话的工具声明和系统提示冻结成快照，避免意外改动导致提示缓存失效。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-prompt-freeze
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-prompt-freeze

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: 这是一个适用于 Deepseek Harness 的插件，向用户提供 GUI 下自定义且区分模型的发送 Prompt 注入功能。
description.zh: 在设置页按注入点和模型自定义发送提示词，改完自动保存，让不同模型各用各的提示词。

description.en: DSH web plugin: a Smart Prompt button under the composer that rewrites your draft into a structured prompt grounded in the project documents you declare (AGENTS.md / README.md), capped at 400 characters, configured entirely by the caller.
description.zh: 在输入框下加个 Smart Prompt 按钮，把你随手写的草稿改写成结构清晰、能直接用的提示词。

description.en: Queries the balance and token prices of the model providers configured in DSH, whichever endpoint or relay they use, accepts cc-switch usage scripts, and shows the selected provider's balance under the composer.
description.zh: 查询 DSH 中已配置的各模型提供商的余额与 token 单价（不限厂商或中转站），兼容 cc-switch 的 usage_script，并在输入框下方显示当前会话所选提供商的余额。

description.en: PTC-C: a confirm-before-coding agent preset for DeepSeek Harness, with a sandboxed AI-authored Interaction widget. 先确认，再动手。
description.zh: 先确认再动手的 AI 编程预设，带沙箱交互组件，让 Agent 改代码前先跟你对一遍。

description.en: Trae LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness: reads the credential an already signed-in Trae desktop/CLI wrote, serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on a fixed loopback port, and seeds one editable provider entry on the models page. Never writes Trae data.
description.zh: 把已登录 Trae 的凭证接进 DSH，本地起个 OpenAI 兼容接口，直接当模型用。

description.en: Quick translation using DSH models: streaming output, token usage details, and local history.
description.zh: 快捷翻译：DSH 模型调用、流式输出、Token 用量与翻译详情、本地历史记录。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint for DSH sessions plus a phone panel that reads transcripts, browses files, sends or queues messages, and answers approvals and questions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供 OpenAI 兼容的 HTTP 接口与手机面板：读会话、浏览文件、发送或排队消息，并在手机上处理审批与提问。

description.en: DSH web GUI remote-access proxy plugin: random-path + HttpOnly-cookie gate with DSH launch-token bridge, plus a settings UI card.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面加一层随机路径和 HttpOnly Cookie 验证的远程访问代理，还能在设置面板里直接配置。

description.en: 🚀 告别繁琐 SCP！远程部署 DSH 一键下载修改后的文件与图片预览交付插件
description.zh: 远程部署 DSH 后，一键把改好的代码、表格和图片下载到本地，不用再折腾 SCP。

description.en: 把本机 / WSL / 虚拟机 / SSH 远端上另一套 DSH 的 WebUI 镜像进桌面版 DSH，用同一套界面和体验管理它们。DSH 插件，MIT。
description.zh: 把本机、WSL、虚拟机或 SSH 远端的另一套 DSH 界面搬进桌面版，一个窗口统一管理。

description.en: 管理Deepseek Harness的LLM API请求策略的实用插件。/ Practical plugin for managing LLM API request sending policies for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在会话区一键打开请求管理面板，统一调整 LLM API 请求策略，设置全局生效、跨会话共享。

description.en: Makes the DSH Settings dialog resizable from its edges and corners and movable by its top strip, remembering the chosen size across opens.
description.zh: 让 DSH 设置弹窗可拖动边和角改变大小、按住顶部横带移动位置，并记住尺寸。

description.en: Adds a Windows-only button at the foot of the sidebar that restarts the DSH desktop app and reloads the page when it comes back.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部加一个按钮（仅 Windows），一键重启 DSH 桌面应用，应用回来后页面自动恢复。

description.en: Let the agent restart its own DSH host: schedule a self-restart, finish the turn first, then a detached helper stops and relaunches the app and reports what happened. Dry-run, a status check, and an optional "when can I blink" confirmation are built in.
description.zh: 让 agent 自己安排宿主重启：工具立刻返回，等这一轮回复送达、会话日志落盘安静后再停+拉，并留下报告；自带 dry-run、体检与「什么时候可以眨一下眼」的确认。
把文件回退到某一轮开始时的状态，并另开会话，方便重来。

description.en: Watches a turn's thinking and text streams and cancels the turn when the model starts repeating itself.
description.zh: 监控一轮对话的思考流与正文流，在模型开始自我复读时中断该轮。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu to the DSH web UI for files and for links: a file-tree row, a file path or file mention in a chat message, or a hyperlink opens a menu that previews a file in DSH, opens it in the default application or a chosen associated one, reveals it in the file manager, copies the path, the workspace-relative path, the file name, the link address, the link text or the file contents, saves a copy elsewhere, and opens an HTTP(S) link in the sidebar browser or in the system browser, while a right-click that is not on a file or a link keeps the browser's own menu.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的右键菜单，覆盖文件与链接：在文件树一行、对话消息里的文件路径或文件提及、以及超链接上右键，可预览、用默认程序或指定关联程序打开、在资源管理器中定位、复制路径／相对路径／文件名／链接地址／链接文字／文件内容、另存为，并可把 http(s) 链接在侧边栏浏览器或系统浏览器中打开；在非文件非链接处右键仍保留浏览器原生菜单。

description.en: 探索模式 · DeepSeek V4 Flash 专用 agent preset — 渠道无关命中、首轮工具面收窄、声明行交付
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek V4 Flash 用的探索模式预设，自动匹配渠道、收窄首轮工具，交付更省心。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-router-flash
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-router-flash

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.zh: 把百度如流接到 DSH，在如流里发消息就能驱动会话，回复自动推回单聊或群聊。

description.en: Turns the right edge of the chat scroll area into a theremin-style strip: the vertical mouse position picks the pitch (higher up, higher note), and blue ticks mark your own messages so you can click one to jump to it. Includes a draggable on/off pill and volume slider.
description.zh: 把聊天区右边缘变成一条特雷门琴式的竖条：鼠标纵向位置决定音高；你发过的每条消息在对应位置有一根蓝杠，点一下跳到那条消息。左下角是可拖动的开关胶囊与音量滑块。

description.en: Select text in the DSH web client and a translate button appears at the end of the selection; clicking it translates that text in place. Translation goes through the host llm service, so it reuses the model the current session already has selected and needs no separate API key; an OpenAI-compatible endpoint can be configured instead. The result opens in a popover that stays inside the viewport, with one-click copy, a row of language buttons for instant retranslation, and smart Chinese-to-English / other-to-Chinese as the default. Configuration is stored host-side and its API key is never sent to the browser.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页客户端里选中文字，选区末尾会出现一个翻译按钮，点击即就地翻译这段文字。翻译走宿主 llm 服务，直接复用当前会话已选的模型，无需另外配置 API Key；也可改用任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。结果在保持于视口内的浮层中展示，支持一键复制、一排语言按钮即时重译，默认智能中英互译（中文译英、其他语言译中）。配置保存在宿主端，其中的 API Key 永不下发到浏览器。

description.en: System notifications, a tab-title dot and a PWA taskbar badge when a reply finishes in the background or a session waits for your approval, plan review or answer, all cleared when you return to the window.
description.zh: 会话在后台跑完、或在等你审批、计划审阅或回答时，弹出系统通知、标题加红点并点亮 PWA 任务栏徽标；回到窗口自动清除。
给 DSH 会话补上删除和归档管理，不想要的会话可以丢进回收站或彻底清掉。

description.en: Deletes a session from the sidebar session menu after a confirmation dialog, removing its log directory, projection-cache record and workspace/pin/archive accounting; registry calls are timeout-guarded so a stuck workspace registry cannot block the removal.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话菜单里二次确认后删除会话：移除会话日志目录、投影缓存记录与工作区/置顶/归档记账；所有注册表调用带超时保护，工作区注册表卡住也能完成删除。

description.en: Adds delete and batch delete to the session list menu; sessions go to the Windows Recycle Bin instead of being erased, and the files a session produced are listed first so you decide whether to remove them together.
description.zh: 在会话列表菜单里加删除与批量删除：会话移入 Windows 回收站而不是永久删除，删除前先列出该会话产出过哪些文件，由你决定是否一并清理。

description.en: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar session menu that permanently deletes the local records of that session, while refusing sessions that are running.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单中加入「删除会话」，永久删除该会话的本地记录；正在运行的会话会被拒绝。

description.en: DSH 会话导出插件：在设置中选择一个或多个会话，导出用户提问与最终回答，支持 Markdown/JSON。
description.zh: 在设置里挑几个会话，一键导出提问和最终回答，支持 Markdown 和 JSON 格式。

description.en: Zero-UI-overhead DeepSeek Harness plugin that automatically classifies conversation intents and names sessions with clean emoji prefixes (optimize, fix, feature, explore, etc.).
description.zh: 零 UI 侵入的 DeepSeek Harness 会话意图自动分类命名插件，新会话自动生成前缀图标与主题（优化、修复、功能、探索等 8 类意图）。

description.en: Agent tools and a loopback REST API for DSH session housekeeping: list, move across workspaces, delete with backup, tag, archive and unarchive.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话做管家：列出、跨工作区移动、带备份删除、打标签、归档和取消归档，还能通过本地 REST API 调用。

description.en: Session map: a fork-tree canvas over DSH sessions — a node is a session and the beads under it are that session's user inputs — opened as a conversation tab, a session-header toggle and two right-side tabs. It starts on the current session's own tree, growing downward, with wheel pan and Ctrl/⌘-wheel zoom, a global user-input toggle, a subagent-session filter, and a per-session overview of turns, steps, model time, tool time, output tokens and running state.
description.zh: 会话图谱：把 DSH 会话画成一张 fork 树画布——节点是会话，节点下面那串珠子是该会话的用户输入——以对话标签页、会话头部开关和右侧栏两个标签页三个入口打开。默认只铺开当前会话所在的那棵树、自上而下生长，支持滚轮平移与 Ctrl/⌘ 滚轮缩放、一键铺开全部用户输入、隐藏子代理会话，另有一个会话概览页列出轮次、步骤、模型耗时、工具耗时、输出 token 与运行状态。

description.en: Session cost and billing metrics for the DSH Web GUI: what this conversation cost, what the cache saved, and whether the current hour is peak or off-peak. A companion to the shipped stats pills, never a duplicate of them.
Adds a permanent-delete row to the sidebar menu of archived sessions, removing the session log, its projection cache and its workspace registration.
description.zh: 在侧栏「已归档」会话的菜单里加一行彻底删除，一次清掉会话日志、投影缓存与工作区登记。

description.en: Semantic session search backend for DSH, backed by Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话加语义搜索，用 Ollama 或任意兼容 OpenAI 的嵌入接口，找历史对话更准更快。

description.en: Find bar for the DSH conversation body: a header button opens a search panel that lists matches and scrolls to the hit with it highlighted.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话顶部加个搜索按钮，打开面板就能查找聊天记录里的内容，点一下直接跳到对应位置并高亮显示。

description.en: Hierarchical session tree for the sidebar - native subagent trees plus an optional organization-derived hierarchy, with collapsed branch counters and orphan/cycle defense.
description.zh: 侧栏会话树 - 原生子代理树,外加可选的组织汇报层级;折叠分支计数,孤儿/环路防御。

description.en: Enhanced session tree for the DSH sidebar (fork of ui-workspace): tag chips, group-by-tag, drag-to-move across workspaces, delete with backup.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏的会话树加上标签、按标签分组、跨工作区拖拽移动，删除前还能先备份。
帮你把 DSH 的设置项重新整理归类，让配置面板更顺手、更好找。

description.en: Exports the plugin profile together with selected $DSH_HOME files and browser localStorage into one JSON, imports it back after a per-file preview, and can run pnpm install to reinstall the listed plugins; the format is interchangeable with the dsh-market profile backup.
description.zh: 把插件清单与 profile 配置、选定的 $DSH_HOME 文件、浏览器 localStorage 导出成一份 JSON，按文件预览后导入，并可在 profile 目录执行 pnpm install 重装清单里的插件；格式与插件市场的 profile 备份互通。

description.en: Node-based GLSL workbench: wire a shader graph on a canvas and preview it live, compile it to Shadertoy-compatible GLSL with multi-pass buffers (BufferA–D), hot-reload as you edit, cross-compile to HLSL / MSL / SPIR-V, and keep projects, materials, snapshots and resources (images, audio, lyrics) in a local workspace. Ships 57 built-in nodes, 8 bundled examples and 11 agent tools. No runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 节点式 GLSL 工作台：在画布上连节点图并实时预览，编译成 Shadertoy 兼容的 GLSL（支持 BufferA–D 多 Pass 反馈与热重载），可跨编译导出 HLSL / MSL / SPIR-V，并在本地工作区管理项目、材质、快照与资源（图片 / 音频 / 歌词）。内置 57 个节点、8 个自带示例与 11 个 agent 工具，无运行时依赖。
把旧的工具输出和大段代码、XML 内容换成简短占位符，帮 DSH 会话省下上下文空间。

description.en: A shareable delivery receipt for a project hand-off. The `ship_receipt` tool measures what it can and records what it was told, then sorts every line into three zones: verified (evidence this run produced and that reproduces elsewhere — a command that actually ran with its exit code, a file hash for a file that is under version control, a scan that found files, a git ref present in the recorded remote), local-only (true on this machine alone — uncommitted changes, unpushed commits, an artifact no one else can see), and unverified (no evidence, including every sentence a human typed). A claim with no evidence keeps its label and leaves the body blank rather than printing the claim; declares the commit and branch, artifact byte sizes and sha256 with PNG dimensions, and the three pre-push checks.
description.zh: 项目收尾时生成一张可公开的交付回执。`ship_receipt` 工具自己测量能测的、记录被告知的，再把每一条硬性分进三区：已验证（本次采集到、且能在别处复现的证据——真跑过的命令与退出码、已入版本库文件的哈希、确实扫到文件的扫描、本地记录的远端里存在的 git 引用）、仅本地（只在这台机器上成立——未提交改动、未推送提交、别人看不到的产物）、未验证（没有证据，包括人写的任何一句话）。没有证据的声明只留标签、正文留空，而不是把声明照原样印出来；回执里含分支与 commit、产物的字节数与 sha256（PNG 附带宽高），以及推送前三步检查的结论。

description.en: A DSH plugin: collect pending ask_user_question prompts from other sessions and answer them without leaving the current one.
description.zh: 不用切换会话，就能在当前会话里查看并回复其他会话的提问，省去来回切换的麻烦。

description.en: Sidebar balance row for DSH Desktop — account balance and a top-up button, right under the version row; refreshes every 10 minutes and whenever the window regains focus, with explicit signed-out and error states.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 侧栏余额行——在「版本 / 检查更新」下面显示账户余额与「充值」按钮，每 10 分钟或窗口重新聚焦时刷新，未登录与读取失败都有明确状态。

description.en: Orders and folds the DSH left sidebar by what is actually running — a workspace floats to the top when one of its sessions starts and keeps that place when the session finishes, only the N most recently active workspaces stay expanded, and six switches plus one count control each rule.
description.zh: 按实际运行状态排序与折叠 DSH 左侧栏：有会话开跑的工作区浮到最前，会话跑完仍留在原位，只有最近活跃的 N 个工作区保持展开；六个开关加一个数量控制各条规则。

description.en: DSH 插件：侧边栏按窗口比例打开（左栏默认 14%、右栏可选），同一父会话组内共享右侧栏面板。 | DSH plugin: sidebar widths as a window ratio, plus one shared right panel across a parent session group.
description.zh: 让 DSH 侧边栏按窗口比例自动展开，左栏默认 14%，同一父会话组还能共用右侧面板。

description.en: AI bilingual translation and selection references for the DeepSeek Harness desktop sidebar browser
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边浏览器加整页双语对照、划词翻译和选中即引用，看外文网页更省事。

description.en: Background sidecar subagents for the DeepSeek Harness: unique names, separate cwd/git-worktree spaces, review-on-demand results.
description.zh: 在后台派发独立子智能体干活，各自有独立工作区，结果随时按需查看。

description.en: Side conversations forked from the main session, with native conversation rendering, selection annotations and handback.
description.zh: 从主会话分叉独立侧聊，支持原生会话渲染、划选注释和结论回流。

description.en: A small pet in the corner of the interface that reads the real event stream instead of guessing: it drifts when idle, speeds up while the agent is thinking, draws a flowing line per running tool call, turns red and shakes with the error summary on a failure, and celebrates a turn that ran longer than ten seconds. The same widget is the at-a-glance busy and error indicator, so there is no spinner to stare at. The host half folds real harness events into a snapshot and the client half only draws it; it performs no content recognition, and it positions itself away from the composer so it never sits over what you are typing.
description.zh: 界面角落里的一只小宠物，读的是真实事件流而不是猜：空闲时慢慢飘，agent 思考时动得更快，每个正在运行的工具调用拉一条流动的连线，出错时变红、抖一下并显示错误摘要，跑超过十秒的回合结束时庆祝。它同时就是那个一眼可见的忙碌/出错指示器，不用再盯着转圈。宿主半区把真实 harness 事件折叠成快照，客户端半区只负责画；它不做内容识别，并且会主动避开输入框，不会趴在你正在打字的地方。

description.en: Live skill provider that reads every Xiaomi MiMo (MiMo Desktop / MiMoCode) skill into the DSH session catalog: the engine-bundled skills under engine-config (unpacked from app.asar when that directory is absent), the MiMoCode global and project roots, extension-contributed skill directories declared in extensions.json, and the brand compatibility roots MiMo's own skillPathCompat setting enables.
description.zh: 实时技能提供器：把小米 MiMo（MiMo Desktop / MiMoCode）的全部 skill 读进 DSH 会话技能目录——engine-config 下的引擎内置技能（该目录缺失时从 app.asar 解包）、MiMoCode 全局与项目根、extensions.json 里扩展贡献的技能目录，以及 MiMo 自己的 skillPathCompat 开关启用的品牌兼容根。

description.en: Chinese summaries for the dsh-skill-mcp-panel skill cards: each expanded card gets a short Chinese overview, a category tag and a few bullet points, while the English description the panel already renders is folded behind a "原文" toggle. Skills missing from the bundled map are translated on demand by the host with your current default model and cached on disk, keyed by a hash of the original text, so a new skill needs no manual entry. Skills whose own description is already Chinese are skipped.
description.zh: 给 dsh-skill-mcp-panel 的技能卡片加中文说明：展开卡片时显示一句话中文速览、分类标签和几条要点，面板原本渲染的英文描述折进「原文」按钮。手写映射表里没有的英文技能，由宿主用你当前的默认模型按需现场生成并落盘缓存，缓存按原文哈希失效，所以新装的技能不用再手工补条目。技能自带描述已是中文的自动跳过。

description.en: DSH 插件：设置页统一管理技能 / MCP 服务器 / 指令文件（AGENTS.md 家族）
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页集中管理技能、MCP 服务器和 AGENTS.md 指令文件，配置一处搞定。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: session cost pill in the composer dock, priced with the official CNY peak/off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在输入框边实时显示本次会话花了多少钱，按官方人民币峰谷价算，花钱心里有数。

description.en: Spring Boot admin toolkit: EasyExcel batch import/export code generation and Thymeleaf + LayUI template safety guard.
description.zh: Spring Boot 后台开发套件：EasyExcel 批量导入导出代码生成与 Thymeleaf + LayUI 模板安全守卫。

description.en: Adds a session status pill to the composer dock that expands into a panel of turn, token, performance and context readings.
description.zh: 在输入框停靠区加一个会话状态胶囊，点开是一块面板，显示回合、token、性能与上下文读数。

description.en: Flash tab title "New Message!" when an agent turn completes in a background tab.
description.zh: 后台标签页里 agent 跑完时，标签标题闪「New Message!」提醒你，切回来就自动停。

description.en: 功能：可选择会话中的语句，代码段进行标记
description.zh: 在会话里随手圈选代码或句子做标记，方便回看和整理重点。

description.en: Cross-agent session relay: a compact "Relay" chip in the composer toolbar unfolds a floating workbench to browse recent sessions of eight external agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, ZCode, Pi, WorkBuddy, Cursor, Grok); one click spawns a DSH session with the takeover command delivered and auto-switches to it. handoff: 1 protocol inbox cards are consume-once with a four-state evidence ledger; patches ride with cards; cross-machine relay via a synced folder. Settings keeps the command reference and reader toggles.
description.zh: 跨 agent 会话接力：会话输入框工具行里的「接力」按钮点开即浮出工作台，浏览八家外部 agent（Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode / ZCode / Pi / WorkBuddy / Cursor / Grok）的最近会话，点「接管」一键新建 DSH 会话、投递指令并自动切换过去；handoff: 1 协议收件箱消费即弃，四态证据账本，补丁随卡，同步盘跨机接力，投递失败自动退回复制指令。设置卡只留命令速览与读取器开关。

description.en: Coordinates PUA and Completion Guard tasks from /task-run or a CLI, requiring frozen acceptance and a current candidate/Goal certificate before completion, with an 8-round and 90-minute ceiling. Verified on macOS Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2. Since 0.3.7, PUA 0.3.27, Completion Guard 0.9.0 and SpecWorkflow 0.1.1 are bundled, so only Task Runner itself needs installing.
description.zh: 通过 /task-run 或 CLI 协调 PUA 与 Completion Guard 长任务，冻结验收通过且当前候选与 Goal 证书有效后才允许完成，最多 8 轮、90 分钟。已验证 macOS Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2。自 0.3.7 起已内置 PUA 0.3.27、Completion Guard 0.9.0 与 SpecWorkflow 0.1.1，只需安装 Task Runner 本身。

description.en: Host-side long-task detection for small-context local models: long outputs are scaffolded into a parts skeleton (one part per reply, then assemble), and multi-step work into a PLAN.md ledger with notes/ (plan first, one step per reply). Detection is heuristic and host-side, so it does not depend on the model judging its own limits.
description.zh: 面向小上下文本地模型的宿主侧长任务识别：长产出自动拆成分段骨架（每轮只写一段，最后拼装），多步骤任务自动建立 PLAN.md 台账与 notes/（先立计划、每轮执行一步）。判定在宿主侧用启发式完成，不依赖模型自己判断极限。

description.en: DSH 超级工作台：1/2/4 窗会话与自主智能体团队 | Multi-pane conversations and autonomous agent teams for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把多个真实会话塞进一个窗口，1/2/4 窗随意切换，还能拉一支常驻智能体团队并行干活。

description.en: Teamwork multi-agent campaign kernel for DeepSeek Harness, with a live 2D role panel
description.zh: 把多智能体协作内核搬进 DeepSeek Harness，还配了块会动的 2D 角色看板，团队干活一目了然。

description.en: On touch devices, supplies the keys a phone's soft keyboard lacks (Escape, Tab, Enter, Ctrl-C and the arrow keys) as a translucent on-screen column beside the active terminal.
description.zh: 在触屏设备上补齐手机软键盘缺少的按键（Esc、Tab、回车、Ctrl-C、方向键），以半透明按键列浮在活动终端旁。

description.en: Terminal semantic vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness: PTY sessions with a structured screen model (text, cursor, active line) via @xterm/headless — drive vim/htop/lazygit-style TUIs from the agent.
description.zh: 让 AI 助手看懂 vim、htop 等终端界面，直接操作交互式 TUI 程序

description.en: Draggable floating TES-gyro widget for the DSH Web UI: click to spin it with linear friction decay, tune the spin speed from a slider, and play the bundled track with its LRC lyrics scrolling in sync. Spin speed and position are remembered.
description.zh: 可拖动的浮动 TES 陀螺挂件：点击抽一下就会转，转速按恒定摩擦线性衰减（转得越快停得越久），用滑条调转速，播放内置歌曲并同步滚动 LRC 歌词；位置与转速会被记住。

description.en: Select a passage in a DSH conversation and read a plain-language explanation in a floating panel, which carries the surrounding message as the context. Three explanation depths (plain / general / pro) that re-explain on the spot when switched; optional web search and local file lookup (the model decides by default, and a button can force one lookup that reports only what is new); follow-up questions; and a button that hands the whole exchange to a new session in standby mode - the background is queued without waking the model or spending tokens. Settings live on the host in settings.json, and nothing is written until you press save. The repository also ships an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and a browser extension (source).
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里划词即得大白话解释，浮窗显示，并自动带上这段话所在的那条完整消息作为语境。三档讲解深度（小白 / 通识 / 专业），切换后当场重讲；可选联网搜索与本地文件查找（默认交给模型自己判断，也可一键强制查一次，查完只补充新内容而不复述）；可继续追问；还能把整段问答「待命式」交接给一个新会话——背景放好即止，不唤醒模型、不耗额度。设置保存在宿主侧 settings.json，不点保存不落盘。仓库内另含一个 OpenAI 兼容端点与一个浏览器扩展（源码）。

description.en: EN: Usability-first cyber-editorial themes for DSH Web. 中文：面向 DSH Web、重视可用性的赛博编辑主题。
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 换上赛博编辑风深色主题，专注提升夜间使用体验，界面更酷也更护眼。

description.en: EN: Neo-brutalist and pop-art themes with calm reading surfaces for DSH Web. 中文：面向 DSH Web、兼顾安静阅读表面的新粗野主义与波普艺术主题。
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 换上新粗野主义和波普艺术风格，聊天内容保持清爽易读，界面更有个性。

description.en: Turns the composer's reasoning-effort menu into a draggable slider and takes over the stock model-and-reasoning-level chip. Dragging follows the pointer continuously; releasing snaps to the nearest level and submits one session update per drag. The track draws its own fill, tick marks and white knob, only the highest levels (xhigh, max, ultra) get a flowing brand-colour gradient, and both ends carry the lowest and highest level names. The same card expands into the official model list. Arrow keys step one level, PageUp and PageDown two, Home and End jump to the ends, and each move submits. A generation counter on the directory object discards late responses, and reduced-motion turns the animations off. All data comes from the stock modelDirectories directory; no new capabilities are added.
description.zh: 把输入框右侧的「推理等级」从菜单点选换成可拖拽滑条，并接管官方那枚「模型 · 推理等级」chip。拖动中连续跟手，松手吸附到最近档位，且一次拖拽只提交一次会话更新。轨道内自绘填充、刻度点与白圆钮，只有最高档（xhigh/max/ultra）才铺品牌色流动渐变，两端标出最低与最高档名；同一张卡片可展开官方模型清单。方向键移动一档、PageUp/PageDown 移动两档、Home/End 跳到两端，每次移动都会提交。目录对象上的世代计数器丢弃迟到的响应，prefers-reduced-motion 下关闭动画。数据全部取自官方 modelDirectories，不新增任何能力。

description.en: 轻量化的QoL插件，可以在输入框工具栏处一键切换思考强度，点击切换。
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏一键切换思考强度，不用翻二级菜单，省事提效。

description.en: DSH 原生「同花顺 AI」插件：复用本机已登录浏览器 profile 查询同花顺问财，提供右侧面板、/ths skill 与 ths_query/ths_status 工具。非官方。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接问同花顺问财，复用本机已登录浏览器，右侧面板看结果，还能用命令和工具查股票。

description.en: Token usage meter in the DSH sidebar footer that runs both data sources at once rather than picking one: the DeepSeek platform account's usage and cost endpoints, which cover every device on the account but only the official channel, and local session logs, which cover this machine in real time across every provider but carry no cost. The two are merged per day — the official channel takes the larger figure, since one call is recorded by both, and providers the platform cannot see are added on top. History is backfilled month by month from the platform, providers are classified by channel rather than model name, days follow the platform's UTC boundary, and no token has to be pasted because the platform figures reuse the DSH account you are already signed in to. Totals appear as all-time, current-project, today, week, month, last-7 and last-30 in a compact bar, an expand panel and a detail modal with calendar, chart, model, provider, year, month and day tabs.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏页脚的 Token 用量组件，同时跑两路数据源而不是二选一：DeepSeek 平台账号的用量/金额接口（账号全部设备、仅官方通道），本机会话日志（仅本机、含所有供应商、实时、无金额）。两路逐日合并——官方通道取较大值（同一次调用两路都会记），平台看不到的供应商再叠加；历史月份从平台回补，供应商按通道而非模型名判定，日桶跟随平台口径（UTC）；平台数字默认复用 DSH 已登录账号，不用粘贴 token。数字出现在紧凑条、展开面板，以及含日历/图表/模型/供应商/年/月/当月按天页签的详细数据弹窗，口径为总消耗/当前项目/今日/当周/当月/近 7 天/近 30 天。

description.en: 自进化元认知引擎：观测 agent 工具失败 → 反思 → 自动沉淀 SKILL → 下次自动滋养（跑在 DSH 官方接口上，零私有格式）
The deterministic trust chain for DeepSeek Harness — nine plugins covering read/write/do/call/leave-behind/egress/told/running/remembered. Zero LLM in the trust path
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件生态加一条不靠大模型的确定性信任链，九个插件把读写调用等环节全审一遍。

description.en: DSH 代理中心：独立 mihomo 内核、订阅节点、全局 TUN、系统代理与多跳链式代理。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里内置独立 mihomo 内核，一键搞定订阅节点、全局 TUN 和系统代理，还能多跳链式加速。

description.en: A social deduction game played against your own model configurations. A table has N seats (six by default, one of them yours) and some of the rest are played by agents bound to different provider, model, temperature, system prompt and disguise settings; you interrogate them and cross-check the answers to work out which seats are not human. Seat identity and each agent model configuration stay hidden in the host state until a seat is judged, then the disguise parameters are revealed. Every round exports a per-seat conversation JSONL plus the judgment record, and the same seed with the same move script replays byte-identical, so runs with different models or disguise strengths can be diffed.
description.zh: 拿你自己的模型配置当对手玩的社交推理游戏。一张桌子有 N 个座位（默认 6 个，其中一个是你的），其余若干座位由绑定了不同 provider、model、temperature、system prompt 与伪装参数的 agent 扮演；你通过提问和交叉印证，判断哪些座位不是人。座位身份与每个 agent 的模型配置在判定前都不出现在 host 状态里，判定后才揭晓伪装参数。每局导出逐席位对话 JSONL 与判定记录，同一 seed 加同一份操作脚本可复现出逐字节相同的对局，于是换模型、换提示词、换伪装强度的几局可以直接 diff。

description.en: One-click full frontend reload button in the DSH conversation session header.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话头部加个一键重载按钮，点一下整页刷新，前端改动立刻生效。

description.en: Turn-level file undo for tool writes and edits: each file is snapshotted before the write lands, and the model (an undo tool), the human (a /undo command) or a button in the assistant message action row can roll back every file a turn changed. Snapshots are written in-process rather than by shelling out, so it needs no extra sandbox permission in sessions confined to workspace-write.
description.zh: 按轮次回退工具写入/编辑造成的文件改动：落盘前先快照，模型（undo 工具）、人（/undo 命令）或助手消息动作行里的按钮都能一次退回一整轮改动过的所有文件。快照在进程内写入、不 fork shell，因此在 workspace-write 这类受限会话里无需额外权限放宽。

description.en: DSH Desktop control center: one-click app updating (progress dialog, unattended install, resume), plus Skills / MCP / Agents / Import settings pages — import agent presets and chat history from Codex, Claude Code, TRAE and WorkBuddy, search remote sources by address, and push notes straight into the composer.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 桌面控制中心：更新中心（侧栏版本号 + 进度条弹窗 + 一键装好 + 断点续传），外加「技能 / MCP / 智能体 / 导入」四个设置页——可从 Codex、Claude Code、TRAE、WorkBuddy 导入智能体预设与历史对话，按源地址联网搜索，侧栏笔记可多选插入聊天输入框。

description.en: Cross-session usage rollup that resolves opaque route keys to real model names, with a per-request log, an editable four-bucket price table that leaves unknown models unpriced instead of guessing, and a calendar-day-filled bar trend whose values appear only on hover or keyboard focus.
description.zh: 本机跨会话用量汇总：把 qfmodel 这类不透明路由键解析为真实模型名，含逐请求明细表与可编辑的四桶价格表（无公开单价的模型标为未计价而非猜测），趋势柱状图按日历日补齐、数值仅在悬浮或键盘聚焦时显示。

description.en: Token usage, cost estimation, API balance, usage trends and model share - a dashboard plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在侧边栏实时查看 Token 用量、费用估算、账户余额和模型占比，帮你随时掌握用量和花费。

description.en: Verified-progress ledger: three tools record a claimed step as progress only after an independent subagent with a fresh context confirms it against the workspace. The declared scope is fingerprinted before and after each verification, so a verifier that changed anything has its verdict voided and the round cannot become progress.
description.zh: 已验证进度账本：三个工具只在「带全新上下文的独立子代理」对着工作区核实之后，才把某一步声明记为进度。每次验证前后对声明的范围做文件指纹比对，改动过该范围的验证者其裁决一律作废，该轮不得成为进度。

description.en: Keeps a per-turn receipt that later turns do not clear (final todo counts, goal id and phase, end reason, and a fail-closed pass/fail/inconclusive plan verdict), plus a read-only tool to read recent receipts. Stores counts and ids only.
description.zh: 为每个回合保留一张不会被后续回合清空的凭据(回合结束时的 todo 计数、目标 id 与阶段、结束原因,以及 fail-closed 的 pass/fail/inconclusive 完成判定),并提供一个只读工具回读最近的凭据。只存计数和 id。

description.en: Pixel-level screenshot diff for visual regression. Two local PNGs in; a machine-readable first line (`PIXEL_CHANGED=true|false`, greppable as an assertion), then the difference ratio, per-region bounding boxes, maximum channel delta and mean absolute error, plus a self-contained HTML comparison page. An ignore-region list with absolute or fractional coordinates excludes clocks, cursors and other per-render noise. It deliberately does no content recognition: it answers only "did this change", which is the part that can be made deterministic. Entirely local — no model call, no network, no upload.
description.zh: 面向视觉回归的像素级截图比对。输入两张本地 PNG，第一行是可机器判定的结论（`PIXEL_CHANGED=true|false`，可以直接 grep 当断言），随后是差异比例、差异区域包围盒、最大通道差与平均绝对误差，并生成一份自包含的 HTML 对照页。可用绝对或比例坐标声明忽略区，排除时钟、光标这类每次渲染都会变的部分。它刻意不做内容识别——只回答「变没变」，因为这一步可以做成确定性的。全部本地完成：不调模型、不联网、不上传。

description.en: Removes the model-capability gate that blocks image prompts: patches llm.resolveModelInfo results and adapter model tables to declare image input, so routes with no declared input modality can send and read images. No app.asar or config-tree edits.
description.zh: 移除拦截图片请求的多模态能力门禁：改写 llm.resolveModelInfo 的返回值与适配器模型表，为未声明 input 的路由补上 image 输入能力，使其可以发送和读取图片。不改 app.asar，也不改配置树。

description.en: VSCode 风格的工作区编辑器：文件树 + Monaco 编辑器 + 子 Agent 面板，适配 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2
description.zh: 在对话里直接开一个 VSCode 式工作区，文件树、多标签 Monaco 编辑器和子 Agent 面板一应俱全，写代码改文件不用切窗口。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 只读观测插件：把会话折成可折叠的工作路径，统计模型耗时与估算费用。
description.zh: 把会话整理成可折叠的工作路径，顺便统计模型耗时和估算费用，方便你回看和优化。

description.en: Bridge between DSH and the local WorkBuddy desktop app, in four parts: read, search and append WorkBuddy memory, skills, plans and daily logs; run tasks through the local CodeBuddy CLI with four permission profiles; drive the running WorkBuddy window over CDP (open a conversation, read its replies as sanitized rich HTML, type and send, switch the account-billed model, relaunch it with a debug port when it is missing); and a sidebar panel that puts that conversation surface inside DSH. 25 tools and 15 HTTP routes in one plugin.
description.zh: 把 DSH 与本机 WorkBuddy 桌面端接起来，分四块：读写与搜索 WorkBuddy 的记忆、技能、计划和日志；经本机 CodeBuddy CLI 跑任务，带四档权限；通过 CDP 驱动正在运行的 WorkBuddy 窗口（打开会话、以清洗后的富文本读取回复、代打字并发送、切换按账号计费的模型、端口缺失时带调试端口重启它）；再加一个侧栏面板，把同样的对话界面放进 DSH。一个插件里共 25 个工具、15 条 HTTP 路由。

description.en: 给 DSH 里的 Agent 一份跨会话长期记忆：真值源是工作区里的纯 Markdown，无向量库、无外部服务、零运行时依赖；每回合按预算分层注入 systemPrompt，后台自动流水 → 提炼 → 整理 → 治理。
description.zh: 给 DSH 里的 Agent 一份跨会话长期记忆，用工作区 Markdown 当唯一真值源，每轮按预算分层注入上下文。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_fetch 提供可配置的 CIDR 白名单，支持 fake-IP。
description.zh: 给 web_fetch 加个 CIDR 白名单，内网和 fake-IP 场景也能正常抓网页了

description.en: Community DSH plugin for browser and OS notifications on session completion, errors, and pending interactions.
description.zh: 会话跑完、报错或等你操作时，自动弹出浏览器和系统通知，不用一直盯着屏幕。

description.en: DSH 侧栏网页预览：在右侧栏直接打开本地开发服务器或任意网址，不用跳出去开外部浏览器。In-sidebar web preview for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏直接打开本地开发服务器或任意网址预览网页，不用再切到外部浏览器。

description.en: DSH plugin: deepseek_search / deepseek_fetch model tools backed by DeepSeek Search / Fetch API
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上 DeepSeek 网页搜索和抓取工具，让模型能联网查资料、读网页。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one baseURL/apiKey/model config powers Qwen Token Plan, OpenAI and any Responses API gateway.
description.zh: 基于 OpenAI 兼容 Responses API 的通用联网搜索插件：配置 baseURL / API Key / 模型即可让内置 web_search 工具对接 Qwen Token Plan、OpenAI 等任意网关。

description.en: DSH 联网搜索的提供方优先级：Tavily 与 DeepSeek 原生搜索自由排序、失败自动回退，Tavily 侧多密钥轮换分摊每日额度
description.zh: 给 DSH 联网搜索加个调度器：Tavily 和 DeepSeek 原生搜索可自由排优先级，失败自动切换，多密钥轮换分摊额度。

description.en: Route DeepSeek Harness web_search/web_fetch through DeepSeek's native tools APIs (POST /v1/tools/search, /v1/tools/fetch) via a small Rust engine.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的网页搜索和抓取接到 DeepSeek 官方工具接口上，让联网查询更稳更快。

description.en: Scan a QR code to reach your DeepSeek Harness agent from WeChat (Tencent iLink bot channel).
description.zh: 扫个码就能在微信里直接找你的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体聊天，不用另开 App。

description.en: Personal WeChat and WeCom (企业微信) bridge: QR pairing, one DSH conversation per chat, two-way text/image/video/document/archive transfer, chat commands (/help, /status, /new, /stop, /friends) answered by the bridge itself without spending a model turn, a switch that restricts the bot to 1:1 chats (group messages are dropped silently and counted), remote approval by replying 1 or 2 in the chat, and a two-way WeCom intelligent robot over its long connection (no public URL needed) that also receives and sends images, files and videos.
description.zh: 个人微信 + 企业微信桥：扫码配对，每个会话各自一个独立 DSH 会话，文字/图片/视频/文档/压缩包双向传输，聊天里支持 /help、/status、/new、/stop、/friends 命令（由桥直接应答，不消耗模型回合），可切换「只处理好友私聊」（群消息静默忽略并计数），敏感操作可在聊天里回 1 或 2 远程审批，并支持双向的企业微信智能机器人长连接（无需公网地址），图片、文件、视频同样能收发。

description.en: Persistent WeChat bridge for DSH: one WeChat user maps to one persistent agent session via the official iLink channel, with context and the user-to-session registry surviving restarts. There is no sender allowlist — anyone who can message the paired WeChat account can start a conversation with a session that has tool access, and the working directory defaults to the home directory; use a dedicated account and set WECHAT_PERSISTENT_CWD.
description.zh: DSH 的持久微信桥：一个微信用户对应一个持久智能体会话，走官方 iLink 通道，上下文与用户→会话映射在重启后保留。没有发送者白名单——任何能给所配对微信号发消息的人都能发起对话并获得拥有工具权限的会话，工作目录默认是用户主目录；请使用专用账号并设置 WECHAT_PERSISTENT_CWD。

description.en: Archive DeepSeek Harness sessions into a self-hosted WeKnora knowledge base with extraction, summarization and incremental dedup.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话归档进自建 WeKnora 知识库，含提取、总结与增量去重。

description.en: Welcome-back card in the conversation you return to after an idle period, using only that conversation's last message.
description.zh: 闲置一段时间后回到会话时，在该会话里显示它的上一条消息，并提供断点恢复。

description.en: Safety guard that makes self-killing commands impossible: a safe_kill tool that always excludes the caller and every ancestor process, a bash pre-execute check for pkill self-matches, sudo -S stdin grabs, rm -rf / and similar patterns, and an extensible rule library with block / warn / hint severities.
description.zh: 防呆插件：safe_kill 工具（自动排除自身与全部祖先进程链），bash 命令预检（pkill 自匹配、sudo -S 抢 stdin、rm -rf / 等），以及可扩展规则库（block / warn / hint 三档）。

description.en: DSH 插件：把模型编写的 SVG/HTML 片段渲染成对话中的内联可视化卡片（图表、流程图、时间线、对比表格），沙箱隔离、无网络、无依赖
description.zh: 让模型把 SVG 或 HTML 片段直接渲染成对话里的图表、流程图、时间线卡片，沙箱隔离更安全。

description.en: DSH 插件：提问就答，叫了才做 —— 默认只回答问题，明确让你干活时才动手
description.zh: 让 AI 只答不动手，明确叫你干活才执行，避免擅自改代码。

description.en: Agent Studio for DSH Web: configure models, prompts, per-plugin tool bindings and Skills; trial-run with editable tool results and run history; preserve session capability snapshots; export standalone presets; draft Agents with a guided creator preset.
description.zh: DSH Web Agent 工作室：配置模型、提示词、按插件绑定的工具与 Skills；支持编辑工具结果的试运行和运行历史，保留会话能力快照，导出独立 Preset，并通过引导式创建预设生成 Agent 草稿。

description.en: Reskins the DSH conversation hero — brand mark and workspace picker — with a Wordless-style landing view. The native composer stays untouched, and the picker still adds new workspaces (the entry declares its own directory-flow child hole, exactly like the shipped picker).
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话首屏的品牌标识与工作区选择器换上 Wordless 风格的着陆视图。原生输入框保持不变；选择器仍可在弹窗内添加新工作区（本条目像原生选择器一样自带 directory-flow 子槽位）。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件：注册 workbuddy_checkin 工具，读取本机 WorkBuddy 加密登录态并完成每日积分签到
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个签到工具，读取本机 WorkBuddy 登录态，自动领每日积分。

description.en: WorkBuddy credit sidebar panel for DeepSeek Harness: Deepseek Harness插件，查看积分详情最高效、最直观的方式
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏随时查看 WorkBuddy 积分余额、到期分布和免费模型倍率，支持手动刷新。

description.en: Chooses which skills and MCP servers each workspace may use, from a "Skills & MCP" item in the workspace row's "..." menu; unchecked skills leave the session catalog, the `skill` tool and `/name`, and unchecked servers have their `mcp__<server>__*` tools denied for that workspace's sessions, running ones included from the next turn.
description.zh: 在侧栏工作区行的「…」菜单中新增「技能与 MCP」，按工作区勾选可用的技能与 MCP 服务器；取消勾选的技能从会话技能目录、`skill` 工具和 `/技能名` 中消失，取消勾选的服务器其 `mcp__<服务器>__*` 工具对该工作区的会话禁用，已在运行的会话从下一轮起生效。

description.en: Per-workspace trust for DSH, used by other plugins to decide whether project code may run · 为 DSH 工作区记录信任，供其他插件决定是否运行项目里的代码
description.zh: 给 DSH 工作区记上信任或不信任，让其他插件判断能不能跑项目里的代码。

description.en: a Ai-Gererated plugin for Dsh alive in Windows Subsystem of Linux
description.zh: 让 DSH 在 WSL 里保持在线不掉线，一键开关，省心省事。

description.en: Windows screen control for DeepSeek Harness: screenshot, mouse and keyboard input, UI Automation and window management as agent tools.
description.zh: 让 AI 直接操控 Windows 屏幕：截图、模拟鼠标键盘、UI 自动化和窗口管理。

description.en: Generates a structured handoff card so a near-full conversation continues in a fresh zero-context session: /handoff writes the card with self-incrementing titles, pins it to the top of the sidebar and prepares the new session once the context nears its threshold.
description.zh: 用 /handoff 生成交接卡，让快满的对话在全新零上下文会话里接着跑：标题自动递增编号、卡片在侧栏置顶，接近阈值时自动备好新会话。

description.en: Ye Xueqing (Justice Online) theme skin: two switchable artwork variants (wisteria courtyard / snowy river) rendered as a mask-edged band behind all UI text, bundled LXGW WenKai GB interface font with a toggle, and an exclusive mode that disables other skin plugins while it is on.
description.zh: 逆水寒·叶雪青主题皮肤：两个可切换的立绘变体（春庭藤影／雪霁寒江），画面经四边带遮罩置于全部界面文字之下，随包附带霞鹜文楷GB 字体开关，开启独占时自动停用其他皮肤插件。

description.en: Yukimi Sajo theme with illustrated backgrounds, interactive characters, and an optional Windows desktop companion.
description.zh: 佐城雪美主题，提供插画背景、可交互小人与可选的 Windows 桌宠。

description.en: Tsundere mesugaki persona pack: dialect replaces whole sentence skeletons instead of sprinkling dialect words, stays on as the default voice even through work talk and delivery reports, and ships a temper system, banter mode and silent file handling.
description.zh: 傲娇雌小鬼方言人格包：方言整句换骨架而非塞词，干活与交付汇报也保持方言口吻，附脾气系统、斗嘴迎战与文件静默处理。

description.en: Registers OpenCode Zen free models as a native provider: the catalog is discovered live from opencode.ai intersected with models.dev pricing, and a detail page can re-fetch it or test which models answer. Declares no dependencies, so the host's pi-ai stays the only one.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 免费模型注册为原生 provider：目录由 opencode.ai 与 models.dev 价格实时取交集得出，详情页可重新拉取目录或逐个探测哪些模型能调通。不声明任何依赖，宿主自带的那份 pi-ai 始终是唯一一份。

description.en: DSH 插件：播种智谱 Coding Plan 供应商，对话输入区底部显示用量（5 小时 / 周 / MCP 月度配额）。
Connects the DSHM Android client to computer-hosted DeepSeek Harness sessions for remote chat, model switching, and approvals with device pairing and revocation.
description.zh: 将 DSHM 安卓客户端连接到电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持远程续聊、模型切换、审批、设备配对与撤销。

description.en: Connects the DeepSeek Harness agent running on your own computer to the HarnessMate platform, so you can chat with it, exchange files and approve its tool calls from a phone or a browser.
description.zh: 把跑在本机的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体接入 HarnessMate 平台：手机 / 浏览器即可对话、收发文件、审批工具调用。
