description.en: Keyless web powers for any MCP client: web_search, JS-rendered web_extract over dual CDP Chrome with proxy failover, and 7 real-browser page_* tools in an isolated context.
description.zh: 免密钥上网 MCP server：web_search、基于双 CDP Chrome 的 JS 渲染抓取（代理自动互备），以及 7 个隔离上下文真实浏览器 page_* 工具。

description.en: Evidence-first reuse skill for DeepSeek Harness: before implementing, porting, choosing dependencies, or troubleshooting a tool, it searches the local project and machine for existing solutions in layers, judges reuse on checkable evidence, refuses reuse when essential requirements or risks are unmet, and reports what could not be verified. Ships as a DSH bundle that registers the skill on ctx.skills.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「先找本地现成方案、再用证据验证」技能：动手实现、移植、选依赖、排查工具之前，先在项目与本机分层检索已有方案，用可核对的证据判断能否复用，必要条件或风险不满足时明确拒绝复用，并写清哪些结论无法核实。以 DSH 组合包（dsh.bundle）注册到 ctx.skills。

description.en: Bridge to the local doc2md (markdown_monitor) CLI — one doc2md tool with convert, read, scan and status actions over docx, doc, xls, xlsx, pdf and image files.
description.zh: 桥接本机 doc2md（markdown_monitor）命令行——一个 doc2md 工具，提供 convert / read / scan / status 四个动作，支持 docx、doc、xls、xlsx、pdf 与图片。

description.en: MindIE Agent for DeepSeek Harness: Ascend NPU knowledge and remote-dev tools composed from stable DSH plugins.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 补上昇腾 NPU 知识和远程开发工具，让模型在昇腾环境里跑得更顺、调得更快。

description.en: Displays and copies full session IDs, provides cross-session listing, reading and messaging, and creates scratch workspaces.
description.zh: 显示和复制完整会话 ID，提供跨会话查询、读取与消息投递，以及临时工作区。

description.en: A mandatory 7-step plan on every request, each step with a binary acceptance criterion, executed through worker subagents and validated by independent memoryless verifier subagents that report PASS or FAIL with evidence.
description.zh: 每个请求都必须走完 7 步计划,每步都有可判定的验收标准,执行交给 worker 子代理,完成情况由无记忆的独立 verifier 子代理带证据判定 PASS / FAIL。

description.en: Adds a local phone pairing, gateway control, and diagnostic panel for Pocket Bridge in DSH Settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里为 Pocket Bridge 提供本机手机配对、网关控制与诊断面板。

description.en: Live hotel and flight prices in USD across Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com and Traveloka: bundles the remote PriceWin MCP server (no account or API key) and a travel-search skill.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接比价 Booking、Agoda、携程和 Traveloka 的酒店与机票，实时价格一目了然。

description.en: Strict verification for every task: plan 2-7 steps, execute them with worker subagents, verify each deliverable with an independent memoryless verifier subagent, and fix in at most three cycles before reporting honestly.
description.zh: 给每个任务加上严格验证:把任务拆成 2-7 步,用 worker 子代理执行,每个交付物都由无记忆的独立 verifier 子代理验证,最多修 3 轮后如实汇报。

description.en: Provides 15 Superpowers skills for DeepSeek Harness, covering test-driven development, debugging, planning, and code review.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 15 个 Superpowers 技能，覆盖测试驱动开发、调试、规划与代码评审。

description.en: Zagent — unified three-role self-improvement loop with three operators. Data-RSI (daily cross-sectional cleaning: winsorize → cross-sectional standardization → median fill, plus experience extraction), Harness-RSI (evolves system prompt / memory / skills), and Model-RSI (evolves alpha training recipes via framework-native walk-forward with 2-day gap and multi-seed). Offline one-command run, GPU auto-detect. Ships one skill.
description.zh: Zagent——统一 RSI 三角色自改进闭环框架，三个算子：Data-RSI（逐日截面清洗：去极值→截面驻日标准化→中位数填充，加经验提取）、Harness-RSI（进化系统提示词/记忆/技能）、Model-RSI（进化 alpha 训练配方，框架内置 walk-forward，含 2 天空白与多 seed）。离线一条命令跑，GPU 自动走 CUDA。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Sweeps AI byproducts (scratch files, backups, logs, caches) into a reversible trash per project, and on project close classifies deliverables, archives reference results and writes a cleanup report. Requires Python 3 on PATH (the cleanup engine is a Python script; python3 / python / py are auto-detected, and without one cleanup cannot run and says so).

description.en: Three-player LAN Dou Dizhu (斗地主) played from a floating window: one machine opens a room on its own port, the other two join with a six-character room code plus an address. Empty seats can be filled by computer players in four switchable strengths (easy, medium, hard, hell), so one or two people can still play a whole hand; the deal starts as soon as the three seats are filled. 54 cards in four suits, bidding of 1/2/3 or pass, the landlord takes the three bottom cards and holds 20, play runs clockwise, and the first-bid seat rotates clockwise between hands. The rule engine is pure and covers 11 legal shapes, with big joker > small joker > 2 > A > K down to 3, suits never compared, straights, pair-straights and planes excluding the 2s and the jokers, and a rocket that beats everything. The table itself is built to be read at a glance: three seat cards side by side in play order (you, then your next and previous seats) with role, hand count and a bar that runs out, one line that says whose hand is on the table and what would beat it, the bottom cards as text, an in-place play history that folds into a single summary line and unfolds into every trick including the passes, plus hint and auto-play buttons that pick the cheapest legal answer out of the local rule enumeration. Nicknames can be changed mid-hand (twelve characters, duplicates get a suffix). Computers run inside the authority and are handed only their own hand, the public record and the seat counts, so no hand can leak; the authority is the only place that decides which card ids leave it. Computers are driven by the room itself, so a one-person table keeps playing with nobody else on the LAN port. Humans have no turn timer, the collapsed floating pill can be dragged around the screen, and 179 unit tests pin the rules, the wire format, the theme tokens, the drag gesture, the history grouping and the computer seats.
description.zh: 三人局域网斗地主，从浮窗里打：一台机器用自己的端口开房，另外两家填六位房间码加地址入座。空位可以交给电脑补，四档强度（简单/中等/困难/地狱）随时可换，一个人或两个人也能打完整一局；座位坐满就发牌。54 张牌四种花色，叫分为 1/2/3 或不叫，地主拿三张底牌共 20 张，顺时针出牌，下局首叫位顺时针轮换。规则引擎为纯函数，覆盖 11 种合法牌型，大王 > 小王 > 2 > A > K 直到 3，花色不参与比较，顺子、连对与飞机不含 2 和王，王炸最大。牌桌本身按「一眼看懂」来做：三张座位卡按出牌顺序并排（我、下家、上家），带身份、剩余张数和一条会走空的进度条；一行说清台面上是谁的牌、要压过什么；底牌以文字贴在右侧；出牌历史贴在牌桌上，默认折成一行摘要，展开就是每一轮谁出了什么、谁不出；另有提示与帮我出两个按钮，从本地规则枚举里挑最省牌力的一手。昵称随时可改（十二字以内，重名自动加后缀）。电脑跑在权威那台机器里，只拿得到自己的手牌、公开的出牌记录与各家张数，因此看不到别人的手牌；权威服务是唯一决定哪些牌能离开它的地方。电脑由房间本身驱动，所以一个人加两台电脑的单机桌在没有别人连局域网端口时也照样打完；真人没有回合计时，收起后的药丸可以拖到屏幕任意位置，179 个单元测试钉住规则、传输格式、主题 token、拖动手势、历史分组与电脑座位。

description.zh: 让模型写出 HTML/CSS/JS，在会话里以沙箱 iframe 渲染，并通过 POST 与 SSE 与模型互通，支持模板复用。

description.en: Re-encodes WebP attachment images to PNG so alpha-channel images load on LLM backends that cannot decode WebP (e.g. llama.cpp).
description.zh: 把 WebP 附件图片转码成 PNG，让带 alpha 通道的图能在无法解码 WebP 的 LLM 后端上加载（例如 llama.cpp）。
给 DSH 加上跨会话长期记忆，自动挑出值得记住的对话内容按工作区存好，需要时再注入上下文。

description.en: DSH ?????:?? Markdown ???,?????/???? + ?????? kb_search / kb_read?Knowledge-base plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个本地 Markdown 资料库，能浏览管理文件，也能让会话直接检索和读取。

description.en: Fork of amlyczz/dsh-lark-link (MIT), maintained by Very12345. Per-conversation reasoning-effort controls, multi-app isolation, and streamed task-status cards.
description.zh: amlyczz/dsh-lark-link（MIT）的分叉，由 Very12345 维护；提供每会话推理强度控制、多应用隔离与任务状态流式卡片。

description.en: Multiple named launch targets in the DSH composer: left-click starts the default target, right-click opens the list.
description.zh: 对话输入框的多启动项按钮：左键启动默认项，右键弹出列表，每项可绑定一个程序或目录。

description.en: Adds a power button to the DSH sidebar - Shut down or Restart, each behind a confirmation - and ships a Windows tray launcher that starts DSH without a console window, supervises it so Restart can relaunch it, and offers the same start-at-logon switch.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏加一个电源按钮——关机 / 重启（各自二次确认）；并自带 Windows 托盘启动器：无窗口启动 DSH、托管它以让「重启」能自动拉起，并提供同一个开机自启开关。

description.en: Laurel 套件：给 DeepSeek Harness 的「功能管理」面板 + 四个可单独开关的插件（通知 / Claude 主题 / 记忆与上下文 / 可视化规划）
description.zh: 给 Harness 加个功能管理面板，通知、主题、记忆、规划四个小功能随开随关。

description.en: DSH 插件：读取本机冒险岛客户端 WZ —— 浏览/搜索/图鉴/精灵图 GIF/纸娃娃（可坐椅子）/聊天气泡/地图背景/桌宠
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接读取本机冒险岛客户端 WZ，浏览搜索素材、看精灵图和纸娃娃，还能养只桌宠。

description.en: Copying rendered math from the chat puts the formula's LaTeX source on the clipboard instead of KaTeX's visual glyph text.
description.zh: 在对话中复制渲染后的数学公式时，剪贴板里得到的是公式的 LaTeX 源码，而不是 KaTeX 的字形文本。

description.en: DSH插件：会话页右上角「全屏」按钮，点击隐藏顶部标题栏（对话/轨迹 tabs）、底部输入框、左侧边栏；右侧边栏保持可打开，按钮落在整页最右上。再点或按 ESC 恢复。毛玻璃图标按钮，中英文文案。
description.zh: 会话页右上角一键全屏，隐藏标题栏、输入框和左侧边栏，右侧边栏照常可用，再点或按 ESC 恢复。

description.en: DSH plugin: manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel (list, start/stop, edit, probe by real handshake) and import configs from Codex TOML, mcpServers JSON and VS Code mcp.json.
description.zh: 在设置面板里可视化管理和启停 MCP 服务器，还能一键导入 Codex、VS Code 等配置。

description.en: DSH plugin: bridge to a Siemens TIA Portal MCP server (TIA Portal Openness). Registers mcp__tia__* tools for reading and writing PLC/HMI content, compiling and diagnosing. Siemens ships no official MCP server, so you supply the Openness-backed server binary and fill in one path after install.
description.zh: 把西门子 TIA Portal 接进 DSH，让 AI 读写 PLC/HMI 程序、编译并诊断报错。

description.en: Export the current session to clean Markdown from a button in the session header, through the native save dialog, with a CLI and an HTTP route over the same renderer; reads session logs directly (formats v0, v3 and v4) and declares no @deepseek-ai peer dependencies.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏加入「导出 MD」按钮，经系统原生保存窗口把当前会话导出为干净的 Markdown，并提供共用同一渲染核心的命令行与 HTTP 路由；直接读取会话日志（支持 v0、v3、v4 格式），且不声明任何 @deepseek-ai peer 依赖。

description.en: Right-sidebar media tab for DeepSeek Harness: inline playback for local audio/video — HTTP Range for native formats, ffmpeg transcoding for mkv/avi/flv/wmv.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏直接播放本地音视频，原生格式走 HTTP Range，mkv/avi 等靠 ffmpeg 转码。

description.en: Claude-compatible memory for DeepSeek Harness: a user-chosen memory directory with MEMORY.md index and topic files, the memory tool, and a settings page
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话加一个 Claude 风格的记忆目录，用 MEMORY.md 索引和主题文件长期记住上下文。

description.en: Curated durable memory for DeepSeek Harness: automatic capture, progressive-disclosure recall, duplicate folding and conflict resolution, plus a sidebar management panel.
description.zh: 自动记住对话里的决定、纠正和待办，需要时按需回忆，还能去重、解冲突，并在侧边栏统一管理。

description.en: SQLite-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: add, search, update and archive entries with categories and tags, automatic conversation logging, tiered compression, and a project dimension that scopes retrieval to the current workspace plus global facts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 SQLite 长期记忆插件：按分类与标签增删改查、搜索、归档记忆，自动记录对话并分层压缩，带项目维度——检索默认收窄到当前工作区加全局事实。

description.en: Touch-device comfort fixes for the DeepSeek Harness web client: ghost tooltip suppression + touch-action policy
description.zh: 为触屏设备优化 DeepSeek Harness 网页端，修复幽灵提示和触摸操作问题，提升移动端使用体验。

description.en: Replaces the composer model seat with a search-first picker and adds a model management page: create and edit llm-pi-ai channels, choose which of an endpoint's models exist, and declare per-model thinking ladders and capabilities.
description.zh: 接管输入框的模型座位并新增模型管理页：增改删 llm-pi-ai 渠道、挑选端点里的哪些模型进入本软件、按模型声明思考档位与能力。

description.en: 解决单实例容器在公司给多个用户使用时，如何让每个用户自行设置自己的API KEY的问题。
description.zh: 多人共用一个 DSH 服务时，让每个人用自己的 API Key，Key 只存浏览器不落盘。

description.en: Per-model enable/disable and renaming for every provider in DeepSeek Harness: a panel at the bottom of Settings - Models with a search box, status chips with counts, a provider filter, collapsible provider groups with group-level switches, and batch actions scoped to the current view. Disabled models leave the model picker and custom names replace the built-in ones. Preferences persist in the profile and apply immediately, without reloading the page or restarting DSH.
description.zh: DSH 全体模型管理：在「设置 → 模型」页底部加一块面板，管理所有 provider 的每一个模型——逐条启用/停用与改名。带搜索框、状态筛选（含计数）、提供商下拉、可折叠的 provider 分组与组级开关，批量操作只作用于当前筛选视图。停用的模型从模型选择器里消失，自定义名直接替换显示名；偏好持久化在 profile，改完立即生效，不用刷新页面、不用重启 DSH。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin — pre-probed OpenCode Go / Zen model routes with availability annotations (region blocks, no credit, client-only free tiers) written into the model name.
description.zh: 装完就能一眼看出哪些 OpenCode 模型真能用、哪些被地区封锁，封锁的自动走本地代理，额度一条命令查清。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that puts the conversation session id on OpenCode requests, so OpenCode's free tier works without a paid key.
description.zh: 让 OpenCode 免费模型在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接可用，不用付费密钥也不用配置。

description.en: DSH 插件：自动同步 opencode-go 模型清单到 pi-ai catalog，按官方文档精确标记协议（anthropic-messages / openai-completions / openai-responses）与多模态支持
description.zh: 自动把 opencode-go 模型清单同步到 pi-ai catalog，标好协议和多模态支持（现已废弃，pi-ai 1.x 起自带此功能）

description.en: DSH Web plugin: shows the remaining OpenCode Go usage allowance (5-hour, weekly, monthly) in the composer toolbar.
description.zh: 在输入框旁实时显示 OpenCode Go 剩余额度，点开可看5小时、周、月用量和重置时间。

description.en: Gated four-stage video pipeline: brief, script, assets and compose, turning one sentence into a narrated explainer with ComfyUI workflows or image/video APIs and FFmpeg assembly.
description.zh: 四段带审批闸的视频创作管线：立项、脚本、素材、合成，把一句话变成带配音、配图或视频和字幕的解说片；生成走 ComfyUI 工作流或图片/视频 API，合成走 FFmpeg。

description.en: DSH guard against self-repetition in streamed model output: detects a degeneration loop in reasoning or visible text, aborts the runaway turn and wakes the agent with a corrective notice.
description.zh: 模型输出陷入重复循环时自动检测并中断，唤醒智能体继续干活，避免空转浪费。

description.en: DSH community plugin: ask any set of models to draw a pelican riding a bicycle on a schedule, then lay every drawing out on a read-only board. No scoring — the pictures are the result. Pausable, with a settable interval.
description.zh: 定时让各种模型画骑自行车的鹈鹕，把画作摆在一块只读看板上，用来长期监测模型有没有变笨。

description.en: dsh-persona-driven，dsh技能插件，人格驱动引擎
description.zh: 把AI过度谨慎的毛病变成八个可调旋钮，一句话就能让它果断干活、少烧token。

description.en: Adds an agnes_image tool that calls the Agnes Image Flash models (2.5, 2.1, 2.0) for text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image composition, and ships a settings-page console for the active model, default size and aspect ratio, output folder, API key and generation history.
description.zh: 提供 agnes_image 工具，调用 Agnes Image Flash 系列模型（2.5 / 2.1 / 2.0）完成文生图、图生图与多图合成，并带一个设置页控制台管理当前模型、默认档位与画幅、输出目录、API Key 与生成历史。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Google Antigravity bridge with OAuth & dual OpenAI/Anthropic protocol support
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 一键接入 Google Antigravity，OAuth 登录后同时兼容 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 协议，用量无感。

description.en: Adds /btw and /side slash commands that answer ephemeral side questions in an isolated forked sub-session without polluting the main conversation context.
description.zh: 新增 /btw 与 /side 斜杠命令，在隔离的分叉子会话中回答临时旁问，不污染主会话上下文。

description.en: Category tabs (All, Appearance & UI, Usage & account and more) for the Installed list on the Plugins page, remembering the chosen tab; patch plugins named in an editable parent table are indented under the plugin they patch. Display-only, writes no files.
description.zh: 给插件页「已安装」列表加一行分类 Tab（全部 / 界面与外观 / 用量与账户 …），记住选中的分类；在可编辑对照表里登记的补丁插件会缩进挂在它修的插件下面。纯显示层，不写任何文件。

description.en: DSH 插件：向模型暴露 Komari 探针面板工具（列机器、远程执行、上传下载文件），设置页配置面板地址与账号 | DSH plugin exposing Komari monitoring-panel tools (list nodes, remote exec, file transfer) with a settings-page config card
description.zh: 让模型直接操作 Komari 探针面板，查看机器、远程执行命令、传文件，设置页填地址账号即可用。

description.en: Simple notepad plugin for DeepSeek Harness: record short notes in a global ($DSH_HOME) or project (<projectRoot>/.dsh) level
description.zh: 随手记点小笔记，支持全局和项目两级存放，随时翻看不丢。

description.en: A right-sidebar session panel that lists every Skill, MCP tool call and file read or write by turn and step, with per-failure error detail.
description.zh: 右侧边栏的会话面板：按轮次与步骤列出全部 Skill、MCP 工具调用与文件读写，并展开每次失败的报错详情。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: permanently delete a session from the sidebar session menu - stops running work first, refuses forked parents, and clears every local storage surface.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单里一键彻底删除会话，先停掉运行中的任务，并清空所有本地存储痕迹。

description.en: Browser-style tab management for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: batch close, float/dock, reopen closed tabs, and a tab overview panel.
description.zh: 给右侧栏标签加上浏览器式管理：批量关闭、浮窗、恢复已关标签，还有总览页。

description.en: Adds a "Check updates" tab to the Built-in plugins settings: one row per installed bundle, with its latest npm version and an update button. Each row also reports DSH-runtime compatibility. The registry is read through the .npmrc chain (environment, then profile, then user, first hit wins); with nothing configured it races a mirror against the public registry, and a private registry is never raced against a public one. A version is installed from the registry it was read from.
description.zh: 在内置插件设置里新增「检查更新」标签页：每个已安装插件一行，显示 npm 最新版本并提供更新按钮。每行还会报告 DSH 运行时兼容性。注册表按 .npmrc 逐级读取（环境变量 → profile → 用户级，取第一个命中），未配置时并发探测镜像与公共源，内部源不会与公共源竞速。版本从哪个注册表读到，就由它安装。

description.en: dsh 三角色会话架构门禁 + manon 本地图谱组件（bundle：派遣规范门 / scout 常驻 / 地图前置 / 模型钉死 / 提交门 / 领导面限定 / manon 桥接）
description.zh: 给 dsh 会话加上三角色分工和本地知识图谱，省下高级模型的钱，主会话上下文更清爽。

description.en: dsh-plugin dsh deepseek-harness plugin-manager settings
description.zh: 把侧栏插件面板搬进设置里，在设置→插件中统一添加、开关和卸载插件，管理更顺手。

description.en: Ports jcode's auto-poke so an idle agent keeps working while its session still has incomplete todos.
description.zh: 把 jcode 的自动催办搬了过来：会话里还有未完成待办时，空闲的 agent 会被推着继续做。

description.en: Pomodoro timer for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a sidebar page with focus/short-break/long-break cycles plus a countdown pill beside the composer. · DSH Web 番茄钟：侧栏整页（专注/短休息/长休息）+ 输入框旁倒计时胶囊。
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面里加个番茄钟，侧栏管专注和休息，输入框旁还能看倒计时。

description.en: Adds an enhancement chip to the composer input action row, left of the model selector: it rewrites the draft in place using the model already selected in the session, in five styles, with one-click undo and an /enhance slash command.
description.zh: 在输入框动作行的模型选择器左侧加一颗增强芯片：用当前会话已选的模型就地改写草稿，五种风格，可一键撤销，另有 /enhance 斜杠命令。

description.en: Adds a one-click switch to every provider row in Settings - Models: turn a provider off and it leaves the model picker, turn it back on and it returns. It works by wrapping the model catalog call, so it affects the catalog and the picker only, never routing, keys or provider config; existing sessions that already use such a model keep working.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 模型」每个提供商行的「编辑」左边加一个一键开关：关掉哪个提供商，它就从主界面模型选择栏里消失，打开即恢复。做法是包一层模型目录调用，因此只影响目录与选择器，不动路由、密钥与 provider 配置；已经选着该模型的旧会话照常工作。

description.en: Keeps the OpenCode Go free-tier provider in sync with the gateway: reads /v1/models, filters to models the official docs mark Free, and writes the list into the DSH profile. Adds new models, removes delisted ones.
description.zh: 自动同步 OpenCode Go 免费模型清单到 DSH 配置，新增的补上、下架的删掉，省得手动维护。

description.en: Mount the QianYuan MCP server inside DeepSeek Harness: one config-layer bundle brings 15 agent-record tools (pitfalls, cached results, identity, task board) to mcp__qianyuan__*. No runtime code; reads are anonymous, writes are ed25519-signed.
description.zh: 把乾元 MCP 服务器挂进 DeepSeek Harness：一个纯配置层 bundle 带来 15 个 agent 记录工具（坑库、成果缓存、身份、任务板），注册为 mcp__qianyuan__*。不含运行时代码；读匿名，写用 ed25519 签名。

description.en: Connects Qoder CN desktop app models to DeepSeek Harness with zero user interaction: decrypts local OSCrypt credentials, signs requests with the COSY scheme against the CN gateway, and lists 14 models with free-tier badges.
description.zh: 将 Qoder CN 桌面版的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，零用户交互：解密本地 OSCrypt 凭据，以 COSY 签名对接国内网关，14 个模型含免费额度标注。

description.en: dsh插件-即开即走的快捷面板
description.zh: 按 Ctrl+Space 唤出快捷面板，找会话、调技能、跳插件和设置，一步到位。

description.en: Attention gate for DeepSeek Harness: sorts run events into blocked / terminal / progress and alerts only on the first two, holding everything non-blocking during a /focus block and delivering it when the block ends. Alerts flash the taskbar button only - no toast, no sound, no focus steal. Windows only.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的注意力闸门：把运行事件分成「卡住 / 终态 / 中间进展」三级，只对前两级提醒；专注块内的非阻塞事件一律攒着，块结束时一次性交付。提醒只闪任务栏按钮——不弹通知、不出声、不抢焦点。仅 Windows。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: parks every model call until a configured pause window ends, so work pauses on a schedule and resumes by itself.
description.zh: 给模型调用设个暂停时段，到点自动停工、到点自动接着干，帮你避开高价时段。

description.en: Rancher cluster, node, Pod and workload management plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH 里连上多个 Rancher 服务器，轻松查看和管理集群、节点、Pod 与工作负载。

description.en: DSH 扫榜插件：多站小说榜单采集 + 本地变化分析 + 面板；零运行时依赖
description.zh: 定时或手动抓取多个小说站的公开榜单，自动比对排名变化，在一个面板里挑着看。

description.en: Adds a 最近 (Recent) section below the workspace list in the DSH web sidebar that flattens the newest sessions of every workspace into one timeline, reusing the session rows and hover cards the shell already renders, paging in earlier sessions as you scroll, and folding the workspace list itself to the five folders with the newest history. Requires DSH ^0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏的工作区列表下面加一个「最近」区块，把所有工作区的最新会话平铺成一条时间线，行与悬停卡片复用外壳自己渲染的会话行，滚到底继续加载更早的会话；同时把工作区列表本身折叠为最近有记录的 5 个文件夹。需要 DSH ^0.2.0-rc.1。

description.en: Minecraft redstone music: rm_render renders instrument samples from a SoundFont and aligns every onset to within 3 ms, and rm_build compiles a song plus lane table into a datapack of scheduled mcfunction shards (optionally deployed over RCON).
description.zh: Minecraft 红石音乐：rm_render 从 SoundFont 渲染乐器采样并把起音对齐到 3ms 内，rm_build 把谱面与轨表编译成分片 mcfunction 数据包（可选经 RCON 部署开建）。

description.en: Adds a refresh button to the sidebar footer that reloads the plugin list and the page so newly installed plugins take effect without restarting the desktop app.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部添加一个刷新按钮，一键重载插件列表与页面，让新安装的插件无需重启应用即可生效。

description.en: dsh-release-selfcheck · DSH 插件
description.zh: 给 AI Agent 装上发布前自检能力，上线前自动查一遍，少踩坑。

description.en: Reload a plugin or skill you just installed without restarting DSH. reload_plugin clears that plugin's own module cache, unloads the old instance and re-imports it, restoring the previous module if the new code throws; reload_skill forces skill directories to be re-discovered. Ships both as tools and as the /reload-plugin and /reload-skill commands.
description.zh: 不用重启 DSH 就能重载刚装好的插件或技能。reload_plugin 清掉该插件自己的模块缓存、卸载旧实例再重新 import，新代码报错时自动换回旧模块；reload_skill 强制重新发现技能目录。工具与 /reload-plugin、/reload-skill 两个命令都有。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 和 Desktop 远程访问插件：提供 TLS、登录认证、会话保护和 HTTP/WebSocket 透明反代，支持局域网及 FRP ，cloudflare隧道等远程访问。
description.zh: 让 dsh 和 Desktop 支持远程访问，自带 TLS、登录认证和 HTTP/WebSocket 反代，局域网、FRP、Cloudflare 隧道都能用。

description.en: A code review workflow that reviews uncommitted changes, changes against a base branch, a single commit, a GitHub pull request, or a file.
description.zh: 一种代码审查工作流，用于审查未提交的更改、相对于基础分支的更改、单个提交、GitHub Pull Request 或某个文件。

description.en: Markdown preview and rendered side-by-side compare for the changes-review tab.
description.zh: 评审页的 Markdown 预览与渲染态双栏对比。

overlay.name: dsh-market-fixed-dsh-review-md-preview
overlay.description: Install shim generated by dsh-market for dsh-review-md-preview

notes: declared the bundle patch the repository already ships (cordis.patch.yml)

description.en: 让 dsh 可以修改 AI 回答内容 + 显示大纲悬浮栏：回答署名、修订分支、悬浮大纲
description.zh: 让 dsh 能直接修改 AI 的回答内容，还能固定显示大纲侧栏，随时看清回答结构和修订分支。

description.en: RSS/Atom reader with grouped subscriptions and unread/total counts, FreshRSS account sync over the Google Reader API with read/star written back, local image proxy, optional BYOK AI summary/translate/Q&A, podcast audio playback and full-text fetch.
description.zh: RSS/Atom 阅读器——分组订阅与未读/总数双计数、FreshRSS 账号同步（Google Reader API，已读/收藏双向写回）、图片本地代理、自带 Key 的 AI 摘要/翻译/单篇问答、播客音频与全文抓取。

description.en: Search inside the New-Session workspace picker: pinyin initials and full pinyin spelling for Chinese titles, substring matching anywhere for English titles, and separator-insensitive matching.
description.zh: 在「新建会话」的工作区下拉里直接搜索：中文支持拼音首字母与全拼，英文支持任意位置子串与忽略分隔符匹配。

description.en: 先分析、再动手、最后交叉检查——给编码工作加一道第二意见，评审方可以换成你自己的（DeepSeek Harness 插件） · Analyze first, then implement, then cross-check: a second opinion for coding work, with a pluggable reviewer (DeepSeek Harness plugin).
description.zh: 写代码前先分析、写完再交叉复查，还能换成你自己的评审方，让 AI 帮你多把一道关。

description.en: 密钥泄露扫描：密钥被提交进仓库了吗
description.zh: 提交前扫一遍代码，把混进仓库的密钥和敏感信息揪出来，避免泄露。

description.en: Select text in the chat to quote it into the composer as an annotation, or to ask about it in a throwaway side panel that leaves no record.
description.zh: 在对话里划词引用进输入框（显示为「N 条注释」小框），或在侧栏一次性小窗里就这段内容提问（不留任何记录）。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）网页版的划词引用插件：选中任意文本 → 就地写批注 → 变成带编号的引用胶囊落进输入框，原文同时留下高亮与编号。
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页版里划词写批注，自动变成带编号的引用胶囊塞进输入框，原文同步高亮标记。

description.en: Let the agent restart its own DSH host: schedule a self-restart, finish the turn first, then a detached helper stops and relaunches the app and reports back.
description.zh: 让 agent 自己安排重启 DSH 宿主，先说完这轮再原地拉起并回报结果，不用再等用户动手。

description.en: Per-conversation timestamp toggle for the dsh Web composer: each submitted message is followed by a hidden context message carrying the current local time.
description.zh: 在 dsh 聊天框加个时间戳开关，开启后每条消息都悄悄带上发送时间，界面看不到但模型知道。

description.en: SSH server dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and network meters, trend charts, an xterm.js terminal, SFTP file transfer, and server_box_hosts / server_box_exec / server_box_upload / server_box_download chat tools; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a sidebar tab or a standalone drawer.
description.zh: DSH 服务器面板：每台主机展示在线状态、CPU/内存/磁盘/网速与趋势图，点卡片进入 xterm.js 终端并支持 SFTP 上传下载；提供 server_box_hosts、server_box_exec、server_box_upload、server_box_download 对话工具，可导入 ~/.ssh/config，挂载为右侧栏页签或独立抽屉。

description.en: Adds a red "Delete session" row beneath Archive in the sidebar session menu and permanently deletes that one session - its stored logs and its workspace account entry, written through the workspace registry itself. A second click confirms and the row leaves the list immediately; sessions opened this run are disposed from memory first so nothing resurrects them, and a session running work shows one extra warning whose click stops the task before deleting.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话“…”菜单的“归档会话”下方新增红色“删除会话”行，永久删除该会话的日志与工作区账目（走 workspace registry 自己的持久化写）。第二次点击确认后该行立即从列表消失；当次启动使用过的会话会先从内存停用再删（不会复活）；正在跑任务的会话会再显示一次警告，点下去先停止任务再删除。

description.en: DSH plugin: permanent Delete-session action for the session menu (DSH only ships archive)
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话菜单加个「删除会话」按钮，弥补官方只有归档的不足，一键彻底清理。

description.en: Adds Copy session ID and permanent deletion of a Conversation's log, projection cache and workspace references to the session row's ⋯ menu, behind a two-step confirm.
description.zh: 在会话行的「⋯」菜单里补上复制会话 ID，以及永久删除会话（日志、投影缓存与工作区引用），删除前有二次确认。

description.en: Export DeepSeek Harness (dsh) sessions as readable Markdown. Pick individual messages from one session, or merge several into a single .md / split them into a ZIP.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话导出成好读的 Markdown，可挑单条消息，也能合并成一个文件或拆成 ZIP。

description.en: Turns a DSH session into a self-contained interactive HTML mind map of its topics, conclusions, decisions, todos and open questions, and reports what changed since the previous run.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话整理成一张自包含的交互式 HTML 脑图（主题、结论、决策、待办、未决问题），并给出与上一次生成相比的变更。

description.en: Move a session to another folder, permanently delete it, or AI-rename it from the Web UI — by dragging a session row onto a folder title or from the session menu. Moving rewrites the session header cwd, relocates the persisted log and updates workspace accounting so history travels with it; deleting stops running agents and removes the log, projection-cache row and workspace accounting. The same three operations ship as agent tools: workbench_session_move, workbench_session_delete and workbench_session_rename_ai.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中把会话移动到其他文件夹、永久删除，或进行 AI 重命名——支持把会话行拖到文件夹标题上，也可从会话菜单操作。移动会重写会话头的 cwd、迁移持久化日志并更新工作区账目，历史随会话一起走；删除会先停止运行中的 agent，再移除日志、投影缓存行与工作区账目。同样提供三个 agent tools：workbench_session_move、workbench_session_delete、workbench_session_rename_ai。

description.en: Per-session settings infrastructure for DSH: a native right-sidebar settings page plus a host-side store and HTTP bridge other plugins register their options into.
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件提供按会话保存设置的底层能力，右侧栏直接改配置，其他插件也能接入。

description.en: DSH 插件：上下文压力到阈值时，把当前工作交接给一个新会话（文件式交接包 + handoff_now 工具 + HTTP 接口）。
description.zh: 上下文快满时自动把工作交接给新会话，旧会话原样保留，长任务不再卡壳。
给 DSH 补上删除会话的能力，用斜杠命令查看归档会话并彻底删掉，不再只藏不删。

description.en: Delete sessions from the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar straight into a Trash settings page, then restore them or delete them permanently.
description.zh: 把侧边栏里的会话删进设置页的回收站，误删了还能恢复，或彻底清掉。

description.en: Adds a Settings row to the sidebar header before Plugins, which opens the shell's Settings panel.
description.zh: 在侧边栏顶部 Plugins 之前新增「设置」一行，点击即打开原生设置面板。

description.en: Reach DSH from your phone with a single plugin — requires Tailscale on both the host and the phone. No other configuration needed.
description.zh: 只用一个插件就可以手机访问 DSH——需本机与手机都装好并连上 Tailscale，没有额外设置。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: your DeepSeek API balance and the current peak/off-peak billing window, below the message input.
description.zh: 在消息输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额和当前计费时段，帮你随时掌握用量和花费。

description.en: DSH skill authoring toolkit: scaffold + 9-gate quality audit for skills
description.zh: DSH skill 创作流水线：脚手架生成、9 项质量门禁审计、写入自动复检，让 skill 达到可复用标准。

description.en: Skill browser and switchboard for the DSH web GUI: a sidebar entry lists skills from configurable source directories as cards, clicking a card opens the full SKILL.md, and the per-card switch writes disable-model-invocation and registers or removes that skill in the agent skill catalog, so the model can load exactly the skills that are switched on. It also recognises WorkBuddy expert-team folders and shows avatar, tags, quick prompts and members, registering its lead prompt as a skill when switched on. Source directories are editable in the panel.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的技能中心：侧栏入口把可配置来源目录里的技能铺成卡片，点击卡片查看完整 SKILL.md；卡片上的开关会写入 disable-model-invocation，并同步把该技能注册进或移出模型可用的技能表，让「模型能加载的技能」与开关一致。同时识别 WorkBuddy 专家团目录（带 agents 的 .codebuddy-plugin/plugin.json），以头像、描述、标签、快捷提示与团队成员的形式展示，打开开关即把它的 lead 提示词注册为技能（不写这些文件）。卡片还支持在文件管理器中定位、复制路径，来源目录本身也可在面板里编辑。

description.en: Skill-creation console for the Web UI: fetches the official creator skills, hands the requirements to the Huawei Cloud, generic, or REST API creator, then scores the generated skill against a 10-point rubric and returns the itemised deductions to the creator until it reaches 8.5/10.
description.zh: Web 界面上的技能创建面板：拉取官方 creator 技能，把需求交给华为云 / 通用 / REST API 三个 creator 之一执行创建，随后按 10 分制评测产物，未达 8.5 分就把逐项扣分交回 creator 修改直到通过。

description.en: Skill center: browse and manage local Agent Skills, and search, preview and install skills from the ClawHub, ModelScope and QwenPaw marketplaces in one merged view with source and category filters; ships a `skill_hub` tool so the agent can install skills itself.
description.zh: 技能中心：浏览与管理本地 Agent Skills，并在同一视图中搜索、预览、安装 ClawHub、ModelScope、QwenPaw 三个市场的技能，支持来源与分类筛选；同时提供 skill_hub 工具，让 agent 也能自助安装技能。

description.en: 在 DSH 设置面板里管理 agent skill：按项目或来源分组列出，支持启用、禁用、定位、预览与删除
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板里统一管理 agent skill，按项目或来源分组，随手启用、禁用、定位、预览和删除。

description.en: DSH plugin: keeps a local skills-repo mirror up to date (periodic git pull + /skills-sync)
description.zh: 定时自动拉取更新本地技能仓库镜像，也能用 /skills-sync 命令手动同步，让技能库始终保持最新。

description.en: 2005-era instant-messenger skin for the DeepSeek Harness client: right-angle 1px window chrome, a blue-gradient title bar, SimSun for the Chinese UI, a buddy-group sidebar with an avatar card and editable signature, per-message name/time headers, and three switchable intensities. All artwork is original SVG; the reskinned toolbar also carries a cross-session notepad, a running-session panel, and an 8-ball game, minesweeper, a token garden and heads-up poker that a built-in focus mode silences.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 客户端的 2005 年代即时通讯皮肤：直角 1px 窗框、蓝色渐变标题条、中文界面统一宋体、好友分组式侧栏（含头像档案卡与可编辑签名）、每条消息带名字与时间抬头，皮肤档位三档可实时切换。美术全部为原创 SVG；重绘后的工具条另带跨会话备注框、后台任务面板，以及美式八球、扫雷、Token 农场和德州扑克——插件内置的专注模式会把它们静音。

description.en: DSH 侧边栏【软件工具】管理器:勾选本机 WSL/Windows 软件工具并注入模型系统提示,随插件自带 add-software-tool 技能。Sidebar software-tools manager for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 在侧边栏管理本机 WSL/Windows 软件工具，勾选后注入系统提示，让模型直接调用。

description.en: Per-task disk-space ledger in the sidebar with opt-in reclamation of unowned junk; session logs are never trimmed.
description.zh: 侧栏里的每个任务磁盘占用账本，可勾选回收无主垃圾；会话日志绝不被裁剪。

description.en: DSH plugin bundle for safe SSH operations with an embedded Skill and MCP runtime
description.zh: 让 DSH 通过系统 OpenSSH 安全操作 WSL 和远端 Linux 主机，内置 23 个 MCP 工具与操作指引。

description.en: Encrypted SSH host vault for the DeepSeek Harness: the agent works with host aliases, while the address, port, account, and password stay in an AES-256-GCM vault whose key is wrapped by Windows DPAPI.
description.zh: 把 SSH 主机的地址、端口、账号密码加密存进保险库，AI 只用别名就能连服务器，不怕泄露。

description.en: Five task-state reminders for DeepSeek Harness (completion, approval, question, block, error) with four synthesized browser sound presets, system notifications that open the right session, and a terminal-BEL fallback when no browser is ready.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供五类任务状态提醒（完成、审批、提问、受阻、出错）：四种浏览器合成音方案、可点击回到会话的系统通知，没有就绪浏览器时降级为终端 BEL。

description.en: Multi-agent A-share research pipeline skill for DeepSeek Harness (6 roles, dual-blind risk review, source-cited reports, PII gate)
description.zh: 6个AI角色分工协作做A股研究，双向盲审加逐数核对，产出带来源引用的研报。

description.en: Task workspace convention: one folder per session, one PROGRESS.md per task overwritten on each update, and per-task git once the task runs long.
description.zh: 任务工作区约定：一个会话只用一个文件夹，一个任务一个 PROGRESS.md（每次修改整体覆盖更新），任务过长就在任务目录里建 git 仓库。

description.en: Alpha Agent Teams plugin for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and newer that lets same-session user Steer end the Lead’s current wait_agent call while teammates continue, with native message delivery and Node PTC continuation.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 起版本的 Agent Teams 预览插件，让同会话用户 Steer 结束主代理当前的 wait_agent 等待，队友继续工作，并保留原生消息领取与 Node PTC 后续执行。

description.en: Reports each machine's token usage to a team server you host, with one-time enrollment codes, an offline disk queue, and idempotent replay, so an administrator can see every member's usage and cost in one place.
description.zh: 把每台机器的 token 用量上报给你自己托管的团队服务器：一次性绑定码、离线落盘队列、幂等重放，管理员在一处看到全员用量与成本。

description.en: Injects the exact current local time and the timestamp, day relation and recency gap of the previous user message into every prompt, and adds a /time command that prints the injected block.
description.zh: 为每次请求注入精确的本地当前时间，以及上一条用户消息的时间、日期关系与间隔；并提供 /time 命令查看注入内容。

description.en: Cross-session token-usage ledger for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): every billed model call becomes one row in a local per-day JSONL ledger, aggregated with costs and shown in a sidebar overlay.
description.zh: 把每次模型调用的 token 用量记成本地账本，按天汇总花费，侧边栏随时看账。

description.en: Live token usage and estimated cost in the sidebar: the current task plus every session combined, an as-of clock for those totals, per-session time detail (elapsed, turns/steps, first-token, model vs tool time, decode speed), and a per-turn breakdown with each turn cost on hover.
description.zh: 侧栏里实时显示 token 用量与估算费用：当前任务与全部会话合计、这份账目的截至时刻、逐会话时间明细（运行时长/轮步/首token/模型与工具耗时/解码速度），鼠标悬停某个对话还能看到逐轮用量与每轮费用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 用量看板：账户余额、Token 使用量与三档成本拆分，含整年热力图与分组趋势曲线。Fork of lyk308/dsh-token-dashboard with dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 fixes.
description.zh: 一个页面看清 DeepSeek 账户余额、Token 用量和花费，按天、模型、工作区分组，还有全年热力图。

description.en: Connects Trae CN desktop app models to DeepSeek Harness with no OAuth flow: reuses the desktop sign-in, exposes 17 models (including deepseek-v4.1-flash) with consumption-rate badges and reasoning-effort mapping.
description.zh: 将 Trae CN 桌面版的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需单独 OAuth：复用桌面端登录，17 个模型（含 deepseek-v4.1-flash）带倍率标注与思考强度映射。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）右栏划词翻译插件：在文件树 / 文档预览 / 侧栏浏览器里选中文本即弹卡片。三条引擎（微软 / Google / 模型），默认微软，模型跟随当前对话；源语言与目标语言各是一个可手动选择的下拉。
description.zh: 在文件树、文档预览和侧栏浏览器里划词即弹卡片翻译，微软、Google、模型三引擎随意切换。

description.en: AI tabletop RPG plugin for DeepSeek Harness - GM snark / dice / bribery intel / scenario-adaptive
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个会说人话的 AI 跑团 GM，掷骰、吐槽、剧情随你变。

description.en: English-only fork of dsh-TUI — Claude Code-style terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness

description.zh: 在侧边栏头像下方实时显示 Codex、Gemini、OpenRouter 等各家 AI 服务的额度与余额，随时掌握用量。

description.en: 把一支视频复制成 N 份，每份在容器层写入唯一 GUID，使文件哈希互异而媒体流与解码帧逐字节不变；附 guid→文件→标签 溯源账本、CLI 与 DSH Web 面板。
description.zh: 把一支视频复制成多份，每份写入唯一 GUID 让哈希各不相同，画面内容却完全不变，还能溯源查账。

description.en: Vietnamese UI language for the DSH web client (all 2,615 core strings), three Vietnamese palettes in light and dark, and a rotating Vietnam-landscape backdrop from Wikimedia Commons with per-photo attribution.
description.zh: DSH 网页客户端的越南语界面（全部 2,615 条核心文案）、浅色与深色各三套越南风配色，以及来自 Wikimedia Commons 的越南风景轮播背景（逐张标注作者与许可）。

description.en: Web design for DeepSeek Harness: preview and edit HTML elements in the Sidebar
description.zh: 在侧边栏里直接预览和编辑网页的 HTML 元素，改样式调结构不用来回切窗口。

description.en: System monitor overlay for DeepSeek Harness: a corner pill showing live CPU and memory, expanding into disk activity and throughput, per-volume capacity, network state, uptime and battery. Windows collector.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 角落显示实时 CPU 和内存，点开还能看磁盘、网络、电量和开机时长。

description.en: Replaces the shipped sidebar workspace browser with Recents, a project editor that adds extra source folders, and pin, rename, fork, and archive row actions.
description.zh: 替换出厂侧边栏工作区浏览器，补上最近会话、可添加额外源文件夹的项目编辑器，以及置顶、重命名、派生和归档行操作。

description.en: Independent workspace last-used ordering for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar (experimental)
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的工作区文件夹单独排序，按最近使用顺序排列，互不干扰。

description.en: Reuses the local model proxy of a logged-in XiaoyiWork desktop app (Windows only) so its models appear in DeepSeek Harness without a separate API key.
description.zh: 复用已登录的小艺Work 桌面端本地模型代理（仅限 Windows），其模型直接出现在 DeepSeek Harness 中，无需单独 API Key。

description.en: Persistent long-term memory for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh), powered by HydraDB.
description.zh: 给 dsh 加上跨会话的长期记忆，随时想起之前聊过的内容。

description.en: Provide a LeLogin skill for credential injection and authenticated business applications without exposing plaintext secrets.
description.zh: 提供 LeLogin 技能，用于凭据注入和已登录业务系统调用，避免向模型暴露明文秘密。

description.en: Inspect conversation context and apply configurable compaction with usage history.
description.zh: 查看会话上下文、用量记录，并按设置执行压缩。

description.en: Four assistant output layouts with full reasoning, independent tool details, and frame-synchronized or fading text.
description.zh: 提供四种助手输出布局、完整思考展示，以及刷新率同步或新增文字淡入效果。

description.en: Adds a thinking-depth slider mapped to declared model levels, configuration guidance, and optional inline model settings.
description.zh: 按模型声明的能力提供思考深度滑块、配置指引与可选模型行设置。

description.en: Local session and Token statistics with daily and hourly activity charts for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 汇总本地会话的 Token 用量、每日与小时活动，以及模型、工具和技能使用情况。

description.en: Persists scoped user corrections and method candidates for DSH with bounded recall and restart-safe completion settlement.
description.zh: 为 DSH 持久保存分作用域的用户纠错与方法候选，提供限额召回和可跨重启恢复的完成结算。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Netx Ops agent preset (UME alarms, NE, managed CLI)
description.zh: 把 UME 告警、网元和受管命令行接进 DeepSeek Harness，让 AI 助手直接查网络、跑运维操作。

description.en: Eyes for text-only models: mounts the bundled stdio MCP server as mcp__opencode_eyes__describe_image, which sends an image file to StepFun step-3.7-flash and returns a detailed description.
description.zh: 给不具备多模态能力的模型一双眼睛:把随插件分发的 stdio MCP 服务器挂成 mcp__opencode_eyes__describe_image,把图片交给 StepFun step-3.7-flash 并返回详细描述。

description.en: Vision through NVIDIA NIM: mounts the bundled stdio MCP server as mcp__opencode_eyes_nvidia__describe_image, which describes an image with any of seven hosted vision models (MiniMax-M3 by default) and rotates several API keys.
description.zh: 走 NVIDIA NIM 的视觉能力:把随插件分发的 stdio MCP 服务器挂成 mcp__opencode_eyes_nvidia__describe_image,用 7 个托管视觉模型之一(默认 MiniMax-M3)描述图片,并支持多 Key 轮换。

description.en: Local OCR with nothing sent to a cloud: mounts the PP-OCRv6 Medium stdio MCP server (PaddleOCR on ONNX Runtime, CPU) as mcp__ppocr__ocr_image and mcp__ppocr__ocr_pdf for images and multi-page PDFs.
description.zh: 本地 OCR,不把文件发到云端:把 PP-OCRv6 Medium stdio MCP 服务器(PaddleOCR + ONNX Runtime CPU)挂成 mcp__ppocr__ocr_image 与 mcp__ppocr__ocr_pdf,识别图片和多页 PDF。

description.en: 把 SillyTavern 的聊天补全预设原样搬进 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）：读 ST 预设 JSON，按 📌 分区列出条目、🔀 多选一互斥、逐条开关与正文就地编辑；导入/删除/改名都在面板里完成，状态按会话（窗口）隔离；注入发生在系统提示词组装期，工具调用轮同样带着预设。无需 install_bundle，一行 patch 即可插拔。
description.zh: 把 SillyTavern 的聊天补全预设原样搬进 DSH，分区管理、逐条开关、就地编辑，按会话隔离，一行 patch 即插即用。

description.en: Quick Notes: a Cordis plugin for ACRYL and DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 顶栏点开小本子就能随手记笔记，每条自动存成独立 txt 文件，方便随时翻看。

description.en: Makes small text in a screenshot readable before a model reads it: crop a region, magnify it with a chosen kernel, hand back a new image. DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin + standalone CLI.
description.zh: 截图里的小字看不清？先裁出这块再放大，模型就能读懂了。

description.en: Sidebar tab listing running and completed-unread sessions across projects, with click-to-switch and grouping.
description.zh: 在侧边栏集中查看跨项目的进行中与未读会话，点一下就能切换过去。
在会话里直接查国内期货 CTP 账户状态和资金持仓，不用切窗口。
把你自己写好的重建包原样注入成动态上下文快照，让 AI 助手始终带着这份设定对话。

description.en: Floating overlay that surfaces pending approvals, plan reviews and user questions from any session, with click-through to the session.
description.zh: 任何会话有待审批、计划评审或提问时，自动弹出悬浮窗提醒，点一下就能跳到对应会话。

description.en: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DSH Web UI, adapted to DSH v0.2.x and desktop v0.22.3+: the header, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view become frosted glass panes over a live WebGL fluid board or an image/video wallpaper, with mica and compatibility layouts, adjustable blur, frost, hue and brightness, marine decorations (particle whale, fish, mesh, cursor glow), a one-click reset-to-defaults button, and a master switch whose off state restores the stock UI exactly; adapted from WYH66666666's original (0.1.x) and du-u-uck's 0.1.1-rc.2 port.
description.zh: Aqua 玻璃质感主题（适配 DSH v0.2.x 与桌面端 v0.22.3+）：顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行与轨迹视图悬浮在 WebGL 流体板或图片/视频壁纸上的磨砂玻璃片，云母/兼容双布局，模糊、磨砂、色调、亮度可调，海洋装饰（粒子鲸鱼、小鱼、网状交互、鼠标辉光），一键恢复默认，总开关关闭即完全还原原生界面；承 WYH66666666 原作（0.1.x）与 du-u-uck 的 0.1.1-rc.2 适配。

description.en: Archived-session management with single and batch deletion, native workspace registry cleanup, and deferred file cleanup while the host holds session resources.
description.zh: 归档会话管理，支持单条与批量删除、原生工作区登记同步，以及宿主持有会话资源时的延迟文件清理。

description.en: DSH 侧栏余额栏：自动显示官方账号余额，点击在 DSH 内查询用量
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏常驻显示官方账号余额，点一下就能查用量，不用再跳出去看。

description.en: Replaces the built-in bash executor so every command gets an environment resolved from its own working directory: configurable PATH prepends, Python venv activation and mise shims, with a dedicated section in the Web UI settings.
description.zh: 替换内置 bash 执行器，按每条命令的工作目录解析环境：可配置的 PATH 追加、Python venv 自动激活与 mise shims，并在 Web UI 设置中提供独立分区。

description.en: Windows settings switch that replaces PowerShell with Git Bash across the four built-in presets, including a persistent terminal in minimal mode.
description.zh: Windows 上的一键 Git Bash 开关，替换四种内置模式的 PowerShell，极简模式保留持久终端。

description.en: DSH 个性化插件：自定义背景 + 半透明玻璃 + 主题色
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上自定义背景和半透明玻璃效果，还能调主题色，界面随你好看。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操作浏览器与电脑：以插件形式装配 playwright-mcp 与 peekaboo-mcp，附一键依赖安装、macOS 系统权限引导与 MCP 连接自检。
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接操控浏览器和电脑，一键装好依赖，自动搞定权限和连接检查。

description.en: See what ate your prompt cache. Hit-rate & tool-block cost report for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) — zero deps, registers no tools.
description.zh: 看看是谁吃掉了你的提示缓存：统计命中率和工具块开销，零依赖、不注册任何工具。

description.en: 东南大学校园主题插件：校园配色、九龙湖与四牌楼风景、可选叮东，适配 DSH Web。
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 换上东南大学校园皮肤，九龙湖、四牌楼风景配色随心切换，还能叫上叮东。

description.en: 在 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）右侧边栏里下国际象棋：完整规则、八档内置对手、lichess 云端评估 / 复盘 / 战术题，中英双语。· A chess tab for DeepSeek Harness: full rules, built-in opponent, lichess eval, review and puzzles.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏直接下国际象棋，规则完整、八档电脑对手，还能用 lichess 评估复盘和做题。

description.en: deepseek harness 插件，兼容claude的skill、rules加载规则，mcp配置
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接复用你现有的 Claude Code 技能、规则和 MCP 配置，不用重新折腾。

description.en: Bayern Munich skin for the dsh web GUI: home-red/away-white canvases, real match-photo backdrops for 19 first-team players plus drawn shirt, squad-wall, Allianz-Arena and plain backdrops, switchable player and accent colour.
description.zh: 拜仁慕尼黑主题的 dsh Web 皮肤：主场红/客场白双配色画布，19 名一线队球员的真实赛场照背景，外加球员球衣、阵容号码墙、安联球场、纯色四种程序绘制背景，可切换球员与强调色。

description.en: 日志留存合规：检查日志是否开启、是否记了该记的、是否留够法定 6 个月。
description.zh: 检查日志有没有开、该记的记没记、够不够法定6个月，帮你把日志留存合规一次看清。

description.en: 等保对照：按 GB/T 22239-2019 找出代码与配置里可静态发现的等保项。
description.zh: 按 GB/T 22239-2019 等保标准，静态扫描代码和配置，帮你找出可发现的等保合规项。

description.en: ChatGPT subscription / GPT provider for DeepSeek Harness desktop: image input, host tools and DeepSeek/GPT switching. Harness 桌面版 ChatGPT 订阅适配器，支持图片、工具调用和模型切换。Community MIT plugin.
description.zh: 把 ChatGPT 订阅接进 Harness 桌面版，支持图片输入、工具调用，还能在 DeepSeek 和 GPT 之间随时切换。

description.en: Standalone remote Web UI for DeepSeek Harness with mobile viewport, soft-keyboard and touch-target adaptations while leaving the native Desktop presentation unchanged.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 独立远程 Web UI：适配手机视口、软键盘与触控热区，同时保持原生桌面端界面不变。

description.en: Codex-style window-swap compaction engine: deterministic pointer-template summaries with zero LLM calls, replacing the default LLM-summary compaction.
description.zh: 用纯模板指针做上下文压缩，不调用大模型，换窗更快更省成本。

description.en: Native macOS completion notifications and user approval alerts with Settings UI for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生任务完成通知与审批提醒插件，集成设置面板。

description.en: Ports the Codex CLI TokenBudget mechanism to dsh: remaining-context awareness, archive rollover, and notes/history retrieval tools for past sessions.
description.zh: 把 Codex 的上下文预算机制搬进 DSH，实时显示剩余 token，超限自动归档，还能翻查历史会话笔记。

description.en: DSH 上下文守卫：工具输出按内容类型压缩 + 可逆取回（CCR）+ 高保真历史摘要
description.zh: 自动压缩过长的工具输出和历史记录，需要时还能原样取回，让模型不再被上下文淹没。

description.en: Harness-owned lifecycle for the dario proxy — starts it with your harness, readiness-gates it, and stops it when the harness stops, so subscription-backed (Claude/ChatGPT) model routes just work.
description.zh: 随 DSH 启动并管理 dario 代理（把 Claude/ChatGPT 订阅当 API 用），就绪门控、随停随止，订阅模型路由开箱即用。

description.en: Named database connections for DeepSeek Harness - configure MySQL in a settings page, then refer to them by name in chat. Read-only by default, writes opt-in per connection.
description.zh: 在设置页配好 MySQL 连接并起个名字，聊天里直接喊名字就能查库，默认只读、按需开启写入。

description.en: DSH plugin: DeepSeek-official cost accounting (session total + current turn) added to the built-in Token usage panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内置 Token 统计旁显示本次会话和当前轮次的 DeepSeek 花费，随时看清花了多少钱。

description.en: Windows-only plugin that shows permission requests, waiting questions, task errors and finished turns as native card windows, and can allow a permission request straight from the card.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows：把审批请求、待回答的提问、任务出错和轮次完成显示为原生卡片窗口，审批请求可直接在卡片上放行。

description.en: Window-local shortcut guide for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: hold-to-open overlay, keycap search, temporary pinning, light/dark themes, and bilingual UI.
description.zh: 长按快捷键就能唤出窗口内的快捷键速览浮层，支持搜索、临时固定和亮暗主题，中英双语。

description.en: dsh-email gives a DSH agent working access to a mailbox: the email tool reads and sends the user's mail over standard IMAP/SMTP, so the agent can check and answer it with only a password or app-specific password.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体通过 IMAP/SMTP 收发邮件，只需密码或应用专用密码就能帮你查看和回复邮箱。

description.en: Live English-to-Chinese translation of model output in the web UI - translation above, original kept aside - with an optional local MT engine and LLM fallback.
description.zh: 把 DSH 网页会话里模型输出的英文自动译成中文，译文在上原文在旁，还能翻思考块。

description.en: An exec extension for headless dsh runner allowing more flags etc.

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: configured extra writable roots for the fs tools and the sandboxed shell — first-try writes with no approval, plus a Web settings page and structure-anchored path patterns.
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接写入配置好的外部路径，不用每次审批，写文件和跑命令都管用。

description.en: Global memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one persistent cross-session requirement injected into every session's system prompt. Ships a settings-page panel, a global_memory agent tool, and a same-origin HTTP API.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一条全局记忆，跨会话常驻注入每个会话，让每次任务都自动遵守同一要求。

description.en: Connects dsh to the GreatArrow.ai MCP server over Streamable HTTP, so the agent can search and save workspace memories, tasks and decisions shared with your other AI clients; a config-only bundle that reads the token from great-arrow.token in the dsh home, never from the environment.
description.zh: 通过 Streamable HTTP 将 dsh 连接到 GreatArrow.ai MCP 服务器，让智能体检索和保存与你其他 AI 客户端共享的工作区记忆、任务与决策；纯配置包，从 dsh 主目录的 great-arrow.token 读取令牌，从不读取环境变量。
把 GSD Core 的规范驱动开发流程（讨论→计划→执行→验证→发布）接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 AI 助手按规范一步步推进项目。

description.en: Bridges a guild expert-team board into dsh: routes guild tasks to one-shot dsh subagents, visible in the GUI.
description.zh: 把 guild 专家团的任务自动派给 DSH 一次性子代理执行，专家在界面里看得见。

description.en: Session hygiene suite: strips leaked thinking tags, adds retry cooldown budgets, blocks plaintext credentials before execution, runs a daily health-check loop with a health panel, and auto-tunes agent instruction hints from error statistics.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话做体检：过滤思考标签泄露、管住重试次数、拦截明文密钥，还能每天自动巡检并出健康面板。

description.en: dsh-icon-switch: in-app icon switcher for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在设置页就能换掉应用、托盘和任务栏图标，传张图自动生成整套图标。

description.en: Advanced model-context injection and request-only rewriting for DeepSeek Harness with native Keysmith rules compatibility.
description.zh: 在模型请求前按角色替换消息关键词或正则，还能按会话切换多套上下文预设、插入构造回合。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 滑动变祖器/前端插件：把模型/推理等级控件换成一台滑动变阻器（31 档，档位图铺背景后 5 秒淡出）
description.zh: 把模型和推理等级选择换成物理课本里的滑动变阻器，拖滑片就能同时切换，停手5秒档位图自动淡出。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: inject a body-level extra_headers entry into OpenAI-compatible chat/completions requests for listed providers and upstream hosts (the only injection point that survives a LiteLLM relay).
description.zh: 把 extra_headers 写进请求 body，绕过 LiteLLM 等代理丢头问题，只对指定 provider 和上游生效。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness: ds-llm-manage.  模型管理（收藏、置顶、探活），熟练度排序，故障自动切换，防止长任务中途中断
description.zh: 给模型做收藏置顶和探活，按熟练度排序，故障自动切换，长任务不再中途断掉。
给 DeepSeek Harness 换上日语界面，让日语用户也能顺手用起来。

description.en: macOS desktop notifications for dsh events, delivered over SSH to a small notifier HTTP listener running on the Mac.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的任务完成、会话暂停等事件通过 SSH 推到 Mac 上弹出通知，随时掌握进度。

description.en: DSH 插件：STM32 / PY32 调试与烧录（CMSIS-DAP / DAPLink / openocd）+ 串口收发。内置独立 openocd 副本，不碰你的 IDE 树。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接给 STM32 / PY32 烧录调试，还能收发串口，自带 openocd 不干扰你的 IDE。
在聊天里直接生成图片和视频，随手就能创作多媒体内容。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 本地用量桌宠：逐轮 token 用量气泡 + 按天养成的 Q 版战地医护，含本机统计、每日任务、勋章、久坐/喝水提醒与四套换装主题。不联网、不读凭据。
description.zh: 页面角落养一只Q版战地医护，逐轮播报token用量，还能做每日任务、攒勋章、提醒喝水久坐。

description.en: DSH 四层自动记忆系统：会话开始自动读取记忆、长任务目标锚定防遗忘、每轮结束自动沉淀、跨工作区审计。纯 Markdown、零依赖、可审计。
description.zh: 给每个工作区的 AI 装上四层自动记忆，会话自动读、任务防跑偏、结束自动记，纯 Markdown 可审计。

description.en: Mobile push when a DSH task goes idle, over 10 channels: ntfy, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu, ServerChan, PushPlus, Telegram, Qmsg and generic webhooks. The message carries the session, workspace, elapsed time, turn number and a reply excerpt, and it runs host-side rather than in the browser page.
description.zh: DSH 任务停下来时把通知推送到手机，支持 10 个渠道：ntfy、Bark、钉钉、企业微信、飞书、Server酱、PushPlus、Telegram、Qmsg 与通用 webhook；消息里带会话、目录、耗时、回合号与回复摘要，运行在 Host 侧而不是浏览器页面里。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的模型fallback链插件：以更智能、更人性化的方式配置fallback链。当主模型撞限流、额度耗尽，或者5xx超时的时候自动向下改派模型，回合不中断。设置页可视化编排：拖拽排序、按计费或者上下文窗口排序候选模型、失败模型自动冷却、管理多条链的停用和启用。零依赖、无构建步骤、默认不介入任何请求。
description.zh: 主模型限流、超时或额度用完时，自动按顺序切换到备用模型，任务不中断。

description.en: Vendor marks in the DeepSeek Harness model picker: the provider's own model catalog and logos mirrored to a loopback route, painted with a CSS mask in the composer menu, the model button and the /model popup.
description.zh: 在模型选择器里给每个模型配上厂商图标，一眼就能认出是哪家的模型。

description.en: Per-model input type and thinking level declarations on the 模型 settings page — 输入类型 checkboxes on every provider card, and a 思考等级 field in the provider 编辑 dialog. Writes the official pi-ai input and reasoningEfforts fields.
description.zh: 在「模型」设置页面按模型声明输入类型与思考等级——每个渠道卡片上的「输入类型」勾选框，以及渠道「编辑」对话框里的「思考等级」。写入 pi-ai 官方的 input 与 reasoningEfforts 字段。

description.en: 模型菜单整理器：按厂商折叠、悬浮滑出模型面板，支持置顶、最近、厂商内搜索、别名与隐藏。纯客户端插件（DSH / DeepSeek Harness）
description.zh: 把 DSH 模型菜单按厂商折叠整理，支持置顶、最近、搜索、别名和隐藏，找模型不再翻长列表。

description.en: 控制dsh会话界面显示的模型
description.zh: 在设置页一键开关 DSH 里的模型，关掉的模型会从所有选择器里消失，界面更清爽。

description.en: DSH 服务器流量监测插件：宿主半边采样 /proc/net/dev，浏览器半边在输入框下方显示实时上下行速率。
description.zh: 在输入框下方常驻显示服务器实时上下行网速，鼠标悬停还能看累计流量和采样情况。

description.en: Notes workspace in the right sidebar: a notes tree beside a live-preview Markdown editor with tabs, split panes, outline and trash, over plain .md files plus a thin per-workspace index that agents organize through one `knowledge` tool.
description.zh: 右侧栏的笔记工作区：笔记树 + 实时预览的 Markdown 编辑器（标签 / 分屏 / 大纲 / 回收站），笔记是普通 .md 文件，索引是按工作区的薄映射，Agent 侧只用一个 `knowledge` 工具整理。

description.en: OpenCode Go and Zen live model discovery, pricing and session routing for DeepSeek Harness

description.zh: 把没发出去的会话草稿存到侧边栏，随时改、随时发，还能一键删掉不要的会话。

description.en: dsh plugin that syncs pi.dev model listings into the pi-ai catalog and llm-pi-ai settings — new provider models become selectable without hand-editing node_modules.
description.zh: 自动把 pi.dev 的新模型同步进 pi-ai 目录和设置，不用再手动改 node_modules 就能直接选用。

description.zh: 上下文用到一半就自动压缩，让 DSH 会话不再爆窗口，长聊更省心。

description.en: Cell-aware Jupyter notebook tools for DSH agents
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体按单元格读写 Jupyter 笔记本，改代码、跑分析都更顺手。

description.zh: 把 QQ 官方机器人接进 DSH，在群里 @ 它或私聊发消息，就能直接和你的 DSH 会话对话。

description.en: Discover and verify DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins from GitHub topic:dsh-plugin — trust score, official peer compatibility, one-click install via the official installer

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会话费用估算、账号余额与额度监控插件
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时显示当前会话花了多少钱，点开还能看用量、余额和近期累计。

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里直接查看和编辑 Excel/SpreadJS 表格文件，改完即存。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会话自动命名插件：类别 emoji + 对象｜目标
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 会话自动起名，用类别 emoji 加对象和目标，侧边栏一眼看清在忙什么。

description.en: 余额水桶：水位就是你的 DeepSeek API 余额，出水口流出的是正在花的钱。A bucket that drains while your DeepSeek API balance is being spent (DeepSeek Harness plugin).
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek API 余额做成一个会漏水的小水桶，钱一花水位就降，随时看得见还剩多少。

description.en: DSH agent preset: 七阶段工作流常驻骨架 + 按需技能通道 + 可自我进化的规则账本（无总长上限，单条硬约束 ≤60）
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体装上七阶段工作流骨架，细节按需调技能，踩过的坑自动攒成规则账本。

description.en: DSH plugin: keep session projection values (titles) alive across a Host generation reset, so the session list never falls back to the untitled placeholder.
description.zh: 让会话标题在宿主重置后依然保留，会话列表不再变成无标题占位。

description.en: Smart prompt optimization & dynamic thinking effort adaptation with composer capsule, DSH/custom models, undo/re-optimize, and native settings.

description.en: DSH 提示词工作台：优化与多轮迭代 | Prompt Studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH 左栏优化提示词、多轮迭代、多模型对比测试，还能存模板看历史。

description.en: Collapsible provider groups and prominent provider headings for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) model selection menu.

description.zh: 让 DSH 自动跟随本机代理，开关代理不用重启，还能用 proxy_fetch 抓取墙外网页

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: supervise a workbuddy2api gateway and register its models as an editable LLM provider. Self-hosted, no upstream wrapping.

description.en: Compaction backend that replaces the default compaction-basic: it summarizes the conversation with a configurable pool of low-cost models, sizes each chunk to the chosen model's context window, and merges all digests in one call, with per-route cooldown and session-model fallback.
description.zh: 压缩后端，替代默认的 compaction-basic：用可配置的低成本模型池压缩对话内容，按所选模型的上下文窗口切块，并将所有摘要一次归并，支持逐路由冷却与会话模型兜底。

description.en: DSH plugin: DeepSeek account balance and per-Session spend in the composer dock
description.zh: 在输入框下方常驻显示 DeepSeek 账号余额和本次会话花了多少，随时心里有数。

description.en: Deepseek harness UI风格 from workbuddy
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换一套久看不累的界面皮肤，纯 CSS 实现，不改布局、零依赖。

description.en: A read-only Cordis Inspect provider that lets an agent see the interface it is driving: outline() reports which UI regions the running shell actually rendered, with occupancy, geometry and current or past failure state; snapshot() returns one region's rendered node tree (tag, role, aria-label, own text, geometry, computed styles) addressed by slot key or CSS selector; failures() keeps a history of regions that failed to render and whether they recovered. Regions are addressed by the anchor the shell already writes for every slot, so it needs no region list and covers regions added later or contributed by other plugins. No UI, no tools, no dependencies, no network access.
description.zh: 只读的 Cordis Inspect provider，让 agent 能看见自己正在驱动的界面：outline() 报告运行中的壳实际渲染了哪些 UI 区域，含占用、几何与当前/历史失败状态；snapshot() 按 slot key 或 CSS 选择器返回某区域的渲染节点树（标签、角色、aria-label、自身文本、几何、计算样式）；failures() 保留「哪些区域渲染失败过、是否已恢复」的历史。寻址用壳为每个 slot 已写好的锚点，无需区域清单，也覆盖以后新增或其他插件贡献的区域。无界面、无工具、无依赖、不发网络请求。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: rewrite assistant replies in the persisted session log in place, so later turns read your version. DSH 插件：就地改写会话落盘记录里的助手回复，后续轮次读到的是改写后的版本。也支持伪造伪造回复，刷新就变回去，不影响流程。

description.en: Diagnostic plugin: wraps global fetch to log requests and capture bodies whose URL matches a configurable substring to disk.

description.zh: 粘贴岗位 JD，AI 就按这个岗位帮你重写简历，只改真实经历，绝不瞎编。

description.en: Visual frontend revision workbench: point at a real page element, describe the change, send it into the current DSH session, then review fixed-viewport before/after screenshots (1280x800 and 390x844) beside a captured source diff, accepting each revision item by item. Revision records are kept per session under .dsh-revise/ and export as a single portable HTML report.

description.zh: 在每次请求末尾注入一行时距读数，让模型知道自己距上次对话、上次自省和今日已醒过了多久。

description.en: DSH 思考强度滑块：把「推理等级」变成一条会呼吸、会飞光点、拉满还会流彩的科幻滑块
